FILE: supabase/migrations/20260508060000_v07_hittrax_capture_pipeline.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — task #118: HitTrax capture pipeline schema
-- =============================================================================
-- Adds the four foundation tables for swing-data ingest:
--
--   public.sessions             one cage session = a contiguous batch of swings
--   public.swings               one swing recorded by a capture system
--   public.personal_bests       canonical PR per (kid, metric)
--   public.kid_capture_links    one link per (kid, capture_source) — tracks
--                               the HitTrax association lifecycle and the
--                               per-link polling cursor
--
-- Plus a trigger that detects PRs on swing insert, writes/updates
-- personal_bests, sets swings.is_personal_best, and inserts a
-- points_ledger row (+15, reason='pr_hit', reference_type='swing').
--
-- Conventions carried from v0.1–v0.6:
--   * Tenant pin on every write/select policy via JWT tenant_id claim.
--   * App-level role checks read auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role' (NOT 'role').
--   * Per-table GRANTs match RLS scope. RLS narrows rows; GRANTs gate the verb.
--   * Reuses public.set_updated_at().
--   * SECURITY DEFINER functions ALTER OWNER TO postgres so they bypass RLS
--     on the rows they mutate; ownership/tenant pinning is re-asserted in
--     plpgsql before any write.
--
-- Idempotency is the entire architectural backbone: every swing carries a
-- UNIQUE (capture_source, capture_event_id), every session a
-- UNIQUE (capture_source, capture_session_id), and the PR ledger insert
-- is guarded by a partial unique index on (reference_id) where
-- reason='pr_hit' AND reference_type='swing'. Replays are no-ops by
-- construction — the polling worker never has to remember what it sent.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Tables
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- sessions ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A "session" is a contiguous batch of swings. For HitTrax this comes from the
-- terminal grouping; for manual entry it can be a coach-tagged block. We store
-- per-session aggregates so the Sessions list (task #119) can render without
-- re-aggregating swings on every read.
CREATE TABLE public.sessions (
  id                       uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id                uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id                   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  capture_source           text        NOT NULL CHECK (capture_source IN ('hittrax', 'rapsodo', 'manual', 'none')),
  -- HitTrax (or future capture) session identifier. NULL for manual sessions.
  capture_session_id       text,
  -- HitTrax FacilityID (or equivalent). Stored for ops debugging + future
  -- "which cage location did this happen at" filtering.
  facility_id              text,
  started_at               timestamptz NOT NULL,
  ended_at                 timestamptz,
  swing_count              int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (swing_count >= 0),
  best_exit_velocity_mph   numeric(5,1),
  avg_exit_velocity_mph    numeric(5,1),
  max_distance_ft          int,
  notes                    text,
  created_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT sessions_time_order CHECK (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at)
);

-- (capture_source, capture_session_id) is the idempotency key for sessions.
-- Partial unique because manual sessions don't carry a capture_session_id.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uniq_sessions_capture
  ON public.sessions (capture_source, capture_session_id)
  WHERE capture_session_id IS NOT NULL;

-- swings -----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- One row per recorded swing. capture_event_id is the HitTrax-provided unique
-- swing identifier (or future-system equivalent). The composite UNIQUE makes
-- replays idempotent — re-polling the same window UPSERTs with no duplicates.
CREATE TABLE public.swings (
  id                  uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id           uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id              uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  session_id          uuid        REFERENCES public.sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  capture_source      text        NOT NULL CHECK (capture_source IN ('hittrax', 'rapsodo', 'manual')),
  -- HitTrax-provided swing/event id (or future-system equivalent).
  capture_event_id    text        NOT NULL,
  occurred_at         timestamptz NOT NULL,
  -- Headline metrics. All nullable because not every system reports every
  -- field, and HitTrax content-types vary by contract tier.
  exit_velocity_mph   numeric(5,1) CHECK (exit_velocity_mph IS NULL OR exit_velocity_mph >= 0),
  launch_angle_deg    numeric(5,1),
  distance_ft         int          CHECK (distance_ft IS NULL OR distance_ft >= 0),
  contact_quality     text,
  result              text,
  pitch_speed_mph     numeric(5,1) CHECK (pitch_speed_mph IS NULL OR pitch_speed_mph >= 0),
  spray_angle_deg     numeric(5,1),
  -- TRUE iff the PR trigger detected at least one new personal best on insert.
  is_personal_best    boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  -- Raw HitTrax payload for the swing — kept verbatim for debugging /
  -- replay / future re-parsing without another HitTrax round-trip.
  raw                 jsonb,
  created_at          timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT swings_capture_event_id_present CHECK (length(capture_event_id) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT swings_capture_event_unique UNIQUE (capture_source, capture_event_id)
);

-- personal_bests ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- One row per (kid_id, metric). Updated in place by the PR trigger.
CREATE TABLE public.personal_bests (
  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id    uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  metric       text        NOT NULL CHECK (metric IN (
                              'exit_velocity_mph',
                              'distance_ft',
                              'launch_angle_deg',
                              'pitch_speed_mph'
                            )),
  value        numeric     NOT NULL,
  swing_id     uuid        REFERENCES public.swings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  achieved_at  timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT personal_bests_kid_metric_unique UNIQUE (kid_id, metric)
);

-- kid_capture_links ------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tracks the HitTrax association lifecycle for a single (kid, capture_source).
-- third_party_user_id is the opaque UUID we send to HitTrax as ThirdPartyUserID
-- — we never store the parent's HitTrax email or password, only the
-- HitTrax-issued password returned in CompleteHitTraxRegistration.
--
-- The polling cursor (last_polled_through) is a timestamp because HitTrax's
-- GetAvailableThirdPartyData uses StartDate/EndDate, not an opaque token.
-- We advance it ONLY after a successful poll + UPSERT of all returned swings.
CREATE TABLE public.kid_capture_links (
  id                            uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id                     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id                        uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  capture_source                text        NOT NULL CHECK (capture_source IN ('hittrax', 'rapsodo')),
  -- Our internal UUID we send to HitTrax as ThirdPartyUserID. Never reused.
  third_party_user_id           text        NOT NULL,
  -- The HitTrax UserID the parent typed. Stored only for ops debugging /
  -- support — we do NOT use it for any HitTrax API call after associate.
  external_user_id              text,
  -- HitTrax-issued password returned in CompleteHitTraxRegistration. Used as
  -- the auth on every subsequent GetAvailableThirdPartyData / Remove / Forget
  -- call. Treat as a credential — never log, never return to the client.
  third_party_user_password     text,
  -- The two booleans HitTrax returns from AssociateThirdPartyAccount. Stored
  -- for support / "your HitTrax subscription needs upgrading" UX.
  hittrax_registration_status   boolean,
  hittrax_release_status        boolean,
  association_status            text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                                  CHECK (association_status IN ('pending', 'active', 'declined', 'removed')),
  associated_at                 timestamptz,
  removed_at                    timestamptz,
  -- Polling cursor. Only swings with occurred_at > last_polled_through are
  -- considered new. Initialised to associated_at when the link first goes
  -- active, advanced by hittrax-poll on success.
  last_polled_through           timestamptz,
  last_polled_at                timestamptz,
  last_poll_error               text,
  created_at                    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at                    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT kid_capture_links_third_party_user_id_unique
    UNIQUE (capture_source, third_party_user_id),
  -- One link per (kid, capture_source). 'removed' links are kept for audit
  -- but a kid can only have one ACTIVE/PENDING/DECLINED link per source —
  -- enforced by a partial unique index (so 'removed' rows don't block re-link).
  CONSTRAINT kid_capture_links_kid_source_unique
    UNIQUE (kid_id, capture_source)
);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Indexes on FK columns + hot lookup keys
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_tenant_id            ON public.sessions(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_kid_id_started_at    ON public.sessions(kid_id, started_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX idx_swings_tenant_id              ON public.swings(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_swings_kid_id_occurred_at     ON public.swings(kid_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_swings_session_id             ON public.swings(session_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_personal_bests_tenant_id      ON public.personal_bests(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_personal_bests_kid_id         ON public.personal_bests(kid_id);

CREATE INDEX idx_kid_capture_links_tenant_id   ON public.kid_capture_links(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_kid_capture_links_kid_id      ON public.kid_capture_links(kid_id);
-- Hot path for the polling worker: find every active link, oldest cursor first.
CREATE INDEX idx_kid_capture_links_poll_cursor
  ON public.kid_capture_links(association_status, last_polled_at NULLS FIRST)
  WHERE association_status = 'active';

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. PR detection trigger on swings
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runs AFTER INSERT on public.swings. For each metric the new swing carries,
-- compares to the existing personal_bests row (if any) and if higher (or
-- absent) UPSERTs the PR row. If at least one PR was set, flips
-- swings.is_personal_best=true and inserts a +15 points_ledger row keyed
-- on the swing.
--
-- Idempotency:
--   * Re-inserting the same swing is impossible due to the UNIQUE on
--     (capture_source, capture_event_id) — the second insert errors out
--     before the trigger fires.
--   * The points_ledger insert is guarded by a partial unique index on
--     reference_id WHERE reason='pr_hit' AND reference_type='swing', so
--     even if the trigger were re-fired for the same swing.id (which it
--     can't be in normal operation), the duplicate ledger row would be
--     rejected and the trigger would gracefully no-op.
--
-- Defense-in-depth: SET search_path is pinned, OWNER is postgres so the
-- function bypasses RLS on points_ledger / personal_bests (both of which
-- have no client write policy). tenant_id and kid_id are read from the
-- NEW row — never from caller input — so cross-tenant smuggling is
-- impossible.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.detect_swing_pr()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_award constant int := 15;
  v_metric text;
  v_value  numeric;
  v_existing_value numeric;
  v_any_pr boolean := false;
  v_new_balance int;
  -- Iterate over the metrics we recognise as PR-eligible. launch_angle is
  -- intentionally excluded — "highest launch angle" isn't a meaningful PR.
  v_metrics text[] := ARRAY['exit_velocity_mph', 'distance_ft', 'pitch_speed_mph'];
BEGIN
  FOREACH v_metric IN ARRAY v_metrics LOOP
    v_value := CASE v_metric
      WHEN 'exit_velocity_mph' THEN NEW.exit_velocity_mph
      WHEN 'distance_ft'       THEN NEW.distance_ft::numeric
      WHEN 'pitch_speed_mph'   THEN NEW.pitch_speed_mph
    END;

    IF v_value IS NULL THEN CONTINUE; END IF;

    SELECT value INTO v_existing_value
      FROM public.personal_bests
     WHERE kid_id = NEW.kid_id AND metric = v_metric
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      -- First time we've seen this metric for this kid — it IS a PR by definition.
      INSERT INTO public.personal_bests (tenant_id, kid_id, metric, value, swing_id, achieved_at)
      VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, NEW.kid_id, v_metric, v_value, NEW.id, NEW.occurred_at);
      v_any_pr := true;
    ELSIF v_value > v_existing_value THEN
      UPDATE public.personal_bests
         SET value = v_value,
             swing_id = NEW.id,
             achieved_at = NEW.occurred_at
       WHERE kid_id = NEW.kid_id AND metric = v_metric;
      v_any_pr := true;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF v_any_pr THEN
    -- Mark the swing for the UI badge.
    UPDATE public.swings SET is_personal_best = true WHERE id = NEW.id;

    -- Award points + write ledger row. Guard with the partial unique index;
    -- a duplicate insert (e.g. trigger re-firing) becomes a graceful no-op.
    BEGIN
      UPDATE public.kids
         SET points_balance = points_balance + v_award
       WHERE id = NEW.kid_id
       RETURNING points_balance INTO v_new_balance;

      INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
        tenant_id, kid_id, delta, reason, reference_type, reference_id, balance_after, note
      ) VALUES (
        NEW.tenant_id, NEW.kid_id, v_award, 'pr_hit', 'swing', NEW.id, v_new_balance,
        'New personal best'
      );
    EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
      -- Already credited for this swing — undo the kids.points_balance bump
      -- so the ledger and the balance stay consistent.
      UPDATE public.kids
         SET points_balance = points_balance - v_award
       WHERE id = NEW.kid_id;
    END;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.detect_swing_pr() OWNER TO postgres;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_swings_detect_pr
  AFTER INSERT ON public.swings
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.detect_swing_pr();

-- Partial unique index that backs the idempotency guard above. A single swing
-- can only ever generate one 'pr_hit' ledger row.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uniq_points_ledger_pr_hit
  ON public.points_ledger (reference_id)
  WHERE reason = 'pr_hit' AND reference_type = 'swing';

ALTER TABLE public.sessions           ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.swings             ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.personal_bests     ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.kid_capture_links  ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. RLS policies
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- All four tables are READ-only from the client. Writes go through:
--   * Edge Function hittrax-poll               (sessions, swings — service role)
--   * Trigger detect_swing_pr                  (personal_bests, points_ledger, kids)
--   * Edge Function hittrax-associate          (kid_capture_links insert — service role)
--   * Edge Function hittrax-registration-...   (kid_capture_links update — service role)
--   * Edge Function hittrax-disconnect         (kid_capture_links update — service role)
--
-- Both parents and coaches can read; the kid-ownership join keeps parents
-- scoped to their own family, and coaches see everything in their tenant.

-- sessions: parent SELECT for own family; coach SELECT for own tenant.
-- Defence-in-depth: the families join also pins f.tenant_id = JWT tenant_id.
-- See replit.md "Cross-tenant RLS audit (task #86)" for the same pattern on
-- public.kids — public.swings/sessions/personal_bests/kid_capture_links
-- carry their own tenant_id column AND we re-pin in the join, so even a
-- forged tenant_id row is unreachable.
CREATE POLICY sessions_select_own_family ON public.sessions
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND kid_id IN (
      SELECT k.id FROM public.kids k
      JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY sessions_select_coach ON public.sessions
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
  );

-- swings: same pattern.
CREATE POLICY swings_select_own_family ON public.swings
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND kid_id IN (
      SELECT k.id FROM public.kids k
      JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY swings_select_coach ON public.swings
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
  );

-- personal_bests: same pattern.
CREATE POLICY personal_bests_select_own_family ON public.personal_bests
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND kid_id IN (
      SELECT k.id FROM public.kids k
      JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY personal_bests_select_coach ON public.personal_bests
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
  );

-- kid_capture_links: parent SELECT for own family. Realtime subscription
-- in the mobile app uses this to flip the UI from Pending to Connected
-- when hittrax-registration-complete updates the row.
-- third_party_user_password is a credential. RLS works at row, not column
-- granularity — column-level defence lives in the GRANT below (we never
-- GRANT SELECT on that column to authenticated). The mobile API layer
-- (src/api/hittrax.ts) also uses an explicit column allow-list as a second
-- line of defence.
CREATE POLICY kid_capture_links_select_own_family ON public.kid_capture_links
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND kid_id IN (
      SELECT k.id FROM public.kids k
      JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY kid_capture_links_select_coach ON public.kid_capture_links
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
  );


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7. GRANTs
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- All four tables are SELECT-only for authenticated users. Writes happen
-- via service-role Edge Functions / SECURITY DEFINER triggers.
GRANT SELECT ON public.sessions          TO authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON public.swings            TO authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON public.personal_bests    TO authenticated;

-- kid_capture_links: COLUMN-LEVEL grant. third_party_user_password is the
-- HitTrax-issued credential — we treat it like a database password and
-- never expose it to authenticated users, even via a forged column-list
-- query. RLS narrows rows but Postgres has no row-level column filter, so
-- defence lives at the GRANT layer:
--   1. (no table-level GRANT SELECT — would allow SELECT *)
--   2. explicit allow-list of every column EXCEPT third_party_user_password
-- src/api/hittrax.ts uses the same allow-list as a second line of defence.
GRANT SELECT (
  id,
  tenant_id,
  kid_id,
  capture_source,
  third_party_user_id,
  external_user_id,
  hittrax_registration_status,
  hittrax_release_status,
  association_status,
  associated_at,
  removed_at,
  last_polled_through,
  last_polled_at,
  last_poll_error,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) ON public.kid_capture_links TO authenticated;

-- service_role needs full DML for the Edge Functions. (Repeats the v0.6
-- service_role grant pattern — see 20260508010000.)
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.sessions          TO service_role;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.swings            TO service_role;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.personal_bests    TO service_role;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.kid_capture_links TO service_role;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260508070000_v07_hittrax_backoff.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- v0.7 task #118 — Per-link transient-failure backoff for the HitTrax poller.
-- =============================================================================
-- Adds two columns to kid_capture_links so the poll worker can implement
-- exponential backoff on transient failures (HitTrax timeout / unreachable /
-- 5xx / parse drift) per link, without starving healthy links:
--
--   retry_count  : 0 on success; ++1 on every transient failure. Cleared on
--                  the first successful poll. Used to compute the backoff
--                  delay (capped at 30 minutes).
--   next_poll_at : NULL when the link is poll-eligible right now. Set to a
--                  future timestamp by the worker after a transient failure;
--                  cleared on success. The poll-eligibility filter is
--                  `next_poll_at IS NULL OR next_poll_at <= now()`.
--
-- The 2-minute pg_cron tick still fires; backoff means a backed-off link is
-- silently skipped on ticks where it's not eligible. Healthy links continue
-- to poll on every tick.
-- =============================================================================

ALTER TABLE public.kid_capture_links
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS retry_count  integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS next_poll_at timestamptz;

-- Replace the cursor index so the worker can cheaply select eligible links.
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_kid_capture_links_poll_cursor;
CREATE INDEX idx_kid_capture_links_poll_cursor
  ON public.kid_capture_links(association_status, next_poll_at NULLS FIRST, last_polled_at NULLS FIRST)
  WHERE association_status = 'active';

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — task #119: kid_swing_favorites + toggle RPC
-- =============================================================================
-- Per-parent "heart" on a swing. UI uses it for the Videos → Favorites
-- sub-tab and for the heart toggle on the Swing Detail screen.
--
-- Why a separate table (instead of `is_favorite` on swings):
--   * swings.tenant_id and swings rows are pre-existing — adding a column
--     that the parent UI mutates would need a swings UPDATE policy, which
--     defeats the "swings are write-only via service role" model.
--   * Future schema supports multiple kids per family — favoriting is per
--     PARENT, but today we scope by kid (one-kid-per-family UI) so the
--     join key is (kid_id, swing_id). We add parent_user_id too so a
--     future "second parent on the family" edit doesn't inherit the other
--     parent's favorites.
--
-- Idempotency: UNIQUE (parent_user_id, swing_id). The toggle RPC inserts
-- on first call and deletes on second; either path returns the new state.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE public.kid_swing_favorites (
  id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id          uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id)    ON DELETE CASCADE,
  swing_id        uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.swings(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
  parent_user_id  uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id)     ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT kid_swing_favorites_parent_swing_unique
    UNIQUE (parent_user_id, swing_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_kid_swing_favorites_tenant_id ON public.kid_swing_favorites(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_kid_swing_favorites_parent    ON public.kid_swing_favorites(parent_user_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_kid_swing_favorites_swing     ON public.kid_swing_favorites(swing_id);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RLS
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.kid_swing_favorites ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Parent can SELECT/INSERT/DELETE only their own rows in their own tenant.
-- The kid_id is verified to belong to the parent's family in the WITH
-- CHECK on INSERT (defence-in-depth — a forged kid_id from another family
-- in the same tenant would still pass tenant_id alone).
CREATE POLICY kid_swing_favorites_select_own ON public.kid_swing_favorites
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  );

CREATE POLICY kid_swing_favorites_insert_own ON public.kid_swing_favorites
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND kid_id IN (
      SELECT k.id FROM public.kids k
      JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
    AND swing_id IN (
      SELECT s.id FROM public.swings s
      WHERE s.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
        AND s.kid_id IN (
          SELECT k.id FROM public.kids k
          JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
          WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
            AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
        )
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY kid_swing_favorites_delete_own ON public.kid_swing_favorites
  FOR DELETE TO authenticated
  USING (
    parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  );

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, DELETE ON public.kid_swing_favorites TO authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.kid_swing_favorites TO service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- toggle_swing_favorite RPC
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- One round-trip toggle. Returns TRUE if the swing is now favorited, FALSE
-- if it was just un-favorited. SECURITY DEFINER so the implementation can
-- bypass RLS for the lookup, but every effect is pinned to auth.uid() and
-- the JWT tenant_id — the caller can only ever toggle their own favorite
-- on a swing that belongs to their family.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.toggle_swing_favorite(p_swing_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id    uuid := auth.uid();
  v_tenant_id  uuid := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
  v_kid_id     uuid;
  v_swing_tid  uuid;
  v_existing   uuid;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'toggle_swing_favorite: not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'toggle_swing_favorite: missing tenant_id claim' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  -- Verify the swing belongs to the caller's family + tenant. We resolve
  -- the kid_id from the swing so we don't trust the caller for it.
  SELECT s.kid_id, s.tenant_id INTO v_kid_id, v_swing_tid
  FROM public.swings s
  JOIN public.kids k    ON k.id = s.kid_id
  JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
  WHERE s.id = p_swing_id
    AND s.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND f.parent_user_id = v_user_id
    AND f.tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

  IF v_kid_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'toggle_swing_favorite: swing not found or not visible'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_existing
  FROM public.kid_swing_favorites
  WHERE parent_user_id = v_user_id AND swing_id = p_swing_id;

  IF v_existing IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.kid_swing_favorites WHERE id = v_existing;
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.kid_swing_favorites (tenant_id, kid_id, swing_id, parent_user_id)
  VALUES (v_swing_tid, v_kid_id, p_swing_id, v_user_id)
  ON CONFLICT (parent_user_id, swing_id) DO NOTHING;

  RETURN true;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.toggle_swing_favorite(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.toggle_swing_favorite(uuid) TO authenticated;

-- =============================================================================
-- v0.7 task #120 — bidirectional coach_messages + parent video uploads
-- =============================================================================
-- The same `public.coach_messages` table that v0.4 introduced for coach -> family
-- messaging is widened in this migration to also carry parent -> coach messages
-- (the "Send Video to Coach" composer). The thread UI then renders rows from
-- both directions, ordered by created_at, with sender_user_id deciding the
-- bubble side.
--
-- Changes:
--   1. videos.purpose CHECK constraint: add 'parent_to_coach'.
--   2. coach_messages: add `label` (game_footage | home_practice | swing_check |
--      question | other | NULL) and `sender_display` (free-text "Sent from
--      Mom" attribution typed by the parent in step 4 of the composer).
--   3. New RLS policy `coach_messages_insert_own_parent` mirroring the coach
--      one but inverted: sender is the parent themselves; recipient_kid_id
--      must belong to one of the parent's kids; the attached video (if any)
--      must have purpose='parent_to_coach' and the same tenant. We
--      intentionally do NOT add a separate "select coach inbox" policy:
--      coaches already see every coach_messages row in their tenant via the
--      existing `coach_messages_select_coach_stub` policy
--      (20260505040800_rename_role_to_app_role_in_jwt.sql).
--   4. New RLS policy `coach_messages_select_parent_sender` so the parent
--      can read messages they themselves sent (the existing
--      `coach_messages_select_recipient_parent` only covers inbound).
--   5. New RLS policy `coach_messages_update_coach_recipient` so a coach
--      can mark a parent->coach message viewed (column-level GRANT below
--      already restricts UPDATE to viewed_at).
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. videos.purpose -----------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.videos
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS videos_purpose_check;

ALTER TABLE public.videos
  ADD CONSTRAINT videos_purpose_check
  CHECK (purpose IN ('coach_message', 'drill', 'parent_to_coach'));

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.videos.purpose IS
  'What this video was uploaded for. coach_message = sent to a family in the inbox; drill = attached to (or attachable to) an assignments row; parent_to_coach = parent-uploaded video sent to a coach via Send Video to Coach (v0.7 task #120). Set by mux-create-upload from the client''s purpose param; defaults to coach_message for back-compat with rows uploaded before v0.6.';


-- 2. coach_messages columns ---------------------------------------------------
-- recipient_coach_user_id is the explicit coach addressed by a parent->coach
-- row. NULL on coach->parent rows (the coach is the sender there). Required
-- by the INSERT policy + every parent->coach SELECT/UPDATE policy below so
-- threads + inboxes can deterministically attribute a message to one coach
-- (no "lastCoachSeen" guessing in client code).
ALTER TABLE public.coach_messages
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS label                   text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sender_display          text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recipient_coach_user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS coach_messages_recipient_coach_user_id_idx
  ON public.coach_messages (recipient_coach_user_id)
  WHERE recipient_coach_user_id IS NOT NULL;

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.coach_messages.recipient_coach_user_id IS
  'Explicit coach addressed by a parent->coach message (v0.7 task #120). NULL on coach->parent rows.';

ALTER TABLE public.coach_messages
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS coach_messages_label_check;

ALTER TABLE public.coach_messages
  ADD CONSTRAINT coach_messages_label_check
  CHECK (
    label IS NULL OR label IN (
      'game_footage', 'home_practice', 'swing_check', 'question', 'other'
    )
  );

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.coach_messages.label IS
  'Composer "tag this clip" choice for parent->coach messages. NULL on coach->parent rows.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN public.coach_messages.sender_display IS
  'Composer "sent from" attribution typed by the parent (e.g. "Mom"). NULL on coach->parent rows.';


-- 3. Parent INSERT RLS --------------------------------------------------------
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coach_messages_insert_own_parent ON public.coach_messages;
CREATE POLICY coach_messages_insert_own_parent ON public.coach_messages
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND sender_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'parent'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.kids k
        JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
       WHERE k.id = coach_messages.recipient_kid_id
         AND f.id = coach_messages.recipient_family_id
         AND f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
         AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
    AND coach_messages.recipient_coach_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.coaches c
       WHERE c.user_id = coach_messages.recipient_coach_user_id
         AND c.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
    AND (
      coach_messages.video_id IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.videos v
         WHERE v.id = coach_messages.video_id
           AND v.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
           AND v.uploaded_by_user_id = auth.uid()
           AND v.purpose = 'parent_to_coach'
      )
    )
  );

COMMENT ON POLICY coach_messages_insert_own_parent ON public.coach_messages IS
  'v0.7 task #120 — parent can INSERT a row addressed to one of their own kids; if a video is attached it must be the parent''s own parent_to_coach upload in the same tenant.';


-- 4. Parent SELECT-own-sent RLS ----------------------------------------------
-- The existing coach_messages_select_recipient_parent only covers inbound
-- (coach -> parent). For the thread view to render the parent's own sent
-- messages we need a second SELECT policy keyed on sender_user_id.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coach_messages_select_parent_sender ON public.coach_messages;
CREATE POLICY coach_messages_select_parent_sender ON public.coach_messages
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND sender_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'parent'
  );


-- 4b. Coach SELECT on parent->coach rows addressed to THEM -------------------
-- The pre-existing `coach_messages_select_own_coach` policy only covers rows
-- the coach SENT (`sender_user_id = auth.uid()`). Without this addition a
-- coach would not be able to read parent->coach messages routed to them.
-- Scoped to `recipient_coach_user_id = auth.uid()` so other coaches in the
-- same tenant cannot read messages addressed to a different coach (privacy
-- separation between coaches in the same facility).
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coach_messages_select_recipient_coach ON public.coach_messages;
CREATE POLICY coach_messages_select_recipient_coach ON public.coach_messages
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
    AND recipient_coach_user_id = auth.uid()
  );


-- 5. Coach UPDATE viewed_at on parent->coach rows ----------------------------
-- Existing coach_messages_update_recipient_parent covers parent marking
-- coach->parent viewed. We add the inverse so the coach can mark a
-- parent->coach message viewed only when THEY are the addressed recipient
-- (recipient_coach_user_id = auth.uid()).
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coach_messages_update_coach_recipient ON public.coach_messages;
CREATE POLICY coach_messages_update_coach_recipient ON public.coach_messages
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
    AND recipient_coach_user_id = auth.uid()
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
    AND recipient_coach_user_id = auth.uid()
  );


-- 6. videos: parent SELECT for own parent_to_coach uploads -------------------
-- The existing videos_select_recipient_parent only matches coach->parent
-- rows (anchored on coach_messages.video_id where the parent is the
-- recipient). When the parent IS the uploader (parent_to_coach) we need a
-- direct uploader-side SELECT so the thread can render the Mux poster.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS videos_select_own_parent_upload ON public.videos;
CREATE POLICY videos_select_own_parent_upload ON public.videos
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND uploaded_by_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND purpose = 'parent_to_coach'
  );


-- 7. videos: parent INSERT for parent_to_coach -------------------------------
-- Existing videos_insert_own_coach is coach-only. Add a parent-side INSERT
-- restricted to purpose='parent_to_coach' so a parent can never smuggle a
-- coach_message / drill row.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS videos_insert_own_parent_to_coach ON public.videos;
CREATE POLICY videos_insert_own_parent_to_coach ON public.videos
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND uploaded_by_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'parent'
    AND purpose = 'parent_to_coach'
  );

-- 8. videos: coach SELECT on parent_to_coach addressed to them via thread ----
-- A coach must see the Mux poster + playback id of a parent_to_coach video,
-- but ONLY when they are a participant on the message that links to it —
-- either the coach SENT the message (sender_user_id) or the coach is the
-- addressed recipient (recipient_coach_user_id). Without this join scope
-- any coach in the same tenant could read playback ids for parent uploads
-- addressed to a different coach in the same facility, leaking media
-- across coaches. Anchored on the message join, mirroring
-- videos_select_recipient_parent.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS videos_select_coach_thread ON public.videos;
CREATE POLICY videos_select_coach_thread ON public.videos
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.coach_messages cm
       WHERE cm.video_id = videos.id
         AND cm.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
         AND (
           cm.sender_user_id = auth.uid()
           OR cm.recipient_coach_user_id = auth.uid()
         )
    )
  );

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260509000002_fix_achievements_swings_streak_cast.sql
=================================================================================
-- Fix: _achievements_after_swings streak calculation used ROW_NUMBER() which
-- returns bigint, but the date - bigint operator does not exist in PostgreSQL.
-- Cast (rn - 1) to integer so date subtraction resolves correctly.
-- Symptom: any INSERT into public.swings raised
--   "operator does not exist: date - bigint" (pg error 42883).

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_swings()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_count int;
  v_streak int;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM public.swings WHERE kid_id = NEW.kid_id;

  IF v_count >= 1 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_swing');
  END IF;
  IF v_count >= 50 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'fifty_swings');
  END IF;
  IF v_count >= 100 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'hundred_swings');
  END IF;

  -- Distinct-day streak ending today. ROW_NUMBER() returns bigint, so cast
  -- to integer before subtracting from a date (date - integer = date).
  WITH days AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
      FROM public.swings
     WHERE kid_id = NEW.kid_id
       AND occurred_at >= now() - INTERVAL '40 days'
  ),
  ordered AS (
    SELECT d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d DESC) AS rn FROM days
  )
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_streak
    FROM ordered
   WHERE d = (CURRENT_DATE - (rn - 1)::integer);

  IF v_streak >= 7 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'streak_7');
  END IF;
  IF v_streak >= 30 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'streak_30');
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260509000003_fix_hook_owner_role.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix custom_access_token_hook to handle owner (and admin) roles
-- =============================================================================
-- Previously the hook only injected app_role for users found in
-- public.families (parents) or public.coaches. Owner/admin users exist
-- only in auth.users with raw_user_meta_data.app_role set, so the hook
-- fell through without setting any claim — readAppRole() returned "parent"
-- and the portal signed them out immediately on login.
--
-- Fix: add a third fallback branch that reads raw_user_meta_data from
-- auth.users (accessible from SECURITY DEFINER as postgres) and injects
-- app_role + tenant_id for 'owner' and 'admin' roles.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id   uuid;
  v_claims    jsonb;
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_family_id uuid;
  v_app_role  text;
  v_meta_role text;
  v_meta_slug text;
BEGIN
  v_user_id := (event->>'user_id')::uuid;
  v_claims  := COALESCE(event->'claims', '{}'::jsonb);

  -- 1. Parent / family path.
  SELECT tenant_id, id, role
    INTO v_tenant_id, v_family_id, v_app_role
    FROM public.families
   WHERE parent_user_id = v_user_id;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
           'family_id', v_family_id,
           'app_role',  v_app_role
         );

  ELSE
    -- 2. Coach path.
    SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
      FROM public.coaches
     WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND is_active = true;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_claims := v_claims
        || jsonb_build_object(
             'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
             'app_role',  'coach'
           );

    ELSE
      -- 3. Owner / admin path — read raw_user_meta_data directly from
      --    auth.users (only accessible inside a SECURITY DEFINER fn).
      SELECT
        (raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role'),
        (raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug')
        INTO v_meta_role, v_meta_slug
        FROM auth.users
       WHERE id = v_user_id;

      IF v_meta_role IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id
          FROM public.tenants
         WHERE slug = v_meta_slug;

        v_claims := v_claims
          || jsonb_build_object(
               'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
               'app_role',  v_meta_role
             );
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) TO supabase_auth_admin;

-- =============================================================================
-- v0.7 task #121 — Training video library
-- =============================================================================
-- Self-serve catalog of HQ-curated training videos exposed in the mobile
-- Train tab. Tenant-scoped so a future second tenant gets its own library.
--
-- Tables:
--   training_videos       the catalog row (one Mux asset + metadata).
--   training_video_views  per-kid view log (analytics + future
--                         personalization). view_count on the parent row
--                         is denormalized via the record_training_view RPC.
--
-- RPC:
--   record_training_view(p_video_id uuid, p_kid_id uuid)
--     SECURITY DEFINER. Inserts a view row + bumps view_count atomically.
--     Tenant + kid ownership are enforced inside the function so the
--     client can't smuggle a foreign kid_id.
--
-- RLS:
--   training_videos
--     SELECT  any signed-in user in the same tenant where published_at
--             IS NOT NULL (parents and coaches see published rows only).
--             Admins see all rows including drafts.
--     INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE  app_role='admin' AND tenant matches.
--   training_video_views
--     SELECT  parent on their own family's kids; admin on their tenant.
--     INSERT  blocked at the policy level — only the SECURITY DEFINER RPC
--             writes here, so the client cannot fabricate inflated views.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.training_videos (
  id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mux_playback_id text        NOT NULL,
  title           text        NOT NULL,
  description     text,
  category        text        NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('hitting','mental','situational','fielding')),
  level           text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'beginner' CHECK (level IN ('beginner','intermediate','advanced')),
  coach_name      text,
  duration_sec    integer     CHECK (duration_sec IS NULL OR duration_sec >= 0),
  view_count      integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (view_count >= 0),
  featured        boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  published_at    timestamptz,
  created_by      uuid        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS training_videos_tenant_published_idx
  ON public.training_videos (tenant_id, published_at DESC NULLS LAST);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS training_videos_tenant_category_idx
  ON public.training_videos (tenant_id, category, published_at DESC NULLS LAST);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS training_videos_tenant_featured_idx
  ON public.training_videos (tenant_id, featured, published_at DESC NULLS LAST)
  WHERE featured = true AND published_at IS NOT NULL;

COMMENT ON TABLE public.training_videos IS
  'HQ-curated training video catalog (v0.7 task #121). One row per Mux asset.';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.training_video_views (
  id                uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id         uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  training_video_id uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.training_videos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id            uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  viewed_at         timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS training_video_views_kid_viewed_idx
  ON public.training_video_views (kid_id, viewed_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS training_video_views_video_idx
  ON public.training_video_views (training_video_id);

ALTER TABLE public.training_videos      ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.training_video_views ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'

-- record_training_view RPC ---------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_training_view(
  p_video_id uuid,
  p_kid_id   uuid
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_kid_tenant  uuid;
  v_caller_role text := (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role');
  v_caller_tnt  uuid := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  SELECT tv.tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
  FROM public.training_videos tv
  WHERE tv.id = p_video_id
    AND tv.published_at IS NOT NULL;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'training video not found or unpublished' USING ERRCODE = '42704';
  END IF;
  IF v_tenant_id <> v_caller_tnt THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'cross-tenant access denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Parent: kid must belong to caller's family. Admin: kid must be in tenant.
  SELECT f.tenant_id INTO v_kid_tenant
  FROM public.kids k
  JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
  WHERE k.id = p_kid_id
    AND (
      v_caller_role = 'admin'
      OR f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    );
  IF v_kid_tenant IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'kid not found or not owned by caller' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_kid_tenant <> v_caller_tnt THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'cross-tenant access denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.training_video_views (tenant_id, training_video_id, kid_id)
  VALUES (v_tenant_id, p_video_id, p_kid_id);

  UPDATE public.training_videos
     SET view_count = view_count + 1
   WHERE id = p_video_id;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.record_training_view(uuid, uuid) FROM public;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_training_view(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.record_training_view(uuid, uuid) IS
  'Idempotent-ish view logger for training_videos (v0.7 task #121). Bumps view_count and inserts a per-kid row. Client throttles via in-memory ref so we get ~1 call per playback session.';

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260510000001_v07_training_videos_followup.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- v0.7 task #121 — Training video library FOLLOW-UP (code review fixes)
-- =============================================================================
-- 1) Extend videos.purpose CHECK with 'training' so admin Train uploads can
--    persist into public.videos via mux-create-upload (purpose='training').
-- 2) Replace record_training_view with a server-side dedupe so view_count
--    increments AT MOST ONCE per (kid, video) per 30-minute window — the
--    client-side useRef gate is now defence in depth, not the only line.
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. videos.purpose ----------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.videos
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS videos_purpose_check;

ALTER TABLE public.videos
  ADD CONSTRAINT videos_purpose_check
  CHECK (purpose IN ('coach_message', 'drill', 'parent_to_coach', 'training'));

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.videos.purpose IS
  'What this video was uploaded for. coach_message | drill | parent_to_coach | training. Set by mux-create-upload from the client''s purpose param; training is admin-only (v0.7 task #121).';


-- 1a. Admin SELECT on public.videos for training uploads ---------------------
-- mux-create-upload INSERTs the videos row with the service role (bypasses
-- RLS) but the portal admin then needs to SELECT mux_playback_id once the
-- mux-webhook fills it in (poll loop in TrainingVideoUploadField). Without
-- this policy admins read 0 rows under RLS and the auto-fill never resolves.
-- Scoped to the admin's tenant AND purpose='training' for least privilege.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS videos_select_admin_training ON public.videos;
CREATE POLICY videos_select_admin_training ON public.videos
  FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND tenant_id = ((auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid)
    AND purpose = 'training'
  );


-- 2. record_training_view: server-side per-session dedupe --------------------
-- Drop the prior signature first; CREATE OR REPLACE cannot change return type.
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.record_training_view(uuid, uuid);

-- A "session" for analytics is "this kid hasn't viewed this video in the
-- last 30 minutes". Repeated calls within the window are no-ops — the
-- view row is NOT inserted and view_count is NOT bumped. This guarantees
-- the once-per-session semantics even if the client retries / remounts /
-- bypasses its in-memory throttle.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_training_view(
  p_video_id uuid,
  p_kid_id   uuid
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_kid_tenant  uuid;
  v_caller_role text := (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role');
  v_caller_tnt  uuid := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  v_recent      boolean;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  SELECT tv.tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
  FROM public.training_videos tv
  WHERE tv.id = p_video_id
    AND tv.published_at IS NOT NULL;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'training video not found or unpublished' USING ERRCODE = '42704';
  END IF;
  IF v_tenant_id <> v_caller_tnt THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'cross-tenant access denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Parent: kid must belong to caller's family. Admin: kid must be in tenant.
  SELECT f.tenant_id INTO v_kid_tenant
  FROM public.kids k
  JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
  WHERE k.id = p_kid_id
    AND (
      v_caller_role = 'admin'
      OR f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    );
  IF v_kid_tenant IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'kid not found or not owned by caller' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_kid_tenant <> v_caller_tnt THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'cross-tenant access denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Server-side per-session dedupe: skip if this kid already logged a
  -- view for this video in the last 30 minutes.
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.training_video_views v
    WHERE v.training_video_id = p_video_id
      AND v.kid_id = p_kid_id
      AND v.viewed_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'
  ) INTO v_recent;
  IF v_recent THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.training_video_views (tenant_id, training_video_id, kid_id)
  VALUES (v_tenant_id, p_video_id, p_kid_id);

  UPDATE public.training_videos
     SET view_count = view_count + 1
   WHERE id = p_video_id;

  RETURN true;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.record_training_view(uuid, uuid) FROM public;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_training_view(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.record_training_view(uuid, uuid) IS
  'View logger for training_videos with server-side per-session dedupe (v0.7 task #121 follow-up). Returns true on first view in a 30-minute window, false on subsequent calls — view_count increments AT MOST ONCE per (kid, video) per window regardless of client retries.';


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260511000000_v07_achievements_and_fulfillment.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — v0.7 task #122
-- Achievements catalog + grant pipeline + redemption fulfillment
-- =============================================================================
-- Adds:
--   * public.achievements           — HQ-curated catalog (one row per badge)
--   * public.kid_achievements       — per-kid earned-at log (idempotent)
--   * public._grant_achievement(kid, key) function — INSERTS the kid row
--                                     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; on a real
--                                     grant it writes the points_ledger
--                                     bonus and fires a pg_net.http_post
--                                     to the notify-achievement Edge Func.
--   * Five trigger functions (one per source table) calling _grant_achievement
--     for the achievement keys eligible to be earned by that source's INSERT:
--        - points_ledger    -> first_session_attended, first_pr,
--                              first_reward_redeemed, ten_assignments_completed
--        - swings           -> first_swing, fifty_swings, hundred_swings,
--                              streak_7, streak_30
--        - personal_bests   -> first_pr (defence-in-depth — points_ledger
--                              also fires it via reason='pr_hit')
--        - orders           -> first_reward_redeemed (defence-in-depth)
--        - coach_messages   -> first_video_to_coach (parent_to_coach only)
--        - assignments      -> homework_5_star (on review with rating=5)
--   * orders.fulfilled_by_user_id   — admin who closed the redemption out
--   * mark_redemption_fulfilled(p_code) SECURITY DEFINER RPC for the
--     portal /admin/redemptions page.
--   * points_ledger.reason CHECK extended with 'achievement_bonus'
--   * points_ledger.reference_type CHECK extended with 'achievement'
--   * Idempotency: partial UNIQUE on points_ledger for achievement bonuses
--     keyed on (reference_id) WHERE reason='achievement_bonus'.
--
-- Notes:
--   * pg_net is part of Supabase by default; the http_post is best-effort
--     so a missing extension never blocks the trigger fire path (we wrap
--     in EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS).
--   * Catalog seed runs at the bottom of this file and is idempotent
--     against the UNIQUE(key) constraint.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_net WITH SCHEMA extensions;

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. achievements catalog
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.achievements (
  id            uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  key           text        NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name          text        NOT NULL,
  description   text        NOT NULL,
  icon          text        NOT NULL,                  -- lucide-react-native icon name
  points_bonus  int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (points_bonus >= 0),
  sort_order    int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
  created_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. kid_achievements
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.kid_achievements (
  id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id          uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  achievement_id  uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.achievements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  earned_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT kid_achievements_kid_achievement_unique UNIQUE (kid_id, achievement_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kid_achievements_kid    ON public.kid_achievements(kid_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kid_achievements_tenant ON public.kid_achievements(tenant_id);

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. orders.fulfilled_by_user_id
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fulfilled_by_user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_fulfilled_by ON public.orders(fulfilled_by_user_id);

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Extend points_ledger.reason / reference_type CHECK
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS points_ledger_reason_check;
ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger
  ADD CONSTRAINT points_ledger_reason_check CHECK (reason IN (
    'session_attended',
    'assignment_completed',
    'pr_hit',
    'redemption',
    'manual_adjustment',
    'achievement_bonus'
  ));

ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS points_ledger_reference_type_check;
ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger
  ADD CONSTRAINT points_ledger_reference_type_check CHECK (
    reference_type IS NULL OR reference_type IN ('booking', 'order', 'assignment', 'swing', 'manual', 'achievement')
  );

-- Idempotency: one ledger row per (kid, achievement) bonus
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_points_ledger_achievement_bonus
  ON public.points_ledger (reference_id)
  WHERE reason = 'achievement_bonus' AND reference_type = 'achievement';

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. _grant_achievement(kid, key)
--
-- INSERTs the kid_achievements row ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. If a row was
-- actually inserted (RETURNING produced one), this also:
--   (a) writes a points_ledger row with reason='achievement_bonus' if the
--       achievement carries a points_bonus > 0. Idempotent via the
--       partial UNIQUE on (reference_id).
--   (b) fires pg_net.http_post to notify-achievement Edge Function so the
--       parent gets a push. Best-effort; failures are swallowed.
--
-- SECURITY DEFINER so the triggers (which run in the inserting user's
-- context) can write through RLS on points_ledger / kid_achievements.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._grant_achievement(p_kid_id uuid, p_key text)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_achievement public.achievements%ROWTYPE;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_balance     int;
  v_new_kid_ach uuid;
  v_supabase_url text;
  v_service_key  text;
BEGIN
  -- Look up the achievement; silently no-op for unknown keys so a typo in
  -- a trigger never breaks the inserting transaction.
  SELECT * INTO v_achievement FROM public.achievements WHERE key = p_key;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;

  -- Resolve the kid's tenant. `kids` has no direct tenant_id column —
  -- tenant lives on families. If the kid was deleted between trigger
  -- fire and now, no-op.
  SELECT f.tenant_id
    INTO v_tenant_id
    FROM public.kids k
    JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
   WHERE k.id = p_kid_id;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;

  -- Idempotent insert. RETURNING surfaces the new id only on a real
  -- insert (not on an ON CONFLICT skip).
  INSERT INTO public.kid_achievements (tenant_id, kid_id, achievement_id)
       VALUES (v_tenant_id, p_kid_id, v_achievement.id)
  ON CONFLICT (kid_id, achievement_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id INTO v_new_kid_ach;

  IF v_new_kid_ach IS NULL THEN
    -- Already earned. Nothing else to do.
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Points bonus, if any.
  IF v_achievement.points_bonus > 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = points_balance + v_achievement.points_bonus
     WHERE id = p_kid_id
     RETURNING points_balance INTO v_balance;

    INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
      tenant_id, kid_id, delta, reason, reference_type, reference_id, balance_after, note
    ) VALUES (
      v_tenant_id, p_kid_id, v_achievement.points_bonus, 'achievement_bonus',
      'achievement', v_new_kid_ach, v_balance, v_achievement.name
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  -- Best-effort push fan-out via pg_net + Edge Function.
  -- Wrapped in BEGIN/EXCEPTION so a missing extension or bad config
  -- never blocks the trigger.
  BEGIN
    v_supabase_url := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true);
    v_service_key  := current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true);
    IF v_supabase_url IS NOT NULL AND v_service_key IS NOT NULL
       AND v_supabase_url <> '' AND v_service_key <> '' THEN
      PERFORM extensions.http_post(
        url     := v_supabase_url || '/functions/v1/notify-achievement',
        headers := jsonb_build_object(
                     'Content-Type',  'application/json',
                     'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_service_key
                   ),
        body    := jsonb_build_object(
                     'kid_id',         p_kid_id,
                     'achievement_id', v_achievement.id,
                     'achievement_key', v_achievement.key
                   )
      );
    END IF;
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    -- swallow; achievement is granted regardless
    NULL;
  END;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public._grant_achievement(uuid, text) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._grant_achievement(uuid, text) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
-- service_role only (triggers escalate via SECURITY DEFINER)
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._grant_achievement(uuid, text) TO service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. Trigger fns + triggers
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- 6a. points_ledger -----------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_points_ledger()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_count int;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.reason = 'session_attended' THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_session_attended');
  ELSIF NEW.reason = 'pr_hit' THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_pr');
  ELSIF NEW.reason = 'redemption' THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_reward_redeemed');
  ELSIF NEW.reason = 'assignment_completed' THEN
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
      FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id = NEW.kid_id AND reason = 'assignment_completed';
    IF v_count >= 1 THEN
      PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_assignment_done');
    END IF;
    IF v_count >= 10 THEN
      PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'ten_assignments_done');
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_achievements_after_points_ledger ON public.points_ledger;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_achievements_after_points_ledger
AFTER INSERT ON public.points_ledger
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_points_ledger();


-- 6b. swings ------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_swings()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_count int;
  v_streak int;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM public.swings WHERE kid_id = NEW.kid_id;

  IF v_count >= 1 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_swing');
  END IF;
  IF v_count >= 50 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'fifty_swings');
  END IF;
  IF v_count >= 100 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'hundred_swings');
  END IF;

  -- Distinct-day streak ending today (or NEW.occurred_at). Cheap because
  -- swings are heavily indexed by kid_id; cap at 31 days back.
  WITH days AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d
      FROM public.swings
     WHERE kid_id = NEW.kid_id
       AND occurred_at >= now() - INTERVAL '40 days'
  ),
  ordered AS (
    SELECT d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d DESC) AS rn FROM days
  )
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_streak
    FROM ordered
   WHERE d = (CURRENT_DATE - (rn - 1));

  IF v_streak >= 7 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'streak_7');
  END IF;
  IF v_streak >= 30 THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'streak_30');
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_achievements_after_swings ON public.swings;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_achievements_after_swings
AFTER INSERT ON public.swings
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_swings();

  PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_pr');
