-- 6d. orders (defence-in-depth for first_reward_redeemed) -------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_orders()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.payment_method = 'points' AND NEW.kid_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_reward_redeemed');
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_achievements_after_orders ON public.orders;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_achievements_after_orders
AFTER INSERT ON public.orders
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_orders();


-- 6e. coach_messages (parent_to_coach -> first_video_to_coach) ---------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_coach_messages()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_kid_id uuid;
  v_purpose text;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.video_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  SELECT purpose INTO v_purpose FROM public.videos WHERE id = NEW.video_id;
  IF v_purpose IS DISTINCT FROM 'parent_to_coach' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  -- The recipient kid is the kid the parent recorded about.
  v_kid_id := NEW.recipient_kid_id;
  IF v_kid_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  PERFORM public._grant_achievement(v_kid_id, 'first_video_to_coach');
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_achievements_after_coach_messages ON public.coach_messages;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_achievements_after_coach_messages
AFTER INSERT ON public.coach_messages
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_coach_messages();


-- 6f. assignments (homework_5_star) ------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_assignments_review()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_supabase_url text;
  v_service_key  text;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'reviewed' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'reviewed' THEN
    -- 5-star homework achievement
    IF NEW.rating = 5 THEN
      PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'homework_5_star');
    END IF;

    -- Best-effort push fan-out to notify-assignment-reviewed.
    BEGIN
      v_supabase_url := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true);
      v_service_key  := current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true);
      IF v_supabase_url IS NOT NULL AND v_service_key IS NOT NULL
         AND v_supabase_url <> '' AND v_service_key <> '' THEN
        PERFORM extensions.http_post(
          url     := v_supabase_url || '/functions/v1/notify-assignment-reviewed',
          headers := jsonb_build_object(
                       'Content-Type',  'application/json',
                       'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_service_key
                     ),
          body    := jsonb_build_object('assignment_id', NEW.id)
        );
      END IF;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      NULL;
    END;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_achievements_after_assignments_review ON public.assignments;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_achievements_after_assignments_review
AFTER UPDATE ON public.assignments
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_assignments_review();


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7. mark_redemption_fulfilled(p_code) RPC
--
-- Admin-only (verifies app_role='admin' on the JWT). Stamps fulfilled_at
-- + fulfilled_by_user_id and flips status from 'pending' to 'fulfilled'.
-- Idempotent: re-running on an already-fulfilled order returns it
-- unchanged (no error) so a double-tap from the front-desk surface
-- never throws.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(p_code text)
RETURNS public.orders
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id   uuid := auth.uid();
  v_app_role  text := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_jwt_tenant_id uuid;
  v_order     public.orders%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;
  IF v_app_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: caller is not an admin' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_jwt_tenant_id := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
  IF v_jwt_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: missing tenant_id claim' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders
    WHERE redemption_code = upper(btrim(p_code))
    FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: code % not found', p_code USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  IF v_order.tenant_id <> v_jwt_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: tenant mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_order.fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN v_order;  -- idempotent re-tap on an already-fulfilled order
  END IF;

  -- Hard guards: this surface is points-only ordered redemptions. Card
  -- orders go through a separate Stripe flow (v0.5 deferred); cancelled
  -- / refunded orders are terminal. Refuse instead of mutating so a
  -- mistyped code never silently flips an unrelated order to fulfilled.
  IF v_order.payment_method <> 'points' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: order % is %, only points redemptions can be fulfilled here',
      v_order.id, v_order.payment_method
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
  IF v_order.status <> 'ordered' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: order % status is %, expected ordered',
      v_order.id, v_order.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.orders
     SET status               = 'fulfilled',
         fulfilled_at         = now(),
         fulfilled_by_user_id = v_user_id
   WHERE id = v_order.id
   RETURNING * INTO v_order;

  RETURN v_order;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) TO authenticated;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8. RLS
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.achievements      ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.kid_achievements  ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- achievements: every authenticated user reads the whole catalog (it's
-- HQ-curated and tenant-agnostic). No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policy — only
-- service_role writes.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS achievements_select_all ON public.achievements;
CREATE POLICY achievements_select_all ON public.achievements
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (true);

-- kid_achievements: parent reads own family's; coach reads own tenant's;
-- admin reads own tenant's. Writes are SECURITY DEFINER only.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS kid_achievements_select_own_family ON public.kid_achievements;
CREATE POLICY kid_achievements_select_own_family ON public.kid_achievements
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    kid_id IN (
      SELECT k.id FROM public.kids k
        JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
       WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS kid_achievements_select_tenant_staff ON public.kid_achievements;
CREATE POLICY kid_achievements_select_tenant_staff ON public.kid_achievements
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('coach', 'admin')
    AND tenant_id = NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid
  );

GRANT SELECT ON public.achievements     TO authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON public.kid_achievements TO authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.achievements     TO service_role;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.kid_achievements TO service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7c. notification_log — durable per-period dedupe for fan-out jobs
--
-- Keyed by (tenant_id, kid_id, event_type, period_key). The
-- notify-leaderboard-weekly function inserts a row before sending; the
-- UNIQUE constraint guarantees the push only fires once per ISO week
-- per (kid, event), no matter how many times the cron / operator
-- re-invokes the function. Other best-effort jobs can adopt the same
-- table by picking their own `period_key` convention (daily, hourly,
-- one-shot UUID, etc).
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.notification_log (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id      uuid NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id     uuid NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  event_type  text NOT NULL,
  period_key  text NOT NULL,
  sent_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_notification_log_kid_event_period
  ON public.notification_log (tenant_id, kid_id, event_type, period_key)
  WHERE kid_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_notification_log_user_event_period
  ON public.notification_log (tenant_id, user_id, event_type, period_key)
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND kid_id IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.notification_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
-- No client policies — service-role only.
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON public.notification_log TO service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7b. get_kid_weekly_rank_delta(p_kid_id) RPC
--
-- Returns how many ranks a kid has climbed (+) or dropped (-) over the
-- past 7 days within their own tenant. SECURITY DEFINER so the
-- reconstruction can read every kid + ledger row in the tenant — the
-- standard parent RLS on points_ledger hides other kids' deltas, which
-- would skew the old ranking. The function explicitly pins to the
-- caller's JWT tenant_id and verifies the kid lives in that tenant
-- before returning anything, so this widens read access by *exactly* the
-- one number the parent already needs (their own kid's rank delta) and
-- nothing else.
--
-- Returns NULL if the kid is not in the tenant's top-50 leaderboard
-- (matches the live RanksScreen cap).
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_kid_weekly_rank_delta(p_kid_id uuid)
RETURNS int
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_jwt_tenant_id uuid := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
  v_kid_tenant_id uuid;
  v_rank_now      int;
  v_rank_then     int;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'get_kid_weekly_rank_delta: not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;
  IF v_jwt_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'get_kid_weekly_rank_delta: missing tenant_id claim' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  -- `kids` has no direct tenant_id column — tenant lives on families.
  SELECT f.tenant_id
    INTO v_kid_tenant_id
    FROM public.kids k
    JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
   WHERE k.id = p_kid_id;
  IF v_kid_tenant_id IS NULL OR v_kid_tenant_id <> v_jwt_tenant_id THEN
    -- Refuse to leak across tenants. NULL signals "no rank data".
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  WITH top50 AS (
    SELECT k.id, k.points_balance
      FROM public.kids k
      JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
     WHERE f.tenant_id = v_jwt_tenant_id
     ORDER BY k.points_balance DESC
     LIMIT 50
  ),
  ranked_now AS (
    SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY points_balance DESC, id) AS rnk FROM top50
  ),
  recent AS (
    SELECT pl.kid_id, COALESCE(SUM(pl.delta), 0)::int AS d
      FROM public.points_ledger pl
     WHERE pl.tenant_id = v_jwt_tenant_id
       AND pl.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
     GROUP BY pl.kid_id
  ),
  ranked_then AS (
    SELECT t.id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             ORDER BY (t.points_balance - COALESCE(r.d, 0)) DESC, t.id
           ) AS rnk
      FROM top50 t
      LEFT JOIN recent r ON r.kid_id = t.id
  )
  SELECT (SELECT rnk FROM ranked_then WHERE id = p_kid_id),
         (SELECT rnk FROM ranked_now  WHERE id = p_kid_id)
    INTO v_rank_then, v_rank_now;

  IF v_rank_now IS NULL OR v_rank_then IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;

  -- Positive = climbed (lower rank number is better).
  RETURN v_rank_then - v_rank_now;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.get_kid_weekly_rank_delta(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_kid_weekly_rank_delta(uuid) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_kid_weekly_rank_delta(uuid) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260511000001_fix_handle_new_user_owner_admin.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Fix handle_new_user: skip families INSERT for owner / admin roles
-- =============================================================================
-- Previously the ELSE branch of handle_new_user inserted every non-coach
-- user into public.families as a parent. Owner and admin accounts created
-- via the admin API (app_role='owner'/'admin' in raw_user_meta_data) were
-- silently inserted as parent family rows. The custom_access_token_hook
-- then found those rows first and returned app_role='parent', causing the
-- portal to sign them out immediately on login.
--
-- Fix: add an ELSIF guard for 'owner' and 'admin' that just returns NEW
-- without touching any table. These roles are portal-only; they live only
-- in auth.users and are resolved by the hook's third fallback branch.
--
-- Also: delete the spurious family row for the existing owner account.
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. Remove the spurious family row created for the owner account.
DELETE FROM public.families
 WHERE parent_user_id = '75dfb0d3-1c53-49b8-a7b2-813ea33aab76';

-- 2. Update the trigger so future owner/admin accounts are never inserted
--    into public.families.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_slug         text;
  v_tenant_id           uuid;
  v_app_role            text;
  v_first_name          text;
  v_last_name           text;
  v_primary_location_id uuid;
BEGIN
  v_tenant_slug := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug';
  IF v_tenant_slug IS NULL OR v_tenant_slug = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'handle_new_user: tenant_slug missing from raw_user_meta_data';
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id FROM public.tenants WHERE slug = v_tenant_slug;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'handle_new_user: unknown tenant_slug %', v_tenant_slug;
  END IF;

  v_app_role := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role';

  IF v_app_role = 'coach' THEN
    v_first_name := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name';
    v_last_name  := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name';
    IF v_first_name IS NULL OR v_first_name = ''
       OR v_last_name  IS NULL OR v_last_name  = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'handle_new_user: app_role=coach requires first_name and last_name in raw_user_meta_data';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.coaches (
      tenant_id,
      user_id,
      first_name,
      last_name,
      is_active
    ) VALUES (
      v_tenant_id,
      NEW.id,
      v_first_name,
      v_last_name,
      true
    );

  ELSIF v_app_role IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
    -- Portal-only roles: no row needed in families or coaches.
    -- The custom_access_token_hook resolves them from raw_user_meta_data.
    NULL;

  ELSE
    -- Default: parent / family.
    SELECT id
      INTO v_primary_location_id
      FROM public.locations
     WHERE tenant_id = v_tenant_id
     ORDER BY name ASC
     LIMIT 1;

    INSERT INTO public.families (
      tenant_id,
      parent_user_id,
      parent_first_name,
      parent_last_name,
      parent_phone,
      parent_email,
      primary_location_id
    ) VALUES (
      v_tenant_id,
      NEW.id,
      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name', ''),
      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name', ''),
      NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone',
      NEW.email,
      v_primary_location_id
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM anon, authenticated;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- MEMBERSHIPS
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.memberships (
  id                     uuid        DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id              uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
  family_id              uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.families(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kid_id                 uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id)     ON DELETE CASCADE,
  plan_name              text        NOT NULL,
  plan_type              text        NOT NULL CHECK (plan_type IN ('eft','otc')),
  status                 text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                                     CHECK (status IN ('active','paused','cancelled')),
  amount_cents           integer     NOT NULL CHECK (amount_cents >= 0),
  billing_anchor_day     smallint    CHECK (billing_anchor_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28),
  stripe_subscription_id text,
  started_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  cancelled_at           timestamptz,
  created_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS memberships_tenant_idx   ON public.memberships (tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS memberships_kid_idx      ON public.memberships (kid_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS memberships_family_idx   ON public.memberships (family_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS memberships_status_idx   ON public.memberships (status);

-- PAYMENT EVENTS
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.payment_events (
  id                       uuid        DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id                uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
  family_id                uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.families(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  membership_id            uuid        REFERENCES public.memberships(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  amount_cents             integer     NOT NULL CHECK (amount_cents >= 0),
  status                   text        NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('paid','failed','refunded')),
  payment_method           text        NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('eft','card','cash')),
  stripe_payment_intent_id text,
  error_code               text,
  created_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payment_events_status_idx     ON public.payment_events (status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payment_events_created_idx    ON public.payment_events (created_at DESC);

-- ============================================================
-- Task #160 fix: least-privilege RLS correction.
--
-- Drops the over-privileged memberships_admin_all /
-- payment_events_admin_all (FOR ALL) policies created in
-- migration 000003 and replaces them with SELECT-only policies
-- for admin+owner.  Write access on these billing tables is
-- handled exclusively by service_role Edge Functions and the
-- existing memberships_service_all / payment_events_service_all
-- policies created in 000002.
-- ============================================================

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- memberships: drop FOR ALL, create SELECT-only for admin/owner
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='memberships' AND policyname='memberships_admin_all'
  ) THEN
    DROP POLICY memberships_admin_all ON public.memberships;
  END IF;
END $$;

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='memberships' AND policyname='memberships_admin_select'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY memberships_admin_select ON public.memberships
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING (
        tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
        AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('admin','owner')
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- payment_events: drop FOR ALL, create SELECT-only for admin/owner
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='payment_events' AND policyname='payment_events_admin_all'
  ) THEN
    DROP POLICY payment_events_admin_all ON public.payment_events;
  END IF;
END $$;

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='payment_events' AND policyname='payment_events_admin_select'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY payment_events_admin_select ON public.payment_events
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING (
        tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
        AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('admin','owner')
      );
  END IF;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260514000001_tenants_admin_update_policy.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — task #185: Allow admins to update their own tenant row
-- =============================================================================
-- The /admin/settings portal page needs to write tenants.hittrax_facility_id
-- (and future per-tenant fields) via the authenticated Supabase client.
-- Previously tenants only had a SELECT policy for authenticated users.
--
-- Policy is double-scoped:
--   1. tenant_id = the caller's JWT tenant_id claim  (no cross-tenant writes)
--   2. app_role IN ('admin', 'owner')                (no coach/parent writes)
--
-- GRANT UPDATE is column-specific: only the fields an operator may legitimately
-- change from the portal UI. id, slug, created_at, and the core brand fields
-- are intentionally excluded from this grant — schema changes and branding
-- updates remain a migration/Supabase dashboard operation for now.
-- =============================================================================

-- Row-level UPDATE policy: same-tenant AND admin/owner role.
CREATE POLICY tenants_update_admin ON public.tenants
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (
    id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('admin', 'owner')
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('admin', 'owner')
  );

-- Column-level grant: only allow updating the fields exposed in the portal
-- settings UI. Keeps the broad UPDATE GRANT from turning into accidental
-- schema / tenant-isolation damage if new columns are added later.
GRANT UPDATE (hittrax_facility_id) ON public.tenants TO authenticated;

-- ============================================================
-- Task #188: Stripe Connect Phase 1 — Location onboarding

ALTER TABLE public.tenants
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS royalty_config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"model":"per_transaction","rate":0.025}'::jsonb;

-- Ensure the Infinite Hitting tenant has the standard 2.5% per-transaction rate.
-- The NOT NULL + DEFAULT clause above back-fills existing rows on Supabase cloud,
-- so this UPDATE is redundant for fresh environments but harmless — it clarifies
-- intent and ensures the value is correct even if the back-fill behavior changes.
-- Migrations run once, so this will not overwrite manually-customized rates.
UPDATE public.tenants
SET royalty_config = '{"model":"per_transaction","rate":0.025}'::jsonb
WHERE id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- RLS — allow owners to update their location's Stripe fields
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Owners can SELECT their own tenant's locations (guard with IF NOT EXISTS
-- since an earlier migration may have created a similar policy).
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
      AND tablename  = 'locations'
      AND policyname = 'locations_owner_select'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY locations_owner_select ON public.locations
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING (
        tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
        AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('owner', 'admin')
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Owners can UPDATE their location row (Stripe onboarding fields only;
-- the API route uses the service-role client so this policy is a
-- defence-in-depth layer for future direct-client paths).
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
      AND tablename  = 'locations'
      AND policyname = 'locations_owner_update_stripe'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY locations_owner_update_stripe ON public.locations
      FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
      USING (
        tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
        AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('owner', 'admin')
      )
      WITH CHECK (
        tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
        AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('owner', 'admin')
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Service role keeps full access
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
      AND tablename  = 'locations'
      AND policyname = 'locations_service_all'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY locations_service_all ON public.locations
      FOR ALL TO service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Explicit DML grants so the new RLS UPDATE policy is reachable by the
-- authenticated role (base table grants are required in addition to policies).
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON public.locations TO authenticated;

  id         uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id    uuid        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name       text        NOT NULL,
  email      text        NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Updated custom_access_token_hook
--    Priority order: super_admin → parent/family → coach → owner/admin
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id   uuid;
  v_claims    jsonb;
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_family_id uuid;
  v_app_role  text;
  v_is_sa     boolean;
BEGIN
  v_user_id := (event->>'user_id')::uuid;
  v_claims  := COALESCE(event->'claims', '{}'::jsonb);

  -- 1. Super-admin check first (no tenant_id injected).
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.super_admins WHERE user_id = v_user_id)
    INTO v_is_sa;

  IF v_is_sa THEN
    v_claims := v_claims || jsonb_build_object('app_role', 'super_admin');
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 2. Try parent / family.
  SELECT tenant_id, id, role
    INTO v_tenant_id, v_family_id, v_app_role
    FROM public.families
   WHERE parent_user_id = v_user_id;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
           'family_id', v_family_id,
           'app_role',  'parent'
         );
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 3. Try coach.
  SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
    FROM public.coaches
   WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND is_active = true;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
           'app_role',  'coach'
         );
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 4. Fallback: owner / admin from raw_user_meta_data (portal-only roles).
  v_app_role := (
    SELECT raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role'
      FROM auth.users
     WHERE id = v_user_id
  );
  IF v_app_role IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id
      FROM public.tenants
     WHERE slug = (
       SELECT raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug'
         FROM auth.users
        WHERE id = v_user_id
     );
    IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_claims := v_claims
        || jsonb_build_object(
             'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
             'app_role',  v_app_role
           );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) TO supabase_auth_admin;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Updated handle_new_user — skip for super_admin (no tenant_slug needed)
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_slug         text;
  v_tenant_id           uuid;
  v_app_role            text;
  v_first_name          text;
  v_last_name           text;
  v_primary_location_id uuid;
BEGIN
  v_app_role := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role';

  -- Super-admin accounts are provisioned directly; no profile rows needed.
  IF v_app_role = 'super_admin' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_tenant_slug := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug';
  IF v_tenant_slug IS NULL OR v_tenant_slug = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'handle_new_user: tenant_slug missing from raw_user_meta_data';
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id FROM public.tenants WHERE slug = v_tenant_slug;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'handle_new_user: unknown tenant_slug %', v_tenant_slug;
  END IF;

  IF v_app_role = 'coach' THEN
    v_first_name := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name';
    v_last_name  := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name';
    IF v_first_name IS NULL OR v_first_name = ''
       OR v_last_name  IS NULL OR v_last_name  = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'handle_new_user: app_role=coach requires first_name and last_name in raw_user_meta_data';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.coaches (tenant_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, is_active)
    VALUES (v_tenant_id, NEW.id, v_first_name, v_last_name, true);

  ELSIF v_app_role IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
    NULL;

  ELSE
    SELECT id INTO v_primary_location_id
      FROM public.locations
     WHERE tenant_id = v_tenant_id
     ORDER BY name ASC
     LIMIT 1;

    INSERT INTO public.families (
      tenant_id, parent_user_id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name,
      parent_phone, parent_email, primary_location_id
    ) VALUES (
      v_tenant_id, NEW.id,
      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name', ''),
      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name', ''),
      NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone',
      NEW.email,
      v_primary_location_id
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM anon, authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260514000010_orders_payment_failed_status.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Add 'payment_failed' and 'payment_pending' statuses + failure_reason column
-- =============================================================================
-- 'payment_pending' — order created when Stripe PaymentIntent is created;
--   transitions to 'fulfilled' on PI confirmation (payment confirmed, item
--   ready for front-desk pickup), 'payment_failed' on hard failure, or
--   'cancelled' on PI cancellation (user dismissed payment sheet).
-- 'payment_failed'  — Stripe reported a hard failure; visible in portal.
-- 'failure_reason'  — human-readable Stripe decline message, stored so
--   portal can show actionable "Card declined: insufficient funds" text.
-- =============================================================================

ALTER TABLE public.orders

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260514000011_card_order_fulfillment.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Card order fulfillment support
-- =============================================================================
-- Three changes needed for Stripe Connect Phase 2 card checkout:
--
-- 1. reserve_product_inventory(p_product_id) → BOOLEAN
--    Called from stripe-create-payment-intent BEFORE creating the Stripe
--    PaymentIntent. Atomically decrements inventory_count WHERE > 0 and
--    returns TRUE if decrement happened, FALSE if already at 0 (sold out).
--    For unlimited-stock products (inventory_count IS NULL) always returns TRUE
--    (no decrement needed). Service-role only.
--
-- 2. restore_product_inventory(p_product_id)
--    Compensation function — increments inventory_count by 1 for finite-stock
--    products only. Called on PI creation failure (Edge Function) or on
--    payment_intent.canceled / payment_intent.payment_failed (webhook) to
--    return inventory that was reserved but never consumed. Service-role only.
--
-- 3. Update mark_redemption_fulfilled to accept card orders
--    The original RPC (v0.7) only allowed payment_method='points' orders.
--    Card orders (Stripe Phase 2) follow the same front-desk pickup flow:
--      payment_pending → ordered (webhook) → fulfilled (staff QR scan)
--    This migration removes the points-only guard so the existing portal
--    /admin/redemptions QR scanner works for card orders too.
-- =============================================================================

-- ─── 1. reserve_product_inventory ────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reserve_product_inventory(p_product_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_updated int;
  v_count   int;
BEGIN
  -- First check if this is a finite-stock product
  SELECT inventory_count INTO v_count FROM public.products WHERE id = p_product_id;

  -- Unlimited stock (NULL) — no decrement needed, always available
  IF v_count IS NULL THEN
    RETURN TRUE;
  END IF;

  -- Try to atomically decrement if still in stock
  UPDATE public.products
     SET inventory_count = inventory_count - 1,
         updated_at      = now()
   WHERE id = p_product_id
     AND inventory_count > 0;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_updated = ROW_COUNT;

  -- TRUE = reservation succeeded; FALSE = sold out (inventory was 0)
  RETURN v_updated > 0;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.reserve_product_inventory(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.reserve_product_inventory(uuid) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.reserve_product_inventory(uuid) TO service_role;

-- ─── 2. restore_product_inventory ────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_product_inventory(p_product_id uuid)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Only restore for finite-stock products (inventory_count IS NOT NULL).
  -- Unlimited products (NULL) were not decremented, so nothing to restore.
  UPDATE public.products
     SET inventory_count = inventory_count + 1,
         updated_at      = now()
   WHERE id = p_product_id
     AND inventory_count IS NOT NULL;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.restore_product_inventory(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.restore_product_inventory(uuid) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.restore_product_inventory(uuid) TO service_role;

-- ─── 3. Update mark_redemption_fulfilled to accept card orders ───────────────
-- Remove the payment_method='points' guard. Card orders in 'ordered' status
-- (payment confirmed by Stripe) may now be fulfilled at the front desk via
-- the existing QR scanner in /admin/redemptions. All other guards remain:
--   • admin-only (app_role='admin')
--   • tenant isolation (tenant_id matches JWT claim)
--   • status must be 'ordered' (not already fulfilled/cancelled)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(p_code text)
RETURNS public.orders
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id   uuid := auth.uid();
  v_app_role  text := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_jwt_tenant_id uuid;
  v_order     public.orders%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;
  IF v_app_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: caller is not an admin' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_jwt_tenant_id := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
  IF v_jwt_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: missing tenant_id claim' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders
    WHERE redemption_code = upper(btrim(p_code))
    FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: code % not found', p_code USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  IF v_order.tenant_id <> v_jwt_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: tenant mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_order.fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN v_order;  -- idempotent re-tap on an already-fulfilled order
  END IF;

  -- Guard: only 'ordered' status may be fulfilled (payment must be confirmed).
  -- Accepts both payment_method='points' and payment_method='card'.
  -- Cancelled, refunded, payment_failed, and payment_pending orders are terminal
  -- or not yet ready — refuse so a mistyped code never silently mutates state.
  IF v_order.status <> 'ordered' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: order % status is %, expected ordered',
      v_order.id, v_order.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.orders
     SET status               = 'fulfilled',
         fulfilled_at         = now(),
         fulfilled_by_user_id = v_user_id
   WHERE id = v_order.id
   RETURNING * INTO v_order;

  RETURN v_order;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260514000012_fix_parent_video_rls.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix coach_messages_insert_own_parent: avoid the same 42P17 RLS recursion
-- that was fixed for coaches in migration 20260507233000.
--
-- Cycle for parent video sends:
--   coach_messages_insert_own_parent (WITH CHECK) →
--     EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM videos v …)  →
--     videos SELECT RLS (videos_select_recipient_parent USING) →
--     EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coach_messages cm …) →
--     re-enters coach_messages policies → 42P17
--
-- Fix: introduce _video_is_parent_upload, a SECURITY DEFINER function that
-- bypasses videos SELECT RLS, and use it in the policy instead of the raw
-- EXISTS subquery.  Same pattern as _video_in_tenant from 20260507233000.
--
-- Text-only parent messages (video_id IS NULL) were NOT affected by this
-- cycle because the OR short-circuits. Only parent→coach video sends hit it.
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. Helper -----------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._video_is_parent_upload(
  p_video_id uuid,
  p_tenant_id uuid,
  p_user_id   uuid
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.videos v
    WHERE v.id                  = p_video_id
      AND v.tenant_id           = p_tenant_id
      AND v.uploaded_by_user_id = p_user_id
      AND v.purpose             = 'parent_to_coach'
  );
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._video_is_parent_upload(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._video_is_parent_upload(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public._video_is_parent_upload(uuid, uuid, uuid) IS
  'RLS-bypass helper: returns true iff the video was uploaded by the given user'
  ' for parent_to_coach purpose in the given tenant. Used by'
  ' coach_messages_insert_own_parent to avoid the videos<->coach_messages RLS'
  ' cycle that causes 42P17 (same pattern as _video_in_tenant in 20260507233000).';


-- 2. Rewrite the parent INSERT policy to use the helper --------------------

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coach_messages_insert_own_parent ON public.coach_messages;

CREATE POLICY coach_messages_insert_own_parent ON public.coach_messages
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    tenant_id        = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND sender_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'parent'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.kids k
        JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
       WHERE k.id              = coach_messages.recipient_kid_id
         AND f.id              = coach_messages.recipient_family_id
         AND f.parent_user_id  = auth.uid()
         AND f.tenant_id       = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
    AND coach_messages.recipient_coach_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.coaches c
       WHERE c.user_id   = coach_messages.recipient_coach_user_id
         AND c.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
    AND (
      coach_messages.video_id IS NULL
      OR public._video_is_parent_upload(
           coach_messages.video_id,
           (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid,
           auth.uid()
         )
    )
  );

COMMENT ON POLICY coach_messages_insert_own_parent ON public.coach_messages IS
  'v0.7 task #120 — parent can INSERT a row addressed to one of their own kids.'
  ' If a video is attached it must be the parent''s own parent_to_coach upload'
  ' in the same tenant. Uses _video_is_parent_upload (SECURITY DEFINER) to'
  ' break the videos<->coach_messages RLS cycle (fixed in 20260514000012;'
  ' same pattern as coaches in 20260507233000).';

-- ============================================================
-- Task #189: Stripe Connect Phase 3 — Recurring Subscription Billing
-- ============================================================

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. Add payment_overdue to memberships status enum
--    The inline CHECK constraint must be dropped and recreated.
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DO $$ DECLARE
  c_name text;
BEGIN
  SELECT conname INTO c_name
  FROM pg_constraint
  WHERE conrelid = 'public.memberships'::regclass
    AND contype = 'c'
    AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%status%';

  IF c_name IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE public.memberships DROP CONSTRAINT ' || quote_ident(c_name);
  END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD CONSTRAINT memberships_status_check
    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'paused', 'cancelled', 'payment_overdue'));

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. Add stripe_invoice_id to payment_events for idempotency
--    NOTE: NOT unique — one invoice can produce both a failed
--    row (attempt 1) and a paid row (successful retry).
--    Idempotency is handled at the application layer by checking
--    (stripe_invoice_id, status) before inserting.
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.payment_events
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripe_invoice_id text;

-- If a unique index was created by a previous migration version, drop it first
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS payment_events_stripe_invoice_id_uniq;

-- Non-unique index for fast lookups by invoice
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payment_events_stripe_invoice_id_idx
  ON public.payment_events (stripe_invoice_id)
  WHERE stripe_invoice_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. Ensure stripe_subscription_id exists on memberships
--    (already added in the initial schema, but guard for safety)
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripe_subscription_id text;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS memberships_stripe_sub_idx
  ON public.memberships (stripe_subscription_id)
  WHERE stripe_subscription_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 4. Track next billing date for portal display
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS next_billing_at timestamptz;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 5. Canonical Stripe Price ID per membership plan
--    Stored on first subscription activation; reused on every
--    subsequent activation to avoid Stripe price sprawl and
--    ensure consistent plan→Price mapping in Stripe reporting.
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripe_price_id text;

ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancelled_at timestamptz;

-- cancel_at: when cancel_at_period_end=true, Stripe returns the timestamp of
-- the next period boundary when the subscription will terminate. Persisting this
-- lets the portal display a consistent "Cancels on <date>" badge across page
-- reloads without re-querying Stripe.
ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancel_at timestamptz;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 6. Separate customer IDs for platform vs connected accounts
--    families.stripe_customer_id → platform-account customer
--      (used by stripe-create-payment-intent for store checkout)
--    families.stripe_connected_customer_id → connected-account customer
--      (used by stripe-setup-intent + stripe-create-subscription
--       for EFT membership subscriptions on the location account)
--    Keeping them in separate columns prevents a connected-account
--    customer ID from being passed to platform-account API calls
--    (which would cause "No such customer" errors).
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.families
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripe_connected_customer_id text;

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Phase 1c: coach_locations junction table
-- =============================================================================
-- Adds a coach_locations junction table so a coach can be linked to multiple
-- locations. coaches.primary_location_id is LEFT UNCHANGED and remains the
-- source of truth for all Phase 1 queries.
--
-- Backfills one row per coach whose primary_location_id is non-null.
-- All four RLS policies are defined below.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Table
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE public.coach_locations (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  coach_id    uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.coaches(id)   ON DELETE CASCADE,
  location_id uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  is_primary  boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT coach_locations_unique_pair UNIQUE (coach_id, location_id)
);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Indexes
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE INDEX idx_coach_locations_coach_id    ON public.coach_locations(coach_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_coach_locations_location_id ON public.coach_locations(location_id);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Backfill: one row per coach with a non-null primary_location_id
--    is_primary = true mirrors coaches.primary_location_id.
--    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes this idempotent on re-run.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO public.coach_locations (coach_id, location_id, is_primary)
SELECT id, primary_location_id, true
  FROM public.coaches
 WHERE primary_location_id IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (coach_id, location_id) DO NOTHING;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. RLS
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.coach_locations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Coaches can SELECT their own rows.
CREATE POLICY coach_locations_select_own ON public.coach_locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    coach_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.coaches WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- Owners can SELECT all rows scoped to their tenant's locations.
CREATE POLICY coach_locations_owner_select ON public.coach_locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'owner'
    AND location_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.locations
       WHERE tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  );

-- Admins can SELECT all rows scoped to their tenant's locations.
CREATE POLICY coach_locations_admin_select ON public.coach_locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND location_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.locations
       WHERE tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  );

-- Owners and admins can INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE rows scoped to their tenant.
CREATE POLICY coach_locations_owner_manage ON public.coach_locations
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('owner', 'admin')
    AND location_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.locations
       WHERE tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('owner', 'admin')
    AND location_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.locations
       WHERE tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  );


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. Grants
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.coach_locations TO authenticated;

=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260522000000_fix_handle_new_user_location.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Phase 1a: Fix handle_new_user to honour selected location at signup
-- =============================================================================
-- Root cause: the trigger ignored the `location_id` passed in signup metadata
-- and always assigned `primary_location_id` by picking the alphabetically-first
-- location. For any tenant with more than one location this silently placed
-- every new user at the wrong facility.
--
-- Changes in this migration (function body only — no table/RLS changes):
--
--   Parent branch:
--     Before the alphabetical fallback, attempt to resolve `primary_location_id`
--     from `(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'location_id')::uuid`.
--     Validate: the UUID must exist in public.locations AND have a matching
--     tenant_id AND is_active = true.  If valid → use it.
--     If null/invalid/cross-tenant → fall back to alphabetical-first (unchanged).
--
--   Coach branch:
--     Apply the same metadata → validate → fallback logic to populate
--     coaches.primary_location_id (previously always left NULL).
--
-- Guards preserved:
--   - super_admin early-return (20260514000003_super_admin.sql)
--   - owner/admin NULL-branch  (20260511000001_fix_handle_new_user_owner_admin.sql)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_slug         text;
  v_tenant_id           uuid;
  v_app_role            text;
  v_first_name          text;
  v_last_name           text;
  v_requested_loc_id    uuid;
  v_primary_location_id uuid;
BEGIN
  v_app_role := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role';

  -- Super-admin accounts are provisioned directly; no profile rows needed.
  IF v_app_role = 'super_admin' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_tenant_slug := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug';
  IF v_tenant_slug IS NULL OR v_tenant_slug = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'handle_new_user: tenant_slug missing from raw_user_meta_data';
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id FROM public.tenants WHERE slug = v_tenant_slug;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'handle_new_user: unknown tenant_slug %', v_tenant_slug;
  END IF;

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Shared location resolution (runs before the coach/parent branch).
  -- Step 1: Try to parse the location_id from signup metadata.
  --         A missing or malformed value is silently treated as NULL
  --         (no exception surfaced to the user).
  -- Step 2: If parsed, validate it belongs to this tenant and is active.
  --         Cross-tenant UUIDs and inactive locations are silently rejected.
  -- Step 3: Fall back to the alphabetically-first location for the tenant
  --         when no valid location was obtained (preserves existing behaviour).
  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BEGIN
    v_requested_loc_id := (NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'location_id')::uuid;
  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN
    v_requested_loc_id := NULL;
  END;

  IF v_requested_loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_primary_location_id
      FROM public.locations
     WHERE id        = v_requested_loc_id
       AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id
       AND is_active = true;
  END IF;

  IF v_primary_location_id IS NULL THEN
    -- Fallback: alphabetical-first location (unchanged from previous behaviour).
    SELECT id INTO v_primary_location_id
      FROM public.locations
     WHERE tenant_id = v_tenant_id
     ORDER BY name ASC
     LIMIT 1;
  END IF;

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Branch on app_role.
  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IF v_app_role = 'coach' THEN
    v_first_name := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name';
    v_last_name  := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name';
    IF v_first_name IS NULL OR v_first_name = ''
       OR v_last_name  IS NULL OR v_last_name  = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'handle_new_user: app_role=coach requires first_name and last_name in raw_user_meta_data';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.coaches (
      tenant_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, is_active, primary_location_id
    ) VALUES (
      v_tenant_id, NEW.id, v_first_name, v_last_name, true, v_primary_location_id
    );

  ELSIF v_app_role IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
    -- Portal-only roles: no row needed in families or coaches.
    NULL;

  ELSE
    -- Default: parent / family.
    INSERT INTO public.families (
      tenant_id, parent_user_id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name,
      parent_phone, parent_email, primary_location_id
    ) VALUES (
      v_tenant_id, NEW.id,
      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name', ''),
      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name', ''),
      NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone',
      NEW.email,
      v_primary_location_id
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM anon, authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260523000001_get_coach_hours_rpc.sql
=================================================================================
-- ============================================================
-- Task #244: get_coach_hours RPC
--
-- Aggregates bookings by coach for a given tenant + date range.
-- Returns one row per coach with counts by status and total
-- completed hours (computed from scheduled_start/scheduled_end).
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_coach_hours(
  p_tenant_id  uuid,
  p_start_date date,
  p_end_date   date
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  coach_id          uuid,
  coach_name        text,
  confirmed_count   bigint,
  completed_count   bigint,
  no_show_count     bigint,
  cancelled_count   bigint,
  total_hours       numeric
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT
    c.id                                                     AS coach_id,
    (c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name)                    AS coach_name,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'confirmed')           AS confirmed_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'completed')           AS completed_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'no_show')             AS no_show_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'cancelled')           AS cancelled_count,
    COALESCE(
      ROUND(
        SUM(
          EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.scheduled_end - b.scheduled_start)) / 3600.0
        ) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'completed')
      , 2),
      0
    )                                                        AS total_hours
  FROM public.coaches c
  LEFT JOIN public.bookings b
    ON  b.coach_id  = c.id
    AND b.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND b.scheduled_start >= p_start_date::timestamptz
    AND b.scheduled_start <  (p_end_date + 1)::timestamptz
  WHERE c.tenant_id  = p_tenant_id
    AND c.is_active  = true
  GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name
  ORDER BY coach_name;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_coach_hours(uuid, date, date) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260524000000_membership_pause.sql

-- ============================================================
-- Task #240: Membership pause flow
-- Adds pause columns to memberships, a parent SELECT policy,
-- and SECURITY DEFINER RPCs for pause / resume.
-- ============================================================

-- ── Pause columns ───────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pause_start  date,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pause_end    date,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paused_at    timestamptz;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS memberships_pause_end_idx
  ON public.memberships (pause_end)
  WHERE status = 'paused';

-- ── Parent can read their own family's memberships ──────────
-- (Used by the mobile app useMembership hook.)
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
      AND tablename  = 'memberships'
      AND policyname = 'memberships_parent_select'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY memberships_parent_select ON public.memberships
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING (
        (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'parent'
        AND family_id IN (
          SELECT id FROM public.families
          WHERE parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        )
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- ── pause_membership RPC ────────────────────────────────────
-- Derives caller identity from auth.jwt() / auth.uid() — never from
-- caller-supplied parameters. Granted only to 'authenticated'.
--
-- Validates:
--   1. Caller is 'parent' (own family) or 'owner'/'admin' (same tenant)
--   2. EFT membership, active status, 7–90 day window
--   3. No other membership in same family currently paused (overlap guard)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pause_membership(
  p_membership_id uuid,
  p_pause_end     date
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller_role   text;
  v_caller_id     uuid;
  v_caller_tenant text;
  v_mem           record;
  v_today         date := current_date;
  v_overlap_count int;
BEGIN
  -- Derive caller identity from JWT (never trust caller-supplied params)
  v_caller_role   := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_id     := auth.uid();
  v_caller_tenant := auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id';

  IF v_caller_role IS NULL OR v_caller_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'unauthorized');
  END IF;

  -- Only parents and owners/admins can pause memberships
  IF v_caller_role NOT IN ('parent', 'owner', 'admin') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
  END IF;

  -- Load membership row
  SELECT m.id, m.plan_type, m.status, m.tenant_id, m.family_id, f.parent_user_id
    INTO v_mem
    FROM public.memberships m
    JOIN public.families    f ON f.id = m.family_id
   WHERE m.id = p_membership_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_found');
  END IF;

  -- Scope enforcement
  IF v_caller_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF v_mem.parent_user_id <> v_caller_id THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  ELSE
    -- owner / admin must be in the same tenant
    IF v_caller_tenant IS NULL OR v_mem.tenant_id::text <> v_caller_tenant THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Business rule validations
  IF v_mem.plan_type <> 'eft' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_eft');
  END IF;
  IF v_mem.status = 'paused' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_paused');
  END IF;
  IF v_mem.status <> 'active' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_active');
  END IF;
  IF p_pause_end < v_today + 7 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'pause_too_short');
  END IF;
  IF p_pause_end > v_today + 90 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'pause_too_long');
  END IF;

  -- Family-level overlap prevention:
  -- Reject if any OTHER membership in the same family is currently paused.
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_overlap_count
    FROM public.memberships
   WHERE family_id = v_mem.family_id
     AND id       <> p_membership_id
     AND status    = 'paused'
     AND pause_end >= v_today;

  IF v_overlap_count > 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'family_already_paused');
  END IF;

  -- Apply pause
  UPDATE public.memberships
     SET status      = 'paused',
         pause_start = v_today,
         pause_end   = p_pause_end,
         paused_at   = now(),
         updated_at  = now()
   WHERE id = p_membership_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'pause_start', v_today, 'pause_end', p_pause_end);
END;
$$;

-- Only authenticated users may call this RPC; internal auth derived from JWT.
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pause_membership(uuid, date) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.pause_membership(uuid, date) TO authenticated;

-- ── resume_membership RPC ───────────────────────────────────
-- Same JWT-derived auth model. Callable by parents (own family) and
-- owners/admins (same tenant). The nightly cron uses a direct service-role
-- UPDATE instead of this RPC (see resume-paused-memberships edge function).
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resume_membership(
  p_membership_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller_role   text;
  v_caller_id     uuid;
  v_caller_tenant text;
  v_mem           record;
BEGIN
  -- Derive caller identity from JWT
  v_caller_role   := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_id     := auth.uid();
  v_caller_tenant := auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id';

  IF v_caller_role IS NULL OR v_caller_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'unauthorized');
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role NOT IN ('parent', 'owner', 'admin') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
  END IF;

  SELECT m.id, m.status, m.tenant_id, f.parent_user_id
    INTO v_mem
    FROM public.memberships m
    JOIN public.families    f ON f.id = m.family_id
   WHERE m.id = p_membership_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_found');
  END IF;

  -- Scope enforcement
  IF v_caller_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF v_mem.parent_user_id <> v_caller_id THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF v_caller_tenant IS NULL OR v_mem.tenant_id::text <> v_caller_tenant THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_mem.status <> 'paused' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_paused');
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.memberships
     SET status      = 'active',
         pause_start = NULL,
         pause_end   = NULL,
         paused_at   = NULL,
         updated_at  = now()
   WHERE id     = p_membership_id
     AND status = 'paused';  -- idempotency guard

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.resume_membership(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.resume_membership(uuid) TO authenticated;

-- ── pg_cron: auto-resume schedule ───────────────────────────
-- Registers a daily job at 06:00 UTC that calls the
-- resume-paused-memberships Edge Function via pg_net.
--
-- Prerequisites (run once per environment, not in migration):
--   ALTER DATABASE postgres SET app.settings.supabase_url = '<url>';
--   ALTER DATABASE postgres SET app.settings.service_role_key = '<key>';
--   SELECT pg_reload_conf();
--
-- Idempotent: unschedule-then-schedule, skipped if pg_cron not installed.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron'
  ) THEN
    PERFORM cron.unschedule('resume-paused-memberships-daily');
    PERFORM cron.schedule(
      'resume-paused-memberships-daily',
      '0 6 * * *',
      $cron$
        SELECT net.http_post(
          url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url')
                     || '/functions/v1/resume-paused-memberships',
          headers := jsonb_build_object(
            'Content-Type', 'application/json',
            'Authorization', 'Bearer '
              || current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key')
          ),
          body    := '{}'::jsonb
        );
      $cron$
    );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Allow owners to update any booking in their tenant.
-- Needed for cage assignment, status changes, and cancellations from the portal.
-- Mirrors the existing bookings_owner_select policy (same tenant_id check).

CREATE POLICY bookings_owner_update ON public.bookings
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'owner'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'owner'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  );

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260525000001_fix_coaches_rls_recursion.sql

-- Fix infinite RLS recursion: coaches ↔ coach_locations cycle
--
-- Root cause (introduced when coaches_admin_select_staff_locations was added):
--   1. Any query on bookings JOINs coaches
--   2. coaches RLS evaluates coaches_admin_select_staff_locations
--      → subquery on coach_locations
--   3. coach_locations RLS evaluates coach_locations_select_own
--      → subquery on coaches  ← triggers coaches RLS again → ∞
--
-- Fix: replace the coaches subquery inside coach_locations_select_own with a
-- SECURITY DEFINER helper that bypasses RLS, breaking the cycle at step 3.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_coach_id()
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT id FROM public.coaches WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_coach_id() TO authenticated;

-- Recreate the policy using the SECURITY DEFINER function (no coaches RLS triggered)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coach_locations_select_own ON public.coach_locations;

CREATE POLICY coach_locations_select_own ON public.coach_locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (coach_id = public.get_my_coach_id());

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260525000002_fix_checkin_rpcs_service_role.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix check-in RPCs to accept service-role callers (portal server actions).
--
-- The portal's server actions use the service-role client so they can bypass
-- the missing app_role JWT claim in production. The service-role JWT carries
-- { "role": "service_role" } but not app_role / tenant_id, so the original
-- role gate (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') raises PERMISSION_DENIED.
--
-- Fix: when auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role', skip all JWT-based checks
-- and use the booking row's own tenant_id for isolation. The server action has
-- already verified the caller's identity via supabase.auth.getUser() and
-- app_metadata before invoking the service client.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- check_in_booking
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role        text;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_coach_id    uuid;
  v_booking     public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  -- Detect service-role caller (trusted portal server action).
  -- Service-role JWTs carry { "role": "service_role" } but no app_role claim.
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Lock the booking row
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- Tenant isolation
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    -- Role-specific location/ownership scoping
    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id INTO v_coach_id
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;
      IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Idempotent: already completed
  IF v_booking.status = 'completed' THEN
    RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
  END IF;

  -- Only pending/confirmed may be checked in
  IF v_booking.status NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS: booking is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0003';
  END IF;

  -- Mark completed (fires award_booking_completion_points trigger)
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'completed',
         attended_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- Create sessions row if one doesn't exist for this booking
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
  ) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.sessions (
      tenant_id, kid_id, coach_id, booking_id,
      capture_source, started_at, ended_at
    ) VALUES (
      v_booking.tenant_id, v_booking.kid_id, v_booking.coach_id, p_booking_id,
      'none', v_booking.scheduled_start, v_booking.scheduled_end
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- mark_no_show
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_no_show(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role        text;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_coach_id    uuid;
  v_booking     public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id INTO v_coach_id
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;
      IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Idempotent
  IF v_booking.status = 'no_show' THEN
    RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
  END IF;

  IF v_booking.status NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS: booking is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0003';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'no_show',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.mark_no_show(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_no_show(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- undo_check_in
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role        text;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_coach_id    uuid;
  v_booking     public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta       int;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id INTO v_coach_id
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;
      IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Must be completed to undo
  IF v_booking.status != 'completed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_CHECKED_IN: booking status is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0004';
  END IF;

  -- 5-minute undo window
  IF v_booking.attended_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0005';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'confirmed',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  DELETE FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id;

  SELECT delta INTO v_delta
    FROM public.points_ledger
   WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
     AND reference_type = 'booking'
     AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
     AND reason         = 'session_attended';

  IF FOUND AND v_delta IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
       AND reference_type = 'booking'
       AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
       AND reason         = 'session_attended';

    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = GREATEST(0, points_balance - v_delta)
     WHERE id = v_booking.kid_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
