FILE: supabase/migrations/20260525000003_fix_memberships_parent_rls.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix memberships table permissions for mobile app (parent users).
--
-- Problem 1: No GRANT SELECT on memberships to authenticated role.
--            The error is explicit: "permission denied for table memberships
--            (hint: GRANT SELECT ON public.memberships TO authenticated)"
--
-- Problem 2: All existing parent SELECT policies check
--            (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'parent'
--            In production the Custom Access Token Hook may not have run
--            for the current session, so app_role is absent from the JWT.
--            The policy never matches → permission denied even after the GRANT.
--
-- Fix: GRANT + rewrite parent policy to use auth.uid() directly (no JWT
--      claim required). Matching families.parent_user_id = auth.uid() is
--      the ground-truth ownership check — no role claim needed.
-- =============================================================================

-- Grant table-level SELECT so RLS policies can be evaluated at all.
GRANT SELECT ON public.memberships TO authenticated;

-- Remove stale parent policies that relied on the JWT app_role claim.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS memberships_parent_self   ON public.memberships;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS memberships_parent_select ON public.memberships;

-- Recreate without the JWT claim dependency.
-- A user can read memberships where they are the parent of the family.
CREATE POLICY memberships_parent_select ON public.memberships
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    family_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.families
       WHERE parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260525000004_fix_pause_resume_rpc_role_fallback.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix pause_membership + resume_membership RPCs: role-claim fallback
--
-- Problem: both RPCs derive app_role via  auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role'.
-- When the Custom Access Token Hook is absent / not yet configured, this
-- returns NULL → the RPCs immediately return 'unauthorized'.
--
-- Fix: if the JWT claim is absent but auth.uid() is present, look up the
-- families table. If the caller's uid matches a parent_user_id they are a
-- parent; otherwise leave the role NULL (still unauthorized for non-parents).
-- Owner/admin paths continue to require an explicit JWT claim.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pause_membership(
  p_membership_id uuid,
  p_pause_end     date
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller_role   text;
  v_caller_id     uuid;
  v_caller_tenant text;
  v_mem           record;
  v_today         date := current_date;
  v_overlap_count int;
BEGIN
  v_caller_role   := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_id     := auth.uid();
  v_caller_tenant := auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id';

  IF v_caller_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'unauthorized');
  END IF;

  -- Fallback: if app_role claim is absent, derive role from DB tables.
  -- Owners/admins must always have the explicit JWT claim.
  IF v_caller_role IS NULL THEN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.families WHERE parent_user_id = v_caller_id LIMIT 1) THEN
      v_caller_role := 'parent';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role IS NULL OR v_caller_role NOT IN ('parent', 'owner', 'admin') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
  END IF;

  SELECT m.id, m.plan_type, m.status, m.tenant_id, m.family_id, f.parent_user_id
    INTO v_mem
    FROM public.memberships m
    JOIN public.families    f ON f.id = m.family_id
   WHERE m.id = p_membership_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_found');
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF v_mem.parent_user_id <> v_caller_id THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF v_caller_tenant IS NULL OR v_mem.tenant_id::text <> v_caller_tenant THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_mem.plan_type <> 'eft' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_eft');
  END IF;
  IF v_mem.status = 'paused' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_paused');
  END IF;
  IF v_mem.status <> 'active' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_active');
  END IF;
  IF p_pause_end < v_today + 7 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'pause_too_short');
  END IF;
  IF p_pause_end > v_today + 90 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'pause_too_long');
  END IF;

  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_overlap_count
    FROM public.memberships
   WHERE family_id = v_mem.family_id
     AND id       <> p_membership_id
     AND status    = 'paused'
     AND pause_end >= v_today;

  IF v_overlap_count > 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'family_already_paused');
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.memberships
     SET status      = 'paused',
         pause_start = v_today,
         pause_end   = p_pause_end,
         paused_at   = now(),
         updated_at  = now()
   WHERE id = p_membership_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'pause_start', v_today, 'pause_end', p_pause_end);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pause_membership(uuid, date) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.pause_membership(uuid, date) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resume_membership(
  p_membership_id uuid
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller_role   text;
  v_caller_id     uuid;
  v_caller_tenant text;
  v_mem           record;
BEGIN
  v_caller_role   := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_id     := auth.uid();
  v_caller_tenant := auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id';

  IF v_caller_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'unauthorized');
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role IS NULL THEN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.families WHERE parent_user_id = v_caller_id LIMIT 1) THEN
      v_caller_role := 'parent';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role IS NULL OR v_caller_role NOT IN ('parent', 'owner', 'admin') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
  END IF;

  SELECT m.id, m.status, m.tenant_id, f.parent_user_id
    INTO v_mem
    FROM public.memberships m
    JOIN public.families    f ON f.id = m.family_id
   WHERE m.id = p_membership_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_found');
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF v_mem.parent_user_id <> v_caller_id THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF v_caller_tenant IS NULL OR v_mem.tenant_id::text <> v_caller_tenant THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_mem.status <> 'paused' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_paused');
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.memberships
     SET status      = 'active',
         pause_start = NULL,
         pause_end   = NULL,
         paused_at   = NULL,
         updated_at  = now()
   WHERE id     = p_membership_id
     AND status = 'paused';

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.resume_membership(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.resume_membership(uuid) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260525000005_fix_pause_rpc_min_days_tz.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Lower pause_membership minimum days from 7 to 6 to absorb timezone skew.
--
-- Problem: clients in UTC-N timezones send "7 days from local today" which
-- arrives at the UTC server as 6 days ahead. The RPC check
--   IF p_pause_end < v_today + 7
-- then rejects it as "pause_too_short" even though the user picked 1 week.
--
-- Fix: change the boundary to v_today + 6 (i.e. accept pause_end that is at
-- least 6 days after the server's UTC current_date). The 1-day buffer covers
-- UTC-11 … UTC+0. Clients are never in a positive UTC offset large enough to
-- push the date backwards by a day.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pause_membership(
  p_membership_id uuid,
  p_pause_end     date
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_caller_role   text;
  v_caller_id     uuid;
  v_caller_tenant text;
  v_mem           record;
  v_today         date := current_date;
  v_overlap_count int;
BEGIN
  v_caller_role   := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_id     := auth.uid();
  v_caller_tenant := auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id';

  IF v_caller_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'unauthorized');
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role IS NULL THEN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.families WHERE parent_user_id = v_caller_id LIMIT 1) THEN
      v_caller_role := 'parent';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role IS NULL OR v_caller_role NOT IN ('parent', 'owner', 'admin') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
  END IF;

  SELECT m.id, m.plan_type, m.status, m.tenant_id, m.family_id, f.parent_user_id
    INTO v_mem
    FROM public.memberships m
    JOIN public.families    f ON f.id = m.family_id
   WHERE m.id = p_membership_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_found');
  END IF;

  IF v_caller_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF v_mem.parent_user_id <> v_caller_id THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF v_caller_tenant IS NULL OR v_mem.tenant_id::text <> v_caller_tenant THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'forbidden');
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_mem.plan_type <> 'eft' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_eft');
  END IF;
  IF v_mem.status = 'paused' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_paused');
  END IF;
  IF v_mem.status <> 'active' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'not_active');
  END IF;

  -- 6 days (not 7) to absorb up to 1 day of UTC-offset skew from the client.
  IF p_pause_end < v_today + 6 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'pause_too_short');
  END IF;
  IF p_pause_end > v_today + 91 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'pause_too_long');
  END IF;

  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_overlap_count
    FROM public.memberships
   WHERE family_id = v_mem.family_id
     AND id       <> p_membership_id
     AND status    = 'paused'
     AND pause_end >= v_today;

  IF v_overlap_count > 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'family_already_paused');
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.memberships
     SET status      = 'paused',
         pause_start = v_today,
         pause_end   = p_pause_end,
         paused_at   = now(),
         updated_at  = now()
   WHERE id = p_membership_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'pause_start', v_today, 'pause_end', p_pause_end);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pause_membership(uuid, date) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.pause_membership(uuid, date) TO authenticated;

=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260527000003_fix_handle_new_user_no_is_active.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix handle_new_user: remove is_active filter from location validation.
-- =============================================================================
-- The locations table does not have an is_active column in the live database,
-- so the trigger was crashing with "unexpected_failure" whenever a location_id
-- was passed in signup metadata (i.e. whenever the location picker was used).
-- Remove the is_active predicate from both the validation query and the
-- fallback query. Location availability is managed at the app layer.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_slug         text;
  v_tenant_id           uuid;
  v_app_role            text;
  v_first_name          text;
  v_last_name           text;
  v_requested_loc_id    uuid;
  v_primary_location_id uuid;
BEGIN
  v_app_role := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role';

  -- Super-admin accounts are provisioned directly; no profile rows needed.
  IF v_app_role = 'super_admin' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_tenant_slug := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug';
  IF v_tenant_slug IS NULL OR v_tenant_slug = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'handle_new_user: tenant_slug missing from raw_user_meta_data';
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id FROM public.tenants WHERE slug = v_tenant_slug;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'handle_new_user: unknown tenant_slug %', v_tenant_slug;
  END IF;

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Location resolution.
  -- Step 1: Parse location_id from signup metadata (invalid UUID → NULL).
  -- Step 2: Validate it belongs to this tenant (cross-tenant UUIDs rejected).
  -- Step 3: Fall back to alphabetically-first location if none resolved.
  -- NOTE: No is_active filter — that column does not exist on locations.
  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BEGIN
    v_requested_loc_id := (NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'location_id')::uuid;
  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN
    v_requested_loc_id := NULL;
  END;

  IF v_requested_loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_primary_location_id
      FROM public.locations
     WHERE id        = v_requested_loc_id
       AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_primary_location_id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_primary_location_id
      FROM public.locations
     WHERE tenant_id = v_tenant_id
     ORDER BY name ASC
     LIMIT 1;
  END IF;

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Branch on app_role.
  -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IF v_app_role = 'coach' THEN
    v_first_name := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name';
    v_last_name  := NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name';
    IF v_first_name IS NULL OR v_first_name = ''
       OR v_last_name  IS NULL OR v_last_name  = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'handle_new_user: app_role=coach requires first_name and last_name in raw_user_meta_data';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.coaches (
      tenant_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, is_active, primary_location_id
    ) VALUES (
      v_tenant_id, NEW.id, v_first_name, v_last_name, true, v_primary_location_id
    );

  ELSIF v_app_role IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
    NULL;

  ELSE
    INSERT INTO public.families (
      tenant_id, parent_user_id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name,
      parent_phone, parent_email, primary_location_id
    ) VALUES (
      v_tenant_id, NEW.id,
      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name', ''),
      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name', ''),
      NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone',
      NEW.email,
      v_primary_location_id
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() FROM anon, authenticated;


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260601000000_phase2_staff_locations.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Phase 2, Step 1: staff_locations table
-- =============================================================================
-- Junction table that tracks which locations each admin/owner portal user
-- is assigned to. Owners are tenant-wide by role; admins are scoped to
-- their staff_locations entries.
--
-- A separate backfill script (scripts/backfill-staff-locations.mjs) must be
-- run and confirmed complete BEFORE applying step 3
-- (20260601000003_phase2_admin_rls_staff_locations.sql). Running that
-- migration without completing the backfill will lock admins out of their
-- own data.
--
-- Do NOT include the backfill in this migration — it must be a separate,
-- audited, human-run step.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Table
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE public.staff_locations (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  tenant_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  location_id uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT staff_locations_unique_pair UNIQUE (user_id, location_id)
);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Indexes
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE INDEX idx_staff_locations_user_id    ON public.staff_locations(user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_staff_locations_tenant_id  ON public.staff_locations(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_staff_locations_location_id ON public.staff_locations(location_id);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. RLS
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.staff_locations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Owners can SELECT all rows for their tenant.
CREATE POLICY staff_locations_owner_select ON public.staff_locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'owner'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  );

-- Admins can SELECT their own rows (to know which locations they manage).
CREATE POLICY staff_locations_admin_select_own ON public.staff_locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND user_id = auth.uid()
  );

-- Owners can manage all staff_locations for their tenant.
-- WITH CHECK enforces that location_id also belongs to the same tenant,
-- preventing insertion of (tenant_id, foreign_location_id) pairs even when
-- the owner knows a location UUID from another tenant.
CREATE POLICY staff_locations_owner_manage ON public.staff_locations
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'owner'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'owner'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.locations l
       WHERE l.id = location_id
         AND l.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
  );

-- Super admin: cross-tenant visibility.
CREATE POLICY staff_locations_super_admin ON public.staff_locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING ((auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'super_admin');


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Grants
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.staff_locations TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260601000002_phase2_booking_location_trigger.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Phase 2, Step 3: booking location validation trigger
-- =============================================================================
-- A BEFORE INSERT trigger on public.bookings that enforces the
-- allow_cross_location_booking flag from tenant_config.
--
-- When the flag is false, a booking whose location_id differs from the
-- family's primary_location_id is rejected with a descriptive error.
--
-- Key properties:
--   - Only fires on INSERT (existing bookings are never touched).
--   - Reads tenant_config directly; no extra index needed (unique on tenant_id).
--   - Resolves family via kid_id → kids.family_id → families.primary_location_id.
--   - When tenant_config row is missing it defaults to allow = false (safe).
--   - Exception message uses a machine-readable code for client handling.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Trigger function
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_booking_location()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_family_primary_location_id uuid;
  v_allow_cross               boolean;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve the family's primary location via kid.
  SELECT f.primary_location_id
    INTO v_family_primary_location_id
    FROM public.kids k
    JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
   WHERE k.id = NEW.kid_id;

  -- Read the tenant flag (default false if config row is missing).
  SELECT allow_cross_location_booking
    INTO v_allow_cross
    FROM public.tenant_config
   WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id;

  v_allow_cross := COALESCE(v_allow_cross, false);

  -- If cross-location is not allowed and the booking is at a different
  -- location from the family's primary, reject it.
  IF NOT v_allow_cross
     AND v_family_primary_location_id IS NOT NULL
     AND NEW.location_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_family_primary_location_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'cross_location_booking_not_allowed: booking location % differs from family primary location %',
      NEW.location_id, v_family_primary_location_id
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.validate_booking_location() OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.validate_booking_location() FROM public, anon, authenticated;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Trigger
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TRIGGER trg_validate_booking_location
  BEFORE INSERT ON public.bookings
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.validate_booking_location();


-- =============================================================================
-- VALIDATION QUERIES
-- =============================================================================
-- 1. Insert a booking at a different location for a family whose primary is
--    location A → should raise 'cross_location_booking_not_allowed'.
--
-- 2. Set allow_cross_location_booking = true for the tenant, re-try the same
--    insert → should succeed.
--
-- 3. Insert a booking whose location matches the family's primary → should
--    always succeed regardless of the flag.
--
-- ROLLBACK (to disable trigger without touching the function):
--   DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_validate_booking_location ON public.bookings;
-- =============================================================================

CREATE POLICY bookings_admin_select_staff_locations ON public.bookings
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND location_id IN (
      SELECT sl.location_id
        FROM public.staff_locations sl
       WHERE sl.user_id = auth.uid()

  );


-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================

-- Drop the old tenant-wide admin policy (from 20260511000000_v07_achievements_and_fulfillment.sql).

-- Admins see only families whose primary_location_id is in their assigned locations.
CREATE POLICY families_admin_select_staff_locations ON public.families
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND primary_location_id IN (
      SELECT sl.location_id
        FROM public.staff_locations sl
       WHERE sl.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );


-- =============================================================================
-- coaches — narrow broad policy to exclude admin, add admin staff_locations policy
-- =============================================================================

-- coaches_select_active_in_tenant applies to ALL authenticated users including
-- admin, which means admins can see every coach in the tenant. Narrow it to
-- only parent and coach roles; the owner policy below covers owners; admins
-- get a separate staff_locations-scoped policy.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coaches_select_active_in_tenant ON public.coaches;

CREATE POLICY coaches_select_active_in_tenant ON public.coaches
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND is_active = true
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('parent', 'coach')
  );

-- coaches_owner_select already exists with correct owner-only semantics.
-- Leave it untouched.

-- Admins see coaches who are assigned (via coach_locations) to at least one
-- of the admin's staff_locations. Scoping through the junction table means
-- a coach appears to an admin as long as any of their assigned locations
-- matches — regardless of which location is marked primary.
CREATE POLICY coaches_admin_select_staff_locations ON public.coaches
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND id IN (
      SELECT cl.coach_id
        FROM public.coach_locations cl
       WHERE cl.location_id IN (
         SELECT sl.location_id
           FROM public.staff_locations sl
          WHERE sl.user_id = auth.uid()
       )
    )
  );


-- =============================================================================
-- locations — narrow broad policies to exclude admin, add admin staff_locations
-- =============================================================================

-- locations_select_tenant applies to ALL authenticated users including admins.
-- Narrow it to parent and coach roles only.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS locations_select_tenant ON public.locations;

CREATE POLICY locations_select_parent_coach ON public.locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('parent', 'coach')
  );

-- locations_owner_select currently covers owner AND admin (from stripe_connect_locations).
-- Split into owner-only + admin-specific.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS locations_owner_select ON public.locations;

CREATE POLICY locations_owner_select ON public.locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'owner'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  );

-- Admins see only their assigned locations.
-- tenant_id pin is mandatory: it prevents reading a foreign-tenant location
-- row even if a maliciously-crafted staff_locations row referenced it.
CREATE POLICY locations_admin_select_staff_locations ON public.locations
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND id IN (
      SELECT sl.location_id
        FROM public.staff_locations sl
       WHERE sl.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260601000004_phase2_jwt_location_claim.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Phase 2, Step 5: Inject primary_location_id into JWT
-- =============================================================================
-- Updates custom_access_token_hook to include `primary_location_id` in the
-- JWT claims for parent and coach roles.
--
-- Staleness note: existing sessions will not receive the new claim until
-- their token is refreshed (up to 1 hour). Communicate this to the team
-- before deploying. Users can force-refresh by signing out and back in.
-- =============================================================================


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id            uuid;
  v_claims             jsonb;
  v_tenant_id          uuid;
  v_family_id          uuid;
  v_app_role           text;
  v_is_sa              boolean;
  v_primary_loc_id     uuid;
BEGIN
  v_user_id := (event->>'user_id')::uuid;
  v_claims  := COALESCE(event->'claims', '{}'::jsonb);

  -- 1. Super-admin check first (no tenant_id or location injected).
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.super_admins WHERE user_id = v_user_id)
    INTO v_is_sa;

  IF v_is_sa THEN
    v_claims := v_claims || jsonb_build_object('app_role', 'super_admin');
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 2. Try parent / family.
  SELECT f.tenant_id, f.id, f.primary_location_id
    INTO v_tenant_id, v_family_id, v_primary_loc_id
    FROM public.families f
   WHERE f.parent_user_id = v_user_id;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id',           v_tenant_id,
           'family_id',           v_family_id,
           'app_role',            'parent',
           'primary_location_id', v_primary_loc_id
         );
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 3. Try coach.
  SELECT c.tenant_id, c.primary_location_id
    INTO v_tenant_id, v_primary_loc_id
    FROM public.coaches c
   WHERE c.user_id = v_user_id AND c.is_active = true;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id',           v_tenant_id,
           'app_role',            'coach',
           'primary_location_id', v_primary_loc_id
         );
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 4. Fallback: owner / admin from raw_user_meta_data (portal-only roles).
  --    No primary_location_id injected — owners/admins use staff_locations.
  v_app_role := (
    SELECT raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role'
      FROM auth.users
     WHERE id = v_user_id
  );
  IF v_app_role IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id
      FROM public.tenants
     WHERE slug = (
       SELECT raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug'
         FROM auth.users
        WHERE id = v_user_id
     );
    IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_claims := v_claims
        || jsonb_build_object(
             'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
             'app_role',  v_app_role
           );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) TO supabase_auth_admin;

--

--       'claims', '{}'::jsonb

-- Expected: the UUID of the family's primary location.
-- =============================================================================


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260601000005_fix_hook_super_admins_guard.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Hotfix: guard super_admins table check in custom_access_token_hook
-- =============================================================================
-- Phase 2 migration 20260601000004 added a SELECT from public.super_admins
-- before checking whether the table exists, crashing the hook with
-- "relation public.super_admins does not exist" and returning 500 to GoTrue.
-- Supabase surfaces hook 500s as "Email or password is incorrect", blocking
-- every login for every role.
--
-- Fix: check pg_tables first; only query super_admins if the table is present.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id            uuid;
  v_claims             jsonb;
  v_tenant_id          uuid;
  v_family_id          uuid;
  v_app_role           text;
  v_is_sa              boolean := false;
  v_primary_loc_id     uuid;
BEGIN
  v_user_id := (event->>'user_id')::uuid;
  v_claims  := COALESCE(event->'claims', '{}'::jsonb);

  -- 1. Super-admin check — only if the table exists (graceful degradation).
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables
     WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'super_admins'
  ) THEN
    SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.super_admins WHERE user_id = v_user_id)
      INTO v_is_sa;
  END IF;

  IF v_is_sa THEN
    v_claims := v_claims || jsonb_build_object('app_role', 'super_admin');
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 2. Try parent / family.
  SELECT f.tenant_id, f.id, f.primary_location_id
    INTO v_tenant_id, v_family_id, v_primary_loc_id
    FROM public.families f
   WHERE f.parent_user_id = v_user_id;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id',           v_tenant_id,
           'family_id',           v_family_id,
           'app_role',            'parent',
           'primary_location_id', v_primary_loc_id
         );
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 3. Try coach.
  SELECT c.tenant_id, c.primary_location_id
    INTO v_tenant_id, v_primary_loc_id
    FROM public.coaches c
   WHERE c.user_id = v_user_id AND c.is_active = true;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id',           v_tenant_id,
           'app_role',            'coach',
           'primary_location_id', v_primary_loc_id
         );
    RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
  END IF;

  -- 4. Fallback: owner / admin from raw_user_meta_data (portal-only roles).
  v_app_role := (
    SELECT raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role'
      FROM auth.users
     WHERE id = v_user_id
  );
  IF v_app_role IN ('owner', 'admin') THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id
      FROM public.tenants
     WHERE slug = (
       SELECT raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug'
         FROM auth.users
        WHERE id = v_user_id
     );
    IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_claims := v_claims
        || jsonb_build_object(
             'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
             'app_role',  v_app_role
           );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) TO supabase_auth_admin;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260601000006_booking_reminder_log.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Task #234: Automated booking reminders (24h + 2h before session)
-- =============================================================================
-- Adds the `booking_reminder_log` idempotency table and two pg_cron jobs
-- that call the `send-booking-reminders` Edge Function every 30 minutes.
--
-- pg_cron is a Supabase built-in on Pro plans. The cron.schedule() calls
-- are wrapped in a DO block that checks for the extension first so the
-- migration is safe to apply on projects where pg_cron is not yet enabled.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. booking_reminder_log table
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.booking_reminder_log (
  id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id      uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  reminder_type   text        NOT NULL CHECK (reminder_type IN ('24h', '2h')),
  sent_at         timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT booking_reminder_log_uniq UNIQUE (booking_id, reminder_type)
);

COMMENT ON TABLE public.booking_reminder_log IS
$c$One row per (booking, reminder_type) — the idempotency gate for the
send-booking-reminders Edge Function. The unique constraint on
(booking_id, reminder_type) ensures a booking never receives the same
reminder twice, regardless of how many times the cron fires.$c$;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Indexes
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_booking_reminder_log_booking_id ON public.booking_reminder_log(booking_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_booking_reminder_log_sent_at    ON public.booking_reminder_log(sent_at);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. RLS — service-role only; no client access needed
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.booking_reminder_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON public.booking_reminder_log TO service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. pg_cron jobs — only registered when the extension is present.
--    Uses $job$ as the inner dollar-quote to avoid conflicts with the
--    outer DO $$ block delimiter.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO $$
DECLARE
  v_sql_24h text;
  v_sql_2h  text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron') THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'pg_cron not installed — skipping booking reminder cron jobs';
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Unschedule existing jobs (ignore error if they do not exist yet)
  BEGIN
    PERFORM cron.unschedule('booking-reminder-24h');
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
  END;

  BEGIN
    PERFORM cron.unschedule('booking-reminder-2h');
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
  END;

  v_sql_24h := $job$
    SELECT net.http_post(
      url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true)
                   || '/functions/v1/send-booking-reminders',
      headers := jsonb_build_object(
                   'Content-Type',  'application/json',
                   'Authorization', 'Bearer '
                     || current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true)
                 ),
      body    := '{"reminder_type":"24h"}'::jsonb
    ) AS request_id;
  $job$;

  v_sql_2h := $job$
    SELECT net.http_post(
      url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true)
                   || '/functions/v1/send-booking-reminders',
      headers := jsonb_build_object(
                   'Content-Type',  'application/json',
                   'Authorization', 'Bearer '
                     || current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true)
                 ),
      body    := '{"reminder_type":"2h"}'::jsonb
    ) AS request_id;
  $job$;

  PERFORM cron.schedule('booking-reminder-24h', '*/30 * * * *', v_sql_24h);
  PERFORM cron.schedule('booking-reminder-2h',  '*/30 * * * *', v_sql_2h);

  RAISE NOTICE 'pg_cron: booking-reminder-24h and booking-reminder-2h scheduled';
END;
$$;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260602000000_check_in_rpcs.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Check-in RPCs + schema additions
-- =============================================================================
-- Depends on: 20260601000000_phase2_staff_locations.sql (staff_locations table)
--             20260601000003_phase2_admin_rls_staff_locations.sql (admin booking SELECT)
--
-- 1. Add booking_id + coach_id columns to sessions (nullable; used when a
--    booking is checked in without a HitTrax/capture source).
-- 2. Add admin/coach UPDATE policies on bookings so direct Supabase client
--    calls (outside of SECURITY DEFINER RPCs) are also appropriately scoped.
--    The RPC path enforces the same checks in-function (see below).
-- 3. Three SECURITY DEFINER RPCs. Role gate and location scoping:
--
--    Role          Location scope
--    -----------   -----------------------------------------------
--    coach         Only bookings assigned to their own coach row
--    admin         Only bookings whose location_id is in their staff_locations
--    owner         Tenant-wide (owns the whole facility)
--    super_admin   Tenant-wide (platform operator, no location restriction)
--    parent        DENIED — check-in is staff-only
--
--    Because SECURITY DEFINER bypasses RLS, all location/ownership checks
--    are re-enforced explicitly inside each function body.
--
--      check_in_booking(uuid)   — marks attended, creates session row, fires points trigger
--      mark_no_show(uuid)       — sets status='no_show', clears attended_at
--      undo_check_in(uuid)      — reverts within 5 minutes, deletes session row + points
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Extend sessions table with booking linkage
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ALTER TABLE public.sessions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS booking_id uuid REFERENCES public.bookings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS coach_id   uuid REFERENCES public.coaches(id)  ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_booking_id ON public.sessions(booking_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_coach_id   ON public.sessions(coach_id);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Admin + coach UPDATE policy on bookings
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE POLICY bookings_admin_update_staff_locations ON public.bookings
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND location_id IN (
      SELECT sl.location_id FROM public.staff_locations sl WHERE sl.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND location_id IN (
      SELECT sl.location_id FROM public.staff_locations sl WHERE sl.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY bookings_coach_update_own ON public.bookings
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND coach_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.coaches WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND coach_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.coaches WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper macro (inline in each RPC): enforce_checkin_access
-- Rather than a shared helper function, the identical check is inlined so each
-- RPC's access control is self-contained and auditable in isolation.
--
-- Logic (applied after tenant check, before status mutation):
--   coach      → must own the booking (coach_id matches their coaches row)
--   admin      → booking's location_id must be in their staff_locations rows
--   owner      → tenant-wide (no extra restriction)
--   super_admin→ unrestricted (platform operator)
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3a. check_in_booking(p_booking_id)
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role       text;
  v_tenant_id  uuid;
  v_coach_id   uuid;
  v_booking    public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  -- ── Role gate (parent denied) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant isolation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Role-specific access control ───────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
    -- Coach may only act on bookings assigned to them
    SELECT id INTO v_coach_id
      FROM public.coaches
     WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
       AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;
    IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

  ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
    -- Admin is location-scoped: booking's location must be in their staff_locations
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
       WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
         AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

  -- owner + super_admin: tenant-wide access, no additional location restriction
  END IF;

  -- ── Idempotent: already completed → return current row ─────────────────
  IF v_booking.status = 'completed' THEN
    RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
  END IF;

  -- ── Only pending/confirmed may be checked in ────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS: booking is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0003';
  END IF;

  -- ── Mark completed (fires award_booking_completion_points trigger) ───────
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'completed',
         attended_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- ── Create sessions row if one doesn't exist for this booking ───────────
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
  ) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.sessions (
      tenant_id, kid_id, coach_id, booking_id,
      capture_source, started_at, ended_at
    ) VALUES (
      v_booking.tenant_id, v_booking.kid_id, v_booking.coach_id, p_booking_id,
      'none', v_booking.scheduled_start, v_booking.scheduled_end
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) TO authenticated;

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3c. undo_check_in(p_booking_id)
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Reverts a completed booking back to confirmed within a 5-minute window.
-- Also deletes the sessions row and reverses the points award.
-- Raises UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED if called after 5 minutes.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role      text;
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_coach_id  uuid;
  v_booking   public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta     int;
BEGIN
  -- ── Role gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant isolation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Role-specific access control ─────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_coach_id
      FROM public.coaches
     WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
       AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;
    IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

  ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
       WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
         AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

  -- owner + super_admin: tenant-wide, no location restriction
  END IF;

  -- ── Booking must be completed to undo ────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status != 'completed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_CHECKED_IN: booking status is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0004';
  END IF;

  -- ── 5-minute undo window ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.attended_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0005';
  END IF;

  -- ── Revert booking (award trigger only fires on → 'completed', so this
  --    UPDATE does NOT re-trigger points) ──────────────────────────────
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'confirmed',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- ── Delete the sessions row created by check_in_booking ─────────────
  DELETE FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id;

  -- ── Reverse points: remove ledger row and decrement kid balance ───────
  SELECT delta INTO v_delta
    FROM public.points_ledger
   WHERE kid_id        = v_booking.kid_id
     AND reference_type = 'booking'
     AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
     AND reason         = 'session_attended';

  IF FOUND AND v_delta IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id        = v_booking.kid_id
       AND reference_type = 'booking'
       AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
       AND reason         = 'session_attended';

    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = GREATEST(0, points_balance - v_delta)
     WHERE id = v_booking.kid_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260602000003_v08_waivers.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark v0.8 — Digital waiver + consent capture
-- =============================================================================
-- Tables: waivers (catalog), family_waivers (log)
-- RPC:    sign_waiver(p_waiver_id, p_app_version) — SECURITY DEFINER, idempotent
-- RLS:    families read active waivers in own tenant; INSERT only via RPC;
--         admins/service role full access
-- Seed:   v1 Infinite Hitting liability waiver (is_active = true)
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. waivers catalog
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE public.waivers (
  id             uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id      uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version        integer     NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
  body_text      text        NOT NULL,
  effective_date date        NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  is_active      boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, version)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_waivers_tenant_id ON public.waivers(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_waivers_active    ON public.waivers(tenant_id, is_active) WHERE is_active = true;

-- Enforce at most one active waiver per tenant so .maybeSingle() never panics
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_waivers_one_active_per_tenant
  ON public.waivers(tenant_id)
  WHERE is_active = true;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. family_waivers log
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE public.family_waivers (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  family_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.families(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  waiver_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.waivers(id)  ON DELETE CASCADE,
  signed_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  app_version text,
  ip_address  text,
  UNIQUE (family_id, waiver_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_family_waivers_family_id ON public.family_waivers(family_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_family_waivers_waiver_id ON public.family_waivers(waiver_id);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Base table privileges (required before RLS policy evaluation)
-- Without these, PostgREST returns 42501 before even reaching RLS.
-- See migration 20260505041500_grant_table_privileges_to_authenticated.sql
-- for the project precedent.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
GRANT SELECT                    ON public.waivers        TO authenticated;
GRANT SELECT                    ON public.family_waivers TO authenticated;
-- INSERT on family_waivers is intentionally withheld from authenticated;
-- all writes go through the sign_waiver SECURITY DEFINER RPC.


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. RLS
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.waivers        ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.family_waivers ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Authenticated users may read waivers for their own tenant
CREATE POLICY waivers_select_own_tenant ON public.waivers
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid);

-- Families may SELECT their own waiver records
CREATE POLICY family_waivers_select_own ON public.family_waivers
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    family_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.families WHERE parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- Direct INSERT is blocked — all writes go through sign_waiver RPC
CREATE POLICY family_waivers_no_direct_insert ON public.family_waivers
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (false);


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. sign_waiver RPC — SECURITY DEFINER, idempotent
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sign_waiver(
  p_waiver_id   uuid,
  p_app_version text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_family_id        uuid;
  v_tenant_id        uuid;
  v_waiver_tenant_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve caller's family_id and tenant_id from JWT custom claims
  v_family_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'family_id')::uuid;
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  IF v_family_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sign_waiver: caller is not a parent (no family_id in JWT)';
  END IF;

  -- Verify the waiver belongs to the caller's tenant (prevent cross-tenant signing)
  SELECT tenant_id
    INTO v_waiver_tenant_id
    FROM public.waivers
   WHERE id = p_waiver_id;

  IF v_waiver_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sign_waiver: waiver not found';
  END IF;

  IF v_waiver_tenant_id <> v_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sign_waiver: cross-tenant waiver signing is not allowed';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotent insert — subsequent calls for the same (family, waiver) pair are no-ops
  INSERT INTO public.family_waivers (family_id, waiver_id, app_version)
  VALUES (v_family_id, p_waiver_id, p_app_version)
  ON CONFLICT (family_id, waiver_id) DO NOTHING;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.sign_waiver(uuid, text) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.sign_waiver(uuid, text) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.sign_waiver(uuid, text) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260602000004_cancellation_policy.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Task #238: Cancellation Policy Enforcement
-- =============================================================================
-- Adds configurable cancellation-window fields to tenant_config, notice-period
-- columns to memberships, and two SECURITY DEFINER RPCs:
--   • cancel_booking(p_booking_id, p_reason, p_override)
--   • cancel_membership(p_membership_id, p_override)
-- Also registers a daily pg_cron job to auto-cancel memberships whose
-- cancel_effective_at has passed.
-- =============================================================================


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. tenant_config — three new policy columns
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.tenant_config
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS booking_cancel_window_hours  int  NOT NULL DEFAULT 24,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS booking_cancel_fee_cents     int  NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS membership_cancel_notice_days int NOT NULL DEFAULT 30;


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. memberships — track cancellation request + effective date separately
--    cancel_requested_at: when parent hit "Cancel Membership"
--    cancel_effective_at: computed = MAX(NOW()+notice_days, next_billing_at)
--    (cancel_at already exists from Phase 3; keep it for Stripe end-of-period)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancel_requested_at  timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancel_effective_at  timestamptz;


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Extend points_ledger constraints to accommodate cancellation audit rows
--
-- The existing schema has:
--   • reason CHECK: a closed enum (session_attended, assignment_completed, …)
--   • delta CHECK: delta <> 0
-- We add 'booking_cancelled' to the reason enum and allow delta=0 ONLY for
-- that reason so that cancel_booking can write a zero-delta audit row.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS points_ledger_reason_check;
ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger
  ADD CONSTRAINT points_ledger_reason_check CHECK (reason IN (
    'session_attended',
    'assignment_completed',
    'pr_hit',
    'redemption',
    'manual_adjustment',
    'achievement_bonus',
    'booking_cancelled'
  ));

-- Relax delta constraint: non-zero for all reasons except booking_cancelled
-- (audit-only rows legitimately carry delta=0).
-- The initial schema creates this as an inline CHECK, so the auto-generated
-- constraint name may vary. We find it dynamically and drop it, then add an
-- explicitly-named replacement.
DO $$
DECLARE
  r RECORD;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT conname
      FROM pg_constraint
     WHERE conrelid = 'public.points_ledger'::regclass
       AND contype  = 'c'
       AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%delta%<>%0%'
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger DROP CONSTRAINT %I', r.conname);
  END LOOP;
END;
$$;

ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger
  ADD CONSTRAINT points_ledger_delta_nonzero
    CHECK (delta <> 0 OR reason = 'booking_cancelled');


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. cancel_booking RPC
--
-- Callable by the parent who owns the booking OR by staff with p_override=true.
-- On a successful cancellation, writes a points_ledger audit row (delta=0,
-- reason='booking_cancelled') for traceability.
--
-- Returns JSON:
--   { ok: true }                                          on success
--   { code: 'LATE_CANCEL', fee_cents: N, window_hours: N } inside window
--   { code: 'NOT_FOUND' }
--   { code: 'ALREADY_CANCELLED' }
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancel_booking(
  p_booking_id uuid,
  p_reason     text    DEFAULT NULL,
  p_override   boolean DEFAULT false
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_booking       record;
  v_config        record;
  v_caller_tenant uuid;
  v_caller_role   text;
  v_mins_until    numeric;
  v_window_mins   numeric;
  v_kid_balance   int;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve caller context from JWT
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  v_caller_role   := coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role', '');

  -- Load booking (tenant-scoped)
  SELECT b.*
    INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings b
   WHERE b.id = p_booking_id
     AND b.tenant_id = v_caller_tenant;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'NOT_FOUND',
      'message', 'Booking not found or access denied');
  END IF;

  -- Verify parent ownership (bypass for staff roles)
  IF v_caller_role NOT IN ('admin', 'owner', 'coach') THEN
    -- parent: must own the kid on the booking
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.kids k
       WHERE k.id = v_booking.kid_id
         AND k.family_id IN (
           SELECT f.id FROM public.families f
            WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
         )
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'NOT_FOUND',
        'message', 'Booking not found or access denied');
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Already cancelled?
  IF v_booking.status IN ('cancelled', 'no_show') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'ALREADY_CANCELLED',
      'message', 'Booking is already cancelled');
  END IF;

  -- Load tenant config (cancellation window + fee)
  SELECT tc.*
    INTO v_config
    FROM public.tenant_config tc
   WHERE tc.tenant_id = v_caller_tenant;

  -- Default values if config row missing
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    v_config.booking_cancel_window_hours := 24;
    v_config.booking_cancel_fee_cents    := 0;
  END IF;

  -- Check cancellation window (only for non-override calls)
  IF NOT p_override THEN
    v_mins_until  := EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v_booking.scheduled_start - now())) / 60.0;
    v_window_mins := v_config.booking_cancel_window_hours * 60.0;

    IF v_mins_until > 0 AND v_mins_until < v_window_mins THEN
      -- Inside the cancellation window → return policy info, do NOT cancel
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'code',         'LATE_CANCEL',
        'fee_cents',    v_config.booking_cancel_fee_cents,
        'window_hours', v_config.booking_cancel_window_hours,
        'message',      format(
          'This booking is within the %s-hour cancellation window.',
          v_config.booking_cancel_window_hours
        )
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Perform cancellation
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status              = 'cancelled',
         cancelled_at        = now(),
         cancellation_reason = p_reason,
         updated_at          = now()
   WHERE id        = p_booking_id
     AND tenant_id = v_caller_tenant;

  -- Audit trail: write a points_ledger row (delta=0) for every cancellation.
  -- If a late-cancel fee is ever applied in points, change delta accordingly.
  IF v_booking.kid_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT coalesce(k.points_balance, 0)
      INTO v_kid_balance
      FROM public.kids k
     WHERE k.id = v_booking.kid_id;

    INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
      tenant_id, kid_id, delta, balance_after, reason, reference_id
    ) VALUES (
      v_caller_tenant,
      v_booking.kid_id,
      0,
      coalesce(v_kid_balance, 0),
      'booking_cancelled',
      p_booking_id
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.cancel_booking(uuid, text, boolean) TO authenticated;


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. cancel_membership RPC
--
-- Parents (app_role='parent') may self-serve cancel their own family's EFT
-- membership via this RPC. Staff (admin/owner) may use p_override=true to
-- re-process an already-requested cancellation.
--
-- SECURITY: ownership check always runs for non-staff callers regardless of
-- p_override. Non-staff callers who pass p_override=true are denied.
--
-- Returns JSON:
--   { ok: true, cancel_effective_at: <ISO> }
--   { code: 'NOT_FOUND' }
--   { code: 'NOT_EFT', message: '...' }
--   { code: 'ALREADY_CANCELLED' }
--   { code: 'ALREADY_REQUESTED', cancel_effective_at: <ISO> }
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancel_membership(
  p_membership_id uuid,
  p_override      boolean DEFAULT false
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_mem           record;
  v_config        record;
  v_caller_tenant uuid;
  v_caller_role   text;
  v_is_staff      boolean;
  v_notice_days   int;
  v_effective_at  timestamptz;
  v_period_end    timestamptz;
BEGIN
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  v_caller_role   := coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role', '');
  v_is_staff      := v_caller_role IN ('admin', 'owner');

  -- Load membership (tenant-scoped)
  SELECT m.*
    INTO v_mem
    FROM public.memberships m
   WHERE m.id = p_membership_id
     AND m.tenant_id = v_caller_tenant;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'NOT_FOUND',
      'message', 'Membership not found or access denied');
  END IF;

  -- Ownership check: ALWAYS enforced for non-staff callers.
  -- p_override does NOT bypass ownership — it only bypasses the
  -- ALREADY_REQUESTED guard below (staff use case: re-process).
  IF NOT v_is_staff THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.families f
       WHERE f.id = v_mem.family_id
         AND f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    ) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'NOT_FOUND',
        'message', 'Membership not found or access denied');
    END IF;

    -- Non-staff callers must never use override — reject silently as NOT_FOUND
    -- to avoid leaking policy internals.
    IF p_override THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'NOT_FOUND',
        'message', 'Membership not found or access denied');
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Only EFT memberships support notice-period self-serve cancellation
  IF v_mem.plan_type <> 'eft' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'NOT_EFT',
      'message', 'Only recurring (EFT) memberships can be cancelled through the app. '
               || 'Please contact staff to cancel a one-time plan.');
  END IF;

  -- Already fully cancelled?
  IF v_mem.status = 'cancelled' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'ALREADY_CANCELLED',
      'message', 'Membership is already cancelled');
  END IF;

  -- Already requested (and not a staff override)?
  IF v_mem.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT p_override THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('code', 'ALREADY_REQUESTED',
      'cancel_effective_at', to_char(v_mem.cancel_effective_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
      'message', 'Cancellation already requested');
  END IF;

  -- Load tenant config for notice period
  SELECT tc.membership_cancel_notice_days
    INTO v_notice_days
    FROM public.tenant_config tc
   WHERE tc.tenant_id = v_caller_tenant;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    v_notice_days := 30;
  END IF;

  -- Effective date = MAX(now + notice_days, next_billing_at)
  -- next_billing_at is the current period end for EFT subscriptions
  v_period_end := v_mem.next_billing_at;

  v_effective_at := GREATEST(
    now() + (v_notice_days || ' days')::interval,
    coalesce(v_period_end, now() + (v_notice_days || ' days')::interval)
  );

  -- Set cancel_requested_at + cancel_effective_at; do NOT change status yet
  -- (status remains 'active' until auto-cancel cron fires)
  UPDATE public.memberships
     SET cancel_requested_at = now(),
         cancel_effective_at = v_effective_at,
         updated_at          = now()
   WHERE id        = p_membership_id
     AND tenant_id = v_caller_tenant;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',                 true,
    'cancel_effective_at', to_char(v_effective_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.cancel_membership(uuid, boolean) TO authenticated;


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. pg_cron: daily job to auto-cancel memberships whose effective date passed
--
-- Requires pg_cron + pg_net extensions. Tolerates their absence (wrapped in
-- a DO block with EXCEPTION). Also requires app.settings.supabase_url and
-- app.settings.service_role_key GUCs — migration is a no-op when absent.
-- Re-running this migration is safe: cron.schedule is idempotent by name.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron')
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_net') THEN
    PERFORM cron.schedule(
      'process-membership-cancellations',
      '0 2 * * *',
      $cron$
        SELECT net.http_post(
          url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true)
                     || '/functions/v1/process-membership-cancellations',
          headers := jsonb_build_object(
            'Content-Type',  'application/json',
            'Authorization', 'Bearer '
              || current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true)
          ),
          body    := '{}'::jsonb
        ) AS request_id
        WHERE current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true) IS NOT NULL
          AND current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true) IS NOT NULL;
      $cron$
    );
  END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- pg_cron or pg_net not available in this environment — skip silently.
  NULL;
END;
$$;

=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260602000010_session_packs_credit_tracking.sql
