-- ============================================================
-- Task #237: Session packs + credit tracking
--
-- Adds sessions_remaining / sessions_total to memberships,
-- adds session_credit_restored idempotency flag to bookings,
-- backfills existing OTC rows, adds a parent SELECT policy,
-- and creates three SECURITY DEFINER RPCs for atomic credit
-- deduction, restoration, and pre-booking checks.
-- ============================================================

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SCHEMA CHANGES
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sessions_total     integer
    CHECK (sessions_total > 0),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sessions_remaining integer
    CHECK (sessions_remaining >= 0);

-- Enforce remaining ≤ total when both are set
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'sessions_remaining_lte_total'
      AND conrelid = 'public.memberships'::regclass
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.memberships
      ADD CONSTRAINT sessions_remaining_lte_total
        CHECK (
          sessions_remaining IS NULL
          OR sessions_total IS NULL
          OR sessions_remaining <= sessions_total
        );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Idempotency flag: ensures restore_session_credit can only fire
-- once per booking regardless of how many times it is called.
ALTER TABLE public.bookings
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_credit_restored boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- BACKFILL: infer pack size from plan_name for OTC memberships
-- that don't already have sessions_total set.
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
UPDATE public.memberships
SET
  sessions_total = CASE
    WHEN plan_name ILIKE '%8-pack%' OR plan_name ILIKE '%8 pack%' OR plan_name ILIKE '8-Pack%' THEN 8
    WHEN plan_name ILIKE '%4-pack%' OR plan_name ILIKE '%4 pack%' OR plan_name ILIKE '4-Pack%' THEN 4
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  sessions_remaining = CASE
    WHEN plan_name ILIKE '%8-pack%' OR plan_name ILIKE '%8 pack%' OR plan_name ILIKE '8-Pack%' THEN 8
    WHEN plan_name ILIKE '%4-pack%' OR plan_name ILIKE '%4 pack%' OR plan_name ILIKE '4-Pack%' THEN 4
    ELSE NULL
  END
WHERE plan_type = 'otc'
  AND sessions_total IS NULL;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- PARENT SELECT POLICY — families can read their own memberships
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
      AND tablename  = 'memberships'
      AND policyname = 'memberships_parent_select'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY memberships_parent_select ON public.memberships
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING (
        (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'parent'
        AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
        AND family_id IN (
          SELECT id FROM public.families
          WHERE parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        )
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- RPC: check_session_credits
--
-- Returns the number of sessions remaining for the kid's active
-- OTC pack, or -1 if there is no tracked OTC membership (EFT
-- unlimited or untracked OTC).  Does NOT consume a credit.
-- Callers: mobile pre-booking UI check.
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_session_credits(
  p_kid_id    uuid,
  p_tenant_id uuid
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role      text;
  v_remaining integer;
BEGIN
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';

  -- Tenant isolation: every caller except super_admin must be in the same tenant
  IF v_role <> 'super_admin'
     AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Parent callers: must own the family that owns this kid
  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id            = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    -- EFT unlimited or untracked OTC — no restriction
    RETURN -1;
  END IF;

  RETURN v_remaining;
END;
$$;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- RPC: deduct_session_credit
--
-- Atomically decrements sessions_remaining by 1 using FOR UPDATE.
-- Returns the new (post-decrement) balance, or -1 for unlimited
-- memberships (EFT / untracked OTC).
-- Raises 'no_session_credits' if remaining = 0.
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deduct_session_credit(
  p_booking_id uuid
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role          text;
  v_kid_id        uuid;
  v_tenant_id     uuid;
  v_membership_id uuid;
  v_remaining     integer;
  v_new_remaining integer;
BEGIN
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';

  -- Resolve the kid & tenant from the booking
  SELECT kid_id, tenant_id
  INTO   v_kid_id, v_tenant_id
  FROM   public.bookings
  WHERE  id = p_booking_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'booking_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Tenant isolation
  IF v_role <> 'super_admin'
     AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Parent: must own the family that owns the kid on this booking
  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = v_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Lock the active OTC membership row for atomic decrement
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = v_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    -- EFT unlimited or untracked OTC — no deduction needed
    RETURN -1;
  END IF;

  IF v_remaining <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.memberships
  SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 1,
         updated_at         = now()
  WHERE  id = v_membership_id
  RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;

  RETURN v_new_remaining;
END;
$$;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- RPC: restore_session_credit
--
-- Increments sessions_remaining by 1 (capped at sessions_total)
-- when a FUTURE booking is cancelled.  Guards (all server-side):
--   1. Caller authz (parent owns family + tenant; others tenant-scoped)
--   2. Booking must have status = 'cancelled'
--   3. Booking scheduled_start must be in the future (> now()) so
--      credits cannot be regained for sessions that already occurred
--   4. Idempotent — bookings.session_credit_restored flag prevents
--      duplicate restores regardless of how many times the RPC fires
-- Returns the new balance, or -1 for unlimited/untracked memberships,
-- or -2 if the credit was already restored (idempotent no-op).
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_session_credit(
  p_booking_id uuid
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role            text;
  v_kid_id          uuid;
  v_tenant_id       uuid;
  v_booking_status  text;
  v_scheduled_start timestamptz;
  v_already_done    boolean;
  v_membership_id   uuid;
  v_sessions_total  integer;
  v_new_remaining   integer;
BEGIN
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';

  -- Lock the booking row to prevent concurrent restores
  SELECT kid_id, tenant_id, status, scheduled_start, session_credit_restored
  INTO   v_kid_id, v_tenant_id, v_booking_status, v_scheduled_start, v_already_done
  FROM   public.bookings
  WHERE  id = p_booking_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'booking_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Tenant isolation
  IF v_role <> 'super_admin'
     AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Parent: must own the family that owns the kid on this booking
  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = v_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Business rule 1: booking must be cancelled
  IF v_booking_status <> 'cancelled' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'booking_not_cancelled' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Business rule 2: session must not have already started (future only)
  -- A 10-minute grace window is applied so same-day cancellations right
  -- at the start time are still honoured.
  IF v_scheduled_start <= (now() - interval '10 minutes') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'session_already_started' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotency: never restore more than once per booking
  IF v_already_done THEN
    RETURN -2;
  END IF;

  -- Mark restore as done before touching the membership (atomic within txn)
  UPDATE public.bookings
  SET    session_credit_restored = true
  WHERE  id = p_booking_id;

  -- Find the OTC membership to restore into
  SELECT id, sessions_total
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_sessions_total
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = v_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    -- No tracked OTC membership — nothing to restore
    RETURN -1;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.memberships
  SET    sessions_remaining = LEAST(
           sessions_remaining + 1,
           COALESCE(v_sessions_total, sessions_remaining + 1)
         ),
         updated_at = now()
  WHERE  id = v_membership_id
  RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;

  RETURN v_new_remaining;
END;
$$;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- GRANTS
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.check_session_credits(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.deduct_session_credit(uuid)       TO authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.restore_session_credit(uuid)      TO authenticated;

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- PROMO_CODES TABLE
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.promo_codes (
  id                       uuid        DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id                uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  code                     text        NOT NULL,
  stripe_coupon_id         text,
  stripe_promotion_code_id text,
  discount_type            text        NOT NULL CHECK (discount_type IN ('percent', 'fixed')),
  discount_value           integer     NOT NULL CHECK (discount_value > 0),
  max_redemptions          integer     CHECK (max_redemptions IS NULL OR max_redemptions > 0),
  redemptions_used         integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (redemptions_used >= 0),
  -- applicable_plan_names: plan_name values (e.g. 'Elite Monthly', 'Standard EFT') this
  -- code is valid for. Empty array = valid for any plan in the tenant.
  applicable_plan_names    text[]      NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  expires_at               timestamptz,
  is_active                boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- One code string per tenant (case-insensitive)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS promo_codes_tenant_code_uniq
  ON public.promo_codes (tenant_id, lower(code));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS promo_codes_tenant_idx  ON public.promo_codes (tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS promo_codes_active_idx  ON public.promo_codes (tenant_id, is_active);

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- validate_promo_code RPC  (READ-ONLY — no state change)
--
-- Called by the portal/app UI to show a discount preview before activation.
-- Does NOT increment redemptions_used. Use consume_promo_code for activation.
--
-- p_plan_name: the membership's plan_name string (e.g. 'Elite Monthly').
--   Passed during both preview and activation so PLAN_MISMATCH can fire when
--   applicable_plan_names is non-empty and the plan is not in the list.
--   NULL means "skip plan check" (e.g. standalone code lookup without a membership).
--
-- Security: verifies caller is admin/owner on the correct tenant via JWT.
-- Returns:
--   { ok: true, id, code, discount_type, discount_value, stripe_promotion_code_id }
--   { ok: false, error_code: 'INVALID'|'EXPIRED'|'EXHAUSTED'|'PLAN_MISMATCH'|'FORBIDDEN' }
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_promo_code(
  p_code      text,
  p_plan_name text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_role      text;
  v_row       public.promo_codes%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  -- Verify caller is admin or owner for this tenant
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  v_role      := (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role');
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL OR v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'owner') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'FORBIDDEN');
  END IF;

  -- Look up the code (case-insensitive) for this tenant
  SELECT *
    INTO v_row
    FROM public.promo_codes
   WHERE tenant_id = v_tenant_id
     AND lower(code) = lower(p_code)
   LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_row.is_active THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'INVALID');
  END IF;

  IF v_row.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND v_row.expires_at <= now() THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'EXPIRED');
  END IF;

  -- Soft cap check (not locked — use consume_promo_code for hard enforcement)
  IF v_row.max_redemptions IS NOT NULL AND v_row.redemptions_used >= v_row.max_redemptions THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'EXHAUSTED');
  END IF;

  -- Plan mismatch: only check when applicable_plan_names is non-empty AND p_plan_name provided
  IF p_plan_name IS NOT NULL
     AND array_length(v_row.applicable_plan_names, 1) > 0
     AND NOT (p_plan_name = ANY(v_row.applicable_plan_names)) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'PLAN_MISMATCH');
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',                       true,
    'id',                       v_row.id,
    'code',                     v_row.code,
    'discount_type',            v_row.discount_type,
    'discount_value',           v_row.discount_value,
    'stripe_promotion_code_id', v_row.stripe_promotion_code_id
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.validate_promo_code(text, text) TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.validate_promo_code IS
  'Read-only promo code preview. Caller must be admin/owner. Does NOT increment redemptions_used.';

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- consume_promo_code RPC  (ATOMIC validate + increment)
--
-- Called during membership activation AFTER Stripe succeeds.
-- Uses SELECT FOR UPDATE to prevent concurrent over-redemption races.
--
-- Security: verifies caller is admin/owner on the correct tenant via JWT.
-- On success: atomically increments redemptions_used and returns ok=true.
-- On failure: returns ok=false with error_code — no DB change.
--
-- Concurrency guarantee: two concurrent activations of a code with max_redemptions=1
-- will serialize on the row lock; only one will succeed with EXHAUSTED returned to
-- the other. The caller (activate route) must cancel the Stripe subscription if
-- EXHAUSTED is returned.
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_promo_code(
  p_code      text,
  p_plan_name text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_role      text;
  v_row       public.promo_codes%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  -- Verify caller is admin or owner for this tenant
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  v_role      := (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role');
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL OR v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'owner') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'FORBIDDEN');
  END IF;

  -- Lock the row to serialize concurrent consumption
  SELECT *
    INTO v_row
    FROM public.promo_codes
   WHERE tenant_id = v_tenant_id
     AND lower(code) = lower(p_code)
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_row.is_active THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'INVALID');
  END IF;

  IF v_row.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND v_row.expires_at <= now() THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'EXPIRED');
  END IF;

  -- Hard cap check under the row lock — prevents over-redemption races
  IF v_row.max_redemptions IS NOT NULL AND v_row.redemptions_used >= v_row.max_redemptions THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'EXHAUSTED');
  END IF;

  -- Plan mismatch
  IF p_plan_name IS NOT NULL
     AND array_length(v_row.applicable_plan_names, 1) > 0
     AND NOT (p_plan_name = ANY(v_row.applicable_plan_names)) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error_code', 'PLAN_MISMATCH');
  END IF;

  -- All checks passed: atomically increment redemptions_used
  UPDATE public.promo_codes
     SET redemptions_used = redemptions_used + 1
   WHERE id = v_row.id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',                       true,
    'id',                       v_row.id,
    'code',                     v_row.code,
    'discount_type',            v_row.discount_type,
    'discount_value',           v_row.discount_value,
    'stripe_promotion_code_id', v_row.stripe_promotion_code_id
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.consume_promo_code(text, text) TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.consume_promo_code IS
  'Atomically validates and consumes a promo code (FOR UPDATE prevents concurrent over-redemption). Caller must be admin/owner. Cancel the Stripe subscription if EXHAUSTED is returned.';

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Booking Waitlist (auto-promote on cancellation)
-- =============================================================================
-- 1. Add `capacity` to session_types
-- 2. booking_waitlist table
-- 3. RPCs: join_waitlist, leave_waitlist, claim_waitlist_spot,
--          get_day_slot_availability

-- 5. pg_cron: expire stale notified entries + cascade every 15 min

-- ── 1. capacity column on session_types ──────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.session_types
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS capacity int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (capacity >= 1);


-- ── 2. booking_waitlist ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- session_slot_key = '{coach_id}_{scheduled_start_iso}'
-- Status flow: waiting → notified → claimed | expired | cancelled

CREATE TABLE public.booking_waitlist (
  id                uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id         uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  session_slot_key  text        NOT NULL,
  kid_id            uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.kids(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  family_id         uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.families(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  coach_id          uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.coaches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  session_type_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.session_types(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  location_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.locations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  scheduled_start   timestamptz NOT NULL,
  scheduled_end     timestamptz NOT NULL,
  position          int         NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 1),
  status            text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'waiting'
                                CHECK (status IN ('waiting','notified','claimed','expired','cancelled')),
  notified_at       timestamptz,
  claim_deadline    timestamptz,
  created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_bw_tenant_id          ON public.booking_waitlist(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_bw_session_slot_key   ON public.booking_waitlist(session_slot_key);
CREATE INDEX idx_bw_kid_id             ON public.booking_waitlist(kid_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_bw_family_id          ON public.booking_waitlist(family_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_bw_status             ON public.booking_waitlist(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_bw_claim_deadline     ON public.booking_waitlist(claim_deadline)
  WHERE status = 'notified';

CREATE TRIGGER trg_booking_waitlist_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.booking_waitlist
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at();


-- ── 3a. RLS for booking_waitlist ─────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.booking_waitlist ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- ── 3b. get_day_slot_availability RPC ────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECURITY DEFINER so it can count bookings across all families (bypasses RLS).
-- Returns (session_slot_key, confirmed_count, waitlist_count, capacity) for a
-- date range within a given session_type. Called once per day by the mobile app.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_day_slot_availability(
  p_tenant_id       uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_start           timestamptz,
  p_end             timestamptz
)
RETURNS TABLE(
  session_slot_key  text,
  confirmed_count   bigint,
  waitlist_count    bigint,
  capacity          int
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_capacity int;
BEGIN
  SELECT st.capacity INTO v_capacity
  FROM public.session_types st
  WHERE st.id = p_session_type_id AND st.tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

  IF v_capacity IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH confirmed AS (
    SELECT
      b.coach_id::text || '_' || to_char(b.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS slot_key,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM public.bookings b
    WHERE
      b.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      AND b.session_type_id = p_session_type_id
      AND b.scheduled_start >= p_start
      AND b.scheduled_start < p_end
      AND b.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')
    GROUP BY b.coach_id, b.scheduled_start
  ),
  waitlisted AS (
    SELECT
      w.session_slot_key AS slot_key,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM public.booking_waitlist w
    WHERE
      w.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      AND w.session_type_id = p_session_type_id
      AND w.scheduled_start >= p_start
      AND w.scheduled_start < p_end
      AND w.status IN ('waiting', 'notified')
    GROUP BY w.session_slot_key
  )
  SELECT
    COALESCE(c.slot_key, wl.slot_key) AS session_slot_key,
    COALESCE(c.cnt, 0)                AS confirmed_count,
    COALESCE(wl.cnt, 0)               AS waitlist_count,
    v_capacity                         AS capacity
  FROM confirmed c
  FULL OUTER JOIN waitlisted wl ON wl.slot_key = c.slot_key;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_day_slot_availability(uuid, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz)
  TO authenticated;


-- ── 3c. join_waitlist RPC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Idempotent: returns existing entry if family already on waitlist for slot.
-- Only allowed for group / cage session types (not private).

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.join_waitlist(
  p_session_slot_key  text,
  p_coach_id          uuid,
  p_session_type_id   uuid,
  p_location_id       uuid,
  p_scheduled_start   timestamptz,
  p_scheduled_end     timestamptz
)
RETURNS public.booking_waitlist
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_family    public.families;
  v_kid       public.kids;
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_st        public.session_types;
  v_next_pos  int;
  v_existing  public.booking_waitlist;
  v_new       public.booking_waitlist;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve caller's family
  SELECT f.* INTO v_family
  FROM public.families f
  WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid();

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_family' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Resolve first kid (v0.5 single-kid-per-family assumption)
  SELECT k.* INTO v_kid
  FROM public.kids k
  WHERE k.family_id = v_family.id
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_kid' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  v_tenant_id := v_family.tenant_id;

  -- Validate session type belongs to tenant and is group/cage
  SELECT st.* INTO v_st
  FROM public.session_types st
  WHERE st.id = p_session_type_id AND st.tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'session_type_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF v_st.type_category = 'private' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'waitlist_not_available_for_private' USING ERRCODE = 'P0003';
  END IF;

  -- Verify coach, location, session_type all belong to this tenant
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches WHERE id = p_coach_id AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_coach' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations WHERE id = p_location_id AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_location' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotency: return existing active entry for this family + slot
  SELECT bw.* INTO v_existing
  FROM public.booking_waitlist bw
  WHERE bw.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND bw.session_slot_key = p_session_slot_key
    AND bw.family_id = v_family.id
    AND bw.status IN ('waiting', 'notified');

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN v_existing;
  END IF;

  -- Compute next position
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(bw.position), 0) + 1 INTO v_next_pos
  FROM public.booking_waitlist bw
  WHERE bw.session_slot_key = p_session_slot_key
    AND bw.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND bw.status IN ('waiting', 'notified');

  INSERT INTO public.booking_waitlist (
    tenant_id, session_slot_key, kid_id, family_id, coach_id,
    session_type_id, location_id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end,
    position, status
  ) VALUES (
    v_tenant_id, p_session_slot_key, v_kid.id, v_family.id, p_coach_id,
    p_session_type_id, p_location_id, p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end,
    v_next_pos, 'waiting'
  )
  RETURNING * INTO v_new;

  RETURN v_new;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.join_waitlist(text, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz)
  TO authenticated;


-- ── 3d. leave_waitlist RPC ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Sets status='cancelled', re-numbers remaining positions for the slot.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leave_waitlist(p_waitlist_id uuid)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_entry     public.booking_waitlist;
  v_family_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve caller's family
  SELECT f.id INTO v_family_id
  FROM public.families f
  WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid();

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_family' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Find and lock the entry
  SELECT bw.* INTO v_entry
  FROM public.booking_waitlist bw
  WHERE bw.id = p_waitlist_id
    AND bw.family_id = v_family_id
    AND bw.status IN ('waiting', 'notified')
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found_or_not_yours' USING ERRCODE = 'P0004';
  END IF;

  -- Mark cancelled
  UPDATE public.booking_waitlist
  SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_waitlist_id;

  -- Re-number remaining active entries for the slot
  WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at ASC) AS new_pos
    FROM public.booking_waitlist
    WHERE session_slot_key = v_entry.session_slot_key
      AND tenant_id = v_entry.tenant_id
      AND status IN ('waiting', 'notified')
  )
  UPDATE public.booking_waitlist bw
  SET position = r.new_pos, updated_at = now()
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE bw.id = r.id;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.leave_waitlist(uuid) TO authenticated;


-- ── 3e. claim_waitlist_spot RPC ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Validates claim is within deadline; atomically creates booking + marks claimed.
-- Returns CLAIM_EXPIRED if past deadline.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_waitlist_spot(p_waitlist_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_entry   public.booking_waitlist;
  v_family  public.families;
  v_booking public.bookings;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve caller's family
  SELECT f.* INTO v_family
  FROM public.families f
  WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid();

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_family' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Lock the waitlist entry
  SELECT bw.* INTO v_entry
  FROM public.booking_waitlist bw
  WHERE bw.id = p_waitlist_id
    AND bw.family_id = v_family.id
    AND bw.status = 'notified'
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN json_build_object('code', 'NOT_FOUND');
  END IF;

  -- Check deadline
  IF v_entry.claim_deadline IS NOT NULL AND now() > v_entry.claim_deadline THEN
    UPDATE public.booking_waitlist
    SET status = 'expired', updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_waitlist_id;
    RETURN json_build_object('code', 'CLAIM_EXPIRED');
  END IF;

  -- Create the booking atomically
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status
  ) VALUES (
    v_entry.tenant_id, v_entry.location_id, v_entry.kid_id,
    v_entry.coach_id, v_entry.session_type_id,
    v_entry.scheduled_start, v_entry.scheduled_end, 'confirmed'
  )
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- Mark entry claimed
  UPDATE public.booking_waitlist
  SET status = 'claimed', updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_waitlist_id;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'code', 'OK',
    'booking_id', v_booking.id
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.claim_waitlist_spot(uuid) TO authenticated;


-- ── 4. Cancellation trigger → promote-waitlist Edge Function ─────────────────
-- Fires when bookings.status changes TO 'cancelled' or 'no_show'.
-- Uses pg_net to call the promote-waitlist Edge Function asynchronously.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_promote_waitlist_on_cancel()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_supabase_url       text;
  v_service_role_key   text;
  v_slot_key           text;
BEGIN
  -- Only fire on cancellation transitions
  IF NEW.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show') THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF OLD.status IN ('cancelled', 'no_show') THEN
    RETURN NEW; -- already cancelled, no re-fire
  END IF;

  v_supabase_url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true);
  v_service_role_key := current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true);

  IF v_supabase_url IS NULL OR v_supabase_url = '' THEN
    RETURN NEW; -- pg_net not configured; skip silently
  END IF;

  v_slot_key := NEW.coach_id::text || '_' || to_char(NEW.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"');

  PERFORM net.http_post(
    url     := v_supabase_url || '/functions/v1/promote-waitlist',
    headers := jsonb_build_object(
      'Content-Type',  'application/json',
      'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_service_role_key
    ),
    body    := jsonb_build_object(
      'session_slot_key', v_slot_key,
      'tenant_id',        NEW.tenant_id::text
    )
  );

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_bookings_promote_waitlist
  AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.bookings
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.trg_promote_waitlist_on_cancel();


-- ── 5. pg_cron: expire stale notified entries every 15 min ──────────────────
-- Marks entries past claim_deadline as expired, then fires promote-waitlist
-- for each affected slot so the next person in the queue gets notified.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_stale_waitlist_entries()
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_supabase_url     text;
  v_service_role_key text;
  r                  record;
BEGIN
  v_supabase_url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true);
  v_service_role_key := current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true);

  -- Expire entries past their claim_deadline
  FOR r IN
    UPDATE public.booking_waitlist
    SET status = 'expired', updated_at = now()
    WHERE status = 'notified'
      AND claim_deadline < now()
    RETURNING session_slot_key, tenant_id
  LOOP
    IF v_supabase_url IS NOT NULL AND v_supabase_url <> '' THEN
      PERFORM net.http_post(
        url     := v_supabase_url || '/functions/v1/promote-waitlist',
        headers := jsonb_build_object(
          'Content-Type',  'application/json',
          'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_service_role_key
        ),
        body    := jsonb_build_object(
          'session_slot_key', r.session_slot_key,
          'tenant_id',        r.tenant_id::text
        )
      );
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$$;

-- Register pg_cron job (tolerates extension not installed)
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron') THEN
    PERFORM cron.schedule(
      'expire-waitlist-entries',
      '*/15 * * * *',
      'SELECT public.expire_stale_waitlist_entries()'
    );
  END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  NULL; -- pg_cron not available in this environment; skip silently
END;
$$;

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Public booking page: SECURITY DEFINER helpers for anon access
-- =============================================================================
-- Adds two SECURITY DEFINER functions callable by the `anon` role (no JWT):
--
--   get_public_session_types(p_tenant_slug)
--     Returns active session types for a tenant (for filter pills + booking).
--
--   get_public_availability(p_tenant_slug, p_date_range_start, p_date_range_end)

--     for that coach on that day).

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. get_public_availability
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_availability(
  p_tenant_slug       text,
  p_date_range_start  date,
  p_date_range_end    date
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  coach_id         uuid,
  coach_first_name text,
  coach_last_name  text,
  location_id      uuid,
  location_name    text,
  slot_date        date,
  start_time       time,
  end_time         time,
  is_available     boolean
)
SECURITY DEFINER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT t.id INTO v_tenant_id FROM public.tenants t WHERE t.slug = p_tenant_slug;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;

  -- Safety: cap range to 30 days to avoid runaway queries
  IF p_date_range_end - p_date_range_start > 30 THEN
    p_date_range_end := p_date_range_start + 30;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    c.id                  AS coach_id,
    c.first_name          AS coach_first_name,
    c.last_name           AS coach_last_name,
    l.id                  AS location_id,
    l.name                AS location_name,
    d.slot_date::date     AS slot_date,
    ca.start_time,
    ca.end_time,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.bookings b
      WHERE b.tenant_id  = v_tenant_id
        AND b.coach_id   = c.id
        AND b.status     NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')
        AND b.scheduled_start <  (d.slot_date::date + ca.end_time  )::timestamptz
        AND b.scheduled_end   >  (d.slot_date::date + ca.start_time)::timestamptz
    ) AS is_available
  FROM generate_series(
    p_date_range_start::timestamp,
    p_date_range_end::timestamp,
    '1 day'::interval
  ) AS d(slot_date)
  JOIN public.coach_availability ca
    ON  ca.tenant_id   = v_tenant_id
    AND ca.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.slot_date)::int
    AND (ca.effective_from  IS NULL OR ca.effective_from  <= d.slot_date::date)
    AND (ca.effective_until IS NULL OR ca.effective_until >= d.slot_date::date)
  JOIN public.coaches c
    ON  c.id        = ca.coach_id
    AND c.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND c.is_active = true
  JOIN public.locations l
    ON  l.id        = ca.location_id
    AND l.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
  WHERE d.slot_date::date >= CURRENT_DATE
  ORDER BY d.slot_date, ca.start_time, c.first_name;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.get_public_availability(text, date, date) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_public_availability(text, date, date) TO anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_public_availability(text, date, date) TO authenticated;

-- Drop the old overload with old param names if it exists (idempotent rename guard)
-- (CREATE OR REPLACE keeps the same overload; nothing to drop — param names don't
-- affect the function signature in Postgres, so this is purely a readability fix.)

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260603000012_public_booking_rpc_rework.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Public booking page: rework availability + booking creation RPC
-- =============================================================================
-- Fixes identified in code review:
--
-- 1. get_public_availability now takes p_duration_minutes so it generates
--    discrete bookable start times (e.g. 9:00, 10:00, 11:00 for 60-min sessions
--    in a 9:00–12:00 window) rather than returning raw windows.  Each slot is
--    availability-checked independently for exactly that [start, start+duration]
--    window, so one existing booking never blocks unrelated future slots.
--
-- 2. create_public_booking is a new SECURITY DEFINER function that:
--    · verifies auth.uid() is present (authenticated caller only)
--    · derives tenant from slug (not from client-supplied tenant_id)
--    · validates kid belongs to caller's family in that tenant
--    · validates session_type belongs to that tenant and is active
--    · performs a FOR UPDATE overlap check before inserting (atomic guard)
--    · returns the new booking id
--    This replaces the direct client-side bookings INSERT and enforces all
--    business invariants on the server.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Rework get_public_availability — discrete slots, duration-aware
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Drop old overloads (both (text,date,date) and (text,date,date,int) if present)
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.get_public_availability(text, date, date);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.get_public_availability(text, date, date, int);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_availability(
  p_tenant_slug       text,
  p_date_range_start  date,
  p_date_range_end    date,
  p_duration_minutes  int DEFAULT 60
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  coach_id         uuid,
  coach_first_name text,
  coach_last_name  text,
  location_id      uuid,
  location_name    text,
  slot_date        date,
  start_time       time,
  end_time         time,
  is_available     boolean
)
SECURITY DEFINER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_dur       interval;
BEGIN
  SELECT t.id INTO v_tenant_id FROM public.tenants t WHERE t.slug = p_tenant_slug;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;

  -- Safety: cap range to 30 days; cap duration to 8 hours
  IF p_date_range_end - p_date_range_start > 30 THEN
    p_date_range_end := p_date_range_start + 30;
  END IF;
  IF p_duration_minutes < 15  THEN p_duration_minutes := 15;  END IF;
  IF p_duration_minutes > 480 THEN p_duration_minutes := 480; END IF;

  v_dur := (p_duration_minutes::text || ' minutes')::interval;

  -- For every coach availability window on every date in range, generate
  -- discrete start times spaced v_dur apart.  Each slot is
  -- [slot_start, slot_start + v_dur] and must fit entirely within the window.
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH windows AS (
    SELECT
      c.id          AS coach_id,
      c.first_name  AS coach_first_name,
      c.last_name   AS coach_last_name,
      l.id          AS location_id,
      l.name        AS location_name,
      d.dt::date    AS slot_date,
      ca.start_time,
      ca.end_time
    FROM generate_series(
      p_date_range_start::timestamp,
      p_date_range_end::timestamp,
      '1 day'::interval
    ) AS d(dt)
    JOIN public.coach_availability ca
      ON  ca.tenant_id   = v_tenant_id
      AND ca.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.dt)::int
      AND (ca.effective_from  IS NULL OR ca.effective_from  <= d.dt::date)
      AND (ca.effective_until IS NULL OR ca.effective_until >= d.dt::date)
    JOIN public.coaches c
      ON  c.id        = ca.coach_id
      AND c.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
      AND c.is_active = true
    JOIN public.locations l
      ON  l.id        = ca.location_id
      AND l.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    WHERE d.dt::date >= CURRENT_DATE
  )
  SELECT
    w.coach_id,
    w.coach_first_name,
    w.coach_last_name,
    w.location_id,
    w.location_name,
    w.slot_date,
    gs.slot_start::time                  AS start_time,
    (gs.slot_start + v_dur)::time        AS end_time,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.bookings b
      WHERE b.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
        AND b.coach_id       = w.coach_id
        AND b.status         NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')
        AND b.scheduled_start < (gs.slot_start + v_dur)::timestamptz
        AND b.scheduled_end   >  gs.slot_start::timestamptz
    )                                    AS is_available
  FROM windows w
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    (w.slot_date + w.start_time)::timestamp,
    (w.slot_date + w.end_time)::timestamp - v_dur,
    v_dur
  ) AS gs(slot_start)
  ORDER BY w.slot_date, gs.slot_start::time, w.coach_first_name;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.get_public_availability(text, date, date, int) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_public_availability(text, date, date, int) TO anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_public_availability(text, date, date, int) TO authenticated;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. create_public_booking — server-side booking creation with overlap guard
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_public_booking(
  p_tenant_slug     text,
  p_coach_id        uuid,
  p_location_id     uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_kid_id          uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz
)
RETURNS TABLE (booking_id uuid)
SECURITY DEFINER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id     uuid;
  v_duration      interval;
  v_scheduled_end timestamptz;
  v_family_id     uuid;
  v_booking_id    uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Must be authenticated
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  -- Derive tenant from slug (never trust a client-supplied tenant_id)
  SELECT t.id INTO v_tenant_id FROM public.tenants t WHERE t.slug = p_tenant_slug LIMIT 1;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_not_found';
  END IF;

  -- Caller must have a family in this tenant
  SELECT f.id INTO v_family_id
  FROM public.families f
  WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND f.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_family_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'family_not_found';
  END IF;

  -- The kid must belong to this family
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.kids k
    WHERE k.id        = p_kid_id
      AND k.family_id = v_family_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'kid_not_in_family';
  END IF;

  -- Session type must belong to this tenant and be active
  SELECT (st.duration_minutes::text || ' minutes')::interval INTO v_duration
  FROM public.session_types st
  WHERE st.id        = p_session_type_id
    AND st.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND st.is_active = true
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_duration IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'session_type_not_found';
  END IF;

  v_scheduled_end := p_scheduled_start + v_duration;

  -- Atomic overlap guard — FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED: if another concurrent
  -- transaction is inserting into the same slot, we optimistically skip and
  -- proceed; the UNIQUE constraint on (coach_id, scheduled_start) would catch
  -- true duplicates.  The select + insert pair is not 100% serializable without
  -- SERIALIZABLE isolation, but provides a best-effort guard consistent with
  -- the rest of the system.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.bookings b
    WHERE b.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
      AND b.coach_id       = p_coach_id
      AND b.status         NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')
      AND b.scheduled_start < v_scheduled_end
      AND b.scheduled_end   > p_scheduled_start
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'slot_not_available';
  END IF;

  -- Insert booking
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status
  ) VALUES (
    v_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, v_scheduled_end, 'confirmed'
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_booking_id;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_booking_id;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.create_public_booking(text, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.create_public_booking(text, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz) TO authenticated;


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260603000013_harden_create_public_booking.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Harden create_public_booking
-- =============================================================================
-- Fixes identified in code review:
--
-- 1. Tenant isolation: validate p_coach_id and p_location_id belong to the
--    derived tenant_id (a SECURITY DEFINER fn must never trust client-supplied
--    FK references to rows it hasn't verified belong to the right tenant).
--
-- 2. Atomic overlap guard: replace the misleading `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`
--    (which skips locked rows and does NOT prevent concurrent double-booking)
--    with pg_advisory_xact_lock keyed on (coach_id, scheduled_start_hour).
--    The advisory lock is transaction-scoped and auto-released on commit/
--    rollback.  Two concurrent requests for the same coach at overlapping times
--    will serialize: the first acquires the lock, checks no overlap, inserts,
--    commits; the second then acquires the lock, checks again (sees the first
--    booking), and raises slot_not_available.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_public_booking(
  p_tenant_slug     text,
  p_coach_id        uuid,
  p_location_id     uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_kid_id          uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz
)
RETURNS TABLE (booking_id uuid)
SECURITY DEFINER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id     uuid;
  v_duration      interval;
  v_scheduled_end timestamptz;
  v_family_id     uuid;
  v_booking_id    uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Must be authenticated
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  -- Derive tenant from slug (never trust a client-supplied tenant_id)
  SELECT t.id INTO v_tenant_id FROM public.tenants t WHERE t.slug = p_tenant_slug LIMIT 1;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_not_found';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant-isolation: all FK references must belong to this tenant ────────

  -- Validate coach belongs to derived tenant and is active
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches c
    WHERE c.id        = p_coach_id
      AND c.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
      AND c.is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'coach_not_found';
  END IF;

  -- Validate location belongs to derived tenant
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations l
    WHERE l.id        = p_location_id
      AND l.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'location_not_found';
  END IF;

  -- Caller must have a family in this tenant
  SELECT f.id INTO v_family_id
  FROM public.families f
  WHERE f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND f.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_family_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'family_not_found';
  END IF;

  -- The kid must belong to this family
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.kids k
    WHERE k.id        = p_kid_id
      AND k.family_id = v_family_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'kid_not_in_family';
  END IF;

  -- Session type must belong to this tenant and be active
  SELECT (st.duration_minutes::text || ' minutes')::interval INTO v_duration
  FROM public.session_types st
  WHERE st.id        = p_session_type_id
    AND st.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND st.is_active = true
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_duration IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'session_type_not_found';
  END IF;

  v_scheduled_end := p_scheduled_start + v_duration;

  -- ── Atomic overlap guard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- Advisory transaction lock keyed on (coach, hour-bucket) prevents two
  -- concurrent transactions from both seeing an empty slot and double-booking.
  -- Lock is automatically released when this transaction commits or rolls back.
  -- Using two-arg form: (int4 classid, int4 objid) = (coach hash, epoch/hour).
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtext(p_coach_id::text),
    (extract(epoch from date_trunc('hour', p_scheduled_start)) / 3600)::int
  );

  -- After acquiring the lock, re-check for any actual overlapping bookings
  -- (committed by other transactions before this lock was acquired).
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.bookings b
    WHERE b.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
      AND b.coach_id       = p_coach_id
      AND b.status         NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')
      AND b.scheduled_start < v_scheduled_end
      AND b.scheduled_end   > p_scheduled_start
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'slot_not_available';
  END IF;

  -- Insert booking
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status
  ) VALUES (
    v_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, v_scheduled_end, 'confirmed'
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_booking_id;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_booking_id;
END;
$$;

-- Grants unchanged — function signature is identical
ALTER FUNCTION public.create_public_booking(text, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.create_public_booking(text, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260605000000_coach_capabilities.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Coach capabilities / access-tier presets (Task #310)
-- =============================================================================
-- Adds a `capabilities` JSONB column to `public.coaches` that stores the
-- access-tier preset for each coach. Two presets are defined:
--
--   "instructor" (default) — training tools only (Inbox, Sessions, Assignments)
--   "staff"                — also gets operational portal sections
--                            (Schedule, Check-In, Families, Redemptions)
--
-- The column is forward-compatible with per-capability grants by allowing
-- arbitrary extra keys alongside `preset`. Only the `preset` value is
-- constrained by a CHECK.
--
-- Additionally adds:
--   • An owner/admin UPDATE policy on coaches so the owner can flip presets
--     from the portal team management page.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Add the capabilities column
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.coaches
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS capabilities JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"preset":"instructor"}';


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Backfill: any existing row that somehow lacks the column default gets it.
--    ON CONFLICT is not applicable here; the DEFAULT handles new rows.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
UPDATE public.coaches
  SET capabilities = '{"preset":"instructor"}'::jsonb
  WHERE capabilities IS NULL OR capabilities->>'preset' IS NULL;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. CHECK constraint — preset must be one of the two known tiers
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.coaches
  ADD CONSTRAINT coaches_capabilities_preset_check
  CHECK ((capabilities->>'preset') IN ('instructor', 'staff'));


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Allow owners and admins to UPDATE any coach row in their tenant.
--    Previously only coaches could update their own row; owners had no UPDATE
--    policy which meant flipping presets from the portal was blocked by RLS.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE POLICY coaches_owner_admin_update ON public.coaches
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('owner', 'admin')
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('owner', 'admin')
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
  );


-- =============================================================================
-- ROLLBACK SQL
-- =============================================================================
-- To undo (in reverse order):
--
--   DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coaches_owner_admin_update ON public.coaches;
--   ALTER TABLE public.coaches DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS coaches_capabilities_preset_check;
--   ALTER TABLE public.coaches DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS capabilities;
-- =============================================================================

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260605000001_staff_coach_db_access.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Staff-coach DB access: tenant-wide booking reads + check-in ops
-- =============================================================================
-- Addresses two gaps left after 20260605000000_coach_capabilities:
--
--   A) bookings SELECT RLS — instructor coaches can only see their own assigned
--      bookings (bookings_select_coach policy). Staff coaches need a tenant-wide
--      view so the /coach/schedule and /coach/check-in pages show the full
--      facility board.
--
--   B) Check-in RPCs enforce "coach may only act on bookings assigned to them".
--      Staff coaches need to check in any booking in the tenant, not just theirs.
--
--   C) mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff(p_code) — DB-enforced SECURITY DEFINER
--      RPC that validates app_role='coach' AND capabilities->>'preset'='staff'
--      at the DB layer, so the portal route never needs service-role for redemptions.
--
-- Depends on:
--   20260605000000_coach_capabilities.sql  (coaches.capabilities column)
--   20260602000000_check_in_rpcs.sql       (three check-in RPCs)
--   20260511000000_v07_achievements_and_fulfillment.sql (orders / redemption_code)
-- =============================================================================


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A. Helper: get_my_coach_preset()
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECURITY DEFINER so it bypasses coaches RLS when invoked inside a bookings
-- SELECT policy. This prevents infinite RLS recursion:
--   bookings policy → subquery coaches → coaches policy → subquery bookings
-- Returns NULL when the calling user has no coaches row (e.g. admin, parent).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_coach_preset()
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
  SELECT capabilities->>'preset'
    FROM public.coaches
   WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
   LIMIT 1;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.get_my_coach_preset() OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_coach_preset() FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_coach_preset() TO authenticated;


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A. Booking SELECT policy for staff coaches (tenant-wide)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Staff coaches see ALL bookings in their tenant (floor-ops view).
-- Instructor coaches continue to use bookings_select_coach (own bookings only).
-- The SECURITY DEFINER helper avoids RLS recursion on the coaches table.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS bookings_select_staff_coach ON public.bookings;
CREATE POLICY bookings_select_staff_coach ON public.bookings
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'coach'
    AND tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND public.get_my_coach_preset() = 'staff'
  );


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- B. Update check-in RPCs — staff coaches act on any booking in their tenant
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Each of the three RPCs has the same coach block:
--   "Coach may only act on bookings assigned to them"
-- We replace that block with:
--   - IF coach is staff → tenant-wide (skip coach_id match)
--   - IF coach is instructor → original own-booking restriction
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


-- ── check_in_booking ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role        text;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_coach_id    uuid;
  v_coach_preset text;
  v_booking     public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  -- ── Role gate (parent denied) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant isolation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Role-specific access control ───────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
    SELECT id, capabilities->>'preset'
      INTO v_coach_id, v_coach_preset
      FROM public.coaches
     WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
       AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

    -- Instructor coaches may only act on their own assigned bookings.
    -- Staff coaches have facility-wide check-in authority.
    IF v_coach_preset IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' THEN
      IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
    END IF;

  ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
       WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
         AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

  -- owner + super_admin: tenant-wide access, no additional restriction
  END IF;

  -- ── Idempotent: already completed → return current row ─────────────────
  IF v_booking.status = 'completed' THEN
    RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
  END IF;

  -- ── Only pending/confirmed may be checked in ────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS: booking is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0003';
  END IF;

  -- ── Mark completed (fires award_booking_completion_points trigger) ───────
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'completed',
         attended_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- ── Create sessions row if one doesn't exist for this booking ───────────
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
  ) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.sessions (
      tenant_id, kid_id, coach_id, booking_id,
      capture_source, started_at, ended_at
    ) VALUES (
      v_booking.tenant_id, v_booking.kid_id, v_booking.coach_id, p_booking_id,
      'none', v_booking.scheduled_start, v_booking.scheduled_end
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) TO authenticated;


-- ── mark_no_show ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_no_show(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role        text;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_coach_id    uuid;
  v_coach_preset text;
  v_booking     public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  -- ── Role gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant isolation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Role-specific access control ─────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
    SELECT id, capabilities->>'preset'
      INTO v_coach_id, v_coach_preset

    IF v_coach_preset IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' THEN
      IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';

  ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN

-- ── undo_check_in ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role        text;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_coach_id    uuid;
  v_coach_preset text;
  v_booking     public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta       int;
BEGIN
  -- ── Role gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant isolation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
  IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Role-specific access control ─────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
    SELECT id, capabilities->>'preset'
      INTO v_coach_id, v_coach_preset
      FROM public.coaches
     WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
       AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

    IF v_coach_preset IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' THEN
      IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
    END IF;

  ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
       WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
         AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

  -- owner + super_admin: tenant-wide, no location restriction
  END IF;

  -- ── Booking must be completed to undo ────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status != 'completed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_CHECKED_IN: booking status is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0004';
  END IF;

  -- ── 5-minute undo window ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.attended_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0005';
  END IF;

  -- ── Revert booking (award trigger only fires on → 'completed', so this
  --    UPDATE does NOT re-trigger points) ──────────────────────────────
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'confirmed',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- ── Delete the sessions row created by check_in_booking ─────────────
  DELETE FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id;

  -- ── Reverse points: remove ledger row and decrement kid balance ───────
  SELECT delta INTO v_delta
    FROM public.points_ledger
   WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
     AND reference_type = 'booking'
     AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
     AND reason         = 'session_attended';

  IF FOUND AND v_delta IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
       AND reference_type = 'booking'
       AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
       AND reason         = 'session_attended';

    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = GREATEST(0, points_balance - v_delta)
     WHERE id = v_booking.kid_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) TO authenticated;


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- C. mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff(p_code text)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DB-enforced SECURITY DEFINER RPC for staff coaches to fulfill point
-- redemptions. Enforces at the DB layer:
--   • app_role must be 'coach'
--   • caller's coaches row must have capabilities->>'preset' = 'staff'
--   • order's tenant_id must match caller's tenant_id
--   • same business guards as mark_redemption_fulfilled (admin version):
--     payment_method = 'points', status = 'ordered'
-- Identical fulfillment logic (idempotent, FOR UPDATE lock, status + timestamps).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff(p_code text)
RETURNS public.orders
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role       text;
  v_tenant_id  uuid;
  v_user_id    uuid;
  v_order      public.orders%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  -- ── Role gate: must be a coach ─────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  IF v_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'coach' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff: caller is not a coach'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_user_id   := auth.uid();
  v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  -- ── Preset gate: must be staff ────────────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches
     WHERE user_id    = v_user_id
       AND tenant_id  = v_tenant_id
       AND capabilities->>'preset' = 'staff'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff: caller is not a staff coach'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- ── Resolve code → order (FOR UPDATE to serialize concurrent taps) ────
  SELECT o.* INTO v_order
    FROM public.orders o
   WHERE o.redemption_code = upper(trim(p_code))
     AND o.tenant_id       = v_tenant_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff: redemption code % not found in tenant',
      p_code
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Idempotent re-tap ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_order.fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN v_order;
  END IF;

  -- ── Business guards ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_order.payment_method <> 'points' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff: order % is %, only points redemptions can be fulfilled here',
      v_order.id, v_order.payment_method
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
  IF v_order.status <> 'ordered' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff: order % status is %, expected ordered',
      v_order.id, v_order.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Fulfill ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  UPDATE public.orders
     SET status               = 'fulfilled',
         fulfilled_at         = now(),
         fulfilled_by_user_id = v_user_id
   WHERE id = v_order.id
  RETURNING * INTO v_order;

  RETURN v_order;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff(text) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff(text) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff(text) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260605000004_fix_redeem_reward_ambiguous_col.sql
=================================================================================
-- Fix ambiguous column reference in redeem_reward_for_kid.
-- The original function body had:
--   EXIT WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE redemption_code = v_code);
-- PostgreSQL 42702: "redemption_code" is ambiguous — it matches both the RETURNS TABLE
-- output variable and the orders.redemption_code column.
-- Fix: table-qualify the column reference as orders.redemption_code.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.redeem_reward_for_kid(
  p_kid_id    uuid,
  p_product_id uuid
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  order_id        uuid,
  redemption_code text,
  new_balance     int
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id        uuid := auth.uid();
  v_jwt_tenant_id  uuid;
  v_kid            public.kids%ROWTYPE;
  v_family         public.families%ROWTYPE;
  v_product        public.products%ROWTYPE;
  v_new_balance    int;
  v_code           text;
  v_attempts       int := 0;
  v_order_id       uuid;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  v_jwt_tenant_id := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
  IF v_jwt_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: missing tenant_id claim' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  -- Lock the kid row for update; resolves the family via the FK.
  SELECT * INTO v_kid
    FROM public.kids
   WHERE id = p_kid_id
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: kid % not found', p_kid_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_family
    FROM public.families
   WHERE id = v_kid.family_id;

  IF v_family.parent_user_id <> v_user_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: kid does not belong to caller' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_family.tenant_id <> v_jwt_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: tenant mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Lock the product row to prevent inventory race.
  SELECT * INTO v_product
    FROM public.products
   WHERE id = p_product_id
     AND tenant_id = v_jwt_tenant_id
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: product % not found', p_product_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_product.is_active THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: product is inactive' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_product.is_redeemable OR v_product.points_cost IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: product not redeemable for points' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_product.inventory_count IS NOT NULL AND v_product.inventory_count <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: product is sold out' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_kid.points_balance < v_product.points_cost THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: insufficient points (have %, need %)',
      v_kid.points_balance, v_product.points_cost
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Generate a unique redemption code; retry on the (vanishingly rare) collision.
  -- NOTE: orders.redemption_code is table-qualified to avoid 42702 ambiguity with
  -- the RETURNS TABLE output variable of the same name.
  LOOP
    v_attempts := v_attempts + 1;
    v_code := public.gen_redemption_code();
    EXIT WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE orders.redemption_code = v_code);
    IF v_attempts > 8 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'redeem_reward_for_kid: failed to generate unique code' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  v_new_balance := v_kid.points_balance - v_product.points_cost;

  -- 1) Decrement the balance.
  UPDATE public.kids
     SET points_balance = v_new_balance
   WHERE id = v_kid.id;

  -- 2) Decrement inventory if it's tracked.
  IF v_product.inventory_count IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.products
       SET inventory_count = v_product.inventory_count - 1
     WHERE id = v_product.id;
  END IF;

  -- 3) Insert the order.
  INSERT INTO public.orders (
    tenant_id, family_id, kid_id, product_id,
    payment_method, amount_paid_points,
    status, redemption_code
  ) VALUES (
    v_jwt_tenant_id, v_family.id, v_kid.id, v_product.id,
    'points', v_product.points_cost,
    'ordered', v_code
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_order_id;

  -- 4) Insert the ledger entry.
  INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
    tenant_id, kid_id, delta, reason, reference_type, reference_id, balance_after, note
  ) VALUES (
    v_jwt_tenant_id, v_kid.id, -v_product.points_cost, 'redemption', 'order', v_order_id,
    v_new_balance, v_product.name
  );

  order_id := v_order_id;
  redemption_code := v_code;
  new_balance := v_new_balance;
  RETURN NEXT;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.redeem_reward_for_kid(uuid, uuid) OWNER TO postgres;

REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.redeem_reward_for_kid(uuid, uuid) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.redeem_reward_for_kid(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260606000000_booking_flow_overhaul.sql
