-- ============================================================
-- Booking flow overhaul
--
-- 1. locations.cage_rental_enabled  — per-location opt-in for cage rentals
-- 2. bookings: is_guest + guest contact fields  — Bring-a-Friend guest row
-- 3. deduct_session_credits(p_kid_id, p_n)  — atomic N-credit deduction
--    used by Bring-a-Friend (deducts 2 in one transaction)
-- ============================================================

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. locations: cage_rental_enabled toggle
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.locations
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cage_rental_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. bookings: Bring-a-Friend guest fields
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.bookings
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_guest   boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS guest_name  text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS guest_phone text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS guest_email text;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. RPC: deduct_session_credits(p_kid_id uuid, p_n int)
--
-- Atomically checks sessions_remaining >= p_n and decrements by p_n.
-- Returns the new (post-decrement) balance, or -1 for unlimited/untracked.
-- Raises 'no_session_credits' if remaining < p_n.
-- Used for Bring-a-Friend (p_n = 2).
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deduct_session_credits(
  p_kid_id    uuid,
  p_n         int
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role          text;
  v_tenant_id     uuid;
  v_membership_id uuid;
  v_remaining     integer;
  v_new_remaining integer;
BEGIN
  IF p_n < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_n' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';

  -- Resolve tenant from the kid row
  SELECT f.tenant_id
  INTO   v_tenant_id
  FROM   public.kids k
  JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
  WHERE  k.id = p_kid_id
  LIMIT  1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'kid_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Tenant isolation
  IF v_role <> 'super_admin'
     AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Parent: must own the family that owns this kid
  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id            = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Lock the active OTC membership row for atomic decrement
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    -- EFT unlimited or untracked OTC — no deduction needed
    RETURN -1;
  END IF;

  IF v_remaining < p_n THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.memberships
  SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - p_n,
         updated_at         = now()
  WHERE  id = v_membership_id
  RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;

  RETURN v_new_remaining;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.deduct_session_credits(uuid, int) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260606000001_book_with_friend_rpc.sql
=================================================================================
-- ============================================================
-- book_session_with_friend RPC
--
-- Atomically books a primary session + a guest (Bring-a-Friend) session
-- in a single transaction:
--   1. Deducts 2 session credits (FOR UPDATE lock on the membership row)
--   2. Inserts the primary booking row (confirmed, is_guest = false)
--   3. Inserts the guest booking row  (confirmed, is_guest = true)
--   4. Inserts a points_ledger row     (+100 pts, reason = 'bring_a_friend')
--
-- Returns the primary booking id and the post-deduction credit balance.
-- Errors if the member's balance < 2 ('no_session_credits').
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  p_tenant_id      uuid,
  p_location_id    uuid,
  p_kid_id         uuid,
  p_coach_id       uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz,
  p_scheduled_end   timestamptz,
  p_guest_name      text,
  p_guest_phone     text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_guest_email     text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role              text;
  v_caller_tenant     uuid;
  v_membership_id     uuid;
  v_remaining         integer;
  v_new_remaining     integer;
  v_primary_id        uuid;
  v_guest_id          uuid;
BEGIN
  -- ── Auth checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role          := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin' AND v_caller_tenant IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Validate all referenced entities belong to the caller's tenant ───────
  -- location
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations
    WHERE  id = p_location_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- coach (p_coach_id is coaches.id, which is the FK bookings.coach_id references)
  IF p_coach_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches
    WHERE  id = p_coach_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- session type
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.session_types
    WHERE  id = p_session_type_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Deduct 2 credits atomically ───────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  -- EFT / unlimited: skip credit deduction, v_new_remaining = -1
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    v_new_remaining := -1;
  ELSE
    IF v_remaining < 2 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 2,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
  END IF;

  -- ── Insert primary booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, is_guest
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed', false
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_primary_id;

  -- ── Insert guest booking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status,
    is_guest, guest_name, guest_phone, guest_email
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed',
    true, p_guest_name, p_guest_phone, p_guest_email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_guest_id;

  -- ── Award 100 Bring-a-Friend bonus points ─────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (kid_id, tenant_id, delta, reason)
  VALUES (p_kid_id, p_tenant_id, 100, 'bring_a_friend');

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'primary_booking_id',  v_primary_id,
    'guest_booking_id',    v_guest_id,
    'sessions_remaining',  v_new_remaining
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz, text, text, text
) TO authenticated;

-- Add 'bring_a_friend' to the points_ledger reason allow-list.
-- The book_session_with_friend RPC awards 100 pts with reason='bring_a_friend',
-- but this value was missing from the CHECK constraint, causing the entire
-- transaction to roll back on every BAF booking attempt.

ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger
  DROP CONSTRAINT points_ledger_reason_check,
  ADD  CONSTRAINT points_ledger_reason_check
    CHECK (reason = ANY (ARRAY[
      'session_attended',
      'assignment_completed',
      'pr_hit',
      'redemption',
      'manual_adjustment',
      'achievement_bonus',
      'booking_cancelled',
      'bring_a_friend'
    ]));

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260606000003_fix_baf_rpc_balance_after.sql

-- Fix book_session_with_friend: supply balance_after in the points_ledger INSERT.
-- The original function omitted balance_after, which is NOT NULL — causing
-- every BAF booking to fail with a not-null constraint violation.
--
-- Pattern mirrors all other ledger inserts in the codebase:
--   1. Read current balance with COALESCE(SUM(delta), 0)
--   2. balance_after = current_balance + delta

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  p_tenant_id      uuid,
  p_location_id    uuid,
  p_kid_id         uuid,
  p_coach_id       uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz,
  p_scheduled_end   timestamptz,
  p_guest_name      text,
  p_guest_phone     text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_guest_email     text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role              text;
  v_caller_tenant     uuid;
  v_membership_id     uuid;
  v_remaining         integer;
  v_new_remaining     integer;
  v_primary_id        uuid;
  v_guest_id          uuid;
  v_current_balance   integer;
  v_balance_after     integer;
BEGIN
  -- ── Auth checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role          := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin' AND v_caller_tenant IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Validate all referenced entities belong to the caller's tenant ───────
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations
    WHERE  id = p_location_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF p_coach_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches
    WHERE  id = p_coach_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.session_types
    WHERE  id = p_session_type_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Deduct 2 credits atomically ───────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    -- EFT / unlimited: skip credit deduction
    v_new_remaining := -1;
  ELSE
    IF v_remaining < 2 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 2,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
  END IF;

  -- ── Insert primary booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, is_guest
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed', false
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_primary_id;

  -- ── Insert guest booking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status,
    is_guest, guest_name, guest_phone, guest_email
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed',
    true, p_guest_name, p_guest_phone, p_guest_email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_guest_id;

  -- ── Award 100 Bring-a-Friend bonus points ─────────────────────────────────
  -- Compute current balance first (same pattern as every other ledger insert)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delta), 0)
  INTO   v_current_balance
  FROM   public.points_ledger
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

  v_balance_after := v_current_balance + 100;

  INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
    tenant_id, kid_id, delta, reason,
    reference_type, reference_id, balance_after
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_kid_id, 100, 'bring_a_friend',
    'booking', v_primary_id, v_balance_after
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'primary_booking_id',  v_primary_id,
    'guest_booking_id',    v_guest_id,
    'sessions_remaining',  v_new_remaining
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz, text, text, text
) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260606000004_baf_rpc_update_kid_points_balance.sql

-- Fix book_session_with_friend: also UPDATE kids.points_balance.
-- Every other point-awarding RPC updates kids.points_balance directly
-- (the ledger is the audit trail; the column is the live balance the app reads).
-- The original BAF RPC only inserted into points_ledger but never touched
-- kids.points_balance, so the UI showed no change after booking.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  p_tenant_id      uuid,
  p_location_id    uuid,
  p_kid_id         uuid,
  p_coach_id       uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz,
  p_scheduled_end   timestamptz,
  p_guest_name      text,
  p_guest_phone     text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_guest_email     text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role              text;
  v_caller_tenant     uuid;
  v_membership_id     uuid;
  v_remaining         integer;
  v_new_remaining     integer;
  v_primary_id        uuid;
  v_guest_id          uuid;
  v_balance_after     integer;
BEGIN
  -- ── Auth checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role          := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin' AND v_caller_tenant IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Validate all referenced entities belong to the caller's tenant ───────
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations
    WHERE  id = p_location_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF p_coach_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches
    WHERE  id = p_coach_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.session_types
    WHERE  id = p_session_type_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Deduct 2 credits atomically ───────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    v_new_remaining := -1;
  ELSE
    IF v_remaining < 2 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 2,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
  END IF;

  -- ── Insert primary booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, is_guest
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed', false
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_primary_id;

  -- ── Insert guest booking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status,
    is_guest, guest_name, guest_phone, guest_email
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed',
    true, p_guest_name, p_guest_phone, p_guest_email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_guest_id;

  -- ── Award 100 Bring-a-Friend bonus points ─────────────────────────────────
  -- Increment kids.points_balance (the live column the app reads) and capture
  -- the new value to write into the ledger row as balance_after.
  UPDATE public.kids
  SET    points_balance = points_balance + 100
  WHERE  id = p_kid_id
  RETURNING points_balance INTO v_balance_after;

  INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
    tenant_id, kid_id, delta, reason,
    reference_type, reference_id, balance_after
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_kid_id, 100, 'bring_a_friend',
    'booking', v_primary_id, v_balance_after
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'primary_booking_id',  v_primary_id,
    'guest_booking_id',    v_guest_id,
    'sessions_remaining',  v_new_remaining
  );
END;
$$;

) TO authenticated;

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Gamification points rules update
-- =============================================================================
-- Three changes:
--
--   1. Documents why launch_angle_deg and spray_angle_deg are excluded from
--      detect_swing_pr() — no code change needed; confirmation comment only.
--
--   2. Adds tenant_settings(tenant_id, key, value) — an operator-editable
--      key/value table. Seeds bring_a_friend_points = '100' for infinitehitting.
--
--   3. Replaces the flat +10 award_booking_completion_points() trigger with
--      a tiered weekly-visit bonus:
--        1st visit of ISO week → +2 pts
--        2nd visit             → +3 pts
--        3rd+ visit            → +5 pts per visit
--      Reason changes from 'session_attended' → 'weekly_visit_bonus'.
--      Idempotency preserved via partial unique index on reference_id.
--      The old trigger is dropped; old index and function are kept for any
--      existing ledger rows that used reason='session_attended'.
--
--   4. Updates book_session_with_friend() to read the bonus amount from
--      tenant_settings where key = 'bring_a_friend_points', falling back to 100.
-- =============================================================================


-- =============================================================================
-- §1  PR TRIGGER AUDIT COMMENT
-- =============================================================================
-- detect_swing_pr() (migration 20260508060000) covers exactly three metrics:
--
--   exit_velocity_mph  — higher is unambiguously better; tracked as PR.
--   distance_ft        — higher is unambiguously better; tracked as PR.
--   pitch_speed_mph    — higher is unambiguously better; tracked as PR.
--
-- Two metrics are intentionally excluded:
--
--   launch_angle_deg   — directionally ambiguous. The "ideal" launch angle
--                        depends on the pitch location, batted-ball intent, and
--                        hitter profile. A higher number is not always better
--                        (pop-up vs. line-drive vs. ground-ball), so there is
--                        no meaningful "personal best" to track.
--
--   spray_angle_deg    — directionally ambiguous. Pull, center, and opposite-
--                        field results all have context-dependent value.
--                        Tracking a PR for "most pull-side" or "most oppo" is
--                        not a meaningful athletic achievement.
--
-- The personal_bests table's metric CHECK constraint also enforces these
-- exclusions at the DB level. No code change is required.
-- =============================================================================


-- =============================================================================
-- §1b  Extend points_ledger reason CHECK
-- =============================================================================
-- The constraint was last set in 20260602000004_cancellation_policy.sql.
-- It is missing 'bring_a_friend' (used by book_session_with_friend) and
-- 'weekly_visit_bonus' (introduced below). We drop and recreate it here to
-- add both. The delta constraint and reference_type constraint are unchanged.
-- =============================================================================
ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS points_ledger_reason_check;
ALTER TABLE public.points_ledger
  ADD CONSTRAINT points_ledger_reason_check CHECK (reason IN (
    'session_attended',
    'weekly_visit_bonus',
    'assignment_completed',
    'pr_hit',
    'redemption',
    'manual_adjustment',
    'achievement_bonus',
    'booking_cancelled',
    'bring_a_friend'
  ));

-- =============================================================================
-- §3  TIERED WEEKLY-VISIT BONUS  (replaces flat +10 award_booking_completion_points)
-- =============================================================================

-- Drop the old trigger (not the function — existing ledger rows reference it
-- for historical display; the function can stay as dead code).
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_bookings_award_completion_points ON public.bookings;

-- New function ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Counts how many non-guest bookings the kid has completed in the current
-- ISO week (Monday–Sunday) — including the booking that just transitioned.
-- Determines the incremental award for THIS visit:
--   visit 1 → +2 pts
--   visit 2 → +3 pts
--   visit 3+ → +5 pts each
--
-- Idempotency: a partial unique index on (reference_id) WHERE
-- reason = 'weekly_visit_bonus' AND reference_type = 'booking' ensures
-- each booking can only produce one ledger row regardless of how many times
-- the row is updated to 'completed'.
--
-- Note: is_guest bookings are excluded from the weekly count so a
-- Bring-a-Friend guest booking does not pad the member's visit tally.
-- =============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.award_weekly_visit_points()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_week_count  int;
  v_award       int;
  v_new_balance int;
BEGIN
  -- Only fire on transitions INTO 'completed'.
  IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF OLD.status = 'completed'                THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  -- Skip guest bookings — they don't count toward the member's weekly visit tally.
  IF NEW.is_guest THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  -- Count completed (non-guest) bookings for this kid in the current ISO week.
  -- date_trunc('week', ...) truncates to Monday 00:00 UTC (ISO week start).
  -- NEW.id is already 'completed' in the table (AFTER UPDATE), so it is
  -- included in this count, giving us this-visit's ordinal position.
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int
    INTO v_week_count
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE kid_id      = NEW.kid_id
     AND tenant_id   = NEW.tenant_id
     AND status      = 'completed'
     AND is_guest    = false
     AND date_trunc('week', scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
       = date_trunc('week', NEW.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');

  -- Determine the incremental award for this visit.
  v_award := CASE
    WHEN v_week_count = 1 THEN 2
    WHEN v_week_count = 2 THEN 3
    ELSE 5
  END;

  -- Guard with the partial unique index; duplicate triggers are a graceful no-op.
  BEGIN
    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = points_balance + v_award
     WHERE id = NEW.kid_id
     RETURNING points_balance INTO v_new_balance;

    INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
      tenant_id, kid_id, delta, reason, reference_type, reference_id, balance_after, note
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.tenant_id,
      NEW.kid_id,
      v_award,
      'weekly_visit_bonus',
      'booking',
      NEW.id,
      v_new_balance,
      'Visit ' || v_week_count || ' this week (+' || v_award || ' pts)'
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
    -- Already credited for this booking — undo the balance bump.
    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = points_balance - v_award
     WHERE id = NEW.kid_id;
  END;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.award_weekly_visit_points() OWNER TO postgres;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_bookings_award_weekly_visit_points
  AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.bookings
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.award_weekly_visit_points();

-- Partial unique index backing the idempotency guard.
-- A single booking can only ever produce one 'weekly_visit_bonus' ledger row.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_points_ledger_weekly_visit_bonus
  ON public.points_ledger (reference_id)
  WHERE reason = 'weekly_visit_bonus' AND reference_type = 'booking';


-- =============================================================================
-- §4  CONFIGURABLE BRING-A-FRIEND POINTS
-- =============================================================================
-- Re-creates book_session_with_friend() with a tenant_settings lookup for the
-- bonus amount. Falls back to 100 pts if the row is absent.
-- All other logic is identical to 20260606000001_book_with_friend_rpc.sql.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  p_tenant_id       uuid,
  p_location_id     uuid,
  p_kid_id          uuid,
  p_coach_id        uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz,
  p_scheduled_end   timestamptz,
  p_guest_name      text,
  p_guest_phone     text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_guest_email     text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role              text;
  v_caller_tenant     uuid;
  v_membership_id     uuid;
  v_remaining         integer;
  v_new_remaining     integer;
  v_primary_id        uuid;
  v_guest_id          uuid;
  v_baf_points        int;
BEGIN
  -- ── Auth checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  v_role          := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin' AND v_caller_tenant IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Validate all referenced entities belong to the caller's tenant ───────
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations
    WHERE  id = p_location_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF p_coach_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches
    WHERE  id = p_coach_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.session_types
    WHERE  id = p_session_type_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── Resolve Bring-a-Friend bonus amount from tenant_settings ─────────────
  -- Falls back to 100 pts if the operator has not configured the key.
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT value::int
       FROM public.tenant_settings
      WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        AND key = 'bring_a_friend_points'
      LIMIT 1),
    100
  ) INTO v_baf_points;

  -- ── Deduct 2 credits atomically ───────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    v_new_remaining := -1;
  ELSE
    IF v_remaining < 2 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 2,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
  END IF;

  -- ── Insert primary booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, is_guest
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed', false
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_primary_id;

  -- ── Insert guest booking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status,
    is_guest, guest_name, guest_phone, guest_email
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed',
    true, p_guest_name, p_guest_phone, p_guest_email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_guest_id;

  -- ── Award operator-configured Bring-a-Friend bonus points ─────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (kid_id, tenant_id, delta, reason)
  VALUES (p_kid_id, p_tenant_id, v_baf_points, 'bring_a_friend');

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'primary_booking_id',  v_primary_id,
    'guest_booking_id',    v_guest_id,
    'sessions_remaining',  v_new_remaining
  );
END;
$$;

-- =============================================================================
-- §4b  Update achievements trigger to fire on weekly_visit_bonus
-- =============================================================================
-- The _achievements_after_points_ledger trigger (20260511000000) only fires
-- _grant_achievement(kid, 'first_session_attended') for reason='session_attended'.
-- New bookings use reason='weekly_visit_bonus', so we patch the trigger function
-- to treat both reasons as equivalent for the first-session achievement.
-- =============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._achievements_after_points_ledger()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_count int;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.reason IN ('session_attended', 'weekly_visit_bonus') THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_session_attended');
  ELSIF NEW.reason = 'pr_hit' THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_pr');
  ELSIF NEW.reason = 'redemption' THEN
    PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_reward_redeemed');
  ELSIF NEW.reason = 'assignment_completed' THEN
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
      FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id = NEW.kid_id AND reason = 'assignment_completed';
    IF v_count >= 1 THEN
      PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'first_assignment_done');
    END IF;
    IF v_count >= 10 THEN
      PERFORM public._grant_achievement(NEW.kid_id, 'ten_assignments_done');
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public._achievements_after_points_ledger() OWNER TO postgres;


-- =============================================================================
-- §5  UPDATE undo_check_in — reverse weekly_visit_bonus instead of session_attended
-- =============================================================================
-- The undo_check_in RPC (20260606000000_fix_checkin_rpcs_service_role_bypass.sql)
-- reverses points by finding the ledger row for the booking with
-- reason = 'session_attended'. New bookings will have reason = 'weekly_visit_bonus'.
-- We update the function to match either reason so both old and new ledger rows
-- can be reversed correctly.
-- =============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role         text;
  v_tenant_id    uuid;
  v_coach_id     uuid;
  v_coach_preset text;
  v_booking      public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta        int;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  -- ── Service-role short-circuit ─────────────────────────────────────────
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  -- ── Role gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Fetch + lock the booking ──────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking FROM public.bookings WHERE id = p_booking_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id, capabilities->>'preset'
        INTO v_coach_id, v_coach_preset
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

      IF v_coach_preset IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' THEN
        IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
        END IF;
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Booking must be completed to undo ────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status != 'completed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_CHECKED_IN: booking status is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0004';
  END IF;

  -- ── 5-minute undo window ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.attended_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0005';
  END IF;

  -- ── Revert booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'confirmed',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- ── Delete the sessions row created by check_in_booking ──────────────
  DELETE FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id;

  -- ── Reverse points: support both old ('session_attended') and new
  --    ('weekly_visit_bonus') ledger reasons so the undo works regardless
  --    of when the booking was originally checked in. ──────────────────
  SELECT delta INTO v_delta
    FROM public.points_ledger
   WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
     AND reference_type = 'booking'
     AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
     AND reason         IN ('weekly_visit_bonus', 'session_attended');

  IF FOUND AND v_delta IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
       AND reference_type = 'booking'
       AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
       AND reason         IN ('weekly_visit_bonus', 'session_attended');

    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = GREATEST(0, points_balance - v_delta)
     WHERE id = v_booking.kid_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260610000000_coach_can_fulfill_redemptions.sql
=================================================================================
-- Allow coaches (in addition to admins) to call mark_redemption_fulfilled.
-- Coaches staff the front desk and need to scan + close redemptions from the
-- mobile app. All other guards (tenant match, status='ordered', payment_method
-- check) are unchanged.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(p_code text)
RETURNS public.orders
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id       uuid := auth.uid();
  v_app_role      text := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_jwt_tenant_id uuid;
  v_order         public.orders%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  IF v_app_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: caller must be admin or coach' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_jwt_tenant_id := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
  IF v_jwt_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: missing tenant_id claim' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders
    WHERE redemption_code = upper(btrim(p_code))
    FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: code % not found', p_code USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF v_order.tenant_id <> v_jwt_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: tenant mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotent: re-scanning an already-fulfilled order just returns it.
  IF v_order.fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN v_order;
  END IF;

  -- Only 'ordered' status may be fulfilled.
  IF v_order.status <> 'ordered' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'mark_redemption_fulfilled: order % status is %, expected ordered',
      v_order.id, v_order.status USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.orders
     SET status        = 'fulfilled',
         fulfilled_at  = now(),
         updated_at    = now()
   WHERE id = v_order.id
  RETURNING * INTO v_order;

  RETURN v_order;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_redemption_fulfilled(text) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260611000000_sync_sessions_per_week_on_enrolment.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Task #428 — Sync sessions_per_week from plan to membership on enrolment
--
-- Adds a BEFORE INSERT trigger on memberships that automatically copies
-- sessions_per_week (and initialises weekly_period_start to the current
-- Monday) from the matching membership_plans row whenever a new EFT membership
-- is created with a NULL sessions_per_week.
--
-- This is defence-in-depth on top of the application-layer copy already
-- present in the enrolment API route — it guarantees the field is always
-- populated for any INSERT path (API, scripts, direct SQL, future code).
--
-- Plan lookup intentionally omits is_active so that memberships referencing
-- since-deactivated plans are still correctly seeded. If multiple plans share
-- the same (tenant_id, plan_type, name) the one most recently updated wins.
--
-- Also backfills active/pending/paused EFT memberships still missing the
-- value (idempotent — safe to run multiple times).
-- =============================================================================

-- ── 1. Trigger function ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_sync_membership_sessions_per_week()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_spw integer;
BEGIN
  -- Only act on EFT rows where the caller did not already supply a value.
  IF NEW.plan_type <> 'eft' OR NEW.sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Look up the plan by (tenant_id, plan_type, plan_name) — the three
  -- denormalised keys stored on every membership at creation time.
  -- No is_active filter: memberships may reference plans that were later
  -- deactivated. Most-recently-updated plan wins when names collide.
  SELECT sessions_per_week
  INTO   v_spw
  FROM   public.membership_plans
  WHERE  tenant_id         = NEW.tenant_id
    AND  plan_type         = 'eft'
    AND  name              = NEW.plan_name
    AND  sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT  1;

  IF v_spw IS NOT NULL THEN
    NEW.sessions_per_week   := v_spw;
    -- Default weekly_period_start to this week's Monday.
    NEW.weekly_period_start := COALESCE(
      NEW.weekly_period_start,
      date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    );
    -- Ensure the rolling counter starts at zero.
    NEW.weekly_sessions_used := COALESCE(NEW.weekly_sessions_used, 0);
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- ── 2. Attach trigger to memberships ─────────────────────────────────────────

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_sync_membership_sessions_per_week
  ON public.memberships;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_membership_sessions_per_week
  BEFORE INSERT ON public.memberships
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_sync_membership_sessions_per_week();

-- ── 3. Backfill — EFT memberships still missing sessions_per_week ────────────
-- Covers active, pending, and paused statuses.
-- Omits is_active so archived plans can still seed their memberships.
-- Uses a lateral subquery for deterministic plan selection (most-recently-
-- updated plan wins when names collide within the same tenant).
UPDATE public.memberships m
SET    sessions_per_week   = best_plan.sessions_per_week,
       weekly_period_start = COALESCE(
                               m.weekly_period_start,
                               date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
                             ),
       weekly_sessions_used = COALESCE(m.weekly_sessions_used, 0)
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (m2.id)
         m2.id             AS membership_id,
         mp.sessions_per_week
  FROM   public.memberships m2
  JOIN   public.membership_plans mp
         ON  mp.tenant_id         = m2.tenant_id
         AND mp.plan_type         = 'eft'
         AND mp.name              = m2.plan_name
         AND mp.sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
  WHERE  m2.plan_type         = 'eft'
    AND  m2.status            IN ('active', 'pending', 'paused')
    AND  m2.sessions_per_week IS NULL
  ORDER BY m2.id, mp.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
) best_plan
WHERE  m.id = best_plan.membership_id;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260612000000_kids_admin_role_rls.sql

-- Fix admin role: add super_admin to kids SELECT policy.
--
-- The existing kids_select_admin policy (added in v0.7) covers app_role='admin'
-- but not app_role='super_admin'. Both roles map to the CoachTabNavigator on
-- mobile and should have the same tenant-scoped read access for drill
-- assignment and recipient picker flows.
--
-- The kids_select_admin policy is left untouched; we add a peer policy for
-- super_admin using the same family→tenant join pattern.

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
      AND tablename  = 'kids'
      AND policyname = 'kids_select_super_admin'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY kids_select_super_admin ON public.kids
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING (
        (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'super_admin'
        AND family_id IN (
          SELECT id FROM public.families
           WHERE tenant_id = NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid
        )
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260613000000_fix_kids_admin_rls.sql
=================================================================================
-- Fix kids_select_admin: resolve family IDs without applying the caller's
-- families RLS (which restricts admins to staff_locations-scoped families).
--
-- The Phase 2 migration introduced families_admin_select_staff_locations,
-- which limits SELECT on public.families to rows whose primary_location_id
-- is in public.staff_locations for the calling user. A freshly-provisioned
-- admin with no staff_locations rows therefore sees an empty families
-- subquery inside kids_select_admin, making the full kid list invisible on
-- the drill-assign screen.
--
-- Fix: replace the inline subquery with a SECURITY DEFINER helper that runs
-- as the function owner (bypassing the caller's families RLS) and returns
-- only the family IDs that belong to the CALLER'S OWN tenant (derived from
-- auth.jwt() inside the function — never from a caller-supplied parameter,
-- so cross-tenant enumeration is impossible even via direct SQL/RPC calls).
-- The policy still pins app_role='admin' and tenant_id from the JWT — only
-- the family-id resolution is lifted out of the caller's RLS context.

-- 1. Drop the old parameterized version if it exists (initial deploy attempt
--    may have left it; idempotent DROP guards against "does not exist" error).

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public._get_tenant_family_ids(uuid);

-- 2. Helper function (no parameter — tenant derived from JWT internally) ------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._get_caller_tenant_family_ids()
RETURNS SETOF uuid
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT id
    FROM public.families
   WHERE tenant_id = NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public._get_caller_tenant_family_ids() FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public._get_caller_tenant_family_ids() TO authenticated;

-- 3. Recreate kids_select_admin using the helper ------------------------------

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS kids_select_admin ON public.kids;

CREATE POLICY kids_select_admin ON public.kids
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'admin'
    AND family_id IN (
      SELECT public._get_caller_tenant_family_ids()
    )
  );

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260614000000_fix_families_kids_admin_owner_rls.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix: families + kids RLS for admin / owner / super_admin mobile flows
-- =============================================================================
--
-- Problem 1 — families inner join blocks kids list for admin
--   Phase 2 migration replaced the broad families_select_admin policy with
--   families_admin_select_staff_locations, which limits rows to those whose
--   primary_location_id is in the admin's staff_locations rows. A freshly-
--   provisioned admin (zero staff_locations rows) therefore gets 0 family rows,
--   and the `kids JOIN families!inner(...)` in listTenantKids() returns 0 kids.
--
--   Fix: add a stacking policy (OR logic in Postgres RLS) that lets admin,
--   owner, and super_admin see ALL families in their own tenant_id. This does
--   NOT replace families_admin_select_staff_locations, so portal queries that
--   want location-scoped results are unaffected.
--
-- Problem 2 — kids_owner_select and kids_select_super_admin use a raw subquery
--   on public.families that is evaluated under the caller's RLS context.
--   Owner's families_owner_select and super_admin's families_select_super_admin
--   work fine, but the INNER expression `SELECT id FROM public.families WHERE
--   tenant_id = ...` inside the kids policy runs as the caller, so it can only
--   see families the caller's families policies permit. The existing SECURITY
--   DEFINER helper _get_caller_tenant_family_ids() (created in 20260613000000)
--   bypasses this by running as the function owner. Use it for owner and
--   super_admin kids policies too, mirroring the admin fix.
-- =============================================================================


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Broad tenant-scoped families SELECT for staff roles (mobile join path)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Stacks with families_admin_select_staff_locations (portal location-scoping).
-- Postgres evaluates RLS policies with OR logic within a command type.

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS families_staff_role_tenant_select ON public.families;

CREATE POLICY families_staff_role_tenant_select ON public.families
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('admin', 'owner', 'super_admin')
  );


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Fix kids_owner_select — use SECURITY DEFINER helper
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS kids_owner_select ON public.kids;

CREATE POLICY kids_owner_select ON public.kids
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'owner'
    AND family_id IN (
      SELECT public._get_caller_tenant_family_ids()
    )
  );


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Fix kids_select_super_admin — use SECURITY DEFINER helper
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Drops the existing policy (created in 20260612000000) and recreates it
-- using the helper so the family subquery is not subject to the caller's
-- families RLS policies.

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS kids_select_super_admin ON public.kids;

CREATE POLICY kids_select_super_admin ON public.kids
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') = 'super_admin'
    AND family_id IN (
      SELECT public._get_caller_tenant_family_ids()
    )
  );

-- =============================================================================
-- Widen assignments and coach_messages INSERT policies for staff roles
-- =============================================================================
--
-- Previously both insert policies required app_role = 'coach', which blocks
-- admin / owner / super_admin callers even after the families/kids RLS fixes
-- in 20260614000000 let them read the relevant rows. These callers have no
-- coaches row by design (the client-side createAssignment / sendCoachMessage
-- now falls back to JWT tenant_id for the tenantId field), but the RLS
-- WITH CHECK still rejected them at the database layer.
--
-- Strategy:
--   Replace the single coach-only policy with a widened version that accepts
--   app_role IN ('coach', 'admin', 'owner', 'super_admin'). All FK anti-
--   smuggling EXISTS clauses are preserved verbatim — they pin kid+family to
--   the JWT tenant_id and are evaluated under the caller's RLS context, which
--   now allows admin/owner/super_admin to see those rows (via
--   families_staff_role_tenant_select + kids_select_admin/_owner_select /
--   _select_super_admin). Nothing else on the table changes.
-- =============================================================================


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. assignments — widen insert to staff roles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS assignments_insert_own_coach ON public.assignments;

CREATE POLICY assignments_insert_own_coach ON public.assignments
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND coach_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('coach', 'admin', 'owner', 'super_admin')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.kids k
        JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
       WHERE k.id = assignments.kid_id
         AND f.id = assignments.family_id
         AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
    AND (
      assignments.drill_video_id IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.videos v
         WHERE v.id = assignments.drill_video_id
           AND v.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
      )
    )
  );

COMMENT ON POLICY assignments_insert_own_coach ON public.assignments IS
$c$Cross-tenant FK smuggling defense (same pattern as coach_messages_insert_own_coach).
The kid+family sub-select verifies the kid belongs to that family AND pins
f.tenant_id to the JWT tenant. The optional drill_video_id sub-select pins
the video tenant likewise. Do not simplify either EXISTS clause.
Widened from app_role='coach' to include admin/owner/super_admin (20260614000001).$c$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The parent_to_coach direction (coach_messages_insert_own_parent) is
-- intentionally left untouched — parents can only insert rows they themselves
-- compose and that is unrelated to staff roles.

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coach_messages_insert_own_coach ON public.coach_messages;

CREATE POLICY coach_messages_insert_own_coach ON public.coach_messages
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND sender_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('coach', 'admin', 'owner', 'super_admin')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.kids k
        JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
       WHERE k.id = coach_messages.recipient_kid_id
         AND f.id = coach_messages.recipient_family_id

    )

      coach_messages.video_id IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (

         WHERE v.id = coach_messages.video_id
           AND v.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
      )
    )
  );

COMMENT ON POLICY coach_messages_insert_own_coach ON public.coach_messages IS
$c$Cross-tenant FK smuggling defense (same pattern as 20260505081000).
The kid+family sub-select does TWO things:
  (a) Verifies recipient_kid_id+recipient_family_id form a real pair.
  (b) Pins f.tenant_id to the JWT tenant to prevent cross-tenant FK smuggling.
The video EXISTS clause does the same tenant pin for the optional video_id.
Do NOT simplify either EXISTS clause.
Widened from app_role='coach' to include admin/owner/super_admin (20260614000001).$c$;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260614000002_fix_coach_messages_insert_rls_recursion.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix coach_messages_insert_own_coach RLS recursion (text replies)
-- =============================================================================
--
-- Migration 20260614000001 widened coach_messages_insert_own_coach to accept
-- admin/owner/super_admin roles but accidentally reintroduced the raw EXISTS
-- subquery against public.videos that 20260507233000 specifically fixed.
--
-- The cycle:
--   coach_messages_insert_own_coach (WITH CHECK) →
--     EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.videos v …)  →
--     videos SELECT RLS (videos_select_recipient_parent USING) →
--     EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coach_messages cm …) →
--     re-enters coach_messages policies → 42P17
--
-- Fix: replace the raw EXISTS on videos with public._video_in_tenant()
-- (SECURITY DEFINER helper from 20260507233000) which bypasses videos SELECT
-- RLS and breaks the cycle. The staff-role widening from 20260614000001 is
-- fully preserved.
-- =============================================================================

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS coach_messages_insert_own_coach ON public.coach_messages;

CREATE POLICY coach_messages_insert_own_coach ON public.coach_messages
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    AND sender_user_id = auth.uid()
    AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role') IN ('coach', 'admin', 'owner', 'super_admin')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.kids k
        JOIN public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
       WHERE k.id = coach_messages.recipient_kid_id
         AND f.id = coach_messages.recipient_family_id
         AND f.tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
    )
    AND (
      coach_messages.video_id IS NULL
      OR public._video_in_tenant(
           coach_messages.video_id,
           (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid
         )
    )
  );

COMMENT ON POLICY coach_messages_insert_own_coach ON public.coach_messages IS
$c$Cross-tenant FK smuggling defense (same pattern as 20260505081000).
The kid+family sub-select verifies recipient_kid_id+recipient_family_id form
a real pair and pins f.tenant_id to the JWT tenant.
The video check uses public._video_in_tenant() (SECURITY DEFINER, from
20260507233000) to break the videos<->coach_messages RLS cycle (42P17).
Do NOT replace _video_in_tenant() with a raw EXISTS on public.videos — that
reintroduces the cycle (see 20260614000002).
Widened from app_role='coach' to include admin/owner/super_admin (20260614000001).$c$;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260615000000_fix_baf_balance_after_regression.sql
=================================================================================
-- Fix book_session_with_friend: restore balance_after in the points_ledger INSERT.
-- The 20260610000000_eft_weekly_credits.sql migration rewrote this function to add
-- EFT weekly-credit support but regressed the points-ledger block — it omitted
-- balance_after (NOT NULL) and stopped updating kids.points_balance. This caused
-- every Bring-a-Friend booking to fail with a not-null constraint violation.
--
-- This migration is identical to the EFT version except:
--   1. v_balance_after integer added to DECLARE block.
--   2. Points block replaced with the _0004 pattern:
--        UPDATE kids … RETURNING points_balance INTO v_balance_after
--        INSERT INTO points_ledger (… balance_after) VALUES (… v_balance_after)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  p_tenant_id       uuid,
  p_location_id     uuid,
  p_kid_id          uuid,
  p_coach_id        uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz,
  p_scheduled_end   timestamptz,
  p_guest_name      text,
  p_guest_phone     text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_guest_email     text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role                  text;
  v_caller_tenant         uuid;
  v_membership_id         uuid;
  v_remaining             integer;
  v_new_remaining         integer;
  v_spw                   integer;
  v_weekly_used           integer;
  v_period_start          date;
  v_new_weekly_used       integer;
  v_weekly_remaining      integer;
  v_primary_id            uuid;
  v_guest_id              uuid;
  v_is_eft                boolean := false;
  v_balance_after         integer;
BEGIN
  v_role          := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin' AND v_caller_tenant IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations
    WHERE  id = p_location_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF p_coach_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches
    WHERE  id = p_coach_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.session_types
    WHERE  id = p_session_type_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── OTC: deduct 2 credits ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_remaining < 2 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 2,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
    v_weekly_remaining := -1;

  ELSE
    -- ── EFT: deduct 2 weekly credits ─────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT id, sessions_per_week, weekly_sessions_used, weekly_period_start
    INTO   v_membership_id, v_spw, v_weekly_used, v_period_start
    FROM   public.memberships
    WHERE  kid_id            = p_kid_id
      AND  tenant_id         = p_tenant_id
      AND  plan_type         = 'eft'
      AND  status            = 'active'
      AND  sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF FOUND THEN
      IF v_period_start IS NULL
         OR v_period_start < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
      THEN
        v_weekly_used  := 0;
        v_period_start := date_trunc('week', current_date)::date;
      END IF;

      IF v_weekly_used + 2 > v_spw THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

      v_new_weekly_used := v_weekly_used + 2;

      UPDATE public.memberships
      SET    weekly_sessions_used  = v_new_weekly_used,
             weekly_period_start   = v_period_start,
             updated_at            = now()
      WHERE  id = v_membership_id;

      v_new_remaining    := -1;
      v_weekly_remaining := GREATEST(0, v_spw - v_new_weekly_used);
      v_is_eft           := true;

    ELSE
      -- EFT unlimited or no tracked membership
      v_new_remaining    := -1;
      v_weekly_remaining := -1;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Insert primary booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, is_guest
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed', false
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_primary_id;

  -- ── Insert guest booking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status,
    is_guest, guest_name, guest_phone, guest_email
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed',
    true, p_guest_name, p_guest_phone, p_guest_email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_guest_id;

  -- ── Award 100 Bring-a-Friend bonus points ─────────────────────────────────
  -- Increment kids.points_balance (the live column the app reads) and capture
  -- the new value so the ledger row has a correct non-null balance_after.
  UPDATE public.kids
  SET    points_balance = points_balance + 100
  WHERE  id = p_kid_id
  RETURNING points_balance INTO v_balance_after;

  INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
    tenant_id, kid_id, delta, reason,
    reference_type, reference_id, balance_after
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_kid_id, 100, 'bring_a_friend',
    'booking', v_primary_id, v_balance_after
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'primary_booking_id',        v_primary_id,
    'guest_booking_id',          v_guest_id,
    'sessions_remaining',        v_new_remaining,
    'weekly_sessions_remaining', v_weekly_remaining
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz, text, text, text
) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260616000000_fix_checkin_rpcs_owner_role.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Re-apply service-role bypass to check-in RPCs.
--
-- Migration 20260602000000_check_in_rpcs.sql introduced the final check-in RPC
-- definitions but did so WITHOUT the service-role bypass that was added in
-- 20260525000002_fix_checkin_rpcs_service_role.sql. Because migrations run in
-- timestamp order, the later migration overwrote the fix.
--
-- This migration re-instates the bypass: when the caller's JWT carries
-- { "role": "service_role" } (the portal's server actions use the service-role
-- key), all JWT-based role/tenant checks are skipped. Tenant isolation is still
-- enforced via the booking row's own tenant_id column. The portal server action
-- has already verified the caller's identity via supabase.auth.getUser() and
-- the app_metadata/user_metadata role fallbacks before invoking the service
-- client.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- check_in_booking
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role        text;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_coach_id    uuid;
  v_booking     public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id INTO v_coach_id
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;
      IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_booking.status = 'completed' THEN
    RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
  END IF;

  IF v_booking.status NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS: booking is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0003';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'completed',
         attended_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
  ) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.sessions (
      tenant_id, kid_id, coach_id, booking_id,
      capture_source, started_at, ended_at
    ) VALUES (
      v_booking.tenant_id, v_booking.kid_id, v_booking.coach_id, p_booking_id,
      'none', v_booking.scheduled_start, v_booking.scheduled_end
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
