-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- undo_check_in
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role        text;
  v_tenant_id   uuid;
  v_coach_id    uuid;
  v_booking     public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta       int;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id INTO v_coach_id
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;
      IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_booking.status != 'completed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_CHECKED_IN: booking status is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0004';
  END IF;

  IF v_booking.attended_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0005';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'confirmed',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  DELETE FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id;

  SELECT delta INTO v_delta
    FROM public.points_ledger
   WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
     AND reference_type = 'booking'
     AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
     AND reason         = 'session_attended';

  IF FOUND AND v_delta IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
       AND reference_type = 'booking'
       AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
       AND reason         = 'session_attended';

    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = GREATEST(0, points_balance - v_delta)
     WHERE id = v_booking.kid_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260616000001_fix_checkin_rpcs_service_role_bypass.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Re-apply service-role bypass to check-in RPCs (after staff-coach rewrite).
--
-- Migration 20260605000001_staff_coach_db_access.sql re-wrote all three
-- check-in RPCs to add staff-coach/instructor-coach branching but accidentally
-- dropped the service-role JWT bypass that was introduced by
-- 20260603000000_fix_checkin_rpcs_owner_role.sql.
--
-- The portal server actions call these RPCs via createServiceClient(), whose
-- JWT carries { "role": "service_role" } with no "app_role" claim. Without the
-- bypass, auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role' is NULL → role gate fires → PERMISSION_DENIED.
--
-- This migration reinstates the bypass on all three RPCs while preserving the
-- full staff-coach vs. instructor-coach access-control logic.
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- check_in_booking
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role         text;
  v_tenant_id    uuid;
  v_coach_id     uuid;
  v_coach_preset text;
  v_booking      public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  -- ── Service-role short-circuit ─────────────────────────────────────────
  -- Portal server actions call via the service-role key. When the JWT carries
  -- role = 'service_role' there is no app_role claim; skip all JWT-based
  -- role/tenant checks. Tenant isolation is still enforced via the booking
  -- row's own tenant_id column.
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  -- ── Role gate (parent / anon denied) ──────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant isolation + role-specific access control ───────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id, capabilities->>'preset'
        INTO v_coach_id, v_coach_preset
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

      -- Instructor coaches may only act on their own assigned bookings.
      -- Staff coaches have facility-wide check-in authority.
      IF v_coach_preset IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' THEN
        IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
        END IF;
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    -- owner + super_admin: tenant-wide access, no additional restriction
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Idempotent: already completed → return current row ─────────────────
  IF v_booking.status = 'completed' THEN
    RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
  END IF;

  -- ── Only pending/confirmed may be checked in ────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS: booking is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0003';
  END IF;

  -- ── Mark completed (fires award_booking_completion_points trigger) ───────
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'completed',
         attended_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- ── Create sessions row if one doesn't exist for this booking ───────────
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
  ) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.sessions (
      tenant_id, kid_id, coach_id, booking_id,
      capture_source, started_at, ended_at
    ) VALUES (
      v_booking.tenant_id, v_booking.kid_id, v_booking.coach_id, p_booking_id,
      'none', v_booking.scheduled_start, v_booking.scheduled_end
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.check_in_booking(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- mark_no_show
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_no_show(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role         text;
  v_tenant_id    uuid;
  v_coach_id     uuid;
  v_coach_preset text;
  v_booking      public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  -- ── Service-role short-circuit ─────────────────────────────────────────
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  -- ── Role gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant isolation + role-specific access control ───────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id, capabilities->>'preset'
        INTO v_coach_id, v_coach_preset
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

      IF v_coach_preset IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' THEN
        IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
        END IF;
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    -- owner + super_admin: tenant-wide, no location restriction
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Idempotent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status = 'no_show' THEN
    RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
  END IF;

  IF v_booking.status NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_STATUS: booking is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0003';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'no_show',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.mark_no_show(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_no_show(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- undo_check_in
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role         text;
  v_tenant_id    uuid;
  v_coach_id     uuid;
  v_coach_preset text;
  v_booking      public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta        int;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  -- ── Service-role short-circuit ─────────────────────────────────────────
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  -- ── Role gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking
    FROM public.bookings
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
     FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant isolation + role-specific access control ───────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id, capabilities->>'preset'
        INTO v_coach_id, v_coach_preset
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

      IF v_coach_preset IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' THEN
        IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
        END IF;
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    -- owner + super_admin: tenant-wide, no location restriction
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Booking must be completed to undo ────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status != 'completed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_CHECKED_IN: booking status is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0004';
  END IF;

  -- ── 5-minute undo window ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.attended_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0005';
  END IF;

  -- ── Revert booking (award trigger only fires on → 'completed', so this
  --    UPDATE does NOT re-trigger points) ──────────────────────────────
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'confirmed',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- ── Delete the sessions row created by check_in_booking ─────────────
  DELETE FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id;

  -- ── Reverse points: remove ledger row and decrement kid balance ───────
  SELECT delta INTO v_delta
    FROM public.points_ledger
   WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
     AND reference_type = 'booking'
     AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
     AND reason         = 'session_attended';

  IF FOUND AND v_delta IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
       AND reference_type = 'booking'
       AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
       AND reason         = 'session_attended';

    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = GREATEST(0, points_balance - v_delta)
     WHERE id = v_booking.kid_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260616000002_leaderboard_expansion.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Leaderboard expansion: HitTrax all-time records + lesson count
-- =============================================================================
-- 1. Update kids.age_group check constraint to the new age-group taxonomy
--    (8U / 10U / 12U / 14U / HS / College).  Existing rows with old values
--    (9U, 11U, 13U, 15U+) are NULLed before the new constraint is added so
--    the migration never rejects pre-existing data.
--
-- 2. Add get_hittrax_leaderboard(p_metric, p_scope, p_location_id, p_age_group)
--    SECURITY DEFINER RPC — returns top 50 kids by their personal best for the
--    requested metric, optionally scoped to an age group and/or location.
--    Tenant-pins via JWT tenant_id claim.
--
-- 3. Add get_lesson_count_leaderboard(p_location_id)
--    SECURITY DEFINER RPC — returns top 50 active members ranked by count of
--    completed bookings at the requested location.
--    Tenant-pins via JWT tenant_id claim.
--
-- Both RPCs are callable by any authenticated tenant member (parent + coach).
-- =============================================================================


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Update age_group check constraint
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Null out any existing rows whose values are no longer valid.
UPDATE public.kids
   SET age_group = NULL
 WHERE age_group IS NOT NULL
   AND age_group NOT IN ('8U','10U','12U','14U','HS','College');

-- Drop the old check constraint (name from initial schema).
ALTER TABLE public.kids
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS kids_age_group_check;

-- Add the new constraint.
ALTER TABLE public.kids
  ADD CONSTRAINT kids_age_group_check
    CHECK (age_group IS NULL OR age_group IN ('8U','10U','12U','14U','HS','College'));


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. RPC: get_hittrax_leaderboard
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameters:
--   p_metric      TEXT   — 'exit_velocity_mph' | 'distance_ft' (required)
--   p_scope       TEXT   — 'national' | 'clubhouse' (default 'national')
--   p_location_id uuid   — required when p_scope = 'clubhouse'; ignored otherwise
--   p_age_group   TEXT   — optional; NULL = all age groups; 'unranked' = kids with age_group IS NULL
--
-- Returns: top 50 rows, ordered by value DESC.
--   national scope  → all locations in this tenant
--   clubhouse scope → only kids whose family.primary_location_id = p_location_id
--
-- RLS: caller must be authenticated in the right tenant. The function derives
-- tenant_id from auth.jwt() and never trusts the caller to supply it.
--
-- Note on clubhouse scope: home location lives on families.primary_location_id
-- (not kids), so the clubhouse filter does a JOIN to families. The SECURITY
-- DEFINER context allows this join without a separate RLS policy on families.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_hittrax_leaderboard(
  p_metric      text,
  p_scope       text    DEFAULT 'national',
  p_location_id uuid    DEFAULT NULL,
  p_age_group   text    DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  kid_id     uuid,
  first_name text,
  last_name  text,
  age_group  text,
  value      numeric,
  rank       bigint
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Tenant guard.
  v_tenant_id := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'get_hittrax_leaderboard: missing tenant_id claim' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  -- Validate metric.
  IF p_metric NOT IN ('exit_velocity_mph', 'distance_ft') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'get_hittrax_leaderboard: unsupported metric %', p_metric USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- Validate scope.
  IF p_scope NOT IN ('national', 'clubhouse') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'get_hittrax_leaderboard: unsupported scope %', p_scope USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
      k.id                                                          AS kid_id,
      k.first_name,
      k.last_name,
      k.age_group,
      pb.value,
      RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pb.value DESC)                          AS rank
    FROM public.personal_bests pb
    JOIN public.kids k
      ON k.id = pb.kid_id
    -- Clubhouse scope: filter via families.primary_location_id (location lives
    -- on the family row, not the kid row).
    LEFT JOIN public.families f
      ON f.id = k.family_id
    WHERE pb.tenant_id  = v_tenant_id
      AND pb.metric     = p_metric
      -- Age-group filter:
      --   NULL          → all groups (ranked + unranked)
      --   'unranked'    → only kids with no age_group set
      --   anything else → exact match
      AND (
        p_age_group IS NULL
        OR (p_age_group = 'unranked' AND k.age_group IS NULL)
        OR (p_age_group <> 'unranked' AND k.age_group = p_age_group)
      )
      -- Scope filter: clubhouse uses families.primary_location_id.
      AND (
        p_scope = 'national'
        OR (
          p_scope = 'clubhouse'
          AND p_location_id IS NOT NULL
          AND f.primary_location_id = p_location_id
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT r.kid_id, r.first_name, r.last_name, r.age_group, r.value, r.rank
    FROM ranked r
   -- Clubhouse: top 10 athletes per location.
   -- National:  top 40 athletes across all locations.
   WHERE r.rank <= CASE WHEN p_scope = 'clubhouse' THEN 10 ELSE 40 END
   ORDER BY r.rank, r.first_name;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.get_hittrax_leaderboard(text, text, uuid, text) OWNER TO postgres;

REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_hittrax_leaderboard(text, text, uuid, text) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_hittrax_leaderboard(text, text, uuid, text) TO authenticated;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. RPC: get_lesson_count_leaderboard
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Returns the top 50 kids (with active memberships) ranked by total completed
-- bookings at the given location. Tenant-pinned via JWT.
--
-- Parameters:
--   p_location_id uuid — filter to bookings at this location (required)
--
-- A kid is included when they have at least 1 completed booking at the location
-- AND an active membership in the tenant (status = 'active').
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_lesson_count_leaderboard(
  p_location_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  kid_id       uuid,
  first_name   text,
  last_name    text,
  lesson_count bigint,
  rank         bigint
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_tenant_id uuid;
BEGIN
  v_tenant_id := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id', '')::uuid;
  IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'get_lesson_count_leaderboard: missing tenant_id claim' USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH lesson_counts AS (
    SELECT
      b.kid_id,
      COUNT(*)::bigint AS lesson_count
    FROM public.bookings b
    JOIN public.memberships m
      ON m.kid_id    = b.kid_id
     AND m.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
     AND m.status    = 'active'
    WHERE b.tenant_id  = v_tenant_id
      AND b.status     = 'completed'
      AND (p_location_id IS NULL OR b.location_id = p_location_id)
    GROUP BY b.kid_id
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT
      lc.kid_id,
      k.first_name,
      k.last_name,
      lc.lesson_count,
      RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lc.lesson_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM lesson_counts lc
    JOIN public.kids k ON k.id = lc.kid_id
  )
  SELECT r.kid_id, r.first_name, r.last_name, r.lesson_count, r.rank
    FROM ranked r
   -- Location-scoped (clubhouse): top 10.
   -- All locations (national): top 40.
   WHERE r.rank <= CASE WHEN p_location_id IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE 40 END
   ORDER BY r.rank, r.first_name;
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.get_lesson_count_leaderboard(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;

REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_lesson_count_leaderboard(uuid) FROM public, anon;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_lesson_count_leaderboard(uuid) TO authenticated;


-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Supporting index — personal_bests lookup for leaderboard queries
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The leaderboard query hits personal_bests filtered by (tenant_id, metric),
-- joined to kids. The existing idx_personal_bests_tenant_id covers tenant scans;
-- this composite index makes the (tenant_id, metric) filter selective.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_personal_bests_tenant_metric
  ON public.personal_bests (tenant_id, metric);

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260616000004_eft_weekly_credits.sql

-- ============================================================
-- Task #427 — Credit-based booking display & enforcement
--
-- 1. membership_plans.sessions_per_week   — weekly allowance for EFT plans
-- 2. memberships.sessions_per_week        — denormalised copy (set on enrolment)
-- 3. memberships.weekly_sessions_used     — rolling counter, reset each Monday
-- 4. memberships.weekly_period_start      — date of the Monday this counter covers
-- 5. pg_cron weekly reset job
-- 6. Updated RPCs: check_session_credits, deduct_session_credit,
--    deduct_session_credits, book_session_with_friend, restore_session_credit
-- ============================================================

-- ── 1. membership_plans: sessions_per_week ───────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.membership_plans
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sessions_per_week integer
    CHECK (sessions_per_week > 0);

-- ── 2-4. memberships: EFT weekly credit columns ──────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sessions_per_week    integer CHECK (sessions_per_week > 0),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS weekly_sessions_used integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK (weekly_sessions_used >= 0),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS weekly_period_start  date;

-- ── 5. Backfill weekly_period_start for active EFT memberships ───────────────
UPDATE public.memberships
SET    weekly_period_start = date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
WHERE  plan_type = 'eft'
  AND  status    = 'active'
  AND  weekly_period_start IS NULL;

-- ── 6. Backfill sessions_per_week from membership_plans to existing memberships
-- Joins on tenant_id + plan_name + plan_type (no FK stored, but plan_name is
-- denormalised from the plan at enrolment time and is effectively the key).
UPDATE public.memberships m
SET    sessions_per_week   = mp.sessions_per_week,
       weekly_period_start = COALESCE(
                               m.weekly_period_start,
                               date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
                             )
FROM   public.membership_plans mp
WHERE  mp.tenant_id        = m.tenant_id
  AND  mp.plan_type        = 'eft'
  AND  mp.name             = m.plan_name
  AND  mp.sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
  AND  m.plan_type         = 'eft'
  AND  m.status            = 'active'
  AND  m.sessions_per_week IS NULL;

-- ── 7. pg_cron weekly reset job ──────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Runs every Monday at 00:00 UTC. Resets weekly_sessions_used and advances
-- weekly_period_start for all active EFT memberships whose period is stale.
-- Uses distinct dollar-quote tags ($do$ outer, $job$ inner) to avoid the
-- nested-$$ quoting conflict.
DO $do$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron'
  ) THEN
    -- Remove old job if already scheduled (idempotent dedup via exception handler)
    BEGIN
      PERFORM cron.unschedule('reset-eft-weekly-credits');
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      NULL; -- job didn't exist yet — that's fine
    END;

    PERFORM cron.schedule(
      'reset-eft-weekly-credits',
      '0 0 * * 1',
      $job$
        UPDATE public.memberships
        SET    weekly_sessions_used  = 0,
               weekly_period_start   = date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
        WHERE  plan_type             = 'eft'
          AND  status                = 'active'
          AND  (
               weekly_period_start IS NULL
            OR weekly_period_start < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
          );
      $job$
    );
  END IF;
END
$do$;

-- ── Helper: current week Monday ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Used inline in RPCs. date_trunc('week', ...) returns Monday in ISO calendar.

-- ── 7. Updated RPCs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- check_session_credits — pre-booking UI check (does NOT consume a credit)
--
-- Returns:
--   >= 0   : OTC sessions_remaining (0 = blocked)
--   >= 0   : EFT weekly_sessions_remaining when sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
--   -1     : unlimited (EFT unlimited or untracked OTC)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_session_credits(
  p_kid_id    uuid,
  p_tenant_id uuid
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role              text;
  v_remaining         integer;
  v_spw               integer;  -- sessions_per_week
  v_weekly_used       integer;
  v_period_start      date;
BEGIN
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin'
     AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id            = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── OTC check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN v_remaining;
  END IF;

  -- ── EFT weekly check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT sessions_per_week, weekly_sessions_used, weekly_period_start
  INTO   v_spw, v_weekly_used, v_period_start
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id             = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id          = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type          = 'eft'
    AND  status             = 'active'
    AND  sessions_per_week  IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    -- If period is stale, treat used count as 0 for the check
    IF v_period_start IS NULL
       OR v_period_start < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    THEN
      v_weekly_used := 0;
    END IF;
    RETURN GREATEST(0, v_spw - v_weekly_used);
  END IF;

  -- No tracked OTC or limited EFT — unlimited
  RETURN -1;
END;
$$;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- deduct_session_credit — atomically deduct 1 credit (called after booking insert)
--
-- Returns:
--   new sessions_remaining (OTC)
--   new weekly_sessions_remaining (EFT)
--   -1 for unlimited
-- Raises 'no_session_credits' if balance = 0.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deduct_session_credit(
  p_booking_id uuid
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role              text;
  v_kid_id            uuid;
  v_tenant_id         uuid;
  v_membership_id     uuid;
  v_remaining         integer;
  v_new_remaining     integer;
  v_spw               integer;
  v_weekly_used       integer;
  v_period_start      date;
  v_new_weekly_used   integer;
BEGIN
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';

  SELECT kid_id, tenant_id
  INTO   v_kid_id, v_tenant_id
  FROM   public.bookings
  WHERE  id = p_booking_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'booking_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin'
     AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = v_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── OTC path ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = v_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_remaining <= 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 1,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
    RETURN v_new_remaining;
  END IF;

  -- ── EFT path ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_per_week, weekly_sessions_used, weekly_period_start
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_spw, v_weekly_used, v_period_start
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id            = v_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id         = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type         = 'eft'
    AND  status            = 'active'
    AND  sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    -- Reset period if stale
    IF v_period_start IS NULL
       OR v_period_start < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    THEN
      v_weekly_used  := 0;
      v_period_start := date_trunc('week', current_date)::date;
    END IF;

    IF v_weekly_used >= v_spw THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    v_new_weekly_used := v_weekly_used + 1;

    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    weekly_sessions_used  = v_new_weekly_used,
           weekly_period_start   = v_period_start,
           updated_at            = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id;

    RETURN GREATEST(0, v_spw - v_new_weekly_used);
  END IF;

  -- EFT unlimited or untracked OTC
  RETURN -1;
END;
$$;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- deduct_session_credits — atomically deduct N credits (Bring-a-Friend)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deduct_session_credits(
  p_kid_id    uuid,
  p_n         int
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role              text;
  v_tenant_id         uuid;
  v_membership_id     uuid;
  v_remaining         integer;
  v_new_remaining     integer;
  v_spw               integer;
  v_weekly_used       integer;
  v_period_start      date;
  v_new_weekly_used   integer;
BEGIN
  IF p_n < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_n' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';

  SELECT f.tenant_id
  INTO   v_tenant_id
  FROM   public.kids k
  JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
  WHERE  k.id = p_kid_id
  LIMIT  1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'kid_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin'
     AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id            = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── OTC path ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_remaining < p_n THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - p_n,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
    RETURN v_new_remaining;
  END IF;

  -- ── EFT path ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_per_week, weekly_sessions_used, weekly_period_start
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_spw, v_weekly_used, v_period_start
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id            = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id         = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type         = 'eft'
    AND  status            = 'active'
    AND  sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_period_start IS NULL
       OR v_period_start < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    THEN
      v_weekly_used  := 0;
      v_period_start := date_trunc('week', current_date)::date;
    END IF;

    IF v_weekly_used + p_n > v_spw THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    v_new_weekly_used := v_weekly_used + p_n;

    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    weekly_sessions_used  = v_new_weekly_used,
           weekly_period_start   = v_period_start,
           updated_at            = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id;

    RETURN GREATEST(0, v_spw - v_new_weekly_used);
  END IF;

  RETURN -1;
END;
$$;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- book_session_with_friend — atomic BAF booking (2 credits)
-- Returns weekly_sessions_remaining in addition to sessions_remaining.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  p_tenant_id       uuid,
  p_location_id     uuid,
  p_kid_id          uuid,
  p_coach_id        uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz,
  p_scheduled_end   timestamptz,
  p_guest_name      text,
  p_guest_phone     text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_guest_email     text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role                  text;
  v_caller_tenant         uuid;
  v_membership_id         uuid;
  v_remaining             integer;
  v_new_remaining         integer;
  v_spw                   integer;
  v_weekly_used           integer;
  v_period_start          date;
  v_new_weekly_used       integer;
  v_weekly_remaining      integer;
  v_primary_id            uuid;
  v_guest_id              uuid;
  v_is_eft                boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_role          := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin' AND v_caller_tenant IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations
    WHERE  id = p_location_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF p_coach_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches
    WHERE  id = p_coach_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.session_types
    WHERE  id = p_session_type_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── OTC: deduct 2 credits ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_remaining < 2 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 2,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
    v_weekly_remaining := -1;

  ELSE
    -- ── EFT: deduct 2 weekly credits ─────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT id, sessions_per_week, weekly_sessions_used, weekly_period_start
    INTO   v_membership_id, v_spw, v_weekly_used, v_period_start
    FROM   public.memberships
    WHERE  kid_id            = p_kid_id
      AND  tenant_id         = p_tenant_id
      AND  plan_type         = 'eft'
      AND  status            = 'active'
      AND  sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF FOUND THEN
      IF v_period_start IS NULL
         OR v_period_start < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
      THEN
        v_weekly_used  := 0;
        v_period_start := date_trunc('week', current_date)::date;
      END IF;

      IF v_weekly_used + 2 > v_spw THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

      v_new_weekly_used := v_weekly_used + 2;

      UPDATE public.memberships
      SET    weekly_sessions_used  = v_new_weekly_used,
             weekly_period_start   = v_period_start,
             updated_at            = now()
      WHERE  id = v_membership_id;

      v_new_remaining    := -1;
      v_weekly_remaining := GREATEST(0, v_spw - v_new_weekly_used);
      v_is_eft           := true;

    ELSE
      -- EFT unlimited or no tracked membership
      v_new_remaining    := -1;
      v_weekly_remaining := -1;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Insert primary booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, is_guest
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed', false
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_primary_id;

  -- ── Insert guest booking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status,
    is_guest, guest_name, guest_phone, guest_email
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed',
    true, p_guest_name, p_guest_phone, p_guest_email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_guest_id;

  -- ── Award 100 Bring-a-Friend bonus points ─────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (kid_id, tenant_id, delta, reason)
  VALUES (p_kid_id, p_tenant_id, 100, 'bring_a_friend');

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'primary_booking_id',     v_primary_id,
    'guest_booking_id',       v_guest_id,
    'sessions_remaining',     v_new_remaining,
    'weekly_sessions_remaining', v_weekly_remaining
  );
END;
$$;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- restore_session_credit — called on cancellation to return 1 credit
-- Handles both OTC (sessions_remaining++) and EFT (weekly_sessions_used--)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_session_credit(
  p_booking_id uuid
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role            text;
  v_kid_id          uuid;
  v_tenant_id       uuid;
  v_booking_status  text;
  v_scheduled_start timestamptz;
  v_already_done    boolean;
  v_membership_id   uuid;
  v_sessions_total  integer;
  v_new_remaining   integer;
  v_spw             integer;
  v_weekly_used     integer;
  v_period_start    date;
  v_new_weekly_used integer;
BEGIN
  v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';

  SELECT kid_id, tenant_id, status, scheduled_start, session_credit_restored
  INTO   v_kid_id, v_tenant_id, v_booking_status, v_scheduled_start, v_already_done
  FROM   public.bookings
  WHERE  id = p_booking_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'booking_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin'
     AND (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = v_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = v_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_booking_status <> 'cancelled' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'booking_not_cancelled' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_scheduled_start <= (now() - interval '10 minutes') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'session_already_started' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_already_done THEN
    RETURN -2;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.bookings
  SET    session_credit_restored = true
  WHERE  id = p_booking_id;

  -- ── OTC restore ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_total
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_sessions_total
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = v_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = LEAST(
             sessions_remaining + 1,
             COALESCE(v_sessions_total, sessions_remaining + 1)
           ),
           updated_at = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
    RETURN v_new_remaining;
  END IF;

  -- ── EFT weekly restore ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_per_week, weekly_sessions_used, weekly_period_start
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_spw, v_weekly_used, v_period_start
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id            = v_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id         = v_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type         = 'eft'
    AND  status            = 'active'
    AND  sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    -- Only restore within the current week; if the booking was in a prior
    -- week's period, the counter was already reset by cron — no-op.
    IF v_period_start IS NOT NULL
       AND v_period_start >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    THEN
      v_new_weekly_used := GREATEST(0, v_weekly_used - 1);
      UPDATE public.memberships
      SET    weekly_sessions_used = v_new_weekly_used,
             updated_at           = now()
      WHERE  id = v_membership_id;
      RETURN GREATEST(0, v_spw - v_new_weekly_used);
    END IF;
    -- Period already rolled — nothing to restore
    RETURN -1;
  END IF;

  -- No tracked membership
  RETURN -1;
END;
$$;

-- ── Re-grant execute on updated functions ──────────────────────────────────
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.check_session_credits(uuid, uuid)             TO authenticated;

=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260616000005_restore_undo_check_in.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Restore undo_check_in to the definitive version.
--
-- 20260616000001_fix_checkin_rpcs_service_role_bypass.sql (applied just before
-- this) rewrites undo_check_in with service-role bypass but without support for
-- the 'weekly_visit_bonus' ledger reason introduced by
-- 20260607000000_gamification_points_rules.sql §5.
--
-- Because gamification_points_rules was applied to production before the
-- service-role-bypass migration (due to the duplicate-timestamp ordering
-- anomaly), the §5 version in gamification_points_rules is the authoritative
-- one and needs to be re-applied here to preserve both:
--   • service-role bypass           (portal server actions)
--   • staff-coach preset branching  (instructor vs. staff coaches)
--   • weekly_visit_bonus support    (new bookings use this ledger reason)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(p_booking_id uuid)
RETURNS json
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role         text;
  v_tenant_id    uuid;
  v_coach_id     uuid;
  v_coach_preset text;
  v_booking      public.bookings%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta        int;
  v_service_role boolean := false;
BEGIN
  -- ── Service-role short-circuit ─────────────────────────────────────────
  IF auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' THEN
    v_service_role := true;
  END IF;

  -- ── Role gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_role := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
    IF v_role NOT IN ('admin', 'coach', 'owner', 'super_admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Fetch + lock the booking ──────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT * INTO v_booking FROM public.bookings WHERE id = p_booking_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BOOKING_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- ── Tenant check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF NOT v_service_role THEN
    v_tenant_id := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;
    IF v_booking.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_tenant_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF v_role = 'coach' THEN
      SELECT id, capabilities->>'preset'
        INTO v_coach_id, v_coach_preset
        FROM public.coaches
       WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
         AND tenant_id = v_tenant_id;

      IF v_coach_preset IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' THEN
        IF v_booking.coach_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_coach_id THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
        END IF;
      END IF;

    ELSIF v_role = 'admin' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_locations sl
         WHERE sl.user_id     = auth.uid()
           AND sl.location_id = v_booking.location_id
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERMISSION_DENIED' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

    -- owner + super_admin: tenant-wide access, no additional restriction
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Booking must be completed to undo ────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.status != 'completed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_CHECKED_IN: booking status is %', v_booking.status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0004';
  END IF;

  -- ── 5-minute undo window ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF v_booking.attended_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0005';
  END IF;

  -- ── Revert booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  UPDATE public.bookings
     SET status      = 'confirmed',
         attended_at = NULL
   WHERE id = p_booking_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_booking;

  -- ── Delete the sessions row created by check_in_booking ──────────────
  DELETE FROM public.sessions WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id;

  -- ── Reverse points: support both old ('session_attended') and new
  --    ('weekly_visit_bonus') ledger reasons so the undo works regardless
  --    of when the booking was originally checked in. ──────────────────
  SELECT delta INTO v_delta
    FROM public.points_ledger
   WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
     AND reference_type = 'booking'
     AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
     AND reason         IN ('weekly_visit_bonus', 'session_attended');

  IF FOUND AND v_delta IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.points_ledger
     WHERE kid_id         = v_booking.kid_id
       AND reference_type = 'booking'
       AND reference_id   = p_booking_id
       AND reason         IN ('weekly_visit_bonus', 'session_attended');

    UPDATE public.kids
       SET points_balance = GREATEST(0, points_balance - v_delta)
     WHERE id = v_booking.kid_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN row_to_json(v_booking);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.undo_check_in(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/migrations/20260617000000_fix_baf_points_ledger_balance_after.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Fix book_session_with_friend: add balance_after to points_ledger insert
-- and update kids.points_balance.
--
-- The eft_weekly_credits migration (20260616000004) re-created this function
-- with the OTC/EFT weekly-credit logic but accidentally dropped two things
-- that had been fixed in 20260606000003 and 20260606000004:
--   1. Updating kids.points_balance when BAF points are awarded.
--   2. Supplying balance_after in the points_ledger INSERT (NOT NULL column).
--
-- Without this fix every Bring-a-Friend booking fails at the ledger insert:
--   "null value in column "balance_after" violates not-null constraint"
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  p_tenant_id       uuid,
  p_location_id     uuid,
  p_kid_id          uuid,
  p_coach_id        uuid,
  p_session_type_id uuid,
  p_scheduled_start timestamptz,
  p_scheduled_end   timestamptz,
  p_guest_name      text,
  p_guest_phone     text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_guest_email     text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_role                  text;
  v_caller_tenant         uuid;
  v_membership_id         uuid;
  v_remaining             integer;
  v_new_remaining         integer;
  v_spw                   integer;
  v_weekly_used           integer;
  v_period_start          date;
  v_new_weekly_used       integer;
  v_weekly_remaining      integer;
  v_primary_id            uuid;
  v_guest_id              uuid;
  v_is_eft                boolean := false;
  v_balance_after         integer;
BEGIN
  v_role          := auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role';
  v_caller_tenant := (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid;

  IF v_role <> 'super_admin' AND v_caller_tenant IS DISTINCT FROM p_tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_role = 'parent' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM   public.kids k
      JOIN   public.families f ON f.id = k.family_id
      WHERE  k.id             = p_kid_id
        AND  f.parent_user_id = auth.uid()
        AND  f.tenant_id      = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.locations
    WHERE  id = p_location_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF p_coach_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.coaches
    WHERE  id = p_coach_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.session_types
    WHERE  id = p_session_type_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- ── OTC: deduct 2 credits ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id, sessions_remaining
  INTO   v_membership_id, v_remaining
  FROM   public.memberships
  WHERE  kid_id    = p_kid_id
    AND  tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND  plan_type = 'otc'
    AND  status    = 'active'
    AND  sessions_remaining IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_remaining < 2 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.memberships
    SET    sessions_remaining = sessions_remaining - 2,
           updated_at         = now()
    WHERE  id = v_membership_id
    RETURNING sessions_remaining INTO v_new_remaining;
    v_weekly_remaining := -1;

  ELSE
    -- ── EFT: deduct 2 weekly credits ─────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT id, sessions_per_week, weekly_sessions_used, weekly_period_start
    INTO   v_membership_id, v_spw, v_weekly_used, v_period_start
    FROM   public.memberships
    WHERE  kid_id            = p_kid_id
      AND  tenant_id         = p_tenant_id
      AND  plan_type         = 'eft'
      AND  status            = 'active'
      AND  sessions_per_week IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF FOUND THEN
      IF v_period_start IS NULL
         OR v_period_start < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
      THEN
        v_weekly_used  := 0;
        v_period_start := date_trunc('week', current_date)::date;
      END IF;

      IF v_weekly_used + 2 > v_spw THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_session_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;

      v_new_weekly_used := v_weekly_used + 2;

      UPDATE public.memberships
      SET    weekly_sessions_used  = v_new_weekly_used,
             weekly_period_start   = v_period_start,
             updated_at            = now()
      WHERE  id = v_membership_id;

      v_new_remaining    := -1;
      v_weekly_remaining := GREATEST(0, v_spw - v_new_weekly_used);
      v_is_eft           := true;

    ELSE
      -- EFT unlimited or no tracked membership
      v_new_remaining    := -1;
      v_weekly_remaining := -1;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- ── Insert primary booking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, is_guest
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed', false
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_primary_id;

  -- ── Insert guest booking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO public.bookings (
    tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id,
    scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status,
    is_guest, guest_name, guest_phone, guest_email
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_location_id, p_kid_id, p_coach_id, p_session_type_id,
    p_scheduled_start, p_scheduled_end, 'confirmed',
    true, p_guest_name, p_guest_phone, p_guest_email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_guest_id;

  -- ── Award 100 Bring-a-Friend bonus points ─────────────────────────────────
  -- Increment kids.points_balance (the live balance the app reads) and capture
  -- the new value to write into the ledger row as balance_after (NOT NULL).
  UPDATE public.kids
  SET    points_balance = points_balance + 100
  WHERE  id = p_kid_id
  RETURNING points_balance INTO v_balance_after;

  INSERT INTO public.points_ledger (
    tenant_id, kid_id, delta, reason,
    reference_type, reference_id, balance_after
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id, p_kid_id, 100, 'bring_a_friend',
    'booking', v_primary_id, v_balance_after
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'primary_booking_id',        v_primary_id,
    'guest_booking_id',          v_guest_id,
    'sessions_remaining',        v_new_remaining,
    'weekly_sessions_remaining', v_weekly_remaining
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.book_session_with_friend(
  uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz, text, text, text
) TO authenticated;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260626000000_fix_sessions_capture_unique.sql

-- Replace partial unique index on sessions(capture_source, capture_session_id) with a
-- full unique index. PostgreSQL's ON CONFLICT clause cannot target a partial index unless
-- the WHERE predicate is also specified; Supabase JS upsert() does not support partial
-- index predicates in onConflict. Since NULL != NULL in SQL, a full unique index still
-- allows multiple rows with NULL capture_session_id (e.g. manual/booking sessions).

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.uniq_sessions_capture;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uniq_sessions_capture
  ON public.sessions (capture_source, capture_session_id);

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260702000000_rewire_cancellation_cron.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Task #519: Re-wire cancellation cron
-- =============================================================================
-- The initial cancellation_policy migration registered the pg_cron job with
-- cron.schedule() but without a preceding cron.unschedule(). This migration
-- re-registers it idempotently (unschedule-then-schedule) so that:
--   1. Any stale registration (e.g. from a run before GUCs were set) is replaced.
--   2. The job name is standardised to 'process-membership-cancellations-daily'
--      (the original used 'process-membership-cancellations' without '-daily').
--   3. The WHERE guard is preserved: the http_post is a no-op if GUCs are unset.
--
-- Prerequisites (one-time per environment, run via scripts/setup-cron-guc.mjs):
--   ALTER DATABASE postgres SET app.settings.supabase_url = '<url>';
--   ALTER DATABASE postgres SET app.settings.service_role_key = '<key>';
--   SELECT pg_reload_conf();
--
-- Safe to re-run: unschedule is wrapped in EXCEPTION to tolerate missing job.
-- =============================================================================

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron')
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_net') THEN

    -- Remove both the old name (without -daily) and the new name, then re-add.
    BEGIN
      PERFORM cron.unschedule('process-membership-cancellations');
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
    END;

    BEGIN
      PERFORM cron.unschedule('process-membership-cancellations-daily');
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
    END;

    PERFORM cron.schedule(
      'process-membership-cancellations-daily',
      '0 2 * * *',
      $cron$
        SELECT net.http_post(
          url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true)
                     || '/functions/v1/process-membership-cancellations',
          headers := jsonb_build_object(
            'Content-Type',  'application/json',
            'Authorization', 'Bearer '
              || current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true)
          ),
          body    := '{}'::jsonb
        ) AS request_id
        WHERE current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true) IS NOT NULL
          AND current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true) <> ''
          AND current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true) IS NOT NULL
          AND current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true) <> '';
      $cron$
    );

  END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- pg_cron or pg_net not available — skip silently.
  NULL;
END;
$$;


-- =============================================================================
-- VALIDATION
-- =============================================================================
-- SELECT jobname, schedule, active FROM cron.job
--  WHERE jobname = 'process-membership-cancellations-daily';
-- Expected: 1 row, active = true, schedule = '0 2 * * *'
-- =============================================================================

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260702000001_rewire_pause_resume_cron.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- Ballpark — Task #520: Re-wire pause/resume cron
-- =============================================================================
-- The original pause migration registered the pg_cron job using
-- current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url') WITHOUT the safe second
-- argument (true). If that GUC is unset the cron body throws a runtime error
-- instead of skipping gracefully, meaning pg_cron would log an error at 06:00
-- every day rather than being a quiet no-op.
--
-- This migration re-registers the job with:
--   current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true)
--   current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true)
-- and adds a WHERE guard identical to the cancellation cron so the http_post
-- only fires when both GUCs are non-null and non-empty.
--
-- Idempotent: unschedule is wrapped in EXCEPTION to tolerate missing job.
-- Safe to re-run: schedule replaces any existing job with the same name.
--
-- Prerequisites (one-time per environment):
--   ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.settings.supabase_url"     = '<url>';
--   ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.settings.service_role_key" = '<key>';
--   SELECT pg_reload_conf();
--
-- See docs/RUNBOOK.md and scripts/setup-cron-guc.mjs for full setup.
-- =============================================================================

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron')
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_net') THEN

    -- Remove existing registration (any name) then re-add with safe GUC access.
    BEGIN
      PERFORM cron.unschedule('resume-paused-memberships-daily');
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
    END;

    PERFORM cron.schedule(
      'resume-paused-memberships-daily',
      '0 6 * * *',
      $cron$
        SELECT net.http_post(
          url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true)
                     || '/functions/v1/resume-paused-memberships',
          headers := jsonb_build_object(
            'Content-Type',  'application/json',
            'Authorization', 'Bearer '
              || current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true)
          ),
          body    := '{}'::jsonb
        ) AS request_id
        WHERE current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true) IS NOT NULL
          AND current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true) <> ''
          AND current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true) IS NOT NULL
          AND current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true) <> '';
      $cron$
    );

  END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- pg_cron or pg_net not available — skip silently.
  NULL;
END;
$$;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260703000000_notify_cancel_requested_trigger.sql
=================================================================================
-- =============================================================================
-- Task #261 — Cancellation emails
--
-- Fires the notify-cancel-requested edge function via pg_net when a membership's
-- cancel_requested_at changes from NULL to a non-null value (i.e. when a parent
-- or owner requests a cancellation via the cancel_membership() RPC).
--
-- The trigger uses the same GUC guard pattern as achievement/waiver triggers:
-- it only fires if app.settings.supabase_url and app.settings.service_role_key
-- are configured. It is a no-op otherwise (safe for environments where the
-- settings are absent).
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.after_membership_cancel_requested()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_url     text;
  v_key     text;
BEGIN
  -- Only fire when cancel_requested_at transitions from NULL → non-null
  IF NEW.cancel_requested_at IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF OLD.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- GUC guard: only invoke if pg_net / URLs are configured
  v_url := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true);
  v_key := current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true);

  IF v_url IS NULL OR v_url = '' OR v_key IS NULL OR v_key = '' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  PERFORM net.http_post(
    url     := v_url || '/functions/v1/notify-cancel-requested',
    headers := jsonb_build_object(
      'Content-Type',  'application/json',
      'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_key
    ),
    body    := jsonb_build_object('membership_id', NEW.id::text)
  );

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_notify_cancel_requested ON public.memberships;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_cancel_requested
  AFTER UPDATE OF cancel_requested_at ON public.memberships
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.after_membership_cancel_requested();

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260707000000_fix_custom_access_token_hook.sql
=================================================================================
-- Fix custom_access_token_hook to inject tenant_id + app_role for owners/admins.
--
-- Previously the hook only handled parents (via families) and coaches (via coaches),
-- so owner/admin JWTs were issued with no tenant_id or app_role claim. This caused:
--   • Portal member list to show demo data (readTenantId returned null → 0 rows)
--   • stripe_subscription_id never saved (DB update matched 0 rows on tenant_id='')
--   • Pause/resume edge functions to return 403 for portal owners
--
-- Changes:
--   1. Add third lookup branch for owners/admins via raw_user_meta_data tenant_slug
--      → tenants.slug lookup → injects tenant_id + app_role
--   2. Also inject 'app_role' for parents and coaches (was only 'role' before);
--      keeps 'role' for backward-compat with any code that reads it.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id   uuid;
  v_claims    jsonb;
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_family_id uuid;
  v_role      text;
  v_app_role  text;
  v_slug      text;
BEGIN
  v_user_id := (event->>'user_id')::uuid;
  v_claims  := COALESCE(event->'claims', '{}'::jsonb);

  -- ── 1. Parent / family ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT tenant_id, id, role
    INTO v_tenant_id, v_family_id, v_role
    FROM public.families
   WHERE parent_user_id = v_user_id;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
           'family_id', v_family_id,
           'app_role',  'parent',
           'role',      v_role
         );

  ELSE
    -- ── 2. Coach ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
      FROM public.coaches
     WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND is_active = true;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_claims := v_claims
        || jsonb_build_object(
             'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
             'app_role',  'coach',
             'role',      'coach'
           );

    ELSE
      -- ── 3. Owner / admin (role stored in raw_user_meta_data) ────────────
      -- Owners are not in families or coaches; their tenant is identified by
      -- raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug' which maps to public.tenants.slug.
      SELECT
        raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role',
        raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug'
      INTO v_app_role, v_slug
      FROM auth.users
      WHERE id = v_user_id
        AND raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role' IN ('owner', 'admin');

      IF v_slug IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id
          FROM public.tenants
         WHERE slug = v_slug;

        IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
          v_claims := v_claims
            || jsonb_build_object(
                 'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
                 'app_role',  v_app_role,
                 'role',      v_app_role
               );
        END IF;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
END;
$$;

-- Permissions are unchanged — hook runs as postgres, callable only by supabase_auth_admin.
ALTER FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) TO supabase_auth_admin;

FILE: supabase/migrations/20260707120000_fix_hook_role_claim.sql
=================================================================================
-- Fix custom_access_token_hook: remove 'role' overrides that break PostgREST.
--
-- Migration 20260707000000 re-introduced a bug that was already fixed in
-- 20260505040800: it set 'role' to 'parent'/'coach'/'owner' in the JWT.
-- PostgREST uses the JWT 'role' claim to SET ROLE in Postgres, so it must
-- stay as 'authenticated' (injected by GoTrue). Overwriting it causes:
--   401 {"code":"22023","message":"role \"parent\" does not exist"}
-- on every single authenticated REST call, making families/kids return empty.
--
-- Fix: only write to 'app_role', 'tenant_id', 'family_id' — never 'role'.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id   uuid;
  v_claims    jsonb;
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_family_id uuid;
  v_app_role  text;
  v_slug      text;
BEGIN
  v_user_id := (event->>'user_id')::uuid;
  v_claims  := COALESCE(event->'claims', '{}'::jsonb);

  -- ── 1. Parent / family ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT tenant_id, id, role
    INTO v_tenant_id, v_family_id, v_app_role
    FROM public.families
   WHERE parent_user_id = v_user_id;

  IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_claims := v_claims
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
           'family_id', v_family_id,
           'app_role',  v_app_role   -- 'parent' — stored in families.role
         );

  ELSE
    -- ── 2. Coach ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
      FROM public.coaches
     WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND is_active = true;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_claims := v_claims
        || jsonb_build_object(
             'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
             'app_role',  'coach'
           );

    ELSE
      -- ── 3. Owner / admin ──────────────────────────────────────────────
      SELECT
        raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role',
        raw_user_meta_data->>'tenant_slug'
      INTO v_app_role, v_slug
      FROM auth.users
      WHERE id = v_user_id
        AND raw_user_meta_data->>'app_role' IN ('owner', 'admin');

      IF v_slug IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_tenant_id
          FROM public.tenants
         WHERE slug = v_slug;

        IF v_tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
          v_claims := v_claims
            || jsonb_build_object(
                 'tenant_id', v_tenant_id,
                 'app_role',  v_app_role
               );
        END IF;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- NOTE: 'role' claim is intentionally NOT set here.
  -- GoTrue injects role='authenticated' and PostgREST needs that exact value
  -- to SET ROLE authenticated for RLS evaluation. Overwriting it with any
  -- application-level string (e.g. 'parent') causes 401 on every REST call.
  RETURN jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', v_claims);
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) OWNER TO postgres;
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) FROM public, anon, authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) TO supabase_auth_admin;
