// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/account-delete/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #118 Step 8c — Outbound GDPR/COPPA propagation on parent account delete.
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Headers: Authorization: Bearer <parent-jwt>
//   Body: {} (empty)
//   Response 200: { ok: true, hittrax_links_purged: number, kids_purged: number }
//
// Flow (in order — each step's failure mode is documented):
//   1. Verify the caller's JWT and recover their user_id + tenant_id claim.
//   2. Look up the family + every kid owned by this parent.
//   3. For every active hittrax kid_capture_link, call HitTrax outbound
//      (RemoveThirdPartyAssociation) so HitTrax stops sending us data and
//      the active-association count drops on their billing side. Failures
//      are logged but do NOT block account deletion — the parent has
//      requested deletion and we owe them deletion.
//   4. Hard-delete kid_capture_links rows (so the password column is
//      destroyed, not just nulled).
//   5. Call supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.deleteUser(userId) — the database FK
//      cascade then removes families, kids, and all per-kid data.
//
// Why this is the OUTBOUND counterpart to hittrax-forget:
//   - hittrax-forget is HitTrax-INITIATED (HitTrax POSTs us when their user
//     requests data deletion through HitTrax). It removes ONLY the
//     HitTrax-sourced rows for one specific link.
//   - account-delete is BALLPARK-INITIATED (parent taps Delete Account in
//     the app). It walks every kid in the family, calls the HitTrax
//     outbound disconnect for each active link, and then deletes the auth
//     user. The two functions cover the two propagation directions; see
//     docs/HITTRAX_INTEGRATION.md.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty,
  jsonError,
  jsonOk,
  logOutSession,
  readHitTraxConfig,
  removeThirdPartyAssociation,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split(".");
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const padded = b64 + "=".repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4);
    return JSON.parse(atob(padded));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// v1.3: Remove a single active HitTrax link during account deletion.
// Best-effort — failures are logged but never block the deletion.
// Flow: authenticate via ThirdParty creds → remove association → logout.
async function removeHitTraxLinkV13(
  cfg: Parameters<typeof authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty>[0],
  thirdPartyUserId: string,
  thirdPartyUserPassword: string,
  linkId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const sessionToken = await authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty(cfg, thirdPartyUserId, thirdPartyUserPassword);
    await removeThirdPartyAssociation(cfg, sessionToken);
    void logOutSession(cfg, sessionToken);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`account-delete hittrax remove failed link=${linkId} reason=${String(err).slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
}

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");

  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();

  // Cryptographically verify the JWT by asking Supabase auth to resolve it
  // to a user. This rejects expired/forged tokens.
  const userClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  });
  const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser(token);
  if (userErr || !userData?.user) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Invalid or expired token");
  const userId = userData.user.id;

  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  const tenantId = typeof payload?.tenant_id === "string" ? payload.tenant_id : null;
  if (!tenantId) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Token missing tenant_id claim");

  // Find the family + kids for this parent.
  const { data: family, error: famErr } = await adminClient
    .from("families")
    .select("id, tenant_id")
    .eq("parent_user_id", userId)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (famErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to fetch family");

  let hittraxLinksPurged = 0;
  let kidsPurged = 0;

  if (family) {
    const { data: kids } = await adminClient
      .from("kids")
      .select("id")
      .eq("family_id", family.id);
    const kidIds = (kids ?? []).map((k) => k.id);
    kidsPurged = kidIds.length;

    if (kidIds.length > 0) {
      // Look up every kid_capture_link we need to walk. We project the
      // password explicitly here (admin client bypasses the column-level
      // GRANT) — the value never leaves this function; we use it only for
      // the outbound HitTrax call and then hard-delete the row.
      const { data: links } = await adminClient
        .from("kid_capture_links")
        .select("id, capture_source, association_status, third_party_user_id, third_party_user_password")
        .in("kid_id", kidIds);

      const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
      // v1.3: outbound HitTrax cleanup in parallel — best-effort.
      // For each active link: authenticate via ThirdPartyUserID/Password →
      // remove association → logout. A HitTrax failure MUST NOT block
      // the deletion — the parent asked us to delete and we cannot hold
      // them hostage to a third-party outage. Failures are logged for ops.
      const outbound: Promise<unknown>[] = [];
      for (const link of links ?? []) {
        if (
          link.capture_source === "hittrax" &&
          link.association_status === "active" &&
          link.third_party_user_id &&
          link.third_party_user_password &&
          cfg
        ) {
          outbound.push(
            removeHitTraxLinkV13(cfg, link.third_party_user_id, link.third_party_user_password, link.id),
          );
        }
      }
      if (outbound.length > 0) await Promise.allSettled(outbound);

      // Hard-delete the link rows. This destroys the password column on
      // disk (vs the soft-flip-to-removed that hittrax-disconnect does
      // for a single-link deactivation). Cascade on the user delete will
      // also remove these via families → kids, but we delete explicitly
      // here so the password column is gone before we even ask
      // auth.admin.deleteUser to fire.
      const { error: delLinksErr } = await adminClient
        .from("kid_capture_links")
        .delete()
        .in("kid_id", kidIds);
      if (delLinksErr) {
        console.error("account-delete delete kid_capture_links failed", delLinksErr);
      } else {
        hittraxLinksPurged = links?.length ?? 0;
      }
    }
  }

  // Auth-level user deletion. This cascades to public.families (FK), which
  // cascades to public.kids, which cascades to swings/personal_bests/
  // bookings/orders/etc — see the migration FK definitions.
  const { error: delUserErr } = await adminClient.auth.admin.deleteUser(userId);
  if (delUserErr) {
    console.error("account-delete deleteUser failed", delUserErr);
    return jsonError(500, "auth_delete_failed", delUserErr.message);
  }

  console.log(
    `account-delete ok user=${userId} kids=${kidsPurged} hittrax_links=${hittraxLinksPurged} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
  );
  return jsonOk({ ok: true, hittrax_links_purged: hittraxLinksPurged, kids_purged: kidsPurged });
});

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/booking-confirmation/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #291 — Send a booking confirmation email after a public booking.
//
// Called from the public booking page immediately after a booking is created.
// Auth model: caller's JWT (the parent who just booked). RLS on the bookings
// table restricts access to the caller's own family — no privilege escalation.
// The function uses the service role only to look up the tenant name (tenants
// table is not readable by the anon/authenticated role without a matching
// tenant_id claim, which new accounts may not have in their first JWT).
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Header: Authorization: Bearer <caller_jwt>
//   Body:   { booking_id: string }
//   Response 200: { ok: true }             — email sent (or skipped if unconfigured)
//   Response 400: { error: { code, message } }
//   Response 404: { error: { code, message } }
//
// Best-effort delivery: if RESEND_API_KEY is absent or Resend times out, the
// function returns 200 so as not to fail the booking flow.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const RESEND_API_KEY = Deno.env.get("RESEND_API_KEY") ?? "";
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL =
  Deno.env.get("RESEND_FROM_EMAIL") ?? "onboarding@resend.dev";

const RESEND_URL = "https://api.resend.com/emails";
const RESEND_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function jsonError(status: number, code: string, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function jsonOk(body: Record<string, unknown>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

function formatSessionTime(isoString: string, timezone: string): string {
  const d = new Date(isoString);
  const tz = timezone || "America/Chicago";
  const datePart = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric", timeZone: tz,
  }).format(d);
  const timePart = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", hour12: true, timeZone: tz,
  }).format(d);
  return `${datePart} at ${timePart}`;
}

async function sendResendEmail(opts: {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  html: string;
  text: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) {
    console.log("booking-confirmation: RESEND_API_KEY not configured — skipping email");
    return;
  }
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const t = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), RESEND_TIMEOUT_MS);
  try {
    const r = await fetch(RESEND_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
        to: [opts.to],
        subject: opts.subject,
        html: opts.html,
        text: opts.text,
      }),
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(t);
    if (!r.ok) {
      console.error(`booking-confirmation resend_error status=${r.status}`);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(t);
    if ((err as Error)?.name === "AbortError") {
      console.error("booking-confirmation resend_timeout");
    } else {
      console.error("booking-confirmation resend_unreachable", err);
    }
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CORS
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// The public booking page is served from the same origin as the portal
// (REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN), but browser preflight still fires for custom headers
// (Authorization). We allow all origins since this is a public booking page.
const CORS_HEADERS = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Authorization, Content-Type",
  "Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400",
};

function corsOk(): Response {
  return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS_HEADERS });
}

function addCors(r: Response): Response {
  const h = new Headers(r.headers);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(CORS_HEADERS)) h.set(k, v);
  return new Response(r.body, { status: r.status, headers: h });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Handler
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

serve(async (req) => {
  // Preflight
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return corsOk();

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return addCors(jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required"));
  }

  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? "";
  const token = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")
    ? authHeader.slice(7).trim()
    : "";
  if (!token) {
    return addCors(jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Authorization: Bearer <token> required"));
  }

  let body: { booking_id?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return addCors(jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Invalid JSON body"));
  }
  const bookingId =
    typeof body.booking_id === "string" ? body.booking_id.trim() : "";
  if (!bookingId) {
    return addCors(jsonError(400, "bad_request", "booking_id is required"));
  }

  // Caller-scoped client — RLS restricts to the parent's own bookings.
  // This prevents any user from fetching another family's booking details.
  const callerClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  });

  // Fetch the booking with all related data in one round-trip.
  const { data: raw, error: fetchErr } = await callerClient
    .from("bookings")
    .select(
      `id, scheduled_start, tenant_id,
       session_type:session_types(name),
       coach:coaches(first_name, last_name),
       location:locations(name, timezone),
       kid:kids(first_name, family:families(parent_first_name, parent_email))`
    )
    .eq("id", bookingId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (fetchErr) {
    console.error("booking-confirmation db_fetch_error", fetchErr.message);
    return addCors(jsonError(500, "db_error", fetchErr.message));
  }
  if (!raw) {
    return addCors(jsonError(404, "not_found", "Booking not found"));
  }

  // Type-safe extraction
  const bk = raw as {
    id: string;
    scheduled_start: string;
    tenant_id: string;
    session_type: { name: string } | null;
    coach: { first_name: string; last_name: string } | null;
    location: { name: string; timezone: string } | null;
    kid: {
      first_name: string;
      family: { parent_first_name: string; parent_email: string } | null;
    } | null;
  };

  const parentEmail = bk.kid?.family?.parent_email ?? null;
  if (!parentEmail) {
    console.log("booking-confirmation: no parent email for booking", bookingId);
    return addCors(jsonOk({ ok: true, skipped: "no_parent_email" }));
  }

  // Fetch tenant name via service role — tenants RLS blocks anon/fresh JWTs
  // that don't yet carry the tenant_id claim (common right after signup).
  const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
  });
  const { data: tenantRow } = await adminClient
    .from("tenants")
    .select("name")
    .eq("id", bk.tenant_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  const tenantName = (tenantRow as { name?: string } | null)?.name ?? "Ballpark";
  const timeLabel = formatSessionTime(
    bk.scheduled_start,
    bk.location?.timezone ?? "America/Chicago"
  );

  const emailOpts = {
    parentFirstName: bk.kid?.family?.parent_first_name ?? null,
    kidFirstName: bk.kid?.first_name ?? "Athlete",
    sessionTypeName: bk.session_type?.name ?? "Session",
    coachFirstName: bk.coach?.first_name ?? "Coach",
    coachLastName: bk.coach?.last_name ?? "",
    timeLabel,
    locationName: bk.location?.name ?? "the facility",
    tenantName,
    bookingRef: bk.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase(),
  };

  await sendResendEmail({
    to: parentEmail,
    subject: `Booking confirmed: ${emailOpts.sessionTypeName} on ${timeLabel}`,
    html: buildConfirmationHtml(emailOpts),
    text: buildConfirmationText(emailOpts),
  });

  return addCors(jsonOk({ ok: true }));
});

FILE: supabase/functions/CompleteHitTraxRegistration/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/CompleteHitTraxRegistration/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Inbound CompleteHitTraxRegistration callback — HitTrax-spec endpoint name.
//
// This is the canonical endpoint name required by the HitTrax Third Party Data
// Sharing API v1.0 spec. HitTrax calls this endpoint after the user taps
// Accept/Decline in the email HitTrax sent them following our
// AssociateThirdPartyAccount call. Per spec:
//
//   POST <our-base-url>/CompleteHitTraxRegistration
//        ?PartnerID=<PID>&APIKey=<SECRET>
//        &ThirdPartyUserID=<UUID>&Accepted=<true|false>
//        &ThirdPartyUserPassword=<HITTRAX_ISSUED_PASSWORD>
//
// Callback URLs to give HitTrax:
//   https://exjcwvvglthnxerzpukw.supabase.co/functions/v1/CompleteHitTraxRegistration
//
// We:
//   1. Verify PartnerID + APIKey in constant time (the entire HitTrax inbound
//      auth model — there is NO HMAC, NO bearer token, NO OAuth in v1.0).
//   2. Look up kid_capture_links by ThirdPartyUserID.
//   3. If Accepted=true: persist password, flip status -> 'active',
//      seed last_polled_through = associated_at = now.
//   4. If Accepted=false: flip status -> 'declined'.
//   5. Return PLAIN TEXT "true" on success or "Error <reason>" on failure
//      (HitTrax expects this exact wire format — see Appendix on page 12).
//
// Deploy:
//   npx supabase functions deploy CompleteHitTraxRegistration --no-verify-jwt
//
// Idempotency (CRITICAL — re-delivery must NEVER lose data):
//   * The same Accepted=true callback may be re-delivered (HitTrax network
//     retry, at-least-once delivery semantics). The active-link branch
//     short-circuits BEFORE touching last_polled_through or associated_at
//     because re-running the UPDATE would jump the cursor forward to "now"
//     and silently skip every swing the poller hasn't yet ingested in the
//     window between original activation and re-delivery. The only state
//     we refresh on re-delivery is the password (in case HitTrax rotated
//     it) — and that's gated by `.neq()` so it's a no-op when unchanged.
//   * If a callback for an already-removed link arrives, we treat it as a
//     no-op and return "true" — there's nothing to do, and erroring would
//     make HitTrax retry forever.
//   * declined → accepted re-delivery is a real state change (parent
//     re-tried via associate), so we proceed with the normal activate
//     path and seed the cursor at "now".
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  hittraxText,
  readHitTraxConfig,
  verifyHitTraxInbound,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  // HitTrax sends POST per spec; tolerate GET too because some implementations
  // use GET for query-param-only endpoints.
  if (req.method !== "POST" && req.method !== "GET") {
    return hittraxText("Error Method Not Allowed", 405);
  }

  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) {
    console.error("CompleteHitTraxRegistration: HITTRAX_* secrets not configured");
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const auth = verifyHitTraxInbound(url, cfg);
  if (!auth.ok) {
    console.error(
      `CompleteHitTraxRegistration auth_failed code=${auth.code} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return hittraxText(`Error ${auth.message}`, auth.status);
  }

  const tpuid = url.searchParams.get("ThirdPartyUserID");
  const acceptedRaw = url.searchParams.get("Accepted");
  const password = url.searchParams.get("ThirdPartyUserPassword");

  if (!tpuid) return hittraxText("Error Missing Third Party UserID", 400);
  if (acceptedRaw === null) return hittraxText("Error Missing Accepted", 400);
  // Strict ∈ {true,false} parse — anything else is a malformed callback and
  // MUST 400 rather than silently being treated as decline (which would
  // mutate the link to 'declined' on a spec-violating payload).
  const acceptedNorm = acceptedRaw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (acceptedNorm !== "true" && acceptedNorm !== "false") {
    return hittraxText("Error Invalid Accepted value", 400);
  }
  const accepted = acceptedNorm === "true";

  if (accepted && (!password || password.length === 0)) {
    return hittraxText("Error Missing Third Party User Password", 400);
  }

  // Look up the link by third_party_user_id.
  const { data: link, error: lookupErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, association_status, kid_id, tenant_id")
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .eq("third_party_user_id", tpuid)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (lookupErr) {
    console.error("CompleteHitTraxRegistration db error on lookup", lookupErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }
  if (!link) {
    // Per spec error table: "No Third Party User found".
    console.warn(`CompleteHitTraxRegistration no_link tpuid=${tpuid.slice(0, 8)}…`);
    return hittraxText("Error No Third Party User found", 404);
  }

  // If link is already removed, ack and noop — HitTrax should not retry.
  if (link.association_status === "removed") {
    console.log(
      `CompleteHitTraxRegistration noop link=${link.id} status=removed ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return hittraxText("true");
  }

  if (accepted) {
    // IDEMPOTENCY: HitTrax may re-deliver the same Accepted=true callback
    // (network retry, at-least-once delivery). A re-delivery for an
    // already-active link MUST be a true no-op — re-running the UPDATE
    // would clobber `last_polled_through` back to "now", silently
    // skipping every swing the poller has not yet ingested in the
    // window between the original activation and the re-delivery. The
    // only state we are willing to refresh on a re-delivery is the
    // password, in case HitTrax rotated it (the spec doesn't mandate it
    // but the password we store is the one HitTrax just sent — keeping
    // them in sync is safe). The cursor + activation timestamp are
    // ABSOLUTELY frozen post-activation.
    if (link.association_status === "active") {
      if (password) {
        const { error: pwErr } = await adminClient
          .from("kid_capture_links")
          .update({ third_party_user_password: password })
          .eq("id", link.id)
          .neq("third_party_user_password", password); // skip write if unchanged
        if (pwErr) {
          console.error("CompleteHitTraxRegistration db error on password refresh", pwErr);
          // Best-effort: still ack so HitTrax doesn't retry forever.
        }
      }
      console.log(
        `CompleteHitTraxRegistration noop_active link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
      );
      return hittraxText("true");
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { error: updateErr } = await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .update({
        association_status: "active",
        third_party_user_password: password,
        associated_at: now,
        // Seed cursor at activation time so the first poll only fetches
        // swings recorded from now onward. Backfill is intentionally not
        // attempted in v1 — see runbook. Guarded above so this only ever
        // runs on the first accepted callback.
        last_polled_through: now,
        // Reset any backoff state from previous failed pending attempts.
        retry_count: 0,
        next_poll_at: null,
        last_poll_error: null,
      })
      .eq("id", link.id);
    if (updateErr) {
      console.error("CompleteHitTraxRegistration db error on accept update", updateErr);
      return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
    }
    console.log(
      `CompleteHitTraxRegistration accepted link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
  } else {
    const { error: updateErr } = await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .update({
        association_status: "declined",
        third_party_user_password: null,
      })
      .eq("id", link.id);
    if (updateErr) {
      console.error("CompleteHitTraxRegistration db error on decline update", updateErr);
      return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
    }
    console.log(
      `CompleteHitTraxRegistration declined link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
  }

  return hittraxText("true");
});

FILE: supabase/functions/ForgetHitTraxUser/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/ForgetHitTraxUser/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Inbound ForgetHitTraxUser endpoint — HitTrax-spec endpoint name (GDPR/COPPA).
//
// This is the canonical endpoint name required by the HitTrax Third Party Data
// Sharing API v1.0 spec. HitTrax calls this endpoint when a user has elected
// to be "forgotten". Per spec, the third party MUST delete all HitTrax-derived
// data and the HitTrax-issued password. We:
//
//   1. Verify PartnerID + APIKey (same constant-time check as the
//      registration-complete callback — there is no other auth mechanism).
//   2. Look up kid_capture_links by ThirdPartyUserID.
//   3. Verify the inbound ThirdPartyUserPassword matches what we have stored
//      for that link (extra defense-in-depth on top of PartnerID check —
//      prevents a HitTrax operator with leaked partner creds from forgetting
//      arbitrary users without also knowing the per-user password).
//   4. Delete sessions + swings + personal_bests for that kid where
//      capture_source = 'hittrax'. (We do NOT delete the kid or the family —
//      just the HitTrax-derived data.)
//   5. Mark the link 'removed' and clear the password.
//   6. Return PLAIN TEXT "true" or "Error <reason>".
//
// Callback URLs to give HitTrax:
//   https://exjcwvvglthnxerzpukw.supabase.co/functions/v1/ForgetHitTraxUser
//
// Deploy:
//   npx supabase functions deploy ForgetHitTraxUser --no-verify-jwt
//
// Idempotency: a re-delivered Forget call after the data is already gone
// returns "true" (the link is removed, swings query returns 0 rows).
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  hittraxText,
  readHitTraxConfig,
  timingSafeEqual,
  verifyHitTraxInbound,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST" && req.method !== "GET") {
    return hittraxText("Error Method Not Allowed", 405);
  }

  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) {
    console.error("ForgetHitTraxUser: HITTRAX_* secrets not configured");
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const auth = verifyHitTraxInbound(url, cfg);
  if (!auth.ok) {
    console.error(`ForgetHitTraxUser auth_failed code=${auth.code}`);
    return hittraxText(`Error ${auth.message}`, auth.status);
  }

  const tpuid = url.searchParams.get("ThirdPartyUserID");
  const password = url.searchParams.get("ThirdPartyUserPassword");
  if (!tpuid) return hittraxText("Error Missing Third Party UserID", 400);
  if (!password) return hittraxText("Error Missing Third Party User Password", 400);

  const { data: link, error: lookupErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, kid_id, third_party_user_password, association_status")
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .eq("third_party_user_id", tpuid)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (lookupErr) {
    console.error("ForgetHitTraxUser db error on lookup", lookupErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }
  if (!link) {
    // Already forgotten — ack to stop HitTrax retries.
    console.log(`ForgetHitTraxUser noop tpuid=${tpuid.slice(0, 8)}…`);
    return hittraxText("true");
  }

  // Defense-in-depth: per-user password check. If the link is already
  // removed (no password on file), accept the call as a no-op.
  if (link.third_party_user_password) {
    if (!timingSafeEqual(password, link.third_party_user_password)) {
      return hittraxText("Error Invalid Third Party User Login", 401);
    }
  }

  // Delete the HitTrax-derived data for this kid. We must NOT touch
  // sessions / swings / PRs from other capture sources (Rapsodo, manual)
  // and we don't touch the kid / family / points balance — only
  // HitTrax-sourced rows.
  //
  // Order matters: PBs first (while we can still resolve swing_id ->
  // capture_source). Then swings. Then sessions.

  // 1) Pull every HitTrax swing id for this kid so we can scope the PB delete
  //    by swing_id (not by kid_id, which would also nuke Rapsodo/manual PBs).
  const { data: hittraxSwingIds, error: swingIdsErr } = await adminClient
    .from("swings")
    .select("id")
    .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax");
  if (swingIdsErr) {
    console.error("ForgetHitTraxUser fetch hittrax swing ids failed", swingIdsErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }
  const idList = (hittraxSwingIds ?? []).map((r: { id: string }) => r.id);

  // 2) Delete only personal_bests whose achieving swing is a HitTrax swing.
  //    PBs whose swing came from another source survive untouched.
  if (idList.length > 0) {
    const { error: delPbErr } = await adminClient
      .from("personal_bests")
      .delete()
      .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id)
      .in("swing_id", idList);
    if (delPbErr) {
      console.error("ForgetHitTraxUser delete personal_bests failed", delPbErr);
      return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
    }
  }

  // 3) Delete the swings themselves.
  const { error: delSwingsErr } = await adminClient
    .from("swings")
    .delete()
    .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax");
  if (delSwingsErr) {
    console.error("ForgetHitTraxUser delete swings failed", delSwingsErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  // 4) Delete the sessions.
  const { error: delSessionsErr } = await adminClient
    .from("sessions")
    .delete()
    .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax");
  if (delSessionsErr) {
    console.error("ForgetHitTraxUser delete sessions failed", delSessionsErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  const { error: linkErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .update({
      association_status: "removed",
      removed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      third_party_user_password: null,
    })
    .eq("id", link.id);
  if (linkErr) {
    console.error("ForgetHitTraxUser update link failed", linkErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  console.log(`ForgetHitTraxUser ok link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`);
  return hittraxText("true");
});

FILE: supabase/functions/hittrax-associate/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/hittrax-associate/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// HitTrax API v1.3 — associate a parent's kid with a HitTrax Cloud account.
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Headers:  Authorization: Bearer <parent-jwt>
//
//   Mode 1 – password auth:
//     Body:     { kid_id, hittrax_username, hittrax_password }
//     Response: { link_id, association_status: "active", hittrax_username }
//
//   Mode 2 – OTP trigger (no association yet, just sends SMS):
//     Body:     { kid_id, hittrax_username, use_otp: true }
//     Response: { status: "otp_sent" }
//
//   Mode 3 – OTP submit + associate:
//     Body:     { kid_id, hittrax_username, otp_code: "123456" }
//     Response: { link_id, association_status: "active", hittrax_username }
//
//   Errors:
//     401 unauthorized | 403 forbidden | 400 bad_request
//     404 hittrax_user_not_found | 400 hittrax_no_phone
//     409 conflict (kid already active) | 503 hittrax_not_configured
//     401 invalid_hittrax_credentials | 401 hittrax_invalid_otp
//     502 hittrax_error | 504 hittrax_timeout | 502 hittrax_unreachable
//
// v1.3 Association flow (Modes 1 & 3):
//   1. Authenticate → session token
//      Mode 1: AuthenticateCloudUser(username, password)
//      Mode 3: ProvideOTPResponseCode(username, otp_code)
//   2. AssociateThirdPartyAccountWithCloudCredentials(sessionToken, thirdPartyUserId)
//      → thirdPartyUserPassword
//   3. LogOutThirdPartyCloudUser(sessionToken)   [best-effort]
//   4. Upsert kid_capture_links: status = 'active', password stored.
//
// The link goes DIRECTLY to 'active' — no pending/email-confirmation step.
// The raw HitTrax password is never stored or logged.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  associateThirdPartyAccount,
  authenticateCloudUser,
  hitTraxErrorResponse,
  jsonError,
  jsonOk,
  logOutSession,
  readHitTraxConfig,
  submitOTPCode,
  triggerOTP,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split(".");
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const padded = b64 + "=".repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4);
    return JSON.parse(atob(padded));
  } catch { return null; }
}

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");

  // ---- 1. Verify parent JWT -----------------------------------------------
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader?.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  const userClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  });
  const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser(token);
  if (userErr || !userData?.user) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Invalid or expired token");
  const userId = userData.user.id;

  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  const tenantId = typeof payload?.tenant_id === "string" ? payload.tenant_id : null;
  const appRole = typeof payload?.app_role === "string" ? payload.app_role : null;
  if (!tenantId) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Token missing tenant_id claim");
  if (appRole !== "parent") return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Parent role required");

  // ---- 2. Parse body and detect mode --------------------------------------
  let body: {
    kid_id?: unknown;
    hittrax_username?: unknown;
    hittrax_password?: unknown;
    use_otp?: unknown;
    otp_code?: unknown;
  };
  try { body = await req.json(); }
  catch { return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Body is not valid JSON"); }

  const kidId = typeof body.kid_id === "string" ? body.kid_id : "";
  const hittraxUsername = typeof body.hittrax_username === "string" ? body.hittrax_username.trim() : "";
  const hittraxPassword = typeof body.hittrax_password === "string" ? body.hittrax_password : "";
  const useOtp = body.use_otp === true;
  const otpCode = typeof body.otp_code === "string" ? body.otp_code.trim() : "";

  if (!kidId) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "kid_id required");
  if (!hittraxUsername) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "hittrax_username required");
  if (!useOtp && !otpCode && !hittraxPassword) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "One of hittrax_password, use_otp, or otp_code is required");
  }

  // ---- 3. Verify kid ownership (all modes) --------------------------------
  const { data: kid, error: kidErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kids")
    .select("id, family_id, tenant_id:families!inner(tenant_id, parent_user_id)")
    .eq("id", kidId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (kidErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to look up kid");
  if (!kid) return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Kid not found or not yours");

  const family = kid.tenant_id as unknown as { tenant_id: string; parent_user_id: string } | null;
  if (!family || family.parent_user_id !== userId || family.tenant_id !== tenantId) {
    return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Kid does not belong to this parent/tenant");
  }

  // ---- 4. HitTrax config (all modes) --------------------------------------
  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) return jsonError(503, "hittrax_not_configured", "HitTrax credentials not provisioned for this environment");

  // =========================================================================
  // MODE 2: OTP trigger — send SMS, return immediately (no DB write)
  // =========================================================================
  if (useOtp) {
    try {
      await triggerOTP(cfg, hittraxUsername);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("hittrax-associate otp-trigger failed", String(err));
      return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
    }
    console.log(`hittrax-associate otp-sent user=${hittraxUsername} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`);
    return jsonOk({ status: "otp_sent" });
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // MODES 1 & 3: Authenticate → Associate → persist link
  // =========================================================================

  // ---- 5. Check for existing active link ----------------------------------
  const { data: existing, error: existingErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, association_status")
    .eq("kid_id", kidId)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .maybeSingle();
  if (existingErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query existing link");
  if (existing?.association_status === "active") {
    return jsonError(409, "conflict", "This kid is already linked to HitTrax. Disconnect first to re-link.");
  }

  // Generate a fresh ThirdPartyUserID for this attempt.
  // Written to DB only after HitTrax accepts.
  const thirdPartyUserId = crypto.randomUUID();

  // ---- 6. Authenticate with HitTrax ---------------------------------------
  let sessionToken: string;
  try {
    if (otpCode) {
      // Mode 3: OTP submit — ProvideOTPResponseCode → session token
      sessionToken = await submitOTPCode(cfg, hittraxUsername, otpCode);
    } else {
      // Mode 1: Password — AuthenticateCloudUser → session token
      sessionToken = await authenticateCloudUser(cfg, hittraxUsername, hittraxPassword);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("hittrax-associate auth failed", String(err));
    return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
  }

  // ---- 7. Associate our ThirdPartyUserID with the authenticated session ---
  let thirdPartyUserPassword: string;
  try {
    thirdPartyUserPassword = await associateThirdPartyAccount(cfg, sessionToken, thirdPartyUserId);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("hittrax-associate associate failed", String(err));
    void logOutSession(cfg, sessionToken);
    return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
  }

  // Best-effort session logout — don't await so it doesn't add latency.
  void logOutSession(cfg, sessionToken);

  // ---- 8. Persist kid_capture_links row -----------------------------------
  // Write AFTER HitTrax success so a transient HitTrax error never strands
  // the parent. Link goes straight to 'active' in v1.3 — no pending state.
  //
  // associated_at is set 90 days in the past so the first poll window covers
  // historic swing data. last_polled_through stays NULL so hittrax-poll uses
  // associated_at as StartDate on its first run.
  const BACKFILL_WINDOW_MS = 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const backfilledAt = new Date(Date.now() - BACKFILL_WINDOW_MS).toISOString();

  let linkId: string;
  if (existing) {
    const { data: updated, error: updateErr } = await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .update({
        third_party_user_id: thirdPartyUserId,
        external_user_id: hittraxUsername,
        third_party_user_password: thirdPartyUserPassword,
        hittrax_registration_status: true,
        hittrax_release_status: true,
        association_status: "active",
        associated_at: backfilledAt,
        removed_at: null,
        last_polled_through: null,
        last_polled_at: null,
        last_poll_error: null,
        retry_count: 0,
        next_poll_at: null,
      })
      .eq("id", existing.id)
      .select("id")
      .single();
    if (updateErr || !updated) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to update link");
    linkId = updated.id;
  } else {
    const { data: inserted, error: insertErr } = await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .insert({
        tenant_id: tenantId,
        kid_id: kidId,
        capture_source: "hittrax",
        third_party_user_id: thirdPartyUserId,
        external_user_id: hittraxUsername,
        third_party_user_password: thirdPartyUserPassword,
        hittrax_registration_status: true,
        hittrax_release_status: true,
        association_status: "active",
        associated_at: backfilledAt,
      })
      .select("id")
      .single();
    if (insertErr || !inserted) {
      console.error("hittrax-associate insert failed", insertErr);
      return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to create link row");
    }
    linkId = inserted.id;
  }

  // ---- 9. Trigger an immediate poll so historic data loads within seconds --
  // Fire-and-forget: we do NOT await or propagate errors. The 2-minute pg_cron
  // tick is the safety net if this call fails. Duplicate swings from a race
  // with the next cron tick are absorbed by the UNIQUE on
  // (capture_source, capture_event_id) in the swings table.
  const pollUrl = `${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/hittrax-poll`;
  fetch(pollUrl, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Authorization": `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
  }).then(() => {
    console.log(`hittrax-associate immediate poll dispatched link=${linkId}`);
  }).catch((err) => {
    console.warn(`hittrax-associate immediate poll dispatch failed (non-fatal) link=${linkId}`, err);
  });

  const mode = otpCode ? "otp" : "password";
  console.log(`hittrax-associate ok mode=${mode} link=${linkId} user=${hittraxUsername} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`);

  return jsonOk({
    link_id: linkId,
    association_status: "active",
    hittrax_username: hittraxUsername,
  });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/hittrax-create-account/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/hittrax-create-account/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Creates a new HitTrax Cloud account for the parent's kid and immediately
// links it to our system — no separate association step required.
//
// Two modes (POST):
//   Mode A — Username availability check (fast, no DB write):
//     Body: { check_username: string }
//     Response: { available: boolean }
//
//   Mode B — Create account:
//     Body: { kid_id, hittrax_username, password, sport, skill_level,
//             gender, position?, bats?, throws?, height_inches? }
//     Response: { link_id, association_status: "active", hittrax_username }
//
// v1.3 Create flow:
//   1. CreateCloudUserAccount(username, password, profile...) → ThirdPartyUserPassword
//   2. Upsert kid_capture_links: status='active', credentials stored.
//
// COPPA guard: if kid's DOB puts them under 13, the parent's email is sent as
// GuardianEmailAddress (required by HitTrax for COPPA compliance).
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  checkCloudUsernameEligibility,
  createCloudUserAccount,
  hitTraxErrorResponse,
  jsonError,
  jsonOk,
  readHitTraxConfig,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split(".");
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const padded = b64 + "=".repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4);
    return JSON.parse(atob(padded));
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** Convert ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) → MM/DD/YYYY for HitTrax. */
function isoToHitTraxDate(iso: string): string {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split("-");
  return `${month}/${day}/${year}`;
}

/** Return age in years given an ISO date_of_birth string. */
function ageFromDOB(dob: string): number {
  const birth = new Date(dob);
  const today = new Date();
  let age = today.getFullYear() - birth.getFullYear();
  const m = today.getMonth() - birth.getMonth();
  if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && today.getDate() < birth.getDate())) age--;
  return age;
}

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");

  // ---- 1. Verify parent JWT -----------------------------------------------
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader?.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  const userClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  });
  const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser(token);
  if (userErr || !userData?.user) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Invalid or expired token");
  const userId = userData.user.id;
  const parentEmail = userData.user.email ?? "";

  const jwtPayload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  const tenantId = typeof jwtPayload?.tenant_id === "string" ? jwtPayload.tenant_id : null;
  const appRole = typeof jwtPayload?.app_role === "string" ? jwtPayload.app_role : null;
  if (!tenantId) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Token missing tenant_id claim");
  if (appRole !== "parent") return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Parent role required");

  // ---- 2. Parse body -------------------------------------------------------
  let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  try { body = await req.json(); }
  catch { return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Body is not valid JSON"); }

  // ---- 3. HitTrax config (required for both modes) ------------------------
  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) return jsonError(503, "hittrax_not_configured", "HitTrax credentials not provisioned for this environment");

  // =========================================================================
  // MODE A: Username availability check
  // =========================================================================
  if (typeof body.check_username === "string") {
    const username = body.check_username.trim();
    if (!username) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "check_username must be a non-empty string");
    try {
      const available = await checkCloudUsernameEligibility(cfg, username);
      return jsonOk({ available });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("hittrax-create-account username-check failed", String(err));
      return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // MODE B: Create account
  // =========================================================================
  const kidId = typeof body.kid_id === "string" ? body.kid_id.trim() : "";
  const hittraxUsername = typeof body.hittrax_username === "string" ? body.hittrax_username.trim() : "";
  const password = typeof body.password === "string" ? body.password : "";
  const sport = typeof body.sport === "string" ? body.sport : "";
  const skillLevel = typeof body.skill_level === "string" ? body.skill_level : "";
  const gender = typeof body.gender === "string" ? body.gender : "";
  const position = typeof body.position === "string" ? body.position || undefined : undefined;
  const bats = typeof body.bats === "string" ? body.bats || undefined : undefined;
  const throws_ = typeof body.throws === "string" ? body.throws || undefined : undefined;
  const heightInches = typeof body.height_inches === "number" ? body.height_inches : undefined;

  if (!kidId) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "kid_id required");
  if (!hittraxUsername) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "hittrax_username required");
  if (!password) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "password required");
  if (!sport) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "sport required");
  if (!skillLevel) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "skill_level required");
  if (!gender) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "gender required");

  // ---- 4. Verify kid ownership + read profile -----------------------------
  const { data: kid, error: kidErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kids")
    .select("id, first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, primary_position, family_id")
    .eq("id", kidId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (kidErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to look up kid");
  if (!kid) return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Kid not found or not yours");

  // Verify parent owns this kid
  const { data: family, error: famErr } = await adminClient
    .from("families")
    .select("tenant_id, parent_user_id")
    .eq("id", kid.family_id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (famErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to look up family");
  if (!family || family.parent_user_id !== userId || family.tenant_id !== tenantId) {
    return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Kid does not belong to this parent/tenant");
  }

  // ---- 5. Check for existing active link ----------------------------------
  const { data: existing, error: existingErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, association_status")
    .eq("kid_id", kidId)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .maybeSingle();
  if (existingErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query existing link");
  if (existing?.association_status === "active") {
    return jsonError(409, "conflict", "This kid is already linked to HitTrax. Disconnect first before creating a new account.");
  }

  // ---- 6. Build COPPA-aware account params --------------------------------
  const dob = kid.date_of_birth;
  if (!dob) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Kid must have a date of birth set before creating a HitTrax account");

  const age = ageFromDOB(dob);
  const guardianEmail = age < 13 ? parentEmail : undefined;
  const thirdPartyUserId = crypto.randomUUID();

  // ---- 7. Create the HitTrax account --------------------------------------
  let thirdPartyUserPassword: string;
  try {
    thirdPartyUserPassword = await createCloudUserAccount(cfg, {
      username: hittraxUsername,
      thirdPartyUsername: thirdPartyUserId,
      password,
      firstName: kid.first_name,
      lastName: kid.last_name,
      birthdate: isoToHitTraxDate(dob),
      email: parentEmail,
      guardianEmail,
      gender: gender as "male" | "female" | "other",
      sport: sport as "Baseball" | "Fastpitch Softball" | "Slowpitch Softball",
      skillLevel,
      position: position ?? kid.primary_position ?? undefined,
      bats: bats as "Right" | "Left" | "Switch" | undefined,
      throws: throws_ as "Right" | "Left" | undefined,
      heightInches,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("hittrax-create-account create failed", String(err));
    return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
  }

  // ---- 8. Persist kid_capture_links row -----------------------------------
  // Link goes straight to 'active' — CreateCloudUserAccount pre-links the account.
  let linkId: string;
  if (existing) {
    const { data: updated, error: updateErr } = await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .update({
        third_party_user_id: thirdPartyUserId,
        external_user_id: hittraxUsername,
        third_party_user_password: thirdPartyUserPassword,
        hittrax_registration_status: true,
        hittrax_release_status: true,
        association_status: "active",
        associated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        removed_at: null,
        last_polled_through: null,
        last_polled_at: null,
        last_poll_error: null,
        retry_count: 0,
        next_poll_at: null,
      })
      .eq("id", existing.id)
      .select("id")
      .single();
    if (updateErr || !updated) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to update link");
    linkId = updated.id;
  } else {
    const { data: inserted, error: insertErr } = await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .insert({
        tenant_id: tenantId,
        kid_id: kidId,
        capture_source: "hittrax",
        third_party_user_id: thirdPartyUserId,
        external_user_id: hittraxUsername,
        third_party_user_password: thirdPartyUserPassword,
        hittrax_registration_status: true,
        hittrax_release_status: true,
        association_status: "active",
        associated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .select("id")
      .single();
    if (insertErr || !inserted) {
      console.error("hittrax-create-account insert failed", insertErr);
      return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to create link row");
    }
    linkId = inserted.id;
  }

  const coppaNote = guardianEmail ? ` (COPPA: guardian email sent to ${guardianEmail})` : "";
  console.log(`hittrax-create-account ok link=${linkId} user=${hittraxUsername} age=${age}${coppaNote} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`);

  return jsonOk({
    link_id: linkId,
    association_status: "active",
    hittrax_username: hittraxUsername,
  });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/hittrax-disconnect/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/hittrax-disconnect/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// HitTrax API v1.3 — remove a kid's association with HitTrax.
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Headers:  Authorization: Bearer <parent-jwt>
//   Body:     { kid_id: uuid }
//   Response 200: { ok: true, link_id: uuid }
//
// v1.3 Flow (for active links):
//   1. AuthenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty(thirdPartyUserId, thirdPartyPassword)
//      → sessionToken
//   2. RemoveThirdPartyAssociationFromCloudUser(sessionToken)
//   3. LogOutThirdPartyCloudUser(sessionToken)   [best-effort cleanup]
//   4. Update kid_capture_links: status = 'removed', clear password.
//
// For pending/declined links (v1.x legacy users without a thirdPartyPassword):
//   Skip the HitTrax API calls — no active association exists on HitTrax side.
//   Flip local status to 'removed'.
//
// Order matters: HitTrax call FIRST so their billing side reflects the
// removal. Only flip the local row after HitTrax confirms. If HitTrax
// errors, leave the row 'active' so the parent can retry.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty,
  hitTraxErrorResponse,
  jsonError,
  jsonOk,
  logOutSession,
  readHitTraxConfig,
  removeThirdPartyAssociation,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split(".");
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const padded = b64 + "=".repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4);
    return JSON.parse(atob(padded));
  } catch { return null; }
}

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");

  // ---- 1. Verify parent JWT -----------------------------------------------
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader?.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  const userClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  });
  const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser(token);
  if (userErr || !userData?.user) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Invalid or expired token");
  const userId = userData.user.id;

  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  const tenantId = typeof payload?.tenant_id === "string" ? payload.tenant_id : null;
  if (!tenantId) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Token missing tenant_id claim");

  // ---- 2. Parse body -------------------------------------------------------
  let body: { kid_id?: unknown };
  try { body = await req.json(); }
  catch { return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Body is not valid JSON"); }

  const kidId = typeof body.kid_id === "string" ? body.kid_id : "";
  if (!kidId) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "kid_id required");

  // ---- 3. Verify kid ownership --------------------------------------------
  const { data: kid } = await adminClient
    .from("kids")
    .select("id, family_id, families!inner(tenant_id, parent_user_id)")
    .eq("id", kidId)
    .maybeSingle();
  const family = (kid as unknown as { families: { tenant_id: string; parent_user_id: string } } | null)?.families;
  if (!family || family.parent_user_id !== userId || family.tenant_id !== tenantId) {
    return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Kid does not belong to this parent/tenant");
  }

  // ---- 4. Fetch the link --------------------------------------------------
  const { data: link, error: linkErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, third_party_user_id, third_party_user_password, association_status")
    .eq("kid_id", kidId)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .maybeSingle();
  if (linkErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to fetch link");
  if (!link) return jsonError(404, "not_found", "No HitTrax link for this kid");
  if (link.association_status === "removed") {
    return jsonOk({ ok: true, link_id: link.id, already_removed: true });
  }

  // ---- 5. HitTrax config --------------------------------------------------
  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) return jsonError(503, "hittrax_not_configured", "HitTrax credentials not provisioned");

  // ---- 6. Call HitTrax to remove the association (active links only) ------
  // Only active v1.3 links have a thirdPartyUserPassword. Legacy pending/
  // declined links (v1.x era, no password) had no confirmed association on
  // HitTrax's side, so we skip the API call and just flip locally.
  if (link.association_status === "active" && link.third_party_user_password) {
    // Step 6a: Authenticate via ThirdPartyUserID + ThirdPartyUserPassword
    let sessionToken: string;
    try {
      sessionToken = await authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty(
        cfg,
        link.third_party_user_id,
        link.third_party_user_password,
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("hittrax-disconnect auth failed", String(err));
      return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
    }

    // Step 6b: Remove association (requires session token in v1.3)
    try {
      await removeThirdPartyAssociation(cfg, sessionToken);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("hittrax-disconnect remove failed", String(err));
      void logOutSession(cfg, sessionToken);
      return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
    }

    // Step 6c: Log out session (best-effort)
    void logOutSession(cfg, sessionToken);
  } else {
    console.log(`hittrax-disconnect skipping HitTrax call for status=${link.association_status} (no active v1.3 link)`);
  }

  // ---- 7. Flip local row to 'removed' -------------------------------------
  const { error: updateErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .update({
      association_status: "removed",
      removed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      third_party_user_password: null,
    })
    .eq("id", link.id);
  if (updateErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to mark link removed");

  console.log(`hittrax-disconnect ok link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`);
  return jsonOk({ ok: true, link_id: link.id });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/hittrax-forget/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/hittrax-forget/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #118 Step 8b — Inbound ForgetHitTraxUser endpoint (GDPR/COPPA).
//
// HitTrax calls this endpoint when a user has elected to be "forgotten". Per
// spec, the third party MUST delete all HitTrax-derived data and the
// HitTrax-issued password. We:
//
//   1. Verify PartnerID + APIKey (same constant-time check as the
//      registration-complete callback — there is no other auth mechanism).
//   2. Look up kid_capture_links by ThirdPartyUserID.
//   3. Verify the inbound ThirdPartyUserPassword matches what we have stored
//      for that link (extra defense-in-depth on top of PartnerID check —
//      prevents a HitTrax operator with leaked partner creds from forgetting
//      arbitrary users without also knowing the per-user password).
//   4. Delete sessions + swings + personal_bests for that kid where
//      capture_source = 'hittrax'. (We do NOT delete the kid or the family —
//      just the HitTrax-derived data.)
//   5. Mark the link 'removed' and clear the password.
//   6. Return PLAIN TEXT "true" or "Error <reason>".
//
// Deploy:
//   npx supabase functions deploy hittrax-forget --no-verify-jwt
//
// Idempotency: a re-delivered Forget call after the data is already gone
// returns "true" (the link is removed, swings query returns 0 rows).
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  hittraxText,
  readHitTraxConfig,
  timingSafeEqual,
  verifyHitTraxInbound,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST" && req.method !== "GET") {
    return hittraxText("Error Method Not Allowed", 405);
  }

  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) {
    console.error("hittrax-forget: HITTRAX_* secrets not configured");
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const auth = verifyHitTraxInbound(url, cfg);
  if (!auth.ok) {
    console.error(`hittrax-forget auth_failed code=${auth.code}`);
    return hittraxText(`Error ${auth.message}`, auth.status);
  }

  const tpuid = url.searchParams.get("ThirdPartyUserID");
  const password = url.searchParams.get("ThirdPartyUserPassword");
  if (!tpuid) return hittraxText("Error Missing Third Party UserID", 400);
  if (!password) return hittraxText("Error Missing Third Party User Password", 400);

  const { data: link, error: lookupErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, kid_id, third_party_user_password, association_status")
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .eq("third_party_user_id", tpuid)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (lookupErr) {
    console.error("hittrax-forget db error on lookup", lookupErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }
  if (!link) {
    // Already forgotten — ack to stop HitTrax retries.
    console.log(`hittrax-forget noop tpuid=${tpuid.slice(0, 8)}…`);
    return hittraxText("true");
  }

  // Defense-in-depth: per-user password check. If the link is already
  // removed (no password on file), accept the call as a no-op.
  if (link.third_party_user_password) {
    if (!timingSafeEqual(password, link.third_party_user_password)) {
      return hittraxText("Error Invalid Third Party User Login", 401);
    }
  }

  // Delete the HitTrax-derived data for this kid. We must NOT touch
  // sessions / swings / PRs from other capture sources (Rapsodo, manual)
  // and we don't touch the kid / family / points balance — only
  // HitTrax-sourced rows.
  //
  // Order matters: PBs first (while we can still resolve swing_id ->
  // capture_source). Then swings. Then sessions.

  // 1) Pull every HitTrax swing id for this kid so we can scope the PB delete
  //    by swing_id (not by kid_id, which would also nuke Rapsodo/manual PBs).
  const { data: hittraxSwingIds, error: swingIdsErr } = await adminClient
    .from("swings")
    .select("id")
    .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax");
  if (swingIdsErr) {
    console.error("hittrax-forget fetch hittrax swing ids failed", swingIdsErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }
  const idList = (hittraxSwingIds ?? []).map((r: { id: string }) => r.id);

  // 2) Delete only personal_bests whose achieving swing is a HitTrax swing.
  //    PBs whose swing came from another source survive untouched.
  if (idList.length > 0) {
    const { error: delPbErr } = await adminClient
      .from("personal_bests")
      .delete()
      .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id)
      .in("swing_id", idList);
    if (delPbErr) {
      console.error("hittrax-forget delete personal_bests failed", delPbErr);
      return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
    }
  }

  // 3) Delete the swings themselves.
  const { error: delSwingsErr } = await adminClient
    .from("swings")
    .delete()
    .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax");
  if (delSwingsErr) {
    console.error("hittrax-forget delete swings failed", delSwingsErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  // 4) Delete the sessions.
  const { error: delSessionsErr } = await adminClient
    .from("sessions")
    .delete()
    .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax");
  if (delSessionsErr) {
    console.error("hittrax-forget delete sessions failed", delSessionsErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  const { error: linkErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .update({
      association_status: "removed",
      removed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      third_party_user_password: null,
    })
    .eq("id", link.id);
  if (linkErr) {
    console.error("hittrax-forget update link failed", linkErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  console.log(`hittrax-forget ok link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`);
  return hittraxText("true");
});
