FILE: supabase/functions/hittrax-kiosk-event/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/hittrax-kiosk-event/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// HitTrax API v1.3 — fire a kiosk event by scanning the kiosk's QR code.
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Headers:  Authorization: Bearer <parent-jwt>
//   Body:     { kid_id: uuid, qr_url: string }
//   Response 200: { ok: true, event_type: string, kiosk_response: string }
//
// Flow:
//   1. Verify parent JWT, kid ownership, and active HitTrax link.
//   2. AuthenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty (stored credentials) → sessionToken.
//   3. Append PartnerID, APIKey, UserSessionToken to qr_url → GET it.
//   4. Best-effort LogOut the session.
//   5. Return { ok: true, event_type, kiosk_response }.
//
// Security: the qr_url origin is validated against HITTRAX_BASE_URL inside
// notifyKioskOfUserEvent to prevent the parent app from using stored creds
// to hit arbitrary URLs.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty,
  hitTraxErrorResponse,
  jsonError,
  jsonOk,
  logOutSession,
  notifyKioskOfUserEvent,
  readHitTraxConfig,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split(".");
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const padded = b64 + "=".repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4);
    return JSON.parse(atob(padded));
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** Derive a human-readable event type string from the QR URL. */
function parseEventType(qrUrl: string): string {
  try {
    const url = new URL(qrUrl);
    // Prefer an explicit EventType query param
    const explicit = url.searchParams.get("EventType") ?? url.searchParams.get("eventtype");
    if (explicit) return explicit.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "_");
    // Fall back to the last meaningful path segment
    const segments = url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
    const last = segments[segments.length - 1] ?? "";
    return last.toLowerCase() || "kiosk_event";
  } catch {
    return "kiosk_event";
  }
}

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");

  // ---- 1. Verify parent JWT -----------------------------------------------
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader?.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  const userClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  });
  const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser(token);
  if (userErr || !userData?.user) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Invalid or expired token");
  const userId = userData.user.id;

  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token);
  const tenantId = typeof payload?.tenant_id === "string" ? payload.tenant_id : null;
  if (!tenantId) return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Token missing tenant_id claim");

  const appRole = typeof payload?.app_role === "string" ? payload.app_role : null;
  if (appRole !== "parent") return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Only parents can use the kiosk scanner");

  // ---- 2. Parse body -------------------------------------------------------
  let body: { kid_id?: unknown; qr_url?: unknown };
  try { body = await req.json(); }
  catch { return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Body is not valid JSON"); }

  const kidId = typeof body.kid_id === "string" ? body.kid_id.trim() : "";
  const qrUrl = typeof body.qr_url === "string" ? body.qr_url.trim() : "";
  if (!kidId) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "kid_id required");
  if (!qrUrl) return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "qr_url required");

  // ---- 3. Verify kid ownership --------------------------------------------
  const { data: kid } = await adminClient
    .from("kids")
    .select("id, family_id, families!inner(tenant_id, parent_user_id)")
    .eq("id", kidId)
    .maybeSingle();
  const family = (kid as unknown as { families: { tenant_id: string; parent_user_id: string } } | null)?.families;
  if (!family || family.parent_user_id !== userId || family.tenant_id !== tenantId) {
    return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Kid does not belong to this parent/tenant");
  }

  // ---- 4. Fetch the active link -------------------------------------------
  const { data: link, error: linkErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, third_party_user_id, third_party_user_password, association_status")
    .eq("kid_id", kidId)
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .maybeSingle();
  if (linkErr) return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to fetch HitTrax link");
  if (!link) return jsonError(404, "not_found", "No HitTrax account linked for this kid");
  if (link.association_status !== "active") {
    return jsonError(409, "hittrax_link_not_active", "HitTrax account is not active. Please connect first.");
  }
  if (!link.third_party_user_password) {
    return jsonError(409, "hittrax_link_not_active", "HitTrax credentials not available. Please reconnect.");
  }

  // ---- 5. HitTrax config --------------------------------------------------
  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) return jsonError(503, "hittrax_not_configured", "HitTrax credentials not provisioned");

  // ---- 6. Authenticate via ThirdParty -------------------------------------
  let sessionToken: string;
  try {
    sessionToken = await authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty(
      cfg,
      link.third_party_user_id,
      link.third_party_user_password,
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("hittrax-kiosk-event auth failed", String(err));
    return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
  }

  // ---- 7. Fire the kiosk event -------------------------------------------
  let kioskResponse: string;
  try {
    kioskResponse = await notifyKioskOfUserEvent(cfg, sessionToken, qrUrl);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("hittrax-kiosk-event notify failed", String(err));
    void logOutSession(cfg, sessionToken);
    return hitTraxErrorResponse(err);
  }

  // ---- 8. Best-effort session logout -------------------------------------
  void logOutSession(cfg, sessionToken);

  const eventType = parseEventType(qrUrl);
  console.log(`hittrax-kiosk-event ok kid=${kidId} event=${eventType} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`);
  return jsonOk({ ok: true, event_type: eventType, kiosk_response: kioskResponse });
});


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/functions/hittrax-poll/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/hittrax-poll/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #118 Step 5 — Polling worker for active HitTrax links.
//
// Trigger: Supabase scheduled invocation (every 2 minutes via pg_cron — see
// runbook). May also be invoked on-demand via POST with the service-role
// bearer for ops / fixture replay.
//
// For each active kid_capture_links row (oldest last_polled_at first),
// calls HitTrax GetAvailableThirdPartyData with:
//   StartDate = last_polled_through (or associated_at on first poll)
//   EndDate   = now() - SLACK_SECONDS  (small safety margin so HitTrax
//               isn't still buffering swings at the boundary)
//
// On success:
//   * Parses the returned JSON via parseSwingsPayload.
//   * For each swing: UPSERT into sessions (one per session_id) + UPSERT
//     into swings (idempotent on (capture_source, capture_event_id)).
//   * Advances last_polled_through to EndDate, clears last_poll_error.
//   * Best-effort fans out a push notification per detected PR via
//     send-push-notification (Promise.allSettled — never blocks the cursor).
//
// On HitTrax error / timeout:
//   * Records last_poll_error on the link, leaves last_polled_through
//     untouched so the next run retries the same window.
//
// Concurrency: Edge Functions are stateless and may overlap if a poll runs
// longer than 2 min. Per-link work is naturally serialised because we
// advance last_polled_through atomically on success — overlapping runs
// would re-fetch the same window and dedupe via the swings UNIQUE.
//
// Auth model: this endpoint is service-role only. The caller (pg_cron via
// pg_net, or an operator script) MUST pass SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Authorization.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  buildHitTraxUrl,
  formatHitTraxDate,
  jsonError,
  jsonOk,
  parseHitTraxTextResponse,
  parseSwingsPayloadStrict,
  readHitTraxConfig,
  type HitTraxConfig,
  type ParsedSwing,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
// HitTrax content type for swing data (spec v1.3 p.15).
// Per the spec: "A string value representing a type data object you would
// like returned from the list of available data objects provisioned for you
// during this initial contracting / licensing discussions."
// → The value is PARTNER-SPECIFIC. HitTrax assigns it during onboarding.
//   Set via: npx supabase secrets set HITTRAX_CONTENT_TYPE=<contracted_value>
// → When unset (null), the parameter is OMITTED — HitTrax returns 404.
// → Common wrong guesses ("Swings", "HitTrax") return "Invalid Content Type".
const HITTRAX_CONTENT_TYPE = Deno.env.get("HITTRAX_CONTENT_TYPE") ?? null;

const POLL_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000;
const SLACK_SECONDS = 30;        // back EndDate off by 30s to avoid boundary misses
const MAX_LINKS_PER_RUN = 50;    // cap per invocation so a stalled link can't starve others

// Exponential backoff on transient failures. The poller runs every 2 minutes;
// a healthy link is poll-eligible every tick. A failing link's next_poll_at
// is pushed out by min(BACKOFF_BASE_SEC * 2^(retry_count-1), BACKOFF_MAX_SEC),
// so the schedule looks like: 30s → 1m → 2m → 4m → 8m → 16m → 30m (capped).
// Cleared (next_poll_at = NULL, retry_count = 0) on the next success.
const BACKOFF_BASE_SEC = 30;
const BACKOFF_MAX_SEC = 30 * 60;

function backoffSeconds(retryCount: number): number {
  // retryCount is the count AFTER incrementing for this failure.
  const exp = Math.min(retryCount - 1, 30);
  return Math.min(BACKOFF_BASE_SEC * Math.pow(2, exp), BACKOFF_MAX_SEC);
}

async function recordFailure(linkId: string, retryCount: number, error: string): Promise<void> {
  const nextRetry = retryCount + 1;
  const delay = backoffSeconds(nextRetry);
  const nextPollAt = new Date(Date.now() + delay * 1000).toISOString();
  await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .update({
      last_polled_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      last_poll_error: error,
      retry_count: nextRetry,
      next_poll_at: nextPollAt,
    })
    .eq("id", linkId);
}

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

type LinkRow = {
  id: string;
  tenant_id: string;
  kid_id: string;
  third_party_user_id: string;
  third_party_user_password: string | null;
  associated_at: string | null;
  last_polled_through: string | null;
  retry_count: number;
};

type PollOutcome = {
  link_id: string;
  ok: boolean;
  swings_inserted: number;
  prs_detected: number;
  error?: string;
};

// Per-push budget. A hung downstream push must not delay cursor advance.
const PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000;

// One push per swing-PR EVENT, regardless of how many metrics the swing
// just topped. Task intent (and the trigger) is one PR event per qualifying
// swing — emitting per-metric pushes was a duplicate-notification bug.
// We pick the most exciting metric for the title (priority: exit velo →
// distance → pitch speed) but include all metrics that PR'd in `data` for
// the client to render however it likes.
type PrSummary = {
  metrics: Array<{ metric: string; value: number }>;
};

async function fanOutSwingPrPush(
  parentUserId: string,
  kidFirstName: string,
  pr: PrSummary,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!parentUserId || pr.metrics.length === 0) return;
  const ac = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS);
  // Headline metric — first match in priority order, falling back to the
  // first reported metric if no priority match (futureproofing).
  const priority = ["exit_velocity_mph", "distance_ft", "pitch_speed_mph"];
  const headline =
    pr.metrics.find((m) => priority.includes(m.metric)) ?? pr.metrics[0];
  const niceMetric =
    headline.metric === "exit_velocity_mph"
      ? `${Math.round(headline.value)} mph exit velo`
      : headline.metric === "distance_ft"
        ? `${Math.round(headline.value)} ft distance`
        : headline.metric === "pitch_speed_mph"
          ? `${Math.round(headline.value)} mph pitch`
          : `${headline.value}`;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        user_ids: [parentUserId],
        title: `New PR! ${niceMetric}`,
        body: `${kidFirstName} just set a personal best.`,
        data: { kind: "swing_pr", metrics: pr.metrics },
      }),
      signal: ac.signal,
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const txt = await res.text().catch(() => "");
      console.error(`hittrax-poll push failed status=${res.status} body=${txt.slice(0, 200)}`);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("hittrax-poll push error", err);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

async function pollOneLink(cfg: HitTraxConfig, link: LinkRow, facilityId: string | null): Promise<PollOutcome> {
  const outcome: PollOutcome = { link_id: link.id, ok: false, swings_inserted: 0, prs_detected: 0 };

  if (!link.third_party_user_password) {
    outcome.error = "missing_password";
    await recordFailure(link.id, link.retry_count, "missing_password");
    return outcome;
  }

  const startDate = new Date(link.last_polled_through ?? link.associated_at ?? new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString());
  const endDate = new Date(Date.now() - SLACK_SECONDS * 1000);
  if (endDate <= startDate) {
    // Nothing to do this run — note the timestamp and clear any backoff;
    // this is a healthy "empty window" outcome, not a failure.
    await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .update({
        last_polled_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        last_poll_error: null,
        retry_count: 0,
        next_poll_at: null,
      })
      .eq("id", link.id);
    outcome.ok = true;
    return outcome;
  }

  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "GetAvailableThirdPartyData", {
    ThirdPartyUserID: link.third_party_user_id,
    ThirdPartyUserPassword: link.third_party_user_password,
    ContentType: HITTRAX_CONTENT_TYPE,
    StartDate: formatHitTraxDate(startDate),
    EndDate: formatHitTraxDate(endDate),
    ...(facilityId ? { FacilityID: facilityId } : {}),
  });

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), POLL_TIMEOUT_MS);
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(url, { method: "GET", signal: controller.signal });
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
    const code = (err as Error)?.name === "AbortError" ? "hittrax_timeout" : "hittrax_unreachable";
    outcome.error = code;
    await recordFailure(link.id, link.retry_count, code);
    return outcome;
  }
  clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errBody = await res.text().catch(() => "(unreadable)");
    console.error(
      `hittrax-poll GetAvailableThirdPartyData failed link=${link.id} status=${res.status} body=${errBody.slice(0, 500)}`,
    );
    const errorCode = `hittrax_status_${res.status}: ${errBody.slice(0, 200)}`;
    outcome.error = errorCode;
    await recordFailure(link.id, link.retry_count, errorCode);
    return outcome;
  }
  const bodyText = await res.text();
  // HitTrax may return "Error <reason>" in 200-OK responses (their convention).
  const checkErr = parseHitTraxTextResponse(bodyText);
  if (!checkErr.ok) {
    outcome.error = checkErr.error.slice(0, 200);
    await recordFailure(link.id, link.retry_count, outcome.error);
    return outcome;
  }

  // Strict parser distinguishes "empty window" from "malformed body". A
  // contract-drift / HTML error page / truncated body must NOT advance the
  // cursor — otherwise we'd silently skip every event in this window
  // forever. Treat as a hard poll failure: cursor untouched, error logged.
  const parseResult = parseSwingsPayloadStrict(checkErr.body);
  if (!parseResult.ok) {
    outcome.error = `parse_${parseResult.code}`;
    console.error(
      `hittrax-poll parse failure link=${link.id} code=${parseResult.code} sample=${parseResult.sample}`,
    );
    await recordFailure(link.id, link.retry_count, outcome.error);
    return outcome;
  }
  const swings = parseResult.swings;
  if (swings.length === 0) {
    console.log(`hittrax-poll empty window link=${link.id} body_sample=${bodyText.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  // ANY dropped row is treated as a hard failure: the cursor stays put and
  // we apply backoff, so a partial schema drift never silently skips
  // events. Without this guard, an unparseable row inside a window with
  // valid rows would be permanently lost when last_polled_through advanced
  // past it. Fail-loud is correct here — the next poll re-fetches the same
  // window and the swings UNIQUE absorbs the now-already-stored good rows
  // while we wait for the contract-drift fix to land.
  if (parseResult.dropped > 0) {
    outcome.error = `parse_partial_dropped_count_${parseResult.dropped}_kept_${swings.length}`;
    console.error(
      `hittrax-poll partial parse rejected link=${link.id} kept=${swings.length} dropped=${parseResult.dropped}`,
    );
    await recordFailure(link.id, link.retry_count, outcome.error);
    return outcome;
  }

  // Look up parent + kid name once for push fan-out.
  let parentUserId = "";
  let kidFirstName = "your kid";
  try {
    const { data: kid } = await adminClient
      .from("kids")
      .select("first_name, family_id")
      .eq("id", link.kid_id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (kid) {
      kidFirstName = kid.first_name ?? kidFirstName;
      const { data: family } = await adminClient
        .from("families")
        .select("parent_user_id")
        .eq("id", kid.family_id)
        .maybeSingle();
      parentUserId = family?.parent_user_id ?? "";
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("hittrax-poll lookup parent failed", e);
  }

  // UPSERT sessions (one per distinct capture_session_id), then UPSERT swings.
  const sessionIdMap = new Map<string, string>(); // hittrax session id -> our uuid
  const distinctSessions = new Map<string, ParsedSwing[]>();
  for (const s of swings) {
    const sid = s.capture_session_id ?? `solo:${s.capture_event_id}`;
    if (!distinctSessions.has(sid)) distinctSessions.set(sid, []);
    distinctSessions.get(sid)!.push(s);
  }

  // Track per-link success. The cursor (last_polled_through) only advances
  // if EVERY upsert in this window succeeded. Partial failure leaves the
  // cursor untouched so the next poll re-fetches the same window — duplicate
  // rows are absorbed by the swings UNIQUE on (capture_source, capture_event_id).
  let allOk = true;
  // Push fan-out is best-effort. We collect every PR push as a promise here
  // and Promise.allSettled them at the end of the link — pushes never block
  // a swing UPSERT and never block cursor advance.
  const pushPromises: Promise<void>[] = [];

  for (const [hittraxSessionId, members] of distinctSessions.entries()) {
    if (!hittraxSessionId.startsWith("solo:")) {
      // Real HitTrax session — UPSERT.
      const startedAt = members.reduce(
        (min, s) => (s.occurred_at < min ? s.occurred_at : min),
        members[0].occurred_at,
      );
      const endedAt = members.reduce(
        (max, s) => (s.occurred_at > max ? s.occurred_at : max),
        members[0].occurred_at,
      );
      const evs = members.map((m) => m.exit_velocity_mph).filter((v): v is number => v != null);
      const dists = members.map((m) => m.distance_ft).filter((v): v is number => v != null);
      const facility = members.find((m) => m.facility_id)?.facility_id ?? null;

      const { data: upserted, error: sessErr } = await adminClient
        .from("sessions")
        .upsert(
          {
            tenant_id: link.tenant_id,
            kid_id: link.kid_id,
            capture_source: "hittrax",
            capture_session_id: hittraxSessionId,
            facility_id: facility,
            started_at: startedAt,
            ended_at: endedAt,
            swing_count: members.length,
            best_exit_velocity_mph: evs.length ? Math.max(...evs) : null,
            avg_exit_velocity_mph: evs.length ? Math.round((evs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / evs.length) * 10) / 10 : null,
            max_distance_ft: dists.length ? Math.max(...dists) : null,
          },
          { onConflict: "capture_source,capture_session_id" },
        )
        .select("id")
        .single();
      if (sessErr) {
        console.error("hittrax-poll session upsert failed", sessErr);
        allOk = false;
        continue;
      }
      sessionIdMap.set(hittraxSessionId, upserted.id);
    }
  }

  // PR detection in this run = swings that the trigger flips to is_personal_best.
  // We can detect them after-the-fact by selecting back rows with is_personal_best
  // matching our just-inserted ids. To keep things simple, count returned PRs
  // by comparing against the personal_bests table BEFORE insert.
  const beforePbs = new Map<string, number>();
  try {
    const { data: pbs } = await adminClient
      .from("personal_bests")
      .select("metric, value")
      .eq("kid_id", link.kid_id);
    for (const p of pbs ?? []) {
      beforePbs.set(p.metric, Number(p.value));
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("hittrax-poll fetch beforePbs failed", e);
  }

  for (const swing of swings) {
    const hittraxSessionId = swing.capture_session_id ?? null;
    const ourSessionId = hittraxSessionId ? sessionIdMap.get(hittraxSessionId) ?? null : null;
    const { error: insertErr } = await adminClient.from("swings").upsert(
      {
        tenant_id: link.tenant_id,
        kid_id: link.kid_id,
        session_id: ourSessionId,
        capture_source: "hittrax",
        capture_event_id: swing.capture_event_id,
        occurred_at: swing.occurred_at,
        exit_velocity_mph: swing.exit_velocity_mph,
        launch_angle_deg: swing.launch_angle_deg,
        distance_ft: swing.distance_ft,
        contact_quality: swing.contact_quality,
        result: swing.result,
        pitch_speed_mph: swing.pitch_speed_mph,
        spray_angle_deg: swing.spray_angle_deg,
        raw: swing.raw,
      },
      { onConflict: "capture_source,capture_event_id", ignoreDuplicates: false },
    );
    if (insertErr) {
      console.error(`hittrax-poll swing upsert failed event=${swing.capture_event_id}`, insertErr);
      allOk = false;
      continue;
    }
    outcome.swings_inserted++;

    // PR detection (best-effort mirror of the canonical detect_swing_pr
    // trigger). We collapse all metrics this swing topped into ONE push
    // event, matching the ledger semantics: detect_swing_pr writes a
    // single points_ledger row per qualifying swing, so the user sees a
    // single +15 — they should also see a single notification, not three.
    const checks: Array<{ metric: string; value: number | null }> = [
      { metric: "exit_velocity_mph", value: swing.exit_velocity_mph },
      { metric: "distance_ft", value: swing.distance_ft },
      { metric: "pitch_speed_mph", value: swing.pitch_speed_mph },
    ];
    const pr: PrSummary = { metrics: [] };
    for (const c of checks) {
      if (c.value === null) continue;
      const before = beforePbs.get(c.metric);
      if (before === undefined || c.value > before) {
        // Update local cache so a later swing in the same payload doesn't
        // re-detect this metric as a PR.
        beforePbs.set(c.metric, c.value);
        pr.metrics.push({ metric: c.metric, value: c.value });
      }
    }
    if (pr.metrics.length > 0) {
      outcome.prs_detected++;
      // ONE push per swing-PR event regardless of metric count — see
      // fanOutSwingPrPush. Best-effort, never blocks cursor advance.
      pushPromises.push(fanOutSwingPrPush(parentUserId, kidFirstName, pr));
    }
  }

  // Drain push fan-out before returning. Each push has its own 5s timeout,
  // so worst-case wall-clock here is bounded. allSettled means a single
  // push failure doesn't poison the link — failures are already logged
  // inside fanOutPrPush.
  if (pushPromises.length > 0) {
    await Promise.allSettled(pushPromises);
  }

  // Cursor only advances on FULL success. On partial failure we record the
  // failure on the link and leave last_polled_through where it was so the
  // next run re-fetches and the swings UNIQUE absorbs the dupes. Successful
  // polls clear retry_count + next_poll_at so the link returns to "every
  // tick" cadence.
  if (allOk) {
    await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .update({
        last_polled_through: endDate.toISOString(),
        last_polled_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        last_poll_error: null,
        retry_count: 0,
        next_poll_at: null,
      })
      .eq("id", link.id);
    outcome.ok = true;
  } else {
    outcome.error = "partial_upsert_failure";
    await recordFailure(link.id, link.retry_count, outcome.error);
  }
  return outcome;
}

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  // Service-role auth — same convention as send-push-notification.
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  if (token !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Service role required");
  }

  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) {
    return jsonError(503, "hittrax_not_configured", "HitTrax credentials not provisioned");
  }

  // Backoff filter: a link is poll-eligible when next_poll_at is NULL
  // (healthy, never-backed-off) OR has elapsed (backoff window expired).
  // PostgREST `.or()` with two clauses keeps the cron tick cheap and lets
  // healthy links continue to poll on every tick while backed-off links
  // wait for their delay to pass. The index on (association_status,
  // next_poll_at NULLS FIRST, last_polled_at NULLS FIRST) added in
  // 20260508070000_v07_hittrax_backoff supports this read pattern.
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const { data: links, error: linksErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, tenant_id, kid_id, third_party_user_id, third_party_user_password, associated_at, last_polled_through, retry_count")
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .eq("association_status", "active")
    .or(`next_poll_at.is.null,next_poll_at.lte.${nowIso}`)
    .order("last_polled_at", { ascending: true, nullsFirst: true })
    .limit(MAX_LINKS_PER_RUN);
  if (linksErr) {
    console.error("hittrax-poll fetch links failed", linksErr);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to fetch active links");
  }

  // Look up hittrax_facility_id once per distinct tenant in a single query.
  const tenantIds = [...new Set((links ?? []).map((l) => l.tenant_id))];
  const facilityIdByTenant = new Map<string, string | null>();
  if (tenantIds.length > 0) {
    const { data: tenantRows, error: tenantsErr } = await adminClient
      .from("tenants")
      .select("id, hittrax_facility_id")
      .in("id", tenantIds);
    if (tenantsErr) {
      // Non-fatal: polling proceeds without FacilityID param (graceful
      // degradation), but we log so operators can catch misconfiguration.
      console.error("hittrax-poll tenant facility_id lookup failed", tenantsErr);
    }
    for (const row of tenantRows ?? []) {
      facilityIdByTenant.set(row.id, row.hittrax_facility_id ?? null);
    }
  }

  const outcomes: PollOutcome[] = [];
  for (const link of links ?? []) {
    const facilityId = facilityIdByTenant.get(link.tenant_id) ?? null;
    const o = await pollOneLink(cfg, link as LinkRow, facilityId);
    outcomes.push(o);
  }

  const totalSwings = outcomes.reduce((a, o) => a + o.swings_inserted, 0);
  const totalPrs = outcomes.reduce((a, o) => a + o.prs_detected, 0);
  const errors = outcomes.filter((o) => !o.ok).length;
  console.log(
    `hittrax-poll links=${outcomes.length} swings=${totalSwings} prs=${totalPrs} errors=${errors} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
  );

  return jsonOk({ ok: true, outcomes, totals: { links: outcomes.length, swings: totalSwings, prs: totalPrs, errors } });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/hittrax-registration-complete/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/hittrax-registration-complete/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #118 Step 4 — Inbound CompleteHitTraxRegistration callback.
//
// HitTrax calls this endpoint after the user taps Accept/Decline in the email
// HitTrax sent them following our AssociateThirdPartyAccount call. Per spec:
//
//   POST <our-base-url>/CompleteHitTraxRegistration
//        ?PartnerID=<PID>&APIKey=<SECRET>
//        &ThirdPartyUserID=<UUID>&Accepted=<true|false>
//        &ThirdPartyUserPassword=<HITTRAX_ISSUED_PASSWORD>
//
// We:
//   1. Verify PartnerID + APIKey in constant time (the entire HitTrax inbound
//      auth model — there is NO HMAC, NO bearer token, NO OAuth in v1.0).
//   2. Look up kid_capture_links by ThirdPartyUserID.
//   3. If Accepted=true: persist password, flip status -> 'active',
//      seed last_polled_through = associated_at = now.
//   4. If Accepted=false: flip status -> 'declined'.
//   5. Return PLAIN TEXT "true" on success or "Error <reason>" on failure
//      (HitTrax expects this exact wire format — see Appendix on page 12).
//
// Deploy:
//   npx supabase functions deploy hittrax-registration-complete --no-verify-jwt
//
// Idempotency (CRITICAL — re-delivery must NEVER lose data):
//   * The same Accepted=true callback may be re-delivered (HitTrax network
//     retry, at-least-once delivery semantics). The active-link branch
//     short-circuits BEFORE touching last_polled_through or associated_at
//     because re-running the UPDATE would jump the cursor forward to "now"
//     and silently skip every swing the poller hasn't yet ingested in the
//     window between original activation and re-delivery. The only state
//     we refresh on re-delivery is the password (in case HitTrax rotated
//     it) — and that's gated by `.neq()` so it's a no-op when unchanged.
//   * If a callback for an already-removed link arrives, we treat it as a
//     no-op and return "true" — there's nothing to do, and erroring would
//     make HitTrax retry forever.
//   * declined → accepted re-delivery is a real state change (parent
//     re-tried via associate), so we proceed with the normal activate
//     path and seed the cursor at "now".
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

import {
  hittraxText,
  readHitTraxConfig,
  verifyHitTraxInbound,
} from "../_shared/hittrax.ts";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  // HitTrax sends POST per spec; tolerate GET too because some implementations
  // use GET for query-param-only endpoints.
  if (req.method !== "POST" && req.method !== "GET") {
    return hittraxText("Error Method Not Allowed", 405);
  }

  const cfg = readHitTraxConfig();
  if (!cfg) {
    console.error("hittrax-registration-complete: HITTRAX_* secrets not configured");
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const auth = verifyHitTraxInbound(url, cfg);
  if (!auth.ok) {
    console.error(
      `hittrax-registration-complete auth_failed code=${auth.code} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return hittraxText(`Error ${auth.message}`, auth.status);
  }

  const tpuid = url.searchParams.get("ThirdPartyUserID");
  const acceptedRaw = url.searchParams.get("Accepted");
  const password = url.searchParams.get("ThirdPartyUserPassword");

  if (!tpuid) return hittraxText("Error Missing Third Party UserID", 400);
  if (acceptedRaw === null) return hittraxText("Error Missing Accepted", 400);
  // Strict ∈ {true,false} parse — anything else is a malformed callback and
  // MUST 400 rather than silently being treated as decline (which would
  // mutate the link to 'declined' on a spec-violating payload).
  const acceptedNorm = acceptedRaw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (acceptedNorm !== "true" && acceptedNorm !== "false") {
    return hittraxText("Error Invalid Accepted value", 400);
  }
  const accepted = acceptedNorm === "true";

  if (accepted && (!password || password.length === 0)) {
    return hittraxText("Error Missing Third Party User Password", 400);
  }

  // Look up the link by third_party_user_id.
  const { data: link, error: lookupErr } = await adminClient
    .from("kid_capture_links")
    .select("id, association_status, kid_id, tenant_id")
    .eq("capture_source", "hittrax")
    .eq("third_party_user_id", tpuid)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (lookupErr) {
    console.error("hittrax-registration-complete db error on lookup", lookupErr);
    return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
  }
  if (!link) {
    // Per spec error table: "No Third Party User found".
    console.warn(`hittrax-registration-complete no_link tpuid=${tpuid.slice(0, 8)}…`);
    return hittraxText("Error No Third Party User found", 404);
  }

  // If link is already removed, ack and noop — HitTrax should not retry.
  if (link.association_status === "removed") {
    console.log(
      `hittrax-registration-complete noop link=${link.id} status=removed ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return hittraxText("true");
  }

  if (accepted) {
    // IDEMPOTENCY: HitTrax may re-deliver the same Accepted=true callback
    // (network retry, at-least-once delivery). A re-delivery for an
    // already-active link MUST be a true no-op — re-running the UPDATE
    // would clobber `last_polled_through` back to "now", silently
    // skipping every swing the poller has not yet ingested in the
    // window between the original activation and the re-delivery. The
    // only state we are willing to refresh on a re-delivery is the
    // password, in case HitTrax rotated it (the spec doesn't mandate it
    // but the password we store is the one HitTrax just sent — keeping
    // them in sync is safe). The cursor + activation timestamp are
    // ABSOLUTELY frozen post-activation.
    if (link.association_status === "active") {
      if (password) {
        const { error: pwErr } = await adminClient
          .from("kid_capture_links")
          .update({ third_party_user_password: password })
          .eq("id", link.id)
          .neq("third_party_user_password", password); // skip write if unchanged
        if (pwErr) {
          console.error("hittrax-registration-complete db error on password refresh", pwErr);
          // Best-effort: still ack so HitTrax doesn't retry forever.
        }
      }
      console.log(
        `hittrax-registration-complete noop_active link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
      );
      return hittraxText("true");
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { error: updateErr } = await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .update({
        association_status: "active",
        third_party_user_password: password,
        associated_at: now,
        // Seed cursor at activation time so the first poll only fetches
        // swings recorded from now onward. Backfill is intentionally not
        // attempted in v1 — see runbook. Guarded above so this only ever
        // runs on the first accepted callback.
        last_polled_through: now,
        // Reset any backoff state from previous failed pending attempts.
        retry_count: 0,
        next_poll_at: null,
        last_poll_error: null,
      })
      .eq("id", link.id);
    if (updateErr) {
      console.error("hittrax-registration-complete db error on accept update", updateErr);
      return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
    }
    console.log(
      `hittrax-registration-complete accepted link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
  } else {
    const { error: updateErr } = await adminClient
      .from("kid_capture_links")
      .update({
        association_status: "declined",
        third_party_user_password: null,
      })
      .eq("id", link.id);
    if (updateErr) {
      console.error("hittrax-registration-complete db error on decline update", updateErr);
      return hittraxText("Error Internal Exception", 500);
    }
    console.log(
      `hittrax-registration-complete declined link=${link.id} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
  }

  return hittraxText("true");
});

FILE: supabase/functions/mux-create-upload/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/mux-create-upload/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// v0.4 Step 4.4 — Mux Direct Upload URL minter.
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Headers:
//     Authorization: Bearer <coach-jwt>     required
//     Idempotency-Key: <client-uuid>        optional but recommended
//   Body (optional JSON):
//     { purpose?: 'coach_message' | 'drill' }   defaults to 'coach_message'
//   Response 200: { upload_url: string, video_id: string }
//   Errors:     { error: { code: string, message: string } }
//                 401 unauthorized | 403 forbidden | 405 method_not_allowed
//                 502 mux_error | mux_unreachable | mux_bad_response
//                 504 mux_timeout | 500 db_error | 409 conflict
//
// Auth model:
//   1. Header is parsed; missing/malformed -> 401.
//   2. JWT signature is verified by calling supabase.auth.getUser(token) on an
//      ANON-KEY client — never trust an unverified decode for auth decisions.
//   3. After verification we decode the payload only to read custom claims
//      (app_role, tenant_id) which the access-token hook injects (and which
//      are NOT in user.user_metadata).
//   4. app_role !== 'coach' -> 403.
//
// DB write model:
//   Insert uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY so the call doesn't depend on user
//   JWT RLS, but tenant_id and uploaded_by_user_id are pinned from the
//   verified JWT — the client can't smuggle either.
//
// Idempotency:
//   Forward client Idempotency-Key to Mux. Mux returns the SAME upload row
//   (same `id`) for repeated calls with the same key. We store that upload id
//   in videos.mux_asset_id (UNIQUE), so a retry hits the existing row and we
//   return its video_id without a second insert. The webhook in Step 4.5 will
//   later replace this with the real asset_id once Mux finishes processing.
//
// Failure model:
//   Mux is called BEFORE the DB insert, so any Mux 5xx / timeout / malformed
//   response leaves no orphan row in public.videos.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const MUX_TOKEN_ID = Deno.env.get("MUX_TOKEN_ID")!;
const MUX_TOKEN_SECRET = Deno.env.get("MUX_TOKEN_SECRET")!;

const MUX_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
const MUX_UPLOADS_URL = "https://api.mux.com/video/v1/uploads";

type ErrorCode =
  | "method_not_allowed"
  | "unauthorized"
  | "forbidden"
  | "bad_request"
  | "mux_error"
  | "mux_unreachable"
  | "mux_bad_response"
  | "mux_timeout"
  | "db_error"
  | "conflict";

function jsonError(status: number, code: ErrorCode, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function jsonOk(body: Record<string, unknown>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

// Decode (without verifying) the payload of a JWT we have ALREADY verified
// via supabase.auth.getUser. Used only to read custom claims that the
// access-token hook injects (app_role, tenant_id) and which are not surfaced
// on the user object.
function decodeVerifiedJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split(".");
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const padded = b64 + "=".repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4);
    return JSON.parse(atob(padded));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }

  // ---- 1. Parse Authorization header --------------------------------------
  const authHeader =
    req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  if (!token) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Empty bearer token");
  }

  // ---- 2. Verify the JWT against the project (anon-key client) ------------
  const userClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  });
  const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser(token);
  if (userErr || !userData?.user) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Invalid or expired token");
  }
  const userId = userData.user.id;

  // ---- 3. Read custom claims from the verified JWT -----------------------
  const payload = decodeVerifiedJwtPayload(token);
  const appRole = typeof payload?.app_role === "string" ? (payload.app_role as string) : undefined;
  const tenantId = typeof payload?.tenant_id === "string" ? (payload.tenant_id as string) : undefined;

  if (!tenantId) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Token missing tenant_id claim");
  }

  // ---- 3b. Read optional purpose from request body ------------------------
  // Body is optional; tolerate missing / malformed JSON the same way as
  // before (treat as empty object). Anything other than the three known
  // purposes is rejected so the DB CHECK constraint never gets a chance
  // to surface as a 500.
  let bodyJson: { purpose?: unknown } = {};
  try {
    const raw = await req.text();
    if (raw) bodyJson = JSON.parse(raw) as { purpose?: unknown };
  } catch {
    bodyJson = {};
  }
  const allowedPurposes = ["coach_message", "drill", "parent_to_coach", "training"] as const;
  type Purpose = typeof allowedPurposes[number];
  if (
    bodyJson.purpose !== undefined &&
    !allowedPurposes.includes(bodyJson.purpose as Purpose)
  ) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Invalid purpose");
  }
  const purpose: Purpose = (bodyJson.purpose as Purpose | undefined) ?? "coach_message";

  // Role check, defence-in-depth on top of DB RLS:
  //   coach_message / drill   -> app_role='coach' OR app_role='owner'
  //                             OR app_role='admin' OR app_role='super_admin'
  //                             (owner/admin/super_admin can upload on behalf of a coach)
  //   parent_to_coach         -> app_role='parent'
  //   training                -> app_role='admin' OR app_role='super_admin'
  //                             (HQ-curated catalog; v0.7 task #121)
  if (purpose === "parent_to_coach") {
    if (appRole !== "parent") {
      return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Parent role required for parent_to_coach uploads");
    }
  } else if (purpose === "training") {
    if (appRole !== "admin" && appRole !== "super_admin") {
      return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Admin role required for training uploads");
    }
  } else {
    if (
      appRole !== "coach" &&
      appRole !== "owner" &&
      appRole !== "admin" &&
      appRole !== "super_admin"
    ) {
      return jsonError(403, "forbidden", "Coach or owner role required");
    }
  }

  // ---- 4. Call Mux Direct Upload API --------------------------------------
  const idempotencyKey =
    req.headers.get("Idempotency-Key") ?? req.headers.get("idempotency-key");

  const muxBasicAuth = btoa(`${MUX_TOKEN_ID}:${MUX_TOKEN_SECRET}`);
  const muxHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Basic ${muxBasicAuth}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  };
  if (idempotencyKey) muxHeaders["Idempotency-Key"] = idempotencyKey;

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), MUX_TIMEOUT_MS);

  let muxRes: Response;
  try {
    muxRes = await fetch(MUX_UPLOADS_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: muxHeaders,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        cors_origin: "*",
        new_asset_settings: { playback_policy: ["public"] },
      }),
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
    if ((err as Error)?.name === "AbortError") {
      return jsonError(504, "mux_timeout", "Mux request timed out");
    }
    return jsonError(502, "mux_unreachable", "Failed to reach Mux");
  }
  clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);

  if (!muxRes.ok) {
    // Drain body to free the connection; do not leak Mux details.
    try { await muxRes.text(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    return jsonError(502, "mux_error", `Mux returned status ${muxRes.status}`);
  }

  let muxJson: { data?: { id?: string; url?: string } } | null = null;
  try {
    muxJson = await muxRes.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonError(502, "mux_bad_response", "Malformed Mux response");
  }
  const uploadId = muxJson?.data?.id;
  const uploadUrl = muxJson?.data?.url;
  if (!uploadId || !uploadUrl) {
    return jsonError(502, "mux_bad_response", "Mux response missing id or url");
  }

  // ---- 5. Insert (or fetch on idempotent retry) the videos row -----------
  const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
  });

  // Look up first: an idempotent Mux retry returns the same upload id, and
  // mux_asset_id is UNIQUE — so the existing row IS the canonical answer.
  const { data: existing, error: existingErr } = await adminClient
    .from("videos")
    .select("id, uploaded_by_user_id, tenant_id")
    .eq("mux_asset_id", uploadId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (existingErr) {
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query videos");
  }

  if (existing) {
    if (
      existing.uploaded_by_user_id !== userId ||
      existing.tenant_id !== tenantId
    ) {
      // Defensive: should be impossible because Mux would not hand the same
      // upload id to a different caller, but guard anyway.
      return jsonError(409, "conflict", "Idempotency key collides across users/tenants");
    }
    return jsonOk({ upload_url: uploadUrl, video_id: existing.id });
  }

  const { data: inserted, error: insertErr } = await adminClient
    .from("videos")
    .insert({
      tenant_id: tenantId,
      uploaded_by_user_id: userId,
      mux_asset_id: uploadId,
      status: "uploading",
      purpose,
    })
    .select("id")
    .single();

  if (insertErr || !inserted) {
    // Race-loser path: another concurrent request inserted the same upload id.
    // Re-fetch with ownership columns and apply the SAME tenant/user check as
    // the existing-row branch — never return a video_id owned by a different
    // caller, even in a race / shared-credential collision scenario.
    const { data: retryRow, error: retryErr } = await adminClient
      .from("videos")
      .select("id, uploaded_by_user_id, tenant_id")
      .eq("mux_asset_id", uploadId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (retryErr) {
      return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to insert video row");
    }
    if (retryRow) {
      if (
        retryRow.uploaded_by_user_id !== userId ||
        retryRow.tenant_id !== tenantId
      ) {
        return jsonError(409, "conflict", "Idempotency key collides across users/tenants");
      }
      return jsonOk({ upload_url: uploadUrl, video_id: retryRow.id });
    }
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to insert video row");
  }

  return jsonOk({ upload_url: uploadUrl, video_id: inserted.id });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/mux-webhook/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/mux-webhook/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// v0.4 Step 4.5 — Mux outbound webhook receiver.
//
// Auth model: there is NO Supabase JWT on this endpoint. Authentication is
// the Mux signature on the raw request body, verified against
// MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy mux-webhook --no-verify-jwt
//
// Required Edge Function secrets:
//   SUPABASE_URL                 (auto-injected by Supabase)
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY    (auto-injected by Supabase)
//   MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET           (operator: copy from Mux Dashboard ->
//                                 Settings -> Webhooks when registering
//                                 this endpoint, then
//                                 `npx supabase secrets set MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET=...`)
//
// Trust boundary: the request body MUST be read as raw bytes (text), not
// parsed, for signature verification. We HMAC-SHA256 over `${t}.${rawBody}`
// and compare in constant time, then JSON.parse only after the signature
// passes. A tampered body changes the HMAC; a replayed body older than the
// tolerance window is rejected by the timestamp check.
//
// Idempotency: every event update is keyed on a UNIQUE column
// (mux_asset_id), and every UPDATE is shape-guarded with WHERE clauses so
// replays become no-ops. The function never inserts new rows on this path.
//
// Failure model:
//   - 200 {ok:true}                          event applied (or replay no-op)
//   - 200 {ok:true, ignored:true, reason}    unhandled event type (so Mux
//                                            stops retrying)
//   - 400 {error:{code,message}}             malformed JSON / missing or
//                                            malformed Mux-Signature header
//   - 401 {error:{code,message}}             bad signature or stale timestamp
//   - 503 {error:{code,message}}             event references an asset/upload
//                                            id we have no videos row for —
//                                            Mux exponentially backs off and
//                                            re-delivers (24h cap)
//
// Handled events:
//   video.upload.asset_created  upload id -> real asset id, status=processing
//   video.asset.ready           status=ready, mux_playback_id, duration_seconds
//   video.asset.errored         status=errored
//
// Race handling for `video.asset.ready` arriving before
// `video.upload.asset_created` (Mux delivery is at-least-once and unordered):
// fall back to looking up the row by the original upload id stored as
// mux_asset_id (data.upload_id on the ready event), and in one statement
// SET mux_asset_id = data.id AND populate playback / duration / status='ready'.
// This collapses both events into a single idempotent write.
//
// All DB writes use the service-role client (no JWT, no tenant pin
// available). Cross-tenant smuggling is prevented because every UPDATE
// keys on mux_asset_id, which is UNIQUE across the whole videos table —
// a forged event with a known asset id of tenant A cannot mutate tenant
// B's rows. Signature verification (which requires MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
// gates the entire path.
//
// Logging: one line per request,
//   mux-webhook event=<type> asset_or_upload=<id> outcome=<...> ms=<n>
// No event payloads in logs (PII / private playback ids).
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET = Deno.env.get("MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET")!;

// Best-effort fan-out for coach-video notifications (task #93). Fired from
// inside the video.asset.ready success path AFTER the row is updated to
// status='ready'. Both invocations run via Promise.allSettled and any
// failure is logged but never changes the 200 response to Mux — otherwise
// a flaky notification would make Mux retry and double-write the videos
// row. The push side (`send-push-notification`) and the email side
// (`send-coach-video-notification`) are independent: one failing does not
// block the other.
async function fanOutCoachVideoNotifications(videoId: string): Promise<void> {
  const { data: video, error: vErr } = await adminClient
    .from("videos")
    .select("id, purpose")
    .eq("id", videoId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (vErr || !video) return;
  if (video.purpose === "parent_to_coach") {
    await fanOutParentToCoachNotifications(videoId);
    return;
  }
  if (video.purpose !== "coach_message") return;

  // Look up the message + recipient parent for push targeting + push title.
  const { data: msg } = await adminClient
    .from("coach_messages")
    .select("recipient_family_id, recipient_kid_id, sender_user_id")
    .eq("video_id", videoId)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!msg) return;

  const [familyRes, kidRes, coachRes] = await Promise.all([
    adminClient
      .from("families")
      .select("parent_user_id")
      .eq("id", msg.recipient_family_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    adminClient
      .from("kids")
      .select("first_name")
      .eq("id", msg.recipient_kid_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    adminClient
      .from("coaches")
      .select("first_name")
      .eq("user_id", msg.sender_user_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
  ]);

  const parentUserId = familyRes.data?.parent_user_id ?? "";
  const kidFirst = kidRes.data?.first_name ?? "your kid";
  const coachFirst = coachRes.data?.first_name ?? "Your coach";

  const authHeader = { Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` };
  const fnBase = `${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1`;

  await Promise.allSettled([
    parentUserId
      ? fetch(`${fnBase}/send-push-notification`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { ...authHeader, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            user_ids: [parentUserId],
            title: `Coach ${coachFirst} sent ${kidFirst} a new video`,
            body: "Tap to watch in Ballpark",
            data: {
              kind: "coach_message",
              video_id: videoId,
              kid_id: msg.recipient_kid_id,
              coach_user_id: msg.sender_user_id,
            },
          }),
        }).then(async (r) => {
          if (!r.ok) {
            const txt = await r.text().catch(() => "");
            console.error(
              `mux-webhook fanout push status=${r.status} body=${txt.slice(0, 200)}`,
            );
          }
        })
      : Promise.resolve(),
    fetch(`${fnBase}/send-coach-video-notification`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { ...authHeader, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ video_id: videoId }),
    }).then(async (r) => {
      if (!r.ok) {
        const txt = await r.text().catch(() => "");
        console.error(
          `mux-webhook fanout email status=${r.status} body=${txt.slice(0, 200)}`,
        );
      }
    }),
  ]);
}

// Parent->coach push fan-out (v0.7 task #120). Mirrors the coach->parent
// branch above but: (a) targets the coach addressed via
// coach_messages.recipient_coach_user_id, and (b) skips email — coach
// inbox is in-app only. Best-effort: any failure is logged but never
// turns the 200 to Mux into a retry.
async function fanOutParentToCoachNotifications(videoId: string): Promise<void> {
  const { data: msg } = await adminClient
    .from("coach_messages")
    .select("recipient_coach_user_id, recipient_kid_id, sender_display")
    .eq("video_id", videoId)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!msg || !msg.recipient_coach_user_id) return;

  const { data: kidRes } = await adminClient
    .from("kids")
    .select("first_name")
    .eq("id", msg.recipient_kid_id)
    .maybeSingle();
  const kidFirst = kidRes?.first_name ?? "an athlete";
  const fromName =
    typeof msg.sender_display === "string" && msg.sender_display.trim()
      ? msg.sender_display.trim()
      : "A parent";

  const authHeader = { Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` };
  const fnBase = `${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1`;

  const r = await fetch(`${fnBase}/send-push-notification`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { ...authHeader, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      user_ids: [msg.recipient_coach_user_id],
      title: `New video about ${kidFirst}`,
      body: `${fromName} sent you a clip.`,
      data: { kind: "parent_to_coach", video_id: videoId },
    }),
  }).catch((e) => {
    console.error(`mux-webhook parent_to_coach push fetch_err=${e}`);
    return null as Response | null;
  });
  if (r && !r.ok) {
    const txt = await r.text().catch(() => "");
    console.error(
      `mux-webhook parent_to_coach push status=${r.status} body=${txt.slice(0, 200)}`,
    );
  }
}

const TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 300; // 5 min replay window — Stripe convention.

type ErrorCode =
  | "method_not_allowed"
  | "missing_signature_header"
  | "malformed_signature_header"
  | "bad_timestamp"
  | "stale_timestamp"
  | "bad_signature"
  | "malformed_json"
  | "row_not_found"
  | "row_not_ready"
  | "db_error";

type Outcome =
  | "applied"
  | "noop"
  | "ignored"
  | "row_not_found"
  | "row_not_ready"
  | "bad_sig"
  | "stale"
  | "bad_request"
  | "db_error"
  | "method_not_allowed";

function jsonError(status: number, code: ErrorCode, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function jsonOk(body: Record<string, unknown>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function logLine(eventType: string, idOrUpload: string, outcome: Outcome, ms: number): void {
  console.log(
    `mux-webhook event=${eventType || "-"} asset_or_upload=${idOrUpload || "-"} outcome=${outcome} ms=${ms}`,
  );
}

// Verify Mux's `Mux-Signature: t=<unix-seconds>,v1=<hex-hmac>` header
// against the raw body using HMAC-SHA256 over `${t}.${rawBody}`. Constant-
// time compare on the hex strings.
async function verifyMuxSignature(
  rawBody: string,
  header: string | null,
  secret: string,
  toleranceSeconds: number,
): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; status: 400 | 401; reason: ErrorCode }> {
  if (!header) return { ok: false, status: 400, reason: "missing_signature_header" };

  const parts: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const kv of header.split(",")) {
    const [k, v] = kv.trim().split("=");
    if (k && v !== undefined) parts[k] = v;
  }
  const t = parts.t;
  const v1 = parts.v1;
  if (!t || !v1) return { ok: false, status: 400, reason: "malformed_signature_header" };
  const tNum = Number(t);
  if (!Number.isFinite(tNum)) return { ok: false, status: 400, reason: "bad_timestamp" };
  if (Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - tNum) > toleranceSeconds) {
    return { ok: false, status: 401, reason: "stale_timestamp" };
  }

  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    enc.encode(secret),
    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"],
  );
  const macBytes = new Uint8Array(
    await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, enc.encode(`${t}.${rawBody}`)),
  );
  const expected = Array.from(macBytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

  if (expected.length !== v1.length) {
    return { ok: false, status: 401, reason: "bad_signature" };
  }
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) {
    diff |= expected.charCodeAt(i) ^ v1.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return diff === 0 ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, status: 401, reason: "bad_signature" };
}

// Pick the public playback id from a Mux asset.ready payload. Step 4.4 mints
// uploads with new_asset_settings.playback_policy: ["public"], so there is
// always exactly one public id once Mux finishes processing.
function pickPublicPlaybackId(
  playbackIds: Array<{ id?: string; policy?: string }> | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (!Array.isArray(playbackIds)) return null;
  for (const p of playbackIds) {
    if (p && p.policy === "public" && typeof p.id === "string" && p.id.length > 0) {
      return p.id;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    logLine("-", "-", "method_not_allowed", Date.now() - startedAt);
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }

  // ---- 1. Read raw body (required for signature verification) ------------
  const rawBody = await req.text();

  // ---- 2. Verify Mux signature -------------------------------------------
  const sigHeader =
    req.headers.get("Mux-Signature") ?? req.headers.get("mux-signature");
  const sig = await verifyMuxSignature(
    rawBody,
    sigHeader,
    MUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
    TOLERANCE_SECONDS,
  );
  if (!sig.ok) {
    const outcome: Outcome =
      sig.reason === "stale_timestamp"
        ? "stale"
        : sig.reason === "bad_signature"
          ? "bad_sig"
          : "bad_request";
    logLine("-", "-", outcome, Date.now() - startedAt);
    return jsonError(sig.status, sig.reason, sig.reason);
  }

  // ---- 3. Parse JSON (only after signature has passed) -------------------
  let event: {
    type?: string;
    data?: {
      id?: string;
      asset_id?: string;
      upload_id?: string;
      duration?: number;
      playback_ids?: Array<{ id?: string; policy?: string }>;
    };
  };
  try {
    event = JSON.parse(rawBody);
  } catch {
    logLine("-", "-", "bad_request", Date.now() - startedAt);
    return jsonError(400, "malformed_json", "Body is not valid JSON");
  }

  const eventType = typeof event.type === "string" ? event.type : "";
  const data = event.data ?? {};
  const dataId = typeof data.id === "string" ? data.id : "";

  // ---- 4. Dispatch by event type -----------------------------------------
  try {
    switch (eventType) {
      // -------------------------------------------------------------------
      // upload.asset_created: Mux has accepted the bytes. data.id is the
      // upload id (which we stored in mux_asset_id at create time);
      // data.asset_id is the freshly-allocated real asset id.
      // -------------------------------------------------------------------
      case "video.upload.asset_created": {
        const newAssetId =
          typeof data.asset_id === "string" ? data.asset_id : "";
        if (!dataId || !newAssetId) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "bad_request", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(400, "malformed_json", "Missing data.id or data.asset_id");
        }

        // Try the canonical path first: row keyed on the upload id, still
        // in 'uploading'. The WHERE guard makes a replay a no-op (returns 0
        // rows because status is no longer 'uploading').
        const { data: applied, error: applyErr } = await adminClient
          .from("videos")
          .update({ mux_asset_id: newAssetId, status: "processing" })
          .eq("mux_asset_id", dataId)
          .eq("status", "uploading")
          .select("id")
          .maybeSingle();

        if (applyErr) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to update video row");
        }
        if (applied) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "applied", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonOk({ ok: true });
        }

        // No row updated. Either (a) replay after we already swapped to the
        // asset id, or (b) ready already arrived first and collapsed both
        // events. Both are no-ops if a row exists keyed on the new asset id.
        const { data: alreadyDone, error: alreadyErr } = await adminClient
          .from("videos")
          .select("id")
          .eq("mux_asset_id", newAssetId)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (alreadyErr) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query video row");
        }
        if (alreadyDone) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "noop", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonOk({ ok: true });
        }

        // Truly no row for this upload id. Per Race #1 in the plan this
        // shouldn't happen because Step 4.4 inserts before returning the
        // upload URL — but we 503 so Mux retries with backoff. (Per the
        // "always 503 row_not_found" decision in the plan.)
        logLine(eventType, dataId, "row_not_found", Date.now() - startedAt);
        return jsonError(503, "row_not_found", "No video row for this upload id");
      }

      // -------------------------------------------------------------------
      // asset.ready: Mux finished processing. data.id is the asset id,
      // data.upload_id is the original direct-upload id (used for the
      // race fallback below), data.playback_ids[] contains the public
      // playback id, data.duration is float seconds.
      // -------------------------------------------------------------------
      case "video.asset.ready": {
        if (!dataId) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "bad_request", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(400, "malformed_json", "Missing data.id");
        }
        const playbackId = pickPublicPlaybackId(data.playback_ids);
        if (!playbackId) {
          // Mux always sends a public playback id for assets created with
          // playback_policy: ["public"]; treat absence as transient.
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "row_not_ready", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(503, "row_not_ready", "No public playback_id on event");
        }
        const durationSeconds =
          typeof data.duration === "number" && Number.isFinite(data.duration)
            ? Math.max(0, Math.round(data.duration))
            : null;

        // Path A: row already keyed on the real asset id (normal case —
        // upload.asset_created arrived first).
        const updateA = await adminClient
          .from("videos")
          .update({
            mux_playback_id: playbackId,
            duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
            status: "ready",
          })
          .eq("mux_asset_id", dataId)
          .neq("status", "errored")
          .select("id")
          .maybeSingle();

        if (updateA.error) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to update video row");
        }
        if (updateA.data) {
          // Best-effort coach-video notification fan-out (task #93).
          // Wrapped so any failure is logged but never changes the 200.
          try {
            await fanOutCoachVideoNotifications(updateA.data.id);
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("mux-webhook fanout error", e);
          }
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "applied", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonOk({ ok: true });
        }

        // Path B: ready arrived BEFORE upload.asset_created (Race #2). The
        // row is still keyed on the upload id. Collapse both events into
        // one statement: swap to the asset id AND populate ready fields.
        const uploadId =
          typeof data.upload_id === "string" ? data.upload_id : "";
        if (uploadId) {
          const updateB = await adminClient
            .from("videos")
            .update({
              mux_asset_id: dataId,
              mux_playback_id: playbackId,
              duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
              status: "ready",
            })
            .eq("mux_asset_id", uploadId)
            .neq("status", "errored")
            .select("id")
            .maybeSingle();
          if (updateB.error) {
            logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
            return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to update video row");
          }
          if (updateB.data) {
            try {
              await fanOutCoachVideoNotifications(updateB.data.id);
            } catch (e) {
              console.error("mux-webhook fanout error", e);
            }
            logLine(eventType, dataId, "applied", Date.now() - startedAt);
            return jsonOk({ ok: true });
          }
        }

        // Path C (idempotency): replay where we already set everything.
        // The neq('status','errored') guard above filters out an already-
        // ready row that would otherwise be re-written; check explicitly
        // so we return ok instead of 503 in that case.
        const { data: existing, error: existingErr } = await adminClient
          .from("videos")
          .select("id, status, mux_playback_id")
          .eq("mux_asset_id", dataId)
          .maybeSingle();
        if (existingErr) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query video row");
        }
        if (existing && existing.mux_playback_id === playbackId) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "noop", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonOk({ ok: true });
        }
        if (existing && existing.status === "errored") {
          // We already marked this asset errored; refuse to flip it back.
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "noop", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonOk({ ok: true });
        }

        logLine(eventType, dataId, "row_not_found", Date.now() - startedAt);
        return jsonError(503, "row_not_found", "No video row for this asset id");
      }

      // -------------------------------------------------------------------
      // asset.errored: Mux failed to process. data.id is the asset id;
      // we may also receive this before upload.asset_created landed, so
      // try the upload_id fallback too.
      // -------------------------------------------------------------------
      case "video.asset.errored": {
        if (!dataId) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "bad_request", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(400, "malformed_json", "Missing data.id");
        }

        const updateA = await adminClient
          .from("videos")
          .update({ status: "errored" })
          .eq("mux_asset_id", dataId)
          .neq("status", "errored")
          .select("id")
          .maybeSingle();
        if (updateA.error) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to update video row");
        }
        if (updateA.data) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "applied", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonOk({ ok: true });
        }

        const uploadId =
          typeof data.upload_id === "string" ? data.upload_id : "";
        if (uploadId) {
          const updateB = await adminClient
            .from("videos")
            .update({ mux_asset_id: dataId, status: "errored" })
            .eq("mux_asset_id", uploadId)
            .neq("status", "errored")
            .select("id")
            .maybeSingle();
          if (updateB.error) {
            logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
            return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to update video row");
          }
          if (updateB.data) {
            logLine(eventType, dataId, "applied", Date.now() - startedAt);
            return jsonOk({ ok: true });
          }
        }

        // Idempotent replay (already errored) -> noop ok.
        const { data: existing, error: existingErr } = await adminClient
          .from("videos")
          .select("id, status")
          .eq("mux_asset_id", dataId)
          .maybeSingle();
        if (existingErr) {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query video row");
        }
        if (existing && existing.status === "errored") {
          logLine(eventType, dataId, "noop", Date.now() - startedAt);
          return jsonOk({ ok: true });
        }

        logLine(eventType, dataId, "row_not_found", Date.now() - startedAt);
        return jsonError(503, "row_not_found", "No video row for this asset id");
      }

      // -------------------------------------------------------------------
      // Anything else: ack 200 so Mux stops retrying. Returning a non-2xx
      // here would make every unhandled event type retry forever.
      // -------------------------------------------------------------------
      default: {
        logLine(eventType, dataId, "ignored", Date.now() - startedAt);
        return jsonOk({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: "unhandled_event_type" });
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("mux-webhook unexpected error", err);
    logLine(eventType, dataId, "db_error", Date.now() - startedAt);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Unexpected error handling event");
  }
});
