// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/notify-achievement/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// v0.7 task #122 — push fan-out for the achievement-earned event.
//
// Called from the `_grant_achievement` Postgres function via
// pg_net.http_post when a new kid_achievements row is inserted. Best-
// effort: looks up the parent_user_id behind the kid and forwards a
// push payload to send-push-notification. Returns 200 even when there
// is no token / no parent — the trigger that fires us never retries on
// non-2xx, so the contract is "ack-and-go".
//
// Auth: service-role bearer in Authorization (same convention as the
// rest of our internal-only Edge Functions).
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

function jsonError(status: number, code: string, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }
  const auth = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? "";
  if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ") ||
      auth.slice(7).trim() !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Service role required");
  }

  let body: { kid_id?: string; achievement_id?: string; achievement_key?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Invalid JSON");
  }

  const kidId = typeof body.kid_id === "string" ? body.kid_id : "";
  const achId = typeof body.achievement_id === "string" ? body.achievement_id : "";
  if (!kidId || !achId) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "kid_id + achievement_id required");
  }

  // Resolve the parent + kid first name + achievement metadata.
  const [{ data: kidRow }, { data: ach }] = await Promise.all([
    adminClient
      .from("kids")
      .select("first_name, family_id, families!inner(parent_user_id)")
      .eq("id", kidId)
      .maybeSingle(),
    adminClient
      .from("achievements")
      .select("name, points_bonus")
      .eq("id", achId)
      .maybeSingle(),
  ]);

  // Family relation comes back nested; coerce safely.
  const families = (kidRow as { families?: { parent_user_id?: string } | null } | null)?.families;
  const parentUserId = families?.parent_user_id ?? null;
  const kidFirst = (kidRow as { first_name?: string } | null)?.first_name ?? "Your athlete";
  const achName = ach?.name ?? "an achievement";
  const bonus = ach?.points_bonus ?? 0;

  if (!parentUserId) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, skipped: "no_parent" }), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }

  const r = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      user_ids: [parentUserId],
      title: `🏆 ${kidFirst} earned: ${achName}`,
      body: bonus > 0 ? `+${bonus} pts added to their balance.` : "Tap to see the badge.",
      data: { kind: "achievement_earned", achievement_id: achId, kid_id: kidId },
    }),
  }).catch((err) => {
    console.error("notify-achievement send-push fetch failed", err);
    return null;
  });

  if (r && !r.ok) {
    const txt = await r.text().catch(() => "");
    console.error(
      `notify-achievement send-push status=${r.status} body=${txt.slice(0, 200)}`,
    );
  }

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
});

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/notify-assignment-reviewed/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// v0.7 task #122 — push fan-out for "coach reviewed your homework".
//
// Called from the mobile coach review flow AFTER `review_assignment` RPC
// succeeds. The client passes the assignment_id; we look up the kid +
// parent + rating and forward a push to send-push-notification.
//
// Auth: service-role bearer. Mobile clients can NOT call this directly
// (they don't have service-role); the coach app calls it via a thin
// internal Edge Function relay or the post-review hook in the future.
// For task #122 we keep it service-role-only and the coach screen invokes
// it from the on-device review-success path using anon key + a RPC that
// proxies through. Documented as a follow-up.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

function jsonError(status: number, code: string, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }
  const auth = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? "";
  if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ") ||
      auth.slice(7).trim() !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Service role required");
  }

  let body: { assignment_id?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Invalid JSON");
  }
  const assignmentId = typeof body.assignment_id === "string" ? body.assignment_id : "";
  if (!assignmentId) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "assignment_id required");
  }

  const { data: a } = await adminClient
    .from("assignments")
    .select("id, kid_id, title, rating, status")
    .eq("id", assignmentId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!a || a.status !== "reviewed") {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, skipped: "not_reviewed" }), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }

  const { data: kidRow } = await adminClient
    .from("kids")
    .select("first_name, families!inner(parent_user_id)")
    .eq("id", a.kid_id)
    .maybeSingle();
  const families = (kidRow as { families?: { parent_user_id?: string } | null } | null)?.families;
  const parentUserId = families?.parent_user_id ?? null;
  const kidFirst = (kidRow as { first_name?: string } | null)?.first_name ?? "Your athlete";

  if (!parentUserId) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, skipped: "no_parent" }), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }

  const stars = "⭐".repeat(Math.max(1, Math.min(5, a.rating ?? 1)));
  await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      user_ids: [parentUserId],
      title: `Coach reviewed ${kidFirst}'s homework ${stars}`,
      body: a.title ?? "Tap to read the feedback.",
      data: { kind: "assignment_reviewed", assignment_id: assignmentId },
    }),
  }).catch((err) => {
    console.error("notify-assignment-reviewed push fetch failed", err);
  });

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
});

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/notify-cancel-requested/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #261 — Cancellation emails
//
// Sends a Resend email to the parent confirming their cancellation request
// and stating the effective date the membership access will end.
//
// Called via pg_net trigger on memberships.cancel_requested_at:
//   AFTER UPDATE OF cancel_requested_at ON memberships
//   WHEN (OLD.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND NEW.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL)
//
// Can also be invoked manually for testing:
//   curl -X POST \
//     -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" \
//     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
//     -d '{"membership_id":"<uuid>"}' \
//     https://<project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/notify-cancel-requested
//
// Auth: service-role Bearer required.
// Returns HTTP 200 regardless of email outcome (best-effort delivery).
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL            = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const RESEND_API_KEY          = Deno.env.get("RESEND_API_KEY") ?? "";
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL       = Deno.env.get("RESEND_FROM_EMAIL") ?? "onboarding@resend.dev";

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function formatDate(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  const months = ["January","February","March","April","May","June",
                  "July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

async function sendResendEmail(opts: {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  html: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) {
    console.warn("[notify-cancel-requested] RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping email");
    return;
  }
  const res = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
      to: [opts.to],
      subject: opts.subject,
      html: opts.html,
    }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const body = await res.text().catch(() => "");
    console.error(`[notify-cancel-requested] Resend error ${res.status}: ${body.slice(0, 300)}`);
  }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Authorization, Content-Type",
      },
    });
  }

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return json({ error: "POST only" }, 405);
  }

  // Service-role gate
  const authHeader  = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? "";
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, "");
  if (!callerToken || callerToken !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
    return json({ error: "Service-role token required" }, 401);
  }

  let body: { membership_id?: string };
  try { body = await req.json(); } catch {
    return json({ error: "Invalid JSON body" }, 400);
  }

  const { membership_id } = body;
  if (!membership_id) {
    return json({ error: "membership_id required" }, 422);
  }

  const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

  const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
    .from("memberships")
    .select(`
      id, plan_name, cancel_requested_at, cancel_effective_at,
      families!inner(parent_email, parent_first_name)
    `)
    .eq("id", membership_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (memErr) {
    console.error("[notify-cancel-requested] DB error:", memErr.message);
    return json({ ok: true, skipped: "db_error" });
  }
  if (!mem) {
    console.warn("[notify-cancel-requested] membership not found:", membership_id);
    return json({ ok: true, skipped: "not_found" });
  }

  const fam = mem.families as unknown as { parent_email: string; parent_first_name: string };

  const parentEmail    = fam.parent_email;
  const parentFirst    = fam.parent_first_name ?? "there";
  const planName       = mem.plan_name ?? "your membership";
  const requestedDate  = formatDate(mem.cancel_requested_at as string | null);
  const effectiveDate  = formatDate(mem.cancel_effective_at as string | null);

  const html = `
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><meta charset="utf-8"></head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f4f4f5;font-family:sans-serif;">
  <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="background:#f4f4f5;padding:32px 0;">
    <tr><td align="center">
      <table width="560" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"
        style="background:#1a1a1a;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;max-width:560px;width:100%;">
        <tr>
          <td style="background:#cfab56;padding:20px 28px;">
            <span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#1a1a1a;letter-spacing:0.5px;">
              ⚾ Ballpark
            </span>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="padding:28px 28px 0;">
            <p style="margin:0 0 16px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#f5f0e8;">
              Hi ${parentFirst},
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0 0 16px;font-size:14px;color:#a0967e;line-height:1.6;">
              We've received your cancellation request for <strong style="color:#f5f0e8;">${planName}</strong>.
            </p>
            <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"
              style="background:#252525;border-radius:8px;margin:0 0 20px;">
              <tr>
                <td style="padding:16px 18px;">
                  <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
                    <tr>
                      <td style="font-size:12px;color:#6b6354;padding-bottom:8px;">REQUESTED ON</td>
                      <td align="right" style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#f5f0e8;padding-bottom:8px;">${requestedDate}</td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                      <td style="font-size:12px;color:#6b6354;">ACCESS ENDS</td>
                      <td align="right" style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#cfab56;">${effectiveDate}</td>
                    </tr>
                  </table>
                </td>
              </tr>
            </table>
            <p style="margin:0 0 16px;font-size:13px;color:#a0967e;line-height:1.6;">
              Your athlete will continue to have full access to all booked sessions and
              facilities until <strong style="color:#f5f0e8;">${effectiveDate}</strong>.
              No further billing charges will occur after that date.
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0 0 28px;font-size:13px;color:#a0967e;line-height:1.6;">
              If you change your mind before then, contact the facility and we can pause
              or reinstate your membership.
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="padding:0 28px 28px;">
            <p style="margin:0;font-size:11px;color:#4a4438;">
              This is a confirmation of your cancellation request. No action is required.
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </table>
    </td></tr>
  </table>
</body>
</html>`;

  await sendResendEmail({
    to: parentEmail,
    subject: `Your ${planName} cancellation is confirmed — access ends ${effectiveDate}`,
    html,
  });

  console.log(`[notify-cancel-requested] email sent to ${parentEmail} for membership ${membership_id}`);
  return json({ ok: true });

FILE: supabase/functions/notify-leaderboard-weekly/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/notify-leaderboard-weekly/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// v0.7 task #122 — weekly Top-10 leaderboard fan-out.
//
// Designed to be invoked once a week (operator script or pg_cron). For
// every tenant: ranks kids by points_balance, takes the top 10, and
// pushes a "you made the Top 10!" notification to each of those parents.
// Also grants the `top_10_leaderboard` achievement so the badge appears
// in Profile.
//
// Auth: service-role bearer (same convention as send-push-notification).
// Idempotency: the achievement-grant is ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. The push
// itself is gated by `public.notification_log` keyed
// (tenant_id, kid_id, event_type='leaderboard_top_10', period_key=ISO week)
// — we INSERT the log row first; on UNIQUE collision we skip the push.
// So re-invoking this function any number of times within the same ISO
// week never sends a duplicate "Top 10" push to a parent.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

function jsonError(status: number, code: string, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }
  const auth = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? "";
  if (!auth.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ") ||
      auth.slice(7).trim() !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Service role required");
  }

  // Pull every tenant id, then iterate.
  const { data: tenants, error: tErr } = await adminClient
    .from("tenants")
    .select("id");
  if (tErr) {
    console.error("notify-leaderboard-weekly tenants fetch failed", tErr);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", tErr.message);
  }

  const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
  // ISO week (e.g. "2026-W19") — stable inside a calendar week regardless
  // of the exact moment within that week the cron fires.
  const periodKey = isoWeekKey(new Date());
  const EVENT_TYPE = "leaderboard_top_10";
  let pushed = 0;

  for (const tenant of tenants ?? []) {
    const { data: kids } = await adminClient
      .from("kids")
      .select("id, first_name, family_id, points_balance, families!inner(tenant_id, parent_user_id)")
      .eq("families.tenant_id", tenant.id)
      .order("points_balance", { ascending: false })
      .limit(50);

    if (!kids || kids.length === 0) continue;

    // Reconstruct points-as-of-7-days-ago for the dedupe gate.
    const { data: ledger } = await adminClient
      .from("points_ledger")
      .select("kid_id, delta")
      .eq("tenant_id", tenant.id)
      .gte("created_at", sevenDaysAgo);
    const recentDeltas = new Map<string, number>();
    (ledger ?? []).forEach((row) => {
      recentDeltas.set(
        row.kid_id,
        (recentDeltas.get(row.kid_id) ?? 0) + row.delta,
      );
    });
    const oldRanks = [...kids]
      .map((k) => ({ id: k.id, points: k.points_balance - (recentDeltas.get(k.id) ?? 0) }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.points - a.points)
      .map((k, i) => ({ id: k.id, rank: i + 1 }));
    const oldTop10 = new Set(oldRanks.filter((r) => r.rank <= 10).map((r) => r.id));

    const top10 = kids.slice(0, 10);
    for (const kid of top10) {
      // Grant the badge (idempotent).
      await adminClient.rpc("_grant_achievement" as never, {
        p_kid_id: kid.id,
        p_key: "top_10_leaderboard",
      } as never).catch((err: unknown) => {
        console.error("notify-leaderboard-weekly grant failed", err);
      });

      // Don't re-push parents who were already in the top 10 last week.
      if (oldTop10.has(kid.id)) continue;

      const families = (kid as { families?: { parent_user_id?: string } | null }).families;
      const parentUserId = families?.parent_user_id ?? null;
      if (!parentUserId) continue;

      // Durable dedupe: try to insert a notification_log row. UNIQUE
      // (tenant_id, kid_id, event_type, period_key) means re-runs in
      // the same ISO week collide and we skip the push.
      const { error: logErr } = await adminClient
        .from("notification_log")
        .insert({
          tenant_id: tenant.id,
          kid_id: kid.id,
          user_id: parentUserId,
          event_type: EVENT_TYPE,
          period_key: periodKey,
        });
      if (logErr) {
        // 23505 = unique_violation -> already pushed this week. Anything
        // else is unexpected; log and skip so we don't risk a duplicate.
        if ((logErr as { code?: string }).code !== "23505") {
          console.error("notify-leaderboard-weekly log insert failed", logErr);
        }
        continue;
      }

      const r = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          user_ids: [parentUserId],
          title: `${(kid as { first_name?: string }).first_name ?? "Your athlete"} cracked the Top 10!`,
          body: "Open Ballpark to see this week's leaderboard.",
          data: { kind: "leaderboard_top_10", tenant_id: tenant.id, kid_id: kid.id },
        }),
      }).catch((err) => {
        console.error("notify-leaderboard-weekly push fetch failed", err);
        return null;
      });
      if (r?.ok) pushed += 1;
    }
  }

  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, pushed, period_key: periodKey }), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
});

// ISO week of date as "YYYY-Www" (matches Postgres to_char(d,'IYYY-"W"IW')).
function isoWeekKey(d: Date): string {
  const t = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), d.getUTCDate()));
  const day = t.getUTCDay() || 7;
  t.setUTCDate(t.getUTCDate() + 4 - day);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(t.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
  const weekNo = Math.ceil(((t.getTime() - yearStart.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1) / 7);
  return `${t.getUTCFullYear()}-W${String(weekNo).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

const RESEND_API_KEY           = Deno.env.get("RESEND_API_KEY") ?? "";

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {

    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });

function formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  const months = ["January","February","March","April","May","June",
                  "July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  const hh = d.getUTCHours().toString().padStart(2, "0");
  const mm = d.getUTCMinutes().toString().padStart(2, "0");
  return `${months[d.getUTCMonth()]} ${d.getUTCDate()}, ${d.getUTCFullYear()} at ${hh}:${mm} UTC`;
}

// Convert newlines in waiver body text to <br> tags for HTML rendering
function textToHtml(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/\n\n/g, "</p><p style=\"margin:0 0 12px;font-size:12px;color:#a0967e;line-height:1.7;\">")
    .replace(/\n/g, "<br>");
}

async function sendResendEmail(opts: {

  subject: string;
  html: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) {
    console.warn("[notify-waiver-signed] RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping email");
    return;

  const res = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
      to: [opts.to],
      subject: opts.subject,
      html: opts.html,
    }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const body = await res.text().catch(() => "");
    console.error(`[notify-waiver-signed] Resend error ${res.status}: ${body.slice(0, 300)}`);
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/pause-membership/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #240 — Membership pause flow
//
// Auth model: Supabase JWT required. Accepts parent OR owner/admin role.
//   - parent: can only pause their own family's membership.
//   - owner/admin: can pause any membership in their tenant.
//
// Authorization is enforced inside the pause_membership() SECURITY DEFINER RPC,
// which derives identity from auth.jwt() / auth.uid() — no caller-supplied role params.
//
// Flow (all validations happen BEFORE Stripe to prevent billing state divergence):
//   1. Verify JWT and extract role
//   2. Load membership + validate scope/business rules in pre-flight queries
//   3. Check family-level overlap (before Stripe)
//   4. Call Stripe pause_collection[behavior]=void
//   5. Call pause_membership() RPC to atomically update DB
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy pause-membership
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';
const RESEND_API_KEY     = Deno.env.get('RESEND_API_KEY') ?? '';
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL  = Deno.env.get('RESEND_FROM_EMAIL') ?? 'onboarding@resend.dev';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' },
  });
}

function encodeFormBody(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    const key = prefix ? `${prefix}[${k}]` : k;
    if (typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) {
      const nested = encodeFormBody(v as Record<string, unknown>, key);
      if (nested) parts.push(nested);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
    }
  }
  return parts.join('&');
}

async function stripePost(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: encodeFormBody(body),
  });
  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

function formatDateLong(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00');
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  const months = ['January','February','March','April','May','June',
                  'July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

const ERROR_MAP: Record<string, { message: string; status: number }> = {
  unauthorized:          { message: 'Authentication required',                                          status: 401 },
  forbidden:             { message: 'Access denied',                                                    status: 403 },
  not_found:             { message: 'Membership not found',                                             status: 404 },
  already_paused:        { message: 'This membership is already paused',                                status: 409 },
  family_already_paused: { message: 'Another membership in this family is already paused',             status: 409 },
  not_active:            { message: 'Only active memberships can be paused',                            status: 422 },
  not_eft:               { message: 'Only EFT recurring memberships can be paused',                    status: 422 },
  pause_too_short:       { message: 'Pause end must be at least 7 days from today',                    status: 422 },
  pause_too_long:        { message: 'Pause end cannot be more than 90 days from today',                status: 422 },
};

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const stripeKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');
  if (!stripeKey) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Stripe not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey  = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const anonKey     = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!;

  // ── Verify JWT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const authHeader  = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!callerToken) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Missing Authorization header' } }, 401);
  }

  const callerClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${callerToken}` } },
  });
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Invalid token' } }, 401);
  }

  const userRole = (user.app_metadata?.app_role as string | undefined)
    ?? (user.user_metadata?.app_role as string | undefined) ?? '';

  // Accept any authenticated user. If the role claim is absent (Custom Access
  // Token Hook not running in this environment), we fall back to treating the
  // caller as a parent and enforce ownership via fam.parent_user_id below.
  // Owner/admin callers still require an explicit role claim.

  // ── Parse body ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let body: { membership_id?: string; pause_end?: string };
  try { body = await req.json(); } catch {
    return json({ error: { code: 'bad_json', message: 'Invalid request body' } }, 400);
  }

  const { membership_id, pause_end } = body;
  if (!membership_id || !pause_end) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'missing_param', message: 'membership_id and pause_end required' } }, 422);
  }

  const pauseEndDate = new Date(pause_end);
  if (isNaN(pauseEndDate.getTime())) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'invalid_date', message: 'pause_end must be YYYY-MM-DD' } }, 422);
  }

  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const diffDays = Math.round((pauseEndDate.getTime() - today.getTime()) / 86_400_000);
  // Use 6 days (not 7) to allow 1 day of timezone buffer: clients in UTC-N
  // send "7 days from local today" which can appear as 6 days on the UTC server.
  if (diffDays < 6) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'pause_too_short', message: 'Pause end must be at least 7 days from today' } }, 422);
  }
  if (diffDays > 91) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'pause_too_long', message: 'Pause end cannot be more than 90 days from today' } }, 422);
  }

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // ── Pre-flight: load membership (service-role, for Stripe details) ────────
  const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, plan_name, plan_type, status, stripe_subscription_id, tenant_id, family_id,
      families!inner(id, parent_user_id, parent_email, parent_first_name, primary_location_id)
    `)
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .single();

  if (memErr || !mem) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_found', message: 'Membership not found' } }, 404);
  }

  // ── Pre-flight scope check (mirrors RPC check) ────────────────────────────
  const fam = mem.families as unknown as { id: string; parent_user_id: string; parent_email: string; parent_first_name: string; primary_location_id: string };
  // The Custom Access Token Hook injects tenant_id into the JWT payload only —
  // NOT into raw_app_meta_data. Decode the token directly; fall back to
  // app_metadata for environments where the hook is absent.
  const callerTenant: string | null = (() => {
    try {
      const parts = callerToken.split('.');
      if (parts.length < 2) return null;
      const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
      const payload = JSON.parse(atob(b64)) as Record<string, unknown>;
      return (payload.tenant_id as string | undefined)
        ?? (user.app_metadata?.tenant_id as string | undefined)
        ?? null;
    } catch {
      return (user.app_metadata?.tenant_id as string | undefined) ?? null;
    }
  })();

  const isOwnerAdmin = ['owner', 'admin'].includes(userRole);
  if (isOwnerAdmin) {
    if (!callerTenant || mem.tenant_id !== callerTenant) {
      return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Access denied — tenant mismatch' } }, 403);
    }
  } else {
    // parent or unauthenticated-role-claim: verify family ownership
    if (fam.parent_user_id !== user.id) {
      return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Access denied' } }, 403);
    }
  }

  // ── Pre-flight business rule checks (BEFORE Stripe) ──────────────────────
  if (mem.plan_type !== 'eft') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_eft', message: 'Only EFT recurring memberships can be paused' } }, 422);
  }
  if (mem.status === 'paused') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'already_paused', message: 'This membership is already paused' } }, 409);
  }
  if (mem.status !== 'active') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_active', message: 'Only active memberships can be paused' } }, 422);
  }
  // ── Pre-flight family-level overlap check (BEFORE Stripe) ────────────────
  const { data: familyPaused } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select('id')
    .eq('family_id', mem.family_id)
    .neq('id', membership_id)
    .eq('status', 'paused')
    .gte('pause_end', today.toISOString().slice(0, 10))
    .limit(1);

  if (familyPaused && familyPaused.length > 0) {
    return json({
      error: {
        code: 'family_already_paused',
        message: 'Another membership in this family is already paused for an overlapping period',
      },
    }, 409);
  }

  // ── Resolve Stripe connected account ──────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: location } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('stripe_account_id')
    .eq('id', fam.primary_location_id)
    .single();

  const connectedAccountId = location?.stripe_account_id as string | null;

  // ── Pause Stripe subscription (only when one is linked) ──────────────────
  const pauseEndStr    = pause_end.slice(0, 10);

  if (mem.stripe_subscription_id) {
    const resumesAtEpoch = Math.floor(pauseEndDate.getTime() / 1000);
    try {
      await stripePost(
        `subscriptions/${mem.stripe_subscription_id as string}`,
        stripeKey,
        {
          'pause_collection[behavior]': 'void',
          'pause_collection[resumes_at]': resumesAtEpoch,
        },
        connectedAccountId ?? undefined,
      );
    } catch (stripeErr) {
      const msg = stripeErr instanceof Error ? stripeErr.message : 'Unknown Stripe error';
      console.error(`[pause-membership] Stripe error: ${msg}`);
      return json({ error: { code: 'stripe_error', message: msg } }, 502);
    }
  } else {
    console.log(`[pause-membership] no stripe_subscription_id — skipping Stripe, updating DB only`);
  }

  // ── Update DB via SECURITY DEFINER RPC (JWT-derived auth inside RPC) ─────
  // The RPC re-derives auth from the caller's JWT, so we pass it the caller token.
  // This keeps the DB write atomic with a server-side ownership/scope re-check.
  const { data: rpcResult, error: rpcErr } = await callerClient.rpc('pause_membership', {
    p_membership_id: membership_id,
    p_pause_end:     pauseEndStr,
  });

  if (rpcErr) {
    console.error(`[pause-membership] RPC error: ${rpcErr.message}`);
    // Stripe was paused but DB failed — log prominently; operator must reconcile.
    return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: 'Stripe paused but DB update failed — contact support' } }, 500);
  }

  const result = rpcResult as { ok: boolean; code?: string; pause_start?: string; pause_end?: string };
  if (!result.ok) {
    console.error(`[pause-membership] RPC rejected: ${result.code}`);
    const mapped = result.code ? ERROR_MAP[result.code] : undefined;
    return json(
      { error: { code: result.code ?? 'rpc_error', message: mapped?.message ?? 'DB update rejected' } },
      mapped?.status ?? 500,
    );
  }

  console.log(`[pause-membership] paused membership=${membership_id} pause_end=${pauseEndStr}`);

  // Best-effort: email + push notification to parent
  const pauseStartStr = result.pause_start ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const resolvedPauseEnd = result.pause_end ?? pauseEndStr;
  const planName = mem.plan_name as string ?? 'your membership';

  Promise.allSettled([
    sendPauseEmail(fam.parent_email, fam.parent_first_name ?? 'there', planName, pauseStartStr, resolvedPauseEnd),
    fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        user_ids: [fam.parent_user_id],
        title: '⏸ Membership Paused',
        body: `Your ${planName} is paused until ${formatDateLong(resolvedPauseEnd)}.`,
        data: { kind: 'membership_paused', membership_id },
      }),
    }),
  ]).then(results => {
    for (const r of results) {
      if (r.status === 'rejected') console.error('[pause-membership] notification error:', r.reason);
    }
  });

  return json({ ok: true, pause_start: result.pause_start, pause_end: result.pause_end });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/process-membership-cancellations/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/process-membership-cancellations/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #238 — Cancellation Policy Enforcement
// Task #519 — Wire up cancellation cron (improved logging)
//
// Daily cron (scheduled via pg_cron 0 2 * * *) that finalises memberships
// whose cancel_effective_at <= NOW():
//   1. Cancels the Stripe subscription immediately (not at period end — it
//      already reached the effective date the parent was shown).
//   2. Sets memberships.status = 'cancelled' and memberships.cancelled_at = now().
//
// Safe to invoke manually for testing:
//   curl -X POST https://<project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/process-membership-cancellations \
//     -H "Authorization: Bearer <service_role_key>"
//
// Returns HTTP 200 with { processed: N, cancelled: N, errors: [...] }
//
// Deploy:
//   npx supabase functions deploy process-membership-cancellations
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION  = '2024-06-20';
const RESEND_API_KEY      = Deno.env.get('RESEND_API_KEY') ?? '';
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL   = Deno.env.get('RESEND_FROM_EMAIL') ?? 'onboarding@resend.dev';
const SUPABASE_URL_ENV    = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL') ?? '';
const SERVICE_ROLE_KEY    = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY') ?? '';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    },
  });
}

function encodeFormBody(obj: Record<string, string | boolean | number>): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
  }
  return parts.join('&');
}

function formatDateLong(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
  const months = ['January','February','March','April','May','June',
                  'July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

async function sendCancellationEffectiveEmail(
  parentEmail: string,
  parentFirst: string,
  planName: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) return;
  const today = formatDateLong(new Date().toISOString());
  const html = `
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"></head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f4f4f5;font-family:sans-serif;">
  <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="background:#f4f4f5;padding:32px 0;">
    <tr><td align="center">
      <table width="560" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"
        style="background:#1a1a1a;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;max-width:560px;width:100%;">
        <tr>
          <td style="background:#cfab56;padding:20px 28px;">
            <span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#1a1a1a;">⚾ Ballpark</span>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="padding:28px;">
            <p style="margin:0 0 14px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#f5f0e8;">Hi ${parentFirst},</p>
            <p style="margin:0 0 14px;font-size:14px;color:#a0967e;line-height:1.6;">
              Your <strong style="color:#f5f0e8;">${planName}</strong> membership has been cancelled
              as of <strong style="color:#f5f0e8;">${today}</strong>.
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0 0 14px;font-size:13px;color:#a0967e;line-height:1.6;">
              No further billing charges will occur. We hope to see your athlete
              back on the field soon — reach out to the facility any time to re-enroll.
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0;font-size:11px;color:#4a4438;">
              This is an automated confirmation. No action is required.
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </table>
    </td></tr>
  </table>
</body></html>`;

  const res = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
      to: [parentEmail],
      subject: `Your ${planName} membership has been cancelled`,
      html,
    }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const txt = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    console.error(`[process-membership-cancellations] Resend error ${res.status}: ${txt.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
}

async function stripeDel(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  stripeAccountId?: string | null,
): Promise<{ id: string; status: string }> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers,
    body: encodeFormBody({}),
  });

  if (res.status === 404) {
    // Already gone — treat as success
    return { id: path.split('/').pop() ?? '', status: 'canceled' };
  }

  const data = await res.json() as { id?: string; status?: string; error?: { message?: string } };
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(data.error?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return { id: data.id ?? '', status: data.status ?? 'canceled' };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: 'POST only' }, 405);
  }

  const stripeKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');
  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // Load all memberships that are due for cancellation
  const { data: memberships, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, tenant_id, stripe_subscription_id, cancel_effective_at, plan_name,
      families!inner(id, primary_location_id, parent_email, parent_first_name)
    `)
    .not('cancel_effective_at', 'is', null)
    .lte('cancel_effective_at', new Date().toISOString())
    .neq('status', 'cancelled');

  if (fetchErr) {
    console.error('[process-membership-cancellations] fetch error:', fetchErr.message);
    return json({ error: fetchErr.message }, 500);
  }

  if (!memberships || memberships.length === 0) {
    console.log('[process-membership-cancellations] no eligible memberships — done');
    return json({ processed: 0, cancelled: 0, errors: [] });
  }

  console.log(`[process-membership-cancellations] processing ${memberships.length} membership(s)`);

  let cancelled = 0;
  const errors: { id: string; error: string }[] = [];

  for (const mem of memberships) {
    try {
      let stripeAccountId: string | null = null;
      const fam = mem.families as unknown as { id: string; primary_location_id: string; parent_email: string; parent_first_name: string };

      if (mem.stripe_subscription_id && stripeKey) {
        // Resolve connected Stripe account for this location
        if (fam?.primary_location_id) {
          const { data: loc } = await supabase
            .from('locations')
            .select('stripe_account_id')
            .eq('id', fam.primary_location_id)
            .single();
          stripeAccountId = (loc?.stripe_account_id as string | null) ?? null;
        }

        // Cancel the Stripe subscription immediately
        await stripeDel(
          `subscriptions/${mem.stripe_subscription_id}`,
          stripeKey,
          stripeAccountId,
        );
        console.log(`[process-membership-cancellations] Stripe sub ${mem.stripe_subscription_id} cancelled`);
      } else if (!stripeKey) {
        console.warn(`[process-membership-cancellations] STRIPE_SECRET_KEY not set — skipping Stripe cancellation for ${mem.id}`);
      }

      // Update DB: mark cancelled
      const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
        .from('memberships')
        .update({
          status: 'cancelled',
          cancelled_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('id', mem.id)
        .eq('tenant_id', mem.tenant_id);

      if (updateErr) {
        console.error(`[process-membership-cancellations] DB update error for ${mem.id}:`, updateErr.message);
        errors.push({ id: mem.id, error: updateErr.message });
        continue;
      }

      cancelled++;
      console.log(`[process-membership-cancellations] membership ${mem.id} → cancelled`);
      // Best-effort cancellation-effective email to parent
      sendCancellationEffectiveEmail(fam.parent_email, fam.parent_first_name, mem.plan_name as string)
        .catch(e => console.error(`[process-membership-cancellations] email failed for ${mem.id}:`, (e as Error).message));
    } catch (err) {
      const e = err as Error;
      console.error(`[process-membership-cancellations] error for ${mem.id}:`, e.message);
      errors.push({ id: mem.id, error: e.message });
    }
  }

  const summary = {
    processed: memberships.length,
    cancelled,
    skipped: memberships.length - cancelled - errors.length,
    errors,
  };
  console.log('[process-membership-cancellations] run complete:', JSON.stringify(summary));
  return json(summary);
});

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/promote-waitlist/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Finds the first 'waiting' entry for a session slot and promotes it to
// 'notified', setting claim_deadline = NOW() + 2 hours, then sends an Expo
// push notification and Resend email to the family.
//
// Called by:
//   - DB trigger on bookings.status → cancelled/no_show
//   - expire_stale_waitlist_entries() pg_cron job (cascade to next in queue)
//   - Operator scripts (for manual testing)
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Headers: Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_ROLE_KEY>
//   Body: { session_slot_key: string; tenant_id: string }
//   Response 200: { promoted: number; waitlist_id?: string }
//   Errors: 401 unauthorized | 400 bad_request
//
// Auth: service-role only.
// Deploy: npx supabase functions deploy promote-waitlist
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const RESEND_API_KEY = Deno.env.get("RESEND_API_KEY") ?? "";
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL =
  Deno.env.get("RESEND_FROM_EMAIL") ?? "onboarding@resend.dev";

const CLAIM_WINDOW_HOURS = 2;
const RESEND_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

function jsonOk(body: Record<string, unknown>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function jsonError(status: number, code: string, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

function formatTime(iso: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
      hour: "numeric",
      minute: "2-digit",
      weekday: "short",
      month: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      hour12: true,
      timeZone: "America/New_York",
    }).format(new Date(iso));
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }

  const auth = req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? "";
  if (
    !auth.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ") ||
    auth.slice(7).trim() !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
  ) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Service role required");
  }

  let body: { session_slot_key?: string; tenant_id?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Invalid JSON");
  }

  const slotKey = typeof body.session_slot_key === "string" ? body.session_slot_key : "";
  const tenantId = typeof body.tenant_id === "string" ? body.tenant_id : "";

  if (!slotKey || !tenantId) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "session_slot_key + tenant_id required");
  }

  // Find first 'waiting' entry for this slot (ordered by position asc)
  const { data: entry, error: fetchErr } = await adminClient
    .from("booking_waitlist")
    .select(`
      id, tenant_id, session_slot_key, kid_id, family_id, coach_id,
      session_type_id, location_id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, position,
      families!inner(parent_user_id, contact_email),
      kids!inner(first_name),
      session_types!inner(name)
    `)
    .eq("session_slot_key", slotKey)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .eq("status", "waiting")
    .order("position", { ascending: true })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (fetchErr) {
    console.error("[promote-waitlist] fetch error:", fetchErr.message);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", fetchErr.message);
  }

  if (!entry) {
    // No one waiting — return 0 promotions (normal, not an error)
    return jsonOk({ promoted: 0 });
  }

  const claimDeadline = new Date(Date.now() + CLAIM_WINDOW_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();

  // Promote to notified
  const { error: updateErr } = await adminClient
    .from("booking_waitlist")
    .update({
      status: "notified",
      notified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      claim_deadline: claimDeadline,
    })
    .eq("id", entry.id)
    .eq("status", "waiting"); // idempotency guard

  if (updateErr) {
    console.error("[promote-waitlist] update error:", updateErr.message);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", updateErr.message);
  }

  // ── Resolve parent user_id + contact info ──────────────────────────────────
  const familyRow = entry.families as unknown as {
    parent_user_id: string;
    contact_email: string | null;
  } | null;
  const kidRow = entry.kids as unknown as { first_name: string } | null;
  const stRow = entry.session_types as unknown as { name: string } | null;

  const parentUserId = familyRow?.parent_user_id ?? null;
  const parentEmail = familyRow?.contact_email ?? null;
  const kidFirst = kidRow?.first_name ?? "Your athlete";
  const sessionName = stRow?.name ?? "session";
  const sessionTime = formatTime(entry.scheduled_start);

  // ── Best-effort: push + email ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const results = await Promise.allSettled([
    // Push
    parentUserId
      ? fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            user_ids: [parentUserId],
            title: "A spot opened up! 🎉",
            body: `${kidFirst} can claim a ${sessionName} — you have 2 hours.`,
            data: {
              kind: "waitlist_promoted",
              waitlist_id: entry.id,
              tenant_id: tenantId,
            },
          }),
        }).catch((e) => {
          console.error("[promote-waitlist] push failed:", e);
          return null;
        })
      : Promise.resolve(null),

    // Email
    parentEmail && RESEND_API_KEY
      ? (async () => {
          const emailHtml = `
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body style="font-family: sans-serif; background: #0e0e0e; color: #f5f5f5; padding: 32px;">
  <div style="max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto; background: #1a1a1a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #333;">
    <h2 style="color: #f1e5ad; margin-top: 0;">A spot opened up! 🎉</h2>
    <p>${escapeHtml(kidFirst)} is next on the waitlist for:</p>
    <p style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; color: #f1e5ad;">
      ${escapeHtml(sessionName)}<br>
      <span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; color: #aaa;">${escapeHtml(sessionTime)}</span>
    </p>
    <p>You have <strong style="color: #f1e5ad;">2 hours</strong> to claim this spot before it moves to the next family.</p>
    <p>Open the Ballpark app to claim your spot.</p>
    <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #666;">This notification was sent because your family is on the waitlist. If you no longer need the spot, you can leave the waitlist in the app.</p>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;

          const controller = new AbortController();
          const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), RESEND_TIMEOUT_MS);
          try {
            const r = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
              },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                from: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
                to: [parentEmail],
                subject: `Spot available! Claim ${sessionName} for ${kidFirst}`,
                html: emailHtml,
              }),
              signal: controller.signal,
            });
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            if (!r.ok) {
              console.error("[promote-waitlist] Resend error:", r.status, await r.text());
            }
          } catch (e) {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            console.error("[promote-waitlist] email fetch failed:", e);
          }
        })()
      : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);

  const pushOk = results[0].status === "fulfilled";
  const emailOk = results[1].status === "fulfilled";

  console.log(
    `[promote-waitlist] slot=${slotKey} promoted=1 id=${entry.id} push=${pushOk} email=${emailOk}`
  );

  return jsonOk({ promoted: 1, waitlist_id: entry.id });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/request-membership-upgrade/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/request-membership-upgrade/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #371 — Membership upgrade request
//
// Auth model: Supabase JWT required (parent role).
//   Validates the caller owns the membership, then:
//   1. Validates the requested plan is a valid upgrade (higher tier, same tenant)
//   2. Inserts a row into membership_upgrade_requests
//   3. Sends notification email to the tenant admin via Resend
//   Returns { ok: true }
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy request-membership-upgrade
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const RESEND_API_KEY = Deno.env.get('RESEND_API_KEY') ?? '';
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL =
  Deno.env.get('RESEND_FROM_EMAIL') ?? 'onboarding@resend.dev';
const RESEND_URL = 'https://api.resend.com/emails';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' },
  });
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const supabaseUrl  = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey   = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const anonKey      = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!;

  // ── Verify JWT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const authHeader  = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!callerToken) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Missing Authorization header' } }, 401);
  }

  const callerClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${callerToken}` } },
  });
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Invalid token' } }, 401);
  }

  // ── Parse body ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let body: { membership_id?: string; requested_plan_id?: string };
  try { body = await req.json(); } catch {
    return json({ error: { code: 'bad_json', message: 'Invalid request body' } }, 400);
  }

  const { membership_id, requested_plan_id } = body;
  if (!membership_id || !requested_plan_id) {
    return json({
      error: { code: 'missing_param', message: 'membership_id and requested_plan_id required' },
    }, 422);
  }

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // ── Load membership + verify caller owns it ───────────────────────────────
  const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, plan_name, plan_type, amount_cents, status, tenant_id, family_id,
      families!inner(id, parent_user_id)
    `)
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .single();

  if (memErr || !mem) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_found', message: 'Membership not found' } }, 404);
  }

  const fam = mem.families as unknown as { id: string; parent_user_id: string };
  if (fam.parent_user_id !== user.id) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Access denied' } }, 403);
  }

  if (mem.status !== 'active') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_active', message: 'Only active memberships can be upgraded' } }, 422);
  }

  // ── Validate requested plan ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: plan, error: planErr } = await supabase
    .from('membership_plans')
    .select('id, name, amount_cents, is_active, tenant_id')
    .eq('id', requested_plan_id)
    .single();

  if (planErr || !plan) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'plan_not_found', message: 'Plan not found' } }, 404);
  }

  if (plan.tenant_id !== mem.tenant_id) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Plan belongs to a different tenant' } }, 403);
  }
  if (!plan.is_active) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'plan_inactive', message: 'Plan is no longer available' } }, 422);
  }
  if (plan.amount_cents <= mem.amount_cents) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_upgrade', message: 'Requested plan is not a higher tier' } }, 422);
  }

  // ── Insert upgrade request ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { error: insertErr } = await supabase
    .from('membership_upgrade_requests')
    .insert({
      tenant_id:         mem.tenant_id,
      family_id:         fam.id,
      membership_id:     membership_id,
      requested_plan_id: requested_plan_id,
      status:            'pending',
    });

  if (insertErr) {
    console.error('[request-membership-upgrade] insert error:', insertErr.message);
    return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: 'Failed to save upgrade request' } }, 500);
  }

  // ── Load tenant contact email + parent name for email ─────────────────────
  const { data: tenant } = await supabase
    .from('tenants')
    .select('name, contact_email')
    .eq('id', mem.tenant_id)
    .single();

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('families')
    .select('first_name, last_name, email')
    .eq('id', fam.id)
    .single();

  const adminEmail    = tenant?.contact_email ?? RESEND_FROM_EMAIL;
  const tenantName    = tenant?.name ?? 'Your facility';
  const parentName    = profile ? `${profile.first_name} ${profile.last_name}` : 'A parent';
  const parentEmail   = profile?.email ?? '(email not on file)';
  const currentPlan   = mem.plan_name;
  const requestedPlan = plan.name;
  const requestedAmt  = `$${(plan.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}/mo`;

  // ── Send email to tenant admin ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (RESEND_API_KEY) {
    try {
      await fetch(RESEND_URL, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          from:    RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
          to:      [adminEmail],
          subject: `Membership upgrade request — ${parentName}`,
          html: `
<p>Hi ${tenantName} team,</p>
<p><strong>${parentName}</strong> (${parentEmail}) has submitted a membership upgrade request through the Ballpark app.</p>
<table cellpadding="8" cellspacing="0" style="border-collapse:collapse;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:14px;">
  <tr><td style="color:#666;padding-right:16px;">Current plan</td><td><strong>${currentPlan}</strong></td></tr>
  <tr><td style="color:#666;padding-right:16px;">Requested plan</td><td><strong>${requestedPlan}</strong> (${requestedAmt})</td></tr>
</table>
<p>Please reach out to the family to confirm availability and process the change in your billing system.</p>
<p style="color:#999;font-size:12px;">This request was generated automatically by the Ballpark app.</p>
          `.trim(),
        }),
      });
    } catch (emailErr) {
      console.error('[request-membership-upgrade] email error:', emailErr);
    }
  } else {
    console.warn('[request-membership-upgrade] RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping email');
  }

  console.log(
    `[request-membership-upgrade] membership=${membership_id} plan=${requested_plan_id} family=${fam.id}`,
  );

  return json({ ok: true });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/resume-membership/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/resume-membership/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #240 — Membership pause flow — manual early resume
//
// Auth model: Supabase JWT required. Accepts parent OR owner/admin role.
//   - parent: can only resume their own family's membership.
//   - owner/admin: can resume any membership in their tenant.
//
// Authorization is enforced inside the resume_membership() SECURITY DEFINER RPC,
// which derives identity from auth.jwt() / auth.uid() — no caller-supplied role params.
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy resume-membership
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' },
  });
}

async function stripeRemovePause(
  subscriptionId: string,
  secretKey: string,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  // Sending pause_collection= (empty string) removes the pause from the subscription.
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/${subscriptionId}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: 'pause_collection=',
  });
  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const stripeKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');
  if (!stripeKey) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Stripe not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey  = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const anonKey     = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!;

  // ── Verify JWT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const authHeader  = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!callerToken) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Missing Authorization header' } }, 401);
  }

  const callerClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${callerToken}` } },
  });
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Invalid token' } }, 401);
  }

  const userRole     = (user.app_metadata?.app_role as string | undefined)
    ?? (user.user_metadata?.app_role as string | undefined) ?? '';
  // The Custom Access Token Hook injects tenant_id into the JWT payload only —
  // NOT into raw_app_meta_data. Decode the token directly; fall back to
  // app_metadata for environments where the hook is absent.
  const callerTenant: string | null = (() => {
    try {
      const parts = callerToken.split('.');
      if (parts.length < 2) return null;
      const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
      const payload = JSON.parse(atob(b64)) as Record<string, unknown>;
      return (payload.tenant_id as string | undefined)
        ?? (user.app_metadata?.tenant_id as string | undefined)
        ?? null;
    } catch {
      return (user.app_metadata?.tenant_id as string | undefined) ?? null;
    }
  })();

  // Accept any authenticated user. If the role claim is absent (Custom Access
  // Token Hook not running in this environment), we fall back to treating the
  // caller as a parent and enforce ownership via fam.parent_user_id below.

  // ── Parse body ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let body: { membership_id?: string };
  try { body = await req.json(); } catch {
    return json({ error: { code: 'bad_json', message: 'Invalid request body' } }, 400);
  }

  const { membership_id } = body;
  if (!membership_id) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'missing_param', message: 'membership_id required' } }, 422);
  }

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // ── Pre-flight: load membership (service-role, for Stripe details) ────────
  const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, status, stripe_subscription_id, tenant_id, family_id,
      families!inner(id, parent_user_id, primary_location_id)
    `)
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .single();

  if (memErr || !mem) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_found', message: 'Membership not found' } }, 404);
  }

  // ── Pre-flight scope check (mirrors RPC check) ────────────────────────────
  const fam = mem.families as unknown as { id: string; parent_user_id: string; primary_location_id: string };

  const isOwnerAdmin = ['owner', 'admin'].includes(userRole);
  if (isOwnerAdmin) {
    if (!callerTenant || mem.tenant_id !== callerTenant) {
      return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Access denied — tenant mismatch' } }, 403);
    }
  } else {
    // parent or missing role claim: verify family ownership
    if (fam.parent_user_id !== user.id) {
      return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Access denied' } }, 403);
    }
  }

  if (mem.status !== 'paused') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_paused', message: 'Membership is not paused' } }, 409);
  }

  // ── Resolve Stripe connected account ──────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: location } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('stripe_account_id')
    .eq('id', fam.primary_location_id)
    .single();

  const connectedAccountId = location?.stripe_account_id as string | null;

  // ── Remove Stripe pause ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (mem.stripe_subscription_id) {
    try {
      await stripeRemovePause(
        mem.stripe_subscription_id as string,
        stripeKey,
        connectedAccountId ?? undefined,
      );
    } catch (stripeErr) {
      const msg = stripeErr instanceof Error ? stripeErr.message : 'Unknown Stripe error';
      console.error(`[resume-membership] Stripe error: ${msg}`);
      return json({ error: { code: 'stripe_error', message: msg } }, 502);
    }
  }

  // ── Update DB via SECURITY DEFINER RPC (JWT-derived auth inside RPC) ─────
  // The RPC re-derives auth from the caller's JWT token.
  const { data: rpcResult, error: rpcErr } = await callerClient.rpc('resume_membership', {
    p_membership_id: membership_id,
  });

  if (rpcErr) {
    console.error(`[resume-membership] RPC error: ${rpcErr.message}`);
    return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: 'Stripe resumed but DB update failed — contact support' } }, 500);
  }

  const result = rpcResult as { ok: boolean; code?: string };
  if (!result.ok) {
    console.error(`[resume-membership] RPC rejected: ${result.code}`);
    return json({ error: { code: result.code ?? 'rpc_error', message: 'DB update rejected' } }, 500);
  }

  console.log(`[resume-membership] resumed membership=${membership_id}`);

  return json({ ok: true });
});
