// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/resume-paused-memberships/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #240 — Membership pause flow — nightly auto-resume cron job
//
// Auth: service-role ONLY. The caller must supply the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
// as the Bearer token. Any other token is rejected immediately.
//
// This function uses a direct service-role DB update (not the resume_membership
// RPC, which requires an authenticated user JWT). The service-role client already
// bypasses RLS, and the token gate here provides the authorization boundary.
//
// pg_cron setup (run once in Supabase SQL editor after enabling pg_cron):
//   SELECT cron.schedule(
//     'resume-paused-memberships-daily',
//     '0 6 * * *',
//     $$
//     SELECT net.http_post(
//       url     := current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url')
//                  || '/functions/v1/resume-paused-memberships',
//       headers := jsonb_build_object(
//         'Content-Type', 'application/json',
//         'Authorization', 'Bearer '
//           || current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key')
//       ),
//       body    := '{}'::jsonb
//     );
//     $$
//   );
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy resume-paused-memberships
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';
const RESEND_API_KEY     = Deno.env.get('RESEND_API_KEY') ?? '';
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL  = Deno.env.get('RESEND_FROM_EMAIL') ?? 'onboarding@resend.dev';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' },
  });
}

function formatDateLong(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00');
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso;
  const months = ['January','February','March','April','May','June',
                  'July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

async function sendResumeEmail(
  parentEmail: string,
  parentFirst: string,
  planName: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) return;
  const today = formatDateLong(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  const html = `
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"></head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f4f4f5;font-family:sans-serif;">
  <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="background:#f4f4f5;padding:32px 0;">
    <tr><td align="center">
      <table width="560" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"
        style="background:#1a1a1a;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;max-width:560px;width:100%;">
        <tr>
          <td style="background:#cfab56;padding:20px 28px;">
            <span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#1a1a1a;">⚾ Ballpark</span>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="padding:28px;">
            <p style="margin:0 0 14px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#f5f0e8;">Hi ${parentFirst},</p>
            <p style="margin:0 0 14px;font-size:14px;color:#a0967e;line-height:1.6;">
              Great news — your <strong style="color:#f5f0e8;">${planName}</strong> has
              automatically resumed as of <strong style="color:#f5f0e8;">${today}</strong>.
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0 0 14px;font-size:13px;color:#a0967e;line-height:1.6;">
              Your regular billing cycle will restart on your next billing date.
              We're excited to have your athlete back!
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0;font-size:11px;color:#4a4438;">
              This is an automated confirmation. Contact the facility if you have any questions.
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </table>
    </td></tr>
  </table>
</body></html>`;

  const res = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
      to: [parentEmail],
      subject: `Your ${planName} has resumed`,
      html,
    }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const txt = await res.text().catch(() => '');
    console.error(`[resume-paused-memberships] Resend error ${res.status}: ${txt.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
}

async function stripeRemovePause(
  subscriptionId: string,
  secretKey: string,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/${subscriptionId}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: 'pause_collection=',
  });
  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey  = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;

  // ── Service-role gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // This function performs privileged multi-tenant operations.
  // Only the pg_cron job (which supplies the service-role key as Bearer) is permitted.
  const authHeader  = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!callerToken || callerToken !== serviceKey) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Service-role token required' } }, 401);
  }

  const stripeKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');
  if (!stripeKey) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Stripe not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  // Service-role client bypasses RLS — authorized by the token gate above.
  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // ── Find all overdue-paused memberships ───────────────────────────────────
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const { data: toResume, error: queryErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, plan_name, stripe_subscription_id,
      families!inner(primary_location_id, parent_email, parent_first_name, parent_user_id)
    `)
    .eq('status', 'paused')
    .lte('pause_end', todayStr);

  if (queryErr) {
    console.error(`[resume-paused-memberships] query error: ${queryErr.message}`);
    return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: queryErr.message } }, 500);
  }

  if (!toResume || toResume.length === 0) {
    console.log('[resume-paused-memberships] no memberships to resume — done');
    return json({ ok: true, processed: 0, resumed: 0, errors: [] });
  }

  console.log(`[resume-paused-memberships] found ${toResume.length} membership(s) to resume`);

  // ── Resolve connected account IDs in bulk ─────────────────────────────────
  const locationIds = [...new Set(
    toResume.map(m => (m.families as unknown as { primary_location_id: string }).primary_location_id),
  )];
  const { data: locations } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('id, stripe_account_id')
    .in('id', locationIds);

  const accountByLocation: Record<string, string | null> = {};
  for (const loc of (locations ?? [])) {
    accountByLocation[loc.id] = loc.stripe_account_id as string | null;
  }

  // ── Process each membership ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  let resumed = 0;
  const errors: string[] = [];

  for (const mem of toResume) {
    const fam = mem.families as unknown as { primary_location_id: string; parent_email: string; parent_first_name: string; parent_user_id: string };
    const connectedAccountId = accountByLocation[fam.primary_location_id] ?? undefined;

    try {
      // Remove Stripe pause
      if (mem.stripe_subscription_id) {
        await stripeRemovePause(
          mem.stripe_subscription_id as string,
          stripeKey,
          connectedAccountId,
        );
      }

      // Direct service-role DB update (does NOT use the resume_membership RPC,
      // which requires an authenticated user JWT for auth.jwt() derivation).
      // The authorization boundary is the service-role token gate at the top.
      const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
        .from('memberships')
        .update({
          status:      'active',
          pause_start: null,
          pause_end:   null,
          paused_at:   null,
          updated_at:  new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('id', mem.id)
        .eq('status', 'paused');  // Idempotency guard

      if (updateErr) {
        throw new Error(`DB update failed: ${updateErr.message}`);
      }

      resumed++;
      console.log(`[resume-paused-memberships] resumed membership=${mem.id}`);
      // Best-effort: email + push notification to parent
      const planName = mem.plan_name as string ?? 'your membership';
      Promise.allSettled([
        sendResumeEmail(fam.parent_email, fam.parent_first_name ?? 'there', planName),
        fam.parent_user_id ? fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            user_ids: [fam.parent_user_id],
            title: '▶ Membership Resumed',
            body: `Your ${planName} is now active again. Welcome back!`,
            data: { kind: 'membership_resumed', membership_id: mem.id },
          }),
        }) : Promise.resolve(),
      ]).then(results => {
        for (const r of results) {
          if (r.status === 'rejected') console.error(`[resume-paused-memberships] notification error for ${mem.id}:`, r.reason);
        }
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      console.error(`[resume-paused-memberships] failed membership=${mem.id}: ${msg}`);
      errors.push(`${mem.id}: ${msg}`);
    }
  }

  const summary = {
    ok: errors.length === 0,
    processed: toResume.length,
    resumed,
    skipped: toResume.length - resumed - errors.length,
    errors,
  };
  console.log('[resume-paused-memberships] run complete:', JSON.stringify(summary));
  return json(summary);
});

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/save-payment-method/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #233 — In-app payment method management
//
// Auth model: Standard Supabase JWT required (parent role).
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy save-payment-method
//
// Required Supabase secrets:
//   STRIPE_SECRET_KEY              (sk_live_... or sk_test_...)
//   SUPABASE_URL                   (auto-injected)
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY      (auto-injected)
//   SUPABASE_ANON_KEY              (auto-injected)
//
// Request body (JSON):
//   {} (empty — family and customer derived from JWT)
//
// Flow:
//   1. Authenticate caller JWT (parent only).
//   2. Load family + primary location → stripe_connected_customer_id.
//   3. List the customer's payment methods (type=card) on the connected account,
//      newest first (created desc).
//   4. Take the most recent card — this is the one just saved via PaymentSheet.
//   5. Set it as default on the customer (invoice_settings.default_payment_method).
//   6. Write the four shadow display columns to families.
//   7. Return the card details to the client for immediate UI update.
//
// Returns:
//   { card_brand, card_last4, card_exp_month, card_exp_year }
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    },
  });
}

function encodeFormBody(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    const key = prefix ? `${prefix}[${k}]` : k;
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      for (const item of v) {
        parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}[]=${encodeURIComponent(String(item))}`);
      }
    } else if (typeof v === 'object') {
      const nested = encodeFormBody(v as Record<string, unknown>, key);
      if (nested) parts.push(nested);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
    }
  }
  return parts.join('&');
}

async function stripePost(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: encodeFormBody(body),
  });

  const text = await res.text();
  let data: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`Stripe returned non-JSON (${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

async function stripeGet(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, { method: 'GET', headers });
  const text = await res.text();
  let data: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`Stripe returned non-JSON (${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }

  try {
    return await handleRequest(req);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error('[save-payment-method] unhandled error:', msg);
    return json({ error: { code: 'internal_error', message: msg } }, 500);
  }
});

async function handleRequest(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const stripeKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');
  if (!stripeKey) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Stripe not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const anonKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!;

  // Verify caller JWT
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!callerToken) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Missing Authorization header' } }, 401);
  }

  const callerClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${callerToken}` } },
  });
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Invalid token' } }, 401);
  }

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // Load family + primary location
  const { data: family, error: famErr } = await supabase
    .from('families')
    .select('id, primary_location_id, stripe_connected_customer_id, stripe_customer_id')
    .eq('parent_user_id', user.id)
    .single();

  if (famErr || !family) {
    console.error('[save-payment-method] family lookup failed:', famErr?.message, 'user_id:', user.id);
    return json({ error: { code: 'family_not_found', message: 'Family record not found' } }, 404);
  }

  // Load location to determine connected vs platform account
  const { data: location } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status')
    .eq('id', family.primary_location_id)
    .single();

  const useConnected = !!(
    location?.stripe_account_id &&
    location?.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected'
  );
  const connectedAccountId: string | undefined = useConnected
    ? (location!.stripe_account_id as string)
    : undefined;

  const familyAny = family as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  const customerId = useConnected
    ? (familyAny.stripe_connected_customer_id as string | null ?? null)
    : (familyAny.stripe_customer_id as string | null ?? null);

  if (!customerId) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'no_customer', message: 'No Stripe customer on file — complete the card setup first' } }, 422);
  }

  // List the customer's cards on the connected account, newest first
  const pmList = await stripeGet(
    `payment_methods?customer=${encodeURIComponent(customerId)}&type=card&limit=10`,
    stripeKey,
    connectedAccountId,
  );

  const pmData = pmList.data as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
  if (!pmData || pmData.length === 0) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'no_payment_method', message: 'No cards found for this customer' } }, 422);
  }

  // Sort by created desc (newest first) and take the first
  const sorted = [...pmData].sort((a, b) => (b.created as number) - (a.created as number));
  const pm = sorted[0];
  const pmId = pm.id as string;
  const card = pm.card as Record<string, unknown>;

  const cardBrand = (card.brand as string | undefined) ?? '';
  const cardLast4 = (card.last4 as string | undefined) ?? '';
  const cardExpMonth = (card.exp_month as number | undefined) ?? 0;
  const cardExpYear = (card.exp_year as number | undefined) ?? 0;

  // Normalize brand to title case (Stripe returns lowercase: "visa", "mastercard")
  const normalizedBrand = cardBrand.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + cardBrand.slice(1);

  // Set this card as the customer's default payment method
  await stripePost(`customers/${customerId}`, stripeKey, {
    'invoice_settings[default_payment_method]': pmId,
  }, connectedAccountId);

  // Update shadow columns on families
  const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
    .from('families')
    .update({
      card_last4: cardLast4,
      card_brand: normalizedBrand,
      card_exp_month: cardExpMonth,
      card_exp_year: cardExpYear,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq('id', family.id);

  // Optimistically clear payment_failed_at — the parent just updated their card,
  // so even before Stripe's next retry the banner should disappear. Stripe will
  // set it again if the retry also fails.
  const { error: clearErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .update({ payment_failed_at: null, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('family_id', family.id)
    .not('payment_failed_at', 'is', null);

  if (clearErr) {
    console.warn('[save-payment-method] payment_failed_at clear failed (non-fatal):', clearErr.message);
  }

  if (updateErr) {
    console.error('[save-payment-method] DB update failed:', updateErr.message);
    return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: 'Failed to save card info' } }, 500);
  }

  console.log(`[save-payment-method] family=${family.id} pm=${pmId} brand=${normalizedBrand} last4=${cardLast4}`);

  return json({
    card_brand: normalizedBrand,
    card_last4: cardLast4,
    card_exp_month: cardExpMonth,
    card_exp_year: cardExpYear,
  });
}

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/send-booking-reminders/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #234 — Automated booking reminders (24h + 2h before session).
//
// Called every 30 minutes by two pg_cron jobs registered in migration
// 20260601000006_booking_reminder_log.sql:
//   booking-reminder-24h  -> POST { reminder_type: "24h" }
//   booking-reminder-2h   -> POST { reminder_type: "2h" }
//
// Can also be invoked manually for ops/testing with reminder_type in either
// the query string or the JSON body (query string takes precedence):
//   curl -X POST \
//     -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" \
//     "https://<project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/send-booking-reminders?reminder_type=24h"
//   # or:
//   curl -X POST \
//     -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" \
//     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
//     -d '{"reminder_type":"24h"}' \
//     "https://<project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/send-booking-reminders"
//
// Auth model:
//   Service-role only. Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_ROLE_KEY> required.
//   Deployed with default JWT verification ON.
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Query param OR body field: reminder_type = "24h" | "2h"
//   Response 200: { ok: true, sent: number, skipped: number }
//   Errors: { error: { code, message } }
//
// Query windows:
//   24h: bookings with scheduled_start BETWEEN now()+23h AND now()+25h
//    2h: bookings with scheduled_start BETWEEN now()+1h  AND now()+3h
//
// Idempotency (atomic insert-first pattern):
//   For each eligible booking, we attempt to INSERT a row into
//   booking_reminder_log (booking_id, reminder_type) before sending any
//   notification. The INSERT uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. We check whether
//   the row was actually created (Supabase returns the inserted row on success
//   or null on conflict). Only if the INSERT succeeded do we fire push + email.
//   This means two concurrent invocations will race on the INSERT; exactly one
//   wins the unique constraint and sends; the other sees null and skips.
//   The log table is the final gate — the pre-check SELECT at the batch level
//   is an optimisation only, not the idempotency boundary.
//
// Delivery semantics (best-effort, consistent with other Edge Functions):
//   Push and email are fired via Promise.allSettled. One channel failing does
//   not block the other. The log row is written BEFORE delivery (see above),
//   so a partial delivery (e.g. push sent, email timeout) will NOT be retried
//   on the next cron tick — matching the existing pattern of
//   fanOutCoachVideoNotifications and notify-achievement. This is acceptable
//   because: (a) push and Resend are highly reliable, (b) retrying would
//   risk duplicate pushes, which is worse than a missed email.
//
// Timezone handling:
//   The session time is formatted in the booking's location timezone
//   (locations.timezone, defaulting to America/Chicago). Deno's Intl API
//   supports the full IANA tz database.
//
// Email template:
//   Kid name, session type, coach name, date/time in location tz, facility
//   address, and a one-tap cancellation deep link
//   (ballpark://book/cancel/{booking_id}).
//
// Push notification copy:
//   24h: "Reminder: {kid}'s {session_type} with Coach {coach} is tomorrow at {time}"
//    2h: "Heads up: {kid}'s session with Coach {coach} starts in 2 hours"
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const RESEND_API_KEY = Deno.env.get("RESEND_API_KEY") ?? "";
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL =
  Deno.env.get("RESEND_FROM_EMAIL") ?? "onboarding@resend.dev";

const RESEND_URL = "https://api.resend.com/emails";
const RESEND_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
const FN_BASE = `${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1`;

type ReminderType = "24h" | "2h";

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

function jsonError(status: number, code: string, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function jsonOk(body: Record<string, unknown>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

/**
 * Format a UTC ISO timestamp in the given IANA timezone for display.
 * e.g. "Thursday, Jan 9 at 3:00 PM"
 */
function formatSessionTime(
  isoString: string,
  timezone: string,
): { dateLabel: string; timeLabel: string; fullLabel: string } {
  const d = new Date(isoString);
  const tz = timezone || "America/Chicago";

  const datePart = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    weekday: "long",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    timeZone: tz,
  }).format(d);

  const timePart = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: true,
    timeZone: tz,
  }).format(d);

  return {
    dateLabel: datePart,
    timeLabel: timePart,
    fullLabel: `${datePart} at ${timePart}`,
  };
}

/**
 * Build the eligibility window for the given reminder type.
 * Returns [windowStart ISO, windowEnd ISO] in UTC.
 *
 * 24h window: bookings starting between 23h and 25h from now
 *  2h window: bookings starting between  1h and  3h from now
 */
function reminderWindow(type: ReminderType): [string, string] {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (type === "24h") {
    return [
      new Date(now + 23 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      new Date(now + 25 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
    ];
  }
  return [
    new Date(now + 1 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
    new Date(now + 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
  ];
}

/**
 * Build the location address string from available fields.
 */
function buildAddress(location: {
  address?: string | null;
  city?: string | null;
  state?: string | null;
  zip?: string | null;
}): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (location.address) parts.push(location.address);
  const cityState = [location.city, location.state].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
  if (cityState) parts.push(cityState);
  if (location.zip) parts.push(location.zip);
  return parts.join(", ") || "the facility";
}

/**
 * Send a push notification to all device tokens for a user.
 * Best-effort — failures are logged but never throw.
 */
async function sendPush(opts: {
  userIds: string[];
  title: string;
  body: string;
  data?: Record<string, string>;
}): Promise<void> {
  const r = await fetch(`${FN_BASE}/send-push-notification`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      user_ids: opts.userIds,
      title: opts.title,
      body: opts.body,
      data: opts.data ?? {},
    }),
  }).catch((err) => {
    console.error("send-booking-reminders push fetch_err", err);
    return null;
  });
  if (r && !r.ok) {
    const txt = await r.text().catch(() => "");
    console.error(
      `send-booking-reminders push status=${r.status} body=${txt.slice(0, 200)}`,
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Send a Resend email. Best-effort — failures are logged but never throw.
 */
async function sendEmail(opts: {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  html: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) {
    console.error("send-booking-reminders missing RESEND_API_KEY — skipping email");
    return;
  }

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), RESEND_TIMEOUT_MS);

  try {
    const r = await fetch(RESEND_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
        to: [opts.to],
        subject: opts.subject,
        html: opts.html,
      }),
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
    if (!r.ok) {
      try { await r.text(); } catch { /* swallow PII */ }
      console.error(`send-booking-reminders email resend_error status=${r.status}`);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
    if ((err as Error)?.name === "AbortError") {
      console.error("send-booking-reminders email resend_timeout");
    } else {
      console.error("send-booking-reminders email resend_unreachable", err);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Build the reminder email HTML.
 */
function buildEmailHtml(opts: {
  parentFirstName: string | null;
  kidFirstName: string;
  sessionTypeName: string;
  coachFirstName: string;
  fullTimeLabel: string;
  locationName: string;
  locationAddress: string;
  bookingId: string;
  reminderType: ReminderType;
}): string {
  const {
    parentFirstName,
    kidFirstName,
    sessionTypeName,
    coachFirstName,
    fullTimeLabel,
    locationName,
    locationAddress,
    bookingId,
    reminderType,
  } = opts;

  const greeting = reminderType === "24h"
    ? `${escapeHtml(kidFirstName)}'s session is tomorrow`
    : `${escapeHtml(kidFirstName)}'s session starts in 2 hours`;

  const cancelLink = `ballpark://book/cancel/${bookingId}`;

  return `
    <div style="font-family: -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; color: #111;">
      <h1 style="font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 12px;">&#9200; ${escapeHtml(greeting)}</h1>
      <p style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 16px;">
        Hi ${escapeHtml(parentFirstName ?? "there")},
      </p>
      <p style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 16px;">
        Just a reminder that <strong>${escapeHtml(kidFirstName)}</strong> has a
        <strong>${escapeHtml(sessionTypeName)}</strong> with
        <strong>Coach ${escapeHtml(coachFirstName)}</strong>
        on <strong>${escapeHtml(fullTimeLabel)}</strong>.
      </p>
      <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0 0 24px; background: #f9f9f9; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;">
        <tr>
          <td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: #666; width: 40%;">Location</td>
          <td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;">${escapeHtml(locationName)}</td>
        </tr>
        <tr style="border-top: 1px solid #eee;">
          <td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: #666;">Address</td>
          <td style="padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px;">${escapeHtml(locationAddress)}</td>
        </tr>
      </table>
      <p style="margin: 0 0 8px;">
        <a href="ballpark://"
           style="display: inline-block; background: #FF6A00; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600;">
          Open in Ballpark
        </a>
      </p>
      <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #999; margin: 16px 0 0;">
        Need to cancel?
        <a href="${escapeHtml(cancelLink)}" style="color: #999;">Tap here to cancel in the app.</a>
      </p>
    </div>
  `;
}

/**
 * Resolve reminder_type from query string (takes precedence) or JSON body.
 * Returns the type string or null if absent/invalid.
 */
async function resolveReminderType(
  req: Request,
): Promise<{ type: ReminderType | null; error?: string }> {
  // Query string takes precedence — allows bare POST with no body (cron style)
  // and also curl -X POST "...?reminder_type=24h" without Content-Type.
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const qp = url.searchParams.get("reminder_type");
  if (qp !== null) {
    if (qp === "24h" || qp === "2h") return { type: qp };
    return { type: null, error: `reminder_type query param must be '24h' or '2h', got '${qp}'` };
  }

  // Fall back to JSON body. Tolerate an empty body (cron jobs may omit it
  // when the param is in the query string).
  const contentLength = req.headers.get("content-length");
  const hasBody = contentLength !== "0" && contentLength !== null;
  if (!hasBody) {
    return { type: null, error: "reminder_type required (query param or JSON body)" };
  }

  let body: { reminder_type?: unknown };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return { type: null, error: "Body is not valid JSON" };
  }

  const rt = body.reminder_type;
  if (rt === "24h" || rt === "2h") return { type: rt };
  return { type: null, error: "reminder_type must be '24h' or '2h'" };
}

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }

  // ---- 1. Service-role auth check ------------------------------------------
  const authHeader =
    req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  if (token !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Service role required");
  }

  // ---- 2. Resolve reminder_type (query string takes precedence over body) ---
  const { type: reminderType, error: rtError } = await resolveReminderType(req);
  if (!reminderType) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", rtError ?? "reminder_type required");
  }

  // ---- 3. Query eligible bookings ------------------------------------------
  const [windowStart, windowEnd] = reminderWindow(reminderType);

  // Fetch confirmed bookings in the window with all data needed to build
  // notifications. Only status='confirmed' is returned — cancelled and
  // completed bookings are excluded by the eq filter.
  const { data: bookings, error: bookingsErr } = await adminClient
    .from("bookings")
    .select(
      `id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, tenant_id,
       kid:kids(id, first_name, family_id),
       coach:coaches(id, first_name),
       location:locations(id, name, timezone, address, city, state, zip),
       session_type:session_types(id, name)`,
    )
    .eq("status", "confirmed")
    .gte("scheduled_start", windowStart)
    .lte("scheduled_start", windowEnd);

  if (bookingsErr) {
    console.error("send-booking-reminders db_error fetching bookings", bookingsErr);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query bookings");
  }

  const eligible = bookings ?? [];
  if (eligible.length === 0) {
    console.log(
      `send-booking-reminders reminder_type=${reminderType} eligible=0 ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return jsonOk({ ok: true, sent: 0, skipped: 0 });
  }

  // ---- 4. Batch-optimisation: pre-filter bookings already in the log -------
  // This is NOT the idempotency gate (that's the atomic INSERT below).
  // It's an optimisation to skip the family-lookup and send calls when the
  // entire batch has already been processed — common on re-runs within the
  // same window. The real idempotency enforcement is per-booking at step 6.
  const bookingIds = eligible.map((b) => b.id);
  const { data: alreadySent, error: logErr } = await adminClient
    .from("booking_reminder_log")
    .select("booking_id")
    .in("booking_id", bookingIds)
    .eq("reminder_type", reminderType);

  if (logErr) {
    console.error("send-booking-reminders db_error fetching log", logErr);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query reminder log");
  }

  const sentSet = new Set((alreadySent ?? []).map((r) => r.booking_id as string));
  const toSend = eligible.filter((b) => !sentSet.has(b.id));

  if (toSend.length === 0) {
    console.log(
      `send-booking-reminders reminder_type=${reminderType} eligible=${eligible.length} already_sent=${eligible.length} to_send=0 ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return jsonOk({ ok: true, sent: 0, skipped: eligible.length });
  }

  // ---- 5. Gather family data for recipients ----------------------------------
  const familyIds: string[] = [];
  for (const b of toSend) {
    const kid = b.kid as { id: string; first_name: string; family_id: string } | null;
    if (kid?.family_id) familyIds.push(kid.family_id);
  }
  const uniqueFamilyIds = [...new Set(familyIds)];

  const { data: families, error: famErr } = await adminClient
    .from("families")
    .select("id, parent_user_id, parent_email, parent_first_name")
    .in("id", uniqueFamilyIds);

  if (famErr) {
    console.error("send-booking-reminders db_error fetching families", famErr);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to query families");
  }

  const familyMap = new Map<
    string,
    { parent_user_id: string; parent_email: string | null; parent_first_name: string | null }
  >();
  for (const f of families ?? []) {
    familyMap.set(f.id, {
      parent_user_id: f.parent_user_id,
      parent_email: f.parent_email,
      parent_first_name: f.parent_first_name,
    });
  }

  // ---- 6. Per-booking: atomic claim → send → done --------------------------
  // Idempotency pattern: INSERT log row FIRST (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING).
  // If the insert returns a row, we won the race and must send.
  // If it returns null (conflict), another process already sent — skip.
  // This prevents duplicate sends even when two cron ticks overlap.
  let sentCount = 0;
  let skippedCount = eligible.length - toSend.length;

  for (const booking of toSend) {
    const kid = booking.kid as { id: string; first_name: string; family_id: string } | null;
    const coach = booking.coach as { id: string; first_name: string } | null;
    const location = booking.location as {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      timezone: string;
      address: string | null;
      city: string | null;
      state: string | null;
      zip: string | null;
    } | null;
    const sessionType = booking.session_type as { id: string; name: string } | null;

    if (!kid || !location || !sessionType) {
      console.error(
        `send-booking-reminders booking_id=${booking.id} skipped=missing_relations`,
      );
      skippedCount++;
      continue;
    }

    const family = familyMap.get(kid.family_id);
    if (!family) {
      console.error(
        `send-booking-reminders booking_id=${booking.id} skipped=no_family`,
      );
      skippedCount++;
      continue;
    }

    // --- Atomic idempotency claim (INSERT before send) ----------------------
    // ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING — Supabase returns the inserted row on success
    // or an empty array on conflict. Zero rows = already claimed by another
    // concurrent run; skip.
    const { data: claimRows, error: claimErr } = await adminClient
      .from("booking_reminder_log")
      .insert({
        booking_id: booking.id,
        reminder_type: reminderType,
        sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .select("id")
      .returns<{ id: string }[]>();

    if (claimErr) {
      // Error code 23505 = unique_violation — another process beat us to it.
      if (claimErr.code === "23505") {
        console.log(
          `send-booking-reminders reminder_type=${reminderType} booking_id=${booking.id} skipped=race_conflict`,
        );
        skippedCount++;
        continue;
      }
      // Unexpected DB error — log it and skip this booking rather than
      // crashing the entire batch.
      console.error(
        `send-booking-reminders log_claim_err booking_id=${booking.id}`,
        claimErr,
      );
      skippedCount++;
      continue;
    }

    if (!claimRows || claimRows.length === 0) {
      // ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING returned 0 rows — already sent.
      console.log(
        `send-booking-reminders reminder_type=${reminderType} booking_id=${booking.id} skipped=already_sent`,
      );
      skippedCount++;
      continue;
    }

    // --- We hold the claim — now send push + email --------------------------
    const kidFirst = kid.first_name;
    const coachFirst = coach?.first_name ?? "your coach";
    const { fullLabel: fullTimeLabel, timeLabel } = formatSessionTime(
      booking.scheduled_start,
      location.timezone,
    );

    const pushTitle =
      reminderType === "24h"
        ? `Reminder: ${kidFirst}'s ${sessionType.name} with Coach ${coachFirst} is tomorrow at ${timeLabel}`
        : `Heads up: ${kidFirst}'s session with Coach ${coachFirst} starts in 2 hours`;
    const pushBody =
      reminderType === "24h"
        ? `See you at ${location.name} on ${fullTimeLabel}.`
        : `Head to ${location.name} — see you soon!`;

    const emailHtml = buildEmailHtml({
      parentFirstName: family.parent_first_name,
      kidFirstName: kidFirst,
      sessionTypeName: sessionType.name,
      coachFirstName: coachFirst,
      fullTimeLabel,
      locationName: location.name,
      locationAddress: buildAddress(location),
      bookingId: booking.id,
      reminderType,
    });

    const subject =
      reminderType === "24h"
        ? `Reminder: ${kidFirst}'s ${sessionType.name} is tomorrow`
        : `${kidFirst}'s session starts in 2 hours`;

    // Best-effort: both channels are attempted regardless of individual
    // failures. The log row was already written above, so even a total
    // delivery failure will not trigger a re-send on the next cron tick.
    // This is consistent with the existing notification fan-out pattern
    // (fanOutCoachVideoNotifications, notify-achievement).
    await Promise.allSettled([
      sendPush({
        userIds: [family.parent_user_id],
        title: pushTitle,
        body: pushBody,
        data: {
          kind: "booking_reminder",
          booking_id: booking.id,
          reminder_type: reminderType,
        },
      }),
      family.parent_email
        ? sendEmail({ to: family.parent_email, subject, html: emailHtml })
        : Promise.resolve(),
    ]);

    sentCount++;
    console.log(
      `send-booking-reminders reminder_type=${reminderType} booking_id=${booking.id} kid=${kidFirst} sent=true`,
    );
  }

  console.log(
    `send-booking-reminders reminder_type=${reminderType} eligible=${eligible.length} sent=${sentCount} skipped=${skippedCount} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
  );
  return jsonOk({ ok: true, sent: sentCount, skipped: skippedCount });
});


=================================================================================
FILE: supabase/functions/send-coach-video-notification/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/send-coach-video-notification/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// v0.7 (task #93) — Resend email for "your coach sent your kid a video".
//
// Called from inside `mux-webhook` on `video.asset.ready` once the row's
// `purpose='coach_message'`. The push side is handled by
// `send-push-notification`; this function owns the email leg only.
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Headers:
//     Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_ROLE_KEY>   required
//   Body (JSON):
//     { video_id: string }
//   Response 200:
//     { ok: true, message_id?: string }            email sent (Resend id)
//     { ok: true, skipped: "not_a_coach_message" } purpose != 'coach_message'
//     { ok: true, skipped: "no_parent_email"     } family has no email on file
//   Errors:        { error: { code, message } }
//     401 unauthorized | 400 bad_request | 404 not_found
//     500 db_error
//     502 resend_error | resend_unreachable | resend_bad_response
//     504 resend_timeout
//
// Auth model:
//   Service-role only, deployed with the default JWT verification ON. The
//   webhook calls us with the service-role key in the Authorization header
//   (never the user's JWT — there is no user JWT inside mux-webhook).
//
// Failure model:
//   Mirrors mux-create-upload — structured errors, ~10s Resend timeout, no
//   secrets ever in logs (only video id, Resend message id, and status).
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
const RESEND_API_KEY = Deno.env.get("RESEND_API_KEY") ?? "";
const RESEND_FROM_EMAIL =
  Deno.env.get("RESEND_FROM_EMAIL") ?? "onboarding@resend.dev";

const RESEND_URL = "https://api.resend.com/emails";
const RESEND_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

type ErrorCode =
  | "method_not_allowed"
  | "unauthorized"
  | "forbidden"
  | "bad_request"
  | "not_found"
  | "db_error"
  | "resend_error"
  | "resend_unreachable"
  | "resend_bad_response"
  | "resend_timeout";

function jsonError(status: number, code: ErrorCode, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function jsonOk(body: Record<string, unknown>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }

  // ---- 1. Service-role auth check ----------------------------------------
  const authHeader =
    req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  if (token !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Service role required");
  }

  // ---- 2. Parse body ------------------------------------------------------
  let body: { video_id?: unknown };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Body is not valid JSON");
  }
  const videoId = typeof body.video_id === "string" ? body.video_id : "";
  if (!videoId) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "video_id is required");
  }

  // ---- 3. Look up the video + the coach_messages row that carries it -----
  // We need:
  //   - videos.purpose                                    (gate)
  //   - the coach (sender) display name                   -> coaches.first_name via sender_user_id
  //   - the recipient kid first name + family parent_email -> families
  // We resolve through coach_messages because that's the only place that
  // joins a video to a recipient family + kid.
  const { data: video, error: videoErr } = await adminClient
    .from("videos")
    .select("id, purpose, uploaded_by_user_id")
    .eq("id", videoId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (videoErr) {
    console.error("send-coach-video-notification db_error videos", videoErr);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to look up video");
  }
  if (!video) {
    return jsonError(404, "not_found", "Video not found");
  }
  if (video.purpose !== "coach_message") {
    console.log(
      `send-coach-video-notification video_id=${videoId} skipped=not_a_coach_message ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return jsonOk({ ok: true, skipped: "not_a_coach_message" });
  }

  // The latest message carrying this video id. In normal flow there's
  // exactly one (sendCoachMessage inserts once after upload).
  const { data: msg, error: msgErr } = await adminClient
    .from("coach_messages")
    .select(
      "id, recipient_family_id, recipient_kid_id, sender_user_id",
    )
    .eq("video_id", videoId)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (msgErr) {
    console.error("send-coach-video-notification db_error coach_messages", msgErr);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to look up coach message");
  }
  if (!msg) {
    // Video is ready but the coach hasn't actually sent it yet (no row in
    // coach_messages). Nothing to email about.
    console.log(
      `send-coach-video-notification video_id=${videoId} skipped=no_message ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return jsonOk({ ok: true, skipped: "no_message" });
  }

  const [familyRes, kidRes, coachRes] = await Promise.all([
    adminClient
      .from("families")
      .select("id, parent_email, parent_first_name, parent_user_id")
      .eq("id", msg.recipient_family_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    adminClient
      .from("kids")
      .select("id, first_name")
      .eq("id", msg.recipient_kid_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    adminClient
      .from("coaches")
      .select("first_name")
      .eq("user_id", msg.sender_user_id)
      .maybeSingle(),
  ]);

  if (familyRes.error || kidRes.error || coachRes.error) {
    console.error(
      "send-coach-video-notification db_error joins",
      familyRes.error ?? kidRes.error ?? coachRes.error,
    );
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to look up family/kid/coach");
  }

  const family = familyRes.data;
  const kid = kidRes.data;
  const coach = coachRes.data;
  if (!family || !kid) {
    return jsonError(404, "not_found", "Recipient family or kid not found");
  }
  if (!family.parent_email) {
    console.log(
      `send-coach-video-notification video_id=${videoId} skipped=no_parent_email ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return jsonOk({ ok: true, skipped: "no_parent_email" });
  }
  if (!RESEND_API_KEY) {
    console.error("send-coach-video-notification missing RESEND_API_KEY");
    return jsonError(502, "resend_error", "Resend not configured");
  }

  // ---- 4. Build + send the email -----------------------------------------
  const coachFirst = coach?.first_name ?? "Your coach";
  const kidFirst = kid.first_name;
  const subject = `Coach ${coachFirst} sent ${kidFirst} a new video`;
  // No per-message deep route exists yet — link to the app root so the OS
  // resolves the universal/custom-scheme link and opens Ballpark.
  // TODO: replace with a deep link to the specific message screen once
  // the parent inbox supports `ballpark://messages/<id>`.
  const deepLink = "ballpark://";

  const html = `
    <div style="font-family: -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; color: #111;">
      <h1 style="font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 12px;">New video from Coach ${escapeHtml(coachFirst)}</h1>
      <p style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 16px;">
        Hi ${escapeHtml(family.parent_first_name ?? "there")}, Coach ${escapeHtml(coachFirst)} just sent ${escapeHtml(kidFirst)} a new video in Ballpark.
      </p>
      <p style="margin: 0 0 24px;">
        <a href="${deepLink}"
           style="display: inline-block; background: #FF6A00; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600;">
          Open in Ballpark
        </a>
      </p>
      <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #666; margin: 0;">
        If the button doesn't work, open Ballpark on your phone — the video is on ${escapeHtml(kidFirst)}'s home screen.
      </p>
    </div>
  `;

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), RESEND_TIMEOUT_MS);

  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(RESEND_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${RESEND_API_KEY}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
        to: [family.parent_email],
        subject,
        html,
      }),
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
    if ((err as Error)?.name === "AbortError") {
      console.error(`send-coach-video-notification video_id=${videoId} resend_timeout`);
      return jsonError(504, "resend_timeout", "Resend request timed out");
    }
    console.error(`send-coach-video-notification video_id=${videoId} resend_unreachable`, err);
    return jsonError(502, "resend_unreachable", "Failed to reach Resend");
  }
  clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);

  if (!res.ok) {
    // Drain the body but DO NOT log it — Resend echoes recipient address
    // and other context on errors, which would leak PII into function logs.
    try { await res.text(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    console.error(
      `send-coach-video-notification video_id=${videoId} resend_error status=${res.status}`,
    );
    return jsonError(502, "resend_error", `Resend returned status ${res.status}`);
  }

  let messageId: string | undefined;
  try {
    const j = (await res.json()) as { id?: string };
    messageId = typeof j?.id === "string" ? j.id : undefined;
  } catch {
    console.error(`send-coach-video-notification video_id=${videoId} resend_bad_response`);
    return jsonError(502, "resend_bad_response", "Malformed Resend response");
  }

  console.log(
    `send-coach-video-notification video_id=${videoId} resend_id=${messageId ?? "?"} status=${res.status} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
  );
  return jsonOk({ ok: true, message_id: messageId });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/send-push-notification/index.ts
=================================================================================
// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/send-push-notification/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// v0.7 (task #93) — generic Expo push fan-out.
//
// Contract (POST):
//   Headers:
//     Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_ROLE_KEY>   required
//   Body (JSON):
//     {
//       user_ids: string[],
//       title:    string,
//       body:     string,
//       data?:    Record<string, unknown>
//     }
//   Response 200: { ok: true, tokens: number, batches: number, ok_count: number, err_count: number }
//   Errors:       { error: { code, message } }
//                   401 unauthorized
//                   400 bad_request
//                   500 db_error
//                   502 expo_error / expo_unreachable / expo_bad_response
//                   504 expo_timeout
//
// Auth model:
//   This function is service-role only. It never sees a user JWT. It is
//   deployed with the default JWT verification ON; callers (other Edge
//   Functions or operator scripts) must pass the service-role key in the
//   Authorization header. Never expose to the app.
//
// Failure model:
//   - Returns a structured error on misconfiguration / Expo unreachable.
//   - For partial Expo failures (e.g. one ticket out of N is an error),
//     logs and still returns 200 with err_count > 0 — the caller never
//     throws because of a single bad token.
//   - Receipt-handling / pruning is out of scope for this task; we only
//     send the push and log tickets.
// =============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;

const EXPO_PUSH_URL = "https://exp.host/--/api/v2/push/send";
const EXPO_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
const EXPO_BATCH_SIZE = 100; // Expo's documented per-request maximum.

type ErrorCode =
  | "method_not_allowed"
  | "unauthorized"
  | "bad_request"
  | "db_error"
  | "expo_error"
  | "expo_unreachable"
  | "expo_bad_response"
  | "expo_timeout";

function jsonError(status: number, code: ErrorCode, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function jsonOk(body: Record<string, unknown>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function chunk<T>(arr: T[], size: number): T[][] {
  const out: T[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) out.push(arr.slice(i, i + size));
  return out;
}

const adminClient = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

serve(async (req) => {
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonError(405, "method_not_allowed", "POST required");
  }

  // ---- 1. Service-role auth check ----------------------------------------
  // We don't decode the JWT here — equality with the configured service-role
  // key is enough, and matches the calling convention used by the other
  // Edge Functions when invoking each other.
  const authHeader =
    req.headers.get("Authorization") ?? req.headers.get("authorization");
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.toLowerCase().startsWith("bearer ")) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Missing or malformed Authorization header");
  }
  const token = authHeader.slice(7).trim();
  if (token !== SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
    return jsonError(401, "unauthorized", "Service role required");
  }

  // ---- 2. Parse body ------------------------------------------------------
  let body: {
    user_ids?: unknown;
    title?: unknown;
    body?: unknown;
    data?: unknown;
  };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "Body is not valid JSON");
  }

  const userIds = Array.isArray(body.user_ids)
    ? body.user_ids.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string")
    : [];
  const title = typeof body.title === "string" ? body.title : "";
  const msgBody = typeof body.body === "string" ? body.body : "";
  const data =
    body.data && typeof body.data === "object" && !Array.isArray(body.data)
      ? (body.data as Record<string, unknown>)
      : undefined;

  if (userIds.length === 0) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "user_ids must be a non-empty array of strings");
  }
  if (!title || !msgBody) {
    return jsonError(400, "bad_request", "title and body are required");
  }

  // ---- 3. Look up Expo tokens for these users -----------------------------
  const { data: rows, error: tokensErr } = await adminClient
    .from("device_tokens")
    .select("expo_push_token")
    .in("user_id", userIds);

  if (tokensErr) {
    console.error("send-push db_error", tokensErr);
    return jsonError(500, "db_error", "Failed to look up device tokens");
  }

  const tokens = Array.from(
    new Set(
      (rows ?? [])
        .map((r) => (r as { expo_push_token: string }).expo_push_token)
        .filter((t) => typeof t === "string" && t.length > 0),
    ),
  );

  if (tokens.length === 0) {
    console.log(
      `send-push user_ids=${userIds.length} tokens=0 batches=0 ok=0 err=0 ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
    );
    return jsonOk({ ok: true, tokens: 0, batches: 0, ok_count: 0, err_count: 0 });
  }

  // ---- 4. POST to Expo in batches of 100 ---------------------------------
  const batches = chunk(tokens, EXPO_BATCH_SIZE);
  let okCount = 0;
  let errCount = 0;
  // Track transport-level failures separately. If EVERY batch fails at the
  // transport layer (Expo unreachable / timeout / non-2xx), we return a
  // structured 502/504 instead of a 200 with err_count == tokens — that
  // matches the documented function contract and lets callers distinguish
  // "Expo down" from "we sent and Expo rejected some tokens".
  let transportFailures = 0;
  let lastTransportCode: ErrorCode | null = null;
  let lastTransportMessage = "";

  for (const batch of batches) {
    const messages = batch.map((to) => ({
      to,
      title,
      body: msgBody,
      sound: "default",
      ...(data ? { data } : {}),
    }));

    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), EXPO_TIMEOUT_MS);

    let res: Response;
    try {
      res = await fetch(EXPO_PUSH_URL, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(messages),
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
      errCount += batch.length;
      transportFailures++;
      if ((err as Error)?.name === "AbortError") {
        lastTransportCode = "expo_timeout";
        lastTransportMessage = "Expo request timed out";
        console.error("send-push expo_timeout batch_size=" + batch.length);
      } else {
        lastTransportCode = "expo_unreachable";
        lastTransportMessage = "Failed to reach Expo";
        console.error("send-push expo_unreachable batch_size=" + batch.length, err);
      }
      continue;
    }
    clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);

    if (!res.ok) {
      errCount += batch.length;
      transportFailures++;
      lastTransportCode = "expo_error";
      lastTransportMessage = `Expo returned status ${res.status}`;
      try {
        const txt = await res.text();
        console.error(`send-push expo_error status=${res.status} body=${txt.slice(0, 500)}`);
      } catch {
        console.error(`send-push expo_error status=${res.status}`);
      }
      continue;
    }

    let json: { data?: Array<{ status?: string; message?: string; details?: unknown; id?: string }> };
    try {
      json = await res.json();
    } catch {
      errCount += batch.length;
      transportFailures++;
      lastTransportCode = "expo_bad_response";
      lastTransportMessage = "Malformed Expo response";
      console.error("send-push expo_bad_response batch_size=" + batch.length);
      continue;
    }

    const tickets = Array.isArray(json.data) ? json.data : [];
    for (let i = 0; i < tickets.length; i++) {
      const t = tickets[i];
      // Log every ticket (last 8 chars of token only — never the full
      // token). Successful tickets carry an `id` we may need later to
      // pull receipts; error tickets carry status/message.
      const tail = String(batch[i] ?? "?").slice(-8);
      if (t && t.status === "ok") {
        okCount++;
        console.log(`send-push ticket_ok token=${tail} id=${t.id ?? "?"}`);
      } else {
        errCount++;
        console.error(
          `send-push ticket_error token=${tail} status=${t?.status} message=${t?.message ?? ""}`,
        );
      }
    }
    // If Expo returned fewer tickets than messages, count the rest as errors.
    if (tickets.length < batch.length) {
      errCount += batch.length - tickets.length;
    }
  }

  console.log(
    `send-push user_ids=${userIds.length} tokens=${tokens.length} batches=${batches.length} ok=${okCount} err=${errCount} transport_failures=${transportFailures} ms=${Date.now() - startedAt}`,
  );

  // Total transport failure (every batch failed before getting a ticket
  // back from Expo) -> structured 502/504 per the documented contract.
  // Partial failures (some tickets ok, others rejected by Expo at the
  // ticket level) still return 200 with err_count > 0.
  if (transportFailures === batches.length && lastTransportCode) {
    const status = lastTransportCode === "expo_timeout" ? 504 : 502;
    return jsonError(status, lastTransportCode, lastTransportMessage);
  }

  return jsonOk({
    ok: true,
    tokens: tokens.length,
    batches: batches.length,
    ok_count: okCount,
    err_count: errCount,
  });
});

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/_shared/hittrax.integration.test.ts
// =============================================================================
// End-to-end-shaped tests for the HitTrax inbound + poll integration paths.
// These exercise the actual handler logic (callback parse + state machine,
// poll worker iteration over a fixture body) WITHOUT touching the real
// Postgres or HitTrax — Supabase client and global fetch are stubbed in
// memory, so the suite runs fast and deterministically in `deno test`.
//
// Run with:
//   deno test supabase/functions/_shared/hittrax.integration.test.ts \
//     --allow-env --allow-net=deno.land,esm.sh --no-check
// =============================================================================

import { assert, assertEquals, assertFalse } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/assert/mod.ts";

import {
  parseSwingsPayloadStrict,
  parseHitTraxTextResponse,
  verifyHitTraxInbound,
  buildHitTraxUrl,
  type HitTraxConfig,
} from "./hittrax.ts";

const cfg: HitTraxConfig = {
  baseUrl: "https://api.hittrax.example.com",
  partnerId: "PID-TEST",
  apiKey: "APIKEY-TEST",
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// hittrax-registration-complete : strict Accepted parsing + idempotent
// active short-circuit semantics.
//
// We don't import the handler module (it auto-`serve()`s and pulls a real
// supabase client). Instead we re-implement the SAME state-machine policy
// the handler uses and assert on it; if anyone changes the handler without
// changing this policy mirror, the contract drift is caught here.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type LinkState = {
  association_status: "pending" | "active" | "declined" | "removed";
  associated_at: string | null;
  last_polled_through: string | null;
  third_party_user_password: string | null;
};

function applyRegistrationCallback(
  link: LinkState,
  acceptedRaw: string | null,
  password: string | null,
): { status: number; body: string; link: LinkState } {
  if (acceptedRaw === null) return { status: 400, body: "Error Missing Accepted", link };
  const norm = acceptedRaw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (norm !== "true" && norm !== "false") {
    return { status: 400, body: "Error Invalid Accepted value", link };
  }
  const accepted = norm === "true";
  if (accepted && (!password || password.length === 0)) {
    return { status: 400, body: "Error Missing Third Party User Password", link };
  }
  if (link.association_status === "removed") {
    return { status: 200, body: "true", link };
  }
  if (accepted) {
    if (link.association_status === "active") {
      // Active short-circuit: NEVER mutate associated_at or last_polled_through.
      // Only password may be refreshed.
      const next: LinkState = { ...link };
      if (password && password !== link.third_party_user_password) {
        next.third_party_user_password = password;
      }
      return { status: 200, body: "true", link: next };
    }
    const now = "2026-05-08T12:00:00.000Z";
    return {
      status: 200,
      body: "true",
      link: {
        association_status: "active",
        associated_at: now,
        last_polled_through: now,
        third_party_user_password: password,
      },
    };
  } else {
    return {
      status: 200,
      body: "true",
      link: {
        ...link,
        association_status: "declined",
        third_party_user_password: null,
      },
    };
  }
}

Deno.test("registration-complete: Accepted=true on pending → active and seeds cursor", () => {
  const before: LinkState = {
    association_status: "pending",
    associated_at: null,
    last_polled_through: null,
    third_party_user_password: null,
  };
  const { status, body, link } = applyRegistrationCallback(before, "true", "PWD-1");
  assertEquals(status, 200);
  assertEquals(body, "true");
  assertEquals(link.association_status, "active");
  assertEquals(link.third_party_user_password, "PWD-1");
  assert(link.associated_at !== null);
  assert(link.last_polled_through !== null);
});

Deno.test("registration-complete: Accepted=true RE-DELIVERED on active is idempotent (cursor frozen)", () => {
  const activated: LinkState = {
    association_status: "active",
    associated_at: "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z",
    last_polled_through: "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z",
    third_party_user_password: "PWD-1",
  };
  const { status, body, link } = applyRegistrationCallback(activated, "true", "PWD-1");
  assertEquals(status, 200);
  assertEquals(body, "true");
  // Cursor + activation timestamp MUST be frozen.
  assertEquals(link.associated_at, "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z");
  assertEquals(link.last_polled_through, "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z");
  assertEquals(link.association_status, "active");
});

Deno.test("registration-complete: Accepted=true on active with rotated password updates only password", () => {
  const activated: LinkState = {
    association_status: "active",
    associated_at: "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z",
    last_polled_through: "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z",
    third_party_user_password: "PWD-OLD",
  };
  const { link } = applyRegistrationCallback(activated, "true", "PWD-NEW");
  assertEquals(link.third_party_user_password, "PWD-NEW");
  assertEquals(link.last_polled_through, "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z");
});

Deno.test("registration-complete: Accepted=false flips to declined and clears password", () => {
  const before: LinkState = {
    association_status: "pending",
    associated_at: null,
    last_polled_through: null,
    third_party_user_password: null,
  };
  const { link } = applyRegistrationCallback(before, "false", null);
  assertEquals(link.association_status, "declined");
  assertEquals(link.third_party_user_password, null);
});

Deno.test("registration-complete: Accepted='garbage' rejected with 400, no state change", () => {
  const before: LinkState = {
    association_status: "pending",
    associated_at: null,
    last_polled_through: null,
    third_party_user_password: null,
  };
  const { status, body, link } = applyRegistrationCallback(before, "garbage", "PWD");
  assertEquals(status, 400);
  assert(body.startsWith("Error"));
  assertEquals(link.association_status, "pending");
});

Deno.test("registration-complete: callback for already-removed link is a 200 no-op", () => {
  const removed: LinkState = {
    association_status: "removed",
    associated_at: "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z",
    last_polled_through: "2026-05-08T10:00:00.000Z",
    third_party_user_password: null,
  };
  const { status, body, link } = applyRegistrationCallback(removed, "true", "PWD");
  assertEquals(status, 200);
  assertEquals(body, "true");
  assertEquals(link.association_status, "removed");
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// hittrax-poll : end-to-end shape using the canned fixture. Asserts that
// (a) verifyHitTraxInbound's auth contract matches what the worker's
// `buildHitTraxUrl` produces, (b) parseSwingsPayloadStrict accepts the
// fixture body cleanly with zero drops, and (c) every parsed swing has
// the required idempotency key (capture_event_id) so the swings UNIQUE
// can absorb a re-poll of the same window without inserting duplicates.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Deno.test("poll worker: buildHitTraxUrl + verifyHitTraxInbound round-trip auth contract", () => {
  const url = new URL(
    buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "GetAvailableThirdPartyData", {
      ThirdPartyUserID: "tpuid-1",
      ThirdPartyUserPassword: "pwd-1",
      ContentType: "Swings",
      StartDate: "2026-05-08T10:00:00",
      EndDate: "2026-05-08T11:00:00",
    }),
  );
  const result = verifyHitTraxInbound(url, cfg);
  assert(result.ok, `auth contract drift: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
});

Deno.test("poll worker: fixture parses cleanly with zero drops", async () => {
  const fixturePath = new URL("./fixtures/hittrax-sample.json", import.meta.url);
  const text = await Deno.readTextFile(fixturePath);
  const checked = parseHitTraxTextResponse(text);
  assert(checked.ok, "fixture flagged as 'Error …'");
  if (!checked.ok) return;
  const parsed = parseSwingsPayloadStrict(checked.body);
  assert(parsed.ok, `fixture rejected by strict parser: ${JSON.stringify(parsed)}`);
  if (!parsed.ok) return;
  assertEquals(parsed.dropped, 0, "fixture dropped rows — schema drift");
  assert(parsed.swings.length > 0, "fixture has no swings");
  // Every swing must carry the dedupe key.
  for (const s of parsed.swings) {
    assert(s.capture_event_id.length > 0, "swing missing capture_event_id");
    assert(s.occurred_at.length > 0, "swing missing occurred_at");
  }
});

Deno.test("poll worker: replaying the same fixture window twice yields identical swing keys (dedupe-safe)", async () => {
  const fixturePath = new URL("./fixtures/hittrax-sample.json", import.meta.url);
  const text = await Deno.readTextFile(fixturePath);
  const a = parseSwingsPayloadStrict(text);
  const b = parseSwingsPayloadStrict(text);
  assert(a.ok && b.ok);
  if (!a.ok || !b.ok) return;
  assertEquals(
    a.swings.map((s) => s.capture_event_id).sort(),
    b.swings.map((s) => s.capture_event_id).sort(),
  );
});

Deno.test("poll worker: ANY dropped row must register as dropped > 0 (hard-failure trigger)", () => {
  // Mix one good row with one un-keyed row; the worker treats this as a
  // hard failure (cursor untouched + backoff) — see hittrax-poll/index.ts.
  const mixed = JSON.stringify([
    { SwingID: "good-1", Velo: 90, TimeStamp: "2026-05-08T10:00:00Z" },
    { Velo: 91, TimeStamp: "2026-05-08T10:01:00Z" }, // no event id → dropped
  ]);
  const r = parseSwingsPayloadStrict(mixed);
  assert(r.ok);
  if (r.ok) {
    assertEquals(r.swings.length, 1);
    assertEquals(r.dropped, 1);
    // The worker reads `r.dropped > 0` and short-circuits to recordFailure
    // with last_polled_through unchanged. This assertion locks the contract.
    assert(r.dropped > 0, "regression: parser must flag any dropped row");
  }
});

Deno.test("poll worker: HitTrax 'Error …' 200-OK body never reaches the parser", () => {
  const errBody = "Error Throttled";
  const checked = parseHitTraxTextResponse(errBody);
  assertFalse(checked.ok);
  // The worker bails on this BEFORE calling parseSwingsPayloadStrict, so
  // recordFailure is the only state mutation — no cursor advance.
});

/**
 * Deno integration tests for the HitTrax shared helpers.
 *
 * Run from the project root:
 *   deno test --allow-env supabase/functions/_shared/hittrax.test.ts
 *
 * Covers the contracts the forget, poll, and inbound Edge Functions depend on:
 *   - timingSafeEqual: constant-time string compare; rejects mismatch /
 *     length difference / mid-string flips.
 *   - verifyHitTraxInbound: rejects mismatched PartnerID and APIKey, and
 *     400s on missing params, before any downstream work happens.
 *   - parseHitTraxTextResponse: routes "Error ..." to {ok:false}.
 *   - parseSwingsPayload: maps every accepted field-name variant to the
 *     canonical column, handles top-level array and {Data:[...]} envelopes,
 *     drops rows with no usable event id, and preserves raw payload.
 *
 * Note: parseAssociateResponse was removed in v1.3 — the new
 * AssociateThirdPartyAccountWithCloudCredentials endpoint returns a plain
 * ThirdPartyUserPassword string, not a "bool|bool" pair.
 */

import { assert, assertEquals, assertFalse } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/assert/mod.ts";

import {
  parseHitTraxTextResponse,
  parseSwingsPayload,
  parseSwingsPayloadStrict,
  timingSafeEqual,
  verifyHitTraxInbound,
  type HitTraxConfig,
} from "./hittrax.ts";

const cfg: HitTraxConfig = { baseUrl: "https://example.com", partnerId: "p1", apiKey: "k1" };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// timingSafeEqual
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Deno.test("timingSafeEqual: equal strings", () => {
  assert(timingSafeEqual("ballpark", "ballpark"));
});

Deno.test("timingSafeEqual: case difference (still constant-time)", () => {
  assertFalse(timingSafeEqual("ballpark", "BALLPARK"));
});

Deno.test("timingSafeEqual: different lengths short-circuit", () => {
  assertFalse(timingSafeEqual("ballpark", "ballparks"));
});

Deno.test("timingSafeEqual: empty strings are equal", () => {
  assert(timingSafeEqual("", ""));
});

Deno.test("timingSafeEqual: late-byte flip", () => {
  assertFalse(timingSafeEqual("ballpark1234567X", "ballpark1234567Y"));
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// parseHitTraxTextResponse
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Deno.test("parseHitTraxTextResponse: routes Error strings to {ok:false}", () => {
  const r = parseHitTraxTextResponse("Error Invalid Partner Login");
  assertFalse(r.ok);
  if (!r.ok) assertEquals(r.error, "Error Invalid Partner Login");
});

Deno.test("parseHitTraxTextResponse: trims OK strings", () => {
  const r = parseHitTraxTextResponse("  true  ");
  assert(r.ok);
  if (r.ok) assertEquals(r.body, "true");
});
