// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/_shared/hittrax.ts
// =============================================================================
// Shared helpers for the HitTrax Edge Functions.
//
// HitTrax API v1.3 — Third Party / HitTrax Account Management and Data
// Retrieval API (Developers Guide v1.3, HitTrax, Northborough MA).
//
// ---- Outbound calls WE make TO HitTrax (all GET unless noted) ----
//   CheckForCloudUsernameEligibility      GET  → "true"|"false"
//   CreateCloudUserAccount                POST → ThirdPartyUserPassword
//   AuthenticateCloudUser                 GET  → session token
//   ProvideOTPResponseCode                GET  → session token
//   AuthenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty    GET  → session token
//   AssociateThirdPartyAccountWithCloudCredentials GET → ThirdPartyUserPassword
//   RemoveThirdPartyAssociationFromCloudUser       GET → "true"
//   RetrieveThirdPartyAccountFromLinkedCloudUser   GET → JSON
//   RetrieveCloudUserAccountFromLinkedThirdPartyAccount GET → JSON
//   NotifyKioskOfUserEvent                GET  → "true"
//   GetAvailableThirdPartyData            GET  → JSON
//   LogOutThirdPartyCloudUser             GET  → "true"
//
// ---- Inbound calls HitTrax makes TO US ----
//   ForgetHitTraxUser  POST  (GDPR purge)
//
// All responses on success are plain text.
// All error responses begin with "Error" followed by a reason string
// (see Appendix, p.20 of the spec).
//
// Auth model: PartnerID + APIKey in every query string. No Authorization
// header. Session tokens are short-lived (2h inactivity TTL) and must
// never be persisted — generate fresh per-request.
// =============================================================================

export type HitTraxConfig = {
  baseUrl: string;
  partnerId: string;
  apiKey: string;
};

export function readHitTraxConfig(): HitTraxConfig | null {
  const baseUrl = Deno.env.get("HITTRAX_BASE_URL");
  const partnerId = Deno.env.get("HITTRAX_PARTNER_ID");
  const apiKey = Deno.env.get("HITTRAX_API_KEY");
  if (!baseUrl || !partnerId || !apiKey) return null;
  return { baseUrl: baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, ""), partnerId, apiKey };
}

// Constant-time string comparison — never use === on a secret value.
export function timingSafeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}

// Verify an inbound HitTrax callback (ForgetHitTraxUser) carries the
// PartnerID + APIKey issued to us.
export function verifyHitTraxInbound(
  url: URL,
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
): { ok: true } | { ok: false; status: 401 | 400; code: string; message: string } {
  const partnerId = url.searchParams.get("PartnerID");
  const apiKey = url.searchParams.get("APIKey");
  if (!partnerId) return { ok: false, status: 400, code: "missing_partner_id", message: "Missing PartnerID" };
  if (!apiKey) return { ok: false, status: 400, code: "missing_api_key", message: "Missing APIKey" };
  if (!timingSafeEqual(partnerId, cfg.partnerId) || !timingSafeEqual(apiKey, cfg.apiKey)) {
    return { ok: false, status: 401, code: "invalid_partner_login", message: "Invalid Partner Login" };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

// Build a HitTrax outbound URL. Uses URLSearchParams so values are always
// properly encoded and secrets never leak into the URL path.
export function buildHitTraxUrl(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  endpoint: string,
  params: Record<string, string | number | undefined | null> = {},
): string {
  const url = new URL(`${cfg.baseUrl}/${endpoint}`);
  url.searchParams.set("PartnerID", cfg.partnerId);
  url.searchParams.set("APIKey", cfg.apiKey);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
  }
  return url.toString();
}

// Format a Date for HitTrax StartDate/EndDate params.
// Spec says YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MI:SS:SSS (colon before ms, URI-encoded), but
// ASP.NET's model binder cannot parse the colon-before-ms variant and returns
// a generic 400 "The request is invalid." BEFORE HitTrax's own validation
// runs. Omitting milliseconds produces a standard ISO 8601 datetime that
// ASP.NET parses cleanly; HitTrax returns its own "Invalid Start/End Date"
// if it still disagrees. Values are URI-encoded by URLSearchParams.
export function formatHitTraxDate(d: Date): string {
  const pad = (n: number, w = 2) => String(n).padStart(w, "0");
  return (
    `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getUTCDate())}` +
    `T${pad(d.getUTCHours())}:${pad(d.getUTCMinutes())}:${pad(d.getUTCSeconds())}`
  );
}

// Parse a HitTrax plain-text response.
// Returns { ok: true, body } for normal values ("true", session token, password, etc.)
// Returns { ok: false, error } when HitTrax returned an "Error ..." string.
export type HitTraxResponse = { ok: true; body: string } | { ok: false; error: string };

export function parseHitTraxTextResponse(body: string): HitTraxResponse {
  const trimmed = body.trim();
  if (trimmed.toLowerCase().startsWith("error")) {
    return { ok: false, error: trimmed };
  }
  return { ok: true, body: trimmed };
}

// =============================================================================
// v1.3 HTTP helpers — one function per outbound endpoint.
// All throw a descriptive Error on failure so callers can catch + re-throw
// as structured edge-function errors.
// =============================================================================

const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;

// Internal: GET a HitTrax URL and return the plain-text body.
// Throws on network error, timeout, or non-2xx HTTP status.
async function hitTraxGet(url: string, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS): Promise<string> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(url, { method: "GET", signal: controller.signal });
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if ((err as Error)?.name === "AbortError") throw new Error("hittrax_timeout");
    throw new Error("hittrax_unreachable");
  }
  clearTimeout(timer);
  const text = await res.text().catch(() => "");
  if (!res.ok) {
    console.error("hitTraxGet non-2xx", { status: res.status, url, body: text.slice(0, 200) });
    throw new Error(`hittrax_http_${res.status}: ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  return text;
}

// Internal: POST a HitTrax URL with a JSON body, return plain-text body.
async function hitTraxPost(url: string, bodyObj: unknown, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS): Promise<string> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(bodyObj),
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if ((err as Error)?.name === "AbortError") throw new Error("hittrax_timeout");
    throw new Error("hittrax_unreachable");
  }
  clearTimeout(timer);
  const text = await res.text().catch(() => "");
  if (!res.ok) {
    console.error("hitTraxPost non-2xx", { status: res.status, url, body: text.slice(0, 200) });
    throw new Error(`hittrax_http_${res.status}: ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  return text;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AuthenticateCloudUser (v1.3 p.6)
// Authenticate with HitTrax username + password → session token.
// Throws on bad credentials ("HitTrax User Authentication Failure") or any
// other HitTrax error so the caller can surface a meaningful message.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function authenticateCloudUser(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  username: string,
  password: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "AuthenticateCloudUser", {
    UserName: username,
    Password: password,
    UseOTP: "false",
  });
  const raw = await hitTraxGet(url);
  const parsed = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) {
    const lower = parsed.error.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.includes("authentication failure") || lower.includes("account not verified")) {
      throw new Error("invalid_hittrax_credentials: " + parsed.error);
    }
    throw new Error("hittrax_auth_error: " + parsed.error);
  }
  return parsed.body; // session token
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// triggerOTP (v1.3 p.6-7)
// Initiate OTP authentication: calls AuthenticateCloudUser with UseOTP=true.
// HitTrax sends an SMS to the user's registered phone and returns the string
// "Error: Waiting for OTP response" — this is the EXPECTED success response
// (not a real error). We normalise it to a no-op return.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function triggerOTP(cfg: HitTraxConfig, username: string): Promise<void> {
  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "AuthenticateCloudUser", {
    UserName: username,
    Password: "",
    UseOTP: "true",
  });
  const raw = await hitTraxGet(url);
  const lower = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  // "Error: Waiting for OTP response" is HitTrax's way of saying "SMS sent".
  if (lower.includes("waiting for otp response")) return;
  // If we got a session token back instead (edge case) that's also fine.
  const parsed = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (parsed.ok) return;
  // Any other error string is a real error.
  const lowerErr = parsed.error.toLowerCase();
  if (lowerErr.includes("user not found") || lowerErr.includes("account not found")) {
    throw new Error("hittrax_user_not_found: " + parsed.error);
  }
  if (lowerErr.includes("no phone") || lowerErr.includes("phone number")) {
    throw new Error("hittrax_no_phone: " + parsed.error);
  }
  throw new Error("hittrax_otp_trigger_error: " + parsed.error);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// submitOTPCode (v1.3 p.8)
// Submit the OTP code received via SMS → session token.
// Spec note: the URL example shows "OPTCode" (apparent typo in spec) while
// the parameter description table says "OTPCode". We use "OTPCode" which is
// clearly the intended name.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function submitOTPCode(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  username: string,
  otpCode: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "ProvideOTPResponseCode", {
    UserName: username,
    OTPCode: otpCode,
  });
  const raw = await hitTraxGet(url);
  const parsed = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) {
    const lower = parsed.error.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.includes("invalid") || lower.includes("expired") || lower.includes("mismatch")) {
      throw new Error("hittrax_invalid_otp: " + parsed.error);
    }
    throw new Error("hittrax_otp_verify_error: " + parsed.error);
  }
  return parsed.body; // session token
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AuthenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty (v1.3 p.9)
// Authenticate using the ThirdPartyUserID + ThirdPartyUserPassword we stored
// at association time → session token. Used for disconnect and future re-auth.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  thirdPartyUserId: string,
  thirdPartyUserPassword: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "AuthenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty", {
    ThirdPartyUserID: thirdPartyUserId,
    ThirdPartyUserPassword: thirdPartyUserPassword,
  });
  const raw = await hitTraxGet(url);
  const parsed = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error("hittrax_third_party_auth_error: " + parsed.error);
  return parsed.body; // session token
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AssociateThirdPartyAccountWithCloudCredentials (v1.3 p.10)
// Associate our ThirdPartyUserID with the authenticated session.
// Returns the ThirdPartyUserPassword — store it; it's the permanent credential
// for future API calls on behalf of this user.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function associateThirdPartyAccount(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  sessionToken: string,
  thirdPartyUserId: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "AssociateThirdPartyAccountWithCloudCredentials", {
    UserSessionToken: sessionToken,
    ThirdPartyUserID: thirdPartyUserId,
  });
  const raw = await hitTraxGet(url);
  const parsed = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error("hittrax_associate_error: " + parsed.error);
  return parsed.body; // ThirdPartyUserPassword
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// RemoveThirdPartyAssociationFromCloudUser (v1.3 p.11)
// Terminates the association. Requires an active session token — call
// authenticateCloudUserViaThirdParty first.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function removeThirdPartyAssociation(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  sessionToken: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "RemoveThirdPartyAssociationFromCloudUser", {
    UserSessionToken: sessionToken,
  });
  const raw = await hitTraxGet(url);
  const parsed = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error("hittrax_remove_error: " + parsed.error);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// NotifyKioskOfUserEvent (v1.3 p.13)
// The QR code displayed on the kiosk encodes the base event URL.
// Ballpark appends PartnerID, APIKey, and UserSessionToken then fires it.
// For security, the caller MUST verify the URL origin matches cfg.baseUrl
// before calling this function.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function notifyKioskOfUserEvent(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  sessionToken: string,
  qrBaseUrl: string,
): Promise<string> {
  // Validate: QR URL must be from the same origin as the configured HitTrax server.
  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(qrBaseUrl);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("hittrax_invalid_qr_url: Not a valid URL");
  }
  const cfgOrigin = new URL(cfg.baseUrl).origin;
  if (parsed.origin !== cfgOrigin) {
    throw new Error("hittrax_invalid_qr_url: QR code is not from the configured HitTrax server");
  }
  // Append auth params (do not re-set PartnerID/APIKey if already present —
  // the kiosk URL may pre-set them; we override to ensure our credentials).
  parsed.searchParams.set("PartnerID", cfg.partnerId);
  parsed.searchParams.set("APIKey", cfg.apiKey);
  parsed.searchParams.set("UserSessionToken", sessionToken);
  const raw = await hitTraxGet(parsed.toString());
  const result = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error("hittrax_kiosk_event_error: " + result.error);
  return result.body; // "true"
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// LogOutThirdPartyCloudUser (v1.3 p.17)
// Terminates the session. Best-effort — always call after associate/remove to
// avoid leaving dangling sessions on HitTrax servers.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function logOutSession(cfg: HitTraxConfig, sessionToken: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "LogOutThirdPartyCloudUser", { UserSessionToken: sessionToken });
    await hitTraxGet(url);
  } catch (err) {
    // Best-effort — log but never let a logout failure bubble up.
    console.warn("hittrax logOutSession failed (non-fatal)", err);
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CheckForCloudUsernameEligibility (v1.3 p.3)
// Returns true if username is available, false if taken.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function checkCloudUsernameEligibility(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  cloudUsername: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "CheckForCloudUsernameEligibility", { CloudUsername: cloudUsername });
  const raw = await hitTraxGet(url);
  const parsed = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error("hittrax_username_check_error: " + parsed.error);
  return parsed.body.toLowerCase() === "true";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CreateCloudUserAccount (v1.3 p.4)
// Creates a HitTrax Cloud account and automatically links it to our
// ThirdPartyUserID. Returns the ThirdPartyUserPassword — store it.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export type CreateHitTraxAccountParams = {
  username: string;
  thirdPartyUsername: string; // our internal identifier (e.g. kid's Supabase UUID as string)
  password: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  birthdate: string; // MM/DD/YYYY
  email: string;
  guardianEmail?: string; // required if user < 13
  cellPhone?: string;
  heightInches?: number;
  gender: "male" | "female" | "other";
  sport: "Baseball" | "Fastpitch Softball" | "Slowpitch Softball";
  skillLevel: string;
  position?: string;
  bats?: "Right" | "Left" | "Switch";
  throws?: "Right" | "Left";
};

export async function createCloudUserAccount(
  cfg: HitTraxConfig,
  params: CreateHitTraxAccountParams,
): Promise<string> {
  const url = buildHitTraxUrl(cfg, "CreateCloudUserAccount");
  const postBody = {
    Username: params.username,
    ThirdPartyUsername: params.thirdPartyUsername,
    Password: params.password,
    FirstName: params.firstName,
    LastName: params.lastName,
    Birthdate: params.birthdate,
    Email: params.email,
    ...(params.guardianEmail ? { GuardianEmailAddress: params.guardianEmail } : {}),
    ...(params.cellPhone ? { CellPhoneNumber: params.cellPhone } : {}),
    ...(params.heightInches !== undefined ? { Height: params.heightInches } : {}),
    Gender: params.gender,
    Sport: params.sport,
    SkillLevel: params.skillLevel,
    ...(params.position ? { Position: params.position } : {}),
    ...(params.bats ? { Bats: params.bats } : {}),
    ...(params.throws ? { Throws: params.throws } : {}),
  };
  const raw = await hitTraxPost(url, postBody);
  const parsed = parseHitTraxTextResponse(raw);
  if (!parsed.ok) {
    if (parsed.error.toLowerCase().includes("username already in use")) {
      throw new Error("hittrax_username_taken: " + parsed.error);
    }
    throw new Error("hittrax_create_account_error: " + parsed.error);
  }
  return parsed.body; // ThirdPartyUserPassword
}

// =============================================================================
// Swing payload parser (GetAvailableThirdPartyData)
// =============================================================================

export type ParsedSwing = {
  capture_event_id: string;
  capture_session_id: string | null;
  facility_id: string | null;
  occurred_at: string;
  exit_velocity_mph: number | null;
  launch_angle_deg: number | null;
  distance_ft: number | null;
  contact_quality: string | null;
  result: string | null;
  pitch_speed_mph: number | null;
  spray_angle_deg: number | null;
  raw: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const FIELD_MAP = {
  event_id:           ["SwingID", "EventID", "Id", "id"],
  // FullPlays uses "SnId" (session number) — "SId" is the user ID, not the session
  session_id:         ["SnId", "SnUuid", "SessionID", "session_id"],
  facility_id:        ["FacilityID", "facility_id"],
  // FullPlays uses "TS" for the swing timestamp
  occurred_at:        ["TS", "TimeStamp", "Timestamp", "EventTime", "occurred_at", "Time"],
  exit_velocity_mph:  ["Velo", "EBV", "ExitVelocity", "ExitVelo", "exit_velocity_mph", "EV"],
  // FullPlays uses "Elv" for elevation/launch angle
  launch_angle_deg:   ["Elv", "LaunchAngle", "VertAngle", "launch_angle_deg", "LA"],
  distance_ft:        ["Dist", "Distance", "distance_ft", "GD"],
  contact_quality:    ["QD", "ContactQuality", "Quality", "contact_quality"],
  // FullPlays uses "Res" for result
  result:             ["Res", "Result", "AB", "result", "Outcome"],
  // FullPlays uses "PV" for pitch velocity
  pitch_speed_mph:    ["PV", "PitchSpeed", "PitchVelo", "pitch_speed_mph"],
  spray_angle_deg:    ["HorzAngle", "SprayAngle", "spray_angle_deg"],
} as const;

function pickString(obj: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]): string | null {
  for (const k of keys) {
    const v = obj[k];
    if (typeof v === "string" && v.length > 0) return v;
    if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) return String(v);
  }
  return null;
}

function pickNumber(obj: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]): number | null {
  for (const k of keys) {
    const v = obj[k];
    if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) return v;
    if (typeof v === "string" && v.length > 0) {
      const n = Number(v);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function parseSwingRow(raw: unknown): ParsedSwing | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw)) return null;
  const obj = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const eventId = pickString(obj, FIELD_MAP.event_id);
  if (!eventId) return null;
  const occurredAtRaw = pickString(obj, FIELD_MAP.occurred_at);
  let occurred_at = occurredAtRaw ?? new Date().toISOString();
  if (Number.isNaN(Date.parse(occurred_at))) occurred_at = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    capture_event_id: eventId,
    capture_session_id: pickString(obj, FIELD_MAP.session_id),
    facility_id: pickString(obj, FIELD_MAP.facility_id),
    occurred_at: new Date(occurred_at).toISOString(),
    exit_velocity_mph: pickNumber(obj, FIELD_MAP.exit_velocity_mph),
    launch_angle_deg: pickNumber(obj, FIELD_MAP.launch_angle_deg),
    distance_ft: (() => {
      const n = pickNumber(obj, FIELD_MAP.distance_ft);
      return n === null ? null : Math.max(0, Math.round(n));
    })(),
    contact_quality: pickString(obj, FIELD_MAP.contact_quality),
    result: pickString(obj, FIELD_MAP.result),
    pitch_speed_mph: pickNumber(obj, FIELD_MAP.pitch_speed_mph),
    spray_angle_deg: pickNumber(obj, FIELD_MAP.spray_angle_deg),
    raw: obj,
  };
}

export function parseSwingsPayload(rawJson: string): ParsedSwing[] {
  const r = parseSwingsPayloadStrict(rawJson);
  return r.ok ? r.swings : [];
}

export type ParsedSwingsResult =
  | { ok: true; swings: ParsedSwing[]; dropped: number }
  | { ok: false; code: "invalid_json" | "unexpected_envelope"; sample: string };

export function parseSwingsPayloadStrict(rawJson: string): ParsedSwingsResult {
  let parsed: unknown;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(rawJson);
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, code: "invalid_json", sample: rawJson.slice(0, 200) };
  }
  let arr: unknown[] | null = null;
  if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
    arr = parsed;
  } else if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object") {
    const obj = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const key of ["Data", "Swings", "Records", "Plays", "FullPlays", "data", "swings", "records", "plays"]) {
      const v = obj[key];
      if (Array.isArray(v)) { arr = v; break; }
    }
  }
  if (arr === null) {
    const sample = (() => { try { return JSON.stringify(parsed).slice(0, 200); } catch { return "<unstringifiable>"; } })();
    return { ok: false, code: "unexpected_envelope", sample };
  }
  const swings: ParsedSwing[] = [];
  let dropped = 0;
  for (const row of arr) {
    const swing = parseSwingRow(row);
    if (swing) swings.push(swing); else dropped++;
  }
  return { ok: true, swings, dropped };
}

// =============================================================================
// Response helpers — shared shape across all functions
// =============================================================================

export function jsonError(status: number, code: string, message: string): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

export function jsonOk(body: Record<string, unknown>): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

// Plain-text response for inbound HitTrax callbacks (ForgetHitTraxUser).
export function hittraxText(body: string, status = 200): Response {
  return new Response(body, {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" },
  });
}

// Map a thrown Error from a v1.3 helper to a structured jsonError response.
export function hitTraxErrorResponse(err: unknown): Response {
  const msg = (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)) ?? "unknown";
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_timeout")) return jsonError(504, "hittrax_timeout", "HitTrax request timed out");
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_unreachable")) return jsonError(502, "hittrax_unreachable", "Could not reach HitTrax");
  if (msg.startsWith("invalid_hittrax_credentials")) {
    return jsonError(401, "invalid_hittrax_credentials", "Invalid HitTrax username or password. Please check your credentials and try again.");
  }
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_username_taken")) {
    return jsonError(409, "hittrax_username_taken", "That HitTrax username is already taken. Please choose a different one.");
  }
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_user_not_found")) {
    return jsonError(404, "hittrax_user_not_found", "HitTrax username not found. Please check the username and try again.");
  }
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_no_phone")) {
    return jsonError(400, "hittrax_no_phone", "No phone number is registered with this HitTrax account. Use the password option instead.");
  }
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_invalid_otp")) {
    return jsonError(401, "hittrax_invalid_otp", "Invalid or expired code. Please go back and request a new one.");
  }
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_otp_trigger_error") || msg.startsWith("hittrax_otp_verify_error")) {
    const detail = msg.includes(": ") ? msg.split(": ").slice(1).join(": ") : msg;
    return jsonError(502, "hittrax_otp_error", detail);
  }
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_invalid_qr_url")) {
    const detail = msg.includes(": ") ? msg.split(": ").slice(1).join(": ") : "Not a valid HitTrax kiosk QR code.";
    return jsonError(400, "hittrax_invalid_qr_url", detail);
  }
  if (msg.startsWith("hittrax_kiosk_event_error")) {
    const detail = msg.includes(": ") ? msg.split(": ").slice(1).join(": ") : "Kiosk event failed.";
    return jsonError(502, "hittrax_kiosk_event_error", detail);
  }
  // Surface the HitTrax error text after the colon so the app can show it.
  const detail = msg.includes(": ") ? msg.split(": ").slice(1).join(": ") : msg;
  return jsonError(502, "hittrax_error", detail);
}

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/stripe-cancel-subscription/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #189 — Stripe Connect Phase 3: Cancel a recurring membership subscription
//
// Auth model: Standard Supabase JWT required (admin or owner role only).
// Tenant isolation: caller's tenant_id (from JWT app_metadata) must match
// the target membership's tenant_id. The service-role membership query is
// scoped to BOTH membership_id AND tenant_id, preventing cross-tenant access.
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy stripe-cancel-subscription
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    },
  });
}

function encodeFormBody(obj: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
  }
  return parts.join('&');
}

async function stripePost(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: encodeFormBody(body),
  });

  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string; code?: string } | undefined;
    if ((err as { code?: string })?.code === 'resource_missing') {
      throw Object.assign(new Error(err?.message ?? 'Not found'), { code: 'resource_missing' });
    }
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const stripeKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');
  if (!stripeKey) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Stripe not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const anonKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!;

  // ── Auth: verify caller JWT, role, and tenant ──────────────────────────────
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!callerToken) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Missing Authorization header' } }, 401);
  }

  const callerClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${callerToken}` } },
  });
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Invalid token' } }, 401);
  }

  const userRole = (user.app_metadata?.app_role as string | undefined)
    ?? (user.user_metadata?.app_role as string | undefined)
    ?? '';
  if (userRole !== 'admin' && userRole !== 'owner') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Admin or owner role required' } }, 403);
  }

  // Tenant isolation: read tenant_id from the JWT payload.
  // The Custom Access Token Hook injects tenant_id as a top-level JWT claim —
  // it is NOT stored in raw_app_meta_data, so auth.getUser() does NOT surface
  // it in user.app_metadata. Decode the token payload directly (signature was
  // already verified by auth.getUser() above).
  const callerTenantId: string = (() => {
    try {
      const parts = callerToken.split('.');
      if (parts.length < 2) return '';
      const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
      const payload = JSON.parse(atob(b64)) as Record<string, unknown>;
      return (payload.tenant_id as string | undefined)
        ?? (user.app_metadata?.tenant_id as string | undefined)
        ?? '';
    } catch {
      return (user.app_metadata?.tenant_id as string | undefined) ?? '';
    }
  })();
  if (!callerTenantId) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'No tenant in token — re-authenticate' } }, 403);
  }

  let body: { membership_id?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return json({ error: { code: 'bad_json', message: 'Invalid request body' } }, 400);
  }

  const { membership_id } = body;
  if (!membership_id) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'missing_param', message: 'membership_id required' } }, 422);
  }

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // Load membership — scoped to BOTH membership_id AND caller's tenant_id (tenant isolation)
  const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, stripe_subscription_id, status, tenant_id, family_id,
      families!inner(id, primary_location_id)
    `)
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', callerTenantId)
    .single();

  if (memErr || !mem) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_found', message: 'Membership not found or access denied' } }, 404);
  }

  if (!mem.stripe_subscription_id) {
    // No Stripe subscription — just mark as cancelled in DB (tenant-scoped update)
    await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .update({ status: 'cancelled', cancelled_at: new Date().toISOString(), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', membership_id)
      .eq('tenant_id', callerTenantId);
    return json({ ok: true, cancel_at_period_end: false, cancelled_immediately: true });
  }

  const fam = mem.families as unknown as { id: string; primary_location_id: string };

  const { data: location } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('stripe_account_id')
    .eq('id', fam.primary_location_id)
    .single();

  const connectedAccountId = location?.stripe_account_id as string | null;

  try {
    // Cancel at period end (family keeps access until the end of the period paid for)
    const cancelled = await stripePost(
      `subscriptions/${mem.stripe_subscription_id}`,
      stripeKey,
      { cancel_at_period_end: 'true' },
      connectedAccountId ?? undefined,
    );

    const cancelAt = cancelled.cancel_at
      ? new Date((cancelled.cancel_at as number) * 1000).toISOString()
      : null;

    // Persist cancel_at to the membership row so the portal can show a consistent
    // "Cancels on <date>" badge across page reloads without re-querying Stripe.
    await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .update({ cancel_at: cancelAt, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', membership_id)
      .eq('tenant_id', callerTenantId);

    console.log(`[stripe-cancel-subscription] sub=${mem.stripe_subscription_id} cancel_at=${cancelAt} tenant=${callerTenantId}`);

    return json({
      ok: true,
      cancel_at_period_end: true,
      cancel_at: cancelAt,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const e = err as Error & { code?: string };
    if (e.code === 'resource_missing') {
      // Subscription already gone — clean up DB (tenant-scoped)
      await supabase
        .from('memberships')
        .update({ status: 'cancelled', cancelled_at: new Date().toISOString(), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', membership_id)
        .eq('tenant_id', callerTenantId);
      return json({ ok: true, cancel_at_period_end: false, cancelled_immediately: true });
    }
    console.error(`[stripe-cancel-subscription] Stripe error: ${e.message}`);
    return json({ error: { code: 'stripe_error', message: e.message } }, 500);
  }
});

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/stripe-create-payment-intent/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #72 — Stripe Connect Phase 2: Card checkout for store items
//
// Auth model: Standard Supabase JWT required (parent role only).
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy stripe-create-payment-intent
//
// Required Supabase secrets:
//   STRIPE_SECRET_KEY              (sk_live_... or sk_test_...)
//   SUPABASE_URL                   (auto-injected)
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY      (auto-injected)
//   SUPABASE_ANON_KEY              (auto-injected)
//
// Request body (JSON):
//   { product_id: string, kid_id: string }
//
// Returns:
//   { client_secret, customer_id, ephemeral_key_secret, order_id,
//     redemption_code, amount_cents }
//
// Errors:
//   422 location_not_connected  — location's Stripe account not fully set up
//   422 unavailable             — product inactive / not purchasable
//   422 sold_out                — product out of stock
//   403 forbidden               — kid does not belong to caller
//
// Design notes:
//   - REQUIRES a fully connected (charges_enabled) location Stripe account.
//     Returns 422 if the location has no connected account or is pending/restricted.
//   - Creates or reuses a Stripe Customer on the PLATFORM account for the family
//     (stored in families.stripe_customer_id), enabling payment sheet to show
//     saved cards on subsequent purchases.
//   - Generates a short-lived ephemeral key so the mobile client can present
//     the Stripe payment sheet with saved payment method support.
//   - Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent on_behalf_of the connected account with
//     application_fee_amount derived from tenant.royalty_config.
//   - Inserts an orders row with status='payment_pending'. Lifecycle:
//     payment_intent.succeeded  → 'ordered'        (inventory already reserved above)
//     payment_intent.canceled   → 'cancelled'      (inventory restored by webhook)
//     payment_intent.failed     → 'payment_failed' (inventory restored by webhook)
//     Staff QR scan             → 'fulfilled'      (mark_redemption_fulfilled RPC)
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    },
  });
}

// ─── Stripe form-body encoder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Recursively encodes nested objects as metadata[key]=value so Stripe's
// form-urlencoded API receives them correctly.

function encodeFormBody(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    const key = prefix ? `${prefix}[${k}]` : k;
    if (typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) {
      const nested = encodeFormBody(v as Record<string, unknown>, key);
      if (nested) parts.push(nested);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
    }
  }
  return parts.join('&');
}

// ─── Stripe API helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function stripePost(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) {
    headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;
  }

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: encodeFormBody(body),
  });

  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

// ─── Redemption code generator ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 8-char base32 (no 0/O/1/I) — matches gen_redemption_code() in SQL.

function genRedemptionCode(): string {
  const alpha = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
  let code = '';
  const arr = new Uint8Array(8);
  crypto.getRandomValues(arr);
  for (const byte of arr) {
    code += alpha[byte % alpha.length];
  }
  return code;
}

// ─── Main handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, content-type',
      },
    });
  }

  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  // ── Authenticate caller ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const token = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!token) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Missing Authorization header' } }, 401);
  }

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const anonKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!;
  const stripeSecretKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');

  if (!stripeSecretKey) {
    console.error('[stripe-create-payment-intent] STRIPE_SECRET_KEY not configured');
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Payment processing not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  // Verify caller JWT to get their identity
  const supabaseUser = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
    auth: { persistSession: false },
  });

  const { data: { user }, error: userErr } = await supabaseUser.auth.getUser();
  if (userErr || !user) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Invalid token' } }, 401);
  }

  // ── Parse body ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let productId: string;
  let kidId: string;
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    productId = body.product_id;
    kidId = body.kid_id;
    if (!productId || !kidId) throw new Error('missing fields');
  } catch {
    return json({ error: { code: 'bad_request', message: 'product_id and kid_id required' } }, 400);
  }

  // ── Service-role client for trusted DB reads/writes ──────────────────────
  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // ── Verify caller owns the kid ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: kid, error: kidErr } = await supabase
    .from('kids')
    .select('id, family_id, tenant_id')
    .eq('id', kidId)
    .single();

  if (kidErr || !kid) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_found', message: 'Kid not found' } }, 404);
  }

  const { data: family, error: famErr } = await supabase
    .from('families')
    .select('id, tenant_id, parent_user_id, primary_location_id, stripe_customer_id')
    .eq('id', kid.family_id)
    .single();

  if (famErr || !family) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_found', message: 'Family not found' } }, 404);
  }

  if (family.parent_user_id !== user.id) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Kid does not belong to caller' } }, 403);
  }

  // ── Load product ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: product, error: prodErr } = await supabase
    .from('products')
    .select('id, name, dollar_price_cents, is_purchasable, is_active, inventory_count')
    .eq('id', productId)
    .eq('tenant_id', kid.tenant_id)
    .single();

  if (prodErr || !product) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_found', message: 'Product not found' } }, 404);
  }
  if (!product.is_active) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unavailable', message: 'Product is not available' } }, 422);
  }
  if (!product.is_purchasable || product.dollar_price_cents === null) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unavailable', message: 'Product cannot be purchased with a card' } }, 422);
  }
  // Non-atomic sold-out guard: quick pre-check to return a fast 422 before
  // attempting the atomic reserve below. Not the definitive check — the
  // reserve_product_inventory RPC is authoritative.
  if (product.inventory_count !== null && product.inventory_count <= 0) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'sold_out', message: 'Product is sold out' } }, 422);
  }

  // ── REQUIRE connected Stripe account ─────────────────────────────────────
  // Card payments MUST route through the location's connected Stripe account.
  // If the location has not completed onboarding, reject the request clearly.
  const locationId = family.primary_location_id;
  let stripeAccountId: string | null = null;

  if (locationId) {
    const { data: location } = await supabase
      .from('locations')
      .select('stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status')
      .eq('id', locationId)
      .single();

    const loc = location as { stripe_account_id?: string | null; stripe_onboarding_status?: string | null } | null;
    if (loc?.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected' && loc?.stripe_account_id) {
      stripeAccountId = loc.stripe_account_id;
    }
  }

  if (!stripeAccountId) {
    return json({
      error: {
        code: 'location_not_connected',
        message: 'Card payments are not yet available at this location. Please pay at the front desk or check back later.',
      },
    }, 422);
  }

  // ── Load tenant royalty config ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: tenant } = await supabase
    .from('tenants')
    .select('royalty_config')
    .eq('id', kid.tenant_id)
    .single();

  const royaltyRate = (tenant?.royalty_config as { rate?: number } | null)?.rate ?? 0.025;
  const amountCents = product.dollar_price_cents;
  const applicationFeeCents = Math.round(amountCents * royaltyRate);

  // ── Create or retrieve Stripe Customer on the PLATFORM account ───────────
  // Customers live on the platform account (no Stripe-Account header) and are
  // reused across purchases. The customer_id is stored in families.stripe_customer_id.
  let customerId: string = family.stripe_customer_id ?? '';

  if (!customerId) {
    try {
      const customer = await stripePost('customers', stripeSecretKey, {
        description: `Ballpark family ${family.id}`,
        metadata: {
          family_id: family.id,
          tenant_id: kid.tenant_id,
          supabase_user_id: user.id,
        },
      });
      customerId = customer.id as string;

      // Persist so we reuse the same Customer on future purchases
      await supabase
        .from('families')
        .update({ stripe_customer_id: customerId })
        .eq('id', family.id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[stripe-create-payment-intent] Customer create error:', err);
      return json({ error: { code: 'stripe_error', message: 'Could not set up payment customer' } }, 502);
    }
  }

  // ── Generate ephemeral key for the customer ───────────────────────────────
  // Ephemeral keys allow the mobile client to present the Stripe payment sheet
  // with saved payment methods. The key is short-lived (max 24 hours).
  let ephemeralKeySecret: string;
  try {
    const ek = await stripePost('ephemeral_keys', stripeSecretKey, {
      customer: customerId,
    });
    ephemeralKeySecret = ek.secret as string;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[stripe-create-payment-intent] Ephemeral key error:', err);
    return json({ error: { code: 'stripe_error', message: 'Could not create payment session' } }, 502);
  }

  // ── Generate redemption code ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  let redemptionCode = genRedemptionCode();
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 8; attempt++) {
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .select('id')
      .eq('redemption_code', redemptionCode)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!existing) break;
    redemptionCode = genRedemptionCode();
  }

  // ── Atomically reserve inventory BEFORE creating the Stripe PaymentIntent ──
  // This is the authoritative sold-out check. reserve_product_inventory
  // does a conditional UPDATE WHERE inventory_count > 0 and returns:
  //   TRUE  = reserved successfully (or unlimited stock, no decrement needed)
  //   FALSE = sold out (another buyer just took the last unit)
  // By reserving here (before Stripe is called), we prevent the race where
  // two parents both successfully pay for the last unit.
  const { data: reserved, error: reserveErr } = await supabase.rpc(
    'reserve_product_inventory',
    { p_product_id: productId },
  );
  if (reserveErr) {
    console.error('[stripe-create-payment-intent] reserve_product_inventory error:', reserveErr.message);
    return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: 'Could not reserve product' } }, 500);
  }
  if (!reserved) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'sold_out', message: 'Product is sold out' } }, 422);
  }

  // ── Create Stripe PaymentIntent on_behalf_of the connected account ────────
  let paymentIntentId: string;
  let clientSecret: string;

  try {
    const pi = await stripePost('payment_intents', stripeSecretKey, {
      amount: amountCents,
      currency: 'usd',
      customer: customerId,
      automatic_payment_methods: { enabled: 'true' },
      application_fee_amount: applicationFeeCents,
      on_behalf_of: stripeAccountId,
      transfer_data: { destination: stripeAccountId },
      metadata: {
        product_id: productId,
        kid_id: kidId,
        family_id: family.id,
        tenant_id: kid.tenant_id,
        redemption_code: redemptionCode,
      },
    });
    paymentIntentId = pi.id as string;
    clientSecret = pi.client_secret as string;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[stripe-create-payment-intent] PaymentIntent error:', err);
    // Restore the inventory reservation — the Stripe PI was never created
    await supabase.rpc('restore_product_inventory', { p_product_id: productId }).catch((e: unknown) => {
      console.error('[stripe-create-payment-intent] restore_product_inventory (PI create failure):', e);
    });
    return json({
      error: {
        code: 'stripe_error',
        message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not create payment',
      },
    }, 502);
  }

  // ── Insert order row with status='payment_pending' ────────────────────────
  // Status transitions via webhook:
  //   payment_intent.succeeded      → 'ordered'       (payment confirmed; inventory already reserved above)
  //                                    Then: staff QR scan → 'fulfilled' (mark_redemption_fulfilled RPC)
  //   payment_intent.payment_failed → 'payment_failed'
  //   payment_intent.canceled       → 'cancelled'
  const { data: order, error: orderErr } = await supabase
    .from('orders')
    .insert({
      tenant_id: kid.tenant_id,
      family_id: family.id,
      kid_id: kidId,
      product_id: productId,
      payment_method: 'card',
      amount_paid_cents: amountCents,
      stripe_payment_intent_id: paymentIntentId,
      status: 'payment_pending',
      redemption_code: redemptionCode,
    })
    .select('id')
    .single();

  if (orderErr || !order) {
    console.error('[stripe-create-payment-intent] Order insert failed:', orderErr?.message);
    // Cancel the PI to avoid an orphaned charge, and restore the inventory
    // reservation since no order was created to track this purchase.
    await Promise.allSettled([
      stripePost(`payment_intents/${paymentIntentId}/cancel`, stripeSecretKey, {
        cancellation_reason: 'duplicate',
      }),
      supabase.rpc('restore_product_inventory', { p_product_id: productId }),
    ]);
    return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: 'Could not create order' } }, 500);
  }

  console.log(
    `[stripe-create-payment-intent] order=${order.id} pi=${paymentIntentId}` +
    ` amount=${amountCents} fee=${applicationFeeCents} acct=${stripeAccountId}`,
  );

  return json({
    client_secret: clientSecret,
    customer_id: customerId,
    ephemeral_key_secret: ephemeralKeySecret,
    order_id: order.id,
    redemption_code: redemptionCode,
    amount_cents: amountCents,
  });
});

FILE: supabase/functions/stripe-create-subscription/index.ts

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/stripe-create-subscription/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #189 — Stripe Connect Phase 3: Create recurring membership subscription
//
// Auth model: Standard Supabase JWT required (admin or owner role only).
// Tenant isolation: caller's tenant_id (from JWT app_metadata) must match
// the target membership's tenant_id. Service-role queries are scoped by both
// membership_id AND tenant_id — a privileged user from Tenant B cannot act on
// Tenant A's memberships even if they obtain a membership UUID.
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy stripe-create-subscription
//
// Required Supabase secrets:
//   STRIPE_SECRET_KEY              (sk_live_... or sk_test_...)
//   SUPABASE_URL                   (auto-injected)
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY      (auto-injected)
//   SUPABASE_ANON_KEY              (auto-injected)
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    },
  });
}

function encodeFormBody(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    const key = prefix ? `${prefix}[${k}]` : k;
    if (typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) {
      const nested = encodeFormBody(v as Record<string, unknown>, key);
      if (nested) parts.push(nested);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
    }
  }
  return parts.join('&');
}

async function stripePost(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: encodeFormBody(body),
  });

  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

async function stripeGet(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, { method: 'GET', headers });
  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }
  try {
    return await handleRequest(req);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error('[stripe-create-subscription] unhandled:', msg);
    return json({ error: { code: 'internal_error', message: msg } }, 500);
  }
});

async function handleRequest(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const stripeKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');
  if (!stripeKey) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Stripe not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const anonKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!;

  // ── Auth: verify caller JWT, role, and tenant ──────────────────────────────
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!callerToken) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Missing Authorization header' } }, 401);
  }

  const callerClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${callerToken}` } },
  });
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Invalid token' } }, 401);
  }

  // Only admin/owner may create subscriptions
  const userRole = (user.app_metadata?.app_role as string | undefined)
    ?? (user.user_metadata?.app_role as string | undefined)
    ?? '';
  if (userRole !== 'admin' && userRole !== 'owner') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'Admin or owner role required' } }, 403);
  }

  // Tenant isolation: read tenant_id from the JWT payload.
  // The Custom Access Token Hook injects tenant_id as a top-level JWT claim —
  // it is NOT stored in raw_app_meta_data, so auth.getUser() does NOT surface
  // it in user.app_metadata. Decode the token payload directly (signature was
  // already verified by auth.getUser() above).
  const callerTenantId: string = (() => {
    try {
      const parts = callerToken.split('.');
      if (parts.length < 2) return '';
      const b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
      const payload = JSON.parse(atob(b64)) as Record<string, unknown>;
      return (payload.tenant_id as string | undefined)
        ?? (user.app_metadata?.tenant_id as string | undefined)
        ?? '';
    } catch {
      return (user.app_metadata?.tenant_id as string | undefined) ?? '';
    }
  })();
  if (!callerTenantId) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'forbidden', message: 'No tenant in token — re-authenticate' } }, 403);
  }

  let body: { membership_id?: string; stripe_promotion_code_id?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return json({ error: { code: 'bad_json', message: 'Invalid request body' } }, 400);
  }

  const { membership_id, stripe_promotion_code_id } = body;
  if (!membership_id) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'missing_param', message: 'membership_id required' } }, 422);
  }

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // Load membership + family + location + tenant.
  // The query is scoped to BOTH membership_id AND the caller's tenant_id,
  // ensuring a user from Tenant B cannot act on Tenant A's memberships.
  const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, plan_name, plan_type, status, amount_cents, billing_anchor_day,
      stripe_subscription_id, stripe_price_id, tenant_id, family_id, kid_id,
      families!inner(id, stripe_connected_customer_id, primary_location_id),
      kids(first_name, last_name)
    `)
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', callerTenantId)
    .single();

  if (memErr || !mem) {
    console.error('[stripe-create-subscription] membership query failed', {
      membership_id,
      callerTenantId,
      errCode: memErr?.code,
      errMsg: memErr?.message,
    });
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_found', message: 'Membership not found or access denied' } }, 404);
  }

  // Only EFT memberships get subscriptions
  if (mem.plan_type !== 'eft') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'not_applicable', message: 'Subscriptions only apply to EFT memberships' } }, 422);
  }

  // stripe_connected_customer_id is the connected-account customer (separate from
  // stripe_customer_id which is the platform-account customer for store checkout).
  const fam = mem.families as unknown as { id: string; stripe_connected_customer_id: string | null; primary_location_id: string };
  const kid = mem.kids as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null };

  if (!fam.stripe_connected_customer_id) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'no_payment_method', message: 'Family has no saved payment method on the connected account. Use stripe-setup-intent first.' } }, 422);
  }

  // ── Load location stripe account (must come before any Stripe calls) ────────
  // Resolves connectedAccountId, which is required for all subsequent Stripe API
  // requests. No tenant_id filter needed — location is looked up via the family's
  // primary_location_id which was itself validated through the tenant-scoped
  // membership query above.
  const { data: location, error: locErr } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('id, stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status')
    .eq('id', fam.primary_location_id)
    .single();

  if (locErr || !location || !location.stripe_account_id) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'location_not_connected', message: 'Location Stripe account not configured' } }, 422);
  }

  if (location.stripe_onboarding_status !== 'connected') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'location_not_connected', message: 'Location Stripe account not fully set up' } }, 422);
  }

  const connectedAccountId = location.stripe_account_id as string;

  // ── Verify customer has at least one usable payment method ─────────────────
  // stripe_connected_customer_id is created during setup-intent flow but the
  // card is only attached after the SetupIntent confirms. Attempting subscription
  // creation with no attached card produces an immediate Stripe error — we surface
  // an actionable message instead of letting that propagate as a generic failure.
  // connectedAccountId must be resolved before this call (done above).
  {
    const pmRes = await fetch(
      `https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers/${fam.stripe_connected_customer_id}/payment_methods?type=card&limit=1`,
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${stripeKey}`,
          'Stripe-Account': connectedAccountId,
          'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
        },
      },
    );
    if (!pmRes.ok) {
      const pmBody = await pmRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as { error?: { message?: string } };
      return json({ error: { code: 'stripe_error', message: pmBody.error?.message ?? `Could not verify payment methods (${pmRes.status})` } }, 502);
    }
    const pmData = await pmRes.json() as { data: unknown[] };
    if (!pmData.data || pmData.data.length === 0) {
      return json({ error: { code: 'no_payment_method', message: 'The customer has no attached card. Ask the family to add a payment method in the Ballpark app (Me → Payment Method) before activating billing.' } }, 422);
    }
  }

  // Idempotency: check existing subscription on Stripe
  if (mem.stripe_subscription_id) {
    try {
      const existing = await stripeGet(
        `subscriptions/${mem.stripe_subscription_id}`,
        stripeKey,
        connectedAccountId,
      );
      const subStatus = existing.status as string;
      if (subStatus === 'active' || subStatus === 'trialing' || subStatus === 'past_due') {
        console.log(`[stripe-create-subscription] already active sub=${mem.stripe_subscription_id}`);
        return json({
          subscription_id: existing.id,
          status: subStatus,
          current_period_end: existing.current_period_end,
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // Subscription doesn't exist on Stripe; fall through to create a new one
    }
  }

  // Load tenant royalty config for application_fee_percent.
  // For subscriptions, Stripe requires application_fee_percent (a percentage)
  // so it can apply the platform fee on every renewal invoice automatically.
  // (PaymentIntents use application_fee_amount in cents; subscriptions use percent.)
  const { data: tenant } = await supabase
    .from('tenants')
    .select('royalty_config')
    .eq('id', mem.tenant_id)
    .single();

  const royaltyConfig = (tenant?.royalty_config as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? {};
  const applicationFeePct = (royaltyConfig.fee_percent as number | undefined) ?? 6;

  // ── Canonical Price ID: plan-level lookup-or-create ──────────────────────
  // One canonical Stripe Price per (plan_name + amount_cents + connected account).
  // On first activation for a given plan, we create the Price and store it on
  // the membership row. Subsequent memberships on the SAME plan look up an
  // existing price from another row with the same plan_name + amount_cents +
  // primary_location_id, avoiding price sprawl across members on identical plans.
  let canonicalPriceId: string = (mem as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).stripe_price_id as string ?? '';

  if (canonicalPriceId) {
    // Verify the stored Price still exists and is active on the connected account
    try {
      const existingPrice = await stripeGet(`prices/${canonicalPriceId}`, stripeKey, connectedAccountId);
      if (existingPrice.active !== true) {
        canonicalPriceId = ''; // Price archived — fall through to plan-level lookup
      }
    } catch {
      canonicalPriceId = ''; // Price not found on Stripe — fall through
    }
  }

  if (!canonicalPriceId) {
    // Plan-level lookup: find another membership at the SAME LOCATION (connected account)
    // that already has a stripe_price_id. Filtering on primary_location_id ensures we only
    // reuse Prices that belong to the same connected Stripe account — a Price on account A
    // cannot be used on account B, so cross-account siblings would always fail validation
    // and cause unnecessary fallback price creation (price sprawl).
    const { data: siblingWithPrice } = await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('stripe_price_id, families!inner(primary_location_id)')
      .eq('tenant_id', mem.tenant_id)
      .eq('plan_name', mem.plan_name)
      .eq('amount_cents', mem.amount_cents)
      .eq('families.primary_location_id', fam.primary_location_id)
      .neq('id', membership_id)
      .not('stripe_price_id', 'is', null)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (siblingWithPrice?.stripe_price_id) {
      // Validate the sibling's price is still active on the connected account
      try {
        const sibPrice = await stripeGet(
          `prices/${siblingWithPrice.stripe_price_id}`,
          stripeKey,
          connectedAccountId,
        );
        if (sibPrice.active === true) {
          canonicalPriceId = siblingWithPrice.stripe_price_id as string;
          console.log(`[stripe-create-subscription] reusing plan-level price=${canonicalPriceId} for plan=${mem.plan_name}`);
        }
      } catch {
        // Sibling price not found or not active — create fresh below
      }
    }
  }

  if (!canonicalPriceId) {
    // Create a new canonical Price on the connected account for this plan.
    const newPrice = await stripePost('prices', stripeKey, {
      unit_amount: mem.amount_cents,
      currency: 'usd',
      recurring: { interval: 'month' },
      product_data: { name: mem.plan_name },
      metadata: {
        tenant_id: mem.tenant_id,
        plan_name: mem.plan_name,
      },
    }, connectedAccountId);

    canonicalPriceId = newPrice.id as string;
    console.log(`[stripe-create-subscription] created plan-level price=${canonicalPriceId} plan=${mem.plan_name}`);
  }

  // Persist the canonical Price ID on this membership row (enables plan-level
  // reuse for the next member on this same plan).
  await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .update({ stripe_price_id: canonicalPriceId, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', callerTenantId);

  // Build subscription params.
  // application_fee_percent lets Stripe apply the platform royalty percentage
  // to every renewal invoice automatically. on_behalf_of is intentionally
  // omitted — the subscription is already created directly on the connected
  // account via the Stripe-Account header; setting on_behalf_of to the same
  // account causes Stripe to reject with "cannot be set to your own account".
  const subParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
    customer: fam.stripe_connected_customer_id,
    'items[0][price]': canonicalPriceId,
    'off_session': 'true',
    'payment_behavior': 'default_incomplete',
    'application_fee_percent': applicationFeePct,
    'metadata[membership_id]': mem.id,
    'metadata[tenant_id]': mem.tenant_id,
    'metadata[kid_name]': [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
    'expand[0]': 'latest_invoice.payment_intent',
  };

  // Apply promotion code if provided (Stripe PromotionCode id, not coupon id).
  // promotion_code applies the discount to the first billing period.
  if (stripe_promotion_code_id) {
    subParams.promotion_code = stripe_promotion_code_id;
  }

  // Set billing_cycle_anchor if we have a billing_anchor_day
  if (mem.billing_anchor_day) {
    const now = new Date();
    const anchor = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), mem.billing_anchor_day);
    if (anchor <= now) {
      anchor.setMonth(anchor.getMonth() + 1);
    }
    subParams['billing_cycle_anchor'] = Math.floor(anchor.getTime() / 1000);
    subParams['proration_behavior'] = 'none';
  }

  const subscription = await stripePost('subscriptions', stripeKey, subParams, connectedAccountId);

  const currentPeriodEnd = subscription.current_period_end as number;
  const nextBillingAt = new Date(currentPeriodEnd * 1000).toISOString();
  const stripeStatus = subscription.status as string;

  // Map Stripe subscription status → DB membership status.
  // We do NOT unconditionally force 'active' because the first invoice may be
  // incomplete/past_due (e.g., card requires authentication or first charge fails).
  // The webhook will reconcile status further as events arrive, but we start with
  // an accurate status based on what Stripe actually returned.
  let dbStatus: string;
  if (stripeStatus === 'active' || stripeStatus === 'trialing') {
    dbStatus = 'active';
  } else if (stripeStatus === 'incomplete' || stripeStatus === 'past_due') {
    dbStatus = 'payment_overdue';
  } else {
    // incomplete_expired, unpaid, cancelled, etc.
    dbStatus = 'payment_overdue';
  }

  // Persist subscription_id + next_billing_at to the membership (tenant-scoped for safety)
  const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .update({
      stripe_subscription_id: subscription.id as string,
      next_billing_at: nextBillingAt,
      status: dbStatus,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', callerTenantId);

  if (updateErr) {
    console.error(`[stripe-create-subscription] DB update failed: ${updateErr.message}`);
    // Don't fail — subscription was created, just log
  }

  console.log(`[stripe-create-subscription] created sub=${subscription.id} membership=${membership_id} tenant=${callerTenantId}`);

  return json({
    subscription_id: subscription.id,
    status: subscription.status,
    current_period_end: currentPeriodEnd,
    next_billing_at: nextBillingAt,
  });
}
