// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/stripe-setup-intent/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #189 — Stripe Connect Phase 3: Payment method capture for subscriptions
//
// Auth model: Standard Supabase JWT required (parent role).
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy stripe-setup-intent
//
// Required Supabase secrets:
//   STRIPE_SECRET_KEY              (sk_live_... or sk_test_...)
//   SUPABASE_URL                   (auto-injected)
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY      (auto-injected)
//
// Request body (JSON):
//   {} (empty — family derived from JWT)
//
// Returns:
//   { setup_intent_client_secret, customer_id, ephemeral_key_secret }
//
// Design notes:
//   - Creates or reuses a Stripe Customer on the location's connected account.
//     Customer ID is stored in families.stripe_customer_id for reuse.
//   - Returns a SetupIntent client secret + ephemeral key so the mobile client
//     can present stripe-react-native's initPaymentSheet to save the card.
//   - The saved payment method is then usable by stripe-create-subscription.
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    },
  });
}

function encodeFormBody(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    const key = prefix ? `${prefix}[${k}]` : k;
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      for (const item of v) {
        parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}[]=${encodeURIComponent(String(item))}`);
      }
    } else if (typeof v === 'object') {
      const nested = encodeFormBody(v as Record<string, unknown>, key);
      if (nested) parts.push(nested);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
    }
  }
  return parts.join('&');
}

async function stripePost(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: encodeFormBody(body),
  });

  const text = await res.text();
  let data: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`Stripe returned non-JSON (${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

async function stripeGet(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  stripeAccountId?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
  };
  if (stripeAccountId) headers['Stripe-Account'] = stripeAccountId;

  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, { method: 'GET', headers });
  const text = await res.text();
  let data: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`Stripe returned non-JSON (${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(err?.message ?? `Stripe error ${res.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, {
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type',
      },
    });
  }

  try {
    return await handleRequest(req);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error('[stripe-setup-intent] unhandled error:', msg);
    return json({ error: { code: 'internal_error', message: msg } }, 500);
  }
});

async function handleRequest(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const stripeKey = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY');
  if (!stripeKey) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Stripe not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const anonKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!;

  // Verify caller JWT
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '';
  const callerToken = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (!callerToken) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Missing Authorization header' } }, 401);
  }

  const callerClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, {
    global: { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${callerToken}` } },
  });
  const { data: { user }, error: authErr } = await callerClient.auth.getUser();
  if (authErr || !user) {
    return json({ error: { code: 'unauthorized', message: 'Invalid token' } }, 401);
  }

  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  // Look up the family + location
  const { data: family, error: famErr } = await supabase
    .from('families')
    .select('id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email, stripe_connected_customer_id, stripe_customer_id, primary_location_id')
    .eq('parent_user_id', user.id)
    .single();

  if (famErr || !family) {
    console.error('[stripe-setup-intent] family lookup failed:', famErr?.message, 'user_id:', user.id);
    return json({ error: { code: 'family_not_found', message: 'Family record not found' } }, 404);
  }

  const { data: location } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('id, stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status')
    .eq('id', family.primary_location_id)
    .single();

  // Use connected account when fully onboarded; fall back to platform account
  // for dev/test environments where Stripe Connect hasn't been configured.
  const useConnected = !!(
    location?.stripe_account_id &&
    location?.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected'
  );
  const connectedAccountId: string | undefined = useConnected
    ? (location!.stripe_account_id as string)
    : undefined;

  // Pick the right stored customer ID column
  const familyAny = family as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  let customerId: string | null = useConnected
    ? (familyAny.stripe_connected_customer_id as string | null ?? null)
    : (familyAny.stripe_customer_id as string | null ?? null);

  if (customerId) {
    // Verify the customer still exists on the target account
    try {
      await stripeGet(`customers/${customerId}`, stripeKey, connectedAccountId);
    } catch {
      customerId = null; // Customer doesn't exist, create fresh
    }
  }

  if (!customerId) {
    const parentName = [family.parent_first_name, family.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    const customer = await stripePost('customers', stripeKey, {
      name: parentName || undefined,
      email: family.parent_email || undefined,
      metadata: { family_id: family.id },
    }, connectedAccountId);

    customerId = customer.id as string;

    // Persist to the appropriate column
    const col = useConnected ? 'stripe_connected_customer_id' : 'stripe_customer_id';
    await supabase
      .from('families')
      .update({ [col]: customerId, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', family.id);
  }

  // Create ephemeral key for the payment sheet
  const ephemeralKey = await stripePost('ephemeral_keys', stripeKey, {
    customer: customerId,
  }, connectedAccountId);

  // Create SetupIntent
  const setupIntent = await stripePost('setup_intents', stripeKey, {
    customer: customerId,
    payment_method_types: ['card'],
    usage: 'off_session',
    metadata: { family_id: family.id },
  }, connectedAccountId);

  console.log(`[stripe-setup-intent] family=${family.id} customer=${customerId} si=${setupIntent.id} connected=${useConnected}`);

  return json({
    setup_intent_client_secret: setupIntent.client_secret,
    customer_id: customerId,
    ephemeral_key_secret: (ephemeralKey.secret as string),
    stripe_account_id: connectedAccountId ?? null,
  });
}

// =============================================================================
// supabase/functions/stripe-webhook/index.ts
// =============================================================================
// Task #188 — Stripe Connect Phase 1
// Task #72  — Stripe Connect Phase 2 (payment_intent fulfillment)
// Task #189 — Stripe Connect Phase 3 (subscription lifecycle)
//
// Auth model: NO Supabase JWT on this endpoint. Authentication is the
// Stripe-Signature header verified against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET using
// Stripe's HMAC-SHA256 scheme with a 300-second replay window.
//
// Deploy with:
//   npx supabase functions deploy stripe-webhook --no-verify-jwt
//
// Required Supabase secrets:
//   STRIPE_SECRET_KEY      (sk_live_... or sk_test_...)
//   STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET  (whsec_... from Stripe Dashboard → Webhooks)
//   RESEND_API_KEY         (for dunning emails on invoice.payment_failed)
//   RESEND_FROM_EMAIL      (from address for dunning emails)
//   SUPABASE_URL           (auto-injected)
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (auto-injected)
//
// Handled events:
//   account.updated                   → sync stripe_onboarding_status on locations
//   payment_intent.succeeded          → mark order 'ordered' + record amount_paid_cents
//   payment_intent.payment_failed     → mark order payment_failed + log reason
//   payment_intent.canceled           → mark order 'cancelled' (user dismissed sheet)
//   customer.subscription.created     → set membership active + next_billing_at
//   invoice.payment_succeeded         → insert paid payment_events, mark membership active
//   invoice.payment_failed            → insert failed payment_events, set payment_overdue,
//                                       send Resend dunning email with app deep link
//   customer.subscription.deleted     → mark membership cancelled
//
// Idempotency model for invoice events:
//   payment_events.stripe_invoice_id is a non-unique index.
//   Before each insert we check for an existing row with the SAME
//   (stripe_invoice_id, status). This allows:
//     - Multiple failed rows for different retry attempts (different attempt_count)
//     - A paid row for a recovered invoice that previously had a failed row
//   The unique-per-attempt constraint is enforced by checking both invoice_id and
//   the error_code (which encodes the attempt number for failed events).
//
// All unrecognised events → 200 {ignored:true} so Stripe stops retrying.
// =============================================================================

import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const REPLAY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 300;

// ─── HMAC-SHA256 signature verification ──────────────────────────────────────

async function verifyStripeSignature(
  rawBody: string,
  signatureHeader: string,
  secret: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const parts = signatureHeader.split(',');
  let timestamp = '';
  const signatures: string[] = [];

  for (const part of parts) {
    const [k, v] = part.split('=');
    if (k === 't') timestamp = v;
    if (k === 'v1') signatures.push(v);
  }

  if (!timestamp || signatures.length === 0) return false;

  const ts = parseInt(timestamp, 10);
  if (isNaN(ts)) return false;

  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  if (Math.abs(now - ts) > REPLAY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS) return false;

  const payload = `${timestamp}.${rawBody}`;
  const enc = new TextEncoder();

  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw',
    enc.encode(secret),
    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    false,
    ['sign'],
  );

  const mac = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, enc.encode(payload));
  const expected = Array.from(new Uint8Array(mac))
    .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    .join('');

  return signatures.some(sig => {
    if (sig.length !== expected.length) return false;
    let diff = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < sig.length; i++) {
      diff |= sig.charCodeAt(i) ^ expected.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return diff === 0;
  });
}

// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function json(body: unknown, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  });
}

// ─── Onboarding status mapping ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function deriveOnboardingStatus(account: {
  charges_enabled?: boolean;
  payouts_enabled?: boolean;
  requirements?: { disabled_reason?: string | null };
}): 'not_connected' | 'pending' | 'connected' | 'restricted' {
  if (account.charges_enabled && account.payouts_enabled) return 'connected';
  if (account.requirements?.disabled_reason) return 'restricted';
  return 'pending';
}

// ─── Dunning email via Resend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function sendDunningEmail(opts: {
  toEmail: string;
  parentName: string;
  planName: string;
  amountCents: number;
  resendApiKey: string;
  resendFromEmail: string;
}) {
  const amountStr = `$${(opts.amountCents / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
  // Deep link opens the Payment Method screen directly in the Ballpark app
  const appDeepLink = 'ballpark://me/payment-method';

    `Hi ${opts.parentName},`,

    `Open the Ballpark app → Me → Payment Method`,
    '',
    `Or tap this link on your phone: ${appDeepLink}`,

    'If payment is not resolved within 7 days, your membership may be paused.',

    'Questions? Reply to this email or contact your facility directly.',
  ].join('\n');

  const body = {
    from: opts.resendFromEmail,
    to: opts.toEmail,
    subject: 'Action required: update your payment method',
    text: plainText,
    html: `
      <div style="font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; color: #1a1a1a;">

        <div style="padding: 32px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-top: none; border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;">
          <h2 style="font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #c0392b;">
            Payment failed — action needed
          </h2>
          <p>Hi ${opts.parentName},</p>
          <p>We were unable to process your <strong>${opts.planName}</strong> membership payment of

          <p style="margin: 20px 0;">
            <strong>Fix it in 30 seconds:</strong> Tap the button below to open the Ballpark app
            and update your payment card in <strong>Me → Payment Method</strong>.
          </p>
          <div style="text-align: center; margin: 24px 0;">
            <a href="${appDeepLink}"
               style="display: inline-block; background: #d4a843; color: #1a1a1a;
                      font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; padding: 14px 28px;
                      border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">
              Update Payment Method →
            </a>
          </div>
          <p style="color: #666; font-size: 13px;">
            If the button above doesn't open the app, open Ballpark and go to

      method: 'POST',

        'Authorization': `Bearer ${opts.resendApiKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const errText = await res.text();
      console.error(`[stripe-webhook] Resend dunning email failed: ${res.status} ${errText}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] Dunning email sent to ${opts.toEmail}`);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[stripe-webhook] Resend dunning email exception:', err);
  }
}

// ─── Main handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    return json({ error: { code: 'method_not_allowed', message: 'POST only' } }, 405);
  }

  const webhookSecret = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET');
  if (!webhookSecret) {
    console.error('[stripe-webhook] STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set');
    return json({ error: { code: 'config_error', message: 'Webhook secret not configured' } }, 500);
  }

  const rawBody = await req.text();
  const signatureHeader = req.headers.get('stripe-signature') ?? '';

  const valid = await verifyStripeSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret);
  if (!valid) {
    console.warn('[stripe-webhook] Signature verification failed');
    return json({ error: { code: 'invalid_signature', message: 'Stripe-Signature verification failed' } }, 401);
  }

  let event: { type: string; account?: string; data: { object: Record<string, unknown> } };
  try {
    event = JSON.parse(rawBody);
  } catch {
    return json({ error: { code: 'bad_json', message: 'Could not parse event body' } }, 400);
  }

  // The connected account that generated this event (set by Stripe on Connect webhooks).
  // Used to verify that subscription lifecycle events actually came from the same
  // Stripe account as the membership's location — preventing cross-tenant webhook injection.
  const eventAccount = event.account ?? null;

  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);

  console.log(`[stripe-webhook] event=${event.type}`);

  // ── account.updated ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (event.type === 'account.updated') {
    const account = event.data.object as {
      id: string;
      charges_enabled?: boolean;
      payouts_enabled?: boolean;
      business_profile?: { name?: string };
      settings?: {
        dashboard?: { display_name?: string };
        payouts?: { schedule?: { interval?: string; monthly_anchor?: number; weekly_anchor?: string } };
      };
      email?: string;
      requirements?: { disabled_reason?: string | null };
    };

    const status = deriveOnboardingStatus(account);
    const accountName =
      account.business_profile?.name ??
      account.settings?.dashboard?.display_name ??
      account.email ??
      null;

    let payoutInterval: string | null = null;
    const schedule = account.settings?.payouts?.schedule;
    if (schedule?.interval) {
      if (schedule.interval === 'daily') payoutInterval = 'Daily';
      else if (schedule.interval === 'weekly') payoutInterval = `Weekly (${schedule.weekly_anchor ?? 'Friday'})`;
      else if (schedule.interval === 'monthly') payoutInterval = `Monthly (${schedule.monthly_anchor ?? 1}st)`;
      else payoutInterval = schedule.interval;
    }

    const updates: Record<string, string | null> = {
      stripe_onboarding_status: status,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    if (accountName) updates.stripe_account_name = accountName;
    if (payoutInterval) updates.stripe_payout_interval = payoutInterval;

    const { error: dbErr } = await supabase
      .from('locations')
      .update(updates)
      .eq('stripe_account_id', account.id);

    if (dbErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] account.updated DB error:', dbErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: dbErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    console.log(`[stripe-webhook] account.updated → ${account.id} status=${status}`);
    return json({ ok: true });
  }

  // ── payment_intent.succeeded ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (event.type === 'payment_intent.succeeded') {
    const pi = event.data.object as {
      id: string;
      amount: number;
      currency: string;
      amount_received?: number;
    };

    const amountCents = pi.amount_received ?? pi.amount;

    const { data: order, error: findErr } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .select('id, status, payment_method, product_id')
      .eq('stripe_payment_intent_id', pi.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (findErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.succeeded find error:', findErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: findErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (!order) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.succeeded: no order for pi=${pi.id}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'No order found for this PaymentIntent' });
    }

    if (order.status === 'ordered' || order.status === 'fulfilled') {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.succeeded: order=${order.id} already ${order.status}`);
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    const allowedFromStatuses = ['payment_pending', 'payment_failed'];
    if (!allowedFromStatuses.includes(order.status)) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.succeeded: order=${order.id} in terminal status ${order.status}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    const { data: updated, error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .update({
        status: 'ordered',
        amount_paid_cents: amountCents,
        failure_reason: null,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', order.id)
      .in('status', allowedFromStatuses)
      .select('id')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (updateErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.succeeded update error:', updateErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: updateErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (!updated) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.succeeded: order=${order.id} already transitioned by concurrent delivery`);
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.succeeded → order=${order.id} ordered amount=${amountCents}`);
    return json({ ok: true });
  }

  // ── payment_intent.payment_failed ─────────────────────────────────────────
  if (event.type === 'payment_intent.payment_failed') {
    const pi = event.data.object as {
      id: string;
      last_payment_error?: {
        code?: string;
        message?: string;
        decline_code?: string;
      };
    };

    const failureReason =
      pi.last_payment_error?.message ??
      pi.last_payment_error?.code ??
      'Card declined';

    const { data: order, error: findErr } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .select('id, status, product_id')
      .eq('stripe_payment_intent_id', pi.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (findErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.payment_failed find error:', findErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: findErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (!order) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.payment_failed: no order for pi=${pi.id}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'No order found for this PaymentIntent' });
    }

    if (order.status === 'payment_failed') {
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    if (order.status !== 'payment_pending') {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.payment_failed: order=${order.id} in non-pending status ${order.status}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    const { data: failedUpdate, error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .update({
        status: 'payment_failed',
        failure_reason: failureReason,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', order.id)
      .eq('status', 'payment_pending')
      .select('id')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (updateErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.payment_failed update error:', updateErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: updateErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (failedUpdate && order.product_id) {
      const { error: restoreErr } = await supabase.rpc('restore_product_inventory', {
        p_product_id: order.product_id,
      });
      if (restoreErr) {
        console.error(`[stripe-webhook] restore_product_inventory (payment_failed) failed for product=${order.product_id}:`, restoreErr.message);
      }
    }

    console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.payment_failed → order=${order.id} reason="${failureReason}"`);
    return json({ ok: true });
  }

  // ── payment_intent.canceled ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (event.type === 'payment_intent.canceled') {
    const pi = event.data.object as { id: string };

    const { data: order, error: findErr } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .select('id, status, product_id')
      .eq('stripe_payment_intent_id', pi.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (findErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.canceled find error:', findErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: findErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (!order) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.canceled: no order for pi=${pi.id}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'No order found for this PaymentIntent' });
    }

    if (order.status === 'cancelled') {
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    if (order.status !== 'payment_pending') {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.canceled: order=${order.id} in non-pending status ${order.status}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    const { data: cancelledUpdate, error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .update({
        status: 'cancelled',
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', order.id)
      .eq('status', 'payment_pending')
      .select('id')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (updateErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.canceled update error:', updateErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: updateErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (cancelledUpdate && order.product_id) {
      const { error: restoreErr } = await supabase.rpc('restore_product_inventory', {
        p_product_id: order.product_id,
      });
      if (restoreErr) {
        console.error(`[stripe-webhook] restore_product_inventory (canceled) failed for product=${order.product_id}:`, restoreErr.message);
      }
    }

    console.log(`[stripe-webhook] payment_intent.canceled → order=${order.id} cancelled`);
    return json({ ok: true });
  }

  // ── customer.subscription.created ────────────────────────────────────────
  // Fires when a subscription is first activated (including when created via
  // our stripe-create-subscription edge function). Marks the membership active
  // and records the first billing cycle end as next_billing_at.
  if (event.type === 'customer.subscription.created') {
    const sub = event.data.object as {
      id: string;
      status: string;
      customer: string;
      current_period_end?: number;
      metadata?: Record<string, string>;
    };

    const membershipId = sub.metadata?.membership_id;
    if (!membershipId) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] subscription.created: no membership_id in metadata, ignoring sub=${sub.id}`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'No membership_id in subscription metadata' });
    }

    // Fetch the membership + location to verify the event account matches.
    // This prevents a malicious/compromised connected account from injecting events
    // with a different tenant's membership_id in the subscription metadata.
    const { data: memForVerify } = await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, families!inner(primary_location_id)')
      .eq('id', membershipId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (memForVerify && eventAccount) {
      const famVerify = memForVerify.families as unknown as { primary_location_id: string };
      const { data: locVerify } = await supabase
        .from('locations')
        .select('stripe_account_id')
        .eq('id', famVerify.primary_location_id)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (locVerify?.stripe_account_id && locVerify.stripe_account_id !== eventAccount) {
        console.warn(`[stripe-webhook] subscription.created SECURITY: event account ${eventAccount} ≠ location ${locVerify.stripe_account_id} for membership=${membershipId} — rejecting`);
        return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'Connected account mismatch' });
      }
    }

    const nextBillingAt = sub.current_period_end
      ? new Date(sub.current_period_end * 1000).toISOString()
      : null;

    // Map Stripe subscription status → DB membership status.
    // Do not force 'active' unconditionally: Stripe may return incomplete/past_due
    // on the created event if the first invoice requires authentication or fails.
    // The invoice.payment_succeeded / invoice.payment_failed events will reconcile
    // further, but we start with an accurate status from Stripe.
    let subDbStatus: string;
    if (sub.status === 'active' || sub.status === 'trialing') {
      subDbStatus = 'active';
    } else if (sub.status === 'incomplete' || sub.status === 'past_due' || sub.status === 'unpaid') {
      subDbStatus = 'payment_overdue';
    } else {
      subDbStatus = 'payment_overdue';
    }

    const { error: updErr } = await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .update({
        stripe_subscription_id: sub.id,
        status: subDbStatus,
        next_billing_at: nextBillingAt,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', membershipId);

    if (updErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] subscription.created update error:', updErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: updErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    console.log(`[stripe-webhook] subscription.created → membership=${membershipId} sub=${sub.id} stripe_status=${sub.status} db_status=${subDbStatus}`);
    return json({ ok: true });
  }

  // ── invoice.payment_succeeded / invoice.paid ──────────────────────────────
  // Both events fire when a subscription invoice is successfully charged.
  // `invoice.payment_succeeded` is the older event name; `invoice.paid` is
  // the preferred name in current Stripe docs. We handle both so that the
  // payment_failed_at flag is cleared and the membership re-activates
  // regardless of which event is configured in the Stripe dashboard webhook.
  //
  // Insert a paid payment_events row (if not already present for this
  // invoice+status), ensure membership is active, update next_billing_at,
  // and clear payment_failed_at so in-app banners disappear.
  //
  // Idempotency: check (stripe_invoice_id, status='paid') before inserting.
  // This allows a prior failed row for the same invoice to coexist — the family
  // got their card declined (failed row), fixed it, and was then charged
  // successfully (paid row). Both rows are legitimate history.
  if (event.type === 'invoice.payment_succeeded' || event.type === 'invoice.paid') {
    const invoice = event.data.object as {
      id: string;
      subscription?: string;
      customer: string;
      amount_paid: number;
      currency: string;
      period_end?: number;
    };

    // Only care about subscription invoices
    if (!invoice.subscription) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_succeeded: no subscription, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true });
    }

    // Look up the membership by stripe_subscription_id (include location for account verification)
    const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, tenant_id, family_id, status, families!inner(primary_location_id)')
      .eq('stripe_subscription_id', invoice.subscription)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (memErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_succeeded mem lookup error:', memErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: memErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (!mem) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_succeeded: no membership for sub=${invoice.subscription}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true });
    }

    // Verify the event's connected account matches the membership's location's Stripe account.
    if (eventAccount) {
      const famSucc = mem.families as unknown as { primary_location_id: string };
      const { data: locSucc } = await supabase
        .from('locations')
        .select('stripe_account_id')
        .eq('id', famSucc.primary_location_id)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (locSucc?.stripe_account_id && locSucc.stripe_account_id !== eventAccount) {
        console.warn(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_succeeded SECURITY: event account ${eventAccount} ≠ location ${locSucc.stripe_account_id} membership=${mem.id} — rejecting`);
        return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'Connected account mismatch' });
      }
    }

    // Idempotency: check for an existing PAID row for this invoice.
    // We specifically check status='paid' to allow a prior failed row
    // to coexist (payment retry scenario).
    const { data: existingPaid } = await supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('id')
      .eq('stripe_invoice_id', invoice.id)
      .eq('status', 'paid')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (existingPaid) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_succeeded: paid row already exists invoice=${invoice.id}`);
      // Still update membership status + next_billing_at + clear payment_failed_at
      // in case a prior webhook fired early.
      await supabase
        .from('memberships')
        .update({
          status: 'active',
          payment_failed_at: null,
          next_billing_at: invoice.period_end ? new Date(invoice.period_end * 1000).toISOString() : null,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('id', mem.id);
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    // Insert paid payment_events row
    const nextBillingAt = invoice.period_end
      ? new Date(invoice.period_end * 1000).toISOString()
      : null;

    const { error: insertErr } = await supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .insert({
        tenant_id: mem.tenant_id,
        family_id: mem.family_id,
        membership_id: mem.id,
        amount_cents: invoice.amount_paid,
        status: 'paid',
        payment_method: 'card',
        stripe_invoice_id: invoice.id,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

    if (insertErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_succeeded insert error:', insertErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: insertErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    // Ensure membership is active (recovers from payment_overdue) + update next_billing_at.
    // Clear payment_failed_at so in-app banners disappear immediately.
    await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .update({
        status: 'active',
        payment_failed_at: null,
        next_billing_at: nextBillingAt,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', mem.id);

    console.log(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_succeeded → membership=${mem.id} invoice=${invoice.id} amount=${invoice.amount_paid}`);
    return json({ ok: true });
  }

  // ── invoice.payment_failed ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // A subscription renewal charge failed. Insert a failed payment_events row
  // (idempotent per attempt via stripe_invoice_id + error_code), set membership
  // to payment_overdue, and send a Resend dunning email with a deep link.
  //
  // Idempotency per attempt: each Stripe retry has a unique attempt_count.
  // We store attempt_N in error_code and check (stripe_invoice_id + error_code)
  // before inserting, so the same retry attempt is never double-counted but
  // different retry attempts all get their own row.
  if (event.type === 'invoice.payment_failed') {
    const invoice = event.data.object as {
      id: string;
      subscription?: string;
      customer: string;
      amount_due: number;
      currency: string;
      attempt_count?: number;
      next_payment_attempt?: number | null;
    };

    if (!invoice.subscription) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_failed: no subscription, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true });
    }

    const attemptCode = `attempt_${invoice.attempt_count ?? 1}`;

    // Look up the membership (include location for account verification)
    const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, tenant_id, family_id, plan_name, status, families!inner(primary_location_id)')
      .eq('stripe_subscription_id', invoice.subscription)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (memErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_failed mem lookup error:', memErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: memErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (!mem) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_failed: no membership for sub=${invoice.subscription}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true });
    }

    // Verify the event's connected account matches the membership's location's Stripe account.
    if (eventAccount) {
      const famFail = mem.families as unknown as { primary_location_id: string };
      const { data: locFail } = await supabase
        .from('locations')
        .select('stripe_account_id')
        .eq('id', famFail.primary_location_id)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (locFail?.stripe_account_id && locFail.stripe_account_id !== eventAccount) {
        console.warn(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_failed SECURITY: event account ${eventAccount} ≠ location ${locFail.stripe_account_id} membership=${mem.id} — rejecting`);
        return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'Connected account mismatch' });
      }
    }

    // Idempotency: check for existing row with SAME (stripe_invoice_id, error_code/attempt).
    // Different attempts produce different error_codes, so retries each get their own row.
    const { data: existingAttempt } = await supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('id')
      .eq('stripe_invoice_id', invoice.id)
      .eq('error_code', attemptCode)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!existingAttempt) {
      const { error: insertErr } = await supabase
        .from('payment_events')
        .insert({
          tenant_id: mem.tenant_id,
          family_id: mem.family_id,
          membership_id: mem.id,
          amount_cents: invoice.amount_due,
          status: 'failed',
          payment_method: 'card',
          stripe_invoice_id: invoice.id,
          error_code: attemptCode,
          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        });

      if (insertErr) {
        console.error('[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_failed insert error:', insertErr.message);
        return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: insertErr.message } }, 500);
      }
    }

    // Mark membership as payment_overdue + stamp payment_failed_at (only if currently active).
    // Don't overwrite cancelled or already-overdue — but always stamp payment_failed_at so
    // the in-app banner appears regardless of which attempt this is.
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .update({
        status: 'payment_overdue',
        payment_failed_at: now,
        updated_at: now,
      })
      .eq('id', mem.id)
      .in('status', ['active', 'payment_overdue']);

    // Fan-out: push + email — best-effort via Promise.allSettled, never fail the webhook
    const resendApiKey = Deno.env.get('RESEND_API_KEY');
    const resendFromEmail = Deno.env.get('RESEND_FROM_EMAIL');

    const { data: family } = await supabase
      .from('families')
      .select('parent_first_name, parent_email, parent_user_id')
      .eq('id', mem.family_id)
      .single();

    const fanOutPromises: Promise<unknown>[] = [];

    // Push notification
    if (family?.parent_user_id) {
      fanOutPromises.push(
        fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            user_ids: [family.parent_user_id],
            title: 'Payment failed',
            body: 'Your autopay failed — tap to update your card.',
            data: { kind: 'payment_failed', screen: 'PaymentMethod' },
          }),
        }).catch(err => console.error('[stripe-webhook] push fan-out error:', err)),
      );
    }

    // Dunning email
    if (resendApiKey && resendFromEmail && family?.parent_email) {
      fanOutPromises.push(
        sendDunningEmail({
          toEmail: family.parent_email,
          parentName: family.parent_first_name ?? 'there',
          planName: mem.plan_name,
          amountCents: invoice.amount_due,
          resendApiKey,
          resendFromEmail,
        }).catch(err => console.error('[stripe-webhook] sendDunningEmail unexpected error:', err)),
      );
    }

    await Promise.allSettled(fanOutPromises);

    console.log(`[stripe-webhook] invoice.payment_failed → membership=${mem.id} invoice=${invoice.id} attempt=${invoice.attempt_count}`);
    return json({ ok: true });
  }

  // ── customer.subscription.deleted ─────────────────────────────────────────
  // Stripe has finalised the cancellation (either at period end after our
  // cancel_at_period_end request, or immediately after exhausting dunning
  // retries). Mark the membership as cancelled.
  if (event.type === 'customer.subscription.deleted') {
    const sub = event.data.object as {
      id: string;
      customer: string;
      metadata?: Record<string, string>;
    };

    const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, status, families!inner(primary_location_id)')
      .eq('stripe_subscription_id', sub.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (memErr) {
      console.error('[stripe-webhook] subscription.deleted lookup error:', memErr.message);
      return json({ error: { code: 'db_error', message: memErr.message } }, 500);
    }

    if (!mem) {
      console.log(`[stripe-webhook] subscription.deleted: no membership for sub=${sub.id}, ignoring`);
      return json({ ok: true, ignored: true });
    }

    // Verify the event's connected account matches the membership's location's Stripe account.
    if (eventAccount) {
      const famDel = mem.families as unknown as { primary_location_id: string };
      const { data: locDel } = await supabase
        .from('locations')
        .select('stripe_account_id')
        .eq('id', famDel.primary_location_id)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (locDel?.stripe_account_id && locDel.stripe_account_id !== eventAccount) {
        console.warn(`[stripe-webhook] subscription.deleted SECURITY: event account ${eventAccount} ≠ location ${locDel.stripe_account_id} membership=${mem.id} — rejecting`);
        return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'Connected account mismatch' });
      }
    }

    if (mem.status === 'cancelled') {
      return json({ ok: true });
    }

    await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .update({
        status: 'cancelled',
        cancelled_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', mem.id);

    console.log(`[stripe-webhook] subscription.deleted → membership=${mem.id} cancelled`);
    return json({ ok: true });
  }

  // ── All other events — acknowledge so Stripe stops retrying ───────────────
  console.log(`[stripe-webhook] ignored event type=${event.type}`);
  return json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: `Unhandled event type: ${event.type}` });
});

/**
 * Parent account deletion — calls the `account-delete` Edge Function.
 *
 * The function authenticates with the parent's JWT (verify-jwt = true)
 * and performs the COPPA/GDPR-compliant cascade:
 *   1. Outbound HitTrax RemoveThirdPartyAssociation for every active
 *      kid_capture_link (best-effort — never blocks deletion).
 *   2. Hard-deletes kid_capture_links rows.
 *   3. Deletes the auth user (FK cascade does the rest).
 *
 * On success the local session is invalidated; callers should
 * `await signOut()` immediately to flip RootNavigator back to SignIn.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

export type DeleteAccountResponse = {
  ok: true;
  hittrax_links_purged: number;
  kids_purged: number;
};

export async function deleteAccount(): Promise<DeleteAccountResponse> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke<DeleteAccountResponse>('account-delete', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: {},
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  if (!data?.ok) throw new Error('account-delete returned an unexpected response');
  return data;
}

/**
 * Achievements API helpers — catalog + per-kid earned log.
 *
 * The DB schema (migration 20260511000000) is the source of truth for
 * `achievements` and `kid_achievements`. Until the next type regen, the
 * supabase client is cast to `SupabaseClient` (the un-typed client) so
 * the table-name string literal compiles without `as any`.
 */

import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

export type Achievement = {
  id: string;
  key: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;
  points_bonus: number;
  sort_order: number;
};

export type KidAchievement = {
  id: string;
  tenant_id: string;
  kid_id: string;
  achievement_id: string;
  earned_at: string;
};

const sb: SupabaseClient = supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient;

export async function listAchievements(): Promise<Achievement[]> {
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('achievements')
    .select('id, key, name, description, icon, points_bonus, sort_order')
    .order('sort_order', { ascending: true });
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as Achievement[];
}

export async function listEarnedForKid(kidId: string): Promise<KidAchievement[]> {
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('kid_achievements')
    .select('id, tenant_id, kid_id, achievement_id, earned_at')
    .eq('kid_id', kidId)
    .order('earned_at', { ascending: false });
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as KidAchievement[];
}

FILE: src/api/assignments.ts

/**
 * Assignments API helpers for v0.6 Work.
 *
 * Reads use direct PostgREST against `public.assignments`; RLS narrows to
 * the caller's own family (parent) or the whole tenant (coach). Writes
 * that change state (`completeAssignment`, `reviewAssignment`) go through
 * SECURITY DEFINER RPCs so the points credit + state transition are
 * atomic and idempotent at the database level.
 *
 * `createAssignment` is a direct INSERT — RLS on assignments enforces
 * coach role + tenant pinning + cross-tenant FK smuggling defense, so
 * the client just supplies the row.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import type { Tables, TablesInsert } from '@/types/database';

export type Assignment = Tables<'assignments'>;
export type AssignmentStatus = Assignment['status'];

/**
 * Assignment row joined with the optional drill video (status + Mux
 * playback id) and the recipient kid label. Keeps the detail screen + the
 * coach Review list to a single fetch.
 */
export type AssignmentWithRefs = Assignment & {
  drill_video: Pick<Tables<'videos'>, 'id' | 'status' | 'mux_playback_id' | 'duration_seconds'> | null;
  kid: Pick<Tables<'kids'>, 'id' | 'first_name' | 'last_name'> | null;
};

const ASSIGNMENT_WITH_REFS_SELECT =
  '*, drill_video:videos(id, status, mux_playback_id, duration_seconds), kid:kids(id, first_name, last_name)';

/**
 * List assignments for the given kid, newest first. RLS already restricts
 * SELECT to the parent's own kids; the explicit `kid_id` filter lets the
 * planner use `idx_assignments_kid_status` when the optional `statuses`
 * filter is also supplied (e.g. Home only needs 'pending' so we don't
 * overfetch the kid's full historical list).
 */
export async function listAssignmentsForKid(
  kidId: string,
  statuses?: AssignmentStatus[],
): Promise<AssignmentWithRefs[]> {
  let q = supabase
    .from('assignments')
    .select(ASSIGNMENT_WITH_REFS_SELECT)
    .eq('kid_id', kidId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
  if (statuses && statuses.length > 0) {
    q = q.in('status', statuses);
  }
  const { data, error } = await q;
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as unknown as AssignmentWithRefs[];
}

/**
 * Single assignment lookup. Returns null when the row isn't visible (RLS)
 * or doesn't exist, so callers can render a friendly "not found" state.
 */
export async function getAssignment(id: string): Promise<AssignmentWithRefs | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('assignments')
    .select(ASSIGNMENT_WITH_REFS_SELECT)
    .eq('id', id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? null) as unknown as AssignmentWithRefs | null;
}

/**
 * List assignments owned by the caller (the coach who created them),
 * optionally filtered by status. We filter by `coach_user_id = auth.uid()`
 * client-side so the Review queue only surfaces drills the caller is
 * actually authorized to review — `review_assignment` is restricted to
 * the owning coach (see 20260506100300_v06_review_assignment_owning_coach_fix.sql),
 * so showing tenant-wide submitted rows would just produce avoidable
 * RPC failures in multi-coach tenants.
 *
 * RLS still scopes by tenant; the coach_user_id filter is an additional
 * narrowing so the UI matches the RPC's authorization contract.
 */
export async function listAssignmentsForCoach(
  status?: AssignmentStatus,
): Promise<AssignmentWithRefs[]> {
  const {
    data: { user },
    error: userErr,
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (userErr) throw userErr;
  if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');

  let q = supabase
    .from('assignments')
    .select(ASSIGNMENT_WITH_REFS_SELECT)
    .eq('coach_user_id', user.id)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
  if (status) q = q.eq('status', status);
  const { data, error } = await q;
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as unknown as AssignmentWithRefs[];
}

/**
 * Input shape for `createAssignment`. tenant_id + coach_user_id are
 * derived server-side from the caller's session + `public.coaches` row,
 * so callers can't smuggle mismatched values past the RLS WITH CHECK.
 */
export type CreateAssignmentInput = {
  kidId: string;
  familyId: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  drillVideoId: string | null;
  durationEstimateMinutes: number | null;
  dueDate: string | null; // ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  pointReward: number;
};

/**
 * Decode a single string claim from a JWT payload (base64url).
 * Used only to read custom claims (app_role, tenant_id) injected by the
 * access-token hook. Server-side RLS re-validates independently, so a
 * plain decode without re-verification is safe here.
 */
function jwtStringClaim(token: string | undefined | null, key: string): string | null {
  if (!token) return null;
  try {
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length < 2) return null;
    let b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const pad = b64.length % 4;
    if (pad) b64 += '='.repeat(4 - pad);
    const payload = JSON.parse(globalThis.atob(b64)) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const val = payload[key];
    return typeof val === 'string' ? val : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Insert a new assignment. Looks up the caller's tenant_id from
 * `public.coaches` so the RLS tenant pin matches. For admin / owner /
 * super_admin callers who have no row in `public.coaches`, falls back to
 * the tenant_id claim in the JWT (same value, different source).
 * Returns the freshly inserted row (with refs hydrated) so the caller can
 * prime its TanStack Query cache without a re-fetch.
 */
export async function createAssignment(
  input: CreateAssignmentInput,
): Promise<AssignmentWithRefs> {
  const {
    data: { user },
    error: userErr,
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (userErr) throw userErr;
  if (!user) throw new Error('You appear to be signed out. Sign back in and try again.');

  const { data: sessionData } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const accessToken = sessionData.session?.access_token;
  const appRole = jwtStringClaim(accessToken, 'app_role');
  const staffRoles = ['admin', 'owner', 'super_admin'];

  const { data: coach, error: coachErr } = await supabase
    .from('coaches')
    .select('tenant_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (coachErr) throw coachErr;

  // Admin / owner / super_admin users have no coaches row by design.
  // Fall back to the JWT tenant_id claim — the server enforces RLS using
  // the same claim, so pinning from JWT here is safe.
  const tenantId =
    coach?.tenant_id ?? (staffRoles.includes(appRole ?? '') ? jwtStringClaim(accessToken, 'tenant_id') : null);
  if (!tenantId) {
    throw new Error('Could not resolve tenant. Sign out, sign back in, and try again.');
  }

  const row: TablesInsert<'assignments'> = {
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    coach_user_id: user.id,
    kid_id: input.kidId,
    family_id: input.familyId,
    title: input.title,
    description: input.description,
    drill_video_id: input.drillVideoId,
    duration_estimate_minutes: input.durationEstimateMinutes,
    due_date: input.dueDate,
    point_reward: input.pointReward,
  };

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('assignments')
    .insert(row)
    .select(ASSIGNMENT_WITH_REFS_SELECT)
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data as unknown as AssignmentWithRefs;
}

export type CompleteAssignmentResult = {
  assignmentId: string;
  newBalance: number;
  pointsCredited: number;
};

/**
 * Wraps the `complete_assignment_for_kid` RPC. Server-side it locks the
 * assignment row, verifies ownership + status, flips status to
 * 'submitted', credits the configured points, and inserts the ledger
 * row. Idempotent via partial unique index on points_ledger.
 */
export async function completeAssignment(
  assignmentId: string,
): Promise<CompleteAssignmentResult> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('complete_assignment_for_kid', {
    p_assignment_id: assignmentId,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  const row = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data;
  if (!row) throw new Error('Completion returned no row');
  return {
    assignmentId: row.assignment_id,
    newBalance: row.new_balance,
    pointsCredited: row.points_credited,
  };
}

/**
 * Wraps the `review_assignment` RPC. Coach-only; flips status to
 * 'reviewed' with rating + feedback. Returns the updated row so the
 * coach UI can re-render without a re-fetch.
 */
export async function reviewAssignment(input: {
  assignmentId: string;
  rating: number;
  feedback: string | null;
}): Promise<Assignment> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('review_assignment', {
    p_assignment_id: input.assignmentId,
    p_rating: input.rating,
    p_feedback: input.feedback ?? '',
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  const row = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data;
  if (!row) throw new Error('Review returned no row');
  return row as Assignment;
}

/**
 * Auth API helpers.
 *
 * Thin wrappers around supabase.auth that bake in the v0.1 tenant_slug
 * convention: every signup must carry tenant_slug in user_metadata so
 * `public.handle_new_user` can resolve the tenant and provision a family row.
 *
 * Multi-tenant builds (EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG unset) pass tenant_slug at
 * call time via the LocationPickerScreen; single-tenant builds fall back to
 * the baked-in env var.
 */

import { queryClient } from '@/lib/queryClient';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { getEmailRedirectUrl } from '@/utils/authRedirect';

const DEFAULT_TENANT_SLUG = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG ?? '';

export type SignUpInput = {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  phone?: string;
  /** Override the baked-in tenant slug. Used by LocationPickerScreen. */
  tenantSlug?: string;
  /** The UUID of the location the parent selected. Used by LocationPickerScreen.
   *  When present, `handle_new_user` sets `families.primary_location_id`. */
  locationId?: string;
};

export async function signUpParent(input: SignUpInput) {
  const tenantSlug = input.tenantSlug ?? DEFAULT_TENANT_SLUG;
  if (!tenantSlug) {
    throw new Error('signUpParent: tenantSlug is required (no EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG set and none provided)');
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
    email: input.email.trim(),
    password: input.password,
    options: {
      // Tells Supabase where to send the parent after they tap the
      // confirmation link. The deep-link handler in `useAuth.tsx` picks up
      // the resulting `?code=...` and exchanges it for a session.
      emailRedirectTo: getEmailRedirectUrl(),
      data: {
        tenant_slug: tenantSlug,
        first_name: input.firstName.trim(),
        last_name: input.lastName.trim(),
        phone: input.phone?.trim() ?? null,
        ...(input.locationId ? { location_id: input.locationId } : {}),
      },
    },
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

/**
 * Re-send the Supabase signup confirmation email. Uses the same
 * `emailRedirectTo` as `signUpParent` so the deep-link round-trip works
 * identically — the parent taps the new email and lands back in the app
 * with a session.
 */
export async function resendConfirmationEmail(email: string) {
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.resend({
    type: 'signup',
    email: email.trim(),
    options: { emailRedirectTo: getEmailRedirectUrl() },
  });
  if (error) throw error;
}

export async function signInParent(email: string, password: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
    email: email.trim(),
    password,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

export async function signOut() {
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
  if (error) throw error;
  // Drop all cached queries so a subsequent sign-in never sees the
  // previous account's family/kids.
  queryClient.clear();
}

/**
 * Bookings API helpers.
 *
 * Thin Supabase select wrappers used by the Book tab. Tenant scoping is
 * enforced by RLS (see `session_types_select_tenant` in
 * `20260505050000_v03_bookings_schema.sql`), so we don't need to filter by
 * tenant_id client-side — the policy will only return rows the caller can see.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import type { Tables, TablesInsert } from '@/types/database';

export type SessionType = Tables<'session_types'>;
export type CoachAvailability = Tables<'coach_availability'>;
export type Location = Tables<'locations'>;
export type Booking = Tables<'bookings'>;
export type Coach = Tables<'coaches'>;
export type BookingInsert = TablesInsert<'bookings'>;

export async function listSessionTypes(): Promise<SessionType[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('session_types')
    .select('*')
    .eq('is_active', true)
    .order('type_category', { ascending: true })
    .order('name', { ascending: true });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data ?? [];
}

/**
 * Fetch coach_availability rows the caller can see (RLS scopes by tenant).
 * Returns recurring weekly windows; one row per coach + day_of_week.
 *
 * When `locationId` is provided, only returns availability for coaches that
 * are assigned to that location via the `coach_locations` junction table.
 * coach_availability has no location_id column, so we resolve the coach
 * set first, then filter availability by coach_id.
 *
 * coach_locations is a Phase 2 table not yet in generated database.ts types;
 * the untyped client is used for that query only.
 */
export async function listCoachAvailability(
  locationId?: string | null,
): Promise<CoachAvailability[]> {
  if (locationId) {
    // Resolve which coach_ids are assigned to this location.
    const { data: coachLocs, error: clErr } = await (
      supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
    )
      .from('coach_locations')
      .select('coach_id')
      .eq('location_id', locationId);
    if (clErr) throw clErr;

    const coachIds: string[] = (coachLocs ?? []).map(
      (r: { coach_id: string }) => r.coach_id,
    );
    if (coachIds.length === 0) return [];

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('coach_availability')
      .select('*')
      .in('coach_id', coachIds);
    if (error) throw error;
    return data ?? [];
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('coach_availability')
    .select('*');
  if (error) throw error;
  return data ?? [];
}

/**
 * Fetch all bookings whose `scheduled_start` falls within the half-open
 * range `[startISO, endISO)`. Cancelled / no-show rows are excluded since
 * they don't reserve time. Tenant scoping is enforced by RLS.
 */
export async function listDayBookings(
  startISO: string,
  endISO: string,
): Promise<Booking[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .select('*')
    .gte('scheduled_start', startISO)
    .lt('scheduled_start', endISO)
    .not('status', 'in', '("cancelled","no_show")');
  if (error) throw error;
  return data ?? [];
}

/**
 * Fetch active coaches the caller can see (RLS scopes by tenant).
 *
 * When `locationId` is provided, only coaches assigned to that location via
 * the `coach_locations` junction table are returned. A coach is visible at a
 * location regardless of which location is their primary — any assignment row
 * in coach_locations qualifies.
 *
 * coach_locations is a Phase 2 table not yet in generated database.ts types;
 * the untyped client is used for that query only.
 */
export async function listCoaches(locationId?: string | null): Promise<Coach[]> {
  if (locationId) {
    const { data: coachLocs, error: clErr } = await (
      supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
    )
      .from('coach_locations')
      .select('coach_id')
      .eq('location_id', locationId);
    if (clErr) throw clErr;

    const coachIds: string[] = (coachLocs ?? []).map(
      (r: { coach_id: string }) => r.coach_id,
    );
    if (coachIds.length === 0) return [];

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('coaches')
      .select('*')
      .eq('is_active', true)
      .in('id', coachIds)
      .order('first_name', { ascending: true });
    if (error) throw error;
    return data ?? [];
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('coaches')
    .select('*')
    .eq('is_active', true)
    .order('first_name', { ascending: true });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data ?? [];
}

/**
 * Insert a new booking row. RLS policies in
 * `20260505050000_v03_bookings_schema.sql` (and the harden migration) verify
 * tenant_id, kid_id ownership, and that coach/location/session_type all
 * belong to the same tenant. We pass `status: 'confirmed'` since v0.3 has no
 * payment step.
 */
export async function createBooking(input: BookingInsert): Promise<Booking> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .insert(input)
    .select('*')
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

/**
 * Booking row enriched with the related kid / coach / location names needed
 * to render a list row. RLS still scopes everything to the caller's tenant.
 */
export type FamilyBooking = Booking & {
  kid: Pick<Tables<'kids'>, 'id' | 'first_name' | 'last_name'> | null;
  coach: Pick<Tables<'coaches'>, 'id' | 'first_name' | 'last_name'> | null;
  location: Pick<Tables<'locations'>, 'id' | 'name'> | null;
  session_type:
    | Pick<Tables<'session_types'>, 'id' | 'name' | 'type_category' | 'duration_minutes'>
    | null;
};

const FAMILY_BOOKING_SELECT =
  'id, tenant_id, location_id, kid_id, coach_id, session_type_id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, cage_number, status, attended_at, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason, notes, created_at, updated_at, kid:kids(id, first_name, last_name), coach:coaches(id, first_name, last_name), location:locations(id, name), session_type:session_types(id, name, type_category, duration_minutes)';

/**
 * Fetch all bookings for the given kid ids, embedding the kid / coach /
 * location names so the bookings list can render without N+1 follow-ups.
 * Sorted newest scheduled_start first; the caller splits into upcoming/past.
 */
export async function listFamilyBookings(kidIds: string[]): Promise<FamilyBooking[]> {
  if (kidIds.length === 0) return [];
  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  )
    .from('bookings')
    .select(FAMILY_BOOKING_SELECT)
    .in('kid_id', kidIds)
    .eq('is_guest', false)
    .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: false });
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as unknown as FamilyBooking[];
}

/**
 * Fetch a single booking by id with the same embeds used by the list, so the
 * detail screen can render without depending on cached list rows. RLS scopes
 * the query to the caller's tenant + own family.
 */
export async function getFamilyBookingById(id: string): Promise<FamilyBooking | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .select(FAMILY_BOOKING_SELECT)
    .eq('id', id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data as unknown as FamilyBooking) ?? null;
}

/**
 * Cancel a booking via the `cancel_booking` SECURITY DEFINER RPC.
 * The RPC enforces cancellation-window policy and returns a `LATE_CANCEL`
 * code when the booking is inside the tenant's configured window without
 * override. Pass `override = true` to bypass the window check (staff only).
 *
 * Returns:
 *   { ok: true }  — booking cancelled successfully
 *   { code: 'LATE_CANCEL', fee_cents: N, window_hours: N }  — inside window
 *   throws on DB/network error
 */
export type CancelBookingResult =
  | { ok: true }
  | { code: 'LATE_CANCEL'; fee_cents: number; window_hours: number; message: string }
  | { code: 'NOT_FOUND' | 'ALREADY_CANCELLED'; message: string };

export async function cancelBookingRpc(
  bookingId: string,
  reason?: string,
  override = false,
): Promise<CancelBookingResult> {
  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  ).rpc('cancel_booking', {
    p_booking_id: bookingId,
    p_reason: reason?.trim() || null,
    p_override: override,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data as CancelBookingResult;
}

/**
 * @deprecated Use cancelBookingRpc instead. This direct-table cancel is kept
 * for backward compatibility but does not enforce cancellation-window policy.
 */
export async function cancelBooking(
  bookingId: string,
  reason?: string,
): Promise<Booking> {
  const trimmed = reason?.trim();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .update({
      status: 'cancelled',
      cancelled_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      cancellation_reason: trimmed && trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : null,
    })
    .eq('id', bookingId)
    .select('*')
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

/**
 * Cancel a membership via the `cancel_membership` SECURITY DEFINER RPC.
 * Sets cancel_requested_at + cancel_effective_at (≥ notice_days from now).
 * Does NOT immediately cancel the Stripe subscription.
 *
 * Returns:
 *   { ok: true, cancel_effective_at: ISO string }  — request recorded
 *   { code: 'NOT_EFT' | 'ALREADY_CANCELLED' | 'ALREADY_REQUESTED' | 'NOT_FOUND', message: string }
 */
export type CancelMembershipResult =
  | { ok: true; cancel_effective_at: string }
  | {
      code: 'NOT_EFT' | 'ALREADY_CANCELLED' | 'ALREADY_REQUESTED' | 'NOT_FOUND';
      message: string;
      cancel_effective_at?: string;
    };

export async function cancelMembershipRpc(
  membershipId: string,
  override = false,
): Promise<CancelMembershipResult> {
  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  ).rpc('cancel_membership', {
    p_membership_id: membershipId,
    p_override: override,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data as CancelMembershipResult;
}

/**
 * Fetch all locations the caller can see (RLS scopes by tenant). Sorted by
 * name so the AddKid picker matches the trigger's "first alphabetically"
 * default ordering.
 */
export async function listTenantLocations(): Promise<Location[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('*')
    .order('name', { ascending: true });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data ?? [];
}

export async function getLocationById(id: string): Promise<Location | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

// ─── Staff check-in API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * A booking row enriched with kid/coach/session_type names, membership status,
 * and pending assignment count for the staff check-in board.
 */
export type StaffBooking = {
  id: string;
  coach_id: string | null;
  kid_id: string | null;
  scheduled_start: string;
  scheduled_end: string;
  cage_number: string | null;
  status: string;
  attended_at: string | null;
  kid_first_name: string | null;
  kid_last_name: string | null;
  coach_first_name: string | null;
  coach_last_name: string | null;
  session_type_name: string | null;
  membership_status: string | null;
  pending_assignment_count: number;
};

const STAFF_BOOKING_SELECT =
  'id, coach_id, kid_id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, cage_number, status, attended_at, ' +
  'kid:kids(first_name, last_name, memberships(status, plan_name)), ' +
  'coach:coaches(first_name, last_name), ' +
  'session_type:session_types(name)';

/**
 * Derive the most relevant membership status label from a kid's memberships
 * array (as returned by PostgREST nested select). Returns the status of the
 * first active/paused membership found, or the first any-status membership,
 * or null when no memberships exist.
 */
function deriveMembershipStatus(
  memberships: Array<{ status: string | null; plan_name: string | null }> | null,
): string | null {
  if (!memberships || memberships.length === 0) return null;
  const active = memberships.find((m) => m.status === 'active' || m.status === 'paused');
  return (active ?? memberships[0]).status;
}

/**
 * Fetch today's bookings for the staff check-in board, enriched with
 * membership status. Pending assignment counts are fetched separately and
 * merged in `getTodayStaffBookingsWithAssignments`.
 *
 * - When `coachId` is provided (instructor coach), only that coach's bookings
 *   are returned.
 * - When omitted (admin or staff coach), the full tenant board is returned —
 *   RLS + the `check_in_booking` RPC handle the server-side authority check.
 *
 * Cancelled rows are excluded. Sorted by `scheduled_start` ascending.
 */
export async function getTodayStaffBookings(coachId?: string | null): Promise<StaffBooking[]> {
  const todayStart = new Date();
  todayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const todayEnd = new Date();
  todayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

  let bookingQuery = (supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient)
    .from('bookings')
    .select(STAFF_BOOKING_SELECT)
    .gte('scheduled_start', todayStart.toISOString())
    .lte('scheduled_start', todayEnd.toISOString())
    .not('status', 'in', '("cancelled")')
    .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: true });

  if (coachId) {
    bookingQuery = bookingQuery.eq('coach_id', coachId);
  }

  const { data: bookingData, error: bookingError } = await bookingQuery;
  if (bookingError) throw bookingError;

  type RawRow = {
    id: string;
    coach_id: string | null;
    kid_id: string | null;
    scheduled_start: string;
    scheduled_end: string;
    cage_number: string | null;
    status: string;
    attended_at: string | null;
    kid: {
      first_name: string | null;
      last_name: string | null;
      memberships: Array<{ status: string | null; plan_name: string | null }> | null;
    } | null;
    coach: { first_name: string | null; last_name: string | null } | null;
    session_type: { name: string | null } | null;
  };

  const rows = (bookingData ?? []) as unknown as RawRow[];

  // Fetch pending assignment counts for all kid_ids in one round-trip.
  const kidIds = [...new Set(rows.map((r) => r.kid_id).filter(Boolean) as string[])];
  const pendingCountByKid = await getPendingAssignmentCounts(kidIds);

  return rows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    coach_id: r.coach_id,
    kid_id: r.kid_id,
    scheduled_start: r.scheduled_start,
    scheduled_end: r.scheduled_end,
    cage_number: r.cage_number,
    status: r.status,
    attended_at: r.attended_at,
    kid_first_name: r.kid?.first_name ?? null,
    kid_last_name: r.kid?.last_name ?? null,
    coach_first_name: r.coach?.first_name ?? null,
    coach_last_name: r.coach?.last_name ?? null,
    session_type_name: r.session_type?.name ?? null,
    membership_status: deriveMembershipStatus(r.kid?.memberships ?? null),
    pending_assignment_count: r.kid_id ? (pendingCountByKid.get(r.kid_id) ?? 0) : 0,
  }));
}

/**
 * Fetch pending assignment counts grouped by kid_id for the given kid UUIDs.
 * Returns a Map<kid_id, count>. Empty list → empty map (no DB call).
 */
async function getPendingAssignmentCounts(kidIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, number>> {
  if (kidIds.length === 0) return new Map();
  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  )
    .from('assignments')
    .select('kid_id')
    .in('kid_id', kidIds)
    .eq('status', 'pending');
  if (error) {
    console.warn('[staff-sessions] pending assignment count error:', error.message);
    return new Map();
  }
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const row of (data ?? []) as { kid_id: string }[]) {
    counts.set(row.kid_id, (counts.get(row.kid_id) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return counts;
}

/**
 * Mark a booking as completed (attended). Calls the `check_in_booking`
 * SECURITY DEFINER RPC which handles idempotency, points grant, and sessions
 * row creation. Returns the updated booking row as JSON.
 */
/** Shape returned by the check-in/no-show/undo RPCs (booking row, no joins). */
type RpcBookingRow = {
  id: string;
  coach_id: string | null;
  kid_id: string | null;
  scheduled_start: string;
  scheduled_end: string;
  cage_number: string | null;
  status: string;
  attended_at: string | null;
};

function rpcRowToStaffBooking(row: RpcBookingRow): Omit<StaffBooking, 'kid_first_name' | 'kid_last_name' | 'coach_first_name' | 'coach_last_name' | 'session_type_name' | 'membership_status' | 'pending_assignment_count'> & Pick<StaffBooking, 'kid_first_name' | 'kid_last_name' | 'coach_first_name' | 'coach_last_name' | 'session_type_name' | 'membership_status' | 'pending_assignment_count'> {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    coach_id: row.coach_id,
    kid_id: row.kid_id,
    scheduled_start: row.scheduled_start,
    scheduled_end: row.scheduled_end,
    cage_number: row.cage_number ?? null,
    status: row.status,
    attended_at: row.attended_at ?? null,
    // Display names/counts not returned by RPC — the hook merges these from
    // the cached query row so the UI doesn't lose them after a write.
    kid_first_name: null,
    kid_last_name: null,
    coach_first_name: null,
    coach_last_name: null,
    session_type_name: null,
    membership_status: null,
    pending_assignment_count: 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Mark a booking as completed (attended). Calls the `check_in_booking`
 * SECURITY DEFINER RPC which handles idempotency, points grant, and sessions
 * row creation. Returns the updated booking row as JSON.

export async function checkInBookingRpc(bookingId: string): Promise<StaffBooking> {

    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  ).rpc('check_in_booking', { p_booking_id: bookingId });
