/**
 * Swings API helpers (task #119).
 *
 * Reads against `public.swings` and `public.personal_bests`. RLS scopes
 * to the parent's own family — see migration 20260508060000.
 *
 * `raw` is excluded from every projection: it's the verbatim HitTrax
 * payload kept for ops debugging, never rendered, and would balloon
 * payload size + leak third-party shape into the client bundle.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import type { Database } from '@/types/database';

type SwingRow = Database['public']['Tables']['swings']['Row'];

export type Swing = Omit<SwingRow, 'raw'>;

export type PersonalBest = Database['public']['Tables']['personal_bests']['Row'];

export type SwingMetric =
  | 'exit_velocity_mph'
  | 'launch_angle_deg'
  | 'distance_ft'
  | 'pitch_speed_mph';

const SWING_COLUMNS =
  'id, tenant_id, kid_id, session_id, capture_source, capture_event_id, occurred_at, exit_velocity_mph, launch_angle_deg, distance_ft, contact_quality, result, pitch_speed_mph, spray_angle_deg, is_personal_best, created_at';

/**
 * List every swing for a kid, newest first. The Videos tab "All swings"
 * grid renders this directly, so the cap (`limit`) prevents an over-fetch
 * if a power user has thousands of swings — the FlatList virtualizes
 * inside, and the parent rarely needs the full historical tail in one
 * request. Default 500 matches the spec's "scroll 500+ swings" target.
 */
export async function listSwingsForKid(
  kidId: string,
  opts: { limit?: number } = {},
): Promise<Swing[]> {
  const limit = opts.limit ?? 500;
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('swings')
    .select(SWING_COLUMNS)
    .eq('kid_id', kidId)
    .order('occurred_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(limit);
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as Swing[];
}

/**
 * List every swing in a single session, newest first. Powers Session
 * Detail. RLS still scopes by kid_id ownership via the session_id FK.
 */
export async function listSwingsForSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Swing[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('swings')
    .select(SWING_COLUMNS)
    .eq('session_id', sessionId)
    .order('occurred_at', { ascending: false });
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as Swing[];
}

/** Single swing by id; returns null if RLS hides it. */
export async function getSwing(swingId: string): Promise<Swing | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('swings')
    .select(SWING_COLUMNS)
    .eq('id', swingId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data as Swing | null) ?? null;
}

/**
 * All personal bests for a kid (one row per metric).
 */
export async function listPersonalBestsForKid(kidId: string): Promise<PersonalBest[]> {

    .from('personal_bests')
    .select('*')
    .eq('kid_id', kidId)
    .order('achieved_at', { ascending: false });
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as PersonalBest[];
}

/**
 * Single most-recently-achieved personal best for a kid (any metric).
 * Powers the Home "Latest personal best" card. Returns null when the

    .select('*')
    .eq('kid_id', kidId)

/**
 * Training video catalog API (v0.7 task #121).
 *
 * `training_videos` is HQ-curated and tenant-scoped. RLS lets every
 * authenticated user in the tenant SELECT published rows; only admins can
 * insert/update/delete. Per-kid view logging goes through the
 * `record_training_view` SECURITY DEFINER RPC which dedupes server-side
 * (≤ 1 view_count bump per kid+video per 30 minutes) so the client cannot
 * inflate counts even by retrying.
 */

import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

// `training_videos` and `record_training_view` were added in migrations
// 20260510000000 / 20260510000001 and are not in the regenerated `Database`
// types yet (same caveat as v0.7 task #120 noted in replit.md). Casting
// to the un-typed `SupabaseClient` (rather than `any`) preserves method
// signatures and return-type inference for everything except the table
// name string literal — `scripts/post-merge.sh` regens the typed client
// after the migration runs in CI.
const sb = supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient;

export type TrainingVideoCategory = 'hitting' | 'mental' | 'situational' | 'fielding';
export type TrainingVideoLevel = 'beginner' | 'intermediate' | 'advanced';

export const TRAINING_CATEGORIES: { value: TrainingVideoCategory; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'hitting',     label: 'Hitting' },
  { value: 'mental',      label: 'Mental' },
  { value: 'situational', label: 'Situational' },
  { value: 'fielding',    label: 'Fielding' },
];

export type TrainingVideo = {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  muxPlaybackId: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  category: TrainingVideoCategory;
  level: TrainingVideoLevel;
  coachName: string | null;
  durationSec: number | null;
  viewCount: number;
  featured: boolean;
  publishedAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

const COLUMNS =
  'id, tenant_id, mux_playback_id, title, description, category, level, coach_name, duration_sec, view_count, featured, published_at, created_at';

type Row = {
  id: string;
  tenant_id: string;
  mux_playback_id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  category: TrainingVideoCategory;
  level: TrainingVideoLevel;
  coach_name: string | null;
  duration_sec: number | null;
  view_count: number;
  featured: boolean;
  published_at: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

function toCamel(r: Row): TrainingVideo {
  return {
    id: r.id,
    tenantId: r.tenant_id,
    muxPlaybackId: r.mux_playback_id,
    title: r.title,
    description: r.description,
    category: r.category,
    level: r.level,
    coachName: r.coach_name,
    durationSec: r.duration_sec,
    viewCount: r.view_count,
    featured: r.featured,
    publishedAt: r.published_at,
    createdAt: r.created_at,
  };
}

/**
 * List published training videos. Optionally filter by category. Tenant
 * scope is enforced by RLS — we never pass tenant_id from the client.
 */
export async function listTrainingVideos(
  opts: { category?: TrainingVideoCategory } = {},
): Promise<TrainingVideo[]> {
  let q = sb
    .from('training_videos')
    .select(COLUMNS)
    .not('published_at', 'is', null)
    .order('featured', { ascending: false })
    .order('published_at', { ascending: false });
  if (opts.category) q = q.eq('category', opts.category);
  const { data, error } = await q;
  if (error) throw error;
  return ((data ?? []) as unknown as Row[]).map(toCamel);
}

/** Single fetch for the player screen. */
export async function getTrainingVideo(id: string): Promise<TrainingVideo | null> {
  const { data, error } = await sb
    .from('training_videos')
    .select(COLUMNS)
    .eq('id', id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data ? toCamel(data as unknown as Row) : null;
}

/**
 * Fire-and-forget view logger. The SECURITY DEFINER RPC dedupes
 * server-side (≤ 1 increment per kid+video per 30 minutes). The
 * client's useRef gate in TrainingVideoPlayerScreen is defence in
 * depth, not the source of correctness.
 */
export async function recordTrainingView(videoId: string, kidId: string): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await sb.rpc('record_training_view', {
    p_video_id: videoId,
    p_kid_id: kidId,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
}

FILE: src/api/waitlist.ts

/**
 * Waitlist API helpers.
 *
 * All RPCs are SECURITY DEFINER; the caller only needs to be authenticated.
 * Slot-level capacity counts use get_day_slot_availability (SECURITY DEFINER
 * so it can see all families' bookings).
 */

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

export type WaitlistEntry = {
  id: string;
  tenant_id: string;
  session_slot_key: string;
  kid_id: string;
  family_id: string;
  coach_id: string;
  session_type_id: string;
  location_id: string;
  scheduled_start: string;
  scheduled_end: string;
  position: number;
  status: 'waiting' | 'notified' | 'claimed' | 'expired' | 'cancelled';
  notified_at: string | null;
  claim_deadline: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
};

export type WaitlistEntryRich = WaitlistEntry & {
  kid: { id: string; first_name: string; last_name: string } | null;
  coach: { id: string; first_name: string; last_name: string } | null;
  location: { id: string; name: string } | null;
  session_type: { id: string; name: string; type_category: string; duration_minutes: number } | null;
};

export type SlotAvailability = {
  session_slot_key: string;
  confirmed_count: number;
  waitlist_count: number;
  capacity: number;
};

export type JoinWaitlistResult = WaitlistEntry;

export type ClaimResult =
  | { code: 'OK'; booking_id: string }
  | { code: 'CLAIM_EXPIRED' }
  | { code: 'NOT_FOUND' };

const WAITLIST_RICH_SELECT =
  'id, tenant_id, session_slot_key, kid_id, family_id, coach_id, session_type_id, location_id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, position, status, notified_at, claim_deadline, created_at, updated_at, kid:kids(id, first_name, last_name), coach:coaches(id, first_name, last_name), location:locations(id, name), session_type:session_types(id, name, type_category, duration_minutes)';

/**
 * Join the waitlist for a slot. Idempotent — returns the existing entry if
 * already queued (status = waiting | notified).
 */
export async function joinWaitlist(params: {
  session_slot_key: string;
  coach_id: string;
  session_type_id: string;
  location_id: string;
  scheduled_start: string;
  scheduled_end: string;
}): Promise<JoinWaitlistResult> {
  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  ).rpc('join_waitlist', {
    p_session_slot_key: params.session_slot_key,
    p_coach_id: params.coach_id,
    p_session_type_id: params.session_type_id,
    p_location_id: params.location_id,
    p_scheduled_start: params.scheduled_start,
    p_scheduled_end: params.scheduled_end,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data as JoinWaitlistResult;
}

/**
 * Leave the waitlist. Sets status='cancelled' and re-numbers remaining positions.
 */
export async function leaveWaitlist(waitlistId: string): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  ).rpc('leave_waitlist', { p_waitlist_id: waitlistId });
  if (error) throw error;
}

/**
 * Claim a spot that was offered via push notification. Returns CLAIM_EXPIRED if
 * the 2-hour window has passed, NOT_FOUND if the entry no longer exists in
 * 'notified' status, OK + booking_id on success.
 */
export async function claimWaitlistSpot(waitlistId: string): Promise<ClaimResult> {
  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  ).rpc('claim_waitlist_spot', { p_waitlist_id: waitlistId });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data as ClaimResult;
}

/**
 * Fetch all active (waiting | notified) + recently claimed waitlist entries
 * for the authenticated family, with embedded kid/coach/location/session_type.
 */
export async function listFamilyWaitlistEntries(): Promise<WaitlistEntryRich[]> {
  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  )
    .from('booking_waitlist')
    .select(WAITLIST_RICH_SELECT)
    .in('status', ['waiting', 'notified'])
    .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: true });
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []) as unknown as WaitlistEntryRich[];
}

/**
 * Get slot capacity counts for a day + session type. Used by the Book tab to
 * show "Join Waitlist" on full slots.
 *
 * Returns a map of session_slot_key → SlotAvailability.
 */
export async function getDaySlotAvailability(params: {
  tenant_id: string;
  session_type_id: string;
  start: string;
  end: string;
}): Promise<Map<string, SlotAvailability>> {
  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  ).rpc('get_day_slot_availability', {
    p_tenant_id: params.tenant_id,
    p_session_type_id: params.session_type_id,
    p_start: params.start,
    p_end: params.end,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  const map = new Map<string, SlotAvailability>();
  for (const row of (data ?? []) as SlotAvailability[]) {
    map.set(row.session_slot_key, row);
  }
  return map;
}

import Constants from 'expo-constants';

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

export type ActiveWaiver = {
  id: string;
  version: number;
  body_text: string;
  effective_date: string;
};

export type FamilyWaiver = {
  id: string;
  waiver_id: string;
  signed_at: string;
  app_version: string | null;
};

/** Fetch the currently-active waiver for the authenticated user's tenant. */
export async function getActiveWaiver(): Promise<ActiveWaiver | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('waivers')
    .select('id, version, body_text, effective_date')
    .eq('is_active', true)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) throw error;
  return data as ActiveWaiver | null;
}

/**
 * Check whether the authenticated family has signed the given waiver.
 * Returns the family_waivers record, or null if not yet signed.
 */
export async function getFamilyWaiver(waiverId: string): Promise<FamilyWaiver | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('family_waivers')
    .select('id, waiver_id, signed_at, app_version')
    .eq('waiver_id', waiverId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) throw error;
  return data as FamilyWaiver | null;
}

/**
 * Sign the given waiver on behalf of the authenticated family.
 * Idempotent — safe to call multiple times for the same (family, waiver) pair.
 */
export async function signWaiver(waiverId: string): Promise<void> {
  const appVersion =
    (Constants.expoConfig?.version ?? Constants.manifest?.version ?? null) as string | null;

  const { error } = await supabase.rpc('sign_waiver', {
    p_waiver_id: waiverId,
    p_app_version: appVersion,
  });

  if (error) throw error;
}

FILE: src/components/ui/Button.tsx
=================================================================================
import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';
import { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  type StyleProp,
  type TextStyle,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

export type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary';
export type ButtonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
export type ButtonTone = 'gold' | 'muted' | 'danger';

export interface ButtonProps {
  label: string;
  onPress: () => void;

  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  tone?: ButtonTone;

  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;

  leftIcon?: ReactNode;
  rightIcon?: ReactNode;
  fullWidth?: boolean;

  testID?: string;
  accessibilityLabel?: string;
}

export function Button({
  label,
  onPress,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  tone = 'gold',
  loading = false,
  disabled = false,
  leftIcon,
  rightIcon,
  fullWidth,
  testID,
  accessibilityLabel,
}: ButtonProps) {
  const isDisabled = disabled || loading;
  // Tertiary buttons are link-style and should hug their label by default;
  // primary/secondary stretch to fill their parent unless explicitly opted out.
  const shouldFillWidth = fullWidth ?? variant !== 'tertiary';

  const handlePress = () => {
    if (isDisabled) return;
    if (variant === 'primary' || variant === 'secondary') {
      // Fire-and-forget; never block onPress on haptic feedback.
      void Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light);
    }
    onPress();
  };

  const containerStyle: StyleProp<ViewStyle> = [
    styles.base,
    sizeStyles[size].container,
    variantContainerStyle(variant),
    shouldFillWidth && styles.fullWidth,
    isDisabled && styles.disabled,
  ];

  const textStyle: StyleProp<TextStyle> = [
    sizeStyles[size].text,
    variantTextStyle(variant, tone),
  ];

  const spinnerColor = variantSpinnerColor(variant, tone);

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      style={containerStyle}
      onPress={handlePress}
      disabled={isDisabled}
      activeOpacity={0.7}
      testID={testID}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel ?? label}
      accessibilityState={{ disabled: isDisabled, busy: loading }}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <ActivityIndicator color={spinnerColor} />
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.content}>
          {leftIcon ? <View style={styles.iconLeft}>{leftIcon}</View> : null}
          <Text style={textStyle}>{label}</Text>
          {rightIcon ? <View style={styles.iconRight}>{rightIcon}</View> : null}
        </View>
      )}
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

function variantContainerStyle(variant: ButtonVariant): ViewStyle {
  if (variant === 'primary') {
    return {
      backgroundColor: colors.gold,
      borderRadius: radius.xl,
    };
  }
  if (variant === 'secondary') {
    return {
      backgroundColor: colors.darker,
      borderColor: colors.gold,
      borderWidth: 1,
      borderRadius: radius.xl,
    };
  }
  // tertiary
  return {
    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
    borderRadius: radius.md,
  };
}

function variantTextStyle(variant: ButtonVariant, tone: ButtonTone): TextStyle {
  if (variant === 'primary') {
    return {
      color: colors.dark,
      fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
      textTransform: 'uppercase',
      letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
    };
  }
  if (variant === 'secondary') {
    return {
      color: colors.gold,
      fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
      textTransform: 'uppercase',
      letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
    };
  }
  // tertiary — tone-driven, no uppercase (used for links + sign-out)
  return {
    color: toneColor(tone),
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
  };
}

function variantSpinnerColor(variant: ButtonVariant, tone: ButtonTone): string {
  if (variant === 'primary') return colors.dark;
  if (variant === 'secondary') return colors.gold;
  return toneColor(tone);
}

function toneColor(tone: ButtonTone): string {
  if (tone === 'muted') return colors.textMuted;
  if (tone === 'danger') return colors.danger;
  return colors.gold;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  fullWidth: {
    alignSelf: 'stretch',
  },
  disabled: {
    opacity: 0.6,
  },
  content: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  iconLeft: {
    marginRight: spacing.sm,
  },
  iconRight: {
    marginLeft: spacing.sm,
  },
});

const sizeStyles: Record<ButtonSize, { container: ViewStyle; text: TextStyle }> = {
  sm: {
    container: { paddingVertical: spacing.lg, paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'] },
    text: { fontSize: fontSizes.md },
  },
  md: {
    container: { paddingVertical: spacing['3xl'], paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'] },
    text: { fontSize: fontSizes.lg },
  },
  lg: {
    container: { paddingVertical: spacing['4xl'], paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'] },
    text: { fontSize: fontSizes.xl },
  },
};

import { forwardRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import {
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
  type TextInputProps,
} from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

export interface InputProps {
  label?: string;
  value: string;
  onChangeText: (v: string) => void;

  placeholder?: string;
  secureTextEntry?: boolean;
  autoCapitalize?: TextInputProps['autoCapitalize'];
  autoComplete?: TextInputProps['autoComplete'];
  keyboardType?: TextInputProps['keyboardType'];
  textContentType?: TextInputProps['textContentType'];
  returnKeyType?: TextInputProps['returnKeyType'];
  onSubmitEditing?: TextInputProps['onSubmitEditing'];
  onBlur?: TextInputProps['onBlur'];
  onFocus?: TextInputProps['onFocus'];
  editable?: boolean;
  maxLength?: number;
  multiline?: boolean;

  error?: string;
  helperText?: string;
  required?: boolean;

  leftIcon?: ReactNode;
  rightIcon?: ReactNode;

  testID?: string;
  accessibilityLabel?: string;
}

export const Input = forwardRef<TextInput, InputProps>(function Input(
  {
    label,
    value,
    onChangeText,
    placeholder,
    secureTextEntry,
    autoCapitalize,
    autoComplete,
    keyboardType,
    textContentType,
    returnKeyType,
    onSubmitEditing,
    onBlur,
    onFocus,
    editable = true,
    maxLength,
    multiline = false,
    error,
    helperText,
    required,
    leftIcon,
    rightIcon,
    testID,
    accessibilityLabel,
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);

  const borderColor = error
    ? colors.danger
    : focused
      ? colors.gold
      : colors.border;

  return (
    <View style={styles.field}>
      {label ? (
        <Text style={styles.label}>
          {label}
          {required ? <Text style={styles.requiredMark}> *</Text> : null}
        </Text>
      ) : null}

      <View
        style={[
          styles.inputRow,
          { borderColor },
          !editable && styles.inputDisabled,
        ]}
      >
        {leftIcon ? <View style={styles.adornment}>{leftIcon}</View> : null}
        <TextInput
          ref={ref}
          style={[styles.input, multiline && styles.inputMultiline]}
          value={value}
          onChangeText={onChangeText}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
          secureTextEntry={secureTextEntry}
          autoCapitalize={autoCapitalize}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          keyboardType={keyboardType}
          textContentType={textContentType}
          returnKeyType={returnKeyType}
          onSubmitEditing={onSubmitEditing}
          onFocus={(e) => {
            setFocused(true);
            onFocus?.(e);
          }}
          onBlur={(e) => {
            setFocused(false);
            onBlur?.(e);
          }}
          editable={editable}
          maxLength={maxLength}
          multiline={multiline}
          testID={testID}
          accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel ?? label}
        />
        {rightIcon ? <View style={styles.adornment}>{rightIcon}</View> : null}
      </View>

      {error ? (
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>{error}</Text>
      ) : helperText ? (
        <Text style={styles.helperText}>{helperText}</Text>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
});

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  field: { marginBottom: spacing['3xl'] },
  label: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    marginBottom: spacing.sm,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  requiredMark: {
    color: colors.danger,
  },
  inputRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: radius.lg,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
  },
  inputDisabled: {
    opacity: 0.5,
  },
  input: {
    flex: 1,
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
    paddingVertical: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  inputMultiline: {
    // ~4 lines at the body line-height; matches DESIGN.md textarea guidance.
    minHeight: spacing['7xl'] * 2,
    textAlignVertical: 'top',
  },
  adornment: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.sm,

  errorText: {

  },

    color: colors.textMuted,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,

  },

/**
 * KidSwitcherPill — self-contained pill + sheet for switching the active kid.
 *
 * Renders nothing when the family has only one athlete. Drop into any screen
 * header to give parents a quick way to switch between siblings.
 */

import { ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text } from 'react-native';

import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

import KidSwitcherSheet from './KidSwitcherSheet';

export default function KidSwitcherPill() {
  const { kid, kids, setSelectedKid } = useSelectedKid();
  const [sheetVisible, setSheetVisible] = useState(false);

  if (!kid || kids.length <= 1) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setSheetVisible(true)}
        style={({ pressed }) => [styles.pill, pressed && { opacity: 0.75 }]}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={`Viewing ${kid.first_name}. Tap to switch athlete.`}
      >
        <Text style={styles.name} numberOfLines={1}>
          {kid.first_name.toUpperCase()}
        </Text>
        <ChevronDown size={14} color={colors.dark} strokeWidth={2.5} />
      </Pressable>

      <KidSwitcherSheet
        visible={sheetVisible}
        onClose={() => setSheetVisible(false)}
        kids={kids}
        selectedKidId={kid.id}
        onSelect={(id) => {
          setSelectedKid(id);
          setSheetVisible(false);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  pill: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.xs,
    alignSelf: 'flex-start',
    backgroundColor: colors.gold,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    paddingVertical: spacing.xs,
  },
  name: {
    color: colors.dark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
});

  Modal,

  ScrollView,

          <ScrollView
            style={styles.list}
            contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          >
            {kids.map((kid) => {
              const isSelected = kid.id === selectedKidId;
              const initial = (kid.first_name?.[0] ?? '?').toUpperCase();
              const fullName = `${kid.first_name} ${kid.last_name ?? ''}`.trim();
              const meta = [kid.age_group, kid.primary_position]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(' · ');
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={kid.id}
                  onPress={() => {
                    onSelect(kid.id);
                    onClose();
                  }}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.kidRow,
                    isSelected && styles.kidRowSelected,
                    pressed && { opacity: 0.8 },
                  ]}
                  accessibilityRole="button"
                  accessibilityState={{ selected: isSelected }}
                  accessibilityLabel={fullName}
                >
                  <View
                    style={[styles.avatar, isSelected && styles.avatarSelected]}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.avatarText,
                        isSelected && styles.avatarTextSelected,
                      ]}
                    >
                      {initial}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.kidInfo}>
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.kidName,
                        isSelected && styles.kidNameSelected,
                      ]}
                    >
                      {fullName}
                    </Text>
                    {meta ? (
                      <Text style={styles.kidMeta}>{meta}</Text>
                    ) : null}
                  </View>
                  {isSelected ? (
                    <Check size={18} color={colors.gold} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                  ) : (
                    <ChevronRight size={18} color={colors.textMuted} />
                  )}
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}

            {onAddAthlete ? (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => {
                  onClose();
                  onAddAthlete();
                }}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.addRow,
                  pressed && { opacity: 0.75 },
                ]}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="Add another athlete"
              >
                <View style={styles.addIcon}>
                  <UserPlus size={18} color={colors.gold} />
                </View>
                <Text style={styles.addText}>Add Another Athlete</Text>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import {
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

export type PickerMode = 'chips' | 'modal';

export interface PickerOption<T extends string | number> {
  value: T;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
}

export interface PickerFieldProps<T extends string | number> {
  label?: string;
  options: ReadonlyArray<PickerOption<T>>;
  value: T | null;
  onChange: (value: T | null) => void;

  mode?: PickerMode;
  allowClear?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;

  /**
   * Called after every selection. Lets RHF `<Controller>` mark the field
   * touched on first interaction (chip pickers have no native blur event,
   * so we treat the selection itself as the touch signal).
   */
  onBlur?: () => void;

  error?: string;
  helperText?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;

  testID?: string;
}

export function PickerField<T extends string | number>({
  label,
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  mode = 'chips',
  allowClear = true,
  onBlur,
  error,
  helperText,
  required,
  disabled = false,
  testID,
}: PickerFieldProps<T>) {
  if (mode === 'modal') {
    // Reserved API surface; implementation lands when v0.3 booking needs a
    // location/coach picker.
    throw new Error("PickerField mode='modal' not implemented");
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.field} testID={testID}>
      {label ? (
        <Text style={styles.label}>
          {label}
          {required ? <Text style={styles.requiredMark}> *</Text> : null}
        </Text>
      ) : null}

      <View style={[styles.chipRow, disabled && styles.disabled]}>
        {options.map((option) => {
          const selected = option.value === value;
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={String(option.value)}
              onPress={() => {
                if (disabled) return;
                if (selected && allowClear) {
                  onChange(null);
                } else {
                  onChange(option.value);
                }
                onBlur?.();
              }}
              disabled={disabled}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityState={{ selected, disabled }}
              style={[styles.chip, selected && styles.chipSelected]}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.chipText, selected && styles.chipTextSelected]}>
                {option.label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      {error ? (
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>{error}</Text>
      ) : helperText ? (
        <Text style={styles.helperText}>{helperText}</Text>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  field: { marginBottom: spacing['3xl'] },
  label: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    marginBottom: spacing.sm,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  requiredMark: {
    color: colors.danger,
  },
  chipRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    flexWrap: 'wrap',
    gap: spacing.base,
  },
  disabled: {
    opacity: 0.5,
  },
  chip: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing.lg,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
  },
  chipSelected: {

    borderColor: colors.gold,
  },

/**
 * Minimal in-app toast system.
 *
 * `ToastProvider` mounts a single absolutely-positioned banner near the top
 * of the screen and exposes a `useToast()` hook so any screen can fire
 * `showToast('Message')`. The banner fades + slides in, sits for ~3s, then
 * fades out. Intentionally tiny — we don't need queues or variants for v0.3.
 */

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { Animated, Easing, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import {
  colors,
  fontFamilies,
  fontSizes,
  radius,
  spacing,
} from '@/theme';

type ToastContextValue = {
  showToast: (message: string) => void;
};

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | null>(null);

const VISIBLE_MS = 2800;
const FADE_MS = 200;

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const opacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const translateY = useRef(new Animated.Value(-12)).current;
  const hideTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const clearHideTimer = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(hideTimer.current);
      hideTimer.current = null;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => () => clearHideTimer(), []);

  const showToast = useCallback(
    (msg: string) => {
      clearHideTimer();
      setMessage(msg);
      opacity.setValue(0);
      translateY.setValue(-12);
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.timing(opacity, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: FADE_MS,
          easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad),
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(translateY, {
          toValue: 0,
          duration: FADE_MS,
          easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad),
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]).start();

      hideTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        Animated.parallel([
          Animated.timing(opacity, {
            toValue: 0,
            duration: FADE_MS,
            easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad),
            useNativeDriver: true,
          }),
          Animated.timing(translateY, {
            toValue: -12,
            duration: FADE_MS,
            easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad),
            useNativeDriver: true,
          }),
        ]).start(({ finished }) => {
          if (finished) setMessage(null);
        });
      }, VISIBLE_MS);
    },
    [opacity, translateY],
  );

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ showToast }), [showToast]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      {message ? (
        <SafeAreaView
          pointerEvents="none"
          style={styles.host}
          edges={['top']}
        >
          <Animated.View
            style={[
              styles.toast,
              { opacity, transform: [{ translateY }] },
            ]}
          >
            <Text style={styles.text} numberOfLines={2}>
              {message}
            </Text>
          </Animated.View>
        </SafeAreaView>
      ) : null}
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast(): ToastContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    // Soft fallback so a missing provider never crashes the app.
    return { showToast: () => undefined };
  }
  return ctx;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  host: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0,
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  toast: {
    marginTop: spacing.lg,
    marginHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing.xl,
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.borderGold,
    maxWidth: 360,
  },
  text: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
});

// Bare-View component used in tests / storybook if needed later.
export function ToastBanner({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.toast}>
      <Text style={styles.text}>{message}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

FILE: src/hooks/useActiveMembership.ts

/**
 * useActiveMembership — fetches the current kid's active membership.
 *
 * OTC pack holders:    sessions_remaining / sessions_total.
 * EFT limited:        sessions_per_week / weekly_sessions_used / weekly_period_start.
 *                     Derives weeklyRemaining and weeklyTotal for UI consumption.
 * EFT unlimited:      sessions_per_week = null → weeklyRemaining = null (uncapped).
 * No membership:      returns null.
 */

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { getActiveMembership, type ActiveMembership } from '@/api/memberships';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';

export const activeMembershipKey = (kidId: string) =>
  ['active_membership', kidId] as const;

/** Returns Monday of the ISO week containing `date` as a YYYY-MM-DD string. */
function currentMondayYmd(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  const day = d.getDay(); // 0=Sun, 1=Mon, …, 6=Sat
  const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // offset to Monday
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + diff);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export type UseMembershipResult = {
  data: ActiveMembership | null | undefined;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  /**
   * EFT limited: credits remaining this week (>= 0).
   * EFT unlimited or OTC: null (no weekly cap).
   */
  weeklyRemaining: number | null;
  /**
   * EFT limited: total credits allowed per week (sessions_per_week).
   * EFT unlimited or OTC: null.
   */
  weeklyTotal: number | null;
};

export function useActiveMembership(): UseMembershipResult {
  const { family, kids } = useFamily();
  const kid = kids[0] ?? null;

  const query = useQuery<ActiveMembership | null, Error>({
    queryKey: activeMembershipKey(kid?.id ?? ''),
    queryFn: () => getActiveMembership(kid!.id, family!.tenant_id),
    enabled: !!kid && !!family,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });

  const { weeklyRemaining, weeklyTotal } = useMemo(() => {
    const m = query.data;
    if (!m || m.plan_type !== 'eft' || m.sessions_per_week == null) {
      return { weeklyRemaining: null, weeklyTotal: null };
    }

    // If the stored period_start is before the current Monday, the DB cron
    // hasn't run yet — treat weekly_sessions_used as 0 for display purposes.
    const storedMonday = m.weekly_period_start ?? null;
    const currentMonday = currentMondayYmd();
    const weeklyUsed =
      storedMonday && storedMonday >= currentMonday ? m.weekly_sessions_used : 0;

    return {
      weeklyRemaining: Math.max(0, m.sessions_per_week - weeklyUsed),
      weeklyTotal:     m.sessions_per_week,
    };
  }, [query.data]);

  return {
    data:            query.data,
    isLoading:       query.isLoading,
    error:           query.error,
    weeklyRemaining,
    weeklyTotal,
  };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useAuth.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * Auth context — the single source of truth for the current Supabase session.
 *
 * - `loading` is true during the initial getSession() call so the root
 *   navigator can render a splash instead of flashing the auth stack.
 * - Subscribes to onAuthStateChange so sign-in/out updates propagate.
 * - Exposes `appRole` decoded from the JWT's custom claim (set by the
 *   Custom Access Token Hook). Missing/unknown values fall back to
 *   `'parent'` so existing parent users without the claim keep working.
 * - Races getSession() against an 8-second timeout on startup and on
 *   foreground resume so a stalled network never leaves the splash
 *   spinning forever. The onAuthStateChange listener remains mounted in
 *   both cases and will update session automatically once the network
 *   recovers, navigating the user in without any manual re-login.
 */

import type { Session, User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import * as Linking from "expo-linking";
import * as Notifications from "expo-notifications";
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { AppState, type AppStateStatus } from "react-native";

import { supabase } from "@/lib/supabase";
import { registerForPushNotifications } from "@/services/notifications";
import { parseAuthCallbackCode } from "@/utils/authRedirect";

export type AppRole = "coach" | "admin" | "parent";

type AuthContextValue = {
  session: Session | null;
  user: User | null;
  loading: boolean;
  appRole: AppRole | null;
};

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

/**
 * Decode the payload of a JWT without verifying its signature. We only need
 * to read claims that Supabase already verified server-side, so a plain
 * base64url decode is sufficient. Returns null on any parse failure.
 */
function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split(".");
    if (parts.length < 2) return null;
    let b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const pad = b64.length % 4;
    if (pad) b64 += "=".repeat(4 - pad);
    // `globalThis.atob` is available in Hermes/React Native.
    const json = globalThis.atob(b64);
    return JSON.parse(json) as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function readAppRole(session: Session | null): AppRole | null {
  if (!session?.access_token) return null;
  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(session.access_token);
  const claim = payload?.app_role;
  if (claim === "coach") return "coach";
  if (claim === "admin" || claim === "owner" || claim === "super_admin") return "admin";
  // Treat anything else (missing, 'parent', unknown) as parent so existing
  // users without the claim continue to land in the parent flow.
  return "parent";
}

/**
 * Race supabase.auth.getSession() against an 8-second timeout.
 *
 * On iOS/Android, the network stack is not always immediately ready when
 * the app cold-starts after a long gap — the underlying fetch() can hang at
 * the TCP layer. Because getSession() has no built-in timeout, setLoading(false)
 * would never fire and the splash spinner would spin forever.
 *
 * Returns `timedOut: true` when the timeout sentinel won the race so callers
 * can skip writing null over a valid session. The onAuthStateChange listener
 * remains mounted in both cases and will update the session automatically
 * when the actual refresh completes.
 */
async function getSessionWithTimeout(): Promise<
  | { timedOut: false; data: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof supabase.auth.getSession>>["data"] }
  | { timedOut: true; data: { session: null } }
> {
  const TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;
  const timeout = new Promise<{ timedOut: true; data: { session: null } }>(
    (resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.warn(
          "[auth] getSession timed out — network may be unavailable on resume",
        );
        resolve({ timedOut: true, data: { session: null } });
      }, TIMEOUT_MS);
    },
  );
  const real = supabase.auth.getSession().then((result) => ({
    timedOut: false as const,
    data: result.data,
  }));
  return Promise.race([real, timeout]);
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Tracks whether the initial getSession() has resolved (either by real
  // result or by timeout). Used by the AppState handler to avoid firing
  // during the initial mount check.
  const initializedRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;

    getSessionWithTimeout().then(({ data }) => {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setSession(data.session);
      if (data.session?.user) {
        void registerForPushNotifications();
      }
      initializedRef.current = true;
      setLoading(false);
    });

    const { data: sub } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(
      async (_event, newSession) => {
        setSession(newSession);

        // Register push token after successful auth session
        if (newSession?.user) {
          try {
            const token = await registerForPushNotifications();

            if (token) {
              console.log("[push] token registered", token);

              // TODO:
              // Save token to Supabase once push_tokens column exists.
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn("[push] registration failed", err);
          }
        }
      },
    );

    // Deep-link handler: when the parent taps the Supabase confirmation
    // email, the OS opens the app with `ballpark:///auth/callback?code=...`.
    // We exchange that PKCE code for a session — `onAuthStateChange` then
    // fires SIGNED_IN and the app navigates past the auth stack
    // automatically, no polling required.
    const handleUrl = async (url: string) => {
      const code = parseAuthCallbackCode(url);
      if (!code) return;
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
      if (error) {
        // Surface to console only; the auth screens stay put and the user
        // can retry from there. Avoids a noisy modal on cold start.
        console.warn("[auth] exchangeCodeForSession failed", error.message);
      }
    };

    Linking.getInitialURL().then((url) => {
      if (url) void handleUrl(url);
    });
    const linkingSub = Linking.addEventListener("url", ({ url }) => {
      void handleUrl(url);
    });

    // Push notification tap routing:
    // Each push kind maps to a ballpark:// deep link that the NavigationContainer
    // linking config resolves to the correct screen.
    //
    //   coach_message       → Work tab, WorkHome initialSubTab=messages
    //                         (payload has only video_id; kidId+coachUserId are
    //                         unavailable so we can't jump to MessageThread directly)
    //   parent_to_coach     → coach-side; no parent route needed
    //   assignment_reviewed → Work tab → AssignmentDetail (has assignment_id)
    //   waitlist_promoted   → Me tab → WaitlistClaim
    const notifSub = Notifications.addNotificationResponseReceivedListener(
      (response) => {
        const data = response.notification.request.content.data as Record<
          string,
          unknown
        > | null;
        if (!data) return;

        if (data.kind === "coach_message") {
          // Prefer direct MessageThread navigation when the payload carries both
          // IDs (payloads from mux-webhook v2+). Fall back to the WorkHome
          // Messages sub-tab for older payloads that omit them.
          if (
            typeof data.kid_id === "string" &&
            typeof data.coach_user_id === "string"
          ) {
            void Linking.openURL(
              `ballpark://work/thread/${data.kid_id}/${data.coach_user_id}`,
            );
          } else {
            void Linking.openURL("ballpark://work/?initialSubTab=messages");
          }
        } else if (
          data.kind === "assignment_reviewed" &&
          typeof data.assignment_id === "string"
        ) {
          void Linking.openURL(
            `ballpark://work/assignment/${data.assignment_id}`,
          );
        } else if (
          data.kind === "waitlist_promoted" &&
          typeof data.waitlist_id === "string"
        ) {
          void Linking.openURL(
            `ballpark://me/waitlist-claim/${data.waitlist_id}`,
          );
        }
      },
    );

    // AppState listener — re-check session when the app transitions from
    // background/inactive to active (e.g. user reopens after 1+ hour).
    // Only runs after the initial mount check has completed (`initializedRef`)
    // so it never races with the startup path.
    // Never sets `loading` back to true — the UI stays usable during the
    // silent re-check. `onAuthStateChange` handles the visible update if a
    // fresh token comes back.
    const handleAppStateChange = (nextState: AppStateStatus) => {
      if (nextState !== "active") return;
      if (!initializedRef.current) return;

      getSessionWithTimeout().then((result) => {
        if (!mounted) return;
        // Only overwrite session when Supabase actually responded.
        // If the timeout fired first, skip setSession entirely — writing null
        // would evict a valid session and bounce the user to the auth stack.
        // onAuthStateChange will update the session once the network responds.
        if (!result.timedOut) {
          setSession(result.data.session);
        }
      });
    };

    const appStateSub = AppState.addEventListener("change", handleAppStateChange);

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      sub.subscription.unsubscribe();
      linkingSub.remove();
      notifSub.remove();
      appStateSub.remove();
    };
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
    () => ({
      session,
      user: session?.user ?? null,
      loading,
      appRole: readAppRole(session),
    }),
    [session, loading],
  );

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useAuth must be used inside <AuthProvider>");
  return ctx;
}

/**
 * useCancelBookingPolicy — TanStack mutation that cancels a booking via the
 * `cancel_booking` SECURITY DEFINER RPC, which enforces the tenant's
 * configurable cancellation-window policy.
 *
 * On { ok: true } it invalidates the same query keys as useCancelBooking so
 * the Bookings list, detail screen, Book tab, and Home "Up Next" card all
 * refresh automatically.
 *
 * On { code: 'LATE_CANCEL' } the mutation resolves (does NOT throw) —
 * the caller must inspect the result and show the warning bottom sheet.
 */

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { cancelBookingRpc, type CancelBookingResult } from '@/api/bookings';

export type CancelBookingPolicyInput = {
  bookingId: string;
  reason?: string;
  override?: boolean;
};

export function useCancelBookingPolicy() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation<CancelBookingResult, Error, CancelBookingPolicyInput>({
    mutationFn: ({ bookingId, reason, override = false }) =>
      cancelBookingRpc(bookingId, reason, override),

    onSuccess: (result, { bookingId }) => {
      // Only invalidate caches when the booking was actually cancelled
      if ('ok' in result && result.ok) {
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['family_bookings'] });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['booking', bookingId] });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['day_bookings'] });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['upcoming-session'] });
      }
    },
  });
}


=================================================================================
FILE: src/hooks/useCancelBooking.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * useCancelBooking — TanStack mutation that soft-cancels a booking.
 *
 * On success it invalidates `['family_bookings', ...]` (so the Bookings list
 * moves the row from Upcoming to Past with a "Cancelled" badge),
 * `['booking', bookingId]` (so the detail screen re-renders with the
 * cancelled state), `['day_bookings', ...]` (so the Book tab time picker
 * frees the slot back up), and the `upcomingSessionKey(...)` prefix
 * (`['upcoming-session']`) so the Home "Up Next" card re-fetches and either
 * drops the cancelled session or rolls forward to the next one — without a
 * pull-to-refresh. The kid id isn't on the booking row we get back, so we
 * invalidate by prefix to cover every kid in the family.
 *
 * Session-credit restoration: if `scheduledStart` is provided and the
 * session is in the future, `restore_session_credit` is called so OTC
 * pack holders get their credit back.  Restoration is best-effort —
 * failure does NOT block the cancel.
 */

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { cancelBooking, type Booking } from '@/api/bookings';
import { restoreSessionCredit } from '@/api/memberships';
import { activeMembershipKey } from '@/hooks/useActiveMembership';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';

export type CancelBookingInput = {
  bookingId: string;
  reason?: string;
  /** ISO timestamp of the session — when provided and in the future, restores 1 credit for OTC packs. */
  scheduledStart?: string;
  /** kid_id — used to invalidate the active_membership cache key. */
  kidId?: string;
};

export function useCancelBooking() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { kids } = useFamily();
  const defaultKidId = kids[0]?.id ?? '';

  return useMutation<Booking, Error, CancelBookingInput>({
    mutationFn: async ({ bookingId, reason, scheduledStart }) => {
      const booking = await cancelBooking(bookingId, reason);

      // Restore credit for future sessions only (best-effort)
      const isFuture = scheduledStart
        ? new Date(scheduledStart) > new Date()
        : false;

      if (isFuture) {
        await restoreSessionCredit(bookingId).catch(() => undefined);
      }

      return booking;
    },
    onSuccess: (booking, { kidId }) => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['family_bookings'] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['booking', booking.id] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['day_bookings'] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['upcoming-session'] });
      const kid = kidId ?? defaultKidId;
      if (kid) {
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: activeMembershipKey(kid) });
      }
    },
  });
}

=================================================================================
FILE: src/hooks/useCoachInbox.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * TanStack Query hooks for the coach-side inbox, with Supabase Realtime
 * subscriptions that keep both the thread view and the inbox list up to date
 * without a manual pull-to-refresh.
 *
 * Realtime strategy
 * ─────────────────
 * useCoachInbox
 *   Subscribes to INSERT events on coach_messages.  When a new row arrives
 *   that involves this coach (as sender OR as recipient_coach_user_id),
 *   it invalidates the inbox query so the last-message preview and unread
 *   dot refresh automatically.
 *
 * useCoachMessageThread
 *   Subscribes to INSERT events filtered to recipient_kid_id = kidId.
 *   New rows whose thread matches (kidId, coachUserId) are appended
 *   directly to the TanStack Query cache so they appear immediately without
 *   a full refetch.  Video rows arrive with null playback ids (Mux hasn't
 *   processed them yet) — the UI shows "Still processing…" which is correct.
 *   The inbox query is also invalidated so the conversation list stays fresh.
 *
 * Channel naming avoids collisions: one channel per (coach, thread) pair.
 */

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import type { CoachThreadMessage } from '@/api/coachInbox';
import { listCoachInbox, listCoachMessageThread } from '@/api/coachInbox';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

import { useAuth } from './useAuth';

export const coachInboxKeys = {
  inbox: (coachUserId: string) => ['coachInbox', coachUserId] as const,
  thread: (kidId: string, coachUserId: string) =>
    ['coachInbox', 'thread', kidId, coachUserId] as const,
};

export function useCoachInbox() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: user ? coachInboxKeys.inbox(user.id) : ['coachInbox', 'none'],
    enabled: !!user,
    queryFn: () => listCoachInbox(user!.id),
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });

  // Realtime: invalidate inbox when any new coach_message involving this coach
  // arrives so the last-message preview and unread dot update automatically.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    const coachUserId = user.id;

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`coach-inbox-list-${coachUserId}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'coach_messages' },
        (payload) => {
          const row = payload.new as Record<string, unknown>;
          // Only react when this coach is the sender or the named recipient.
          if (
            row.sender_user_id !== coachUserId &&
            row.recipient_coach_user_id !== coachUserId
          ) {
            return;
          }
          void qc.invalidateQueries({
            queryKey: coachInboxKeys.inbox(coachUserId),
          });
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      void supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [user?.id, qc]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  return query;
}

/**
 * Coach-side message thread for a (kid, coach) pair.
 *
 * Uses listCoachMessageThread which correctly fetches both directions:
 *   - coach→parent (sender_user_id = coachUserId)
 *   - parent→coach (recipient_coach_user_id = coachUserId)
 *
 * This is intentionally separate from useMessageThread (parent-side hook)
 * because the parent hook's `or` filter collapses when selfUserId === coachUserId,
 * causing parent→coach messages to be excluded.
 *
 * Realtime: new INSERT rows for this thread are appended directly to the
 * TanStack Query cache so they appear instantly.  The inbox list is also
 * invalidated so the last-message preview stays current.
 */
export function useCoachMessageThread(
  kidId: string | null | undefined,
  coachUserId: string | null | undefined,
) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey:
      kidId && coachUserId
        ? coachInboxKeys.thread(kidId, coachUserId)
        : ['coachInbox', 'thread', 'none'],
    enabled: !!kidId && !!coachUserId,
    queryFn: () =>
      listCoachMessageThread({ kidId: kidId as string, coachUserId: coachUserId as string }),
    staleTime: 15_000,
  });

  // Realtime: append incoming messages to the cache immediately.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!kidId || !coachUserId) return;

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`coach-thread-${kidId}-${coachUserId}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        {
          event: 'INSERT',
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'coach_messages',
          // Server-side filter: only rows for this kid's thread are delivered.
          filter: `recipient_kid_id=eq.${kidId}`,
        },
        (payload) => {
          const row = payload.new as Record<string, unknown>;

          // Confirm this message is for our (kidId, coachUserId) thread —
          // the server filter already handles kidId, but we double-check the
          // coach side to avoid cross-contamination when a kid has multiple coaches.
          if (
            row.sender_user_id !== coachUserId &&
            row.recipient_coach_user_id !== coachUserId
          ) {
            return;
          }

          const threadKey = coachInboxKeys.thread(kidId, coachUserId);

          qc.setQueryData<CoachThreadMessage[]>(threadKey, (prev) => {
            if (!prev) return prev;
            // Guard against duplicate deliveries (Realtime can replay).
            if (prev.some((m) => m.id === (row.id as string))) return prev;

            const msg: CoachThreadMessage = {
              id: row.id as string,
              createdAt: row.created_at as string,
              senderUserId: row.sender_user_id as string,
              recipientFamilyId: (row.recipient_family_id as string) ?? '',
              recipientKidId: (row.recipient_kid_id as string) ?? kidId,
              recipientCoachUserId:
                (row.recipient_coach_user_id as string | null) ?? null,
              messageText: (row.message_text as string | null) ?? null,
              label: (row.label as string | null) ?? null,
              senderDisplay: (row.sender_display as string | null) ?? null,
              viewedAt: (row.viewed_at as string | null) ?? null,
              // Video rows arrive with null playback id — Mux hasn't processed
              // them yet.  The Bubble component renders "Still processing…".
              video: null,
            };

            return [...prev, msg];
          });

          // Force a refetch so the cache stays in sync when the insert
          // originated from the web portal rather than a mobile mutation.
          void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: threadKey });

          // Keep the inbox list preview current.
          void qc.invalidateQueries({
            queryKey: coachInboxKeys.inbox(coachUserId),
          });
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      void supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [kidId, coachUserId, qc]);

  return query;
}

FILE: src/hooks/useCoach.tsx

/**
 * Current coach hook — selects the row in `public.coaches` for the signed-in
 * user. Used by the coach landing screen to greet by first name.
 *
 * One query per signed-in user (`['coach', userId]`), enabled only when an
 * authenticated user exists. Returns `null` until the row resolves so callers
 * can fall back to a generic label instead of rendering "undefined".
 */

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import type { Tables } from '@/types/database';

import { useAuth } from './useAuth';

type Coach = Tables<'coaches'>;

export function coachKey(userId: string) {
  return ['coach', userId] as const;
}

async function fetchCoach(userId: string): Promise<Coach | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('coaches')
    .select('*')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data ?? null;
}

export function useCoach() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const userId = user?.id ?? null;

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: userId ? coachKey(userId) : ['coach', 'anonymous'],
    queryFn: () => fetchCoach(userId as string),
    enabled: !!userId,
  });

  return {
    coach: query.data ?? null,
    firstName: query.data?.first_name ?? null,
    lastName: query.data?.last_name ?? null,
    loading: !!userId && query.isPending,
    error: (query.error as Error | null) ?? null,
  };
}

/**

 * `complete_assignment_for_kid` RPC and invalidates every query whose

 * Home HeroCard), the per-kid assignments list, the single-assignment
 * cache, the per-kid points ledger (Earn → Recent activity), and the

=================================================================================
FILE: src/hooks/useFamily.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * Family + kids hook, backed by TanStack Query.
 *
 * One query per signed-in user (`['family', userId]`) fetches the family row
 * and, if present, the kids list in a single async function. Consumers get
 * the same `{ family, kids, loading, error }` shape they relied on before
 * the migration. `useAddKid` is a `useMutation` that invalidates the family
 * query on success so the kids list refreshes automatically.
 */

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useCallback } from 'react';

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import type { Tables, TablesInsert, TablesUpdate } from '@/types/database';

import { useAuth } from './useAuth';

type Family = Tables<'families'>;
type Kid = Tables<'kids'>;

type FamilyData = {
  family: Family | null;
  kids: Kid[];
};

const EMPTY: FamilyData = { family: null, kids: [] };

function familyKey(userId: string) {
  return ['family', userId] as const;
}

async function fetchFamilyAndKids(userId: string): Promise<FamilyData> {
  const { data: family, error: famErr } = await supabase
    .from('families')
    .select('*')
    .eq('parent_user_id', userId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (famErr) throw famErr;
  if (!family) return { family: null, kids: [] };

  const { data: kids, error: kidErr } = await supabase
    .from('kids')
    .select('*')
    .eq('family_id', family.id)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
  if (kidErr) throw kidErr;

  return { family, kids: kids ?? [] };
}

export function useFamily() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const userId = user?.id ?? null;

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: userId ? familyKey(userId) : ['family', 'anonymous'],
    queryFn: () => fetchFamilyAndKids(userId as string),
    enabled: !!userId,
  });

  const data = query.data ?? EMPTY;
  return {
    family: data.family,
    kids: data.kids,
    // When there's no user we resolve to the empty shape rather than
    // staying in a loading state.
    loading: !!userId && query.isPending,
    // True while a background refetch is in flight (e.g. after adding a kid
    // and invalidating the query). Used by useSelectedKid to avoid premature
    // fallback to kids[0] before the new kid appears in the fetched list.
    isFetching: query.isFetching,
    error: (query.error as Error | null) ?? null,
  };
}

export function useAddKid() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (input: AddKidInput) => {
      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');

      // Family must exist (provisioned by handle_new_user). Read from cache
      // when available, otherwise fetch fresh (e.g. directly after signup).
      const cached = qc.getQueryData<FamilyData>(familyKey(user.id));
      let family = cached?.family ?? null;
      if (!family) {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('families')
          .select('*')
          .eq('parent_user_id', user.id)
          .maybeSingle();
        if (error) throw error;
        if (!data) throw new Error('Family not found — auth hook may have failed');
        family = data;
      }

      // If the parent picked a different home location at AddKid time,
      // persist that on the family row first so a kid insert that also
      // references the location stays consistent. No-op when the value
      // matches the trigger-set default.
      const { primary_location_id, ...kidFields } = input;
      if (
        primary_location_id !== undefined &&
        primary_location_id !== family.primary_location_id
      ) {
        const { error: famErr } = await supabase
          .from('families')
          .update({ primary_location_id })
          .eq('id', family.id);
        if (famErr) throw famErr;
      }

      const { data: inserted, error: insertErr } = await supabase
        .from('kids')
        .insert({ ...kidFields, family_id: family.id })
        .select('id')
        .single();
      if (insertErr) throw insertErr;
      // Return the new kid's id so callers (e.g. AddKidScreen) can pass an
      // explicit kidId into the post-AddKid HitTrax onboarding gate
      // instead of relying on `kids[0]` racing the family refetch.
      return { id: inserted.id };
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (user) {
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: familyKey(user.id) });
      }
    },
  });

  // Preserve the existing call signature: `await addKid(input)`.
  return useCallback(
    (input: AddKidInput) => mutation.mutateAsync(input),
    [mutation],
  );
}

type AddKidInput = Omit<TablesInsert<'kids'>, 'family_id'> & {
  primary_location_id?: string | null;
};

type EditKidInput = {
  kidId: string;
  first_name?: string | null;
  last_name?: string | null;
  age_group?: string | null;
  primary_position?: string | null;
  jersey_number?: number | null;
};

export function useEditKid() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ kidId, ...fields }: EditKidInput) => {
      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('kids')
        .update(fields as TablesUpdate<'kids'>)
        .eq('id', kidId);
      if (error) throw error;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (user) {
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: familyKey(user.id) });
      }
    },
  });

  return useCallback(
    (input: EditKidInput) => mutation.mutateAsync(input),
    [mutation],
  );
}

export function useDeleteKid() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (kidId: string) => {
      if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('kids')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', kidId);
      if (error) throw error;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (user) {
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: familyKey(user.id) });
      }
    },
  });

  return useCallback(
    (kidId: string) => mutation.mutateAsync(kidId),
    [mutation],
  );
}

/**
 * useHitTraxLink — TanStack Query hook for the (kid, hittrax) link row.
 *
 * Primary transport is a Realtime postgres_changes subscription on
 * `kid_capture_links` — when hittrax-poll UPDATEs the row we invalidate
 * the cache and the UI flips immediately.
 *
 * v1.3: new connections go straight to 'active'. The 'pending' refetch
 * interval is kept for backward-compat with any existing v1.x users who
 * linked before the API upgrade (they'll still see "pending" until they
 * cancel + re-link via the new flow).
 *
 * Three association paths:
 *   useAssociateHitTrax       — Mode 1 (password)
 *   useTriggerHitTraxOTP      — Mode 2 (send SMS code, no link yet)
 *   useAssociateHitTraxWithOTP — Mode 3 (submit SMS code → link active)
 */

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

import {
  associateHitTrax,
  associateHitTraxWithOTP,
  createHitTraxAccount,
  disconnectHitTrax,
  getHitTraxLinkForKid,
  notifyKioskEvent,
  triggerHitTraxOTP,
  type AssociateResponse,
  type CreateHitTraxAccountInput,
  type KidCaptureLink,
  type KioskEventResponse,
  type OTPTriggerResponse,
} from '@/api/hittrax';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

export function hittraxLinkKey(kidId: string) {
  return ['hittrax-link', kidId] as const;
}

export function useHitTraxLink(kidId: string | undefined) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const instanceId = useRef(`${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!kidId) return;
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`hittrax-link-${kidId}-${instanceId.current}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes' as never,
        {
          event: '*',
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'kid_capture_links',
          filter: `kid_id=eq.${kidId}`,
        },
        () => {
          void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: hittraxLinkKey(kidId) });
        },
      )
      .subscribe();
    return () => {
      void supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [kidId, qc]);

  return useQuery<KidCaptureLink | null>({
    queryKey: kidId ? hittraxLinkKey(kidId) : ['hittrax-link', 'none'],
    queryFn: () => getHitTraxLinkForKid(kidId as string),
    enabled: !!kidId,
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      const link = query.state.data;
      if (link?.association_status === 'pending') return 5_000;
      if (link?.association_status === 'active') return 60_000;
      return false;
    },
  });
}

/** Mode 1: password-based association. */
export function useAssociateHitTrax(kidId: string | undefined) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<AssociateResponse, Error, { hittraxUsername: string; hittraxPassword: string }>({
    mutationFn: ({ hittraxUsername, hittraxPassword }) => {
      if (!kidId) throw new Error('No kid selected');
      return associateHitTrax(kidId, hittraxUsername, hittraxPassword);
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (kidId) void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: hittraxLinkKey(kidId) });
    },
  });
}

/** Mode 2: trigger OTP SMS. No DB write — just kicks off the SMS. */
export function useTriggerHitTraxOTP(kidId: string | undefined) {
  return useMutation<OTPTriggerResponse, Error, { hittraxUsername: string }>({
    mutationFn: ({ hittraxUsername }) => {
      if (!kidId) throw new Error('No kid selected');
      return triggerHitTraxOTP(kidId, hittraxUsername);
    },
  });
}

/** Mode 3: submit the SMS code to complete association. */
export function useAssociateHitTraxWithOTP(kidId: string | undefined) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<AssociateResponse, Error, { hittraxUsername: string; otpCode: string }>({
    mutationFn: ({ hittraxUsername, otpCode }) => {
      if (!kidId) throw new Error('No kid selected');
      return associateHitTraxWithOTP(kidId, hittraxUsername, otpCode);
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (kidId) void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: hittraxLinkKey(kidId) });
    },
  });
}

/** Create a new HitTrax account in-app and immediately link it. */
export function useCreateHitTraxAccount(kidId: string | undefined) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<AssociateResponse, Error, Omit<CreateHitTraxAccountInput, 'kidId'>>({
    mutationFn: (params) => {
      if (!kidId) throw new Error('No kid selected');
      return createHitTraxAccount({ kidId, ...params });
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (kidId) void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: hittraxLinkKey(kidId) });
    },
  });
}

/** Fire a kiosk QR event for the kid. */
export function useKioskEvent(kidId: string | undefined) {
  return useMutation<KioskEventResponse, Error, { qrUrl: string }>({
    mutationFn: ({ qrUrl }) => {
      if (!kidId) throw new Error('No kid selected');
      return notifyKioskEvent(kidId, qrUrl);
    },
  });
}

export function useDisconnectHitTrax(kidId: string | undefined) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<{ link_id: string }, Error, void>({
    mutationFn: () => {
      if (!kidId) throw new Error('No kid selected');
      return disconnectHitTrax(kidId);
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (kidId) void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: hittraxLinkKey(kidId) });
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Latest coach message for a kid, backed by TanStack Query.
 *
 * Used by the parent's Home tab to render the "Today's video" card. The
 * query is disabled when there's no kid (e.g. before kid registration) so
 * we don't fire a request that the RLS policy would reject anyway.
 */

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import {
  getLatestCoachMessageForKid,
  type LatestCoachMessage,
} from '@/api/coachMessages';

export function latestCoachMessageKey(kidId: string) {
  return ['coachMessages', 'latest', kidId] as const;
}

export function useLatestCoachMessage(
  kidId: string | null | undefined,
  options: { enabled?: boolean } = {},
) {
  // Polling and focus-refetch are conditional on the caller asserting
  // they're the active consumer (HomeScreen passes `useIsFocused()`).
  // When defocused we keep the observer alive but with `enabled: false`
  // so cached data still renders (avoids a flash on tab switch) without
  // re-running the 60s timer or fetching on AppState foreground events.
  const enabled = !!kidId && (options.enabled ?? true);
  return useQuery<LatestCoachMessage | null, Error>({
    queryKey: kidId
      ? latestCoachMessageKey(kidId)
      : ['coachMessages', 'latest', 'none'],
    queryFn: () => getLatestCoachMessageForKid(kidId as string),
    enabled,
    // Step 4.14 — in-app polling. AppState is wired to TanStack's
    // focusManager in `src/lib/queryClient.ts`, so foreground events
    // trigger an immediate refetch without waiting the full 60s.
    refetchInterval: enabled ? 60_000 : false,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: enabled,
    refetchOnReconnect: enabled,
  });
}

FILE: src/hooks/useMembership.ts

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import {
  fetchActiveMembership,
  pauseMembership,
  resumeMembership,
  requestUpgrade,
  type MembershipRow,
} from '@/api/membership';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

export type UseMembershipResult = {
  membership: MembershipRow | null;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  pause: (pauseEnd: string) => Promise<void>;
  resume: () => Promise<void>;
  upgrade: (planId: string) => Promise<void>;
};

export function useMembership(): UseMembershipResult {
  const { family } = useFamily();
  const [membership, setMembership] = useState<MembershipRow | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!family?.id) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const m = await fetchActiveMembership(family.id);
      setMembership(m);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [family?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const pause = useCallback(async (pauseEnd: string) => {
    if (!membership) throw new Error('No active membership');
    await pauseMembership(membership.id, pauseEnd);
    await load();
  }, [membership, load]);

  const resume = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!membership) throw new Error('No membership to resume');
    await resumeMembership(membership.id);
    await load();
  }, [membership, load]);

  const upgrade = useCallback(async (planId: string) => {
    if (!membership) throw new Error('No active membership');
    await requestUpgrade(membership.id, planId);
  }, [membership]);

  return { membership, loading, error, refresh: load, pause, resume, upgrade };
}
