FILE: src/hooks/useNewCoachMessage.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * "Is the latest coach message new?" hook for Home-tab consumers.
 *
 * Composes `useAuth`, `useFamily`, and `useLatestCoachMessage` (the
 * polling query) with the persisted seen store. Used by HomeScreen and
 * the in-app `CoachMessageToast` — both of which only mount on the Home
 * tab, so the underlying `useQuery` observer (and its 60s
 * `refetchInterval`) is scoped exactly to where Step 4.14 wants polling
 * to happen.
 *
 * Side effects:
 *   - Pushes a snapshot `{id, viewedAt}` of the latest message into the
 *     coach-message-seen store on every change. The tab-bar badge in
 *     `MainTabNavigator` reads from that snapshot via
 *     `useCoachMessageBadge`, which mounts NO query observer — that's
 *     how we keep polling off non-Home tabs.
 *   - Lazy-init: first time a user sees data with no stored last-seen
 *     entry, marks the current message id as seen so messages that
 *     pre-date this code shipping don't pop a "new!" toast.
 *
 * A message is considered "new" when:
 *   - the latest-message query has resolved to a non-null row,
 *   - that row is not yet `viewed_at`-stamped, and
 *   - its id differs from the id we last marked seen for this user.
 */

import { useIsFocused } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { useLatestCoachMessage } from '@/hooks/useLatestCoachMessage';
import {
  useCoachMessageSeenStore,
  useHydrateCoachMessageSeen,
} from '@/store/coachMessageSeen';

export function useNewCoachMessage() {
  useHydrateCoachMessageSeen();

  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  // Polling, focus refetch, and the isNew → toast effect must only run
  // while the Home tab is actually visible. `useIsFocused` returns true
  // for HomeMain when both the Home tab is selected AND the inner stack
  // is on HomeMain (not the VideoPlayback modal). When we lose focus,
  // the underlying query goes `enabled: false` so polling stops; cached
  // data still renders the CoachVideoCard so there's no flash on
  // re-focus.
  const isFocused = useIsFocused();
  // `isSuccess` is needed alongside `data` so lazy-init can fire on a
  // `null` first response too (the inbox-empty case).
  const { data: message, isSuccess: messageSettled } = useLatestCoachMessage(
    kid?.id,
    { enabled: isFocused },
  );

  const hydrated = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) => s.hydrated);
  const initialized = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) =>
    user ? user.id in s.seenByUser : false,
  );
  const lastSeen = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) =>
    user ? s.seenByUser[user.id] : undefined,
  );
  const setLastSeen = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) => s.setLastSeen);
  const setLatest = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) => s.setLatest);

  // Push the current snapshot into the store so the tab-bar badge
  // (computed off store-only state) stays in sync without needing its
  // own query observer.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    setLatest(
      user.id,
      message ? { id: message.id, viewedAt: message.viewedAt } : null,
    );
  }, [user, message, setLatest]);

  // Lazy-init: the very first time the query settles for this user with
  // no stored baseline, write a baseline so pre-existing messages don't
  // pop a "new!" toast. We persist the current message id when one
  // exists, or `null` (an "initialized but never notified" sentinel)
  // when the inbox is empty — that way the next message that arrives
  // for an empty-inbox user IS treated as new.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hydrated || !user || !messageSettled || initialized) return;
    setLastSeen(user.id, message ? message.id : null);
  }, [hydrated, user, messageSettled, initialized, message, setLastSeen]);

  const isNew =
    isFocused &&
    !!user &&
    hydrated &&
    initialized &&
    !!message &&
    message.viewedAt == null &&
    lastSeen !== message.id;

  return {
    isNew,
    message: isNew ? message : null,
    markSeen: () => {
      if (user && message) setLastSeen(user.id, message.id);
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Pure store-derived "should the Home tab show a badge?" selector.
 * Mounts NO query observer, so it's safe to call from
 * `MainTabNavigator` without keeping the 60s polling loop alive while
 * the parent is on a non-Home tab. The Home tab itself is responsible
 * for keeping the underlying snapshot fresh via `useNewCoachMessage`.
 */
export function useCoachMessageBadge(): boolean {
  useHydrateCoachMessageSeen();
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const hydrated = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) => s.hydrated);
  const initialized = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) =>
    user ? user.id in s.seenByUser : false,
  );
  const lastSeen = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) =>
    user ? s.seenByUser[user.id] : undefined,
  );
  const latest = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) =>
    user ? s.latestByUser[user.id] ?? null : null,
  );

  if (!user || !hydrated || !initialized || !latest) return false;
  if (latest.viewedAt != null) return false;
  return lastSeen !== latest.id;
}

FILE: src/hooks/useParentMessages.tsx

/**
 * Parent-side messaging hooks (v0.7 task #120). Wraps src/api/parentMessages.ts
 * in TanStack Query mutations + queries. Query keys:
 *
 *   parentMessageKeys.inbox(kidId)              parent's inbox
 *   parentMessageKeys.thread(kidId, coachId)    one bidirectional thread
 *   parentMessageKeys.coaches()                  tenant coaches
 *
 * Mutations invalidate the inbox + relevant thread on success.
 */

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import {
  listMessageThread,
  listParentInbox,
  listTenantCoachesForParent,
  sendParentMessage,
  type SendParentMessageInput,
  type SentParentMessage,
} from '@/api/parentMessages';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

import { useAuth } from './useAuth';

export const parentMessageKeys = {
  inbox: (kidId: string) => ['parentMessages', 'inbox', kidId] as const,
  thread: (kidId: string, coachUserId: string) =>
    ['parentMessages', 'thread', kidId, coachUserId] as const,
  coaches: () => ['parentMessages', 'coaches'] as const,
};

export function useTenantCoachesForParent() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: parentMessageKeys.coaches(),
    queryFn: listTenantCoachesForParent,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useParentInbox(kidId: string | null | undefined) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: kidId ? parentMessageKeys.inbox(kidId) : ['parentMessages', 'inbox', 'none'],
    enabled: !!kidId && !!user,
    queryFn: () =>
      listParentInbox({ kidId: kidId as string, selfUserId: user!.id }),
  });
}

export function useMessageThread(
  kidId: string | null | undefined,
  coachUserId: string | null | undefined,
) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey:
      kidId && coachUserId
        ? parentMessageKeys.thread(kidId, coachUserId)
        : ['parentMessages', 'thread', 'none'],
    enabled: !!kidId && !!coachUserId && !!user,
    queryFn: () =>
      listMessageThread({
        kidId: kidId as string,
        coachUserId: coachUserId as string,
        selfUserId: user!.id,
      }),
  });

  // Realtime: invalidate thread when a new coach_message arrives so
  // web-portal-sent messages appear without a manual pull-to-refresh.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!kidId || !coachUserId || !user) return;

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`parent-thread-${kidId}-${coachUserId}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        {
          event: 'INSERT',
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'coach_messages',
          filter: `recipient_kid_id=eq.${kidId}`,
        },
        (payload) => {
          const row = payload.new as Record<string, unknown>;
          // Only react to messages in this (kid, coach) thread.
          if (
            row.sender_user_id !== coachUserId &&
            row.recipient_coach_user_id !== coachUserId
          ) {
            return;
          }
          void qc.invalidateQueries({
            queryKey: parentMessageKeys.thread(kidId, coachUserId),
          });
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      void supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [kidId, coachUserId, user, qc]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  return query;
}

export function useSendParentMessage(
  opts: { kidId: string; coachUserId: string } | null,
) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<SentParentMessage, Error, SendParentMessageInput>({
    mutationFn: (input) => sendParentMessage(input),
    onSuccess: () => {
      if (opts) {
        void qc.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: parentMessageKeys.thread(opts.kidId, opts.coachUserId),
        });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: parentMessageKeys.inbox(opts.kidId) });
      }
    },
  });
}

FILE: src/hooks/useSelectedKid.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * useSelectedKid — the single source of truth for "which kid is active."
 *
 * Composes the persisted `selectedKidStore` with `useFamily` so that:
 *  - On first load, the store is hydrated from AsyncStorage.
 *  - If the stored kid id is not in the current kids list (deleted,
 *    first install, etc.) we fall back to `kids[0]` and persist that.
 *  - `setSelectedKid(id)` updates the store and AsyncStorage.
 *
 * All screens that scope data to a single kid should use this hook
 * instead of reading `kids[0]` directly.
 */

import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { useSelectedKidStore } from '@/store/selectedKid';

import { useFamily } from './useFamily';

export function useSelectedKid() {
  const { family, kids, loading, isFetching } = useFamily();
  const { selectedKidId, hydrated, hydrate, setSelectedKid } =
    useSelectedKidStore();

  useEffect(() => {
    void hydrate();
  }, [hydrate]);

  // Once hydrated, reconcile the stored id with the actual kids list.
  // This handles: first install (no stored id), kid deleted, family
  // data finally loaded after a cold start.
  //
  // Guard: skip while `isFetching` so we don't prematurely fall back to
  // kids[0] when the list is stale mid-refetch (e.g. right after addKid
  // invalidates the family query but before the response arrives).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hydrated || loading || isFetching || kids.length === 0) return;
    const found = kids.some((k) => k.id === selectedKidId);
    if (!found) {
      setSelectedKid(kids[0].id);
    }
  }, [hydrated, loading, isFetching, kids, selectedKidId, setSelectedKid]);

  const kid =
    kids.find((k) => k.id === selectedKidId) ?? kids[0] ?? null;

  return {
    kid,
    kids,
    family,
    loading,
    selectedKidId: kid?.id ?? null,
    setSelectedKid,
  };
}

/**
 * Sent coach-messages list hook (v0.4 Step 4.11).
 *
 * Wraps `listSentCoachMessages()` in a TanStack query keyed
 * `['coachMessages', 'sent', userId]` — the same key
 * `useSendCoachMessage()` invalidates on successful insert, so a freshly
 * sent message appears immediately when the coach lands here.
 *
 * Also refetches when the screen regains focus (`useFocusEffect`) — covers
 * the case where the coach navigates back from another tab and a webhook
 * has flipped a video status / a parent has marked something viewed in
 * the meantime. The list itself is the source of truth, not the cache.
 */

import { useFocusEffect } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useCallback } from 'react';

import {
  listSentCoachMessages,
  type SentCoachMessageRow,
} from '@/api/coachMessages';

import { useAuth } from './useAuth';
import { sentCoachMessagesKey } from './useSendCoachMessage';

export function useSentCoachMessages() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const userId = user?.id ?? null;

  const query = useQuery<SentCoachMessageRow[], Error>({
    queryKey: userId
      ? sentCoachMessagesKey(userId)
      : ['coachMessages', 'sent', 'anonymous'],
    queryFn: () => listSentCoachMessages(userId as string),
    enabled: !!userId,

 * session type from the SECURITY DEFINER `get_day_slot_availability` RPC.

export function useSlotAvailability(

=================================================================================
FILE: src/hooks/useStaffSessions.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Hook for the staff mobile check-in board.
 *
 * Fetches today's bookings from Supabase and maintains a Realtime subscription
 * so concurrent check-ins (from the portal or another device) are reflected
 * within a few seconds without a manual refresh.
 *
 * `coachId` — when provided, filters to that coach's own bookings (instructor
 * view). When null/undefined, returns all tenant bookings (admin / staff-coach
 * view). The server-side RLS + `check_in_booking` RPC enforce the authority
 * at write time regardless of what we fetch here.
 *
 * Design notes
 * ────────────
 * • `key` is kept in a `useRef` so the realtime callback and `mutate` always
 *   read the *current* key rather than a stale closure captured at mount. This
 *   matters for coaches: the query key starts as `['staff-sessions','all']`
 *   while the coach row is loading, then switches to `['staff-sessions', id]`.
 *   Without the ref, cache patches would target the wrong key.
 * • The realtime `useEffect` depends on `coachId` so Supabase resubscribes
 *   (and the closure re-captures the latest ref value) whenever the key changes.
 * • The query is disabled for coaches until `coachId` resolves so we never
 *   issue an unfiltered tenant-wide fetch on their behalf.
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import {
  getTodayStaffBookings,
  checkInBookingRpc,
  markNoShowRpc,
  undoCheckInRpc,
  type StaffBooking,
} from '@/api/bookings';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

export type StaffBookingWithPending = StaffBooking & {
  pending?: 'checkin' | 'noshow' | 'undo';
};

/** True when a coach has no coachId yet (coach row is still loading). */
type CoachIdState = string | null | undefined;

function staffSessionsKey(coachId: CoachIdState) {
  return ['staff-sessions', coachId ?? 'all'] as const;
}

export function isWithinUndoWindow(b: StaffBooking): boolean {
  if (!b.attended_at || b.status !== 'completed') return false;
  return Date.now() - new Date(b.attended_at).getTime() < 5 * 60 * 1000;
}

/**
 * @param coachId - UUID of the coach row when the caller is a coach;
 *   undefined/null for admins (full tenant view).
 * @param isCoach - true when the caller has app_role='coach'. When true and
 *   coachId is still undefined (coach row loading), the query is disabled so
 *   we don't accidentally fetch unfiltered bookings on a coach's behalf.
 */
export function useStaffSessions(coachId: CoachIdState, isCoach = false) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  // Always-current key ref — closures in realtime and mutate read this, not
  // a captured snapshot from their creation time.
  const keyRef = useRef(staffSessionsKey(coachId));
  keyRef.current = staffSessionsKey(coachId);

  const queryEnabled = isCoach ? !!coachId : true;

  const { data: fetchedBookings, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: keyRef.current,
    queryFn: () => getTodayStaffBookings(coachId),
    enabled: queryEnabled,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });

  // Local overlay to merge optimistic pending flags on top of server data.
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<Record<string, StaffBookingWithPending['pending']>>({});

  const bookings: StaffBookingWithPending[] = (fetchedBookings ?? []).map((b) => ({
    ...b,
    pending: pending[b.id],
  }));

  // Realtime subscription — mirrors portal CheckInBoard behaviour.
  // Depends on `coachId` so it resubscribes (and picks up the new keyRef
  // value) whenever the coach row resolves.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isCoach && !coachId) return; // wait until we know which coach to scope

    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const tomorrow = new Date(today.getTime() + 86_400_000);

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`mobile-checkin-bookings-${coachId ?? 'all'}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'bookings' },
        (payload) => {
          const row = payload.new as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (!row?.id) return;
          const start = new Date(row.scheduled_start as string);
          if (start < today || start >= tomorrow) return;

          // Patch the live key (captured via ref, never stale).
          qc.setQueryData<StaffBooking[]>(keyRef.current, (prev) => {
            if (!prev) return prev;
            const idx = prev.findIndex((b) => b.id === row.id);
            if (idx === -1) return prev;
            const next = [...prev];
            next[idx] = {
              ...next[idx],
              status: row.status as string,
              attended_at: (row.attended_at as string | null) ?? null,
              cage_number: (row.cage_number as string | null) ?? null,
            };
            return next;
          });
          // Clear any pending overlay for this row.
          setPending((p) => {
            if (!p[row.id as string]) return p;
            const next = { ...p };
            delete next[row.id as string];
            return next;
          });
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => { void supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [coachId, isCoach, qc]);  // resubscribe when coachId resolves

  const mutate = useCallback(
    async (
      action: 'checkin' | 'noshow' | 'undo',
      bookingId: string,
    ): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; message: string }> => {
      setPending((p) => ({ ...p, [bookingId]: action }));

      try {
        let updated: StaffBooking;
        if (action === 'checkin') updated = await checkInBookingRpc(bookingId);
        else if (action === 'noshow') updated = await markNoShowRpc(bookingId);
        else updated = await undoCheckInRpc(bookingId);

        // Optimistic patch: immediately flip status in cache so the row
        // re-renders without waiting for the network round-trip.
        qc.setQueryData<StaffBooking[]>(keyRef.current, (prev) => {
          if (!prev) return prev;
          return prev.map((b) =>
            b.id === bookingId
              ? { ...b, status: updated.status, attended_at: updated.attended_at }
              : b,
          );
        });

        // Guaranteed sync: invalidate so TanStack Query immediately refetches
        // from Supabase, ensuring the UI reflects the true DB state even if
        // the optimistic patch above didn't trigger a re-render.
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keyRef.current });

        setPending((p) => {
          const next = { ...p };
          delete next[bookingId];
          return next;
        });

        return { ok: true };
      } catch (err) {
        setPending((p) => {
          const next = { ...p };
          delete next[bookingId];
          return next;
        });
        return { ok: false, message: errorMessage(err) };
      }
    },
    [qc],  // keyRef is a stable ref object — no need to list it
  );

  return {
    bookings,
    isPending: isCoach && !coachId ? true : isPending,
    isError,
    error,
    refetch,
    mutate,
  };
}

/**
 * Swings + sessions + favorites + personal-bests query hooks (task #119).
 *
 * All hooks are guarded by `kidId` truthiness so they no-op cleanly before

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

/**
 * Optimistic toggle. We mutate the local Set immediately so the heart on
 * Swing Detail / the Favorites grid never lags behind the tap, then
 * reconcile against the server's authoritative boolean. On failure we
 * roll back via the snapshot saved in `onMutate`.
 */
export function useToggleFavorite() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<boolean, Error, string, { previous: Set<string> | undefined }>({
    mutationFn: (swingId: string) => toggleSwingFavorite(swingId),
    onMutate: async (swingId) => {
      await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: favoritesKeys.all });
      const previous = qc.getQueryData<Set<string>>(favoritesKeys.all);
      const next = new Set(previous ?? []);
      if (next.has(swingId)) next.delete(swingId);
      else next.add(swingId);
      qc.setQueryData<Set<string>>(favoritesKeys.all, next);
      return { previous };
    },
    onError: (_err, _swingId, ctx) => {
      if (ctx?.previous) qc.setQueryData(favoritesKeys.all, ctx.previous);
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: favoritesKeys.all });
    },
  });
}

FILE: src/hooks/useTenantKids.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * useTenantKids — TanStack Query wrapper around `listTenantKids`.
 *
 * Cache key is `['tenantKids', tenantId]` so the list survives between
 * coach uploads. We derive `tenantId` from the coach's row when available,
 * and fall back to the JWT `tenant_id` claim for admin/owner users who do
 * not have a row in `public.coaches`. The query stays disabled until at
 * least one source resolves a non-null tenant id.
 */

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { listTenantKids, type TenantKid } from '@/api/coachMessages';

import { useAuth } from './useAuth';
import { useCoach } from './useCoach';

/**
 * Decode a single string claim from an already-verified JWT access token.
 * We only read it for UX purposes (enabling the query); the server enforces
 * RLS independently, so a plain base64url decode without re-verification is safe.
 */
function jwtClaim(token: string | undefined, key: string): string | null {
  if (!token) return null;
  try {
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length < 2) return null;
    let b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const pad = b64.length % 4;
    if (pad) b64 += '='.repeat(4 - pad);
    const payload = JSON.parse(globalThis.atob(b64)) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const val = payload[key];
    return typeof val === 'string' ? val : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function tenantKidsKey(tenantId: string) {
  return ['tenantKids', tenantId] as const;
}

export function useTenantKids() {
  const { coach } = useCoach();
  const { session } = useAuth();

  // Admin/owner users may not have a row in public.coaches; fall back to the
  // tenant_id claim from the JWT so the query is still enabled for them.
  const tenantId =
    coach?.tenant_id ??
    jwtClaim(session?.access_token, 'tenant_id') ??
    null;

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: tenantId ? tenantKidsKey(tenantId) : ['tenantKids', 'anonymous'],
    queryFn: () => listTenantKids(),
    enabled: !!tenantId,
  });

  return {
    kids: (query.data ?? []) as TenantKid[],
    loading: !!tenantId && query.isPending,
    error: (query.error as Error | null) ?? null,
    refetch: query.refetch,
    isFetching: query.isFetching,
  };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useTrainingVideos.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * Train tab hooks (v0.7 task #121).
 *
 * Wraps the `training_videos` API in TanStack Query so the Train tab
 * gets caching, focus refetch, and pull-to-refresh for free. The
 * Continue Watching list is a separate hook because it reads from
 * AsyncStorage on the device, not from Supabase.
 */

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import {
  getTrainingVideo,
  listTrainingVideos,
  recordTrainingView,
  type TrainingVideo,
  type TrainingVideoCategory,
} from '@/api/trainingVideos';
import { readProgress, type TrainingProgressMap } from '@/store/trainingProgress';

export const trainingVideoKeys = {
  all: ['trainingVideos'] as const,
  list: (cat: TrainingVideoCategory | 'all') =>
    [...trainingVideoKeys.all, 'list', cat] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...trainingVideoKeys.all, 'detail', id] as const,
  progress: (kidId: string) => [...trainingVideoKeys.all, 'progress', kidId] as const,
};

export function useTrainingVideos(category: TrainingVideoCategory | 'all' = 'all') {
  return useQuery<TrainingVideo[]>({
    queryKey: trainingVideoKeys.list(category),
    queryFn: () =>
      listTrainingVideos(category === 'all' ? {} : { category }),
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useTrainingVideo(id: string | null | undefined) {
  return useQuery<TrainingVideo | null>({
    queryKey: id ? trainingVideoKeys.detail(id) : ['trainingVideos', 'detail', 'noop'],
    queryFn: () => (id ? getTrainingVideo(id) : Promise.resolve(null)),
    enabled: !!id,
  });
}

/**
 * Reads the AsyncStorage continue-watching map for a kid. Refresh is
 * exposed so the player can bump it after writing a new position. We
 * use plain useState (not React Query) because the source of truth is
 * device-local — there's no network round-trip to optimize.
 */
export function useTrainingProgress(kidId: string | null | undefined) {
  const [map, setMap] = useState<TrainingProgressMap>({});
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!kidId) {
      setMap({});
      setLoaded(true);
      return;
    }
    const next = await readProgress(kidId);
    setMap(next);
    setLoaded(true);
  }, [kidId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [refresh]);

  return { map, loaded, refresh };
}

/**
 * Records a view via the SECURITY DEFINER RPC. The player throttles
 * via a useRef so a burst of expo-av status ticks only fires once per
 * playback session.
 */
export function useRecordTrainingView() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ videoId, kidId }: { videoId: string; kidId: string }) =>
      recordTrainingView(videoId, kidId),
    onSuccess: (_data, { videoId }) => {
      // Bump the cached row so the player's view-count display reflects
      // the new total without a manual refresh.
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trainingVideoKeys.detail(videoId) });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trainingVideoKeys.all });
    },
  });
}

FILE: src/hooks/useUpcomingSession.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * Upcoming session hook, backed by TanStack Query.
 *
 * Fetches the next confirmed booking for a given kid: the earliest booking
 * with status='confirmed' and scheduled_start >= now(). Coach (first/last
 * name) and location (name) are joined in a single query so the Home card
 * has display-ready fields.
 *
 * RLS: queried as the signed-in parent. The bookings_select_own_family
 * policy already restricts to bookings whose kid belongs to the caller's
 * family, so no extra filter is needed beyond kid_id.
 */

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

export type UpcomingSession = {
  id: string;
  scheduledStart: Date;
  scheduledEnd: Date;
  durationMinutes: number;
  coachName: string;
  locationName: string;
};

export function upcomingSessionKey(kidId: string) {
  return ['upcoming-session', kidId] as const;
}

async function fetchUpcomingSession(kidId: string): Promise<UpcomingSession | null> {
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .select(
      `
        id,
        scheduled_start,
        scheduled_end,
        coach:coaches!bookings_coach_id_fkey ( first_name, last_name ),
        location:locations!bookings_location_id_fkey ( name )
      `,
    )
    .eq('kid_id', kidId)
    .eq('status', 'confirmed')
    .gte('scheduled_start', nowIso)
    .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: true })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) throw error;
  if (!data) return null;

  // Supabase typings model the joined relation as an array | object depending
  // on the FK shape; normalize to a single record for either case.
  const coachRaw = data.coach as
    | { first_name: string; last_name: string }
    | { first_name: string; last_name: string }[]
    | null;
  const coach = Array.isArray(coachRaw) ? coachRaw[0] ?? null : coachRaw;

  const locationRaw = data.location as { name: string } | { name: string }[] | null;
  const location = Array.isArray(locationRaw) ? locationRaw[0] ?? null : locationRaw;

  // If the joined coach/location metadata is missing for any reason
  // (RLS, deleted row, etc.), treat as "no upcoming session" so the
  // card renders its clean empty state instead of a half-blank row.
  const coachName = coach ? `${coach.first_name} ${coach.last_name}`.trim() : '';
  const locationName = location?.name ?? '';
  if (!coachName || !locationName) return null;

  const start = new Date(data.scheduled_start);
  const end = new Date(data.scheduled_end);
  const durationMinutes = Math.max(0, Math.round((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 60000));

  return {
    id: data.id,
    scheduledStart: start,
    scheduledEnd: end,
    durationMinutes,
    coachName,
    locationName,
  };
}

export function useUpcomingSession(kidId: string | null | undefined) {
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: kidId ? upcomingSessionKey(kidId) : ['upcoming-session', 'none'],
    queryFn: () => fetchUpcomingSession(kidId as string),
    enabled: !!kidId,
  });

  return {
    session: query.data ?? null,
    loading: !!kidId && query.isPending,
    error: (query.error as Error | null) ?? null,
  };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useVideoPreview.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * Polls a single video row until Mux finishes processing.
 *
 * The Send Confirmation screen needs to swap a "Processing video…" placeholder
 * for the real Mux poster as soon as the `mux-webhook` Edge Function flips
 * `videos.status` to `ready`. We poll every 5 seconds until status is a
 * terminal value (`ready` or `errored`); after that the interval is disabled
 * so we don't keep hammering the database.
 */

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { getVideo, type VideoPreview } from '@/api/coachMessages';

const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 5_000;

export function videoPreviewKey(videoId: string) {
  return ['video', 'preview', videoId] as const;
}

export function useVideoPreview(videoId: string | null) {
  return useQuery<VideoPreview | null, Error>({
    queryKey: videoId ? videoPreviewKey(videoId) : ['video', 'preview', 'none'],
    queryFn: () => getVideo(videoId as string),
    enabled: !!videoId,
    // Poll while Mux is still processing; stop once we hit a terminal status.
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      const data = query.state.data;
      if (!data) return POLL_INTERVAL_MS;
      if (data.status === 'ready' || data.status === 'errored') return false;
      return POLL_INTERVAL_MS;
    },
    // The cached value can stay fresh for a moment so navigating back to the
    // screen doesn't refetch immediately.
    staleTime: 2_000,
  });
}

FILE: src/hooks/useWaitlistEntries.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * useWaitlistEntries — fetch active waitlist entries for the authenticated
 * family (status = waiting | notified). TanStack Query with 60-second
 * background refetch so the UI stays roughly fresh.
 */

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import {
  listFamilyWaitlistEntries,
  joinWaitlist,
  leaveWaitlist,
  claimWaitlistSpot,
  type WaitlistEntryRich,
  type JoinWaitlistResult,
} from '@/api/waitlist';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';

export const WAITLIST_QUERY_KEY = 'family_waitlist';

export function useWaitlistEntries() {
  const { family } = useFamily();
  const tenantId = family?.tenant_id ?? null;

  return useQuery<WaitlistEntryRich[]>({
    queryKey: [WAITLIST_QUERY_KEY, tenantId],
    queryFn: listFamilyWaitlistEntries,
    enabled: !!tenantId,
    staleTime: 30_000,
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useJoinWaitlist() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation<
    JoinWaitlistResult,
    Error,
    Parameters<typeof joinWaitlist>[0]
  >({
    mutationFn: joinWaitlist,
    onSuccess: () => {
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [WAITLIST_QUERY_KEY] });
    },
  });
}

export function useLeaveWaitlist() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation<void, Error, string>({
    mutationFn: leaveWaitlist,
    onSuccess: () => {
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [WAITLIST_QUERY_KEY] });
    },
  });
}

export function useClaimWaitlistSpot() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation<
    Awaited<ReturnType<typeof claimWaitlistSpot>>,
    Error,
    string
  >({
    mutationFn: claimWaitlistSpot,
    onSuccess: () => {
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [WAITLIST_QUERY_KEY] });
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['family_bookings'] });
    },
  });
}

FILE: src/hooks/useWaiver.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Waiver gate hook.
 *
 * Returns the active waiver for the tenant and whether the currently
 * authenticated family has already signed it. Used by RootNavigator to
 * block access to MainTabNavigator until the waiver is accepted.
 *
 * Backed by TanStack Query so the status refreshes automatically after
 * sign_waiver() is called (caller should invalidate the query).
 */

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { getActiveWaiver, getFamilyWaiver, signWaiver } from '@/api/waivers';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';

const ACTIVE_WAIVER_KEY = ['waivers', 'active'] as const;
function familyWaiverKey(waiverId: string) {
  return ['waivers', 'family', waiverId] as const;
}

export function useActiveWaiver() {
  const { session } = useAuth();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ACTIVE_WAIVER_KEY,
    queryFn: getActiveWaiver,
    enabled: !!session,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

export function useFamilyWaiver(waiverId: string | undefined) {
  const { session } = useAuth();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: waiverId ? familyWaiverKey(waiverId) : ['waivers', 'family', 'none'],
    queryFn: () => (waiverId ? getFamilyWaiver(waiverId) : null),
    enabled: !!session && !!waiverId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

/**
 * Consolidated gate hook used by RootNavigator.
 *
 * Returns:
 *   loading       — still fetching (show splash)
 *   needsWaiver   — family must sign before accessing the app
 *   activeWaiver  — the waiver document to display
 */
export function useWaiverGate() {
  const { data: activeWaiver, isLoading: waiverLoading } = useActiveWaiver();
  const { data: familyWaiver, isLoading: signedLoading } = useFamilyWaiver(activeWaiver?.id);

  const loading = waiverLoading || (!!activeWaiver && signedLoading);
  const needsWaiver = !loading && !!activeWaiver && !familyWaiver;

  return { loading, needsWaiver, activeWaiver: activeWaiver ?? null };
}

/** Mutation that calls sign_waiver and invalidates the gate queries. */
export function useSignWaiver() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: signWaiver,
    onSuccess: (_data, waiverId) => {
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: familyWaiverKey(waiverId) });
    },
  });
}

FILE: src/hooks/useWeeklyRankDelta.tsx

/**
 * useWeeklyRankDelta — returns how many ranks a kid has climbed (+) or
 * dropped (-) over the past 7 days within their own tenant.
 *
 * The reconstruction (reverse every points_ledger delta in the past 7
 * days, re-rank) requires reading every kid's recent ledger rows —
 * something the parent RLS on `points_ledger` correctly forbids. So the
 * computation lives in `get_kid_weekly_rank_delta(p_kid_id)`, a
 * SECURITY DEFINER RPC that pins to the JWT's tenant_id and the kid's
 * tenant_id; it returns just the single integer delta with no row
 * leakage.
 *
 * Returns null when the kid is outside the top-50 (matches RanksScreen).
 */

import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';

// Cast to the un-typed client (NOT `any`) until next type regen picks up
// the new `get_kid_weekly_rank_delta` RPC name from the migration.
const sb: SupabaseClient = supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient;

async function fetchWeeklyDelta(kidId: string): Promise<number | null> {
  const { data, error } = await sb.rpc('get_kid_weekly_rank_delta', {
    p_kid_id: kidId,
  });
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data as number | null) ?? null;
}

export function useWeeklyRankDelta(kidId: string | null | undefined) {
  return useQuery<number | null, Error>({
    queryKey: kidId ? ['leaderboard', 'delta', kidId] : ['leaderboard', 'delta', 'none'],
    queryFn: () => fetchWeeklyDelta(kidId as string),
    enabled: !!kidId,
    staleTime: 60 * 1000,
  });
}


=================================================================================
FILE: src/lib/queryClient.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Shared TanStack Query client.
 *
 * Mobile-friendly defaults: no window-focus refetching by default
 * (queries opt in individually), modest retry, and conservative stale
 * time. Exported as a module-level singleton so non-React code
 * (e.g. signOut) can call `queryClient.clear()` to drop the previous
 * account's cached data.
 *
 * AppState wiring: TanStack Query's web `focusManager` listens to the
 * browser `visibilitychange` event, which doesn't exist in React
 * Native. Without the bridge below, queries that opt into
 * `refetchOnWindowFocus: true` (e.g. `useLatestCoachMessage` for
 * Step 4.14's in-app coach-video polling) would never get the
 * "foreground after backgrounding" refetch the spec requires. The
 * listener returns a cleanup so it tears down cleanly during HMR.
 */

import { focusManager, QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { AppState, type AppStateStatus, Platform } from 'react-native';

if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
  focusManager.setEventListener((handleFocus) => {
    const onChange = (status: AppStateStatus) => {
      handleFocus(status === 'active');
    };
    const sub = AppState.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    return () => sub.remove();
  });
}

export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      retry: 1,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
      staleTime: 30_000,
    },
    mutations: {
      retry: 0,
    },
  },
});

FILE: src/lib/supabase.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Supabase client for Ballpark.
 *
 * - Reads URL + anon key from EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
 * - Persists auth session in expo-secure-store (encrypted on-device).
 * - Uses the PKCE auth flow so email confirmation links return a `code`
 *   query param that the app exchanges for a session via
 *   `supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession` (see `useAuth.tsx`'s deep link
 *   handler). `detectSessionInUrl` stays off because React Native has no
 *   `window.location` for supabase-js to inspect; we drive the exchange
 *   ourselves from the `Linking` listener.
 */

import 'react-native-url-polyfill/auto';
import { createClient, type SupabaseClient, type SupportedStorage } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

import type { DatabaseExt } from '@/types/databaseExt';
import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

import type { Database } from '@/types/database';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey) {
  // Fail loudly — silent fallbacks here would mask a missing-secrets bug.
  throw new Error(
    'Supabase env vars missing. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in Replit Secrets.',
  );
}

/**
 * SecureStore-backed storage adapter for Supabase auth.
 *
 * SecureStore is unavailable on web; fall back to localStorage there so the
 * Expo web preview still works for development.
 */
const secureStorage: SupportedStorage = {
  getItem: (key) => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      return Promise.resolve(
        typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.localStorage.getItem(key) : null,
      );
    }
    return SecureStore.getItemAsync(key);
  },
  setItem: (key, value) => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
    return SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value);
  },
  removeItem: (key) => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
      return Promise.resolve();
    }
    return SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key);
  },
};

export const supabase = createClient<Database>(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
  auth: {
    storage: secureStorage,
    autoRefreshToken: true,
    persistSession: true,
    detectSessionInUrl: false,
    flowType: 'pkce',
  },
});

/**
 * Typed view of the same client that knows about the columns added by
 * migration `20260509000000_v07_parent_to_coach_messages.sql`. Used by
 * `src/api/parentMessages.ts` so we never reach for `as any`. Drop this
 * extension and re-export `supabase` directly once `src/types/database.ts`
 * is regenerated.
 */
export const supabaseExt = supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient<DatabaseExt>;

import { createNativeStackNavigator } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';

import AddKidScreen from '@/screens/Auth/AddKidScreen';
import ConnectHitTraxOnboardingScreen from '@/screens/Auth/ConnectHitTraxOnboardingScreen';

export default function HomeStackNavigator() {

    <Stack.Navigator
      screenOptions={{

        headerTintColor: colors.gold,
        headerTitleStyle: {
          fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
          fontSize: fontSizes.xl,

      }}
    >
      <Stack.Screen name="HomeMain" component={HomeScreen} options={{ headerShown: false }} />
      <Stack.Screen
        name="VideoPlayback"
        component={VideoPlaybackScreen}
        options={{
          // True full-screen player: no header. The screen renders its own
          // top-left close button overlaid on the video. Modal presentation
          // hides the tab bar underneath on iOS.
          presentation: 'fullScreenModal',
          headerShown: false,
        }}
      />
      <Stack.Screen
        name="AddKid"
        component={AddKidScreen}
        options={{
          // AddKidScreen renders its own headline + sign-out escape, so
          // the native header would just be visual noise. Keeping it
          // hidden matches how AddKidScreen looks when shown as the root
          // (signed-in parent with no kid yet).
          headerShown: false,
        }}
      />
      <Stack.Screen
        name="ConnectHitTraxOnboarding"
        component={ConnectHitTraxOnboardingScreen}
        options={{
          headerShown: false,
          gestureEnabled: false,
        }}
      />
      <Stack.Screen
        name="CreateHitTraxAccount"
        component={CreateHitTraxAccountScreen}
        options={{ headerShown: false }}
      />
    </Stack.Navigator>
  );
}

FILE: src/navigation/RootNavigator.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * Root navigator — picks between flows based on auth + role + family state:
 *   1. Loading splash (initial session check, family fetch)
 *   2. Auth stack (signed-out)
 *   3. CoachTabs (signed-in coach)
 *   4. Main tabs (signed-in parent — Home tab shows a friendly empty state
 *      with an "Add your kid" CTA when no kid has been added yet, instead
 *      of trapping the parent in a forced full-screen AddKid prompt).
 *
 * Mounts at the NavigationContainer level. AuthProvider must wrap this.
 */

import { NavigationContainer, type LinkingOptions } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';

import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useWaiverGate } from '@/hooks/useWaiver';
import WaiverScreen from '@/screens/Auth/WaiverScreen';
import { colors } from '@/theme';
import type { MainTabParamList } from './types';

import AuthNavigator from './AuthNavigator';
import CoachTabNavigator from './CoachTabNavigator';
import MainTabNavigator from './MainTabNavigator';

// ── Deep-link routing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Maps inbound URLs (custom scheme + HTTPS universal links) to screens.
//
// Supported deep links:
//   ballpark://me/payment-method                      → Me tab → PaymentMethod screen
//   ballpark://me/waitlist-claim/:id                  → Me tab → WaitlistClaim screen
//   ballpark://work/?initialSubTab=messages           → Work tab → WorkHome (Messages sub-tab, fallback)
//   ballpark://work/thread/:kidId/:coachUserId        → Work tab → MessageThread
//   ballpark://work/assignment/:assignmentId          → Work tab → AssignmentDetail
//   ballpark://auth/callback                          → Auth callback (handled by Supabase PKCE)
//
// The `ballpark` scheme is registered in app.json.
// HTTPS universal links (when EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_REDIRECT_HOST is set) use the
// same path structure under https://{host}/.
const linking: LinkingOptions<MainTabParamList> = {
  prefixes: [
    'ballpark://',
    ...(process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_REDIRECT_HOST
      ? [`https://${process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_REDIRECT_HOST}/`]
      : []),
  ],
  config: {
    screens: {
      Me: {
        path: 'me',
        screens: {
          MeHome: '',
          PaymentMethod: 'payment-method',
          WaitlistClaim: 'waitlist-claim/:waitlistId',
        },
      },
      Work: {
        path: 'work',
        screens: {
          WorkHome: '',
          AssignmentDetail: 'assignment/:assignmentId',
          MessageThread: 'thread/:kidId/:coachUserId',
        },
      },
    },
  },
};

function Splash() {
  return (
    <View style={styles.splash}>
      <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
    </View>
  );
}

function Inner() {
  const { session, loading: authLoading, appRole } = useAuth();

  // Waiver gate — only applies to parents (coaches don't sign waivers).
  // useWaiverGate is a no-op when there's no session (queries are disabled).
  const { loading: waiverLoading, needsWaiver, activeWaiver } = useWaiverGate();

  if (authLoading) return <Splash />;
  if (!session) return <AuthNavigator />;

  // Coaches and admins don't have a family record — `useFamily` is only mounted
  // under MainTabNavigator (parent surface), so staff never trigger that fetch.
  if (appRole === 'coach' || appRole === 'admin') return <CoachTabNavigator />;

  // While checking the waiver status, show the splash so there's no
  // unprotected flash of the main tabs.
  if (waiverLoading) return <Splash />;

  // Mount MainTabNavigator regardless so navigation state initialises. The
  // WaiverScreen is a full-screen Modal that sits on top and blocks until
  // the parent taps "I Agree" and the query cache is invalidated.
  return (
    <>
      <MainTabNavigator />
      {needsWaiver && activeWaiver ? (
        <WaiverScreen waiver={activeWaiver} />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

export default function RootNavigator() {
  return (
    <NavigationContainer
      linking={linking}
      theme={{
        dark: true,
        colors: {
          primary: colors.gold,
          background: colors.darkest,
          card: colors.darker,
          text: colors.textOnDark,
          border: colors.border,
          notification: colors.gold,
        },
        fonts: {
          regular: { fontFamily: 'Inter_400Regular', fontWeight: '400' },
          medium: { fontFamily: 'Inter_500Medium', fontWeight: '500' },
          bold: { fontFamily: 'Inter_700Bold', fontWeight: '700' },
          heavy: { fontFamily: 'Inter_800ExtraBold', fontWeight: '800' },
        },
      }}
    >
      <Inner />
    </NavigationContainer>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  splash: { flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
});

import type { BottomTabScreenProps } from '@react-navigation/bottom-tabs';
import type { CompositeScreenProps, NavigatorScreenParams } from '@react-navigation/native';
import type { NativeStackScreenProps } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';

export type SignUpFormData = {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  phone?: string;
};

export type AuthStackParamList = {
  SignIn: undefined;
  SignUp: undefined;
  LocationPicker: {
    signUpData: SignUpFormData;
  };
};

export type AuthStackScreenProps<T extends keyof AuthStackParamList> = NativeStackScreenProps<
  AuthStackParamList,
  T
>;

export type MainTabParamList = {
  Home: NavigatorScreenParams<HomeStackParamList>;
  Work: NavigatorScreenParams<WorkStackParamList>;
  Book: undefined;
  Earn: NavigatorScreenParams<EarnStackParamList>;
  Me: NavigatorScreenParams<MeStackParamList> | undefined;
};

export type MainTabScreenProps<T extends keyof MainTabParamList> = BottomTabScreenProps<
  MainTabParamList,
  T
>;

export type HomeStackParamList = {
  HomeMain: undefined;
  VideoPlayback: { messageId: string };
  AddKid: { fromMe?: boolean } | undefined;
  ConnectHitTraxOnboarding: { kidId: string } | undefined;
  CreateHitTraxAccount: { kidId?: string } | undefined;
};

export type HomeStackScreenProps<T extends keyof HomeStackParamList> = CompositeScreenProps<
  NativeStackScreenProps<HomeStackParamList, T>,
  BottomTabScreenProps<MainTabParamList>
>;

/**
 * Work tab — the consolidated work surface. Sub-tab routing for
 * Swings / Assign / Messages / HW / Drills happens *in-screen* on
 * `WorkHome`; the stack only registers the push destinations that the
 * sub-tabs navigate into (assignment detail, swing detail, message
 * thread, full-screen training player, etc.).
 */
export type WorkStackParamList = {
  WorkHome: { initialSubTab?: 'swings' | 'assign' | 'messages' | 'hw' | 'drills' } | undefined;
  AssignmentDetail: { assignmentId: string };
  SessionDetail: { sessionId: string };
  SwingDetail: { swingId: string };
  ShareCard: { swingId: string };
  SendVideoToCoach: { coachUserId?: string } | undefined;
  SendVideoSuccess: { coachUserId: string; kidId: string };
  MessagesInbox: undefined;
  MessageThread: { kidId: string; coachUserId: string };
  TrainingVideoPlayer: { videoId: string };
  VideoPlayback: { messageId: string };
};

export type WorkStackScreenProps<T extends keyof WorkStackParamList> = CompositeScreenProps<
  NativeStackScreenProps<WorkStackParamList, T>,
  BottomTabScreenProps<MainTabParamList>
>;

/**
 * Earn tab — re-merges Rewards / Store / Ranks / Earn-rules into one
 * screen with an in-screen pill switcher. Only push destination is the
 * reward-redeem confirmation modal.
 */
export type EarnStackParamList = {
  EarnHome: { initialSubTab?: 'rewards' | 'store' | 'ranks' | 'rules' } | undefined;
  RewardRedeem: { productId: string; kidId: string; existingOrderId?: string };
  StoreCheckout: { productId: string; kidId: string };
};

export type EarnStackScreenProps<T extends keyof EarnStackParamList> = CompositeScreenProps<
  NativeStackScreenProps<EarnStackParamList, T>,
  BottomTabScreenProps<MainTabParamList>
>;

export type CoachInboxStackParamList = {
  CoachInboxHome: undefined;
  CoachMessageThread: { kidId: string; coachUserId: string; familyId: string; familyDisplayName?: string };
  InboxHome: undefined;
  RecordVideo: { purpose?: 'coach_message' | 'drill_assignment' } | undefined;
  RecipientPicker: { videoId: string };
  SendConfirmation: {
    videoId: string;
    recipientFamilyId: string;
    recipientKidId: string;
  };
  SentVideos: undefined;
  CreateAssignment: { drillVideoId?: string } | undefined;
  ReviewQueue: undefined;
  ReviewAssignment: { assignmentId: string };
  CoachVideoPlayback: { playbackId: string };
  ScanRedemption: undefined;
};

export type CoachInboxStackScreenProps<T extends keyof CoachInboxStackParamList> =
  NativeStackScreenProps<CoachInboxStackParamList, T>;

export type CoachTabParamList = {
  Inbox: undefined;
};

export type CoachTabScreenProps<T extends keyof CoachTabParamList> = BottomTabScreenProps<
  CoachTabParamList,
  T
>;

/**
 * Me tab — Profile root + account-management sub-screens. Book is no
 * longer here; it's a top-level tab.
 */
export type MeStackParamList = {
  MeHome: undefined;
  BookingsList: undefined;
  BookingDetail: { bookingId: string };
  WaitlistClaim: { waitlistId: string };
  Orders: undefined;
  ConnectHitTrax: undefined;
  CreateHitTraxAccount: undefined;
  KioskScan: { kidId: string };
  PaymentMethod: undefined;
  MembershipDetails: undefined;
  UpgradeMembership: undefined;
  AddKid: { fromMe: true };
  EditKid: { kidId: string };
};

export type MeStackScreenProps<T extends keyof MeStackParamList> = CompositeScreenProps<
  NativeStackScreenProps<MeStackParamList, T>,
  BottomTabScreenProps<MainTabParamList>
>;

FILE: src/screens/Auth/AddKidScreen.tsx
=================================================================================
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Controller, useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import {
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { signOut } from '@/api/auth';
import { Button, Input, PickerField, type PickerOption } from '@/components/ui';
import { AGE_GROUPS, type AgeGroup } from '@/constants/kid';
import { useFamily, useAddKid } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import { useSelectedKidStore } from '@/store/selectedKid';
import type { HomeStackScreenProps, MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import {
  addKidSchema,
  type AddKidFormOutput,
  type AddKidFormValues,
} from '@/screens/Auth/schemas';
import { useTenantLocations } from '@/screens/Book/hooks/useTenantLocations';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

const AGE_GROUP_OPTIONS: ReadonlyArray<PickerOption<AgeGroup>> = AGE_GROUPS.map((g) => ({
  value: g,
  label: g,
}));

type HomeRoute = HomeStackScreenProps<'AddKid'>['route'];
type MeRoute = MeStackScreenProps<'AddKid'>['route'];

export default function AddKidScreen() {
  const addKid = useAddKid();
  const { family } = useFamily();
  const locations = useTenantLocations();
  const setSelectedKid = useSelectedKidStore((s) => s.setSelectedKid);

  // The screen lives in both HomeStack and MeStack. Check route params to
  // determine origin — MeStack always passes fromMe: true.
  const route = useRoute<HomeRoute | MeRoute>();
  const fromMe = (route.params as { fromMe?: boolean } | undefined)?.fromMe ?? false;

  // Navigation typed to the HomeStack version (superset of goBack + full
  // tab navigate). When fromMe we only call goBack() so MeStack is safe.
  const navigation = useNavigation<HomeStackScreenProps<'AddKid'>['navigation']>();

  const [signingOut, setSigningOut] = useState(false);

  const locationOptions = useMemo<ReadonlyArray<PickerOption<string>>>(
    () => (locations.data ?? []).map((l) => ({ value: l.id, label: l.name })),
    [locations.data],
  );
  const hasLocations = locationOptions.length > 0;

  const { control, handleSubmit, formState, setValue, watch } = useForm<
    AddKidFormValues,
    unknown,
    AddKidFormOutput
  >({
    resolver: zodResolver(addKidSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onChange',
    defaultValues: {
      firstName: '',
      lastName: '',
      ageGroup: null,
      position: '',
      locationId: null,
    },
  });

  const watchedLocationId = watch('locationId');
  const familyDefault = family?.primary_location_id ?? null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      hasLocations &&
      watchedLocationId === null &&
      familyDefault &&
      locationOptions.some((o) => o.value === familyDefault)
    ) {
      setValue('locationId', familyDefault, { shouldDirty: false });
    }
  }, [hasLocations, watchedLocationId, familyDefault, locationOptions, setValue]);

  const submitting = formState.isSubmitting;

  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    if (hasLocations && !values.locationId) {
      Alert.alert('Pick a home location', 'Choose where your kid trains.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const created = await addKid({
        first_name: values.firstName,
        last_name: values.lastName,
        age_group: values.ageGroup,
        primary_position: values.position,
        primary_location_id: values.locationId,
      });

      // Always switch to the newly added kid.
      setSelectedKid(created.id);

      if (fromMe) {
        // Opened from the Me tab — just pop back to profile.
        navigation.goBack();
      } else {
        // Onboarding flow — proceed to HitTrax linking gate.
        navigation.navigate('ConnectHitTraxOnboarding', { kidId: created.id });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('addKid failed', err);
      Alert.alert('Could not add kid', errorMessage(err));
    }
  });

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    setSigningOut(true);
    try {
      await signOut();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('signOut failed', err);
      Alert.alert('Could not sign out', errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setSigningOut(false);
    }
  };

  const busy = submitting || signingOut;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.container} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
          <Text style={styles.title}>{fromMe ? 'Add another athlete' : 'Add your kid'}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
            {fromMe
              ? 'Fill in their details below to add them to your account.'
              : 'You can add more later from the Me tab.'}
          </Text>

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="firstName"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="First name"
                value={field.value}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="words"
                required
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="lastName"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Last name"
                value={field.value}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="words"
                required
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="ageGroup"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <PickerField<AgeGroup>
                label="Age group (optional)"
                options={AGE_GROUP_OPTIONS}
                value={field.value}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                allowClear
                disabled={busy}
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          {hasLocations ? (
            <Controller
              control={control}
              name="locationId"
              render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
                <PickerField<string>
                  label="Home location"
                  options={locationOptions}
                  value={field.value}
                  onChange={field.onChange}
                  onBlur={field.onBlur}
                  allowClear={false}
                  required
                  disabled={busy}
                  error={fieldState.error?.message}
                />
              )}
            />
          ) : null}

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="position"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Primary position (optional)"
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="words"
                placeholder="e.g. Shortstop"
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Button
            label={fromMe ? 'Add athlete' : 'Add kid'}
            onPress={onSubmit}
            loading={submitting}
            disabled={busy}
            testID="addkid-submit"
          />

          {fromMe ? null : (
            <View style={styles.signOutWrap}>
              <Button
                label="SIGN OUT"
                onPress={handleSignOut}
                variant="tertiary"
                tone="muted"
                disabled={busy}
                testID="addkid-sign-out"
              />
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  flex: { flex: 1 },
  container: { padding: spacing['4xl'], paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'] },
  title: {
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['3xl'],
    marginBottom: spacing.sm,
  },
  subtitle: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    marginBottom: spacing['4xl'],
  },
  signOutWrap: {
    marginTop: spacing.lg,
  },
});

FILE: src/screens/Auth/ConnectHitTraxOnboardingScreen.tsx

/**
 * ConnectHitTraxOnboardingScreen — post-AddKid onboarding step.
 *
 * Two ways to connect an existing HitTrax account:
 *   A. Password  — enter username + password (used once, never stored)
 *   B. SMS code  — enter username → HitTrax texts code → enter code
 *      (requires a phone number registered in HitTrax)
 *
 * Both go directly to 'active'. On success we pop to Home.
 * "Skip for now" is always available — Home shows a nudge banner later.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { Button, Input } from '@/components/ui';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import {
  useAssociateHitTrax,
  useAssociateHitTraxWithOTP,
  useHitTraxLink,
  useTriggerHitTraxOTP,
} from '@/hooks/useHitTraxLink';
import type { HomeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type AuthMethod = 'password' | 'otp';
type ConnectStep = 'choose' | 'otp_pending';

export default function ConnectHitTraxOnboardingScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<HomeStackScreenProps<'ConnectHitTraxOnboarding'>['navigation']>();
  const route = useRoute<HomeStackScreenProps<'ConnectHitTraxOnboarding'>['route']>();
  const { kids } = useFamily();
  const routedKidId = route.params?.kidId;
  const kid = routedKidId ? kids.find((k) => k.id === routedKidId) ?? { id: routedKidId } : kids[0];
  const { data: link } = useHitTraxLink(kid?.id);
  const associate = useAssociateHitTrax(kid?.id);
  const triggerOTP = useTriggerHitTraxOTP(kid?.id);
  const associateWithOTP = useAssociateHitTraxWithOTP(kid?.id);

  const [authMethod, setAuthMethod] = useState<AuthMethod>('password');
  const [connectStep, setConnectStep] = useState<ConnectStep>('choose');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState('');

  const goHome = () => navigation.popToTop();
  const onCreateAccount = () =>
    navigation.navigate('CreateHitTraxAccount', { kidId: kid?.id });

  const onConnect = async () => {
    if (!username.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Username required', 'Enter the HitTrax username for this athlete.');
      return;
    }
    if (!password) {
      Alert.alert('Password required', 'Enter your HitTrax password.');
      return;
    }
    if (!kid) { Alert.alert('No kid found', 'Add a kid first.'); return; }
    try {
      await associate.mutateAsync({ hittraxUsername: username.trim(), hittraxPassword: password });
      goHome();
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Connect failed', errorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  const onSendCode = async () => {
    if (!username.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Username required', 'Enter your HitTrax username so we know where to send the code.');
      return;
    }
    if (!kid) { Alert.alert('No kid found', 'Add a kid first.'); return; }
    try {
      await triggerOTP.mutateAsync({ hittraxUsername: username.trim() });
      setConnectStep('otp_pending');
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not send code', errorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  const onVerifyOTP = async () => {
    if (!otpCode.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Code required', 'Enter the code texted to your phone.');
      return;
    }
    if (!kid) { Alert.alert('No kid found', 'Add a kid first.'); return; }
    try {
      await associateWithOTP.mutateAsync({ hittraxUsername: username.trim(), otpCode: otpCode.trim() });
      goHome();
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Verification failed', errorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  const onBackFromOTP = () => {
    setConnectStep('choose');
    setOtpCode('');
  };

  const alreadyActive = link?.association_status === 'active';
  const isConnecting =
    associate.isPending || triggerOTP.isPending || associateWithOTP.isPending;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.container} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
          <View>
            <Text style={styles.title}>Connect HitTrax</Text>
            <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
              Pull your athlete&apos;s cage swings into Ballpark automatically — exit
              velo, distance, and personal bests appear within ~5 minutes of
              every session. Requires a HitTrax account.
            </Text>

            {alreadyActive ? (
              <View style={styles.card}>
                <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>Already connected</Text>
                <Text style={styles.cardValue}>
                  HitTrax is linked. Manage it any time from Me → HitTrax.
                </Text>
              </View>

            ) : link?.association_status === 'pending' ? (
              <View style={styles.card}>
                <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>Previous link pending</Text>
                <Text style={styles.cardValue}>
                  An older link is waiting on email confirmation. Go to
                  Me → HitTrax to cancel it and re-link with the new
                  instant-connect flow.
                </Text>
              </View>

            ) : connectStep === 'choose' ? (
              <View>
                <Input
                  label="HitTrax Username"
                  placeholder="Your HitTrax username"
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  keyboardType="email-address"
                  value={username}
                  onChangeText={setUsername}
                  testID="connect-hittrax-onboarding-username"
                />

                <Text style={styles.methodLabel}>How would you like to verify?</Text>
                <View style={styles.methodPicker}>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.methodTab, authMethod === 'password' && styles.methodTabActive]}
                    onPress={() => setAuthMethod('password')}
                    activeOpacity={0.75}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.methodTabText, authMethod === 'password' && styles.methodTabTextActive]}>
                      My password
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.methodTab, authMethod === 'otp' && styles.methodTabActive]}
                    onPress={() => setAuthMethod('otp')}
                    activeOpacity={0.75}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.methodTabText, authMethod === 'otp' && styles.methodTabTextActive]}>
                      Text me a code
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>

                {authMethod === 'password' ? (
                  <View>
                    <View style={styles.passwordRow}>
                      <View style={styles.passwordInput}>
                        <Input
                          label="HitTrax Password"
                          placeholder="Your HitTrax password"
                          secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
                          autoCapitalize="none"
                          autoCorrect={false}
                          value={password}
                          onChangeText={setPassword}
                          testID="connect-hittrax-onboarding-password"
                        />
                      </View>
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        style={styles.showHide}
                        onPress={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
                        hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
                      >
                        <Text style={styles.showHideText}>{showPassword ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}</Text>
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                    <Text style={styles.note}>
                      Your password is used once to verify with HitTrax — it is never stored by Ballpark.
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                ) : (
                  <Text style={styles.note}>
                    HitTrax will text a verification code to the phone number registered on your account. No password needed.
                  </Text>
                )}
              </View>

            ) : (
              <View>
                <View style={styles.card}>
                  <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>📱 Code sent</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.cardValue}>
                    HitTrax texted a code to the phone number on your account.
                    Codes expire after 10 minutes.
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.cardLabel, { marginTop: spacing.lg }]}>Username</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.cardValue}>{username}</Text>
                </View>

                <Input
                  label="Verification Code"
                  placeholder="Enter the code from your text"
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  value={otpCode}
                  onChangeText={setOtpCode}
                  testID="connect-hittrax-onboarding-otp-code"
                />
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          <View style={styles.actions}>
            {alreadyActive || link?.association_status === 'pending' ? (
              <Button
                label="Continue to Home"
                onPress={goHome}
                testID="connect-hittrax-onboarding-continue"
              />

            ) : connectStep === 'otp_pending' ? (
              <View>
                <Button
                  label="Verify & Connect"
                  onPress={onVerifyOTP}
                  loading={associateWithOTP.isPending}
                  testID="connect-hittrax-onboarding-verify-otp"
                />
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.backLink}
                  onPress={onBackFromOTP}
                  disabled={isConnecting}
                  hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 16, right: 16 }}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.backLinkText}>← Back</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

            ) : authMethod === 'password' ? (
              <Button
                label="Connect HitTrax"
                onPress={onConnect}
                loading={associate.isPending}
                testID="connect-hittrax-onboarding-connect"
              />
            ) : (
              <Button
                label="Send Code to My Phone"
                onPress={onSendCode}
                loading={triggerOTP.isPending}
                testID="connect-hittrax-onboarding-send-otp"
              />
            )}

            {!(alreadyActive || link?.association_status === 'pending') ? (
              <View style={styles.skipWrap}>
                <Button
                  label="Skip for now"
                  onPress={goHome}
                  variant="tertiary"
                  tone="muted"
                  disabled={isConnecting}
                  testID="connect-hittrax-onboarding-skip"
                />
              </View>
            ) : null}

            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={onCreateAccount}
              disabled={isConnecting}
              hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 16, right: 16 }}
              style={styles.createHint}
            >
              <Text style={styles.createHintText}>
                No account yet?{' '}
                <Text style={styles.createHintLink}>Create one in-app →</Text>
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <Text style={styles.footnote}>
              You can connect or change this any time from Me → HitTrax.
            </Text>
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

FILE: src/screens/Auth/LocationPickerScreen.tsx
