import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  FlatList,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { signUpParent } from '@/api/auth';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';
import type { AuthStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';

const TENANT_SLUG = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG ?? '';

type LocationRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  tenantSlug: string;
  tenantName: string;
  city: string | null;
  state: string | null;
};

type Props = AuthStackScreenProps<'LocationPicker'>;

export default function LocationPickerScreen({ route, navigation }: Props) {
  const { signUpData } = route.params;

  const [locations, setLocations] = useState<LocationRow[]>([]);
  const [filtered, setFiltered] = useState<LocationRow[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [fetchError, setFetchError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function fetchLocations() {
      try {
        // In single-tenant builds, resolve the tenant UUID first so we can
        // filter locations to only that tenant's active facilities.
        // Fail-closed: if the tenant slug cannot be resolved, surface an error
        // and do NOT fall back to an unfiltered query.
        let singleTenantId: string | null = null;
        if (TENANT_SLUG) {
          const { data: tenantRows, error: tenantErr } = await supabase
            .from('tenants')
            .select('id')
            .eq('slug', TENANT_SLUG)
            .limit(1);
          if (tenantErr) throw tenantErr;
          singleTenantId = tenantRows?.[0]?.id ?? null;
          if (!singleTenantId) {
            throw new Error('Facility configuration error. Please contact support.');
          }
        }

        // Two queries: locations (anon can read active), then tenants for slugs.
        let locsQuery = supabase
          .from('locations')
          .select('id, name, city, state, tenant_id')
          .order('name');

        if (singleTenantId) {
          locsQuery = locsQuery.eq('tenant_id', singleTenantId);
        }

        const { data: locs, error: locsErr } = await locsQuery;

        if (locsErr) throw locsErr;
        if (!locs || locs.length === 0) {
          setLocations([]);
          setFiltered([]);
          return;
        }

        const tenantIds = [...new Set(locs.map(l => l.tenant_id as string))];
        const { data: tenants, error: tenantsErr } = await supabase
          .from('tenants')
          .select('id, name, slug')
          .in('id', tenantIds);

        if (tenantsErr) throw tenantsErr;

        const tenantMap = new Map<string, { name: string; slug: string }>();
        for (const t of (tenants ?? [])) {
          tenantMap.set(t.id, { name: t.name, slug: t.slug });
        }

        const rows: LocationRow[] = locs.map(l => ({
          id: l.id,
          name: l.name,
          city: l.city ?? null,
          state: l.state ?? null,
          tenantSlug: tenantMap.get(l.tenant_id)?.slug ?? '',
          tenantName: tenantMap.get(l.tenant_id)?.name ?? '',
        }));

        setLocations(rows);
        setFiltered(rows);
      } catch (err) {
        setFetchError(errorMessage(err));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    void fetchLocations();
  }, []);

  const handleSearch = useCallback((text: string) => {
    setSearch(text);
    const q = text.toLowerCase();
    setFiltered(
      q
        ? locations.filter(
            l =>
              l.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
              l.tenantName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
              (l.city ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
              (l.state ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
          )
        : locations,
    );
  }, [locations]);

  async function handleSelect(loc: LocationRow) {
    if (submitting) return;
    if (!loc.tenantSlug) {
      Alert.alert('Error', 'This location is not configured correctly. Please contact support.');
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await signUpParent({
        email: signUpData.email,
        password: signUpData.password,
        firstName: signUpData.firstName,
        lastName: signUpData.lastName,
        phone: signUpData.phone,
        tenantSlug: loc.tenantSlug,
        locationId: loc.id,
      });
      // Auth state listener in RootNavigator routes the user into the app.
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Sign-up failed', errorMessage(err));
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  function renderItem({ item }: { item: LocationRow }) {
    const region = [item.city, item.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    return (
      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.row} onPress={() => void handleSelect(item)} activeOpacity={0.7} disabled={submitting}>
        <View style={styles.iconWrap}>
          <Text style={styles.iconText}>📍</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.rowText}>
          <Text style={styles.locationName}>{item.name}</Text>
          {region ? <Text style={styles.region}>{region}</Text> : null}
          {item.tenantName ? <Text style={styles.tenant}>{item.tenantName}</Text> : null}
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.chevron}>›</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text style={styles.brand}>BALLPARK</Text>
        <Text style={styles.title}>Choose your location</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Select the facility where you train.</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.searchWrap}>
        <Text style={styles.searchIcon}>🔍</Text>
        <TextInput
          style={styles.searchInput}
          placeholder="Search by city or name…"
          placeholderTextColor={colors.textLight}
          value={search}
          onChangeText={handleSearch}
          autoCapitalize="none"
          returnKeyType="search"
        />
      </View>

      {loading ? (
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : fetchError ? (
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <Text style={styles.errorText}>{fetchError}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={filtered}
          keyExtractor={item => item.id}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          contentContainerStyle={filtered.length === 0 ? styles.center : styles.list}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No locations match your search.</Text>
          }
          ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={styles.separator} />}
        />
      )}

      {submitting && (
        <View style={styles.submittingOverlay}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
          <Text style={styles.submittingText}>Creating your account…</Text>
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={styles.footer}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} disabled={submitting}>
          <Text style={styles.backLink}>← Back</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  header: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['4xl'],
    paddingTop: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing.xl,
  },
  brand: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['4xl'],
    textAlign: 'center',
    marginBottom: spacing['3xl'],
  },
  title: {
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['2xl'],
    marginBottom: spacing.sm,
  },
  subtitle: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
  },

FILE: src/screens/Auth/schemas.ts

/**
 * Zod schemas for the auth screens.
 *
 * Schemas own validation only — server errors (duplicate email, bad
 * credentials, etc.) still surface via `errorMessage(err)` + Alert.alert
 * in each screen's submit handler. RHF wires these through `zodResolver`.
 *
 * Field naming: form fields stay camelCase for ergonomic Controller usage.
 * Mapping to snake_case API payloads happens in the submit handler so the
 * boundary is explicit and reviewable.
 */
import { z } from 'zod';

import { AGE_GROUPS } from '@/constants/kid';

const trimmed = z.string().transform((v) => v.trim());

export const signUpSchema = z.object({
  firstName: trimmed.pipe(z.string().min(1, 'First name is required')),
  lastName: trimmed.pipe(z.string().min(1, 'Last name is required')),
  email: trimmed.pipe(
    z.string().min(1, 'Email is required').email('Enter a valid email'),
  ),
  phone: z
    .string()
    .transform((v) => v.trim())
    .optional()
    .transform((v) => (v ? v : undefined)),
  password: z
    .string()
    .min(1, 'Password is required')
    .min(8, 'Must be at least 8 characters'),
});

export type SignUpFormValues = z.input<typeof signUpSchema>;
export type SignUpFormOutput = z.output<typeof signUpSchema>;

export const signInSchema = z.object({
  email: trimmed.pipe(
    z.string().min(1, 'Email is required').email('Enter a valid email'),
  ),
  password: z.string().min(1, 'Password is required'),
});

export type SignInFormValues = z.input<typeof signInSchema>;
export type SignInFormOutput = z.output<typeof signInSchema>;

export const addKidSchema = z.object({
  firstName: trimmed.pipe(z.string().min(1, 'First name is required')),
  lastName: trimmed.pipe(z.string().min(1, 'Last name is required')),
  ageGroup: z.enum(AGE_GROUPS).nullable(),
  position: z
    .string()
    .transform((v) => v.trim())
    .transform((v) => (v.length ? v : null))
    .nullable(),
  // Nullable rather than required: when the tenant has zero locations the
  // picker is hidden and this field stays null. When the picker IS shown,
  // the AddKid screen enforces a non-null value via an imperative submit
  // guard (we don't know `hasLocations` at schema-construction time, so
  // expressing it via `refine` here would require threading runtime state
  // into the schema — the screen-level guard keeps that simple).
  locationId: z.string().uuid('Pick a home location').nullable(),
});

export type AddKidFormValues = z.input<typeof addKidSchema>;
export type AddKidFormOutput = z.output<typeof addKidSchema>;

  ScrollView,

  View,
} from 'react-native';

                required

FILE: src/screens/Auth/SignUpScreen.tsx

import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { Controller, useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import {
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { signUpParent } from '@/api/auth';
import { Button, Input } from '@/components/ui';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import type { AuthStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import {
  signUpSchema,
  type SignUpFormOutput,
  type SignUpFormValues,
} from '@/screens/Auth/schemas';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

const TENANT_SLUG = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG ?? '';

type Props = AuthStackScreenProps<'SignUp'>;

export default function SignUpScreen({ navigation }: Props) {
  const { control, handleSubmit, formState } = useForm<
    SignUpFormValues,
    unknown,
    SignUpFormOutput
  >({
    resolver: zodResolver(signUpSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onChange',
    defaultValues: {
      firstName: '',
      lastName: '',
      email: '',
      phone: '',
      password: '',
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      const signUpData = {
        email: values.email,
        password: values.password,
        firstName: values.firstName,
        lastName: values.lastName,
        phone: values.phone,
      };

      if (TENANT_SLUG) {
        // Single-tenant build: resolve locations for this tenant first.
        // Fail-closed: if the tenant or its locations cannot be resolved, block signup.
        const { data: tenantRows, error: tenantErr } = await supabase
          .from('tenants')
          .select('id')
          .eq('slug', TENANT_SLUG)
          .limit(1);

        if (tenantErr) throw tenantErr;

        const tenantId = tenantRows?.[0]?.id ?? null;
        if (!tenantId) {
          throw new Error('Facility configuration error. Please contact support.');
        }

        const { data: locs, error: locsErr } = await supabase
          .from('locations')
          .select('id')
          .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
          .order('name');

        if (locsErr) throw locsErr;

        if (!locs || locs.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No active locations are available. Please contact support.');
        }

        if (locs.length > 1) {
          // Multiple locations — let the parent choose.
          navigation.navigate('LocationPicker', { signUpData });
          return;
        }

        // Exactly one location — auto-select and skip the picker.
        await signUpParent({
          ...signUpData,
          locationId: locs[0].id,
        });
        // Auth state listener routes us into the app.
      } else {
        // Multi-tenant: navigate to location picker first.
        navigation.navigate('LocationPicker', { signUpData });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Sign-up failed', errorMessage(err));
    }
  });

  const submitting = formState.isSubmitting;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.container} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
          <Text style={styles.brand}>BALLPARK</Text>
          <Text style={styles.title}>Create your account</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Parents — add your kid in the next step.</Text>

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="firstName"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="First name"
                value={field.value}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="words"
                required
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="lastName"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Last name"
                value={field.value}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="words"
                required
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="email"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Email"
                value={field.value}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="none"
                keyboardType="email-address"
                autoComplete="email"
                textContentType="emailAddress"
                required
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="phone"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Phone (optional)"
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                keyboardType="phone-pad"
                autoComplete="tel"
                textContentType="telephoneNumber"
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />
          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="password"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Password"
                value={field.value}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                secureTextEntry
                autoCapitalize="none"
                autoComplete="password-new"
                textContentType="newPassword"
                required
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Button
            label={TENANT_SLUG ? 'Sign up' : 'Choose your location →'}
            onPress={onSubmit}
            loading={submitting}
            disabled={submitting}
            testID="signup-submit"
          />

          <View style={styles.linkWrap}>
            <Button
              label="Already have an account? Sign in"
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('SignIn')}
              variant="tertiary"
              disabled={submitting}
              testID="signup-go-to-signin"
            />
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  flex: { flex: 1 },
  container: { padding: spacing['4xl'], paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'] },
  brand: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['4xl'],
    textAlign: 'center',
    marginBottom: spacing['4xl'],
  },
  title: {
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['2xl'],
    marginBottom: spacing.sm,
  },
  subtitle: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    marginBottom: spacing['4xl'],

    marginTop: spacing['3xl'],

/**
 * WaiverScreen — full-screen modal gate shown to parents who have not yet
 * signed the active liability waiver for their tenant.
 *
 * Gate rules:
 *   • Scrollable body; "I Agree" button stays disabled until the user has
 *     scrolled within 40px of the bottom of the waiver text.
 *   • On confirmation, calls sign_waiver() RPC (idempotent).
 *   • Modal disappears as soon as the query cache is invalidated (parent
 *     component re-renders when needsWaiver becomes false).
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Modal,
  NativeScrollEvent,
  NativeSyntheticEvent,
  SafeAreaView,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import type { ActiveWaiver } from '@/api/waivers';
import { useSignWaiver } from '@/hooks/useWaiver';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Props = {
  waiver: ActiveWaiver;
};

const SCROLL_THRESHOLD = 40;

export default function WaiverScreen({ waiver }: Props) {
  const [scrolledToBottom, setScrolledToBottom] = useState(false);
  const { mutateAsync: signWaiver, isPending } = useSignWaiver();

  function handleScroll(e: NativeSyntheticEvent<NativeScrollEvent>) {
    if (scrolledToBottom) return;
    const { contentOffset, layoutMeasurement, contentSize } = e.nativeEvent;
    const distanceFromBottom = contentSize.height - (contentOffset.y + layoutMeasurement.height);
    if (distanceFromBottom <= SCROLL_THRESHOLD) {
      setScrolledToBottom(true);
    }
  }

  async function handleAgree() {
    try {
      await signWaiver(waiver.id);
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not save waiver', errorMessage(err));
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      visible
      animationType="slide"
      presentationStyle="fullScreen"
      statusBarTranslucent
    >
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe}>
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <Text style={styles.headerLabel}>REQUIRED</Text>
          <Text style={styles.title}>Liability Waiver</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
            Version {waiver.version} · Effective {waiver.effective_date}
          </Text>
        </View>

        {/* Waiver body */}
        <ScrollView
          style={styles.scroll}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
          onScroll={handleScroll}
          scrollEventThrottle={16}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator
        >
          <Text style={styles.body}>{waiver.body_text}</Text>

          {/* Trailing spacer so "I Agree" is never hidden under the body */}
          <View style={{ height: spacing['4xl'] }} />
        </ScrollView>

        {/* Footer */}
        <View style={styles.footer}>
          {!scrolledToBottom && (
            <Text style={styles.hint}>{'Scroll to the bottom to enable "I Agree"'}</Text>
          )}
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.agreeBtn, !scrolledToBottom && styles.agreeBtnDisabled]}
            onPress={handleAgree}
            disabled={!scrolledToBottom || isPending}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
          >
            {isPending ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color={colors.dark} />
            ) : (
              <Text style={styles.agreeBtnText}>I Agree</Text>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
  },

  header: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingTop: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['2xl'],
    borderBottomWidth: 1,
    borderBottomColor: colors.border,
  },
  headerLabel: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
    color: colors.gold,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    marginBottom: spacing.xs,
  },
  title: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['3xl'],
    color: colors.gold,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
  },
  subtitle: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.textMuted,
    marginTop: spacing.xs,
  },

  scroll: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  scrollContent: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingTop: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  body: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.textLight,
    lineHeight: 22,
  },

  footer: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],

function statusLabel(status: string): string {
  if (status === 'confirmed') return 'CONFIRMED';
  if (status === 'pending') return 'PENDING';
  return status.toUpperCase();
}

function statusColors(status: string): { bg: string; text: string } {
  if (status === 'confirmed') return { bg: 'rgba(168,198,127,0.18)', text: colors.success };
  if (status === 'pending') return { bg: 'rgba(232,167,71,0.18)', text: colors.warning };
  return { bg: 'rgba(155,149,144,0.18)', text: colors.textLight };
}

function dateBadgeLabel(start: Date, today: Date, tomorrow: Date): { top: string; bottom: string } {
  const isSameDay = (a: Date, b: Date) =>
    a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() &&
    a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() &&
    a.getDate() === b.getDate();

  let top: string;
  if (isSameDay(start, today)) {
    top = 'TOD';
  } else if (isSameDay(start, tomorrow)) {
    top = 'TMR';
  } else {
    top = start.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short' }).toUpperCase().slice(0, 3);
  }

  const bottom = start.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: true,
  });

  return { top, bottom };
}

export default function BookScreen() {
  const tabBarHeight = useBottomTabBarHeight();
  const navigation = useNavigation<MainTabScreenProps<'Book'>['navigation']>();
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const scrollRef = useRef<ScrollViewType>(null);
  const summaryY = useRef<number>(0);

  const [calendarOpen, setCalendarOpen] = useState(false);
  const [cageMode, setCageMode] = useState(false);

  const [selectedSessionTypeId, setSelectedSessionTypeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedSlot, setSelectedSlot] = useState<Slot | null>(null);
  const [selectedCoachId, setSelectedCoachId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { data: sessionTypes } = useSessionTypes();
  const selectedSessionType: SessionType | null =
    sessionTypes?.find((s) => s.id === selectedSessionTypeId) ?? null;

  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  const activeLocationData = useActiveLocation();
  const timezone = activeLocationData.data?.timezone ?? null;
  const cageRentalEnabled = (activeLocationData.data as { cage_rental_enabled?: boolean } | null)
    ?.cage_rental_enabled ?? false;

  const { data: membership, weeklyRemaining, weeklyTotal } = useActiveMembership();
  const sessionsRemaining =
    membership?.sessions_remaining !== undefined && membership?.sessions_remaining !== null
      ? membership.sessions_remaining
      : null;

  // Auto-select the first non-cage session type when types load
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sessionTypes || sessionTypes.length === 0) return;
    if (selectedSessionTypeId) return;
    const nonCage = sessionTypes.find((s) => s.type_category !== 'cage');
    if (nonCage) {
      setSelectedSessionTypeId(nonCage.id);
    }
  }, [sessionTypes, selectedSessionTypeId]);

  // When cage mode toggles, switch to appropriate session type
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sessionTypes) return;
    if (cageMode) {
      const cage = sessionTypes.find((s) => s.type_category === 'cage');
      if (cage) {
        setSelectedSessionTypeId(cage.id);
        setSelectedDate(null);
        setSelectedSlot(null);
        setSelectedCoachId(null);
      }
    } else {
      const nonCage = sessionTypes.find((s) => s.type_category !== 'cage');
      if (nonCage) {
        setSelectedSessionTypeId(nonCage.id);
        setSelectedDate(null);
        setSelectedSlot(null);
        setSelectedCoachId(null);
      }
    }
  }, [cageMode, sessionTypes]);

  // Slot availability for the selected date — used for slotIsFull check and BAF
  const slotAvailability = useSlotAvailability(
    selectedDate,
    selectedSessionTypeId,
    selectedSessionType?.type_category ?? null,
    timezone,
  );

  // Canonical slot key for the selected slot
  const selectedWaitlistSlotKey = selectedSlot
    ? `${selectedSlot.coach_id}_${new Date(selectedSlot.start).toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, 'Z')}`
    : null;

  const selectedSlotInfo = selectedWaitlistSlotKey
    ? slotAvailability.data?.get(selectedWaitlistSlotKey)
    : null;

  const slotIsFull =
    !!selectedSlotInfo &&
    selectedSlotInfo.confirmed_count >= selectedSlotInfo.capacity;

  // Remaining spots in the selected slot (used for Bring-a-Friend eligibility)
  const slotRemainingSpots = selectedSlotInfo
    ? Math.max(0, selectedSlotInfo.capacity - selectedSlotInfo.confirmed_count)
    : null;

  const { data: bookings } = useFamilyBookings();
  const today = new Date();
  const tomorrow = new Date(today.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const upcoming = useMemo(() => {
    if (!bookings) return [];
    const now = Date.now();
    return bookings
      .filter(
        (b) =>
          b.status !== 'cancelled' &&
          new Date(b.scheduled_start).getTime() >= now &&
          (!kid || b.kid_id === kid.id),
      )
      .sort(
        (a, b) =>
          new Date(a.scheduled_start).getTime() - new Date(b.scheduled_start).getTime(),
      )
      .slice(0, 3);
  }, [bookings, kid]);

  const handleSelectDate = useCallback((d: string) => {
    setSelectedDate(d);
    setSelectedSlot(null);
    setSelectedCoachId(null);
  }, []);

  const handleSelectSlot = useCallback((slot: Slot, _eligible: string[]) => {
    setSelectedSlot(slot);
    // Always auto-assign coach — names are not shown to the member
    setSelectedCoachId(slot.coach_id);
  }, []);

  const selectedSlotKey = selectedSlot
    ? `${selectedSlot.coach_id}|${selectedSlot.start}`
    : null;

  const scrollToSummary = useCallback(() => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ y: summaryY.current, animated: true });
    }, 80);
  }, []);

  // When the keyboard opens (user tapped a field in the BAF form), scroll
  // to the end so the Confirm button stays visible above the keyboard.
  useEffect(() => {
    const sub = Keyboard.addListener('keyboardDidShow', () => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        scrollRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true });
      }, 100);
    });
    return () => sub.remove();
  }, []);

  const resetSelection = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectedDate(null);
    setSelectedSlot(null);
    setSelectedCoachId(null);
    setCalendarOpen(false);
  }, []);

  const handleBooked = useCallback(
    (formattedWhen: string) => {
      resetSelection();
      navigation.navigate('Home', { screen: 'HomeMain' });
      showToast(`Session booked for ${formattedWhen}`);
    },
    [navigation, resetSelection, showToast],
  );

  const handleWaitlistJoined = useCallback(
    (position: number) => {
      showToast(`You're #${position} on the waitlist!`);
    },
    [showToast],
  );

  const handleMultiDaySlotPick = useCallback(
    (date: string, slot: Slot) => {
      handleSelectDate(date);
      handleSelectSlot(slot, [slot.coach_id]);
      scrollToSummary();
    },
    [handleSelectDate, handleSelectSlot, scrollToSummary],
  );

  const handleCalendarSlotPick = useCallback(
    (slot: Slot, eligible: string[]) => {
      handleSelectSlot(slot, eligible);
      setCalendarOpen(false);
      scrollToSummary();
    },
    [handleSelectSlot, scrollToSummary],
  );

  const summaryLocked =
    !selectedSessionTypeId || !selectedDate || !selectedSlot || !selectedCoachId;

  // Sessions total from the pack (OTC)
  const sessionsTotal =
    membership?.sessions_total !== undefined && membership?.sessions_total !== null
      ? membership.sessions_total
      : null;

  // Credit banner:
  //   OTC pack    → "N of T credits remaining"
  //   EFT limited → "N of T credits this week"
  //   EFT unlimited → "Membership active"
  //   No membership → null (no banner)
  // Label passed to session type cards for member price display
  // OTC and EFT-limited → "1 credit"; EFT-unlimited → "Included"; no membership → null
  const memberCreditLabel: string | null = (() => {
    if (!membership) return null;
    if (membership.plan_type === 'otc') return '1 credit';
    if (membership.plan_type === 'eft') {
      return membership.sessions_per_week != null ? '1 credit' : 'Included';
    }
    return null;
  })();

  // Non-cage session types — shown as selectable cards (step 1 of booking flow)
  const nonCageTypes = useMemo(
    () => (sessionTypes ?? []).filter((s) => s.type_category !== 'cage'),
    [sessionTypes],
  );
  const showSessionTypeCards = !cageMode && nonCageTypes.length > 1;

  const creditsLabel = (() => {
    if (!membership) return null;
    if (membership.plan_type === 'otc' && sessionsRemaining !== null && sessionsTotal !== null) {
      return `${sessionsRemaining} of ${sessionsTotal} credit${sessionsTotal === 1 ? '' : 's'} remaining`;
    }
    if (membership.plan_type === 'eft') {
      if (weeklyTotal !== null && weeklyRemaining !== null) {
        return `${weeklyRemaining} of ${weeklyTotal} credit${weeklyTotal === 1 ? '' : 's'} this week`;
      }
      return 'Membership active';
    }
    return null;
  })();

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={flowStyles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <BookHeader />
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={shellStyles.keyboardAvoid}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'}
        keyboardVerticalOffset={0}
      >
      <ScrollView
        ref={scrollRef}
        style={flowStyles.scroll}
        contentContainerStyle={[
          flowStyles.scrollContent,
          { paddingBottom: tabBarHeight + spacing['4xl'] },
        ]}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {/* YOUR UPCOMING --------------------------------------------------- */}
        <View style={flowStyles.section}>
          <Text style={shellStyles.sectionLabel}>YOUR UPCOMING</Text>
          {upcoming.length === 0 ? (
            <View style={shellStyles.emptyCard}>
              <CalendarIcon size={18} color={colors.gold} />
              <Text style={shellStyles.emptyText}>
                No upcoming sessions. Pick one below.
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            upcoming.map((b) => {
              const start = new Date(b.scheduled_start);
              const badge = dateBadgeLabel(start, today, tomorrow);
              const sc = statusColors(b.status ?? 'pending');
              const locationSub = b.location?.name ?? null;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={b.id}
                  onPress={() =>
                    navigation.navigate('Me', {
                      screen: 'BookingDetail',
                      params: { bookingId: b.id },
                    })
                  }
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    shellStyles.upcomingRow,
                    pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
                  ]}
                >
                  <View style={shellStyles.dateBadge}>
                    <Text style={shellStyles.dateBadgeTop}>{badge.top}</Text>
                    <Text style={shellStyles.dateBadgeBottom}>{badge.bottom}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={shellStyles.upcomingMiddle}>
                    <Text style={shellStyles.upcomingTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
                      {b.session_type?.name ?? 'Session'}
                    </Text>
                    {locationSub ? (
                      <Text style={shellStyles.upcomingSub} numberOfLines={1}>
                        {locationSub}
                      </Text>
                    ) : null}
                  </View>
                  <View style={[shellStyles.statusPill, { backgroundColor: sc.bg }]}>
                    <Text style={[shellStyles.statusPillText, { color: sc.text }]}>
                      {statusLabel(b.status ?? 'pending')}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Credit balance pill --------------------------------------------- */}
        {creditsLabel ? (
          <View style={shellStyles.creditsBanner}>
            <Text style={shellStyles.creditsText}>{creditsLabel}</Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Cage mode toggle ------------------------------------------------- */}
        {cageRentalEnabled ? (
          <View style={shellStyles.cageToggleRow}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setCageMode(false)}
              style={[shellStyles.cageTab, !cageMode && shellStyles.cageTabActive]}
              accessibilityRole="tab"
              accessibilityState={{ selected: !cageMode }}
            >
              <Text style={[shellStyles.cageTabText, !cageMode && shellStyles.cageTabTextActive]}>
                HITTING LESSONS
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setCageMode(true)}
              style={[shellStyles.cageTab, cageMode && shellStyles.cageTabActive]}
              accessibilityRole="tab"
              accessibilityState={{ selected: cageMode }}
            >
              <Text style={[shellStyles.cageTabText, cageMode && shellStyles.cageTabTextActive]}>
                CAGE RENTALS
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* SESSION TYPE SELECTION — shown when > 1 non-cage type available ── */}
        {showSessionTypeCards ? (
          <View style={flowStyles.section}>
            <Text style={shellStyles.sectionLabel}>SELECT SESSION TYPE</Text>
            <SessionTypeSection
              selectedSessionTypeId={selectedSessionTypeId}
              onSelect={(id) => {
                setSelectedSessionTypeId(id);
                setSelectedDate(null);
                setSelectedSlot(null);
                setSelectedCoachId(null);
              }}
              categoryFilter="all"
              memberCreditLabel={memberCreditLabel}
            />
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* AVAILABLE SLOTS ------------------------------------------------- */}
        <View style={flowStyles.section}>
          <Text style={shellStyles.sectionLabel}>AVAILABLE SLOTS</Text>
          <MultiDaySlotList
            sessionType={selectedSessionType}
            onPickSlot={handleMultiDaySlotPick}
          />
        </View>

        {/* Browse other dates button --------------------------------------- */}
        <View style={flowStyles.section}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => {
              if (!selectedSessionTypeId) {
                showToast('Session types still loading — please wait.');
                return;
              }
              setCalendarOpen(true);
            }}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              shellStyles.browseButton,
              pressed && { opacity: 0.75 },
            ]}
            accessibilityRole="button"
          >
            <CalendarIcon size={16} color={colors.textLight} />
            <Text style={shellStyles.browseText}>Browse other dates</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {/* SUMMARY --------------------------------------------------------- */}
        <View
          style={flowStyles.section}
          onLayout={(e) => {
            summaryY.current = e.nativeEvent.layout.y;
          }}
        >
          <SummarySection
            locked={summaryLocked}
            lockedHint="Tap any slot above to see your booking summary."
            sessionType={selectedSessionType}
            date={selectedDate}
            slot={selectedSlot}
            selectedCoachId={selectedCoachId}
            slotIsFull={slotIsFull}
            slotRemainingSpots={slotRemainingSpots}
            onBooked={handleBooked}
            onWaitlistJoined={handleWaitlistJoined}
            onBafError={scrollToSummary}
          />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>

      {/* Browse other dates — bottom-sheet modal -------------------------- */}
      <Modal
        visible={calendarOpen}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setCalendarOpen(false)}
      >
        <View style={shellStyles.modalOverlay}>
          <Pressable
            style={shellStyles.modalBackdrop}
            onPress={() => setCalendarOpen(false)}
          />

          <View style={shellStyles.modalSheet}>
            <View style={shellStyles.modalHandle} />

            <View style={shellStyles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={shellStyles.modalTitle}>BROWSE DATES</Text>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setCalendarOpen(false)}
                style={shellStyles.modalCloseBtn}
                hitSlop={12}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="Close"
              >
                <X size={20} color={colors.textLight} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            <ScrollView
              style={shellStyles.modalScroll}
              contentContainerStyle={shellStyles.modalScrollContent}
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            >
              <DateSection
                locked={false}
                durationMinutes={selectedSessionType?.duration_minutes ?? null}
                selectedDate={selectedDate}
                onSelectDate={handleSelectDate}
              />
              {selectedDate ? (
                <View style={shellStyles.modalTimeSectionWrap}>
                  <TimeSection
                    locked={false}
                    date={selectedDate}
                    sessionTypeId={selectedSessionTypeId}
                    durationMinutes={selectedSessionType?.duration_minutes ?? null}
                    selectedSlotKey={selectedSlotKey}
                    onSelectSlot={handleCalendarSlotPick}
                  />
                </View>
              ) : null}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const shellStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  keyboardAvoid: {
    flex: 1,
  },

    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,

    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,

  },

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import {
  colors,
  fontFamilies,
  fontSizes,
  radius,
  spacing,
  tracking,
} from '@/theme';

import { dayOfWeekUtc } from '../utils/availability';

type Props = {
  range: string[];
  today: string;
  availableDates: Set<string>;
  selectedDate: string | null;
  onSelect: (ymd: string) => void;
};

const WEEKDAY_LABELS = ['S', 'M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S'];
const MONTH_LABELS = [
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
  'October',
  'November',
  'December',
];

type Cell =
  | { kind: 'pad'; key: string }
  | {
      kind: 'day';
      key: string;
      ymd: string;
      day: number;
      inRange: boolean;
      available: boolean;
      isToday: boolean;
      isSelected: boolean;
    };

type MonthGroup = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  cells: Cell[];
};

function buildMonths(
  range: string[],
  today: string,
  availableDates: Set<string>,
  selectedDate: string | null,
): MonthGroup[] {
  if (range.length === 0) return [];
  const inRange = new Set(range);
  const first = range[0]!;
  const last = range[range.length - 1]!;
  const [fy, fm] = first.split('-').map(Number);
  const [ly, lm] = last.split('-').map(Number);

  const months: MonthGroup[] = [];
  let y = fy;
  let m = fm;
  while (y < ly || (y === ly && m <= lm)) {
    const monthKey = `${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    const daysInMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, 0)).getUTCDate();
    const firstDow = dayOfWeekUtc(`${monthKey}-01`);

    const cells: Cell[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < firstDow; i++) {
      cells.push({ kind: 'pad', key: `${monthKey}-pad-${i}` });
    }
    for (let day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
      const ymd = `${monthKey}-${String(day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      cells.push({
        kind: 'day',
        key: ymd,
        ymd,
        day,
        inRange: inRange.has(ymd),
        available: availableDates.has(ymd),
        isToday: ymd === today,
        isSelected: ymd === selectedDate,
      });
    }
    months.push({
      key: monthKey,
      label: `${MONTH_LABELS[m - 1]} ${y}`,
      cells,
    });

    m += 1;
    if (m > 12) {
      m = 1;
      y += 1;
    }
  }
  return months;
}

export default function Calendar({
  range,
  today,
  availableDates,
  selectedDate,
  onSelect,
}: Props) {
  const months = useMemo(
    () => buildMonths(range, today, availableDates, selectedDate),
    [range, today, availableDates, selectedDate],
  );

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {months.map((month) => (
        <View key={month.key} style={styles.month}>
          <Text style={styles.monthLabel}>{month.label}</Text>
          <View style={styles.weekdayRow}>
            {WEEKDAY_LABELS.map((label, idx) => (
              <View key={`${month.key}-w-${idx}`} style={styles.cell}>
                <Text style={styles.weekdayText}>{label}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
          <View style={styles.grid}>
            {month.cells.map((cell) => {
              if (cell.kind === 'pad') {
                return <View key={cell.key} style={styles.cell} />;
              }
              const tappable = cell.inRange && cell.available && !cell.isSelected;
              return (
                <View key={cell.key} style={styles.cell}>
                  <Pressable
                    disabled={!cell.inRange || !cell.available}
                    onPress={() => onSelect(cell.ymd)}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityState={{
                      selected: cell.isSelected,
                      disabled: !cell.inRange || !cell.available,
                    }}
                    accessibilityLabel={`${cell.ymd}${cell.available ? '' : ', unavailable'}${cell.isToday ? ', today' : ''}`}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.day,
                      cell.available && cell.inRange && styles.dayAvailable,
                      cell.isToday && styles.dayToday,
                      cell.isSelected && styles.daySelected,
                      pressed && tappable && styles.dayPressed,
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.dayText,
                        (!cell.inRange || !cell.available) && styles.dayTextDim,
                        cell.available && cell.inRange && styles.dayTextAvailable,
                        cell.isSelected && styles.dayTextSelected,
                      ]}
                    >
                      {cell.day}
                    </Text>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

const CELL_PERCENT = `${100 / 7}%` as const;

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

import { Image, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

  colors,

  spacing,
  tracking,
} from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
  specialty: string | null;
  bio: string | null;
  selected?: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  onPress?: () => void;
};

function initials(first: string, last: string): string {
  const a = first.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  const b = last.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  return `${a}${b}` || '?';
}

export default function CoachCard({
  firstName,
  lastName,
  avatarUrl,
  specialty,
  bio,
  selected = false,
  readOnly = false,
  onPress,
}: Props) {
  const fullName = `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim();
  const subtitle = specialty ?? bio ?? null;

  const content = (
    <>
      {readOnly ? (
        <View style={styles.badgeRow}>
          <Text style={styles.badge}>Auto-selected</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <View style={styles.row}>
        <View style={styles.avatar}>
          {avatarUrl ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: avatarUrl }} style={styles.avatarImage} />
          ) : (
            <Text style={styles.avatarInitials}>{initials(firstName, lastName)}</Text>
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={styles.body}>
          <Text style={[styles.name, selected && styles.nameSelected]} numberOfLines={1}>
            {fullName}
          </Text>
          {subtitle ? (
            <Text
              style={[styles.subtitle, selected && styles.subtitleSelected]}
              numberOfLines={2}
            >
              {subtitle}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      </View>
    </>
  );

  if (readOnly || !onPress) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[styles.card, styles.cardReadOnly]}
        accessibilityRole="text"
        accessibilityLabel={`${fullName}, automatically selected`}
      >

        styles.card,
        selected && styles.cardSelected,
        pressed && !selected && styles.cardPressed,

    </Pressable>
  );
}

import { ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';

import { useCoaches } from '../hooks/useCoaches';
import CoachCard from './CoachCard';
import SectionCard from './SectionCard';

type Props = {
  locked: boolean;
  lockedHint?: string;
  autoSelectedCoachId: string | null;
  eligibleCoachIds: string[];
  selectedCoachId: string | null;
  onSelectCoach: (coachId: string) => void;
};

export default function CoachSection({
  locked,
  lockedHint,
  autoSelectedCoachId,
  eligibleCoachIds,
  selectedCoachId,
  onSelectCoach,
}: Props) {
  const coaches = useCoaches();
  const findCoach = (id: string) =>
    coaches.data?.find((c) => c.id === id) ?? null;
  const autoCoach = autoSelectedCoachId ? findCoach(autoSelectedCoachId) : null;

  const renderBody = () => {
    if (locked) {
      return (
        <View style={styles.placeholder}>
          <Text style={styles.placeholderText}>
            Available coaches will appear here.
          </Text>
        </View>
      );
    }

    if (coaches.isPending) {
      return (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      );
    }

    if (coaches.isError) {
      return (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <Text style={styles.errorText}>Couldn&apos;t load coaches.</Text>
          <Text
            style={styles.retry}
            onPress={() => {
              if (!coaches.isRefetching) void coaches.refetch();
            }}
          >
            {coaches.isRefetching ? 'Retrying…' : 'Tap to retry'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      );
    }

    if (autoCoach) {
      return (
        <CoachCard
          firstName={autoCoach.first_name}
          lastName={autoCoach.last_name}
          avatarUrl={autoCoach.avatar_url}
          specialty={autoCoach.specialty}
          bio={autoCoach.bio}
          readOnly
        />
      );
    }

    // Intersect eligible IDs with the resolved coach rows; if the intersection
    // is empty (no eligible coach, or every eligible ID failed to resolve to
    // an active coach in the cache), show the defensive empty state.
    const visibleCoaches = eligibleCoachIds
      .map((id) => findCoach(id))
      .filter((c): c is NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof findCoach>> => c !== null);

    if (visibleCoaches.length === 0) {
      return (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
            No coaches available for this slot.
          </Text>
        </View>
      );
    }

    return (
      <View style={styles.list}>
        {visibleCoaches.map((coach) => (
          <CoachCard
            key={coach.id}
            firstName={coach.first_name}
            lastName={coach.last_name}
            avatarUrl={coach.avatar_url}
            specialty={coach.specialty}
            bio={coach.bio}
            selected={coach.id === selectedCoachId}
            onPress={() => onSelectCoach(coach.id)}
          />
        ))}
      </View>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SectionCard
      title="Coach"
      locked={locked}
      lockedHint={locked ? lockedHint : undefined}
    >
      {renderBody()}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  placeholder: {
    minHeight: 80,
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  placeholderText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textLight,
  },
  state: {
    minHeight: 80,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: spacing.base,
  },
  errorText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textLight,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  retry: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.gold,
  },
  emptyText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textLight,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  list: {
    gap: spacing.lg,
  },
});

FILE: src/screens/Book/components/DateSection.tsx

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';

import { useCoachAvailability } from '../hooks/useCoachAvailability';
import { useActiveLocation } from '../hooks/useActiveLocation';
import { computeAvailableDates } from '../utils/availability';
import Calendar from './Calendar';
import SectionCard from './SectionCard';

type Props = {
  locked: boolean;
  durationMinutes: number | null;
  selectedDate: string | null;
  onSelectDate: (ymd: string) => void;
};

export default function DateSection({
  locked,
  durationMinutes,
  selectedDate,
  onSelectDate,
}: Props) {
  const availability = useCoachAvailability();
  const location = useActiveLocation();

  const computed = useMemo(() => {
    if (!availability.data || durationMinutes == null) return null;
    return computeAvailableDates({
      durationMinutes,
      rows: availability.data,
      timezone: location.data?.timezone ?? null,
      daysAhead: 30,
    });
  }, [availability.data, durationMinutes, location.data?.timezone]);

  // A disabled query (no primary_location_id on the family) reports
  // isPending=true forever; treat fetchStatus='idle' as "not loading" so the
  // calendar still renders using the device timezone fallback.
  const locationLoading =
    location.fetchStatus !== 'idle' && location.isPending && !location.data;
  const isPending = availability.isPending || locationLoading;
  const isError = availability.isError || location.isError;
  const isRefetching = availability.isRefetching || location.isRefetching;
  const retry = () => {
    if (availability.isError) void availability.refetch();
    if (location.isError) void location.refetch();
  };

  return (
    <SectionCard
      title="Date"
      locked={locked}
      lockedHint={locked ? 'Pick a session type first.' : undefined}
    >
      {locked ? (
        <View style={styles.placeholder}>
          <Text style={styles.placeholderText}>Calendar will appear here.</Text>
        </View>
      ) : isPending ? (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : isError ? (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <Text style={styles.errorText}>
            Couldn&apos;t load availability.
          </Text>
          <Text
            style={styles.retry}
            onPress={() => {
              if (!isRefetching) retry();
            }}
          >
            {isRefetching ? 'Retrying…' : 'Tap to retry'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : !computed || computed.availableDates.size === 0 ? (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
            No dates available in the next 30 days.
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <Calendar
          range={computed.range}
          today={computed.today}
          availableDates={computed.availableDates}
          selectedDate={selectedDate}
          onSelect={onSelectDate}
        />
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  placeholder: {
    minHeight: 80,
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  placeholderText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textLight,
  },
  state: {
    minHeight: 80,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: spacing.base,
  },
  errorText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textLight,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  retry: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.gold,
  },
  emptyText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textLight,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
});

FILE: src/screens/Book/components/MultiDaySlotList.tsx
=================================================================================
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import { getDaySlotAvailability, type SlotAvailability } from '@/api/waitlist';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { useCoachAvailability } from '../hooks/useCoachAvailability';
import { useDayBookings } from '../hooks/useDayBookings';
import { useActiveLocation } from '../hooks/useActiveLocation';
import { formatSlotTime, generateDaySlots, dayBoundsUtcISO, type Slot, type AvailabilityForSlots } from '../utils/slots';
import type { SessionType } from '@/api/bookings';

type Props = {
  sessionType: SessionType | null;
  onPickSlot: (date: string, slot: Slot) => void;
};

function ymd(d: Date): string {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${dd}`;
}

function getShortDayLabel(date: string, index: number): string {
  if (index === 0) return 'TODAY';
  if (index === 1) return 'TOMORROW';
  const d = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00`);
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short' }).toUpperCase();
}

function getMonthDay(date: string): string {
  const d = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00`);
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

function useDaySlotAvailability(
  date: string,
  sessionTypeId: string,
  timezone: string | null,
) {
  const { family } = useFamily();
  const tenantId = family?.tenant_id ?? null;

  return useQuery<Map<string, SlotAvailability>>({
    queryKey: ['slot_availability', tenantId, sessionTypeId, date, timezone ?? null],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const { startISO, endISO } = dayBoundsUtcISO(date, timezone);
      return getDaySlotAvailability({
        tenant_id: tenantId as string,
        session_type_id: sessionTypeId,
        start: startISO,
        end: endISO,
      });
    },
    enabled: !!tenantId && !!date && !!sessionTypeId,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}

function capacityLabel(info: SlotAvailability | undefined): string | null {
  if (!info) return null;
  const remaining = info.capacity - info.confirmed_count;
  if (remaining <= 0) return 'Full';
  if (info.capacity === 1) return null;
  return `${remaining} of ${info.capacity}`;
}

function slotKey(slot: Slot): string {
  return `${slot.coach_id}_${new Date(slot.start).toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, 'Z')}`;
}

function DayColumn({
  date,
  dayLabel,
  monthDay,
  sessionType,
  availability,
  timezone,
  onPickSlot,
}: {
  date: string;
  dayLabel: string;
  monthDay: string;
  sessionType: SessionType;
  availability: AvailabilityForSlots[] | undefined;
  timezone: string | null;
  onPickSlot: (slot: Slot) => void;
}) {
  const bookings = useDayBookings(date, timezone);
  const slotAvail = useDaySlotAvailability(date, sessionType.id, timezone);
  const isPending = bookings.isPending || !availability;

  const slots =
    !isPending && availability && bookings.data
      ? generateDaySlots({
          date,
          durationMinutes: sessionType.duration_minutes,
          timezone,
          availability,
          bookings: bookings.data,
        })
      : [];

  return (
    <View style={styles.column}>
      <View style={styles.colHeader}>
        <Text style={styles.colDayLabel}>{dayLabel}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.colMonthDay}>{monthDay}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.colDivider} />

      {isPending ? (
        <View style={styles.colState}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : slots.length === 0 ? (
        <View style={styles.colState}>
          <Text style={styles.colNoneText}>None open</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.chips}>
          {slots.map((slot) => {
            const key = slotKey(slot);
            const info = slotAvail.data?.get(key);
            const isFull = !!info && info.confirmed_count >= info.capacity;
            const capLabel = capacityLabel(info);
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={`${slot.coach_id}|${slot.start}`}
                onPress={() => onPickSlot(slot)}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.chip,
                  isFull && styles.chipFull,
                  pressed && !isFull && styles.chipPressed,
                ]}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel={`${formatSlotTime(slot.start, timezone)}${isFull ? ', full' : ''}`}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.chipTime, isFull && styles.chipTimeFull]}>
                  {formatSlotTime(slot.start, timezone)}
                </Text>
                {capLabel ? (
                  <Text style={[styles.chipCapacity, isFull && styles.chipCapacityFull]}>
                    {capLabel}
                  </Text>
                ) : null}
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function MultiDaySlotList({ sessionType, onPickSlot }: Props) {
  const availability = useCoachAvailability();
  const location = useActiveLocation();

  const timezone = location.data?.timezone ?? null;

  const today = new Date();
  const days = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => {
    const d = new Date(today.getTime() + i * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    return ymd(d);
  });

  if (!sessionType) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.noTypeHint}>
        <Text style={styles.noTypeText}>
          Loading available slots…
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrollView
      horizontal
      showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.row}
    >
      {days.map((date, i) => (
        <DayColumn
          key={date}
          date={date}
          dayLabel={getShortDayLabel(date, i)}
          monthDay={getMonthDay(date)}
          sessionType={sessionType}
          availability={availability.data}
          timezone={timezone}
          onPickSlot={(slot) => onPickSlot(date, slot)}
        />
      ))}
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const COLUMN_WIDTH = 116;

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  noTypeHint: {
    padding: spacing['2xl'],
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
    backgroundColor: colors.dark,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
  },
  noTypeText: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  row: {
    gap: spacing.base,
    paddingRight: spacing.lg,
    alignItems: 'stretch',
  },
  column: {
    width: COLUMN_WIDTH,
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
    backgroundColor: colors.dark,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    overflow: 'hidden',
  },
  colHeader: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    paddingTop: spacing.lg,
    paddingBottom: spacing.base,
  },
  colDayLabel: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
  },
  colMonthDay: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
    marginTop: 1,
  },
  colDivider: {
    height: 1,
    backgroundColor: colors.border,
    marginHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    marginBottom: spacing.base,
  },
  colState: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    paddingBottom: spacing.lg,
    minHeight: 52,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    flex: 1,
  },

import { Hash, User, Users } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import {
  colors,
  fontFamilies,
  fontSizes,
  radius,
  spacing,
  tracking,
} from '@/theme';

type TypeCategory = 'private' | 'group' | 'cage' | string;

type Props = {
  name: string;
  durationMinutes: number;
  basePriceCents: number;
  selected: boolean;
  typeCategory?: TypeCategory;
  /**
   * When provided, replaces the dollar-price display.
   * Pass "1 credit", "Included", etc. for members.
   * Non-members receive null/undefined and see the dollar amount.
   */
  priceOverride?: string | null;
  onPress: () => void;
};

function formatDuration(mins: number): string {
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins} min`;
  const hours = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  const rest = mins % 60;
  if (rest === 0) return hours === 1 ? '1 hr' : `${hours} hr`;
  return `${hours} hr ${rest} min`;
}

function formatPrice(cents: number): string {
  if (cents === 0) return 'Free';
  const dollars = cents / 100;
  return cents % 100 === 0 ? `$${dollars}` : `$${dollars.toFixed(2)}`;
}

function CategoryIcon({
  typeCategory,
  selected,
}: {
  typeCategory: TypeCategory;
  selected: boolean;
}) {
  const color = selected ? colors.gold : colors.textLight;
  const size = 28;
  if (typeCategory === 'group') return <Users size={size} color={color} />;
  if (typeCategory === 'cage') return <Hash size={size} color={color} />;
  return <User size={size} color={color} />;
}

export default function SessionTypeCard({
  name,
  durationMinutes,
  basePriceCents,
  selected,
  typeCategory = 'private',
  priceOverride,
  onPress,
}: Props) {
  // Free sessions always show "Free" regardless of membership status
  const isFree = basePriceCents === 0;
  const displayPrice = isFree
    ? 'Free'
    : (priceOverride ?? formatPrice(basePriceCents));

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.card,
        selected && styles.cardSelected,
        pressed && !selected && styles.cardPressed,
      ]}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityState={{ selected }}
      accessibilityLabel={`${name}, ${formatDuration(durationMinutes)}, ${displayPrice}`}
    >
      <View style={styles.iconWrap}>
        <CategoryIcon typeCategory={typeCategory} selected={selected} />
      </View>
      <Text style={[styles.name, selected && styles.nameSelected]} numberOfLines={2}>
        {name}
      </Text>
      <Text style={[styles.duration, selected && styles.durationSelected]}>
        {formatDuration(durationMinutes)}
      </Text>
      <Text style={[styles.price, selected && styles.priceSelected]}>
        {displayPrice}
      </Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

import { ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';

import { useSessionTypes } from '../hooks/useSessionTypes';
import SessionTypeCard from './SessionTypeCard';

type Props = {
  selectedSessionTypeId: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
  categoryFilter?: 'all' | 'private' | 'group' | 'cage';
  /**
   * When provided, replaces the dollar-price display on every non-free
   * session type card. Pass "1 credit" for OTC/EFT limited members,
   * "Included" for EFT unlimited members, or null for non-members.
   */
  memberCreditLabel?: string | null;
};

export default function SessionTypeSection({
  selectedSessionTypeId,
  onSelect,
  categoryFilter = 'all',
  memberCreditLabel,
}: Props) {
  const { data: raw, isPending, isError, refetch, isRefetching } = useSessionTypes();
  const data =
    categoryFilter === 'all' || !raw
      ? raw
      : raw.filter((s) => s.type_category === categoryFilter);

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.state}>
        <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.state}>
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>
          Couldn&apos;t load sessions. Pull down to try again.
        </Text>
        <Text
          style={styles.retry}
          onPress={() => {
            if (!isRefetching) void refetch();
          }}
        >
          {isRefetching ? 'Retrying…' : 'Tap to retry'}
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.state}>
        <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No sessions available.</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.grid}>
      {data.map((s) => (
        <SessionTypeCard
          key={s.id}
          name={s.name}
          durationMinutes={s.duration_minutes}
          basePriceCents={s.base_price_cents}
          typeCategory={s.type_category ?? 'private'}
          selected={selectedSessionTypeId === s.id}
          priceOverride={memberCreditLabel}
          onPress={() => onSelect(s.id)}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  grid: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: spacing.lg,
  },
  state: {
    minHeight: 80,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: spacing.base,
  },
  errorText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textLight,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  retry: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.gold,
  },
  emptyText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textLight,
  },
});
