import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Modal, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, TextInput, View } from 'react-native';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { useActiveMembership } from '@/hooks/useActiveMembership';
import { activeMembershipKey } from '@/hooks/useActiveMembership';
import { useJoinWaitlist } from '@/hooks/useWaitlistEntries';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import type { Tables } from '@/types/database';

import { useCoaches } from '../hooks/useCoaches';
import { useCreateBooking, isNoSessionCreditsError, type CreateBookingResult } from '../hooks/useCreateBooking';
import { useActiveLocation } from '../hooks/useActiveLocation';
import { bookSessionWithFriend, type BookWithFriendResult } from '@/api/memberships';
import type { SessionType } from '@/api/bookings';
import type { Slot } from '../utils/slots';
import SectionCard from './SectionCard';

type Kid = Tables<'kids'>;

type Props = {
  locked: boolean;
  lockedHint?: string;
  sessionType: SessionType | null;
  date: string | null;
  slot: Slot | null;
  selectedCoachId: string | null;
  /** When true the slot is at capacity — show "Join Waitlist" instead of "Confirm Booking" */
  slotIsFull?: boolean;
  /** Number of remaining spots in the selected slot (for Bring-a-Friend eligibility) */
  slotRemainingSpots?: number | null;
  onBooked: (formattedWhen: string) => void;
  onWaitlistJoined?: (position: number) => void;
  /** Called after a BAF booking error so the parent can scroll the error into view */
  onBafError?: () => void;
};

/** Extract a human-readable message from any thrown value */
function extractMessage(err: unknown): string {
  if (err === null || err === undefined) return 'Something went wrong.';
  if (typeof err === 'string') return err.trim() || 'Something went wrong.';
  if (typeof err === 'object') {
    console.error('[BAF] bookSessionWithFriend error:', JSON.stringify(err));
    const o = err as Record<string, unknown>;
    const pick = (v: unknown) => (typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim() : '');
    return pick(o.message) || pick(o.details) || pick(o.hint) || pick(o.code) || 'Something went wrong.';
  }
  return 'Something went wrong.';
}

const BAF_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;

function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number, timeoutMsg: string): Promise<T> {
  return Promise.race([
    promise,
    new Promise<T>((_, reject) =>
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(timeoutMsg)), ms),
    ),
  ]);
}

function formatPriceUSD(cents: number): string {
  if (cents === 0) return 'Free';
  const dollars = cents / 100;
  return cents % 100 === 0 ? `$${dollars}` : `$${dollars.toFixed(2)}`;
}

function formatDateLabel(ymd: string, timezone: string | null | undefined): string {
  const [y, m, d] = ymd.split('-').map(Number);
  const anchor = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d, 12, 0, 0));
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: timezone || undefined,
      weekday: 'short',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    }).format(anchor);
  } catch {
    return ymd;
  }
}

function formatTimeLabel(iso: string, timezone: string | null | undefined): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: timezone || undefined,
      hour: 'numeric',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: true,
    }).format(new Date(iso));
  } catch {
    const dt = new Date(iso);
    return `${dt.getHours()}:${String(dt.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
}

export default function SummarySection({
  locked,
  lockedHint,
  sessionType,
  date,
  slot,
  selectedCoachId,
  slotIsFull = false,
  slotRemainingSpots = null,
  onBooked,
  onWaitlistJoined,
  onBafError,
}: Props) {
  const { family, kid: defaultKid, kids } = useSelectedKid();
  const location = useActiveLocation();
  const coaches = useCoaches();
  const createBooking = useCreateBooking();
  const { data: membership, weeklyRemaining, weeklyTotal } = useActiveMembership();
  const joinWaitlist = useJoinWaitlist();

  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const [errorVisible, setErrorVisible] = useState(false);
  const [kidPickerVisible, setKidPickerVisible] = useState(false);
  const [overrideKidId, setOverrideKidId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [noCreditsVisible, setNoCreditsVisible] = useState(false);
  const [bookingResult, setBookingResult] = useState<CreateBookingResult | null>(null);
  const [bafResult, setBafResult] = useState<BookWithFriendResult | null>(null);
  const [bafPending, setBafPending] = useState(false);
  const [bafBookingError, setBafBookingError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [waitlistPosition, setWaitlistPosition] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Bring-a-Friend: pre-confirm form state
  const [bafOptedIn, setBafOptedIn] = useState(false);
  const [bafName, setBafName] = useState('');
  const [bafPhone, setBafPhone] = useState('');
  const [bafEmail, setBafEmail] = useState('');
  const [bafError, setBafError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const activeKid: Kid | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (overrideKidId) {
      return kids.find((k) => k.id === overrideKidId) ?? defaultKid;
    }
    return defaultKid;
  }, [overrideKidId, kids, defaultKid]);

  const multipleKids = kids.length > 1;

  const tz = location.data?.timezone ?? null;
  const coach = useMemo(
    () => coaches.data?.find((c) => c.id === selectedCoachId) ?? null,
    [coaches.data, selectedCoachId],
  );

  const ready =
    !locked &&
    !!sessionType &&
    !!date &&
    !!slot &&
    !!coach &&
    !!family &&
    !!activeKid &&
    !!location.data;

  const dateLabel = ready ? formatDateLabel(date as string, tz) : null;
  const timeLabel = ready ? formatTimeLabel((slot as Slot).start, tz) : null;

  // ── Membership-aware credit state ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const hasMembership = !!membership;
  const isFreeSession = sessionType?.base_price_cents === 0;

  // OTC pack
  const isOtcPack =
    membership?.plan_type === 'otc' &&
    membership.sessions_remaining !== null &&
    membership.sessions_total !== null;
  const otcRemaining = isOtcPack ? (membership!.sessions_remaining as number) : null;
  const otcTotal     = isOtcPack ? (membership!.sessions_total as number) : null;

  // EFT limited (has sessions_per_week)
  const isEftLimited = membership?.plan_type === 'eft' && weeklyTotal !== null;

  // Out of credits check — covers both OTC and EFT limited
  const outOfCredits =
    (otcRemaining !== null && otcRemaining === 0) ||
    (isEftLimited && weeklyRemaining !== null && weeklyRemaining === 0);

  // Price label for solo booking
  const priceLabel = useMemo((): string | null => {
    if (!sessionType) return null;
    if (isFreeSession) return 'Free';
    // Members: show credit label instead of dollar
    if (hasMembership) return '1 credit';
    return formatPriceUSD(sessionType.base_price_cents);
  }, [sessionType, hasMembership, isFreeSession]);

  // Price label when BAF is opted in
  const bafPriceLabel = useMemo((): string | null => {
    if (!sessionType) return null;
    if (isFreeSession) return 'Free';
    if (hasMembership) return '2 credits';
    return `${formatPriceUSD(sessionType.base_price_cents)} × 2 sessions`;
  }, [sessionType, hasMembership, isFreeSession]);

  /**
   * Bring-a-Friend eligibility:
   * - Member has >= 2 sessions available (or unlimited EFT)
   * - Slot has >= 2 remaining spots
   */
  const bafEligible = useMemo((): boolean => {
    if (slotIsFull) return false;
    if (slotRemainingSpots !== null && slotRemainingSpots < 2) return false;
    // OTC: need >= 2 remaining
    if (otcRemaining !== null && otcRemaining < 2) return false;
    // EFT limited: need >= 2 weekly remaining
    if (isEftLimited && weeklyRemaining !== null && weeklyRemaining < 2) return false;
    return true;
  }, [slotIsFull, slotRemainingSpots, otcRemaining, isEftLimited, weeklyRemaining]);

  // Credits preview after booking (used in OTC "After booking" row)
  const creditsAfterPrimary = otcRemaining !== null ? Math.max(0, otcRemaining - 1) : null;
  const creditsAfterBaf     = otcRemaining !== null ? Math.max(0, otcRemaining - 2) : null;
  const creditsDisplayAfter = bafOptedIn ? creditsAfterBaf : creditsAfterPrimary;

  // Weekly credits after booking (EFT limited preview)
  const weeklyAfterPrimary = weeklyRemaining !== null ? Math.max(0, weeklyRemaining - 1) : null;
  const weeklyAfterBaf     = weeklyRemaining !== null ? Math.max(0, weeklyRemaining - 2) : null;
  const weeklyDisplayAfter = bafOptedIn ? weeklyAfterBaf : weeklyAfterPrimary;

  useEffect(() => {
    setBookingResult(null);
    setBafResult(null);
    setBafPending(false);
    setBafBookingError(null);
    setErrorVisible(false);
    setNoCreditsVisible(false);
    setBafOptedIn(false);
    setBafName('');
    setBafPhone('');
    setBafEmail('');
    setBafError(null);
    setWaitlistPosition(null);
  }, [slot, date, sessionType?.id, selectedCoachId]);

  const formattedWhenRef = useRef<string>('');

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (!ready || createBooking.isPending || bafPending || !activeKid || outOfCredits) return;
    if (bafOptedIn && !bafName.trim()) {
      setBafError('Friend\'s name is required to add them.');
      return;
    }
    setErrorVisible(false);
    setNoCreditsVisible(false);
    setBookingResult(null);
    setBafResult(null);
    setBafBookingError(null);

    formattedWhenRef.current = `${dateLabel} at ${timeLabel}`;

    // ── BAF path ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (bafOptedIn) {
      setBafPending(true);
      try {
        const result = await withTimeout(
          bookSessionWithFriend({
            tenant_id:        family!.tenant_id,
            location_id:      location.data!.id,
            kid_id:           activeKid.id,
            coach_id:         coach!.id,
            session_type_id:  sessionType!.id,
            scheduled_start:  (slot as Slot).start,
            scheduled_end:    (slot as Slot).end,
            guest_name:       bafName.trim(),
            guest_phone:      bafPhone.trim() || null,
            guest_email:      bafEmail.trim() || null,
          }),
          BAF_TIMEOUT_MS,
          'Unable to complete booking — please try again.',
        );
        setBafResult(result);
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['day_bookings'] });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['upcoming-session'] });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['family_bookings'] });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: activeMembershipKey(activeKid.id) });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['family'] });
        void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['points_ledger'] });
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = extractMessage(err);
        setBafBookingError(
          msg.includes('no_session_credits')
            ? 'Not enough credits for Bring-a-Friend (need 2).'
            : msg,
        );
        onBafError?.();
      } finally {
        setBafPending(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    // ── Normal path ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const insert = {
      tenant_id:       family!.tenant_id,
      location_id:     location.data!.id,
      kid_id:          activeKid.id,
      coach_id:        coach!.id,
      session_type_id: sessionType!.id,
      scheduled_start: (slot as Slot).start,
      scheduled_end:   (slot as Slot).end,
      status:          'confirmed' as const,
    };

    createBooking.mutate(insert, {
      onSuccess: (result) => {
        setBookingResult(result);
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        if (isNoSessionCreditsError(err)) {
          setNoCreditsVisible(true);
        } else {
          setErrorVisible(true);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleDone = () => {
    onBooked(formattedWhenRef.current);
  };

  const handleJoinWaitlist = () => {
    if (!ready || joinWaitlist.isPending) return;
    setErrorVisible(false);

    const slotKey = `${(slot as Slot).coach_id}_${new Date((slot as Slot).start).toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, 'Z')}`;

    joinWaitlist.mutate(
      {
        session_slot_key: slotKey,
        coach_id: coach!.id,
        session_type_id: sessionType!.id,
        location_id: location.data!.id,
        scheduled_start: (slot as Slot).start,
        scheduled_end: (slot as Slot).end,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: (entry) => {
          setWaitlistPosition(entry.position);
          onWaitlistJoined?.(entry.position);
        },
        onError: () => {
          setErrorVisible(true);
        },
      },
    );
  };

  // Post-booking success — BAF path
  if (bafResult !== null) {
    const otcBalanceAfter = bafResult.sessions_remaining;
    const weeklyBalanceAfter = bafResult.weekly_sessions_remaining;
    const showOtcBalance  = isOtcPack && otcBalanceAfter >= 0;
    const showEftBalance  = isEftLimited && weeklyBalanceAfter >= 0 && weeklyTotal !== null;
    return (
      <SectionCard title="Summary" locked={false}>
        <View style={styles.confirmedBlock}>
          <Text style={styles.confirmedTitle}>Sessions booked!</Text>
          <Text style={styles.confirmedWhen}>{formattedWhenRef.current}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.confirmedProvider}>Infinite Hitting</Text>
          <View style={styles.bafResultBox}>
            <Text style={[styles.bafResultText, styles.bafResultSuccess]}>
              ✓ Friend spot reserved · +100 points earned
            </Text>
          </View>
          {showOtcBalance ? (
            <View style={styles.balanceBox}>
              <Text style={styles.balanceLabel}>Credits remaining</Text>
              <Text style={styles.balanceNumber}>{otcBalanceAfter}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.balanceOf}>of {otcTotal}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          {showEftBalance ? (
            <View style={styles.balanceBox}>
              <Text style={styles.balanceLabel}>Credits this week</Text>
              <Text style={styles.balanceNumber}>{weeklyBalanceAfter}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.balanceOf}>of {weeklyTotal} remaining</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          <Button label="Done" onPress={handleDone} variant="primary" />
        </View>
      </SectionCard>
    );
  }

  // Post-booking success — normal path
  if (bookingResult !== null) {
    const otcBalanceAfter    = bookingResult.sessionsRemaining;
    const showOtcBalance     = isOtcPack && otcBalanceAfter >= 0;
    // weeklyRemaining from the hook already reflects the latest DB state after
    // invalidation; show it if this is an EFT limited membership.
    const showEftBalance     = isEftLimited && weeklyTotal !== null;
    return (
      <SectionCard title="Summary" locked={false}>
        <View style={styles.confirmedBlock}>
          <Text style={styles.confirmedTitle}>Session booked!</Text>
          <Text style={styles.confirmedWhen}>{formattedWhenRef.current}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.confirmedProvider}>Infinite Hitting</Text>
          {showOtcBalance ? (
            <View style={styles.balanceBox}>
              <Text style={styles.balanceLabel}>Credits remaining</Text>
              <Text style={styles.balanceNumber}>{otcBalanceAfter}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.balanceOf}>of {otcTotal}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          {showEftBalance ? (
            <View style={styles.balanceBox}>
              <Text style={styles.balanceLabel}>Credits this week</Text>
              <Text style={styles.balanceNumber}>{weeklyRemaining ?? '—'}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.balanceOf}>of {weeklyTotal} remaining</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          <Button label="Done" onPress={handleDone} variant="primary" />
        </View>
      </SectionCard>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <SectionCard
        title="Summary"
        locked={locked}
        lockedHint={locked ? lockedHint : undefined}
      >
        {ready ? (
          <View style={styles.lines}>
            <SummaryLine label="Session" value={sessionType!.name} />
            <SummaryLine label="Date" value={dateLabel as string} />
            <SummaryLine label="Time" value={timeLabel as string} />
            <SummaryLine label="Provider" value="Infinite Hitting" />
            {!slotIsFull ? (
              <SummaryLine
                label="Price"
                value={bafOptedIn ? (bafPriceLabel as string) : (priceLabel as string)}
                valueStyle={hasMembership && !isFreeSession ? styles.lineValueGold : undefined}
              />
            ) : (
              <SummaryLine label="Status" value="Session Full — Waitlist" />
            )}

            {/* Kid selector — only shown when family has multiple kids */}
            {multipleKids ? (
              <View style={styles.kidRow}>
                <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>BOOKING FOR</Text>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => setKidPickerVisible(true)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [styles.kidPill, pressed && { opacity: 0.75 }]}
                  accessibilityRole="button"
                  accessibilityLabel={`Booking for ${activeKid?.first_name ?? ''}. Tap to change.`}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.kidPillName}>
                    {activeKid?.first_name ?? '—'}
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.kidPillChange}>Change</Text>
                </Pressable>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* OTC pack balance preview */}
            {!slotIsFull && isOtcPack && otcRemaining !== null && otcTotal !== null ? (
              <SummaryLine
                label="After booking"
                value={
                  outOfCredits
                    ? 'No credits remaining'
                    : `${creditsDisplayAfter as number} of ${otcTotal} remaining`
                }
                valueStyle={outOfCredits ? styles.lineValueDanger : styles.lineValueGold}
              />
            ) : null}

            {/* EFT limited: weekly credit indicator */}
            {!slotIsFull && isEftLimited && weeklyRemaining !== null && weeklyTotal !== null ? (
              <SummaryLine
                label="This week"
                value={
                  outOfCredits
                    ? 'No credits remaining this week'
                    : `${weeklyDisplayAfter as number} of ${weeklyTotal} remaining${bafOptedIn ? ' after' : ''}`
                }
                valueStyle={outOfCredits ? styles.lineValueDanger : styles.lineValueGold}
              />
            ) : null}

            {/* Bring-a-Friend */}
            {bafEligible && !slotIsFull ? (
              <View style={styles.bafSection}>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => {
                    setBafOptedIn((v) => !v);
                    setBafError(null);
                  }}
                  style={styles.bafToggleRow}
                  accessibilityRole="checkbox"
                  accessibilityState={{ checked: bafOptedIn }}
                >
                  <View style={[styles.bafCheckbox, bafOptedIn && styles.bafCheckboxChecked]}>
                    {bafOptedIn ? (
                      <Text style={styles.bafCheckmark}>✓</Text>
                    ) : null}
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.bafToggleLabelBlock}>
                    <Text style={styles.bafToggleLabel}>
                      BRING A FRIEND
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={styles.bafToggleSub}>
                      Uses 2 credits total · You earn +100 pts
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </Pressable>

                {bafOptedIn ? (
                  <View style={styles.bafForm}>
                    <TextInput
                      style={[styles.bafInput, !bafName.trim() && bafError ? styles.bafInputError : null]}
                      placeholder="Friend's name *"
                      placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
                      value={bafName}
                      onChangeText={(v) => {
                        setBafName(v);
                        if (bafError) setBafError(null);
                      }}
                      autoCorrect={false}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                      style={styles.bafInput}
                      placeholder="Phone (optional)"
                      placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
                      value={bafPhone}
                      onChangeText={setBafPhone}
                      keyboardType="phone-pad"
                      autoCorrect={false}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                      style={styles.bafInput}
                      placeholder="Email (optional)"
                      placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
                      value={bafEmail}
                      onChangeText={setBafEmail}
                      keyboardType="email-address"
                      autoCapitalize="none"
                      autoCorrect={false}
                    />
                    {bafError ? (
                      <Text style={styles.bafErrorText}>{bafError}</Text>
                    ) : null}
                  </View>
                ) : null}
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.placeholder}>
            <Text style={styles.placeholderText}>
              Tap any slot above — your summary appears here instantly.
            </Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Waitlist success state */}
        {waitlistPosition !== null ? (
          <View style={styles.waitlistSuccess}>
            <Text style={styles.waitlistSuccessTitle}>
              ✓ You&apos;re #{waitlistPosition} on the waitlist
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.waitlistSuccessBody}>
              We&apos;ll notify you if a spot opens. You can leave the waitlist from Me → Bookings.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.confirmWrap}>
            {slotIsFull ? (
              <>
                <Button
                  label={joinWaitlist.isPending ? 'Joining Waitlist…' : 'Join Waitlist'}
                  onPress={handleJoinWaitlist}
                  variant="primary"
                  loading={joinWaitlist.isPending}
                  disabled={!ready || joinWaitlist.isPending}
                />
                {errorVisible ? (
                  <View style={styles.errorBlock}>
                    <Text style={styles.errorText}>
                      Couldn&apos;t join the waitlist — please try again.
                    </Text>
                    <Button
                      label="Tap to retry"
                      variant="tertiary"
                      tone="gold"
                      onPress={handleJoinWaitlist}
                    />
                  </View>
                ) : null}
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                {outOfCredits && ready ? (
                  <View style={styles.errorBlock}>
                    <Text style={styles.errorText}>
                      {isEftLimited
                        ? 'You\'ve used all your credits for this week. Come back Monday!'
                        : 'You\'ve used all your session credits. Contact the front desk to add more.'}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                ) : null}

                <Button
                  label={
                    bafPending ? 'Booking…' :
                    createBooking.isPending ? 'Booking…' :
                    'Confirm Booking'
                  }
                  onPress={() => { void handleConfirm(); }}
                  variant="primary"
                  loading={createBooking.isPending || bafPending}
                  disabled={!ready || createBooking.isPending || bafPending || outOfCredits}
                />

                {noCreditsVisible ? (
                  <View style={styles.errorBlock}>
                    <Text style={styles.errorText}>
                      {isEftLimited
                        ? 'You\'ve used all your credits for this week. Come back Monday!'
                        : 'You\'ve used all your session credits. Contact the front desk to add more.'}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                ) : null}

                {bafBookingError ? (
                  <View style={styles.errorBlock}>
                    <Text style={styles.errorText}>{bafBookingError}</Text>
                    <Button
                      label="Tap to retry"
                      variant="tertiary"
                      tone="gold"
                      onPress={() => { void handleConfirm(); }}
                    />
                  </View>
                ) : null}

                {errorVisible ? (
                  <View style={styles.errorBlock}>
                    <Text style={styles.errorText}>
                      Couldn&apos;t book that session — please try again.
                    </Text>
                    <Button
                      label="Tap to retry"
                      variant="tertiary"
                      tone="gold"
                      onPress={() => { void handleConfirm(); }}
                    />
                  </View>
                ) : null}
              </>
            )}
          </View>
        )}
      </SectionCard>

      {/* Kid picker modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={kidPickerVisible}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setKidPickerVisible(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <Pressable
            style={styles.modalBackdrop}
            onPress={() => setKidPickerVisible(false)}
          />
          <View style={styles.modalSheet}>
            <View style={styles.modalHandle} />
            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>BOOKING FOR</Text>
            <View style={styles.modalKids}>
              {kids.map((k) => {
                const isActive = k.id === (activeKid?.id ?? null);
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={k.id}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setOverrideKidId(k.id);
                      setKidPickerVisible(false);
                    }}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.modalKidRow,
                      isActive && styles.modalKidRowActive,
                      pressed && { opacity: 0.8 },
                    ]}
                    accessibilityRole="radio"
                    accessibilityState={{ checked: isActive }}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.modalKidName,
                        isActive && styles.modalKidNameActive,
                      ]}
                    >
                      {`${k.first_name} ${k.last_name ?? ''}`.trim()}
                    </Text>
                    {isActive ? (
                      <Text style={styles.modalKidCheck}>✓</Text>
                    ) : null}
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

function SummaryLine({
  label,
  value,
  valueStyle,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  valueStyle?: object;
}) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.line}>
      <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>{label}</Text>
      <Text style={[styles.lineValue, valueStyle]} numberOfLines={2}>
        {value}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { useSlotAvailability } from '@/hooks/useSlotAvailability';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing } from '@/theme';

import { useCoachAvailability } from '../hooks/useCoachAvailability';
import { useDayBookings } from '../hooks/useDayBookings';
import { useActiveLocation } from '../hooks/useActiveLocation';
import {
  formatSlotTime,
  generateDaySlots,
  type Slot,
} from '../utils/slots';
import SectionCard from './SectionCard';
import type { SlotAvailability } from '@/api/waitlist';

type Props = {
  locked: boolean;
  lockedHint?: string;
  date: string | null;
  sessionTypeId?: string | null;
  durationMinutes: number | null;
  selectedSlotKey: string | null;
  onSelectSlot: (slot: Slot, eligibleCoachIds: string[]) => void;
};

function slotKey(slot: Slot): string {
  return `${slot.coach_id}_${new Date(slot.start).toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, 'Z')}`;
}

function capacityLabel(info: SlotAvailability | undefined): string | null {
  if (!info) return null;
  const remaining = info.capacity - info.confirmed_count;
  if (remaining <= 0) return 'Full';
  if (info.capacity === 1) return null;
  return `${remaining} of ${info.capacity}`;
}

export default function TimeSection({
  locked,
  lockedHint,
  date,
  sessionTypeId = null,
  durationMinutes,
  selectedSlotKey,
  onSelectSlot,
}: Props) {
  const availability = useCoachAvailability();
  const location = useActiveLocation();
  const tz = location.data?.timezone ?? null;
  const bookings = useDayBookings(date, tz);

  // Slot availability for capacity labels
  const slotAvail = useSlotAvailability(date, sessionTypeId ?? null, null, tz);

  const slots = useMemo<Slot[] | null>(() => {
    if (!date || durationMinutes == null || !availability.data || !bookings.data) {
      return null;
    }
    return generateDaySlots({
      date,
      durationMinutes,
      timezone: tz,
      availability: availability.data,
      bookings: bookings.data,
    });
  }, [date, durationMinutes, availability.data, bookings.data, tz]);

  const locationLoading =
    location.fetchStatus !== 'idle' && location.isPending && !location.data;
  const isPending =
    availability.isPending ||
    (bookings.isPending && !!date) ||
    locationLoading;
  const isError = availability.isError || bookings.isError || location.isError;
  const isRefetching =
    availability.isRefetching || bookings.isRefetching || location.isRefetching;
  const retry = () => {
    if (availability.isError) void availability.refetch();
    if (bookings.isError) void bookings.refetch();
    if (location.isError) void location.refetch();
  };

  // Deduplicate slots by start time — one chip per time, first available coach wins
  const uniqueSlots = useMemo(() => {
    if (!slots) return [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    return slots.filter((s) => {
      if (seen.has(s.start)) return false;
      seen.add(s.start);
      return true;
    });
  }, [slots]);

  return (
    <SectionCard
      title="Time"
      locked={locked}
      lockedHint={locked ? lockedHint : undefined}
    >
      {locked ? (
        <View style={styles.placeholder}>
          <Text style={styles.placeholderText}>Available time slots will appear here.</Text>
        </View>
      ) : isPending ? (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : isError ? (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <Text style={styles.errorText}>Couldn&apos;t load times.</Text>
          <Text
            style={styles.retry}
            onPress={() => {
              if (!isRefetching) retry();
            }}
          >
            {isRefetching ? 'Retrying…' : 'Tap to retry'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : !uniqueSlots || uniqueSlots.length === 0 ? (
        <View style={styles.state}>
          <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No times available — try another date.</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.grid}>
          {uniqueSlots.map((slot) => {
            const key = `${slot.coach_id}|${slot.start}`;
            const selected = key === selectedSlotKey;
            const info = slotAvail.data?.get(slotKey(slot));
            const isFull = !!info && info.confirmed_count >= info.capacity;
            const capLabel = capacityLabel(info);
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={key}
                onPress={() => {
                  const eligible = (slots ?? [])
                    .filter((s) => s.start === slot.start)
                    .map((s) => s.coach_id);
                  onSelectSlot(slot, Array.from(new Set(eligible)));
                }}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityState={{ selected }}
                accessibilityLabel={`${formatSlotTime(slot.start, tz)}${isFull ? ', full — join waitlist' : ''}`}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.slot,
                  selected && styles.slotSelected,
                  isFull && styles.slotFull,
                  pressed && !selected && styles.slotPressed,
                ]}
              >
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.slotTime,
                    selected && styles.slotTimeSelected,
                    isFull && styles.slotTimeFull,
                  ]}
                >
                  {formatSlotTime(slot.start, tz)}
                </Text>
                {capLabel ? (
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      styles.slotCap,
                      selected && styles.slotCapSelected,
                      isFull && styles.slotCapFull,
                    ]}
                  >
                    {capLabel}
                  </Text>
                ) : null}
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  placeholder: {
    minHeight: 80,

  },
  placeholderText: {

FILE: src/screens/Book/hooks/useCreateBooking.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * useCreateBooking — TanStack mutation that inserts a confirmed booking.
 *
 * Flow:
 *  1. Pre-check session credits via `checkSessionCredits`.
 *     If credits = 0 → throw NoSessionCreditsError immediately (no booking
 *     row is inserted).
 *  2. Insert the booking row.
 *  3. Call `deductSessionCredit` atomically (FOR UPDATE in the RPC protects
 *     against concurrent bookings racing on the last credit).
 *     If that fails (race condition edge case) → cancel the booking and
 *     re-throw NoSessionCreditsError.
 *
 * On success: invalidates day_bookings, upcoming-session, family_bookings,
 * and active_membership (so the Me tab updates the credit badge immediately).
 */

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { createBooking, cancelBooking, type Booking, type BookingInsert } from '@/api/bookings';
import {
  checkSessionCredits,
  deductSessionCredit,
} from '@/api/memberships';
import { activeMembershipKey } from '@/hooks/useActiveMembership';

export class NoSessionCreditsError extends Error {
  readonly code = 'NO_SESSION_CREDITS' as const;
  constructor() {
    super('no_session_credits');
    this.name = 'NoSessionCreditsError';
  }
}

export function isNoSessionCreditsError(err: unknown): err is NoSessionCreditsError {
  return err instanceof NoSessionCreditsError ||
    (err instanceof Error && err.message.includes('no_session_credits'));
}

export type CreateBookingResult = {
  booking: Booking;
  sessionsRemaining: number;
};

export function useCreateBooking() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation<CreateBookingResult, Error, BookingInsert>({
    mutationFn: async (input) => {
      // ── Step 1: Pre-flight credit check (fast UX fail-fast) ──────────────
      // Treat any RPC error as unlimited (-1) so a cold-start / network
      // hiccup on the first call doesn't block the booking. The real
      // race-condition guard is deductSessionCredit (FOR UPDATE in DB).
      let remaining = -1;
      try {
        remaining = await checkSessionCredits(input.kid_id, input.tenant_id);
      } catch {
        remaining = -1;
      }
      if (remaining === 0) {
        throw new NoSessionCreditsError();
      }

      // ── Step 2: Insert the booking ────────────────────────────────────────
      const booking = await createBooking(input);

      // ── Step 3: Atomically deduct one credit (FOR UPDATE race guard) ──────
      let sessionsRemaining = -1;
      try {
        sessionsRemaining = await deductSessionCredit(booking.id);
      } catch {
        // Race condition: another concurrent booking consumed the last credit
        // between our pre-check and the deduction. Cancel this booking and
        // surface the error to the caller.
        await cancelBooking(booking.id, 'no_session_credits').catch(() => undefined);
        throw new NoSessionCreditsError();
      }

      return { booking, sessionsRemaining };
    },
    onSuccess: (_result, input) => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['day_bookings'] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['upcoming-session'] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['family_bookings'] });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: activeMembershipKey(input.kid_id) });
    },
  });
}

/**

 * location's timezone via TanStack Query.

 * IH only) that's enough to surface the slots the parent already has booked.

) {

  return useQuery<Booking[]>({
    queryKey: ['day_bookings', tenantId, date, timezone ?? null],

    },

  });
}

FILE: src/screens/Book/utils/availability.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Availability helpers for the Book tab date picker.
 *
 * Pure date math — no React, no Supabase. Given today's date in the
 * location's timezone, the active session type's `duration_minutes`, and
 * the tenant's `coach_availability` rows, compute which dates in the next
 * `daysAhead` window have at least one window long enough to fit the
 * session.
 *
 * Dates are represented as `YYYY-MM-DD` strings so they can be compared
 * cheaply and stored in a Set without timezone surprises.
 */

import type { CoachAvailability } from '@/api/bookings';

export type AvailabilityRow = Pick<
  CoachAvailability,
  'day_of_week' | 'start_time' | 'end_time' | 'effective_from' | 'effective_until'
>;

/** Parse a `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS` time string into minutes past midnight. */
function timeToMinutes(t: string): number {
  const [hh, mm] = t.split(':');
  return Number(hh) * 60 + Number(mm);
}

/** Format a Date's UTC components as YYYY-MM-DD. */
function formatYmd(d: Date): string {
  const y = d.getUTCFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

/**
 * Today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the given IANA timezone. Falls back to the
 * device timezone if `timezone` is empty or invalid.
 */
export function todayInTimezone(timezone: string | null | undefined): string {
  try {
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
      timeZone: timezone || undefined,
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
    });
    // en-CA yields YYYY-MM-DD already.
    return fmt.format(new Date());
  } catch {
    const now = new Date();
    return `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
}

/**
 * Build a list of `count` consecutive YYYY-MM-DD strings starting at
 * `startYmd` (inclusive). Calendar days only — no timezone shifts because
 * we step by adding 1 day to a UTC-noon anchor.
 */
export function buildDateRange(startYmd: string, count: number): string[] {
  const [y, m, d] = startYmd.split('-').map(Number);
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d + i, 12));
    out.push(formatYmd(dt));
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Day-of-week (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday) for a YYYY-MM-DD string,
 * computed from a UTC-noon anchor so local timezone never flips it.
 */
export function dayOfWeekUtc(ymd: string): number {
  const [y, m, d] = ymd.split('-').map(Number);
  return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d, 12)).getUTCDay();
}

function isWithinEffectiveWindow(
  ymd: string,
  effectiveFrom: string | null,
  effectiveUntil: string | null,
): boolean {
  if (effectiveFrom && ymd < effectiveFrom) return false;
  if (effectiveUntil && ymd > effectiveUntil) return false;
  return true;
}

/**
 * Compute the set of dates in the upcoming window that have at least one
 * coach_availability row long enough for `durationMinutes`.
 *
 * @returns the date range used (as YYYY-MM-DD strings), today's date in
 *   the supplied timezone, and the set of available dates within the range.
 */
export function computeAvailableDates(opts: {
  durationMinutes: number;
  rows: AvailabilityRow[];
  timezone: string | null | undefined;
  daysAhead?: number;
}): {
  today: string;
  range: string[];
  availableDates: Set<string>;
} {
  const daysAhead = opts.daysAhead ?? 30;
  const today = todayInTimezone(opts.timezone);
  const range = buildDateRange(today, daysAhead);

  // Pre-bucket rows by day_of_week and keep only those long enough.
  const buckets: AvailabilityRow[][] = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => []);
  for (const row of opts.rows) {
    const len = timeToMinutes(row.end_time) - timeToMinutes(row.start_time);
    if (len >= opts.durationMinutes) {
      buckets[row.day_of_week]?.push(row);
    }
  }

  const availableDates = new Set<string>();
  for (const ymd of range) {
    const dow = dayOfWeekUtc(ymd);
    const candidates = buckets[dow];
    if (!candidates || candidates.length === 0) continue;
    for (const row of candidates) {
      if (isWithinEffectiveWindow(ymd, row.effective_from, row.effective_until)) {
        availableDates.add(ymd);
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  return { today, range, availableDates };
}

FILE: src/screens/Book/utils/slots.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Slot generation for the Book tab time picker.
 *
 * Pure date/time math — no React, no Supabase. Given a calendar date in the
 * location's timezone, the active session type's `duration_minutes`, the
 * tenant's `coach_availability` rows, and the day's existing `bookings`,
 * compute the list of free, non-overlapping start times.
 *
 * Slots are aligned to the start of each availability window and stepped by
 * `duration_minutes`. Any slot that overlaps an existing booking for the same
 * coach is removed. Slots whose start is in the past are also removed so the
 * UI never offers an unbookable time.
 */

import type { AvailabilityRow } from './availability';
import { dayOfWeekUtc } from './availability';

export type SlotBookingInput = {
  coach_id: string;
  scheduled_start: string;
  scheduled_end: string;
};

export type AvailabilityForSlots = AvailabilityRow & {
  coach_id: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
};

export type Slot = {
  start: string; // UTC ISO timestamp
  end: string; // UTC ISO timestamp
  coach_id: string;
};

/** Parse a `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS` time string into minutes past midnight. */
function timeToMinutes(t: string): number {
  const [hh, mm] = t.split(':');
  return Number(hh) * 60 + Number(mm);
}

/** `9:00 AM` style label for a UTC ISO timestamp in the given timezone. */
export function formatSlotTime(iso: string, timezone: string | null | undefined): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: timezone || undefined,
      hour: 'numeric',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: true,
    }).format(new Date(iso));
  } catch {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    return `${d.getHours()}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
}

/**
 * Convert a wall-clock time (`YYYY-MM-DD` + minutes past midnight) in
 * `timezone` to a UTC ISO string. Works by computing the offset between the
 * "naive UTC" interpretation of the wall time and how that same instant
 * formats back in the target timezone.
 */
export function zonedWallTimeToUtcISO(
  ymd: string,
  minutesPastMidnight: number,
  timezone: string | null | undefined,
): string {
  const [y, m, d] = ymd.split('-').map(Number);
  const hh = Math.floor(minutesPastMidnight / 60);
  const mm = minutesPastMidnight % 60;
  const naiveUtcMs = Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d, hh, mm, 0);

  if (!timezone) return new Date(naiveUtcMs).toISOString();

  let offsetMs = 0;
  try {
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: timezone,
      hour12: false,
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
    });
    const parts = fmt.formatToParts(new Date(naiveUtcMs));
    const get = (t: string) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === t)?.value);
    const hour = get('hour') % 24;
    const asUtcMs = Date.UTC(get('year'), get('month') - 1, get('day'), hour, get('minute'), get('second'));
    offsetMs = asUtcMs - naiveUtcMs;
  } catch {
    offsetMs = 0;
  }
  return new Date(naiveUtcMs - offsetMs).toISOString();
}

function isWithinEffectiveWindow(
  ymd: string,
  effectiveFrom: string | null,
  effectiveUntil: string | null,
): boolean {
  if (effectiveFrom && ymd < effectiveFrom) return false;
  if (effectiveUntil && ymd > effectiveUntil) return false;
  return true;
}

/**
 * Generate free slots for a single calendar day.
 *
 * @param now Optional override for "right now" (used for past-slot pruning
 *   and tests). Defaults to `new Date()`.
 */
export function generateDaySlots(opts: {
  date: string;
  durationMinutes: number;
  timezone: string | null | undefined;
  availability: AvailabilityForSlots[];
  bookings: SlotBookingInput[];
  now?: Date;
}): Slot[] {
  const { date, durationMinutes, timezone, availability, bookings } = opts;
  const dow = dayOfWeekUtc(date);
  const nowMs = (opts.now ?? new Date()).getTime();

  // Pre-compute booking ranges per coach for fast overlap lookup.
  const bookingsByCoach = new Map<string, { startMs: number; endMs: number }[]>();
  for (const b of bookings) {
    const arr = bookingsByCoach.get(b.coach_id) ?? [];
    arr.push({
      startMs: new Date(b.scheduled_start).getTime(),
      endMs: new Date(b.scheduled_end).getTime(),
    });
    bookingsByCoach.set(b.coach_id, arr);
  }

  // Dedupe across availability rows that yield the same (coach_id, start).
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: Slot[] = [];

  for (const row of availability) {
    if (row.day_of_week !== dow) continue;
    if (!isWithinEffectiveWindow(date, row.effective_from, row.effective_until)) continue;

    const winStart = timeToMinutes(row.start_time);
    const winEnd = timeToMinutes(row.end_time);
    if (winEnd - winStart < durationMinutes) continue;

    for (let m = winStart; m + durationMinutes <= winEnd; m += durationMinutes) {
      const startISO = zonedWallTimeToUtcISO(date, m, timezone);
      const endISO = zonedWallTimeToUtcISO(date, m + durationMinutes, timezone);
      const startMs = new Date(startISO).getTime();
      const endMs = new Date(endISO).getTime();

      if (startMs < nowMs) continue;

      const coachBookings = bookingsByCoach.get(row.coach_id);
      if (coachBookings) {
        let conflict = false;
        for (const b of coachBookings) {
          if (b.startMs < endMs && b.endMs > startMs) {
            conflict = true;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (conflict) continue;
      }

      const key = `${row.coach_id}|${startISO}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      out.push({ start: startISO, end: endISO, coach_id: row.coach_id });
    }
  }

  out.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.start !== b.start) return a.start < b.start ? -1 : 1;
    return a.coach_id < b.coach_id ? -1 : a.coach_id > b.coach_id ? 1 : 0;
  });
  return out;
}

/** Distinct coach_ids present in a slot list, preserving first-seen order. */
export function uniqueCoachIds(slots: Slot[]): string[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const s of slots) {
    if (!seen.has(s.coach_id)) {
      seen.add(s.coach_id);
      out.push(s.coach_id);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Compute the UTC ISO bounds `[startISO, endISO)` for the given calendar
 * day in the location's timezone. Used to query bookings for that day.
 */
export function dayBoundsUtcISO(
  ymd: string,
  timezone: string | null | undefined,
): { startISO: string; endISO: string } {
  return {
    startISO: zonedWallTimeToUtcISO(ymd, 0, timezone),
    endISO: zonedWallTimeToUtcISO(ymd, 24 * 60, timezone),
  };
}

FILE: src/screens/Coach/CoachHomeScreen/CoachHomeScreen.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * Coach / admin landing screen — home base for staff when they open the app.
 *
 * Greets by first name and organises content into two pill sub-tabs:
 *   • Home     — action cards (send video, review drills, etc.)
 *   • Sessions — today's check-in board with real-time Supabase updates
 *
 * Coaches see only their own bookings in Sessions. Admins (app_role = 'admin')
 * see the full tenant board.
 */

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { ClipboardCheck, Dumbbell, Inbox, QrCode, Send, Video } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Alert,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { signOut } from '@/api/auth';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { coachKey, useCoach } from '@/hooks/useCoach';
import type { CoachInboxStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

import BookingsStatRow from './components/BookingsStatRow';
import CoachActionCard from './components/CoachActionCard';
import CoachGreetingHeader from './components/CoachGreetingHeader';
import SessionsBody from './subtabs/SessionsBody';

type Nav = CoachInboxStackScreenProps<'InboxHome'>['navigation'];
type TabKey = 'home' | 'sessions';

// Placeholder count — wired to a real Supabase query in a later step.
const PLACEHOLDER_UPCOMING_BOOKINGS = 3;

export default function CoachHomeScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { user, appRole } = useAuth();
  const { firstName } = useCoach();
  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabKey>('home');
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      if (user) {
        await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: coachKey(user.id) });
      }
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [qc, user]);

  const handleSignOut = useCallback(() => {
    Alert.alert('Sign out?', 'You will need to sign in again to use Ballpark.', [
      { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Sign out',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          try {
            await signOut();
          } catch (err) {
            Alert.alert('Sign-out failed', errorMessage(err));
          }
        },
      },
    ]);
  }, []);

  const tabs: { key: TabKey; label: string }[] = useMemo(
    () => [
      { key: 'home', label: 'Home' },
      { key: 'sessions', label: 'Sessions' },
    ],
    [],
  );

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <CoachGreetingHeader firstName={firstName} appRole={appRole} />

      {/* Sub-tab pill bar */}
      <View style={styles.tabBarWrapper}>
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.tabBar}
        >
          {tabs.map((t) => {
            const active = tab === t.key;
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={t.key}
                onPress={() => setTab(t.key)}
                style={[styles.pill, active && styles.pillActive]}
                accessibilityRole="tab"
                accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
                accessibilityLabel={t.label}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.pillText, active && styles.pillTextActive]}>
                  {t.label}
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>

      {/* Tab body */}
      {tab === 'sessions' ? (
        <SessionsBody />
      ) : (
        <ScrollView
          style={styles.scroll}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={refreshing}
              onRefresh={onRefresh}
              tintColor={colors.gold}
              colors={[colors.gold]}
            />
          }
        >
          {appRole !== 'parent' && (
            <View style={styles.section}>
              <BookingsStatRow upcomingCount={PLACEHOLDER_UPCOMING_BOOKINGS} />
            </View>
          )}
          <View style={[styles.section, styles.cards]}>
            <CoachActionCard
              title="New Video"
              subtitle="Record a quick message and send it to a family."
              icon={Video}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('RecordVideo')}
            />
            <CoachActionCard
              title="My Videos"
              subtitle="See videos you've already sent."
              icon={Send}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('SentVideos')}
            />
            {appRole !== 'parent' && (
              <>
                <CoachActionCard
                  title="Assign Drill"
                  subtitle="Send a kid a drill to practice this week."
                  icon={Dumbbell}
                  onPress={() => navigation.navigate('CreateAssignment')}
                />
                <CoachActionCard
                  title="Review Drills"
                  subtitle="Rate and respond to submitted drills."
                  icon={ClipboardCheck}
                  onPress={() => navigation.navigate('ReviewQueue')}
                />
              </>
            )}
            <CoachActionCard
              title="Inbox"
              subtitle="Read messages and video clips from families."
              icon={Inbox}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('CoachInboxHome')}
            />
            <CoachActionCard
              title="Scan Redemption"
              subtitle="Scan a family's QR code to mark their reward as picked up."
              icon={QrCode}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('ScanRedemption')}
            />
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSignOut} style={styles.signOutBtn}>
            <Text style={styles.signOutText}>Sign out</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  scroll: { flex: 1 },
  scrollContent: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['5xl'],
  },
  section: { marginBottom: spacing['2xl'] },
  cards: { gap: spacing['2xl'] },
  signOutBtn: {
    marginTop: spacing['4xl'],
    borderColor: colors.border,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: radius.lg,
    paddingVertical: spacing['3xl'],
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  signOutText: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  tabBarWrapper: { flexShrink: 0 },
  tabBar: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing.base,
    gap: spacing.base,
    alignItems: 'flex-start',
  },
  pill: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.xs,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['2xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing.base,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
  },
  pillActive: { backgroundColor: colors.gold, borderColor: colors.gold },
  pillText: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
  },
  pillTextActive: { color: colors.dark },
});

/**
 * Sessions sub-tab — staff mobile check-in board.
 *
 * Today's bookings are grouped into "sessions" (same scheduled_start +
 * coach_id). Each session renders as a tappable card that expands to reveal
 * the full roster. Each roster row shows:
 *   • Kid name
 *   • Membership status badge
 *   • Pending assignment count
 *   • Check-in status: timestamp (primary) or Check-In / No-Show buttons
 *
 * A 5-minute Undo button appears below the timestamp when a check-in is
 * still reversible, so the timestamp is always the first thing shown.
 *
 * Supabase Realtime in useStaffSessions keeps the roster live so concurrent
 * portal check-ins appear within a few seconds.
 */

import { CheckCircle, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, RotateCcw, UserCircle, XCircle } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Animated,
  FlatList,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useCoach } from '@/hooks/useCoach';
import { isWithinUndoWindow, useStaffSessions, type StaffBookingWithPending } from '@/hooks/useStaffSessions';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing } from '@/theme';

// ─── Time formatting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function formatTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const h = d.getHours();
  const min = d.getMinutes();
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h > 12 ? h - 12 : h === 0 ? 12 : h;
  return min === 0
    ? `${h12}:00 ${ampm}`
    : `${h12}:${String(min).padStart(2, '0')} ${ampm}`;
}

// ─── Session grouping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type SessionGroup = {
  key: string; // `${scheduled_start}__${coach_id ?? 'none'}`
  scheduled_start: string;
  coach_first_name: string | null;
  coach_last_name: string | null;
  session_type_name: string | null;
  cage_number: string | null;
  bookings: StaffBookingWithPending[];
};

function groupIntoSessions(bookings: StaffBookingWithPending[]): SessionGroup[] {
  const map = new Map<string, SessionGroup>();

  for (const b of bookings) {
    const key = `${b.scheduled_start}__${b.coach_id ?? 'none'}`;
    if (!map.has(key)) {
      map.set(key, {
        key,
        scheduled_start: b.scheduled_start,
        coach_first_name: b.coach_first_name,
        coach_last_name: b.coach_last_name,
        session_type_name: b.session_type_name,
        cage_number: b.cage_number,
        bookings: [],
      });
    }
    map.get(key)!.bookings.push(b);
  }

  return Array.from(map.values()).sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(a.scheduled_start).getTime() - new Date(b.scheduled_start).getTime(),
  );
}

// ─── Membership badge ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function MembershipBadge({ status }: { status: string | null }) {
  if (!status) return null;
  const map: Record<string, { color: string; bg: string; label: string }> = {
    active:   { color: '#34D399', bg: 'rgba(52,211,153,0.12)', label: 'Member' },
    paused:   { color: '#FBBF24', bg: 'rgba(251,191,36,0.12)', label: 'Paused' },
    cancelled: { color: '#F87171', bg: 'rgba(248,113,113,0.12)', label: 'Cancelled' },
  };
  const s = map[status] ?? { color: colors.textLight, bg: 'transparent', label: status };
  return (
    <View style={[badgeStyles.badge, { backgroundColor: s.bg, borderColor: s.color }]}>
      <Text style={[badgeStyles.text, { color: s.color }]}>{s.label}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

const badgeStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  badge: {
    paddingHorizontal: 6,
    paddingVertical: 2,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  text: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: 9,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: 0.5,
  },
});

// ─── Roster row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type RosterRowProps = {
  booking: StaffBookingWithPending;
  onAction: (action: 'checkin' | 'noshow' | 'undo', id: string) => void;
};

function RosterRow({ booking: b, onAction }: RosterRowProps) {
  const canUndo = isWithinUndoWindow(b);
  const isPending = !!b.pending;
  const isActionable = b.status === 'confirmed' || b.status === 'pending';
  const kidName = [b.kid_first_name, b.kid_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Unknown';

  return (
    <View style={rosterStyles.row}>
      {/* Top: avatar + name + status */}
      <View style={rosterStyles.topRow}>
        <View style={rosterStyles.avatar}>
          <UserCircle size={18} color={colors.gold} strokeWidth={1.5} />
        </View>
        <View style={rosterStyles.info}>
          <View style={rosterStyles.nameRow}>
            <Text style={rosterStyles.name} numberOfLines={1}>{kidName}</Text>
            <MembershipBadge status={b.membership_status} />
          </View>
          {b.pending_assignment_count > 0 && (
            <Text style={rosterStyles.assignBadge}>
              {b.pending_assignment_count} pending drill{b.pending_assignment_count !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
            </Text>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Inline status for completed / no-show */}
        {b.status === 'completed' && b.attended_at && (
          <View style={rosterStyles.arrivedRow}>
            <CheckCircle size={12} color="#34D399" />
            <Text style={rosterStyles.arrivedTime}>{formatTime(b.attended_at)}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
        {b.status === 'no_show' && (
          <Text style={rosterStyles.noShowLbl}>No show</Text>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Bottom: full-width action buttons */}
      {isActionable && (
        <View style={rosterStyles.actionRow}>
          <Pressable
            style={[rosterStyles.actionBtn, rosterStyles.btnGreen]}
            disabled={isPending}
            onPress={() => onAction('checkin', b.id)}
            accessibilityLabel={`Check in ${kidName}`}
            accessibilityRole="button"
          >
            {b.pending === 'checkin'
              ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#34D399" />
              : <><CheckCircle size={13} color="#34D399" /><Text style={[rosterStyles.actionBtnTxt, rosterStyles.txtGreen]}>Check In</Text></>}
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            style={[rosterStyles.actionBtn, rosterStyles.btnRed]}
            disabled={isPending}
            onPress={() => onAction('noshow', b.id)}
            accessibilityLabel={`Mark ${kidName} no-show`}
            accessibilityRole="button"
          >
            {b.pending === 'noshow'
              ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#F87171" />
              : <><XCircle size={13} color="#F87171" /><Text style={[rosterStyles.actionBtnTxt, rosterStyles.txtRed]}>No Show</Text></>}
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Undo row for completed bookings within 5-min window */}
      {b.status === 'completed' && canUndo && (
        <View style={rosterStyles.undoRow}>
          <Pressable
            style={[rosterStyles.actionBtn, rosterStyles.btnUndo]}
            disabled={isPending}
            onPress={() => onAction('undo', b.id)}
            accessibilityLabel={`Undo check-in for ${kidName}`}
            accessibilityRole="button"
          >
            {b.pending === 'undo'
              ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.textLight} />
              : <><RotateCcw size={12} color={colors.textLight} /><Text style={[rosterStyles.actionBtnTxt, rosterStyles.txtUndo]}>Undo Check-In</Text></>}
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const rosterStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: 'column',
    paddingVertical: spacing['2xl'],
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    borderTopColor: colors.border,
    gap: spacing.lg,
  },
  topRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.lg,
  },
  avatar: {
    width: 36,
    height: 36,
    borderRadius: 18,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    flexShrink: 0,
  },
  info: { flex: 1, minWidth: 0, gap: 3 },
  nameRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' },
  name: {
    color: colors.cream,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
  },
  assignBadge: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
  },
  actionRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: spacing.sm,
  },
  undoRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
  },
  actionBtn: {
    flex: 1,
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: 5,
    paddingVertical: 10,
    borderRadius: radius.md,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  actionBtnTxt: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
  },
  btnGreen: { borderColor: '#065f46', backgroundColor: 'rgba(6,78,59,0.3)' },
  btnRed: { borderColor: '#7f1d1d', backgroundColor: 'rgba(127,29,29,0.2)' },
  btnUndo: { borderColor: colors.border, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  txtGreen: { color: '#34D399' },
  txtRed: { color: '#F87171' },
  txtUndo: { color: colors.textLight },
  arrivedRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flexShrink: 0 },
  arrivedTime: {
    color: '#34D399',
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
  },
  noShowLbl: {
    color: colors.textMuted,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
    fontStyle: 'italic',
    flexShrink: 0,
  },
});

// ─── Session card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type SessionCardProps = {
  session: SessionGroup;
  onAction: (action: 'checkin' | 'noshow' | 'undo', id: string) => void;
};

function SessionCard({ session, onAction }: SessionCardProps) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

  const checkedInCount = session.bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').length;
  const total = session.bookings.length;
  const allDone = checkedInCount === total;
  const coachName = [session.coach_first_name, session.coach_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

  return (
    <View style={cardStyles.card}>
      {/* Session header — tappable to expand/collapse */}
      <Pressable
        style={cardStyles.header}
        onPress={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={`${formatTime(session.scheduled_start)} session with ${coachName || 'coach'}, ${total} athlete${total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`}
        accessibilityState={{ expanded }}
      >
        <View style={cardStyles.headerLeft}>
          <Text style={cardStyles.time}>{formatTime(session.scheduled_start)}</Text>
          <View style={cardStyles.headerMeta}>
            {coachName ? <Text style={cardStyles.metaText}>{coachName}</Text> : null}
            {session.session_type_name ? (
              <Text style={cardStyles.metaText}>· {session.session_type_name}</Text>
            ) : null}
            {session.cage_number ? (
              <Text style={cardStyles.metaText}>· Cage {session.cage_number}</Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </View>
        <View style={cardStyles.headerRight}>
          <View style={[cardStyles.countBadge, allDone && cardStyles.countBadgeDone]}>
            <Text style={[cardStyles.countText, allDone && cardStyles.countTextDone]}>
              {checkedInCount}/{total}
            </Text>
          </View>
          {expanded
            ? <ChevronUp size={16} color={colors.textLight} />
            : <ChevronDown size={16} color={colors.textLight} />}
        </View>
      </Pressable>

      {/* Roster */}
      {expanded && (
        <View style={cardStyles.roster}>
          {session.bookings.map((b) => (
            <RosterRow key={b.id} booking={b} onAction={onAction} />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Toast ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type ToastState = { msg: string; ok: boolean } | null;

function Toast({ toast }: { toast: ToastState }) {
  const opacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!toast) {
      Animated.timing(opacity, { toValue: 0, duration: 200, useNativeDriver: true }).start();
      return;
    }
    Animated.sequence([
      Animated.timing(opacity, { toValue: 1, duration: 200, useNativeDriver: true }),
      Animated.delay(2800),
      Animated.timing(opacity, { toValue: 0, duration: 300, useNativeDriver: true }),
    ]).start();
  }, [toast, opacity]);

  if (!toast) return null;

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        toastStyles.toast,
        toast.ok ? toastStyles.ok : toastStyles.err,
        { opacity, pointerEvents: 'none' },
      ]}
    >
      {toast.ok
        ? <CheckCircle size={14} color="#34D399" />
        : <XCircle size={14} color="#F87171" />}
      <Text style={[toastStyles.msg, toast.ok ? toastStyles.msgOk : toastStyles.msgErr]}>
        {toast.msg}
      </Text>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

const toastStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  toast: {
    position: 'absolute',
    bottom: spacing['4xl'],
    left: spacing['3xl'],
    right: spacing['3xl'],
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.sm,
    padding: spacing['2xl'],
    borderRadius: radius.lg,
    borderWidth: 1,
    zIndex: 100,
  },
  ok: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(6,78,59,0.9)', borderColor: '#065f46' },
  err: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(127,29,29,0.9)', borderColor: '#7f1d1d' },
  msg: { fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium, fontSize: fontSizes.sm, flex: 1 },
  msgOk: { color: '#6EE7B7' },
  msgErr: { color: '#FCA5A5' },
});

// ─── Main component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function SessionsBody() {
  const { appRole } = useAuth();
  const { coach } = useCoach();

  const isCoach = appRole === 'coach';
  const coachId = isCoach ? (coach?.id ?? undefined) : undefined;

  const { bookings, isPending, isError, error, refetch, mutate } = useStaffSessions(coachId, isCoach);

  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<ToastState>(null);

  const showToast = useCallback((msg: string, ok: boolean) => {
    setToast({ msg, ok });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  }, []);

  const handleAction = useCallback(
    async (action: 'checkin' | 'noshow' | 'undo', bookingId: string) => {
      const result = await mutate(action, bookingId);
      if (!result.ok) {
        showToast(result.message, false);
      } else {
        const labels: Record<string, string> = {
          checkin: 'Checked in!',
          noshow: 'Marked no-show.',
          undo: 'Check-in undone.',
        };
        showToast(labels[action] ?? 'Done.', true);
      }
    },
    [mutate, showToast],
  );

  const onRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try { await refetch(); } finally { setRefreshing(false); }
  }, [refetch]);

  const sessions = groupIntoSessions(bookings);

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <View style={bodyStyles.center}>
        <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <View style={bodyStyles.center}>
        <Text style={bodyStyles.errorText}>
          {error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to load sessions.'}
        </Text>
        <Pressable style={bodyStyles.retryBtn} onPress={() => void refetch()}>
          <Text style={bodyStyles.retryText}>Retry</Text>
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (sessions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={bodyStyles.emptyContent}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={colors.gold} colors={[colors.gold]} />
        }
      >
        <Text style={bodyStyles.emptyText}>No sessions scheduled for today.</Text>
      </ScrollView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={bodyStyles.root}>
      <FlatList
        data={sessions}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.key}
        contentContainerStyle={bodyStyles.list}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={colors.gold} colors={[colors.gold]} />
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <SessionCard session={item} onAction={handleAction} />
        )}
      />
      <Toast toast={toast} />
    </View>
  );
}

const bodyStyles = StyleSheet.create({
  root: { flex: 1 },
  list: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingTop: spacing['2xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['5xl'],
  },
  center: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: spacing['2xl'],
    padding: spacing['3xl'],
  },
  errorText: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  retryBtn: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing['2xl'],
    borderRadius: radius.lg,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.gold,
  },
  retryText: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
  },
  emptyContent: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: spacing['5xl'],
  },
  emptyText: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
});

function formatRelative(isoString: string): string {
  if (!isoString) return '';
  const date = new Date(isoString);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
  const diffMs = Date.now() - date.getTime();
  const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60_000);
  if (diffMins < 1) return 'just now';
  if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}m ago`;
  const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMins / 60);
  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
  const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHours / 24);
  if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}d ago`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}
