/**
 * SendConfirmationScreen — v0.4 Step 4.10.
 *
 * Final step of the coach send flow. The coach lands here from the Recipient
 * Picker with `{ videoId, recipientFamilyId, recipientKidId }` in route
 * params. We:
 *   1. Show a summary card: Mux poster (or "Processing video…" placeholder
 *      while the webhook hasn't flipped status to `ready`), recipient name,
 *      and the coach's own name.
 *   2. Let the coach attach an optional note (multi-line input).
 *   3. On Send, INSERT a row into `public.coach_messages` via
 *      `useSendCoachMessage()`. RLS pins tenant + sender server-side; we
 *      still pass tenant_id explicitly because the policy's WITH CHECK
 *      requires it on the row itself.
 *
 * On success we toast and `popToTop()` back to the Coach landing. On error
 * we surface the message inline and re-enable Send while preserving the note
 * so the coach doesn't lose typing.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useToast } from '@/components/ui';
import { useCoach } from '@/hooks/useCoach';
import { useSendCoachMessage } from '@/hooks/useSendCoachMessage';
import { useTenantKids } from '@/hooks/useTenantKids';
import { useVideoPreview } from '@/hooks/useVideoPreview';
import type { CoachInboxStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { useDraftNote, useDraftNotesStore } from '@/store/draftNotes';
import { colors } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

import { styles } from './styles';

type Nav = CoachInboxStackScreenProps<'SendConfirmation'>['navigation'];
type Route = CoachInboxStackScreenProps<'SendConfirmation'>['route'];

const POSTER_WIDTH = 480;

function muxPosterUrl(playbackId: string) {
  return `https://image.mux.com/${playbackId}/thumbnail.jpg?width=${POSTER_WIDTH}`;
}

export default function SendConfirmationScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const { videoId, recipientFamilyId, recipientKidId } = route.params;

  const { firstName: coachFirstName, lastName: coachLastName } = useCoach();
  const { kids } = useTenantKids();
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const recipient = useMemo(
    () => kids.find((k) => k.kidId === recipientKidId) ?? null,
    [kids, recipientKidId],
  );

  const videoQuery = useVideoPreview(videoId);
  const sendMutation = useSendCoachMessage();

  // Note text is kept in a Zustand slice keyed by videoId so navigating
  // back to the Recipient Picker (to fix the recipient) and returning here
  // does NOT lose what the coach already typed. Cleared on successful send.
  const [note, setNote] = useDraftNote(videoId);
  const clearDraft = useDraftNotesStore((s) => s.clearDraft);
  const [errorText, setErrorText] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const canSend = !sendMutation.isPending;

  const handleSend = () => {
    setErrorText(null);
    const trimmed = note.trim();
    sendMutation.mutate(
      {
        videoId,
        recipientFamilyId,
        recipientKidId,
        messageText: trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : null,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          clearDraft(videoId);
          const name = recipient?.firstName ?? 'the family';
          showToast(`Video sent to ${name}`);
          navigation.popToTop();
        },
        onError: (err) => {
          setErrorText(errorMessage(err));
        },
      },
    );
  };

  const handleBack = () => {
    navigation.goBack();
  };

  const recipientName = recipient
    ? `${recipient.firstName} ${recipient.lastName}`
    : 'Loading…';
  const familyLine = recipient ? `${recipient.familyLastName} Family` : '';
  const senderName =
    coachFirstName || coachLastName
      ? `${coachFirstName ?? ''} ${coachLastName ?? ''}`.trim()
      : 'You';

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView
          style={styles.scroll}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        >
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <VideoPosterArea
              status={videoQuery.data?.status ?? null}
              playbackId={videoQuery.data?.mux_playback_id ?? null}
              loading={videoQuery.isPending}
            />
            <View style={styles.cardBody}>
              <View>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>To</Text>
                <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>{recipientName}</Text>
                {familyLine ? (
                  <Text style={styles.fieldValueMuted}>{familyLine}</Text>
                ) : null}
              </View>
              <View>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>From</Text>
                <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>{senderName}</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          <Text style={styles.noteLabel}>Add a note (optional)</Text>
          <TextInput
            style={styles.noteInput}
            value={note}
            onChangeText={setNote}
            multiline
            numberOfLines={4}
            maxLength={1000}
            placeholder="Say something to the family…"
            placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
            editable={!sendMutation.isPending}
          />

          {errorText ? (
            <View style={styles.errorBanner}>
              <Text style={styles.errorBannerText}>{errorText}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </ScrollView>

        <View style={styles.footer}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Send video"
            style={[
              styles.primaryBtn,
              !canSend && styles.primaryBtnDisabled,
            ]}
            onPress={handleSend}
            disabled={!canSend}
          >
            {sendMutation.isPending ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color={colors.dark} />
            ) : (
              <Text style={styles.primaryBtnText}>Send</Text>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Go back"
            style={styles.secondaryBtn}
            onPress={handleBack}
            disabled={sendMutation.isPending}
          >
            <Text style={styles.secondaryBtnText}>Back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function VideoPosterArea({
  status,
  playbackId,
  loading,
}: {
  status: string | null;
  playbackId: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
}) {
  if (status === 'ready' && playbackId) {
    return (
      <Image
        source={{ uri: muxPosterUrl(playbackId) }}
        style={styles.poster}
        resizeMode="cover"
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'errored') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.posterPlaceholder}>
        <Text style={styles.posterErrorText}>
          Video processing failed. You can still send a note, or go back and
          re-upload.
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // uploading / processing / unknown / loading
  return (
    <View style={styles.posterPlaceholder}>
      <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
      <Text style={styles.posterPlaceholderText}>
        {loading ? 'Loading preview…' : 'Processing video…'}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

  },
  poster: {

    backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
  },

FILE: src/screens/Coach/SentVideos/components/SentMessageRow.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * One row in the coach Sent Videos list.
 *
 * Visual: Mux poster thumbnail (or "Processing…" placeholder while the asset
 * isn't ready), recipient kid name + family line, relative sent time, and a
 * "Viewed" / "Sent" badge driven by `viewedAt`.
 *
 * Press: when the Mux asset is `ready`, navigates to CoachVideoPlayback
 * so the coach can review what they sent. Coaches do NOT mark messages
 * viewed — that field is parent-only telemetry. Rows that are still
 * processing or errored are non-tappable (the press is swallowed) so we
 * don't open a black player on a missing playback id.
 */

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { Image, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { SentCoachMessageRow } from '@/api/coachMessages';
import type { CoachInboxStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { formatRelativeTime } from '@/utils/time';

import { styles } from '../styles';

type Nav = CoachInboxStackScreenProps<'SentVideos'>['navigation'];

const POSTER_WIDTH = 240;

function muxPosterUrl(playbackId: string): string {
  return `https://image.mux.com/${playbackId}/thumbnail.jpg?width=${POSTER_WIDTH}`;
}

function formatDuration(totalSeconds: number): string {
  const safe = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));
  const minutes = Math.floor(safe / 60);
  const seconds = safe % 60;
  return `${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

type Props = {
  message: SentCoachMessageRow;
};

export default function SentMessageRow({ message }: Props) {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const recipient = `${message.kidFirstName} ${message.kidLastName}`.trim();
  const familyLine = message.familyLastName
    ? `${message.familyLastName} Family`
    : '';
  const sent = formatRelativeTime(message.createdAt);
  const viewed = message.viewedAt != null;
  const playable =
    message.videoStatus === 'ready' && !!message.muxPlaybackId;
  const showPoster = playable;

  return (
    <Pressable
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={`Video sent to ${recipient}, ${viewed ? 'viewed' : 'not yet viewed'}`}
      accessibilityState={{ disabled: !playable }}
      disabled={!playable}
      style={({ pressed }) => [styles.row, pressed && playable && styles.rowPressed]}
      onPress={() => {
        if (!playable) return;
        navigation.navigate('CoachVideoPlayback', {
          playbackId: message.muxPlaybackId as string,
        });
      }}
    >
      <View style={styles.thumbWrap}>
        {showPoster ? (
          <Image
            source={{ uri: muxPosterUrl(message.muxPlaybackId as string) }}
            style={styles.thumbImage}
            resizeMode="cover"
            accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors
          />
        ) : (
          <Text style={styles.thumbProcessingText} numberOfLines={2}>
            {message.videoStatus === 'errored' ? 'Failed' : 'Processing…'}
          </Text>
        )}
        {message.durationSeconds != null ? (
          <View style={styles.durationBadge} pointerEvents="none">
            <Text style={styles.durationText}>
              {formatDuration(message.durationSeconds)}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.rowBody}>
        <Text style={styles.recipientName} numberOfLines={1}>
          {recipient}
        </Text>
        {familyLine ? (
          <Text style={styles.familyLine} numberOfLines={1}>
            {familyLine}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
        <View style={styles.rowFooter}>
          <Text style={styles.sentTime}>{sent}</Text>
          <View style={[styles.badge, viewed ? styles.badgeViewed : styles.badgeSent]}>
            <Text
              style={[
                styles.badgeText,
                viewed ? styles.badgeTextViewed : styles.badgeTextSent,
              ]}
            >
              {viewed ? 'Viewed' : 'Sent'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

FILE: src/screens/Coach/SentVideos/SentVideosScreen.tsx

/**
 * Coach Sent Videos screen — v0.4 Step 4.11.
 *
 * Chronological list (newest first) of every coach_messages row Coach Mike
 * has sent. Each row shows: Mux poster thumb, recipient kid name, family,
 * relative sent time, and a Viewed/Sent badge.
 *
 * Data flow:
 *   `useSentCoachMessages()` (TanStack Query, key
 *   `['coachMessages', 'sent', userId]`) — refetches on screen focus and on
 *   pull-to-refresh. The same key is invalidated by `useSendCoachMessage()`
 *   so a freshly-sent message appears at the top without a manual refresh.
 *
 * Out of scope (per task): playback / detail screen, resend / delete,
 * realtime updates.
 */

import { Send } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  RefreshControl,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useSentCoachMessages } from '@/hooks/useSentCoachMessages';
import { colors } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

import SentMessageRow from './components/SentMessageRow';
import { styles } from './styles';

export default function SentVideosScreen() {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch, isRefetching } =
    useSentCoachMessages();
  const [manualRefreshing, setManualRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setManualRefreshing(true);
    try {
      await refetch();
    } finally {
      setManualRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [refetch]);

  const refreshControl = (
    <RefreshControl
      refreshing={manualRefreshing || isRefetching}
      onRefresh={onRefresh}
      tintColor={colors.gold}
      colors={[colors.gold]}
    />
  );

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Couldn&apos;t load videos</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorBody}>{errorMessage(error)}</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity
            accessibilityRole="button"
            style={styles.retryBtn}
            onPress={() => void refetch()}
          >
            <Text style={styles.retryBtnText}>Retry</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const messages = data ?? [];

  if (messages.length === 0) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <FlatList
          data={[]}
          keyExtractor={() => 'noop'}
          renderItem={() => null}
          refreshControl={refreshControl}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.centered}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.centered}>
              <View style={styles.emptyIconWrap}>
                <Send size={32} color={colors.gold} />
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>No videos yet</Text>
              <Text style={styles.emptyBody}>
                You haven&apos;t sent any videos yet — tap New Video to send
                your first.
              </Text>
            </View>
          }
        />
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <FlatList
        data={messages}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => <SentMessageRow message={item} />}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
        refreshControl={refreshControl}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

  const m = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][d.getMonth()];

}

FILE: src/screens/Earn/components/ProductCard.tsx
=================================================================================
import { Coins, ShoppingBag } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Image, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';

import type { Product } from '@/api/earn';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

export default function ProductCard({
  product,
  mode,
  pointsBalance,
  onPress,
  pendingOrder,
}: {
  product: Product;
  mode: 'redeem' | 'store';
  pointsBalance: number;
  onPress: () => void;
  pendingOrder?: { id: string } | null;
}) {
  const showPoints = mode === 'redeem';
  const canAfford =
    !showPoints || (product.points_cost !== null && pointsBalance >= product.points_cost);
  const soldOut = product.inventory_count !== null && product.inventory_count <= 0;
  const hasPending = !!pendingOrder;
  const disabled = soldOut || (showPoints && !canAfford) || hasPending;

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      style={[styles.card, disabled && styles.cardDisabled]}
      onPress={onPress}
      activeOpacity={0.8}
    >
      <View style={styles.thumb}>
        {product.image_url ? (
          <Image
            source={{ uri: product.image_url }}
            style={styles.thumbImage}
            resizeMode="cover"
          />
        ) : showPoints ? (
          <Coins size={28} color={colors.gold} />
        ) : (
          <ShoppingBag size={28} color={colors.gold} />
        )}
      </View>
      <Text style={styles.name} numberOfLines={2}>
        {product.name}
      </Text>
      <Text style={styles.category}>{product.category}</Text>
      <View style={styles.priceRow}>
        {showPoints && product.points_cost !== null ? (
          <Text style={styles.priceGold}>{product.points_cost.toLocaleString()} PTS</Text>
        ) : null}
        {!showPoints && product.dollar_price_cents !== null ? (
          <Text style={styles.priceGold}>
            ${(product.dollar_price_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      {soldOut ? <Text style={styles.tag}>SOLD OUT</Text> : null}
      {hasPending ? <Text style={styles.tagPending}>PENDING PICKUP</Text> : null}
      {showPoints && !canAfford && !soldOut && !hasPending ? (
        <Text style={styles.tagMuted}>NEED {product.points_cost! - pointsBalance} MORE</Text>
      ) : null}
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import { AGE_GROUPS, type AgeGroup } from '@/constants/kid';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import {
  useHitTraxLeaderboard,
  useLessonCountLeaderboard,
  usePointsLeaderboard,
} from '@/hooks/useLeaderboard';
import type { HitTraxMetric, LeaderboardScope, AgeGroupFilter } from '@/api/leaderboard';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Types
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type BoardView = 'points' | 'performance' | 'lessons';

// 'all' = no filter (all kids), 'unranked' = kids with no age_group set.
type AgeGroupChip = AgeGroup | 'all' | 'unranked';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shared sub-components
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function LoadingState() {
  return (
    <View style={styles.centered}>
      <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
    </View>
  );
}

function ErrorState({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.centered}>
      <Text style={styles.errorText}>{message}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ label }: { label: string }) {
  return <Text style={styles.empty}>{label}</Text>;
}

function RankPill({ rank }: { rank: number }) {
  return (
    <View style={[styles.rankPill, rank <= 3 && styles.rankPillTop]}>
      <Text style={[styles.rankText, rank <= 3 && styles.rankTextTop]}>#{rank}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

// Small segmented-toggle button used inside sub-views.
function Toggle<T extends string>({
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  options: { key: T; label: string }[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (v: T) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.toggleBar}>
      {options.map((o) => {
        const active = o.key === value;
        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={o.key}
            onPress={() => onChange(o.key)}
            style={[styles.toggleBtn, active && styles.toggleBtnActive]}
            accessibilityRole="tab"
            accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.toggleLabel, active && styles.toggleLabelActive]}>
              {o.label}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Points sub-view (existing)

function PointsView({ ownKidIds }: { ownKidIds: string[] }) {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error } = usePointsLeaderboard();
  const ownSet = new Set(ownKidIds);

  if (isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (isError) return <ErrorState message={(error as Error)?.message ?? 'Could not load ranks'} />;

  const rows = data ?? [];

  return (
    <FlatList
      data={rows}
      keyExtractor={(item) => item.kidId}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
      ListHeaderComponent={
        <View style={styles.listHeader}>
          <Text style={styles.boardTitle}>Points Board</Text>
          <Text style={styles.boardSubtitle}>Top 50 athletes by total points</Text>
        </View>
      }
      ListEmptyComponent={<EmptyState label="No athletes ranked yet." />}
      renderItem={({ item }) => {
        const mine = ownSet.has(item.kidId);
        return (
          <View style={[styles.row, mine && styles.rowMine]}>
            <RankPill rank={item.rank} />
            <View style={styles.rowBody}>
              <Text style={styles.name}>
                {item.firstName} {item.lastName}
                {mine ? ' · YOU' : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.statValue}>{(item.pointsBalance ?? 0).toLocaleString()}</Text>
          </View>
        );
      }}
    />
  );
}

const METRIC_OPTIONS: { key: HitTraxMetric; label: string; unit: string }[] = [
  { key: 'exit_velocity_mph', label: 'Exit Velocity', unit: 'mph' },
  { key: 'distance_ft',       label: 'Distance',      unit: 'ft'  },
];

const SCOPE_OPTIONS: { key: LeaderboardScope; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'national',  label: 'National'  },
  { key: 'clubhouse', label: 'Clubhouse' },
];

const AGE_GROUP_FILTER_OPTIONS: { key: AgeGroupChip; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'all',      label: 'All'      },
  ...AGE_GROUPS.map((g) => ({ key: g as AgeGroupChip, label: g })),
  { key: 'unranked', label: 'Unranked' },
];

function PerformanceView({
  ownKidIds,
  locationId,
}: {
  ownKidIds: string[];
  locationId: string | null;
}) {
  const [metric, setMetric]    = useState<HitTraxMetric>('exit_velocity_mph');
  const [scope, setScope]      = useState<LeaderboardScope>('national');
  const [ageGroup, setAgeGroup] = useState<AgeGroupChip>('all');

  const ownSet = new Set(ownKidIds);
  // 'all' → null (no filter), 'unranked' → 'unranked' sentinel, otherwise exact match.
  const ageGroupFilter: AgeGroupFilter = ageGroup === 'all' ? null : ageGroup;
  const effectiveLocationId = scope === 'clubhouse' ? locationId : null;

  const { data, isPending, isError, error } = useHitTraxLeaderboard({
    metric,
    scope,
    locationId: effectiveLocationId,
    ageGroup:   ageGroupFilter,
  });

  const currentMetaUnit = METRIC_OPTIONS.find((m) => m.key === metric)?.unit ?? '';
  const rows = data ?? [];
  // Check whether any own kid appears in the returned top-50 list.
  const ownInList = rows.some((r) => ownSet.has(r.kidId));
  const hasOwnKids = ownKidIds.length > 0;

  return (
    <View style={styles.subViewRoot}>
      {/* Metric toggle */}
      <Toggle<HitTraxMetric>
        options={METRIC_OPTIONS.map((m) => ({ key: m.key, label: m.label }))}
        value={metric}
        onChange={setMetric}
      />

      {/* Scope toggle */}
      <Toggle<LeaderboardScope>
        options={SCOPE_OPTIONS}
        value={scope}
        onChange={setScope}
      />

      {/* Age group chips — includes 'Unranked' bucket for kids with no age group set */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.chipRow}
      >
        {AGE_GROUP_FILTER_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
          const active = opt.key === ageGroup;
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={opt.key}
              onPress={() => setAgeGroup(opt.key)}
              style={[styles.chip, active && styles.chipActive]}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.chipLabel, active && styles.chipLabelActive]}>
                {opt.label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* List */}
      {isPending ? (
        <LoadingState />
      ) : isError ? (
        <ErrorState message={(error as Error)?.message ?? 'Could not load performance board'} />
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={rows}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.kidId}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
          ListHeaderComponent={
            <View style={styles.listHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.boardTitle}>
                {METRIC_OPTIONS.find((m) => m.key === metric)?.label ?? 'Performance'} Records
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.boardSubtitle}>
                {scope === 'clubhouse'
                  ? 'Top 10 at your location · all-time personal bests'
                  : 'Top 40 nationally · all-time personal bests'}
              </Text>
            </View>
          }
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <EmptyState
              label={
                scope === 'clubhouse' && !locationId
                  ? 'Set a home location to see the clubhouse board.'
                  : 'No HitTrax records found. Hit some swings!'
              }
            />
          }
          ListFooterComponent={
            hasOwnKids && !ownInList && rows.length > 0 ? (
              <View style={styles.outsideTopRow}>
                <Text style={styles.outsideTopText}>
                  You're outside the top {scope === 'clubhouse' ? 10 : 40} — keep swinging!
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const mine = ownSet.has(item.kidId);
            return (
              <View style={[styles.row, mine && styles.rowMine]}>
                <RankPill rank={item.rank} />
                <View style={styles.rowBody}>
                  <Text style={styles.name}>
                    {item.firstName} {item.lastName}
                    {mine ? ' · YOU' : ''}
                  </Text>
                  {item.ageGroup ? (
                    <Text style={styles.ageGroupBadge}>{item.ageGroup}</Text>
                  ) : (
                    <Text style={[styles.ageGroupBadge, styles.ageGroupUnranked]}>Unranked</Text>
                  )}
                </View>
                <Text style={styles.statValue}>
                  {typeof item.value === 'number'
                    ? `${item.value % 1 === 0 ? item.value : item.value.toFixed(1)} ${currentMetaUnit}`
                    : '—'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            );
          }}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function LessonsView({

              ? 'Top 10 at your location · completed lessons'

        </View>
      }
      ListEmptyComponent={
        <EmptyState label="No completed lessons yet — book your first session!" />

      ListFooterComponent={
        hasOwnKids && !ownInList && rows.length > 0 ? (

      }
      renderItem={({ item }) => {

              <Text style={styles.lessonUnit}>lessons</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        );

    />
  );
}

const VIEW_OPTIONS: { key: BoardView; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'points',      label: 'Points'      },
  { key: 'performance', label: 'Performance' },
  { key: 'lessons',     label: 'Lessons'     },
];

export default function RanksTab({ ownKidIds }: { ownKidIds: string[] }) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<BoardView>('points');
  const { family } = useFamily();

  // Use the family's primary location for clubhouse scope.
  const locationId = family?.primary_location_id ?? null;

  const handleViewChange = useCallback((v: BoardView) => setView(v), []);

  return (
    <View style={styles.root}>
      {/* Top-level segmented control */}
      <View style={styles.segmentedBar}>
        {VIEW_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
          const active = opt.key === view;
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={opt.key}
              onPress={() => handleViewChange(opt.key)}
              style={[styles.segmentBtn, active && styles.segmentBtnActive]}
              accessibilityRole="tab"
              accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.segmentLabel, active && styles.segmentLabelActive]}>
                {opt.label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      {/* Body */}
      <View style={styles.body}>
        {view === 'points' && <PointsView ownKidIds={ownKidIds} />}
        {view === 'performance' && (
          <PerformanceView ownKidIds={ownKidIds} locationId={locationId} />
        )}
        {view === 'lessons' && (
          <LessonsView ownKidIds={ownKidIds} locationId={locationId} />
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { ActivityIndicator, FlatList, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { OrderWithProduct, Product } from '@/api/earn';
import { useOrders } from '@/hooks/useOrders';
import { useProducts } from '@/hooks/useProducts';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';

import PointsBadge from './PointsBadge';
import ProductCard from './ProductCard';

export default function RewardsTab({
  pointsBalance,
  onSelect,
  onSelectExisting,
}: {
  pointsBalance: number;
  onSelect: (p: Product) => void;
  onSelectExisting?: (orderId: string, productId: string) => void;
}) {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error } = useProducts();
  const { data: orders } = useOrders();

  // Build a map of productId → pending order for quick lookup.
  const pendingByProductId = (orders ?? []).reduce<Record<string, OrderWithProduct>>(
    (acc, o) => {
      if (o.status === 'ordered' && o.product?.id) {
        acc[o.product.id] = o;
      }
      return acc;
    },
    {},
  );

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>{(error as Error)?.message ?? 'Could not load rewards'}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  const rewards = (data ?? []).filter((p) => p.is_redeemable);

  return (
    <FlatList
      data={rewards}
      keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
      numColumns={2}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
      columnWrapperStyle={styles.row}
      ListHeaderComponent={
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <View>
            <Text style={styles.headerLabel}>Your balance</Text>
            <Text style={styles.headerValue}>{pointsBalance.toLocaleString()} pts</Text>
          </View>
          <PointsBadge points={pointsBalance} />
        </View>
      }
      ListEmptyComponent={<Text style={styles.empty}>No rewards available yet.</Text>}
      renderItem={({ item }) => {
        const pending = pendingByProductId[item.id] ?? null;
        return (
          <ProductCard
            product={item}
            mode="redeem"
            pointsBalance={pointsBalance}
            pendingOrder={pending}
            onPress={() => {
              if (pending) {
                onSelectExisting?.(pending.id, item.id);
              } else {
                onSelect(item);
              }
            }}
          />
        );
      }}
    />
  );

import { ActivityIndicator, FlatList, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { Product } from '@/api/earn';
import { useProducts } from '@/hooks/useProducts';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';

import ProductCard from './ProductCard';

type Props = {
  onBuyWithCard: (product: Product) => void;
};

export default function StoreTab({ onBuyWithCard }: Props) {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error } = useProducts();

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>{(error as Error)?.message ?? 'Could not load store'}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  const items = (data ?? []).filter((p) => p.is_purchasable);

  return (
    <FlatList
      data={items}
      keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
      numColumns={2}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
      columnWrapperStyle={styles.row}
      ListEmptyComponent={<Text style={styles.empty}>No store items yet.</Text>}
      renderItem={({ item }) => (
        <ProductCard
          product={item}
          mode="store"
          pointsBalance={0}
          onPress={() => onBuyWithCard(item)}
        />
      )}
    />
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  list: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'],
    gap: spacing.lg,
  },
  row: { gap: spacing.lg },
  centered: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: spacing['4xl'],
  },
  errorText: {
    color: colors.danger,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    textAlign: 'center',

    color: colors.textMuted,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    textAlign: 'center',
    paddingVertical: spacing['5xl'],

});

import { StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

export type SubTabKey = 'rewards' | 'store' | 'ranks' | 'earn';

const TABS: { key: SubTabKey; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'rewards', label: 'Rewards' },
  { key: 'store', label: 'Store' },
  { key: 'ranks', label: 'Ranks' },
  { key: 'earn', label: 'Earn' },
];

export default function SubTabBar({
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: SubTabKey;
  onChange: (k: SubTabKey) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.bar}>
      {TABS.map((t) => {
        const active = t.key === value;
        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={t.key}
            onPress={() => onChange(t.key)}
            style={[styles.pill, active && styles.pillActive]}
            accessibilityRole="tab"
            accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.pillText, active && styles.pillTextActive]}>{t.label}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

  bar: {

    marginBottom: spacing['3xl'],
    borderWidth: 1,

/**
 * EarnScreen.
 *
 * Re-merges the v0.4 Earn tab: Rewards / Store / Ranks / Rules behind a
 * pill-style sub-tab switcher. Sub-tab body components are unchanged from
 * the v0.5 split (RewardsTab / StoreTab / RanksTab / EarnRulesTab).
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import type { Product } from '@/api/earn';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import KidSwitcherPill from '@/components/ui/KidSwitcherPill';
import type { EarnStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

import EarnRulesTab from './components/EarnRulesTab';
import RanksTab from './components/RanksTab';
import RewardsTab from './components/RewardsTab';
import StoreTab from './components/StoreTab';

type Nav = EarnStackScreenProps<'EarnHome'>['navigation'];
type Route = EarnStackScreenProps<'EarnHome'>['route'];

type SubTab = 'rewards' | 'store' | 'ranks' | 'rules';
const TABS: { key: SubTab; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'rewards', label: 'Rewards' },
  { key: 'store', label: 'Store' },
  { key: 'ranks', label: 'Ranks' },
  { key: 'rules', label: 'Rules' },
];

export default function EarnScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  const initial = route.params?.initialSubTab ?? 'rewards';
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<SubTab>(initial);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (route.params?.initialSubTab) setTab(route.params.initialSubTab);
  }, [route.params?.initialSubTab]);

  const handleSelect = (p: Product) => {
    if (!kid) return;
    navigation.navigate('RewardRedeem', { productId: p.id, kidId: kid.id });
  };

  const handleSelectExisting = (orderId: string, productId: string) => {
    if (!kid) return;
    navigation.navigate('RewardRedeem', { productId, kidId: kid.id, existingOrderId: orderId });
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View style={styles.titleRow}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>Earn</Text>
          <KidSwitcherPill />
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          Redeem points, browse the store, climb the leaderboard
        </Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.bar}>
        {TABS.map((t) => {
          const active = t.key === tab;
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={t.key}
              onPress={() => setTab(t.key)}
              style={[styles.pill, active && styles.pillActive]}
              accessibilityRole="tab"
              accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.pillText, active && styles.pillTextActive]}>{t.label}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.body}>
        {tab === 'rewards' && (
          <RewardsTab
            pointsBalance={kid?.points_balance ?? 0}
            onSelect={handleSelect}
            onSelectExisting={handleSelectExisting}
          />
        )}
        {tab === 'store' && (
          <StoreTab
            onBuyWithCard={(p) => {
              if (!kid) return;
              navigation.navigate('StoreCheckout', { productId: p.id, kidId: kid.id });
            }}
          />
        )}
        {tab === 'ranks' && <RanksTab ownKidIds={kid ? [kid.id] : []} />}
        {tab === 'rules' && <EarnRulesTab kidId={kid?.id ?? null} />}
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

    paddingBottom: spacing['3xl'],
  },
  titleRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    marginBottom: spacing.xs,
  },
  title: {
    color: colors.gold,

FILE: src/screens/Earn/RewardRedeemScreen.tsx

/**
 * RewardRedeemScreen — confirm + redeem a reward, then surface the
 * server-issued redemption code so the parent can show it at the front
 * desk. The actual spend happens in the `redeem_reward_for_kid` RPC.
 *
 * Accepts an optional `existingOrderId` param. When present the screen
 * skips the confirmation step and jumps straight to the success view
 * using the already-issued code from that order.
 */

import * as Clipboard from 'expo-clipboard';
import { CheckCircle2, Coins, Copy, X } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import QRCode from 'react-native-qrcode-svg';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import { useOrders } from '@/hooks/useOrders';
import { useProducts } from '@/hooks/useProducts';
import { useRedeemReward } from '@/hooks/useRedeemReward';
import type { EarnStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Props = EarnStackScreenProps<'RewardRedeem'>;

export default function RewardRedeemScreen({ route, navigation }: Props) {
  const { productId, kidId, existingOrderId } = route.params;
  const { kids } = useFamily();
  const { data: products, isPending } = useProducts();
  const { data: orders } = useOrders();
  const product = useMemo(
    () => (products ?? []).find((p) => p.id === productId) ?? null,
    [products, productId],
  );
  const kid = kids.find((k) => k.id === kidId) ?? null;
  const balance = kid?.points_balance ?? 0;

  const redeem = useRedeemReward();
  const [code, setCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newBalance, setNewBalance] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // Short-circuit to success view when navigated with an existing order id.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!existingOrderId || !orders) return;
    const existing = orders.find((o) => o.id === existingOrderId);
    if (existing?.redemption_code && !code) {
      setCode(existing.redemption_code);
      setNewBalance(kid?.points_balance ?? null);
    }
  }, [existingOrderId, orders, code, kid?.points_balance]);

  const handleRedeem = async () => {
    if (!product) return;
    try {
      const res = await redeem.mutateAsync({ kidId, productId });
      setCode(res.redemptionCode);
      setNewBalance(res.newBalance);
    } catch {
      // Surfaced via redeem.error below.
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = async (value: string) => {
    await Clipboard.setStringAsync(value);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
  };

  const handleViewOrders = () => {
    navigation.navigate('Me');
    navigation.navigate('Me', { screen: 'Orders' });
  };

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (!product) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Reward not found</Text>
          <Button label="Close" variant="secondary" onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // Success state ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (code) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={styles.successContent}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          <View style={styles.successIcon}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={56} color={colors.gold} />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.successTitle}>You did it!</Text>
          <Text style={styles.successSubtitle}>Show this at the front desk to claim:</Text>
          <View style={styles.qrFrame}>
            <QRCode
              value={code}
              size={180}
              color={colors.dark}
              backgroundColor={colors.cream}
            />
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.codeBlock}
            onPress={() => handleCopy(code)}
            activeOpacity={0.75}
          >
            <Text style={styles.codeText}>{code}</Text>
            <Copy size={18} color={colors.gold} style={styles.copyIcon} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          {copied ? (
            <Text style={styles.copiedLabel}>Copied ✓</Text>
          ) : null}
          <Text style={styles.successProduct}>{product.name}</Text>
          {newBalance !== null ? (
            <Text style={styles.successBalance}>
              New balance:{' '}
              <Text style={styles.successBalanceVal}>{newBalance.toLocaleString()} pts</Text>
            </Text>
          ) : null}
          <View style={styles.actions}>
            <Button label="Done" onPress={() => navigation.popToTop()} fullWidth />
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleViewOrders} style={styles.viewOrdersBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.viewOrdersText}>View my orders →</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // Confirm state ----------------------------------------------------------
  const canAfford = product.points_cost !== null && balance >= product.points_cost;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}>
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>Confirm redemption</Text>
          <Button
            label=""
            variant="tertiary"
            tone="muted"
            leftIcon={<X size={20} color={colors.textLight} />}
            onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          />
        </View>

        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.productName}>{product.name}</Text>
          {product.description ? (
            <Text style={styles.productDesc}>{product.description}</Text>
          ) : null}
          <View style={styles.divider} />
          <View style={styles.line}>
            <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>Cost</Text>
            <View style={styles.lineCost}>
              <Coins size={14} color={colors.gold} />
              <Text style={styles.lineCostText}>
                {product.points_cost?.toLocaleString() ?? '—'} pts
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.line}>
            <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>Your balance</Text>
            <Text style={styles.lineValue}>{balance.toLocaleString()} pts</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.line}>
            <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>After redemption</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.lineValue, styles.afterValue]}>
              {(balance - (product.points_cost ?? 0)).toLocaleString()} pts
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {!canAfford ? (
          <Text style={styles.warn}>
            Not enough points yet — keep training!
          </Text>
        ) : null}

        {redeem.error ? (
          <Text style={styles.warn}>{errorMessage(redeem.error)}</Text>
        ) : null}

        <View style={styles.confirmActions}>
          <Button
            label="Redeem"
            onPress={handleRedeem}
            loading={redeem.isPending}
            disabled={!canAfford}
            fullWidth
          />
          <Button
            label="Cancel"
            variant="secondary"
            onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
            fullWidth
          />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  scroll: {
    padding: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'],
  },
  centered: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: spacing['4xl'],
  },
  headerRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    marginBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  eyebrow: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.gold,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
  },
  card: {
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    borderWidth: 1,

/**
 * StoreCheckoutScreen — dual-path checkout for store items.
 *
 * Supports two payment methods where available:
 *   • Pay with Points — uses the existing `redeem_reward_for_kid` RPC,
 *     same as RewardRedeemScreen. Available when product.points_cost is set
 *     and the kid has sufficient balance.
 *   • Pay with Card  — Stripe payment sheet via stripe-create-payment-intent
 *     Edge Function. Available when product.dollar_price_cents is set AND
 *     the family's primary location has a connected Stripe account.
 *
 * Location pre-check: the screen queries the location's stripe_onboarding_status
 * before rendering. If not connected, the card button is disabled with a clear
 * explanation, so parents know to pay at the front desk instead.
 *
 * Order lifecycle (card path):
 *   payment_pending → fulfilled   (payment_intent.succeeded webhook)
 *   payment_pending → payment_failed  (payment_intent.payment_failed)
 *   payment_pending → cancelled   (payment_intent.canceled — sheet dismissed)
 *
 * Note: @stripe/stripe-react-native requires a custom dev build (EAS Build)
 * or Expo Development Build — it is not available in standard Expo Go.
 */

import {
  useStripe,
} from '@stripe/stripe-react-native';
import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { CheckCircle2, Coins, CreditCard, WifiOff, X } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import QRCode from 'react-native-qrcode-svg';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { createCardPaymentIntent } from '@/api/stripe';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import { useProducts } from '@/hooks/useProducts';
import { useRedeemReward } from '@/hooks/useRedeemReward';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import type { EarnStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Props = EarnStackScreenProps<'StoreCheckout'>;

type LocationStatus = 'loading' | 'connected' | 'not_connected';

type SuccessData = {
  redemptionCode: string;
  amountCents: number | null;
  amountPoints: number | null;
  newBalance: number | null;
  method: 'card' | 'points';
};

export default function StoreCheckoutScreen({ route, navigation }: Props) {
  const { productId, kidId } = route.params;
  const { family, kids } = useFamily();
  const { data: products, isPending } = useProducts();

  const product = useMemo(
    () => (products ?? []).find((p) => p.id === productId) ?? null,
    [products, productId],
  );
  const kid = kids.find((k) => k.id === kidId) ?? null;
  const pointsBalance = kid?.points_balance ?? 0;

  const { initPaymentSheet, presentPaymentSheet } = useStripe();
  const redeem = useRedeemReward();

  const [locationStatus, setLocationStatus] = useState<LocationStatus>('loading');
  const [isCardLoading, setIsCardLoading] = useState(false);
  const [cardErrorMsg, setCardErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successData, setSuccessData] = useState<SuccessData | null>(null);

  // ── Pre-check: does this family's location have a connected Stripe account? ─
  useEffect(() => {
    async function checkLocationStatus() {
      const locationId = family?.primary_location_id;
      if (!locationId) {
        setLocationStatus('not_connected');
        return;
      }

      // stripe_onboarding_status was added post-generated-types; use the
      // untyped client cast per project convention (not `any`).
      const { data, error } = await (supabase as SupabaseClient)
        .from('locations')
        .select('stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status')
        .eq('id', locationId)
        .single<{ stripe_account_id: string | null; stripe_onboarding_status: string | null }>();

      if (error || !data) {
        setLocationStatus('not_connected');
        return;
      }

      if (
        data.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected' &&
        data.stripe_account_id
      ) {
        setLocationStatus('connected');
      } else {
        setLocationStatus('not_connected');
      }
    }

    if (family !== null) {
      void checkLocationStatus();
    }
  }, [family]);

  // ── Pay with Points ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const handlePayWithPoints = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!product) return;
    try {
      const res = await redeem.mutateAsync({ kidId, productId });
      setSuccessData({
        redemptionCode: res.redemptionCode,
        amountCents: null,
        amountPoints: product.points_cost,
        newBalance: res.newBalance,
        method: 'points',
      });
    } catch {
      // surfaced via redeem.error
    }
  }, [product, kidId, productId, redeem]);

  // ── Pay with Card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const handlePayWithCard = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!product || !kid) return;
    setIsCardLoading(true);
    setCardErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      // 1. Get client_secret, customer context, and ephemeral key from Edge Function.
      //    The Edge Function also inserts an order with status='payment_pending'.
      const result = await createCardPaymentIntent({
        productId: product.id,
        kidId: kid.id,
      });

      // 2. Initialise the Stripe payment sheet with customer context so saved
      //    payment methods are surfaced on subsequent purchases.
      const { error: initError } = await initPaymentSheet({
        merchantDisplayName: 'Ballpark',
        paymentIntentClientSecret: result.clientSecret,
        customerId: result.customerId,
        customerEphemeralKeySecret: result.ephemeralKeySecret,
        style: 'alwaysDark',
        appearance: {
          colors: {
            primary: '#E3A020',
            background: '#1A1A1A',
            componentBackground: '#242424',
            componentBorder: '#333333',
            componentDivider: '#333333',
            primaryText: '#FFFFFF',
            secondaryText: '#AAAAAA',
            componentText: '#FFFFFF',
            placeholderText: '#888888',
            icon: '#E3A020',
            error: '#FF4444',
          },
        },
      });

      if (initError) {
        setCardErrorMsg(initError.localizedMessage ?? initError.message ?? 'Payment setup failed');
        return;
      }

      // 3. Present the Stripe payment sheet
      const { error: presentError } = await presentPaymentSheet();

      if (presentError) {
        if (presentError.code === 'Canceled') {
          // User cancelled — order stays payment_pending until webhook fires
          // payment_intent.canceled and sets it to 'cancelled'. No-op in UI.
          return;
        }
        setCardErrorMsg(presentError.localizedMessage ?? presentError.message ?? 'Payment failed');
        return;
      }

      // 4. Payment sheet confirmed — show success.
      //    Webhook will set order to 'ordered' asynchronously (payment_pending → ordered).
      //    Staff then scans the QR code at the front desk → mark_redemption_fulfilled → 'fulfilled'.
      setSuccessData({
        redemptionCode: result.redemptionCode,
        amountCents: result.amountCents,
        amountPoints: null,
        newBalance: null,
        method: 'card',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setCardErrorMsg(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setIsCardLoading(false);
    }
  }, [product, kid, initPaymentSheet, presentPaymentSheet]);

  // ── Loading state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  if (isPending || (locationStatus === 'loading' && family === null)) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (!product) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Product not found</Text>
          <Button label="Close" variant="secondary" onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Success state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  if (successData) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.successWrap}>
          <View style={styles.successIcon}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={56} color={colors.gold} />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.successTitle}>
            {successData.method === 'card' ? 'Payment successful!' : 'You did it!'}
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.successSubtitle}>
            Show this code at the front desk to claim your item:
          </Text>
          <View style={styles.qrFrame}>
            <QRCode
              value={successData.redemptionCode}
              size={180}
              color={colors.dark}
              backgroundColor={colors.cream}
            />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.codeBlock}>{successData.redemptionCode}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.successProduct}>{product.name}</Text>
          {successData.method === 'card' && successData.amountCents !== null ? (
            <Text style={styles.successMeta}>
              Paid:{' '}
              <Text style={styles.successMetaVal}>
                ${(successData.amountCents / 100).toFixed(2)}
              </Text>
            </Text>
          ) : null}
          {successData.method === 'points' && successData.amountPoints !== null ? (
            <Text style={styles.successMeta}>
              Spent:{' '}
              <Text style={styles.successMetaVal}>
                {successData.amountPoints.toLocaleString()} pts
              </Text>
            </Text>
          ) : null}
          {successData.newBalance !== null ? (
            <Text style={styles.successBalance}>
              New balance:{' '}
              <Text style={styles.successBalanceVal}>
                {successData.newBalance.toLocaleString()} pts
              </Text>
            </Text>
          ) : null}
          <View style={{ height: spacing['5xl'] }} />
          <Button label="Done" onPress={() => navigation.popToTop()} fullWidth />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Checkout state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const price = product.dollar_price_cents !== null
    ? `$${(product.dollar_price_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`
    : null;

  const pointsCost = product.points_cost ?? null;
  const soldOut = product.inventory_count !== null && product.inventory_count <= 0;
  const canAffordPoints = pointsCost !== null && pointsBalance >= pointsCost;
  const cardNotAvailable = locationStatus === 'not_connected';
  const cardLoading = locationStatus === 'loading';

  const hasPoints = pointsCost !== null;
  const hasCard = price !== null;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}>
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>Checkout</Text>
          <Button
            label=""
            variant="tertiary"
            tone="muted"
            leftIcon={<X size={20} color={colors.textLight} />}
            onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          />
        </View>

        {/* ── Product summary ── */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.productName}>{product.name}</Text>
          {product.description ? (
            <Text style={styles.productDesc}>{product.description}</Text>
          ) : null}
          <View style={styles.divider} />

          {hasCard ? (
            <View style={styles.line}>
              <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>Card price</Text>
              <Text style={styles.linePriceGold}>{price}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {hasPoints ? (
            <View style={styles.line}>
              <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>Points cost</Text>
              <View style={styles.lineCost}>
                <Coins size={14} color={colors.gold} />
                <Text style={styles.lineCostText}>
                  {pointsCost!.toLocaleString()} pts
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {hasPoints ? (
            <View style={styles.line}>
              <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>Your balance</Text>
              <Text style={styles.lineValue}>{pointsBalance.toLocaleString()} pts</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {kid ? (
            <View style={styles.line}>
              <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>For</Text>
              <Text style={styles.lineValue}>{kid.first_name}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          <View style={styles.line}>
            <Text style={styles.lineLabel}>Pickup</Text>
            <Text style={styles.lineValue}>Front desk</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* ── Location not connected — explain why card is unavailable ── */}
        {cardNotAvailable && hasCard ? (
          <View style={styles.notConnectedBanner}>
            <WifiOff size={20} color={colors.textMuted} style={{ marginBottom: spacing.sm }} />
            <Text style={styles.notConnectedText}>
              Card payments are not yet available at this location.
              {hasPoints ? ' You can still pay with points below.' : ' Please pay at the front desk or check back later.'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {soldOut ? (
          <Text style={styles.warn}>This item is sold out.</Text>
        ) : null}

        {!canAffordPoints && hasPoints && !hasCard ? (
          <Text style={styles.warn}>
            Not enough points yet — keep training!
          </Text>
        ) : null}

        {redeem.error ? (
          <Text style={styles.warn}>{errorMessage(redeem.error)}</Text>
        ) : null}

        {cardErrorMsg ? (
          <Text style={styles.warn}>{cardErrorMsg}</Text>
        ) : null}

        {/* ── Payment options ── */}
        <View style={styles.actions}>

          {/* Pay with Card */}
          {hasCard ? (
            cardLoading ? (
              <View style={styles.locationLoading}>
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.gold} />
                <Text style={styles.locationLoadingText}>Checking payment availability…</Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              <Button
                label={isCardLoading ? 'Processing…' : `Pay ${price} with Card`}
                leftIcon={
                  <CreditCard
                    size={18}
                    color={cardNotAvailable || soldOut ? colors.textMuted : colors.dark}
                  />
                }
                onPress={handlePayWithCard}
                loading={isCardLoading}
                disabled={soldOut || isCardLoading || cardNotAvailable}
                fullWidth
              />
            )
          ) : null}

          {/* Pay with Points */}
          {hasPoints ? (
            <Button
              label={
                redeem.isPending
                  ? 'Processing…'
                  : `Pay ${pointsCost!.toLocaleString()} pts with Points`
              }
              variant={hasCard ? 'secondary' : 'primary'}
              leftIcon={<Coins size={18} color={canAffordPoints ? colors.gold : colors.textMuted} />}
              onPress={handlePayWithPoints}
              loading={redeem.isPending}
              disabled={!canAffordPoints || soldOut || redeem.isPending}
              fullWidth
            />
          ) : null}

          <Button
            label="Cancel"
            variant="secondary"
            onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
            fullWidth
          />
        </View>

        <Text style={styles.disclaimer}>
          {hasCard
            ? 'Card details are processed securely by Stripe and never stored on Ballpark servers.'
            : 'Points redemptions are instant and cannot be reversed.'}
        </Text>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  scroll: {
    padding: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'],
  },
  centered: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: spacing['4xl'],
  },
  headerRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',

FILE: src/screens/Home/components/CoachMessageToast.tsx

/**
 * In-app toast that nudges the parent to watch a freshly-arrived coach
 * video. Mounted inside HomeScreen (the only tab the spec requires it on)
 * and listens to `useNewCoachMessage` for state.
 *
 * Behaviour (Step 4.14):
 *   - Slides in from the top when `isNew` flips true.
 *   - Tapping it: marks the message seen, dismisses, and navigates to
 *     the Video Playback screen with the new message id.
 *   - Auto-dismisses after ~5s by marking the message seen and animating
 *     out — the underlying message id is captured at the time of arrival
 *     so a quick second message doesn't get swallowed by the timer.
 */

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Animated, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useNewCoachMessage } from '@/hooks/useNewCoachMessage';
import type { HomeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import {
  colors,
  fontFamilies,
  fontSizes,
  radius,
  spacing,
} from '@/theme';

type Nav = HomeStackScreenProps<'HomeMain'>['navigation'];

const AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 5000;
const SLIDE_DISTANCE = 80;

export default function CoachMessageToast() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { isNew, message, markSeen } = useNewCoachMessage();

  const translateY = useRef(new Animated.Value(-SLIDE_DISTANCE)).current;
  const opacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  // `mounted` keeps the Animated.View in the tree long enough for the
  // slide-out to play after `isNew` flips false. We flip it to false from
  // the animation completion callback.
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  // Slide in / out whenever the new-message state flips. We avoid putting
  // `markSeen` in the dep array because it's a new function ref every
  // render and would otherwise re-trigger the dismiss timer endlessly.
  useEffect(() => {
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    if (isNew && message) {
      setMounted(true);
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.timing(translateY, {
          toValue: 0,
          duration: 220,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(opacity, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: 220,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]).start();
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        markSeen();
      }, AUTO_DISMISS_MS);
    } else if (mounted) {
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.timing(translateY, {
          toValue: -SLIDE_DISTANCE,
          duration: 180,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(opacity, {
          toValue: 0,
          duration: 180,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]).start(({ finished }) => {
        if (finished) setMounted(false);
      });
    }
    return () => {
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isNew, message?.id]);

  if (!mounted) return null;

  const coachName = message?.coach
    ? `${message.coach.firstName} ${message.coach.lastName}`.trim()
    : 'Your coach';

  const onPress = () => {
    if (!message) return;
    const id = message.id;
    markSeen();
    navigation.navigate('VideoPlayback', { messageId: id });
  };

  return (
    <Animated.View
      pointerEvents={isNew ? 'box-none' : 'none'}
      style={[
        styles.wrap,
        { transform: [{ translateY }], opacity },
      ]}
    >
      <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} pointerEvents="box-none">
        <Pressable
          onPress={onPress}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel={`${coachName} sent a new video. Tap to watch.`}
          style={({ pressed }) => [styles.toast, pressed && styles.pressed]}
        >
          <View style={styles.dot} />
          <Text style={styles.text} numberOfLines={1}>
            {coachName} sent a new video!
          </Text>
        </Pressable>
      </SafeAreaView>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrap: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0,
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    zIndex: 100,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
  },
  toast: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.lg,
    marginTop: spacing.base,
    paddingVertical: spacing.lg,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['2xl'],
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.gold,
    shadowColor: '#000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.35,
    shadowRadius: 8,
    elevation: 6,
  },
  pressed: {
    opacity: 0.85,
  },
  dot: {
    width: 8,
    height: 8,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    backgroundColor: colors.gold,
  },
  text: {
    flex: 1,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    color: colors.textOnDark,
  },
});

FILE: src/screens/Home/components/CoachVideoCard.tsx

import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Loader, Mail, Play } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Image, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import {
  colors,
  fontFamilies,
  fontSizes,
  radius,
  spacing,
  tracking,
} from '@/theme';

type Variant = 'ready' | 'processing' | 'empty';

type Props = {
  variant?: Variant;
  coachName?: string;
  thumbnail?: string;
  durationSeconds?: number;
  subtitle?: string;
  onPress?: () => void;
  /**
   * When true and variant === 'ready', renders a small gold "unread" dot
   * on the thumbnail. Ignored on the processing/empty variants since
   * there's no message to be unread on those.
   */
  unread?: boolean;
};

function formatDuration(totalSeconds: number): string {
  const safe = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));
  const minutes = Math.floor(safe / 60);
  const seconds = safe % 60;
  return `${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export default function CoachVideoCard({
  variant = 'ready',
  coachName,
  thumbnail,
  durationSeconds,
  subtitle,
  onPress,
  unread = false,
}: Props) {
  const interactive = variant === 'ready' && !!onPress;

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={interactive ? onPress : undefined}
      disabled={!interactive}
      style={({ pressed }) => [styles.card, pressed && interactive && styles.pressed]}
    >
      <View style={styles.thumbWrap}>
        {thumbnail ? (
          <Image source={{ uri: thumbnail }} style={styles.thumbImage} />
        ) : (
          <LinearGradient
            colors={[colors.dark, colors.darker]}
            start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
            end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
            style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
          />
        )}
        <View style={styles.iconWrap} pointerEvents="none">
          {variant === 'ready' ? (
            <Play size={22} color={colors.gold} fill={colors.gold} />
          ) : variant === 'processing' ? (
            <Loader size={22} color={colors.gold} />
          ) : (
            <Mail size={22} color={colors.gold} />
          )}
        </View>
        {variant === 'ready' && durationSeconds != null ? (
          <View style={styles.durationBadge} pointerEvents="none">
            <Text style={styles.durationText}>
              {formatDuration(durationSeconds)}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        {variant === 'ready' && unread ? (
          <View
            style={styles.unreadDot}
            pointerEvents="none"
            accessibilityLabel="Unread"
          />
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.body}>
        <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>
          {variant === 'ready'
            ? "TODAY'S VIDEO"
            : variant === 'processing'
              ? 'NEW VIDEO'
              : 'COACH VIDEOS'}
        </Text>
        <Text
          style={styles.title}
          numberOfLines={variant === 'empty' ? 2 : 1}
        >
          {variant === 'ready'
            ? coachName ?? ''
            : variant === 'processing'
              ? 'Processing video…'
              : 'No coach videos yet — your coach will send one soon!'}
        </Text>
        {subtitle ? (
          <Text style={styles.subtitle} numberOfLines={2}>
            {subtitle}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const THUMB_WIDTH = spacing['7xl'] + spacing['5xl'];

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: spacing.lg,
    padding: spacing.xl,
    borderRadius: radius['3xl'],
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.borderGold,
  },
  pressed: {
    opacity: 0.85,
  },
  thumbWrap: {
    width: THUMB_WIDTH,
    aspectRatio: 3 / 4,
    borderRadius: radius.lg,
    backgroundColor: colors.dark,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.gold,
    overflow: 'hidden',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  thumbImage: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,

    height: '100%',
  },
  iconWrap: {

  },
  durationText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    letterSpacing: tracking.tight,
  },
  unreadDot: {

/**
 * ConnectHitTraxBanner — prompts the parent to connect HitTrax so cage
 * swings flow into the app within ~5 minutes (task #118).
 *
 * Rendering rules (driven by the caller via the `link` prop):
 *   - link === undefined          → loading (render nothing)
 *   - link === null               → no link yet → "Connect HitTrax" CTA
 *   - link.association_status:
 *       'pending'                 → "Check your inbox" pill, no CTA
 *       'declined' | 'removed'    → "Re-connect HitTrax" CTA
 *       'active'                  → render nothing
 *
 * Tapping the CTA navigates to Me → ConnectHitTrax (cross-tab nav via the
 * tab nav child screen param).
 */

import { Activity } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { KidCaptureLink } from '@/api/hittrax';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  link: KidCaptureLink | null | undefined;
  onPress: () => void;
};

export default function ConnectHitTraxBanner({ link, onPress }: Props) {
  // Hide for active links and during the initial fetch.
  if (link === undefined) return null;
  if (link?.association_status === 'active') return null;

  const isPending = link?.association_status === 'pending';
  const ctaLabel =
    link?.association_status === 'declined' ||
    link?.association_status === 'removed'
      ? 'Re-connect HitTrax'
      : 'Connect HitTrax';

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={isPending ? undefined : onPress}
      disabled={isPending}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.card,
        pressed && !isPending ? styles.pressed : null,
      ]}
      accessibilityRole={isPending ? 'text' : 'button'}
      accessibilityLabel={
        isPending ? 'HitTrax connection pending' : 'Connect HitTrax'
      }
      testID="hittrax-banner"
    >
      <View style={styles.iconCircle}>
        <Activity size={20} color={colors.gold} />
      </View>
      <View style={styles.body}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>
          {isPending ? 'SETTING UP HITTRAX' : 'TRACK EVERY CAGE SWING'}
        </Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          {isPending
            ? 'We sent a confirmation email to your athlete. Tap the link to finish.'
            : 'Connect HitTrax so swings show up here automatically — and earn points for every personal best.'}
        </Text>
        {!isPending ? <Text style={styles.cta}>{ctaLabel} →</Text> : null}
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderRadius: radius['3xl'],
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    padding: spacing.lg,
    gap: spacing.md,
  },
  pressed: {
    opacity: 0.85,
  },
  iconCircle: {
    width: 36,
    height: 36,
    borderRadius: 18,
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(216, 168, 60, 0.12)',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  body: {
    flex: 1,
    gap: spacing.xs,
  },
  title: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    letterSpacing: tracking.tight,
  },
  subtitle: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.textMuted,
    lineHeight: fontSizes.sm * 1.4,
  },
  cta: {
    marginTop: spacing.xs,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.gold,
  },
});

import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  pointsBalance: number;
  nextRewardName: string | null;
  nextRewardCost: number | null;
  onPress?: () => void;
};

export default function HeroCard({
  pointsBalance,
  nextRewardName,
  nextRewardCost,
  onPress,
}: Props) {
  const cost = nextRewardCost ?? 0;
  const pointsAway = cost > 0 ? Math.max(cost - pointsBalance, 0) : 0;
  const progressPct =
    cost > 0 ? Math.min(Math.max(pointsBalance / cost, 0), 1) : 0;

  return (
    <Pressable onPress={onPress} accessibilityRole="button" style={styles.shadow}>
      <LinearGradient
        colors={[colors.gold, colors.goldBright]}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
        end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
        style={styles.card}
      >
        <View style={styles.decorCircle} pointerEvents="none" />
        <View style={styles.innerBorder} pointerEvents="none" />

        <View style={styles.content}>
          <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>YOUR POINTS</Text>
          <View style={styles.row}>
            <Text style={styles.pointsValue}>{pointsBalance}</Text>
            {nextRewardCost != null ? (
              <Text style={styles.pointsTotal}> / {nextRewardCost}</Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
          {nextRewardName ? (
            <Text style={styles.nextLabel} numberOfLines={1}>
              NEXT REWARD: {nextRewardName.toUpperCase()}
            </Text>
          ) : (
            <Text style={styles.nextLabel}>KEEP EARNING</Text>
          )}
          <View style={styles.progressTrack}>
            <View style={[styles.progressFill, { width: `${progressPct * 100}%` }]} />
          </View>
          {nextRewardCost != null ? (
            <Text style={styles.awayLabel}>
              {pointsAway === 0 ? 'READY TO REDEEM' : `${pointsAway} PTS AWAY`}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      </LinearGradient>
    </Pressable>
  );
}
