import { ChevronRight, Dumbbell } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { AssignmentWithRefs } from '@/api/assignments';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  assignments: AssignmentWithRefs[];
  onPress: () => void;
};

function formatDue(dateStr: string | null): string {
  if (!dateStr) return 'No due date';
  const d = new Date(`${dateStr}T00:00:00`);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const diffDays = Math.round((d.getTime() - today.getTime()) / 86400000);
  if (diffDays < 0) return 'Overdue';
  if (diffDays === 0) return 'Due today';
  if (diffDays === 1) return 'Due tomorrow';
  if (diffDays < 7) return `Due in ${diffDays} days`;
  return `Due ${d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}`;
}

export default function HomeAssignmentsCard({ assignments, onPress }: Props) {
  const pending = assignments.filter((a) => a.status === 'pending');
  if (pending.length === 0) return null;

  const sorted = [...pending].sort((a, b) => {
    if (!a.due_date && !b.due_date) return 0;
    if (!a.due_date) return 1;
    if (!b.due_date) return -1;
    return a.due_date.localeCompare(b.due_date);
  });
  const top = sorted.slice(0, 2);

  return (
    <View style={styles.wrap}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View style={styles.iconWrap}>
          <Dumbbell size={18} color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>ASSIGNMENTS</Text>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <Pressable
          onPress={onPress}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="See all assignments"
          style={styles.seeAllPress}
        >
          <Text style={styles.seeAll}>SEE ALL</Text>
          <ChevronRight size={14} color={colors.gold} />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {top.map((a) => (
        <Pressable
          key={a.id}
          onPress={onPress}
          style={({ pressed }) => [styles.row, pressed && styles.rowPressed]}
          accessibilityRole="button"
        >
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <Text style={styles.rowTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
              {a.title}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.rowMeta} numberOfLines={1}>
              {formatDue(a.due_date)}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.pointsPill}>
            <Text style={styles.pointsPillText}>+{a.point_reward ?? 25} PTS</Text>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrap: {
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderColor: colors.borderGold,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing.lg,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    gap: spacing.base,
  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.base,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.base,
    paddingTop: spacing.xs,
  },
  iconWrap: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    borderRadius: 16,
    backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.borderGold,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  eyebrow: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.gold,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
  },
  seeAllPress: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 },
  seeAll: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
    color: colors.gold,

  },
  row: {

import { ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  kidFirstName: string;
  multipleKids?: boolean;
  onSwitchPress?: () => void;
};

export default function HomeHeader({ kidFirstName, multipleKids, onSwitchPress }: Props) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>WELCOME BACK</Text>
        {multipleKids && onSwitchPress ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={onSwitchPress}
            style={({ pressed }) => [styles.switcherPill, pressed && { opacity: 0.75 }]}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={`Currently viewing ${kidFirstName}. Tap to switch athlete.`}
          >
            <Text style={styles.switcherName} numberOfLines={1}>
              {kidFirstName.toUpperCase()}
            </Text>
            <ChevronDown size={16} color={colors.dark} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </Pressable>
        ) : (
          <Text style={styles.greeting} numberOfLines={1}>
            {kidFirstName.toUpperCase()}
          </Text>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * LatestPersonalBestCard — v0.7 task #119.
 *
 * Real card on Home, backed by `personal_bests`. Renders an empty state
 * (no PR yet → "head to the cage") rather than hiding entirely so the
 * Home rhythm is preserved for new families.
 */

import { Award, Star } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { PersonalBest } from '@/api/swings';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

const METRIC_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  exit_velocity_mph: 'EXIT VELO',
  launch_angle_deg: 'LAUNCH ANGLE',
  distance_ft: 'DISTANCE',
  pitch_speed_mph: 'PITCH SPEED',
};

const METRIC_UNITS: Record<string, string> = {
  exit_velocity_mph: 'MPH',
  launch_angle_deg: '°',
  distance_ft: 'FT',
  pitch_speed_mph: 'MPH',
};

type Props = {
  pr: PersonalBest | null;
  onPress?: () => void;
};

function fmt(v: number, metric: string) {
  if (metric === 'distance_ft' || metric === 'launch_angle_deg') return Math.round(v).toString();
  return Number(v).toFixed(1);
}

function timeAgo(iso: string): string {
  const then = new Date(iso).getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(then)) return '';
  const diffMs = Date.now() - then;
  const days = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  if (days < 1) return 'Today';
  if (days === 1) return 'Yesterday';
  if (days < 7) return `${days}d ago`;
  if (days < 30) return `${Math.floor(days / 7)}w ago`;
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

export default function LatestPersonalBestCard({ pr, onPress }: Props) {
  if (!pr) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.card}>
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          <Award size={16} color={colors.gold} />
          <Text style={styles.headerLabel}>LATEST PERSONAL BEST</Text>
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>No personal best yet</Text>
        <Text style={styles.emptyBody}>
          Your first PR will land here as soon as HitTrax syncs your next cage session.
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  const interactive = !!onPress && !!pr.swing_id;
  const inner = (
    <>
      <View style={styles.headerRow}>
        <Award size={16} color={colors.gold} />
        <Text style={styles.headerLabel}>LATEST PERSONAL BEST</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.valueRow}>
        <Text style={styles.value}>{fmt(Number(pr.value), pr.metric)}</Text>
        <View style={styles.unitBlock}>
          <Text style={styles.unit}>{METRIC_UNITS[pr.metric] ?? ''}</Text>
          <View style={styles.prPip}>
            <Star size={10} color={colors.dark} fill={colors.dark} />
            <Text style={styles.prText}>NEW PR</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>
      <Text style={styles.metricLabel}>
        {(METRIC_LABELS[pr.metric] ?? pr.metric).toUpperCase()} · {timeAgo(pr.achieved_at)}
      </Text>
    </>
  );

  return interactive ? (
    <Pressable onPress={onPress} style={({ pressed }) => [styles.card, pressed && styles.pressed]}>
      {inner}
    </Pressable>
  ) : (
    <View style={styles.card}>{inner}</View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderRadius: radius['3xl'],
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    padding: spacing['3xl'],
  },
  pressed: { opacity: 0.85 },
  headerRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.base,
    marginBottom: spacing.lg,
  },
  headerLabel: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  valueRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'flex-end',
    gap: spacing.lg,
  },
  value: {
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['5xl'],
    lineHeight: fontSizes['5xl'] + 4,
  },
  unitBlock: { paddingBottom: spacing.base, alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: spacing.xs },
  unit: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  prPip: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.xxs,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.base,
    paddingVertical: spacing.xxs,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    backgroundColor: colors.gold,
  },
  prText: {

    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,

import * as Haptics from 'expo-haptics';
import { ReactNode, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import {
  colors,
  fontFamilies,
  fontSizes,
  radius,
  spacing,
  tracking,
} from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  icon: ReactNode;
  label: string;
  onPress?: () => void;
};

export default function QuickAction({ icon, label, onPress }: Props) {
  const handlePress = useCallback(() => {
    void Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light);
    onPress?.();
  }, [onPress]);

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={handlePress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [styles.container, pressed && styles.pressed]}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={label}
    >
      <View style={styles.circle}>{icon}</View>
      <Text style={styles.label} numberOfLines={1}>
        {label}
      </Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

  },

    height: spacing['7xl'],
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  label: {

    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,

    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,

});

import { CalendarPlus } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text } from 'react-native';

import {
  colors,
  fontFamilies,
  fontSizes,
  radius,
  spacing,
  tracking,
} from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  date?: Date;
  durationMinutes?: number;
  coachName?: string;
  location?: string;
  isPast?: boolean;
  onPress?: () => void;
};

const WEEKDAYS = ['SUN', 'MON', 'TUE', 'WED', 'THU', 'FRI', 'SAT'] as const;
const MONTHS = [
  'JAN',
  'FEB',
  'MAR',
  'APR',
  'MAY',
  'JUN',
  'JUL',
  'AUG',
  'SEP',
  'OCT',
  'NOV',
  'DEC',
] as const;

function formatDate(date: Date): string {
  return `${WEEKDAYS[date.getDay()]}, ${MONTHS[date.getMonth()]} ${date.getDate()}`;
}

function formatTime(date: Date): string {
  const hours24 = date.getHours();
  const minutes = date.getMinutes();
  const period = hours24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const hours12 = hours24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hours24 % 12;
  const minutesStr = minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${hours12}:${minutesStr} ${period}`;
}

export default function UpcomingSessionCard({
  date,
  durationMinutes,
  coachName,
  location,
  isPast,
  onPress = () => {},
}: Props) {
  const hasSession = date != null && coachName != null && location != null;

  if (!hasSession) {
    return (
      <Pressable
        onPress={onPress}
        style={({ pressed }) => [styles.card, styles.emptyCard, pressed && styles.pressed]}
      >
        <CalendarPlus size={20} color={colors.gold} />
        <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
          No upcoming sessions — book one!
        </Text>
      </Pressable>
    );
  }

  const subtitleParts: string[] = [];
  if (durationMinutes != null) subtitleParts.push(`${durationMinutes} min`);
  if (isPast) subtitleParts.push('Past');

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [styles.card, pressed && styles.pressed]}
    >
      <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>
        {formatDate(date)} · {formatTime(date)}
      </Text>
      <Text style={styles.title} numberOfLines={1}>
        {coachName} · {location}
      </Text>
      {subtitleParts.length > 0 ? (
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>{subtitleParts.join(' · ')}</Text>
      ) : null}
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    borderRadius: radius['3xl'],
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.borderGold,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['2xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  pressed: {
    opacity: 0.85,
  },
  emptyCard: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.lg,
    minHeight: 72,
  },
  emptyText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    flexShrink: 1,
  },
  eyebrow: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.gold,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    marginBottom: spacing.sm,
  },
  title: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    letterSpacing: -tracking.tight,
  },
  subtitle: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.base,
    color: colors.textMuted,
    marginTop: spacing.xs,
  },
});

FILE: src/screens/Home/HomeScreen.tsx
=================================================================================
import { useBottomTabBarHeight } from '@react-navigation/bottom-tabs';
import { useFocusEffect, useIsFocused, useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, RefreshControl, ScrollView, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useAssignments } from '@/hooks/useAssignments';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useLeaderboard } from '@/hooks/useLeaderboard';
import { useMembership } from '@/hooks/useMembership';
import { useProducts } from '@/hooks/useProducts';
import {
  latestCoachMessageKey,
  useLatestCoachMessage,
} from '@/hooks/useLatestCoachMessage';
import { personalBestsKeys, useLatestPersonalBest } from '@/hooks/useSwings';
import { upcomingSessionKey, useUpcomingSession } from '@/hooks/useUpcomingSession';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import type { HomeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, spacing } from '@/theme';
import { formatRelativeTime } from '@/utils/time';

import KidSwitcherSheet from '@/components/ui/KidSwitcherSheet';
import CoachMessageToast from './components/CoachMessageToast';
import CoachVideoCard from './components/CoachVideoCard';
import EmptyHomeCard from './components/EmptyHomeCard';
import FailedPaymentCard from './components/FailedPaymentCard';
import HeroCard from './components/HeroCard';
import HomeAssignmentsCard from './components/HomeAssignmentsCard';
import HomeHeader from './components/HomeHeader';
import LatestPersonalBestCard from './components/LatestPersonalBestCard';
import StatTilesRow from './components/StatTilesRow';
import UpcomingSessionCard from './components/UpcomingSessionCard';
import { styles } from './styles';

const POSTER_WIDTH = 480;

function muxPosterUrl(playbackId: string) {
  return `https://image.mux.com/${playbackId}/thumbnail.jpg?width=${POSTER_WIDTH}`;
}

type Nav = HomeStackScreenProps<'HomeMain'>['navigation'];

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const tabBarHeight = useBottomTabBarHeight();
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [switcherVisible, setSwitcherVisible] = useState(false);
  const [paymentAlertDismissed, setPaymentAlertDismissed] = useState(false);
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const { kid, kids, loading: familyLoading, selectedKidId, setSelectedKid } = useSelectedKid();
  const { membership, refresh: refreshMembership } = useMembership();

  // Re-fetch membership on focus so the payment_failed_at banner clears
  // immediately after returning from PaymentMethodScreen.
  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      void refreshMembership();
    }, [refreshMembership]),
  );
  const showEmpty = !kid && !familyLoading;
  const { session: upcoming } = useUpcomingSession(kid?.id);
  const isFocused = useIsFocused();
  const { data: latestMessage, isPending: latestMessagePending } =
    useLatestCoachMessage(kid?.id, { enabled: isFocused });
  const { data: assignments } = useAssignments(kid?.id, ['pending']);
  const { data: latestPr } = useLatestPersonalBest(kid?.id);
  const { data: products } = useProducts();
  const { data: leaderboard } = useLeaderboard();

  const nextReward = useMemo(() => {
    if (!products || !kid) return null;
    const balance = kid.points_balance ?? 0;
    const affordable = products
      .filter((p) => p.points_cost != null && p.points_cost > balance)
      .sort((a, b) => (a.points_cost ?? 0) - (b.points_cost ?? 0));
    return affordable[0] ?? null;
  }, [products, kid]);

  const rank = useMemo(() => {
    if (!leaderboard || !kid) return null;
    const row = leaderboard.find((r) => r.kidId === kid.id);
    return row?.rank ?? null;
  }, [leaderboard, kid]);

  const exitVeloMph =
    latestPr && latestPr.metric === 'exit_velocity_mph'
      ? Number(latestPr.value)
      : null;

  const onRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        user
          ? qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['family', user.id] })
          : Promise.resolve(),
        kid
          ? qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: upcomingSessionKey(kid.id) })
          : Promise.resolve(),
        kid
          ? qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: latestCoachMessageKey(kid.id) })
          : Promise.resolve(),
        kid
          ? qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['assignments', kid.id] })
          : Promise.resolve(),
        kid
          ? qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: personalBestsKeys.latestByKid(kid.id) })
          : Promise.resolve(),
        qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['products'] }),
        qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['leaderboard'] }),
      ]);
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [qc, user, kid]);

  const renderCoachVideo = () => {
    if (latestMessagePending) {
      return <CoachVideoCard variant="processing" />;
    }
    if (!latestMessage) {
      return <CoachVideoCard variant="empty" />;
    }
    const video = latestMessage.video;
    if (!video || video.status !== 'ready' || !video.muxPlaybackId) {
      return <CoachVideoCard variant="processing" />;
    }
    const coachName = latestMessage.coach
      ? `${latestMessage.coach.firstName} ${latestMessage.coach.lastName}`.trim()
      : 'Your coach';
    return (
      <CoachVideoCard
        variant="ready"
        coachName={coachName}
        thumbnail={muxPosterUrl(video.muxPlaybackId)}
        durationSeconds={video.durationSeconds ?? undefined}
        subtitle={formatRelativeTime(latestMessage.createdAt)}
        unread={!latestMessage.viewedAt}
        onPress={() =>
          navigation.navigate('VideoPlayback', { messageId: latestMessage.id })
        }
      />
    );
  };

  const handleAddAthlete = () => {
    navigation.navigate('AddKid', { fromMe: false });
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <HomeHeader
        kidFirstName={kid?.first_name ?? 'CHAMP'}
        multipleKids={kids.length > 1}
        onSwitchPress={() => setSwitcherVisible(true)}
      />
      <CoachMessageToast />
      <ScrollView
        style={styles.scroll}
        contentContainerStyle={[
          styles.scrollContent,
          { paddingBottom: tabBarHeight + spacing['4xl'] },
        ]}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={colors.gold}
            colors={[colors.gold]}
          />
        }
      >
        {kid ? (
          <>
            {membership?.payment_failed_at && !paymentAlertDismissed ? (
              <View style={styles.section}>
                <FailedPaymentCard
                  onPress={() =>
                    navigation.navigate('Me', {
                      screen: 'PaymentMethod',
                    })
                  }
                  onDismiss={() => setPaymentAlertDismissed(true)}
                />
              </View>
            ) : null}
            <View style={styles.section}>
              <HeroCard
                pointsBalance={kid.points_balance}
                nextRewardName={nextReward?.name ?? null}
                nextRewardCost={nextReward?.points_cost ?? null}
                onPress={() => navigation.navigate('Earn', { screen: 'EarnHome' })}
              />
            </View>
            <View style={styles.section}>
              <StatTilesRow
                currentStreakDays={kid.current_streak_days}
                rank={rank}
                exitVeloMph={exitVeloMph}
              />
            </View>
            <View style={styles.section}>{renderCoachVideo()}</View>
            <View style={styles.section}>
              <UpcomingSessionCard
                date={upcoming?.scheduledStart}
                durationMinutes={upcoming?.durationMinutes}
                coachName={upcoming?.coachName}
                location={upcoming?.locationName}
              />
            </View>
            {assignments && assignments.some((a) => a.status === 'pending') ? (
              <View style={styles.section}>
                <HomeAssignmentsCard
                  assignments={assignments}
                  onPress={() =>
                    navigation.navigate('Work', {
                      screen: 'WorkHome',
                      params: { initialSubTab: 'assign' },
                    })
                  }
                />
              </View>
            ) : null}
            <View style={styles.section}>
              <LatestPersonalBestCard
                pr={latestPr ?? null}
                onPress={
                  latestPr?.swing_id
                    ? () =>
                        navigation.navigate('Work', {
                          screen: 'SwingDetail',
                          params: { swingId: latestPr.swing_id as string },
                        })
                    : () =>
                        navigation.navigate('Work', {
                          screen: 'WorkHome',
                          params: { initialSubTab: 'swings' },
                        })
                }
              />
            </View>
          </>
        ) : showEmpty ? (
          <View style={styles.section}>
            <EmptyHomeCard onAddKid={() => navigation.navigate('AddKid')} />
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.loadingWrap}>
            <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
          </View>
        )}
      </ScrollView>

      <KidSwitcherSheet
        visible={switcherVisible}
        kids={kids}
        selectedKidId={selectedKidId}
        onSelect={setSelectedKid}
        onAddAthlete={handleAddAthlete}
        onClose={() => setSwitcherVisible(false)}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

/**
 * BookingDetailScreen — full info for a single booking + policy-aware cancel.
 *
 * Cancellation flow:
 *  1. User taps "Cancel booking"
 *  2. App calls cancel_booking RPC (no override) via useCancelBookingPolicy
 *  3a. { ok: true } → queries invalidated, navigate back
 *  3b. { code: 'LATE_CANCEL' } → bottom sheet shown with policy + fee
 *        "Go Back"       — dismiss, booking unchanged
 *        "Cancel Anyway" — re-calls RPC with override=true
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute, type RouteProp } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import type { FamilyBooking } from '@/api/bookings';
import { useBooking } from '@/hooks/useBooking';
import { useCancelBookingPolicy } from '@/hooks/useCancelBookingPolicy';
import type { MeStackParamList, MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

import StatusBadge from './components/StatusBadge';

type Nav = MeStackScreenProps<'BookingDetail'>['navigation'];

const WEEKDAYS = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'] as const;
const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
] as const;

function formatLongDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return `${WEEKDAYS[d.getDay()]}, ${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}`;
}

function formatTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const h24 = d.getHours();
  const m = d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const period = h24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h24 % 12;
  return `${h12}:${m} ${period}`;
}

function formatTimeRange(startISO: string, endISO: string): string {
  return `${formatTime(startISO)} – ${formatTime(endISO)}`;
}

function isCancellable(b: FamilyBooking): boolean {
  if (b.status !== 'confirmed' && b.status !== 'pending') return false;
  return new Date(b.scheduled_start).getTime() > Date.now();
}

function formatFeeDollars(cents: number): string {
  return `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
}

function Field({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.field}>
      <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>{label}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.fieldValue}>{value}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

type LateSheet = {
  window_hours: number;
  fee_cents: number;
  pendingReason?: string;
};

export default function BookingDetailScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const route = useRoute<RouteProp<MeStackParamList, 'BookingDetail'>>();
  const { bookingId } = route.params;

  const { data: booking, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useBooking(bookingId);
  const cancelMut = useCancelBookingPolicy();
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lateSheet, setLateSheet] = useState<LateSheet | null>(null);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const handleBack = () => {
      // If there is a screen before BookingDetail in the Me stack (e.g. the
      // user came from BookingsListScreen), go back to it normally.
      // Otherwise (cross-tab navigation from Home/Book), stay in the Me tab
      // and land on the main screen instead of jumping to another tab.
      const state = navigation.getState();
      if (state && state.index > 0) {
        navigation.goBack();
      } else {
        navigation.navigate('MeHome');
      }
    };

    navigation.setOptions({
      headerLeft: () => (
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleBack}
          hitSlop={12}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Go back"
          style={{ paddingRight: 8, justifyContent: 'center' }}
        >
          <ChevronLeft size={24} color={colors.gold} />
        </Pressable>
      ),
    });
  }, [navigation]);

  const cancellable = useMemo(() => (booking ? isCancellable(booking) : false), [booking]);

  const performCancel = (reason?: string, override = false) => {
    setSubmitError(null);
    cancelMut.mutate(
      { bookingId, reason, override },
      {
        onSuccess: (result) => {
          if ('ok' in result && result.ok) {
            navigation.goBack();
            return;
          }
          if ('code' in result && result.code === 'LATE_CANCEL') {
            setLateSheet({
              window_hours: (result as { window_hours: number }).window_hours,
              fee_cents: (result as { fee_cents: number }).fee_cents,
              pendingReason: reason,
            });
            return;
          }
          if ('code' in result) {
            setSubmitError((result as { message: string }).message);
          }
        },
        onError: (err) => setSubmitError(errorMessage(err)),
      },
    );
  };

  const handleCancelPress = () => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'ios' && typeof Alert.prompt === 'function') {
      Alert.prompt(
        'Reason (optional)',
        'Let your coach know why if you want.',
        [
          { text: 'Skip', style: 'cancel', onPress: () => performCancel() },
          { text: 'Send', onPress: (text?: string) => performCancel(text) },
        ],
        'plain-text',
      );
    } else {
      performCancel();
    }
  };

  const handleCancelAnyway = () => {
    const reason = lateSheet?.pendingReason;
    setLateSheet(null);
    performCancel(reason, true);
  };

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !booking) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Couldn&apos;t load booking</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorMessage}>
            {isError ? errorMessage(error) : 'This booking is no longer available.'}
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => refetch()} style={styles.retryBtn}>
            <Text style={styles.retryText}>Try again</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const kidName = booking.kid
    ? `${booking.kid.first_name} ${booking.kid.last_name}`.trim()
    : 'Unknown kid';
  const coachName = booking.coach
    ? `Coach ${booking.coach.first_name} ${booking.coach.last_name}`.trim()
    : 'Coach TBD';
  const locationName = booking.location?.name ?? 'Location TBD';
  const sessionLabel = booking.session_type
    ? `${booking.session_type.name} · ${booking.session_type.duration_minutes} min`
    : 'Session';

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>{sessionLabel}</Text>
          <StatusBadge status={booking.status} />
        </View>

        <Text style={styles.dateLine}>{formatLongDate(booking.scheduled_start)}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.timeLine}>
          {formatTimeRange(booking.scheduled_start, booking.scheduled_end)}
        </Text>

        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Field label="Athlete" value={kidName} />
          <Field label="Coach" value={coachName} />
          <Field label="Location" value={locationName} />
          {booking.cage_number != null ? (
            <Field label="Cage" value={`#${booking.cage_number}`} />
          ) : null}
          {booking.session_type?.type_category ? (
            <Field
              label="Type"
              value={
                booking.session_type.type_category.charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
                booking.session_type.type_category.slice(1)
              }
            />
          ) : null}
          {booking.notes ? <Field label="Notes" value={booking.notes} /> : null}
        </View>

        {booking.status === 'cancelled' ? (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <Field
              label="Cancelled"
              value={booking.cancelled_at ? formatLongDate(booking.cancelled_at) : '—'}
            />
            {booking.cancellation_reason ? (
              <Field label="Reason" value={booking.cancellation_reason} />
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {cancellable ? (
          <>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={handleCancelPress}
              style={[styles.cancelBtn, cancelMut.isPending && styles.cancelBtnDisabled]}
              disabled={cancelMut.isPending}
            >
              {cancelMut.isPending ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color={colors.danger} />
              ) : (
                <Text style={styles.cancelText}>Cancel booking</Text>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
            {submitError ? (
              <Text style={styles.inlineError}>{submitError}</Text>
            ) : null}
          </>
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Late cancellation warning bottom sheet */}
      <Modal
        visible={lateSheet !== null}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setLateSheet(null)}
      >
        <Pressable style={styles.sheetOverlay} onPress={() => setLateSheet(null)}>
          <Pressable style={styles.sheet} onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <View style={styles.sheetHandle} />
            <Text style={styles.sheetTitle}>Cancellation Policy</Text>
            <Text style={styles.sheetBody}>
              This booking is within the{' '}
              <Text style={styles.sheetEmphasis}>
                {lateSheet?.window_hours}-hour cancellation window
              </Text>
              .
              {lateSheet?.fee_cents && lateSheet.fee_cents > 0
                ? ` A late cancellation fee of ${formatFeeDollars(lateSheet.fee_cents)} may be collected at the front desk.`
                : ' No fee applies, but your coach has limited time to fill the slot.'}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.sheetSubtext}>
              You can go back and keep this booking, or cancel it anyway.
            </Text>
            <View style={styles.sheetActions}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.sheetBackBtn}
                onPress={() => setLateSheet(null)}
              >
                <Text style={styles.sheetBackText}>Go Back</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.sheetCancelBtn, cancelMut.isPending && styles.cancelBtnDisabled]}
                onPress={handleCancelAnyway}
                disabled={cancelMut.isPending}
              >
                {cancelMut.isPending ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color={colors.danger} size="small" />
                ) : (
                  <Text style={styles.sheetCancelText}>Cancel Anyway</Text>
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Modal>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

/**
 * BookingsListScreen — sectioned list of all bookings for the family's kids,
 * split into Upcoming (scheduled_start >= now) and Past (scheduled_start <
 * now or terminal status). Also shows active waitlist entries with a
 * "Waitlisted — #N in queue" badge. Pull-to-refresh re-runs all queries.
 * RLS scopes everything to the caller's tenant + own family.
 */

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  RefreshControl,
  SectionList,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import type { FamilyBooking } from '@/api/bookings';
import { useFamilyBookings } from '@/hooks/useFamilyBookings';
import { useWaitlistEntries, useLeaveWaitlist } from '@/hooks/useWaitlistEntries';
import type { WaitlistEntryRich } from '@/api/waitlist';
import type { MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

import StatusBadge from './components/StatusBadge';

type Nav = MeStackScreenProps<'BookingsList'>['navigation'];

const WEEKDAYS = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'] as const;
const MONTHS = [
  'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
  'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec',
] as const;

function formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const wk = WEEKDAYS[d.getDay()];
  const mo = MONTHS[d.getMonth()];
  const day = d.getDate();
  const h24 = d.getHours();
  const m = d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const period = h24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h24 % 12;
  return `${wk}, ${mo} ${day} · ${h12}:${m} ${period}`;
}

type Section =
  | { title: string; kind: 'bookings'; data: FamilyBooking[] }
  | { title: string; kind: 'waitlist'; data: WaitlistEntryRich[] };

function partitionBookings(bookings: FamilyBooking[]): {
  upcoming: FamilyBooking[];
  past: FamilyBooking[];
} {
  const now = Date.now();
  const upcoming: FamilyBooking[] = [];
  const past: FamilyBooking[] = [];
  for (const b of bookings) {
    const startMs = new Date(b.scheduled_start).getTime();
    const isTerminal =
      b.status === 'completed' || b.status === 'cancelled' || b.status === 'no_show';
    if (!isTerminal && startMs >= now) upcoming.push(b);
    else past.push(b);
  }
  upcoming.sort(
    (a, b) =>
      new Date(a.scheduled_start).getTime() - new Date(b.scheduled_start).getTime(),
  );
  past.sort(
    (a, b) =>
      new Date(b.scheduled_start).getTime() - new Date(a.scheduled_start).getTime(),
  );
  return { upcoming, past };
}

function WaitlistRow({
  entry,
  onLeave,
  onClaim,
}: {
  entry: WaitlistEntryRich;
  onLeave: () => void;
  onClaim: () => void;
}) {
  const kidName = entry.kid
    ? `${entry.kid.first_name} ${entry.kid.last_name}`.trim()
    : 'Unknown kid';
  const coachName = entry.coach
    ? `Coach ${entry.coach.first_name} ${entry.coach.last_name}`.trim()
    : 'Coach TBD';
  const locationName = entry.location?.name ?? 'Location TBD';
  const sessionName = entry.session_type?.name ?? 'Session';
  const isNotified = entry.status === 'notified';

  return (
    <View style={styles.waitlistRow}>
      <View style={styles.rowHeader}>
        <Text style={styles.kidName}>{kidName}</Text>
        <View style={[styles.waitlistBadge, isNotified && styles.waitlistBadgeNotified]}>
          <Text style={[styles.waitlistBadgeText, isNotified && styles.waitlistBadgeTextNotified]}>
            {isNotified ? '🎉 SPOT AVAILABLE' : `WAITLISTED — #${entry.position} IN QUEUE`}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <Text style={styles.dateTime}>{formatDateTime(entry.scheduled_start)}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.meta}>
        {sessionName} · {coachName} · {locationName}
      </Text>

      {isNotified && entry.claim_deadline ? (
        <Text style={styles.claimDeadlineText}>
          Claim within 2 hours · Offer expires soon
        </Text>
      ) : null}

      <View style={styles.waitlistActions}>
        {isNotified ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={onClaim}
            activeOpacity={0.7}
            style={styles.claimBtn}
          >
            <Text style={styles.claimBtnText}>Claim This Spot</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : null}
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={onLeave}
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          style={styles.leaveBtn}
        >
          <Text style={styles.leaveBtnText}>Leave Waitlist</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function BookingRow({
  booking,
  onPress,
}: {
  booking: FamilyBooking;
  onPress: () => void;
}) {
  const kidName = booking.kid
    ? `${booking.kid.first_name} ${booking.kid.last_name}`.trim()
    : 'Unknown kid';
  const coachName = booking.coach
    ? `Coach ${booking.coach.first_name} ${booking.coach.last_name}`.trim()
    : 'Coach TBD';
  const locationName = booking.location?.name ?? 'Location TBD';

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity onPress={onPress} activeOpacity={0.7} style={styles.row}>
      <View style={styles.rowHeader}>
        <Text style={styles.kidName}>{kidName}</Text>
        <StatusBadge status={booking.status} />
      </View>
      <Text style={styles.dateTime}>{formatDateTime(booking.scheduled_start)}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.meta}>
        {coachName} · {locationName}
      </Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

export default function BookingsListScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const bookingsQuery = useFamilyBookings();
  const waitlistQuery = useWaitlistEntries();
  const leaveWaitlist = useLeaveWaitlist();
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const { upcoming, past } = useMemo(
    () => partitionBookings(bookingsQuery.data ?? []),
    [bookingsQuery.data],
  );

  const sections = useMemo<Section[]>(() => {
    const waitlistEntries = waitlistQuery.data ?? [];
    const out: Section[] = [];
    if (waitlistEntries.length > 0) {
      out.push({ title: 'On Waitlist', kind: 'waitlist', data: waitlistEntries });
    }
    if (upcoming.length > 0) out.push({ title: 'Upcoming', kind: 'bookings', data: upcoming });
    if (past.length > 0) out.push({ title: 'Past', kind: 'bookings', data: past });
    return out;
  }, [waitlistQuery.data, upcoming, past]);

  const onRefresh = async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      await Promise.all([bookingsQuery.refetch(), waitlistQuery.refetch()]);
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLeaveWaitlist = (entry: WaitlistEntryRich) => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Leave Waitlist',
      'Remove yourself from the waitlist for this session?',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Leave',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: () => {
            leaveWaitlist.mutate(entry.id, {
              onError: (err) => {
                Alert.alert('Error', errorMessage(err));
              },
            });
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  };

  const handleClaimSpot = (entry: WaitlistEntryRich) => {
    navigation.navigate('WaitlistClaim', { waitlistId: entry.id });
  };

  const isPending = bookingsQuery.isPending && waitlistQuery.isPending;
  const isError = bookingsQuery.isError;

  const refreshControl = (
    <RefreshControl
      refreshing={refreshing || bookingsQuery.isRefetching || waitlistQuery.isRefetching}
      onRefresh={onRefresh}
      tintColor={colors.gold}
      colors={[colors.gold]}
    />
  );

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Couldn&apos;t load bookings</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorMessage}>
            {bookingsQuery.error instanceof Error ? bookingsQuery.error.message : 'Unknown error'}
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={onRefresh} style={styles.retryBtn}>
            <Text style={styles.retryText}>Try again</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (sections.length === 0) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <SectionList
          sections={[]}
          keyExtractor={(item) => (item as FamilyBooking).id}
          renderItem={() => null}
          refreshControl={refreshControl}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.emptyContent}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.emptyBox}>
              <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>No bookings yet</Text>
              <Text style={styles.emptyMessage}>Book your first session!</Text>
            </View>
          }
        />
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <SectionList
        sections={sections}
        keyExtractor={(item) => (item as FamilyBooking | WaitlistEntryRich).id}
        renderItem={({ item, section }) => {
          if (section.kind === 'waitlist') {
            const entry = item as WaitlistEntryRich;
            return (
              <WaitlistRow
                entry={entry}
                onLeave={() => handleLeaveWaitlist(entry)}
                onClaim={() => handleClaimSpot(entry)}
              />
            );
          }
          const booking = item as FamilyBooking;
          return (
            <BookingRow
              booking={booking}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('BookingDetail', { bookingId: booking.id })}
            />
          );
        }}
        renderSectionHeader={({ section }) => (
          <Text style={styles.sectionHeader}>{section.title}</Text>
        )}
        stickySectionHeadersEnabled={false}
        refreshControl={refreshControl}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

/**
 * CancelMembershipScreen — shows the computed effective cancel date BEFORE
 * the parent confirms, so they know exactly when billing stops.
 *
 * Effective date = MAX(today + notice_days, next_billing_at)
 * This mirrors the SQL logic in cancel_membership() exactly.
 *
 * The RPC then sets cancel_requested_at + cancel_effective_at (≥ notice_days
 * from now) without immediately cancelling the Stripe subscription.
 * The actual cancellation happens via the daily pg_cron job that invokes
 * process-membership-cancellations when cancel_effective_at <= NOW().
 */

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { cancelMembershipRpc, type CancelMembershipResult } from '@/api/bookings';
import { getTenantConfig } from '@/api/tenantConfig';
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
] as const;

function formatDate(iso: string | Date): string {
  const d = typeof iso === 'string' ? new Date(iso) : iso;
  return `${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

/**
 * Compute the expected effective cancellation date client-side.
 * Mirrors: GREATEST(now() + notice_days, COALESCE(next_billing_at, now() + notice_days))
 */
function computeEffectiveDate(noticeDays: number, nextBillingAt: string | null): Date {
  const fromNotice = new Date();
  fromNotice.setDate(fromNotice.getDate() + noticeDays);

  if (!nextBillingAt) return fromNotice;
  const billing = new Date(nextBillingAt);
  return billing > fromNotice ? billing : fromNotice;
}

type Membership = {
  id: string;
  plan_name: string;
  plan_type: string;
  status: string;
  billing_anchor_day: number | null;
  cancel_requested_at: string | null;
  cancel_effective_at: string | null;
};

export default function CancelMembershipScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();

  const [membership, setMembership] = useState<Membership | null>(null);
  const [noticeDays, setNoticeDays] = useState<number>(30);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState<{ cancel_effective_at: string } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [membershipResult, config] = await Promise.all([
          (supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient)
            .from('memberships')
            .select(
              'id, plan_name, plan_type, status, billing_anchor_day, cancel_requested_at, cancel_effective_at',
            )
            .eq('status', 'active')
            .maybeSingle(),
          getTenantConfig().catch(() => null),
        ]);

        if (membershipResult.error) throw membershipResult.error;
        setMembership(membershipResult.data as Membership | null);

        if (config?.membership_cancel_notice_days) {
          setNoticeDays(config.membership_cancel_notice_days);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        setLoadError(errorMessage(err));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, []);

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (!membership) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitError(null);
    try {
      const result: CancelMembershipResult = await cancelMembershipRpc(membership.id);
      if ('ok' in result && result.ok) {
        setDone({ cancel_effective_at: result.cancel_effective_at });
        return;
      }
      if ('code' in result) {
        if (result.code === 'ALREADY_REQUESTED' && result.cancel_effective_at) {
          setDone({ cancel_effective_at: result.cancel_effective_at });
          return;
        }
        setSubmitError(result.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setSubmitError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Couldn&apos;t load membership</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorBody}>{loadError}</Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (!membership) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>No active membership</Text>
          <Text style={styles.body}>
            You don&apos;t have an active recurring membership to cancel. Contact staff if
            you need help.
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.backBtn} onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}>
            <Text style={styles.backBtnText}>Go Back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (done) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
          <View style={styles.successIcon}>
            <Text style={styles.successEmoji}>✓</Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.title}>Cancellation Requested</Text>
          <Text style={styles.body}>
            Your membership is scheduled to cancel on{' '}
            <Text style={styles.emphasis}>{formatDate(done.cancel_effective_at)}</Text>.
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.bodyMuted}>
            You&apos;ll keep full access and billing will continue until that date. No
            further action is required.
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.backBtn} onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}>
            <Text style={styles.backBtnText}>Done</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const alreadyRequested =
    membership.cancel_requested_at !== null && membership.cancel_effective_at !== null;

  // Compute the effective date to show BEFORE the parent confirms.
  // If already requested, use the stored value; otherwise compute it.
  const effectiveDate = alreadyRequested && membership.cancel_effective_at
    ? new Date(membership.cancel_effective_at)
    : computeEffectiveDate(noticeDays, null);

  const effectiveDateStr = formatDate(effectiveDate);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>Cancel Membership</Text>

        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.cardRow}>
            <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>Plan</Text>
            <Text style={styles.cardValue}>{membership.plan_name}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.cardRow}>
            <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>Type</Text>
            <Text style={styles.cardValue}>
              {membership.plan_type === 'eft' ? 'Monthly EFT' : membership.plan_type.toUpperCase()}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.cardRow, styles.cardRowLast]}>
            <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>Cancels on</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.cardValue, styles.emphasisValue]}>
              {effectiveDateStr}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {alreadyRequested ? (
          <View style={styles.infoBox}>
            <Text style={styles.infoBoxText}>
              You&apos;ve already requested a cancellation. Your membership stays active
              and billing continues until{' '}
              <Text style={styles.emphasis}>{effectiveDateStr}</Text>.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <>
            <View style={styles.warningBox}>
              <Text style={styles.warningTitle}>Before you cancel</Text>
              <Text style={styles.warningBody}>
                You&apos;ll be charged until{' '}
                <Text style={styles.emphasisDanger}>{effectiveDateStr}</Text>
                {` — ${noticeDays} days from today.`}
                {'\n\n'}
                Your access remains active until that date.
              </Text>
            </View>

            {submitError ? (
              <Text style={styles.inlineError}>{submitError}</Text>
            ) : null}

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.confirmBtn, submitting && styles.confirmBtnDisabled]}
              onPress={() => void handleConfirm()}
              disabled={submitting}
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color={colors.danger} />
              ) : (
                <Text style={styles.confirmText}>Confirm Cancellation</Text>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.backBtn} onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}>
          <Text style={styles.backBtnText}>
            {alreadyRequested ? 'Done' : 'Keep Membership'}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  content: {
    padding: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'],
  },
  centered: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: spacing['4xl'],
  },

  successIcon: {
    width: 72,
    height: 72,

  },
  successEmoji: {

  title: {

import { StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Props = { status: string };

type BadgeStyle = { bg: string; fg: string; label: string };

function styleForStatus(status: string): BadgeStyle {
  switch (status) {
    case 'confirmed':
      return { bg: colors.successBg, fg: colors.success, label: 'Confirmed' };
    case 'completed':
      return { bg: colors.infoBg, fg: colors.info, label: 'Completed' };
    case 'cancelled':
      return { bg: colors.dangerBg, fg: colors.danger, label: 'Cancelled' };
    case 'pending':
      return { bg: colors.warningBg, fg: colors.warning, label: 'Pending' };
    case 'no_show':
      return { bg: colors.dangerBg, fg: colors.danger, label: 'No-show' };
    default:
      return { bg: colors.border, fg: colors.textLight, label: status };
  }
}

export default function StatusBadge({ status }: Props) {
  const s = styleForStatus(status);
  return (
    <View style={[styles.badge, { backgroundColor: s.bg }]}>
      <Text style={[styles.text, { color: s.fg }]}>{s.label}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  badge: {
    alignSelf: 'flex-start',
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    paddingVertical: spacing.xs,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
  },
  text: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
  },
});

/**
 * ConnectHitTraxScreen — Me-tab entry to link or unlink the family kid's
 * HitTrax account.
 *
 * Two ways to connect an existing HitTrax account:
 *   A. Password  — enter username + password (used once server-side, never stored)
 *   B. SMS code  — enter username → HitTrax texts a code → enter code
 *      (requires a phone number registered in HitTrax)
 *
 * Both paths go directly to 'active' — no email confirmation, no waiting.
 *
 * States:
 *   no link / removed / declined  → connect form (method picker)
 *   active                        → connected card + Disconnect button
 *   pending (v1.x legacy)         → "older link" card + Cancel and re-link
 */

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { Button, Input } from '@/components/ui';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import type { MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import {
  useAssociateHitTrax,
  useAssociateHitTraxWithOTP,
  useDisconnectHitTrax,
  useHitTraxLink,
  useTriggerHitTraxOTP,
} from '@/hooks/useHitTraxLink';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type AuthMethod = 'password' | 'otp';
type ConnectStep = 'choose' | 'otp_pending';

function formatRelative(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return 'never';
  const t = Date.parse(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(t)) return 'never';
  const secs = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - t) / 1000));
  if (secs < 60) return `${secs}s ago`;
  if (secs < 3600) return `${Math.floor(secs / 60)}m ago`;
  if (secs < 86400) return `${Math.floor(secs / 3600)}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(secs / 86400)}d ago`;
}

export default function ConnectHitTraxScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<MeStackScreenProps<'ConnectHitTrax'>['navigation']>();
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  const { data: link, isPending } = useHitTraxLink(kid?.id);
  const associate = useAssociateHitTrax(kid?.id);
  const triggerOTP = useTriggerHitTraxOTP(kid?.id);
  const associateWithOTP = useAssociateHitTraxWithOTP(kid?.id);
  const disconnect = useDisconnectHitTrax(kid?.id);

  const [authMethod, setAuthMethod] = useState<AuthMethod>('password');
  const [connectStep, setConnectStep] = useState<ConnectStep>('choose');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState('');

  const resetForm = () => {
    setUsername('');
    setPassword('');
    setOtpCode('');
    setConnectStep('choose');
    setAuthMethod('password');
  };

  const onConnect = async () => {
    if (!username.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Username required', 'Enter the HitTrax username for this athlete.');
      return;
    }
    if (!password) {
      Alert.alert('Password required', 'Enter your HitTrax password.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await associate.mutateAsync({ hittraxUsername: username.trim(), hittraxPassword: password });
      resetForm();
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Connect failed', errorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  const onSendCode = async () => {
    if (!username.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Username required', 'Enter your HitTrax username so we know where to send the code.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await triggerOTP.mutateAsync({ hittraxUsername: username.trim() });
      setConnectStep('otp_pending');
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not send code', errorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  const onVerifyOTP = async () => {
    if (!otpCode.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Code required', 'Enter the code texted to your phone.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await associateWithOTP.mutateAsync({ hittraxUsername: username.trim(), otpCode: otpCode.trim() });
      resetForm();
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Verification failed', errorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  const onBackFromOTP = () => {
    setConnectStep('choose');
    setOtpCode('');
  };

  const onDisconnect = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Disconnect HitTrax?',
      "We'll stop pulling new swing data. Past sessions remain in your history.",
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Disconnect',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: async () => {
            try {
              await disconnect.mutateAsync();
            } catch (err) {
              Alert.alert('Disconnect failed', errorMessage(err));
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  };

  const showConnectForm =
    !link ||
    link.association_status === 'removed' ||
    link.association_status === 'declined';

  const isConnecting =
    associate.isPending || triggerOTP.isPending || associateWithOTP.isPending;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.container} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
        <Text style={styles.title}>HitTrax</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          Link your athlete&apos;s HitTrax account and every cage swing syncs into
          Ballpark within ~5 minutes of a session ending.
        </Text>

        {!kid ? (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>No kid added yet</Text>
            <Text style={styles.cardValue}>Add your kid first to link a HitTrax account.</Text>
          </View>

        ) : isPending ? (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <Text style={styles.cardValue}>Loading…</Text>
          </View>

        ) : link?.association_status === 'active' ? (
          <View>
            <View style={styles.card}>
              <View style={styles.connectedBadge}>
                <Text style={styles.connectedBadgeText}>● CONNECTED</Text>
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>HitTrax username</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardValue}>{link.external_user_id ?? '—'}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>Last sync</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardValue}>
                {formatRelative(link.last_polled_at)}
                {link.last_poll_error ? ` — ${link.last_poll_error}` : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
            {kid ? (
              <Button
                label="📷  Scan at Kiosk"
                onPress={() => navigation.navigate('KioskScan', { kidId: kid.id })}
              />
            ) : null}
            <View style={styles.disconnectRow}>
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                tone="danger"
                label="Disconnect"
                onPress={onDisconnect}
                loading={disconnect.isPending}
              />
            </View>
          </View>

        ) : link?.association_status === 'pending' ? (
          <View>
            <View style={styles.card}>
              <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>Older link — action needed</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardValue}>
                This link was created under an older version of the HitTrax
                integration. Tap &quot;Cancel and re-link&quot; below to switch to the
                new instant-connect flow — it only takes a few seconds.
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              tone="danger"
              label="Cancel and re-link"
              onPress={onDisconnect}
              loading={disconnect.isPending}
            />
          </View>

        ) : showConnectForm ? (
          <View>
            {link?.association_status === 'declined' ? (
              <View style={[styles.card, styles.cardWarning]}>
                <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>Previous attempt declined</Text>
                <Text style={styles.cardValue}>
                  Enter your HitTrax credentials below to try again.
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {connectStep === 'choose' ? (
              <View>
                <Input
                  label="HitTrax Username"
                  placeholder="Your HitTrax username"
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  keyboardType="email-address"
                  value={username}
                  onChangeText={setUsername}
                  testID="connect-hittrax-username"
                />

                <Text style={styles.methodLabel}>How would you like to verify?</Text>
                <View style={styles.methodPicker}>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.methodTab, authMethod === 'password' && styles.methodTabActive]}
                    onPress={() => setAuthMethod('password')}
                    activeOpacity={0.75}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.methodTabText, authMethod === 'password' && styles.methodTabTextActive]}>
                      My password
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.methodTab, authMethod === 'otp' && styles.methodTabActive]}
                    onPress={() => setAuthMethod('otp')}
                    activeOpacity={0.75}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.methodTabText, authMethod === 'otp' && styles.methodTabTextActive]}>
                      Text me a code
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>

                {authMethod === 'password' ? (
                  <View>
                    <View style={styles.passwordRow}>
                      <View style={styles.passwordInput}>
                        <Input
                          label="HitTrax Password"
                          placeholder="Your HitTrax password"
                          secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
                          autoCapitalize="none"
                          autoCorrect={false}
                          value={password}
                          onChangeText={setPassword}
                          testID="connect-hittrax-password"
                        />
                      </View>
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        style={styles.showHide}
                        onPress={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
                        hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
                      >
                        <Text style={styles.showHideText}>{showPassword ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}</Text>
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                    <Text style={styles.note}>
                      Your password is used once to verify with HitTrax — it is never stored by Ballpark.
                    </Text>
                    <Button
                      label="Connect HitTrax"
                      onPress={onConnect}
                      loading={associate.isPending}
                      testID="connect-hittrax-submit"
                    />
                  </View>
                ) : (
                  <View>
                    <Text style={styles.note}>
                      HitTrax will text a verification code to the phone number registered on your account. No password needed.
                    </Text>
                    <Button
                      label="Send Code to My Phone"
                      onPress={onSendCode}
                      loading={triggerOTP.isPending}
                      testID="connect-hittrax-send-otp"
                    />
                  </View>
                )}
              </View>

            ) : (
              <View>
                <View style={styles.card}>
                  <Text style={styles.connectedBadgeText}>📱 CODE SENT</Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.cardLabel, { marginTop: spacing.lg }]}>Username</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.cardValue}>{username}</Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.cardLabel, { marginTop: spacing.lg }]}>
                    Check your phone
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.cardValue}>
                    HitTrax texted a verification code to the phone number on your account. Codes expire after 10 minutes.
                  </Text>
                </View>

                <Input
                  label="Verification Code"
                  placeholder="Enter the code from your text"
                  keyboardType="number-pad"
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  value={otpCode}
                  onChangeText={setOtpCode}
                  testID="connect-hittrax-otp-code"
                />

                <View style={styles.otpActions}>
                  <Button
                    label="Verify & Connect"
                    onPress={onVerifyOTP}
                    loading={associateWithOTP.isPending}
                    testID="connect-hittrax-verify-otp"
                  />
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={styles.backLink}
                    onPress={onBackFromOTP}
                    disabled={isConnecting}
                    hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 16, right: 16 }}
                  >
                    <Text style={styles.backLinkText}>← Back</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </View>
            )}

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.createHint}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('CreateHitTraxAccount')}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
            >
              <Text style={styles.createHintText}>
                Don&apos;t have a HitTrax account?{' '}
                <Text style={styles.createHintLink}>Create one in-app →</Text>
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
