/**
 * CreateHitTraxAccountScreen — create a new HitTrax Cloud account in-app.
 *
 * Three-step flow:
 *   Step 1 — Choose a username (with live availability check)
 *   Step 2 — Set a password
 *   Step 3 — Sport details (sport, skill level, gender, position, bats, throws)
 *
 * On success the link is immediately 'active' — no separate association step.
 * Available from:
 *   • Me → HitTrax → "Create one in-app" (MeStack)
 *   • Onboarding → ConnectHitTrax → "Create one in-app" (HomeStack)
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { Button, Input, PickerField } from '@/components/ui';
import { useCreateHitTraxAccount } from '@/hooks/useHitTraxLink';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { useIsFetching } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { checkHitTraxUsernameAvailable } from '@/api/hittrax';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Step = 1 | 2 | 3;

type UsernameStatus = 'idle' | 'checking' | 'available' | 'taken' | 'error';

const ALPHANUMERIC_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/;

const SPORT_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'Baseball' as const, label: 'Baseball' },
  { value: 'Fastpitch Softball' as const, label: 'Fastpitch' },
  { value: 'Slowpitch Softball' as const, label: 'Slowpitch' },
] as const;

const SKILL_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'Youth', label: 'Youth' },
  { value: 'High School', label: 'High School' },
  { value: 'College', label: 'College' },
  { value: 'Adult', label: 'Adult' },
];

const GENDER_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'male' as const, label: 'Male' },
  { value: 'female' as const, label: 'Female' },
  { value: 'other' as const, label: 'Other' },
] as const;

const BATS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'Right' as const, label: 'Right' },
  { value: 'Left' as const, label: 'Left' },
  { value: 'Switch' as const, label: 'Switch' },
] as const;

const THROWS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'Right' as const, label: 'Right' },
  { value: 'Left' as const, label: 'Left' },
] as const;

export default function CreateHitTraxAccountScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  // route params — kidId is provided from the onboarding path
  const route = useRoute<{ key: string; name: string; params?: { kidId?: string } }>();
  const routeKidId = route.params?.kidId;

  const { kid: selectedKid } = useSelectedKid();
  const { kids } = useFamily();
  const isFetchingFamily = useIsFetching({ queryKey: ['family'] }) > 0;

  // When a specific kid was requested via route params, we ONLY use that kid.
  // Never fall back to selectedKid — that could silently create an account for
  // the wrong athlete if family data hasn't loaded yet.
  const kid = routeKidId
    ? kids.find((k) => k.id === routeKidId)
    : selectedKid;

  // If routeKidId was provided but the kid hasn't appeared in family data yet,
  // block the form until it resolves.
  const kidPending = Boolean(routeKidId && !kid && isFetchingFamily);

  const createAccount = useCreateHitTraxAccount(kid?.id);

  // Step state
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>(1);

  // Step 1: Username
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [usernameStatus, setUsernameStatus] = useState<UsernameStatus>('idle');
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // Step 2: Password
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  // Step 3: Sport details
  const [sport, setSport] = useState<'Baseball' | 'Fastpitch Softball' | 'Slowpitch Softball' | null>('Baseball');
  const [skillLevel, setSkillLevel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [gender, setGender] = useState<'male' | 'female' | 'other' | null>(null);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(kid?.primary_position ?? '');
  const [bats, setBats] = useState<'Right' | 'Left' | 'Switch' | null>(null);
  const [throws_, setThrows] = useState<'Right' | 'Left' | null>(null);

  // Keep position in sync when kid loads
  useEffect(() => {
    if (kid?.primary_position && !position) {
      setPosition(kid.primary_position);
    }
  }, [kid?.primary_position]);

  // Debounced username check
  const checkUsername = useCallback((value: string) => {
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setUsernameStatus('idle');
      return;
    }
    setUsernameStatus('checking');
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const available = await checkHitTraxUsernameAvailable(trimmed);
        setUsernameStatus(available ? 'available' : 'taken');
      } catch {
        setUsernameStatus('error');
      }
    }, 600);
  }, []);

  const onUsernameChange = (value: string) => {
    setUsername(value);
    setUsernameStatus('idle');
    checkUsername(value);
  };

  // Step 1 → 2
  const onNextFromStep1 = () => {
    if (!username.trim()) {
      Alert.alert('Username required', 'Enter a HitTrax username.');
      return;
    }
    if (usernameStatus !== 'available') {
      Alert.alert('Check username', 'Please wait for the availability check or choose a different username.');
      return;
    }
    setStep(2);
  };

  // Step 2 → 3
  const onNextFromStep2 = () => {
    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
      Alert.alert('Password too short', 'Password must be at least 8 characters.');
      return;
    }
    if (!ALPHANUMERIC_RE.test(password)) {
      Alert.alert('Invalid characters', 'Password must contain letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols.');
      return;
    }
    setStep(3);
  };

  // Step 3 → Create
  const onCreateAccount = async () => {
    if (!sport) { Alert.alert('Sport required', 'Please select a sport.'); return; }
    if (!skillLevel) { Alert.alert('Skill level required', 'Please select a skill level.'); return; }
    if (!gender) { Alert.alert('Gender required', 'Please select a gender.'); return; }
    if (!kid) { Alert.alert('No athlete found', 'Add an athlete first.'); return; }

    try {
      await createAccount.mutateAsync({
        hittraxUsername: username.trim(),
        password,
        sport,
        skillLevel,
        gender,
        position: position.trim() || undefined,
        bats: bats ?? undefined,
        throws: throws_ ?? undefined,
      });
      navigation.goBack();
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Account creation failed', errorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  const onBack = () => {
    if (step === 1) {
      navigation.goBack();
    } else {
      setStep((s) => (s - 1) as Step);
    }
  };

  const stepLabel = `Step ${step} of 3`;

  // Block the form until the specific kid is confirmed in family data.
  if (kidPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.loadingCenter}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={styles.container}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={onBack} hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}>
              <Text style={styles.backText}>← Back</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.stepIndicator}>{stepLabel}</Text>
          </View>

          <Text style={styles.title}>Create HitTrax Account</Text>
          {kid ? (
            <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
              Creating account for{' '}
              <Text style={styles.kidName}>{kid.first_name} {kid.last_name}</Text>
            </Text>
          ) : (
            <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
              Set up a HitTrax account to auto-import cage swings into Ballpark.
            </Text>
          )}

          {/* ─── Step 1: Username ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
          {step === 1 && (
            <View style={styles.stepContent}>
              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Choose a username</Text>
              <Text style={styles.sectionNote}>
                This will be your athlete&apos;s HitTrax username. Pick something simple to remember.
              </Text>

              <Input
                label="HitTrax Username"
                placeholder="e.g. jsmith_hitting"
                autoCapitalize="none"
                autoCorrect={false}
                keyboardType="email-address"
                value={username}
                onChangeText={onUsernameChange}
                testID="create-hittrax-username"
              />

              <View style={styles.availabilityRow}>
                {usernameStatus === 'checking' && (
                  <View style={styles.availabilityInner}>
                    <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.gold} />
                    <Text style={styles.checkingText}>Checking availability…</Text>
                  </View>
                )}
                {usernameStatus === 'available' && (
                  <Text style={styles.availableText}>✓ Username is available</Text>
                )}
                {usernameStatus === 'taken' && (
                  <Text style={styles.takenText}>✗ Username is already taken</Text>
                )}
                {usernameStatus === 'error' && (
                  <Text style={styles.takenText}>Could not check — try again</Text>
                )}
              </View>

              <Text style={styles.fieldNote}>
                Letters, numbers, underscores and periods only. You can change this later on hittraxbaseball.com.
              </Text>

              <View style={styles.actions}>
                <Button
                  label="Next: Set Password"
                  onPress={onNextFromStep1}
                  disabled={usernameStatus !== 'available'}
                  testID="create-hittrax-next-1"
                />
              </View>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* ─── Step 2: Password ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
          {step === 2 && (
            <View style={styles.stepContent}>
              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Set a password</Text>
              <Text style={styles.sectionNote}>
                Letters and numbers only, minimum 8 characters. Used to log into HitTrax kiosks.
              </Text>

              <View style={styles.passwordRow}>
                <View style={styles.passwordInput}>
                  <Input
                    label="Password"
                    placeholder="Letters and numbers only"
                    secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
                    autoCapitalize="none"
                    autoCorrect={false}
                    value={password}
                    onChangeText={setPassword}
                    testID="create-hittrax-password"
                  />
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.showHide}
                  onPress={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
                  hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.showHideText}>{showPassword ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              {password.length > 0 && password.length < 8 && (
                <Text style={styles.takenText}>
                  {8 - password.length} more character{8 - password.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} needed
                </Text>
              )}
              {password.length >= 8 && !ALPHANUMERIC_RE.test(password) && (
                <Text style={styles.takenText}>
                  Letters and numbers only — remove spaces or symbols
                </Text>
              )}

              <View style={[styles.actions, { marginTop: spacing['3xl'] }]}>
                <Button
                  label="Next: Sport Details"
                  onPress={onNextFromStep2}
                  disabled={password.length < 8 || !ALPHANUMERIC_RE.test(password)}
                  testID="create-hittrax-next-2"
                />
              </View>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* ─── Step 3: Sport details ────────────────────────────────── */}
          {step === 3 && (
            <View style={styles.stepContent}>
              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Sport details</Text>
              <Text style={styles.sectionNote}>
                Help HitTrax calibrate benchmarks for this athlete.
              </Text>

              <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Sport *</Text>
              <PickerField
                options={SPORT_OPTIONS}
                value={sport}
                onChange={(v) => setSport(v as typeof sport)}
                mode="chips"
                allowClear={false}
                testID="create-hittrax-sport"
              />

              <Text style={[styles.fieldLabel, { marginTop: spacing['2xl'] }]}>Skill Level *</Text>
              <PickerField
                options={SKILL_OPTIONS}
                value={skillLevel}
                onChange={(v) => setSkillLevel(v as string | null)}
                mode="chips"
                allowClear={false}
                testID="create-hittrax-skill-level"
              />

              <Text style={[styles.fieldLabel, { marginTop: spacing['2xl'] }]}>Gender *</Text>
              <PickerField
                options={GENDER_OPTIONS}
                value={gender}
                onChange={(v) => setGender(v as typeof gender)}
                mode="chips"
                allowClear={false}
                testID="create-hittrax-gender"
              />

              <View style={{ marginTop: spacing['2xl'] }}>
                <Input
                  label="Position (optional)"
                  placeholder="e.g. SS, 1B, OF"
                  autoCapitalize="characters"
                  autoCorrect={false}
                  value={position}
                  onChangeText={setPosition}
                  testID="create-hittrax-position"
                />
              </View>

              <Text style={[styles.fieldLabel, { marginTop: spacing['2xl'] }]}>Bats (optional)</Text>
              <PickerField
                options={BATS_OPTIONS}
                value={bats}
                onChange={(v) => setBats(v as typeof bats)}
                mode="chips"
                testID="create-hittrax-bats"
              />

              <Text style={[styles.fieldLabel, { marginTop: spacing['2xl'] }]}>Throws (optional)</Text>
              <PickerField
                options={THROWS_OPTIONS}
                value={throws_}
                onChange={(v) => setThrows(v as typeof throws_)}
                mode="chips"
                testID="create-hittrax-throws"
              />

              <View style={[styles.actions, { marginTop: spacing['4xl'] }]}>
                <Button
                  label="Create Account"
                  onPress={onCreateAccount}
                  loading={createAccount.isPending}
                  testID="create-hittrax-submit"
                />
              </View>

              <Text style={styles.coppaNote}>
                If your athlete is under 13, HitTrax will send a parental consent email to your registered address before activating the account.
              </Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Controller, useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import {
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { z } from 'zod';

import { Button, Input, PickerField, type PickerOption } from '@/components/ui';
import { AGE_GROUPS, type AgeGroup } from '@/constants/kid';
import { useFamily, useEditKid } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import type { MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

const editKidSchema = z.object({
  firstName: z.string().min(1, 'First name is required'),
  lastName: z.string().optional(),
  ageGroup: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  position: z.string().optional(),
  jerseyNumber: z.string().optional(),
});

type FormValues = z.infer<typeof editKidSchema>;

const AGE_GROUP_OPTIONS: ReadonlyArray<PickerOption<AgeGroup>> = AGE_GROUPS.map((g) => ({
  value: g,
  label: g,
}));

type Props = MeStackScreenProps<'EditKid'>;

export default function EditKidScreen({ route, navigation }: Props) {
  const { kidId } = route.params;
  const { kids } = useFamily();
  const editKid = useEditKid();

  const kid = useMemo(() => kids.find((k) => k.id === kidId) ?? null, [kids, kidId]);

  const { control, handleSubmit, formState, reset } = useForm<FormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(editKidSchema),
    mode: 'onBlur',
    reValidateMode: 'onChange',
    defaultValues: {
      firstName: '',
      lastName: '',
      ageGroup: null,
      position: '',
      jerseyNumber: '',
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (kid) {
      reset({
        firstName: kid.first_name ?? '',
        lastName: kid.last_name ?? '',
        ageGroup: kid.age_group ?? null,
        position: kid.primary_position ?? '',
        jerseyNumber: kid.jersey_number != null ? String(kid.jersey_number) : '',
      });
    }
  }, [kid, reset]);

  const submitting = formState.isSubmitting;

  const onSubmit = handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    try {
      const jerseyNum =
        values.jerseyNumber && values.jerseyNumber.trim() !== ''
          ? Number(values.jerseyNumber)
          : null;
      await editKid({
        kidId,
        first_name: values.firstName,
        last_name: values.lastName ?? null,
        age_group: values.ageGroup ?? null,
        primary_position: values.position ?? null,
        jersey_number: Number.isNaN(jerseyNum) ? null : jerseyNum,
      });
      navigation.goBack();
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not save changes', errorMessage(err));
    }
  });

  if (!kid) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.missing}>Athlete not found.</Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.container} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
          <Text style={styles.title}>Edit athlete</Text>

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="firstName"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="First name"
                value={field.value}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="words"
                required
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="lastName"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Last name"
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="words"
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="ageGroup"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <PickerField<AgeGroup>
                label="Age group (optional)"
                options={AGE_GROUP_OPTIONS}
                value={field.value as AgeGroup | null}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                allowClear
                disabled={submitting}
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="position"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Primary position (optional)"
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                autoCapitalize="words"
                placeholder="e.g. Shortstop"
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Controller
            control={control}
            name="jerseyNumber"
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <Input
                label="Jersey number (optional)"
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChangeText={field.onChange}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
                keyboardType="number-pad"
                placeholder="e.g. 7"
                error={fieldState.error?.message}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Button
            label="Save changes"
            onPress={onSubmit}
            loading={submitting}
            disabled={submitting}
            testID="editkid-submit"
          />
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  flex: { flex: 1 },
  centered: { flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  missing: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
    color: colors.textMuted,
  },
  container: { padding: spacing['4xl'], paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'] },
  title: {
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['3xl'],
    marginBottom: spacing['4xl'],
  },
});

FILE: src/screens/Me/KioskScanScreen.tsx

/**
 * KioskScanScreen — parent scans the HitTrax kiosk QR code to auto-login at
 * the cage.
 *
 * Flow:
 *   1. Camera permission prompt.
 *   2. Live viewfinder — scan a QR code.
 *   3. Client-side validation: must look like a HitTrax kiosk URL.
 *   4. Edge function call (hittrax-kiosk-event).
 *   5. Success card with event-specific message.
 *   6. Error card with retry.
 */

import * as Linking from 'expo-linking';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { CheckCircle2, QrCode, X } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import { useKioskEvent } from '@/hooks/useHitTraxLink';
import type { MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Props = MeStackScreenProps<'KioskScan'>;

type ScreenState =
  | { kind: 'scanning' }
  | { kind: 'loading' }
  | { kind: 'success'; eventType: string }
  | { kind: 'error'; message: string };

const FRAME_SIZE = 240;

/** Check whether the raw QR value looks like a HitTrax kiosk event URL. */
function isHitTraxKioskUrl(raw: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(raw);
    if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
    // The kiosk URL must call the NotifyKioskOfUserEvent endpoint
    return url.pathname.toLowerCase().includes('notifykioskofuserevent');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** Map raw event_type strings from the edge function to a display label. */
function eventLabel(eventType: string): string {
  const t = eventType.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  if (t.includes('autologin') || t.includes('login')) return "You're signed in at the kiosk";
  if (t.includes('joinroster') || t.includes('roster')) return 'Added to session roster';
  if (t.includes('jointeam') || t.includes('team')) return 'Added to team session';
  return 'Kiosk notified successfully';
}

export default function KioskScanScreen({ navigation, route }: Props) {
  const { kidId } = route.params;
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [state, setState] = useState<ScreenState>({ kind: 'scanning' });
  const scanLockRef = useRef(false);
  const kioskEvent = useKioskEvent(kidId);

  const handleScan = useCallback(
    async (raw: string) => {
      if (scanLockRef.current) return;
      scanLockRef.current = true;

      if (!isHitTraxKioskUrl(raw)) {
        setState({
          kind: 'error',
          message: "This doesn't look like a HitTrax kiosk QR code. Make sure you scan the QR code displayed on the batting cage kiosk screen.",
        });
        return;
      }

      setState({ kind: 'loading' });
      try {
        const result = await kioskEvent.mutateAsync({ qrUrl: raw });
        setState({ kind: 'success', eventType: result.event_type });
      } catch (err) {
        setState({ kind: 'error', message: errorMessage(err) });
      }
    },
    [kioskEvent],
  );

  const handleRetry = useCallback(() => {
    scanLockRef.current = false;
    setState({ kind: 'scanning' });
  }, []);

  // ── Permission loading ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!permission) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Permission denied ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!permission.granted) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <QrCode size={56} color={colors.gold} style={styles.permIcon} />
          <Text style={styles.permTitle}>Camera access needed</Text>
          <Text style={styles.permBody}>
            Allow camera access so Ballpark can scan the kiosk QR code and sign
            your athlete in at the cage automatically.
          </Text>
          {permission.canAskAgain ? (
            <Button label="Allow camera" onPress={requestPermission} />
          ) : (
            <Button
              label="Open Settings"
              onPress={() => void Linking.openSettings()}
            />
          )}
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
            style={styles.cancelBtn}
          >
            <Text style={styles.cancelText}>Cancel</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Success ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (state.kind === 'success') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <View style={styles.successIcon}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={52} color={colors.gold} />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.successTitle}>Checked In!</Text>
          <Text style={styles.successBody}>{eventLabel(state.eventType)}</Text>
          <View style={styles.successActions}>
            <Button label="Done" onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} />
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleRetry} style={styles.scanAnotherBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.scanAnotherText}>Scan another kiosk</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Error ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (state.kind === 'error') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Scan failed</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorBody}>{state.message}</Text>
          <Button label="Try again" onPress={handleRetry} />
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
            style={styles.cancelBtn}
          >
            <Text style={styles.cancelText}>Cancel</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (state.kind === 'loading') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
          <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Checking in…</Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Scanning ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <View style={styles.scanHeader}>
        <Text style={styles.scanTitle}>Scan Kiosk QR</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} hitSlop={12}>
          <X size={22} color={colors.textLight} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.cameraWrap}>
        <CameraView
          style={styles.camera}
          facing="back"
          barcodeScannerSettings={{ barcodeTypes: ['qr'] }}
          onBarcodeScanned={({ data }) => void handleScan(data)}
        />
        <View style={styles.overlay} pointerEvents="none">
          <View style={styles.scanFrame} />
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.footer}>
        <Text style={styles.footerHint}>
          Point at the QR code displayed on the kiosk screen
        </Text>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  centered: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: spacing['4xl'],
    gap: spacing['2xl'],
  },

  // Permission
  permIcon: { marginBottom: spacing.lg },
  permTitle: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['2xl'],
    color: colors.gold,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  permBody: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,

  cancelBtn: { paddingVertical: spacing.lg },

  // Scanner header
  scanHeader: {

  // Camera

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Linking,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { AlertTriangle, ExternalLink, Info, Star } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useFocusEffect, useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import type { NativeStackNavigationProp } from '@react-navigation/native-stack';

import { useMembership } from '@/hooks/useMembership';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import { fetchUpgradePlans } from '@/api/membership';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import type { MeStackParamList } from '@/navigation/types';

const FACILITY_EMAIL = 'info@infinitehitting.com';

function formatDate(isoDate: string): string {
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const d = new Date(isoDate + 'T00:00:00');
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

function nextBillingDate(anchorDay: number | null): string {
  if (!anchorDay) return '—';
  const now = new Date();
  const thisMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), anchorDay);
  if (thisMonth > now) return formatDate(thisMonth.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  const nextMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, anchorDay);
  return formatDate(nextMonth.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
}

export default function MembershipDetailsScreen() {
  const { membership, loading, refresh } = useMembership();
  const { family } = useFamily();
  const navigation = useNavigation<NativeStackNavigationProp<MeStackParamList>>();

  const [hasUpgradePlans, setHasUpgradePlans] = useState(false);

  // Re-fetch membership when returning from PaymentMethodScreen so the
  // payment_failed_at banner clears immediately on back-navigation.
  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      void refresh();
    }, [refresh]),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!membership || membership.status !== 'active' || membership.plan_type !== 'eft' || !family?.tenant_id) {
      setHasUpgradePlans(false);
      return;
    }
    void fetchUpgradePlans(family.tenant_id as string, membership.amount_cents)
      .then(plans => setHasUpgradePlans(plans.length > 0))
      .catch(() => setHasUpgradePlans(false));
  }, [membership, family?.tenant_id]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (!membership) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>No active membership</Text>
          <Text style={styles.emptyBody}>
            You don't have an active membership on file. Visit us or give us a call — we'd love to get you set up!
          </Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const isPaused = membership.status === 'paused';
  const isPaymentFailed = !!membership.payment_failed_at;
  const statusLabel = isPaused ? 'Paused' : isPaymentFailed ? 'Payment Failed' : 'Active';
  const planTypeLabel = membership.plan_type === 'eft' ? 'Monthly EFT' : 'Session Pack';
  const amountLabel =
    membership.plan_type === 'eft'
      ? `$${(membership.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}/mo`
      : `$${(membership.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {isPaymentFailed ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.failedBanner}
            onPress={() => navigation.navigate('PaymentMethod')}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <AlertTriangle size={18} color="#fff" />
            <View style={styles.failedBannerText}>
              <Text style={styles.failedBannerTitle}>Payment failed</Text>
              <Text style={styles.failedBannerBody}>Tap to update your card →</Text>
            </View>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : null}

        <View style={styles.iconWrap}>
          <Star size={28} color={colors.gold} />
        </View>

        <View style={styles.card}>
          <DetailRow label="Plan" value={membership.plan_name} />
          <DetailRow label="Type" value={planTypeLabel} />
          <DetailRow label="Amount" value={amountLabel} />
          {membership.plan_type === 'eft' && (
            <DetailRow
              label="Next billing"
              value={
                isPaused
                  ? (membership.pause_end ? `Resumes ${formatDate(membership.pause_end)}` : '—')
                  : nextBillingDate(membership.billing_anchor_day)
              }
            />
          )}
          <DetailRow
            label="Status"
            value={statusLabel}
            valueTone={isPaymentFailed ? 'danger' : isPaused ? 'gold' : 'success'}
            last
          />
        </View>

        {membership.contract_url ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.contractLink}
            onPress={() => Linking.openURL(membership.contract_url!)}
            activeOpacity={0.7}
          >
            <ExternalLink size={14} color={colors.gold} />
            <Text style={styles.contractLinkText}>View Contract</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : null}

        {isPaused && membership.pause_end ? (
          <View style={styles.pauseNotice}>
            <Text style={styles.pauseNoticeText}>
              Your membership is paused until {formatDate(membership.pause_end)}. Billing resumes automatically on that date.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <View style={styles.infoBox}>
          <View style={styles.infoBoxHeader}>
            <Info size={16} color={colors.textMuted} />
            <Text style={styles.infoBoxTitle}>Making changes?</Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.infoBoxBody}>
            To pause or cancel your membership, please{' '}
            <Text
              style={styles.emailLink}
              onPress={() => Linking.openURL(`mailto:${FACILITY_EMAIL}`)}
            >
              email us
            </Text>
            {' '}— we're happy to help!
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.infoBoxContact}>
            📍 Infinite Hitting{'\n'}
            ✉️ {FACILITY_EMAIL}
          </Text>
        </View>

        {hasUpgradePlans ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.upgradeButton}
            onPress={() => navigation.navigate('UpgradeMembership')}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <Text style={styles.upgradeButtonText}>Upgrade Plan</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

          valueTone === 'danger' ? { color: '#e74c3c' } : null,
        ]}
      >
        {value}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * OrdersListScreen — chronological history of every order (redemption or
 * purchase) the family has placed. Shows the redemption code for ordered
 * items so the parent can present it at the front desk.
 */

import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import QRCode from 'react-native-qrcode-svg';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import type { OrderWithProduct } from '@/api/earn';
import { useOrders } from '@/hooks/useOrders';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';
import { useState } from 'react';

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  ordered: 'Ordered',
  fulfilled: 'Fulfilled',
  cancelled: 'Cancelled',
  refunded: 'Refunded',
  payment_failed: 'Payment failed',
};

function formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const m = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][d.getMonth()];
  const h24 = d.getHours();
  const min = d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const period = h24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h24 % 12;
  return `${m} ${d.getDate()} · ${h12}:${min} ${period}`;
}

function OrderRow({ order }: { order: OrderWithProduct }) {
  const [showQR, setShowQR] = useState(false);
  const isPoints = order.payment_method === 'points';
  const cost = isPoints
    ? `${order.amount_paid_points?.toLocaleString() ?? 0} pts`
    : order.amount_paid_cents !== null
      ? `$${(order.amount_paid_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`
      : '';
  const productName = order.product?.name ?? 'Unknown product';
  const kidName = order.kid ? `${order.kid.first_name}` : '';
  const statusLabel = STATUS_LABEL[order.status] ?? order.status;
  const showCode = order.status === 'ordered' || order.status === 'fulfilled';
  const isFailed = order.status === 'payment_failed';

  return (
    <View style={styles.row}>
      <View style={styles.rowHeader}>
        <Text style={styles.productName}>{productName}</Text>
        <View style={[
          styles.badge,
          order.status === 'fulfilled' && styles.badgeFulfilled,
          isFailed && styles.badgeFailed,
        ]}>
          <Text style={[styles.badgeText, isFailed && styles.badgeTextFailed]}>
            {statusLabel}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      <Text style={styles.meta}>
        {kidName ? `${kidName} · ` : ''}
        {cost} · {formatDateTime(order.created_at)}
      </Text>
      {showCode && !isFailed ? (
        <View style={styles.codeBox}>
          <Text style={styles.codeLabel}>Front-desk code</Text>
          <Text style={styles.codeValue}>{order.redemption_code}</Text>
          {order.status === 'ordered' && order.redemption_code ? (
            <>
              <TouchableOpacity
                onPress={() => setShowQR((v) => !v)}
                style={styles.showQRBtn}
                activeOpacity={0.7}
              >
                <Text style={styles.showQRText}>{showQR ? 'Hide QR' : 'Show QR'}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              {showQR ? (
                <View style={styles.qrWrap}>
                  <QRCode
                    value={order.redemption_code}
                    size={160}
                    color={colors.dark}
                    backgroundColor={colors.cream}
                  />
                </View>
              ) : null}
            </>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {isFailed ? (
        <Text style={styles.failedNote}>
          Payment was not successful. Please try again or visit the front desk.
        </Text>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function OrdersListScreen() {
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch, isRefetching } = useOrders();

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Couldn&apos;t load orders</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorMsg}>{errorMessage(error)}</Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <FlatList
        data={data ?? []}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        contentContainerStyle={(data ?? []).length === 0 ? styles.emptyContent : styles.listContent}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={isRefetching}
            onRefresh={refetch}
            tintColor={colors.gold}
            colors={[colors.gold]}
          />
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => <OrderRow order={item} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <View style={styles.emptyBox}>
            <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>No orders yet</Text>
            <Text style={styles.emptyMsg}>
              Redeem a reward in the Earn tab and it will show up here.
            </Text>
          </View>
        }
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, PauseCircle } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useMembership } from '@/hooks/useMembership';
import type { MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Props = MeStackScreenProps<'PauseMembership'>;

const MIN_DAYS = 7;
const MAX_DAYS = 90;

function addDays(date: Date, days: number): Date {
  const d = new Date(date);
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
  return d;
}

function toDateStr(date: Date): string {
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function formatDateDisplay(isoDate: string): string {
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const d = new Date(isoDate + 'T00:00:00');
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

function clampDays(n: number): number {
  return Math.max(MIN_DAYS, Math.min(MAX_DAYS, n));
}

const QUICK_OPTIONS = [
  { label: '1 week',   days: 7  },
  { label: '2 weeks',  days: 14 },
  { label: '1 month',  days: 30 },
  { label: '2 months', days: 60 },
  { label: '3 months', days: 90 },
];

export default function PauseMembershipScreen({ navigation }: Props) {
  const { membership, loading, pause, resume } = useMembership();
  const [resuming, setResuming] = useState(false);

  const today = useMemo(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    return d;
  }, []);

  // Controlled number of days from today (7–90)
  const [days, setDays] = useState(30);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const selectedDate = useMemo(() => addDays(today, days), [today, days]);
  const selectedStr  = toDateStr(selectedDate);

  const adjustDays = useCallback((delta: number) => {
    setDays(prev => clampDays(prev + delta));
  }, []);

  const handleConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    const pauseEndStr = toDateStr(selectedDate);
    const startStr    = formatDateDisplay(toDateStr(today));
    const endStr      = formatDateDisplay(pauseEndStr);

    Alert.alert(
      'Confirm Pause',
      `No charges from ${startStr} to ${endStr}.\n\nYour membership will automatically resume on ${endStr}.`,
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Pause Membership',
          style: 'default',
          onPress: async () => {
            setSubmitting(true);
            try {
              await pause(pauseEndStr);
              Alert.alert(
                'Membership Paused',
                `Your membership is paused until ${endStr}. You can resume early from your profile.`,
                [{ text: 'OK', onPress: () => navigation.goBack() }],
              );
            } catch (err) {
              Alert.alert('Could not pause membership', errorMessage(err));
            } finally {
              setSubmitting(false);
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  }, [selectedDate, today, pause, navigation]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={styles.emptyState}>
          <Text style={styles.emptyText}>Loading membership…</Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (membership?.status === 'paused') {
    const pauseEnd = membership.pause_end ? formatDateDisplay(membership.pause_end) : '—';
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <View style={styles.iconWrap}>
              <PauseCircle size={32} color={colors.gold} />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.title}>Membership Paused</Text>
            <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
              Your billing is paused. No charges until your membership resumes.
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.planCard}>
            <Text style={styles.planLabel}>CURRENT PLAN</Text>
            <Text style={styles.planName}>{membership.plan_name}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.planAmount}>
              ${(membership.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}/mo
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.rangeCard}>
            <View style={styles.rangeRow}>
              <View style={styles.rangeCol}>
                <Text style={styles.rangeColLabel}>PAUSED ON</Text>
                <Text style={styles.rangeDate}>
                  {membership.pause_start ? formatDateDisplay(membership.pause_start) : '—'}
                </Text>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.rangeDivider} />
              <View style={styles.rangeCol}>
                <Text style={styles.rangeColLabel}>RESUMES ON</Text>
                <Text style={[styles.rangeDate, { color: colors.gold }]}>{pauseEnd}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.rangeNote}>Automatic</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.noBillingBanner}>
              <Text style={styles.noBillingText}>✓ No charges during this period</Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.infoBox}>
            <Text style={styles.infoText}>
              Your membership will automatically resume on {pauseEnd}.{'\n'}
              You can resume early at any time by tapping the button below.
            </Text>
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.cta, resuming && styles.ctaDisabled]}
            disabled={resuming}
            onPress={() => {
              Alert.alert(
                'Resume Membership?',
                'Billing will resume immediately. Your next charge will be on the next billing date.',
                [
                  { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                  {
                    text: 'Resume Now',
                    onPress: async () => {
                      setResuming(true);
                      try {
                        await resume();
                        navigation.goBack();
                      } catch (err) {
                        Alert.alert('Could not resume', errorMessage(err));
                      } finally {
                        setResuming(false);
                      }
                    },
                  },
                ],
              );
            }}
          >
            {resuming
              ? <ActivityIndicator color={colors.dark} />
              : <Text style={styles.ctaText}>Resume Early</Text>
            }
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}>
            <Text style={styles.cancelText}>Back to profile</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (!membership || membership.plan_type !== 'eft') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={styles.emptyState}>
          <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
            Membership pausing is only available for monthly EFT plans.
          </Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const todayStr = toDateStr(today);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <View style={styles.iconWrap}>
            <PauseCircle size={32} color={colors.gold} />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.title}>Pause Membership</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
            Pause your billing while you travel, recover, or take a break.
            No charges during the pause window.
          </Text>
        </View>

        {/* Plan info */}
        <View style={styles.planCard}>
          <Text style={styles.planLabel}>CURRENT PLAN</Text>
          <Text style={styles.planName}>{membership.plan_name}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.planAmount}>
            ${(membership.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}/mo
          </Text>
        </View>

        {/* ── Date Picker ── */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>CHOOSE RETURN DATE</Text>

        {/* Day stepper */}
        <View style={styles.stepperCard}>
          <Text style={styles.stepperCaption}>Days from today</Text>

          <View style={styles.stepperRow}>
            {/* -7 */}
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.stepBtn, days <= MIN_DAYS && styles.stepBtnDisabled]}
              onPress={() => adjustDays(-7)}
              disabled={days <= MIN_DAYS}
            >
              <ChevronLeft size={14} color={days <= MIN_DAYS ? colors.textMuted : colors.textLight} />
              <ChevronLeft size={14} color={days <= MIN_DAYS ? colors.textMuted : colors.textLight} style={{ marginLeft: -8 }} />
            </TouchableOpacity>

            {/* -1 */}
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.stepBtn, days <= MIN_DAYS && styles.stepBtnDisabled]}
              onPress={() => adjustDays(-1)}
              disabled={days <= MIN_DAYS}
            >
              <ChevronLeft size={18} color={days <= MIN_DAYS ? colors.textMuted : colors.textLight} />
            </TouchableOpacity>

            {/* Day count display */}
            <View style={styles.dayDisplay}>
              <Text style={styles.dayNumber}>{days}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.dayLabel}>days</Text>
            </View>

            {/* +1 */}
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.stepBtn, days >= MAX_DAYS && styles.stepBtnDisabled]}
              onPress={() => adjustDays(1)}
              disabled={days >= MAX_DAYS}
            >
              <ChevronRight size={18} color={days >= MAX_DAYS ? colors.textMuted : colors.textLight} />
            </TouchableOpacity>

            {/* +7 */}
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.stepBtn, days >= MAX_DAYS && styles.stepBtnDisabled]}
              onPress={() => adjustDays(7)}
              disabled={days >= MAX_DAYS}
            >
              <ChevronRight size={14} color={days >= MAX_DAYS ? colors.textMuted : colors.textLight} />
              <ChevronRight size={14} color={days >= MAX_DAYS ? colors.textMuted : colors.textLight} style={{ marginLeft: -8 }} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          {/* Range bar */}
          <View style={styles.rangeBar}>

            ]} />
          </View>

        {/* Quick shortcuts */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionLabel, { marginTop: spacing['2xl'] }]}>QUICK SELECT</Text>

            return (

                key={opt.days}

            );
          })}
        </View>

        {/* Selected range display */}
        <View style={styles.rangeCard}>
          <View style={styles.rangeRow}>
            <View style={styles.rangeCol}>
              <Text style={styles.rangeColLabel}>PAUSE STARTS</Text>

              <Text style={styles.rangeNote}>Today</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.rangeDivider} />
            <View style={styles.rangeCol}>
              <Text style={styles.rangeColLabel}>RESUMES ON</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.rangeDate, { color: colors.gold }]}>
                {formatDateDisplay(selectedStr)}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.rangeNote}>Automatic</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.noBillingBanner}>
            <Text style={styles.noBillingText}>
              ✓ No charges during this period
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Info */}
        <View style={styles.infoBox}>
          <Text style={styles.infoText}>
            • Minimum pause: {MIN_DAYS} days · Maximum: {MAX_DAYS} days{'\n'}
            • Your membership auto-resumes on the return date{'\n'}
            • You can resume early at any time from your profile{'\n'}
            • Session bookings during a pause are still available
          </Text>
        </View>

        {/* CTA */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.cta, submitting && styles.ctaDisabled]}
          onPress={handleConfirm}
          disabled={submitting}
        >
          <Text style={styles.ctaText}>
            {submitting ? 'Pausing…' : `Pause Until ${formatDateDisplay(selectedStr)}`}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}>
          <Text style={styles.cancelText}>Never mind</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

/**
 * PaymentMethodScreen
 *
 * Allows a parent to view, add, or replace the saved payment method for
 * recurring membership subscription billing. Uses the Stripe
 * SetupIntent flow via stripe-react-native's payment sheet.
 *
 * States:
 *   loading    — fetching card-on-file from families table
 *   no-card    — no card saved; shows "Add a card" CTA
 *   has-card   — shows brand/last4/expiry; shows "Replace card" CTA
 *   fetching   — creating SetupIntent before presenting PaymentSheet
 *   presenting — PaymentSheet is open (nested StripeProvider scope)
 *   saving     — PaymentSheet confirmed, calling save-payment-method
 *   success    — card saved/replaced; shown briefly before auto-returning
 *
 * Connect account context:
 * The stripe-setup-intent edge function creates the Customer and SetupIntent
 * on the location's connected Stripe account (via Stripe-Account header) and
 * returns stripe_account_id alongside the client secret. We wrap the payment
 * sheet presentation in a nested StripeProvider with that stripeAccountId so
 * the SDK makes calls against the correct connected account.
 */

import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { StripeProvider, useStripe } from '@stripe/stripe-react-native';
import {
  CreditCard,
  CheckCircle2,
  ShieldCheck,
  RefreshCw,
  PlusCircle,
} from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import {
  createSetupIntent,
  savePaymentMethod,
  getCardOnFile,
  type SetupIntentResult,
  type CardOnFile,
} from '@/api/stripe';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useMembership } from '@/hooks/useMembership';
import type { MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

const STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ?? '';

type Props = MeStackScreenProps<'PaymentMethod'>;

// ── Brand icon label helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

const BRAND_SHORT: Record<string, string> = {
  Visa: 'VISA',
  Mastercard: 'MC',
  Amex: 'AMEX',
  Discover: 'DISC',
  'Diners Club': 'DC',
  JCB: 'JCB',
  UnionPay: 'UP',
};

function brandLabel(brand: string): string {
  return BRAND_SHORT[brand] ?? brand.toUpperCase().slice(0, 4);
}

// ── Inner presenter component (PaymentSheet) ──────────────────────────────────

type PresenterProps = {
  setup: SetupIntentResult;
  onSuccess: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onError: (msg: string) => void;
};

function PaymentSheetPresenter({ setup, onSuccess, onCancel, onError }: PresenterProps) {
  const { initPaymentSheet, presentPaymentSheet } = useStripe();
  const [presenting, setPresentingState] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;

    async function run() {
      try {
        const { error: initError } = await initPaymentSheet({
          setupIntentClientSecret: setup.setupIntentClientSecret,
          customerId: setup.customerId,
          customerEphemeralKeySecret: setup.ephemeralKeySecret,
          merchantDisplayName: 'Ballpark Sports',
          allowsDelayedPaymentMethods: false,
          style: 'alwaysDark',
        });

        if (initError) throw new Error(initError.message);
        if (!mounted) return;

        const { error: presentError } = await presentPaymentSheet();
        if (!mounted) return;

        if (presentError) {
          if (presentError.code === 'Canceled') {
            onCancel();
          } else {
            onError(presentError.message);
          }
        } else {
          onSuccess();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (mounted) onError(errorMessage(err));
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setPresentingState(false);
      }
    }

    run();
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, [initPaymentSheet, presentPaymentSheet, setup, onSuccess, onCancel, onError]);

  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
      {presenting && <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Card-on-file display ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function CardDisplay({ card }: { card: CardOnFile }) {
  const exp = `${String(card.expMonth).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(card.expYear).slice(-2)}`;
  const now = new Date();
  const isExpiringSoon =
    card.expYear === now.getFullYear() && card.expMonth - now.getMonth() <= 2
    || card.expYear < now.getFullYear();

  return (
    <View style={cardStyles.container}>
      <View style={cardStyles.header}>
        <View style={cardStyles.brandBadge}>
          <Text style={cardStyles.brandText}>{brandLabel(card.brand)}</Text>
        </View>
        {isExpiringSoon && (
          <View style={cardStyles.expiringBadge}>
            <Text style={cardStyles.expiringText}>Expiring Soon</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={cardStyles.numberRow}>
        <Text style={cardStyles.dots}>···· ···· ····</Text>
        <Text style={cardStyles.last4}>{card.last4}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={cardStyles.footer}>
        <View>
          <Text style={cardStyles.footerLabel}>EXPIRES</Text>
          <Text style={cardStyles.footerValue}>{exp}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={cardStyles.iconRight}>
          <ShieldCheck size={18} color={colors.success} />
          <Text style={cardStyles.securedText}>Secured</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Main screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Phase = 'loading' | 'idle' | 'fetching' | 'presenting' | 'saving' | 'success';

export default function PaymentMethodScreen({ navigation }: Props) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('loading');
  const [card, setCard] = useState<CardOnFile | null>(null);
  const [setupData, setSetupData] = useState<SetupIntentResult | null>(null);
  const { refresh: refreshMembership } = useMembership();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { user } = useAuth();

  // Load card on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    getCardOnFile()
      .then(result => { if (mounted) { setCard(result); setPhase('idle'); } })
      .catch(() => { if (mounted) setPhase('idle'); });
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, []);

  const handleAddOrReplace = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setPhase('fetching');
      const data = await createSetupIntent();
      setSetupData(data);
      setPhase('presenting');
    } catch (err) {
      setPhase('idle');
      Alert.alert('Could not start card setup', errorMessage(err));
    }
  }, []);

  // Called when PaymentSheet confirms successfully
  const handleSheetSuccess = useCallback(() => {
    setSetupData(null);
    setPhase('saving');
  }, []);

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    setPhase('idle');
    setSetupData(null);
  }, []);

  const handleSheetError = useCallback((msg: string) => {
    setPhase('idle');
    setSetupData(null);
    Alert.alert('Could not save card', msg);
  }, []);

  // After sheet closes with success, call save-payment-method to persist + get card details.
  // Also refresh the membership so the payment_failed_at banner clears immediately.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'saving') return;
    let mounted = true;

    savePaymentMethod()
      .then(result => {
        if (!mounted) return;
        setCard(result);
        setPhase('success');
        // Refresh membership in background — clears payment_failed_at banner.
        void refreshMembership();
        // Invalidate the family query so ProfileScreen's card row shows the
        // new card details immediately without requiring the parent to leave
        // and return to the Me tab.
        if (user?.id) {
          void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['family', user.id] });
        }
      })
      .catch(err => {
        if (!mounted) return;
        setPhase('idle');
        Alert.alert(
          'Card setup issue',
          `Your card was captured by Stripe but we could not confirm the details: ${errorMessage(err)}. Please contact support if the issue persists.`,
        );
      });

    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, [phase, refreshMembership]);

  // ── Loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (phase === 'loading') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Presenting PaymentSheet ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (phase === 'presenting' && setupData) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <StripeProvider
          publishableKey={STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY}
          stripeAccountId={setupData.stripeAccountId}
        >
          <PaymentSheetPresenter
            setup={setupData}
            onSuccess={handleSheetSuccess}
            onCancel={handleCancel}
            onError={handleSheetError}
          />
        </StripeProvider>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Saving (after sheet closed) ───────────────────────────────────────────
  if (phase === 'saving') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }]}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
          <Text style={[styles.subtitle, { marginTop: spacing['2xl'] }]}>
            Saving your card…
          </Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Success ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (phase === 'success' && card) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.container}>
          <View style={styles.content}>
            <View style={styles.iconCircle}>
              <CheckCircle2 size={40} color={colors.success} />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.successTitle}>Card Saved</Text>
            <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
              {card.brand} ending in {card.last4} is now on file for monthly membership billing.
            </Text>
            <CardDisplay card={card} />
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.primaryBtn} onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}>
              <Text style={styles.primaryBtnText}>Done</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Idle: card on file ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (card) {
    const loading = phase === 'fetching';
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.container}>
          <View style={styles.content}>
            <View style={styles.iconCircle}>
              <CreditCard size={36} color={colors.gold} />
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.title}>Payment Method</Text>
            <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
              This card is charged automatically on your membership renewal date each month.
            </Text>

            <CardDisplay card={card} />

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.primaryBtn, loading && styles.btnDisabled]}
              onPress={handleAddOrReplace}
              disabled={loading}
            >
              {loading ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color={colors.dark} size="small" />
              ) : (
                <View style={styles.btnRow}>
                  <RefreshCw size={16} color={colors.dark} />
                  <Text style={styles.primaryBtnText}>Replace Card</Text>
                </View>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <Text style={styles.secureNote}>
              Secured by Stripe · Your card details are never stored on our servers
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  // ── Idle: no card on file ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loading = phase === 'fetching';

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={styles.content}>
          <View style={styles.iconCircle}>
            <CreditCard size={36} color={colors.gold} />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.title}>Add Payment Method</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
            Save a credit or debit card for automatic monthly membership billing.
            Your card will only be charged on your renewal date.
          </Text>

          <View style={styles.infoCard}>
            {[
              { label: 'When you\'ll be charged', value: 'On your membership renewal date each month' },
              { label: 'What you\'ll be charged', value: 'Your current membership plan rate' },
              { label: 'Failed payments', value: 'Stripe retries automatically; you\'ll get an email if action is needed' },
            ].map((row, i) => (
              <View key={i} style={[styles.infoRow, i > 0 && styles.infoRowBorder]}>
                <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>{row.label}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.infoValue}>{row.value}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.primaryBtn, loading && styles.btnDisabled]}
            onPress={handleAddOrReplace}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            {loading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color={colors.dark} size="small" />
            ) : (
              <View style={styles.btnRow}>
                <PlusCircle size={16} color={colors.dark} />
                <Text style={styles.primaryBtnText}>Add Card</Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <Text style={styles.secureNote}>
            Secured by Stripe · Your card details are never stored on our servers
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
