import {
  Award,
  BookOpen,
  CalendarCheck,
  ChevronRight,
  CreditCard,
  Gauge,
  Gift,
  type LucideIcon,
  LogOut,
  type LucideProps,
  MapPin,
  Ruler,
  Sparkles,
  Star,
  Target,
  TrendingUp,
  Trophy,
  Crown,
  Flame,
  Video,
  GraduationCap,
  BookCheck,
  Activity,
  UserPlus,
} from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Alert,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { deleteAccount } from '@/api/account';
import { signOut } from '@/api/auth';
import { useActiveMembership } from '@/hooks/useActiveMembership';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useDeleteKid } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import {
  useAchievementsCatalog,
  useEarnedAchievements,
} from '@/hooks/useAchievements';
import { usePersonalBestsForKid, useSwingsForKid } from '@/hooks/useSwings';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { useHitTraxLink } from '@/hooks/useHitTraxLink';
import type { MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { usePrimaryLocation } from '@/screens/Book/hooks/usePrimaryLocation';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';
import type { Tables } from '@/types/database';

type Props = MeStackScreenProps<'MeHome'>;
type Kid = Tables<'kids'>;

const ICONS: Record<string, LucideIcon> = {
  Award,
  Sparkles,
  Target,
  Trophy,
  Crown,
  Flame,
  CalendarCheck,
  BookCheck,
  GraduationCap,
  Star,
  Gift,
  Video,
  Activity,
};

type PbMetric =
  | 'exit_velocity_mph'
  | 'launch_angle_deg'
  | 'distance_ft'
  | 'contact_rate';

const PB_TILES: Array<{
  metric: PbMetric;
  label: string;
  unit: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  digits: number;
}> = [
  { metric: 'exit_velocity_mph', label: 'EXIT VELO',    unit: 'MPH', icon: Gauge,      digits: 1 },
  { metric: 'launch_angle_deg',  label: 'LAUNCH ANGLE', unit: '°',   icon: TrendingUp, digits: 0 },
  { metric: 'distance_ft',       label: 'DISTANCE',     unit: 'FT',  icon: Ruler,      digits: 0 },
  { metric: 'contact_rate',      label: 'CONTACT RATE', unit: '%',   icon: Target,     digits: 0 },
];

function fmtPb(v: number, digits: number): string {
  if (digits === 0) return Math.round(v).toString();
  return Number(v).toFixed(digits);
}

export default function ProfileScreen({ navigation }: Props) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { family, kid, kids, setSelectedKid } = useSelectedKid();
  const deleteKid = useDeleteKid();

  const { data: primaryLocation } = usePrimaryLocation();

  const { data: hittraxLink } = useHitTraxLink(kid?.id);
  const hittraxStatus =
    hittraxLink?.association_status === 'active'
      ? 'Connected'
      : hittraxLink?.association_status === 'pending'
        ? 'Pending'
        : hittraxLink?.association_status === 'declined'
          ? 'Declined'
          : 'Not connected';

  const { data: activeMembership } = useActiveMembership();

  const { data: prs } = usePersonalBestsForKid(kid?.id);
  const { data: swings } = useSwingsForKid(kid?.id);

  const contactRate = useMemo<number | null>(() => {
    if (!swings || swings.length === 0) return null;
    const total = swings.length;
    const contact = swings.filter(
      (s) => typeof s.exit_velocity_mph === 'number' && s.exit_velocity_mph > 0,
    ).length;
    return Math.round((contact / total) * 100);
  }, [swings]);
  const { data: catalog } = useAchievementsCatalog();
  const { data: earned } = useEarnedAchievements(kid?.id);

  const earnedSet = useMemo(
    () => new Set((earned ?? []).map((e) => e.achievement_id)),
    [earned],
  );

  const prsByMetric = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    (prs ?? []).forEach((p) => map.set(p.metric, Number(p.value)));
    return map;
  }, [prs]);

  const initial = (kid?.first_name?.[0] ?? user?.email?.[0] ?? '?').toUpperCase();
  const fullName = kid
    ? `${kid.first_name} ${kid.last_name ?? ''}`.trim()
    : (family
        ? `${family.parent_first_name ?? ''} ${family.parent_last_name ?? ''}`.trim()
        : (user?.email ?? 'Profile'));
  const subtitle = kid
    ? [
        kid.age_group ?? null,
        kid.primary_position ?? null,
        kid.jersey_number ? `#${kid.jersey_number}` : null,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' · ') || 'Athlete'
    : (user?.email ?? '');

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    try {
      await signOut();
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Sign-out failed', errorMessage(err));
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteAccount = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Delete account?',
      "This permanently deletes your family, your kid's stats, bookings, " +
        'orders, and HitTrax connection. This cannot be undone.',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Delete account',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: async () => {
            try {
              await deleteAccount();
              await signOut().catch(() => undefined);
            } catch (err) {
              Alert.alert('Could not delete account', errorMessage(err));
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {/* Header --------------------------------------------------------- */}
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <View style={styles.avatarTile}>
            <Text style={styles.avatarInitial}>{initial}</Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.name}>{fullName}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>{subtitle}</Text>
          {kid ? (
            <View style={styles.pointsRow}>
              <Trophy size={14} color={colors.gold} />
              <Text style={styles.pointsText}>
                {(kid.points_balance ?? 0).toLocaleString()} pts
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {/* Athletes section ------------------------------------------------ */}
        {kids.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <View style={styles.sectionRow}>
              <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>ATHLETES</Text>
            </View>
            {kids.map((k) => (
              <KidCard
                key={k.id}
                kid={k}
                isSelected={k.id === kid?.id}
                onSwitch={() => setSelectedKid(k.id)}
                onEdit={() => navigation.navigate('EditKid', { kidId: k.id })}
                onDelete={async () => {
                  if (kids.length === 1) {
                    Alert.alert(
                      'Cannot delete',
                      'You need at least one athlete on your account.',
                    );
                    return;
                  }
                  Alert.alert(
                    `Delete ${k.first_name}?`,
                    'This will permanently remove all of this athlete\u2019s data including stats, bookings, and HitTrax history. This cannot be undone.',
                    [
                      { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                      {
                        text: 'Delete athlete',
                        style: 'destructive',
                        onPress: async () => {
                          try {
                            if (k.id === kid?.id) {
                              const next = kids.find((o) => o.id !== k.id);
                              if (next) setSelectedKid(next.id);
                            }
                            await deleteKid(k.id);
                          } catch (err) {
                            Alert.alert('Could not delete athlete', String(err));
                          }
                        },
                      },
                    ],
                  );
                }}
              />
            ))}
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.addAthleteBtn}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('AddKid', { fromMe: true })}
              accessibilityRole="button"
            >
              <View style={styles.addAthleteIcon}>
                <UserPlus size={18} color={colors.gold} />
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.addAthleteText}>Add Another Athlete</Text>
              <ChevronRight size={18} color={colors.gold} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {/* Personal Bests ------------------------------------------------- */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>PERSONAL BESTS</Text>
        <View style={styles.pbGrid}>
          {PB_TILES.map((tile) => {
            const v =
              tile.metric === 'contact_rate'
                ? contactRate ?? undefined
                : prsByMetric.get(tile.metric);
            const Icon = tile.icon;
            return (
              <View key={tile.metric} style={styles.pbTile}>
                <View style={styles.pbHeader}>
                  <Icon size={14} color={colors.gold} />
                  <Text style={styles.pbLabel}>{tile.label}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.pbValueRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.pbValue}>
                    {v == null ? '—' : fmtPb(v, tile.digits)}
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.pbUnit}>{tile.unit}</Text>
                </View>
              </View>
            );
          })}
        </View>

        {/* Achievements --------------------------------------------------- */}
        <View style={styles.sectionRow}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>ACHIEVEMENTS</Text>
          <Text style={styles.sectionCount}>
            {earnedSet.size}/{(catalog ?? []).length}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.badgeGrid}>
          {(catalog ?? []).map((a) => {
            const Icon = ICONS[a.icon] ?? Sparkles;
            const isEarned = earnedSet.has(a.id);
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={a.id}
                style={[styles.badge, isEarned ? styles.badgeEarned : styles.badgeLocked]}
                onPress={() =>
                  Alert.alert(
                    a.name,
                    isEarned
                      ? `${a.description}\n\n+${a.points_bonus} pts`
                      : `Locked — ${a.description}`,
                  )
                }
              >
                <Icon
                  size={26}
                  color={isEarned ? colors.dark : colors.textMuted}
                  strokeWidth={2.2}
                />
                <Text
                  numberOfLines={2}
                  style={[
                    styles.badgeName,
                    isEarned ? styles.badgeNameEarned : styles.badgeNameLocked,
                  ]}
                >
                  {a.name}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          })}
        </View>

        {/* Settings list -------------------------------------------------- */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>SETTINGS</Text>
        <Row
          icon={CalendarCheck}
          label="Book a session"
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('Book')}
        />
        <Row
          icon={BookOpen}
          label="Bookings"
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('BookingsList')}
        />
        <Row
          icon={Gift}
          label="Orders"
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('Orders')}
        />
        <Row
          icon={Star}
          label="Membership"
          subtitle="Plan details"
          subtitleTone="muted"
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('MembershipDetails')}
        />
        <Row
          icon={CreditCard}
          label="Payment Method"
          subtitle={
            activeMembership?.plan_type === 'otc' &&
            activeMembership.sessions_remaining !== null &&
            activeMembership.sessions_total !== null
              ? `${activeMembership.sessions_remaining} of ${activeMembership.sessions_total} sessions remaining`
              : family?.card_last4 && family?.card_brand
                ? `${family.card_brand} ···· ${family.card_last4}  exp ${String(family.card_exp_month ?? 0).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(family.card_exp_year ?? 0).slice(-2)}`
                : 'No card saved — tap to add'
          }
          subtitleTone={
            activeMembership?.plan_type === 'otc' &&
            activeMembership.sessions_remaining !== null
              ? 'gold' as const
              : 'muted' as const
          }
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('PaymentMethod')}
        />
        <Row
          icon={MapPin}
          label="My Location"
          subtitle={primaryLocation?.name ?? '—'}
          subtitleTone="muted"
        />
        <Row
          icon={Activity}
          label="HitTrax"
          subtitle={hittraxStatus}
          subtitleTone={
            hittraxStatus === 'Connected'
              ? 'success'
              : hittraxStatus === 'Pending'
                ? 'gold'
                : hittraxStatus === 'Declined'
                  ? 'light'
                  : 'muted'
          }
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('ConnectHitTrax')}
        />

        <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSignOut} style={styles.signOutBtn}>
          <LogOut size={16} color={colors.gold} />
          <Text style={styles.signOutText}>Sign out</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleDeleteAccount} style={styles.deleteBtn}>
          <Text style={styles.deleteText}>Delete account</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function KidCard({
  kid,
  isSelected,
  onSwitch,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}: {
  kid: Kid;
  isSelected: boolean;
  onSwitch: () => void;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}) {
  const initial = (kid.first_name?.[0] ?? '?').toUpperCase();
  const fullName = `${kid.first_name} ${kid.last_name ?? ''}`.trim();
  const meta = [kid.age_group, kid.primary_position].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return (
    <View style={[styles.kidCard, isSelected && styles.kidCardSelected]}>
      <View style={[styles.kidAvatar, isSelected && styles.kidAvatarSelected]}>
        <Text style={[styles.kidAvatarText, isSelected && styles.kidAvatarTextSelected]}>
          {initial}
        </Text>
      </View>
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <Text style={[styles.kidName, isSelected && styles.kidNameSelected]}>{fullName}</Text>
        {meta ? <Text style={styles.kidMeta}>{meta}</Text> : null}
        <Text style={styles.kidPoints}>{(kid.points_balance ?? 0).toLocaleString()} pts</Text>
        <View style={styles.kidActions}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={onEdit} style={styles.kidActionBtn} accessibilityRole="button">
            <Text style={styles.kidActionText}>Edit</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={onDelete} style={[styles.kidActionBtn, styles.kidActionDelete]} accessibilityRole="button">
            <Text style={[styles.kidActionText, styles.kidActionDeleteText]}>Delete</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
      {!isSelected ? (
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={onSwitch} style={styles.switchBtn} accessibilityRole="button">
          <Text style={styles.switchBtnText}>Switch</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.activeTag}>
          <Text style={styles.activeTagText}>Active</Text>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function Row({
  icon: Icon,
  label,
  subtitle,
  subtitleTone = 'muted',
  onPress,
}: {
  icon: (p: LucideProps) => React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  subtitleTone?: 'success' | 'gold' | 'light' | 'muted';
  onPress?: () => void;
}) {
  const inner = (
    <>
      <View style={styles.rowIcon}>
        <Icon size={18} color={colors.gold} />
      </View>
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <Text style={styles.rowLabel}>{label}</Text>
        {subtitle ? (
          <Text
            style={[
              styles.rowSubtitle,
              subtitleTone === 'success'
                ? { color: colors.success }
                : subtitleTone === 'gold'
                  ? { color: colors.gold }
                  : subtitleTone === 'light'
                    ? { color: colors.textLight }
                    : { color: colors.textMuted },
            ]}
          >
            {subtitle}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      {onPress ? <ChevronRight size={18} color={colors.gold} /> : null}
    </>
  );
  if (onPress) {
    return (
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={onPress} style={styles.row}>
        {inner}
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  }
  return <View style={styles.row}>{inner}</View>;
}

/**
 * MessagesInboxScreen — v0.7 task #120.
 *
 * One row per coach the parent has any thread with (or every coach in the
 * tenant if there are no messages yet). Tap a row to open the thread.
 */

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { Send } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { useParentInbox } from '@/hooks/useParentMessages';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'MessagesInbox'>['navigation'];

export default function MessagesInboxScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch, isFetching } = useParentInbox(kid?.id);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest }} edges={['top']}>
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: 'row',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
          paddingVertical: spacing['2xl'],
        }}
      >
        <Text
          style={{
            color: colors.gold,
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
            fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
            letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
          }}
        >
          MESSAGES
        </Text>
        <Pressable
          hitSlop={12}
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('SendVideoToCoach', undefined)}
        >
          <Send size={20} color={colors.gold} />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {isPending ? (
        <View style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : isError ? (
        <View
          style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: spacing['3xl'] }}
        >
          <Text style={{ color: colors.danger, fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium }}>
            {errorMessage(error)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={data ?? []}
          keyExtractor={(r) => r.coachUserId}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={isFetching}
              onRefresh={refetch}
              tintColor={colors.gold}
            />
          }
          contentContainerStyle={{ padding: spacing['3xl'], gap: spacing['2xl'] }}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <Text
              style={{
                color: colors.textLight,
                fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
                fontSize: fontSizes.md,
                textAlign: 'center',
                marginTop: spacing['6xl'],
              }}
            >
              No coaches yet.
            </Text>
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const name =
              [item.coachFirstName, item.coachLastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Coach';
            const previewLine =
              !item.lastCreatedAt
                ? 'Tap to send a clip'
                : item.lastSenderIsSelf
                  ? `You sent ${item.lastHasVideo ? 'a video' : ''}${item.lastMessageText ? ` — ${item.lastMessageText}` : ''}`.trim()
                  : item.lastHasVideo
                    ? `Sent a video${item.lastMessageText ? ` — ${item.lastMessageText}` : ''}`
                    : (item.lastMessageText ?? 'Message');
            return (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() =>
                  kid &&
                  navigation.navigate('MessageThread', {
                    kidId: kid.id,
                    coachUserId: item.coachUserId,
                  })
                }
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  {
                    flexDirection: 'row',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: spacing['2xl'],
                    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
                    paddingVertical: spacing['3xl'],
                    backgroundColor: colors.dark,
                    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    borderColor: colors.borderGold,
                  },
                  pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
                ]}
              >
                <View
                  style={{
                    width: 44,
                    height: 44,
                    borderRadius: 22,
                    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                  }}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={{
                      color: colors.gold,
                      fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
                      fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
                    }}
                  >
                    {name
                      .split(' ')
                      .map((s) => s[0])
                      .filter(Boolean)
                      .slice(0, 2)
                      .join('')
                      .toUpperCase()}
                  </Text>
                </View>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <View
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: 'row',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    }}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={{
                        color: colors.textOnDark,
                        fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
                        fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
                        letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
                      }}
                    >
                      {name.toUpperCase()}
                    </Text>
                    {item.unread ? (
                      <View
                        style={{
                          width: 10,
                          height: 10,
                          borderRadius: 5,
                          backgroundColor: colors.gold,
                        }}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                  </View>
                  <Text
                    numberOfLines={1}
                    style={{
                      color: colors.textLight,
                      fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
                      fontSize: fontSizes.md,
                      marginTop: 2,
                    }}
                  >
                    {previewLine}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </Pressable>
            );
          }}
        />
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

/**
 * MessageThreadScreen — v0.7 task #120.
 *
 * Bidirectional thread for one (kid, coach) pair. Renders text + video
 * bubbles with sender side decided by `senderUserId === self`. Tapping a
 * coach->parent video opens the existing full-screen Mux player on the
 * Home stack (avoids duplicating player chrome). Tapping a parent->coach
 * video plays inline via expo-av in a modal-ish overlay (out of scope for
 * v0.7 — currently shows a "still processing" placeholder until we wire
 * the parent-side full-screen player in a follow-up).
 *
 * Sender identity is anonymised to "Infinite Hitting" per brand guidelines.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { ArrowLeft, MessageCircle, PlayCircle, Send } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import type { ThreadMessage } from '@/api/parentMessages';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import {
  useMessageThread,
} from '@/hooks/useParentMessages';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'MessageThread'>['navigation'];
type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'MessageThread'>['route'];

const POSTER_WIDTH = 480;
const SENDER_NAME = 'Infinite Hitting';

function muxPosterUrl(playbackId: string): string {
  return `https://image.mux.com/${playbackId}/thumbnail.jpg?width=${POSTER_WIDTH}`;
}

export default function MessageThreadScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const { kidId, coachUserId } = route.params;
  const { user } = useAuth();

  const { data: messages, isPending, isError, error, refetch } = useMessageThread(
    kidId,
    coachUserId,
  );

  const data = useMemo(() => messages ?? [], [messages]);

  const onComposeNew = () =>
    navigation.navigate('SendVideoToCoach', { coachUserId });

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest }} edges={['top']}>
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: 'row',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
          paddingVertical: spacing['2xl'],
          borderBottomWidth: 1,
          borderColor: colors.border,
        }}
      >
        <Pressable onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} hitSlop={12}>
          <ArrowLeft size={22} color={colors.textOnDark} />
        </Pressable>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginHorizontal: spacing['2xl'] }}>
          <Text
            numberOfLines={1}
            style={{
              color: colors.textOnDark,
              fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
              fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
              letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
              textAlign: 'center',
            }}
          >
            {SENDER_NAME.toUpperCase()}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <Pressable onPress={onComposeNew} hitSlop={12}>
          <Send size={20} color={colors.gold} />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {isPending ? (
        <View style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : isError ? (
        <View style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: spacing['3xl'] }}>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.danger, fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium }}>
            {errorMessage(error)}
          </Text>
          <Pressable onPress={() => refetch()} style={{ marginTop: spacing['2xl'] }}>
            <Text style={{ color: colors.gold, fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold }}>RETRY</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : data.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState onCompose={onComposeNew} />
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={data}
          keyExtractor={(m) => m.id}
          contentContainerStyle={{ padding: spacing['3xl'], gap: spacing['2xl'] }}
          renderItem={({ item }) => (
            <Bubble
              message={item}
              isSelf={!!user && item.senderUserId === user.id}
              onPlayCoachVideo={(messageId) =>
                navigation.navigate('VideoPlayback', { messageId })
              }
            />
          )}
        />
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ onCompose }: { onCompose: () => void }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flex: 1,
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: spacing['4xl'],
        gap: spacing['3xl'],
      }}
    >
      <MessageCircle size={48} color={colors.goldDeep} />
      <Text
        style={{
          color: colors.textOnDark,
          fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
          fontSize: fontSizes['2xl'],
          letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        SEND A CLIP TO {SENDER_NAME.toUpperCase()}
      </Text>
      <Text
        style={{
          color: colors.textLight,
          fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
          fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
          textAlign: 'center',
        }}
      >
        Send a quick clip — game footage, a swing check, or a question.
      </Text>
      <Pressable
        onPress={onCompose}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          {
            flexDirection: 'row',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: spacing.base,
            backgroundColor: colors.gold,
            paddingVertical: spacing['3xl'],
            paddingHorizontal: spacing['5xl'],
            borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
          },
          pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
        ]}
      >
        <Send size={18} color={colors.dark} />
        <Text
          style={{
            color: colors.dark,
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
            fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
            letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
          }}
        >
          SEND A CLIP
        </Text>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

function Bubble({
  message,
  isSelf,
  onPlayCoachVideo,
}: {
  message: ThreadMessage;
  isSelf: boolean;
  onPlayCoachVideo: (messageId: string) => void;
}) {
  const align = isSelf ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start';
  const bg = isSelf ? colors.gold : colors.dark;
  const fg = isSelf ? colors.dark : colors.textOnDark;
  const borderColor = isSelf ? colors.gold : colors.borderGold;

  const created = new Date(message.createdAt);
  const time = Number.isNaN(created.getTime()) ? '' : formatSentRelative(created);

  return (
    <View style={{ alignItems: align, maxWidth: '88%', alignSelf: align }}>
      {/* Sender badge */}
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: 'row',
          alignItems: 'center',
          marginBottom: 4,
          marginHorizontal: 6,
          gap: 8,
        }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            paddingHorizontal: 8,
            paddingVertical: 2,
            borderRadius: 4,
            backgroundColor: isSelf ? colors.gold : colors.goldDeep,
          }}
        >
          <Text
            style={{
              fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
              fontSize: 10,
              letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
              color: isSelf ? colors.dark : colors.darkest,
            }}
          >
            {isSelf ? 'YOU' : SENDER_NAME.toUpperCase()}
          </Text>
        </View>
        {time ? (
          <Text
            style={{
              fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
              fontSize: 10,
              color: colors.textMuted,
            }}
          >
            {time}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {message.video?.muxPlaybackId ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => onPlayCoachVideo(message.id)}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            {
              borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
              overflow: 'hidden',
              borderWidth: 1.5,
              borderColor,
              width: 240,
              aspectRatio: 16 / 9,
            },
            pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
          ]}
        >
          <Image
            source={{ uri: muxPosterUrl(message.video.muxPlaybackId) }}
            style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
            resizeMode="cover"
          />
          <View
            style={{
              ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.32)',
            }}
          >
            <PlayCircle size={44} color={colors.gold} />
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      ) : message.video ? (
        <View
          style={{
            borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
            overflow: 'hidden',
            borderWidth: 1.5,
            borderColor,
            width: 240,
            aspectRatio: 16 / 9,
            backgroundColor: colors.dark,
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            gap: 8,
            padding: 16,
          }}
        >
          <PlayCircle size={32} color={colors.textMuted} />
          <Text
            style={{
              fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
              fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
              color: colors.textMuted,
              textAlign: 'center',
            }}
          >
            Still processing…
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View
          style={{
            borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
            borderWidth: 1.5,
            borderColor,
            backgroundColor: bg,
            paddingHorizontal: spacing['2xl'],
            paddingVertical: spacing.lg,
            maxWidth: 280,
          }}
        >
          <Text
            style={{
              fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
              fontSize: fontSizes.base,
              color: fg,
              lineHeight: 22,
            }}
          >
            {message.messageText ?? ''}
          </Text>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// Keep StyleSheet import for absoluteFillObject in Bubble
import { StyleSheet } from 'react-native';

function formatSentRelative(date: Date): string {
  const diffMs = Date.now() - date.getTime();
  const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60_000);
  if (diffMins < 1) return 'just now';
  if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}m ago`;
  const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMins / 60);
  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
  const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHours / 24);
  if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}d ago`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { CheckCircle, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react-native';

import { useMembership } from '@/hooks/useMembership';
import { fetchUpgradePlans, type MembershipPlan } from '@/api/membership';
import { useFamily } from '@/hooks/useFamily';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type ScreenState = 'loading' | 'plans' | 'confirming' | 'success' | 'error';

export default function UpgradeMembershipScreen() {
  const { membership, upgrade } = useMembership();
  const { family } = useFamily();

  const [state, setState] = useState<ScreenState>('loading');
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<MembershipPlan[]>([]);
  const [selectedPlanId, setSelectedPlanId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fetchError, setFetchError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const tenantId = family?.tenant_id as string | undefined;

  const loadPlans = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!membership || !tenantId) return;
    setState('loading');
    setFetchError(null);
    try {
      const result = await fetchUpgradePlans(tenantId, membership.amount_cents);
      setPlans(result);
      setState('plans');
    } catch (err) {
      setFetchError(errorMessage(err));
      setState('error');
    }
  }, [membership, tenantId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadPlans();
  }, [loadPlans]);

  const handleConfirm = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!selectedPlanId) return;
    setState('confirming');
    setSubmitError(null);
    try {
      await upgrade(selectedPlanId);
      setState('success');
    } catch (err) {
      setSubmitError(errorMessage(err));
      setState('plans');
    }
  }, [selectedPlanId, upgrade]);

  if (state === 'loading') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (state === 'error') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Couldn't load plans</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorBody}>{fetchError}</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.retryButton} onPress={loadPlans} activeOpacity={0.8}>
            <Text style={styles.retryButtonText}>Try Again</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (state === 'success') {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <CheckCircle size={56} color={colors.success} style={styles.successIcon} />
          <Text style={styles.successTitle}>Request Sent!</Text>
          <Text style={styles.successBody}>
            We've sent your upgrade request — we'll be in touch shortly to confirm the change.
          </Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const selectedPlan = plans.find(p => p.id === selectedPlanId);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <Text style={styles.heading}>Choose a Plan</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subheading}>
          Select a higher-tier plan and we'll process your upgrade request.
        </Text>

        {plans.length === 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.emptyBox}>
            <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
              No upgrade plans are available right now. Contact us to learn about your options.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          plans.map(plan => {
            const isSelected = plan.id === selectedPlanId;
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={plan.id}
                style={[styles.planCard, isSelected && styles.planCardSelected]}
                onPress={() => setSelectedPlanId(plan.id)}
                activeOpacity={0.8}
              >
                <View style={styles.planCardRow}>
                  <View style={styles.planCardMain}>
                    <Text style={styles.planName}>{plan.name}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.planPrice}>
                      ${(plan.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}/mo
                    </Text>
                    {plan.description ? (
                      <Text style={styles.planDescription}>{plan.description}</Text>
                    ) : null}
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.radioCircle, isSelected && styles.radioCircleFilled]}>
                    {isSelected && <View style={styles.radioDot} />}
                  </View>
                </View>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          })
        )}

        {submitError ? (
          <Text style={styles.submitError}>{submitError}</Text>
        ) : null}

        {plans.length > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.confirmButton,
              (!selectedPlanId || state === 'confirming') && styles.confirmButtonDisabled,
            ]}
            onPress={handleConfirm}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            disabled={!selectedPlanId || state === 'confirming'}
          >
            {state === 'confirming' ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color={colors.darkest} size="small" />
            ) : (
              <View style={styles.confirmButtonInner}>
                <Text style={styles.confirmButtonText}>
                  {selectedPlan
                    ? `Request Upgrade to ${selectedPlan.name}`
                    : 'Select a Plan to Continue'}
                </Text>
                {selectedPlanId ? (
                  <ChevronRight size={18} color={colors.darkest} />
                ) : null}
              </View>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        <Text style={styles.disclaimer}>
          This submits a request to our team. We'll reach out to confirm availability and process the change in your billing.
        </Text>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

/**
 * WaitlistClaimScreen — deep-link destination when a waitlist push arrives.
 *
 * Shows session details and a "Claim This Spot" CTA. On success navigates to
 * the booking detail for the newly-created booking. Returns CLAIM_EXPIRED
 * gracefully if the 2-hour window has passed.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute, type RouteProp } from '@react-navigation/native';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useWaitlistEntries, useClaimWaitlistSpot } from '@/hooks/useWaitlistEntries';
import type { MeStackParamList, MeStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Nav = MeStackScreenProps<'WaitlistClaim'>['navigation'];
type Route = RouteProp<MeStackParamList, 'WaitlistClaim'>;

const WEEKDAYS = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'] as const;
const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
] as const;

function formatLongDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return `${WEEKDAYS[d.getDay()]}, ${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}`;
}

function formatTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const h24 = d.getHours();
  const m = d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const period = h24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h24 % 12;
  return `${h12}:${m} ${period}`;
}

function formatTimeRange(startISO: string, endISO: string): string {
  return `${formatTime(startISO)} – ${formatTime(endISO)}`;
}

function formatDeadline(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = d.getTime() - now.getTime();
  const diffMins = Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / 60_000));
  if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins} min${diffMins !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
  const diffHrs = Math.floor(diffMins / 60);
  return `${diffHrs} hour${diffHrs !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
}

export default function WaitlistClaimScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const { waitlistId } = route.params;

  const { data: entries, isPending, isError } = useWaitlistEntries();
  const claimMutation = useClaimWaitlistSpot();

  const entry = entries?.find((e) => e.id === waitlistId) ?? null;

  const handleClaim = () => {
    claimMutation.mutate(waitlistId, {
      onSuccess: (result) => {
        if (result.code === 'OK') {
          navigation.replace('BookingDetail', { bookingId: result.booking_id });
        } else if (result.code === 'CLAIM_EXPIRED') {
          Alert.alert(
            'Spot Claimed',
            'The claim window has passed and this spot was offered to the next family on the waitlist.',
            [{ text: 'OK', onPress: () => navigation.goBack() }],
          );
        } else {
          Alert.alert('Not Available', 'This spot is no longer available.');
          navigation.goBack();
        }
      },
      onError: (err) => {
        Alert.alert('Error', errorMessage(err));
      },
    });
  };

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !entry) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Spot No Longer Available</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorMsg}>
            This waitlist spot has already been claimed or expired.
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} style={styles.backBtn}>
            <Text style={styles.backBtnText}>Go Back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const isExpired =
    entry.status !== 'notified' ||
    (entry.claim_deadline != null && new Date(entry.claim_deadline).getTime() < Date.now());

  const timeLeft = entry.claim_deadline ? formatDeadline(entry.claim_deadline) : null;
  const kidName = entry.kid
    ? `${entry.kid.first_name} ${entry.kid.last_name}`.trim()
    : 'Athlete';
  const coachName = entry.coach
    ? `Coach ${entry.coach.first_name} ${entry.coach.last_name}`.trim()
    : null;
  const locationName = entry.location?.name ?? null;
  const sessionName = entry.session_type?.name ?? 'Session';

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={styles.headerBadge}>
          <Text style={styles.headerBadgeText}>🎉 SPOT AVAILABLE</Text>
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.title}>Claim Your Spot</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          A spot opened up — tap below to confirm and lock it in for {kidName}.
        </Text>

        {/* Deadline banner */}
        {!isExpired && timeLeft ? (
          <View style={styles.deadlineBanner}>
            <Text style={styles.deadlineText}>
              ⏱ {timeLeft} remaining to claim
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Session details card */}
        <View style={styles.detailCard}>
          <DetailRow label="Session" value={sessionName} />
          <DetailRow label="Athlete" value={kidName} />
          <DetailRow label="Date" value={formatLongDate(entry.scheduled_start)} />
          <DetailRow label="Time" value={formatTimeRange(entry.scheduled_start, entry.scheduled_end)} />
          {coachName ? <DetailRow label="Coach" value={coachName} /> : null}
          {locationName ? <DetailRow label="Location" value={locationName} /> : null}
          <DetailRow label="Queue Position" value={`#${entry.position}`} />
        </View>

        {/* CTA */}
        {isExpired ? (
          <View style={styles.expiredBox}>
            <Text style={styles.expiredTitle}>Claim Window Expired</Text>
            <Text style={styles.expiredMsg}>
              This spot was passed to the next family in the queue.
            </Text>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} style={styles.backBtn}>
              <Text style={styles.backBtnText}>Go Back</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.claimBtn, claimMutation.isPending && styles.claimBtnDisabled]}
            onPress={handleClaim}
            disabled={claimMutation.isPending}
            accessibilityRole="button"
          >
            {claimMutation.isPending ? (
              <ActivityIndicator color={colors.dark} size="small" />
            ) : (
              <Text style={styles.claimBtnText}>Claim This Spot</Text>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        <Text style={styles.noChargeNote}>
          No charge — booking is confirmed immediately upon claiming.
        </Text>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function DetailRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.detailRow}>
      <Text style={styles.detailLabel}>{label}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.detailValue}>{value}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { Check, MessageCircle } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'SendVideoSuccess'>['navigation'];
type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'SendVideoSuccess'>['route'];

const AUTO_REDIRECT_MS = 2000;

export default function SendVideoSuccessScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const { coachUserId, kidId } = route.params;
  const redirected = useRef(false);

  // Auto-redirect into the thread after ~2s. The user can still tap
  // "DONE" before the timer fires; we cancel on unmount and on manual
  // navigation.
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      if (redirected.current) return;
      redirected.current = true;
      navigation.replace('MessageThread', { kidId, coachUserId });
    }, AUTO_REDIRECT_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [navigation, kidId, coachUserId]);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest }}>
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          padding: spacing['3xl'],
          gap: spacing['3xl'],
        }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            width: 80,
            height: 80,
            borderRadius: 40,
            backgroundColor: colors.gold,
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          <Check size={40} color={colors.dark} strokeWidth={3} />
        </View>
        <Text
          style={{
            color: colors.textOnDark,
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
            fontSize: fontSizes['3xl'],
            letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
          }}
        >
          SENT!
        </Text>
        <Text
          style={{
            color: colors.textLight,
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
            fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
            textAlign: 'center',
            paddingHorizontal: spacing['4xl'],
          }}
        >
          Your coach gets a push notification and an inbox card. The clip
          finishes processing in a minute or two. Opening your thread…
        </Text>
        <View style={{ width: '100%', gap: spacing['2xl'] }}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => {
              redirected.current = true;
              navigation.replace('MessageThread', { kidId, coachUserId });
            }}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                flexDirection: 'row',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                gap: spacing.base,
                backgroundColor: colors.gold,
                paddingVertical: spacing['3xl'],
                borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
              },
              pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
            ]}
          >
            <MessageCircle size={18} color={colors.dark} />
            <Text
              style={{
                color: colors.dark,
                fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
                fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
                letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
              }}
            >
              VIEW THREAD
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => {
              redirected.current = true;
              navigation.popToTop();

            style={({ pressed }) => [
              {
                paddingVertical: spacing['3xl'],

                letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
              }}

              DONE
            </Text>

=================================================================================
FILE: src/screens/SendVideoToCoach/SendVideoToCoachScreen.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * SendVideoToCoachScreen — v0.7 task #120.
 *
 * Four-step parent compose flow. Single screen, in-screen stepper.
 *
 *   Step 1 — Source:    Record / Library picker (expo-image-picker).
 *   Step 2 — Tag:       choose label (game_footage / home_practice / etc.).
 *   Step 3 — Caption:   recipient coach + free-form caption.
 *   Step 4 — Sent from: short attribution string ("Mom"). Tap Send.
 *
 * Upload pipeline mirrors the coach's RecordVideoScreen — mint an
 * Idempotency-Key, call `createMuxUpload({ purpose: 'parent_to_coach' })`,
 * PUT to Mux, then INSERT a coach_messages row via `useSendParentMessage`.
 *
 * On success we navigate to a SendVideoSuccess screen and pop the composer
 * off the stack.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Camera,
  ChevronRight,
  FolderOpen,
  Send,
  Tag,
  User as UserIcon,
} from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Linking,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { createMuxUpload } from '@/api/mux';
import { COMPOSER_LABELS, type ComposerLabel } from '@/api/parentMessages';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import {
  useSendParentMessage,
  useTenantCoachesForParent,
} from '@/hooks/useParentMessages';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';
import { uploadVideoToMux } from '@/utils/uploadVideo';
import { uuidv4 } from '@/utils/uuid';

import { styles } from './styles';

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'SendVideoToCoach'>['navigation'];
type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'SendVideoToCoach'>['route'];

type Step = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;

type PickedAsset = { uri: string; mimeType: string };

export default function SendVideoToCoachScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const initialCoachId = route.params?.coachUserId ?? null;

  const { family, kid } = useSelectedKid();
  
  const { data: coaches, isPending: coachesPending } = useTenantCoachesForParent();

  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>(1);
  const [asset, setAsset] = useState<PickedAsset | null>(null);
  const [label, setLabel] = useState<ComposerLabel | null>(null);
  const [coachId, setCoachId] = useState<string | null>(initialCoachId);
  const [caption, setCaption] = useState('');
  // Sent-from selector (Step 4). Options surface the parent's actual name
  // (from the family row), generic Mom/Dad chips so multi-parent
  // households don't have to type, and the kid's first name. The user can
  // also type a custom value via the "Other" chip + text input. We default
  // to the parent's first name when present so the common case is one tap.
  const sentFromOptions = useMemo<string[]>(() => {
    const opts: string[] = [];
    const push = (v: string | null | undefined) => {
      const trimmed = (v ?? '').trim();
      if (!trimmed) return;
      if (opts.some((o) => o.toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase())) return;
      opts.push(trimmed);
    };
    push(family?.parent_first_name);
    push('Mom');
    push('Dad');
    push(kid?.first_name);
    return opts;
  }, [family?.parent_first_name, kid?.first_name]);
  const [senderDisplay, setSenderDisplay] = useState<string>(
    family?.parent_first_name?.trim() || sentFromOptions[0] || '',
  );
  const [sentFromMode, setSentFromMode] = useState<'preset' | 'custom'>('preset');
  const [customSender, setCustomSender] = useState<string>('');
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const idemKeyRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Pre-select a coach if the picker only has one or pre-fill from route.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (coachId || !coaches) return;
    if (coaches.length === 1) setCoachId(coaches[0].userId);
  }, [coachId, coaches]);

  const sendMutation = useSendParentMessage(
    kid && coachId ? { kidId: kid.id, coachUserId: coachId } : null,
  );

  const pick = useCallback(async (source: 'camera' | 'library') => {
    if (source === 'camera') {
      const perm = await ImagePicker.requestCameraPermissionsAsync();
      if (!perm.granted) {
        Alert.alert(
          'Camera access needed',
          'Allow camera access in Settings to record a clip.',
          [
            { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
            { text: 'Open Settings', onPress: () => void Linking.openSettings() },
          ],
        );
        return;
      }
    } else {
      // Note: In Expo Go the permission dialog reads "Experience needs permissions"
      // with the Expo Go app name instead of "Ballpark". This is standard iOS
      // behaviour — production builds (EAS / App Store) show the real app name.
      // No code change is needed or possible to fix this in development.
      const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
      if (!perm.granted) {
        Alert.alert(
          'Photos access needed',
          'Allow Photos access in Settings to pick a clip.',
          [
            { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
            { text: 'Open Settings', onPress: () => void Linking.openSettings() },
          ],
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    const result =
      source === 'camera'
        ? await ImagePicker.launchCameraAsync({
            mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Videos,
            videoMaxDuration: 120,
            quality: 0.8,
          })
        : await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
            mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Videos,
            quality: 0.8,
          });
    if (result.canceled) return;
    const a = result.assets[0];
    setAsset({ uri: a.uri, mimeType: a.mimeType ?? 'video/mp4' });
    idemKeyRef.current = uuidv4();
    setStep(2);
  }, []);

  const onSend = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!asset || !kid || !family || !coachId) {
      Alert.alert('Missing info', 'Pick a video and a coach before sending.');
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    setProgress(0);
    try {
      const resolvedSender =
        (sentFromMode === 'custom' ? customSender : senderDisplay).trim() || null;
      const idemKey = idemKeyRef.current ?? uuidv4();
      idemKeyRef.current = idemKey;
      const { upload_url, video_id } = await createMuxUpload(idemKey, 'parent_to_coach');
      const { promise } = uploadVideoToMux({
        uploadUrl: upload_url,
        fileUri: asset.uri,
        contentType: asset.mimeType,
        onProgress: (f) => setProgress(f),
      });
      await promise;
      setProgress(1);

      await sendMutation.mutateAsync({
        videoId: video_id,
        recipientFamilyId: family.id,
        recipientKidId: kid.id,
        recipientCoachUserId: coachId,
        label,
        senderDisplay: resolvedSender,
        messageText: caption.trim() || null,
      });

      // Coach push fan-out is delivered server-side from `mux-webhook` once
      // the Mux asset reaches `ready` (see fanOutParentToCoachNotifications
      // in supabase/functions/mux-webhook/index.ts). We intentionally do NOT
      // call send-push-notification from the client — that endpoint requires
      // a service-role bearer the client cannot hold.

      navigation.replace('SendVideoSuccess', {
        coachUserId: coachId,
        kidId: kid.id,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Send failed', errorMessage(err));
      setSubmitting(false);
      setProgress(null);
    }
  }, [
    asset,
    kid,
    family,
    coachId,
    label,
    senderDisplay,
    sentFromMode,
    customSender,
    caption,
    sendMutation,
    navigation,
  ]);

  const stepTitle = useMemo(
    () => ({ 1: 'PICK A CLIP', 2: 'TAG IT', 3: 'CAPTION & COACH', 4: 'SENT FROM' }),
    [],
  )[step];

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.headerRow}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => (step === 1 ? navigation.goBack() : setStep(((step - 1) || 1) as Step))}
          hitSlop={12}
          accessibilityRole="button"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={22} color={colors.textOnDark} />
        </Pressable>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>{stepTitle}</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <Stepper step={step} />

      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
          {step === 1 ? (
            <View style={{ gap: spacing['2xl'] }}>
              <BigOption
                icon={<Camera size={26} color={colors.dark} />}
                label="Record a clip"
                onPress={() => pick('camera')}
                primary
              />
              <BigOption
                icon={<FolderOpen size={26} color={colors.gold} />}
                label="Choose from library"
                onPress={() => pick('library')}
              />
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {step === 2 ? (
            <View style={{ gap: spacing['2xl'] }}>
              <Text style={styles.helperText}>
                Help your coach skim their inbox at a glance.
              </Text>
              {COMPOSER_LABELS.map((opt) => (
                <Pressable
                  key={opt.value}
                  onPress={() => {
                    setLabel(opt.value);
                    setStep(3);
                  }}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.tagRow,
                    label === opt.value && styles.tagRowActive,
                    pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
                  ]}
                >
                  <Tag size={18} color={label === opt.value ? colors.dark : colors.gold} />
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      styles.tagLabel,
                      { color: label === opt.value ? colors.dark : colors.textOnDark },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {opt.label}
                  </Text>
                  <ChevronRight size={18} color={colors.textLight} />
                </Pressable>
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {step === 3 ? (
            <View style={{ gap: spacing['3xl'] }}>
              <View>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>SEND TO</Text>
                {coachesPending ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
                ) : !coaches || coaches.length === 0 ? (
                  <>
                    <Text style={styles.helperText}>
                      No coach is configured at your facility yet.
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.helperText, { marginTop: spacing.base }]}>
                      Ask your facility admin to add a coach before sending a video.
                    </Text>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <View style={{ gap: spacing.base }}>
                    {coaches.map((c) => (
                      <Pressable
                        key={c.userId}
                        onPress={() => setCoachId(c.userId)}
                        style={({ pressed }) => [
                          styles.coachRow,
                          coachId === c.userId && styles.coachRowActive,
                          pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <UserIcon
                          size={18}
                          color={coachId === c.userId ? colors.dark : colors.gold}
                        />
                        <Text
                          style={[
                            styles.coachLabel,
                            { color: coachId === c.userId ? colors.dark : colors.textOnDark },
                          ]}
                        >
                          {[c.firstName, c.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Coach'}
                        </Text>
                      </Pressable>
                    ))}
                  </View>
                )}
              </View>
              <View>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>CAPTION (OPTIONAL)</Text>
                <TextInput
                  value={caption}
                  onChangeText={setCaption}
                  multiline
                  maxLength={500}
                  placeholder="Anything you want your coach to know?"
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.textLight}
                  style={styles.textArea}
                />
              </View>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => coachId && setStep(4)}
                disabled={!coachId}
                style={({ pressed }) => [
                  styles.primaryBtn,
                  !coachId && { opacity: 0.4 },
                  coachId && pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
                ]}
              >
                <Text style={styles.primaryBtnLabel}>NEXT</Text>
                <ChevronRight size={18} color={colors.dark} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {step === 4 ? (
            <View style={{ gap: spacing['3xl'] }}>
              <Text style={styles.helperText}>
                Tell your coach who's sending — handy when more than one parent uses the
                same login. Tap a chip or pick "Other" to type a custom name.
              </Text>
              <View>
                <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>SENT FROM</Text>
                <View
                  style={{
                    flexDirection: 'row',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    gap: spacing.base,
                    marginTop: spacing.base,
                  }}
                >
                  {sentFromOptions.map((opt) => {
                    const active =
                      sentFromMode === 'preset' && senderDisplay === opt;
                    return (
                      <Pressable
                        key={opt}
                        onPress={() => {
                          setSentFromMode('preset');
                          setSenderDisplay(opt);
                        }}
                        style={({ pressed }) => [
                          styles.chip,
                          active && styles.chipActive,
                          pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
                        ]}
                        accessibilityRole="button"
                        accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
                      >
                        <Text
                          style={[
                            styles.chipLabel,
                            active && styles.chipLabelActive,
                          ]}
                        >
                          {opt}
                        </Text>
                      </Pressable>
                    );
                  })}
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => setSentFromMode('custom')}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.chip,
                      sentFromMode === 'custom' && styles.chipActive,
                      pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
                    ]}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityState={{ selected: sentFromMode === 'custom' }}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.chipLabel,
                        sentFromMode === 'custom' && styles.chipLabelActive,
                      ]}
                    >
                      Other…
                    </Text>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
                {sentFromMode === 'custom' ? (
                  <TextInput
                    value={customSender}
                    onChangeText={setCustomSender}
                    maxLength={40}
                    placeholder="Type a name (e.g. Grandpa)"
                    placeholderTextColor={colors.textLight}
                    style={[styles.textInput, { marginTop: spacing.lg }]}
                    autoFocus
                  />
                ) : null}
              </View>
              <Pressable
                onPress={onSend}
                disabled={
                  submitting ||
                  (sentFromMode === 'custom' && !customSender.trim()) ||
                  (sentFromMode === 'preset' && !senderDisplay.trim())
                }
                style={({ pressed }) => {
                  const blocked =
                    submitting ||
                    (sentFromMode === 'custom' && !customSender.trim()) ||
                    (sentFromMode === 'preset' && !senderDisplay.trim());
                  return [
                    styles.primaryBtn,
                    pressed && !blocked && { opacity: 0.85 },
                    blocked && { opacity: 0.6 },
                  ];
                }}
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color={colors.dark} />
                ) : (
                  <Send size={18} color={colors.dark} />
                )}
                <Text style={styles.primaryBtnLabel}>
                  {submitting
                    ? progress != null
                      ? `UPLOADING ${Math.round(progress * 100)}%`
                      : 'SENDING…'
                    : 'SEND TO COACH'}
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function Stepper({ step }: { step: Step }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.stepper}>
      {([1, 2, 3, 4] as Step[]).map((s) => (
        <View
          key={s}
          style={[
            styles.stepDot,
            s <= step ? styles.stepDotActive : styles.stepDotInactive,
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function BigOption({
  icon,
  label,
  onPress,
  primary,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  primary?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        {
          flexDirection: 'row',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: spacing['2xl'],
          paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
          paddingVertical: spacing['4xl'],
          borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
          borderWidth: 1,
          backgroundColor: primary ? colors.gold : 'transparent',
          borderColor: primary ? colors.gold : colors.borderGold,
        },
        pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
      ]}
    >
      {icon}
      <Text
        style={{
          fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
          fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
          letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
          color: primary ? colors.dark : colors.textOnDark,
        }}
      >
        {label.toUpperCase()}
      </Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

import { StyleSheet } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

const chipStyles = {
  paddingHorizontal: spacing['2xl'],
  paddingVertical: spacing.lg,
  borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
  borderWidth: 1,
};

export const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  headerRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  headerTitle: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
  },
  stepper: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: spacing.base,
    paddingVertical: spacing.base,
  },
  stepDot: { width: 28, height: 4, borderRadius: 2 },
  stepDotActive: { backgroundColor: colors.gold },
  stepDotInactive: { backgroundColor: colors.border },
  scroll: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'],
  },
  helperText: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    lineHeight: 20,
  },
  tagRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
