/**
 * The actual 1080x1920 artwork. Rendered with absolute pixel sizes — when
 * scaled into the on-screen preview via a Transform, every value is divided
 * proportionally so the preview is pixel-true. NEVER read from `Dimensions`
 * here, the card must be the same in both the preview AND the off-screen
 * capture render so what the parent sees is what they share.
 */

import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Star } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { Swing } from '@/api/swings';
import { colors, fontFamilies } from '@/theme';

const METRIC_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  exit_velocity_mph: 'EXIT VELO',
  launch_angle_deg: 'LAUNCH',
  distance_ft: 'DISTANCE',
  pitch_speed_mph: 'PITCH',
};
const METRIC_UNIT: Record<string, string> = {
  exit_velocity_mph: 'MPH',
  launch_angle_deg: '°',
  distance_ft: 'FT',
  pitch_speed_mph: 'MPH',
};

function fmt(v: number | null | undefined, digits = 1): string {
  if (v == null) return '—';
  return Number(v).toFixed(digits);
}

export default function ShareCardArtwork({
  kidName,
  swing,
  prMetrics,
  ageGroup,
  facilityName,
  facilityLocation,
  achievedAt,
}: {
  kidName: string;
  swing: Swing;
  prMetrics: string[];
  ageGroup: string | null;
  facilityName: string;
  facilityLocation: string | null;
  achievedAt: Date;
}) {
  const metrics: { key: keyof Swing & string }[] = [
    { key: 'exit_velocity_mph' },
    { key: 'launch_angle_deg' },
    { key: 'distance_ft' },
    { key: 'pitch_speed_mph' },
  ];
  const isPr = prMetrics.length > 0;

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        width: 1080,
        height: 1920,
        backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
      }}
    >
      <LinearGradient
        colors={[colors.darkest, colors.dark, colors.darker]}
        style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}
      />
      {/* Top brand strip */}
      <View
        style={{
          paddingHorizontal: 80,
          paddingTop: 100,
          flexDirection: 'row',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
        }}
      >
        <Text
          style={{
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
            color: colors.gold,
            fontSize: 52,
            letterSpacing: 6,
          }}
        >
          {facilityName.toUpperCase()}
        </Text>
        {isPr ? (
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: 'row',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 16,
              backgroundColor: colors.gold,
              paddingHorizontal: 36,
              paddingVertical: 18,
              borderRadius: 999,
            }}
          >
            <Star size={36} color={colors.dark} fill={colors.dark} />
            <Text
              style={{
                fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
                color: colors.dark,
                fontSize: 44,
                letterSpacing: 4,
              }}
            >
              NEW PR
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {/* Big athlete name + age group + headline */}
      <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 80, marginTop: 200 }}>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'baseline', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <Text
            style={{
              fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
              color: colors.textLight,
              fontSize: 38,
              letterSpacing: 4,
              textTransform: 'uppercase',
            }}
          >
            {kidName}
          </Text>
          {ageGroup ? (
            <Text
              style={{
                fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
                color: colors.gold,
                fontSize: 30,
                letterSpacing: 4,
                marginLeft: 24,
                textTransform: 'uppercase',
              }}
            >
              · {ageGroup}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>
        <Text
          style={{
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
            color: colors.gold,
            fontSize: isPr ? 128 : 144,
            letterSpacing: 4,
            marginTop: 12,
            lineHeight: isPr ? 144 : 160,
          }}
        >
          {isPr ? 'NEW PERSONAL BEST' : 'BIG SWING'}
        </Text>
      </View>

      {/* Hero metric — ALWAYS exit velocity with MPH subtitle. Spec keeps
          the share card layout consistent so the brand reads at a glance,
          regardless of which metric earned the PR. The 2x2 metric grid
          below highlights any other PR with a gold ribbon. */}
      <HeroExitVelocity swing={swing} />

      {/* Lower 2x2 metric grid */}
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: 'row',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          paddingHorizontal: 80,
          marginTop: 80,
        }}
      >
        {metrics.map(({ key }) => {
          const v = swing[key] as number | null;
          const isPrMetric = prMetrics.includes(key);
          const digits = key === 'launch_angle_deg' || key === 'distance_ft' ? 0 : 1;
          return (
            <View
              key={key}
              style={{
                width: '50%',
                paddingVertical: 32,
                borderTopWidth: 2,
                borderColor: 'rgba(241, 229, 173, 0.2)',
              }}
            >
              <Text
                style={{
                  fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
                  color: colors.textLight,
                  fontSize: 28,
                  letterSpacing: 3,
                }}
              >
                {METRIC_LABEL[key]}
              </Text>
              <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'baseline', marginTop: 12 }}>
                <Text
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
                    color: isPrMetric ? colors.gold : colors.textOnDark,
                    fontSize: 88,
                  }}
                >
                  {fmt(v, digits)}
                </Text>
                <Text
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldMedium,
                    color: colors.textLight,
                    fontSize: 36,
                    marginLeft: 12,
                  }}
                >
                  {METRIC_UNIT[key]}
                </Text>
                {isPrMetric ? (
                  <Star
                    size={32}
                    color={colors.gold}
                    fill={colors.gold}
                    style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}
                  />
                ) : null}
              </View>
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      {/* Footer: location (if set) + date + ballpark.app wordmark */}
      <View
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          bottom: 100,
          left: 80,
          right: 80,
          flexDirection: 'row',
          alignItems: 'flex-end',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
        }}
      >
        <View>
          {facilityLocation ? (
            <Text
              style={{
                fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
                color: colors.textLight,
                fontSize: 26,
                letterSpacing: 2,
              }}
            >
              {facilityLocation}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
          <Text
            style={{
              fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
              color: colors.textLight,
              fontSize: 26,
              letterSpacing: 2,
              marginTop: facilityLocation ? 8 : 0,
            }}
          >
            {formatDate(achievedAt)}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <Text
          style={{
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
            color: colors.gold,
            fontSize: 26,
            letterSpacing: 2,
          }}
        >
          ballpark.app
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function formatDate(d: Date): string {
  const valid = !Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? d : new Date();
  return valid
    .toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      year: 'numeric',
    })
    .toUpperCase();
}

function HeroExitVelocity({ swing }: { swing: Swing }) {
  const v = swing.exit_velocity_mph;
  return (
    <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 80, marginTop: 60 }}>
      <Text
        style={{
          fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
          color: colors.gold,
          fontSize: 32,
          letterSpacing: 4,
        }}
      >
        EXIT VELO
      </Text>
      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'baseline', marginTop: 16 }}>
        <Text
          style={{
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
            color: colors.gold,
            fontSize: 240,
            lineHeight: 240,
          }}
        >
          {fmt(v, 1)}
        </Text>
        <Text
          style={{
            fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldMedium,
            color: colors.textOnDark,
            fontSize: 72,
            marginLeft: 24,
          }}
        >
          MPH
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}


=================================================================================
FILE: src/screens/ShareCard/ShareCardScreen.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * ShareCardScreen — v0.7 task #120.
 *
 * Generates a 9:16 (1080x1920) personal-best / swing share card and lets the
 * parent share it via the OS share sheet, save it to the camera roll, or copy
 * the image to the clipboard.
 *
 * Architecture:
 *   - The card is rendered TWICE in this screen:
 *       1. visible 220px-wide preview, scaled with a Transform so the layout
 *          is identical to the export.
 *       2. off-screen full-resolution version, absolutely positioned at
 *          left=-99999 so it's measured/painted by RN but never visible.
 *     `react-native-view-shot`'s `captureRef` reads from the off-screen view
 *     so the user always exports the full 1080x1920 PNG regardless of how
 *     small the preview is.
 *   - Sharing uses `expo-sharing` (which handles the iOS share sheet & the
 *     Android intent). Save to camera roll uses `expo-media-library`. Copy
 *     uses `expo-clipboard.setImageAsync`. All three are best-effort with
 *     friendly Alerts on failure.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import * as Clipboard from 'expo-clipboard';
import * as MediaLibrary from 'expo-media-library';
import * as Sharing from 'expo-sharing';
import { Copy, Download, Instagram, MessageSquare, MoreHorizontal, Music2, Smartphone, X } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { captureRef } from 'react-native-view-shot';

import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { usePersonalBestsForKid, useSwing } from '@/hooks/useSwings';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

import ShareCardArtwork from './components/ShareCardArtwork';
import { styles } from './styles';

type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'ShareCard'>['route'];
type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'ShareCard'>['navigation'];

const PREVIEW_WIDTH = 220;
const FULL_WIDTH = 1080;
const FULL_HEIGHT = 1920;

export default function ShareCardScreen() {
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { swingId } = route.params;
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  

  const { data: swing, isPending, isError, error } = useSwing(swingId);
  const { data: prs } = usePersonalBestsForKid(kid?.id);

  const captureContainerRef = useRef<View>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<
    null | 'instagram' | 'tiktok' | 'message' | 'more' | 'save' | 'copy'
  >(null);

  const capture = useCallback(async (): Promise<string> => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') throw new Error('Capture not supported on web.');
    if (!captureContainerRef.current) {
      throw new Error('Card not ready yet — try again.');
    }
    return await captureRef(captureContainerRef.current, {
      width: FULL_WIDTH,
      height: FULL_HEIGHT,
      format: 'png',
      quality: 1,
      result: 'tmpfile',
    });
  }, []);

  // Best-effort: try a native deep link to the destination app first; if
  // the device has no handler (or expo-sharing fails), fall back to the OS
  // share sheet so the user always lands on a working flow.
  const shareViaSheet = useCallback(
    async (uri: string, dialogTitle: string) => {
      const available = await Sharing.isAvailableAsync();
      if (!available) {
        Alert.alert('Sharing unavailable', 'This device does not expose a share sheet.');
        return;
      }
      await Sharing.shareAsync(uri, { mimeType: 'image/png', dialogTitle });
    },
    [],
  );

  // All four primary buttons go through the OS share sheet so the
  // generated PNG is ALWAYS attached. The four labels are user hints
  // about the intended destination — the share sheet itself surfaces
  // Instagram, TikTok, Messages, etc. as targets when the corresponding
  // apps are installed. We deliberately do NOT short-circuit with a deep
  // link (e.g. `instagram-stories://`), because those deep links open
  // the destination app WITHOUT the image, defeating the share action.
  const onInstagram = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy('instagram');
    try {
      const uri = await capture();
      await shareViaSheet(uri, 'Share to Instagram');
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not share', errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }, [capture, shareViaSheet]);

  const onTikTok = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy('tiktok');
    try {
      const uri = await capture();
      await shareViaSheet(uri, 'Share to TikTok');
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not share', errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }, [capture, shareViaSheet]);

  const onMessage = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy('message');
    try {
      const uri = await capture();
      await shareViaSheet(uri, 'Send via Messages');
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not share', errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }, [capture, shareViaSheet]);

  const onMore = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy('more');
    try {
      const uri = await capture();
      await shareViaSheet(uri, 'Share PR');
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not share', errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }, [capture, shareViaSheet]);

  const onSave = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy('save');
    try {
      const perm = await MediaLibrary.requestPermissionsAsync();
      if (!perm.granted) {
        Alert.alert(
          'Photos access needed',
          'Allow Photos access in Settings to save the share card to your camera roll.',
        );
        return;
      }
      const uri = await capture();
      await MediaLibrary.saveToLibraryAsync(uri);
      Alert.alert('Saved', 'Share card saved to your camera roll.');
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not save', errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }, [capture]);

  const onCopy = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy('copy');
    try {
      const uri = await capture();
      // expo-clipboard expects a base64 string for setImageAsync.
      // We re-read the captured tmpfile via the React Native fetch + blob path
      // (works in Expo Go without extra deps).
      const res = await fetch(uri);
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const reader = new FileReader();
      const b64: string = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        reader.onload = () => {
          const dataUrl = reader.result as string;
          const idx = dataUrl.indexOf(',');
          resolve(idx >= 0 ? dataUrl.slice(idx + 1) : dataUrl);
        };
        reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error ?? new Error('Read failed'));
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
      });
      await Clipboard.setImageAsync(b64);
      Alert.alert('Copied', 'Share card copied — paste into any chat or email.');
    } catch (err) {
      Alert.alert('Could not copy', errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }, [capture]);

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }
  if (isError || !swing) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorText}>
            {isError ? errorMessage(error) : 'Swing not found'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const prMatches = (prs ?? []).filter((p) => p.swing_id === swing.id);
  const kidName = kid ? `${kid.first_name}` : 'Athlete';
  const previewScale = PREVIEW_WIDTH / FULL_WIDTH;
  const ageGroup = (kid?.age_group ?? null) as string | null;
  // v0.7 ships with a single tenant (Infinite Hitting). Once the tenant
  // row is fetched per-user we'll thread it through here.
  const facilityName = 'Infinite Hitting';
  const facilityLocation: string | null = null;
  const achievedAt = new Date(swing.created_at);
  const cardProps = {
    kidName,
    swing,
    prMetrics: prMatches.map((p) => p.metric),
    ageGroup,
    facilityName,
    facilityLocation,
    achievedAt,
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.headerRow}>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>SHARE CARD</Text>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          hitSlop={12}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Close"
        >
          <X size={22} color={colors.textOnDark} />
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}>
        <View style={styles.previewWrap}>
          <View
            style={{
              width: PREVIEW_WIDTH,
              height: PREVIEW_WIDTH * (FULL_HEIGHT / FULL_WIDTH),
              overflow: 'hidden',
              borderRadius: 18,
            }}
          >
            <View
              style={{
                width: FULL_WIDTH,
                height: FULL_HEIGHT,
                transform: [
                  { translateX: -((FULL_WIDTH - PREVIEW_WIDTH) / 2) },
                  { translateY: -((FULL_HEIGHT - PREVIEW_WIDTH * (FULL_HEIGHT / FULL_WIDTH)) / 2) },
                  { scale: previewScale },
                ],
              }}
            >
              <ShareCardArtwork {...cardProps} />
            </View>
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.previewCaption}>1080 x 1920 — ready for stories.</Text>
        </View>

        {Platform.OS === 'web' ? (
          <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 24, paddingHorizontal: 24 }}>
            <Smartphone size={28} color={colors.textMuted} />
            <Text
              style={{
                marginTop: 12,
                fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
                fontSize: 14,
                color: colors.textMuted,
                textAlign: 'center',
                lineHeight: 20,
              }}
            >
              Sharing and saving are available in the{'\n'}Ballpark app on your phone.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Primary destinations — IG / TikTok / Message / More. Each tries
                the platform's deep link first and falls back to the OS share
                sheet so the destination is always reachable. */}
            <View style={styles.primaryGrid}>
              <PrimaryAction
                icon={<Instagram size={22} color={colors.gold} />}
                label="Instagram"
                onPress={onInstagram}
                busy={busy === 'instagram'}
                disabled={busy !== null}
              />
              <PrimaryAction
                icon={<Music2 size={22} color={colors.gold} />}
                label="TikTok"
                onPress={onTikTok}
                busy={busy === 'tiktok'}
                disabled={busy !== null}
              />
              <PrimaryAction
                icon={<MessageSquare size={22} color={colors.gold} />}
                label="Message"
                onPress={onMessage}
                busy={busy === 'message'}
                disabled={busy !== null}
              />
              <PrimaryAction
                icon={<MoreHorizontal size={22} color={colors.gold} />}
                label="More"
                onPress={onMore}
                busy={busy === 'more'}
                disabled={busy !== null}
              />
            </View>

            <View style={styles.actions}>
              <ActionRow
                icon={<Download size={18} color={colors.gold} />}
                label="Save to Photos"
                onPress={onSave}
                busy={busy === 'save'}
                disabled={busy !== null}
              />
              <ActionRow
                icon={<Copy size={18} color={colors.gold} />}
                label="Copy image"
                onPress={onCopy}
                busy={busy === 'copy'}
                disabled={busy !== null}
              />
            </View>
          </>
        )}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Off-screen full-resolution capture target — native only. */}
      {Platform.OS !== 'web' && (
        <View
          ref={captureContainerRef}
          collapsable={false}
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            left: -99999,
            top: 0,
            width: FULL_WIDTH,
            height: FULL_HEIGHT,
          }}
        >
          <ShareCardArtwork {...cardProps} />
        </View>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function PrimaryAction({
  icon,
  label,
  onPress,
  busy,
  disabled,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  busy: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={disabled}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.primaryTile,
        pressed && !disabled && styles.actionRowPressed,
        disabled && { opacity: 0.6 },
      ]}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={label}
    >
      {busy ? <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} /> : icon}
      <Text
        style={{
          fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
          fontSize: 12,
          letterSpacing: 1,
          color: colors.gold,
          marginTop: 8,
        }}
      >
        {label.toUpperCase()}
      </Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

function ActionRow({
  icon,
  label,
  onPress,
  primary,
  busy,
  disabled,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  primary?: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={disabled}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.actionRow,
        primary ? styles.actionRowPrimary : styles.actionRowSecondary,
        pressed && !disabled && styles.actionRowPressed,
        disabled && { opacity: 0.6 },
      ]}
    >
      {busy ? (
        <ActivityIndicator color={primary ? colors.dark : colors.gold} />
      ) : (
        icon
      )}
      <Text
        style={[
          { fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold, fontSize: 16, letterSpacing: 1 },
          { color: primary ? colors.dark : colors.gold },
        ]}
      >
        {label.toUpperCase()}
      </Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

/**
 * Training video player (v0.7 task #121).
 *
 * Hero 16:9 Mux player + breadcrumb + metadata strip. Mirrors the
 * pattern in `VideoPlaybackScreen` (expo-av, useNativeControls, no
 * audio mode override). Adds:
 *   - Resume from AsyncStorage `training_progress` map (if a non-zero
 *     last position exists for this kid + video).
 *   - Throttled write of last position back to AsyncStorage every
 *     ~3 seconds during playback.
 *   - One-shot `record_training_view` RPC fire on first real
 *     playback start, gated by a useRef so a burst of expo-av status
 *     ticks only fires it once per mount.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { ResizeMode, Video, type AVPlaybackStatus } from 'expo-av';
import { ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { TRAINING_CATEGORIES } from '@/api/trainingVideos';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { useRecordTrainingView, useTrainingVideo } from '@/hooks/useTrainingVideos';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { readProgress, writeProgress } from '@/store/trainingProgress';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'TrainingVideoPlayer'>['navigation'];
type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'TrainingVideoPlayer'>['route'];

function muxHlsUrl(id: string): string {
  return `https://stream.mux.com/${id}.m3u8`;
}

function categoryLabel(cat: string): string {
  return TRAINING_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.value === cat)?.label ?? cat;
}

function fmtDuration(sec: number | null): string {
  if (!sec || sec <= 0) return '—';
  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = sec % 60;
  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export default function TrainingVideoPlayerScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const { videoId } = route.params;
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  

  const { data: video, isPending, error } = useTrainingVideo(videoId);
  const recordView = useRecordTrainingView();

  const videoRef = useRef<Video | null>(null);
  const viewMarkedRef = useRef(false);
  const lastWriteRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastPosRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastDurRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const seekedRef = useRef(false);
  const [resumeFrom, setResumeFrom] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Read the last saved position once when the screen mounts.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      if (!kid) return;
      const map = await readProgress(kid.id);
      const cur = map[videoId];
      if (!cancelled && cur && cur.positionSec > 5) setResumeFrom(cur.positionSec);
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [kid, videoId]);

  // Save the last position when the screen unmounts so we always
  // capture where the kid actually left off (the throttle in
  // onStatusUpdate may have skipped the very last tick).
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (kid && lastPosRef.current > 0) {
        void writeProgress(
          kid.id,
          videoId,
          lastPosRef.current,
          lastDurRef.current,
        );
      }
    };
  }, [kid, videoId]);

  const onStatusUpdate = useCallback(
    (status: AVPlaybackStatus) => {
      if (!status.isLoaded) return;

      // First successful position read: seek to resume point if set.
      if (!seekedRef.current && resumeFrom != null) {
        seekedRef.current = true;
        // expo-av seek is in millis.
        videoRef.current
          ?.setPositionAsync(resumeFrom * 1000, {
            toleranceMillisBefore: 0,
            toleranceMillisAfter: 0,
          })
          .catch(() => undefined);
      }

      const posSec = (status.positionMillis ?? 0) / 1000;
      const durSec =
        status.durationMillis != null ? status.durationMillis / 1000 : null;
      lastPosRef.current = posSec;
      lastDurRef.current = durSec;

      // Fire the view RPC on the first real playback tick.
      if (!viewMarkedRef.current && kid) {
        if (status.isPlaying || posSec > 0) {
          viewMarkedRef.current = true;
          recordView.mutate(
            { videoId, kidId: kid.id },
            {
              onError: (err) => {
                // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
                console.warn('record_training_view failed:', errorMessage(err));
              },
            },
          );
        }
      }

      // Throttle position writes to ~once every 3 seconds.
      const now = Date.now();
      if (kid && status.isPlaying && now - lastWriteRef.current > 3000) {
        lastWriteRef.current = now;
        void writeProgress(kid.id, videoId, posSec, durSec);
      }
    },
    [kid, recordView, resumeFrom, videoId],
  );

  const goBack = useCallback(() => {
    if (navigation.canGoBack()) navigation.goBack();
  }, [navigation]);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.headerRow}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={goBack}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Back to Train"
          style={({ pressed }) => [styles.backBtn, pressed && { opacity: 0.7 }]}
        >
          <ChevronLeft size={22} color={colors.gold} />
        </Pressable>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Train</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 36 }} />
      </View>

      {isPending ? (
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : error || !video ? (
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Couldn&rsquo;t load video</Text>
          <Text style={styles.errorBody}>
            {error ? errorMessage(error) : 'This video may have been removed.'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}>
          <View style={styles.heroBox}>
            <Video
              ref={(r) => {
                videoRef.current = r;
              }}
              style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
              source={{ uri: muxHlsUrl(video.muxPlaybackId) }}
              resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN}
              shouldPlay
              useNativeControls
              onPlaybackStatusUpdate={onStatusUpdate}
            />
          </View>

          <Text style={styles.crumb}>
            {categoryLabel(video.category).toUpperCase()} · {video.level.toUpperCase()}
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.title}>{video.title}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.meta}>
            {fmtDuration(video.durationSec)}
            {video.coachName ? `  ·  ${video.coachName}` : ''}
            {`  ·  ${video.viewCount.toLocaleString()} views`}
          </Text>
          {video.description ? (
            <Text style={styles.body}>{video.description}</Text>
          ) : null}
        </ScrollView>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  headerRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['2xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing.lg,
  },
  backBtn: {
    width: 36,
    height: 36,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  headerTitle: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  scroll: { paddingBottom: spacing['7xl'] },
  heroBox: {
    width: '100%',
    aspectRatio: 16 / 9,
    backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
  },
  crumb: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingTop: spacing['3xl'],
  },
  title: {
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['2xl'],
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],

  },

FILE: src/screens/VideoPlayback/VideoPlaybackScreen.tsx

/**
 * Video Playback screen (v0.4 Step 4.13).
 *
 * Full-screen Mux HLS player for a single coach_message. Registered in
 * both HomeStackNavigator and WorkStackNavigator so the X button always
 * returns to whichever tab the user came from.
 *
 * Overlay logic (three-layer guard):
 *   1. `videoReady` — false until onReadyForDisplay fires (actual pixels on
 *      screen). Prevents the "black screen + timer running" bug where the
 *      AVPlayerLayer is playing audio but hasn't painted a frame yet.
 *   2. `isBuffering` — from onPlaybackStatusUpdate. Safety timeout re-arms
 *      on every buffering event so replay after finish never gets stuck.
 *   3. `BUFFERING_TIMEOUT_MS` safety — force-clears both guards if no event
 *      arrives within 8 s (slow HLS manifest / cold start / iOS quirks).
 *
 * key={messageId} on <Video> forces a fresh AVPlayer native instance each
 * time the screen is opened so a previously-stale layer can't cause a
 * black-screen repro on the second open.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute, type RouteProp } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { ResizeMode, Video, type AVPlaybackStatus } from 'expo-av';
import { X } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { markCoachMessageViewed } from '@/api/coachMessages';
import { useCoachMessage } from '@/hooks/useCoachMessage';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type VideoPlaybackParams = { messageId: string };
type Route = RouteProp<{ VideoPlayback: VideoPlaybackParams }, 'VideoPlayback'>;

const BUFFERING_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;

function muxHlsUrl(playbackId: string): string {
  return `https://stream.mux.com/${playbackId}.m3u8`;
}

function CloseButton({ onPress, topInset }: { onPress: () => void; topInset: number }) {
  return (
    <View
      pointerEvents="box-none"
      style={[styles.closeOverlay, { top: topInset }]}
    >
      <Pressable
        onPress={onPress}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel="Close video"
        hitSlop={16}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.closeButton,
          pressed && styles.closePressed,
        ]}
      >
        <X size={22} color={colors.gold} />
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

export default function VideoPlaybackScreen() {
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { messageId } = route.params;

  const qc = useQueryClient();

  const { data: message, isPending, error } = useCoachMessage(messageId, {
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      const d = query.state.data as { video?: { status?: string } | null } | null | undefined;
      if (d && d.video && d.video.status === 'processing') return 3000;
      return false;
    },
  });

  // videoReady: true once onReadyForDisplay fires (actual pixels painted).
  // Starts false — overlay stays on until AVPlayerLayer has real frames.
  const [videoReady, setVideoReady] = useState(false);
  // isBuffering: mirrors the native player's buffering state.
  // Starts false because the overlay is already covered by !videoReady.
  const [isBuffering, setIsBuffering] = useState(false);

  const bufferTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const markedRef = useRef(false);

  // Re-usable helper: arm (or re-arm) the safety timeout.
  // Called on initial video-ready and on every subsequent buffering event
  // so replay after finish never produces a permanently-stuck spinner.
  const armSafetyTimeout = useCallback(() => {
    if (bufferTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(bufferTimerRef.current);
    bufferTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setVideoReady(true);
      setIsBuffering(false);
    }, BUFFERING_TIMEOUT_MS);
  }, []);

  const clearSafetyTimeout = useCallback(() => {
    if (bufferTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(bufferTimerRef.current);
      bufferTimerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  // Arm the initial safety timeout as soon as the video row is ready.
  // Cleanup on unmount (or when message changes during processing-poll).
  useEffect(() => {
    const video = (message as { video?: { status?: string; muxPlaybackId?: string } | null } | null)?.video;
    if (!video || video.status !== 'ready' || !video.muxPlaybackId) return;
    armSafetyTimeout();
    return () => clearSafetyTimeout();
  }, [message, armSafetyTimeout, clearSafetyTimeout]);

  // Invalidate the Home card cache on unmount.
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['coachMessages', 'latest'] });
    };
  }, [qc]);

  // onReadyForDisplay fires when AVPlayerLayer has painted the first frame.
  // This is the right signal to hide the "black screen" overlay — NOT the
  // first isBuffering=false event, which can arrive before pixels show.
  const onReadyForDisplay = useCallback(() => {
    setVideoReady(true);
    clearSafetyTimeout();
  }, [clearSafetyTimeout]);

  const onStatusUpdate = useCallback(
    (status: AVPlaybackStatus) => {
      if (!status.isLoaded) return;

      if (status.didJustFinish) {
        // Video reached the end. Clear overlay so replay is clean.
        setIsBuffering(false);
        clearSafetyTimeout();
      } else if (status.isBuffering) {
        // Mid-playback buffer stall OR replay-seek buffer.
        // Re-arm the safety timeout so we never get permanently stuck.
        setIsBuffering(true);
        armSafetyTimeout();
      } else {
        setIsBuffering(false);
        clearSafetyTimeout();
      }

      // Mark-viewed guard (fires at most once per mount).
      if (markedRef.current) return;
      if (status.isPlaying || (status.positionMillis ?? 0) > 0) {
        markedRef.current = true;
        markViewed.mutate();
      }
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [armSafetyTimeout, clearSafetyTimeout],
  );

  const markViewed = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => markCoachMessageViewed(messageId),
    onError: (err) => {
      console.warn('markCoachMessageViewed failed:', errorMessage(err));
    },
  });

  const goBack = useCallback(() => {
    if (navigation.canGoBack()) navigation.goBack();
  }, [navigation]);

  // fullScreenModal on iOS can return insets.top=0 — enforce a minimum so
  // the X button always clears the status bar clock on every device.
  const topInset = Math.max(insets.top, 50);

  // Overlay is visible when AVPlayer hasn't painted frames yet OR is
  // mid-buffer stall. Both guards must be clear before we hide it.
  const showOverlay = !videoReady || isBuffering;

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.fill}>
        <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        <CloseButton onPress={goBack} topInset={topInset} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.messageWrap}>
        <Text style={styles.messageTitle}>Couldn't load video</Text>
        <Text style={styles.messageBody}>{errorMessage(error)}</Text>
        <CloseButton onPress={goBack} topInset={topInset} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!message) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.messageWrap}>
        <Text style={styles.messageTitle}>Video not found</Text>
        <Text style={styles.messageBody}>
          This message may have been removed.
        </Text>
        <CloseButton onPress={goBack} topInset={topInset} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  const video = message.video;

  if (video?.status === 'errored') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.messageWrap}>
        <Text style={styles.messageTitle}>This video couldn't be processed</Text>
        <Text style={styles.messageBody}>
          Your coach will need to re-record and send this one again.
        </Text>
        <CloseButton onPress={goBack} topInset={topInset} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!video || !video.muxPlaybackId) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.messageWrap}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={colors.gold} style={styles.processingSpinner} />
        <Text style={styles.messageTitle}>Getting video ready…</Text>
        <Text style={styles.messageBody}>
          Your video is on its way — this usually takes under a minute.
        </Text>
        <CloseButton onPress={goBack} topInset={topInset} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.fill}>
      {/*
       * key={messageId} forces a fresh AVPlayer native instance every time
       * this screen is opened, preventing stale-layer black-screen repros.
       */}
      <Video
        key={messageId}
        style={styles.video}
        source={{ uri: muxHlsUrl(video.muxPlaybackId) }}
        resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN}
        shouldPlay
        useNativeControls
        onReadyForDisplay={onReadyForDisplay}
        onPlaybackStatusUpdate={onStatusUpdate}
      />
      {showOverlay && (
        <View style={styles.bufferOverlay}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      )}
      <CloseButton onPress={goBack} topInset={topInset} />
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  fill: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  video: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
  },
  bufferOverlay: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
  },
  closeOverlay: {
    position: 'absolute',
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    zIndex: 999,
    elevation: 999,
  },
  closeButton: {
    margin: spacing.md,
    width: 44,
    height: 44,
    borderRadius: 22,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 14, 14, 0.72)',
  },
  closePressed: {
    opacity: 0.7,
  },
  messageWrap: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: colors.darkest,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['4xl'],
    gap: spacing.md,
  },
  processingSpinner: {
    marginBottom: spacing.lg,
  },
  messageTitle: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
    color: colors.gold,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  messageBody: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
});

/**
 * SessionGroupCard — one row in the Videos → Swings (BY SESSION) list.
 * Tapping pushes SessionDetail. Header shows the session date + headline
 * stats; below it a horizontal preview strip of the first few swings.
 */

import { ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { Session } from '@/api/sessions';
import type { Swing } from '@/api/swings';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

import SwingThumbnail from './SwingThumbnail';

type Props = {
  session: Session;
  previewSwings: Swing[];
  favorites: Set<string>;
  onPressSession: () => void;
  onPressSwing: (swingId: string) => void;
};

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

function formatTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  return d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' });
}

export default function SessionGroupCard({
  session,
  previewSwings,
  favorites,
  onPressSession,
  onPressSwing,
}: Props) {
  const top = previewSwings.slice(0, 3);
  return (
    <View style={styles.wrap}>
      <Pressable
        onPress={onPressSession}
        style={({ pressed }) => [styles.header, pressed && styles.pressed]}
      >
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Text style={styles.date}>{formatDate(session.started_at).toUpperCase()}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
            {formatTime(session.started_at)} · {session.swing_count ?? 0} swings
            {session.best_exit_velocity_mph != null
              ? `  ·  TOP ${Number(session.best_exit_velocity_mph).toFixed(1)} MPH`
              : ''}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <ChevronRight size={18} color={colors.textLight} />
      </Pressable>
      {top.length > 0 ? (
        <View style={styles.previewRow}>
          {top.map((s) => (
            <View key={s.id} style={styles.previewCell}>
              <SwingThumbnail
                swing={s}
                favorited={favorites.has(s.id)}
                onPress={() => onPressSwing(s.id)}
              />
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrap: {
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderRadius: radius['3xl'],
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    padding: spacing['2xl'],
    marginBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  pressed: { opacity: 0.85 },
  date: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  subtitle: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    marginTop: spacing.xxs,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  previewRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: spacing.lg,
  },
  previewCell: { flex: 1 },
});

/**
 * StatsBar — header strip used on Videos (kid totals) and Session Detail
 * (single-session totals). Three slots; pass `null` to render an em-dash.
 */

import { StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Stat = { label: string; value: string };

export default function StatsBar({ stats }: { stats: Stat[] }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.row}>
      {stats.map((s, i) => (
        <View key={s.label} style={[styles.cell, i > 0 && styles.cellBorder]}>
          <Text style={styles.value}>{s.value}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.label}>{s.label}</Text>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    paddingVertical: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  cell: { flex: 1, alignItems: 'center' },
  cellBorder: { borderLeftWidth: 1, borderLeftColor: colors.border },
  value: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['2xl'],
  },
  label: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    marginTop: spacing.xxs,
  },
});

import { StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';

import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

export type VideosSubTabKey = 'swings' | 'homework' | 'messages' | 'favorites';

const TABS: { key: VideosSubTabKey; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'swings', label: 'Swings' },
  { key: 'homework', label: 'Homework' },
  { key: 'messages', label: 'Messages' },
  { key: 'favorites', label: 'Favorites' },
];

export default function SubTabBar({
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: VideosSubTabKey;
  onChange: (k: VideosSubTabKey) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.bar}>
      {TABS.map((t) => {
        const active = t.key === value;
        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={t.key}
            onPress={() => onChange(t.key)}
            style={[styles.pill, active && styles.pillActive]}
            accessibilityRole="tab"
            accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.pillText, active && styles.pillTextActive]}>{t.label}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  bar: {
    flexDirection: 'row',

    flex: 1,

/**
 * SwingThumbnail — single 3:4 tile rendered inside the Videos grids and
 * the Session Detail screen.
 *
 * Anatomy (per task #119 spec):
 *   - dark background (per-swing Mux clip ships in a future task; until
 *     then we render a centered Play icon over a gradient backdrop).
 *   - PR variant: gold gradient backdrop + "PR" pip top-left.
 *   - Heart pip top-right when favorited.
 *   - Bottom metric strip: Exit velo / Launch / Distance.
 */

import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Heart, Play, Star } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { Swing } from '@/api/swings';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  swing: Swing;
  favorited?: boolean;
  onPress: () => void;
};

function fmt1(v: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (v == null) return '—';
  return Number(v).toFixed(1);
}
function fmt0(v: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (v == null) return '—';
  return String(Math.round(Number(v)));
}

export default function SwingThumbnail({ swing, favorited, onPress }: Props) {
  const isPr = !!swing.is_personal_best;
  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.card,
        isPr && styles.cardPr,
        pressed && styles.pressed,
      ]}
    >
      <LinearGradient
        colors={
          isPr
            ? ['rgba(241, 229, 173, 0.35)', 'rgba(184, 162, 104, 0.55)']
            : [colors.dark, colors.darker]
        }
        style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
      />
      <View style={styles.playWrap} pointerEvents="none">
        <View style={[styles.playCircle, isPr && styles.playCirclePr]}>
          <Play
            size={20}
            color={isPr ? colors.dark : colors.gold}
            fill={isPr ? colors.dark : colors.gold}
          />
        </View>
      </View>
      {isPr ? (
        <View style={styles.prPip}>
          <Star size={10} color={colors.dark} fill={colors.dark} />
          <Text style={styles.prText}>PR</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {favorited ? (
        <View style={styles.heart}>
          <Heart size={12} color={colors.gold} fill={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <View style={styles.metricStrip}>
        <Metric label="EV" value={fmt1(swing.exit_velocity_mph)} pr={isPr} />
        <Metric label="LA" value={fmt0(swing.launch_angle_deg)} pr={isPr} />
        <Metric label="DIST" value={fmt0(swing.distance_ft)} pr={isPr} />
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

function Metric({ label, value, pr }: { label: string; value: string; pr: boolean }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.metricCell}>
      <Text style={[styles.metricVal, pr && styles.metricValPr]}>{value}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.metricLabel}>{label}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    aspectRatio: 3 / 4,
    borderRadius: radius.xl,
    overflow: 'hidden',
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    justifyContent: 'flex-end',
  },
  cardPr: { borderColor: colors.gold },
  pressed: { opacity: 0.85 },
  playWrap: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  playCircle: {
    width: 36,
    height: 36,
    borderRadius: 18,
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 14, 14, 0.55)',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  playCirclePr: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(241, 229, 173, 0.95)' },
  prPip: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: spacing.base,
    left: spacing.base,
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.xxs,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.base,
    paddingVertical: spacing.xxs,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    backgroundColor: colors.gold,
  },
  prText: {
    color: colors.dark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  heart: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: spacing.base,
    right: spacing.base,
  },
  metricStrip: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'flex-end',
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.base,
    paddingVertical: spacing.base,
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 14, 14, 0.55)',
  },
  metricCell: { alignItems: 'center', flex: 1 },
  metricVal: {
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.lg,
  },
  metricValPr: { color: colors.gold },
  metricLabel: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xs,

/**
 * SessionDetailScreen — task #119.
 *
 * Header = StatsBar (Swings / Avg / Best / PRs). Filter pills below it
 * (All / PRs / Best / Contact) narrow the 4-column swing grid. Tapping a
 * swing tile pushes Swing Detail.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { ZapOff } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import type { Swing } from '@/api/swings';
import {
  useFavoriteSwingIds,
  useSession,
  useSwingsForSession,
} from '@/hooks/useSwings';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

import EmptyState from './components/EmptyState';
import StatsBar from './components/StatsBar';
import SwingThumbnail from './components/SwingThumbnail';

type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'SessionDetail'>['route'];
type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'SessionDetail'>['navigation'];

type FilterKey = 'all' | 'pr' | 'best' | 'contact';
const FILTERS: { key: FilterKey; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { key: 'pr', label: 'PRs' },
  { key: 'best', label: 'Best' },
  { key: 'contact', label: 'Contact' },
];

// "Best" = the top quartile by exit velocity. We compute a threshold over
// the session set and pass swings whose exit velo lies above it. "Contact"
// = swings whose `result` indicates clean contact (HitTrax stores values
// like 'line_drive', 'fly_ball', 'ground_ball', 'hit', 'hr', 'foul', 'miss').
// We treat anything that ISN'T a 'miss' / 'foul' / 'whiff' as contact.
function pctile(arr: number[], p: number): number | null {
  if (arr.length === 0) return null;
  const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const idx = Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(p * sorted.length));
  return sorted[idx];
}

const NON_CONTACT = new Set(['miss', 'foul', 'whiff', 'swing_and_miss']);

export default function SessionDetailScreen() {
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { sessionId } = route.params;

  const { data: session, isPending: sessionPending, isError, error } = useSession(sessionId);
  const { data: swings, isPending: swingsPending } = useSwingsForSession(sessionId);
  const { data: favorites } = useFavoriteSwingIds();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterKey>('all');

  const allSwings = swings ?? [];
  const bestThreshold = useMemo(
    () =>
      pctile(
        allSwings.map((s) => s.exit_velocity_mph).filter((v): v is number => v != null),
        0.75,
      ),
    [allSwings],
  );

  const filtered: Swing[] = useMemo(() => {
    switch (filter) {
      case 'pr':
        return allSwings.filter((s) => s.is_personal_best);
      case 'best':
        if (bestThreshold == null) return [];
        return allSwings.filter(
          (s) => s.exit_velocity_mph != null && s.exit_velocity_mph >= bestThreshold,
        );
      case 'contact':
        return allSwings.filter(
          (s) => s.result != null && !NON_CONTACT.has(s.result.toLowerCase()),
        );
      case 'all':
      default:
        return allSwings;
    }
  }, [allSwings, filter, bestThreshold]);

  if (sessionPending || swingsPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !session) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorText}>{isError ? errorMessage(error) : 'Session not found'}</Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const date = new Date(session.started_at);
  const dateLabel = Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ? ''
    : date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'long', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  const favSet = favorites ?? new Set<string>();
  const prCount = allSwings.filter((s) => s.is_personal_best).length;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.headerWrap}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>{dateLabel.toUpperCase()}</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.statsWrap}>
        <StatsBar
          stats={[
            { label: 'Swings', value: String(session.swing_count ?? allSwings.length) },
            {
              label: 'Avg mph',
              value:
                session.avg_exit_velocity_mph != null
                  ? Number(session.avg_exit_velocity_mph).toFixed(1)
                  : '—',
            },
            {
              label: 'Best mph',
              value:
                session.best_exit_velocity_mph != null
                  ? Number(session.best_exit_velocity_mph).toFixed(1)
                  : '—',
            },
            { label: 'PRs', value: String(prCount) },
          ]}
        />
      </View>

      <View style={styles.filterRow}>
        {FILTERS.map((f) => {
          const active = f.key === filter;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={f.key}
              onPress={() => setFilter(f.key)}
              style={[styles.filterPill, active && styles.filterPillActive]}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.filterText, active && styles.filterTextActive]}>
                {f.label.toUpperCase()}
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={<ZapOff size={26} color={colors.gold} />}
          title={
            filter === 'all'
              ? 'No swings in this session'
              : `No ${FILTERS.find((f) => f.key === filter)?.label.toLowerCase()} swings`
          }
          body={
            filter === 'all'
              ? 'HitTrax may still be syncing — pull to refresh in a moment.'
              : 'Try a different filter.'
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={filtered}
          keyExtractor={(s) => s.id}
          numColumns={4}
          columnWrapperStyle={styles.gridRow}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.gridContent}
          renderItem={({ item }) => (
            <View style={styles.gridCell}>
              <SwingThumbnail
                swing={item}
                favorited={favSet.has(item.id)}
                onPress={() => navigation.navigate('SwingDetail', { swingId: item.id })}
              />
            </View>
          )}
        />
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  headerWrap: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingTop: spacing['2xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  title: {
    color: colors.gold,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['2xl'],
  },
  statsWrap: { paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'], marginBottom: spacing['2xl'] },
  filterRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: spacing.base,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    marginBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  filterPill: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['2xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing.base,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
  },
  filterPillActive: { backgroundColor: colors.gold, borderColor: colors.gold },
  filterText: {
    color: colors.textLight,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    letterSpacing: tracking.wide,
  },
  filterTextActive: { color: colors.dark },
  centered: { flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  errorText: {
    color: colors.danger,
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  gridContent: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'],
  },
  gridRow: { gap: spacing.base, marginBottom: spacing.base },
  gridCell: { flex: 1 },
});

FILE: src/screens/Videos/SwingDetailScreen.tsx

/**
 * SwingDetailScreen — task #119.
 *
 * Layout:
 *   - 16:9 placeholder for the swing clip (per-swing Mux clips ship in
 *     a future task — until then we render a dark "no clip yet" panel).
 *   - PR-aware metric grid (exit velo / launch / distance / pitch speed).
 *   - SHARE + SEND TO COACH 50/50 action row (Alert.alert stubs — the
 *     9:16 share-card generator + coach-composer ship in a follow-up).
 *   - Favorite is a heart icon on the screen header (not in the action
 *     row, per spec — the row is reserved for share/send).
 *   - When this swing IS a PR: a coach-note quote card + a dedicated
 *     points-earned sparkles card.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import {
  Award,
  Heart,
  MessageCircle,
  Send,
  Share2,
  Sparkles,
  Star,
} from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import type { Swing } from '@/api/swings';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import {
  useFavoriteSwingIds,
  usePersonalBestsForKid,
  useSwing,
  useToggleFavorite,
} from '@/hooks/useSwings';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'SwingDetail'>['route'];
type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'SwingDetail'>['navigation'];

const METRIC_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  exit_velocity_mph: 'Exit velo',
  launch_angle_deg: 'Launch',
  distance_ft: 'Distance',
  pitch_speed_mph: 'Pitch mph',
};

const METRIC_UNITS: Record<string, string> = {
  exit_velocity_mph: 'MPH',
  launch_angle_deg: '°',
  distance_ft: 'FT',
  pitch_speed_mph: 'MPH',
};

const PR_POINTS = 15;

function fmt(v: number | null | undefined, digits = 1): string {
  if (v == null) return '—';
  return Number(v).toFixed(digits);
}

export default function SwingDetailScreen() {
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { swingId } = route.params;
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  

  const { data: swing, isPending, isError, error } = useSwing(swingId);
  const { data: favorites } = useFavoriteSwingIds();
  const { data: prs } = usePersonalBestsForKid(kid?.id);
  const toggleFav = useToggleFavorite();

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }
  if (isError || !swing) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorText}>
            {isError ? errorMessage(error) : 'Swing not found'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const favorited = favorites?.has(swing.id) ?? false;
  const prMatches = (prs ?? []).filter((p) => p.swing_id === swing.id);

  const handleFavorite = () => {
    toggleFav.mutate(swing.id, {
      onError: (err) => Alert.alert('Could not save favorite', errorMessage(err)),
    });
  };

  const handleShare = () => {
    navigation.navigate('ShareCard', { swingId: swing.id });
  };

  const handleSend = () => {
    navigation.navigate('SendVideoToCoach', undefined);
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.content}>
        <Header
          swing={swing}
          favorited={favorited}
          favSaving={toggleFav.isPending}
          onFavorite={handleFavorite}
        />
        <PlaceholderPlayer />
        <MetricGrid swing={swing} prs={prMatches.map((p) => p.metric)} />
        <ActionRow onShare={handleShare} onSend={handleSend} />
        {prMatches.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <PRPointsCard count={prMatches.length} />
            <CoachNoteCard prMetrics={prMatches.map((p) => p.metric)} />
          </>
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function Header({
  swing,
  favorited,
  favSaving,
  onFavorite,
}: {
  swing: Swing;
  favorited: boolean;
  favSaving: boolean;
  onFavorite: () => void;
}) {
  const d = new Date(swing.occurred_at);
  const label = Number.isNaN(d.getTime())
    ? 'Swing'
    : d.toLocaleString(undefined, {
        weekday: 'short',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        hour: 'numeric',
        minute: '2-digit',
      });
  return (
    <View style={styles.headerRow}>
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>{label.toUpperCase()}</Text>
        {swing.result ? (
          <Text style={styles.headerSubtitle}>{swing.result.toUpperCase()}</Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      <Pressable
        onPress={onFavorite}
        disabled={favSaving}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={favorited ? 'Remove from favorites' : 'Add to favorites'}
        hitSlop={12}
        style={({ pressed }) => [styles.favBtn, pressed && styles.favBtnPressed]}
      >
        <Heart
          size={22}
          color={favorited ? colors.gold : colors.textLight}
          fill={favorited ? colors.gold : 'transparent'}
        />
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

function PlaceholderPlayer() {
  return (
    <View style={styles.player}>
      <Text style={styles.playerLabel}>SWING CLIP COMING SOON</Text>
      <Text style={styles.playerHint}>
        Replays land here once your facility wires per-swing video capture.
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

function MetricGrid({ swing, prs }: { swing: Swing; prs: string[] }) {
  const items: { key: keyof Swing & string; metric: string }[] = [
    { key: 'exit_velocity_mph', metric: 'exit_velocity_mph' },
    { key: 'launch_angle_deg', metric: 'launch_angle_deg' },
    { key: 'distance_ft', metric: 'distance_ft' },
    { key: 'pitch_speed_mph', metric: 'pitch_speed_mph' },
  ];
  return (
    <View style={styles.grid}>
      {items.map(({ key, metric }) => {
        const isPr = prs.includes(metric);
        const v = swing[key] as number | null;
        return (
          <View key={key} style={[styles.metricCell, isPr && styles.metricCellPr]}>
            {isPr ? (
              <View style={styles.prRibbon}>
                <Star size={10} color={colors.dark} fill={colors.dark} />
                <Text style={styles.prRibbonText}>PR</Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
            <Text style={[styles.metricValue, isPr && styles.metricValuePr]}>
              {fmt(v, key === 'launch_angle_deg' || key === 'distance_ft' ? 0 : 1)}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.metricUnit}>{METRIC_UNITS[metric]}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.metricLabel}>{METRIC_LABELS[metric].toUpperCase()}</Text>
          </View>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

function ActionRow({ onShare, onSend }: { onShare: () => void; onSend: () => void }) {

      {icon}
      <Text

          styles.actionLabel,
          primary ? styles.actionLabelPrimary : styles.actionLabelSecondary,
        ]}
      >
        {label.toUpperCase()}
      </Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

/**
 * AssignmentDetailScreen — parent-side detail for a single drill.
 *
 * States:
 *   pending   → "Mark as done" button calls completeAssignment, then
 *               renders an inline success Alert with the points credited.
 *   submitted → "Submitted, waiting on coach" pill.
 *   reviewed  → coach rating (1–5 stars) + feedback shown.
 *
 * Drill video playback uses expo-av's <Video /> with native controls,
 * the same pattern as v0.4 VideoPlaybackScreen. The Mux HLS URL is
 * `https://stream.mux.com/{playback_id}.m3u8`. While Mux is still
 * processing the asset (status != 'ready' or no playback id) we render
 * a "Drill video processing…" placeholder.
 */

import { useNavigation, useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { ResizeMode, Video } from 'expo-av';
import { CheckCircle2, Clock, Coins, Star } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Alert, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import { useAssignment } from '@/hooks/useAssignment';
import { useCompleteAssignment } from '@/hooks/useCompleteAssignment';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'AssignmentDetail'>['route'];
type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'AssignmentDetail'>['navigation'];

function muxHlsUrl(playbackId: string) {
  return `https://stream.mux.com/${playbackId}.m3u8`;
}

function formatDue(date: string | null): string | null {
  if (!date) return null;
  const d = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00`);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

export default function AssignmentDetailScreen() {
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { assignmentId } = route.params;

  const { data: assignment, isPending, isError, error } = useAssignment(assignmentId);
  const complete = useCompleteAssignment();

  const handleComplete = async () => {
    if (!assignment) return;
    try {
      const res = await complete.mutateAsync({
        assignmentId: assignment.id,
        kidId: assignment.kid_id,
      });
      Alert.alert(
        'Nice work!',
        `You earned ${res.pointsCredited} points. New balance: ${res.newBalance.toLocaleString()} pts.`,
        [{ text: 'Done', onPress: () => navigation.goBack() }],
      );
    } catch {
      // Surfaced via complete.error below.
    }
  };

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.muted}>Loading…</Text>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !assignment) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
        <View style={styles.centered}>
          <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Drill not found</Text>
          {isError ? <Text style={styles.muted}>{errorMessage(error)}</Text> : null}
          <View style={{ height: spacing['3xl'] }} />
          <Button label="Back" variant="secondary" onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} />
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  const due = formatDue(assignment.due_date);
  const drillVideo = assignment.drill_video;
  const drillReady = drillVideo?.status === 'ready' && !!drillVideo.mux_playback_id;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['bottom']}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}>
        {drillVideo ? (
          <View style={styles.videoWrap}>
            {drillReady ? (
              <Video
                source={{ uri: muxHlsUrl(drillVideo.mux_playback_id as string) }}
                style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject}
                useNativeControls
                resizeMode={ResizeMode.CONTAIN}
              />
            ) : (
              <Text style={styles.processingText}>Drill video processing…</Text>
            )}
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <Text style={styles.title}>{assignment.title}</Text>

        <View style={styles.metaRow}>
          {assignment.duration_estimate_minutes != null ? (
            <View style={styles.metaPill}>
              <Clock size={12} color={colors.gold} />
              <Text style={styles.metaText}>{assignment.duration_estimate_minutes} min</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          {due ? (
            <View style={styles.metaPill}>
              <Text style={styles.metaText}>Due {due}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          <View style={styles.metaPill}>
            <Coins size={12} color={colors.gold} />
            <Text style={styles.metaText}>+{assignment.point_reward} pts</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {assignment.description ? (
          <Text style={styles.description}>{assignment.description}</Text>
        ) : null}

        {assignment.status === 'submitted' ? (
          <View style={styles.statusBanner}>
            <Clock size={18} color={colors.gold} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Submitted — waiting on coach to review</Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {assignment.status === 'reviewed' ? (
          <View style={styles.reviewCard}>
            <View style={styles.reviewHeader}>
              <CheckCircle2 size={20} color={colors.gold} />
              <Text style={styles.reviewHeaderText}>Reviewed by your coach</Text>
            </View>
            {assignment.rating != null ? (
              <View style={styles.starsRow}>
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
                  <Star
                    key={n}
                    size={20}
                    color={colors.gold}
                    fill={n <= (assignment.rating ?? 0) ? colors.gold : 'transparent'}
                  />
                ))}
              </View>
            ) : null}
            {assignment.feedback ? (
              <Text style={styles.feedback}>“{assignment.feedback}”</Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {complete.error ? (
          <Text style={styles.errorMsg}>{errorMessage(complete.error)}</Text>
        ) : null}

        {assignment.status === 'pending' ? (
          <View style={styles.actions}>
            <Button
              label="Mark as done"
              onPress={handleComplete}
              loading={complete.isPending}
              fullWidth
            />
            <Button
              label="Back"
              variant="secondary"
              onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
              fullWidth
            />
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  scroll: {
    padding: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'],
  },
  centered: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: spacing['4xl'],
  },
  muted: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    color: colors.textMuted,
  },
  errorTitle: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.xl,
    color: colors.danger,
    marginBottom: spacing.lg,
  },
  errorMsg: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    color: colors.danger,
    textAlign: 'center',
    marginVertical: spacing.lg,
  },
  videoWrap: {
    aspectRatio: 16 / 9,
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],

    overflow: 'hidden',

    marginBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  processingText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interMedium,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.textLight,
  },
  title: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes['3xl'],
    color: colors.textOnDark,
    letterSpacing: -tracking.tight,
  },
  metaRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    flexWrap: 'wrap',
    gap: spacing.sm,
    marginTop: spacing.lg,
    marginBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  metaPill: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.xs,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    paddingVertical: spacing.xs,
    borderRadius: radius.full,
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.border,
  },
  metaText: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.gold,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
  },
  description: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,
    color: colors.textLight,
    lineHeight: fontSizes.md * 1.5,
    marginBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },
  statusBanner: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.lg,
    padding: spacing['2xl'],
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,

    marginBottom: spacing['2xl'],
  },

    fontFamily: fontFamilies.interSemiBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.md,

    flex: 1,
  },
