/**
 * AssignmentRow — single row in the Work tab list. Same chrome as
 * SentMessageRow / UpcomingSessionCard so the Work tab feels native to
 * the app. Right-side badge color encodes status:
 *   pending   → muted gold (action required)
 *   submitted → gold      (waiting on coach)
 *   reviewed  → success   (done; rating shown)
 */

import { CheckCircle2, Circle, Clock, Star } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import type { AssignmentWithRefs } from '@/api/assignments';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Props = {
  assignment: AssignmentWithRefs;
  onPress: () => void;
};

function formatDue(date: string | null): string | null {
  if (!date) return null;
  const d = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00`);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
  return `Due ${d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}`;
}

export default function AssignmentRow({ assignment, onPress }: Props) {
  const status = assignment.status;
  const due = formatDue(assignment.due_date);

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [styles.card, pressed && styles.pressed]}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={`Drill: ${assignment.title}`}
    >
      <View style={styles.iconWrap}>
        {status === 'pending' ? (
          <Circle size={20} color={colors.gold} />
        ) : status === 'submitted' ? (
          <Clock size={20} color={colors.gold} />
        ) : (
          <CheckCircle2 size={20} color={colors.gold} />
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={styles.body}>
        <Text style={styles.title} numberOfLines={1}>{assignment.title}</Text>
        <View style={styles.metaRow}>
          {assignment.duration_estimate_minutes != null ? (
            <Text style={styles.meta}>{assignment.duration_estimate_minutes} min</Text>
          ) : null}
          {due ? <Text style={styles.meta}>{due}</Text> : null}
          <Text style={styles.meta}>+{assignment.point_reward ?? 0} pts</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      {status === 'reviewed' && assignment.rating != null ? (
        <View style={styles.ratingPill}>
          <Star size={12} color={colors.gold} fill={colors.gold} />
          <Text style={styles.ratingText}>{assignment.rating}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.lg,
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderColor: colors.border,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
    paddingVertical: spacing.lg,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.xl,
  },
  pressed: { opacity: 0.85 },
  iconWrap: {

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { Dumbbell } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  RefreshControl,
  SectionList,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import type { AssignmentWithRefs } from '@/api/assignments';
import { useAssignments } from '@/hooks/useAssignments';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import AssignmentRow from '@/screens/Work/components/AssignmentRow';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { todayLocalIso } from '@/utils/date';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'WorkHome'>['navigation'];
type Section = { title: string; data: AssignmentWithRefs[] };

export default function AssignBody() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { kid, loading: familyLoading } = useSelectedKid();
  const { data, isPending, isError, error, refetch, isRefetching } = useAssignments(kid?.id);
  const [manualRefreshing, setManualRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const sections = useMemo<Section[]>(() => {
    const all = data ?? [];
    const todayIso = todayLocalIso();
    const dueNow = all.filter(
      (a) => a.status === 'pending' && (!a.due_date || a.due_date <= todayIso),
    );
    const upcoming = all.filter(
      (a) => a.status === 'pending' && !!a.due_date && a.due_date > todayIso,
    );
    const submitted = all.filter((a) => a.status === 'submitted');
    const done = all.filter((a) => a.status === 'reviewed');
    return [
      { title: 'Due now', data: dueNow },
      { title: 'Upcoming', data: upcoming },
      { title: 'Submitted', data: submitted },
      { title: 'Done', data: done },
    ].filter((s) => s.data.length > 0);
  }, [data]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setManualRefreshing(true);
    try {
      await refetch();
    } finally {
      setManualRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [refetch]);

  const refreshControl = (
    <RefreshControl
      refreshing={manualRefreshing}
      onRefresh={onRefresh}
      tintColor={colors.gold}
      colors={[colors.gold]}
    />
  );

  if (!kid && !familyLoading) {
    return (
      <Empty
        title="No drills yet"
        body="Add your kid on the Home tab to start receiving drill assignments."
      />
    );
  }
  if (familyLoading || (kid && isPending)) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} size="large" />
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <Text style={styles.errorTitle}>Couldn&apos;t load drills</Text>
        <Text style={styles.emptyBody}>{errorMessage(error)}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (sections.length === 0) {
    return (
      <SectionList
        sections={[]}
        keyExtractor={() => 'noop'}
        renderItem={() => null}
        refreshControl={refreshControl}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.centered}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <Empty
            title="No drills yet"
            body="Your coach will send drill assignments here. Pull down to refresh."
          />
        }
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <SectionList
      sections={sections}
      keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
      stickySectionHeadersEnabled={false}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
      refreshControl={refreshControl}
      renderSectionHeader={({ section }) => (
        <Text style={styles.sectionHeader}>{section.title}</Text>
      )}
      renderItem={({ item }) => (
        <View style={styles.rowWrap}>
          <AssignmentRow
            assignment={item}
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate('AssignmentDetail', { assignmentId: item.id })
            }
          />
        </View>
      )}
    />
  );
}

function Empty({ title, body }: { title: string; body: string }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.centered}>
      <View style={styles.emptyIconWrap}>
        <Dumbbell size={32} color={colors.gold} />
      </View>
      <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>{title}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.emptyBody}>{body}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  listContent: { paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'], paddingBottom: spacing['6xl'] },
  sectionHeader: {
    fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
    fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
    color: colors.gold,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
    marginTop: spacing['2xl'],
    marginBottom: spacing.lg,
  },
  rowWrap: { marginBottom: spacing.lg },
  centered: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: spacing['4xl'],
  },
  emptyIconWrap: {
    width: 64,

    borderRadius: 32,
    backgroundColor: colors.darker,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderColor: colors.borderGold,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',

  },
  emptyTitle: {

  },
  emptyBody: {

import { useFocusEffect, useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { Play } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import {
  TRAINING_CATEGORIES,
  type TrainingVideo,
  type TrainingVideoCategory,
} from '@/api/trainingVideos';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { useTrainingProgress, useTrainingVideos } from '@/hooks/useTrainingVideos';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

type Filter = 'all' | TrainingVideoCategory;
type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'WorkHome'>['navigation'];

const FILTERS: { value: Filter; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
  ...TRAINING_CATEGORIES.map((c) => ({ value: c.value as Filter, label: c.label })),
];

function muxThumb(playbackId: string, w = 480): string {
  return `https://image.mux.com/${playbackId}/thumbnail.jpg?width=${w}&fit_mode=smartcrop`;
}

function categoryLabel(cat: TrainingVideoCategory): string {
  return TRAINING_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.value === cat)?.label ?? cat;
}

function fmtDuration(sec: number | null): string {
  if (!sec || sec <= 0) return '—';
  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = sec % 60;
  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export default function DrillsBody() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();

  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('all');
  const { data: videos, isPending, refetch, isRefetching } = useTrainingVideos(filter);
  const { map: progress, refresh: refreshProgress } = useTrainingProgress(kid?.id);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      void refreshProgress();
    }, [refreshProgress]),
  );

  const featured = useMemo<TrainingVideo | null>(() => {
    if (!videos || videos.length === 0) return null;
    return videos.find((v) => v.featured) ?? videos[0];
  }, [videos]);

  const continueWatching = useMemo<TrainingVideo[]>(() => {
    if (!videos) return [];
    return videos
      .filter((v) => {
        const p = progress[v.id];
        if (!p) return false;
        if (p.durationSec && p.positionSec / p.durationSec > 0.95) return false;
        return p.positionSec > 5;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => (progress[b.id]?.updatedAt ?? 0) - (progress[a.id]?.updatedAt ?? 0))
      .slice(0, 8);
  }, [videos, progress]);

  const grid = videos ?? [];

  const onPlay = useCallback(
    (v: TrainingVideo) => {
      navigation.navigate('TrainingVideoPlayer', { videoId: v.id });
    },
    [navigation],
  );

  return (
    <ScrollView
      contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          tintColor={colors.gold}
          refreshing={isRefetching}
          onRefresh={() => {
            void refetch();
            void refreshProgress();
          }}
        />
      }
    >
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.chipRow}
      >
        {FILTERS.map((f) => {
          const active = filter === f.value;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={f.value}
              onPress={() => setFilter(f.value)}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.chip,
                active && styles.chipActive,
                pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
              ]}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.chipLabel, active && styles.chipLabelActive]}>{f.label}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      {isPending ? (
        <View style={styles.loadingBox}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {featured ? (
        <View style={{ marginTop: spacing['3xl'] }}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>NEW THIS WEEK</Text>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => onPlay(featured)}
            style={({ pressed }) => [styles.hero, pressed && { opacity: 0.92 }]}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={`Play ${featured.title}`}
          >
            <Image
              source={{ uri: muxThumb(featured.muxPlaybackId, 720) }}
              style={styles.heroImage}
              resizeMode="cover"
            />
            <View style={styles.heroOverlay}>
              <View style={styles.playBadge}>
                <Play size={28} color={colors.dark} fill={colors.dark} />
              </View>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.heroMeta}>
              <Text style={styles.heroTitle} numberOfLines={2}>
                {featured.title}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.heroSub}>
                {fmtDuration(featured.durationSec)} · {categoryLabel(featured.category)} ·{' '}
                {featured.level}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {continueWatching.length > 0 ? (
        <View style={{ marginTop: spacing['4xl'] }}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>CONTINUE WATCHING</Text>
          <View style={{ gap: spacing.lg, marginTop: spacing.lg }}>
            {continueWatching.map((v) => {
              const p = progress[v.id];
              const pct =
                p?.durationSec && p.positionSec
                  ? Math.min(1, p.positionSec / p.durationSec)
                  : 0;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={v.id}
                  onPress={() => onPlay(v)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [styles.cwRow, pressed && { opacity: 0.9 }]}
                >
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: muxThumb(v.muxPlaybackId, 200) }}
                    style={styles.cwThumb}
                    resizeMode="cover"
                  />
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Text style={styles.cwTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
                      {v.title}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={styles.cwMeta}>
                      {fmtDuration(v.durationSec)} · {categoryLabel(v.category)} · {v.level}
                    </Text>
                    <View style={styles.cwBarTrack}>
                      <View
                        style={[styles.cwBarFill, { width: `${Math.round(pct * 100)}%` }]}
                      />
                    </View>
                  </View>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {grid.length > 0 ? (
        <View style={{ marginTop: spacing['4xl'] }}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>
            {filter === 'all'
              ? 'ALL TRAINING'
              : `ALL IN ${categoryLabel(filter as TrainingVideoCategory).toUpperCase()}`}
          </Text>
          <FlatList
            data={grid}
            keyExtractor={(v) => v.id}
            numColumns={2}
            columnWrapperStyle={{ gap: spacing.lg }}
            contentContainerStyle={{ gap: spacing.lg, marginTop: spacing.lg }}
            scrollEnabled={false}
            renderItem={({ item }) => (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => onPlay(item)}
                style={({ pressed }) => [styles.gridCard, pressed && { opacity: 0.9 }]}
              >
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: muxThumb(item.muxPlaybackId, 360) }}
                  style={styles.gridThumb}
                  resizeMode="cover"
                />
                <Text style={styles.gridTitle} numberOfLines={2}>
                  {item.title}
                </Text>
                <Text style={styles.gridMeta} numberOfLines={1}>
                  {fmtDuration(item.durationSec)} · {categoryLabel(item.category)}
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            )}
          />
        </View>
      ) : !isPending ? (
        <View style={[styles.loadingBox, { marginTop: spacing['4xl'] }]}>
          <Text style={styles.empty}>No videos here yet.</Text>
          <Text style={styles.emptySub}>
            Your facility hasn&rsquo;t published any training videos in this category yet.
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'WorkHome'>['navigation'];

export default function HwBody() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();

  const list = assignments ?? [];

  if (list.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={<ZapOff size={26} color={colors.gold} />}
        title="No homework yet"
        body="When you submit a drill it lands here for review, with your coach's stars + feedback once they grade it."

    );

  return (

        <View key={a.id} style={styles.row}>

            assignment={a}
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate('AssignmentDetail', { assignmentId: a.id })

            <View style={styles.feedbackQuote}>
              <Text style={styles.feedbackText} numberOfLines={2}>
                &ldquo;{a.feedback}&rdquo;
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      ))}
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';
import { Camera, MessageCircle, PlayCircle, Send } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import { createMuxUpload } from '@/api/mux';
import type { ThreadMessage } from '@/api/parentMessages';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import {
  useMessageThread,
  useParentInbox,
  useSendParentMessage,
  useTenantCoachesForParent,
} from '@/hooks/useParentMessages';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';
import { uploadVideoToMux } from '@/utils/uploadVideo';

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'WorkHome'>['navigation'];

const POSTER_WIDTH = 480;
const muxPoster = (id: string) =>
  `https://image.mux.com/${id}/thumbnail.jpg?width=${POSTER_WIDTH}`;

export default function MessagesBody() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { family, kid } = useSelectedKid();

  const { data: coaches, isPending: coachesPending } = useTenantCoachesForParent();
  const { data: inbox } = useParentInbox(kid?.id);

  const [coachUserId, setCoachUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Auto-select the right coach: the most recent inbox row that has any
  // history, else the only tenant coach, else the first coach. Re-runs
  // whenever the inputs change but only when the user hasn't explicitly
  // picked someone yet.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (coachUserId) return;
    const fromInbox = (inbox ?? []).find((r) => r.lastCreatedAt)?.coachUserId;
    if (fromInbox) {
      setCoachUserId(fromInbox);
      return;
    }
    if (coaches && coaches.length > 0) {
      setCoachUserId(coaches[0].userId);
    }
  }, [coachUserId, inbox, coaches]);

  const {
    data: messages,
    isPending: threadPending,
    isError: threadError,
    error: threadErrorObj,
    refetch: refetchThread,
  } = useMessageThread(kid?.id, coachUserId ?? undefined);

  const sendMutation = useSendParentMessage(
    kid && coachUserId ? { kidId: kid.id, coachUserId } : null,
  );

  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadPct, setUploadPct] = useState(0);
  const idemKeyRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const activeCoach = useMemo(
    () => coaches?.find((c) => c.userId === coachUserId) ?? null,
    [coaches, coachUserId],
  );
  const coachName = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeCoach) return 'Your coach';
    const n = [activeCoach.firstName, activeCoach.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    return n || 'Your coach';
  }, [activeCoach]);

  const onPickAndSendVideo = useCallback(async () => {
    if (uploading) return;
    if (!kid || !family || !coachUserId) {
      showToast("Couldn't send — missing recipient.");
      return;
    }
    const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) {
      showToast('Photo library permission is required to send a video.');
      return;
    }
    const picked = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Videos,
      allowsEditing: false,
      quality: 1,
    });
    if (picked.canceled || !picked.assets?.[0]) return;
    const asset = picked.assets[0];
    setUploading(true);
    setUploadPct(0);
    try {
      if (!idemKeyRef.current) {
        idemKeyRef.current = `pmsg-${kid.id}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
      }
      const { upload_url, video_id } = await createMuxUpload(
        idemKeyRef.current,
        'parent_to_coach',
      );
      const { promise } = uploadVideoToMux({
        uploadUrl: upload_url,
        fileUri: asset.uri,
        contentType: asset.mimeType ?? 'video/mp4',
        onProgress: (f) => setUploadPct(Math.round(f * 100)),
      });
      await promise;
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        sendMutation.mutate(
          {
            videoId: video_id,
            recipientFamilyId: family.id,
            recipientKidId: kid.id,
            recipientCoachUserId: coachUserId,
            label: null,
            senderDisplay: null,
            messageText: null,
          },
          { onSuccess: () => resolve(), onError: (e) => reject(e) },
        );
      });
      idemKeyRef.current = null;
      showToast('Video sent — your coach will see it once it finishes processing.');
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      setUploadPct(0);
    }
  }, [uploading, kid, family, coachUserId, sendMutation, showToast]);

  // Navigate within the Work stack so pressing X returns here, not Home.
  const onPlayCoachVideo = (messageId: string) =>
    navigation.navigate('VideoPlayback', { messageId });

  const onSend = () => {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    if (!kid || !family || !coachUserId) {
      showToast("Couldn't send — missing recipient.");
      return;
    }
    sendMutation.mutate(
      {
        videoId: null,
        recipientFamilyId: family.id,
        recipientKidId: kid.id,
        recipientCoachUserId: coachUserId,
        label: null,
        senderDisplay: null,
        messageText: text,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          setDraft('');
        },
        onError: (err) => {
          showToast(errorMessage(err));
        },
      },
    );
  };

  if (!kid) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <Text style={styles.muted}>Add a kid to start messaging your coach.</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  const showCoachPicker = (coaches?.length ?? 0) > 1;

  // Keyboard avoidance is handled by the parent WorkScreen's
  // KeyboardAvoidingView, so this component is a plain View.
  return (
    <View style={styles.flex}>
      {showCoachPicker ? (
        <View style={styles.pickerRow}>
          {coaches!.map((c) => {
            const active = c.userId === coachUserId;
            const label =
              [c.firstName, c.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Coach';
            return (
              <Pressable
                key={c.userId}
                onPress={() => setCoachUserId(c.userId)}
                style={[styles.pickerPill, active && styles.pickerPillActive]}
              >
                <Text
                  style={[styles.pickerPillText, active && styles.pickerPillTextActive]}
                >
                  {label.toUpperCase()}
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          <Text style={styles.headerName}>{coachName.toUpperCase()}</Text>
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={styles.flex}>
        {coachesPending || (threadPending && !!coachUserId) ? (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
            <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
          </View>
        ) : !coachUserId ? (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
            <MessageCircle size={36} color={colors.goldDeep} />
            <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>NO COACH YET</Text>
            <Text style={styles.muted}>
              Your facility admin needs to configure a coach before you can start messaging.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : threadError ? (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
            <Text style={styles.errorText}>{errorMessage(threadErrorObj)}</Text>
            <Pressable onPress={() => refetchThread()}>
              <Text style={styles.retry}>RETRY</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        ) : (messages ?? []).length === 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.centered}>
            <MessageCircle size={36} color={colors.goldDeep} />
            <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>SAY HI TO {coachName.toUpperCase()}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.muted}>
              Send a quick text or a video — game footage, a swing check, or a question.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          // inverted FlatList: index 0 renders at the bottom.
          // Data must be newest-first so the latest message sits at the bottom.
          <FlatList
            data={[...(messages ?? [])].reverse()}
            inverted
            keyExtractor={(m) => m.id}
            contentContainerStyle={styles.threadContent}
            renderItem={({ item }) => (
              <Bubble
                message={item}
                isSelf={!!user && item.senderUserId === user.id}
                onPlayCoachVideo={onPlayCoachVideo}
              />
            )}
          />
        )}
      </View>

      {uploading ? (
        <View style={styles.uploadBar}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
          <Text style={styles.uploadText}>Uploading video… {uploadPct}%</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <View style={styles.composer}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={onPickAndSendVideo}
          disabled={uploading}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.iconBtn,
            uploading && { opacity: 0.4 },
            pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
          ]}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Send a video"
        >
          <Camera size={20} color={colors.gold} />
        </Pressable>
        <TextInput
          value={draft}
          onChangeText={setDraft}
          placeholder={`Message ${coachName}…`}
          placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
          multiline
          style={styles.input}
          editable={!sendMutation.isPending}
        />
        <Pressable
          onPress={onSend}
          disabled={!draft.trim() || sendMutation.isPending || !coachUserId}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.sendBtn,
            (!draft.trim() || sendMutation.isPending || !coachUserId) && { opacity: 0.4 },
            pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
          ]}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Send message"
        >
          <Send size={18} color={colors.dark} />
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function Bubble({
  message,
  isSelf,
  onPlayCoachVideo,
}: {
  message: ThreadMessage;
  isSelf: boolean;
  onPlayCoachVideo: (messageId: string) => void;
}) {
  const align = isSelf ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start';
  const bg = isSelf ? colors.gold : colors.dark;
  const fg = isSelf ? colors.dark : colors.textOnDark;
  const borderColor = isSelf ? colors.gold : colors.borderGold;
  const ready = message.video?.status === 'ready' && !!message.video.muxPlaybackId;

  return (
    <View style={{ alignItems: align, maxWidth: '88%', alignSelf: align }}>
      <View
        style={{
          backgroundColor: bg,
          borderRadius: radius['2xl'],
          borderTopRightRadius: isSelf ? 4 : radius['2xl'],
          borderTopLeftRadius: !isSelf ? 4 : radius['2xl'],
          padding: spacing['2xl'],
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderColor,
          gap: spacing.base,
        }}
      >
        {message.video ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={ready && !isSelf ? () => onPlayCoachVideo(message.id) : undefined}
            disabled={!ready || isSelf}
            style={styles.videoBubble}
          >
            {ready ? (
              <>
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: muxPoster(message.video.muxPlaybackId as string) }}
                  style={styles.videoImg}
                  resizeMode="cover"
                />
                <View style={styles.playOverlay}>
                  <PlayCircle size={36} color={colors.white} />
                </View>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Text style={[styles.muted, { color: colors.textLight }]}>
                {message.video.status === 'errored' ? 'Upload failed' : 'Processing video…'}
              </Text>
            )}
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
        {message.label ? (
          <Text
            style={{
              fontFamily: fontFamilies.oswaldBold,
              fontSize: fontSizes.sm,
              letterSpacing: tracking.wider,
              color: isSelf ? colors.dark : colors.gold,
            }}
          >
            {message.label.replace(/_/g, ' ').toUpperCase()}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
        {message.messageText ? (
          <Text
            style={{ color: fg, fontFamily: fontFamilies.interRegular, fontSize: fontSizes.lg }}
          >
            {message.messageText}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { ZapOff } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import type { Swing } from '@/api/swings';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import {
  useFavoriteSwingIds,
  useSessionsForKid,
  useSwingsForKid,
} from '@/hooks/useSwings';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import EmptyState from '@/screens/Videos/components/EmptyState';
import SessionGroupCard from '@/screens/Videos/components/SessionGroupCard';
import SwingThumbnail from '@/screens/Videos/components/SwingThumbnail';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';
import { errorMessage } from '@/utils/error';

type Nav = WorkStackScreenProps<'WorkHome'>['navigation'];
type Mode = 'session' | 'all';

export default function SwingsBody() {
  const navigation = useNavigation<Nav>();
  const { kid, loading: familyLoading } = useSelectedKid();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('session');

  const { data: swings, isPending: swingsPending, isError, error } = useSwingsForKid(kid?.id);
  const { data: sessions, isPending: sessionsPending } = useSessionsForKid(kid?.id);
  const { data: favorites } = useFavoriteSwingIds();

  const swingsBySession = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string | null, Swing[]>();
    (swings ?? []).forEach((s) => {
      const arr = map.get(s.session_id) ?? [];
      arr.push(s);
      map.set(s.session_id, arr);
    });
    return map;
  }, [swings]);

  const favSet = favorites ?? new Set<string>();

  if (familyLoading || (kid && (swingsPending || sessionsPending))) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <ActivityIndicator color={colors.gold} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (!kid) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={<ZapOff size={26} color={colors.gold} />}
        title="No kid yet"
        body="Add your kid on Home to start collecting swings."
      />
    );
  }
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centered}>
        <Text style={styles.errorText}>{errorMessage(error)}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  if ((swings ?? []).length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={<ZapOff size={26} color={colors.gold} />}
        title="No swings yet"
        body="Connect HitTrax from Me → HitTrax. Cage swings will land here automatically."
      />
    );
  }

  const totalSwings = (swings ?? []).length;
  const totalPRs = (swings ?? []).filter((s) => s.is_personal_best).length;
  const totalSessions = (sessions ?? []).length;

  if (mode === 'all') {
    return (
      <FlatList
        key="swings-grid"
        data={swings ?? []}
        keyExtractor={(s) => s.id}
        numColumns={3}
        columnWrapperStyle={styles.gridRow}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.gridContent}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <>
            <StatsBar swings={totalSwings} prs={totalPRs} sessions={totalSessions} />
            <ModeToggle mode={mode} onChange={setMode} />
          </>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={styles.gridCell}>
            <SwingThumbnail
              swing={item}
              favorited={favSet.has(item.id)}
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate('SwingDetail', { swingId: item.id })}
            />
          </View>
        )}
      />
    );
  }

  const looseSwings = swingsBySession.get(null) ?? [];
  const looseRows: { kind: 'loose'; swings: Swing[] }[] =
    looseSwings.length > 0 ? [{ kind: 'loose', swings: looseSwings }] : [];
  const sessionRows = (sessions ?? []).map((s) => ({ kind: 'session' as const, session: s }));
  type Row = (typeof looseRows)[number] | (typeof sessionRows)[number];
  const rows: Row[] = [...looseRows, ...sessionRows];

  return (
    <FlatList<Row>
      key="swings-sessions"
      data={rows}
      keyExtractor={(r) => (r.kind === 'loose' ? 'loose' : r.session.id)}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
      ListHeaderComponent={
        <>
          <StatsBar swings={totalSwings} prs={totalPRs} sessions={totalSessions} />
          <ModeToggle mode={mode} onChange={setMode} />
        </>
      }
      renderItem={({ item }) => {
        if (item.kind === 'loose') {
          return (
            <View style={styles.looseCard}>
              <Text style={styles.looseTitle}>RECENT SWINGS · NEW SESSION SYNCING</Text>
              <View style={styles.previewRow}>
                {item.swings.slice(0, 3).map((s) => (
                  <View key={s.id} style={styles.previewCell}>
                    <SwingThumbnail
                      swing={s}
                      favorited={favSet.has(s.id)}
                      onPress={() => navigation.navigate('SwingDetail', { swingId: s.id })}
                    />
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            </View>
          );
        }
        const sessionSwings = swingsBySession.get(item.session.id) ?? [];
        return (
          <SessionGroupCard
            session={item.session}
            previewSwings={sessionSwings}
            favorites={favSet}
            onPressSession={() =>
              navigation.navigate('SessionDetail', { sessionId: item.session.id })
            }
            onPressSwing={(id) => navigation.navigate('SwingDetail', { swingId: id })}
          />
        );
      }}
      ListEmptyComponent={
        <EmptyState
          icon={<ZapOff size={26} color={colors.gold} />}
          title="No sessions yet"
          body="Sessions land here once HitTrax syncs your first cage time."
        />
      }
    />
  );
}

function StatsBar({
  swings,
  prs,
  sessions,
}: {
  swings: number;
  prs: number;
  sessions: number;
}) {
  const stats = [
    { label: 'TOTAL SWINGS', value: swings },
    { label: 'PRs', value: prs },
    { label: 'SESSIONS', value: sessions },
  ];
  return (
    <View style={styles.statsCard}>
      {stats.map((s, i) => (
        <View key={s.label} style={[styles.statCol, i < stats.length - 1 && styles.statColBorder]}>
          <Text style={styles.statLabel}>{s.label}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.statValue}>{s.value}</Text>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function ModeToggle({ mode, onChange }: { mode: Mode; onChange: (m: Mode) => void }) {
  const opts: { key: Mode; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'session', label: 'By session' },
    { key: 'all', label: 'All swings' },
  ];
  return (
    <View style={styles.toggleRow}>
      {opts.map((o) => {
        const active = o.key === mode;
        return (
          <Pressable
            key={o.key}
            onPress={() => onChange(o.key)}
            style={[styles.togglePill, active && styles.togglePillActive]}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.toggleText, active && styles.toggleTextActive]}>
              {o.label.toUpperCase()}
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

    marginBottom: spacing.lg,
  },

  previewCell: { flex: 1 },
});

import { useRoute } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, Pressable, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useAssignments } from '@/hooks/useAssignments';
import { useCoachMessagesForKid } from '@/hooks/useCoachMessages';
import { useSelectedKid } from '@/hooks/useSelectedKid';
import { useSwingsForKid } from '@/hooks/useSwings';
import { useTrainingVideos } from '@/hooks/useTrainingVideos';
import KidSwitcherPill from '@/components/ui/KidSwitcherPill';
import type { WorkStackScreenProps } from '@/navigation/types';
import { colors, fontFamilies, fontSizes, radius, spacing, tracking } from '@/theme';

import AssignBody from './subtabs/AssignBody';
import DrillsBody from './subtabs/DrillsBody';
import HwBody from './subtabs/HwBody';
import MessagesBody from './subtabs/MessagesBody';
import SwingsBody from './subtabs/SwingsBody';

type SubTab = NonNullable<WorkStackScreenProps<'WorkHome'>['route']['params']>['initialSubTab'];
type Route = WorkStackScreenProps<'WorkHome'>['route'];

type TabKey = NonNullable<SubTab>;
const TABS: { key: TabKey; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'swings', label: 'Swings' },
  { key: 'assign', label: 'Assign' },
  { key: 'messages', label: 'Messages' },
  { key: 'hw', label: 'HW' },
  { key: 'drills', label: 'Drills' },
];

function fmtCount(n: number): string {
  if (n <= 0) return '';
  if (n >= 100) return '99+';
  return String(n);
}

export default function WorkScreen() {
  const route = useRoute<Route>();
  const initial = route.params?.initialSubTab ?? 'swings';
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabKey>(initial);

  // If the tab is re-focused with a new initialSubTab param, honour it.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (route.params?.initialSubTab) setTab(route.params.initialSubTab);
  }, [route.params?.initialSubTab]);

  // Sub-tab count badges. We fan out the same hooks the bodies already
  // use so React Query dedupes and the badges stay live in sync.
  const { kid } = useSelectedKid();
  const { data: swings } = useSwingsForKid(kid?.id);
  const { data: assignments } = useAssignments(kid?.id);
  const { data: coachMsgs } = useCoachMessagesForKid(kid?.id);
  const { data: drills } = useTrainingVideos('all');

  const counts = useMemo<Record<TabKey, string>>(() => {
    const swingsTotal = swings?.length ?? 0;
    const pendingAssign = (assignments ?? []).filter((a) => a.status === 'pending').length;
    const newMsgs = (coachMsgs ?? []).filter((m) => !m.viewedAt).length;
    const reviewed = (assignments ?? []).filter(
      (a) => a.status === 'submitted' || a.status === 'reviewed',
    ).length;
    const drillsTotal = drills?.length ?? 0;
    return {
      swings: fmtCount(swingsTotal),
      assign: fmtCount(pendingAssign),
      messages: fmtCount(newMsgs),
      hw: fmtCount(reviewed),
      drills: fmtCount(drillsTotal),
    };
  }, [swings, assignments, coachMsgs, drills]);

  const Body = useMemo(() => {
    switch (tab) {
      case 'assign':
        return AssignBody;
      case 'messages':
        return MessagesBody;
      case 'hw':
        return HwBody;
      case 'drills':
        return DrillsBody;
      case 'swings':
      default:
        return SwingsBody;
    }
  }, [tab]);

  // Keyboard avoidance is lifted here so it wraps only the body area,
  // sitting below the SafeAreaView + header + sub-tab bar. This means
  // the KAV's effective offset is zero — the view above it is already
  // outside the KAV and the system correctly measures from here.
  // On Android we leave behavior undefined (same as every other screen).
  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safe} edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View style={styles.titleRow}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>Work</Text>
          <KidSwitcherPill />
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Train, review, and message your coach</Text>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.tabBarWrapper}>
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.tabBar}
        >
          {TABS.map((t) => {
          const active = tab === t.key;
          const count = counts[t.key];
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={t.key}
              onPress={() => setTab(t.key)}
              style={[styles.pill, active && styles.pillActive]}
              accessibilityRole="tab"
              accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
              accessibilityLabel={count ? `${t.label}, ${count}` : t.label}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.pillText, active && styles.pillTextActive]}>{t.label}</Text>
              {count ? (
                <View style={[styles.badge, active && styles.badgeActive]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.badgeText, active && styles.badgeTextActive]}>{count}</Text>
                </View>
              ) : null}
            </Pressable>
          );
          })}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <Body />
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.darkest },
  flex: { flex: 1 },
  header: {
    paddingHorizontal: spacing['3xl'],
    paddingTop: spacing['2xl'],

  },

FILE: src/services/notifications.ts

import * as Device from "expo-device";
import * as Notifications from "expo-notifications";
import Constants from "expo-constants";
import { Platform } from "react-native";

import { supabase } from "@/lib/supabase";
// Kept for documentation: the JWT-decode helper and tenant_id lookup that
// used to live here moved into the `register_device_token` SECURITY
// DEFINER RPC. Client no longer needs to read the JWT tenant claim.

Notifications.setNotificationHandler({
  handleNotification: async () => ({
    shouldShowBanner: true,
    shouldShowList: true,
    shouldPlaySound: true,
    shouldSetBadge: true,
  }),
});

function devicePlatform(): "ios" | "android" | "web" {
  if (Platform.OS === "ios") return "ios";
  if (Platform.OS === "android") return "android";
  return "web";
}

/**
 * Persist (or refresh) the current device's Expo push token in
 * `public.device_tokens` for the signed-in user. Idempotent —
 * repeat sign-ins just bump `last_seen_at`.
 *
 * Routed through the `register_device_token` SECURITY DEFINER RPC
 * (see 20260508040000_v07_register_device_token_rpc.sql) instead of a
 * direct INSERT/UPSERT. The RPC handles the "one phone, two accounts"
 * reassignment atomically — a plain client DELETE+upsert can't, because
 * device_tokens RLS only lets a user delete their OWN rows, so a sibling
 * signing in on the same phone would leave the previous owner's row
 * intact and pushes would fan out to both accounts. The RPC pulls
 * user_id + tenant_id from auth.uid() / auth.jwt() server-side so the
 * client cannot impersonate another user.
 */
export async function upsertDeviceToken(expoPushToken: string): Promise<void> {
  const {
    data: { session },
    error: sessionErr,
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (sessionErr || !session?.user) {
    console.warn("[push] no active session; skipping device_tokens upsert");
    return;
  }

  const { error } = await supabase.rpc("register_device_token", {
    p_expo_push_token: expoPushToken,
    p_platform: devicePlatform(),
  });

  if (error) {
    console.warn("[push] register_device_token RPC failed", error.message);
  }
}

export async function registerForPushNotifications() {
  if (!Device.isDevice) {
    console.log("Push notifications require a physical device");
    return null;
  }

  const { status: existingStatus } = await Notifications.getPermissionsAsync();

  let finalStatus = existingStatus;

  if (existingStatus !== "granted") {
    const { status } = await Notifications.requestPermissionsAsync();

    finalStatus = status;
  }

  if (finalStatus !== "granted") {
    console.log("Push permission not granted");
    return null;
  }

  const projectId = Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.eas?.projectId;

  const token = (
    await Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({
      projectId,
    })
  ).data;

  console.log("Expo Push Token:", token);

  // Persist to device_tokens so the server can fan a push out later. Don't
  // throw on failure — the token is still useful in-memory and the next
  // sign-in will retry.
  try {
    await upsertDeviceToken(token);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[push] upsertDeviceToken threw", err);
  }

  return token;
}

FILE: src/store/coachMessageSeen.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Coach-message notification state store.
 *
 * Two pieces of per-user state live here:
 *
 *   - `seenByUser[userId]` — id of the most recent coach_message the parent
 *     has been shown a notification for. Persisted to AsyncStorage so the
 *     badge / toast doesn't re-appear for an old message every time the
 *     app is restarted.
 *
 *   - `latestByUser[userId]` — a tiny snapshot `{id, viewedAt}` of the
 *     most recent coach_message we know about for this user, pushed in by
 *     the Home tab whenever its `useLatestCoachMessage` query resolves.
 *     Volatile (not persisted). Lets the tab-bar badge be computed from
 *     pure store state instead of mounting another `useQuery` observer
 *     in `MainTabNavigator` — that would otherwise keep the 60s polling
 *     loop alive while the parent is on a non-Home tab, which Step 4.14
 *     explicitly forbids.
 *
 * Lazy initialization (Step 4.14): the very first time a snapshot is
 * pushed for a user with no stored seen entry, we mark whatever message
 * is currently latest as "seen" — so an existing message that pre-dates
 * this code shipping doesn't pop a "new!" toast the first time the
 * parent opens the app post-update.
 */

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { create } from 'zustand';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'coachMessageSeen.v1';

export type LatestSnapshot = {
  id: string;
  viewedAt: string | null;
};

/**
 * Per-user seen value. `string` = id of the most recent message the
 * parent was notified about. `null` = the user has been initialized
 * (we've observed a query result for them post-update) but hasn't been
 * notified about any message yet — i.e. the very first message that
 * arrives later should still trigger isNew. Absent key = not yet
 * initialized.
 */
type SeenValue = string | null;

type State = {
  seenByUser: Record<string, SeenValue>;
  latestByUser: Record<string, LatestSnapshot | null>;
  hydrated: boolean;
  hydrate: () => Promise<void>;
  setLastSeen: (userId: string, messageId: SeenValue) => void;
  setLatest: (userId: string, snapshot: LatestSnapshot | null) => void;
};

async function readStorage(): Promise<Record<string, SeenValue>> {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      // Keep string + null entries; defensively drop anything else so a
      // corrupted blob doesn't poison the store.
      const out: Record<string, SeenValue> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed as Record<string, unknown>)) {
        if (typeof v === 'string' || v === null) out[k] = v;
      }
      return out;
    }
    return {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

async function writeStorage(map: Record<string, SeenValue>): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(map));
  } catch {
    // Best-effort persistence — the worst case is one stale "new" toast
    // after a cold start, which is preferable to crashing.
  }
}

let hydratePromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

export const useCoachMessageSeenStore = create<State>((set, get) => ({
  seenByUser: {},
  latestByUser: {},
  hydrated: false,
  hydrate: () => {
    if (get().hydrated) return Promise.resolve();
    if (hydratePromise) return hydratePromise;
    hydratePromise = readStorage().then((seenByUser) => {
      set({ seenByUser, hydrated: true });
    });
    return hydratePromise;
  },
  setLastSeen: (userId, messageId) => {
    const current = get().seenByUser;
    if (current[userId] === messageId) return;
    const next = { ...current, [userId]: messageId };
    set({ seenByUser: next });
    void writeStorage(next);
  },
  setLatest: (userId, snapshot) => {
    const current = get().latestByUser[userId] ?? null;
    if (
      current === snapshot ||
      (current &&
        snapshot &&
        current.id === snapshot.id &&
        current.viewedAt === snapshot.viewedAt)
    ) {
      return;
    }
    set({
      latestByUser: { ...get().latestByUser, [userId]: snapshot },
    });
  },
}));

/**
 * Convenience hook: kicks off hydration on first mount. Safe to call from
 * multiple components — `hydrate()` is idempotent and dedupes in-flight
 * reads via `hydratePromise`.
 */
export function useHydrateCoachMessageSeen() {
  const hydrate = useCoachMessageSeenStore((s) => s.hydrate);
  useEffect(() => {
    void hydrate();
  }, [hydrate]);
}

FILE: src/store/draftAssignment.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Draft assignment store.
 *
 * Keeps the in-progress drill the coach is composing on
 * CreateAssignmentScreen alive across navigation AND across full Expo Go
 * memory terminations.
 *
 * Why this exists: launching the system camera for a long video clip
 * (`ImagePicker.launchCameraAsync` from RecordVideoScreen with
 * `purpose: 'drill_assignment'`) routinely makes iOS reclaim the Expo
 * Go JS process to free RAM. When the app comes back, React Navigation
 * restores the route params (so `drillVideoId` survives via the merged
 * navigation param), but every screen's local `useState` is reset — so
 * the title / kid / notes / due date the coach already typed disappear.
 * The user sees what looks like a fresh CreateAssignment with the drill
 * video pre-attached. Reported by the user as "it refreshed the whole
 * drill, so I had to retype everything."
 *
 * Same pattern as `draftNotes.ts` (which solves the same problem for the
 * SendConfirmation note). Single global slot — there is only ever one
 * drill being composed at a time. Cleared on successful create AND on
 * Cancel so a future visit always starts blank unless the coach truly
 * abandoned mid-flow.
 *
 * Persisted to AsyncStorage so the draft survives a full process kill.
 * Hydration is lazy on first read; while loading the store returns
 * `null` (= no draft), which CreateAssignment treats as "use defaults".
 */

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { create } from 'zustand';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'draftAssignment.v1';

export type DraftAssignment = {
  selectedKidId: string | null;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  duration: string;
  dueDate: string;
  points: string;
  drillVideoId: string | null;
};

type DraftAssignmentState = {
  draft: DraftAssignment | null;
  hydrated: boolean;
  hydrate: () => Promise<void>;
  setDraft: (patch: Partial<DraftAssignment>) => void;
  clearDraft: () => void;
};

export const useDraftAssignmentStore = create<DraftAssignmentState>((set, get) => ({
  draft: null,
  hydrated: false,
  hydrate: async () => {
    if (get().hydrated) return;
    try {
      const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      // If the user already started typing in this session before
      // AsyncStorage resolved, `draft` will be non-null. Don't clobber
      // their fresh edits with a stale persisted blob — the in-memory
      // values are newer and will be re-persisted on the next setDraft.
      if (raw && get().draft === null) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as DraftAssignment;
        set({ draft: parsed, hydrated: true });
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // Corrupt JSON or AsyncStorage failure — fall through to empty draft.
    }
    set({ hydrated: true });
  },
  setDraft: (patch) => {
    const next: DraftAssignment = {
      selectedKidId: null,
      title: '',
      description: '',
      duration: '15',
      dueDate: '',
      points: '25',
      drillVideoId: null,
      ...(get().draft ?? {}),
      ...patch,
    };
    set({ draft: next });
    void AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next)).catch(() => {
      /* best-effort persistence */
    });
  },
  clearDraft: () => {
    set({ draft: null });
    void AsyncStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY).catch(() => {
      /* best-effort */
    });
  },
}));

/**
 * Draft notes store.
 *
 * Tiny Zustand slice that keeps the optional note a coach is composing on
 * the SendConfirmation screen alive across navigation. Without this, tapping
 * **Back** to fix the recipient unmounts the confirmation screen and any
 * typed note disappears, which the v0.4 Step 4.10 spec explicitly forbids.
 *
 * Keyed by `videoId` so each in-flight send maintains its own draft and we
 * never bleed text from one upload into another. `clearDraft` is called on
 * a successful send so the next time the same video id is somehow revisited
 * we start fresh.
 */

import { create } from 'zustand';

type DraftNotesState = {
  drafts: Record<string, string>;
  setDraft: (videoId: string, text: string) => void;
  clearDraft: (videoId: string) => void;
};

export const useDraftNotesStore = create<DraftNotesState>((set) => ({
  drafts: {},
  setDraft: (videoId, text) =>
    set((state) => ({ drafts: { ...state.drafts, [videoId]: text } })),
  clearDraft: (videoId) =>
    set((state) => {
      if (!(videoId in state.drafts)) return state;
      const rest = { ...state.drafts };
      delete rest[videoId];
      return { drafts: rest };
    }),
}));

export function useDraftNote(videoId: string): [string, (text: string) => void] {
  const value = useDraftNotesStore((s) => s.drafts[videoId] ?? '');
  const setDraft = useDraftNotesStore((s) => s.setDraft);
  return [value, (text: string) => setDraft(videoId, text)];
}

FILE: src/store/selectedKid.ts

/**
 * Selected kid store — persists which kid is "active" across app restarts.
 *
 * When a family has multiple kids, the parent picks one via the kid
 * switcher pill. The selection is stored here (AsyncStorage-backed) and
 * consumed by `useSelectedKid`, which is the single source of truth for
 * "which kid's data am I showing right now?"
 *
 * If the stored id is not in the current kids list (kid deleted, first
 * install, etc.) `useSelectedKid` falls back to `kids[0]` and updates
 * this store to match.
 */

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { create } from 'zustand';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'ballpark.selectedKidId';

type State = {
  selectedKidId: string | null;
  hydrated: boolean;
  hydrate: () => Promise<void>;
  setSelectedKid: (id: string | null) => void;
};

let hydratePromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

async function readStorage(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    return await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function writeStorage(id: string | null): Promise<void> {
  try {
    if (id === null) {
      await AsyncStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    } else {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, id);
    }
  } catch {
    // Best-effort; worst case is defaulting to kids[0] on next cold start.
  }
}

export const useSelectedKidStore = create<State>((set, get) => ({
  selectedKidId: null,
  hydrated: false,
  hydrate: () => {
    if (get().hydrated) return Promise.resolve();
    if (hydratePromise) return hydratePromise;
    hydratePromise = readStorage().then((id) => {
      set({ selectedKidId: id, hydrated: true });
    });
    return hydratePromise;
  },
  setSelectedKid: (id) => {
    if (get().selectedKidId === id) return;
    set({ selectedKidId: id });
    void writeStorage(id);
  },
}));

FILE: src/store/trainingProgress.ts

/**
 * Continue-watching local store for the Train tab (v0.7 task #121).
 *
 * Stores the last playback position (in seconds) per training_video.id
 * inside AsyncStorage. Read on the Train list to render the Continue
 * Watching row and to seed the player's start position on resume.
 *
 * Pragmatic format: a single JSON map under one key. We rewrite the
 * whole map on every save — the catalog is small (tens of videos) so
 * this avoids fan-out reads when rendering the list. A throttled
 * setter in the player screen keeps writes infrequent (every few
 * seconds while playing) so AsyncStorage doesn't become a bottleneck.
 *
 * Scoped per kid so siblings sharing a parent login don't collide.
 */

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

export type TrainingProgress = {
  positionSec: number;
  durationSec: number | null;
  updatedAt: number; // ms epoch
};

export type TrainingProgressMap = Record<string, TrainingProgress>;

const KEY_PREFIX = 'ballpark.trainingProgress.v1.';

function key(kidId: string): string {
  return `${KEY_PREFIX}${kidId}`;
}

export async function readProgress(kidId: string): Promise<TrainingProgressMap> {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(key(kidId));
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as TrainingProgressMap;
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export async function writeProgress(
  kidId: string,
  videoId: string,
  positionSec: number,
  durationSec: number | null,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const cur = await readProgress(kidId);
    cur[videoId] = {
      positionSec: Math.max(0, Math.floor(positionSec)),
      durationSec: durationSec ?? null,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(key(kidId), JSON.stringify(cur));
  } catch {
    // Best-effort — losing a single position update is fine.
  }
}

export async function clearProgress(kidId: string, videoId: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const cur = await readProgress(kidId);
    if (videoId in cur) {
      delete cur[videoId];
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(key(kidId), JSON.stringify(cur));
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}

/**
 * Font loader for Ballpark.
 *
 * Loads Oswald (display) and Inter (body) via expo-font's useFonts hook.
 *
 * IMPORTANT — family-name-per-weight pattern:
 * `@expo-google-fonts/*` exposes each weight as a separate font asset whose
 * registered family name matches the import (e.g. `Oswald_700Bold`). React
 * Native will NOT auto-select a weight from `style.fontWeight` when these
 * fonts are loaded this way. Always pick the family explicitly via
 * `fontFamilies.oswaldBold` (etc.) from `@/theme/tokens`.
 *
 * JetBrains Mono is intentionally NOT loaded yet — it's declared in tokens
 * for design reference but won't ship until v0.5 (redemption codes / IDs).
 */

import { useFonts } from 'expo-font';
import {
  Oswald_400Regular,
  Oswald_500Medium,
  Oswald_600SemiBold,
  Oswald_700Bold,
} from '@expo-google-fonts/oswald';
import {
  Inter_400Regular,
  Inter_500Medium,
  Inter_600SemiBold,
  Inter_700Bold,
  Inter_800ExtraBold,
} from '@expo-google-fonts/inter';

export function useAppFonts(): [boolean, Error | null] {
  const [loaded, error] = useFonts({
    Oswald_400Regular,
    Oswald_500Medium,
    Oswald_600SemiBold,
    Oswald_700Bold,
    Inter_400Regular,
    Inter_500Medium,
    Inter_600SemiBold,
    Inter_700Bold,
    Inter_800ExtraBold,
  });
  return [loaded, error];
}

/**
 * Logical font family names for design reference.
 *
 * IMPORTANT: React Native does NOT pick the right cut from `fontWeight` when
 * using `@expo-google-fonts/*` — each weight is a separate font family at the
 * native level (e.g. `Oswald_700Bold`, `Inter_500Medium`). Use the
 * `fontFamilies` map below in `style.fontFamily` to pick a specific weight,
 * and only set `fontWeight` as a stylistic hint for fallback fonts.
 *
 * Mono is declared here for design reference but not loaded yet (deferred to
 * v0.5 when redemption codes ship).
 */

  mono: 'JetBrains Mono',
} as const;

/**
 * Local augmentation of the generated Supabase Database types for the
 * `public.coach_messages` columns added by migration
 * `20260509000000_v07_parent_to_coach_messages.sql` (label, sender_display,
 * recipient_coach_user_id) and the `public.videos.purpose` value
 * `'parent_to_coach'`.
 *
 * This file is the SINGLE place that bridges the gap until
 * `src/types/database.ts` is regenerated against the dev DB. Use
 * `supabaseExt` from `@/lib/supabase` (re-exported below) wherever you
 * need to insert/select these columns with full type safety — no `any`
 * casts, no per-call workarounds.
 */

import type { Database } from './database';

type CoachMessagesTable = Database['public']['Tables']['coach_messages'];
type CoachMessagesExtRow = CoachMessagesTable['Row'] & {
  label: string | null;
  sender_display: string | null;
  recipient_coach_user_id: string | null;
};
type CoachMessagesExtInsert = CoachMessagesTable['Insert'] & {
  label?: string | null;
  sender_display?: string | null;
  recipient_coach_user_id?: string | null;
};
type CoachMessagesExtUpdate = CoachMessagesTable['Update'] & {
  label?: string | null;
  sender_display?: string | null;
  recipient_coach_user_id?: string | null;
};

export type DatabaseExt = Omit<Database, 'public'> & {
  public: Omit<Database['public'], 'Tables'> & {
    Tables: Omit<Database['public']['Tables'], 'coach_messages'> & {
      coach_messages: Omit<CoachMessagesTable, 'Row' | 'Insert' | 'Update'> & {
        Row: CoachMessagesExtRow;
        Insert: CoachMessagesExtInsert;
        Update: CoachMessagesExtUpdate;
      };
    };
  };
};

FILE: src/utils/authRedirect.ts

/**
 * Deep-link redirect URL used for Supabase auth email links.
 *
 * Resolution order:
 *  1. `EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_REDIRECT_HOST` (preferred for prod) → returns
 *     `https://{host}/auth/callback`. The matching `app.config.js` registers
 *     this host as an iOS Associated Domain and an Android App Link with
 *     `autoVerify=true`, so tapping the link opens Ballpark when installed
 *     and falls through to the web URL (where you can show a "Get the app"
 *     landing page) when not. Add this URL to Supabase Auth → URL
 *     Configuration → Redirect URLs allow-list.
 *  2. Otherwise, `Linking.createURL('/auth/callback')` →
 *     `ballpark:///auth/callback` in standalone builds, or the appropriate
 *     `exp://…` form in Expo Go. Custom-scheme only — fine for local dev,
 *     no graceful fallback when the app isn't installed.
 */

import * as Linking from 'expo-linking';

const AUTH_REDIRECT_HOST = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_REDIRECT_HOST;

export function getEmailRedirectUrl(): string {
  if (AUTH_REDIRECT_HOST) {
    return `https://${AUTH_REDIRECT_HOST}/auth/callback`;
  }
  return Linking.createURL('/auth/callback');
}

/**
 * Returns the PKCE `code` query param from a Supabase auth redirect URL, or
 * null if the URL isn't an auth callback we should handle.
 *
 * Supabase appends `?code=...` (PKCE flow) on success or `?error=...` on
 * failure to whatever `emailRedirectTo` was sent with the signup.
 */
export function parseAuthCallbackCode(url: string): string | null {
  try {
    const parsed = Linking.parse(url);
    // Only handle URLs that target our auth callback path so we don't
    // accidentally consume codes from unrelated deep links (e.g. a future
    // marketing link that also has a `?code=` query param).
    const path = parsed.path ?? '';
    const normalized = path.replace(/^\/+/, '');
    if (normalized !== 'auth/callback') return null;
    const code = parsed.queryParams?.code;
    return typeof code === 'string' && code.length > 0 ? code : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}


=================================================================================
FILE: src/utils/date.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Date helpers — keep timezone-sensitive logic in one place so we don't
 * accidentally mix UTC and local-date math when comparing against
 * Postgres `date` columns (which are timezone-naïve YYYY-MM-DD strings).
 */

/**
 * Today's date in the device's LOCAL timezone, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
 *
 * `new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)` returns the UTC date, which can
 * be off-by-one from the user's perspective: a parent in Pacific time on
 * May 6 evening would already be May 7 in UTC, so an assignment due
 * 2026-05-07 would incorrectly land in "Upcoming" instead of "Due now".
 * This helper builds the date from local components instead.
 */
export function todayLocalIso(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}


=================================================================================
FILE: src/utils/error.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Extract a human-readable message from anything thrown — including the
 * non-Error objects supabase-js / postgrest-js return.
 *
 * Supabase's `PostgrestError` and `AuthError` are plain objects with
 * `{ message, code, details, hint }` and do NOT pass `instanceof Error`.
 * A naive `err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error'` therefore
 * swallows them. This helper walks the most informative fields in order
 * and only falls back to a JSON dump as a last resort.
 */
export function errorMessage(err: unknown): string {
  if (err == null) return 'Unknown error';
  if (typeof err === 'string') return err;

  if (typeof err === 'object') {
    const e = err as {
      message?: unknown;
      details?: unknown;
      hint?: unknown;
      code?: unknown;
      error_description?: unknown;
    };

    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (typeof e.message === 'string' && e.message.trim()) parts.push(e.message.trim());
    else if (typeof e.error_description === 'string' && e.error_description.trim())
      parts.push(e.error_description.trim());

    if (typeof e.details === 'string' && e.details.trim() && !parts.includes(e.details.trim()))
      parts.push(e.details.trim());
    if (typeof e.hint === 'string' && e.hint.trim()) parts.push(`(hint: ${e.hint.trim()})`);
    if (typeof e.code === 'string' && e.code.trim()) parts.push(`[${e.code.trim()}]`);

    if (parts.length) return parts.join(' ');

    try {
      return JSON.stringify(err);
    } catch {
      return String(err);
    }
  }

  return String(err);
}


=================================================================================
FILE: src/utils/time.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Tiny relative-time helper used by the coach Sent Videos list (Step 4.11),
 * the parent Home tab's coach video card (Step 4.12), and any other
 * "when did this happen" UI we add later.
 *
 * Intentionally framework-free — no date-fns / moment / luxon dependency.
 * Buckets are aligned with the v0.4 design spec:
 *   < 60s     -> "Just now"
 *   < 60m     -> "Nm ago"
 *   < 24h     -> "Nh ago"
 *   = 1 day   -> "Yesterday"
 *   < 7 days  -> "N days ago"
 *   else      -> "MMM d" (e.g. "Mar 14")
 *
 * Future timestamps (clock skew, optimistic inserts dated forward) are
 * clamped to "Just now" so the UI never renders e.g. "-3m ago".
 */

const MONTHS = [
  'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
  'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec',
] as const;

export function formatRelativeTime(
  input: Date | string | number,
  now: Date = new Date(),
): string {
  const d = input instanceof Date ? input : new Date(input);
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - d.getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(diffMs)) return '';
  if (diffMs < 60_000) return 'Just now';

  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60_000);
  if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin}m ago`;

  const diffHr = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  if (diffHr < 24) return `${diffHr}h ago`;

  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHr / 24);
  if (diffDay === 1) return 'Yesterday';
  if (diffDay < 7) return `${diffDay} days ago`;

  return `${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}`;
}


=================================================================================
FILE: src/utils/uploadVideo.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Stream a local video file to a Mux Direct Upload URL.
 *
 * Uses `expo-file-system`'s legacy `createUploadTask` with
 * `BINARY_CONTENT` upload type, which is the canonical Expo way to PUT a
 * `file://` URI as the raw request body. The native module streams the
 * file bytes directly — no JS-side base64/Blob round-trip — and exposes a
 * real progress callback (RN's `fetch` doesn't, and the XHR-with-fake-Blob
 * pattern only works for FormData parts, not for raw PUT bodies).
 *
 * Single attempt; resumable / chunked uploads are out of scope for v0.4
 * (see Step 4.6 task notes).
 */

import {
  createUploadTask,
  FileSystemSessionType,
  FileSystemUploadType,
  type FileSystemUploadResult,
  type UploadTask,
} from 'expo-file-system/legacy';

export type UploadProgressHandler = (fraction: number) => void;

export type UploadHandle = {
  /** Cancel the in-flight PUT. The promise rejects with `UploadCancelledError`. */
  cancel: () => void;
};

export class UploadCancelledError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super('Upload cancelled');
    this.name = 'UploadCancelledError';
  }
}

export class UploadFailedError extends Error {
  status: number;
  constructor(status: number, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'UploadFailedError';
    this.status = status;
  }
}

export type UploadOptions = {
  uploadUrl: string;
  fileUri: string;
  /** MIME type from the picker if known; falls back to a generic binary type. */
  contentType?: string;
  onProgress?: UploadProgressHandler;
};

/**
 * Returns the upload promise plus a cancel handle. Resolve = HTTP 2xx;
 * reject = `UploadCancelledError` | `UploadFailedError`.
 */
export function uploadVideoToMux(opts: UploadOptions): {
  promise: Promise<void>;
  handle: UploadHandle;
} {
  let cancelled = false;
  let task: UploadTask | null = null;

  const handle: UploadHandle = {
    cancel: () => {
      cancelled = true;
      // cancelAsync is fire-and-forget from the caller's perspective —
      // the awaited uploadAsync() will resolve with `undefined` on cancel,
      // which the promise body below maps to UploadCancelledError.
      void task?.cancelAsync().catch(() => {
        /* already finished or never started */
      });
    },
  };

  const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    task = createUploadTask(
      opts.uploadUrl,
      opts.fileUri,
      {
        httpMethod: 'PUT',
        uploadType: FileSystemUploadType.BINARY_CONTENT,
        // FOREGROUND so cancelAsync() actually stops bytes mid-flight on
        // iOS; BACKGROUND uploads continue past the JS lifecycle which we
        // explicitly don't want for v0.4 (see task notes).
        sessionType: FileSystemSessionType.FOREGROUND,
        headers: {
          'Content-Type':
            opts.contentType?.trim() ? opts.contentType : 'application/octet-stream',
        },
      },
      (data) => {
        const { totalBytesSent, totalBytesExpectedToSend } = data;
        if (totalBytesExpectedToSend > 0) {
          const fraction = Math.min(
            1,
            Math.max(0, totalBytesSent / totalBytesExpectedToSend),
          );
          opts.onProgress?.(fraction);
        }
      },
    );

    task
      .uploadAsync()
      .then((result: FileSystemUploadResult | undefined | null) => {
        if (cancelled || !result) {
          reject(new UploadCancelledError());
          return;
        }
        if (result.status >= 200 && result.status < 300) {
          opts.onProgress?.(1);
          resolve();
          return;
        }
        reject(
          new UploadFailedError(
            result.status,
            `Upload failed with status ${result.status}`,
          ),
        );
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (cancelled) {
          reject(new UploadCancelledError());
          return;
        }
        const message =
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Network error during upload';
        reject(new UploadFailedError(0, message));
      });
  });

  return { promise, handle };
}


=================================================================================
FILE: src/utils/uuid.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * UUID v4 generator that works in React Native (where `crypto.randomUUID`
 * isn't always available across Hermes / iOS / Android consistently).
 *
 * Used for client-generated `Idempotency-Key` headers so a flaky upload
 * retry hits the same server-side row instead of creating a duplicate.
 *
 * Not security-sensitive — `Math.random` is fine for idempotency tokens.
 */
export function uuidv4(): string {
  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, (c) => {
    const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return v.toString(16);
  });
}

import path from "node:path";
import type { NextConfig } from "next";

const replitDevDomain = process.env.REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN;
const replitExpoDevDomain = process.env.REPLIT_EXPO_DEV_DOMAIN;

const allowedOrigins = [
  "localhost:5000",
  "localhost:3000",
  ...(replitDevDomain
    ? [replitDevDomain, `${replitDevDomain}:5000`]
    : []),
  ...(replitExpoDevDomain ? [replitExpoDevDomain] : []),
];

const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  outputFileTracingRoot: path.join(__dirname),
  experimental: {
    serverActions: {
      allowedOrigins,
    },
  },
  async headers() {
    if (!isDev) return [];
    return [
      {
        source: '/(.*)',
        headers: [
          { key: 'Cache-Control', value: 'no-store, must-revalidate' },
          { key: 'Pragma', value: 'no-cache' },
        ],
      },
    ];
  },
  async rewrites() {
    // beforeFiles: run BEFORE Next.js app-router pages so the expo-platform
    // requests are proxied to Metro (port 8080) before the auth layer can
    // redirect unauthenticated requests to /login.
    const expoRewrites = [
      // Expo manifest request (expo-platform header present)
      {
        source: "/",
        has: [{ type: "header", key: "expo-platform" }],
        destination: "http://localhost:8080/",
      },
      {
        source: "/:path+",
        has: [{ type: "header", key: "expo-platform" }],
        destination: "http://localhost:8080/:path+",
      },
      // JS bundle downloads (platform=ios or platform=android query param)
      {
        source: "/:path*",
        has: [{ type: "query", key: "platform", value: "ios" }],
        destination: "http://localhost:8080/:path*",
      },
      {
        source: "/:path*",
        has: [{ type: "query", key: "platform", value: "android" }],
        destination: "http://localhost:8080/:path*",
      },
      // React Native assets (fonts, images) — path-based, no special header needed
      {
        source: "/assets/:path*",
        destination: "http://localhost:8080/assets/:path*",
      },
      // Source maps
      {
        source: "/symbolicate",
        destination: "http://localhost:8080/symbolicate",
      },
    ];
    return {
      beforeFiles: expoRewrites,
    };
  },
};

export default nextConfig;

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { updateSession } from "@/lib/supabase/middleware";

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  if (request.headers.get("expo-platform")) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }
  // Public booking pages require no authentication
  if (request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith("/book")) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }
  return await updateSession(request);
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    /*
     * Match all request paths except for the ones starting with:
     * - _next/static (static files)
     * - _next/image (image optimization files)
     * - favicon.ico (favicon file)
     * - image files
     */
    "/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$).*)",
  ],
};
