'use server';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

type CheckInRpc = 'check_in_booking' | 'mark_no_show' | 'undo_check_in';

export type CheckInRpcResult =
  | { ok: true; data: { id: string; status: string; attended_at: string | null; cage_number: string | null } }
  | { ok: false; message: string };

async function resolvedRole() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  let role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role === 'parent' && user.app_metadata?.app_role) {
    role = user.app_metadata.app_role as typeof role;
  }
  if (role === 'parent' && user.user_metadata?.app_role) {
    role = user.user_metadata.app_role as typeof role;
  }
  return role;
}

async function callCheckInRpc(rpc: CheckInRpc, bookingId: string): Promise<CheckInRpcResult> {
  const role = await resolvedRole();
  if (!role || (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'owner' && role !== 'super_admin' && role !== 'coach')) {
    return { ok: false, message: 'Not authorised.' };
  }

  const service = createServiceClient();
  const { data, error } = await service.rpc(rpc, { p_booking_id: bookingId });

  if (error) {
    const msg = (error.message ?? '').includes('UNDO_WINDOW_EXPIRED')
      ? 'Undo window has expired (5 minutes).'
      : error.message || 'Something went wrong.';
    return { ok: false, message: msg };
  }

  return { ok: true, data: data as { id: string; status: string; attended_at: string | null; cage_number: string | null } };
}

export async function checkInBookingAction(bookingId: string): Promise<CheckInRpcResult> {
  return callCheckInRpc('check_in_booking', bookingId);
}

export async function markNoShowAction(bookingId: string): Promise<CheckInRpcResult> {
  return callCheckInRpc('mark_no_show', bookingId);
}

export async function undoCheckInAction(bookingId: string): Promise<CheckInRpcResult> {
  return callCheckInRpc('undo_check_in', bookingId);
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { checkInBookingAction, markNoShowAction, undoCheckInAction } from './actions';
import { CheckCircle, XCircle, RotateCcw, Clock, UserCircle, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/Card';

export type CheckInBooking = {
  id: string;
  scheduled_start: string;
  scheduled_end: string;
  cage_number: string | null;
  status: string;
  attended_at: string | null;
  kid_first_name: string | null;
  kid_last_name: string | null;
  coach_first_name: string | null;
  coach_last_name: string | null;
  session_type_name: string | null;
};

export type WaitlistCount = {
  hour_label: string;
  count: number;
};

type BookingState = CheckInBooking & { pending?: 'checkin' | 'noshow' | 'undo' };

function statusChip(status: string) {
  const map: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
    confirmed:  { label: 'Confirmed',  cls: 'border-border-gold text-gold bg-gold/10' },
    pending:    { label: 'Pending',    cls: 'border-yellow-600 text-yellow-400 bg-yellow-900/20' },
    completed:  { label: 'Arrived',   cls: 'border-emerald-600 text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-900/20' },
    no_show:    { label: 'No Show',   cls: 'border-red-700 text-red-400 bg-red-900/20' },
    cancelled:  { label: 'Cancelled', cls: 'border-gray-600 text-gray-400 bg-gray-900/20' },
  };
  const s = map[status] ?? { label: status, cls: 'border-border-gold text-text-light' };
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${s.cls}`}>
      {s.label}
    </span>
  );
}

function hourLabel(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const h = d.getHours();
  const min = d.getMinutes();
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h > 12 ? h - 12 : h === 0 ? 12 : h;
  return min === 0 ? `${h12}:00 ${ampm}` : `${h12}:${String(min).padStart(2, '0')} ${ampm}`;
}

function kidName(b: CheckInBooking): string {
  return [b.kid_first_name, b.kid_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Unknown';
}
function coachName(b: CheckInBooking): string {
  return [b.coach_first_name, b.coach_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || '—';
}

function isWithinUndo(b: CheckInBooking): boolean {
  if (!b.attended_at || b.status !== 'completed') return false;
  return Date.now() - new Date(b.attended_at).getTime() < 5 * 60 * 1000;
}

type Props = { initialBookings: CheckInBooking[]; waitlistCounts: WaitlistCount[]; tenantId: string };

export function CheckInBoard({ initialBookings, waitlistCounts, tenantId }: Props) {
  const [bookings, setBookings] = useState<BookingState[]>(initialBookings);
  const waitlistByHour = new Map(waitlistCounts.map((w) => [w.hour_label, w.count]));
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ msg: string; ok: boolean } | null>(null);

  const showToast = useCallback((msg: string, ok = true) => {
    setToast({ msg, ok });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!toast) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [toast]);

  // Realtime subscription
  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createClient();
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const tomorrow = new Date(today.getTime() + 86_400_000);

    const channel = supabase
      .channel('checkin-bookings')
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        {
          event: '*',
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'bookings',
          filter: `tenant_id=eq.${tenantId}`,
        },
        (payload) => {
          const row = payload.new as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (!row || !row.id) return;
          const start = new Date(row.scheduled_start as string);
          if (start < today || start >= tomorrow) return;

          if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE') {
            setBookings((prev) => prev.filter((b) => b.id !== (payload.old as Record<string, unknown>).id));
            return;
          }

          setBookings((prev) => {
            const idx = prev.findIndex((b) => b.id === row.id);
            if (idx === -1) return prev;
            const updated: BookingState = {
              ...prev[idx],
              status: row.status as string,
              attended_at: (row.attended_at as string | null) ?? null,
              cage_number: (row.cage_number as string | null) ?? null,
              pending: undefined,
            };
            const next = [...prev];
            next[idx] = updated;
            return next;
          });
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => { void supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [tenantId]);

  const callRpc = useCallback(
    async (
      rpc: 'check_in_booking' | 'mark_no_show' | 'undo_check_in',
      bookingId: string,
      pendingState: 'checkin' | 'noshow' | 'undo',
    ) => {
      setBookings((prev) =>
        prev.map((b) => (b.id === bookingId ? { ...b, pending: pendingState } : b)),
      );

      const actionMap = {
        check_in_booking: checkInBookingAction,
        mark_no_show: markNoShowAction,
        undo_check_in: undoCheckInAction,
      };
      const result = await actionMap[rpc](bookingId);

      if (!result.ok) {
        setBookings((prev) =>
          prev.map((b) => (b.id === bookingId ? { ...b, pending: undefined } : b)),
        );
        showToast(result.message, false);
        return;
      }

      const updated = result.data;
      setBookings((prev) =>
        prev.map((b) =>
          b.id === bookingId
            ? { ...b, status: updated.status, attended_at: updated.attended_at, pending: undefined }
            : b,
        ),
      );

      const labels: Record<string, string> = {
        check_in_booking: 'Checked in!',
        mark_no_show: 'Marked no-show.',
        undo_check_in: 'Check-in undone.',
      };
      showToast(labels[rpc] ?? 'Done.');
    },
    [showToast],
  );

  // Group by hour slot
  const groups = new Map<string, BookingState[]>();
  for (const b of bookings) {
    const label = hourLabel(b.scheduled_start);
    if (!groups.has(label)) groups.set(label, []);
    groups.get(label)!.push(b);
  }
  const sortedHours = Array.from(groups.keys()).sort((a, b) => {
    const toMin = (s: string) => {
      const [time, ampm] = s.split(' ');
      const [h, m] = time.split(':').map(Number);
      return (ampm === 'PM' && h !== 12 ? h + 12 : ampm === 'AM' && h === 12 ? 0 : h) * 60 + m;
    };
    return toMin(a) - toMin(b);
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div
          className={[
            'fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium shadow-xl transition-all',
            toast.ok
              ? 'border-emerald-600 bg-emerald-900/80 text-emerald-300'
              : 'border-red-700 bg-red-900/80 text-red-300',
          ].join(' ')}
        >
          {toast.ok ? <CheckCircle size={15} /> : <XCircle size={15} />}
          {toast.msg}
        </div>
      )}

      {bookings.length === 0 && (
        <Card padding="lg" className="border-dashed">
          <p className="text-center text-sm text-text-light">
            No bookings scheduled for today.
          </p>
        </Card>
      )}

      {sortedHours.map((hour) => {
        const slots = groups.get(hour)!;
        return (
          <section key={hour}>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-3">
              <Clock size={14} className="text-gold" />
              <h2 className="font-display text-lg font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gold">
                {hour}
              </h2>
              <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                {slots.length} session{slots.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
              </span>
              {waitlistByHour.get(hour) ? (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-amber-600 bg-amber-900/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-amber-400">
                  <Users size={10} />
                  Waitlist: {waitlistByHour.get(hour)}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              {slots.map((b) => {
                const isLoading = !!b.pending;
                const canUndo = isWithinUndo(b);

                return (
                  <Card key={b.id} padding="md">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
                      {/* Avatar */}
                      <div className="flex h-10 w-10 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border-gold bg-darkest text-gold">
                        <UserCircle size={24} strokeWidth={1.5} />
                      </div>

                      {/* Info */}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-[160px]">
                        <p className="font-display text-base font-semibold text-cream-light">
                          {kidName(b)}
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-text-light">
                          {b.session_type_name ?? 'Session'}
                          {b.cage_number ? ` · Cage ${b.cage_number}` : ''}
                          {' · '}{coachName(b)}
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      {/* Status chip */}
                      <div className="flex-shrink-0">
                        {statusChip(b.status)}
                      </div>

                      {/* Actions */}
                      <div className="flex flex-shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                        {(b.status === 'confirmed' || b.status === 'pending') && (
                          <>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={isLoading}
                              onClick={() => callRpc('check_in_booking', b.id, 'checkin')}
                              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-emerald-700 bg-emerald-900/30 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-400 transition hover:bg-emerald-800/50 disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                              {b.pending === 'checkin' ? '…' : <><CheckCircle size={13} /> Check In</>}
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={isLoading}
                              onClick={() => callRpc('mark_no_show', b.id, 'noshow')}
                              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-red-800 bg-red-900/20 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-red-400 transition hover:bg-red-900/40 disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                              {b.pending === 'noshow' ? '…' : <><XCircle size={13} /> No Show</>}
                            </button>
                          </>
                        )}

                        {b.status === 'completed' && canUndo && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={isLoading}
                            onClick={() => callRpc('undo_check_in', b.id, 'undo')}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-light transition hover:border-gold hover:text-cream-light disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            {b.pending === 'undo' ? '…' : <><RotateCcw size={13} /> Undo</>}
                          </button>
                        )}

                        {b.status === 'completed' && !canUndo && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-text-light/60 italic">Arrived</span>
                        )}
                        {b.status === 'no_show' && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-text-light/60 italic">No show recorded</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { CheckInBoard, type CheckInBooking, type WaitlistCount } from './CheckInBoard';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function CheckInPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect('/login?reason=unauthenticated');

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  // Resolve role — JWT claim with app_metadata fallback, then user_metadata
  // fallback for owner accounts (raw_user_meta_data → user_metadata in JS SDK)
  let role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role === 'parent' && user.app_metadata?.app_role) {
    role = user.app_metadata.app_role as ReturnType<typeof readAppRole>;
  }
  if (role === 'parent' && user.user_metadata?.app_role) {
    role = user.user_metadata.app_role as ReturnType<typeof readAppRole>;
  }
  if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'owner' && role !== 'super_admin') {
    redirect('/logout?reason=forbidden');
  }

  // Resolve tenantId — JWT claim with user_metadata fallback for production
  let tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId && user.app_metadata?.tenant_id) {
    tenantId = user.app_metadata.tenant_id as string;
  }
  if (!tenantId && user.user_metadata?.tenant_id) {
    tenantId = user.user_metadata.tenant_id as string;
  }
  if (!tenantId) redirect('/logout?reason=no-tenant');

  // Today's bookings in the admin's tenant (RLS scopes by staff_locations)
  const todayStart = new Date();
  todayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const todayEnd = new Date();
  todayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

  const { data: rows } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .select(
      `id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, cage_number, status, attended_at,
       kid:kid_id(first_name, last_name),
       coach:coach_id(first_name, last_name),
       session_type:session_type_id(name)`,
    )
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .gte('scheduled_start', todayStart.toISOString())
    .lte('scheduled_start', todayEnd.toISOString())
    .not('status', 'in', '("cancelled")')
    .order('scheduled_start');

  type RawRow = {
    id: string;
    scheduled_start: string;
    scheduled_end: string;
    cage_number: string | null;
    status: string;
    attended_at: string | null;
    kid: { first_name: string | null; last_name: string | null } | null;
    coach: { first_name: string | null; last_name: string | null } | null;
    session_type: { name: string | null } | null;
  };

  const bookings: CheckInBooking[] = ((rows ?? []) as unknown as RawRow[]).map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    scheduled_start: r.scheduled_start,
    scheduled_end: r.scheduled_end,
    cage_number: r.cage_number,
    status: r.status,
    attended_at: r.attended_at,
    kid_first_name: r.kid?.first_name ?? null,
    kid_last_name: r.kid?.last_name ?? null,
    coach_first_name: r.coach?.first_name ?? null,
    coach_last_name: r.coach?.last_name ?? null,
    session_type_name: r.session_type?.name ?? null,
  }));

  // Waitlist counts grouped by hour label — matches how CheckInBoard groups rows
  const { data: waitlistRows } = await supabase
    .from('booking_waitlist')
    .select('scheduled_start')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .in('status', ['waiting', 'notified'])
    .gte('scheduled_start', todayStart.toISOString())
    .lte('scheduled_start', todayEnd.toISOString());

  function toHourLabel(iso: string): string {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    const h24 = d.getHours();
    const period = h24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    const h12 = h24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h24 % 12;
    return `${h12}:00 ${period}`;
  }

  const hourCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const row of waitlistRows ?? []) {
    const label = toHourLabel(row.scheduled_start);
    hourCounts.set(label, (hourCounts.get(label) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const waitlistCounts: WaitlistCount[] = Array.from(hourCounts.entries()).map(
    ([hour_label, count]) => ({ hour_label, count }),
  );

  const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'long',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  const totalWaitlist = waitlistRows?.length ?? 0;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Check-In
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          {today} · {bookings.length} booking{bookings.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} today
          {totalWaitlist > 0 ? ` · ${totalWaitlist} on waitlist` : ''}
        </p>
      </div>

      <CheckInBoard initialBookings={bookings} waitlistCounts={waitlistCounts} tenantId={tenantId} />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/admin/coaches/[id]/locations/actions.ts

"use server";
/**
 * Server actions for the coach location assignment page.
 *
 * Reads/writes coach_locations (junction table).
 * RLS requires app_role IN ('owner','admin') with tenant scope.
 *
 * AUTHORIZATION MODEL:
 *   owner  — can assign/remove any coach to any location in their tenant.
 *   admin  — can only assign/remove coaches to locations they are themselves
 *            assigned to (staff_locations table). Any location ID not in
 *            their staff_locations is rejected server-side, regardless of
 *            what the UI shows.
 *
 * CROSS-TENANT PROTECTION:
 *   Both the coach and the location are verified to belong to tenantId before
 *   any write to coach_locations. This prevents a crafted request from binding
 *   a coach UUID from another tenant to a valid location.
 */

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

type RequireAdminResult = {
  supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>;
  tenantId: string;
  role: string;
  userId: string;
};

async function requireAdmin(): Promise<RequireAdminResult> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "admin" && role !== "owner") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");
  return { supabase, tenantId, role, userId: session.user.id };
}

/**
 * Verify the coach exists and belongs to the caller's tenant.
 * This is the primary cross-tenant guard: an admin cannot pair a coach UUID
 * from another tenant with their location even if they know the value.
 */
async function authorizeCoach(
  supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>,
  coachId: string,
  tenantId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const { data: coach } = await supabase
    .from("coaches")
    .select("id")
    .eq("id", coachId)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!coach) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?error=${encodeURIComponent(
        "Coach not found or not in your organisation.",
      )}`,
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Verify the location belongs to the tenant AND (for admin role) is one of
 * the caller's staff_locations assignments. Redirects with an error on failure.
 */
async function authorizeLocation(
  supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>,
  coachId: string,
  locationId: string,
  tenantId: string,
  role: string,
  userId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  // All roles: verify location belongs to this tenant.
  const { data: loc } = await supabase
    .from("locations")
    .select("id")
    .eq("id", locationId)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!loc) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?error=${encodeURIComponent("Location not found.")}`,
    );
  }

  // Admin only: additionally verify the location is in their staff_locations.
  // Owners have tenant-wide access and skip this check.
  if (role === "admin") {
    const { data: staffLoc } = await supabase
      .from("staff_locations")
      .select("location_id")
      .eq("user_id", userId)
      .eq("location_id", locationId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!staffLoc) {
      redirect(
        `/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?error=${encodeURIComponent(
          "You are not authorized to manage this location.",
        )}`,
      );
    }
  }
}

export async function assignCoachToLocation(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId, role, userId } = await requireAdmin();

  const coachId = String(formData.get("coach_id") ?? "").trim();
  const locationId = String(formData.get("location_id") ?? "").trim();

  if (!coachId || !locationId) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?error=${encodeURIComponent("Missing coach or location.")}`,
    );
  }

  // Verify both coach and location belong to this tenant before any write.
  await authorizeCoach(supabase, coachId, tenantId);
  await authorizeLocation(supabase, coachId, locationId, tenantId, role, userId);

  const { error } = await supabase.from("coach_locations").upsert(
    { coach_id: coachId, location_id: locationId, is_primary: false },
    { onConflict: "coach_id,location_id", ignoreDuplicates: true },
  );

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath(`/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations`);
  redirect(`/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?saved=1`);
}

export async function removeCoachFromLocation(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId, role, userId } = await requireAdmin();

  const coachId = String(formData.get("coach_id") ?? "").trim();
  const locationId = String(formData.get("location_id") ?? "").trim();

  if (!coachId || !locationId) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?error=${encodeURIComponent("Missing coach or location.")}`,
    );
  }

  // Verify both coach and location belong to this tenant before any write.
  await authorizeCoach(supabase, coachId, tenantId);
  await authorizeLocation(supabase, coachId, locationId, tenantId, role, userId);

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("coach_locations")
    .delete()
    .eq("coach_id", coachId)
    .eq("location_id", locationId);

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath(`/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations`);
  redirect(`/admin/coaches/${coachId}/locations?removed=1`);
}

FILE: portal/app/admin/coaches/[id]/locations/page.tsx
=================================================================================
/**
 * Admin page: manage which locations a coach is assigned to.
 *
 * Route: /admin/coaches/[id]/locations
 *
 * Shows:
 *   - Coach name and primary location
 *   - List of currently assigned locations (from coach_locations)
 *   - Add button for locations not yet assigned
 *   - Remove button for each assigned location (except primary if it's the last one)
 */

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { Card, CardSectionLabel } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { assignCoachToLocation, removeCoachFromLocation } from "./actions";

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ error?: string; saved?: string; removed?: string }>;
};

export default async function CoachLocationsPage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const { id: coachId } = await params;
  const sp = await searchParams;

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "admin" && role !== "owner") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  // Fetch the coach.
  const { data: coach } = await supabase
    .from("coaches")
    .select("id, first_name, last_name, primary_location_id, is_active")
    .eq("id", coachId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!coach) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <Link href="/admin" className="text-sm text-gold hover:underline">
          ← Admin
        </Link>
        <p className="text-sm text-danger">Coach not found.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Fetch all tenant locations.
  const { data: allLocations } = await supabase
    .from("locations")
    .select("id, name, city, state")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .order("name");

  const locations = allLocations ?? [];

  // Fetch currently assigned coach_locations rows.
  const { data: assignedRows } = await supabase
    .from("coach_locations")
    .select("id, location_id, is_primary")
    .eq("coach_id", coachId);

  type AssignedRow = { id: string; location_id: string; is_primary: boolean };
  type LocationRow = { id: string; name: string; city: string | null; state: string | null };

  const assigned: AssignedRow[] = (assignedRows ?? []) as AssignedRow[];
  const assignedLocationIds = new Set(assigned.map((r: AssignedRow) => r.location_id));

  const locRows: LocationRow[] = (locations as LocationRow[]);
  const assignedLocations = locRows.filter((l: LocationRow) => assignedLocationIds.has(l.id));
  const unassignedLocations = locRows.filter((l: LocationRow) => !assignedLocationIds.has(l.id));

  const coachName = `${coach.first_name} ${coach.last_name}`;
  const errorMsg = sp.error ? decodeURIComponent(sp.error) : null;
  const saved = sp.saved === "1";
  const removed = sp.removed === "1";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Breadcrumb */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-text-light">
        <Link href="/admin" className="hover:text-gold">
          Admin
        </Link>
        <span>/</span>
        <span className="text-cream-light">{coachName} — Locations</span>
      </div>

      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Coach Locations
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          {coachName} · {coach.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Feedback banners */}
      {saved && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-success bg-success-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-success">
          Location assigned successfully.
        </div>
      )}
      {removed && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-success bg-success-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-success">
          Location removed successfully.
        </div>
      )}
      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-danger bg-danger-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-danger">
          {errorMsg}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Currently assigned */}
      <Card padding="lg">
        <CardSectionLabel>Assigned Locations</CardSectionLabel>
        {assignedLocations.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-text-light">
            No locations assigned yet. Add one below.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="mt-3 divide-y divide-border">
            {assignedLocations.map((loc: LocationRow) => {
              const isPrimary = loc.id === coach.primary_location_id;
              return (
                <li
                  key={loc.id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-3"
                >
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-medium text-cream-light">{loc.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-light">
                      {loc.city}, {loc.state}
                      {isPrimary && (
                        <span className="ml-2 rounded bg-gold/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gold">
                          primary
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <form action={removeCoachFromLocation}>
                    <input type="hidden" name="coach_id" value={coachId} />
                    <input type="hidden" name="location_id" value={loc.id} />
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text-light transition hover:border-danger hover:text-danger"
                    >
                      Remove
                    </button>
                  </form>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* Add a new location */}
      {unassignedLocations.length > 0 && (
        <Card padding="lg">
          <CardSectionLabel>Add Location</CardSectionLabel>
          <form action={assignCoachToLocation} className="mt-3 flex items-end gap-3">
            <input type="hidden" name="coach_id" value={coachId} />
            <div className="flex-1">
              <label
                htmlFor="location_id"
                className="mb-1 block text-xs text-text-light"
              >
                Select a location to assign
              </label>
              <select
                id="location_id"
                name="location_id"
                className="w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-dark px-3 py-2 text-sm text-cream-light focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
              >
                {unassignedLocations.map((loc: LocationRow) => (
                  <option key={loc.id} value={loc.id}>
                    {loc.name} — {loc.city}, {loc.state}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="rounded-md bg-gold px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-dark transition hover:bg-gold/80"
            >
              Assign
            </button>
          </form>
        </Card>
      )}

      {unassignedLocations.length === 0 && assignedLocations.length > 0 && (
        <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
          This coach is already assigned to all active locations.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Admin coaches listing page.
 *
 * Shows all active coaches in the tenant with a link to manage their
 * location assignments.
 */

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

type Coach = {
  id: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
  specialty: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  primary_location_id: string | null;
};

type CoachWithLocation = Coach & {
  primary_location_name: string | null;
};

export default async function AdminCoachesPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "admin" && role !== "owner") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  const { data: coaches } = await supabase
    .from("coaches")
    .select("id, first_name, last_name, specialty, is_active, primary_location_id")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .order("last_name");

  const { data: locations } = await supabase
    .from("locations")
    .select("id, name")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId);

  type LocRow = { id: string; name: string };
  type CoachRow = { id: string; first_name: string; last_name: string; specialty: string | null; is_active: boolean; primary_location_id: string | null };

  const locationMap = new Map((locations ?? []).map((l: LocRow) => [l.id, l.name]));

  const rows: CoachWithLocation[] = ((coaches ?? []) as CoachRow[]).map((c: CoachRow) => {
    const locName = c.primary_location_id
      ? String(locationMap.get(c.primary_location_id) ?? "")
      : null;
    return { ...c, primary_location_name: locName || null };
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-text-light">
        <Link href="/admin" className="hover:text-gold">
          Admin
        </Link>
        <span>/</span>
        <span className="text-cream-light">Coaches</span>
      </div>

      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Coaches
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          Manage coach location assignments.
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card padding="lg">
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-text-light">No coaches found.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
            {rows.map((coach) => (
              <li
                key={coach.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-4"
              >
                <div>
                  <p className="font-medium text-cream-light">
                    {coach.first_name} {coach.last_name}
                    {!coach.is_active && (
                      <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-text-muted">(inactive)</span>
                    )}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-light">
                    {coach.primary_location_name
                      ? `Primary: ${coach.primary_location_name}`
                      : "No primary location"}
                    {coach.specialty ? ` · ${coach.specialty}` : ""}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Link
                  href={`/admin/coaches/${coach.id}/locations`}
                  className="rounded-md border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text-light transition hover:border-gold hover:text-gold"
                >
                  Manage locations
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/admin/layout.tsx

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, type AppRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { PortalShell } from "@/components/PortalShell";

export default async function AdminLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  // readAppRole decodes the JWT access token. In production the token may
  // predate the Custom Access Token Hook, so fall back to app_metadata
  // (set server-side, always present on the verified getUser() result).
  let role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role === "parent" && user.app_metadata?.app_role) {
    const meta = user.app_metadata.app_role as string;
    const known: AppRole[] = ["owner", "admin", "super_admin", "coach", "parent"];
    if (known.includes(meta as AppRole)) role = meta as AppRole;
  }

  if (role === "coach") redirect("/coach/inbox");
  if (role !== "admin" && role !== "owner" && role !== "super_admin") {
    redirect("/logout?reason=parent");
  }

  return (
    <PortalShell role={role === "owner" ? "owner" : "admin"} email={user.email ?? null}>
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 py-8">{children}</div>
    </PortalShell>
  );
}

"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (!["admin", "owner"].includes(readAppRole(session))) {
    redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  }
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");
  return { supabase, tenantId };
}

function parseCents(raw: string | null): number | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const trimmed = raw.trim().replace(/^\$/, "");
  if (trimmed === "") return null;
  const dollars = parseFloat(trimmed);
  if (isNaN(dollars) || dollars < 0) return null;
  return Math.round(dollars * 100);
}

function parseSessionsPerWeek(raw: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (!raw || raw.trim() === "") return null;
  const n = parseInt(raw.trim(), 10);
  if (isNaN(n) || n < 1) return null;
  return n;
}

export async function createMembershipPlan(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId } = await requireAdmin();

  const name = (formData.get("name") as string | null)?.trim() ?? "";
  const planType = formData.get("plan_type") as string | null;
  const priceRaw = formData.get("amount_dollars") as string | null;
  const description = (formData.get("description") as string | null)?.trim() || null;
  const sortOrderRaw = (formData.get("sort_order") as string | null)?.trim();
  const sessionsPerWeekRaw = formData.get("sessions_per_week") as string | null;

  const BASE = "/admin/memberships/plans";

  if (!name) redirect(`${BASE}?error=Name+is+required`);
  if (planType !== "eft" && planType !== "otc") {
    redirect(`${BASE}?error=Invalid+plan+type`);
  }
  const amountCents = parseCents(priceRaw);
  if (amountCents === null) {
    redirect(`${BASE}?error=Price+must+be+a+valid+dollar+amount+(e.g.+149.00)`);
  }

  const sortOrder = sortOrderRaw ? parseInt(sortOrderRaw, 10) : 0;
  if (isNaN(sortOrder)) {
    redirect(`${BASE}?error=Sort+order+must+be+a+whole+number`);
  }

  // sessions_per_week only applies to EFT plans
  const sessionsPerWeek =
    planType === "eft" ? parseSessionsPerWeek(sessionsPerWeekRaw) : null;

  const { error } = await (supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient)
    .from("membership_plans")
    .insert({
      tenant_id: tenantId,
      name,
      plan_type: planType,
      amount_cents: amountCents,
      description,
      sort_order: sortOrder,
      is_active: true,
      sessions_per_week: sessionsPerWeek,
    });

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `${BASE}?error=${encodeURIComponent("DB error: " + error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath(BASE);
  redirect(`${BASE}?ok=created`);
}

export async function updateMembershipPlan(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId } = await requireAdmin();

  const id = (formData.get("id") as string | null)?.trim();
  const name = (formData.get("name") as string | null)?.trim() ?? "";
  const planType = formData.get("plan_type") as string | null;
  const priceRaw = formData.get("amount_dollars") as string | null;
  const description = (formData.get("description") as string | null)?.trim() || null;
  const sortOrderRaw = (formData.get("sort_order") as string | null)?.trim();
  const sessionsPerWeekRaw = formData.get("sessions_per_week") as string | null;

  const BASE = "/admin/memberships/plans";

  if (!id) redirect(`${BASE}?error=Missing+plan+ID`);
  if (!name) redirect(`${BASE}/${id}/edit?error=Name+is+required`);
  if (planType !== "eft" && planType !== "otc") {
    redirect(`${BASE}/${id}/edit?error=Invalid+plan+type`);
  }
  const amountCents = parseCents(priceRaw);
  if (amountCents === null) {
    redirect(`${BASE}/${id}/edit?error=Price+must+be+a+valid+dollar+amount+(e.g.+149.00)`);
  }

  const sortOrder = sortOrderRaw ? parseInt(sortOrderRaw, 10) : 0;
  if (isNaN(sortOrder)) {
    redirect(`${BASE}/${id}/edit?error=Sort+order+must+be+a+whole+number`);
  }

  const sessionsPerWeek =
    planType === "eft" ? parseSessionsPerWeek(sessionsPerWeekRaw) : null;

  const { error } = await (supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient)
    .from("membership_plans")
    .update({
      name,
      plan_type: planType,
      amount_cents: amountCents,
      description,
      sort_order: sortOrder,
      sessions_per_week: sessionsPerWeek,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq("id", id)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId);

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `${BASE}/${id}/edit?error=${encodeURIComponent("DB error: " + error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath(BASE);
  redirect(`${BASE}?ok=updated`);
}

export async function toggleMembershipPlan(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId } = await requireAdmin();

  const id = formData.get("id") as string | null;
  const isActiveStr = formData.get("is_active") as string | null;

  const BASE = "/admin/memberships/plans";

  if (!id || isActiveStr === null) {
    redirect(`${BASE}?error=Missing+parameters`);
  }

  const isActive = isActiveStr === "true";

  const { error } = await (supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient)
    .from("membership_plans")
    .update({ is_active: isActive, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq("id", id)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId);

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `${BASE}?error=${encodeURIComponent("DB error: " + error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath(BASE);
  redirect(`${BASE}?ok=updated`);
}

/**
 * /admin/memberships/plans/[id]/edit — Edit an existing membership plan.
 *
 * Lets staff update the name, plan type, price, description, sort order,
 * and sessions-per-week allowance. Active/inactive toggle stays on the
 * list page.
 */

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input, Select } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { updateMembershipPlan } from "../../actions";

type PlanRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  plan_type: "eft" | "otc";
  amount_cents: number;
  description: string | null;
  sort_order: number;
  is_active: boolean;
  sessions_per_week: number | null;
};

export default async function EditMembershipPlanPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
  searchParams?: Promise<{ error?: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const sp = (await searchParams) ?? {};

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (!["admin", "owner"].includes(readAppRole(session))) {
    redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  }
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  const { data, error } = await (supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient)
    .from("membership_plans")
    .select("id, name, plan_type, amount_cents, description, sort_order, is_active, sessions_per_week")
    .eq("id", id)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error || !data) {
    notFound();
  }
  const row = data as PlanRow;
  const amountDollars = (row.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Edit Plan
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          Update the name, type, price, description, display order, or weekly
          session allowance. Active/inactive status is toggled from the{" "}
          <Link
            href="/admin/memberships/plans"
            className="text-gold hover:underline"
          >
            plans list
          </Link>
          .
        </p>
      </div>

      {sp.error && (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger/5">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">{sp.error}</p>
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card accent padding="lg">
        <form action={updateMembershipPlan} className="space-y-4">
          <input type="hidden" name="id" value={row.id} />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Input
              id="name"
              name="name"
              label="Plan Name"
              required
              maxLength={100}
              defaultValue={row.name}
            />
            <Select
              id="plan_type"
              name="plan_type"
              label="Plan Type"
              required
              defaultValue={row.plan_type}
            >
              <option value="eft">EFT (Recurring monthly)</option>
              <option value="otc">OTC (Session pack)</option>
            </Select>
            <Input
              id="amount_dollars"
              name="amount_dollars"
              label="Price (USD)"
              type="number"
              min={0}
              step={0.01}
              required
              defaultValue={amountDollars}
              helper="Enter the dollar amount — e.g. 149.00 for $149/month."
            />
            <Input
              id="sort_order"
              name="sort_order"
              label="Sort Order"
              type="number"
              min={0}
              required
              defaultValue={row.sort_order}
              helper="Lower numbers appear first."
            />
            <Input
              id="sessions_per_week"
              name="sessions_per_week"
              label="Sessions / Week (EFT only)"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              step={1}
              defaultValue={row.sessions_per_week ?? undefined}
              placeholder="Leave blank for unlimited"
              helper="Blank = unlimited. Only applies to EFT — ignored for OTC."
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label
              htmlFor="description"
              className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep"
            >
              <span>Description</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-normal normal-case tracking-normal text-text-light">
                optional
              </span>
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="description"
              name="description"
              rows={2}
              defaultValue={row.description ?? ""}
              placeholder="Two private lessons per month plus unlimited cage access."
              className="block w-full rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/80 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-cream-light placeholder:text-text-light/60 shadow-inner transition-colors focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/40"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span
                className={
                  "rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider " +
                  (row.is_active
                    ? "bg-success/15 text-success"
                    : "bg-darkest text-text-light")
                }
              >
                {row.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                Toggle visibility from the plans list.
              </span>
            </div>
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
              Save Changes
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Card>

      <Link
        href="/admin/memberships/plans"
        className="inline-block text-sm text-text-light hover:text-gold"
      >
        ← Back to plans
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/admin/memberships/plans/page.tsx

/**
 * /admin/memberships/plans — Membership plan tier management.
 *
 * Lists all tenant membership plans (active + inactive). Staff can create a
 * new plan, edit an existing one, and toggle plans active/inactive. Changes
 * are immediately reflected in what parents see on the Upgrade Plan screen.
 */

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input, Select } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { createMembershipPlan, toggleMembershipPlan } from "./actions";

type PlanRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  plan_type: "eft" | "otc";
  amount_cents: number;
  description: string | null;
  sort_order: number;
  is_active: boolean;
  sessions_per_week: number | null;
  created_at: string;
};

function fmtPrice(cents: number): string {
  return `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
}

function fmtPlanType(row: PlanRow): string {
  if (row.plan_type === "otc") return "OTC (Pack)";
  if (row.sessions_per_week) return `EFT · ${row.sessions_per_week} sessions/week`;
  return "EFT (Unlimited)";
}

export default async function MembershipPlansPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: Promise<{ ok?: string; error?: string }>;
}) {
  const sp = (await searchParams) ?? {};
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (!["admin", "owner"].includes(readAppRole(session))) {
    redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  }
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  const { data, error } = await (supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient)
    .from("membership_plans")
    .select("id, name, plan_type, amount_cents, description, sort_order, is_active, sessions_per_week, created_at")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

  const rows = (data ?? []) as PlanRow[];
  const activePlans = rows.filter((r) => r.is_active);
  const inactivePlans = rows.filter((r) => !r.is_active);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Membership Plans
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          Manage the plan tiers shown to parents on the Upgrade Plan screen.
          Active plans are visible to members; inactive plans are hidden.
        </p>
      </div>

      {sp.ok === "created" && (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-success/40 bg-success/5">
          <p className="text-sm text-success">Plan created successfully.</p>
        </Card>
      )}
      {sp.ok === "updated" && (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-success/40 bg-success/5">
          <p className="text-sm text-success">Plan updated.</p>
        </Card>
      )}
      {sp.error && (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger/5">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">{sp.error}</p>
        </Card>
      )}
      {error && (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger/5">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">
            Failed to load plans: {error.message}
          </p>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ── Create Plan Form ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Card accent padding="lg">
        <h2 className="mb-4 font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide text-gold">
          Add a Plan
        </h2>
        <form action={createMembershipPlan} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Input
              id="name"
              name="name"
              label="Plan Name"
              placeholder="Elite — Unlimited"
              required
              maxLength={100}
            />
            <Select
              id="plan_type"
              name="plan_type"
              label="Plan Type"
              required
            >
              <option value="eft">EFT (Recurring monthly)</option>
              <option value="otc">OTC (Session pack)</option>
            </Select>
            <Input
              id="amount_dollars"
              name="amount_dollars"
              label="Price (USD)"
              type="number"
              min={0}
              step={0.01}
              required
              placeholder="149.00"
              helper="Enter the dollar amount — e.g. 149.00 for $149/month."
            />
            <Input
              id="sort_order"
              name="sort_order"
              label="Sort Order"
              type="number"
              min={0}
              defaultValue={10}
              required
              helper="Lower numbers appear first. Use 10, 20, 30… to leave room."
            />
            <Input
              id="sessions_per_week"
              name="sessions_per_week"
              label="Sessions / Week (EFT only)"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              step={1}
              placeholder="e.g. 2"
              helper="Leave blank for unlimited. Only applies to EFT plans — ignored for OTC."
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label
              htmlFor="description"
              className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep"
            >
              <span>Description</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-normal normal-case tracking-normal text-text-light">
                optional
              </span>
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="description"
              name="description"
              rows={2}
              placeholder="Two private lessons per month plus unlimited cage access."
              className="block w-full rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/80 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-cream-light placeholder:text-text-light/60 shadow-inner transition-colors focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/40"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
              Create Plan
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Card>

      {/* ── Active Plans ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div>
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-lg uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Active Plans{" "}
          <span className="ml-1 text-sm font-normal normal-case text-text-light">
            ({activePlans.length})
          </span>
        </h2>
        {activePlans.length === 0 ? (
          <Card accent padding="lg" className="text-center">
            <p className="text-sm text-cream-light">No active plans yet.</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-light">
              Use the form above to create your first plan.
            </p>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {activePlans.map((row) => (
              <PlanCard key={row.id} row={row} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ── Inactive Plans ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {inactivePlans.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-lg uppercase tracking-wide text-text-light">
            Inactive Plans{" "}
            <span className="ml-1 text-sm font-normal normal-case">
              ({inactivePlans.length})
            </span>
          </h2>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {inactivePlans.map((row) => (
              <PlanCard key={row.id} row={row} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <Link
        href="/admin"
        className="inline-block text-sm text-text-light hover:text-gold"
      >
        ← Back to admin
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

function PlanCard({ row }: { row: PlanRow }) {
  return (
    <Card padding="md">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-base font-semibold text-cream-light">
              {row.name}
            </span>
            {row.is_active ? (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-success/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-success">
                Active
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-darkest px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-light">
                Inactive
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-gold">
            {fmtPrice(row.amount_cents)}{" "}
            <span className="text-text-light">·</span>{" "}
            {fmtPlanType(row)}{" "}
            <span className="text-text-light">· Sort {row.sort_order}</span>
          </p>
          {row.description && (
            <p className="text-xs text-text-light">{row.description}</p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href={`/admin/memberships/plans/${row.id}/edit`}
            className="rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-cream hover:border-gold hover:text-gold transition"
          >
            Edit
          </Link>
          <form action={toggleMembershipPlan}>
            <input type="hidden" name="id" value={row.id} />
            <input
              type="hidden"
              name="is_active"
              value={row.is_active ? "false" : "true"}
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className={
                "rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition " +
                (row.is_active
                  ? "border-danger/40 bg-danger/15 text-danger hover:bg-danger/25"
                  : "border-border-gold bg-darkest text-cream hover:border-gold hover:text-gold")
              }
            >
              {row.is_active ? "Hide" : "Show"}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

/**
 * /admin/messages — read-only inbox for the owner to see all coach↔family
 * messages across the tenant (both directions, newest first, max 200).
 *
 * Direction filter: All / Coach → Family / Parent → Coach.
 *
 * coach→family:  recipient_coach_user_id IS NULL
 * parent→coach:  recipient_coach_user_id IS NOT NULL
 *
 * Uses the service-role client so tenant-admin RLS policies don't need to
 * cover this read path.
 */

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceClient } from "@/lib/supabase/serviceClient";

type MsgRow = {
  id: string;
  sender_user_id: string;
  sender_display: string | null;
  recipient_coach_user_id: string | null;
  message_text: string | null;
  viewed_at: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  label: string | null;
  recipient_kid: { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
  video: { mux_playback_id: string | null } | null;
};

type CoachRow = {
  user_id: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string | null;
};

const DIRECTIONS = ["all", "coach_to_family", "parent_to_coach"] as const;
type Direction = (typeof DIRECTIONS)[number];

const DIRECTION_LABELS: Record<Direction, string> = {
  all: "All",
  coach_to_family: "Coach → Family",
  parent_to_coach: "Parent → Coach",
};

function muxThumb(playbackId: string) {
  return `https://image.mux.com/${playbackId}/thumbnail.jpg?width=320&time=2`;
}

function relativeTime(iso: string): string {
  const diffSec = Math.round((new Date(iso).getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000);
  const abs = Math.abs(diffSec);
  const rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("en", { numeric: "auto" });
  if (abs < 60) return rtf.format(diffSec, "second");
  if (abs < 3600) return rtf.format(Math.round(diffSec / 60), "minute");
  if (abs < 86400) return rtf.format(Math.round(diffSec / 3600), "hour");
  if (abs < 86400 * 7) return rtf.format(Math.round(diffSec / 86400), "day");
  if (abs < 86400 * 30) return rtf.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 7)), "week");
  return rtf.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 30)), "month");
}

function buildHref(dir: Direction): string {
  if (dir === "all") return "/admin/messages";
  return `/admin/messages?direction=${dir}`;
}

export default async function AdminMessagesPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ direction?: string }>;
}) {
  const sp = await searchParams;

  // Auth guard (admin layout also checks but belt-and-suspenders for direct hits).
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "admin") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  const activeDir: Direction =
    sp.direction && (DIRECTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(sp.direction)
      ? (sp.direction as Direction)
      : "all";

  // Service client to read all coach_messages regardless of RLS.
  const svc = createServiceClient();

  // Load messages + kid name + video mux_playback_id.
  let q = svc
    .from("coach_messages")
    .select(
      "id, sender_user_id, sender_display, recipient_coach_user_id, " +
        "message_text, viewed_at, created_at, label, " +
        "recipient_kid:recipient_kid_id(first_name, last_name), " +
        "video:video_id(mux_playback_id)",
    )
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(200);

  if (activeDir === "coach_to_family") {
    q = q.is("recipient_coach_user_id", null);
  } else if (activeDir === "parent_to_coach") {
    q = q.not("recipient_coach_user_id", "is", null);
  }

  const { data: msgData, error: msgError } = await q;

  // Load coaches so we can resolve user_id → name.
  const { data: coachData } = await svc
    .from("coaches")
    .select("user_id, first_name, last_name")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId);

  const coaches = ((coachData ?? []) as unknown as CoachRow[]).reduce<
    Record<string, string>
  >((acc, c) => {
    acc[c.user_id] = [c.first_name, c.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
    return acc;
  }, {});

  const rows = (msgData ?? []) as unknown as MsgRow[];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Messages
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          All coach↔family messages for this location — read-only view, newest first.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Direction filter */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
          Direction
        </span>
        {DIRECTIONS.map((d) => {
          const active = activeDir === d;
          return (
            <Link
              key={d}
              href={buildHref(d)}
              className={
                "rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs " +
                (active
                  ? "border-gold bg-gold/15 text-gold"
                  : "border-border-gold bg-darkest text-cream hover:border-gold hover:text-gold")
              }
            >
              {DIRECTION_LABELS[d]}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-text-light">
          {rows.length === 200 ? "Showing latest 200" : `${rows.length} message${rows.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
        </span>
      </div>

      {msgError ? (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger/5">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">
            Failed to load messages: {msgError.message}
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <Card padding="lg" className="border-dashed text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
            {activeDir === "all"
              ? "No messages yet."
              : `No ${DIRECTION_LABELS[activeDir].toLowerCase()} messages yet.`}
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <Card padding="none" className="overflow-hidden">
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border-gold">
            {rows.map((row) => {
              const isParentToCoach = !!row.recipient_coach_user_id;

              // Resolve names for both directions.
              const coachName = isParentToCoach
                ? (coaches[row.recipient_coach_user_id!] ?? "Coach")
                : (coaches[row.sender_user_id] ?? "Coach");

              const kid = Array.isArray(row.recipient_kid)
                ? row.recipient_kid[0]
                : row.recipient_kid;
              const kidName = kid
                ? [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ")
                : "—";

              const senderName = isParentToCoach
                ? (row.sender_display?.trim() || "Parent")
                : coachName;
              const recipientName = isParentToCoach ? coachName : kidName;

              const video = Array.isArray(row.video) ? row.video[0] : row.video;
              const playbackId = video?.mux_playback_id ?? null;

              const preview = row.message_text?.trim() || (playbackId ? null : "(no text)");

              return (
                <li
                  key={row.id}
                  className="flex items-start gap-4 px-6 py-4 transition-colors hover:bg-darkest/40"
                >
                  {/* Mux thumbnail */}
                  {playbackId ? (
                    <a
                      href={`https://stream.mux.com/${playbackId}.m3u8`}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="shrink-0"
                      title="Open video stream"
                    >
                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                      <img
                        src={muxThumb(playbackId)}
                        alt="Video thumbnail"
                        width={80}
                        height={45}
                        className="rounded border border-border-gold object-cover opacity-80 hover:opacity-100"
                        style={{ width: 80, height: 45 }}
                      />
                    </a>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="h-[45px] w-[80px] shrink-0 rounded border border-border-gold bg-darkest" />
                  )}

                  {/* Main info */}
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      {/* Direction badge */}
                      <span
                        className={
                          "inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] " +
                          (isParentToCoach
                            ? "border border-gold bg-gold/10 text-gold"
                            : "border border-border-gold bg-darkest text-text-light")
                        }
                      >
                        {isParentToCoach ? "Parent → Coach" : "Coach → Family"}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-cream-light">
                        {senderName}
                        <span className="font-normal text-text-light"> → </span>
                        {recipientName}
                      </span>
                      {!isParentToCoach && kidName !== recipientName && (
                        <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                          about {kidName}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {row.label ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-gold-deep">
                          {row.label.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    {preview ? (
                      <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm text-text-light">
                        {preview}
                      </p>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>

                  {/* Meta: time + viewed */}
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-1">
                    <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                      {relativeTime(row.created_at)}
                    </span>
                    {row.viewed_at ? (
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-text-light/70">Viewed</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-gold">
                        <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-gold" />
                        Unread
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </Card>
      )}

      <Link
        href="/admin"
        className="inline-block text-sm text-text-light hover:text-gold"
      >
        ← Back to admin
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}
