"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

const STRIPE_VERSION = "2024-06-20";

/**
 * Encodes a potentially-nested object for Stripe's form-encoded API.
 * Nested objects use bracket notation: metadata[key]=value.
 * encodeURIComponent encodes brackets as %5B/%5D, which Stripe correctly decodes.
 */
function encodeForm(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ""): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    const key = prefix ? `${prefix}[${k}]` : k;
    if (typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) && v !== null) {
      const nested = encodeForm(v as Record<string, unknown>, key);
      if (nested) parts.push(nested);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
    }
  }
  return parts.join("&");
}

async function stripePost(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
      "Stripe-Version": STRIPE_VERSION,
    },
    body: encodeForm(body),
  });
  const data = (await res.json()) as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const errObj = data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(errObj?.message ?? `Stripe error on POST ${path}`);
  }
  return data;
}

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (!["admin", "owner"].includes(readAppRole(session))) {
    redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  }
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");
  return { supabase, tenantId };
}

export async function createPromoCode(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId } = await requireAdmin();

  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;

  const code = (formData.get("code") as string | null)?.trim().toUpperCase() ?? "";
  const discountType = formData.get("discount_type") as string | null;
  const discountValueRaw = formData.get("discount_value") as string | null;
  const maxRedemptionsRaw = (formData.get("max_redemptions") as string | null)?.trim();
  const expiresAtRaw = (formData.get("expires_at") as string | null)?.trim();
  const applicablePlanNamesRaw = (
    formData.get("applicable_plan_names") as string | null
  )?.trim() ?? "";

  if (!code) redirect("/admin/promo-codes?error=Code+is+required");
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9_-]{2,50}$/.test(code)) {
    redirect(
      "/admin/promo-codes?error=Code+must+be+2%E2%80%9350+alphanumeric+characters+%28hyphens+and+underscores+allowed%29",
    );
  }
  if (discountType !== "percent" && discountType !== "fixed") {
    redirect("/admin/promo-codes?error=Invalid+discount+type");
  }
  const discountValue = parseInt(discountValueRaw ?? "", 10);
  if (isNaN(discountValue) || discountValue <= 0) {
    redirect("/admin/promo-codes?error=Discount+value+must+be+a+positive+number");
  }
  if (discountType === "percent" && discountValue > 100) {
    redirect("/admin/promo-codes?error=Percent+discount+cannot+exceed+100");
  }

  const maxRedemptions =
    maxRedemptionsRaw ? parseInt(maxRedemptionsRaw, 10) : null;
  if (
    maxRedemptions !== null &&
    (!Number.isInteger(maxRedemptions) || maxRedemptions <= 0)
  ) {
    redirect("/admin/promo-codes?error=Max+redemptions+must+be+a+positive+number");
  }

  const expiresAt = expiresAtRaw ? new Date(expiresAtRaw) : null;
  if (expiresAt && isNaN(expiresAt.getTime())) {
    redirect("/admin/promo-codes?error=Invalid+expiry+date");
  }

  let stripeCouponId: string | null = null;
  let stripePromoCodeId: string | null = null;

  if (stripeKey) {
    // Create Stripe Coupon
    const couponParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
      name: code,
      ...(discountType === "percent"
        ? { percent_off: discountValue }
        : { amount_off: discountValue, currency: "usd" }),
      duration: "once",
      metadata: { tenant_id: tenantId, ballpark_code: code },
    };
    if (maxRedemptions !== null) couponParams.max_redemptions = maxRedemptions;
    if (expiresAt) couponParams.redeem_by = Math.floor(expiresAt.getTime() / 1000);

    let coupon: Record<string, unknown>;
    try {
      coupon = await stripePost("coupons", stripeKey, couponParams);
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown Stripe error";
      redirect(`/admin/promo-codes?error=${encodeURIComponent("Stripe coupon error: " + msg)}`);
    }
    stripeCouponId = coupon.id as string;

    // Create Stripe PromotionCode
    const promoParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
      coupon: stripeCouponId,
      code,
      metadata: { tenant_id: tenantId },
    };
    if (maxRedemptions !== null) promoParams.max_redemptions = maxRedemptions;
    if (expiresAt) promoParams.expires_at = Math.floor(expiresAt.getTime() / 1000);

    let promoCode: Record<string, unknown>;
    try {
      promoCode = await stripePost("promotion_codes", stripeKey, promoParams);
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown Stripe error";
      if (msg.toLowerCase().includes("already exists"))
        redirect(
          `/admin/promo-codes?error=${encodeURIComponent(`Code "${code}" already exists in Stripe — choose a different name.`)}`,
        );
      redirect(
        `/admin/promo-codes?error=${encodeURIComponent("Stripe promo code error: " + msg)}`,
      );
    }
    stripePromoCodeId = promoCode.id as string;
  }

  // Parse applicable plan names (one name per line/comma, blank = unrestricted)
  const applicablePlanNames: string[] = applicablePlanNamesRaw
    ? applicablePlanNamesRaw
        .split(/[\n,]+/)
        .map((s) => s.trim())
        .filter((s) => s.length > 0)
    : [];

  // Insert DB row
  const { error: insertErr } = await supabase.from("promo_codes").insert({
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    code,
    stripe_coupon_id: stripeCouponId,
    stripe_promotion_code_id: stripePromoCodeId,
    discount_type: discountType,
    discount_value: discountValue,
    max_redemptions: maxRedemptions,
    expires_at: expiresAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    applicable_plan_names: applicablePlanNames,
    is_active: true,
  });

  if (insertErr) {
    if (insertErr.code === "23505") {
      redirect(
        `/admin/promo-codes?error=${encodeURIComponent(`A code "${code}" already exists`)}`,
      );
    }
    redirect(
      `/admin/promo-codes?error=${encodeURIComponent("DB error: " + insertErr.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath("/admin/promo-codes");
  redirect("/admin/promo-codes?ok=created");
}

export async function togglePromoCode(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId } = await requireAdmin();

  const id = formData.get("id") as string | null;
  const isActiveStr = formData.get("is_active") as string | null;
  if (!id || isActiveStr === null) {
    redirect("/admin/promo-codes?error=Missing+parameters");
  }

  const isActive = isActiveStr === "true";

  // Load stripe_promotion_code_id before update
  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from("promo_codes")
    .select("stripe_promotion_code_id")
    .eq("id", id)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .single();

  const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
    .from("promo_codes")
    .update({ is_active: isActive })
    .eq("id", id)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId);

  if (updateErr) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/promo-codes?error=${encodeURIComponent("DB error: " + updateErr.message)}`,
    );
  }

  // Sync to Stripe (best-effort)
  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (stripeKey && existing?.stripe_promotion_code_id) {
    try {
      await stripePost(
        `promotion_codes/${existing.stripe_promotion_code_id}`,
        stripeKey,
        { active: isActive ? "true" : "false" },
      );
    } catch {
      // best-effort; don't fail the request
    }
  }

  revalidatePath("/admin/promo-codes");
  redirect("/admin/promo-codes?ok=updated");
}

/**
 * /admin/promo-codes — Promo code management (Task #241).
 *
 * Lists all tenant promo codes with redemption counts. Lets staff create
 * new codes (Stripe Coupon + PromotionCode are created automatically) and
 * toggle codes active/inactive. Toggle also updates the Stripe PromotionCode.
 */

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input, Select } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { createPromoCode, togglePromoCode } from "./actions";

type PromoRow = {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  discount_type: "percent" | "fixed";
  discount_value: number;
  max_redemptions: number | null;
  redemptions_used: number;
  expires_at: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  created_at: string;
  stripe_coupon_id: string | null;
  stripe_promotion_code_id: string | null;
};

function fmtDiscount(row: PromoRow): string {
  if (row.discount_type === "percent") return `${row.discount_value}% off`;
  return `$${(row.discount_value / 100).toFixed(2)} off`;
}

function fmtExpiry(expiresAt: string | null): string {
  if (!expiresAt) return "Never";
  const d = new Date(expiresAt);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function fmtRedemptions(row: PromoRow): string {
  const used = row.redemptions_used;
  if (row.max_redemptions == null) return `${used} used`;
  return `${used} / ${row.max_redemptions} redemptions`;
}

"use server";
/**
 * Server actions for /admin/redemptions (v0.7 task #122).
 *
 * Both actions delegate to the SECURITY DEFINER RPC
 * `mark_redemption_fulfilled(p_code)` which validates app_role='admin'
 * + tenant on the JWT side. Any error is funneled into ?error= for the
 * page to render in a banner.
 */

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "admin") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");
  return { supabase };
}

async function fulfill(code: string) {
  const trimmed = code.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!trimmed) {
    redirect(`/admin/redemptions?error=${encodeURIComponent("Enter a code.")}`);
  }
  const { supabase } = await requireAdmin();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("mark_redemption_fulfilled", {
    p_code: trimmed,
  });
  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/redemptions?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message ?? "Could not fulfill")}`,
    );
  }
  revalidatePath("/admin/redemptions");
  const fulfilledCode =
    (data as { redemption_code?: string } | null)?.redemption_code ?? trimmed;
  redirect(`/admin/redemptions?ok=${encodeURIComponent(fulfilledCode)}`);
}

export async function fulfillByCode(formData: FormData) {
  const code = (formData.get("code") as string | null) ?? "";
  await fulfill(code);
}

export async function fulfillById(formData: FormData) {
  // Same path — the per-row button submits the redemption_code as `code`.
  const code = (formData.get("code") as string | null) ?? "";
  await fulfill(code);
}

/**
 * /admin/redemptions — front-desk fulfillment surface (v0.7 task #122).
 *
 * Lists every pending (status='ordered', payment_method='points') order
 * for the admin's tenant + a manual-code-entry form. Submitting either
 * the form or the per-row "Mark fulfilled" button calls the
 * `mark_redemption_fulfilled(p_code)` RPC.
 *
 * Two scan paths: a `<QRScanner />` client component that uses
 * `html5-qrcode` + `getUserMedia` to read the parent's QR straight off
 * the customer's phone screen and auto-submits the manual form; and the
 * manual 8-char input for browsers without camera permission.
 */

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

import { QRScanner } from "./QRScanner";
import { fulfillByCode, fulfillById } from "./actions";

type PendingRow = {
  id: string;
  redemption_code: string;
  created_at: string;
  amount_paid_points: number | null;
  payment_method: string;
  status: string;
  kid_id: string;
  product: { name: string | null } | null;
  kid: { first_name: string | null; last_name: string | null } | null;
};

type RecentRow = {
  id: string;
  redemption_code: string;
  fulfilled_at: string | null;
  amount_paid_points: number | null;
  product: { name: string | null } | null;
  kid: { first_name: string | null; last_name: string | null } | null;
};

export default async function RedemptionsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: Promise<{ ok?: string; error?: string }>;
}) {
  const sp = (await searchParams) ?? {};
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "admin") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  const { data: pending } = await supabase
    .from("orders")
    .select(
      "id, redemption_code, created_at, amount_paid_points, payment_method, " +
        "status, kid_id, product:product_id(name), kid:kid_id(first_name, last_name)",
    )
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .eq("payment_method", "points")
    .eq("status", "ordered")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

  const { data: recent } = await supabase
    .from("orders")
    .select(
      "id, redemption_code, fulfilled_at, amount_paid_points, " +
        "product:product_id(name), kid:kid_id(first_name, last_name)",
    )
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .eq("status", "fulfilled")
    .order("fulfilled_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(10);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Redemptions
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          Type the 8-character code shown on the parent&apos;s phone, or click
          &quot;Mark fulfilled&quot; on the matching pending row.
        </p>
      </div>

      {sp.ok ? (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-success/40 bg-success/5">
          <p className="text-sm text-success">
            Marked code <span className="font-mono">{sp.ok}</span> as fulfilled.
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : null}
      {sp.error ? (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger/5">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">{decodeURIComponent(sp.error)}</p>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      <Card accent padding="lg">
        <h2 className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide text-gold">
          Scan or enter code
        </h2>
        <div className="mt-4 space-y-4">
          <QRScanner formId="redemption-fulfill-form" />
          <form
            id="redemption-fulfill-form"
            action={fulfillByCode}
            className="flex flex-wrap gap-3"
          >
            <input
              name="code"
              required
              autoFocus
              placeholder="ABCD1234"
              maxLength={8}
              className="flex-1 min-w-[200px] rounded-md border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-4 py-3 font-mono text-lg uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-gold outline-none focus:border-gold"
              autoComplete="off"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="rounded-md bg-gold px-6 py-3 font-display text-lg uppercase tracking-wide text-dark transition hover:opacity-90"
            >
              Fulfill
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <section>
        <h2 className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Pending ({pending?.length ?? 0})
        </h2>
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
          {(pending ?? []).length === 0 ? (
            <Card padding="md" className="border-dashed">
              <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
                Nothing pending — every redemption has been handed off.
              </p>
            </Card>
          ) : (
            ((pending ?? []) as unknown as PendingRow[]).map((row) => {
              const product = row.product;
              const kid = row.kid;
              return (
                <Card key={row.id} padding="md">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
                      <p className="font-display text-lg text-cream-light">
                        {product?.name ?? "—"}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
                        {kid?.first_name ?? ""} {kid?.last_name ?? ""} ·{" "}
                        {row.amount_paid_points} pts ·{" "}
                        {new Date(row.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="rounded-md border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-base uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-gold">
                      {row.redemption_code}
                    </span>
                    <form action={fulfillById}>
                      <input type="hidden" name="code" value={row.redemption_code} />
                      <button
                        type="submit"
                        className="rounded-md border border-border-gold bg-darker px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gold transition hover:bg-gold hover:text-dark"
                      >
                        Mark fulfilled
                      </button>
                    </form>
                  </div>
                </Card>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section>
        <h2 className="font-display text-xl uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Recently fulfilled
        </h2>
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
          {(recent ?? []).length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-text-light">No fulfilled orders yet.</p>
          ) : (
            ((recent ?? []) as unknown as RecentRow[]).map((row) => {
              const product = row.product;
              const kid = row.kid;
              return (
                <Card key={row.id} padding="sm">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm">
                    <span className="font-display text-base text-cream-light">
                      {product?.name ?? "—"}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-text-light">
                      {kid?.first_name ?? ""} {kid?.last_name ?? ""}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-text-light">{row.amount_paid_points} pts</span>
                    <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-text-light">
                      {row.redemption_code}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                      {row.fulfilled_at
                        ? new Date(row.fulfilled_at).toLocaleString()
                        : ""}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </Card>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/admin/redemptions/QRScanner.tsx

"use client";

/**
 * QRScanner — front-desk camera scan for `/admin/redemptions`
 * (v0.7 task #122).
 *
 * Wraps `html5-qrcode` so the staff phone/laptop camera reads the
 * customer's redemption QR (which encodes the same 8-char alphanumeric
 * code as the printed text below it). On a successful scan we
 * uppercase + sanitise the payload to `[A-Z0-9]{8}`, fill the manual
 * form's `code` input, stop the camera, and submit the form — so the
 * scan flow short-circuits straight into `mark_redemption_fulfilled`
 * with no extra clicks. Manual entry remains the fallback for browsers
 * without camera permission or with no camera.
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type Html5QrcodeModule = typeof import("html5-qrcode");

export function QRScanner({ formId }: { formId: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const scannerRef = useRef<{ stop: () => Promise<void>; clear: () => void } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    let cleanupFn: (() => void) | null = null;

    (async () => {
      try {
        const mod: Html5QrcodeModule = await import("html5-qrcode");
        if (cancelled || !containerRef.current) return;
        const elementId = "qr-scan-region";
        // The library wants a stable id, so attach it imperatively.
        containerRef.current.id = elementId;
        const Html5Qrcode = mod.Html5Qrcode;
        const scanner = new Html5Qrcode(elementId, /* verbose */ false);
        const ref = {
          stop: () => scanner.stop().catch(() => undefined),
          clear: () => {
            try {
              scanner.clear();
            } catch {
              /* no-op */
            }
          },
        };
        scannerRef.current = ref;

        await scanner.start(
          { facingMode: "environment" },
          { fps: 10, qrbox: 240 },
          (decoded: string) => {
            const code = decoded.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, "").toUpperCase().slice(0, 8);
            if (code.length !== 8) return;
            const form = document.getElementById(formId) as HTMLFormElement | null;
            if (!form) return;
            const input = form.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input[name="code"]');
            if (!input) return;
            input.value = code;
            ref.stop().finally(() => {
              ref.clear();
              setOpen(false);
              form.requestSubmit();
            });
          },
          () => {
            /* per-frame decode errors are noisy; ignore */
          },
        );

        cleanupFn = () => {
          ref.stop().finally(() => ref.clear());
        };
      } catch (err) {
        setError(
          err instanceof Error
            ? err.message
            : "Could not start the camera. Use manual entry below.",
        );
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      if (cleanupFn) cleanupFn();
      scannerRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [open, formId]);

  if (!open) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          setError(null);
          setOpen(true);
        }}
        className="rounded-md border border-border-gold bg-darker px-4 py-3 font-display text-base uppercase tracking-wide text-gold transition hover:bg-gold hover:text-dark"
      >
        Scan QR
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full rounded-md border border-border-gold bg-darkest p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="font-display text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-gold">
          Point the camera at the customer&apos;s QR code
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            scannerRef.current?.stop().finally(() => {
              scannerRef.current?.clear();
              setOpen(false);
            });
          }}
          className="text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-text-light hover:text-cream-light"
        >
          Close
        </button>
      </div>
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        className="mt-3 mx-auto aspect-square w-full max-w-sm overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-dark"
      />
      {error ? (
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>
      ) : (
        <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-text-light">
          You can also type the 8-character code manually below.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use server";
/**
 * Admin server actions for tenant settings.
 *
 * RLS pins tenant_id and restricts writes to app_role IN ('admin','owner').
 * These actions add explicit server-side authz (requireAdmin), input
 * sanitisation, and fail-loud error paths consistent with other admin actions.
 */

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "admin" && role !== "owner") {
    redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  }
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");
  return { supabase, tenantId };
}

export async function saveFacilityId(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId } = await requireAdmin();

  const raw = formData.get("hittrax_facility_id");
  const value = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.trim() : "";

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("tenants")
    .update({ hittrax_facility_id: value || null })
    .eq("id", tenantId);

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/settings?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath("/admin/settings");
  redirect("/admin/settings?saved=1");
}

export async function toggleCageRental(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase } = await requireAdmin();

  const locationId = formData.get("location_id");
  const enabledRaw = formData.get("enabled");

  if (typeof locationId !== "string" || !locationId) {
    redirect("/admin/settings?error=Invalid+location");
  }

  const enabled = enabledRaw === "true";

  const { error } = await (supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient)
    .from("locations")
    .update({ cage_rental_enabled: enabled })
    .eq("id", locationId);

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/settings?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath("/admin/settings");
  redirect("/admin/settings?saved=1");
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

export function CopyBookingLink({ url }: { url: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  async function handleCopy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      // Fallback for browsers that block clipboard in non-HTTPS
      const el = document.createElement("textarea");
      el.value = url;
      el.style.position = "fixed";
      el.style.opacity = "0";
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      el.select();
      document.execCommand("copy");
      document.body.removeChild(el);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-2">
        <span className="flex-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-text-light">
          {url}
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-gold px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-dark transition-colors hover:bg-gold-deep focus:outline-none"
        >
          {copied ? "Copied!" : "Copy Link"}
        </button>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
        Share this URL on your website, social media, or Google Business profile
        so prospective members can browse sessions and book without logging in.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Admin tenant settings page.
 *
 * Lets operators view and update per-tenant configuration fields:
 * - HitTrax Facility ID
 * - Public booking link
 * - Per-location cage rental toggle
 */
import { Card, CardSectionLabel } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { saveFacilityId, toggleCageRental } from "./actions";
import { CopyBookingLink } from "./CopyBookingLink";

type Location = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  cage_rental_enabled: boolean;
};

export default async function AdminSettingsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ error?: string; saved?: string }>;
}) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "admin" && role !== "owner") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  const { data } = await supabase
    .from("tenants")
    .select("name, slug, hittrax_facility_id")
    .eq("id", tenantId)
    .maybeSingle();

  const facilityId = data?.hittrax_facility_id ?? null;
  const tenantName = data?.name ?? null;
  const tenantSlug = data?.slug ?? null;

  // Fetch all locations for this tenant to show cage rental toggles
  const { data: locationsRaw } = await (supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient)
    .from("locations")
    .select("id, name, cage_rental_enabled")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .order("name", { ascending: true });

  const locations: Location[] = (locationsRaw ?? []) as Location[];

  // Build the public booking URL from the current request host
  const reqHeaders = await headers();
  const host = reqHeaders.get("host") ?? "localhost:3000";
  const protocol = host.startsWith("localhost") ? "http" : "https";
  const bookingUrl = tenantSlug
    ? `${protocol}://${host}/book/${tenantSlug}`
    : null;

  const sp = await searchParams;
  const errorMsg = sp.error ? decodeURIComponent(sp.error) : null;
  const saved = sp.saved === "1";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Tenant Settings
        </h1>
        {tenantName && (
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">{tenantName}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      {saved && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-success bg-success-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-success">
          Settings saved successfully.
        </div>
      )}
      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-danger bg-danger-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-danger">
          {errorMsg}
        </div>
      )}

      {bookingUrl && (
        <Card padding="lg" accent>
          <CardSectionLabel>Public Booking Link</CardSectionLabel>
          <p className="mb-4 mt-2 text-sm text-text-light">
            Share this URL so prospective members can browse availability and
            book sessions online — no login required.
          </p>
          <CopyBookingLink url={bookingUrl} />
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card padding="lg" accent>
        <CardSectionLabel>HitTrax Integration</CardSectionLabel>
        <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-text-light">
          The Facility ID scopes data pulls to this franchise location. It is
          passed as the <code className="text-gold">FacilityID</code> query
          parameter in every HitTrax polling request. Leave blank to poll
          without a facility filter.
        </p>

        <form
          action={saveFacilityId}
          className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end"
        >
          <div className="flex-1">
            <label
              htmlFor="hittrax_facility_id"
              className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-light"
            >
              HitTrax Facility ID
            </label>
            <input
              id="hittrax_facility_id"
              name="hittrax_facility_id"
              type="text"
              defaultValue={facilityId ?? ""}
              placeholder="e.g. 6514"
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-border-gold bg-darker px-3 py-2 text-sm text-cream-light placeholder:text-text-muted focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="rounded-md bg-gold px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-dark hover:bg-gold-deep focus:outline-none"
          >
            Save
          </button>
        </form>
      </Card>

      {locations.length > 0 && (
        <Card padding="lg" accent>
          <CardSectionLabel>Location Settings</CardSectionLabel>
          <p className="mb-4 mt-2 text-sm text-text-light">
            Enable cage rentals per location. When enabled, members see a
            &ldquo;Cage Rentals&rdquo; tab alongside Hitting Lessons in the app.
          </p>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {locations.map((loc) => (
              <div
                key={loc.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border border-border bg-darker px-4 py-3"
              >
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-cream-light">
                  {loc.name}
                </span>
                <form action={toggleCageRental}>
                  <input type="hidden" name="location_id" value={loc.id} />
                  <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="enabled"
                    value={loc.cage_rental_enabled ? "false" : "true"}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 flex-shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full border-2 border-transparent transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out focus:outline-none ${
                      loc.cage_rental_enabled
                        ? "bg-gold"
                        : "bg-border"
                    }`}
                    role="switch"
                    aria-checked={loc.cage_rental_enabled}
                    aria-label={`Cage rentals for ${loc.name}`}
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 transform rounded-full bg-dark shadow ring-0 transition duration-200 ease-in-out ${
                        loc.cage_rental_enabled ? "translate-x-5" : "translate-x-0"
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>
                </form>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use server";
/**
 * Admin server actions for the training video catalog (v0.7 task #121).
 *
 * RLS already pins tenant_id and admin-only writes — these actions are
 * a thin wrapper that adds form validation, a friendly error path, and
 * `revalidatePath` for the index page.
 */

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

const CATEGORIES = ["hitting", "mental", "situational", "fielding"] as const;
const LEVELS = ["beginner", "intermediate", "advanced"] as const;

type Category = (typeof CATEGORIES)[number];
type Level = (typeof LEVELS)[number];

function isCategory(v: unknown): v is Category {
  return typeof v === "string" && (CATEGORIES as readonly string[]).includes(v);
}
function isLevel(v: unknown): v is Level {
  return typeof v === "string" && (LEVELS as readonly string[]).includes(v);
}

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "admin") {
    redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  }
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");
  return { supabase, tenantId };
}

export async function createTrainingVideo(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase, tenantId } = await requireAdmin();

  const title = (formData.get("title") as string | null)?.trim() ?? "";
  const description = ((formData.get("description") as string | null) ?? "").trim();
  const category = formData.get("category");
  const level = formData.get("level") ?? "beginner";
  const coachName = ((formData.get("coach_name") as string | null) ?? "").trim();
  const durationRaw = (formData.get("duration_sec") as string | null) ?? "";
  const featured = formData.get("featured") === "on";
  const publishNow = formData.get("publish_now") === "on";

  let muxPlaybackId = ((formData.get("mux_playback_id") as string | null) ?? "").trim();
  const videoId = ((formData.get("video_id") as string | null) ?? "").trim();

  if (!title) {
    redirect("/admin/training-videos/new?error=title_required");
  }
  if (!isCategory(category)) {
    redirect("/admin/training-videos/new?error=category_required");
  }
  const lvl: Level = isLevel(level) ? level : "beginner";

  // Resolve mux_playback_id from a videos row if the admin uploaded
  // through the form (rather than pasting a known playback id).
  if (!muxPlaybackId && videoId) {
    const { data: vrow } = await supabase
      .from("videos")
      .select("mux_playback_id, status")
      .eq("id", videoId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (vrow?.mux_playback_id) {
      muxPlaybackId = vrow.mux_playback_id;
    } else {
      redirect(
        "/admin/training-videos/new?error=video_not_ready_or_inaccessible",
      );
    }
  }
  if (!muxPlaybackId) {
    redirect("/admin/training-videos/new?error=playback_id_missing");
  }

  const durationSec = durationRaw ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(durationRaw))) : null;

  const { error } = await supabase.from("training_videos").insert({
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    mux_playback_id: muxPlaybackId,
    title,
    description: description || null,
    category,
    level: lvl,
    coach_name: coachName || null,
    duration_sec: Number.isFinite(durationSec ?? NaN) ? durationSec : null,
    featured,
    published_at: publishNow ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
  });

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/training-videos/new?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath("/admin/training-videos");
  redirect("/admin/training-videos");
}

export async function updateTrainingVideo(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase } = await requireAdmin();

  const id = ((formData.get("id") as string | null) ?? "").trim();
  if (!id) redirect("/admin/training-videos?error=missing_id");

  const title = (formData.get("title") as string | null)?.trim() ?? "";
  const description = ((formData.get("description") as string | null) ?? "").trim();
  const category = formData.get("category");
  const level = formData.get("level") ?? "beginner";
  const coachName = ((formData.get("coach_name") as string | null) ?? "").trim();
  const durationRaw = (formData.get("duration_sec") as string | null) ?? "";

  let muxPlaybackId = ((formData.get("mux_playback_id") as string | null) ?? "").trim();
  const videoId = ((formData.get("video_id") as string | null) ?? "").trim();

  if (!title) redirect(`/admin/training-videos/${id}/edit?error=title_required`);
  if (!isCategory(category)) {
    redirect(`/admin/training-videos/${id}/edit?error=category_required`);
  }
  const lvl: Level = isLevel(level) ? level : "beginner";

  if (!muxPlaybackId && videoId) {
    const { data: vrow } = await supabase
      .from("videos")
      .select("mux_playback_id")
      .eq("id", videoId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (vrow?.mux_playback_id) {
      muxPlaybackId = vrow.mux_playback_id;
    } else {
      redirect(
        `/admin/training-videos/${id}/edit?error=video_not_ready_or_inaccessible`,
      );
    }
  }
  if (!muxPlaybackId) {
    redirect(`/admin/training-videos/${id}/edit?error=playback_id_missing`);
  }

  const durationSec = durationRaw ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(durationRaw))) : null;

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("training_videos")
    .update({
      mux_playback_id: muxPlaybackId,
      title,
      description: description || null,
      category,
      level: lvl,
      coach_name: coachName || null,
      duration_sec: Number.isFinite(durationSec ?? NaN) ? durationSec : null,
    })
    .eq("id", id);

  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/training-videos/${id}/edit?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath("/admin/training-videos");
  revalidatePath(`/admin/training-videos/${id}/edit`);
  redirect("/admin/training-videos");
}

export async function togglePublishTrainingVideo(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase } = await requireAdmin();
  const id = (formData.get("id") as string | null) ?? "";
  const desired = formData.get("publish") === "true"; // true => publish
  if (!id) return;

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("training_videos")
    .update({ published_at: desired ? new Date().toISOString() : null })
    .eq("id", id);
  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/training-videos?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }
  revalidatePath("/admin/training-videos");
}

export async function toggleFeaturedTrainingVideo(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase } = await requireAdmin();
  const id = (formData.get("id") as string | null) ?? "";
  const desired = formData.get("featured") === "true";
  if (!id) return;

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("training_videos")
    .update({ featured: desired })
    .eq("id", id);
  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/training-videos?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }
  revalidatePath("/admin/training-videos");
}

export async function deleteTrainingVideo(formData: FormData) {
  const { supabase } = await requireAdmin();
  const id = (formData.get("id") as string | null) ?? "";
  if (!id) return;
  const { error } = await supabase.from("training_videos").delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) {
    redirect(
      `/admin/training-videos?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}`,
    );
  }
  revalidatePath("/admin/training-videos");
}

FILE: portal/app/admin/training-videos/new/TrainingVideoUploadField.tsx
=================================================================================
"use client";

/**
 * Upload + manual playback-id field for training videos (v0.7 task #121).
 *
 * Two ways to supply mux_playback_id to the create action:
 *   1. Upload a file: POST /api/admin/training-uploads → mints a Mux
 *      Direct Upload + inserts the videos row. We then poll
 *      GET /api/admin/videos/{id} every 3s for up to ~3 minutes
 *      waiting for the asset.ready webhook to populate
 *      videos.mux_playback_id, then auto-fill the playback id field.
 *   2. Paste a known Mux playback id directly (handy for swapping
 *      seed assets without re-uploading).
 *
 * The form's createTrainingVideo action accepts either route.
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

const MAX_BYTES = 500 * 1024 * 1024;

type UploadStatus =
  | { kind: "idle" }
  | { kind: "minting" }
  | { kind: "uploading"; progress: number }
  | { kind: "processing"; videoId: string; fileName: string }
  | { kind: "done"; videoId: string; playbackId: string; fileName: string }
  | { kind: "error"; message: string; canRetry: boolean };

function fmtBytes(n: number): string {
  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  if (n < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  return `${(n / 1024 / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} GB`;
}

export function TrainingVideoUploadField({
  onBusyChange,
  defaultPlaybackId = "",
}: {
  onBusyChange?: (busy: boolean) => void;
  defaultPlaybackId?: string;
}) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<UploadStatus>({ kind: "idle" });
  const [playbackId, setPlaybackId] = useState<string>(defaultPlaybackId);
  const xhrRef = useRef<XMLHttpRequest | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const pollTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const isBusy =
    status.kind === "minting" ||
    status.kind === "uploading" ||
    status.kind === "processing";

  useEffect(() => {
    onBusyChange?.(isBusy);
  }, [isBusy, onBusyChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (pollTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(pollTimerRef.current);
      xhrRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const pollForReady = useCallback(
    (videoId: string, fileName: string, attempt = 0) => {
      const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 60; // 60 * 3s = 3 minutes
      pollTimerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/videos/${videoId}`, {
            cache: "no-store",
          });
          if (res.ok) {
            const body = (await res.json()) as {
              mux_playback_id: string | null;
              status: string;
            };
            if (body.mux_playback_id) {
              setStatus({
                kind: "done",
                videoId,
                playbackId: body.mux_playback_id,
                fileName,
              });
              setPlaybackId(body.mux_playback_id);
              return;
            }
          }
        } catch {
          // ignore network blip; we'll retry below
        }
        if (attempt + 1 >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
          setStatus({
            kind: "error",
            canRetry: true,
            message:
              "Mux didn't finish processing within 3 minutes. You can paste the playback id manually once it's ready, or save as a draft and revisit.",
          });
          return;
        }
        pollForReady(videoId, fileName, attempt + 1);
      }, 3000);
    },
    [],
  );

  const startUpload = useCallback(
    async (file: File) => {
      if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
        setStatus({
          kind: "error",
          canRetry: false,
          message: `That file is ${fmtBytes(file.size)} — please pick something under ${fmtBytes(MAX_BYTES)}.`,
        });
        return;
      }

      setStatus({ kind: "minting" });

      let mintRes: Response;
      try {
        mintRes = await fetch("/api/admin/training-uploads", { method: "POST" });
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Network error";
        setStatus({
          kind: "error",
          canRetry: true,
          message: `Could not reach the server (${msg}).`,
        });
        return;
      }

      let mintBody: {
        upload_url?: string;
        video_id?: string;
        error?: { message?: string };
      };
      try {
        mintBody = (await mintRes.json()) as typeof mintBody;
      } catch {
        setStatus({
          kind: "error",
          canRetry: true,
          message: "Server returned an unreadable response.",
        });
        return;
      }

      if (!mintRes.ok || !mintBody.upload_url || !mintBody.video_id) {
        setStatus({
          kind: "error",
          canRetry: true,
          message:
            mintBody?.error?.message ??
            `Upload service returned status ${mintRes.status}.`,
        });
        return;
      }

      const uploadUrl = mintBody.upload_url;
      const videoId = mintBody.video_id;
      const fileName = file.name;

      const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhrRef.current = xhr;
      setStatus({ kind: "uploading", progress: 0 });

      xhr.open("PUT", uploadUrl, true);
      xhr.setRequestHeader(
        "Content-Type",
        file.type || "application/octet-stream",
      );

      xhr.upload.onprogress = (ev: ProgressEvent) => {
        if (!ev.lengthComputable) return;
        const pct = Math.round((ev.loaded / ev.total) * 100);
        setStatus({ kind: "uploading", progress: pct });
      };
      xhr.onload = () => {
        xhrRef.current = null;
        if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
          setStatus({ kind: "processing", videoId, fileName });
          pollForReady(videoId, fileName);
        } else {
          setStatus({
            kind: "error",
            canRetry: true,
            message: `Upload failed (status ${xhr.status}).`,
          });
        }
      };
      xhr.onerror = () => {
        xhrRef.current = null;
        setStatus({
          kind: "error",
          canRetry: true,
          message: "Network error during upload.",
        });
      };
      xhr.onabort = () => {
        xhrRef.current = null;
        setStatus({ kind: "idle" });
        if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      };

      xhr.send(file);
    },
    [pollForReady],
  );

  const onFile = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) void startUpload(file);
  };

  const cancel = () => xhrRef.current?.abort();

  // Hidden inputs the server action reads.
  const videoId =
    status.kind === "processing" || status.kind === "done"
      ? status.videoId
      : "";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <input type="hidden" name="video_id" value={videoId} />

      <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
        Upload video
      </label>
      {status.kind === "idle" || status.kind === "error" ? (
        <input
          ref={fileInputRef}
          type="file"
          accept="video/*"
          onChange={onFile}
          className="block w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest text-sm text-cream file:mr-4 file:cursor-pointer file:border-0 file:bg-gold file:px-4 file:py-2.5 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:text-darkest hover:file:bg-gold-hover"
        />
      ) : null}

      {status.kind === "minting" ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/60 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-text-light">
          Preparing upload…
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {status.kind === "uploading" ? (
        <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/60 px-4 py-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="font-medium text-cream-light">Uploading…</span>
            <span className="text-text-light">{status.progress}%</span>
          </div>
          <div
            className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-darkest"
            role="progressbar"
            aria-valuenow={status.progress}
            aria-valuemin={0}
            aria-valuemax={100}
          >
            <div
              className="h-full bg-gold transition-[width] duration-150"
              style={{ width: `${status.progress}%` }}
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={cancel}
            className="text-xs text-text-light underline-offset-2 hover:text-gold hover:underline"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {status.kind === "processing" ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/60 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-text-light">
          Mux is processing the asset… This usually takes under a minute.
          The playback id will fill in below automatically when it&rsquo;s ready.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {status.kind === "done" ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-success/40 bg-success-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-success">
          <p className="font-semibold">Asset ready</p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs">
            {status.fileName} · playback id captured below.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {status.kind === "error" ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-danger">
          {status.message}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
        <label
          htmlFor="mux_playback_id"
          className="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep"
        >
          Mux playback id
        </label>
        <input
          id="mux_playback_id"
          name="mux_playback_id"
          type="text"
          value={playbackId}
          onChange={(e) => setPlaybackId(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="DS00Spx1CV902MCtPj5WknGlR102V5HFkDe"
          className="block w-full rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/80 px-3.5 py-2.5 font-mono text-xs text-cream-light shadow-inner focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/40"
        />
        <p className="text-xs text-text-light">
          Auto-filled once Mux finishes processing your upload, or paste an
          existing playback id to reuse a known asset.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/admin/training-videos/page.tsx

/**
 * Admin training videos catalog (v0.7 task #121).
 *
 * Lists every row in the admin's tenant (drafts included) with
 * publish, feature, edit, and delete server-action buttons. Supports
 * category + status filtering via search params (?category=hitting&status=draft).
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { Card, CardSectionLabel } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { LinkButton } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import {
  togglePublishTrainingVideo,
  toggleFeaturedTrainingVideo,
  deleteTrainingVideo,
} from "./actions";

type Row = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  category: string;
  level: string;
  coach_name: string | null;
  duration_sec: number | null;
  view_count: number;
  featured: boolean;
  published_at: string | null;
  mux_playback_id: string;
  created_at: string;
};

const CATEGORIES = ["hitting", "mental", "situational", "fielding"] as const;
const STATUSES = ["all", "published", "draft", "featured"] as const;
type Status = (typeof STATUSES)[number];

function fmtDuration(sec: number | null): string {
  if (!sec || sec <= 0) return "—";
  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = sec % 60;
  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function buildHref(params: { category?: string; status?: string }): string {
  const sp = new URLSearchParams();
  if (params.category && params.category !== "all") sp.set("category", params.category);
  if (params.status && params.status !== "all") sp.set("status", params.status);
  const qs = sp.toString();
  return qs ? `/admin/training-videos?${qs}` : "/admin/training-videos";
}

export default async function AdminTrainingVideosPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ error?: string; category?: string; status?: string }>;
}) {
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const activeCategory =
    sp.category && (CATEGORIES as readonly string[]).includes(sp.category)
      ? sp.category
      : "all";
  const activeStatus: Status =
    sp.status && (STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(sp.status)
      ? (sp.status as Status)
      : "all";

  let q = supabase
    .from("training_videos")
    .select(
      "id, title, category, level, coach_name, duration_sec, view_count, featured, published_at, mux_playback_id, created_at",
    )
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (activeCategory !== "all") q = q.eq("category", activeCategory);
  if (activeStatus === "published") q = q.not("published_at", "is", null);
  if (activeStatus === "draft") q = q.is("published_at", null);
  if (activeStatus === "featured") q = q.eq("featured", true);

  const { data, error } = await q;
  const rows = (data ?? []) as Row[];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
            Training videos
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
            HQ-curated catalog. Parents and coaches see published rows in
            the Train tab.
          </p>
        </div>
        <LinkButton href="/admin/training-videos/new">+ New video</LinkButton>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
            Category
          </span>
          {(["all", ...CATEGORIES] as const).map((c) => {
            const active = activeCategory === c;
            return (
              <Link
                key={c}
                href={buildHref({ category: c, status: activeStatus })}
                className={
                  "rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs capitalize " +
                  (active
                    ? "border-gold bg-gold/15 text-gold"
                    : "border-border-gold bg-darkest text-cream hover:border-gold hover:text-gold")
                }
              >
                {c}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
            Status
          </span>
          {STATUSES.map((s) => {
            const active = activeStatus === s;
            return (
              <Link
                key={s}
                href={buildHref({ category: activeCategory, status: s })}
                className={
                  "rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs capitalize " +
                  (active
                    ? "border-gold bg-gold/15 text-gold"
                    : "border-border-gold bg-darkest text-cream hover:border-gold hover:text-gold")
                }
              >
                {s}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {sp.error ? (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">{sp.error}</p>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      {error ? (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">
            Failed to load videos: {error.message}
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <Card accent padding="lg" className="text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-cream-light">
            No training videos match this filter.
          </p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-light">
            {activeCategory === "all" && activeStatus === "all"
              ? "Click + New video to add the first one."
              : "Clear filters above or add a new video."}
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <Card key={r.id} padding="md">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CardSectionLabel>
                      {r.category} · {r.level}
                    </CardSectionLabel>
                    {r.published_at ? (
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-success/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-success">
                        Published
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-darkest px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-light">
                        Draft
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {r.featured ? (
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-gold/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gold">
                        Featured
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="mt-1 font-display text-lg text-cream-light">
                    {r.title}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-text-light">
                    {fmtDuration(r.duration_sec)}
                    {r.coach_name ? ` · ${r.coach_name}` : ""}
                    {` · ${r.view_count.toLocaleString()} views`}
                  </p>
                  <p
                    className="mt-1 truncate font-mono text-[10px] text-text-light"
                    title={r.mux_playback_id}

                    {r.mux_playback_id}
                  </p>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <Link
                    href={`/admin/training-videos/${r.id}/edit`}
                    className="rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-cream hover:border-gold hover:text-gold"
                  >
                    Edit
                  </Link>
                  <form action={togglePublishTrainingVideo}>
                    <input type="hidden" name="id" value={r.id} />
                    <input
                      type="hidden"
                      name="publish"
                      value={r.published_at ? "false" : "true"}
                    />
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-cream hover:border-gold hover:text-gold"
                    >
                      {r.published_at ? "Unpublish" : "Publish"}
                    </button>
                  </form>
                  <form action={toggleFeaturedTrainingVideo}>
                    <input type="hidden" name="id" value={r.id} />
                    <input
                      type="hidden"
                      name="featured"
                      value={r.featured ? "false" : "true"}
                    />
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-cream hover:border-gold hover:text-gold"
                    >
                      {r.featured ? "Unfeature" : "Feature"}
                    </button>
                  </form>
                  <form action={deleteTrainingVideo}>
                    <input type="hidden" name="id" value={r.id} />
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="rounded-lg border border-danger/40 bg-danger/15 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-danger hover:bg-danger/25"
                    >
                      Delete
                    </button>
                  </form>

              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <Link
        href="/admin"
        className="inline-block text-sm text-text-light hover:text-gold"
      >
        ← Back to admin
      </Link>
    </div>
  );

/**
 * /admin/waivers — family waiver status dashboard.
 *
 * Shows every family in the tenant with their signed / unsigned / outdated
 * status for the active waiver version. Includes filter controls and CSV
 * export (handled in the WaiversClient island).
 *
 * Uses the service-role client for family_waivers reads so tenant-admin
 * RLS policies don't need to cover this cross-family read path.
 */

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceClient } from "@/lib/supabase/serviceClient";

import { WaiversClient, type WaiverRow } from "./WaiversClient";

export default async function WaiversPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "admin") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  // Use service client for cross-family reads (bypasses RLS)
  const svc = createServiceClient();

  // Active waiver for this tenant
  const { data: activeWaiver } = await svc
    .from("waivers")
    .select("id, version")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .maybeSingle();

  // All families in this tenant
  const { data: families } = await svc
    .from("families")
    .select("id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .order("parent_last_name", { ascending: true });

  // All family_waivers records for the active waiver
  const { data: activeSignedRecords } =
    activeWaiver
      ? await svc
          .from("family_waivers")
          .select("family_id, signed_at, app_version, waiver:waiver_id(version)")
          .eq("waiver_id", activeWaiver.id)
      : { data: [] };

  // All other (older) waiver ids for this tenant — to detect "outdated" families
  const { data: allWaivers } = await svc
    .from("waivers")
    .select("id")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .eq("is_active", false);

  const oldWaiverIds = (allWaivers ?? []).map((w) => w.id);

  const { data: oldSignedRecords } =
    oldWaiverIds.length > 0
      ? await svc
          .from("family_waivers")
          .select("family_id")
          .in("waiver_id", oldWaiverIds)
      : { data: [] };

  type SignedRecord = {
    family_id: string;
    signed_at: string;
    app_version: string | null;
    waiver: { version: number } | null;
  };

  const activeSignedMap = new Map<string, SignedRecord>();
  for (const r of activeSignedRecords ?? []) {
    const rec = r as unknown as SignedRecord;
    activeSignedMap.set(rec.family_id, rec);
  }

  const oldSignedFamilyIds = new Set<string>(
    (oldSignedRecords ?? []).map(
      (r) => (r as unknown as { family_id: string }).family_id,
    ),
  );

  const rows: WaiverRow[] = (families ?? []).map((f) => {
    const activeSigned = activeSignedMap.get(f.id);
    let status: WaiverRow["status"];
    if (activeSigned) {
      status = "signed";
    } else if (oldSignedFamilyIds.has(f.id)) {
      status = "outdated";
    } else {
      status = "unsigned";
    }

    return {
      family_id: f.id,
      parent_first_name: f.parent_first_name,
      parent_last_name: f.parent_last_name,
      parent_email: f.parent_email,
      signed_at: activeSigned?.signed_at ?? null,
      app_version: activeSigned?.app_version ?? null,
      waiver_version: activeSigned?.waiver?.version ?? null,
      status,
    };
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Waivers
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          Liability waiver status for every family in your tenant.
          {activeWaiver
            ? ` Active version: v${activeWaiver.version}.`
            : " No active waiver is configured."}
        </p>
      </div>

      <WaiversClient
        rows={rows}
        activeVersion={activeWaiver?.version ?? null}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/admin/waivers/WaiversClient.tsx
=================================================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { exportCsv } from "@/lib/exportCsv";

export type WaiverRow = {
  family_id: string;
  parent_first_name: string;
  parent_last_name: string;
  parent_email: string;
  signed_at: string | null;
  app_version: string | null;
  waiver_version: number | null;
  status: "signed" | "unsigned" | "outdated";
};

type Props = {
  rows: WaiverRow[];
  activeVersion: number | null;
};

type Filter = "all" | "signed" | "unsigned" | "outdated";

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<WaiverRow["status"], string> = {
  signed: "bg-success/15 text-success border-success/30",
  unsigned: "bg-danger/15 text-danger border-danger/30",
  outdated: "bg-gold/15 text-gold border-gold/30",
};

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<WaiverRow["status"], string> = {
  signed: "Signed",
  unsigned: "Not signed",
  outdated: "Outdated",
};

export function WaiversClient({ rows, activeVersion }: Props) {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>("all");

  const filtered = rows.filter((r) => {
    if (filter === "all") return true;
    return r.status === filter;
  });

  const counts = {
    all: rows.length,
    signed: rows.filter((r) => r.status === "signed").length,
    unsigned: rows.filter((r) => r.status === "unsigned").length,
    outdated: rows.filter((r) => r.status === "outdated").length,
  };

  function handleExport() {
    exportCsv(
      `waivers-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`,
      filtered.map((r) => ({
        ...r,
        full_name: `${r.parent_first_name} ${r.parent_last_name}`.trim(),
        signed_at_fmt: r.signed_at
          ? new Date(r.signed_at).toLocaleString()
          : "",
        status_label: STATUS_LABELS[r.status],
      })),
      [
        { label: "Family Name", key: "full_name" },
        { label: "Email", key: "parent_email" },
        { label: "Status", key: "status_label" },
        { label: "Signed At", key: "signed_at_fmt" },
        { label: "Waiver Version", key: "waiver_version" },
        { label: "App Version", key: "app_version" },
      ],
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Filter + Export */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        {(["all", "signed", "unsigned", "outdated"] as Filter[]).map((f) => (
          <button
            key={f}
            onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
            className={[
              "rounded-full border px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide transition",
              filter === f
                ? "border-gold bg-gold text-dark"
                : "border-border-gold text-text-light hover:border-gold hover:text-gold",
            ].join(" ")}
          >
            {f === "all" ? "All" : STATUS_LABELS[f as WaiverRow["status"]]}{" "}
            <span className="opacity-70">({counts[f]})</span>
          </button>
        ))}

        <button
          onClick={handleExport}
          className="ml-auto rounded-md border border-border-gold bg-darker px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gold transition hover:border-gold"
        >
          Export CSV
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Active version note */}
      {activeVersion !== null && (
        <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
          Active waiver:{" "}
          <span className="font-semibold text-gold">v{activeVersion}</span>
          {counts.outdated > 0 && (
            <span className="ml-2 text-gold">
              — {counts.outdated} famil
              {counts.outdated === 1 ? "y has" : "ies have"} signed an older
              version and will be re-prompted.
            </span>
          )}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <Card padding="md" className="border-dashed">
            <p className="text-sm text-text-light">No families match this filter.</p>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          filtered.map((row) => (
            <Card key={row.family_id} padding="md">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="font-display text-base text-cream-light">
                    {row.parent_first_name} {row.parent_last_name}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-text-light">{row.parent_email}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-1">
                  <span
                    className={[
                      "rounded-full border px-3 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide",
                      STATUS_STYLES[row.status],
                    ].join(" ")}
                  >
                    {STATUS_LABELS[row.status]}
                  </span>
                  {row.signed_at && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                      {new Date(row.signed_at).toLocaleString()} · v
                      {row.waiver_version}
                      {row.app_version ? ` · app ${row.app_version}` : ""}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * PATCH /api/admin/promo-codes/[id]
 * Toggle is_active. Also deactivates/reactivates the Stripe PromotionCode.
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const STRIPE_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

async function stripeRequest(
  method: 'POST',
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<void> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_VERSION,
  };
  const init: RequestInit = { method, headers };
  if (body) {
    headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded';
    const parts: string[] = [];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(body)) {
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null) {
        parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
      }
    }
    init.body = parts.join('&');
  }
  await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, init);
  // Best-effort — don't throw on Stripe errors for toggle
}

export async function PATCH(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'owner') return err(403, 'Forbidden');
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return err(401, 'No tenant in session');

  const { id } = await params;

  let body: { is_active?: boolean };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return err(400, 'Invalid JSON');
  }

  if (typeof body.is_active !== 'boolean') {
    return err(422, 'is_active (boolean) required');
  }

  // Load the existing row so we know the Stripe promotion code ID
  const { data: existing, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
    .from('promo_codes')
    .select('id, stripe_promotion_code_id, is_active')
    .eq('id', id)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (fetchErr || !existing) return err(404, 'Promo code not found');

  // Update DB
  const { data: updated, error: updateErr } = await supabase
    .from('promo_codes')
    .update({ is_active: body.is_active })
    .eq('id', id)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .select()
    .single();

  if (updateErr) return err(500, updateErr.message);

  // Sync to Stripe PromotionCode (best-effort)
  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (stripeKey && existing.stripe_promotion_code_id) {
    await stripeRequest(
      'POST',
      `promotion_codes/${existing.stripe_promotion_code_id}`,
      stripeKey,
      { active: body.is_active ? 'true' : 'false' },
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ code: updated });
}
