/**
 * GET  /api/admin/promo-codes  — list all codes for the caller's tenant
 * POST /api/admin/promo-codes  — create a Stripe Coupon + PromotionCode, then insert DB row
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const STRIPE_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

/**
 * Encodes a potentially-nested object for Stripe's form-encoded API.
 * Nested objects use bracket notation: metadata[key]=value.
 * encodeURIComponent encodes brackets as %5B/%5D, which Stripe correctly decodes.
 */
function encodeForm(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    const key = prefix ? `${prefix}[${k}]` : k;
    if (typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) && v !== null) {
      const nested = encodeForm(v as Record<string, unknown>, key);
      if (nested) parts.push(nested);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`);
    }
  }
  return parts.join('&');
}

async function stripePost(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; data: Record<string, unknown> }> {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${secretKey}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
      'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_VERSION,
    },
    body: encodeForm(body),
  });
  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  return { ok: res.ok, data };
}

async function stripePost2(
  path: string,
  secretKey: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const res = await stripePost(path, secretKey, body);
  if (!res.ok) {
    const errObj = res.data.error as { message?: string } | undefined;
    throw new Error(errObj?.message ?? `Stripe error on ${path}`);
  }
  return res.data;
}

async function requireAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) return { error: err(401, 'Unauthorized') };
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'owner') return { error: err(403, 'Forbidden') };
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return { error: err(401, 'No tenant in session') };
  return { supabase, tenantId };
}

// ── GET — list codes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export async function GET() {
  const auth = await requireAdmin();
  if ('error' in auth) return auth.error;
  const { supabase, tenantId } = auth;

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('promo_codes')
    .select('id, code, discount_type, discount_value, max_redemptions, redemptions_used, applicable_plan_names, expires_at, is_active, created_at, stripe_coupon_id, stripe_promotion_code_id')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

  if (error) return err(500, error.message);
  return NextResponse.json({ codes: data ?? [] });
}

// ── POST — create code ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const auth = await requireAdmin();
  if ('error' in auth) return auth.error;
  const { supabase, tenantId } = auth;

  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!stripeKey) return err(500, 'Stripe not configured');

  let body: {
    code?: string;
    discount_type?: string;
    discount_value?: number;
    max_redemptions?: number | null;
    expires_at?: string | null;
    applicable_plan_names?: string[];
  };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return err(400, 'Invalid JSON');
  }

  const code = (body.code ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!code) return err(422, 'code is required');
  if (code.length < 2 || code.length > 50) return err(422, 'code must be 2–50 characters');
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(code)) return err(422, 'code may only contain letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens');

  const discountType = body.discount_type;
  if (discountType !== 'percent' && discountType !== 'fixed') {
    return err(422, 'discount_type must be percent or fixed');
  }

  const discountValue = Number(body.discount_value);
  if (!Number.isInteger(discountValue) || discountValue <= 0) {
    return err(422, 'discount_value must be a positive integer');
  }
  if (discountType === 'percent' && discountValue > 100) {
    return err(422, 'percent discount cannot exceed 100');
  }

  const maxRedemptions = body.max_redemptions != null ? Number(body.max_redemptions) : null;
  if (maxRedemptions !== null && (!Number.isInteger(maxRedemptions) || maxRedemptions <= 0)) {
    return err(422, 'max_redemptions must be a positive integer or omitted');
  }

  const expiresAt = body.expires_at ? new Date(body.expires_at) : null;
  if (expiresAt && isNaN(expiresAt.getTime())) return err(422, 'expires_at is not a valid date');

  const applicablePlanNames: string[] = Array.isArray(body.applicable_plan_names)
    ? (body.applicable_plan_names as unknown[]).filter((n): n is string => typeof n === 'string' && n.trim().length > 0).map((n) => n.trim())
    : [];

  // ── Create Stripe Coupon ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const couponParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
    name: code,
    ...(discountType === 'percent'
      ? { percent_off: discountValue }
      : { amount_off: discountValue, currency: 'usd' }),
    duration: 'once',
    metadata: { tenant_id: tenantId, ballpark_code: code },
  };
  if (maxRedemptions !== null) couponParams.max_redemptions = maxRedemptions;
  if (expiresAt) couponParams.redeem_by = Math.floor(expiresAt.getTime() / 1000);

  let coupon: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    coupon = await stripePost2('coupons', stripeKey, couponParams);
  } catch (e) {
    return err(502, `Stripe coupon creation failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
  }

  // ── Create Stripe PromotionCode ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const promoParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
    coupon: coupon.id as string,
    code,
    metadata: { tenant_id: tenantId },
  };
  if (maxRedemptions !== null) promoParams.max_redemptions = maxRedemptions;
  if (expiresAt) promoParams.expires_at = Math.floor(expiresAt.getTime() / 1000);

  let promoCode: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    promoCode = await stripePost2('promotion_codes', stripeKey, promoParams);
  } catch (e) {
    return err(502, `Stripe promotion code creation failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
  }

  // ── Insert DB row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: inserted, error: insertErr } = await supabase
    .from('promo_codes')
    .insert({
      tenant_id: tenantId,
      code,
      stripe_coupon_id: coupon.id as string,
      stripe_promotion_code_id: promoCode.id as string,
      discount_type: discountType,
      discount_value: discountValue,
      max_redemptions: maxRedemptions,
      expires_at: expiresAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      applicable_plan_names: applicablePlanNames,
      is_active: true,
    })
    .select()
    .single();

  if (insertErr) {
    if (insertErr.code === '23505') {
      return err(409, `A promo code "${code}" already exists for this tenant`);
    }
    return err(500, `DB insert failed: ${insertErr.message}`);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ code: inserted }, { status: 201 });
}

FILE: portal/app/api/admin/promo-codes/validate/route.ts

/**
 * POST /api/admin/promo-codes/validate
 *
 * Read-only promo code check for the membership activation UI discount preview.
 * Does NOT consume the code (no redemptions_used increment).
 * Actual atomic consumption happens in /api/memberships/activate after Stripe succeeds.
 *
 * Body: { code: string, plan_name?: string }
 *   plan_name — the membership's plan_name (e.g. "Elite Monthly"). When provided,
 *   PLAN_MISMATCH fires if the code has applicable_plan_names set and this plan is
 *   not in the list.
 *
 * Returns:
 *   { ok: true, discount_type, discount_value, stripe_promotion_code_id, code }
 *   { ok: false, error_code: 'INVALID'|'EXPIRED'|'EXHAUSTED'|'PLAN_MISMATCH'|'FORBIDDEN' }
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'owner') return err(403, 'Forbidden');

  let body: { code?: string; plan_name?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return err(400, 'Invalid JSON');
  }

  const code = (body.code ?? '').trim();
  if (!code) return err(422, 'code is required');

  // Pass plan_name as p_plan_name so PLAN_MISMATCH fires when applicable_plan_names
  // is set and this plan is not in the allowed list.
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('validate_promo_code', {
    p_code: code,
    p_plan_name: body.plan_name?.trim() ?? null,
  });

  if (error) {
    console.error('[promo-codes/validate] RPC error:', error.message);
    return err(500, error.message);
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data as Record<string, unknown>);
}

FILE: portal/app/api/admin/training-uploads/route.ts

/**
 * Admin-only proxy that mints a Mux Direct Upload for a training video
 * (v0.7 task #121). Mirrors `api/coach/drill-uploads` but pinned to
 * app_role='admin' and posts purpose='training' to the Edge Function.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type EdgeOk = { upload_url: string; video_id: string };
type EdgeErr = { error?: { code?: string; message?: string } };

function clientErr(status: number, code: string, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: { code, message } },
    { status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
  );
}

export async function POST() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session?.access_token) {
    return clientErr(401, "unauthorized", "Sign in again to upload.");
  }
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "admin") {
    return clientErr(403, "forbidden", "Only admins can upload training videos.");
  }

  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!url) {
    return clientErr(500, "config_error", "Server is missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.");
  }

  const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();

  let edgeRes: Response;
  try {
    edgeRes = await fetch(`${url}/functions/v1/mux-create-upload`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ purpose: "training" }),
      cache: "no-store",
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Network error";
    return clientErr(502, "edge_unreachable", `Could not reach upload service: ${msg}`);
  }

  const text = await edgeRes.text();
  let parsed: unknown = null;
  try {
    parsed = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
  } catch {
    return clientErr(502, "edge_bad_response", `Upload service returned non-JSON (status ${edgeRes.status}).`);
  }

  if (!edgeRes.ok) {
    const e = (parsed as EdgeErr | null)?.error;
    return clientErr(
      edgeRes.status >= 500 ? 502 : edgeRes.status,
      e?.code ?? "edge_error",
      e?.message ?? `Upload service returned status ${edgeRes.status}.`,
    );
  }

  const ok = parsed as EdgeOk | null;
  if (!ok?.upload_url || !ok?.video_id) {
    return clientErr(502, "edge_bad_response", "Upload service response was missing upload_url or video_id.");
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    { upload_url: ok.upload_url, video_id: ok.video_id },
    { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
  );
}

/**
 * Admin-only "is my upload ready yet?" lookup. Returns the videos row's
 * mux_playback_id + status so the new-training-video form can poll
 * after a Mux Direct Upload finishes (v0.7 task #121).
 *
 * RLS on `videos` already restricts admins to their tenant; this route
 * just adds the role gate so a parent can't reach the endpoint at all.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(
  _req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session?.access_token) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("videos")
    .select("id, status, mux_playback_id, duration_seconds")
    .eq("id", id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  if (!data) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_found" }, { status: 404 });
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data, {
    headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
  });
}

/**
 * POST /api/bookings/cancel
 *
 * Staff override: cancel a booking bypassing the cancellation-window policy.
 * Uses the cancel_booking SECURITY DEFINER RPC with p_override=true.
 *
 * Auth: owner or admin role required.
 *
 * Request body:
 *   { booking_id: string, reason?: string }
 *
 * Returns:
 *   { ok: true }
 *   { error: string }
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function clientErr(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return clientErr(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return clientErr(403, 'Forbidden');

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
    booking_id?: string;
    reason?: string;
  };
  if (!body.booking_id) return clientErr(400, 'booking_id is required');

  const { data, error } = await (
    supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient
  ).rpc('cancel_booking', {
    p_booking_id: body.booking_id,
    p_reason: body.reason ?? null,
    p_override: true,
  });

  if (error) {
    console.error('[bookings/cancel] RPC error:', error.message);
    return clientErr(500, error.message);
  }

  const result = data as { ok?: boolean; code?: string; message?: string };
  if (result.code && result.code !== undefined) {
    return clientErr(400, result.message ?? result.code);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

  }

  const text = await edgeRes.text();
  let parsed: unknown = null;
  try {
    parsed = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
  } catch {
    return clientErr(
      502,
      "edge_bad_response",
      `Upload service returned non-JSON (status ${edgeRes.status}).`,
    );
  }

  if (!edgeRes.ok) {
    const e = (parsed as EdgeErr | null)?.error;
    return clientErr(
      edgeRes.status >= 500 ? 502 : edgeRes.status,
      e?.code ?? "edge_error",
      e?.message ?? `Upload service returned status ${edgeRes.status}.`,
    );
  }

  const ok = parsed as EdgeOk | null;
  if (!ok?.upload_url || !ok?.video_id) {

FILE: portal/app/api/hq/invite/route.ts
=================================================================================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthenticated' }, { status: 401 });
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (readAppRole(session) !== 'super_admin') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json() as {
    email: string;
    firstName: string;
    lastName: string;
    role: 'coach' | 'admin' | 'owner';
    tenantSlug: string;
    locationId?: string;
  };

  const { email, firstName, lastName, role, tenantSlug, locationId } = body;

  if (!email || !firstName || !lastName || !role || !tenantSlug) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing required fields' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const serviceClient = createServiceClient();

  const { data: tenant, error: tenantError } = await serviceClient
    .from('tenants')
    .select('id, name')
    .eq('slug', tenantSlug)
    .single();

  if (tenantError || !tenant) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: `Tenant slug "${tenantSlug}" not found` }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Validate locationId belongs to this tenant if provided.
  if (locationId) {
    const { data: loc } = await serviceClient
      .from('locations')
      .select('id')
      .eq('id', locationId)
      .eq('tenant_id', tenant.id)
      .single();
    if (!loc) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Location not found for this franchise' }, { status: 400 });
    }
  }

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!;
  const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!;

  const listRes = await fetch(
    `${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`,
    { headers: { apikey: serviceKey, Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}` } },
  );
  const listBody = await listRes.json() as { users?: Array<{ email: string; id: string }> };
  const existing = (listBody.users ?? []).find((u) => u.email === email);
  if (existing) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: `A user with email ${email} already exists.` }, { status: 409 });
  }

  const userMeta = {
    app_role: role,
    tenant_slug: tenantSlug,
    first_name: firstName,
    last_name: lastName,
  };

  const resendKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
  const resendFrom = process.env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL ?? 'noreply@infinitehitting.com';

  let createdUserId: string | null = null;

  if (resendKey) {
    // Generate a magic link and deliver it ourselves via Resend.
    // generate_link with type=invite creates the user immediately.
    const linkRes = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/generate_link`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        apikey: serviceKey,
        Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'invite', email, data: userMeta }),
    });
    const linkBody = await linkRes.json() as {
      action_link?: string; id?: string; error?: string; msg?: string;
    };

    if (!linkRes.ok || !linkBody.action_link) {
      const errMsg = linkBody.error ?? linkBody.msg ?? 'Failed to generate invite link';
      return NextResponse.json({ error: errMsg }, { status: 500 });
    }

    createdUserId = linkBody.id ?? null;

    const roleLabel = role === 'coach' ? 'Coach' : role === 'admin' ? 'Admin' : 'Owner';
    const sendRes = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${resendKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: resendFrom,
        to: email,
        subject: `You've been invited to Ballpark — ${tenant.name}`,
        html: `
          <p>Hi ${firstName},</p>
          <p>You've been invited to join <strong>${tenant.name}</strong> on Ballpark as a <strong>${roleLabel}</strong>.</p>
          <p>Click the link below to set your password and activate your account:</p>
          <p><a href="${linkBody.action_link}" style="background:#F1E5AD;color:#2D2B2A;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;display:inline-block;">Accept Invitation</a></p>
          <p>This link expires in 24 hours.</p>
          <p>— The Ballpark Team</p>
        `,
      }),
    });

    if (!sendRes.ok) {
      const sendErr = await sendRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as { message?: string };
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Email delivery failed: ${sendErr.message ?? sendRes.statusText}` },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }
  } else {
    // No Resend configured — use Supabase's built-in invite email (sends automatically).
    const inviteRes = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/users`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        apikey: serviceKey,
        Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email,
        email_confirm: false,
        invite: true,
        user_metadata: userMeta,
      }),
    });

    if (!inviteRes.ok) {
      const inviteErr = await inviteRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as { msg?: string; message?: string; id?: string };
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: inviteErr.msg ?? inviteErr.message ?? 'Failed to create invite' },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }

    const inviteBody = await inviteRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as { id?: string };
    createdUserId = inviteBody.id ?? null;
  }

  // If a location was specified and role is coach, wire up primary_location_id.
  // The handle_new_user trigger fires synchronously, so the coaches row exists.
  if (locationId && role === 'coach' && createdUserId) {
    await serviceClient
      .from('coaches')
      .update({ primary_location_id: locationId })
      .eq('user_id', createdUserId);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, email, tenantName: tenant.name });
}

FILE: portal/app/api/hq/locations/[id]/route.ts
=================================================================================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

async function assertSuperAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (readAppRole(session) !== 'super_admin') return null;
  return user;
}

export async function PATCH(
  req: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const user = await assertSuperAdmin();
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });

  const { id } = await params;
  if (!id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing location id' }, { status: 400 });

  const body = await req.json() as {
    name?: string;
    address?: string;
    city?: string;
    state?: string;
    zip?: string;
    phone?: string;
    email?: string;
    timezone?: string;
    isActive?: boolean;
  };

  const service = createServiceClient();

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.name !== undefined)     updates.name     = body.name;
  if (body.address !== undefined)  updates.address  = body.address || null;
  if (body.city !== undefined)     updates.city     = body.city || null;
  if (body.state !== undefined)    updates.state    = body.state || null;
  if (body.zip !== undefined)      updates.zip      = body.zip || null;
  if (body.phone !== undefined)    updates.phone    = body.phone || null;
  if (body.email !== undefined)    updates.email    = body.email || null;
  if (body.timezone !== undefined) updates.timezone = body.timezone;
  if (body.isActive !== undefined) updates.is_active = body.isActive;

  if (Object.keys(updates).length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No fields to update' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const { error } = await service
    .from('locations')
    .update(updates)
    .eq('id', id);

  if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  // Auth guard: only super_admin can invoke this route.
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthenticated' }, { status: 401 });
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (readAppRole(session) !== 'super_admin') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json() as {
    isNewTenant: boolean;
    tenantName?: string;
    tenantSlug?: string;
    existingTenantSlug?: string;
    locationName: string;
    city?: string;
    state?: string;
  };

  const { isNewTenant, tenantName, tenantSlug, existingTenantSlug, locationName, city, state } = body;

  if (!locationName) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'locationName is required' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const serviceClient = createServiceClient();
  let tenantId: string;

  if (isNewTenant) {
    if (!tenantName || !tenantSlug) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantName and tenantSlug are required for a new tenant' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const { data: existing } = await serviceClient
      .from('tenants')
      .select('id')
      .eq('slug', tenantSlug)
      .single();

    if (existing) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Slug "${tenantSlug}" is already taken` }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const { data: newTenant, error: tenantError } = await serviceClient
      .from('tenants')
      .insert({
        name: tenantName,
        slug: tenantSlug,
        brand_colors: {},
        royalty_config: { model: 'per_transaction', rate: 0.025 },
      })
      .select('id')
      .single();

    if (tenantError || !newTenant) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: tenantError?.message ?? 'Failed to create tenant' }, { status: 500 });
    }
    tenantId = newTenant.id;
  } else {
    if (!existingTenantSlug) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'existingTenantSlug is required' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const { data: tenant, error } = await serviceClient
      .from('tenants')
      .select('id')
      .eq('slug', existingTenantSlug)
      .single();

    if (error || !tenant) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Tenant slug "${existingTenantSlug}" not found` }, { status: 400 });
    }
    tenantId = tenant.id;
  }

  const { data: location, error: locationError } = await serviceClient
    .from('locations')
    .insert({
      tenant_id: tenantId,
      name: locationName,
      city: city ?? null,
      state: state ?? null,
      is_active: true,
    })
    .select('id')
    .single();

  if (locationError || !location) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: locationError?.message ?? 'Failed to create location' }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, locationId: location.id, tenantId });
}

FILE: portal/app/api/hq/settings/route.ts
=================================================================================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

const HQ_PRIMARY_TENANT_ID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';

async function assertSuperAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (readAppRole(session) !== 'super_admin') return null;
  return user;
}

export async function GET() {
  const user = await assertSuperAdmin();
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });

  const service = createServiceClient();

  const [tenantsRes, configsRes] = await Promise.all([
    service.from('tenants').select('id, name, slug, royalty_config').order('name'),
    service.from('tenant_config').select('tenant_id, royalty_rate_override, network_logo_url, network_favicon_url'),
  ]);

  const configByTenantId = new Map<string, {
    royalty_rate_override: number | null;
    network_logo_url: string | null;
    network_favicon_url: string | null;
  }>();
  for (const c of (configsRes.data ?? [])) {
    configByTenantId.set(c.tenant_id, {
      royalty_rate_override: c.royalty_rate_override ?? null,
      network_logo_url: c.network_logo_url ?? null,
      network_favicon_url: c.network_favicon_url ?? null,
    });
  }

  const tenants = (tenantsRes.data ?? []).map(t => {
    const cfg = configByTenantId.get(t.id);
    const defaultRate = (t.royalty_config as { rate?: number } | null)?.rate ?? 0.025;
    return {
      id: t.id,
      name: t.name,
      slug: t.slug,
      royaltyRate: cfg?.royalty_rate_override ?? defaultRate,
    };
  });

  const primaryConfig = configByTenantId.get(HQ_PRIMARY_TENANT_ID) ?? null;
  const settings = {
    network_logo_url: primaryConfig?.network_logo_url ?? null,
    network_favicon_url: primaryConfig?.network_favicon_url ?? null,
  };

  return NextResponse.json({ settings, tenants });
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  const user = await assertSuperAdmin();
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });

  const body = await req.json() as {
    type: 'branding' | 'royalty';
    networkLogoUrl?: string | null;
    networkFaviconUrl?: string | null;
    tenantId?: string;
    rate?: number;
  };

  const service = createServiceClient();

  if (body.type === 'branding') {
    const { error } = await service
      .from('tenant_config')
      .upsert(
        {
          tenant_id: HQ_PRIMARY_TENANT_ID,
          network_logo_url: body.networkLogoUrl ?? null,
          network_favicon_url: body.networkFaviconUrl ?? null,
        },
        { onConflict: 'tenant_id' },
      );
    if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  }

  if (body.type === 'royalty') {
    if (!body.tenantId || body.rate == null) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantId and rate are required' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (body.rate < 0 || body.rate > 1) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'rate must be between 0 and 1' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const { error } = await service
      .from('tenant_config')
      .upsert(
        { tenant_id: body.tenantId, royalty_rate_override: body.rate },
        { onConflict: 'tenant_id' },
      );
    if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid type' }, { status: 400 });
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/app/api/hq/team/route.ts
=================================================================================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

async function assertSuperAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (readAppRole(session) !== 'super_admin') return null;
  return user;
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  const user = await assertSuperAdmin();
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });

  const body = await req.json() as {
    userId: string;
    action: 'ban' | 'unban' | 'update_role';
    fromRole?: string;
    role?: string;
  };

  const { userId, action, fromRole, role } = body;
  if (!userId || !action) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'userId and action are required' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!;
  const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!;
  const adminHeaders = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    apikey: serviceKey,
    Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
  };

  if (action === 'ban') {
    const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/users/${userId}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: adminHeaders,
      body: JSON.stringify({ ban_duration: '876000h' }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({})) as { msg?: string };
      return NextResponse.json({ error: err.msg ?? 'Failed to ban user' }, { status: 502 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  }

  if (action === 'unban') {
    const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/users/${userId}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: adminHeaders,
      body: JSON.stringify({ ban_duration: 'none' }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({})) as { msg?: string };
      return NextResponse.json({ error: err.msg ?? 'Failed to unban user' }, { status: 502 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  }

  if (action === 'update_role') {
    if (!role) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'role is required for update_role' }, { status: 400 });

    // Demoting to coach is not supported via this UI — coaches have a full
    // profile-table record that requires proper provisioning via the invite flow.
    if (role === 'coach') {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'To add a coach, use the Invite flow instead of changing an existing member\'s role.' },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const service = createServiceClient();

    // Update auth metadata first.
    const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/users/${userId}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: adminHeaders,
      body: JSON.stringify({ user_metadata: { app_role: role } }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({})) as { msg?: string };
      return NextResponse.json({ error: err.msg ?? 'Failed to update role' }, { status: 502 });
    }

    // If the member was a coach, deactivate their coaches table row so they
    // no longer appear in getHQTeam as a coach.
    if (fromRole === 'coach') {
      const { error: coachErr } = await service
        .from('coaches')
        .update({ is_active: false })
        .eq('user_id', userId);
      if (coachErr) {
        // Log but don't fail — metadata is already updated; the coaches row
        // is secondary. An admin can manually clean up if needed.
        console.error('[hq/team] Failed to deactivate coaches row:', coachErr.message);
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unknown action' }, { status: 400 });
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/app/api/memberships/activate/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * POST /api/memberships/activate
 *
 * Combined membership activation endpoint. Behaviour depends on plan type and
 * whether the family has a saved payment method:
 *
 * EFT + has payment method (stripe_connected_customer_id):
 *   1. Validate promo code (read-only preview) if provided — get stripe_promotion_code_id.
 *      Passes plan_name so PLAN_MISMATCH fires if applicable_plan_names is set.
 *   2. Try to create the Stripe Subscription FIRST (with promotion code if provided).
 *   3. Only mark membership active AFTER Stripe succeeds.
 *   4. Atomically consume promo code (consume_promo_code RPC, SELECT FOR UPDATE):
 *      - On success: redemptions_used incremented, done.
 *      - On EXHAUSTED: a concurrent activation beat us to the last redemption.
 *        We immediately cancel the just-created Stripe subscription to compensate
 *        (prevents over-redemption at the billing level), then return 422.
 *      - On any other error: non-fatal, log only — subscription is already live.
 *   Returns 502 if Stripe subscription creation fails (membership unchanged).
 *
 * All other cases (no payment method, not EFT):
 *   - Mark membership active immediately (Stripe skipped).
 *
 * Body: { membership_id: string, promo_code?: string }
 *
 * Returns:
 *   { ok: true, subscription_id, next_billing_at, subscription_status }  — EFT success
 *   { ok: true, stripe_skipped: true, reason: string }                   — non-EFT
 *   { error: string }  with 4xx/5xx                                      — failure
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const STRIPE_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

const PROMO_ERROR_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  INVALID: 'This promo code is invalid.',
  EXPIRED: 'This promo code has expired.',
  EXHAUSTED: 'This promo code has reached its maximum number of uses.',
  PLAN_MISMATCH: 'This promo code does not apply to this membership plan.',
  FORBIDDEN: 'Not authorized to use promo codes.',
};

/**
 * Cancel a Stripe subscription immediately (best-effort compensating action).
 * Used when consume_promo_code returns EXHAUSTED after the subscription was created.
 */
async function cancelStripeSubscription(
  subscriptionId: string,
  stripeKey: string,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(
      `https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/${encodeURIComponent(subscriptionId)}/cancel`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${stripeKey}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
          'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_VERSION,
        },
      },
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      const body = await res.text();
      console.error(
        '[memberships/activate] compensating Stripe cancel failed:',
        res.status,
        body,
      );
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(
      '[memberships/activate] compensating Stripe cancel threw:',
      e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e),
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return err(403, 'Forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return err(401, 'No tenant in session');

  let body: { membership_id?: string; promo_code?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return err(400, 'Invalid JSON body');
  }

  const { membership_id, promo_code } = body;
  if (!membership_id) return err(422, 'membership_id required');

  const trimmedPromoCode = promo_code?.trim() || null;

  // ── 1. Load membership (tenant-scoped, include plan_name for promo plan check) ──
  const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select('id, plan_name, plan_type, status, stripe_subscription_id, family_id, tenant_id, families!inner(stripe_connected_customer_id)')
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (memErr || !mem) return err(404, 'Membership not found or access denied');

  const fam = mem.families as unknown as { stripe_connected_customer_id: string | null };
  const hasPaymentMethod = Boolean(fam.stripe_connected_customer_id);
  const planName = (mem.plan_name as string | null) ?? null;

  // ── 2. Validate promo code (read-only — get stripe_promotion_code_id) ─────────
  // Passes plan_name so PLAN_MISMATCH fires when applicable_plan_names is non-empty
  // and this plan is not in the allowed list.
  // Actual atomic consumption (with row lock) happens AFTER Stripe succeeds.
  let stripePromotionCodeId: string | null = null;

  if (trimmedPromoCode) {
    const { data: promoResult, error: promoErr } = await supabase.rpc(
      'validate_promo_code',
      {
        p_code: trimmedPromoCode,
        p_plan_name: planName,
      },
    );

    if (promoErr) {
      console.error('[memberships/activate] validate_promo_code error:', promoErr.message);
      return err(500, `Promo code validation error: ${promoErr.message}`);
    }

    const result = promoResult as {
      ok: boolean;
      error_code?: string;
      stripe_promotion_code_id?: string;
    };

    if (!result.ok) {
      const errorCode = result.error_code ?? 'INVALID';
      const message = PROMO_ERROR_MESSAGES[errorCode] ?? 'This promo code is invalid.';
      return err(422, message);
    }

    stripePromotionCodeId = result.stripe_promotion_code_id ?? null;
  }

  // ── 3. Determine whether Stripe should be attempted ─────────────────────────
  const shouldCreateSubscription = mem.plan_type === 'eft' && hasPaymentMethod;

  if (!shouldCreateSubscription) {
    if (mem.status !== 'active') {
      const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
        .from('memberships')
        .update({ status: 'active', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', membership_id)
        .eq('tenant_id', tenantId);

      if (updateErr) return err(500, `DB error: ${updateErr.message}`);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      stripe_skipped: true,
      reason: !hasPaymentMethod ? 'no_payment_method' : 'not_eft_plan',
    });
  }

  // ── 4. EFT + payment method: create Stripe subscription ─────────────────────
  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!supabaseUrl) return err(500, 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL not configured');

  let subscriptionId: string;
  let nextBillingAt: string | null;
  let stripeStatus: string | null = null;

  try {
    const fnBody: Record<string, unknown> = { membership_id };
    if (stripePromotionCodeId) fnBody.stripe_promotion_code_id = stripePromotionCodeId;

    const fnRes = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/stripe-create-subscription`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(fnBody),
    });

    const fnData = await fnRes.json() as {
      subscription_id?: string;
      next_billing_at?: string;
      status?: string;
      error?: { message?: string };
    };

    if (!fnRes.ok || !fnData.subscription_id) {
      const msg = typeof fnData.error === 'object'
        ? fnData.error?.message
        : String(fnData.error ?? `Edge function error ${fnRes.status}`);
      console.error('[memberships/activate] stripe-create-subscription failed:', msg);
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: `Could not start Stripe billing: ${msg}. Membership was not activated. ` +
            `Please ensure the family has saved a payment card, then try again.`,
        },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }

    subscriptionId = fnData.subscription_id;
    nextBillingAt = fnData.next_billing_at ?? null;
    stripeStatus = fnData.status ?? null;
  } catch (fetchErr) {
    const msg = fetchErr instanceof Error ? fetchErr.message : 'Unknown error';
    console.error('[memberships/activate] fetch error:', msg);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: `Could not reach Stripe billing service: ${msg}. Membership was not activated.`,
      },
      { status: 502 },
    );
  }

  // ── 5. Mark membership active ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const stripeConfirmedActive = stripeStatus === 'active' || stripeStatus === 'trialing';
  if (stripeConfirmedActive && mem.status !== 'active') {
    const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .update({ status: 'active', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', membership_id)
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId);

    if (updateErr) {
      console.error('[memberships/activate] DB activate update failed:', updateErr.message);
    }
  }

  // ── 6. Atomically consume promo code (SELECT FOR UPDATE) ──────────────────────
  // consume_promo_code re-validates the code under a row lock and atomically
  // increments redemptions_used, preventing concurrent over-redemption.
  //
  // Called AFTER Stripe succeeds so redemptions are never counted for failed billings.
  //
  // EXHAUSTED edge case: a concurrent activation consumed the last redemption between
  // our validate (step 2) and here. We cancel the just-created Stripe subscription as
  // a compensating action to prevent the discount being applied when it shouldn't be.
  if (trimmedPromoCode) {
    const { data: consumeResult, error: consumeErr } = await supabase.rpc(
      'consume_promo_code',
      {
        p_code: trimmedPromoCode,
        p_plan_name: planName,
      },
    );

    if (consumeErr) {
      // Non-fatal: subscription is live, log and continue
      console.error('[memberships/activate] consume_promo_code RPC error:', consumeErr.message);
    } else {
      const result = consumeResult as { ok: boolean; error_code?: string };
      if (!result.ok && result.error_code === 'EXHAUSTED') {
        // Compensate: cancel the subscription that was created with the discount
        if (stripeKey) {
          await cancelStripeSubscription(subscriptionId, stripeKey);
        }
        return err(
          422,
          'This promo code was just fully redeemed by another activation. ' +
            'The subscription has been cancelled. Please try again without a promo code ' +
            'or contact support.',
        );
      } else if (!result.ok) {
        // Other errors (INVALID, EXPIRED, etc.) after Stripe success — log only
        console.warn(
          '[memberships/activate] consume_promo_code non-exhausted failure:',
          result.error_code,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    subscription_id: subscriptionId,
    next_billing_at: nextBillingAt,
    subscription_status: stripeStatus,
  });
}

/**
 * POST /api/memberships/pause
 *
 * Portal proxy to the pause-membership Edge Function.
 * Auth + tenant isolation enforced inside the Edge Function via JWT.
 *
 * Body: { membership_id: string, pause_end: string (YYYY-MM-DD) }
 * Returns: { ok: true, pause_start: string, pause_end: string }
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function clientErr(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return clientErr(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return clientErr(403, 'Forbidden');

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!supabaseUrl) return clientErr(500, 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL not configured');

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
    membership_id?: string;
    pause_end?: string;
  };
  if (!body.membership_id) return clientErr(400, 'membership_id is required');
  if (!body.pause_end) return clientErr(400, 'pause_end is required');

  try {
    const fnRes = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/pause-membership`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        membership_id: body.membership_id,
        pause_end: body.pause_end,
      }),
    });

    const data = await fnRes.json() as {
      ok?: boolean;
      pause_start?: string;
      pause_end?: string;
      error?: { message?: string; code?: string };
    };

    if (!fnRes.ok || !data.ok) {
      const msg = typeof data.error === 'object'
        ? data.error?.message ?? `Error ${fnRes.status}`
        : String(data.error ?? `Error ${fnRes.status}`);
      return clientErr(fnRes.status >= 400 && fnRes.status < 500 ? fnRes.status : 500, msg);
    }

    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
    console.error('[memberships/pause] proxy error:', msg);
    return clientErr(500, msg);
  }
}

FILE: portal/app/api/memberships/sessions/route.ts

/**
 * PATCH /api/memberships/sessions
 *
 * Owner / admin-only endpoint to manually override the `sessions_remaining`
 * field on an OTC membership.  Used from the portal member detail page for
 * staff adjustments (e.g. gifting sessions, correcting data entry errors).
 *
 * Auth flow:
 *  1. Verify the caller's session and confirm app_role ∈ {owner, admin, super_admin}
 *  2. Confirm the membership belongs to the caller's tenant
 *  3. Perform the write via the service-role client to bypass RLS
 *     (memberships has no UPDATE policy for authenticated users by design;
 *      all writes go through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs or service-role paths)
 *
 * Body: { membership_id: string; sessions_remaining: number }
 * Returns: { ok: true; sessions_remaining: number }
 */

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readTenantId, readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

const ALLOWED_ROLES = new Set(['owner', 'admin', 'super_admin']);

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json() as { membership_id?: string; sessions_remaining?: number };
    const { membership_id, sessions_remaining } = body;

    if (!membership_id || typeof sessions_remaining !== 'number' || sessions_remaining < 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'membership_id and non-negative sessions_remaining are required.' },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    // ── Identity & role check (user-auth client, subject to RLS) ──────────
    const userClient = await createClient();
    const { data: { session } } = await userClient.auth.getSession();

    const appRole = readAppRole(session);
    if (!ALLOWED_ROLES.has(appRole)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
    if (!tenantId && appRole !== 'super_admin') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    // ── Validate tenant ownership and OTC type (user-auth client) ─────────
    // The SELECT RLS policy for owner/admin allows reading memberships in
    // their tenant, so this read succeeds without service role.
    const selectQuery = userClient
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, plan_type, sessions_total, tenant_id')
      .eq('id', membership_id);

    if (tenantId) {
      selectQuery.eq('tenant_id', tenantId);
    }

    const { data: mem, error: fetchErr } = await selectQuery.single();

    if (fetchErr || !mem) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Membership not found.' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (mem.plan_type !== 'otc') {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Session credits only apply to OTC (pack) memberships.' },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const sessionsTotal = (mem.sessions_total as number | null) ?? null;
    if (sessionsTotal !== null && sessions_remaining > sessionsTotal) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `sessions_remaining cannot exceed sessions_total (${sessionsTotal}).` },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    // ── Write via service-role client (bypasses RLS on memberships) ───────
    const serviceClient = createServiceClient();
    const { error: updateErr } = await serviceClient
      .from('memberships')
      .update({ sessions_remaining, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', membership_id)
      .eq('tenant_id', mem.tenant_id as string);

    if (updateErr) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: updateErr.message }, { status: 500 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, sessions_remaining });
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

/**
 * Owner portal — insert a coach→family message on behalf of a coach.
 *
 * Uses the SERVICE ROLE client to bypass RLS so the owner can write
 * coach_messages with sender_user_id = the selected coach's auth user_id
 * (not the owner's own user_id).
 *
 * Required body:
 *   coachUserId    string  — auth.users UUID of the sending coach
 *   familyId       string  — recipient family UUID
 *   kidId          string  — recipient kid UUID
 *   tenantId       string  — tenant UUID (double-checked against JWT claim)
 *   videoId?       string  — optional videos row UUID (already uploaded via Mux)
 *   messageText?   string  — optional text body (required when videoId is omitted)
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createServiceClient } from "@/lib/supabase/serviceClient";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function clientErr(status: number, code: string, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: { code, message } },
    { status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
  );
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) {
    return clientErr(401, "unauthorized", "Sign in again.");
  }
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "owner" && role !== "super_admin") {
    return clientErr(403, "forbidden", "Owner role required.");
  }
  const jwtTenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!jwtTenantId) {
    return clientErr(403, "no_tenant", "No tenant in session.");
  }

  let body: {
    coachUserId?: string;
    familyId?: string;
    kidId?: string;
    tenantId?: string;
    videoId?: string | null;
    messageText?: string | null;
  };
  try {
    body = (await req.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return clientErr(400, "bad_request", "Invalid JSON body.");
  }

  const { coachUserId, familyId, kidId, tenantId, videoId, messageText } = body;

  if (!coachUserId || !familyId || !kidId || !tenantId) {
    return clientErr(400, "bad_request", "coachUserId, familyId, kidId, tenantId are required.");
  }
  if (tenantId !== jwtTenantId) {
    return clientErr(403, "tenant_mismatch", "tenantId does not match your session.");
  }
  if (!videoId && !messageText?.trim()) {
    return clientErr(400, "bad_request", "Provide a video, a message, or both.");
  }

  const service = createServiceClient();

  const { data, error } = await service
    .from("coach_messages")
    .insert({
      tenant_id: tenantId,
      sender_user_id: coachUserId,
      recipient_family_id: familyId,
      recipient_kid_id: kidId,
      video_id: videoId ?? null,
      message_text: messageText?.trim() || null,
      recipient_coach_user_id: null,
      label: null,
      sender_display: null,
    })
    .select("id")
    .single();

  if (error) {
    return clientErr(500, "db_error", error.message);
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    { id: data.id },
    { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/api/owner/coach-message-uploads/route.ts

/**
 * Owner portal — mint a Mux Direct Upload URL for a coach→family video message.
 *
 * Proxies to the mux-create-upload Edge Function with purpose='coach_message'.
 * The Edge Function was extended (20260514) to accept app_role='owner' in
 * addition to 'coach' for this purpose.
 *
 * The videos row is inserted by the Edge Function using the SERVICE ROLE, with
 * uploaded_by_user_id = owner's user id (the portal user). The coach_messages
 * INSERT (POST /api/owner/coach-messages) uses the service role to bypass RLS
 * and pin sender_user_id to the selected coach's user_id.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type EdgeOk = { upload_url: string; video_id: string };
type EdgeErr = { error?: { code?: string; message?: string } };

function clientErr(status: number, code: string, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: { code, message } },
    { status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
  );
}

export async function POST() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session?.access_token) {
    return clientErr(401, "unauthorized", "Sign in again to upload.");
  }
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "owner" && role !== "super_admin") {
    return clientErr(403, "forbidden", "Owner role required.");
  }

  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!url) {
    return clientErr(500, "config_error", "Server is missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.");
  }

  const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();

  let edgeRes: Response;
  try {
    edgeRes = await fetch(`${url}/functions/v1/mux-create-upload`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ purpose: "coach_message" }),
      cache: "no-store",
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Network error";
    return clientErr(502, "edge_unreachable", `Could not reach upload service: ${msg}`);
  }

  const text = await edgeRes.text();
  let parsed: unknown = null;
  try {
    parsed = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
  } catch {
    return clientErr(502, "edge_bad_response", `Upload service returned non-JSON (status ${edgeRes.status}).`);
  }

  if (!edgeRes.ok) {
    const e = (parsed as EdgeErr | null)?.error;
    return clientErr(
      edgeRes.status >= 500 ? 502 : edgeRes.status,
      e?.code ?? "edge_error",
      e?.message ?? `Upload service returned status ${edgeRes.status}.`,
    );
  }

  const ok = parsed as EdgeOk | null;
  if (!ok?.upload_url || !ok?.video_id) {
    return clientErr(502, "edge_bad_response", "Upload service response was missing upload_url or video_id.");
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    { upload_url: ok.upload_url, video_id: ok.video_id },
    { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
  );
}

/**
 * POST /api/owner/enroll/attach-payment
 *
 * Called after the Stripe intent is confirmed on the client. All payment
 * parameters (plan_type, amount, connected_account_id) are loaded SERVER-SIDE
 * from the DB using membership_id — client values are ignored for security.
 *
 * EFT (SetupIntent confirmed):
 *   1. Load membership + tenant stripe_account_id from DB
 *   2. Retrieve SetupIntent → get payment_method.id
 *   3. Create Stripe customer on the connected account
 *   4. Attach the payment method to the customer + set as default
 *   5. Save card shadow columns + stripe_connected_customer_id to families row
 *   6. Call /api/memberships/activate — returns error if activation fails
 *   7. Send welcome email via Resend
 *
 * OTC (PaymentIntent confirmed):
 *   1. Load membership + tenant stripe_account_id from DB
 *   2. Retrieve PaymentIntent → verify status === 'succeeded'
 *   3. Save card shadow columns to families row
 *   4. Mark membership active via service-role update
 *   5. Send welcome email via Resend
 *
 * Body: {
 *   family_id: string,
 *   membership_id: string,
 *   stripe_intent_id: string,  -- SetupIntent or PaymentIntent id
 *   intent_type: 'setup' | 'payment',
 * }
 *
 * Returns: { ok: true, activated: true } or { error: string } with 4xx/5xx
 */
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const STRIPE_VERSION = '2024-06-20';
const RESEND_API = 'https://api.resend.com/emails';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

type CardDetail = { brand: string; last4: string; exp_month: number; exp_year: number };
