export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return err(403, 'Forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return err(401, 'No tenant in session');

  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!stripeKey) return err(500, 'Stripe not configured');

  let body: {
    family_id?: string;
    membership_id?: string;
    stripe_intent_id?: string;
    intent_type?: string;   // accepted but NOT trusted for branching — DB plan_type is authoritative
  };
  try {
    body = await req.json() as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return err(400, 'Invalid JSON body');
  }

  const { family_id, membership_id, stripe_intent_id } = body;
  if (!family_id) return err(422, 'family_id required');
  if (!membership_id) return err(422, 'membership_id required');
  if (!stripe_intent_id) return err(422, 'stripe_intent_id required');

  const serviceClient = createServiceClient();
  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!;
  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!;

  // ── Load authoritative payment data from DB (never trust client) ──────────

  const { data: membership } = await serviceClient
    .from('memberships')
    .select('id, tenant_id, family_id, kid_id, plan_type, plan_name, amount_cents, status')
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (!membership) return err(404, 'Membership not found');

  // Verify family matches and belongs to tenant
  if ((membership as { family_id: string }).family_id !== family_id) {
    return err(403, 'family_id does not match membership');
  }

  const planType = (membership as { plan_type: string }).plan_type as 'eft' | 'otc';
  const amountCents = (membership as { amount_cents: number }).amount_cents;
  const planName = (membership as { plan_name: string }).plan_name;

  // ── Load family details + derive location-scoped Stripe account ──────────
  // Must use families.primary_location_id → locations.stripe_account_id,
  // the same derivation used by stripe-create-subscription, so all Stripe
  // objects (customer, SetupIntent/PaymentIntent, subscription) live on
  // the same connected account.

  const { data: familyRow } = await serviceClient
    .from('families')
    .select('id, parent_user_id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email, primary_location_id')
    .eq('id', family_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (!familyRow) return err(404, 'Family not found');

  const primaryLocationId = (familyRow as { primary_location_id?: string }).primary_location_id ?? null;

  let connectedAccountId: string | null = null;
  if (primaryLocationId) {
    const { data: location } = await serviceClient
      .from('locations')
      .select('stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status')
      .eq('id', primaryLocationId)
      .single();
    const loc = location as { stripe_account_id?: string; stripe_onboarding_status?: string } | null;
    if (loc?.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected') {
      connectedAccountId = loc.stripe_account_id ?? null;
    }
  }

  // Hard gate: a connected Stripe account is required. Without it, intents or
  // membership activation would target the wrong Stripe account.
  if (!connectedAccountId) {
    return err(422, 'Stripe account not configured for this location. Complete Stripe Connect onboarding before enrolling members.');
  }

  const { data: kidRow } = await serviceClient
    .from('kids')
    .select('first_name, last_name, age_group')
    .eq('id', (membership as { kid_id: string }).kid_id)
    .single();

  const stripeHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${stripeKey}`,
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_VERSION,
  };
  if (connectedAccountId) stripeHeaders['Stripe-Account'] = connectedAccountId;

  // ── Derive expected intent type from DB plan_type (authoritative) ─────────
  const expectedIntentType: 'setup' | 'payment' = planType === 'otc' ? 'payment' : 'setup';

  // Validate stripe_intent_id prefix matches DB-derived type
  const intentIdPrefix = stripe_intent_id.split('_')[0];
  const validPrefix = expectedIntentType === 'payment' ? 'pi' : 'seti';
  if (intentIdPrefix !== validPrefix) {
    return err(422, `Stripe intent ID prefix "${intentIdPrefix}" does not match plan type "${planType}"`);
  }

  let cardDetails: CardDetail | null = null;

  if (expectedIntentType === 'setup') {
    // ── EFT: SetupIntent flow ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    const siRes = await fetch(
      `https://api.stripe.com/v1/setup_intents/${encodeURIComponent(stripe_intent_id)}?expand[]=payment_method`,
      { headers: stripeHeaders },
    );
    const siData = await siRes.json() as {
      status?: string;
      payment_method?: { id: string; card?: CardDetail };
      error?: { message?: string };
    };

    if (!siRes.ok || siData.status !== 'succeeded') {
      const msg = siData.error?.message ?? `SetupIntent not confirmed (status: ${siData.status ?? 'unknown'})`;
      return err(422, msg);
    }

    const pm = siData.payment_method;
    if (!pm) return err(422, 'No payment method on SetupIntent');
    cardDetails = pm.card ?? null;

    // Create Stripe customer on connected account
    const { data: userRecord } = await serviceClient.auth.admin.getUserById(
      (familyRow as { parent_user_id: string }).parent_user_id,
    );
    const email = userRecord?.user?.email ?? (familyRow as { parent_email: string }).parent_email ?? '';
    const fullName = [
      (familyRow as { parent_first_name: string }).parent_first_name,
      (familyRow as { parent_last_name: string }).parent_last_name,
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

    const custParams = new URLSearchParams();
    if (email) custParams.append('email', email);
    if (fullName) custParams.append('name', fullName);
    custParams.append('metadata[family_id]', family_id);
    custParams.append('metadata[membership_id]', membership_id);

    const custRes = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { ...stripeHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: custParams.toString(),
    });
    const custData = await custRes.json() as { id?: string; error?: { message?: string } };

    if (!custRes.ok || !custData.id) {
      const msg = custData.error?.message ?? `Could not create Stripe customer (${custRes.status})`;
      return err(502, msg);
    }
    const customerId = custData.id;

    // Attach payment method to customer
    const attachParams = new URLSearchParams({ customer: customerId });
    const attachRes = await fetch(
      `https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_methods/${encodeURIComponent(pm.id)}/attach`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { ...stripeHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: attachParams.toString(),
      },
    );
    const attachData = await attachRes.json() as { id?: string; error?: { message?: string } };
    if (!attachRes.ok) {
      const msg = attachData.error?.message ?? `Could not attach payment method (${attachRes.status})`;
      return err(502, msg);
    }

    // Set as customer's default payment method
    const updateCustParams = new URLSearchParams();
    updateCustParams.append('invoice_settings[default_payment_method]', pm.id);
    await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers/${encodeURIComponent(customerId)}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { ...stripeHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: updateCustParams.toString(),
    });

    // Save card details + customer id to families row
    await serviceClient
      .from('families')
      .update({
        stripe_connected_customer_id: customerId,
        card_last4: cardDetails?.last4 ?? null,
        card_brand: cardDetails?.brand ?? null,
        card_exp_month: cardDetails?.exp_month ?? null,
        card_exp_year: cardDetails?.exp_year ?? null,
      })
      .eq('id', family_id);

    // Activate membership — fail hard on error
    const host = req.headers.get('host') ?? 'localhost:3000';
    const proto = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'https' : 'http';
    const activateRes = await fetch(`${proto}://${host}/api/memberships/activate`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Cookie: req.headers.get('cookie') ?? '',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ membership_id }),
    });

    if (!activateRes.ok) {
      const activateData = await activateRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as { error?: string };
      const msg = activateData.error ?? `Activation failed (${activateRes.status})`;
      console.error('[enroll/attach-payment] EFT activation failed:', msg);
      return err(activateRes.status >= 500 ? 502 : 422, `Membership activation failed: ${msg}`);
    }

  } else {
    // ── OTC: PaymentIntent flow ───────────────────────────────────────────

    const piRes = await fetch(
      `https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/${encodeURIComponent(stripe_intent_id)}?expand[]=payment_method`,
      { headers: stripeHeaders },
    );
    const piData = await piRes.json() as {
      status?: string;
      amount?: number;
      payment_method?: { id: string; card?: CardDetail };
      error?: { message?: string };
    };

    if (!piRes.ok) {
      const msg = piData.error?.message ?? `Could not retrieve PaymentIntent (${piRes.status})`;
      return err(502, msg);
    }

    if (piData.status !== 'succeeded') {
      return err(422, `Payment was not completed (status: ${piData.status ?? 'unknown'}). Please try again.`);
    }

    // Verify charged amount matches DB plan amount (tamper guard)
    if (typeof piData.amount === 'number' && piData.amount !== amountCents) {
      console.error(`[attach-payment] Amount mismatch: PI=${piData.amount} DB=${amountCents}`);
      return err(422, 'Payment amount does not match plan. Please contact support.');
    }

    cardDetails = piData.payment_method?.card ?? null;

    // Create Stripe customer on the location-scoped connected account for OTC too,
    // so stripe_connected_customer_id is always set after any successful payment.
    const { data: userRecord } = await serviceClient.auth.admin.getUserById(
      (familyRow as { parent_user_id: string }).parent_user_id,
    );
    const otcEmail = userRecord?.user?.email ?? (familyRow as { parent_email: string }).parent_email ?? '';
    const otcName = [
      (familyRow as { parent_first_name: string }).parent_first_name,
      (familyRow as { parent_last_name: string }).parent_last_name,
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

    let otcCustomerId: string | null = null;
    const otcCustParams = new URLSearchParams();
    if (otcEmail) otcCustParams.append('email', otcEmail);
    if (otcName) otcCustParams.append('name', otcName);
    otcCustParams.append('metadata[family_id]', family_id);
    otcCustParams.append('metadata[membership_id]', membership_id);

    const otcCustRes = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { ...stripeHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: otcCustParams.toString(),
    });
    const otcCustData = await otcCustRes.json() as { id?: string; error?: { message?: string } };
    if (otcCustRes.ok && otcCustData.id) {
      otcCustomerId = otcCustData.id;
    } else {
      console.warn('[attach-payment] OTC customer creation failed:', otcCustData.error?.message);
    }

    // Save card shadow columns + customer id to families row
    const otcFamilyUpdate: Record<string, unknown> = {
      card_last4: cardDetails?.last4 ?? null,
      card_brand: cardDetails?.brand ?? null,
      card_exp_month: cardDetails?.exp_month ?? null,
      card_exp_year: cardDetails?.exp_year ?? null,
    };
    if (otcCustomerId) otcFamilyUpdate.stripe_connected_customer_id = otcCustomerId;

    await serviceClient
      .from('families')
      .update(otcFamilyUpdate)
      .eq('id', family_id);

    // Mark membership active
    const { error: activateErr } = await serviceClient
      .from('memberships')
      .update({ status: 'active', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', membership_id)
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId);

    if (activateErr) {
      console.error('[enroll/attach-payment] OTC activate error:', activateErr.message);
      return err(500, `Could not activate membership: ${activateErr.message}`);
    }
  }

  // ── Send welcome email now that membership is confirmed active ────────────
  // Generate password-reset link so parent can set their own password
  let resetLink: string | null = null;
  try {
    const parentEmail = (familyRow as { parent_email: string }).parent_email ?? '';
    const resetRes = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/generate_link`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        apikey: serviceRoleKey,
        Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceRoleKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'recovery', email: parentEmail }),
    });
    const resetBody = await resetRes.json() as { action_link?: string };
    resetLink = resetBody.action_link ?? null;
  } catch {
    // reset link is best-effort; email still sends
  }

  await sendWelcomeEmail({
    parentEmail: (familyRow as { parent_email: string }).parent_email ?? '',
    parentFirstName: (familyRow as { parent_first_name: string }).parent_first_name ?? '',
    kidFirstName: kidRow ? (kidRow as { first_name: string }).first_name : '',
    kidLastName: kidRow ? ((kidRow as { last_name: string | null }).last_name ?? null) : null,
    ageGroup: kidRow ? ((kidRow as { age_group: string | null }).age_group ?? null) : null,
    planName,
    planType,
    amountCents,
    resetLink,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, activated: true });
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/app/api/owner/enroll/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * POST /api/owner/enroll
 *
 * Staff-led enrollment endpoint. Creates auth user + families + kids + family_waivers
 * + memberships in a single transaction-like sequence using the Supabase Admin API.
 *
 * Body: {
 *   parent_first_name: string,
 *   parent_last_name: string,
 *   parent_email: string,
 *   parent_phone?: string,
 *   kid_first_name: string,
 *   kid_last_name?: string,
 *   age_group?: string,
 *   plan_id: string,
 *   waiver_id: string,
 *   signature_image_data: string,  -- base64 data URL (data:image/png;base64,...)
 * }
 *
 * Returns: { ok: true, family_id, kid_id, membership_id }
 */
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

function dataUrlToBuffer(dataUrl: string): { buffer: Buffer; mimeType: string } | null {
  const match = dataUrl.match(/^data:([a-zA-Z0-9+/]+\/[a-zA-Z0-9+/]+);base64,(.+)$/);
  if (!match) return null;
  return {
    mimeType: match[1],
    buffer: Buffer.from(match[2], 'base64'),
  };
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return err(403, 'Forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return err(401, 'No tenant in session');

  let body: {
    parent_first_name?: string;
    parent_last_name?: string;
    parent_email?: string;
    parent_phone?: string;
    kid_first_name?: string;
    kid_last_name?: string;
    age_group?: string;
    plan_id?: string;
    waiver_id?: string;
    signature_image_data?: string;
    location_id?: string;
  };
  try {
    body = await req.json() as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return err(400, 'Invalid JSON body');
  }

  const {
    parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email, parent_phone,
    kid_first_name, kid_last_name, age_group,
    plan_id, waiver_id, signature_image_data, location_id,
  } = body;

  if (!parent_first_name) return err(422, 'parent_first_name required');
  if (!parent_last_name) return err(422, 'parent_last_name required');
  if (!parent_email) return err(422, 'parent_email required');
  if (!kid_first_name) return err(422, 'kid_first_name required');
  if (!plan_id) return err(422, 'plan_id required');
  if (!waiver_id) return err(422, 'waiver_id required');
  if (!signature_image_data) return err(422, 'signature_image_data required');

  const serviceClient = createServiceClient();
  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!;
  const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!;

  // ── 1. Load tenant slug (required by handle_new_user trigger) + verify plan
  //       + resolve primary_location_id ────────────────────────────────────────
  //
  // If the caller supplies a location_id (staff-selected from the picker),
  // validate it belongs to this tenant and use it directly.
  // Otherwise fall back to the first connected location (legacy auto-pick).

  const [{ data: tenant }, { data: plan, error: planErr }, { data: connectedLocations }] = await Promise.all([
    serviceClient
      .from('tenants')
      .select('slug')
      .eq('id', tenantId)
      .single(),
    serviceClient
      .from('membership_plans')
      .select('id, name, plan_type, amount_cents, sessions_per_week')
      .eq('id', plan_id)
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('is_active', true)
      .single(),
    // Only run the auto-pick query when no explicit location_id was supplied
    location_id
      ? Promise.resolve({ data: null })
      : serviceClient
          .from('locations')
          .select('id')
          .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
          .eq('stripe_onboarding_status', 'connected')
          .limit(1),
  ]);

  // If location_id was provided, validate it belongs to this tenant
  let primaryLocationId: string | null = null;
  if (location_id) {
    const { data: specifiedLocation } = await serviceClient
      .from('locations')
      .select('id')
      .eq('id', location_id)
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!specifiedLocation) return err(422, 'Invalid location_id for this tenant');
    primaryLocationId = specifiedLocation.id as string;
  } else {
    // Auto-pick: use the first connected location (may be null — enrollment proceeds;
    // only the payment step hard-gates on Stripe being present)
    primaryLocationId = (connectedLocations as Array<{ id: string }> | null)?.[0]?.id ?? null;
  }

  const tenantSlug = (tenant as { slug: string } | null)?.slug;
  if (!tenantSlug) return err(500, 'Could not load tenant configuration');
  if (planErr || !plan) return err(404, 'Plan not found or inactive');

  // ── 2. Verify waiver belongs to this tenant ────────────────────────────────
  const { data: waiver, error: waiverErr } = await serviceClient
    .from('waivers')
    .select('id, tenant_id')
    .eq('id', waiver_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (waiverErr || !waiver) return err(404, 'Waiver not found');

  // ── 3. Check for duplicate email ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const listRes = await fetch(
    `${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(parent_email)}`,
    { headers: { apikey: serviceKey, Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}` } },
  );
  const listBody = await listRes.json() as { users?: Array<{ email: string; id: string }> };
  const existing = (listBody.users ?? []).find((u) => u.email?.toLowerCase() === parent_email.toLowerCase());
  if (existing) {
    return err(409, `An account with email ${parent_email} already exists. Use the invite flow to add them.`);
  }

  // ── 4. Create auth user (email_confirm: true so they can sign in immediately) ─
  const tempPassword = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))
    .reduce((acc, b) => acc + b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'), '');

  const createUserRes = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/users`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      apikey: serviceKey,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      email: parent_email,
      password: tempPassword,
      email_confirm: true,
      user_metadata: {
        app_role: 'parent',
        tenant_slug: tenantSlug,
        first_name: parent_first_name,
        last_name: parent_last_name,
      },
    }),
  });

  if (!createUserRes.ok) {
    const createErr = await createUserRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as { msg?: string; message?: string };
    return err(502, createErr.msg ?? createErr.message ?? 'Failed to create user account');
  }
  const createdUser = await createUserRes.json() as { id: string };
  const userId = createdUser.id;

  try {
    // ── 5. The handle_new_user trigger creates the families row.
    //       Poll briefly for it to appear, then update with our fields.
    let familyId: string | null = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
      const { data: fam } = await serviceClient
        .from('families')
        .select('id')
        .eq('parent_user_id', userId)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (fam?.id) { familyId = fam.id; break; }
    }

    if (!familyId) {
      // Trigger may not have fired — insert manually
      const { data: newFam, error: famInsertErr } = await serviceClient
        .from('families')
        .insert({
          parent_user_id: userId,
          tenant_id: tenantId,
          parent_first_name,
          parent_last_name,
          parent_email,
          parent_phone: parent_phone ?? null,
          ...(primaryLocationId ? { primary_location_id: primaryLocationId } : {}),
        })
        .select('id')
        .single();

      if (famInsertErr || !newFam) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to create family: ${famInsertErr?.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
      }
      familyId = newFam.id;
    } else {
      // Update the trigger-created row with full details
      await serviceClient
        .from('families')
        .update({
          parent_first_name,
          parent_last_name,
          parent_email,
          parent_phone: parent_phone ?? null,
          tenant_id: tenantId,
          ...(primaryLocationId ? { primary_location_id: primaryLocationId } : {}),
        })
        .eq('id', familyId);
    }

    // ── 6. Create kid row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const { data: newKid, error: kidErr } = await serviceClient
      .from('kids')
      .insert({
        family_id: familyId,
        first_name: kid_first_name,
        last_name: kid_last_name ?? null,
        age_group: age_group ?? null,
      })
      .select('id')
      .single();

    if (kidErr || !newKid) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to create kid: ${kidErr?.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
    }
    const kidId = newKid.id;

    // ── 7. Upload signature to Supabase Storage (required) ───────────────
    const parsed = dataUrlToBuffer(signature_image_data);
    if (!parsed) {
      throw new Error('Invalid signature image data');
    }

    const storagePath = `${tenantId}/${familyId}/${waiver_id}.png`;
    const uploadRes = await fetch(
      `${supabaseUrl}/storage/v1/object/waiver-signatures/${storagePath}`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          apikey: serviceKey,
          Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
          'Content-Type': 'image/png',
          'x-upsert': 'true',
        },
        body: new Uint8Array(parsed.buffer),
      },
    );
    if (!uploadRes.ok) {
      const uploadErr = await uploadRes.text();
      throw new Error(`Signature upload failed: ${uploadErr}`);
    }
    const signaturePath = storagePath;

    // ── 8. Insert family_waivers row — required for mobile waiver-skip ────
    const { error: waiverInsertErr } = await serviceClient
      .from('family_waivers')
      .insert({
        family_id: familyId,
        waiver_id,
        signature_image_path: signaturePath,
        app_version: 'portal-kiosk',
      });

    if (waiverInsertErr) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to record waiver signature: ${waiverInsertErr.message}`);
    }

    // ── 9. Create membership row ──────────────────────────────────────────
    const typedPlan = plan as { name: string; plan_type: string; amount_cents: number; sessions_per_week: number | null };
    const isEft = typedPlan.plan_type === 'eft';
    const currentMonday = (() => {
      const d = new Date();
      const day = d.getDay();
      const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day;
      d.setDate(d.getDate() + diff);
      return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    })();

    const { data: newMembership, error: memErr } = await serviceClient
      .from('memberships')
      .insert({
        family_id: familyId,
        kid_id: kidId,
        tenant_id: tenantId,
        plan_name: typedPlan.name,
        plan_type: typedPlan.plan_type,
        status: 'active',
        amount_cents: typedPlan.amount_cents,
        ...(isEft && typedPlan.sessions_per_week != null ? {
          sessions_per_week: typedPlan.sessions_per_week,
          weekly_period_start: currentMonday,
          weekly_sessions_used: 0,
        } : {}),
      })
      .select('id')
      .single();

    if (memErr || !newMembership) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to create membership: ${memErr?.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
    }
    const membershipId = newMembership.id;

    // Welcome email is sent from /api/owner/enroll/attach-payment after
    // payment succeeds and the membership is confirmed active.

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      family_id: familyId,
      kid_id: kidId,
      membership_id: membershipId,
    });

  } catch (e) {
    // Clean up the created auth user to avoid orphaned accounts
    console.error('[enroll] rollback — deleting orphaned auth user:', userId, e);
    await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/admin/users/${userId}`, {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: { apikey: serviceKey, Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}` },
    }).catch(() => {});

    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Enrollment failed';
    return err(500, msg);
  }
}

FILE: portal/app/api/owner/enroll/setup-intent/route.ts

/**
 * POST /api/owner/enroll/setup-intent
 *
 * Creates the appropriate Stripe intent for the kiosk payment step.
 * All payment parameters are loaded SERVER-SIDE from the DB using membership_id —
 * the client has no influence over amount, plan type, or connected account.
 *
 *   EFT plans  → SetupIntent (vault card for recurring billing, no charge now)
 *   OTC plans  → PaymentIntent (charge the full plan amount immediately)
 *
 * Body: {
 *   membership_id: string,
 *   customer_email?: string,   -- informational hint only (for Stripe metadata)
 *   customer_name?: string,
 * }
 *
 * Returns: {
 *   client_secret: string,
 *   intent_type: 'setup' | 'payment',
 *   connected_account_id: string | null,
 * }
 */
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const STRIPE_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return err(403, 'Forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return err(401, 'No tenant in session');

  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!stripeKey) return err(500, 'Stripe not configured');

  let body: { membership_id?: string; customer_email?: string; customer_name?: string } = {};
  try {
    body = await req.json() as typeof body;
  } catch {
    // body optional
  }

  const { membership_id, customer_email, customer_name } = body;
  if (!membership_id) return err(422, 'membership_id required');

  const serviceClient = createServiceClient();

  // ── Load plan + location stripe account from DB (authoritative, never trust client) ──
  // Use families.primary_location_id → locations.stripe_account_id, the same path
  // stripe-create-subscription uses, so all Stripe objects live on the same account.

  const { data: membership } = await serviceClient
    .from('memberships')
    .select('id, tenant_id, plan_type, amount_cents, families!inner(primary_location_id)')
    .eq('id', membership_id)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (!membership) return err(404, 'Membership not found');

  const planType = (membership as { plan_type: string }).plan_type as 'eft' | 'otc';
  const amountCents = (membership as { amount_cents: number }).amount_cents;

  const primaryLocationId = (
    (membership as { families?: { primary_location_id?: string } }).families
  )?.primary_location_id ?? null;

  let connectedAccountId: string | null = null;
  if (primaryLocationId) {
    const { data: location } = await serviceClient
      .from('locations')
      .select('stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status')
      .eq('id', primaryLocationId)
      .single();
    const loc = location as { stripe_account_id?: string; stripe_onboarding_status?: string } | null;
    if (loc?.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected') {
      connectedAccountId = loc.stripe_account_id ?? null;
    }
  }

  // Fallback: if primary_location_id was null (family enrolled before the fix
  // landed) or its location isn't connected, search the tenant for any
  // connected location so existing families aren't permanently broken.
  if (!connectedAccountId) {
    const { data: fallbackLocs } = await serviceClient
      .from('locations')
      .select('stripe_account_id')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('stripe_onboarding_status', 'connected')
      .limit(1);
    const fb = (fallbackLocs as Array<{ stripe_account_id?: string }> | null)?.[0];
    if (fb?.stripe_account_id) {
      connectedAccountId = fb.stripe_account_id;
    }
  }

  // Hard gate: a connected Stripe account is required. Without it, any intent
  // created would land on the platform account instead of the tenant's account.
  if (!connectedAccountId) {
    return err(422, 'Stripe account not configured for this location. Complete Stripe Connect onboarding before enrolling members.');
  }

  const stripeHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${stripeKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_VERSION,
  };
  if (connectedAccountId) stripeHeaders['Stripe-Account'] = connectedAccountId;

  let clientSecret: string;
  const intentType: 'setup' | 'payment' = planType === 'otc' ? 'payment' : 'setup';

  if (intentType === 'payment') {
    // OTC: PaymentIntent — charge the DB-sourced amount immediately
    if (!amountCents || amountCents <= 0) {
      return err(422, 'Plan amount must be greater than zero for OTC payment');
    }
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      amount: String(amountCents),
      currency: 'usd',
      'payment_method_types[]': 'card',
      capture_method: 'automatic',
      'metadata[membership_id]': membership_id,
    });
    if (customer_email) params.append('metadata[customer_email]', customer_email);
    if (customer_name) params.append('metadata[customer_name]', customer_name);

    const piRes = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: stripeHeaders,
      body: params.toString(),
    });
    const piData = await piRes.json() as { client_secret?: string; error?: { message?: string } };

    if (!piRes.ok || !piData.client_secret) {
      const msg = piData.error?.message ?? `Stripe error ${piRes.status}`;
      console.error('[enroll/setup-intent] PaymentIntent error:', msg);
      return err(502, `Could not create payment: ${msg}`);
    }
    clientSecret = piData.client_secret;
  } else {
    // EFT: SetupIntent — vault card for recurring billing
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      usage: 'off_session',
      'payment_method_types[]': 'card',
      'metadata[membership_id]': membership_id,
    });
    if (customer_email) params.append('metadata[customer_email]', customer_email);
    if (customer_name) params.append('metadata[customer_name]', customer_name);

    const siRes = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/setup_intents', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: stripeHeaders,
      body: params.toString(),
    });
    const siData = await siRes.json() as { client_secret?: string; error?: { message?: string } };

    if (!siRes.ok || !siData.client_secret) {
      const msg = siData.error?.message ?? `Stripe error ${siRes.status}`;
      console.error('[enroll/setup-intent] SetupIntent error:', msg);
      return err(502, `Could not create payment setup: ${msg}`);
    }
    clientSecret = siData.client_secret;
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    client_secret: clientSecret,
    intent_type: intentType,
    connected_account_id: connectedAccountId,
  });
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/app/api/owner/families/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Owner portal — list families + kids in this tenant for the coach message
 * recipient picker. Uses the owner's session client so RLS (families_owner_select,
 * kids_owner_select) filters results to the owner's tenant automatically.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export type FamilyRecipient = {
  familyId: string;
  parentName: string;
  kids: { kidId: string; kidName: string }[];
};

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "owner" && role !== "super_admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "no_tenant" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { data: families, error: famErr } = await supabase
    .from("families")
    .select("id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .order("parent_last_name", { ascending: true });

  if (famErr) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: famErr.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const familyIds = (families ?? []).map((f) => f.id);
  const { data: kids, error: kidsErr } = familyIds.length
    ? await supabase
        .from("kids")
        .select("id, family_id, first_name, last_name")
        .in("family_id", familyIds)
        .order("first_name", { ascending: true })
    : { data: [], error: null };

  if (kidsErr) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: kidsErr.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const kidsByFamily: Record<string, { kidId: string; kidName: string }[]> = {};
  for (const k of kids ?? []) {
    if (!kidsByFamily[k.family_id]) kidsByFamily[k.family_id] = [];
    kidsByFamily[k.family_id].push({
      kidId: k.id,
      kidName: [k.first_name, k.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" "),
    });
  }

  const result: FamilyRecipient[] = (families ?? [])
    .map((f) => ({
      familyId: f.id,
      parentName: [f.parent_first_name, f.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" "),
      kids: kidsByFamily[f.id] ?? [],
    }))
    .filter((f) => f.kids.length > 0);

  return NextResponse.json(result, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}

/**
 * GET /api/owner/membership-plans
 *
 * Returns active membership plans for the current owner's tenant.
 * Used by the enrollment kiosk to populate the plan-selection step.
 */
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export type MembershipPlan = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  plan_type: 'eft' | 'otc';
  amount_cents: number;
  description: string | null;
  sort_order: number;
};

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin' && role !== 'super_admin') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant in session' }, { status: 401 });

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('membership_plans')
    .select('id, name, plan_type, amount_cents, description, sort_order')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('is_active', true)
    .order('sort_order', { ascending: true })
    .order('name', { ascending: true });

  if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });

  return NextResponse.json(data ?? [], { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { getTenantName } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';

type Body = {
  eftTotal: number;
  otcTotal: number;
  transactionCount: number;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
};

function fmt(n: number) {
  return `$${n.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
}

function fmtK(n: number) {
  if (n >= 1000) return `$${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}K`;
  return fmt(n);
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthenticated' }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'super_admin') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json() as Partial<Body>;
  const { eftTotal = 0, otcTotal = 0, transactionCount = 0, startDate = '', endDate = '' } = body;

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';
  const tenantName = await getTenantName(supabase, tenantId);
  const ownerEmail = session.user.email ?? '';

  if (!ownerEmail) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No email address on your account' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const resendKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
  const resendFrom = process.env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL ?? 'noreply@infinitehitting.com';

  if (!resendKey) {
    console.warn('[send-revenue-report] RESEND_API_KEY not configured — skipping email');
    return NextResponse.json({ skipped: true });
  }

  const totalRevenue = eftTotal + otcTotal;
  const eftPct = totalRevenue > 0 ? Math.round((eftTotal / totalRevenue) * 100) : 0;
  const otcPct = 100 - eftPct;

  const dateLabel = startDate && endDate ? `${startDate} – ${endDate}` : 'Last 12 Months';
  const subject = `Revenue Report — ${tenantName} — ${dateLabel}`;

  const html = `

/**
 * POST /api/settings/policy
 *
 * Saves cancellation-policy fields to tenant_config.
 * Uses the service-role client to bypass the RLS policy that gates on
 * the `app_role` JWT custom claim (Custom Access Token Hook not yet
 * configured in this environment). A valid session is still required.
 *
 * Request body:
 *   {
 *     booking_cancel_window_hours:    number,
 *     booking_cancel_fee_cents:       number,
 *     membership_cancel_notice_days:  number,
 *   }
 *
 * Returns:
 *   { ok: true }
 *   { error: string }
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const FALLBACK_TENANT_ID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? FALLBACK_TENANT_ID;

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})) as Record<string, unknown>;

  const windowHours = typeof body.booking_cancel_window_hours === 'number'
    ? body.booking_cancel_window_hours : null;
  const feeCents = typeof body.booking_cancel_fee_cents === 'number'
    ? body.booking_cancel_fee_cents : null;
  const noticeDays = typeof body.membership_cancel_notice_days === 'number'
    ? body.membership_cancel_notice_days : null;

  if (windowHours === null || feeCents === null || noticeDays === null) {
    return err(400, 'booking_cancel_window_hours, booking_cancel_fee_cents, and membership_cancel_notice_days are required numbers');
  }

  const service = createServiceClient();
  const { error } = await service
    .from('tenant_config')
    .update({
      booking_cancel_window_hours: windowHours,
      booking_cancel_fee_cents: feeCents,
      membership_cancel_notice_days: noticeDays,
    })
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId);

  if (error) {
    console.error('[settings/policy] update error:', error.message);
    return err(500, error.message);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

FILE: portal/app/api/stripe/connect/callback/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * GET /api/stripe/connect/callback
 *
 * Stripe Account Link return URL. Verifies the signed token, fetches the
 * connected account details, persists them to `locations`, and redirects
 * the owner back to the Payments settings page.
 *
 * Security: the token in the query string is
 *   base64url({location_id, account_id, tenant_id, exp}) + "." + HMAC-SHA256
 * created by /api/stripe/connect/start. We verify signature + expiry before
 * touching any database row, and double-check tenant ownership.
 */
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function getOrigin(req: NextRequest): string {
  if (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL) return process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL;
  if (process.env.REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN) return `https://${process.env.REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN}`;
  const proto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto') ?? 'https';
  const host = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host') ?? req.headers.get('host') ?? req.nextUrl.host;
  return `${proto}://${host}`;
}

function redirectWithError(origin: string, message: string) {
  const url = new URL('/owner/payments', origin);
  url.searchParams.set('error', encodeURIComponent(message));
  return NextResponse.redirect(url.toString());
}

function verifyAndParseToken(
  token: string,
  secret: string,
): { location_id: string; account_id: string; tenant_id: string; exp: number } | null {
  const dotIdx = token.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (dotIdx < 0) return null;

  const payload = token.slice(0, dotIdx);
  const receivedSig = token.slice(dotIdx + 1);
  const expectedSig = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');

  try {
    const a = Buffer.from(receivedSig, 'hex');
    const b = Buffer.from(expectedSig, 'hex');
    if (a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const json = Buffer.from(payload, 'base64url').toString('utf-8');
    return JSON.parse(json) as { location_id: string; account_id: string; tenant_id: string; exp: number };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const token = searchParams.get('token');
  const origin = getOrigin(req);

  if (!token) {
    return redirectWithError(origin, 'Missing token parameter');
  }

  const secretKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!secretKey) {
    return redirectWithError(origin, 'Stripe is not configured on this server');
  }

  const parsed = verifyAndParseToken(token, secretKey);
  if (!parsed) {
    return redirectWithError(origin, 'Invalid or tampered token');
  }
  if (Date.now() > parsed.exp) {
    return redirectWithError(origin, 'Session expired — please try connecting again');
  }

  const { location_id: locationId, account_id: stripeAccountId, tenant_id: tenantId } = parsed;

  const basicAuth = Buffer.from(`${secretKey}:`).toString('base64');

  // Fetch account details for display name and payout schedule
  let accountName: string | null = null;
  let payoutInterval: string | null = null;

  try {
    const accountRes = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/accounts/${stripeAccountId}`, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Basic ${basicAuth}`,
        'Stripe-Version': '2024-06-20',
      },
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    if (accountRes.ok) {
      const acctData = await accountRes.json() as {
        business_profile?: { name?: string };
        settings?: {
          dashboard?: { display_name?: string };
          payouts?: { schedule?: { interval?: string; monthly_anchor?: number; weekly_anchor?: string } };
        };
        email?: string;
      };

      accountName =
        acctData.business_profile?.name ??
        acctData.settings?.dashboard?.display_name ??
        acctData.email ??
        null;

      const schedule = acctData.settings?.payouts?.schedule;
      if (schedule?.interval) {
        if (schedule.interval === 'daily') payoutInterval = 'Daily';
        else if (schedule.interval === 'weekly') payoutInterval = `Weekly (${schedule.weekly_anchor ?? 'Friday'})`;
        else if (schedule.interval === 'monthly') payoutInterval = `Monthly (${schedule.monthly_anchor ?? 1}st)`;
        else payoutInterval = schedule.interval;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Best-effort — continue even if account fetch fails
  }

  // Persist to the database — verify tenant ownership before writing
  const supabase = createServiceClient();

  const { data: locationRow } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('id')
    .eq('id', locationId)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (!locationRow) {
    return redirectWithError(origin, 'Location not found or access denied');
  }

  const { error: dbErr } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .update({
      stripe_account_id: stripeAccountId,
      stripe_onboarding_status: 'pending',
      stripe_account_name: accountName,
      stripe_payout_interval: payoutInterval,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq('id', locationId);

  if (dbErr) {
    return redirectWithError(origin, `Database update failed: ${dbErr.message}`);
  }

  const successUrl = new URL('/owner/payments', origin);
  successUrl.searchParams.set('connected', '1');
  return NextResponse.redirect(successUrl.toString());
}

/**
 * POST /api/stripe/connect/disconnect
 *
 * Clears the Stripe connection for a location (for testing / re-onboarding).
 * Does NOT call Stripe's deauthorize endpoint — the operator must do that
 * manually in the Stripe Dashboard if they want to fully revoke access.
 */
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return err(403, 'Forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return err(401, 'No tenant in session');

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})) as { location_id?: string };
  const locationId = body.location_id as string | undefined;
  if (!locationId) return err(400, 'location_id is required');

  // Verify the location belongs to the owner's tenant using the user client
  const { data: location, error: locErr } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('id, tenant_id')
    .eq('id', locationId)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (locErr || !location) return err(404, 'Location not found');

      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });

FILE: portal/app/api/stripe/connect/refresh/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * GET /api/stripe/connect/refresh
 *
 * Stripe Account Link refresh URL — called when the onboarding link expires
 * before the user completes it. Generates a fresh Account Link and redirects
 * the user back to Stripe to continue where they left off.
 */
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function getOrigin(req: NextRequest): string {
  if (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL) return process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL;
  if (process.env.REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN) return `https://${process.env.REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN}`;
  const proto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto') ?? 'https';
  const host = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host') ?? req.headers.get('host') ?? req.nextUrl.host;
  return `${proto}://${host}`;
}

function verifyAndParseToken(
  token: string,
  secret: string,
): { location_id: string; account_id: string; tenant_id: string; exp: number } | null {
  const dotIdx = token.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (dotIdx < 0) return null;

  const payload = token.slice(0, dotIdx);
  const receivedSig = token.slice(dotIdx + 1);
  const expectedSig = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');

  try {
    const a = Buffer.from(receivedSig, 'hex');
    const b = Buffer.from(expectedSig, 'hex');
    if (a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const json = Buffer.from(payload, 'base64url').toString('utf-8');
    return JSON.parse(json) as { location_id: string; account_id: string; tenant_id: string; exp: number };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const token = searchParams.get('token');
  const origin = getOrigin(req);

  const fallback = new URL('/owner/payments', origin);
  fallback.searchParams.set('error', encodeURIComponent('Onboarding link expired — please try again'));

  if (!token) return NextResponse.redirect(fallback.toString());

  const secretKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!secretKey) return NextResponse.redirect(fallback.toString());

  const parsed = verifyAndParseToken(token, secretKey);
  if (!parsed) return NextResponse.redirect(fallback.toString());

  const { account_id: stripeAccountId, location_id: locationId, tenant_id: tenantId } = parsed;

  const basicAuth = Buffer.from(`${secretKey}:`).toString('base64');

  // Build a fresh signed token (resets the 30-min TTL)
  const STATE_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
  const newPayload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
    location_id: locationId,
    account_id: stripeAccountId,
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    exp: Date.now() + STATE_TTL_MS,
  })).toString('base64url');
  const newSig = createHmac('sha256', secretKey).update(newPayload).digest('hex');
  const newToken = `${newPayload}.${newSig}`;

  const returnUrl  = `${origin}/api/stripe/connect/callback?token=${encodeURIComponent(newToken)}`;
  const refreshUrl = `${origin}/api/stripe/connect/refresh?token=${encodeURIComponent(newToken)}`;

  try {
    const linkRes = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/account_links', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Basic ${basicAuth}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        'Stripe-Version': '2024-06-20',
      },
      body: new URLSearchParams({
        account: stripeAccountId,
        refresh_url: refreshUrl,
        return_url: returnUrl,
        type: 'account_onboarding',
      }).toString(),
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const linkData = await linkRes.json() as { url?: string };
    if (linkRes.ok && linkData.url) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(linkData.url);
    }
  } catch {
    // fall through to fallback
  }

  return NextResponse.redirect(fallback.toString());
}

FILE: portal/app/api/stripe/connect/start/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * POST /api/stripe/connect/start
 *
 * Creates (or reuses) a Stripe Express connected account for a location,
 * then generates an Account Link URL for hosted onboarding.
 *
 * Uses the Account Links flow (not the legacy OAuth flow) so no
 * STRIPE_CONNECT_CLIENT_ID is required.
 *
 * Security: the return_url carries a signed token
 *   base64url({location_id, account_id, tenant_id, exp}) + "." + HMAC-SHA256
 * so the callback can verify which tenant/location initiated the flow
 * without trusting raw query params.
 */
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createHmac } from 'crypto';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const STATE_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes

function getOrigin(req: NextRequest): string {
  if (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL) return process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL;
  if (process.env.REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN) return `https://${process.env.REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN}`;
  const proto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto') ?? 'https';
  const host = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host') ?? req.headers.get('host') ?? req.nextUrl.host;
  return `${proto}://${host}`;
}

function b64url(s: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(s).toString('base64url');
}

function signToken(payload: string, secret: string): string {
  return createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');
}

function clientErr(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: { message } }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return clientErr(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return clientErr(403, 'Forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return clientErr(401, 'No tenant in session');

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})) as { location_id?: string };
  const locationId = body.location_id as string | undefined;
  if (!locationId) return clientErr(400, 'location_id is required');

  const secretKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!secretKey) return clientErr(500, 'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not configured');

  const origin = getOrigin(req);

  // Verify the location belongs to the authenticated user's tenant
  const svc = createServiceClient();
  const { data: location } = await svc
    .from('locations')
    .select('id, stripe_account_id')
    .eq('id', locationId)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (!location) return clientErr(404, 'Location not found or access denied');

  const basicAuth = Buffer.from(`${secretKey}:`).toString('base64');
  const stripeHeaders = {
    Authorization: `Basic ${basicAuth}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    'Stripe-Version': '2024-06-20',
  };

  // Reuse existing account or create a new Express account
  let stripeAccountId = location.stripe_account_id as string | null;

  if (!stripeAccountId) {
    const createRes = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/accounts', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: stripeHeaders,
      body: new URLSearchParams({ type: 'express' }).toString(),
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const createData = await createRes.json() as { id?: string; error?: { message?: string } };
    if (!createRes.ok || !createData.id) {
      const msg = createData.error?.message ?? 'Failed to create Stripe account';
      return clientErr(502, msg);
    }

    stripeAccountId = createData.id;

    // Persist the new account ID immediately so refresh flows reuse it
    await svc
      .from('locations')
      .update({
        stripe_account_id: stripeAccountId,
        stripe_onboarding_status: 'pending',
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('id', locationId);
  }

  // Build a signed return token for the callback
  const payload = b64url(JSON.stringify({
    location_id: locationId,
    account_id: stripeAccountId,
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    exp: Date.now() + STATE_TTL_MS,
  }));
  const sig = signToken(payload, secretKey);
  const token = `${payload}.${sig}`;

  const returnUrl  = `${origin}/api/stripe/connect/callback?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
  const refreshUrl = `${origin}/api/stripe/connect/refresh?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;

  // Create the Account Link for hosted onboarding
  const linkRes = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/account_links', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: stripeHeaders,
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      account: stripeAccountId,
      refresh_url: refreshUrl,
      return_url: returnUrl,
      type: 'account_onboarding',
    }).toString(),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  const linkData = await linkRes.json() as { url?: string; error?: { message?: string } };
  if (!linkRes.ok || !linkData.url) {
    const msg = linkData.error?.message ?? 'Failed to create onboarding link';
    return clientErr(502, msg);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ url: linkData.url });
}

FILE: portal/app/api/stripe/connect/sync-status/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * POST /api/stripe/connect/sync-status
 *
 * Force-refreshes a location's Stripe onboarding status by fetching the live
 * account state directly from Stripe. Useful when a webhook was missed or in
 * sandbox/test mode where webhooks may not fire reliably.
 *
 * Security: owner/admin only; verifies location belongs to the caller's tenant.
 */
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function err(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

function deriveOnboardingStatus(account: {
  charges_enabled?: boolean;
  payouts_enabled?: boolean;
  requirements?: { disabled_reason?: string | null };
}): 'pending' | 'connected' | 'restricted' {
  if (account.charges_enabled && account.payouts_enabled) return 'connected';
  if (account.requirements?.disabled_reason) return 'restricted';
  return 'pending';
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return err(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return err(403, 'Forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return err(401, 'No tenant in session');

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})) as { location_id?: string };
  const locationId = body.location_id as string | undefined;
  if (!locationId) return err(400, 'location_id is required');

  const secretKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!secretKey) return err(500, 'Stripe is not configured on this server');

  // Verify the location belongs to the authenticated user's tenant
  const svc = createServiceClient();
  const { data: location, error: locErr } = await svc
    .from('locations')
    .select('id, stripe_account_id')
    .eq('id', locationId)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .single();

  if (locErr || !location) return err(404, 'Location not found or access denied');

  const stripeAccountId = location.stripe_account_id as string | null;
  if (!stripeAccountId) return err(400, 'This location has no Stripe account connected');

  // Fetch live account state from Stripe
  const basicAuth = Buffer.from(`${secretKey}:`).toString('base64');
  const accountRes = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/accounts/${stripeAccountId}`, {
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Basic ${basicAuth}`,
      'Stripe-Version': '2024-06-20',
    },
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (!accountRes.ok) {
    const errData = await accountRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
      error?: { message?: string; code?: string; type?: string };
    };
    const stripeCode = errData.error?.code ?? '';
    const stripeType = errData.error?.type ?? '';

    // Map well-known Stripe failures to owner-friendly messages
    if (
      accountRes.status === 404 ||
      stripeCode === 'resource_missing' ||
      stripeCode === 'account_invalid'
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: 'This Stripe account no longer exists or has been deauthorized. Disconnect this location and reconnect to link a new Stripe account.',
          error_type: 'account_not_found',
        },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }

    if (
      accountRes.status === 401 ||
      stripeType === 'authentication_error' ||
      stripeCode === 'api_key_invalid' ||
      stripeCode === 'api_key_expired'
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: 'Stripe rejected the API key configured for this server. Please contact support to reconfigure Stripe for your account.',
          error_type: 'auth_error',
        },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }

    // Generic fallback — still friendlier than a raw Stripe message
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: 'Unable to reach Stripe right now. Please try again in a moment. If the problem persists, contact support.',
        error_type: 'stripe_error',
      },
      { status: 502 },
    );
  }

  const acctData = await accountRes.json() as {
    charges_enabled?: boolean;
    payouts_enabled?: boolean;
    business_profile?: { name?: string };
    settings?: {
      dashboard?: { display_name?: string };
      payouts?: { schedule?: { interval?: string; monthly_anchor?: number; weekly_anchor?: string } };
    };
    email?: string;
    requirements?: { disabled_reason?: string | null };
  };

  const newStatus = deriveOnboardingStatus(acctData);

  const accountName =
    acctData.business_profile?.name ??
    acctData.settings?.dashboard?.display_name ??
    acctData.email ??
    null;

  let payoutInterval: string | null = null;
  const schedule = acctData.settings?.payouts?.schedule;
  if (schedule?.interval) {
    if (schedule.interval === 'daily') payoutInterval = 'Daily';
    else if (schedule.interval === 'weekly') payoutInterval = `Weekly (${schedule.weekly_anchor ?? 'Friday'})`;
    else if (schedule.interval === 'monthly') payoutInterval = `Monthly (${schedule.monthly_anchor ?? 1}st)`;
    else payoutInterval = schedule.interval;
  }

  const updates: Record<string, string | null> = {
    stripe_onboarding_status: newStatus,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  if (accountName) updates.stripe_account_name = accountName;
  if (payoutInterval) updates.stripe_payout_interval = payoutInterval;

  const { error: dbErr } = await svc
    .from('locations')
    .update(updates)
    .eq('id', locationId);

  if (dbErr) return err(500, `Database update failed: ${dbErr.message}`);

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, status: newStatus });
}

FILE: portal/app/api/stripe/mrr/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * GET /api/stripe/mrr
 *
 * Owner/admin-only route that returns live MRR data from Stripe Subscriptions
 * on the tenant's connected account(s). Falls back gracefully to 0 if Stripe
 * is not configured.
 *
 * Fetching logic is shared with portal/app/owner/billing/page.tsx via
 * portal/lib/stripe/mrrUtils.ts — single source of truth.
 *
 * Returns:
 *   { mrr_cents: number, active_subscription_count: number, source: string }
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { fetchLocationMrr } from '@/lib/stripe/mrrUtils';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function clientErr(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  void req;

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return clientErr(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return clientErr(403, 'Forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) return clientErr(401, 'No tenant in session');

  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!stripeKey) {
    return NextResponse.json({ mrr_cents: 0, active_subscription_count: 0, source: 'no_stripe_key' });
  }

  // Load the tenant's connected locations
  const { data: locations } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('stripe_onboarding_status', 'connected');

  if (!locations || locations.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ mrr_cents: 0, active_subscription_count: 0, source: 'no_connected_account' });
  }

  let totalMrrCents = 0;
  let totalActiveCount = 0;

  // Fetch MRR in parallel across all connected locations using shared utility.
  // Partial failures are tolerated — we sum up the accounts that succeed.
  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    locations
      .filter(l => l.stripe_account_id)
      .map(l => fetchLocationMrr(stripeKey, l.stripe_account_id as string)),
  );

  for (const r of results) {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
      totalMrrCents += r.value.mrrCents;
      totalActiveCount += r.value.activeCount;
    } else {
      console.error('[stripe/mrr] Failed to fetch from one connected account:', r.reason);
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    mrr_cents: totalMrrCents,
    active_subscription_count: totalActiveCount,
    source: 'stripe_live',
  });
}

FILE: portal/app/api/stripe/subscription/cancel/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * POST /api/stripe/subscription/cancel
 *
 * Thin portal proxy to the stripe-cancel-subscription Edge Function.
 * Auth + tenant isolation are enforced inside the Edge Function via JWT.
 * All Stripe logic (cancel_at_period_end, resource_missing cleanup, DB update)
 * lives exclusively in the Edge Function — a single cancellation implementation.
 *
 * Request body:
 *   { membership_id: string }
 *
 * Returns:
 *   { ok: true, cancel_at_period_end: boolean, cancel_at?: string }
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function clientErr(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return clientErr(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return clientErr(403, 'Forbidden');

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!supabaseUrl) return clientErr(500, 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL not configured');

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})) as { membership_id?: string };
  if (!body.membership_id) return clientErr(400, 'membership_id is required');

  // Proxy to the stripe-cancel-subscription Edge Function.
  // The Edge Function enforces role + tenant isolation from the caller's JWT,
  // handles the no-subscription case (immediate DB cancel), calls Stripe with
  // the correct connected-account header, and cleans up on resource_missing.
  try {
    const fnRes = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/stripe-cancel-subscription`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ membership_id: body.membership_id }),
    });

    const data = await fnRes.json() as {
      ok?: boolean;
      cancel_at_period_end?: boolean;
      cancel_at?: string;
      cancelled_immediately?: boolean;
      error?: { message?: string; code?: string };
    };

    if (!fnRes.ok || !data.ok) {
      const msg = typeof data.error === 'object'
        ? data.error?.message ?? `Error ${fnRes.status}`
        : String(data.error ?? `Error ${fnRes.status}`);
      return clientErr(fnRes.status >= 400 && fnRes.status < 500 ? fnRes.status : 500, msg);
    }

    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
    console.error('[stripe/subscription/cancel] proxy error:', msg);
    return clientErr(500, msg);
  }
}

FILE: portal/app/api/stripe/subscription/create/route.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * POST /api/stripe/subscription/create
 *
 * Admin/owner-only route that activates a Stripe Subscription for an EFT
 * membership. Proxies to the stripe-create-subscription edge function using
 * the caller's session token so tenant isolation is enforced end-to-end.
 *
 * Request body:
 *   { membership_id: string }
 *
 * Returns (from edge function):
 *   { subscription_id, status, current_period_end, next_billing_at }
 */

import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

function clientErr(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session) return clientErr(401, 'Unauthorized');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') return clientErr(403, 'Forbidden');

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({})) as { membership_id?: string };
  const { membership_id } = body;
  if (!membership_id) return clientErr(400, 'membership_id is required');

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL ?? process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!supabaseUrl) return clientErr(500, 'Supabase URL not configured');

  // Forward the caller's session token so the edge function can enforce
  // role + tenant isolation from the JWT (same pattern as cancel route).
  const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/stripe-create-subscription`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ membership_id }),
  });

  const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (!res.ok) {
    const msg = (data.error as { message?: string } | null)?.message
      ?? data.error
      ?? `Edge function error ${res.status}`;
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: res.status });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data);
}

FILE: portal/app/book/[tenantSlug]/BookingClient.tsx
