"use client";

import { useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { SupabaseClient, Session } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Types
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface SessionTypeRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type_category: string;
  duration_minutes: number;
  base_price_cents: number;
  description: string | null;
}

interface AvailabilitySlot {
  coach_id: string;
  coach_first_name: string;
  coach_last_name: string;
  location_id: string;
  location_name: string;
  slot_date: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  is_available: boolean;
}

interface KidRow {
  id: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
}

type AuthMode = "signin" | "signup";
type FlowState = "browse" | "auth" | "confirm" | "success";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// sessionStorage keys for slot persistence across auth handoff
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const SS_SLOT = "ballpark.booking.pendingSlot";
const SS_TYPE = "ballpark.booking.selectedType";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function fmt12(t: string): string {
  const [h, m] = t.split(":").map(Number);
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  const hour = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
  return `${hour}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")} ${ampm}`;
}

function formatLongDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00");
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "long",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
  });
}

function formatDateShort(iso: string): { weekday: string; day: string } {
  const d = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00");
  return {
    weekday: d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "short" }),
    day: String(d.getDate()),
  };
}

function toDateStr(d: Date): string {
  return d.toISOString().split("T")[0];
}

function addDays(base: Date, n: number): Date {
  const d = new Date(base);
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + n);
  return d;
}

function categoryLabel(cat: string): string {
  if (cat === "private") return "Private";
  if (cat === "group") return "Group";
  if (cat === "cage") return "Cage Rental";
  return cat;
}

function priceFmt(cents: number): string {
  if (cents <= 0) return "";
  return ` · $${(cents / 100).toFixed(0)}`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Props
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface BookingClientProps {
  tenantSlug: string;
  tenantName: string;
  brandLogoUrl: string | null;
  brandColors: Record<string, string>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main component
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function BookingClient({
  tenantSlug,
  tenantName,
  brandLogoUrl,
  brandColors,
}: BookingClientProps) {
  const supabase: SupabaseClient = createClient();

  // ── Brand color CSS vars ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const brandStyle = {
    "--bp-primary":      brandColors.gold      ?? "#F1E5AD",
    "--bp-primary-deep": brandColors.goldDeep  ?? "#B8A268",
    "--bp-bg":           brandColors.dark       ?? "#2D2B2A",
    "--bp-bg-raised":    brandColors.darker     ?? "#1C1B1A",
    "--bp-cream":        brandColors.cream      ?? "#FAF6E8",
  } as React.CSSProperties;

  // ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [sessionTypes, setSessionTypes] = useState<SessionTypeRow[]>([]);
  const [availability, setAvailability] = useState<AvailabilitySlot[]>([]);
  const [loadingSlots, setLoadingSlots] = useState(false);

  // ── Browse — session type is REQUIRED before seeing slots ─────────────────
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<SessionTypeRow | null>(null);
  const [selectedCoach, setSelectedCoach] = useState("all");

  // ── Browse — date strip ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const today = useRef(new Date());
  const [dateOffset, setDateOffset] = useState(0);
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(toDateStr(today.current));

  // ── Flow ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [flowState, setFlowState] = useState<FlowState>("browse");
  const [pendingSlot, setPendingSlot] = useState<AvailabilitySlot | null>(null);

  // ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [authMode, setAuthMode] = useState<AuthMode>("signin");
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [authLoading, setAuthLoading] = useState(false);
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);

  // ── Sign-in fields ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [siEmail, setSiEmail] = useState("");
  const [siPassword, setSiPassword] = useState("");

  // ── Sign-up fields ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [suFirst, setSuFirst] = useState("");
  const [suLast, setSuLast] = useState("");
  const [suEmail, setSuEmail] = useState("");
  const [suPassword, setSuPassword] = useState("");
  const [suKidFirst, setSuKidFirst] = useState("");
  const [suKidLast, setSuKidLast] = useState("");

  // ── Confirm ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [kids, setKids] = useState<KidRow[]>([]);
  const [selectedKidId, setSelectedKidId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmLoading, setConfirmLoading] = useState(false);
  const [confirmError, setConfirmError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmedId, setConfirmedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ── Date window ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const windowDates = Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) =>
    toDateStr(addDays(today.current, dateOffset + i))
  );
  const windowStart = windowDates[0];
  const windowEnd = windowDates[windowDates.length - 1];

  // ── Session listener + sessionStorage slot restore ────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data }) => {
      setSession(data.session);
      // Restore pending slot/type after email-confirmation redirect
      if (data.session) {
        const rawSlot = sessionStorage.getItem(SS_SLOT);
        const rawType = sessionStorage.getItem(SS_TYPE);
        if (rawSlot && rawType) {
          try {
            const slot = JSON.parse(rawSlot) as AvailabilitySlot;
            const type = JSON.parse(rawType) as SessionTypeRow;
            setPendingSlot(slot);
            setSelectedType(type);
            setFlowState("confirm");
          } catch { /* corrupt storage — ignore */ }
        }
      }
    });
    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(
      (_ev, s) => setSession(s)
    );
    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, [supabase]);

  // ── Session types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    supabase
      .rpc("get_public_session_types", { p_tenant_slug: tenantSlug })
      .then(({ data }) => setSessionTypes((data as SessionTypeRow[]) ?? []));
  }, [supabase, tenantSlug]);

  // ── Availability — only load once a session type is selected ──────────────
  const loadAvailability = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!selectedType) {
      setAvailability([]);
      return;
    }
    setLoadingSlots(true);
    const { data } = await supabase.rpc("get_public_availability", {
      p_tenant_slug:      tenantSlug,
      p_date_range_start: windowStart,
      p_date_range_end:   windowEnd,
      p_duration_minutes: selectedType.duration_minutes,
    });
    setAvailability((data as AvailabilitySlot[]) ?? []);
    setLoadingSlots(false);
  }, [supabase, tenantSlug, windowStart, windowEnd, selectedType]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAvailability();
  }, [loadAvailability]);

  // ── Load kids when session present ────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadKids = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!session) return;
    const db = supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient;
    const { data } = await db
      .from("kids")
      .select("id, first_name, last_name")
      .order("first_name");
    const list = (data ?? []) as KidRow[];
    setKids(list);
    if (list.length > 0 && !selectedKidId) {
      setSelectedKidId(list[0].id);
    }
  }, [session, supabase, selectedKidId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadKids();
  }, [loadKids]);

  // ── Derived ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const uniqueCoaches = Array.from(
    new Map(
      availability.map((s) => [
        s.coach_id,
        `${s.coach_first_name} ${s.coach_last_name}`,
      ])
    ).entries()
  );

  // Slots for the selected date, filtered by coach, with is_available = true
  const filteredSlots = availability.filter(
    (s) =>
      s.is_available &&
      s.slot_date === selectedDate &&
      (selectedCoach === "all" || s.coach_id === selectedCoach)
  );

  const availableDates = new Set(
    availability.filter((s) => s.is_available).map((s) => s.slot_date)
  );

  // ── Handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function handleSelectType(st: SessionTypeRow) {
    setSelectedType(st);
    sessionStorage.setItem(SS_TYPE, JSON.stringify(st));
    setSelectedCoach("all");
  }

  function handleSelectSlot(slot: AvailabilitySlot) {
    setPendingSlot(slot);
    sessionStorage.setItem(SS_SLOT, JSON.stringify(slot));
    setFlowState(session ? "confirm" : "auth");
  }

  async function handleSignIn(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setAuthLoading(true);
    setAuthError(null);
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: siEmail,
      password: siPassword,
    });
    setAuthLoading(false);
    if (error) {
      setAuthError(error.message);
      return;
    }
    setFlowState("confirm");
  }

  async function handleSignUp(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setAuthLoading(true);
    setAuthError(null);

    const { data: signUpData, error: signUpError } =
      await supabase.auth.signUp({
        email: suEmail,
        password: suPassword,
        options: {
          data: {
            first_name: suFirst,
            last_name: suLast,
            tenant_slug: tenantSlug,
          },
        },
      });

    if (signUpError) {
      setAuthError(signUpError.message);
      setAuthLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (!signUpData.session) {
      setAuthError(
        "Account created! Please check your email to confirm, then sign in here."
      );
      setAuthMode("signin");
      setSiEmail(suEmail);
      setAuthLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    // Family + kid created by handle_new_user trigger — add the kid row
    const db = supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient;
    const { data: familyData } = await db
      .from("families")
      .select("id")
      .maybeSingle();
    const familyId = (familyData as { id: string } | null)?.id ?? null;

    if (familyId) {
      await db.from("kids").insert({
        family_id: familyId,
        first_name: suKidFirst,
        last_name: suKidLast,
      });
    }

    await loadKids();
    setAuthLoading(false);
    setFlowState("confirm");
  }

  async function handleConfirmBooking() {
    if (!pendingSlot || !selectedType || !session) return;
    setConfirmLoading(true);
    setConfirmError(null);

    let kidId = selectedKidId;
    if (!kidId && kids.length > 0) kidId = kids[0].id;
    if (!kidId) {
      setConfirmError("No athlete found on your account.");
      setConfirmLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const scheduledStart = new Date(
      `${pendingSlot.slot_date}T${pendingSlot.start_time}`
    ).toISOString();

    const db = supabase as unknown as import("@supabase/supabase-js").SupabaseClient;
    const { data, error } = await db.rpc("create_public_booking", {
      p_tenant_slug:     tenantSlug,
      p_coach_id:        pendingSlot.coach_id,
      p_location_id:     pendingSlot.location_id,
      p_session_type_id: selectedType.id,
      p_kid_id:          kidId,
      p_scheduled_start: scheduledStart,
    });

    if (error) {
      const msg =
        error.message === "slot_not_available"
          ? "This slot was just taken — please choose another time."
          : error.message === "family_not_found"
          ? "Account setup incomplete. Please contact the facility."
          : error.message;
      setConfirmError(msg);
      setConfirmLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const bookingId = (
      (data as Array<{ booking_id: string }> | null)?.[0]?.booking_id ?? ""
    );
    setConfirmedId(bookingId);
    setFlowState("success");
    setConfirmLoading(false);

    // Clear persisted selection
    sessionStorage.removeItem(SS_SLOT);
    sessionStorage.removeItem(SS_TYPE);

    // Confirmation email — best-effort, fire-and-forget
    if (bookingId) {
      const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
      if (supabaseUrl) {
        fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/booking-confirmation`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ booking_id: bookingId }),
        }).catch((err) => {
          console.warn("booking-confirmation: fire-and-forget failed", err);
        });
      }
    }

    loadAvailability();
  }

  function handleClose() {
    setFlowState("browse");
    setPendingSlot(null);
    setAuthError(null);
    setConfirmError(null);
    sessionStorage.removeItem(SS_SLOT);
  }

  // ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-darkest text-cream-light" style={brandStyle}>
      {/* ─── Header ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <header
        className="border-b border-border-gold px-4 py-4"
        style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--bp-bg)" }}
      >
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-2xl items-center gap-3">
          {brandLogoUrl ? (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
            <img
              src={brandLogoUrl}
              alt={tenantName}
              className="h-8 w-auto object-contain"
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span
                className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(241,229,173,0.7)]"
                style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--bp-primary)" }}
              />
              <span className="font-display text-xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-cream-light">
                {tenantName}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
          <span className="ml-auto text-sm text-text-light">Book a Session</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="mx-auto max-w-2xl px-4 py-6 pb-32">

        {/* ─── Step 1: Session Type (REQUIRED) ────────────────────────── */}
        <section className="mb-6">
          <p className="mb-3 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
            1. Choose Session Type
          </p>
          {sessionTypes.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className="h-16 animate-pulse rounded-2xl border border-border-gold bg-darker"
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {sessionTypes.map((st) => {
                const isActive = selectedType?.id === st.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={st.id}
                    onClick={() => handleSelectType(st)}
                    style={
                      isActive
                        ? {
                            borderColor: "var(--bp-primary)",
                            backgroundColor: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--bp-primary) 12%, transparent)",
                          }
                        : undefined
                    }
                    className={[
                      "group flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3 text-left transition-all",
                      isActive
                        ? "shadow-sm"
                        : "border-border-gold bg-darker hover:border-gold/50",
                    ].join(" ")}
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p
                        className={
                          isActive
                            ? "text-sm font-semibold"
                            : "text-sm font-semibold text-cream-light"
                        }
                        style={isActive ? { color: "var(--bp-primary)" } : undefined}
                      >
                        {st.name}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-text-light">
                        {st.duration_minutes} min · {categoryLabel(st.type_category)}
                        {priceFmt(st.base_price_cents)}
                      </p>
                      {st.description && (
                        <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                          {st.description}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {isActive && (
                      <span
                        className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-base font-bold"
                        style={{ color: "var(--bp-primary)" }}
                      >
                        ✓
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* ─── Step 2: Date + Slots (only after type selected) ────────── */}
        {!selectedType ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border-gold/40 bg-darker px-6 py-10 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
              Select a session type above to browse available times.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Coach filter */}
            {uniqueCoaches.length > 1 && (
              <section className="mb-5">
                <p className="mb-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
                  Coach
                </p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {[
                    { id: "all", name: "Any Coach" },
                    ...uniqueCoaches.map(([id, name]) => ({ id, name })),
                  ].map((c) => (
                    <button
                      key={c.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedCoach(c.id)}
                      style={
                        c.id === selectedCoach
                          ? {
                              borderColor: "var(--bp-primary)",
                              backgroundColor: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--bp-primary) 15%, transparent)",
                              color: "var(--bp-primary)",
                            }
                          : undefined
                      }
                      className={
                        c.id === selectedCoach
                          ? "rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1 text-sm font-medium"
                          : PILL
                      }
                    >
                      {c.name}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>
            )}

            {/* Date strip */}
            <section className="mb-6">
              <p className="mb-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
                2. Pick a Date
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setDateOffset(Math.max(0, dateOffset - 7))}
                  disabled={dateOffset === 0}
                  aria-label="Previous week"
                  className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border-gold text-text-light transition-colors hover:border-gold/50 hover:text-cream-light disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  ‹
                </button>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-x-auto">
                  <div className="flex gap-1.5 pb-0.5">
                    {windowDates.map((d) => {
                      const { weekday, day } = formatDateShort(d);
                      const hasSlots = availableDates.has(d);
                      const isSelected = selectedDate === d;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={d}
                          onClick={() => setSelectedDate(d)}
                          style={
                            isSelected
                              ? {
                                  borderColor: "var(--bp-primary)",
                                  backgroundColor: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--bp-primary) 12%, transparent)",
                                  color: "var(--bp-primary)",
                                }
                              : undefined
                          }
                          className={[
                            "flex min-w-[52px] flex-col items-center rounded-xl border py-2 transition-colors",
                            isSelected
                              ? ""
                              : hasSlots
                              ? "border-border-gold text-cream-light hover:border-gold/50"
                              : "border-border-gold/40 text-text-muted",
                          ].join(" ")}
                        >
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide">
                            {weekday}
                          </span>
                          <span className="mt-0.5 text-base font-semibold">{day}</span>
                          {hasSlots && (
                            <span
                              className="mt-1 h-1 w-1 rounded-full"
                              style={{
                                backgroundColor: isSelected
                                  ? "var(--bp-primary)"
                                  : "color-mix(in srgb, var(--bp-primary) 50%, transparent)",
                              }}
                            />
                          )}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setDateOffset(dateOffset + 7)}
                  aria-label="Next week"
                  className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border-gold text-text-light transition-colors hover:border-gold/50 hover:text-cream-light"
                >
                  ›
                </button>
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Slot grid */}
            <section>
              <h2 className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold text-cream-light">
                <span className="mr-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
                  3. Pick a Time ·
                </span>
                {formatLongDate(selectedDate)}
              </h2>

              {loadingSlots ? (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      className="h-16 animate-pulse rounded-2xl border border-border-gold bg-darker"
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : filteredSlots.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border-gold bg-darker px-6 py-8 text-center">
                  <p className="text-text-light">No available times on this day.</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                    Try another date or coach.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {filteredSlots.map((slot, i) => (
                    <button
                      key={`${slot.coach_id}-${slot.start_time}-${i}`}
                      onClick={() => handleSelectSlot(slot)}
                      className="group flex w-full items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-border-gold bg-darker px-4 py-3 text-left transition-all hover:border-gold/50 hover:bg-dark"
                    >
                      <div
                        className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-lg"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--bp-primary) 12%, transparent)",
                          color: "var(--bp-primary)",
                        }}
                      >
                        ⚾
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-cream-light">
                          {fmt12(slot.start_time)} – {fmt12(slot.end_time)}
                        </p>
                        <p className="truncate text-xs text-text-light">
                          {slot.coach_first_name} {slot.coach_last_name} ·{" "}
                          {slot.location_name}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <span
                        className="shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-90"
                        style={{
                          borderWidth: "1px",
                          borderStyle: "solid",
                          borderColor: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--bp-primary) 40%, transparent)",
                          backgroundColor: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--bp-primary) 8%, transparent)",
                          color: "var(--bp-primary)",
                        }}
                      >
                        Book
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </>
        )}
      </main>

      {/* ─── Bottom sheet overlay ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {flowState !== "browse" && (
        <>
          {/* Scrim */}
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-darkest/70 backdrop-blur-sm"
            onClick={handleClose}
          />

              <span className="font-display text-lg font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
                {flowState === "auth" && "Sign In to Book"}

              </span>
              <button
                onClick={handleClose}

            <div className="px-5 py-5">
              {/* Slot + type summary bar */}
              {pendingSlot && selectedType && flowState !== "success" && (

                  </p>

              {flowState === "auth" && (

                        <FieldGroup label="Your First Name">

                          type="email"

                          className={FIELD}

                        />

                        <input

// Shared style constants

const FIELD =
  "block w-full rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/80 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-cream-light placeholder:text-text-light/60 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/40";

const PILL =
  "rounded-full border border-border-gold px-3.5 py-1 text-sm font-medium text-text-light transition-colors hover:border-gold/50 hover:text-cream-light";

function FieldGroup({
  label,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
        {label}
      </label>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

function GoldButton({
  children,
  fullWidth,
  disabled,
  onClick,
  type = "button",
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: () => void;
  type?: "button" | "submit";
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--bp-primary)", color: "var(--bp-bg-raised)" }}
      className={[
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold transition-opacity focus:outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 hover:opacity-90",
        fullWidth ? "w-full" : "",
      ].join(" ")}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { BookingClient } from "./BookingClient";

interface TenantInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  brand_colors: Record<string, string> | null;
  brand_logo_url: string | null;
}

async function fetchTenantInfo(tenantSlug: string): Promise<TenantInfo | null> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  // get_public_tenant_info is SECURITY DEFINER — accessible to the anon role
  // without a JWT, so this page works for unauthenticated visitors.
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("get_public_tenant_info", {
    p_tenant_slug: tenantSlug,
  });
  if (error || !data || (data as TenantInfo[]).length === 0) return null;
  return (data as TenantInfo[])[0];
}

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ tenantSlug: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { tenantSlug } = await params;
  const tenant = await fetchTenantInfo(tenantSlug);
  const name = tenant?.name ?? tenantSlug;
  return {
    title: `Book a Session — ${name}`,
    description: `Browse available sessions and book online at ${name}.`,
  };
}

export default async function PublicBookingPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ tenantSlug: string }>;
}) {
  const { tenantSlug } = await params;
  const tenant = await fetchTenantInfo(tenantSlug);

  if (!tenant) notFound();

  return (
    <BookingClient
      tenantSlug={tenantSlug}
      tenantName={tenant.name}
      brandLogoUrl={tenant.brand_logo_url ?? null}
      brandColors={tenant.brand_colors ?? {}}
    />
  );
}

}

"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole } from "@/lib/auth";

const UUID_RE =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

function backToEdit(id: string, error: string): never {
  redirect(
    `/coach/assignments/${id}/edit?error=${encodeURIComponent(error)}`,
  );
}

function backToDetail(id: string, error: string): never {
  redirect(
    `/coach/assignments/${id}?error=${encodeURIComponent(error)}`,
  );
}

export async function updateAssignment(formData: FormData) {
  const id = String(formData.get("assignment_id") ?? "").trim();
  if (!id || !UUID_RE.test(id)) {
    redirect("/coach/assignments");
  }

  const title = String(formData.get("title") ?? "").trim();
  const description = String(formData.get("description") ?? "").trim();
  const drillVideoIdRaw = String(formData.get("drill_video_id") ?? "").trim();
  const dueDateRaw = String(formData.get("due_date") ?? "").trim();

  if (!title) backToEdit(id, "Drill title is required.");
  if (title.length > 120) backToEdit(id, "Drill title is too long (max 120).");
  if (!description) backToEdit(id, "Drill description is required.");
  if (drillVideoIdRaw && !UUID_RE.test(drillVideoIdRaw)) {
    backToEdit(id, "Drill video id must be a UUID.");
  }
  if (dueDateRaw && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dueDateRaw)) {
    backToEdit(id, "Due date must be a calendar date.");
  }

  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) backToEdit(id, "Your session expired. Sign in again.");
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "coach") {
    backToEdit(id, "Only coaches can edit assignments.");
  }

  const { error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc(
    "update_assignment_for_coach",
    {
      p_assignment_id: id,
      p_title: title,
      p_description: description,
      p_due_date: dueDateRaw || null,
      p_drill_video_id: drillVideoIdRaw || null,
    },
  );

  if (rpcErr) {
    backToEdit(id, `Could not save: ${rpcErr.message}`);
  }

  revalidatePath("/coach/assignments");
  revalidatePath(`/coach/assignments/${id}`);
  redirect(`/coach/assignments/${id}`);
}

export async function cancelAssignment(formData: FormData) {
  const id = String(formData.get("assignment_id") ?? "").trim();
  if (!id || !UUID_RE.test(id)) {
    redirect("/coach/assignments");
  }

  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) backToDetail(id, "Your session expired. Sign in again.");
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "coach") {
    backToDetail(id, "Only coaches can cancel assignments.");
  }

  const { error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc(
    "cancel_assignment_for_coach",
    { p_assignment_id: id },
  );

  if (rpcErr) {
    backToDetail(id, `Could not cancel: ${rpcErr.message}`);
  }

  revalidatePath("/coach/assignments");
  redirect("/coach/assignments");
}

      </div>

      <DrillVideoField
        recent={mergedRecent}
        onBusyChange={setUploadBusy}
        initialPickedId={initial.drill_video_id ?? ""}
      />

      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label
          htmlFor="due_date"
          className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-900"
        >
          Due date{" "}
          <span className="font-normal text-slate-500">(optional)</span>
        </label>
        <input
          id="due_date"
          name="due_date"
          type="date"
          defaultValue={initial.due_date ?? ""}
          className="block w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm shadow-sm focus:border-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-500"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 pt-4">
        {uploadBusy ? (
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Waiting for video upload to finish…
          </span>
        ) : null}
        <Link
          href={`/coach/assignments/${initial.id}`}
          className="text-sm text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900"
        >
          Discard changes
        </Link>
        <SubmitButton disabled={uploadBusy} />
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { EditAssignmentForm } from "./EditAssignmentForm";

type DrillVideo =
  | { id: string; title: string | null }
  | { id: string; title: string | null }[]
  | null;

type Kid =
  | { first_name: string; last_name: string }
  | { first_name: string; last_name: string }[]
  | null;

type Row = {
  id: string;
  tenant_id: string;
  coach_user_id: string;
  status: "pending" | "submitted" | "reviewed";
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  due_date: string | null;
  drill_video_id: string | null;
  kid: Kid;
  drill_video: DrillVideo;
};

type RecentVideo = {
  id: string;
  title: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

function pickOne<T>(v: T | T[] | null): T | null {
  if (!v) return null;
  return Array.isArray(v) ? (v[0] ?? null) : v;
}

export default async function EditAssignmentPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ error?: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const { error: errParam } = await searchParams;
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const [{ data, error }, { data: { user } }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("assignments")
      .select(
        "id, tenant_id, coach_user_id, status, title, description, due_date, drill_video_id, kid:kid_id(first_name, last_name), drill_video:drill_video_id(id, title)",
      )
      .eq("id", id)
      .maybeSingle(),
    supabase.auth.getUser(),
  ]);

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-md border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-800">
        Failed to load assignment: {error.message}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!data) notFound();

  const row = data as Row;

  // Bounce if the caller is not the original author or the row is no longer
  // editable. Server Action re-checks both, but redirecting early avoids
  // rendering a form that would just bounce back with an error.
  if (!user || row.coach_user_id !== user.id) {
    redirect(`/coach/assignments/${id}?error=${encodeURIComponent(
      "Only the assigning coach can edit this drill.",
    )}`);
  }
  if (row.status !== "pending") {
    redirect(`/coach/assignments/${id}?error=${encodeURIComponent(
      "This assignment can no longer be edited.",
    )}`);
  }

  const { data: recent } = await supabase
    .from("videos")
    .select("id, title, created_at")
    .eq("uploaded_by_user_id", user.id)
    .eq("purpose", "drill")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(20);

  const recentVideos = (recent ?? []) as RecentVideo[];
  const kid = pickOne(row.kid);
  const currentVideo = pickOne(row.drill_video);
  const kidName = kid ? `${kid.first_name} ${kid.last_name}` : "Unknown kid";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            Edit assignment
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">
            Fix a typo or swap the drill video before the family marks it
            done.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link
          href={`/coach/assignments/${id}`}
          className="text-sm text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900"
        >
          ← Back
        </Link>
      </div>

      {errParam ? (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">
          {errParam}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <EditAssignmentForm
        initial={{
          id: row.id,
          title: row.title,
          description: row.description,
          due_date: row.due_date,
          drill_video_id: row.drill_video_id,
          current_drill_video: currentVideo,
        }}
        recentVideos={recentVideos}
        kidName={kidName}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en", {
    year: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function fmtDay(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00");
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function pickOne<T>(v: T | T[] | null): T | null {
  if (!v) return null;
  return Array.isArray(v) ? (v[0] ?? null) : v;
}

"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole } from "@/lib/auth";

const UUID_RE =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

export type ReviewFormState = { error: string | null };

export async function reviewAssignment(
  _prev: ReviewFormState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<ReviewFormState> {
  const assignmentId = String(formData.get("assignment_id") ?? "").trim();
  const ratingRaw = String(formData.get("rating") ?? "").trim();
  const feedbackRaw = String(formData.get("feedback") ?? "");

  if (!assignmentId || !UUID_RE.test(assignmentId)) {
    return { error: "Invalid assignment id." };
  }

  const ratingNum = Number.parseInt(ratingRaw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(ratingNum) || ratingNum < 1 || ratingNum > 5) {
    return { error: "Pick a star rating from 1 to 5." };
  }

  const feedback = feedbackRaw.trim();
  if (feedback.length < 10) {
    return { error: "Feedback must be at least 10 characters." };
  }
  if (feedback.length > 2000) {
    return { error: "Feedback must be 2000 characters or fewer." };
  }

  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) {
    return { error: "Your session expired. Sign in again." };
  }

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "coach") {
    return { error: "Only coaches can review assignments." };
  }

  const { error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc("review_assignment", {
    p_assignment_id: assignmentId,
    p_rating: ratingNum,
    p_feedback: feedback,
  });

  if (rpcErr) {
    return { error: rpcErr.message };
  }

  revalidatePath("/coach/assignments");
  revalidatePath(`/coach/assignments/${assignmentId}`);
  return { error: null };
}

"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";
import { Send } from "lucide-react";
import {
  reviewAssignment,
  type ReviewFormState,
} from "./review-actions";

const INITIAL: ReviewFormState = { error: null };

function SubmitButton({ disabled }: { disabled: boolean }) {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  return (
    <button
      type="submit"
      disabled={disabled || pending}
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gold bg-gold/10 px-4 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-gold transition-colors hover:bg-gold/20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
    >
      <Send size={11} />
      {pending ? "Saving…" : "Submit review"}
    </button>
  );
}

export function ReviewForm({ assignmentId }: { assignmentId: string }) {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState(reviewAssignment, INITIAL);
  const [rating, setRating] = useState<number>(0);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string>("");

  const canSubmit = rating >= 1 && rating <= 5 && feedback.trim().length >= 10;

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-4">
      <input type="hidden" name="assignment_id" value={assignmentId} />
      <input type="hidden" name="rating" value={rating} />

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
          Rating
        </label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Rating">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => {
            const active = n <= rating;
            return (
              <button
                key={n}
                type="button"
                role="radio"
                aria-checked={rating === n}
                onClick={() => setRating(n)}
                className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-md border text-2xl leading-none transition-colors ${
                  active
                    ? "border-gold bg-gold/10 text-gold"
                    : "border-border-gold-strong bg-surface text-text-light/40 hover:border-gold/60"
                }`}
              >
                {active ? "★" : "☆"}
              </button>
            );
          })}
          <span className="ml-3 text-sm text-text-light">
            {rating > 0 ? `${rating} / 5` : "Select a rating"}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <label
          htmlFor="feedback"
          className="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep"
        >
          Feedback
        </label>
        <textarea
          id="feedback"
          name="feedback"
          rows={5}
          minLength={10}
          maxLength={2000}
          value={feedback}
          onChange={(e) => setFeedback(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="What did they do well? What should they work on next?"
          className="w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-gold/30 bg-darkest px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-cream-light placeholder:text-text-light/50 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/40"
          style={{ color: "#fdfbf2" }}
          required
        />
        <p className="text-xs text-text-light">
          {feedback.trim().length} characters (min 10)
        </p>
      </div>

      {state.error ? (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg p-3 text-sm text-danger">
          {state.error}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <SubmitButton disabled={!canSubmit} />
    </form>
  );
}

"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

const UUID_RE =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

function backToForm(error: string): never {
  redirect(`/coach/assignments/new?error=${encodeURIComponent(error)}`);
}

export async function createAssignment(formData: FormData) {
  const kidId = String(formData.get("kid_id") ?? "").trim();
  const title = String(formData.get("title") ?? "").trim();
  const description = String(formData.get("description") ?? "").trim();
  const drillVideoIdRaw = String(formData.get("drill_video_id") ?? "").trim();
  const dueDateRaw = String(formData.get("due_date") ?? "").trim();

  // Hand-rolled validation (no zod dep — keep portal/package.json minimal).
  if (!kidId || !UUID_RE.test(kidId)) {
    backToForm("Pick a kid for this assignment.");
  }
  if (!title) backToForm("Drill title is required.");
  if (title.length > 120) backToForm("Drill title is too long (max 120).");
  if (!description) backToForm("Drill description is required.");
  if (drillVideoIdRaw && !UUID_RE.test(drillVideoIdRaw)) {
    backToForm("Drill video id must be a UUID.");
  }
  // Due date is either '' or YYYY-MM-DD (the native date input enforces shape).
  if (dueDateRaw && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dueDateRaw)) {
    backToForm("Due date must be a calendar date.");
  }

  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) backToForm("Your session expired. Sign in again.");

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "coach") {
    backToForm("Only coaches can create assignments.");
  }
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) {
    backToForm("Your account is missing a tenant claim. Contact support.");
  }

  // Look up family_id for the chosen kid. RLS scopes this to the coach's
  // tenant so a stale/forged kid_id from another tenant returns no rows.
  const { data: kid, error: kidErr } = await supabase
    .from("kids")
    .select("family_id")
    .eq("id", kidId)
    .single();

  if (kidErr || !kid) {
    backToForm("That kid is not in your tenant.");
  }

  // Defence-in-depth: if a drill_video_id was submitted, confirm it belongs
  // to this coach. Form tampering or a stale UUID from another coach would
  // otherwise be accepted by the assignments INSERT (videos.id has no
  // FK-level uploader check).
  if (drillVideoIdRaw) {
    const { data: video, error: vidErr } = await supabase
      .from("videos")
      .select("id")
      .eq("id", drillVideoIdRaw)
      .eq("uploaded_by_user_id", user!.id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (vidErr || !video) {
      backToForm("That drill video isn\u2019t one of yours.");
    }
  }

  const insert: Record<string, unknown> = {
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    kid_id: kidId,
    family_id: kid.family_id,
    coach_user_id: user!.id,
    title,
    description,
  };
  // Only set drill_video_id when the coach actually picked one — let the
  // column default to NULL otherwise.
  if (drillVideoIdRaw) insert.drill_video_id = drillVideoIdRaw;
  if (dueDateRaw) insert.due_date = dueDateRaw;

  const { error: insErr } = await supabase
    .from("assignments")
    .insert(insert);

  if (insErr) {
    backToForm(`Could not save: ${insErr.message}`);
  }

  revalidatePath("/coach/assignments");
  redirect("/coach/assignments");
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";
import { createAssignment } from "./actions";
import { DrillVideoField } from "./DrillVideoField";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Input, Select, TextArea } from "@/components/ui/Input";

type Kid = {
  id: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
};

type RecentVideo = {
  id: string;
  title: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

function SubmitButton({ disabled }: { disabled: boolean }) {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  const isDisabled = disabled || pending;
  return (
    <Button type="submit" disabled={isDisabled}>
      {pending ? "Creating…" : "Create assignment"}
    </Button>
  );
}

export function AssignmentForm({
  kids,
  recentVideos,
}: {
  kids: Kid[];
  recentVideos: RecentVideo[];
}) {
  const [uploadBusy, setUploadBusy] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Card accent padding="lg">
      <form action={createAssignment} className="space-y-5">
        <Select
          id="kid_id"
          name="kid_id"
          required
          defaultValue=""
          label="Recipient kid"
        >
          <option value="" disabled>
            Choose a kid…
          </option>
          {kids.map((k) => (
            <option key={k.id} value={k.id}>
              {k.first_name} {k.last_name}
            </option>
          ))}
        </Select>

        <Input
          id="title"
          name="title"
          type="text"
          required
          maxLength={120}
          placeholder="e.g. 50 tee swings, top hand only"
          label="Drill title"
        />

        <TextArea
          id="description"
          name="description"
          required
          rows={4}
          placeholder="What should they do, how many reps, focus cues, etc."
          label="Drill description"
        />

        <DrillVideoField recent={recentVideos} onBusyChange={setUploadBusy} />

        <Input
          id="due_date"
          name="due_date"
          type="date"
          label="Due date"
          optional
        />

        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-border-gold pt-5">
          {uploadBusy ? (
            <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
              Waiting for video upload to finish…
            </span>
          ) : null}
          <Link
            href="/coach/assignments"
            className="text-sm text-text-light transition-colors hover:text-gold"
          >
            Cancel
          </Link>
          <SubmitButton disabled={uploadBusy} />
        </div>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/coach/assignments/new/DrillVideoField.tsx
=================================================================================
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { fieldClasses } from "@/components/ui/Input";

type RecentVideo = {
  id: string;
  title: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

type Mode = "upload" | "pick";

type UploadStatus =
  | { kind: "idle" }
  | { kind: "minting" }
  | { kind: "uploading"; progress: number }
  | { kind: "done"; videoId: string; fileName: string }
  | { kind: "error"; message: string; canRetry: boolean };

const MAX_BYTES = 500 * 1024 * 1024; // 500 MB

const RTF = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("en", { numeric: "auto" });

function relativeTime(iso: string): string {
  const then = new Date(iso).getTime();
  const now = Date.now();
  const diffSec = Math.round((then - now) / 1000);
  const abs = Math.abs(diffSec);
  if (abs < 3600) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 60), "minute");
  if (abs < 86400) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 3600), "hour");
  if (abs < 86400 * 30) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 86400), "day");
  if (abs < 86400 * 365)
    return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 30)), "month");
  return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 365)), "year");
}

function fmtBytes(n: number): string {
  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`;
  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  if (n < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  return `${(n / 1024 / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} GB`;
}

export function DrillVideoField({
  recent,
  onBusyChange,
  initialPickedId = "",
}: {
  recent: RecentVideo[];
  onBusyChange?: (busy: boolean) => void;
  /** Pre-select an existing drill video id (used by the edit form). */
  initialPickedId?: string;
}) {
  const hasRecent = recent.length > 0;
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>(hasRecent ? "pick" : "upload");
  const [pickedId, setPickedId] = useState<string>(initialPickedId);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<UploadStatus>({ kind: "idle" });
  const [pickedFileName, setPickedFileName] = useState<string>("");
  const xhrRef = useRef<XMLHttpRequest | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  const submittedVideoId =
    mode === "upload"
      ? status.kind === "done"
        ? status.videoId
        : ""
      : pickedId;

  const isBusy = status.kind === "minting" || status.kind === "uploading";

  useEffect(() => {
    onBusyChange?.(isBusy);
  }, [isBusy, onBusyChange]);

  const startUpload = useCallback(async (file: File) => {
    if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
      setStatus({
        kind: "error",
        canRetry: false,
        message: `That file is ${fmtBytes(file.size)} — please pick something under ${fmtBytes(MAX_BYTES)}.`,
      });
      return;
    }

    setPickedFileName(file.name);
    setStatus({ kind: "minting" });

    let mintRes: Response;
    try {
      mintRes = await fetch("/api/coach/drill-uploads", { method: "POST" });
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Network error";
      setStatus({
        kind: "error",
        canRetry: true,
        message: `Could not reach the server (${msg}).`,
      });
      return;
    }

    let mintBody: { upload_url?: string; video_id?: string; error?: { message?: string } };
    try {
      mintBody = (await mintRes.json()) as typeof mintBody;
    } catch {
      setStatus({
        kind: "error",
        canRetry: true,
        message: "Server returned an unreadable response.",
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!mintRes.ok || !mintBody.upload_url || !mintBody.video_id) {
      setStatus({
        kind: "error",
        canRetry: true,
        message:
          mintBody?.error?.message ??
          `Upload service returned status ${mintRes.status}.`,
      });
      return;
    }

    const uploadUrl = mintBody.upload_url;
    const videoId = mintBody.video_id;

    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhrRef.current = xhr;
    setStatus({ kind: "uploading", progress: 0 });

    xhr.open("PUT", uploadUrl, true);
    xhr.setRequestHeader(
      "Content-Type",
      file.type || "application/octet-stream",
    );

    xhr.upload.onprogress = (ev: ProgressEvent) => {
      if (!ev.lengthComputable) return;
      const pct = Math.round((ev.loaded / ev.total) * 100);
      setStatus({ kind: "uploading", progress: pct });
    };
    xhr.onload = () => {
      xhrRef.current = null;
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
        setStatus({ kind: "done", videoId, fileName: file.name });
      } else {
        setStatus({
          kind: "error",
          canRetry: true,
          message: `Upload failed (status ${xhr.status}).`,
        });
      }
    };
    xhr.onerror = () => {
      xhrRef.current = null;
      setStatus({
        kind: "error",
        canRetry: true,
        message: "Network error during upload.",
      });
    };
    xhr.onabort = () => {
      xhrRef.current = null;
      setStatus({ kind: "idle" });
      setPickedFileName("");
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
    };

    xhr.send(file);
  }, []);

  const cancel = () => {
    xhrRef.current?.abort();
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setStatus({ kind: "idle" });
    setPickedFileName("");
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
  };

  const onFile = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) void startUpload(file);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep">
          <span>Drill video</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-normal normal-case tracking-normal text-text-light">
            optional
          </span>
        </label>
        {hasRecent ? (
          <div
            role="tablist"
            className="inline-flex overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border-gold text-xs"
          >
            <button
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={mode === "upload"}
              onClick={() => setMode("upload")}
              disabled={isBusy}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${mode === "upload" ? "bg-gold text-darkest" : "bg-darkest text-text-light hover:text-cream-light"}`}
            >
              Upload new
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={mode === "pick"}
              onClick={() => setMode("pick")}
              disabled={isBusy}
              className={`border-l border-border-gold px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${mode === "pick" ? "bg-gold text-darkest" : "bg-darkest text-text-light hover:text-cream-light"}`}
            >
              Pick from recent
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <input type="hidden" name="drill_video_id" value={submittedVideoId} />

      {mode === "upload" ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {status.kind === "idle" || status.kind === "error" ? (
            <>
              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept="video/*"
                onChange={onFile}
                className="block w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest text-sm text-cream file:mr-4 file:cursor-pointer file:border-0 file:bg-gold file:px-4 file:py-2.5 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:text-darkest hover:file:bg-gold-hover"
              />
              <p className="text-xs text-text-light">
                MP4 / MOV / WebM up to {fmtBytes(MAX_BYTES)}. Uploads stream
                directly to Mux.
              </p>
            </>
          ) : null}

          {status.kind === "minting" ? (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/60 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-text-light">
              Preparing upload…
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {status.kind === "uploading" ? (
            <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/60 px-4 py-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span
                  className="truncate pr-3 font-medium text-cream-light"
                  title={pickedFileName}
                >
                  {pickedFileName || "Uploading…"}
                </span>
                <span className="shrink-0 text-text-light">
                  {status.progress}%
                </span>
              </div>
              <div
                className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-darkest"
                role="progressbar"
                aria-valuenow={status.progress}
                aria-valuemin={0}
                aria-valuemax={100}
              >
                <div
                  className="h-full bg-gold transition-[width] duration-150"
                  style={{ width: `${status.progress}%` }}
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={cancel}
                className="text-xs text-text-light underline-offset-2 hover:text-gold hover:underline"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {status.kind === "done" ? (
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-success/40 bg-success-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="font-semibold text-success">Upload complete</p>
                <p
                  className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-success/80"
                  title={status.fileName}
                >
                  {status.fileName} • Mux is processing
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-success/70">
                  {status.videoId}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={reset}
                className="shrink-0 text-xs text-success underline-offset-2 hover:underline"
              >
                Replace
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {status.kind === "error" ? (
            <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-danger">
              <p>{status.message}</p>
              {status.canRetry ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    // Clear value first so re-picking the SAME file still
                    // fires onChange — otherwise browsers suppress it.
                    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
                    fileInputRef.current?.click();
                  }}
                  className="rounded-lg bg-danger px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-cream-light hover:bg-danger/90"
                >
                  Pick a file and retry
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <select
            value={pickedId}
            onChange={(e) => setPickedId(e.target.value)}
            className={fieldClasses()}
          >
            <option value="">No video / link later</option>
            {recent.map((v) => (
              <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
                {(v.title?.trim() || "Untitled drill") +
                  " • " +
                  relativeTime(v.created_at)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <p className="text-xs text-text-light">
            Pick from your last 20 drill videos uploaded via the mobile app.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { AssignmentForm } from "./AssignmentForm";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";

type Kid = {
  id: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
};

type DrillVideo = {
  id: string;
  title: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

export default async function NewAssignmentPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ error?: string }>;
}) {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  const [kidsRes, videosRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("kids")
      .select("id, first_name, last_name")
      .order("first_name", { ascending: true }),
    supabase
      .from("videos")
      .select("id, title, created_at")
      .eq("uploaded_by_user_id", user!.id)
      .eq("purpose", "drill")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(20),
  ]);

  const kids = (kidsRes.data ?? []) as Kid[];
  const videos = (videosRes.data ?? []) as DrillVideo[];
  const { error: errParam } = await searchParams;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
            New assignment
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
            Send a drill to one of your families.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link
          href="/coach/assignments"
          className="text-sm text-text-light transition-colors hover:text-gold"
        >
          ← Back
        </Link>
      </div>

      {errParam ? (
        <Card padding="sm" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">{errParam}</p>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      {kids.length === 0 ? (
        <Card padding="lg" className="border-dashed text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
            There are no kids in your tenant yet, so there&apos;s no one to
            assign a drill to.
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <AssignmentForm kids={kids} recentVideos={videos} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { LinkButton } from "@/components/ui/Button";

type Status = "pending" | "submitted" | "reviewed";

type Row = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status: Status;
  due_date: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  kid: { first_name: string } | { first_name: string }[] | null;
};

const RTF = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("en", { numeric: "auto" });

function relativeTime(iso: string): string {
  const then = new Date(iso).getTime();
  const now = Date.now();
  const diffSec = Math.round((then - now) / 1000);
  const abs = Math.abs(diffSec);
  if (abs < 60) return RTF.format(diffSec, "second");
  if (abs < 3600) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 60), "minute");
  if (abs < 86400) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 3600), "hour");
  if (abs < 86400 * 7) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 86400), "day");
  if (abs < 86400 * 30)
    return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 7)), "week");
  if (abs < 86400 * 365)
    return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 30)), "month");
  return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 365)), "year");
}

function formatDueDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00");
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function kidName(row: Row): string {
  const k = row.kid;
  if (!k) return "Unknown";
  if (Array.isArray(k)) return k[0]?.first_name ?? "Unknown";
  return k.first_name;
}

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<Status, string> = {
  pending: "To do",
  submitted: "Submitted",
  reviewed: "Completed",
};

const STATUS_PILL: Record<Status, string> = {
  pending: "bg-warning-bg text-warning border-warning/40",
  submitted: "bg-info-bg text-info border-info/40",
  reviewed: "bg-success-bg text-success border-success/40",
};

export default async function CoachAssignmentsPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("assignments")
    .select(
      "id, title, status, due_date, created_at, kid:kid_id(first_name)",
    )
    .eq("coach_user_id", user!.id)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    return (
      <Card className="border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg">
        <p className="text-sm text-danger">
          Failed to load assignments: {error.message}
        </p>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const rows = (data ?? []) as Row[];

  const groups: Array<{ status: Status; rows: Row[] }> = [
    { status: "submitted", rows: rows.filter((r) => r.status === "submitted") },
    { status: "pending", rows: rows.filter((r) => r.status === "pending") },
    { status: "reviewed", rows: rows.filter((r) => r.status === "reviewed") },
  ];

  const emptyCopy: Record<Status, string> = {
    submitted: "No submissions waiting.",
    pending: "Nothing here.",
    reviewed: "Nothing here.",
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
            Assignments
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
            Drills you have assigned to your families.
          </p>
        </div>
        <LinkButton href="/coach/assignments/new">
          New assignment
        </LinkButton>
      </div>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <Card padding="lg" className="border-dashed text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
            You haven&apos;t created any assignments yet. Tap{" "}
            <span className="font-semibold text-cream-light">
              New assignment
            </span>{" "}
            to send a drill to one of your families.
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-8">
          {groups.map((group) => (
            <section key={group.status}>
              <h2 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-gold-deep">
                {STATUS_LABEL[group.status]}
                <span className="rounded-full border border-border-gold bg-darker px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-gold">
                  {group.rows.length}
                </span>
              </h2>
              {group.rows.length === 0 ? (
                <Card padding="sm" className="border-dashed text-center">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-light/70">
                    {emptyCopy[group.status]}
                  </p>
                </Card>
              ) : (
                <Card padding="none" className="overflow-hidden">
                  <ul className="divide-y divide-border-gold">
                    {group.rows.map((row) => (
                      <li key={row.id}>
                        <Link
                          href={`/coach/assignments/${row.id}`}
                          className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-4 transition-colors hover:bg-darkest/40"
                        >
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-cream-light">
                                {row.title}
                              </span>
                              <span
                                className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] ${STATUS_PILL[row.status]}`}
                              >
                                {STATUS_LABEL[row.status]}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm text-text-light">
                              For {kidName(row)}
                              {row.due_date
                                ? ` • due ${formatDueDate(row.due_date)}`
                                : ""}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-1">
                            <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                              {relativeTime(row.created_at)}
                            </span>
                            {row.status === "submitted" ? (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-warning/40 bg-warning-bg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-warning">
                                Needs review
                              </span>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                        </Link>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </Card>
              )}
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/coach/check-in/page.tsx

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readTenantId, getCoachCapabilities, isStaffPreset } from "@/lib/auth";
import {
  CheckInBoard,
  type CheckInBooking,
  type WaitlistCount,
} from "@/app/admin/check-in/CheckInBoard";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function CoachCheckInPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");

  const caps = await getCoachCapabilities(supabase, user.id);
  if (!isStaffPreset(caps)) redirect("/coach");

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? "";
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");

  const todayStart = new Date();
  todayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const todayEnd = new Date();
  todayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

  const { data: rows } = await supabase
    .from("bookings")
    .select(
      `id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, cage_number, status, attended_at,
       kid:kid_id(first_name, last_name),
       coach:coach_id(first_name, last_name),
       session_type:session_type_id(name)`,
    )
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .gte("scheduled_start", todayStart.toISOString())
    .lte("scheduled_start", todayEnd.toISOString())
    .not("status", "in", '("cancelled")')
    .order("scheduled_start");

  type RawRow = {
    id: string;
    scheduled_start: string;
    scheduled_end: string;
    cage_number: string | null;
    status: string;
    attended_at: string | null;
    kid: { first_name: string | null; last_name: string | null } | null;
    coach: { first_name: string | null; last_name: string | null } | null;
    session_type: { name: string | null } | null;
  };

  const bookings: CheckInBooking[] = (
    (rows ?? []) as unknown as RawRow[]
  ).map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    scheduled_start: r.scheduled_start,
    scheduled_end: r.scheduled_end,
    cage_number: r.cage_number,
    status: r.status,
    attended_at: r.attended_at,
    kid_first_name: r.kid?.first_name ?? null,
    kid_last_name: r.kid?.last_name ?? null,
    coach_first_name: r.coach?.first_name ?? null,
    coach_last_name: r.coach?.last_name ?? null,
    session_type_name: r.session_type?.name ?? null,
  }));

  const { data: waitlistRows } = await supabase
    .from("booking_waitlist")
    .select("scheduled_start")
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId)
    .in("status", ["waiting", "notified"])
    .gte("scheduled_start", todayStart.toISOString())
    .lte("scheduled_start", todayEnd.toISOString());

  function toHourLabel(iso: string): string {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    const h24 = d.getHours();
    const period = h24 >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
    const h12 = h24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h24 % 12;
    return `${h12}:00 ${period}`;
  }

  const hourCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const row of waitlistRows ?? []) {
    const label = toHourLabel(row.scheduled_start);
    hourCounts.set(label, (hourCounts.get(label) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const waitlistCounts: WaitlistCount[] = Array.from(hourCounts.entries()).map(
    ([hour_label, count]) => ({ hour_label, count }),
  );

  const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "long",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
  });
  const totalWaitlist = waitlistRows?.length ?? 0;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Check-In
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          {today} · {bookings.length} booking
          {bookings.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} today
          {totalWaitlist > 0 ? ` · ${totalWaitlist} on waitlist` : ""}
        </p>
      </div>
      <CheckInBoard
        initialBookings={bookings}
        waitlistCounts={waitlistCounts}
        tenantId={tenantId}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/coach/inbox/actions.ts

"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

export async function replyToThread(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<{ error: string } | undefined> {
  const kidId = String(formData.get("kid_id") ?? "").trim();
  const messageText = String(formData.get("message_text") ?? "").trim();

  if (!kidId || !messageText) return { error: "Missing required fields." };

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
    error: userErr,
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (userErr || !user) return { error: "Not authenticated." };

  // Resolve tenant_id directly from the coaches table — more reliable than
  // decoding the JWT custom claim, which may be absent in server action context.
  const { data: coachRow, error: coachErr } = await supabase
    .from("coaches")
    .select("tenant_id")
    .eq("user_id", user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (coachErr || !coachRow?.tenant_id) {
    return { error: "Could not resolve your coach profile. Please sign out and back in." };
  }

  const tenantId = coachRow.tenant_id as string;

  const rawName = user.user_metadata?.full_name;
  const senderDisplay =
    (typeof rawName === "string" && rawName.length > 0 ? rawName : undefined) ??
    user.email ??
    "Coach";

  // Resolve family_id from the kid row — required by parent-side RLS SELECT policy
  // (coach_messages_select_parent checks recipient_family_id = family.id).
  const { data: kid, error: kidErr } = await supabase
    .from("kids")
    .select("family_id")
    .eq("id", kidId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (kidErr || !kid?.family_id) {
    return { error: "Could not find the athlete. Please refresh and try again." };
  }

  const { error: insertErr } = await supabase.from("coach_messages").insert({
    sender_user_id: user.id,
    sender_display: senderDisplay,
    recipient_kid_id: kidId,
    recipient_family_id: kid.family_id,
    message_text: messageText,
    video_id: null,
    label: null,
    tenant_id: tenantId,
  });

  if (insertErr) {
    return { error: `Failed to send message: ${insertErr.message}` };
  }

  revalidatePath("/coach/inbox");
  revalidatePath(`/coach/inbox/${kidId}`);
}

FILE: portal/app/coach/inbox/InboxList.tsx
