"use client";

/**
 * InboxList — real-time coach inbox conversation list.
 *
 * Receives the initial conversation data from the server component and
 * subscribes to Supabase Realtime INSERT events on coach_messages.  When a
 * new message arrives that involves this coach, it calls router.refresh() so
 * Next.js re-runs the server component and re-fetches the grouped conversation
 * list — keeping the heavy grouping logic on the server while still giving
 * near-instant updates without a manual page reload.
 */

import { useEffect } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

export type ConversationRow = {
  kidId: string;
  kidName: string;
  lastMessageText: string | null;
  lastHasVideo: boolean;
  lastCreatedAt: string;
  lastIsInbound: boolean;
  hasUnread: boolean;
};

const RTF = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("en", { numeric: "auto" });

function relativeTime(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso) return "";
  const then = new Date(iso).getTime();
  const now = Date.now();
  const diffSec = Math.round((then - now) / 1000);
  const abs = Math.abs(diffSec);
  if (abs < 60) return RTF.format(diffSec, "second");
  if (abs < 3600) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 60), "minute");
  if (abs < 86400) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 3600), "hour");
  if (abs < 86400 * 7) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 86400), "day");
  if (abs < 86400 * 30)
    return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 7)), "week");
  if (abs < 86400 * 365)
    return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 30)), "month");
  return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 365)), "year");
}

interface Props {
  conversations: ConversationRow[];
  coachUserId: string;
}

export function InboxList({ conversations, coachUserId }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();

  // Subscribe to new messages and trigger a server-side refresh so the
  // grouped list (last-message preview, unread dot) stays current.
  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createClient();

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`portal-coach-inbox-list-${coachUserId}`)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "INSERT", schema: "public", table: "coach_messages" },
        (payload) => {
          const row = payload.new as Record<string, unknown>;
          // Only react when this coach is the sender or named recipient.
          if (
            row.sender_user_id !== coachUserId &&
            row.recipient_coach_user_id !== coachUserId
          ) {
            return;
          }
          // Re-run the server component to get fresh grouped data.
          router.refresh();
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      void supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [coachUserId, router]);

  if (conversations.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
        No messages yet. Use the Ballpark mobile app to record a video for a
        family — it will show up here.
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ul className="divide-y divide-border-gold">
      {conversations.map((conv) => {
        const preview = conv.lastHasVideo
          ? "📹 Video message"
          : conv.lastMessageText?.trim() || "(empty message)";

        const initials = conv.kidName
          .split(" ")
          .map((w) => w[0])
          .slice(0, 2)
          .join("")
          .toUpperCase();

        return (
          <li key={conv.kidId}>
            <Link
              href={`/coach/inbox/${conv.kidId}`}
              className="flex items-center gap-4 px-5 py-4 transition-colors hover:bg-darkest/40"
            >
              {/* Avatar */}
              <div className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-darker border border-border-gold">
                <span className="font-display text-base font-semibold text-gold">
                  {initials || "?"}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Content */}
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span
                    className={`truncate text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${conv.hasUnread ? "text-cream-light" : "text-text-light"}`}
                  >
                    {conv.kidName}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                    {conv.hasUnread && (
                      <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-gold" />
                    )}
                    <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                      {relativeTime(conv.lastCreatedAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p
                  className={`mt-0.5 truncate text-sm ${conv.hasUnread ? "font-medium text-cream-light" : "text-text-light"}`}
                >
                  {conv.lastIsInbound ? "" : "You: "}
                  {preview}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Chevron */}
              <svg
                className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-text-light/40"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"
                />
              </svg>
            </Link>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/coach/inbox/InboxReplyForm.tsx
=================================================================================
"use client";

import { useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Send } from "lucide-react";
import { replyToThread } from "./actions";

export function InboxReplyForm({ kidId }: { kidId: string }) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [sendError, setSendError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const text = textareaRef.current?.value?.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    setSendError(null);

    // Optimistically clear the textarea; restore if the action fails.
    if (textareaRef.current) textareaRef.current.value = "";

    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("kid_id", kidId);
    fd.append("message_text", text);

    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await replyToThread(fd);
      if (result?.error) {
        setSendError(result.error);
        // Restore the unsent text so the coach doesn't lose it.
        if (textareaRef.current) textareaRef.current.value = text;
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="mt-1.5">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <textarea
          ref={textareaRef}
          name="message_text"
          rows={2}
          required
          autoFocus
          placeholder="Type your reply…"
          className="w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-2 text-sm text-cream-light placeholder:text-text-light/50 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
        />
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={pending}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gold bg-gold/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-gold transition-colors hover:bg-gold/20 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <Send size={10} />
            {pending ? "Sending…" : "Send"}
          </button>
        </div>
        {sendError && (
          <p className="text-xs text-red-400">{sendError}</p>
        )}
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { InboxReplyForm } from "../InboxReplyForm";
import { ThreadMessages, type ThreadMessage } from "./ThreadMessages";

type VideoRow = {
  id: string;
  status: string;
  mux_playback_id: string | null;
  duration_seconds: number | null;
  purpose: string;
};

type RawMessageRow = {
  id: string;
  created_at: string;
  sender_user_id: string;
  sender_display: string | null;
  recipient_family_id: string | null;
  recipient_kid_id: string | null;
  recipient_coach_user_id: string | null;
  message_text: string | null;
  viewed_at: string | null;
  video: VideoRow | VideoRow[] | null;
};

function normalizeVideo(
  raw: VideoRow | VideoRow[] | null,
): ThreadMessage["video"] {
  const v = Array.isArray(raw) ? (raw[0] ?? null) : raw;
  if (!v) return null;
  return {
    id: v.id,
    status: v.status,
    mux_playback_id: v.mux_playback_id,
    duration_seconds: v.duration_seconds,
    purpose: v.purpose,
  };
}

export default async function CoachInboxThreadPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ kidId: string }>;
}) {
  const { kidId } = await params;
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  // Fetch kid info for the header
  const { data: kid } = await supabase
    .from("kids")
    .select("id, first_name, last_name, family_id")
    .eq("id", kidId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!kid) notFound();

  // Fetch bidirectional thread — same logic as listCoachMessageThread on mobile
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("coach_messages")
    .select(
      "id, created_at, sender_user_id, sender_display, recipient_family_id, recipient_kid_id, recipient_coach_user_id, message_text, viewed_at, video:videos(id, status, mux_playback_id, duration_seconds, purpose)",
    )
    .eq("recipient_kid_id", kidId)
    .or(
      `sender_user_id.eq.${user!.id},recipient_coach_user_id.eq.${user!.id}`,
    )
    .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

  const raw = (data ?? []) as unknown as RawMessageRow[];

  // Normalise into the shape ThreadMessages expects.
  const initialMessages: ThreadMessage[] = raw.map((msg) => ({
    id: msg.id,
    created_at: msg.created_at,
    sender_user_id: msg.sender_user_id,
    sender_display: msg.sender_display,
    recipient_family_id: msg.recipient_family_id,
    recipient_kid_id: msg.recipient_kid_id,
    recipient_coach_user_id: msg.recipient_coach_user_id,
    message_text: msg.message_text,
    viewed_at: msg.viewed_at,
    video: normalizeVideo(msg.video),
  }));

  const kidDisplayName = [kid.first_name, kid.last_name]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Link
          href="/coach/inbox"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-text-light transition-colors hover:text-cream-light"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={16} />
          Inbox
        </Link>
        <span className="text-text-light/40">/</span>
        <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          {kidDisplayName}
        </h1>
      </div>

      {error ? (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg">
          <p className="text-sm text-danger">
            Failed to load thread: {error.message}
          </p>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        /* Chat bubbles — live via Realtime */
        <Card padding="none" className="overflow-hidden">
          <ThreadMessages
            initialMessages={initialMessages}
            kidId={kidId}
            coachUserId={user!.id}
          />
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Reply area */}
      <Card padding="lg" className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-light">
          Reply
        </h2>
        <InboxReplyForm kidId={kidId} />
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

export type ThreadMessage = {
  id: string;
  created_at: string;
  sender_user_id: string;
  sender_display: string | null;
  recipient_family_id: string | null;
  recipient_kid_id: string | null;
  recipient_coach_user_id: string | null;
  message_text: string | null;
  viewed_at: string | null;
  video: {
    id: string;
    status: string;
    mux_playback_id: string | null;
    duration_seconds: number | null;
    purpose: string;
  } | null;
};

const RTF = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("en", { numeric: "auto" });

function relativeTime(iso: string): string {
  const then = new Date(iso).getTime();
  const now = Date.now();
  const diffSec = Math.round((then - now) / 1000);
  const abs = Math.abs(diffSec);
  if (abs < 60) return RTF.format(diffSec, "second");
  if (abs < 3600) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 60), "minute");
  if (abs < 86400) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 3600), "hour");
  if (abs < 86400 * 7) return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / 86400), "day");
  if (abs < 86400 * 30)
    return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 7)), "week");
  if (abs < 86400 * 365)
    return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 30)), "month");
  return RTF.format(Math.round(diffSec / (86400 * 365)), "year");
}

interface Props {
  initialMessages: ThreadMessage[];
  kidId: string;
  coachUserId: string;
}

export function ThreadMessages({ initialMessages, kidId, coachUserId }: Props) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ThreadMessage[]>(initialMessages);
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Sync state when the server re-renders with updated initialMessages after
  // revalidatePath. useState only uses the prop on mount, so without this
  // effect the component never reflects the new message from the server render.
  const lastInitialId = initialMessages[initialMessages.length - 1]?.id ?? "";
  useEffect(() => {
    setMessages(initialMessages);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [lastInitialId, initialMessages.length]);

  // Scroll to bottom on mount and when messages grow.
  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [messages.length]);

  // Supabase Realtime: append new messages without a page reload.
  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createClient();

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`portal-coach-thread-${kidId}-${coachUserId}`)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        {
          event: "INSERT",
          schema: "public",
          table: "coach_messages",
          filter: `recipient_kid_id=eq.${kidId}`,
        },
        (payload) => {
          const row = payload.new as Record<string, unknown>;

          // Guard: only messages in this (kid, coach) thread.
          if (
            row.sender_user_id !== coachUserId &&
            row.recipient_coach_user_id !== coachUserId
          ) {
            return;
          }

          const id = row.id as string;

          setMessages((prev) => {
            if (prev.some((m) => m.id === id)) return prev;

            const msg: ThreadMessage = {
              id,
              created_at: row.created_at as string,
              sender_user_id: row.sender_user_id as string,
              sender_display: (row.sender_display as string | null) ?? null,
              recipient_family_id:
                (row.recipient_family_id as string | null) ?? null,
              recipient_kid_id:
                (row.recipient_kid_id as string | null) ?? kidId,
              recipient_coach_user_id:
                (row.recipient_coach_user_id as string | null) ?? null,
              message_text: (row.message_text as string | null) ?? null,
              viewed_at: (row.viewed_at as string | null) ?? null,
              // Video rows inserted via Mux webhook arrive after processing;
              // the INSERT itself has no video join. Show null (no bubble).
              video: null,
            };

            return [...prev, msg];
          });
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      void supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [kidId, coachUserId]);

  if (messages.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
        No messages yet in this thread.
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-5">
      {messages.map((msg) => {
        const isSelf = msg.sender_user_id === coachUserId;
        const video = msg.video;
        const created = new Date(msg.created_at);
        const timeStr = Number.isNaN(created.getTime())
          ? ""
          : relativeTime(msg.created_at);

        return (
          <div
            key={msg.id}
            className={`flex flex-col gap-1 ${isSelf ? "items-end" : "items-start"}`}
          >
            {/* Sender label + time */}
            <div
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${isSelf ? "flex-row-reverse" : ""}`}
            >
              <span
                className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest ${
                  isSelf
                    ? "bg-gold text-dark"
                    : "bg-gold/20 text-gold"
                }`}
              >
                {isSelf ? "You" : (msg.sender_display ?? "Family")}
              </span>
              {timeStr && (
                <span className="text-[11px] text-text-light/60">
                  {timeStr}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Bubble */}
            {video?.mux_playback_id ? (
              <div
                className={`overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border ${isSelf ? "border-gold" : "border-border-gold"}`}
                style={{ width: 240 }}
              >
                <div className="relative aspect-video bg-darkest">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img
                    src={`https://image.mux.com/${video.mux_playback_id}/thumbnail.jpg?width=480`}
                    alt="Video thumbnail"
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                  />
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/30">
                    <span className="text-4xl">▶</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-light">
                  Video message
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : video ? (
              <div
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3 ${isSelf ? "border-gold bg-gold/10" : "border-border-gold bg-dark"}`}
                style={{ maxWidth: 280 }}
              >
                <span className="text-xl">🎬</span>
                <span className="text-sm text-text-light">
                  Processing video…
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                className={`rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed ${
                  isSelf
                    ? "border-gold bg-gold text-dark font-medium"
                    : "border-border-gold bg-dark text-cream-light"
                }`}
                style={{ maxWidth: 320 }}
              >
                {msg.message_text ?? ""}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {/* Invisible anchor used to scroll the thread to the bottom. */}
      <div ref={bottomRef} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { InboxList, type ConversationRow } from "./InboxList";

type RawRow = {
  id: string;
  message_text: string | null;
  video_id: string | null;
  viewed_at: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  sender_user_id: string;
  recipient_kid_id: string | null;
  recipient_family_id: string | null;
  recipient_coach_user_id: string | null;
  recipient_kid:
    | { first_name: string; last_name: string | null }
    | { first_name: string; last_name: string | null }[]
    | null;
};

function kidNameFromRow(row: RawRow): string {
  const k = row.recipient_kid;
  if (!k) return "Unknown";
  const item = Array.isArray(k) ? k[0] : k;
  if (!item) return "Unknown";
  return [item.first_name, item.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

export default async function CoachInboxPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("coach_messages")
    .select(
      "id, message_text, video_id, viewed_at, created_at, sender_user_id, recipient_kid_id, recipient_family_id, recipient_coach_user_id, recipient_kid:recipient_kid_id(first_name, last_name)",
    )
    .or(`sender_user_id.eq.${user!.id},recipient_coach_user_id.eq.${user!.id}`)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    return (
      <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger-bg">
        <p className="text-sm text-danger">
          Failed to load messages: {error.message}
        </p>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as RawRow[];

  // Group by recipient_kid_id — one conversation per kid.
  // Walk newest-first so first encounter = latest message.
  const folder = new Map<string, ConversationRow>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const kidId = row.recipient_kid_id;
    if (!kidId) continue;
    if (folder.has(kidId)) continue;

    const isInbound = row.sender_user_id !== user!.id;
    folder.set(kidId, {
      kidId,
      kidName: kidNameFromRow(row),
      lastMessageText: row.message_text,
      lastHasVideo: !!row.video_id,
      lastCreatedAt: row.created_at,
      lastIsInbound: isInbound,
      hasUnread: isInbound && !row.viewed_at,
    });
  }

  const conversations = Array.from(folder.values());

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Inbox
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          One conversation per athlete — tap to view the full thread and reply.
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card padding="none" className="overflow-hidden">
        {/* InboxList is a client component that subscribes to Realtime and
            calls router.refresh() when a new message arrives, re-running this
            server component so the grouped list stays current automatically. */}
        <InboxList conversations={conversations} coachUserId={user!.id} />
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use server";
/**
 * Server actions for /coach/redemptions — staff coach fulfillment surface.
 *
 * Authorization is enforced at the DB layer by mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff():
 *   • app_role must be 'coach'
 *   • coaches.capabilities->>'preset' must be 'staff'
 *   • order tenant_id must match the caller's JWT tenant_id
 *   • payment_method must be 'points' and status must be 'ordered'
 *
 * The server action pre-checks role/preset to give a meaningful redirect
 * instead of a raw DB exception, but the RPC is the authoritative gate.
 * No service-role client is used — the session client + SECURITY DEFINER RPC
 * is the only path for mutations here.
 */

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, getCoachCapabilities, isStaffPreset } from "@/lib/auth";
import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

async function requireStaffCoachClient(): Promise<SupabaseClient> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  if (readAppRole(session) !== "coach") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");

  const caps = await getCoachCapabilities(supabase, user.id);
  if (!isStaffPreset(caps)) redirect("/coach");

  // Return the typed-as-any cast so we can call the new RPC
  // (mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff not yet in generated types)
  return supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient;
}

async function fulfill(code: string) {
  const trimmed = code.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!trimmed) {
    redirect(`/coach/redemptions?error=${encodeURIComponent("Enter a code.")}`);
  }

  const supabase = await requireStaffCoachClient();

  // DB-enforced SECURITY DEFINER RPC handles all authorization and fulfillment.
  // It validates coach role, staff preset, tenant match, payment_method='points',
  // status='ordered', and is idempotent on already-fulfilled orders.
  const { data, error } = await (supabase as SupabaseClient).rpc(
    "mark_redemption_fulfilled_staff",
    { p_code: trimmed },
  );

  if (error) {
    const msg = (error as { message?: string }).message ?? "Could not fulfill";
    redirect(`/coach/redemptions?error=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`);
  }

  const redemptionCode =
    (data as { redemption_code?: string } | null)?.redemption_code ?? trimmed;
  revalidatePath("/coach/redemptions");
  redirect(`/coach/redemptions?ok=${encodeURIComponent(redemptionCode)}`);
}

export async function fulfillByCode(formData: FormData) {
  const code = (formData.get("code") as string | null) ?? "";
  await fulfill(code);
}

export async function fulfillById(formData: FormData) {
  const code = (formData.get("code") as string | null) ?? "";
  await fulfill(code);
}

      {sp.error ? (
        <Card padding="md" className="border-danger/40 bg-danger/5">

                  <span className="font-display text-base text-cream-light">
                    {row.product?.name ?? "—"}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-text-light">
                    {row.kid?.first_name ?? ""} {row.kid?.last_name ?? ""}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-text-light">
                    {row.amount_paid_points} pts
                  </span>
                  <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-text-light">
                    {row.redemption_code}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-text-light">
                    {row.fulfilled_at
                      ? new Date(row.fulfilled_at).toLocaleString()
                      : ""}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </Card>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/coach/sessions/CoachSessionsBoard.tsx

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, UserCircle, ClipboardList } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/Card';

export type CoachSession = {
  id: string;
  scheduled_start: string;
  scheduled_end: string;
  cage_number: string | null;
  status: string;
  attended_at: string | null;
  kid_first_name: string | null;
  kid_last_name: string | null;
  kid_age_group: string | null;
  session_type_name: string | null;
  pending_assignments: number;
  last_session_notes: string | null;
};

type GroupedSession = {
  slot: string;
  bookings: CoachSession[];
};

function statusChip(status: string) {
  const map: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
    confirmed:  { label: 'Not Yet',   cls: 'border-border-gold text-gold bg-gold/10' },
    pending:    { label: 'Pending',   cls: 'border-yellow-600 text-yellow-400 bg-yellow-900/20' },
    completed:  { label: 'Arrived',  cls: 'border-emerald-600 text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-900/20' },
    no_show:    { label: 'No Show',  cls: 'border-red-700 text-red-400 bg-red-900/20' },
    cancelled:  { label: 'Cancelled', cls: 'border-gray-600 text-gray-400 bg-gray-900/20' },
  };
  const s = map[status] ?? { label: status, cls: 'border-border-gold text-text-light' };
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${s.cls}`}>
      {s.label}
    </span>
  );
}

function kidName(b: CoachSession): string {
  return [b.kid_first_name, b.kid_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'Unknown';
}

function groupBySlot(bookings: CoachSession[]): GroupedSession[] {
  const map = new Map<string, CoachSession[]>();
  for (const b of bookings) {
    const slot = b.scheduled_start.slice(0, 16);
    if (!map.has(slot)) map.set(slot, []);
    map.get(slot)!.push(b);
  }
  return Array.from(map.entries())
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .map(([slot, bks]) => ({ slot, bookings: bks }));
}

function slotLabel(iso: string): string {
  const start = new Date(iso);
  const hs = start.getHours();
  const ms = start.getMinutes();
  const ampm = hs >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12s = hs > 12 ? hs - 12 : hs === 0 ? 12 : hs;
  return ms === 0 ? `${h12s}:00 ${ampm}` : `${h12s}:${String(ms).padStart(2, '0')} ${ampm}`;
}

export function CoachSessionsBoard({ sessions }: { sessions: CoachSession[] }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const toggle = (slot: string) =>
    setExpanded((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(slot)) next.delete(slot);
      else next.add(slot);
      return next;
    });

  const groups = groupBySlot(sessions);

  if (groups.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Card padding="lg" className="border-dashed">
        <p className="text-center text-sm text-text-light">
          No sessions scheduled for you today.
        </p>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {groups.map(({ slot, bookings }) => {
        const isOpen = expanded.has(slot);
        const arrivedCount = bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').length;

        return (
          <Card key={slot} padding="none" accent>
            {/* Session header — click to expand */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => toggle(slot)}
              className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-4 text-left"
            >
              <div>
                <p className="font-display text-lg font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
                  {slotLabel(slot)}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-text-light">
                  {bookings[0]?.session_type_name ?? 'Session'} ·{' '}
                  {bookings.length} athlete{bookings.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} ·{' '}
                  {arrivedCount} arrived
                  {bookings[0]?.cage_number ? ` · Cage ${bookings[0].cage_number}` : ''}
                </p>
              </div>
              {isOpen ? (
                <ChevronUp size={18} className="flex-shrink-0 text-text-light" />
              ) : (
                <ChevronDown size={18} className="flex-shrink-0 text-text-light" />
              )}
            </button>

            {/* Roster */}
            {isOpen && (
              <div className="border-t border-border-gold divide-y divide-border-gold/40">
                {bookings.map((b) => (
                  <div
                    key={b.id}
                    className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 px-6 py-4"
                  >
                    {/* Avatar */}
                    <div className="flex h-10 w-10 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border-gold bg-darkest text-gold">
                      <UserCircle size={24} strokeWidth={1.5} />
                    </div>

                    {/* Kid info */}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-[140px]">
                      <p className="font-display text-base font-semibold text-cream-light">
                        {kidName(b)}
                      </p>
                      {b.kid_age_group && (
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-text-light">
                          {b.kid_age_group}
                        </p>
                      )}
                      {b.last_session_notes && (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-light/70 italic line-clamp-2">
                          Last session: {b.last_session_notes}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Pending assignments */}
                    {b.pending_assignments > 0 && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-yellow-700 bg-yellow-900/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-yellow-400">
                        <ClipboardList size={11} />
                        {b.pending_assignments} pending drill{b.pending_assignments !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Check-in status */}
                    <div className="flex-shrink-0">
                      {statusChip(b.status)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </Card>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/coach/sessions/page.tsx
=================================================================================
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { CoachSessionsBoard, type CoachSession } from './CoachSessionsBoard';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function CoachSessionsPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect('/login?reason=unauthenticated');

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'coach') redirect('/login?reason=forbidden');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect('/logout?reason=no-tenant');

  const { data: coachRow } = await supabase
    .from('coaches')
    .select('id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!coachRow) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          My Sessions
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-text-light">No coach profile found for your account.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const todayStart = new Date();
  todayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const todayEnd = new Date();
  todayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

  // Fetch today's bookings for this coach, including kid_id for assignment lookup
  const { data: rows } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .select(
      `id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, cage_number, status, attended_at, kid_id,
       kid:kid_id(first_name, last_name, age_group),
       session_type:session_type_id(name)`,
    )
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('coach_id', coachRow.id)
    .gte('scheduled_start', todayStart.toISOString())
    .lte('scheduled_start', todayEnd.toISOString())
    .not('status', 'in', '("cancelled")')
    .order('scheduled_start');

  type RawRow = {
    id: string;
    scheduled_start: string;
    scheduled_end: string;
    cage_number: string | null;
    status: string;
    attended_at: string | null;
    kid_id: string;
    kid: { first_name: string | null; last_name: string | null; age_group: string | null } | null;
    session_type: { name: string | null } | null;
  };

  const bookingRows = (rows ?? []) as unknown as RawRow[];
  const kidIds = [...new Set(bookingRows.map((r) => r.kid_id))];

  // Pending assignment counts per kid for this coach
  const pendingByKid: Record<string, number> = {};
  if (kidIds.length > 0) {
    const { data: asgn } = await supabase
      .from('assignments')
      .select('kid_id')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('coach_id', coachRow.id)
      .eq('status', 'pending')
      .in('kid_id', kidIds);

    for (const a of asgn ?? []) {
      const kId = a.kid_id as string;
      pendingByKid[kId] = (pendingByKid[kId] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  // Last completed booking notes per kid (for "last session notes")
  const lastNotesByKid: Record<string, string | null> = {};
  if (kidIds.length > 0) {
    const { data: lastBookings } = await supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('kid_id, notes')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('coach_id', coachRow.id)
      .eq('status', 'completed')
      .not('notes', 'is', null)
      .in('kid_id', kidIds)
      .order('attended_at', { ascending: false });

    // Keep only the first (most recent) row per kid
    for (const lb of lastBookings ?? []) {
      const kId = lb.kid_id as string;
      if (!(kId in lastNotesByKid)) {
        lastNotesByKid[kId] = (lb.notes as string | null) ?? null;
      }
    }
  }

  const sessions: CoachSession[] = bookingRows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    scheduled_start: r.scheduled_start,
    scheduled_end: r.scheduled_end,
    cage_number: r.cage_number,
    status: r.status,
    attended_at: r.attended_at,
    kid_first_name: r.kid?.first_name ?? null,
    kid_last_name: r.kid?.last_name ?? null,
    kid_age_group: r.kid?.age_group ?? null,
    session_type_name: r.session_type?.name ?? null,
    pending_assignments: pendingByKid[r.kid_id] ?? 0,
    last_session_notes: lastNotesByKid[r.kid_id] ?? null,
  }));

  const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'long',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          My Sessions Today
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          {today} · {sessions.length} session{sessions.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} scheduled
        </p>
      </div>

      <CoachSessionsBoard sessions={sessions} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { HQShell } from "@/components/hq/HQShell";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

export const metadata = {
  title: "HQ — Ballpark",
};

export default async function HQLayout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const role = readAppRole(session);

  if (role !== "super_admin") {
    if (role === "owner") redirect("/owner");
    if (role === "admin") redirect("/admin");
    if (role === "coach") redirect("/coach/inbox");
    redirect("/logout?reason=parent");
  }

  return <HQShell email={user.email ?? ""}>{children}</HQShell>;
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { X, Loader2, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { HQLocation } from '@/lib/supabase/hqQueries';

interface Props {
  location: HQLocation;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const US_TIMEZONES = [
  'America/New_York',
  'America/Chicago',
  'America/Denver',
  'America/Phoenix',
  'America/Los_Angeles',
  'America/Anchorage',
  'Pacific/Honolulu',
];

export function HQEditLocationModal({ location, onClose }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: location.name,
    address: location.address ?? '',
    city: location.city ?? '',
    state: location.state ?? '',
    zip: location.zip ?? '',
    phone: location.phone ?? '',
    email: location.email ?? '',
    timezone: location.timezone ?? 'America/Chicago',
    isActive: location.isActive,
  });

  const set = <K extends keyof typeof form>(k: K, v: typeof form[K]) =>
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [k]: v }));

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/hq/locations/${location.id}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });
      const body = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(body.error ?? 'Failed to update location');
      setSuccess(true);
      router.refresh();
      setTimeout(onClose, 1200);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px', borderRadius: 7,
    border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, background: brand.surfaceAlt,
    fontSize: 13, color: brand.text, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
  };
  const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'block', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
    color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 4, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.8,
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 1000,
    }}>
      <div style={{
        background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 14, width: 520,
        maxHeight: '92vh', overflow: 'auto', boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
      }}>
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '20px 24px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
        }}>
          <div>
            <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.text }}>
              Edit Location
            </h2>
            <p style={{ margin: '2px 0 0', fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>
              {location.tenantName} · {location.tenantSlug}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4 }}>
            <X size={18} color={brand.textMuted} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {success ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={40} color={brand.success} style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} />
            <p style={{ color: brand.text, fontWeight: 600, margin: 0 }}>Location updated.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ padding: 24 }}>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Location Name *</label>
              <input
                style={inputStyle} required
                value={form.name}
                onChange={e => set('name', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Dallas North"
              />
            </div>

            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Address</label>
              <input
                style={inputStyle}
                value={form.address}
                onChange={e => set('address', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="123 Main St"
              />
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ flex: 2 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>City</label>
                <input
                  style={inputStyle}
                  value={form.city}
                  onChange={e => set('city', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Dallas"
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>State</label>
                <input
                  style={inputStyle}
                  value={form.state}
                  onChange={e => set('state', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="TX"
                  maxLength={2}
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>ZIP</label>
                <input
                  style={inputStyle}
                  value={form.zip}
                  onChange={e => set('zip', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="75001"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Phone</label>
                <input
                  style={inputStyle}
                  value={form.phone}
                  onChange={e => set('phone', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="(555) 555-5555"
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Email</label>
                <input
                  style={inputStyle}
                  type="email"
                  value={form.email}
                  onChange={e => set('email', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="info@location.com"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Timezone</label>
              <select
                style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'none' }}
                value={form.timezone}
                onChange={e => set('timezone', e.target.value)}
              >
                {US_TIMEZONES.map(tz => (
                  <option key={tz} value={tz}>{tz.replace('America/', '').replace('Pacific/', '').replace(/_/g, ' ')}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Active toggle */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '14px 16px', borderRadius: 8,
              background: form.isActive ? brand.successBg : brand.dangerBg,
              border: `1px solid ${form.isActive ? brand.success + '40' : brand.danger + '40'}`,
              marginBottom: 20,
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
            }}>
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, color: form.isActive ? brand.success : brand.danger }}>
                  {form.isActive ? 'Location Active' : 'Location Inactive'}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
                  {form.isActive
                    ? 'This location appears in booking flows.'
                    : 'Inactive locations are hidden from booking flows.'}
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => set('isActive', !form.isActive)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 16px', borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700,
                  border: 'none',
                  background: form.isActive ? brand.danger : brand.success,
                  color: '#fff', cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                {form.isActive ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}
              </button>
            </div>

            {error && (
              <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8, background: brand.dangerBg, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 16 }}>
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button
                type="button" onClick={onClose}
                style={{
                  padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
                  background: 'transparent', color: brand.text, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit" disabled={loading}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
                  padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none',
                  background: brand.gold, color: brand.darker,
                  fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  opacity: loading ? 0.7 : 1,
                }}
              >
                {loading && <Loader2 size={13} />}
                Save Changes
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function stripeStatusChip(status: string) {

    connected:     { label: 'Connected',    color: brand.success,  bg: brand.successBg,  icon: CheckCircle2 },

    restricted:    { label: 'Restricted',   color: brand.danger,   bg: brand.dangerBg,   icon: AlertCircle },
    not_connected: { label: 'Not Connected',color: brand.textMuted, bg: brand.border,    icon: XCircle },
  };
  const s = map[status] ?? map.not_connected;
  const Icon = s.icon;
  return (
    <span style={{
      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, padding: '3px 10px',
      borderRadius: 20, background: s.bg, color: s.color,
      fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,

      {s.label}

  );
}

                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px', color: brand.text }}>
                    {(loc.royaltyRate * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}>
                    <span style={{
                      padding: '3px 10px', borderRadius: 20,
                      background: loc.isActive ? brand.successBg : brand.dangerBg,
                      color: loc.isActive ? brand.success : brand.danger,
                      fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
                    }}>
                      {loc.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setEditLocation(loc)}
                      title="Edit location"
                      style={{
                        background: 'none', border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
                        borderRadius: 6, padding: '5px 8px', cursor: 'pointer',
                        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                      }}
                    >
                      <Pencil size={12} color={brand.textMuted} />
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {showNewModal && <HQNewLocationModal onClose={() => setShowNewModal(false)} />}
      {editLocation && <HQEditLocationModal location={editLocation} onClose={() => setEditLocation(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface Props {
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function HQNewLocationModal({ onClose }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    tenantName: '',
    tenantSlug: '',
    locationName: '',
    city: '',
    state: '',
    isNewTenant: true,
    existingTenantSlug: '',
  });

  const set = (k: keyof typeof form, v: string | boolean) =>
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [k]: v }));

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/hq/locations', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });
      const body = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(body.error ?? 'Failed to create location');
      router.refresh();
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px', borderRadius: 7,
    border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, background: brand.surface,
    fontSize: 13, color: brand.text, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
  };
  const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'block', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
    color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 4, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.8,
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 1000,
    }}>
      <div style={{
        background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 14, width: 520,
        maxHeight: '90vh', overflow: 'auto', boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
      }}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '20px 24px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
        }}>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.text }}>
            New Location
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4 }}>
            <X size={18} color={brand.textMuted} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ padding: 24 }}>
          {/* Tenant mode toggle */}
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Franchise</label>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
              {[
                { value: true, label: 'New Franchise' },
                { value: false, label: 'Existing Franchise' },
              ].map(opt => (
                <button
                  key={String(opt.value)}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => set('isNewTenant', opt.value)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '7px 14px', borderRadius: 7, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600,
                    border: `1px solid ${form.isNewTenant === opt.value ? brand.goldDeep : brand.border}`,
                    background: form.isNewTenant === opt.value ? brand.goldDeep + '18' : 'transparent',
                    color: form.isNewTenant === opt.value ? brand.goldDeep : brand.textMuted,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {form.isNewTenant ? (
            <>
              <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Franchise Name *</label>
                <input
                  style={inputStyle} required value={form.tenantName}
                  onChange={e => set('tenantName', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Infinite Hitting Phoenix"
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>URL Slug *</label>
                <input
                  style={inputStyle} required value={form.tenantSlug}
                  onChange={e => set('tenantSlug', e.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, ''))}
                  placeholder="e.g. infinitehitting-phoenix"
                />
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Existing Franchise Slug *</label>
              <input
                style={inputStyle} required value={form.existingTenantSlug}
                onChange={e => set('existingTenantSlug', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. infinitehitting"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ height: 1, background: brand.border, margin: '16px 0' }} />
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.8, marginBottom: 12, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Location Details</div>

          <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Location Name *</label>
            <input
              style={inputStyle} required value={form.locationName}
              onChange={e => set('locationName', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Dallas North"
            />
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginBottom: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ flex: 2 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>City</label>
              <input style={inputStyle} value={form.city} onChange={e => set('city', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Dallas" />
            </div>
            <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>State</label>
              <input style={inputStyle} value={form.state} onChange={e => set('state', e.target.value)} placeholder="TX" maxLength={2} />
            </div>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8, background: brand.dangerBg, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 16 }}>
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
            <button
              type="button" onClick={onClose}
              style={{ padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, background: 'transparent', color: brand.text, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit" disabled={loading}
              style={{
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
                padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none',
                background: brand.gold, color: brand.darker,
                fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                opacity: loading ? 0.7 : 1,
              }}
            >
              {loading && <Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin" />}
              Create Location
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';

function fmt(n: number) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(n);
}

function fmtSmall(n: number) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(n);
}

function fmtDate(ts: string) {
  const d = new Date(ts);
  return `${['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}`;
}

function fmtDateFull(ts: string) {
  const d = new Date(ts);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function stripeIcon(status: string) {
  if (status === 'connected') return <CheckCircle2 size={14} color={brand.success} />;
  if (status === 'pending') return <Clock size={14} color={brand.warning} />;
  if (status === 'not_connected') return <XCircle size={14} color={brand.textMuted} />;
  return <AlertCircle size={14} color={brand.danger} />;
}

interface KPICardProps {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  sub?: string;
  icon: React.ElementType;
  accent?: string;
}
function KPICard({ label, value, sub, icon: Icon, accent = brand.goldDeep }: KPICardProps) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
      padding: '20px 22px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8,
    }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', fontFamily: fonts.display }}>
          {label}
        </span>
        <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 8, background: accent + '18', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
          <Icon size={16} color={accent} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 800, color: brand.text, fontFamily: fonts.display, lineHeight: 1 }}>{value}</div>
      {sub && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>{sub}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { Settings, Globe, Percent, Loader2, CheckCircle2, Save } from 'lucide-react';

interface Tenant {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  royaltyRate: number;
}

interface HQSettingsData {
  network_logo_url: string | null;
  network_favicon_url: string | null;
}

interface Props {
  settings: HQSettingsData;
  tenants: Tenant[];
}

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px', borderRadius: 7,
  border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, background: brand.surfaceAlt,
  fontSize: 13, color: brand.text, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
  color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 4, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.8,
};

function SectionCard({ title, icon: Icon, children }: {
  title: string;
  icon: React.ElementType;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
      marginBottom: 20, overflow: 'hidden',
    }}>
      <div style={{
        padding: '16px 20px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
      }}>
        <Icon size={16} color={brand.goldDeep} />
        <span style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, fontFamily: fonts.display }}>
          {title}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function HQSettingsContent({ settings, tenants }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [branding, setBranding] = useState({
    networkLogoUrl: settings.network_logo_url ?? '',
    networkFaviconUrl: settings.network_favicon_url ?? '',
  });
  const [brandingSaving, setBrandingSaving] = useState(false);
  const [brandingSaved, setBrandingSaved] = useState(false);
  const [brandingError, setBrandingError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [royaltyRates, setRoyaltyRates] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(tenants.map(t => [t.id, (t.royaltyRate * 100).toFixed(2)]))
  );
  const [royaltySaving, setRoyaltySaving] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [royaltySaved, setRoyaltySaved] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [royaltyError, setRoyaltyError] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  async function saveBranding(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBrandingSaving(true);
    setBrandingError(null);
    setBrandingSaved(false);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/hq/settings', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: 'branding',
          networkLogoUrl: branding.networkLogoUrl || null,
          networkFaviconUrl: branding.networkFaviconUrl || null,
        }),
      });
      const body = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(body.error ?? 'Failed to save');
      setBrandingSaved(true);
      router.refresh();
      setTimeout(() => setBrandingSaved(false), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      setBrandingError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setBrandingSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function saveRoyalty(tenantId: string) {
    const rateStr = royaltyRates[tenantId] ?? '';
    const rate = parseFloat(rateStr) / 100;
    if (isNaN(rate) || rate < 0 || rate > 100) {
      setRoyaltyError(prev => ({ ...prev, [tenantId]: 'Enter a valid percentage (0–100)' }));
      return;
    }
    setRoyaltySaving(tenantId);
    setRoyaltyError(prev => ({ ...prev, [tenantId]: '' }));
    setRoyaltySaved(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/hq/settings', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'royalty', tenantId, rate }),
      });
      const body = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(body.error ?? 'Failed to save');
      setRoyaltySaved(tenantId);
      router.refresh();
      setTimeout(() => setRoyaltySaved(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      setRoyaltyError(prev => ({ ...prev, [tenantId]: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error' }));
    } finally {
      setRoyaltySaving(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 28, maxWidth: 780 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, marginBottom: 8 }}>
        <Settings size={22} color={brand.goldDeep} />
        <h1 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 26, fontWeight: 800, color: brand.text, margin: 0, letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
          Settings
        </h1>
      </div>
      <p style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 14, marginBottom: 32 }}>
        Global HQ configuration for the Ballpark network.
      </p>

      {/* Network Branding */}
      <SectionCard title="Network Branding" icon={Globe}>
        <form onSubmit={saveBranding}>
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Network Logo URL</label>
            <input
              style={inputStyle}
              type="url"
              placeholder="https://example.com/logo.png"
              value={branding.networkLogoUrl}
              onChange={e => setBranding(prev => ({ ...prev, networkLogoUrl: e.target.value }))}
            />
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
              Full URL to the network-wide logo image (PNG or SVG, recommended 200×60px).
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Network Favicon URL</label>
            <input
              style={inputStyle}
              type="url"
              placeholder="https://example.com/favicon.ico"
              value={branding.networkFaviconUrl}
              onChange={e => setBranding(prev => ({ ...prev, networkFaviconUrl: e.target.value }))}
            />
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
              Full URL to the favicon (ICO or PNG, 32×32px).
            </div>
          </div>

          {brandingError && (
            <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8, background: brand.dangerBg, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 16 }}>
              {brandingError}
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={brandingSaving}
              style={{
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
                padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none',
                background: brand.gold, color: brand.darker,
                fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: brandingSaving ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                opacity: brandingSaving ? 0.7 : 1,
              }}
            >
              {brandingSaving ? <Loader2 size={13} /> : <Save size={13} />}
              Save Branding
            </button>
            {brandingSaved && (
              <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, color: brand.success, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                <CheckCircle2 size={14} /> Saved
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </form>
      </SectionCard>

      {/* Royalty Rates */}
      <SectionCard title="Royalty Rates per Franchise" icon={Percent}>
        <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, margin: '0 0 20px' }}>
          Set the royalty rate (%) applied to each franchise&apos;s transaction volume. Changes take effect on the next billing cycle.
        </p>

        {tenants.length === 0 ? (
          <p style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>No franchises found.</p>
        ) : (
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 13 }}>
            <thead>
              <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
                {['Franchise', 'Slug', 'Royalty Rate', ''].map(h => (
                  <th key={h} style={{
                    padding: '8px 12px', textAlign: 'left',
                    fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted,
                    letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', fontFamily: fonts.display,
                  }}>
                    {h}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {tenants.map((t, i) => (
                <tr key={t.id} style={{ borderBottom: i < tenants.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${brand.border}` : 'none' }}>
                  <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px', fontWeight: 600, color: brand.text }}>{t.name}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px', color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 12 }}>{t.slug}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                      <input
                        style={{ ...inputStyle, width: 80, textAlign: 'right' }}
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        max="100"
                        step="0.1"
                        value={royaltyRates[t.id] ?? '2.50'}
                        onChange={e => setRoyaltyRates(prev => ({ ...prev, [t.id]: e.target.value }))}
                      />
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted }}>%</span>
                    </div>
                    {royaltyError[t.id] && (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.danger, marginTop: 4 }}>{royaltyError[t.id]}</div>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => saveRoyalty(t.id)}
                        disabled={royaltySaving === t.id}
                        style={{
                          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
                          padding: '6px 14px', borderRadius: 7, border: 'none',
                          background: brand.goldDeep + '22', color: brand.goldDeep,
                          fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700,
                          cursor: royaltySaving === t.id ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                          opacity: royaltySaving === t.id ? 0.6 : 1,
                        }}
                      >
                        {royaltySaving === t.id ? <Loader2 size={11} /> : <Save size={11} />}
                        Save
                      </button>
                      {royaltySaved === t.id && (
                        <CheckCircle2 size={14} color={brand.success} />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </SectionCard>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/hq/settings/page.tsx
=================================================================================
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { HQSettingsContent } from './HQSettingsContent';

const HQ_PRIMARY_TENANT_ID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';

export default async function HQSettingsPage() {
  const service = createServiceClient();

  const [tenantsRes, configsRes] = await Promise.all([
    service.from('tenants').select('id, name, slug, royalty_config').order('name'),
    service.from('tenant_config').select('tenant_id, royalty_rate_override, network_logo_url, network_favicon_url'),
  ]);

  const configByTenantId = new Map<string, {
    royalty_rate_override: number | null;
    network_logo_url: string | null;
    network_favicon_url: string | null;
  }>();
  for (const c of (configsRes.data ?? [])) {
    configByTenantId.set(c.tenant_id, {
      royalty_rate_override: c.royalty_rate_override ?? null,
      network_logo_url: c.network_logo_url ?? null,
      network_favicon_url: c.network_favicon_url ?? null,
    });
  }

  const tenants = (tenantsRes.data ?? []).map(t => {
    const cfg = configByTenantId.get(t.id);
    const defaultRate = (t.royalty_config as { rate?: number } | null)?.rate ?? 0.025;
    return {
      id: t.id,
      name: t.name,
      slug: t.slug,
      royaltyRate: cfg?.royalty_rate_override ?? defaultRate,
    };
  });

  const primaryConfig = configByTenantId.get(HQ_PRIMARY_TENANT_ID) ?? null;
  const settings = {
    network_logo_url: primaryConfig?.network_logo_url ?? null,
    network_favicon_url: primaryConfig?.network_favicon_url ?? null,
  };

  return <HQSettingsContent settings={settings} tenants={tenants} />;
}

FILE: portal/app/hq/team/HQEditTeamMemberModal.tsx
