'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { X, Loader2, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, Info } from 'lucide-react';
import type { HQTeamMember } from '@/lib/supabase/hqQueries';

interface Props {
  member: HQTeamMember;
  onClose: () => void;
}

/**
 * Returns the set of roles the member can be reassigned to via this modal.
 *
 * Rules:
 * - super_admin: role cannot be changed (no editable roles)
 * - coach: can be promoted to admin or owner (their coaches row is deactivated)
 * - admin/owner: lateral moves between admin and owner only
 *   (demoting to coach is handled by the Invite flow, not this modal)
 */
function editableRolesFor(currentRole: string): Array<'coach' | 'admin' | 'owner'> {
  if (currentRole === 'super_admin') return [];
  return ['admin', 'owner'];
}

export function HQEditTeamMemberModal({ member, onClose }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const editableRoles = editableRolesFor(member.role);
  const canEditRole = editableRoles.length > 0;

  const [selectedRole, setSelectedRole] = useState<typeof editableRoles[number]>(
    editableRoles.includes(member.role as 'admin' | 'owner') ? member.role as 'admin' | 'owner' : editableRoles[0],
  );
  const [showDeactivateConfirm, setShowDeactivateConfirm] = useState(false);

  const isDeactivated = member.banned;

  async function callTeamApi(body: object) {
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/hq/team', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error ?? 'Request failed');
      setSuccess(true);
      router.refresh();
      setTimeout(onClose, 1200);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSaveRole(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (selectedRole === member.role) { onClose(); return; }
    await callTeamApi({
      userId: member.userId,
      action: 'update_role',
      fromRole: member.role,
      role: selectedRole,
    });
  }

  async function handleToggleBan() {
    const action = isDeactivated ? 'unban' : 'ban';
    await callTeamApi({ userId: member.userId, action });
  }

  const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px', borderRadius: 7,
    border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, background: brand.surfaceAlt,
    fontSize: 13, color: brand.text, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
  };

  const DeactivateSection = () => (
    <>
      {showDeactivateConfirm && !isDeactivated && (
        <div style={{
          padding: '14px 16px', borderRadius: 8,
          background: brand.dangerBg, border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}40`,
          marginBottom: 16,
        }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <AlertTriangle size={13} color={brand.danger} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.danger }}>
              Deactivate {member.name}?
            </span>
          </div>
          <p style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, margin: '0 0 10px' }}>
            They won&apos;t be able to log in until reactivated.
          </p>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleToggleBan}
              disabled={loading}
              style={{
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
                padding: '5px 12px', borderRadius: 6, border: 'none',
                background: brand.danger, color: '#fff',
                fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {loading && <Loader2 size={11} />}
              Confirm Deactivate
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowDeactivateConfirm(false)}
              style={{
                padding: '5px 12px', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
                border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, background: 'transparent',
                color: brand.textMuted, cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {!showDeactivateConfirm && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => isDeactivated ? handleToggleBan() : setShowDeactivateConfirm(true)}
          disabled={loading}
          style={{
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
            padding: '7px 14px', borderRadius: 7, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600,
            border: `1px solid ${isDeactivated ? brand.success + '60' : brand.danger + '60'}`,
            background: 'transparent',
            color: isDeactivated ? brand.success : brand.danger,
            cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          {loading && <Loader2 size={11} />}
          {isDeactivated ? 'Reactivate' : 'Deactivate'}
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 1000,
    }}>
      <div style={{
        background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 14, width: 460,
        boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
      }}>
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '20px 24px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
        }}>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.text }}>
            Edit Team Member
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4 }}>
            <X size={18} color={brand.textMuted} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {success ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={40} color={brand.success} style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} />
            <p style={{ color: brand.text, fontWeight: 600, margin: 0 }}>Updated successfully.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
            {/* Member info */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '12px 14px', borderRadius: 8, background: brand.surfaceAlt,
              marginBottom: 20, display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center',
            }}>
              <div style={{
                width: 38, height: 38, borderRadius: 8, background: brand.goldDeep + '22',
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.goldDeep, fontFamily: fonts.display,
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}>
                {member.name.trim().split(' ').map(p => p[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: brand.text, fontSize: 14 }}>{member.name}</span>
                  {isDeactivated && (
                    <span style={{
                      display: 'inline-block',
                      padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 20,
                      background: brand.dangerBg, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700,
                    }}>
                      DEACTIVATED
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>{member.email}</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {error && (
              <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8, background: brand.dangerBg, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 16 }}>
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Role editor — available for coach, admin, owner (not super_admin) */}
            {canEditRole && (
              <form onSubmit={handleSaveRole}>
                <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                  <label style={{
                    display: 'block', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
                    color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 4, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.8,
                  }}>
                    Role
                  </label>
                  <select
                    style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'none' }}
                    value={selectedRole}
                    onChange={e => setSelectedRole(e.target.value as typeof selectedRole)}
                  >
                    {editableRoles.map(r => (
                      <option key={r} value={r}>
                        {r === 'admin' ? 'Admin' : 'Owner'}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>

                  {member.role === 'coach' && (
                    <div style={{
                      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 6,
                      marginTop: 8, padding: '8px 10px', borderRadius: 6,
                      background: brand.infoBg, color: brand.info, fontSize: 11,
                    }}>
                      <Info size={12} style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: 1 }} />
                      Promoting a coach removes their coach profile. To add a new coach, use the Invite button.
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                  <DeactivateSection />
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
                    <button
                      type="button" onClick={onClose}
                      style={{
                        padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
                        background: 'transparent', color: brand.text, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer',
                      }}
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="submit" disabled={loading}
                      style={{
                        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
                        padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none',
                        background: brand.gold, color: brand.darker,
                        fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700,
                        cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                        opacity: loading ? 0.7 : 1,
                      }}
                    >
                      {loading && <Loader2 size={13} />}
                      Save Role
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            {/* Super admin — deactivate only (role cannot be changed) */}
            {!canEditRole && (
              <div>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
                  <DeactivateSection />
                  <button
                    onClick={onClose}
                    style={{
                      padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
                      background: 'transparent', color: brand.text, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    Close
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { X, Loader2, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { HQLocation } from '@/lib/supabase/hqQueries';

interface Props {
  onClose: () => void;
  locations: HQLocation[];
}

export function HQInviteModal({ onClose, locations }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    email: '',
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    role: 'coach' as 'coach' | 'admin' | 'owner',
    tenantSlug: '',
    locationId: '',
  });

  const set = <K extends keyof typeof form>(k: K, v: typeof form[K]) =>
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [k]: v }));

  // When tenant slug changes, reset location selection.
  const handleTenantChange = (slug: string) => {
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, tenantSlug: slug, locationId: '' }));
  };

  // Locations for the currently selected tenant.
  const tenantLocations = locations.filter(l => l.tenantSlug === form.tenantSlug);

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string> = {
        email: form.email,
        firstName: form.firstName,
        lastName: form.lastName,
        role: form.role,
        tenantSlug: form.tenantSlug,
      };
      if (form.role === 'coach' && form.locationId) {
        payload.locationId = form.locationId;
      }
      const res = await fetch('/api/hq/invite', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const body = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(body.error ?? 'Failed to send invite');
      setSuccess(true);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px', borderRadius: 7,
    border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, background: brand.surface,
    fontSize: 13, color: brand.text, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
  };
  const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'block', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
    color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 4, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.8,
  };

  // Unique tenants from the locations list for the dropdown.
  const tenants = Array.from(
    new Map(locations.map(l => [l.tenantSlug, l.tenantName])).entries()
  ).map(([slug, name]) => ({ slug, name }));

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed', top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
      background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 1000,
    }}>
      <div style={{
        background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 14, width: 480,
        maxHeight: '90vh', overflow: 'auto', boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
      }}>
        <div style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '20px 24px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
        }}>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.text }}>
            Invite Team Member
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4 }}>
            <X size={18} color={brand.textMuted} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {success ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={48} color={brand.success} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }} />
            <h3 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, color: brand.text, margin: '0 0 8px' }}>
              Invite sent!
            </h3>
            <p style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13, margin: '0 0 24px' }}>
              An email has been sent to <strong>{form.email}</strong> with instructions to set their password.
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              style={{ padding: '9px 24px', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none', background: brand.gold, color: brand.darker, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, cursor: 'pointer' }}
            >
              Done
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ padding: 24 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>First Name *</label>
                <input style={inputStyle} required value={form.firstName} onChange={e => set('firstName', e.target.value)} placeholder="Mike" />
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name *</label>
                <input style={inputStyle} required value={form.lastName} onChange={e => set('lastName', e.target.value)} placeholder="Anderson" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Email *</label>
              <input
                style={inputStyle} type="email" required
                value={form.email} onChange={e => set('email', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="coach@infinitehitting.com"
              />
            </div>

            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Role *</label>
              <select
                style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'none' }}
                value={form.role}
                onChange={e => set('role', e.target.value as typeof form.role)}
              >
                <option value="coach">Coach</option>
                <option value="admin">Admin</option>
                <option value="owner">Owner</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Franchise *</label>
              <select
                style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'none' }}
                required
                value={form.tenantSlug}
                onChange={e => handleTenantChange(e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">Select a franchise…</option>
                {tenants.map(t => (
                  <option key={t.slug} value={t.slug}>{t.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {form.role === 'coach' && tenantLocations.length > 0 && (
              <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Primary Location</label>
                <select
                  style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'none' }}
                  value={form.locationId}
                  onChange={e => set('locationId', e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">No specific location</option>
                  {tenantLocations.map(l => (
                    <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>{l.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
                  The facility this coach will be based at.
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {error && (
              <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8, background: brand.dangerBg, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 16 }}>
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
              <button
                type="button" onClick={onClose}
                style={{ padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, background: 'transparent', color: brand.text, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer' }}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit" disabled={loading}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
                  padding: '9px 20px', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none',
                  background: brand.gold, color: brand.darker,
                  fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                  opacity: loading ? 0.7 : 1,
                }}
              >
                {loading && <Loader2 size={13} />}
                Send Invite
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';

interface Props {

const roleConfig: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; bg: string; icon: React.ElementType }> = {
  super_admin: { label: 'HQ Admin',    color: brand.goldDeep, bg: brand.goldDeep + '18', icon: Crown },
  owner:       { label: 'Owner',       color: brand.info,     bg: brand.infoBg,          icon: Shield },
  admin:       { label: 'Admin',       color: brand.warning,  bg: brand.warningBg,       icon: Shield },
  coach:       { label: 'Coach',       color: brand.success,  bg: brand.successBg,       icon: UserCog },
};

type FilterRole = 'all' | 'coach' | 'owner' | 'admin' | 'super_admin';

function RoleChip({ role }: { role: string }) {
  const cfg = roleConfig[role] ?? roleConfig.coach;
  const Icon = cfg.icon;
  return (
    <span style={{
      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, padding: '3px 10px',
      borderRadius: 20, background: cfg.bg, color: cfg.color, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
    }}>
      <Icon size={11} />
      {cfg.label}
    </span>
  );
}

function formatLastSignIn(ts: string | null) {
  if (!ts) return 'Never';
  const d = new Date(ts);
  const diffMs = Date.now() - d.getTime();
  const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86_400_000);
  if (diffDays === 0) return 'Today';
  if (diffDays === 1) return '1d ago';
  if (diffDays < 30) return `${diffDays}d ago`;
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

function formatJoined(ts: string) {
  const d = new Date(ts);
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

function initials(name: string) {
  const parts = name.trim().split(' ');
  return (parts[0]?.[0] ?? '') + (parts[1]?.[0] ?? '');
}

export function HQTeamContent({ team, locations }: Props) {
  const [showInviteModal, setShowInviteModal] = useState(false);
  const [editMember, setEditMember] = useState<HQTeamMember | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterRole>('all');

  const filtered = filter === 'all' ? team : team.filter(m => m.role === filter);

  const tabs: { key: FilterRole; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
    { key: 'super_admin', label: 'HQ Admins' },
    { key: 'owner', label: 'Owners' },
    { key: 'admin', label: 'Admins' },
    { key: 'coach', label: 'Coaches' },
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 28 }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <div>
          <h1 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 26, fontWeight: 800, color: brand.text, margin: 0, letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
            Team
          </h1>
          <p style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13, margin: '4px 0 0' }}>
            {team.length} member{team.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} across all locations
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowInviteModal(true)}
          style={{
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
            padding: '9px 18px', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none',
            background: brand.gold, color: brand.darker,
            fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: fonts.display,
          }}
        >
          <Plus size={15} />
          Invite
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Filter tabs */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 20, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        {tabs.map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.key}
            onClick={() => setFilter(tab.key)}
            style={{
              padding: '6px 14px', borderRadius: 20, border: `1px solid ${filter === tab.key ? brand.goldDeep : brand.border}`,
              background: filter === tab.key ? brand.goldDeep + '18' : 'transparent',
              color: filter === tab.key ? brand.goldDeep : brand.textMuted,
              fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            {tab.label}
            {tab.key !== 'all' && (
              <span style={{ marginLeft: 6, opacity: 0.6 }}>
                {team.filter(m => m.role === tab.key).length}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div style={{ background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 13 }}>
          <thead>
            <tr style={{ background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
              {['Member', 'Role', 'Location', 'Franchise', 'Last Sign-In', 'Joined', ''].map(h => (
                <th key={h} style={{
                  padding: '11px 16px', textAlign: 'left',
                  fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted,
                  letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', fontFamily: fonts.display,
                }}>
                  {h}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={7} style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>
                  No team members found. Click &ldquo;Invite&rdquo; to add someone.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              filtered.map((m, i) => (
                <tr key={m.id} style={{
                  borderBottom: i < filtered.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${brand.border}` : 'none',
                  opacity: m.banned ? 0.6 : 1,
                }}>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}>

                            </span>

                        {m.email && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>{m.email}</div>}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}><RoleChip role={m.role} /></td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px', color: brand.textMuted }}>{m.locationName ?? '—'}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px', color: brand.text }}>{m.tenantName ?? '—'}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px', color: brand.textMuted }}>{formatLastSignIn(m.lastSignIn)}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px', color: brand.textMuted }}>{formatJoined(m.createdAt)}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setEditMember(m)}
                      title="Edit member"
                      style={{

                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {showInviteModal && <HQInviteModal onClose={() => setShowInviteModal(false)} locations={locations} />}
      {editMember && <HQEditTeamMemberModal member={editMember} onClose={() => setEditMember(null)} />}

type Props = {

type Step = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5; // 5 = confirmation

type FormData = {

  parentLastName: string;
  parentEmail: string;
  parentPhone: string;
  kidFirstName: string;
  kidLastName: string;
  ageGroup: string;

const STEPS = [

];

function StepBar({ current }: { current: Step }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0, marginBottom: 32 }}>
      {STEPS.map((s, idx) => {

              }} />
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );

// ── Step 1: Family & Athlete ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function Step1({
  form, setForm, onNext, locations,
}: {
  form: FormData;
  setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<FormData>>;
  onNext: () => void;
  locations: Location[];
}) {
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const showLocationPicker = locations.length > 1;

  const selectedLocation = locations.find(l => l.id === form.locationId) ?? null;
  // For single-location tenants the picker is hidden but locationId is auto-set;
  // readiness must be checked regardless of whether the picker is visible.
  const locationStripeReady = selectedLocation?.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected';
  const hasLocationSelected = !!form.locationId;

  // Block Next when:
  //  - picker is shown and no location selected yet, OR
  //  - any location is resolved (picked or defaulted) but not Stripe-connected
  const nextBlocked = !hasLocationSelected || !locationStripeReady;

  const validate = () => {
    const e: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (!form.parentFirstName.trim()) e.parentFirstName = 'Required';
    if (!form.parentLastName.trim()) e.parentLastName = 'Required';
    if (!form.parentEmail.trim()) e.parentEmail = 'Required';
    else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(form.parentEmail)) e.parentEmail = 'Invalid email';
    if (!form.kidFirstName.trim()) e.kidFirstName = 'Required';
    if (showLocationPicker && !form.locationId) e.locationId = 'Required';
    return e;
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    const e = validate();
    if (Object.keys(e).length > 0) { setErrors(e); return; }
    onNext();
  };

  const f = (field: keyof FormData) => ({
    value: form[field],
    onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
      setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: e.target.value }));
      if (errors[field]) setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: '' }));
    },
  });

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, marginBottom: 4 }}>Family & Athlete</h2>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 24 }}>Enter the parent contact details and athlete information.</p>

      {/* Location section — picker shown for multi-location tenants only;
          Stripe readiness guard shown for all tenants when location is resolved */}
      {(showLocationPicker || (hasLocationSelected && !locationStripeReady)) && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
          {showLocationPicker && (
            <>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 12 }}>Location</div>
              <div style={fieldWrap}>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Enroll Under *</label>
                <select
                  style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto', borderColor: errors.locationId ? brand.danger : brand.border }}
                  value={form.locationId}
                  onChange={e => {
                    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, locationId: e.target.value }));
                    if (errors.locationId) setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, locationId: '' }));
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="">Select a location…</option>
                  {locations.map(loc => (
                    <option key={loc.id} value={loc.id}>{loc.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                {errors.locationId && <div style={errorStyle}>{errors.locationId}</div>}
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Stripe readiness guard — fires for all tenants when location is resolved but not connected */}
          {hasLocationSelected && !locationStripeReady && (
            <div style={{
              marginTop: showLocationPicker ? 4 : 0,
              padding: '12px 16px',
              background: '#2d1a00',
              border: '1px solid #b45309',
              borderRadius: 8,
              fontSize: 13,
              color: '#fbbf24',
              lineHeight: 1.5,
            }}>
              <strong>No Stripe account connected for this location.</strong> Payments will not work until setup is complete.{' '}
              <a
                href="/owner/payments"
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                style={{ color: '#fbbf24', fontWeight: 700, textDecoration: 'underline' }}
              >
                Go to Payments →
              </a>{' '}
              to complete setup first.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 12 }}>Parent / Guardian</div>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 12 }}>
          <div style={fieldWrap}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>First Name *</label>
            <input style={{ ...inputStyle, borderColor: errors.parentFirstName ? brand.danger : brand.border }} placeholder="Carlos" {...f('parentFirstName')} />
            {errors.parentFirstName && <div style={errorStyle}>{errors.parentFirstName}</div>}
          </div>
          <div style={fieldWrap}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name *</label>
            <input style={{ ...inputStyle, borderColor: errors.parentLastName ? brand.danger : brand.border }} placeholder="Martinez" {...f('parentLastName')} />
            {errors.parentLastName && <div style={errorStyle}>{errors.parentLastName}</div>}
          </div>
          <div style={fieldWrap}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Email *</label>
            <input type="email" style={{ ...inputStyle, borderColor: errors.parentEmail ? brand.danger : brand.border }} placeholder="carlos@email.com" {...f('parentEmail')} />
            {errors.parentEmail && <div style={errorStyle}>{errors.parentEmail}</div>}
          </div>
          <div style={fieldWrap}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Phone</label>
            <input type="tel" style={inputStyle} placeholder="(555) 555-5555" {...f('parentPhone')} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.8, textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 12 }}>Athlete</div>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 12 }}>
          <div style={fieldWrap}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>First Name *</label>
            <input style={{ ...inputStyle, borderColor: errors.kidFirstName ? brand.danger : brand.border }} placeholder="Jake" {...f('kidFirstName')} />
            {errors.kidFirstName && <div style={errorStyle}>{errors.kidFirstName}</div>}
          </div>
          <div style={fieldWrap}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name</label>
            <input style={inputStyle} placeholder="Martinez" {...f('kidLastName')} />
          </div>
          <div style={fieldWrap}>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Age Group</label>
            <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} {...f('ageGroup')}>
              <option value="">Select…</option>
              {['8U','10U','12U','14U','HS','College'].map(a => (
                <option key={a} value={a}>{a}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 8 }}>
        <OButton variant="gold" icon={ChevronRight} onClick={handleNext} disabled={nextBlocked}>Next: Choose Plan</OButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Step 2: Plan Selection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

function Step2({
  form, setForm, onNext, onBack,
}: {
  form: FormData;
  setForm: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<FormData>>;
  onNext: () => void;
  onBack: () => void;
}) {
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<MembershipPlan[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/owner/membership-plans')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then((data: MembershipPlan[] | { error: string }) => {
        if (Array.isArray(data)) setPlans(data);
        else setError((data as { error: string }).error);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(e => { setError(String(e)); setLoading(false); });
  }, []);

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (!form.planId) return;
    onNext();
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, marginBottom: 4 }}>Choose a Plan</h2>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 24 }}>Select the membership plan for {form.kidFirstName || 'this athlete'}.</p>

      {loading && (
        <div style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13, padding: '20px 0', textAlign: 'center' }}>Loading plans…</div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <div style={{ color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, padding: '12px 16px', background: brand.dangerBg, borderRadius: 8, marginBottom: 16 }}>
          Could not load plans: {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {!loading && plans.length === 0 && !error && (
        <div style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13, padding: '20px 0', textAlign: 'center' }}>
          No active plans configured. Add plans in the billing settings.
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: 12, marginBottom: 24 }}>
        {plans.map(plan => {
          const selected = form.planId === plan.id;
          const priceLabel = plan.amount_cents > 0
            ? `$${(plan.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`
            : 'Free';
          const billingLabel = plan.plan_type === 'eft' ? '/mo · EFT' : ' · OTC';
          return (
            <div
              key={plan.id}
              onClick={() => setForm(f => ({ ...f, planId: plan.id }))}
              style={{
                padding: '16px 18px', borderRadius: 10, cursor: 'pointer',
                border: `2px solid ${selected ? brand.gold : brand.border}`,
                background: selected ? `${brand.gold}14` : brand.darker,
                transition: 'all 0.15s',
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700, color: selected ? brand.gold : brand.text }}>
                  {plan.name}
                </div>
                <div style={{
                  width: 18, height: 18, borderRadius: 9,
                  border: `2px solid ${selected ? brand.gold : brand.border}`,
                  background: selected ? brand.gold : 'transparent',
                  flexShrink: 0, marginLeft: 8, marginTop: 2,
                }} />
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: selected ? brand.gold : brand.text, marginBottom: 4 }}>
                {priceLabel}
                <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 400, color: brand.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.body }}>{billingLabel}</span>
              </div>
              {plan.description && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{plan.description}</div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
        <OButton variant="secondary" icon={ChevronLeft} onClick={onBack}>Back</OButton>
        <OButton variant="gold" icon={ChevronRight} onClick={handleNext} disabled={!form.planId}>
          Next: Agreement
        </OButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Step 3: Agreement + Signature ─────────────────────────────────────────

function Step3({
  waiver, form, onBack, onNext,
}: {
  waiver: Waiver | null;
  form: FormData;
  onNext: (signatureDataUrl: string) => Promise<void>;
  onBack: () => void;
}) {
  const sigCanvasRef = useRef<SignatureCanvasType | null>(null);
  const [hasInk, setHasInk] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const handleClear = useCallback(() => {
    sigCanvasRef.current?.clear();
    setHasInk(false);
  }, []);

  const handleStroke = useCallback(() => {
    if (!hasInk) setHasInk(true);
  }, [hasInk]);

  const handleSign = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!hasInk || !sigCanvasRef.current) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    const dataUrl = sigCanvasRef.current.toDataURL('image/png');
    try {
      await onNext(dataUrl);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [hasInk, onNext]);

  if (!waiver) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h2 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, marginBottom: 16 }}>Agreement</h2>
        <div style={{ padding: '20px', background: brand.dangerBg, borderRadius: 8, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13 }}>
          No active waiver found for this tenant. Please configure a waiver in the admin settings before enrolling members.
        </div>
        <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
          <OButton variant="secondary" icon={ChevronLeft} onClick={onBack}>Back</OButton>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, marginBottom: 4 }}>Liability Agreement</h2>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 16 }}>
        Version {waiver.version} · Effective {waiver.effective_date} — Have the parent read and sign below.
      </p>

      {/* Waiver body */}
      <div style={{
        height: 260, overflowY: 'auto', background: brand.darker,
        border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 8,
        padding: '16px 20px', marginBottom: 20,
      }}>
        <pre style={{ fontFamily: fonts.body, fontSize: 12, color: brand.textLight, lineHeight: 1.7, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', margin: 0 }}>
          {waiver.body_text}
        </pre>
      </div>

      {/* Signature pad */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
            Parent Signature
          </div>
          {hasInk && (
            <button
              onClick={handleClear}
              style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.textMuted, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, padding: 0 }}
            >
              <RotateCcw size={12} /> Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div style={{
          border: `2px solid ${hasInk ? brand.gold : brand.border}`, borderRadius: 8,
          background: brand.darkest, overflow: 'hidden', cursor: 'crosshair',
          transition: 'border-color 0.2s',
        }}>
          <SignatureCanvas
            ref={sigCanvasRef}
            penColor={brand.gold}
            canvasProps={{
              width: 700,
              height: 160,
              style: { width: '100%', height: 160, display: 'block' },
            }}
            onEnd={handleStroke}
          />
        </div>
        {!hasInk && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 6, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            Have the parent sign with their finger or a mouse
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
        <OButton variant="secondary" icon={ChevronLeft} onClick={onBack} disabled={submitting}>Back</OButton>
        <OButton
          variant="gold"
          icon={ChevronRight}
          onClick={handleSign}
          disabled={!hasInk || submitting}
        >
          {submitting ? 'Saving…' : 'I Agree & Sign'}
        </OButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Step 4 inner: Stripe PaymentElement ───────────────────────────────────

function PaymentForm({
  form,
  plans,
  clientSecret,
  intentType,
  connectedAccountId,
  enrollmentIds,
  onSuccess,
  onBack,
}: {
  form: FormData;
  plans: MembershipPlan[];
  clientSecret: string;
  intentType: 'setup' | 'payment';
  connectedAccountId: string | null;
  enrollmentIds: { familyId: string; kidId: string; membershipId: string } | null;
  onSuccess: () => void;
  onBack: () => void;
}) {
  const stripe = useStripe();
  const elements = useElements();
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [paymentError, setPaymentError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const selectedPlan = plans.find(p => p.id === form.planId);

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (!stripe || !elements || !enrollmentIds) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    setPaymentError(null);

    const { error: submitErr } = await elements.submit();
    if (submitErr) {
      setPaymentError(submitErr.message ?? 'Payment error');
      setSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    // Confirm the intent — EFT uses SetupIntent, OTC uses PaymentIntent
    let stripeIntentId: string | undefined;

    if (intentType === 'payment') {
      const { error: confirmErr, paymentIntent } = await stripe.confirmPayment({
        elements,
        confirmParams: { return_url: window.location.href },
        redirect: 'if_required',
      });
      if (confirmErr) {
        setPaymentError(confirmErr.message ?? 'Payment failed');
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      if (!paymentIntent?.id || paymentIntent.status !== 'succeeded') {
        setPaymentError('Payment did not complete. Please try again.');
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      stripeIntentId = paymentIntent.id;
    } else {
      const { error: confirmErr, setupIntent } = await stripe.confirmSetup({
        elements,
        confirmParams: { return_url: window.location.href },
        redirect: 'if_required',
      });
      if (confirmErr) {
        setPaymentError(confirmErr.message ?? 'Payment authorisation failed');
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      if (!setupIntent?.id) {
        setPaymentError('Payment authorisation incomplete. Please try again.');
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      stripeIntentId = setupIntent.id;
    }

    // Attach payment method to family + activate membership
    const attachRes = await fetch('/api/owner/enroll/attach-payment', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        family_id: enrollmentIds.familyId,
        membership_id: enrollmentIds.membershipId,
        stripe_intent_id: stripeIntentId,
        intent_type: intentType,
        plan_type: selectedPlan?.plan_type ?? 'eft',
        connected_account_id: connectedAccountId,
      }),
    });

    if (!attachRes.ok) {
      const attachData = await attachRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as { error?: string };
      setPaymentError(attachData.error ?? 'Failed to activate membership. Please contact support.');
      setSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    // Guard: only proceed to confirmation when activation succeeded
    const attachData = await attachRes.json().catch(() => ({})) as { ok?: boolean; activated?: boolean };
    if (!attachData.activated) {
      setPaymentError('Membership activation did not complete. Please contact support.');
      setSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    onSuccess();
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {selectedPlan && (
        <div style={{
          background: `${brand.gold}14`, border: `1px solid ${brand.goldDeep}`,
          borderRadius: 8, padding: '12px 16px', marginBottom: 20,
          display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
        }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.gold }}>{selectedPlan.name}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
              {selectedPlan.plan_type === 'eft' ? 'Monthly EFT autopay' : 'One-time payment'}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.gold }}>
            ${(selectedPlan.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
        <PaymentElement options={{ layout: 'tabs' }} />
      </div>

      {paymentError && (
        <div style={{ padding: '10px 14px', background: brand.dangerBg, borderRadius: 8, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 16 }}>
          {paymentError}
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
        <OButton variant="secondary" icon={ChevronLeft} onClick={onBack} disabled={submitting}>Back</OButton>
        <OButton
          variant="gold"
          icon={CreditCard}
          onClick={handleConfirm}
          disabled={!stripe || !elements || submitting || !enrollmentIds}
        >
          {submitting ? 'Processing…' : selectedPlan?.plan_type === 'eft' ? 'Authorize & Activate' : 'Pay & Activate'}
        </OButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Step 4: Payment ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function Step4({
  form,
  plans,
  stripePublishableKey,
  enrollmentIds,
  onSuccess,
  onBack,
}: {
  form: FormData;
  plans: MembershipPlan[];
  stripePublishableKey: string | null;
  enrollmentIds: { familyId: string; kidId: string; membershipId: string } | null;
  onSuccess: () => void;
  onBack: () => void;
}) {
  const [stripePromise, setStripePromise] = useState<ReturnType<typeof loadStripe> | null>(null);
  const [clientSecret, setClientSecret] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [intentType, setIntentType] = useState<'setup' | 'payment'>('setup');
  const [connectedAccountId, setConnectedAccountId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const selectedPlan = plans.find(p => p.id === form.planId);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!stripePublishableKey) {
      setError('Stripe is not configured for this tenant. Contact support to set up payment processing.');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (!enrollmentIds?.membershipId) {
      setError('Enrollment data missing. Please go back and try again.');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    fetch('/api/owner/enroll/setup-intent', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        membership_id: enrollmentIds.membershipId,
        customer_email: form.parentEmail,
        customer_name: `${form.parentFirstName} ${form.parentLastName}`.trim(),
      }),
    })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then((data: { client_secret?: string; intent_type?: string; connected_account_id?: string; error?: string }) => {
        if (data.error || !data.client_secret) {
          setError(data.error ?? 'Could not initialize payment');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        setClientSecret(data.client_secret);
        setIntentType(data.intent_type === 'payment' ? 'payment' : 'setup');
        setConnectedAccountId(data.connected_account_id ?? null);

        const opts = data.connected_account_id
          ? { stripeAccount: data.connected_account_id }
          : undefined;
        setStripePromise(loadStripe(stripePublishableKey, opts));
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(e => { setError(String(e)); setLoading(false); });
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [stripePublishableKey, enrollmentIds?.membershipId, form.parentEmail, form.parentFirstName, form.parentLastName]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h2 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, marginBottom: 24 }}>Payment</h2>
        <div style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13, textAlign: 'center', padding: '32px 0' }}>Initializing secure payment…</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    const isStripeNotConfigured = error.includes('Stripe account not configured');
    return (
      <div>
        <h2 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, marginBottom: 16 }}>Payment</h2>
        <div style={{ padding: '14px 16px', background: brand.dangerBg, borderRadius: 8, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 20 }}>
          <div>{error}</div>
          {isStripeNotConfigured && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 10, fontSize: 12, color: brand.danger }}>
              Go to <a href="/owner/payments" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ color: brand.danger, fontWeight: 700, textDecoration: 'underline' }}>Payments settings</a> to connect a Stripe account for this location, then return here to complete enrollment.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
          <OButton variant="secondary" icon={ChevronLeft} onClick={onBack}>Back</OButton>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!stripePromise || !clientSecret) return null;

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, marginBottom: 16 }}>Payment</h2>
      <Elements
        stripe={stripePromise}
        options={{
          clientSecret,
          appearance: {
            theme: 'night',
            variables: {
              colorPrimary: brand.gold,
              colorBackground: brand.darker,
              colorText: brand.text,
              colorDanger: brand.danger,
              borderRadius: '8px',
              fontFamily: fonts.body,
            },
          },
        }}
      >
        <PaymentForm
          form={form}
          plans={plans}
          clientSecret={clientSecret}
          intentType={intentType}
          connectedAccountId={connectedAccountId}
          enrollmentIds={enrollmentIds}
          onSuccess={onSuccess}
          onBack={onBack}
        />
      </Elements>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Confirmation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ConfirmationScreen({
  form, plans, onEnrollAnother, onViewMember, memberId,
}: {
  form: FormData;
  plans: MembershipPlan[];
  onEnrollAnother: () => void;
  onViewMember: () => void;
  memberId: string | null;
}) {
  const selectedPlan = plans.find(p => p.id === form.planId);

  return (
    <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '32px 0' }}>
      <div style={{
        width: 72, height: 72, borderRadius: 36,
        background: brand.successBg, border: `2px solid ${brand.success}`,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        margin: '0 auto 20px',
      }}>
        <CheckCircle size={36} color={brand.success} strokeWidth={2} />
      </div>
      <h2 style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text, marginBottom: 8 }}>
        Enrollment Complete!
      </h2>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 15, color: brand.textLight, marginBottom: 4 }}>
        <strong style={{ color: brand.gold }}>{form.kidFirstName}{form.kidLastName ? ' ' + form.kidLastName : ''}</strong> is now enrolled.
      </p>
      {selectedPlan && (
        <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 4 }}>
          Plan: {selectedPlan.name} · ${(selectedPlan.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}{selectedPlan.plan_type === 'eft' ? '/mo' : ' one-time'}
        </p>
      )}
      <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 28 }}>
        A welcome email has been sent to <strong style={{ color: brand.text }}>{form.parentEmail}</strong>.
      </p>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, justifyContent: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <OButton variant="secondary" icon={UserPlus} onClick={onEnrollAnother}>
          Enroll Another
        </OButton>
        {memberId && (
          <OButton variant="gold" icon={ChevronRight} onClick={onViewMember}>
            View Member
          </OButton>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const INITIAL_FORM: FormData = {
  parentFirstName: '', parentLastName: '', parentEmail: '', parentPhone: '',
  kidFirstName: '', kidLastName: '', ageGroup: '', planId: '', locationId: '',
};

export function EnrollContent({ waiver, stripePublishableKey, locations }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>(1);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormData>(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<MembershipPlan[]>([]);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [enrollmentIds, setEnrollmentIds] = useState<{
    familyId: string; kidId: string; membershipId: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Auto-select the only location when there is exactly one
  useEffect(() => {
    if (locations.length === 1) {
      setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, locationId: locations[0].id }));
    }
  }, [locations]);

  // Preload plans in the background
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/owner/membership-plans')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then((data: MembershipPlan[] | { error: string }) => {
        if (Array.isArray(data)) setPlans(data);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const handleStep1Next = () => { setSubmitError(null); setStep(2); };
  const handleStep2Next = () => { setSubmitError(null); setStep(3); };
  const handleStep3Next = useCallback(async (signatureDataUrl: string) => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/owner/enroll', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          parent_first_name: form.parentFirstName,
          parent_last_name: form.parentLastName,
          parent_email: form.parentEmail,
          parent_phone: form.parentPhone || undefined,
          kid_first_name: form.kidFirstName,
          kid_last_name: form.kidLastName || undefined,
          age_group: form.ageGroup || undefined,
          plan_id: form.planId,
          waiver_id: waiver?.id,
          signature_image_data: signatureDataUrl,
          location_id: form.locationId || undefined,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as {
        ok?: boolean;
        family_id?: string;
        kid_id?: string;
        membership_id?: string;
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
        setSubmitError(data.error ?? `Error ${res.status}`);
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      setEnrollmentIds({
        familyId: data.family_id!,
        kidId: data.kid_id!,
        membershipId: data.membership_id!,
      });
      setStep(4);
    } catch (e) {
      setSubmitError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Enrollment failed');
    }
    setSubmitting(false);
  }, [form, waiver]);

  const handlePaymentSuccess = () => setStep(5);

  const handleEnrollAnother = () => {
    const defaultLocationId = locations.length === 1 ? locations[0].id : '';
    setForm({ ...INITIAL_FORM, locationId: defaultLocationId });
    setEnrollmentIds(null);
    setSubmitError(null);
    setStep(1);
  };

  const handleViewMember = () => {
    if (enrollmentIds?.membershipId) {
      router.push(`/owner/members/${enrollmentIds.membershipId}`);
    } else {
      router.push('/owner/members');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      minHeight: '100vh', background: brand.darkest,
      display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column',
    }}>
      {/* Top bar */}
      <div style={{
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
        padding: '16px 32px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
        background: brand.darker,
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
          <button
            onClick={() => router.push('/owner/members')}
            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.textMuted, cursor: 'pointer', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: 13, padding: 0 }}
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} /> Members
          </button>
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.gold, letterSpacing: 1 }}>
          ENROLL NEW MEMBER
        </div>
        <div style={{ width: 80 }} />
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '40px 24px' }}>
        <div style={{
          width: '100%', maxWidth: 760,
          background: brand.surface,
          border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
          borderRadius: 14,
          padding: '36px 40px',
          boxShadow: '0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
        }}>
          {/* Step bar — only show during steps 1-4 */}
          {step < 5 && <StepBar current={step} />}

          {/* Submit error from step 3 (enrollment API) */}
          {submitError && step === 4 && (
            <div style={{
              padding: '12px 16px', background: brand.dangerBg, borderRadius: 8,
              color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 20,
              display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
            }}>
              <span>{submitError}</span>
              <button onClick={() => setSubmitError(null)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 16, padding: 0, marginLeft: 12 }}>×</button>
            </div>
          )}

          {step === 1 && (
            <Step1 form={form} setForm={setForm} onNext={handleStep1Next} locations={locations} />
          )}

          {step === 2 && (
            <Step2 form={form} setForm={setForm} onNext={handleStep2Next} onBack={() => setStep(1)} />
          )}

          {step === 3 && (
            <>
              {submitError && (
                <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', background: brand.dangerBg, borderRadius: 8, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 20 }}>
                  {submitError}
                  <button onClick={() => setSubmitError(null)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 16, padding: 0, marginLeft: 12 }}>×</button>
                </div>
              )}
              <Step3
                waiver={waiver}
                form={form}
                onNext={handleStep3Next}
                onBack={() => setStep(2)}
              />
              {submitting && (
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13, marginTop: 16 }}>
                  Creating account and uploading signature…
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          {step === 4 && (
            <Step4
              form={form}
              plans={plans}
              stripePublishableKey={stripePublishableKey}
              enrollmentIds={enrollmentIds}
              onSuccess={handlePaymentSuccess}
              onBack={() => setStep(3)}
            />
          )}

          {step === 5 && (
            <ConfirmationScreen
              form={form}
              plans={plans}
              memberId={enrollmentIds?.familyId ?? null}
              onEnrollAnother={handleEnrollAnother}
              onViewMember={handleViewMember}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { EnrollContent } from './EnrollContent';

export const metadata = {
  title: 'Enroll New Member — Ballpark',
};

export default async function EnrollPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect('/login?reason=unauthenticated');

  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== 'owner' && role !== 'admin') redirect('/owner/members');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';

  const serviceClient = createServiceClient();

  // Load waiver + locations in parallel
  const [{ data: waiver }, { data: locations }] = await Promise.all([
    serviceClient
      .from('waivers')
      .select('id, version, effective_date, body_text')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('is_active', true)
      .maybeSingle(),
    serviceClient
      .from('locations')
      .select('id, name, stripe_onboarding_status')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .order('name'),
  ]);

  const stripePublishableKey = process.env.STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ?? null;

  const locationList = (locations ?? []) as Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    stripe_onboarding_status: string | null;
  }>;

  return (
    <EnrollContent
      waiver={waiver ? {
        id: waiver.id as string,
        version: waiver.version as number,
        effective_date: waiver.effective_date as string,
        body_text: waiver.body_text as string,
      } : null}
      stripePublishableKey={stripePublishableKey}
      locations={locationList}
    />
  );
}

"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole } from "@/lib/auth";

export async function signIn(formData: FormData) {
  const email = String(formData.get("email") ?? "").trim();
  const password = String(formData.get("password") ?? "");

  if (!email || !password) {
    redirect("/login?reason=missing");
  }

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
    email,
    password,
  });

  if (error || !data.session) {
    redirect("/login?reason=invalid");
  }

  const role = readAppRole(data.session);

  if (role === "parent") {
    // Parents are not allowed in the portal. Drop the session and bounce
    // them back to /login with a friendly message.
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    redirect("/login?reason=parent");
  }

  if (role === "admin") redirect("/admin");
  if (role === "owner") redirect("/owner/dashboard");
  redirect("/coach/inbox");
}

export async function signOut() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  await supabase.auth.signOut();
  redirect("/login");
}

FILE: portal/app/logout/route.ts
=================================================================================
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

/**
 * Sign-out endpoint. Implemented as a Route Handler (not invoked from a
 * Server Component) because cookie writes are only allowed in Route
 * Handlers and Server Actions. Layouts that need to evict a session
 * (e.g. a parent who reached a coach/admin route) `redirect()` here.
 *
 * `?reason=parent` is preserved so the login screen can show the
 * "this portal is for coaches and admins" message after the redirect.
 *
 * URL construction: Replit's proxy routes all external traffic to the
 * portal (port 3000) regardless of the URL port suffix, so
 * `request.nextUrl` can carry a host of `0.0.0.0:5000` (the Expo Metro
 * server port). We use the `x-forwarded-host` / `x-forwarded-proto`
 * headers set by the proxy when available. For direct container access
 * we normalise any raw-IP host to port 3000.
 */
async function handler(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  await supabase.auth.signOut();

  const reason = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("reason") ?? "signedout";

  const forwardedHost = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-host");
  const forwardedProto =
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto") ?? "https";

  let loginUrl: URL;

  if (forwardedHost) {
    // x-forwarded-host can be a comma-separated list when multiple proxies
    // are in play; take only the first (outermost) token and strip whitespace.
    const safeHost = forwardedHost.split(",")[0].trim();
    loginUrl = new URL(
      `/login?reason=${encodeURIComponent(reason)}`,
      `${forwardedProto}://${safeHost}`,
    );
  } else {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    const rawIP = /^(0\.0\.0\.0|127\.0\.0\.1|localhost)$/.test(url.hostname);
    if (rawIP) url.port = "3000";
    url.pathname = "/login";
    url.search = "";
    url.searchParams.set("reason", reason);
    loginUrl = url;
  }

  return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
}

export const GET = handler;
export const POST = handler;

type LoadingKey = `${string}-email` | `${string}-free_session`;

type CampaignState =
  | { status: 'idle' }
  | { status: 'sending'; sent: number; total: number }
  | { status: 'done'; succeeded: number; skipped: number; failed: number; notConfigured: boolean };

// ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function AtRiskContent({ members: rawMembers }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<Set<LoadingKey>>(new Set());
  const [campaign, setCampaign] = useState<CampaignState>({ status: 'idle' });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (toast) { const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 5000); return () => clearTimeout(t); }
  }, [toast]);

  const atRisk = rawMembers.filter(
    m => (m.status === 'active' || m.status === 'at-risk' || m.status === 'paused') &&
         (m.churnRisk === 'high' || m.churnRisk === 'medium'),
  );
  const totalMrr = atRisk.reduce((s, m) => s + m.mrr, 0);

  const handleCampaign = async () => {
    const withEmail = atRisk.filter(m => m.parentEmail);
    if (withEmail.length === 0) {
      setToast('No at-risk members have an email address on file');
      return;
    }

    setCampaign({ status: 'sending', sent: 0, total: withEmail.length });

    let succeeded = 0;
    let failed = 0;
    let skipped = 0;
    let notConfigured = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < withEmail.length; i++) {
      const m = withEmail[i];
      setCampaign({ status: 'sending', sent: i, total: withEmail.length });
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/owner/send-reengagement', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ parentName: m.parent, parentEmail: m.parentEmail, kidName: m.name, type: 'email' }),
        });
        const data = await res.json() as { success?: boolean; skipped?: boolean; error?: string };
        if (!res.ok || data.error) {
          failed++;
        } else if (data.skipped) {
          skipped++;
          notConfigured = true;
        } else {
          succeeded++;
        }
      } catch {
        failed++;
      }
    }

    setCampaign({ status: 'done', succeeded, skipped, failed, notConfigured });
  };

  const dismissCampaignResult = () => setCampaign({ status: 'idle' });

  async function sendReengagement(m: OwnerMember, type: 'email' | 'free_session') {
    const key: LoadingKey = `${m.id}-${type}`;
    const parentEmail = m.parentEmail;

    if (!parentEmail) {
      setToast(`No email on file for ${m.parent} — contact them directly`);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(prev => new Set(prev).add(key));
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/owner/send-reengagement', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ parentName: m.parent, parentEmail, kidName: m.name, type }),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as { success?: boolean; skipped?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || data.error) {
        setToast(`Failed to send email: ${data.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`);
      } else if (data.skipped) {
        setToast(`Email not configured — contact your admin to set up Resend (${parentEmail})`);
      } else {
        setToast(type === 'email'
          ? `Re-engagement email sent to ${m.parent} (${parentEmail})`
          : `Free session offer sent to ${m.parent} for ${m.name} (${parentEmail})`);
      }
    } catch {
      setToast('Network error — email not sent');
    } finally {
      setLoading(prev => { const s = new Set(prev); s.delete(key); return s; });
    }
  }

  function copyPhone(m: OwnerMember) {
    const phone = m.parentPhone;
    if (!phone) {
      setToast(`No phone number on file for ${m.parent}`);
      return;
    }
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(phone).then(() => {
      setToast(`${m.parent}'s number copied: ${phone}`);
    }).catch(() => {
      setToast(`Phone: ${phone}`);
    });
  }

  const campaignIsSending = campaign.status === 'sending';


  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="At-Risk Members"
        subtitle={`${atRisk.length} member${atRisk.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} flagged · $${totalMrr.toLocaleString()} monthly revenue at risk`}
        actions={
          <OButton
            variant="gold"
            icon={campaignIsSending ? Loader2 : Send}
            onClick={handleCampaign}
            disabled={campaignIsSending}
          >
            {campaignIsSending
              ? `Sending ${campaign.sent + 1} of ${campaign.total}…`
              : 'Send Re-engagement Campaign'}
          </OButton>
        }
      />

      {/* Campaign result banner */}
      {campaign.status === 'done' && (
        <div style={{ margin: '0 24px', padding: '12px 16px', background: campaign.notConfigured ? `${brand.warning}22` : campaign.failed > 0 ? `${brand.danger}22` : `${brand.success}22`, border: `1px solid ${campaign.notConfigured ? brand.warning : campaign.failed > 0 ? brand.danger : brand.success}44`, borderRadius: 8, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginBottom: 4 }}>
          {campaign.notConfigured
            ? <AlertCircle size={16} color={brand.warning} />
            : <CheckCircle2 size={16} color={campaign.failed > 0 ? brand.danger : brand.success} />}
          <div style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 13 }}>
            {campaign.notConfigured
              ? <><strong>Email not configured</strong> — contact your admin to set up Resend. {campaign.succeeded} sent, {campaign.skipped} skipped.</>
              : <>Campaign complete — <strong>{campaign.succeeded} sent</strong>{campaign.failed > 0 ? `, ${campaign.failed} failed` : ''}{campaign.skipped > 0 ? `, ${campaign.skipped} skipped (no email)` : ''}.</>}
          </div>
          <button onClick={dismissCampaignResult} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 18, lineHeight: 1 }}>×</button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
        {atRisk.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 40, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={48} color={brand.success} style={{ margin: '0 auto 12px' }} />
            <div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display }}>No at-risk members — keep it up!</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>Every active member has engaged within the last 21 days and has no failed payments.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>

                        <OButton variant="gold" size="sm" icon={Phone} onClick={() => copyPhone(m)}>Call Parent</OButton>
                        <OButton
                          variant="secondary" size="sm"
                          icon={emailLoading ? Loader2 : Mail}
                          onClick={() => sendReengagement(m, 'email')}
                          disabled={emailLoading || campaignIsSending}
                        >
                          {emailLoading ? 'Sending…' : 'Send Email'}
                        </OButton>
                        <OButton
                          variant="secondary" size="sm"
                          icon={freeLoading ? Loader2 : Gift}
                          onClick={() => sendReengagement(m, 'free_session')}
                          disabled={freeLoading || campaignIsSending}
                        >
                          {freeLoading ? 'Sending…' : 'Offer Free Session'}
                        </OButton>
                        <OButton variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => router.push(`/owner/members/${m.id}`)}>View Profile →</OButton>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </OCard>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 420 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function formatFetchedAt(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const h = d.getHours();
  const m = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const hour12 = h % 12 || 12;
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()} at ${hour12}:${m} ${ampm}`;
}
