FILE: portal/app/owner/billing/page.tsx
=================================================================================
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { getBillingData, getLocationsStripeStatus } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { fetchLocationMrr } from '@/lib/stripe/mrrUtils';
import { BillingContent } from './BillingContent';

export default async function BillingPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';

  const [data, locations] = await Promise.all([
    getBillingData(supabase, tenantId),
    getLocationsStripeStatus(supabase, tenantId),
  ]);

  // Fetch live MRR from all connected Stripe accounts.
  // When we have a configured Stripe key and at least one connected location,
  // Stripe is the AUTHORITATIVE source for MRR — even if the result is 0
  // (which is a valid state: no active subscriptions yet).
  // We only fall back to the DB-derived value when Stripe is not configured
  // or no locations are connected (i.e., we genuinely cannot reach Stripe).
  const stripeKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY;
  const connectedLocations = (locations ?? []).filter(
    l => l.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected' && l.stripe_account_id,
  );

  const stripeConfigured = Boolean(stripeKey && connectedLocations.length > 0);
  let stripeMrrCents = 0;
  let stripeSubCount = 0;
  let stripeAnySucceeded = false;

  if (stripeConfigured && stripeKey) {
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      connectedLocations.map(l => fetchLocationMrr(stripeKey, l.stripe_account_id!)),
    );
    for (const r of results) {
      if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
        stripeMrrCents += r.value.mrrCents;
        stripeSubCount += r.value.activeCount;
        stripeAnySucceeded = true;
      } else {
        // Partial failure — log but still aggregate the accounts that succeeded
        console.error('[billing/page] Stripe MRR fetch error for one account:', r.reason);
      }
    }
  }

  // Use Stripe MRR when at least one connected account fetch succeeded.
  // Partial aggregation: if 3 accounts are connected and 1 fails, we still
  // show live data from the 2 that succeeded rather than falling back to DB.
  // Only fall back to DB when no Stripe data at all could be fetched.
  const useStripeMrr = stripeAnySucceeded;

  const enrichedData = useStripeMrr
    ? {
        ...data,
        kpis: {
          ...data.kpis,
          mrr: stripeMrrCents / 100,
          // Use Stripe-authoritative count including zero — a live count of 0
          // is a valid state (no active subscriptions yet) and should not be
          // masked by the stale DB-derived value.
          activeMembers: stripeSubCount,
        },
      }
    : data;

  return <BillingContent data={enrichedData} />;
}

          <KPICard label="Lost MRR (EFT)"   value={`$${lostMrr.toLocaleString()}`}            icon={DollarSign} color="warning" />
          <KPICard label="Unused Sessions"  value={unusedSessions}                            icon={Package}   color={unusedSessions > 0 ? 'warning' : 'default'} />
        </div>

        {/* Date range filter */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 20, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {presets.map(p => (
            <div
              key={p.id}
              onClick={() => handlePreset(p.id)}
              style={{
                padding: '7px 14px', borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700,
                background: activePreset === p.id ? brand.dark : brand.surface,
                color: activePreset === p.id ? brand.gold : brand.textMuted,
                border: `1px solid ${activePreset === p.id ? brand.dark : brand.border}`,
                cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase',
              }}
            >
              {p.label}
            </div>
          ))}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginLeft: 8 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 600 }}>Custom:</span>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={customDate}
              onChange={e => setCustomDate(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                padding: '6px 10px', border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 7,
                fontSize: 12, color: brand.text, background: brand.surface, outline: 'none',
              }}
            />
            <OButton variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={handleCustomDate}>Apply</OButton>
          </div>
        </div>

        {raw.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: brand.textMuted }}>
            No cancellations in this period.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <OTable
            columns={columns as TableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]}
            rows={raw as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 380 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { getCancelledMemberships } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { CancellationsContent } from './CancellationsContent';

export default async function CancellationsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ preset?: string; since?: string }>;
}) {
  const params = await searchParams;

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';

  const preset = params.preset ?? '30';
  let since: Date;

  if (params.since) {
    since = new Date(params.since);
    if (isNaN(since.getTime())) since = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000);
  } else {
    const days = preset === '90' ? 90 : preset === 'all' ? 365 : 30;
    since = new Date(Date.now() - days * 86_400_000);
  }

  const memberships = await getCancelledMemberships(supabase, tenantId, since);

  return (
    <CancellationsContent
      memberships={memberships}
      activePreset={params.since ? 'custom' : preset}
      sinceIso={since.toISOString()}
    />
  );
}

export function ChurnAnalysisContent({ data }: Props) {
  const { retentionRate, churnReasons: rawChurnReasons } = data;
  const monthlyChurn = Math.round((100 - retentionRate) * 10) / 10;
  const annualChurn  = Math.round(monthlyChurn * 12 * 10) / 10;

  const hasLiveData    = rawChurnReasons.some(r => r.count > 0);
  const churnReasons   = hasLiveData ? rawChurnReasons.filter(r => r.count > 0) : DEMO_CHURN_REASONS;

  const lostRevenueYtd = hasLiveData ? churnReasons.reduce((s, r) => s + r.count * 280, 0) : 5880;
  const savesYtd       = hasLiveData ? 0 : 14;

  const tenureBars = hasLiveData ? [
    { label: '0-30d',  value: 0,  highlight: false },

    { label: '3-6mo',  value: 0,  highlight: false },
    { label: '6-12mo', value: 0,  highlight: false },
    { label: '1-2yr',  value: 0,  highlight: false },
    { label: '2yr+',   value: 0,  highlight: false },
  ] : DEMO_TENURE_BARS;

  const ageBars = hasLiveData ? [
    { label: '8U',   value: 0, highlight: false },
    { label: '10U',  value: 0, highlight: false },
    { label: '11U',  value: 0, highlight: false },
    { label: '12U',  value: 0, highlight: false },
    { label: '13U',  value: 0, highlight: false },
    { label: '14U+', value: 0, highlight: false },
  ] : DEMO_AGE_BARS;

  return (

      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>

          <KPICard label="Monthly Churn"   value={`${monthlyChurn}%`}                          icon={TrendingDown} color={monthlyChurn < 5 ? 'success' : 'warning'} delta={-0.4} deltaLabel="vs last month" deltaInvert />
          <KPICard label="Annual Churn"    value={`${annualChurn}%`}                            icon={Activity}     color={annualChurn < 20 ? 'success' : 'warning'}  delta={-0.3} deltaLabel="vs last month" deltaInvert />
          <KPICard label="Lost Revenue YTD" value={`$${lostRevenueYtd.toLocaleString()}`}       icon={DollarSign}   color="warning" />

                <XCircle size={18} color={brand.danger} />

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>

FILE: portal/app/owner/coaches/actions.ts

"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole, readTenantId } from "@/lib/auth";

async function requireOwnerOrAdmin() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session) redirect("/login?reason=unauthenticated");
  const role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role !== "owner" && role !== "admin") redirect("/logout?reason=forbidden");
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);
  if (!tenantId) redirect("/logout?reason=no-tenant");
  return { supabase, tenantId };
}

/**
 * Update the `capabilities.preset` for a coach row. Only owner/admin may call
 * this. The preset must be "instructor" or "staff" — anything else is rejected.
 */
export async function updateCoachPreset(formData: FormData) {
  const coachId = (formData.get("coachId") as string | null) ?? "";
  const preset = (formData.get("preset") as string | null) ?? "";

  if (!coachId) throw new Error("coachId is required");
  if (preset !== "instructor" && preset !== "staff") {
    throw new Error(`Invalid preset: ${preset}`);
  }

  const { supabase, tenantId } = await requireOwnerOrAdmin();

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("coaches")
    .update({ capabilities: { preset } })
    .eq("id", coachId)
    .eq("tenant_id", tenantId);

  if (error) throw new Error(`Failed to update preset: ${error.message}`);

  revalidatePath("/owner/coaches");
}

function PresetBadge({ preset }: { preset: 'instructor' | 'staff' }) {
  const { label, color, bg, border, Icon } = PRESET_META[preset];
  return (

      background: bg, border: `1px solid ${border}`,

    }}>

    </span>

function PresetDropdown({
  coachId,
  current,
  disabled,
  onOptimistic,
}: {
  coachId: string;
  current: 'instructor' | 'staff';
  disabled: boolean;
  onOptimistic: (id: string, next: 'instructor' | 'staff') => void;
}) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const next = e.target.value as 'instructor' | 'staff';
    onOptimistic(coachId, next);
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('coachId', coachId);
    fd.append('preset', next);
    startTransition(() => { updateCoachPreset(fd).catch(console.error); });
  };

  if (disabled) {
    return <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>Demo mode</span>;
  }

  return (
    <select
      value={current}
      onChange={handleChange}
      disabled={pending}
      style={{
        padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
        fontFamily: fonts.display, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
        background: brand.surface, color: brand.text, cursor: 'pointer',
        opacity: pending ? 0.6 : 1,
      }}
    >
      <option value="instructor">Instructor</option>
      <option value="staff">Staff</option>
    </select>
  );
}

              border: `1px solid ${disabled ? brand.border : brand.dark}`,
              opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
              transition: 'opacity 0.15s',
            }}
          >
            <MessageCircle size={12} />
            Message
          </button>
        );
      },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Coach Management"
        subtitle={`${coaches.length} coach${coaches.length !== 1 ? 'es' : ''} on staff · ${totalStudents} total students`}
        actions={
          <>
            <OButton variant="secondary" icon={Download} onClick={handleExport}>Export</OButton>
            <OButton variant="gold" icon={Plus} onClick={() => setShowHireModal(true)}>Hire Coach</OButton>
          </>
        }
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <KPICard label="Staff Size"      value={coaches.length}    icon={UserCog} />
          <KPICard label="Avg Utilization" value={`${avgUtil}%`}     icon={Activity}   color="success" />
          <KPICard label="Avg Retention"   value={`${avgRet}%`}      icon={TrendingUp}  color="success" />
          <KPICard label="Total Students"  value={totalStudents}     icon={DollarSign}  color="gold" />
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginBottom: 8, padding: '10px 14px', background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
          <strong style={{ color: brand.text }}>Access Tiers:</strong>{' '}
          <span style={{ color: PRESET_META.instructor.color }}>Instructor</span> — training tools only (Inbox, Sessions, Assignments). {' '}
          <span style={{ color: PRESET_META.staff.color }}>Staff</span> — adds operational sections (Schedule, Check-In, Families, Redemptions). Changes take effect on the coach&apos;s next login.
        </div>

        <SectionHeader title="Coach Roster — Performance" />
        <OTable
          columns={columns as TableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]}
          rows={coaches as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]}
        />

        {coaches.length > 1 && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 20 }}>
            <OCard>
              <SectionHeader title="Utilization Distribution" />
              <BarChart
                data={coaches.map(c => ({
                  label:     c.name.split(' ').pop()?.substring(0, 8) ?? c.name.substring(0, 8),
                  value:     c.utilization,
                  highlight: c.utilization >= 85,
                }))}
                height={180}
              />
            </OCard>

            <OCard>
              <SectionHeader title="Retention by Coach" subtitle="Student retention per coach" />
              {[...coaches].sort((a, b) => b.retention - a.retention).map((c, i, arr) => (
                <div key={c.id} style={{ padding: '10px 0', borderBottom: i < arr.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${brand.border}` : 'none', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 }}>{c.name}</div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 8, background: brand.border, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                    <div style={{ width: `${c.retention}%`, height: '100%', background: c.retention >= 90 ? brand.success : brand.warning }} />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: c.retention >= 90 ? brand.success : brand.warning, width: 50, textAlign: 'right' }}>{c.retention}%</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </OCard>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {activeCoach && (
        <CoachMessagePanel
          coach={activeCoach}
          tenantId={tenantId}
          onClose={() => setActiveCoach(null)}
        />
      )}

      {showHireModal && (
        <div
          onClick={() => setShowHireModal(false)}
          style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)', zIndex: 200, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}
        >
          <div
            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{ width: 460, background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, boxShadow: '0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)', overflow: 'hidden' }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '18px 24px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display }}>Hire New Coach</div>
              <div onClick={() => setShowHireModal(false)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4 }}><X size={16} color={brand.textMuted} /></div>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleHireSubmit} style={{ padding: 24 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Full Name</label>
                  <input required style={inputStyle} value={hireForm.name} onChange={e => setHireForm(f => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Alex Johnson" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Email</label>
                  <input required type="email" style={inputStyle} value={hireForm.email} onChange={e => setHireForm(f => ({ ...f, email: e.target.value }))} placeholder="alex@infinitehitting.com" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Specialty</label>
                  <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} value={hireForm.specialty} onChange={e => setHireForm(f => ({ ...f, specialty: e.target.value }))}>
                    <option>Hitting / Power</option>
                    <option>Pitching / Mechanics</option>
                    <option>Fielding / Speed</option>
                    <option>Catching / Defence</option>
                    <option>General / Multi-skill</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Weekly Hours</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" max="60" style={inputStyle} value={hireForm.weeklyHours} onChange={e => setHireForm(f => ({ ...f, weeklyHours: e.target.value }))} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: '12px 14px', background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderRadius: 8, marginBottom: 20, fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                An invitation email will be sent to the coach. They&apos;ll set their password and appear in the roster once they complete onboarding.
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                <OButton variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShowHireModal(false)}>Cancel</OButton>
                <OButton variant="gold" icon={Plus}>Send Invitation</OButton>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 380 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/app/owner/coaches/CoachMessagePanel.tsx
=================================================================================
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { X, Send, Video, Loader, CheckCircle, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import type { OwnerCoach } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';

type FamilyRecipient = {
  familyId: string;
  parentName: string;
  kids: { kidId: string; kidName: string }[];
};

type Props = {
  coach: OwnerCoach;
  tenantId: string;
  onClose: () => void;
};

type UploadState = 'idle' | 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error';

export function CoachMessagePanel({ coach, tenantId, onClose }: Props) {
  const [families, setFamilies] = useState<FamilyRecipient[]>([]);
  const [familiesLoading, setFamiliesLoading] = useState(true);
  const [familiesError, setFamiliesError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [selectedFamilyId, setSelectedFamilyId] = useState('');
  const [selectedKidId, setSelectedKidId] = useState('');
  const [messageText, setMessageText] = useState('');

  const [videoId, setVideoId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [videoFileName, setVideoFileName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploadState, setUploadState] = useState<UploadState>('idle');
  const [uploadPct, setUploadPct] = useState(0);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [sendError, setSendError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/owner/families')
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((data: FamilyRecipient[] | { error: string }) => {
        if ('error' in data) {
          setFamiliesError(String(data.error));
        } else {
          setFamilies(data);
          if (data.length > 0) {
            setSelectedFamilyId(data[0].familyId);
            setSelectedKidId(data[0].kids[0]?.kidId ?? '');
          }
        }
      })
      .catch((e: unknown) => setFamiliesError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load families.'))
      .finally(() => setFamiliesLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const selectedFamily = families.find((f) => f.familyId === selectedFamilyId) ?? null;

  const handleFamilyChange = (familyId: string) => {
    setSelectedFamilyId(familyId);
    const fam = families.find((f) => f.familyId === familyId);
    setSelectedKidId(fam?.kids[0]?.kidId ?? '');
  };

  const handleFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setUploadState('uploading');
    setUploadPct(0);
    setUploadError(null);
    setVideoId(null);
    setVideoFileName(file.name);

    let uploadUrl: string;
    let vid: string;
    try {
      const mintRes = await fetch('/api/owner/coach-message-uploads', { method: 'POST' });
      if (!mintRes.ok) {
        const err = await mintRes.json() as { error?: { message?: string } };
        throw new Error(err?.error?.message ?? `Upload service error (${mintRes.status})`);
      }
      const mintJson = await mintRes.json() as { upload_url: string; video_id: string };
      uploadUrl = mintJson.upload_url;
      vid = mintJson.video_id;
    } catch (err) {
      setUploadState('error');
      setUploadError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to start upload.');
      return;
    }

    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.upload.onprogress = (ev) => {
        if (ev.lengthComputable) setUploadPct(Math.round((ev.loaded / ev.total) * 100));
      };
      xhr.onload = () => {
        if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) resolve();
        else reject(new Error(`Mux upload failed: HTTP ${xhr.status}`));
      };
      xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Network error during video upload.'));
      xhr.open('PUT', uploadUrl);
      xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', file.type || 'video/mp4');
      xhr.send(file);
    }).then(() => {
      setVideoId(vid);
      setUploadState('done');
    }).catch((err: unknown) => {
      setUploadState('error');
      setUploadError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Upload failed.');
    });
  };

  const clearVideo = () => {
    setVideoId(null);
    setVideoFileName(null);
    setUploadState('idle');
    setUploadPct(0);
    setUploadError(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const canSend =
    !sending &&
    !sent &&
    !!selectedFamilyId &&
    !!selectedKidId &&
    (!!videoId || !!messageText.trim()) &&
    uploadState !== 'uploading';

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!canSend) return;
    setSending(true);
    setSendError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/owner/coach-messages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          coachUserId: coach.userId,
          familyId: selectedFamilyId,
          kidId: selectedKidId,
          tenantId,
          videoId: videoId ?? null,
          messageText: messageText.trim() || null,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json() as { error?: { message?: string } };
        throw new Error(err?.error?.message ?? `Send failed (${res.status})`);
      }
      setSent(true);
      setTimeout(onClose, 1800);
    } catch (err) {
      setSendError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to send message.');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div
        onClick={onClose}
        style={{
          position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)', zIndex: 999,
        }}
      />
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, width: 440,
        background: brand.surface, boxShadow: '-4px 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)',
        zIndex: 1000, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden',
      }}>
        <div style={{
          padding: '20px 24px 16px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          background: brand.dark,
        }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.goldDeep, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 1, fontFamily: fonts.display, textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 3 }}>
              Send Message
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.gold, letterSpacing: 0.3 }}>
              From {coach.name.toUpperCase()}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: brand.textLight, padding: 4, lineHeight: 1 }}
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: 24, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 20 }}>
          {sent ? (
            <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
              <CheckCircle size={48} color={brand.success} />
              <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.success }}>Message Sent!</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                The family will receive a notification and can view the message in the app.
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Recipient Family</label>
                {familiesLoading ? (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>
                    <Loader size={14} style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} /> Loading families…
                  </div>
                ) : familiesError ? (
                  <div style={{ color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13 }}>{familiesError}</div>
                ) : families.length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>No families found in this tenant.</div>
                ) : (
                  <select
                    value={selectedFamilyId}
                    onChange={(e) => handleFamilyChange(e.target.value)}
                    style={selectStyle}
                  >
                    {families.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.familyId} value={f.familyId}>{f.parentName} family</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                )}
              </div>

              {selectedFamily && selectedFamily.kids.length > 1 && (
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Kid</label>
                  <select
                    value={selectedKidId}
                    onChange={(e) => setSelectedKidId(e.target.value)}
                    style={selectStyle}
                  >
                    {selectedFamily.kids.map((k) => (
                      <option key={k.kidId} value={k.kidId}>{k.kidName}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Message</label>
                <textarea
                  value={messageText}
                  onChange={(e) => setMessageText(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Write a note to the family… (optional if sending a video)"
                  rows={4}
                  style={{
                    ...inputStyle,
                    resize: 'vertical', minHeight: 90, lineHeight: 1.5,
                  }}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label style={labelStyle}>Video (optional)</label>
                {uploadState === 'idle' && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
                      padding: '10px 16px', border: `1.5px dashed ${brand.borderStrong}`,
                      borderRadius: 8, background: brand.surfaceAlt, cursor: 'pointer',
                      color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
                      fontFamily: fonts.body, width: '100%',
                    }}
                  >
                    <Video size={16} /> Choose video file
                  </button>
                )}
                {uploadState === 'uploading' && (
                  <div style={{ padding: '10px 0' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, color: brand.textMuted, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                      <Loader size={14} style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} />
                      Uploading {videoFileName}… {uploadPct}%
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ height: 4, background: brand.border, borderRadius: 2, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                      <div style={{ width: `${uploadPct}%`, height: '100%', background: brand.goldDeep, transition: 'width 0.2s' }} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {uploadState === 'done' && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, padding: '8px 12px', background: brand.successBg, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.success}` }}>
                    <CheckCircle size={14} color={brand.success} />
                    <span style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 13, color: brand.success, fontWeight: 600 }}>{videoFileName}</span>
                    <button onClick={clearVideo} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: brand.textMuted, padding: 0, lineHeight: 1 }}>
                      <X size={14} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                {uploadState === 'error' && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13 }}>
                      <AlertCircle size={14} /> {uploadError}
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={clearVideo} style={{ ...btnStyle('secondary'), width: 'fit-content' }}>Try again</button>
                  </div>
                )}
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  type="file"
                  accept="video/*"
                  onChange={handleFileChange}
                  style={{ display: 'none' }}
                />
              </div>

              {sendError && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, color: brand.danger, fontSize: 13 }}>
                  <AlertCircle size={14} /> {sendError}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {!sent && (
          <div style={{ padding: '16px 24px', borderTop: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
            <button onClick={onClose} style={btnStyle('secondary')}>Cancel</button>
            <button
              onClick={handleSend}
              disabled={!canSend}
              style={{ ...btnStyle('gold'), flex: 1, opacity: canSend ? 1 : 0.5, cursor: canSend ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed' }}
            >
              {sending ? (
                <><Loader size={14} style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} /> Sending…</>
              ) : (
                <><Send size={14} /> Send Message</>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <style>{`@keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }`}</style>
    </>
  );
}

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 0.8,
  textTransform: 'uppercase', color: brand.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.display,
  marginBottom: 6,
};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block', width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px',
  border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 8,
  fontSize: 14, fontFamily: fonts.body, color: brand.text,
  background: brand.surface, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
};

const selectStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  ...inputStyle,
  cursor: 'pointer', appearance: 'auto',
};

function btnStyle(variant: 'gold' | 'secondary' | 'primary'): React.CSSProperties {
  const variants = {
    gold: { background: brand.gold, color: brand.dark, border: `1px solid ${brand.gold}` },
    secondary: { background: brand.white, color: brand.darker, border: `1px solid ${brand.borderStrong}` },
    primary: { background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, border: `1px solid ${brand.dark}` },
  };
  return {
    display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6,
    padding: '9px 18px', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700,
    fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase',
    cursor: 'pointer', ...variants[variant],
  };
}

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { getOwnerCoaches } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { CoachesContent } from './CoachesContent';

export default async function CoachesPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';
  const coaches = await getOwnerCoaches(supabase, tenantId);
  return <CoachesContent coaches={coaches} tenantId={tenantId} />;
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/app/owner/coach-hours/CoachHoursContent.tsx

'use client';

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { OButton, PageHeader, SectionHeader, OCard } from '@/components/owner/ui';
import { Download, Clock, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import type { CoachHoursRow } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { exportCsv } from '@/lib/exportCsv';

type Props = {
  rows: CoachHoursRow[] | null;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  defaultStart: string;
  defaultEnd: string;
};

export function CoachHoursContent({ rows, startDate, endDate, defaultStart, defaultEnd }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [start, setStart] = useState(startDate);
  const [end, setEnd] = useState(endDate);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dateError, setDateError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const isDefaultRange = start === defaultStart && end === defaultEnd;
  const heading = isDefaultRange
    ? 'Last 12 months'
    : `${start} – ${end}`;

  function applyFilter() {
    if (end < start) {
      setDateError('End date must be on or after the start date.');
      return;
    }
    setDateError(null);
    startTransition(() => {
      router.push(`/owner/coach-hours?start=${start}&end=${end}`);
    });
  }

  function handleExport() {
    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return;
    exportCsv(
      `coach-hours-${start}-to-${end}.csv`,
      rows as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[],
      [
        { label: 'Coach Name',  key: 'coach_name'      },
        { label: 'Confirmed',   key: 'confirmed_count'  },
        { label: 'Completed',   key: 'completed_count'  },
        { label: 'No-Shows',    key: 'no_show_count'    },
        { label: 'Cancelled',   key: 'cancelled_count'  },
        { label: 'Total Hours', key: 'total_hours'      },
      ],
    );
    setToast(`Exported ${rows.length} coach${rows.length !== 1 ? 'es' : ''} as CSV`);
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  }

  const safeRows      = rows ?? [];
  const totalHours     = safeRows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.total_hours, 0);
  const totalCompleted = safeRows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.completed_count, 0);

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Coach Hours Report"
        subtitle={`Sessions and logged hours by coach — ${heading}`}
        actions={
          <OButton variant="secondary" icon={Download} onClick={handleExport} disabled={!rows || rows.length === 0}>
            Export CSV
          </OButton>
        }
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>

        {/* ── Date range filter ── */}
        <OCard style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.8 }}>
              Date Range
            </div>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={start}
              onChange={e => setStart(e.target.value)}
              style={inputStyle}
            />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>to</span>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={end}
              onChange={e => setEnd(e.target.value)}
              style={inputStyle}
            />
            <OButton variant="gold" size="sm" onClick={applyFilter}>Apply</OButton>
          </div>
          {dateError && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 12, color: brand.warning, fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {dateError}
            </div>
          )}
        </OCard>

        {/* ── RPC error banner ── */}
        {rows === null && (
          <OCard style={{ marginBottom: 24, borderColor: brand.warning }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, color: brand.warning }}>
              <AlertCircle size={20} />
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 2 }}>Coach Hours data unavailable</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>
                  The <code>get_coach_hours</code> database function may not be deployed yet. Run the pending migration and try again.
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </OCard>
        )}

        {/* ── Summary KPIs ── */}
        {safeRows.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
            <SummaryCard label="Total Coaches" value={String(safeRows.length)} />
            <SummaryCard label="Completed Sessions" value={String(totalCompleted)} />
            <SummaryCard label="Total Hours" value={`${totalHours.toFixed(2)} hrs`} />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── Table ── */}
        <SectionHeader title="Hours by Coach" />

        {safeRows.length === 0 ? (
          <OCard>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '40px 0', color: brand.textMuted }}>
              <Clock size={32} color={brand.border} style={{ marginBottom: 12 }} />
              <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                {rows === null ? 'Report unavailable' : 'No sessions in this period'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                {rows === null
                  ? 'Check that the get_coach_hours function is deployed.'
                  : 'Try a different date range where bookings exist.'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </OCard>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
                  {[
                    { label: 'Coach Name',  align: 'left'  },
                    { label: 'Confirmed',   align: 'right' },
                    { label: 'Completed',   align: 'right' },
                    { label: 'No-Shows',    align: 'right' },
                    { label: 'Cancelled',   align: 'right' },
                    { label: 'Total Hours', align: 'right' },
                  ].map((h, i) => (
                    <th key={i} style={{
                      padding: '12px 16px',
                      textAlign: h.align as 'left' | 'right',
                      fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, color: brand.textMuted,
                      letterSpacing: 1, textTransform: 'uppercase',
                      fontFamily: fonts.display, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                    }}>
                      {h.label}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {safeRows.map((row, i) => (
                  <tr
                    key={row.coach_id}
                    style={{ borderBottom: i < safeRows.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${brand.border}` : 'none' }}
                  >
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 16px', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text }}>
                      {row.coach_name}
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 16px', textAlign: 'right', fontSize: 13, fontFamily: fonts.mono, color: brand.text }}>
                      {row.confirmed_count}
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 16px', textAlign: 'right', fontSize: 13, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.success }}>
                      {row.completed_count}
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 16px', textAlign: 'right', fontSize: 13, fontFamily: fonts.mono, color: row.no_show_count > 0 ? brand.warning : brand.textMuted }}>
                      {row.no_show_count}
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 16px', textAlign: 'right', fontSize: 13, fontFamily: fonts.mono, color: brand.textMuted }}>
                      {row.cancelled_count}
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 16px', textAlign: 'right', fontSize: 13, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.goldDeep }}>
                      {row.total_hours.toFixed(2)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  padding: '6px 10px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
  background: brand.surface,
  fontSize: 13,
  color: brand.text,
  fontFamily: fonts.mono,
};

function SummaryCard({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 18 }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 1, textTransform: 'uppercase', fontFamily: fonts.display, marginBottom: 8 }}>
        {label}
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.text, letterSpacing: -0.5 }}>
        {value}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/app/owner/coach-hours/page.tsx
=================================================================================
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { getCoachHours } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { CoachHoursContent } from './CoachHoursContent';

export default async function CoachHoursPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ start?: string; end?: string }>;
}) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';

  const now = new Date();
  const twelveMonthsAgo = new Date(now);
  twelveMonthsAgo.setFullYear(twelveMonthsAgo.getFullYear() - 1);
  const defaultStart = `${twelveMonthsAgo.getFullYear()}-${String(twelveMonthsAgo.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(twelveMonthsAgo.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const defaultEnd   = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const startDate = params.start ?? defaultStart;
  const endDate   = params.end   ?? defaultEnd;

  const rows = await getCoachHours(supabase, tenantId, startDate, endDate);

  return (
    <CoachHoursContent
      rows={rows}
      startDate={startDate}
      endDate={endDate}
      defaultStart={defaultStart}
      defaultEnd={defaultEnd}
    />
  );
}

                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.goldDeep, fontWeight: 700 }}>→</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    {/* Toast */}
    {toast && (
      <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 380 }}>

      </div>
    )}
    </>
  );
}

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { getTodayAtAGlanceData, getTenantName } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { TodayDashboardContent } from './TodayDashboardContent';

export const metadata = {
  title: 'Today at a Glance — Ballpark',
};

export default async function TodayDashboardPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';

  const [data, tenantName] = await Promise.all([
    getTodayAtAGlanceData(supabase, tenantId),
    getTenantName(supabase, tenantId),
  ]);

  return <TodayDashboardContent data={data} tenantName={tenantName} />;
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { KPICard, OButton, PageHeader, SectionHeader, OCard, Chip } from '@/components/owner/ui';
import { Calendar, DollarSign, Users, UserCog, Clock, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import type { TodayAtAGlanceData, TodayBooking, UpcomingBooking } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function formatTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const h = d.getHours();
  const m = d.getMinutes();
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h > 12 ? h - 12 : h === 0 ? 12 : h;
  return m > 0 ? `${h12}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')} ${ampm}` : `${h12} ${ampm}`;
}

function hourLabel(iso: string): string {
  const h = new Date(iso).getHours();
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12  = h > 12 ? h - 12 : h === 0 ? 12 : h;
  return `${h12} ${ampm}`;
}

function groupByHour(bookings: TodayBooking[]): Array<{ hour: string; items: TodayBooking[] }> {
  const map = new Map<string, TodayBooking[]>();
  for (const b of bookings) {
    const key = hourLabel(b.scheduledStart);
    if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);
    map.get(key)!.push(b);
  }
  return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([hour, items]) => ({ hour, items }));
}

type StatusInfo = { label: string; chipColor: 'success' | 'gold' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'default' };

function statusInfo(status: string): StatusInfo {
  switch (status) {
    case 'completed':  return { label: 'Completed',  chipColor: 'success' };
    case 'confirmed':  return { label: 'Upcoming',   chipColor: 'gold'    };
    case 'pending':    return { label: 'Pending',    chipColor: 'warning' };
    case 'cancelled':  return { label: 'Cancelled',  chipColor: 'danger'  };
    case 'no_show':    return { label: 'No Show',    chipColor: 'danger'  };
    default:           return { label: status,       chipColor: 'default' };
  }
}

const SESSION_TYPE_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  'Private':     brand.goldDeep,
  'Group':       brand.info,
  'Cage Rental': brand.textMuted,
};

// ── Sub-components ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function BookingRow({ b }: { b: TodayBooking }) {
  const si = statusInfo(b.status);
  const typeColor = SESSION_TYPE_COLORS[b.sessionType] ?? brand.textMuted;
  const isCancelled = b.status === 'cancelled' || b.status === 'no_show';

  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      gap: 12,
      padding: '10px 0',
      borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
      opacity: isCancelled ? 0.55 : 1,
    }}>
      <div style={{ width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 8, background: `${typeColor}22`, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, color: typeColor, fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>
          {b.sessionType === 'Private' ? 'PRV' : b.sessionType === 'Group' ? 'GRP' : 'CGE'}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text,
          whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
          textDecoration: isCancelled ? 'line-through' : 'none',
        }}>
          {b.kidName}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 1 }}>
          {b.coachName}{b.cage ? ` · ${b.cage}` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ flexShrink: 0, textAlign: 'right' }}>
        <Chip color={si.chipColor} size="sm">{si.label}</Chip>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function UpcomingRow({ b }: { b: UpcomingBooking }) {
  const si = statusInfo(b.status);
  const typeColor = SESSION_TYPE_COLORS[b.sessionType] ?? brand.textMuted;

  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex',
      alignItems: 'center',
      gap: 10,
      padding: '8px 0',
      borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
    }}>
      <div style={{ width: 4, height: 32, borderRadius: 2, background: typeColor, flexShrink: 0 }} />
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text }}>{b.kidName}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 1 }}>
          {b.sessionType} · {b.coachName}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ flexShrink: 0, textAlign: 'right' }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 3 }}>
          {formatTime(b.scheduledStart)}
        </div>
        <Chip color={si.chipColor} size="sm">{si.label}</Chip>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type Props = { data: TodayAtAGlanceData; tenantName: string };

export function TodayDashboardContent({ data, tenantName }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { stats, todayBookings, upcomingBookings } = data;

  const now = new Date();
  const MONTHS  = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  const DAYS    = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
  const dateStr = `${DAYS[now.getDay()]}, ${MONTHS[now.getMonth()]} ${now.getDate()}, ${now.getFullYear()}`;

  const hourGroups = groupByHour(todayBookings);

  const completedCount = todayBookings.filter(b => b.status === 'completed').length;
  const upcomingCount  = todayBookings.filter(b => b.status === 'confirmed' || b.status === 'pending').length;

  const upcomingByDate: Array<{ dateLabel: string; items: UpcomingBooking[] }> = [];
  const dateMap = new Map<string, UpcomingBooking[]>();
  for (const b of upcomingBookings) {
    if (!dateMap.has(b.dateLabel)) dateMap.set(b.dateLabel, []);
    dateMap.get(b.dateLabel)!.push(b);
  }
  for (const [dateLabel, items] of dateMap.entries()) {
    upcomingByDate.push({ dateLabel, items });
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Today at a Glance"
        subtitle={`${tenantName} · ${dateStr}`}
        actions={
          <OButton variant="secondary" icon={Calendar} onClick={() => router.push('/owner/schedule')}>
            Full Schedule
          </OButton>
        }
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>

        {/* ── Quick Stats bar ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)', gap: 16, marginBottom: 28 }}>
          <KPICard
            label="Today's Sessions"
            value={stats.sessionsToday}
            deltaLabel={stats.sessionsToday > 0 ? `${completedCount} done · ${upcomingCount} ahead` : 'none scheduled'}
            icon={Calendar}
            color="gold"
          />
          <KPICard
            label="Revenue Today"
            value={stats.revenueToday > 0 ? `$${stats.revenueToday.toLocaleString()}` : '$0'}
            deltaLabel="from confirmed sessions"
            icon={DollarSign}
            color={stats.revenueToday > 0 ? 'success' : 'default'}
          />
          <KPICard
            label="Active Members"
            value={stats.activeMembers}
            deltaLabel="current memberships"
            icon={Users}
          />
          <KPICard
            label="Coaches On Today"
            value={stats.coachesToday}
            deltaLabel={stats.coachesToday > 0 ? 'scheduled today' : 'none scheduled'}
            icon={UserCog}
            color={stats.coachesToday > 0 ? 'default' : 'warning'}
          />
        </div>

        {/* ── Two-column layout ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 340px', gap: 20, alignItems: 'start' }}>

          {/* ── Left: Today's Schedule ──────────────────────────────────── */}
          <div>
            <SectionHeader
              title="Today's Schedule"
              subtitle={`${todayBookings.length} booking${todayBookings.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} · sorted by time`}
              action={
                <OButton variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => router.push('/owner/schedule')}>
                  Full View →
                </OButton>
              }
            />
            <OCard style={{ padding: 0 }}>
              {hourGroups.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                  <Calendar size={28} color={brand.textMuted} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }} />
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 14, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 600 }}>No sessions scheduled today</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>Bookings will appear here once they are created.</div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                hourGroups.map((group, gi) => (
                  <div key={gi} style={{ padding: '0 20px' }}>
                    <div style={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 10,
                      padding: '12px 0 4px',
                    }}>
                      <Clock size={13} color={brand.goldDeep} />
                      <span style={{
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: 800,
                        color: brand.goldDeep,
                        fontFamily: fonts.display,
                        letterSpacing: 1.5,
                        textTransform: 'uppercase',
                      }}>
                        {group.hour}
                      </span>
                      <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 1, background: brand.border }} />
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {group.items.length} session{group.items.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {group.items.map((b, bi) => (
                      <div key={b.id} style={bi === group.items.length - 1 && gi === hourGroups.length - 1 ? { borderBottom: 'none' } : {}}>
                        <BookingRow b={b} />
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ))
              )}

          </div>

          {/* ── Right: Upcoming 48h ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <div>
            <SectionHeader

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { KPICard, OButton, PageHeader, SectionHeader, OTable, Chip } from '@/components/owner/ui';
import type { TableColumn } from '@/components/owner/ui';
import { Clock, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Download, Mail, Phone, Loader2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import type { ExpiringPack } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { exportCsv } from '@/lib/exportCsv';

type Props = { packs: ExpiringPack[] };

function urgencyColor(daysUntilExpiry: number): string {
  if (daysUntilExpiry <= 7)  return brand.danger;
  if (daysUntilExpiry <= 30) return brand.warning;
  return brand.success;
}

function urgencyLabel(daysUntilExpiry: number): { color: 'danger' | 'warning' | 'success'; text: string } {
  if (daysUntilExpiry <= 7)  return { color: 'danger',  text: `${daysUntilExpiry}d` };
  if (daysUntilExpiry <= 30) return { color: 'warning', text: `${daysUntilExpiry}d` };
  return { color: 'success', text: `${daysUntilExpiry}d` };
}

function makeColumns(
  onReminder: (pack: ExpiringPack) => void,
  loadingIds: Set<string>,
  showRiskFlag: boolean,
): TableColumn<ExpiringPack & Record<string, unknown>>[] {
  const cols: TableColumn<ExpiringPack & Record<string, unknown>>[] = [
    {
      label: 'Member', key: 'kidName',
      render: (r) => (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 18, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, fontFamily: fonts.display, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
            {(r.kidName as string).charAt(0)}
          </div>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{r.kidName as string}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>{r.parentName as string}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      label: 'Plan', key: 'planName',
      render: (r) => <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 }}>{r.planName as string}</span>,
    },
    {
      label: 'Sessions Left', key: 'sessionsRemaining', align: 'right',
      render: (r) => {
        const v = r.sessionsRemaining as number | null;
        if (v == null) return <span style={{ color: brand.textMuted }}>—</span>;
        return (
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.mono, color: v <= 2 ? brand.danger : v <= 5 ? brand.warning : brand.text }}>
            {v}
          </span>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      label: 'Expires', key: 'expiresAtLabel', sortable: true,
      render: (r) => {
        const days = r.daysUntilExpiry as number;
        const label = r.expiresAtLabel as string;
        const color = urgencyColor(days);
        return (
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color }}>{label}</div>
            <Chip color={urgencyLabel(days).color} size="sm">{urgencyLabel(days).text} {days >= 0 ? 'left' : 'ago'}</Chip>
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
  ];

  if (showRiskFlag) {
    cols.push({
      label: 'Risk Flag', key: 'hasUnusedSessions',
      render: (r) => {
        const hasUnused = r.hasUnusedSessions as boolean;
        if (!hasUnused) return <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>—</span>;
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, color: brand.warning }}>
            <AlertCircle size={13} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700 }}>Loyalty Risk</span>
          </div>
        );
      },
    });
  }

  cols.push({
    label: 'Actions', key: 'id',
    render: (r) => {
      const pack = r as unknown as ExpiringPack;
      const isLoading = loadingIds.has(pack.id);
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
          <OButton
            variant="gold" size="sm"
            icon={isLoading ? Loader2 : Mail}
            onClick={() => onReminder(pack)}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? 'Sending…' : 'Send Reminder'}
          </OButton>
          {pack.parentPhone && (
            <OButton variant="secondary" size="sm" icon={Phone}>Call</OButton>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    },
  });

  return cols;
}

export function ExpiringPacksContent({ packs: raw }: Props) {
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingIds, setLoadingIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  useEffect(() => {
    if (toast) { const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000); return () => clearTimeout(t); }
  }, [toast]);

  const expiringSoon    = raw.filter(p => !p.isExpired);
  const recentlyExpired = raw.filter(p => p.isExpired);

  const critical = expiringSoon.filter(p => p.daysUntilExpiry <= 7).length;
  const soon     = expiringSoon.filter(p => p.daysUntilExpiry > 7 && p.daysUntilExpiry <= 30).length;
  const upcoming = expiringSoon.filter(p => p.daysUntilExpiry > 30).length;

  async function sendReminder(pack: ExpiringPack) {
    setLoadingIds(prev => new Set(prev).add(pack.id));
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/owner/send-renewal-reminder', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          parentName: pack.parentName,
          parentEmail: pack.parentEmail,
          kidName: pack.kidName,
          planName: pack.planName,
          sessionsRemaining: pack.sessionsRemaining,
          expiresAtLabel: pack.expiresAtLabel,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as { success?: boolean; skipped?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || data.error) {
        setToast(`Failed to send: ${data.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`);
      } else if (data.skipped) {
        setToast(`Reminder queued for ${pack.parentName} — email not yet configured`);
      } else {
        setToast(`Renewal reminder sent to ${pack.parentName} (${pack.parentEmail})`);
      }
    } catch {
      setToast('Network error — email not sent');
    } finally {
      setLoadingIds(prev => { const s = new Set(prev); s.delete(pack.id); return s; });
    }
  }

  const handleExport = () => {
    exportCsv(`expiring-packs-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`,
      raw as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[],
      [
        { label: 'Kid Name',          key: 'kidName' },
        { label: 'Parent',            key: 'parentName' },
        { label: 'Parent Email',      key: 'parentEmail' },
        { label: 'Plan',              key: 'planName' },
        { label: 'Sessions Remaining',key: 'sessionsRemaining' },
        { label: 'Expires',           key: 'expiresAtLabel' },
        { label: 'Days Until Expiry', key: 'daysUntilExpiry' },
        { label: 'Loyalty Risk',      key: 'hasUnusedSessions' },
      ],
    );
    setToast(`Exported ${raw.length} packs as CSV`);
  };

  const upcomingColumns  = makeColumns(sendReminder, loadingIds, false);
  const expiredColumns   = makeColumns(sendReminder, loadingIds, true);

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Expiring Packs"
        subtitle="OTC lesson packs expiring in the next 60 days, plus recently expired"
        actions={<OButton variant="secondary" icon={Download} onClick={handleExport}>Export CSV</OButton>}
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <KPICard label="Critical (0–7 days)"   value={critical} icon={AlertTriangle} color={critical > 0 ? 'danger' : 'default'} />
          <KPICard label="Soon (8–30 days)"       value={soon}     icon={Clock}         color={soon > 0 ? 'warning' : 'default'} />
          <KPICard label="Upcoming (31–60 days)"  value={upcoming} icon={Clock}         color={upcoming > 0 ? 'success' : 'default'} />
        </div>

        {expiringSoon.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <SectionHeader
              title="Expiring Soon"
              subtitle="Packs expiring in the next 60 days — sorted by expiry date"
            />
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 32 }}>
              <OTable
                columns={upcomingColumns as TableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]}
                rows={expiringSoon as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]}
              />
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 32, textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 32 }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={36} color={brand.success} style={{ margin: '0 auto 10px' }} />
            <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display }}>No packs expiring in the next 60 days</div>
          </div>
        )}

        {recentlyExpired.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <SectionHeader
              title="Recently Expired"
              subtitle="Expired in the last 30 days · Loyalty Risk flag = unused sessions forfeited"
            />
            <OTable
              columns={expiredColumns as TableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]}
              rows={recentlyExpired as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 400 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function FailedPaymentsContent({ payments: rawPayments }: Props) {
  const payments    = rawPayments.length ? rawPayments : DEMO_PAYMENTS;
  const totalAtRisk = payments.reduce((s, f) => s + f.amount, 0);
  const membershipFailures = payments.filter(p => p.source === 'membership');
  const storeFailures      = payments.filter(p => p.source === 'store_order');
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (toast) { const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500); return () => clearTimeout(t); }
  }, [toast]);

  const handleEmailAll = () => {
    setToast(`Payment reminder emails sent to ${payments.length} parent${payments.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Failed Payments"
        subtitle="Resolve these to recover revenue"
        actions={<OButton variant="gold" icon={Send} onClick={handleEmailAll}>Email All Parents</OButton>}
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <KPICard label="Revenue at Risk"   value={`$${totalAtRisk.toLocaleString()}`} icon={AlertCircle} color="danger" />
          <KPICard label="Accounts Affected" value={payments.length}                    icon={Users}       color="warning" />
          <KPICard label="Avg Recovery Rate" value="72%"    deltaLabel="historical"     icon={TrendingUp}  color="success" />
        </div>

        {membershipFailures.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <SectionHeader title="Membership Billing Failures" />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12, marginBottom: 24 }}>
              {membershipFailures.map(f => (
                <FailedPaymentCard key={f.id} f={f} onToast={setToast} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {storeFailures.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <SectionHeader title="Store Purchase Failures" />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
              {storeFailures.map(f => (
                <FailedPaymentCard key={f.id} f={f} onToast={setToast} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {payments.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 48, color: brand.textMuted }}>
            No failed payments. Great work!
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 400 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FailedPaymentCard({ f, onToast }: { f: FailedPayment; onToast: (msg: string) => void }) {
  const isStoreOrder = f.source === 'store_order';
  return (
    <OCard>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 16, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>

            : <AlertCircle size={20} color={brand.danger} />
          }
        </div>
        <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700 }}>{f.member}</div>
                {isStoreOrder && (
                  <span style={{
                    fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, background: '#2a2000', color: brand.gold,
                    borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 6px', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1,
                  }}>Store</span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>Parent: {f.parent}</div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.danger }}>${f.amount.toLocaleString()}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted }}>{f.package}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 16, fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div>Failed: <strong style={{ color: brand.text }}>{f.failedDate}</strong></div>
            <div>Reason: <strong style={{ color: brand.text }}>{f.reason}</strong></div>
            <div>Attempts: <strong style={{ color: brand.text }}>{f.attempts}</strong></div>
            {!isStoreOrder && <div>Next retry: <strong style={{ color: brand.text }}>{f.nextAttempt}</strong></div>}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
            {!isStoreOrder && (
              <OButton variant="gold" size="sm" icon={CreditCard} onClick={() => onToast(`Retry charge queued for ${f.member} — $${f.amount}`)}>Retry Charge</OButton>

            <OButton variant="ghost" size="sm" icon={MessageCircle} onClick={() => onToast(`Opening message thread with ${f.parent}…`)}>Message</OButton>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </OCard>
  );
}

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

import { KPICard, OButton, PageHeader, SectionHeader, OCard, OTable, Chip } from '@/components/owner/ui';

  id: number; name: string; owner: string; members: number;
  mrr: number; retention: number; churnRisk: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'; trend: number; rank: number;
};

const LOCATIONS: LocationRow[] = [

FILE: portal/app/owner/layout.tsx
=================================================================================
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { PortalShell } from '@/components/PortalShell';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { createServiceClient } from '@/lib/supabase/serviceClient';
import { readTenantId, readAppRole, type AppRole } from '@/lib/auth';
import { getTenantName, getTenantNameBySlug } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';

export const metadata = {
  title: 'Owner Portal — Ballpark',
};

export default async function OwnerLayout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect('/login?reason=unauthenticated');

  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  // Decode JWT role; fall back to app_metadata for tokens that predate the
  // Custom Access Token Hook (same pattern used in admin/layout.tsx).
  let role = readAppRole(session);
  if (role === 'parent' && user.app_metadata?.app_role) {
    const meta = user.app_metadata.app_role as string;
    const known: AppRole[] = ['owner', 'admin', 'super_admin', 'coach', 'parent'];
    if (known.includes(meta as AppRole)) role = meta as AppRole;
  }

  if (role === 'coach') redirect('/coach/inbox');
  if (role === 'admin' || role === 'super_admin') redirect('/admin');
  if (role !== 'owner') redirect('/login?reason=unauthenticated');

  const tenantId = readTenantId(session);

  let locationName = 'Your Location';
  if (tenantId) {
    locationName = await getTenantName(supabase, tenantId);
  } else {
    const slug = session?.user?.user_metadata?.tenant_slug as string | undefined;
    if (slug) {
      const serviceClient = createServiceClient();
      locationName = await getTenantNameBySlug(serviceClient, slug);
    }
  }

  const rawFullName = session?.user?.user_metadata?.full_name;
  const userName =
    (typeof rawFullName === 'string' && rawFullName.length > 0 ? rawFullName : undefined)
    ?? session?.user?.email
    ?? 'Owner';

  return (
    <PortalShell
      role="owner"
      email={user?.email ?? null}
      userName={userName}
      locationName={locationName}
    >
      <div style={{ color: '#FAF6E8' }}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </PortalShell>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/owner/low-balance-packs/LowBalancePacksContent.tsx
