'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { KPICard, OButton, PageHeader, OTable } from '@/components/owner/ui';
import type { TableColumn } from '@/components/owner/ui';
import { Battery, Mail, Phone, Loader2, Download, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import type { LowBalancePack } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { exportCsv } from '@/lib/exportCsv';

type Props = { packs: LowBalancePack[] };

function SessionPill({ remaining, total }: { remaining: number; total: number }) {
  const pct = total > 0 ? (remaining / total) * 100 : 0;
  const color = pct <= 15 ? brand.danger : pct <= 30 ? brand.warning : brand.goldDeep;
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
      <div style={{ width: 72, height: 7, background: brand.border, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <div style={{ width: `${pct}%`, height: '100%', background: color, borderRadius: 4, minWidth: 2 }} />
      </div>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color }}>
        {remaining} / {total}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function makeColumns(onReminder: (pack: LowBalancePack) => void, loadingIds: Set<string>): TableColumn<LowBalancePack & Record<string, unknown>>[] {
  return [
    {
      label: 'Member', key: 'kidName',
      render: (r) => (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 18, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, fontFamily: fonts.display, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
            {(r.kidName as string).charAt(0)}
          </div>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{r.kidName as string}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>{r.parentName as string}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      label: 'Plan', key: 'planName',
      render: (r) => <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 }}>{r.planName as string}</span>,
    },
    {
      label: 'Sessions Remaining', key: 'sessionsRemaining', sortable: true,
      render: (r) => (
        <SessionPill
          remaining={r.sessionsRemaining as number}
          total={r.sessionsTotal as number}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      label: 'Last Session', key: 'lastSessionLabel',
      render: (r) => <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>{r.lastSessionLabel as string}</span>,
    },
    {
      label: 'Actions', key: 'id',
      render: (r) => {
        const pack = r as unknown as LowBalancePack;
        const isLoading = loadingIds.has(pack.id);
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
            <OButton
              variant="gold" size="sm"
              icon={isLoading ? Loader2 : Mail}
              onClick={() => onReminder(pack)}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Sending…' : 'Send Reminder'}
            </OButton>
            {pack.parentPhone && (
              <OButton variant="secondary" size="sm" icon={Phone}>Call</OButton>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
  ];
}

export function LowBalancePacksContent({ packs: raw }: Props) {
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingIds, setLoadingIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  useEffect(() => {
    if (toast) { const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000); return () => clearTimeout(t); }
  }, [toast]);

  const totalSessionsLeft = raw.reduce((s, p) => s + p.sessionsRemaining, 0);

  async function sendReminder(pack: LowBalancePack) {
    setLoadingIds(prev => new Set(prev).add(pack.id));
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/owner/send-renewal-reminder', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          parentName: pack.parentName,
          parentEmail: pack.parentEmail,
          kidName: pack.kidName,
          planName: pack.planName,
          sessionsRemaining: pack.sessionsRemaining,
          expiresAtLabel: null,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as { success?: boolean; skipped?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || data.error) {
        setToast(`Failed to send: ${data.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`);
      } else if (data.skipped) {
        setToast(`Reminder queued for ${pack.parentName} — email not yet configured`);
      } else {
        setToast(`Renewal reminder sent to ${pack.parentName} (${pack.parentEmail})`);
      }
    } catch {
      setToast('Network error — email not sent');
    } finally {
      setLoadingIds(prev => { const s = new Set(prev); s.delete(pack.id); return s; });
    }
  }

  const handleExport = () => {
    exportCsv(`low-balance-packs-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`,
      raw as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[],
      [
        { label: 'Kid Name',           key: 'kidName' },
        { label: 'Parent',             key: 'parentName' },
        { label: 'Parent Email',       key: 'parentEmail' },
        { label: 'Plan',               key: 'planName' },
        { label: 'Sessions Remaining', key: 'sessionsRemaining' },
        { label: 'Sessions Total',     key: 'sessionsTotal' },
        { label: 'Last Session',       key: 'lastSessionLabel' },
      ],
    );
    setToast(`Exported ${raw.length} packs as CSV`);
  };

  const columns = makeColumns(sendReminder, loadingIds);

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Low Balance Packs"
        subtitle="OTC memberships running low on sessions — renewal opportunities"
        actions={<OButton variant="secondary" icon={Download} onClick={handleExport}>Export CSV</OButton>}
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, 1fr)', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <KPICard
            label="Low Balance Packs"
            value={raw.length}
            icon={Battery}
            color={raw.length > 0 ? 'warning' : 'default'}
          />
          <KPICard
            label="Sessions Remaining (total)"
            value={totalSessionsLeft}
            icon={Users}
            color="default"
          />
        </div>

        {raw.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: brand.textMuted }}>
            No packs running low right now.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <OTable
            columns={columns as TableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]}
            rows={raw as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 400 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { MemberDetail, TimelineEvent, RecentPaymentEvent } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';

export type DemoMemberDetail = Omit<MemberDetail,
  'stripeSubscriptionId' | 'subscriptionStatus' | 'nextBillingAt' |
  'pauseStart' | 'pauseEnd' | 'pausedAt' |
  'cardLast4' | 'cardBrand' | 'cardExpMonth' | 'cardExpYear' |
  'sessionsRemaining' | 'sessionsTotal' |
  'weeklySessionsUsed' | 'weeklyTotal' | 'weeklyPeriodStart'
> & {
  memberForMonths: number;
  bestVeloMph: number;
  homeworkScore: number;
  parentEmail: string;
  parentPhone: string;
  paymentMethod: string;
  hittraxAvgExitVelo: number;
  hittraxBestVelo: number;
  hittraxLaunchAngle: number;
  sparklinePoints: number[];
  stripeSubscriptionId?: string | null;
  subscriptionStatus?: MemberDetail['subscriptionStatus'];
  nextBillingAt?: string | null;
  pauseStart?: string | null;
  pauseEnd?: string | null;
  pausedAt?: string | null;
  cardLast4?: string | null;
  cardBrand?: string | null;
  cardExpMonth?: number | null;
  cardExpYear?: number | null;
  sessionsRemaining?: number | null;
  sessionsTotal?: number | null;
  weeklySessionsUsed?: number | null;
  weeklyTotal?: number | null;
  weeklyPeriodStart?: string | null;
};

function tl(id: string, kind: 'booking' | 'payment', daysAgo: number, title: string, subtitle: string, status: 'completed' | 'confirmed' | 'pending' | 'cancelled' | 'paid' | 'failed', amount?: number): TimelineEvent {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - daysAgo);
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const label = daysAgo === 0 ? 'Today' : daysAgo === 1 ? 'Yesterday' : `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}`;
  return { id, kind, dateIso: d.toISOString(), dateLabel: label, title, subtitle, status, amount };
}

function pmt(id: string, daysAgo: number, amount: number, status: 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded', method: string): RecentPaymentEvent {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - daysAgo);
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  return { id, date: `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}`, amount, status, method };
}

'use client';

import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { OButton, PageHeader, SectionHeader, OCard, Chip } from '@/components/owner/ui';
import {
  Calendar, MessageCircle, Edit2, Activity, Clock,
  CheckCircle, XCircle, CreditCard, Star, Zap, TrendingUp,
  AlertCircle, PauseCircle, PlayCircle, Package, Phone, Mail,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { MemberDetail } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import type { DemoMemberDetail } from './demoMemberDetails';

type Props = { member: MemberDetail | DemoMemberDetail };

function isDemo(m: MemberDetail | DemoMemberDetail): m is DemoMemberDetail {
  return 'bestVeloMph' in m;
}

function monthsAgo(joinedDate: string): number {
  const parts = joinedDate.split(' ');
  if (parts.length < 2) return 0;
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const mon = months.indexOf(parts[0]);
  const yr = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
  if (mon < 0 || isNaN(yr)) return 0;
  const now = new Date();
  return Math.max(1, (now.getFullYear() - yr) * 12 + (now.getMonth() - mon));
}

function formatNextBilling(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

function KPIBlock({ label, value, sub, highlight }: { label: string; value: string | number; sub?: string; highlight?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      background: brand.surface,
      border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
      borderRadius: 10,
      padding: '14px 16px',
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 4,
    }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 1, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>{label}</div>
      <div style={{
        fontSize: 26,
        fontWeight: 800,
        fontFamily: fonts.display,
        color: highlight ? brand.success : brand.text,
        lineHeight: 1.1,
      }}>
        {value}
      </div>
      {sub && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>{sub}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Sparkline({ points }: { points: number[] }) {
  if (!points || points.length < 2) return null;
  const min = Math.min(...points);
  const max = Math.max(...points);
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const w = 320;
  const h = 60;
  const pad = 8;
  const xs = points.map((_, i) => pad + (i / (points.length - 1)) * (w - pad * 2));
  const ys = points.map(v => h - pad - ((v - min) / range) * (h - pad * 2));
  const d = xs.map((x, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${x.toFixed(1)} ${ys[i].toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  const fillD = `${d} L ${xs[xs.length-1].toFixed(1)} ${h} L ${xs[0].toFixed(1)} ${h} Z`;
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} style={{ width: '100%', height: 60, display: 'block' }} preserveAspectRatio="none">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="spark-fill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stopColor={brand.success} stopOpacity="0.18" />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor={brand.success} stopOpacity="0" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <path d={fillD} fill="url(#spark-fill)" />
      <path d={d} fill="none" stroke={brand.success} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function InfoRow({ label, value, large }: { label: string; value: string; large?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 1, textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 2 }}>{label}</div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: large ? 15 : 13, fontWeight: large ? 700 : 500, color: brand.text }}>{value}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function formatDateShort(isoDate: string | null): string {
  if (!isoDate) return '—';
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const d = new Date(isoDate + 'T00:00:00');
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

function PauseSection({ member }: { member: MemberDetail }) {
  const [resuming, setResuming] = useState(false);
  const [resumeDone, setResumeDone] = useState(false);
  const [resumeErr, setResumeErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { pauseStart, pauseEnd } = member;

  const handleResumeEarly = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!confirm('Resume this membership immediately? Billing will restart on the next billing date.')) return;

    setResuming(true);
    setResumeErr(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/memberships/resume', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ membership_id: member.id }),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as { ok?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
        setResumeErr(typeof data.error === 'string' ? data.error : `Error ${res.status}`);
      } else {
        setResumeDone(true);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setResumeErr(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setResuming(false);
    }
  }, [member.id]);

  if (resumeDone) {
    return (
      <div>
        <SectionHeader title="Membership Pause" />
        <OCard style={{ padding: 14, borderLeft: `4px solid ${brand.success}` }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <PlayCircle size={16} color={brand.success} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.success }}>
              Membership resumed successfully
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}>
            Billing will resume on the next billing date.
          </div>
        </OCard>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeader title="Membership Pause" />
      <OCard style={{ padding: 14, borderLeft: `4px solid ${brand.warning}` }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <PauseCircle size={16} color={brand.warning} />
          <Chip color="warning">Paused</Chip>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>Paused on</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text }}>
              {formatDateShort(pauseStart)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>Auto-resumes</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text }}>
              {formatDateShort(pauseEnd)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 4, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
            No billing charges until the resume date.
          </div>
        </div>

        {resumeErr && (
          <div style={{
            padding: '8px 10px', background: brand.dangerBg, borderRadius: 6,
            fontSize: 12, color: brand.danger, marginBottom: 8,
          }}>
            {resumeErr}
          </div>
        )}

        <button
          onClick={handleResumeEarly}
          disabled={resuming}
          style={{
            width: '100%', padding: '8px 0', borderRadius: 6,
            border: `1px solid ${brand.gold}`, background: brand.gold,
            color: brand.dark, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700,
            cursor: resuming ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
            opacity: resuming ? 0.6 : 1, letterSpacing: 0.5,
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6,
          }}
        >
          <PlayCircle size={14} />
          {resuming ? 'Resuming…' : 'Resume Early'}
        </button>
      </OCard>
    </div>
  );
}

function SessionsOverrideSection({ member }: { member: MemberDetail }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState<string>('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [currentRemaining, setCurrentRemaining] = useState<number | null>(member.sessionsRemaining);

  const sessionsTotal = member.sessionsTotal ?? 0;

  const handleEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setInputValue(String(currentRemaining ?? 0));
    setSaveError(null);
    setEditing(true);
  }, [currentRemaining]);

  const handleSave = useCallback(async () => {
    const parsed = parseInt(inputValue, 10);
    if (isNaN(parsed) || parsed < 0) {
      setSaveError('Enter a valid non-negative number.');
      return;
    }
    if (parsed > sessionsTotal) {
      setSaveError(`Cannot exceed total (${sessionsTotal}).`);
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/memberships/sessions', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ membership_id: member.id, sessions_remaining: parsed }),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as { ok?: boolean; sessions_remaining?: number; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
        setSaveError(data.error ?? `Error ${res.status}`);
      } else {
        setCurrentRemaining(data.sessions_remaining ?? parsed);
        setEditing(false);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setSaveError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }, [inputValue, member.id, sessionsTotal]);

  // All hooks must be called before any conditional return
  if (member.planType !== 'otc' || member.sessionsTotal === null) return null;

  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeader title="Session Pack" />
      <OCard style={{ padding: 14 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <Package size={14} color={brand.gold} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1 }}>
            {member.program}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Credit bar */}
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline', marginBottom: 6 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 800, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: (currentRemaining ?? 0) === 0 ? brand.danger : brand.text }}>
              {currentRemaining ?? 0}
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>of {sessionsTotal} remaining</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ height: 6, background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{
              height: '100%',
              width: `${sessionsTotal > 0 ? Math.round(((currentRemaining ?? 0) / sessionsTotal) * 100) : 0}%`,
              background: (currentRemaining ?? 0) === 0 ? brand.danger : brand.success,
              borderRadius: 4,
              transition: 'width 0.3s ease',
            }} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Editing UI */}
        {editing ? (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                max={sessionsTotal}
                value={inputValue}
                onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
                  background: brand.surfaceAlt,
                  color: brand.text,
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  outline: 'none',
                }}
              />
              <OButton
                variant="gold"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleSave}
                disabled={saving}
                style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}
              >
                {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}
              </OButton>
              <OButton
                variant="secondary"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setEditing(false)}
                disabled={saving}
                style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}
              >
                Cancel
              </OButton>
            </div>
            {saveError && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.danger }}>{saveError}</div>
            )}
            <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted }}>
              Staff override — enter 0–{sessionsTotal}. This updates the credit balance immediately.
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button
            onClick={handleEdit}
            style={{
              width: '100%',
              padding: '7px 0',
              borderRadius: 6,
              border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
              background: 'transparent',
              color: brand.textMuted,
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: 700,
              cursor: 'pointer',
              letterSpacing: 0.5,
            }}
          >
            Override sessions remaining
          </button>
        )}
      </OCard>
    </div>
  );
}

function EftWeeklyCreditsSection({ member }: { member: MemberDetail }) {
  if (
    member.planType !== 'eft' ||
    member.weeklyTotal === null ||
    member.weeklySessionsUsed === null
  ) return null;

  const used    = member.weeklySessionsUsed;
  const total   = member.weeklyTotal;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, total - used);
  const pct     = total > 0 ? Math.round((remaining / total) * 100) : 0;
  const monday  = member.weeklyPeriodStart;

  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeader title="Weekly Credits" />
      <OCard style={{ padding: 14 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <Package size={14} color={brand.gold} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1 }}>
            {member.program}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline', marginBottom: 6 }}>
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 24,
              fontWeight: 800,
              fontFamily: fonts.display,
              color: remaining === 0 ? brand.danger : brand.text,
            }}>
              {remaining}
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>
              of {total} remaining this week
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ height: 6, background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{
              height: '100%',
              width: `${pct}%`,
              background: remaining === 0 ? brand.danger : brand.success,
              borderRadius: 4,
              transition: 'width 0.3s ease',
            }} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {monday && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 8 }}>
            Week starting {monday} · Resets every Monday.
          </div>
        )}
      </OCard>
    </div>
  );
}

function SubscriptionSection({ member }: { member: MemberDetail }) {
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState(false);
  const [cancelDone, setCancelDone] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [cancelErr, setCancelErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activating, setActivating] = useState(false);
  const [activateDone, setActivateDone] = useState<{ subId: string; nextBilling: string | null } | null>(null);
  const [activateErr, setActivateErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ── Promo code state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [promoInput, setPromoInput] = useState('');
  const [promoValidating, setPromoValidating] = useState(false);
  const [promoValid, setPromoValid] = useState<{
    discountType: 'percent' | 'fixed';
    discountValue: number;
    code: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [promoErr, setPromoErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleValidatePromo = useCallback(async () => {
    const code = promoInput.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!code) return;
    setPromoValidating(true);
    setPromoErr(null);
    setPromoValid(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/promo-codes/validate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ code, plan_name: member.program }),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as {
        ok?: boolean;
        error_code?: string;
        discount_type?: 'percent' | 'fixed';
        discount_value?: number;
        code?: string;
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!res.ok) {
        setPromoErr(data.error ?? 'Validation failed');
      } else if (!data.ok) {
        const msgs: Record<string, string> = {
          INVALID: 'This code is invalid.',
          EXPIRED: 'This code has expired.',
          EXHAUSTED: 'This code has reached its maximum number of uses.',
          PLAN_MISMATCH: 'This code does not apply to this plan.',
        };
        setPromoErr(msgs[data.error_code ?? 'INVALID'] ?? 'This code is invalid.');
      } else {
        setPromoValid({
          discountType: data.discount_type!,
          discountValue: data.discount_value!,
          code: data.code!,
        });
      }
    } catch {
      setPromoErr('Could not validate code. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setPromoValidating(false);
    }
  }, [promoInput, member.program]);

  const handleCancel = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!confirm('Cancel this subscription at the end of the current billing period? The member will keep access until then.')) return;

    setCancelling(true);
    setCancelErr(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/stripe/subscription/cancel', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ membership_id: member.id }),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as { ok?: boolean; cancel_at?: string; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
        setCancelErr(data.error ?? `Error ${res.status}`);
      } else {
        const label = data.cancel_at
          ? `Cancels ${formatNextBilling(data.cancel_at)}`
          : 'Cancelled';
        setCancelDone(label);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setCancelErr(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setCancelling(false);
    }
  }, [member.id]);

  const handleActivate = useCallback(async () => {
    const promoLabel = promoValid
      ? ` with promo code ${promoValid.code}`
      : '';
    if (!confirm(`Activate this membership${promoLabel} and start automated Stripe billing? If the family has a saved payment card, Stripe will be set up automatically.`)) return;

    setActivating(true);
    setActivateErr(null);
    try {
      // POST /api/memberships/activate — combined endpoint that:
      //   1. Validates promo code if provided
      //   2. Marks membership active
      //   3. Automatically creates Stripe Subscription if family has stripe_customer_id
      // This eliminates the need for a separate manual "link billing" step.
      const reqBody: Record<string, unknown> = { membership_id: member.id };
      if (promoValid) reqBody.promo_code = promoValid.code;

      const res = await fetch('/api/memberships/activate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(reqBody),
      });
      const data = await res.json() as {
        ok?: boolean;
        subscription_id?: string;
        next_billing_at?: string;
        stripe_skipped?: boolean;
        stripe_error?: string;
        reason?: string;
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!res.ok || !data.ok) {
        setActivateErr(typeof data.error === 'string' ? data.error : `Error ${res.status}`);
      } else if (data.stripe_skipped) {
        // Membership activated but Stripe subscription not yet linked:
        // family hasn't saved a payment card yet (or plan is not EFT).
        setActivateDone({ subId: '', nextBilling: null });
      } else {
        setActivateDone({
          subId: data.subscription_id ?? '',
          nextBilling: data.next_billing_at ?? null,
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setActivateErr(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setActivating(false);
    }
  }, [member.id, promoValid]);

  const { subscriptionStatus, nextBillingAt, stripeSubscriptionId, cancelAt: persistedCancelAt,
          cancelRequestedAt, cancelEffectiveAt } = member;

  // If DB already has a cancel_at (persisted when cancel was first triggered),
  // pre-populate cancelDone so the "Cancels on <date>" label survives page reloads.
  // We only set it once on mount — if the admin cancels again in this session,
  // the handleCancel callback will overwrite it via setCancelDone.
  const persistedCancelLabel = persistedCancelAt
    ? `Cancels ${formatNextBilling(persistedCancelAt)}`
    : null;

  // Use in-session cancelDone if set, otherwise fall back to persisted DB value.
  const effectiveCancelDone = cancelDone ?? persistedCancelLabel;

  // ── No subscription yet — offer to activate ──────────────────────────────
  if (subscriptionStatus === 'none' && !activateDone) {
    const discountLabel = promoValid
      ? promoValid.discountType === 'percent'
        ? `${promoValid.discountValue}% off first month`
        : `$${(promoValid.discountValue / 100).toFixed(2)} off first month`
      : null;

    return (
      <div>
        <SectionHeader title="Subscription" />
        <OCard style={{ padding: 14 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 12 }}>
            No Stripe subscription linked yet. Activating will mark the membership active
            and automatically start recurring billing on Stripe — provided the family has
            saved a payment card in the Ballpark app (Me → Payment Method).
          </div>

          {/* ── Promo code input ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: 1, textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 6,
            }}>
              Promo Code <span style={{ fontWeight: 400, textTransform: 'none', letterSpacing: 0 }}>(optional)</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={promoInput}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setPromoInput(e.target.value.toUpperCase());
                  setPromoValid(null);
                  setPromoErr(null);
                }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); void handleValidatePromo(); } }}
                placeholder="e.g. SUMMER25"
                maxLength={50}
                style={{
                  flex: 1, padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 8,
                  border: `1px solid ${promoValid ? brand.success : promoErr ? brand.danger : brand.border}`,
                  background: brand.surface, color: brand.text,
                  fontSize: 13, fontFamily: 'monospace', outline: 'none',
                }}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { void handleValidatePromo(); }}
                disabled={promoValidating || !promoInput.trim()}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 8,
                  border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
                  background: brand.surface, color: brand.text,
                  fontSize: 12, cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  opacity: promoValidating || !promoInput.trim() ? 0.5 : 1,
                }}
              >
                {promoValidating ? 'Checking…' : 'Apply'}
              </button>
            </div>
            {promoValid && (
              <div style={{
                marginTop: 6, padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 8,
                background: `${brand.success}18`, border: `1px solid ${brand.success}40`,
                fontSize: 12, color: brand.success,
              }}>
                ✓ <strong>{promoValid.code}</strong> applied — {discountLabel}
              </div>
            )}
            {promoErr && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: 11, color: brand.danger }}>{promoErr}</div>
            )}
          </div>

          {activateErr && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.danger, marginBottom: 8 }}>{activateErr}</div>
          )}
          <OButton
            variant="gold"
            size="sm"
            icon={CreditCard}
            onClick={handleActivate}
            disabled={activating}
            style={{ width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
          >
            {activating ? 'Activating…' : promoValid ? `Activate with ${promoValid.code}` : 'Activate & Start Billing'}
          </OButton>
        </OCard>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── Just activated ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (activateDone) {
    return (
      <div>
        <SectionHeader title="Subscription" />
        <OCard style={{ padding: 14 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <Chip color="success">Active</Chip>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>
            Subscription activated. Next billing: {formatNextBilling(activateDone.nextBilling)}.
          </div>
          <div style={{
            marginTop: 8, fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted,
            fontFamily: fonts.mono, wordBreak: 'break-all',
          }}>
            {activateDone.subId}
          </div>
        </OCard>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const statusColor = subscriptionStatus === 'active' ? 'success'
    : subscriptionStatus === 'payment_overdue' ? 'danger'
    : subscriptionStatus === 'cancelled' ? 'warning'
    : 'default' as const;

  const statusLabel = subscriptionStatus === 'payment_overdue' ? 'Payment Overdue'
    : subscriptionStatus.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + subscriptionStatus.slice(1);

  const canCancel = (subscriptionStatus === 'active' || subscriptionStatus === 'payment_overdue')
    && !effectiveCancelDone;

  return (
    <div>
      <SectionHeader title="Subscription" />
      <OCard style={{ padding: 14 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>
          <Chip color={statusColor as 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'default'}>{statusLabel}</Chip>
          {subscriptionStatus === 'payment_overdue' && (
            <AlertCircle size={14} color={brand.danger} />
          )}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>Monthly amount</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text }}>
              {member.mrr > 0 ? `$${member.mrr.toFixed(2)}/mo` : '—'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>Next billing</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text }}>
              {effectiveCancelDone ? '—' : formatNextBilling(nextBillingAt)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>Stripe sub</span>
            <span style={{
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: 600,
              color: brand.textMuted,
              fontFamily: 'monospace',
              maxWidth: 120,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            }}>
              {stripeSubscriptionId ?? '—'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {cancelRequestedAt && subscriptionStatus !== 'cancelled' && (
          <div style={{
            padding: '10px 12px',
            background: 'rgba(255,193,7,0.08)',
            borderRadius: 6,
            border: '1px solid rgba(255,193,7,0.25)',
            marginBottom: 8,
          }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <AlertCircle size={13} color="#FFC107" />
              <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: '#FFC107' }}>Cancellation Pending</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
              Requested {formatNextBilling(cancelRequestedAt ?? null)}
              {cancelEffectiveAt && (
                <span> · Access ends <strong style={{ color: brand.text }}>{formatNextBilling(cancelEffectiveAt ?? null)}</strong></span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {effectiveCancelDone && (
          <div style={{
            padding: '8px 10px',
            background: brand.surfaceAlt,
            borderRadius: 6,
            fontSize: 12,
            color: brand.success,
            fontWeight: 600,
            marginBottom: 8,
          }}>
            {effectiveCancelDone}
          </div>
        )}

        {cancelErr && (
          <div style={{
            padding: '8px 10px',
            background: brand.dangerBg,
            borderRadius: 6,
            fontSize: 12,
            color: brand.danger,
            marginBottom: 8,
          }}>
            {cancelErr}
          </div>
        )}

        {canCancel && (
          <button
            onClick={handleCancel}
            disabled={cancelling}
            style={{
              width: '100%',
              padding: '8px 0',
              borderRadius: 6,
              border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`,
              background: 'transparent',
              color: brand.danger,
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: 700,
              cursor: cancelling ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              opacity: cancelling ? 0.6 : 1,
              letterSpacing: 0.5,
            }}
          >
            {cancelling ? 'Cancelling…' : 'Cancel Subscription'}
          </button>
        )}
      </OCard>
    </div>
  );
}

export function MemberDetailContent({ member: m }: Props) {
  const demo = isDemo(m) ? m : null;
  const mo = demo ? demo.memberForMonths : monthsAgo(m.joinedDate);

  const rawMemberStatus = m.status as string;
  const statusChipColor = rawMemberStatus === 'active' ? 'success'
    : rawMemberStatus === 'paused' ? 'warning'
    : rawMemberStatus === 'payment_overdue' ? 'danger'
    : 'danger';

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        breadcrumb={`Members → ${m.name}`}
        title={m.name}
        subtitle={`${m.age} · ${m.program} · Member for ${mo} months · ${m.bookingCount} total sessions · LTV $${m.lifetime.toLocaleString()}`}
        actions={
          <>
            <OButton variant="secondary" icon={MessageCircle}>Message</OButton>
            <OButton variant="secondary" icon={Edit2}>Edit</OButton>
            <OButton variant="gold" icon={Calendar}>Book Session</OButton>
          </>
        }
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '2fr 1fr', gap: 20 }}>
        {/* ── Left column ── */}
        <div>
          {/* KPI row */}
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(5, 1fr)', gap: 10, marginBottom: 20 }}>
            <KPIBlock label="Sessions Done" value={m.bookingCount} sub="completed" />
            <KPIBlock label="Member For" value={mo} sub="months" />
            <KPIBlock label="Engagement" value={m.engagementScore} sub="out of 100" highlight={m.engagementScore >= 70} />

                <SectionHeader title="HitTrax Performance" />

                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>{row.label}</div>
                    <div style={{
                      fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
                      color: row.value === 'Overdue' ? brand.danger : row.value === 'ON' ? brand.success : brand.text,
                    }}>
                      {row.value === 'ON' ? (
                        <span style={{ background: brand.successBg, color: brand.success, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 10 }}>ON</span>
                      ) : row.value}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {m.recentPayments.length > 0 && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 1, marginBottom: 8 }}>RECENT PAYMENTS</div>
                  {m.recentPayments.map((p, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={p.id}
                      style={{
                        display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
                        padding: '7px 0',
                        borderTop: i > 0 ? `1px solid ${brand.border}` : undefined,
                      }}
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: brand.text }}>${p.amount.toFixed(2)}</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted }}>{p.date} · {p.method}</div>
                      </div>
                      <Chip color={p.status === 'paid' ? 'success' : p.status === 'failed' ? 'danger' : 'warning'} size="sm">
                        {p.status}
                      </Chip>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </OCard>
          </div>

          {/* Pause window (Task #240) */}
          {!demo && (m as MemberDetail).subscriptionStatus === 'paused' && (m as MemberDetail).pauseEnd && (
            <PauseSection member={m as MemberDetail} />
          )}

          {/* Session Pack credits — OTC members only (Task #237) */}
          {!demo && (
            <SessionsOverrideSection member={m as MemberDetail} />
          )}

          {/* Weekly credit usage — EFT limited members only */}
          {!demo && (
            <EftWeeklyCreditsSection member={m as MemberDetail} />
          )}

          {/* Subscription (Phase 3) */}
          {!demo && (m as MemberDetail).subscriptionStatus !== 'paused' && (
            <SubscriptionSection member={m as MemberDetail} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import { getMemberDetail } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { MemberDetailContent } from './MemberDetailContent';
import { DEMO_MEMBER_DETAILS } from './demoMemberDetails';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';

export default async function MemberDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';

  const detail = await getMemberDetail(supabase, tenantId, id);
  if (detail) return <MemberDetailContent member={detail} />;

  const demo = DEMO_MEMBER_DETAILS[id];
  if (demo) return <MemberDetailContent member={demo} />;

  return notFound();
}

// ── Card expiry helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function isCardExpiringSoon(expMonth: number | null, expYear: number | null): boolean {
  if (!expMonth || !expYear) return false;
  const now = new Date();
  const currentYear = now.getFullYear();
  const currentMonth = now.getMonth() + 1;
  const monthsUntilExpiry =
    (expYear - currentYear) * 12 + (expMonth - currentMonth);
  return monthsUntilExpiry <= 2 && monthsUntilExpiry >= 0;
}

function isCardExpired(expMonth: number | null, expYear: number | null): boolean {
  if (!expMonth || !expYear) return false;
  const now = new Date();
  const currentYear = now.getFullYear();
  const currentMonth = now.getMonth() + 1;
  return expYear < currentYear || (expYear === currentYear && expMonth < currentMonth);
}

// ── Payment cell renderer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

function PaymentCell({ member }: { member: OwnerMember }) {
  const { cardLast4, cardBrand, cardExpMonth, cardExpYear, planType } = member;

  if (planType === 'otc') {
    return <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>OTC — no autopay</span>;
  }

  if (!cardLast4) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
        <CreditCard size={13} color={brand.danger} />
        <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.danger, fontWeight: 600 }}>No card on file</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const expiring = isCardExpiringSoon(cardExpMonth, cardExpYear);
  const expired  = isCardExpired(cardExpMonth, cardExpYear);
  const expLabel = cardExpMonth && cardExpYear
    ? `${String(cardExpMonth).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(cardExpYear).slice(-2)}`
    : '';

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, marginBottom: 3 }}>
        <CreditCard size={12} color={brand.textMuted} />
        <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>
          {cardBrand} ····{cardLast4}
        </span>
      </div>
      {expired ? (
        <Chip color="danger">Expired {expLabel}</Chip>
      ) : expiring ? (
        <Chip color="warning">Expiring Soon {expLabel}</Chip>
      ) : (
        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted }}>Exp {expLabel}</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

        : 'danger';

      const resumeDate = rawStatus === 'paused' && m.pauseEnd ? m.pauseEnd.slice(0, 10) : null;
      const hasPendingCancel = !!(m.cancelRequestedAt) && rawStatus !== 'cancelled';
      return (
        <div>
          <Chip color={color}>{label}</Chip>
          {resumeDate && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 3 }}>
              Resumes {resumeDate}
            </div>
          )}
          {hasPendingCancel && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#FFC107', marginTop: 3, fontWeight: 600 }}>
              Cancel pending
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    },
  },
  {
    label: 'Payment Method', key: 'cardLast4',
    render: (r) => <PaymentCell member={r as unknown as OwnerMember} />,
  },
  {
    label: 'Engagement', key: 'engagementScore', sortable: true,
    render: (r) => {
      const score = r.engagementScore as number;
      return (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ width: 60, height: 6, background: brand.border, borderRadius: 3, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{ width: `${score}%`, height: '100%', background: score >= 70 ? brand.success : score >= 50 ? brand.warning : brand.danger }} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>{score}</div>
        </div>
      );
    },
  },
  {
    label: 'Last Session', key: 'lastSession', sortable: true,
    render: (r) => <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>{r.lastSession as string}</span>,
  },
  {
    label: 'Next Charge', key: 'nextCharge',
    render: (r) => {
      const v = r.nextCharge as string;
      return <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: v === 'Overdue' ? brand.danger : brand.text, fontWeight: v === 'Overdue' ? 700 : 400 }}>{v}</span>;
    },
  },
  {
    label: 'MRR', key: 'mrr', sortable: true, align: 'right',
    render: (r) => <span style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontWeight: 700 }}>{(r.mrr as number) > 0 ? `$${r.mrr as number}` : '—'}</span>,
  },
];

// ── Shared input style ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px', border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
  borderRadius: 7, fontSize: 13, color: brand.text, background: brand.surface,
  fontFamily: fonts.body, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.5,
  textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 5, display: 'block',
};

// ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function MembersContent({ members }: Props) {
  const router  = useRouter();
  const source  = members.length ? members : DEMO_MEMBERS;
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'active' | 'paused' | 'pending-cancel' | 'at-risk' | 'card-expiring'>('all');
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast]   = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm]     = useState({
    parentName: '', parentEmail: '', kidName: '',
    ageGroup: '12U', program: 'Unlimited Monthly', planType: 'eft',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (toast) { const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500); return () => clearTimeout(t); }
  }, [toast]);

  const filtered = source.filter(m => {
    if (filter === 'active')         return m.status === 'active' || m.status === 'at-risk';
    if (filter === 'paused')         return m.status === 'paused';
    if (filter === 'pending-cancel') return !!(m as OwnerMember).cancelRequestedAt && m.status !== 'cancelled';
    if (filter === 'at-risk')        return m.churnRisk === 'high' || m.churnRisk === 'medium';
    if (filter === 'card-expiring') {
      return (
        isCardExpiringSoon(m.cardExpMonth, m.cardExpYear) ||
        isCardExpired(m.cardExpMonth, m.cardExpYear) ||
        (m.planType === 'eft' && !m.cardLast4)
      );
    }
    return true;
  });

  const cardExpiringSoonCount = source.filter(m =>
    isCardExpiringSoon(m.cardExpMonth, m.cardExpYear) ||
    isCardExpired(m.cardExpMonth, m.cardExpYear) ||
    (m.planType === 'eft' && !m.cardLast4)
  ).length;

  const pausedCount         = source.filter(m => m.status === 'paused').length;
  const pendingCancelCount  = source.filter(m => !!(m as OwnerMember).cancelRequestedAt && m.status !== 'cancelled').length;

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'all',             label: 'All',                count: source.length },
    { id: 'active',          label: 'Active',             count: source.filter(m => m.status === 'active' || m.status === 'at-risk').length },
    { id: 'paused',          label: 'Paused',             count: pausedCount },
    { id: 'pending-cancel',  label: 'Pending Cancel',     count: pendingCancelCount },
    { id: 'at-risk',         label: 'At Risk',            count: source.filter(m => m.churnRisk === 'high' || m.churnRisk === 'medium').length },
    { id: 'card-expiring',   label: 'Card Expiring Soon', count: cardExpiringSoonCount },
  ];

  const handleExport = () => {
    exportCsv(`members-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`,
      filtered as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[],
      [
        { label: 'Name',         key: 'name' },
        { label: 'Age',          key: 'age' },
        { label: 'Parent',       key: 'parent' },
        { label: 'Parent Phone', key: 'parentPhone' },
        { label: 'Parent Email', key: 'parentEmail' },
        { label: 'Program',      key: 'program' },
        { label: 'Plan',         key: 'planType' },
        { label: 'Status',       key: 'status' },
        { label: 'Card Brand',   key: 'cardBrand' },
        { label: 'Card Last4',   key: 'cardLast4' },
        { label: 'Card Exp',     key: 'cardExpMonth' },
        { label: 'Engagement',   key: 'engagementScore' },
        { label: 'Last Session', key: 'lastSession' },
        { label: 'Next Charge',  key: 'nextCharge' },
        { label: 'MRR',          key: 'mrr' },
        { label: 'Lifetime',     key: 'lifetime' },
        { label: 'Joined',       key: 'joinedDate' },
      ],
    );
    setToast(`Exported ${filtered.length} members as CSV`);
  };

  const handleAddMember = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setShowAddModal(false);
    setForm({ parentName: '', parentEmail: '', kidName: '', ageGroup: '12U', program: 'Unlimited Monthly', planType: 'eft' });
    setToast(`Invitation sent to ${form.parentEmail} — ${form.kidName} will appear once they complete signup`);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Members"
        subtitle={`${source.length} total · ${source.filter(m => m.status === 'active').length} active · ${source.filter(m => m.churnRisk === 'high').length} at high risk`}
        actions={
          <>
            <OButton variant="secondary" icon={Download} onClick={handleExport}>Export</OButton>
            <OButton variant="secondary" icon={Plus} onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}>Invite Member</OButton>
            <OButton variant="gold" icon={UserPlus} onClick={() => router.push('/owner/enroll')}>Enroll New Member</OButton>
          </>
        }
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 16, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {tabs.map(f => {
            const isCardTab = f.id === 'card-expiring';
            const isActive = filter === f.id;
            return (
              <div
                key={f.id}
                onClick={() => setFilter(f.id as typeof filter)}
                style={{
                  padding: '8px 14px', borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700,
                  background: isActive ? brand.dark : brand.surface,
                  color: isActive ? brand.gold : (isCardTab || f.id === 'pending-cancel') && f.count > 0 ? '#FFC107' : brand.textMuted,
                  border: `1px solid ${isActive ? brand.dark : (isCardTab || f.id === 'pending-cancel') && f.count > 0 ? 'rgba(255,193,7,0.4)' : brand.border}`,
                  cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase',
                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5,
                }}
              >
                {isCardTab && f.count > 0 && !isActive && <AlertTriangle size={11} color="#FFC107" />}
                {f.label} <span style={{ opacity: 0.7, marginLeft: 4 }}>{f.count}</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
          <div style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          <OButton variant="secondary" size="sm" icon={Filter}>More Filters</OButton>
        </div>

        <OTable
          columns={columns as TableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]}
          rows={filtered as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]}
          onRowClick={(row) => router.push(`/owner/members/${(row as unknown as OwnerMember).id}`)}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Add Member modal */}
      {showAddModal && (
        <div
          onClick={() => setShowAddModal(false)}
          style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)', zIndex: 200, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}
        >
          <div
            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{ width: 480, background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, boxShadow: '0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)', overflow: 'hidden' }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '18px 24px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display }}>Add New Member</div>
              <div onClick={() => setShowAddModal(false)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4 }}><X size={16} color={brand.textMuted} /></div>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleAddMember} style={{ padding: 24 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Parent Name</label>
                  <input required style={inputStyle} value={form.parentName} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, parentName: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Carlos Martinez" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Parent Email</label>
                  <input required type="email" style={inputStyle} value={form.parentEmail} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, parentEmail: e.target.value }))} placeholder="carlos@email.com" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Kid&apos;s Name</label>
                  <input required style={inputStyle} value={form.kidName} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, kidName: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Jake Martinez" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Age Group</label>
                  <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} value={form.ageGroup} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, ageGroup: e.target.value }))}>
                    {['8U','10U','12U','14U','HS','College'].map(a => <option key={a}>{a}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Program</label>
                  <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} value={form.program} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, program: e.target.value }))}>
                    {['Unlimited Monthly','Team Training','Cage Rental Monthly','8-Pack Lessons','4-Pack Lessons'].map(p => <option key={p}>{p}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Plan Type</label>
                  <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} value={form.planType} onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, planType: e.target.value }))}>
                    <option value="eft">EFT (Monthly)</option>
                    <option value="otc">OTC (Upfront)</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                <OButton variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShowAddModal(false)}>Cancel</OButton>
                <OButton variant="gold" icon={Plus}>Send Invitation</OButton>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 380 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function MissingInActionContent({ groups: rawGroups }: Props) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'7' | '14' | '30'>('7');

  const hasLiveData = rawGroups.sevenDay.length > 0 || rawGroups.fourteenDay.length > 0 || rawGroups.thirtyDay.length > 0;
  const groups = hasLiveData ? rawGroups : DEMO_GROUPS;

  const current = groups[tab === '7' ? 'sevenDay' : tab === '14' ? 'fourteenDay' : 'thirtyDay'];

  const totalRevenueAtRisk = [
    ...groups.sevenDay, ...groups.fourteenDay, ...groups.thirtyDay,
  ].reduce((s, m) => s + m.mrr, 0);

  const tabDefs = [
    { id: '7'  as const, label: '7+ Days',  count: groups.sevenDay.length,    color: brand.warning },
    { id: '14' as const, label: '14+ Days', count: groups.fourteenDay.length,  color: brand.warning },
    { id: '30' as const, label: '30+ Days', count: groups.thirtyDay.length,    color: brand.danger  },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Missing in Action"
        subtitle="Attendance-based early warning · Early intervention dramatically improves retention"
        actions={
          <>
            <OButton variant="secondary" icon={Download}>Export</OButton>
            <OButton variant="gold" icon={Send}>Send Group Email</OButton>
          </>
        }
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <KPICard label="Missing 7+ Days"  value={groups.sevenDay.length}    icon={Clock}         color="warning" />
          <KPICard label="Missing 14+ Days" value={groups.fourteenDay.length}  icon={AlertCircle}   color="warning" />
          <KPICard label="Missing 30+ Days" value={groups.thirtyDay.length}    icon={AlertTriangle} color="danger" />
          <KPICard label="Revenue at Risk"  value={`$${totalRevenueAtRisk.toLocaleString()}`} deltaLabel="monthly" icon={DollarSign} color="danger" />
        </div>

        <div style={{ padding: 14, background: brand.infoBg, borderRadius: 10, marginBottom: 20, display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 18, background: brand.info, color: brand.white, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <AlertCircle size={18} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.5, color: brand.text, flex: 1 }}>
            <strong>Why this matters:</strong> Youth sports members who miss 14+ days have a 68% probability of churning within the next 30 days. Members who miss 30+ days churn 82% of the time. <strong>A single outreach call recovers roughly 1 in 3.</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 20 }}>
          {tabDefs.map(t => (
            <div
              key={t.id}
              onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
              style={{
                padding: '10px 18px', borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700,
                background: tab === t.id ? brand.dark : brand.surface,
                color: tab === t.id ? brand.gold : brand.textMuted,
                border: `1px solid ${tab === t.id ? brand.dark : brand.border}`,
                cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase',
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
              }}
            >
              {t.label}
              <div style={{ padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 10, background: tab === t.id ? brand.gold : `${t.color}22`, color: tab === t.id ? brand.dark : t.color, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, fontFamily: fonts.display }}>
                {t.count}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <SectionHeader title={`Members missing ${tab}+ days`} subtitle="Sorted by last session date — oldest first" />

        {current.length > 0 ? (
          <OTable
            columns={columns as TableColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[]}
            rows={current as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]}
          />
        ) : (
          <div style={{ background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 40, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={48} color={brand.success} style={{ margin: '0 auto 12px' }} />
            <div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display }}>No members in this group</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>Great attendance. Keep it up.</div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  getLocationStripeStatus,
} from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';
import { DashboardContent } from './DashboardContent';

export default async function OwnerDashboardPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';

  const [members, kpis, revenueMonthly, packages, tenantName, locationStripe] = await Promise.all([
    getOwnerMembers(supabase, tenantId),
    getOwnerKPIs(supabase, tenantId),
    getMonthlyRevenue(supabase, tenantId),
    getMembershipPackages(supabase, tenantId),
    getTenantName(supabase, tenantId),
    getLocationStripeStatus(supabase, tenantId),
  ]);

  const stripeConnected = locationStripe?.stripe_onboarding_status === 'connected';

  return (
    <DashboardContent
      kpis={kpis}
      members={members}
      revenueMonthly={revenueMonthly}
      packages={packages}
      locationName={tenantName}
      tenantName={tenantName}
      stripeConnected={stripeConnected}
    />
  );
}

import { Suspense } from 'react';

=================================================================================
FILE: portal/app/owner/payments/PaymentsContent.tsx
