                    <td style={{ padding: '13px 16px' }}>
                      <span style={{
                        display: 'inline-block',
                        padding: '2px 8px',
                        borderRadius: 4,
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        background: `${STATUS_COLOR[t.status] ?? brand.border}22`,
                        color: STATUS_COLOR[t.status] ?? brand.textMuted,
                      }}>
                        {t.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── Cohort Retention ── */}
        {cohortRetention.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
            <SectionHeader title="Cohort Retention" subtitle="% of members still active since joining" />
            <OCard padding={0}>
              <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
                <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 12 }}>
                  <thead>
                    <tr style={{ background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 16px', textAlign: 'left', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 1, fontFamily: fonts.display, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Cohort</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 12px', textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 1, fontFamily: fonts.display, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Size</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 12px', textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 1, fontFamily: fonts.display, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>M0</th>
                      <th style={{ padding: '10px 12px', textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 1, fontFamily: fonts.display, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Current</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {cohortRetention.map((row, i) => (
                      <tr key={i} style={{ borderBottom: i < cohortRetention.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${brand.border}` : 'none' }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 16px', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12 }}>{row.cohort}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '10px 12px', textAlign: 'center', fontFamily: fonts.mono, color: brand.textMuted }}>{row.size}</td>
                        {row.retention.map((pct, j) => {
                          const bg = pct >= 90 ? '#22c55e33' : pct >= 80 ? '#84cc1633' : pct >= 70 ? '#eab30833' : '#ef444433';
                          const textColor = pct >= 80 ? brand.success : pct >= 60 ? brand.warning : brand.danger;
                          return (
                            <td key={j} style={{ padding: '10px 12px', textAlign: 'center', background: bg, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontWeight: 700, color: textColor }}>
                              {pct}%
                            </td>
                          );
                        })}
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </OCard>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>

    {toast && (
      <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: toastError ? brand.danger : brand.dark, color: toastError ? '#fff' : brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 380 }}>
        {toast}
      </div>
    )}
    </>
  );
}

'use server';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { readTenantId } from '@/lib/auth';
import type { ScheduleBooking } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';

export type FetchScheduleResult = {
  bookings: ScheduleBooking[];
  waitlistByHour: Record<string, number>;
};

function localHourLabel(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const h = d.getHours();
  return h === 0 ? '12 AM' : h < 12 ? `${h} AM` : h === 12 ? '12 PM' : `${h - 12} PM`;
}

export async function fetchScheduleRange(
  rangeStart: string,
  rangeEnd: string,
): Promise<FetchScheduleResult> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const tenantId = readTenantId(session) ?? '';

  if (!tenantId) throw new Error('No authenticated session — cannot fetch schedule');

  const [bookingRes, waitlistRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select(`
        id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, cage_number, status,
        session_types(name),
        kids(first_name, last_name),
        coaches(first_name, last_name)
      `)
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .gte('scheduled_start', rangeStart)
      .lte('scheduled_start', rangeEnd)
      .order('scheduled_start'),
    supabase
      .from('booking_waitlist')
      .select('scheduled_start')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .in('status', ['waiting', 'notified'])
      .gte('scheduled_start', rangeStart)
      .lte('scheduled_start', rangeEnd),
  ]);

  if (bookingRes.error) {
    console.error('[fetchScheduleRange] error:', bookingRes.error.message);
    return { bookings: [], waitlistByHour: {} };
  }

  const bookings: ScheduleBooking[] = (bookingRes.data ?? []).map(b => {
    const kid   = b.kids as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
    const coach = b.coaches as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
    const st    = b.session_types as unknown as { name: string } | null;
    return {
      id:             b.id,
      kidName:        kid   ? [kid.first_name,   kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ')   : 'Unknown',
      coachName:      coach ? [coach.first_name, coach.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') : '—',
      scheduledStart: b.scheduled_start,
      scheduledEnd:   b.scheduled_end ?? b.scheduled_start,
      cage:           b.cage_number ? `Cage ${b.cage_number}` : null,
      sessionType:    st?.name ?? 'Private',
      status:         b.status,
    };
  });

  const waitlistByHour: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const row of waitlistRes.data ?? []) {
    const lbl = localHourLabel(row.scheduled_start);
    waitlistByHour[lbl] = (waitlistByHour[lbl] ?? 0) + 1;
  }

  return { bookings, waitlistByHour };
}

export async function assignCageAction(
  bookingId: string,
  cageNumber: number | null,
): Promise<{ error?: string }> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .update({ cage_number: cageNumber })
    .eq('id', bookingId);
  if (error) {
    console.error('[assignCageAction] error:', error.message);
    return { error: error.message };
  }
  return {};
}

const CAGES = ['Cage 1','Cage 2','Cage 3','Cage 4','Cage 5','Cage 6','Cage 7','Cage 8','Unassigned'];
const CAGE_NUMBERS: Record<string, number | null> = {
  'Cage 1': 1, 'Cage 2': 2, 'Cage 3': 3, 'Cage 4': 4,
  'Cage 5': 5, 'Cage 6': 6, 'Cage 7': 7, 'Cage 8': 8,
  'Unassigned': null,

const DAY_NAMES        = ['SUN','MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT'];
const MONTH_NAMES      = ['JAN','FEB','MAR','APR','MAY','JUN','JUL','AUG','SEP','OCT','NOV','DEC'];
const MONTH_NAMES_LONG = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
const WEEK_DAY_LABELS  = ['MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT','SUN'];

// ── Pure helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function isSameDay(a: Date, b: Date): boolean {
  return a.toDateString() === b.toDateString();
}

function toInputDate(d: Date): string {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

function getWeekStart(d: Date): Date {
  const n = new Date(d);
  n.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const dow = n.getDay();
  n.setDate(n.getDate() + (dow === 0 ? -6 : 1 - dow));
  return n;
}

function getWeekDays(d: Date): Date[] {
  const start = getWeekStart(d);
  return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
    const day = new Date(start);
    day.setDate(start.getDate() + i);
    return day;
  });
}

function getMonthGrid(d: Date): Date[] {
  const first = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), 1);
  const dow = first.getDay();
  const offset = dow === 0 ? 6 : dow - 1;
  const start = new Date(first);
  start.setDate(1 - offset);
  return Array.from({ length: 42 }, (_, i) => {
    const day = new Date(start);
    day.setDate(start.getDate() + i);
    return day;
  });
}

function navLabel(d: Date, mode: ViewMode): string {
  if (mode === 'day') {
    return `${DAY_NAMES[d.getDay()]} · ${MONTH_NAMES[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
  }
  if (mode === 'week') {
    const days = getWeekDays(d);
    const s = days[0]; const e = days[6];
    if (s.getFullYear() !== e.getFullYear())
      return `${MONTH_NAMES[s.getMonth()]} ${s.getDate()}, ${s.getFullYear()} – ${MONTH_NAMES[e.getMonth()]} ${e.getDate()}, ${e.getFullYear()}`;
    if (s.getMonth() === e.getMonth())
      return `${MONTH_NAMES_LONG[s.getMonth()]} ${s.getDate()}–${e.getDate()}, ${s.getFullYear()}`;
    return `${MONTH_NAMES[s.getMonth()]} ${s.getDate()} – ${MONTH_NAMES[e.getMonth()]} ${e.getDate()}, ${e.getFullYear()}`;
  }
  return `${MONTH_NAMES_LONG[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

function localHourLabel(iso: string): string {
  const h = new Date(iso).getHours();
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const hr12 = h > 12 ? h - 12 : h === 0 ? 12 : h;
  return `${hr12} ${ampm}`;
}

function todayAt(h24: number): string {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(h24, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.toISOString();
}

function cageLabel(cage: string | null): string { return cage ?? 'Unassigned'; }

function slotsForDayHourCage(bookings: ScheduleBooking[], cage: string, hour: string): ScheduleBooking[] {
  return bookings.filter(b => {
    const lbl = localHourLabel(b.scheduledStart);
    return cage === 'Unassigned'
      ? lbl === hour && b.cage === null
      : lbl === hour && b.cage === cage;
  });
}

type Popover = { bookingId: string; currentCage: string | null; top: number; left: number; isDemo?: boolean };

type Props = { data: OwnerScheduleData; tenantId: string };

// ── Style constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const STATUS_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  confirmed: brand.success,
  pending:   brand.warning,
  completed: brand.info,
  cancelled: brand.danger,
};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px', border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
  borderRadius: 7, fontSize: 13, color: brand.text, background: brand.surface,
  fontFamily: fonts.body, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box',
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.5,
  textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 5, display: 'block',
};

// ── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function ScheduleContent({ data, tenantId }: Props) {
  const hasLiveData = data.bookings.length > 0;
  const todayDate   = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);

  const [bookings,       setBookings]      = useState<ScheduleBooking[]>(hasLiveData ? data.bookings : DEMO_BOOKINGS);
  const [waitlistByHour, setWaitlistByHour] = useState<Map<string, number>>(new Map());
  const [loading,        setLoading]       = useState(false);
  const [popover,        setPopover]       = useState<Popover | null>(null);
  const [saving,         setSaving]        = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [cancelling,     setCancelling]    = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg,       setErrorMsg]      = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [viewMode,       setViewMode]      = useState<ViewMode>('day');
  const [currentDate,    setCurrentDate]   = useState<Date>(() => new Date());
  const [showFilter,     setShowFilter]    = useState(false);
  const [filterType,     setFilterType]    = useState<string>('all');
  const [filterCoach,    setFilterCoach]   = useState<string>('all');
  const [showNewBooking, setShowNewBooking] = useState(false);
  const [toast,          setToast]         = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [bookingForm,    setBookingForm]   = useState({
    kidName: '', coachName: 'Mike Rodriguez', sessionType: 'Private',
    date: toInputDate(new Date()), startHour: '9', cage: 'Cage 1',
  });

  const popoverRef     = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const dateInputRef   = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  // skipOnce: true when SSR already gave us data for the initial view.
  // The cleanup-reset pattern makes this work even under React Strict Mode,
  // which fires effects twice on mount in development.
  const skipOnce = useRef(hasLiveData);

  // ── Sync initial server data ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    setBookings(prev => {
      const local = prev.filter(b => b.id.startsWith('local-'));
      return [...(hasLiveData ? data.bookings : DEMO_BOOKINGS), ...local];
    });
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [data.bookings]);

  // ── Live reload when date / view changes ─────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tenantId) return;

    // Skip the initial fetch when SSR already provided data.
    // Return a cleanup that resets the flag so React Strict Mode's
    // second mount also skips — without this reset, Strict Mode clears
    // the ref on mount #1 and then fires the fetch on mount #2, wiping
    // the SSR bookings with an empty result.
    if (skipOnce.current) {
      skipOnce.current = false;
      return () => { skipOnce.current = true; };
    }

    let cancelled = false;

    let rangeStart: Date, rangeEnd: Date;
    if (viewMode === 'month') {
      rangeStart = new Date(currentDate.getFullYear(), currentDate.getMonth(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
      rangeEnd   = new Date(currentDate.getFullYear(), currentDate.getMonth() + 1, 0, 23, 59, 59, 999);
    } else if (viewMode === 'week') {
      rangeStart = getWeekStart(currentDate);
      rangeEnd   = new Date(rangeStart.getTime() + 7 * 86_400_000 - 1);
    } else {
      rangeStart = new Date(currentDate); rangeStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      rangeEnd   = new Date(currentDate); rangeEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    }

    setLoading(true);
    (async () => {
      try {
        const result = await fetchScheduleRange(
          rangeStart.toISOString(),
          rangeEnd.toISOString(),
        );
        if (cancelled) return;
        setBookings(prev => {
          const local = prev.filter(bk => bk.id.startsWith('local-'));
          return [...result.bookings, ...local];
        });
        setWaitlistByHour(new Map(Object.entries(result.waitlistByHour)));
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) console.error('[schedule] fetch error:', err);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();

    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [tenantId, currentDate, viewMode]);

  // ── Toast auto-clear ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (toast) { const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500); return () => clearTimeout(t); }
  }, [toast]);

  // ── Derived data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const isToday = isSameDay(currentDate, todayDate);

  // Bookings for the currently viewed day (or all loaded bookings in week/month mode)
  const currentViewBookings = useMemo(
    () => viewMode === 'day'
      ? bookings.filter(b => isSameDay(new Date(b.scheduledStart), currentDate))
      : bookings,
    [bookings, currentDate, viewMode],
  );

  const TOTAL_SLOTS  = 8 * 14;
  const totalToday   = currentViewBookings.length > 0 ? currentViewBookings.length : (!hasLiveData ? DEMO_BOOKINGS.length : 0);
  const occupancyPct = currentViewBookings.length > 0
    ? Math.round((currentViewBookings.length / TOTAL_SLOTS) * 1000) / 10
    : (!hasLiveData ? 78 : 0);
  const openSlots    = TOTAL_SLOTS - (currentViewBookings.length > 0 ? currentViewBookings.length : (!hasLiveData ? DEMO_BOOKINGS.length : 0));

  const hourCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  const hourSource = currentViewBookings.length > 0 ? currentViewBookings : (!hasLiveData ? DEMO_BOOKINGS : []);
  for (const b of hourSource) {
    const lbl = localHourLabel(b.scheduledStart);
    hourCounts[lbl] = (hourCounts[lbl] ?? 0) + 1;
  }
  const peakHour = Object.keys(hourCounts).length > 0
    ? Object.entries(hourCounts).sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a)[0][0]
    : (!hasLiveData ? '4 PM' : null);

  const hourBarData = HOURS.map(h => ({ label: h, value: hourCounts[h] ?? 0, highlight: h === peakHour }));

  const coaches = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set(bookings.map(b => b.coachName).filter(Boolean))),
    [bookings],
  );

  const weekDays  = useMemo(() => getWeekDays(currentDate),  [currentDate]);
  const monthGrid = useMemo(() => getMonthGrid(currentDate), [currentDate]);

  const viewBookings = viewMode === 'day'
    ? bookings.filter(b => isSameDay(new Date(b.scheduledStart), currentDate))
    : bookings;

  const filteredViewBookings = useMemo(() => viewBookings.filter(b => {
    if (filterType  !== 'all' && b.sessionType !== filterType)  return false;
    if (filterCoach !== 'all' && b.coachName   !== filterCoach) return false;
    return true;
  }), [viewBookings, filterType, filterCoach]);

  const sessionTypeMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const b of filteredViewBookings) {
    sessionTypeMap[b.sessionType] = (sessionTypeMap[b.sessionType] ?? 0) + 1;
  }
  const sessionTypes = Object.entries(sessionTypeMap);

  // ── Popover ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!popover) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (popoverRef.current && !popoverRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setPopover(null);
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setPopover(null); };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); };
  }, [popover]);

  const openPopover = useCallback((booking: ScheduleBooking, e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const rect = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
    setPopover({
      bookingId: booking.id,
      currentCage: booking.cage,
      top: rect.bottom + 4,
      left: rect.left,
      isDemo: booking.id.startsWith('b') && !booking.id.startsWith('local-'),
    });
    setErrorMsg(null);
  }, []);

  const cancelBookingOverride = useCallback(async (bookingId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Cancel this booking immediately? This bypasses the cancellation policy.')) return;
    setPopover(null);
    if (bookingId.startsWith('local-') || bookingId.match(/^b\d+$/)) {
      // Demo booking — remove from local state only
      setBookings(prev => prev.filter(b => b.id !== bookingId));
      setToast('Demo booking cancelled (no DB write).');
      return;
    }
    setCancelling(bookingId);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/bookings/cancel', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ booking_id: bookingId, reason: 'Staff override' }),
      });
      const resData = await res.json() as { ok?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !resData.ok) {
        setErrorMsg(resData.error ?? `Cancel failed (${res.status})`);
        return;
      }
      setBookings(prev => prev.map(b => b.id === bookingId ? { ...b, status: 'cancelled' } : b));
      setToast('Booking cancelled.');
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
    } finally {
      setCancelling(null);
    }
  }, []);

  const assignCage = useCallback(async (bookingId: string, cageName: string) => {
    const cageNum = CAGE_NUMBERS[cageName];
    const previous = bookings.find(b => b.id === bookingId);
    setBookings(prev => prev.map(b => b.id === bookingId ? { ...b, cage: cageNum == null ? null : cageName } : b));
    setPopover(null);
    if (bookingId.startsWith('local-') || !tenantId) return;
    setSaving(bookingId);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const result = await assignCageAction(bookingId, cageNum ?? null);
      if (result.error) throw new Error(result.error);
    } catch {
      if (previous) setBookings(prev => prev.map(b => b.id === bookingId ? previous : b));
      setErrorMsg('Failed to save cage assignment. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(null);
    }
  }, [bookings, tenantId]);

  // ── Navigation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const navigateDate = (delta: number) => {
    setCurrentDate(d => {
      const n = new Date(d);
      if      (viewMode === 'month') n.setMonth(n.getMonth() + delta);
      else if (viewMode === 'week')  n.setDate(n.getDate() + delta * 7);
      else                           n.setDate(n.getDate() + delta);
      return n;
    });
  };

  const openDatePicker = () => {
    const input = dateInputRef.current;
    if (!input) return;
    try { (input as HTMLInputElement & { showPicker: () => void }).showPicker(); }
    catch { input.focus(); }
  };

  // ── Create booking (optimistic, no DB write) ─────────────────────────────
  const handleNewBooking = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const { kidName, coachName, sessionType, date, startHour, cage } = bookingForm;
    if (!date || !kidName.trim()) return;

    const [y, mo, d] = date.split('-').map(Number);
    const hourNum = parseInt(startHour, 10);
    const start = new Date(y, mo - 1, d, hourNum, 0, 0, 0);
    const end   = new Date(start.getTime() + 60 * 60 * 1000);

    const newBooking: ScheduleBooking = {
      id:             `local-${Date.now()}`,
      kidName:        kidName.trim(),
      coachName,
      scheduledStart: start.toISOString(),
      scheduledEnd:   end.toISOString(),
      cage,
      sessionType,
      status: 'pending',
    };

    setBookings(prev => [...prev, newBooking]);
    setCurrentDate(new Date(y, mo - 1, d));
    setViewMode('day');
    setShowNewBooking(false);
    setBookingForm({ kidName: '', coachName: 'Mike Rodriguez', sessionType: 'Private', date: toInputDate(new Date()), startHour: '9', cage: 'Cage 1' });
    setToast(`Booking added for ${kidName.trim()} — ${sessionType} with ${coachName}`);
  };

  const viewBtn = (mode: ViewMode, label: string) => (
    <OButton variant={viewMode === mode ? 'gold' : 'ghost'} size="sm" onClick={() => setViewMode(mode)}>
      {label}
    </OButton>
  );

  // ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <div onClick={() => setPopover(null)}>
      <PageHeader
        title="Schedule & Capacity"
        subtitle={`${navLabel(currentDate, viewMode)} · 8 cages`}
        actions={
          <>
            <OButton variant="secondary" icon={Filter} onClick={() => setShowFilter(o => !o)}>
              Filter{(filterType !== 'all' || filterCoach !== 'all') ? ' ●' : ''}
            </OButton>
            <OButton variant="gold" icon={Plus} onClick={() => setShowNewBooking(true)}>New Booking</OButton>
          </>
        }
      />

      <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>

        {/* ── KPI row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
          <KPICard label={isToday ? "Today's Sessions" : `${MONTH_NAMES[currentDate.getMonth()]} ${currentDate.getDate()} Sessions`} value={totalToday} deltaLabel="booked" icon={Calendar} color="gold" />
          <KPICard label={isToday ? "Today's Occupancy" : "Day Occupancy"} value={`${occupancyPct}%`} icon={Activity} color="success" />
          <KPICard label="Peak Hour"  value={peakHour ?? '—'} deltaLabel="busiest slot" icon={TrendingUp} color="warning" />
          <KPICard label="Open Slots" value={openSlots}       deltaLabel={isToday ? 'today' : 'this day'} icon={Clock} />
        </div>

        {/* ── Filter panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {showFilter && (
          <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ marginBottom: 16, padding: '16px 20px', background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, display: 'flex', gap: 20, alignItems: 'flex-end', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div style={{ minWidth: 160 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Session Type</label>
              <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} value={filterType} onChange={e => setFilterType(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="all">All Types</option>
                <option value="Private">Private</option>
                <option value="Group">Group</option>
                <option value="Cage Rental">Cage Rental</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div style={{ minWidth: 180 }}>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Coach</label>
              <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} value={filterCoach} onChange={e => setFilterCoach(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="all">All Coaches</option>
                {coaches.map(c => <option key={c}>{c}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <OButton variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => { setFilterType('all'); setFilterCoach('all'); }}>Clear</OButton>
            <OButton variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => setShowFilter(false)}>Done</OButton>
          </div>
        )}

        {errorMsg && (
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 12, padding: '10px 14px', background: `${brand.danger}18`, border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`, borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 12, color: brand.danger }}>
            {errorMsg}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ── Navigation bar ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, marginBottom: 16, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <OButton variant="secondary" size="sm" icon={ChevronLeft} onClick={() => navigateDate(-1)}>Prev</OButton>

          {/* Clickable date with hidden native date-picker */}
          <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={openDatePicker}
              title="Click to jump to a date"
              onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.borderColor = brand.border; }}
              onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.borderColor = 'transparent'; }}
              style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, padding: '5px 10px', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid transparent', borderRadius: 6, cursor: 'pointer', color: brand.text, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}
            >
              {navLabel(currentDate, viewMode)}
              <Calendar size={13} color={brand.textMuted} />
            </button>
            <input
              ref={dateInputRef}
              type="date"
              value={toInputDate(currentDate)}
              onChange={e => {
                if (!e.target.value) return;
                const [y, m, d] = e.target.value.split('-').map(Number);
                setCurrentDate(new Date(y, m - 1, d));
              }}
              style={{ position: 'absolute', opacity: 0, pointerEvents: 'none', width: 0, height: 0, padding: 0, border: 0 }}
            />
          </div>

          <OButton variant="secondary" size="sm" icon={ChevronRight} onClick={() => navigateDate(1)}>Next</OButton>
          <OButton variant={isToday ? 'gold' : 'ghost'} size="sm" onClick={() => setCurrentDate(new Date())}>Today</OButton>
          <div style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          {loading && <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>Loading…</span>}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
            {viewBtn('day',   'Day')}
            {viewBtn('week',  'Week')}
            {viewBtn('month', 'Month')}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            DAY VIEW — cage × hour grid
        ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
        {viewMode === 'day' && (
          <OCard padding={0}>
            <div style={{ overflow: 'auto' }}>
              <div style={{ minWidth: 900, padding: 16 }}>
                {/* Cage column headers */}
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '60px repeat(8, 1fr) minmax(80px, 0.8fr)', gap: 4, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                  <div />
                  {CAGES.map(c => (
                    <div key={c} style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: c === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : brand.textMuted, textAlign: 'center', letterSpacing: 0.5, padding: '6px 0', background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderRadius: 4, fontStyle: c === 'Unassigned' ? 'italic' : 'normal' }}>
                      {c.toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {/* Hour rows */}
                {HOURS.map((hr, hi) => (
                  <div key={hi} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '60px repeat(8, 1fr) minmax(80px, 0.8fr)', gap: 4, marginBottom: 4, minHeight: 48 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, padding: '14px 0', textAlign: 'right', paddingRight: 8 }}>
                      {hr}
                      {waitlistByHour.get(hr) ? (
                        <div style={{ marginTop: 2, fontSize: 8, fontWeight: 800, color: '#f59e0b', letterSpacing: 0, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                          +{waitlistByHour.get(hr)} waitlist
                        </div>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    {CAGES.map((cage, ci) => {
                      const slot = slotsForDayHourCage(filteredViewBookings, cage, hr);
                      const statusColor = slot[0] ? (STATUS_COLOR[slot[0].status] ?? brand.info) : null;
                      return (
                        <div key={ci} style={{ background: statusColor ? `${statusColor}22` : brand.creamLight, borderRadius: 6, padding: 6, border: `1px solid ${statusColor ?? brand.border}`, minHeight: 42 }}>
                          {slot.map((b, si) => (
                            <div
                              key={si}
                              onClick={e => openPopover(b, e)}
                              title={`${b.kidName} · ${b.sessionType}${b.coachName ? ` · ${b.coachName}` : ''}\nClick to assign cage`}
                              style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 700, color: saving === b.id ? brand.textMuted : (STATUS_COLOR[b.status] ?? brand.info), lineHeight: 1.4, borderRadius: 3, padding: '1px 2px', cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }}
                            >
                              {b.kidName}
                              {cage === 'Unassigned' && <div style={{ fontSize: 8, color: brand.warning, fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 1 }}>tap to assign</div>}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </OCard>
        )}

        {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            WEEK VIEW — day × hour grid (Mon–Sun)
        ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
        {viewMode === 'week' && (
          <OCard padding={0}>
            <div style={{ overflow: 'auto' }}>
              <div style={{ minWidth: 720, padding: 16 }}>
                {/* Day column headers */}
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '60px repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 4, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                  <div />
                  {weekDays.map((day, i) => {
                    const isDayToday = isSameDay(day, todayDate);
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={i}
                        onClick={() => { setCurrentDate(day); setViewMode('day'); }}
                        title="Click to open day view"
                        style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '8px 4px', background: isDayToday ? `${brand.goldDeep}22` : brand.surfaceAlt, border: `1px solid ${isDayToday ? brand.goldDeep : 'transparent'}`, borderRadius: 6, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                      >
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>{WEEK_DAY_LABELS[i]}</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700, color: isDayToday ? brand.goldDeep : brand.text, marginTop: 2 }}>{day.getDate()}</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: brand.textMuted }}>{MONTH_NAMES[day.getMonth()]}</div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
                {/* Hour rows */}
                {HOURS.map((hr, hi) => (
                  <div key={hi} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '60px repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 4, marginBottom: 4, minHeight: 44 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, padding: '12px 0', textAlign: 'right', paddingRight: 8 }}>{hr}</div>
                    {weekDays.map((day, di) => {
                      const slot = filteredViewBookings.filter(b =>
                        isSameDay(new Date(b.scheduledStart), day) && localHourLabel(b.scheduledStart) === hr,
                      );
                      const statusColor = slot[0] ? (STATUS_COLOR[slot[0].status] ?? brand.info) : null;
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={di}
                          onClick={() => slot.length > 0 && (() => { setCurrentDate(day); setViewMode('day'); })()}
                          style={{ background: statusColor ? `${statusColor}22` : brand.creamLight, borderRadius: 6, padding: '4px 6px', border: `1px solid ${statusColor ?? brand.border}`, minHeight: 40, cursor: slot.length > 0 ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}
                        >
                          {slot.map((b, si) => (
                            <div key={si} style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 700, color: STATUS_COLOR[b.status] ?? brand.info, lineHeight: 1.4, padding: '1px 2px', userSelect: 'none' }}>
                              {b.kidName}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </OCard>
        )}

        {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            MONTH VIEW — calendar grid with booking counts
        ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
        {viewMode === 'month' && (
          <OCard padding={0}>
            <div style={{ padding: 16 }}>
              {/* Day-of-week headers */}
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {WEEK_DAY_LABELS.map(d => (
                  <div key={d} style={{ textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.5, padding: '6px 0' }}>{d}</div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {/* 6 × 7 calendar cells */}
              {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, row) => (
                <div key={row} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 6, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                  {monthGrid.slice(row * 7, row * 7 + 7).map((day, col) => {
                    const isCurrentMonth = day.getMonth() === currentDate.getMonth();
                    const isDayToday     = isSameDay(day, todayDate);
                    const dayCount       = filteredViewBookings.filter(b => isSameDay(new Date(b.scheduledStart), day)).length;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={col}
                        onClick={() => { setCurrentDate(day); setViewMode('day'); }}
                        onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.filter = 'brightness(0.95)'; }}
                        onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.filter = 'none'; }}
                        style={{ minHeight: 68, padding: '8px 10px', borderRadius: 6, cursor: 'pointer', background: isDayToday ? `${brand.goldDeep}18` : (isCurrentMonth ? brand.creamLight : brand.surfaceAlt), border: `1px solid ${isDayToday ? brand.goldDeep : brand.border}`, opacity: isCurrentMonth ? 1 : 0.45, transition: 'opacity 0.1s' }}
                      >
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: isDayToday ? 700 : 400, color: isDayToday ? brand.goldDeep : brand.text, marginBottom: 4 }}>
                          {day.getDate()}
                        </div>
                        {dayCount > 0 && (
                          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.success, background: `${brand.success}22`, borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 6px' }}>
                            {dayCount}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </OCard>
        )}

        {/* ── Charts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 20 }}>
          <OCard>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, color: brand.text, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Peak Hour Analysis</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>Today&apos;s hourly booking distribution</div>
            </div>
            <BarChart data={hourBarData} height={180} />
          </OCard>

          <OCard>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 14, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, color: brand.text, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Session Type Breakdown</div>
            {sessionTypes.length > 0 ? (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 20, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <DonutChart data={sessionTypes.map(([, v], i) => ({ value: v, color: [brand.goldDeep, brand.info, brand.success, brand.warning][i % 4] }))} size={140} />
                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  {sessionTypes.map(([type, count], i) => (
                    <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '5px 0', borderBottom: i < sessionTypes.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${brand.border}` : 'none' }}>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                        <div style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 2, background: [brand.goldDeep, brand.info, brand.success, brand.warning][i % 4] }} />
                        <span style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{type}</span>
                      </div>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700 }}>{count}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>No sessions booked yet.</div>
            )}
          </OCard>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Cage assignment + actions popover ───────────────────────────── */}
      {popover && (
        <div
          ref={popoverRef}
          onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
          style={{ position: 'fixed', top: Math.min(popover.top, window.innerHeight - 320), left: Math.min(popover.left, window.innerWidth - 180), zIndex: 1000, background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)', padding: 8, minWidth: 160 }}
        >
          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase', padding: '4px 8px 6px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, marginBottom: 4 }}>
            Assign Cage
          </div>
          {CAGES.map(cage => {
            const isCurrent = cageLabel(popover.currentCage) === cage;
            return (
              <button
                key={cage}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => assignCage(popover.bookingId, cage)}
                onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.background = `${brand.goldDeep}18`; }}
                onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.background = isCurrent ? `${brand.goldDeep}22` : 'transparent'; }}
                style={{ display: 'block', width: '100%', textAlign: 'left', padding: '7px 10px', border: 'none', borderRadius: 5, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: isCurrent ? 700 : 400, background: isCurrent ? `${brand.goldDeep}22` : 'transparent', color: cage === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : (isCurrent ? brand.goldDeep : brand.text), fontStyle: cage === 'Unassigned' ? 'italic' : 'normal' }}
              >
                {isCurrent ? `✓ ${cage}` : cage}
              </button>
            );
          })}

          {/* Staff actions */}
          <div style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, marginTop: 6, paddingTop: 6 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.textMuted, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase', padding: '0 8px 5px' }}>
              Actions
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={cancelling === popover.bookingId}
              onClick={() => void cancelBookingOverride(popover.bookingId)}
              onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.background = `${brand.danger}18`; }}
              onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement).style.background = 'transparent'; }}
              style={{ display: 'block', width: '100%', textAlign: 'left', padding: '7px 10px', border: 'none', borderRadius: 5, cursor: cancelling === popover.bookingId ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, background: 'transparent', color: brand.danger, opacity: cancelling === popover.bookingId ? 0.6 : 1 }}
            >
              {cancelling === popover.bookingId ? 'Cancelling…' : 'Cancel (Staff Override)'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── New Booking modal ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showNewBooking && (

              <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowNewBooking(false)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 4 }}><X size={16} color={brand.textMuted} /></button>

                    <option>Group</option>
                    <option>Cage Rental</option>

                      ? coaches.map(c => <option key={c}>{c}</option>)

                    }
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 16, marginBottom: 24 }}>
                <div>

                  <input type="date" required style={inputStyle} value={bookingForm.date} onChange={e => setBookingForm(f => ({ ...f, date: e.target.value }))} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Start Time</label>
                  <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} value={bookingForm.startHour} onChange={e => setBookingForm(f => ({ ...f, startHour: e.target.value }))}>
                    {HOURS.map((h, i) => <option key={h} value={String(9 + i)}>{h}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle}>Cage</label>
                  <select style={{ ...inputStyle, appearance: 'auto' }} value={bookingForm.cage} onChange={e => setBookingForm(f => ({ ...f, cage: e.target.value }))}>
                    {CAGES.filter(c => c !== 'Unassigned').map(c => <option key={c}>{c}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                <OButton type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShowNewBooking(false)}>Cancel</OButton>
                <OButton type="submit" variant="gold" icon={Plus}>Create Booking</OButton>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Toast ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {toast && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', bottom: 24, right: 24, zIndex: 500, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 8, boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, maxWidth: 380 }}>
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { OCard, PageHeader, OButton } from '@/components/owner/ui';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';

type CancellationPolicy = {
  booking_cancel_window_hours: number;
  booking_cancel_fee_cents: number;
  membership_cancel_notice_days: number;
};

const DEFAULTS: CancellationPolicy = {
  booking_cancel_window_hours: 24,
  booking_cancel_fee_cents: 0,
  membership_cancel_notice_days: 30,
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: 11,
  fontWeight: 700,
  color: brand.textMuted,
  letterSpacing: 0.5,
  textTransform: 'uppercase',
  marginBottom: 5,
  display: 'block',
};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%',
  padding: '9px 12px',
  border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
  borderRadius: 7,
  fontSize: 13,
  color: brand.text,
  background: brand.surface,
  fontFamily: fonts.body,
  outline: 'none',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
};

function FieldGroup({
  label,
  hint,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
      <label style={labelStyle}>{label}</label>
      {children}
      {hint && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>{hint}</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function SettingsContent() {
  const [policy, setPolicy] = useState<CancellationPolicy>(DEFAULTS);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ msg: string; kind: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createClient();
    (async () => {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await (supabase as unknown as import('@supabase/supabase-js').SupabaseClient)
          .from('tenant_config')
          .select(
            'booking_cancel_window_hours, booking_cancel_fee_cents, membership_cancel_notice_days',
          )
          .maybeSingle();
        if (error) throw error;
        if (data) {
          setPolicy({
            booking_cancel_window_hours: (data as CancellationPolicy).booking_cancel_window_hours ?? 24,
            booking_cancel_fee_cents: (data as CancellationPolicy).booking_cancel_fee_cents ?? 0,
            membership_cancel_notice_days:
              (data as CancellationPolicy).membership_cancel_notice_days ?? 30,
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[settings] load error:', err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (toast) {
      const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
  }, [toast]);

  const handleSave = useCallback(async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/settings/policy', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(policy),
      });
      const json = await res.json() as { ok?: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? 'Save failed');
      setToast({ msg: 'Cancellation policy saved.', kind: 'success' });
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Save failed';
      setToast({ msg, kind: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }, [policy]);

  const numField = (
    key: keyof CancellationPolicy,
    min: number,
    max: number,
  ) => (
    <input
      type="number"
      min={min}
      max={max}
      style={inputStyle}
      value={policy[key]}
      onChange={(e) =>
        setPolicy((p) => ({
          ...p,
          [key]: Math.max(min, Math.min(max, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0)),
        }))
      }
    />
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Settings"
        subtitle="Cancellation policies and location configuration."
      />

      <div style={{ padding: '28px 32px' }}>
        <OCard>
          <div style={{ padding: '4px 4px 8px' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontFamily: fonts.display,
                color: brand.text,
                letterSpacing: 0.5,
                textTransform: 'uppercase',
                marginBottom: 4,
              }}
            >
              Cancellation Policy
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted, marginBottom: 20 }}>
              These settings apply to all parents booking through the Ballpark app.
              Changes take effect immediately — no redeploy required.
            </div>

            {loading ? (
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: brand.textMuted }}>Loading…</div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 20 }}>
                <FieldGroup
                  label="Session cancellation window (hours)"
                  hint="Cancellations within this window show a policy warning to the parent."
                >
                  {numField('booking_cancel_window_hours', 0, 168)}
                </FieldGroup>

                <FieldGroup
                  label="Late cancellation fee ($)"
                  hint="Informational only — staff collect at the front desk. Enter 0 for no fee."
                >
                  <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                    <span
                      style={{
                        position: 'absolute',
                        left: 11,
                        top: '50%',
                        transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                        fontSize: 13,
                        color: brand.textMuted,
                        pointerEvents: 'none',
                      }}
                    >
                      $
                    </span>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={0}
                      max={50000}
                      step={100}
                      style={{ ...inputStyle, paddingLeft: 22 }}
                      value={(policy.booking_cancel_fee_cents / 100).toFixed(2)}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const dollars = parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0;
                        setPolicy((p) => ({
                          ...p,
                          booking_cancel_fee_cents: Math.round(Math.max(0, dollars) * 100),
                        }));
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </FieldGroup>

                <FieldGroup
                  label="Membership cancellation notice (days)"
                  hint="Minimum notice period before a membership cancellation takes effect."
                >
                  {numField('membership_cancel_notice_days', 0, 90)}
                </FieldGroup>
              </div>
            )}

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 8 }}>
              <OButton
                variant="gold"
                onClick={() => void handleSave()}
                disabled={saving || loading}
              >
                {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save Policy'}
              </OButton>
            </div>
          </div>
        </OCard>
      </div>

      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            bottom: 24,
            right: 24,
            zIndex: 500,
            background: toast.kind === 'success' ? brand.dark : brand.dangerBg,
            color: toast.kind === 'success' ? brand.gold : brand.danger,
            padding: '12px 20px',
            borderRadius: 8,
            boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)',
            fontSize: 13,
            fontWeight: 600,
            border: `1px solid ${toast.kind === 'success' ? brand.border : brand.danger}`,
            maxWidth: 380,
          }}
        >
          {toast.msg}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/app/page.tsx

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { readAppRole } from "@/lib/auth";

export default async function Root() {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  // getUser() validates the JWT against Supabase's auth server (refreshing
  // if needed). Only call getSession() afterwards — at that point the
  // cached session is safe to read for the access_token / app_role claim.
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect("/login");

  const {
    data: { session },
  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  const role = readAppRole(session);

  if (role === "super_admin") redirect("/hq");
  if (role === "coach") redirect("/coach/inbox");
  if (role === "admin") redirect("/admin");
  if (role === "owner") redirect("/owner/dashboard");
  // Parent: route through /logout so cookies are actually cleared (a
  // Server Component can't write cookies, a Route Handler can).
  redirect("/logout?reason=parent");
}

      {/* Main content */}

        {/* Top bar */}
        <div style={{
          height: 56, background: brand.surface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',

          gap: 8,
        }}>
          <Globe2 size={16} color={brand.goldDeep} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.body }}>
            Infinite Hitting HQ
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Page content */}
        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', background: brand.surfaceAlt }}>
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import MuxPlayer from "@mux/mux-player-react";

type CommonProps = {
  title?: string;
  accentColor?: string;
};

type Props =
  | (CommonProps & { playbackId: string; src?: never })
  | (CommonProps & { src: string; playbackId?: never });

export function MuxVideo(props: Props) {
  const { title, accentColor = "#0ea5e9" } = props;
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-black">
      <MuxPlayer
        {...("playbackId" in props && props.playbackId
          ? { playbackId: props.playbackId }
          : { src: (props as { src: string }).src })}
        metadata={title ? { video_title: title } : undefined}
        streamType="on-demand"
        autoPlay={false}
        accentColor={accentColor}
        style={{ aspectRatio: "16 / 9", width: "100%" }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

export function NavLink({
  href,
  children,
}: {
  href: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const active = pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`);
  return (
    <Link
      href={href}
      className={[
        "relative px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors",
        active ? "text-gold" : "text-text-light hover:text-cream-light",
      ].join(" ")}
    >
      {children}
      <span
        aria-hidden
        className={[
          "absolute inset-x-2 -bottom-[17px] h-0.5 rounded-full transition-all",
          active ? "bg-gold opacity-100" : "bg-gold opacity-0",
        ].join(" ")}
      />
    </Link>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { brand } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import { Sidebar } from './Sidebar';
import { TopBar } from './TopBar';

interface OwnerShellProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  locationName?: string;
  userName?: string;
}

export function OwnerShell({ children, locationName, userName }: OwnerShellProps) {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const isFranchisorPath = pathname?.startsWith('/owner/franchisor');
  const [role, setRole] = useState<'owner' | 'franchisor'>(
    isFranchisorPath ? 'franchisor' : 'owner'
  );

  const handleRoleChange = (newRole: 'owner' | 'franchisor') => {
    setRole(newRole);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100vh', width: '100vw', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', background: brand.cream, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <Sidebar collapsed={collapsed} onToggle={() => setCollapsed(c => !c)} role={role} />
        <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          <TopBar role={role} onRoleChange={handleRoleChange} locationName={locationName} userName={userName} />
          <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', background: brand.cream }}>
            {children}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Sidebar({ collapsed, onToggle, role }: SidebarProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const width = collapsed ? 68 : 220;
  const sections = role === 'franchisor' ? franchisorNav : ownerNav;

  const isActive = (href: string) => {
    if (href === '/owner') return pathname === '/owner';
    if (href === '/owner/franchisor') return pathname === '/owner/franchisor';
    return pathname.startsWith(href);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      width, minWidth: width, height: '100%',

      overflow: 'hidden',

            <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: brand.textLight, letterSpacing: 0.5, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Operations Portal</div>
          </div>

      <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', overflowX: 'hidden', padding: '12px 0' }}>
        {sections.map((section, si) => (
          <div key={si} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            {section.label && !collapsed && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 800, color: brand.textLight, letterSpacing: 1.5, padding: '0 20px 6px', textTransform: 'uppercase', fontFamily: fonts.display }}>
                {section.label}
              </div>
            )}
            {section.items.map(item => {
              const active = isActive(item.href);
              return (
                <div
                  key={item.href}
                  onClick={() => router.push(item.href)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
                    padding: collapsed ? '10px 22px' : '9px 20px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: active ? `${brand.gold}15` : 'transparent',
                    color: active ? brand.gold : brand.cream,
                    borderLeft: active ? `3px solid ${brand.gold}` : '3px solid transparent',
                    transition: 'all 0.15s',
                  }}
                >
                  <item.icon size={16} strokeWidth={2.2} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
                  {!collapsed && (
                    <>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: active ? 700 : 500, flex: 1, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{item.label}</div>
                      {item.badge !== undefined && (
                        <div style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 800, background: brand.danger, color: brand.white, padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: 10, minWidth: 16, textAlign: 'center' }}>

                      )}
                    </>
                  )}

FILE: portal/components/owner/TopBar.tsx
=================================================================================
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { brand, fonts } from '@/lib/ownerBrandTokens';
import {
  Search, Bell, ChevronDown, LogOut, User, X,
  AlertCircle, AlertTriangle, Calendar, CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface TopBarProps {
  role: 'owner' | 'franchisor';
  onRoleChange: (role: 'owner' | 'franchisor') => void;
  userName?: string;
  locationName?: string;
}

const NOTIFICATIONS = [
  { id: 1, Icon: AlertCircle,  color: brand.danger,  text: '3 failed payments need attention',  sub: '2 min ago', link: '/owner/failed-payments' },
  { id: 2, Icon: AlertTriangle,color: brand.warning, text: '8 members flagged as at-risk',       sub: '1 hr ago',  link: '/owner/at-risk' },
  { id: 3, Icon: Calendar,     color: brand.info,    text: '20 sessions booked for today',        sub: '3 hrs ago', link: '/owner/schedule' },
  { id: 4, Icon: CheckCircle2, color: brand.success, text: '$4,200 collected today',              sub: 'Today',     link: '/owner/billing' },
];

const SEARCH_LINKS = [
  { label: 'Members',          sub: 'View all members & subscriptions', path: '/owner/members' },
  { label: 'Schedule',         sub: 'Today\'s bookings & cage grid',     path: '/owner/schedule' },
  { label: 'Coaches',          sub: 'Coach roster & performance',         path: '/owner/coaches' },
  { label: 'Billing',          sub: 'Revenue, MRR, auto-collect',         path: '/owner/billing' },
  { label: 'Revenue Reports',  sub: 'EFT vs OTC, cohort data',            path: '/owner/revenue-reports' },
  { label: 'Failed Payments',  sub: 'Recover missed charges',             path: '/owner/failed-payments' },
  { label: 'At-Risk Members',  sub: 'Churn prevention',                   path: '/owner/at-risk' },
  { label: 'Points & Rewards', sub: 'Redemptions & leaderboard',          path: '/owner/points-rewards' },
];

export function TopBar({ role, onRoleChange, userName = 'Owner', locationName = 'Your Location' }: TopBarProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen]   = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [bellOpen,   setBellOpen]     = useState(false);
  const [userOpen,   setUserOpen]     = useState(false);
  const [bellRead,   setBellRead]     = useState(false);
  const bellRef      = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const userRef      = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const searchInput  = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); setSearchOpen(true); }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { setSearchOpen(false); setBellOpen(false); setUserOpen(false); }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (searchOpen) { setTimeout(() => searchInput.current?.focus(), 40); }
    else { setSearchQuery(''); }
  }, [searchOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (bellRef.current && !bellRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setBellOpen(false);
      if (userRef.current && !userRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setUserOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onClick);
  }, []);

  const handleRoleChange = (newRole: 'owner' | 'franchisor') => {
    onRoleChange(newRole);
    router.push(newRole === 'franchisor' ? '/owner/franchisor' : '/owner');
  };

  const filtered = searchQuery.trim()
    ? SEARCH_LINKS.filter(l =>
        l.label.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        l.sub.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()))
    : SEARCH_LINKS;

  const go = (path: string) => { setSearchOpen(false); router.push(path); };

  const pill: React.CSSProperties = {
    padding: '5px 12px', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer',
    borderRadius: 5, fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5,
    textTransform: 'uppercase', transition: 'all 0.15s',
  };

  const dropItem: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '10px 16px',
    cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 12, transition: 'background 0.1s',
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div style={{
        height: 60, background: brand.surface, borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', padding: '0 24px', gap: 16,
        flexShrink: 0, position: 'relative', zIndex: 10,
      }}>

        {/* Search trigger */}
        <div
          onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
          style={{
            flex: 1, maxWidth: 480, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
            padding: '8px 14px', background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderRadius: 8,
            border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, cursor: 'pointer', transition: 'border-color 0.15s',
          }}
          onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.borderColor = brand.goldDeep; }}
          onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.borderColor = brand.border; }}
        >
          <Search size={14} color={brand.textMuted} />
          <div style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted }}>Search members, payments, sessions...</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted, background: brand.white, padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: 4, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontWeight: 600 }}>⌘K</div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ flex: 1 }} />

        {/* Role switcher */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, background: brand.surfaceAlt, padding: 3, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
          {(['owner', 'franchisor'] as const).map(r => (
            <div
              key={r}
              onClick={() => handleRoleChange(r)}
              style={{
                ...pill,
                background: role === r ? brand.dark : 'transparent',
                color:      role === r ? brand.gold  : brand.textMuted,
              }}
            >
              {r === 'owner' ? 'Owner' : 'Franchisor'}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Bell */}
        <div ref={bellRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          <div
            onClick={() => { setBellOpen(o => !o); setBellRead(true); setUserOpen(false); }}
            style={{
              position: 'relative', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 6, borderRadius: 8,
              background: bellOpen ? brand.surfaceAlt : 'transparent', transition: 'background 0.15s',
            }}
          >
            <Bell size={18} color={bellOpen ? brand.goldDeep : brand.textMuted} />
            {!bellRead && (
              <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 4, right: 4, width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 4, background: brand.danger }} />
            )}
          </div>
          {bellOpen && (
            <div style={{
              position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 8px)', right: 0, width: 320,
              background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 10,
              boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.14)', zIndex: 100, overflow: 'hidden',
            }}>
              <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>Notifications</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted }}>Today</span>
              </div>
              {NOTIFICATIONS.map(({ id, Icon, color, text, sub, link }) => (
                <div
                  key={id}
                  onClick={() => { setBellOpen(false); router.push(link); }}
                  style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, padding: '12px 16px', cursor: 'pointer', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, transition: 'background 0.1s' }}
                  onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.background = brand.surfaceAlt; }}
                  onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.background = 'transparent'; }}
                >
                  <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 16, background: `${color}18`, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    <Icon size={14} color={color} />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: brand.text, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{text}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>{sub}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div style={{ padding: '10px 16px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                <span
                  onClick={() => { setBellOpen(false); router.push('/owner'); }}
                  style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.goldDeep, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  View Dashboard →
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* User dropdown */}
        <div ref={userRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          <div
            onClick={() => { setUserOpen(o => !o); setBellOpen(false); }}
            style={{
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, cursor: 'pointer',
              paddingLeft: 12, borderLeft: `1px solid ${brand.border}`,
              padding: '6px 6px 6px 12px', borderRadius: 8,
              background: userOpen ? brand.surfaceAlt : 'transparent', transition: 'background 0.15s',
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 16, background: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display }}>
              {userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </div>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.text }}>{userName}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: brand.textMuted }}>{role === 'franchisor' ? 'All 17 Locations' : locationName}</div>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown size={14} color={brand.textMuted} style={{ transform: userOpen ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)', transition: 'transform 0.2s' }} />
          </div>
          {userOpen && (
            <div style={{
              position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 8px)', right: 0, width: 210,
              background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 10,
              boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.14)', zIndex: 100, overflow: 'hidden',
            }}>
              <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700 }}>{userName}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>{locationName}</div>
              </div>
              <div
                onClick={() => { setUserOpen(false); router.push('/owner'); }}
                style={dropItem}
                onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.background = brand.surfaceAlt; }}
                onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.background = 'transparent'; }}
              >
                <User size={14} color={brand.textMuted} />
                Dashboard
              </div>
              <div
                onClick={() => { setUserOpen(false); window.location.href = '/logout'; }}
                style={{ ...dropItem, color: brand.danger, borderTop: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}
                onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.background = brand.dangerBg; }}
                onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLDivElement).style.background = 'transparent'; }}
              >
                <LogOut size={14} />
                Sign out
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search modal */}
      {searchOpen && (
        <div
          onClick={() => setSearchOpen(false)}
          style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)', zIndex: 200, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'center', paddingTop: 110 }}
        >
          <div
            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{ width: 560, background: brand.surface, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, boxShadow: '0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.24)', overflow: 'hidden' }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, padding: '14px 18px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
              <Search size={16} color={brand.textMuted} />
              <input
                ref={searchInput}
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && filtered.length > 0) go(filtered[0].path); }}
                placeholder="Search pages, members, payments..."
                className="search-modal-input"

                >
                  <Search size={13} color={brand.textMuted} />
                  <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600 }}>{l.label}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, marginTop: 1 }}>{l.sub}</div>
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>↵</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{ padding: '8px 18px', borderTop: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, display: 'flex', gap: 16 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>↵ navigate</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>ESC close</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

type KPIColor = 'default' | 'gold' | 'danger' | 'success' | 'warning';

interface KPICardProps {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  unit?: string;
  delta?: number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  deltaInvert?: boolean;
  icon?: React.ElementType;
  color?: KPIColor;
}

const kpiColors: Record<KPIColor, { bg: string; border: string; iconBg: string; iconColor: string }> = {
  default: { bg: brand.surface, border: brand.border, iconBg: `${brand.goldDeep}22`, iconColor: brand.goldDeep },
  gold: { bg: `${brand.gold}15`, border: brand.goldDeep, iconBg: brand.gold, iconColor: brand.dark },
  danger: { bg: brand.dangerBg, border: brand.danger, iconBg: `${brand.danger}22`, iconColor: brand.danger },
  success: { bg: brand.successBg, border: brand.success, iconBg: `${brand.success}22`, iconColor: brand.success },
  warning: { bg: brand.warningBg, border: brand.warning, iconBg: `${brand.warning}22`, iconColor: brand.warning },
};

export function KPICard({ label, value, unit, delta, deltaLabel, deltaInvert = false, icon: Icon, color = 'default' }: KPICardProps) {
  const c = kpiColors[color];
  const rawPositive = (delta ?? 0) >= 0;
  const isGood = deltaInvert ? !rawPositive : rawPositive;
  const isPositive = rawPositive;
  return (
    <div style={{ background: c.bg, border: `1px solid ${c.border}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: 18, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 1, textTransform: 'uppercase', fontFamily: fonts.display }}>{label}</div>
        {Icon && (
          <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 8, background: c.iconBg, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
            <Icon size={16} color={c.iconColor} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, fontFamily: fonts.display, color: brand.text, letterSpacing: -0.5, lineHeight: 1 }}>{value}</div>
        {unit && <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 600 }}>{unit}</div>}
      </div>
      {delta !== undefined && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: isGood ? brand.success : brand.danger }}>
          {isPositive ? <ArrowUpRight size={12} /> : <ArrowDownRight size={12} />}
          {isPositive ? '+' : ''}{delta}%
          <span style={{ color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 500, marginLeft: 4 }}>{deltaLabel || 'vs last month'}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
