// ── OButton ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type OBtnVariant = 'primary' | 'gold' | 'secondary' | 'ghost';
type OBtnSize = 'sm' | 'md';

const btnVariants: Record<OBtnVariant, { bg: string; color: string; border: string }> = {
  primary: { bg: brand.dark, color: brand.gold, border: brand.dark },
  gold: { bg: brand.gold, color: brand.dark, border: brand.gold },
  secondary: { bg: brand.darker, color: brand.cream, border: brand.borderStrong },
  ghost: { bg: 'transparent', color: brand.textMuted, border: 'transparent' },
};

const btnSizes: Record<OBtnSize, { padding: string; fontSize: number }> = {
  sm: { padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 11 },
  md: { padding: '9px 16px', fontSize: 13 },
};

export function OButton({
  children,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  icon: Icon,
  onClick,
  disabled = false,
  style: extraStyle = {},
  type = 'button',
}: {
  children?: ReactNode;
  variant?: OBtnVariant;
  size?: OBtnSize;
  icon?: React.ElementType;
  onClick?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  style?: CSSProperties;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
}) {
  const v = btnVariants[variant];
  const s = btnSizes[size];
  return (
    <button type={type} onClick={onClick} disabled={disabled} style={{
      display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
      padding: s.padding, fontSize: s.fontSize,
      background: v.bg, color: v.color,
      border: `1px solid ${v.border}`, borderRadius: 8,
      fontWeight: 700, cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
      fontFamily: fonts.display, letterSpacing: 0.5, textTransform: 'uppercase',
      opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
      ...extraStyle,
    }}>
      {Icon && <Icon size={s.fontSize + 2} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

// ── OTable ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TableColumn<T> {
  label: string;
  key: keyof T | string;
  align?: 'left' | 'right' | 'center';
  render?: (row: T) => ReactNode;
  sortable?: boolean;
}

export function OTable<T extends Record<string, unknown>>({
  columns,
  rows,
  onRowClick,
}: {
  columns: TableColumn<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  onRowClick?: (row: T) => void;
}) {
  const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');

  const handleSort = (key: string) => {
    if (sortKey === key) {
      setSortDir(d => d === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setSortKey(key);
      setSortDir('asc');
    }
  };

  const sorted = sortKey
    ? [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
        const av = a[sortKey as keyof T];
        const bv = b[sortKey as keyof T];
        if (av === undefined || av === null) return 1;
        if (bv === undefined || bv === null) return -1;
        const cmp = typeof av === 'number' && typeof bv === 'number'
          ? av - bv
          : String(av).localeCompare(String(bv));
        return sortDir === 'asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
      })
    : rows;

  return (
    <div style={{ background: brand.surface, border: `1px solid ${brand.border}`, borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}>
        <thead>
          <tr style={{ background: brand.surfaceAlt, borderBottom: `1px solid ${brand.border}` }}>
            {columns.map((col, i) => (
              <th
                key={i}
                onClick={col.sortable ? () => handleSort(String(col.key)) : undefined}
                style={{
                  padding: '12px 16px',
                  textAlign: col.align || 'left',
                  fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, color: sortKey === String(col.key) ? brand.goldDeep : brand.textMuted,
                  letterSpacing: 1, textTransform: 'uppercase', fontFamily: fonts.display, whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                  cursor: col.sortable ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                  userSelect: 'none',
                }}
              >
                <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                  {col.label}
                  {col.sortable && (
                    <span style={{ opacity: sortKey === String(col.key) ? 1 : 0.3, display: 'inline-flex' }}>
                      {sortKey === String(col.key) && sortDir === 'desc'
                        ? <ChevronDown size={10} />
                        : <ChevronUp size={10} />
                      }
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {sorted.map((row, i) => (
            <tr
              key={i}
              onClick={() => onRowClick?.(row)}
              style={{ borderBottom: i < sorted.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${brand.border}` : 'none', cursor: onRowClick ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => { if (onRowClick) (e.currentTarget as HTMLTableRowElement).style.background = brand.surfaceAlt; }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => { if (onRowClick) (e.currentTarget as HTMLTableRowElement).style.background = 'transparent'; }}
            >
              {columns.map((col, j) => (
                <td key={j} style={{ padding: '14px 16px', fontSize: 13, color: brand.text, textAlign: col.align || 'left', verticalAlign: 'middle' }}>
                  {col.render ? col.render(row) : String(row[col.key as keyof T] ?? '')}
                </td>
              ))}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── MiniLineChart ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function MiniLineChart({ data, color = brand.goldDeep, height = 60, fill = true }: { data: number[]; color?: string; height?: number; fill?: boolean }) {
  if (data.length < 2) return null;
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const points = data.map((v, i) => ({ x: (i / (data.length - 1)) * 100, y: 100 - ((v - min) / range) * 100 }));
  const pathD = points.map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'}${p.x},${p.y}`).join(' ');
  const fillD = fill ? `${pathD} L100,100 L0,100 Z` : '';
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" style={{ width: '100%', height }}>
      {fill && <path d={fillD} fill={`${color}22`} />}
      <path d={pathD} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.5} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
    </svg>
  );
}

// ── BarChart ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function BarChart({ data, color = brand.goldDeep, height = 160 }: {
  data: Array<{ label: string; value: number; highlight?: boolean }>;
  color?: string;
  height?: number;
}) {
  const max = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value));
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 6, height, paddingBottom: 20, position: 'relative' }}>
      {data.map((d, i) => (
        <div key={i} style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', height: '100%', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 700 }}>{d.value}</div>
          <div style={{ width: '100%', height: `${(d.value / max) * 100}%`, background: d.highlight ? brand.gold : color, borderRadius: '4px 4px 0 0', minHeight: 2 }} />
          <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: brand.textMuted, fontWeight: 600, position: 'absolute', bottom: 0, transform: 'translateY(14px)' }}>{d.label}</div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── DonutChart ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function DonutChart({ data, size = 140 }: { data: Array<{ value: number; color: string }>; size?: number }) {
  const total = data.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.value, 0);
  let cumulative = 0;
  const radius = size / 2 - 10;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}>
      <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none" stroke={brand.border} strokeWidth={10} />
      {data.map((d, i) => {
        const pct = d.value / total;
        const strokeDasharray = `${pct * circumference} ${circumference}`;
        const strokeDashoffset = -cumulative * circumference;
        cumulative += pct;
        return (
          <circle key={i} cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none"
            stroke={d.color} strokeWidth={10}
            strokeDasharray={strokeDasharray} strokeDashoffset={strokeDashoffset}
            transform={`rotate(-90 ${size / 2} ${size / 2})`} />
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}

            </span>
          )}
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Role badge + owner role switcher */}
      {!collapsed && (
        <div className="px-3 pt-3 pb-2 flex-shrink-0 space-y-2">
          <span className="inline-flex rounded-full border border-border-gold-strong bg-darkest px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-gold">
            {role === 'owner' ? ownerSubRole : role}
          </span>
          {role === 'owner' && (
            <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darkest p-1">
              {(['owner', 'franchisor'] as const).map((r) => (
                <button
                  key={r}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setOwnerSubRole(r);
                    router.push(r === 'franchisor' ? '/owner/franchisor' : '/owner');
                  }}
                  className={[
                    'flex-1 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] transition-all',
                    ownerSubRole === r
                      ? 'bg-darker text-gold'
                      : 'text-text-light hover:text-cream-light',
                  ].join(' ')}
                >
                  {r === 'owner' ? 'Owner' : 'Franchisor'}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Nav */}
      <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden py-2 min-h-0">
        {sections.map((section, si) => (
          <div key={si} className="mb-4">
            {section.label && !collapsed && (
              <div className="px-5 pb-1.5 text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-text-light">
                {section.label}
              </div>
            )}
            {section.items.map((item) => {
              const active = isActive(pathname ?? '', item.href);
              return (
                <Link
                  key={item.href}
                  href={item.href}
                  className={[
                    'flex items-center gap-2.5 border-l-[3px] py-2.5 transition-all',
                    collapsed ? 'justify-center px-[22px]' : 'px-5',
                    active
                      ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10 text-gold'
                      : 'border-transparent text-text-light hover:bg-darkest/60 hover:text-cream-light',
                  ].join(' ')}
                >
                  <item.icon size={16} strokeWidth={2.2} className="flex-shrink-0" />
                  {!collapsed && (
                    <span
                      className={[
                        'text-[13px] whitespace-nowrap',
                        active ? 'font-bold' : 'font-medium',
                      ].join(' ')}
                    >
                      {item.label}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>

      {/* Collapse toggle (desktop only) */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setCollapsed((c) => !c)}
        className="hidden md:flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border-t border-border-gold px-3 py-3 text-[11px] text-text-light hover:text-cream-light transition-colors flex-shrink-0"
      >
        {collapsed ? (
          <ChevronRight size={14} />
        ) : (
          <>
            <ChevronLeft size={14} />
            <span>Collapse</span>
          </>
        )}
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-darkest">
      {/* Desktop sidebar */}
      <div className="hidden md:flex h-full flex-col flex-shrink-0">
        {SidebarContent}
      </div>

      {/* Mobile sidebar overlay */}
      {mobileOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 md:hidden">
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60"
            onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
          />
          <div className="relative flex h-full w-[220px] flex-col">
            {SidebarContent}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main area */}
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden min-w-0">
        {/* Top bar */}
        <div className="flex h-14 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border-gold bg-darker px-4">
          {/* Hamburger (mobile only) */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMobileOpen((o) => !o)}
            className="md:hidden rounded-lg p-1.5 text-text-light hover:text-cream-light transition-colors"
          >
            {mobileOpen ? <X size={20} /> : <Menu size={20} />}
          </button>

          <div className="flex-1" />

          {/* User info + avatar + sign out */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="hidden sm:flex h-8 w-8 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gold/20 border border-border-gold text-sm font-bold text-gold font-display">
                {initial}
              </div>
              <div className="hidden sm:block text-right leading-tight">
                {locationName && (
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-text-light truncate max-w-[160px]">
                    {locationName}
                  </div>
                )}
                {email && (
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-text-light/80 truncate max-w-[160px]">
                    {email}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <form action={signOut}>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darkest px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-cream transition-colors hover:border-gold hover:text-gold"
              >
                <LogOut size={12} />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Sign out</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Page content */}
        <main className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto min-h-0">
          {children}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Search, Phone, Mail, User, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import type { StaffFamilyContact } from '@/lib/supabase/ownerQueries';

const RTF = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat('en', { numeric: 'auto' });

function relativeTime(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return 'No sessions yet';
  const diff = (new Date(iso).getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000;
  const abs = Math.abs(diff);
  if (abs < 60) return 'just now';
  if (abs < 3600) return RTF.format(Math.round(diff / 60), 'minute');
  if (abs < 86400) return RTF.format(Math.round(diff / 3600), 'hour');
  if (abs < 86400 * 7) return RTF.format(Math.round(diff / 86400), 'day');
  if (abs < 86400 * 30) return RTF.format(Math.round(diff / (86400 * 7)), 'week');
  if (abs < 86400 * 365) return RTF.format(Math.round(diff / (86400 * 30)), 'month');
  return RTF.format(Math.round(diff / (86400 * 365)), 'year');
}

interface Props {
  families: StaffFamilyContact[];
}

export function StaffFamiliesContent({ families }: Props) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const filtered = search.trim()
    ? families.filter(f => {
        const q = search.toLowerCase();
        const parentName = `${f.parentFirstName} ${f.parentLastName}`.toLowerCase();
        const kidNames = f.kids.map(k => `${k.firstName} ${k.lastName}`.toLowerCase()).join(' ');
        return (
          parentName.includes(q) ||
          kidNames.includes(q) ||
          (f.parentEmail ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (f.parentPhone ?? '').includes(q)
        );
      })
    : families;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cream-light">
          Families
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-light">
          {families.length} famil{families.length !== 1 ? 'ies' : 'y'} · Contact directory
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative">
        <Search
          size={14}
          className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-light"
        />
        <input
          type="search"
          placeholder="Search by name, email, or phone…"
          value={search}
          onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-lg border border-border-gold bg-darker pl-8 pr-4 py-2 text-sm text-cream-light placeholder:text-text-light outline-none focus:border-gold"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darker px-6 py-12 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-text-light">
            {search ? 'No families match your search.' : 'No families found.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-border-gold">
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-border-gold bg-darker">
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-text-light">
                  Parent
                </th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-text-light">
                  Contact
                </th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-text-light">
                  Athletes
                </th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-text-light">
                  Last Session
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filtered.map((f, i) => (
                <tr
                  key={f.familyId}
                  className={[
                    'border-b border-border-gold last:border-0',
                    i % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-darkest' : 'bg-darker',
                  ].join(' ')}
                >
                  {/* Parent name */}
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <div className="flex h-8 w-8 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gold/10 border border-border-gold font-display text-xs font-bold text-gold">
                        {f.parentFirstName.charAt(0)}{f.parentLastName.charAt(0)}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-semibold text-cream-light">
                          {f.parentFirstName} {f.parentLastName}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  {/* Contact info */}
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-text-light">
                        <Mail size={11} className="flex-shrink-0 text-text-light" />
                        <a
                          href={`mailto:${f.parentEmail}`}
                          className="hover:text-gold transition-colors truncate max-w-[200px]"
                        >
                          {f.parentEmail}
                        </a>
                      </div>
                      {f.parentPhone ? (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-text-light">
                          <Phone size={11} className="flex-shrink-0 text-text-light" />
                          <a
                            href={`tel:${f.parentPhone}`}
                            className="hover:text-gold transition-colors"
                          >
                            {f.parentPhone}
                          </a>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-text-light/40">
                          <Phone size={11} />
                          <span>No phone on file</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  {/* Athletes */}
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      {f.kids.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-text-light/40">
                          <User size={11} />
                          <span>No athletes</span>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        f.kids.map(k => (
                          <div key={k.id} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-cream-light">
                            <User size={11} className="flex-shrink-0 text-text-light" />
                            <span>
                              {k.firstName} {k.lastName}
                              {k.ageGroup && (
                                <span className="ml-1 text-text-light">({k.ageGroup})</span>
                              )}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        ))
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  {/* Last session */}
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-text-light">
                      <Clock size={11} className="flex-shrink-0" />
                      <span>{relativeTime(f.lastSessionDate)}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import type { ComponentProps, ReactNode } from "react";

type Variant = "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger";
type Size = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

const BASE =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl font-medium tracking-wide transition-colors focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-gold focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-darkest disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50";

const VARIANTS: Record<Variant, string> = {
  primary:
    "bg-gold text-darkest hover:bg-gold-hover active:bg-gold-bright shadow-[0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.18)_inset,0_6px_18px_-8px_rgba(241,229,173,0.45)]",
  secondary:
    "bg-darker text-cream border border-border-gold-strong hover:border-gold hover:text-gold",
  ghost:
    "bg-transparent text-cream hover:text-gold hover:bg-darker/60",
  danger:
    "bg-danger/15 text-danger border border-danger/40 hover:bg-danger/25",
};

const SIZES: Record<Size, string> = {
  sm: "px-3 py-1.5 text-xs",
  md: "px-4 py-2 text-sm",
  lg: "px-5 py-2.5 text-base",
};

export function buttonClasses({
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  className = "",
}: {
  variant?: Variant;
  size?: Size;
  className?: string;
} = {}) {
  return `${BASE} ${VARIANTS[variant]} ${SIZES[size]} ${className}`.trim();
}

type ButtonProps = ComponentProps<"button"> & {
  variant?: Variant;
  size?: Size;
  children: ReactNode;
};

export function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  className = "",
  children,
  ...rest
}: ButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      {...rest}
      className={buttonClasses({ variant, size, className })}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

type LinkButtonProps = ComponentProps<typeof Link> & {
  variant?: Variant;
  size?: Size;
  children: ReactNode;
};

export function LinkButton({
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  className = "",
  children,
  ...rest
}: LinkButtonProps) {
  return (
    <Link
      {...rest}
      className={buttonClasses({ variant, size, className })}
    >
      {children}
    </Link>
  );
}

  accent?: boolean;
  padding?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  children: ReactNode;
};

const PADDING = {
  none: "",
  sm: "p-4",
  md: "p-6",
  lg: "p-8",
} as const;

export function Card({
  accent = false,
  padding = "md",
  className = "",
  children,
  ...rest
}: CardProps) {
  return (
    <div
      {...rest}

import type {
  InputHTMLAttributes,
  ReactNode,
  SelectHTMLAttributes,
  TextareaHTMLAttributes,
} from "react";

const FIELD_BASE =
  "block w-full rounded-xl border border-border-gold bg-darkest/80 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-cream-light placeholder:text-text-light/60 shadow-inner transition-colors focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 selection:bg-gold/30 selection:text-cream-light";

export function fieldClasses(extra = "") {
  return `${FIELD_BASE} ${extra}`.trim();
}

function Wrapper({
  id,
  label,
  helper,
  error,
  optional,
  children,
}: {
  id?: string;
  label?: ReactNode;
  helper?: ReactNode;
  error?: ReactNode;
  optional?: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      {label ? (
        <label
          htmlFor={id}
          className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep"
        >
          <span>{label}</span>
          {optional ? (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-normal normal-case tracking-normal text-text-light">
              optional
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </label>
      ) : null}
      {children}
      {error ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-danger">{error}</p>
      ) : helper ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-text-light">{helper}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

type InputProps = InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & {
  label?: ReactNode;
  helper?: ReactNode;
  error?: ReactNode;
  optional?: boolean;
};

export function Input({
  label,
  helper,
  error,
  optional,
  className = "",
  ...rest
}: InputProps) {
  return (
    <Wrapper
      id={rest.id}
      label={label}
      helper={helper}
      error={error}
      optional={optional}
    >
      <input {...rest} className={fieldClasses(className)} />
    </Wrapper>
  );
}

type TextAreaProps = TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement> & {
  label?: ReactNode;
  helper?: ReactNode;
  error?: ReactNode;
  optional?: boolean;
};

export function TextArea({
  label,
  helper,
  error,
  optional,
  className = "",
  ...rest
}: TextAreaProps) {
  return (
    <Wrapper
      id={rest.id}
      label={label}
      helper={helper}
      error={error}
      optional={optional}
    >
      <textarea {...rest} className={fieldClasses(className)} />
    </Wrapper>
  );
}

type SelectProps = SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> & {
  label?: ReactNode;
  helper?: ReactNode;
  error?: ReactNode;
  optional?: boolean;
};

export function Select({
  label,
  helper,

        {children}

  );

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import type { InputHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from "react";
import { Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react";
import { fieldClasses } from "./Input";

type PasswordInputProps = Omit<
  InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>,
  "type"
> & {
  label?: ReactNode;
  helper?: ReactNode;
  error?: ReactNode;
  optional?: boolean;
};

export function PasswordInput({
  label,
  helper,
  error,
  optional,
  className = "",
  id,
  ...rest
}: PasswordInputProps) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      {label ? (
        <label
          htmlFor={id}
          className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-gold-deep"
        >
          <span>{label}</span>
          {optional ? (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-normal normal-case tracking-normal text-text-light">
              optional
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </label>
      ) : null}
      <div className="relative">
        <input
          {...rest}
          id={id}
          type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
          className={fieldClasses(`pr-10 ${className}`)}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={visible ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
          onClick={() => setVisible((v) => !v)}
          className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center px-3 text-text-light hover:text-gold transition-colors"
          tabIndex={-1}
        >
          {visible ? (
            <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
          ) : (
            <Eye className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
      {error ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-danger">{error}</p>
      ) : helper ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-text-light">{helper}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: portal/lib/auth.ts

import type { Session, SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export type AppRole = "coach" | "admin" | "owner" | "parent" | "super_admin";

/**
 * Decode the payload of a JWT without verifying its signature. Supabase
 * already verified the signature server-side; we only need to read the
 * `app_role` custom claim injected by the Custom Access Token Hook.
 */
function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split(".");
    if (parts.length < 2) return null;
    let b64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const pad = b64.length % 4;
    if (pad) b64 += "=".repeat(4 - pad);
    const json =
      typeof Buffer !== "undefined"
        ? Buffer.from(b64, "base64").toString("utf-8")
        : atob(b64);
    return JSON.parse(json) as Record<string, unknown>;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Read the `app_role` claim from the access token. Defaults to "parent"
 * for any session whose JWT does not carry the claim — matches the
 * mobile app's behaviour in `src/hooks/useAuth.tsx`.
 *
 * NOTE: the claim is `app_role`, NOT `role` (which is reserved by
 * PostgREST and means SET ROLE).
 */
export function readAppRole(session: Session | null): AppRole {
  if (!session?.access_token) return "parent";
  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(session.access_token);
  const claim = payload?.app_role;
  if (claim === "super_admin") return "super_admin";
  if (claim === "coach") return "coach";
  if (claim === "admin") return "admin";
  if (claim === "owner") return "owner";
  return "parent";
}

/**
 * Read the `tenant_id` claim from the access token. Returns null when
 * there is no session or no claim. Super admins intentionally have no
 * tenant_id claim since they are not scoped to any single tenant.
 *
 * @supabase/ssr does not surface custom JWT claims directly, so we
 * decode the access token payload ourselves (signature already verified
 * by Supabase). Same shape as the mobile app's `useAuth.tsx` decoder,
 * implemented fresh here — never imported from `src/`.
 */
export function readTenantId(session: Session | null): string | null {
  if (!session?.access_token) return null;
  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(session.access_token);
  const claim = payload?.tenant_id;
  return typeof claim === "string" && claim.length > 0 ? claim : null;
}

export type CoachPreset = "instructor" | "staff";

export interface CoachCapabilities {
  preset: CoachPreset;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

/**
 * Fetch the `capabilities` JSONB for the coach who owns the given user_id.
 * Returns `{ preset: "instructor" }` as the safe default when no row is found
 * or the column is missing/malformed — matching the DB column default.
 *
 * Call server-side only (requires an authenticated Supabase client).
 */
export async function getCoachCapabilities(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  userId: string,
): Promise<CoachCapabilities> {
  const fallback: CoachCapabilities = { preset: "instructor" };
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("coaches")
      .select("capabilities")
      .eq("user_id", userId)
      .single();
    if (error || !data) return fallback;
    const caps = data.capabilities as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    if (!caps || typeof caps !== "object") return fallback;
    const preset = caps.preset;
    if (preset !== "instructor" && preset !== "staff") return fallback;
    return { ...caps, preset } as CoachCapabilities;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

/**
 * Convenience check: returns true when the coach has the "staff" preset,
 * granting access to operational portal sections.
 */
export function isStaffPreset(caps: CoachCapabilities): boolean {
  return caps.preset === "staff";
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/lib/exportCsv.ts
=================================================================================
export function exportCsv(
  filename: string,
  rows: Record<string, unknown>[],
  cols: { label: string; key: string }[],
) {
  const esc = (v: unknown) => {
    const s = v == null ? '' : String(v);
    return s.includes(',') || s.includes('"') || s.includes('\n')
      ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
  };
  const header = cols.map(c => esc(c.label)).join(',');
  const body   = rows.map(r => cols.map(c => esc(r[c.key])).join(',')).join('\n');
  const blob   = new Blob([header + '\n' + body], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url    = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a      = document.createElement('a');
  a.href       = url;
  a.download   = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

/**
 * Shared Stripe MRR fetch utility.
 *
 * Used by:
 *   - portal/app/owner/billing/page.tsx  (server component, called server-side)
 *   - portal/app/api/stripe/mrr/route.ts (API route, called by client dashboards)
 *
 * Paginates through all active subscriptions on a single connected account and
 * returns the total MRR (in cents) and active subscription count for that account.
 *
 * Throws on Stripe HTTP errors so Promise.allSettled callers can distinguish
 * a genuine zero from a fetch failure — preventing silent MRR underreporting.
 */

const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2024-06-20';

export interface LocationMrrResult {
  mrrCents: number;
  activeCount: number;
}

/**
 * Fetch live MRR for a single connected Stripe account.
 * Paginates automatically (up to 100 subscriptions per page).
 *
 * Throws on non-OK Stripe responses — callers should wrap in try/catch or use
 * Promise.allSettled, so a single account failure does not mask other accounts'
 * real data and can be logged/reported distinctly.
 */
export async function fetchLocationMrr(
  stripeKey: string,
  connectedAccountId: string,
): Promise<LocationMrrResult> {
  let mrrCents = 0;
  let activeCount = 0;
  let hasMore = true;
  let startingAfter: string | undefined;

  while (hasMore) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ status: 'active', limit: '100' });
    if (startingAfter) params.set('starting_after', startingAfter);

    const res = await fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions?${params}`, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${stripeKey}`,
        'Stripe-Account': connectedAccountId,
        'Stripe-Version': STRIPE_API_VERSION,
      },
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      // Throw so Promise.allSettled registers this as a rejection — callers can
      // then log the failure and still aggregate the accounts that succeeded.
      const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({})) as { error?: { message?: string } };
      throw new Error(
        body.error?.message ?? `Stripe responded ${res.status} for account ${connectedAccountId}`,
      );
    }

    const data = await res.json() as {
      data: Array<{
        id: string;
        status: string;
        items: {
          data: Array<{
            price: { unit_amount: number; recurring?: { interval: string } };
          }>;
        };
      }>;
      has_more: boolean;
    };

    for (const sub of data.data) {
      if (sub.status !== 'active' && sub.status !== 'trialing') continue;
      // Count the subscription once (not once per item), then sum all monthly item amounts.
      let subHasMonthlyItem = false;
      for (const item of sub.items?.data ?? []) {
        if (item.price?.recurring?.interval === 'month') {
          mrrCents += item.price.unit_amount ?? 0;
          subHasMonthlyItem = true;
        }
      }
      if (subHasMonthlyItem) activeCount += 1;
    }

    hasMore = data.has_more;
    if (hasMore && data.data.length > 0) {
      startingAfter = data.data[data.data.length - 1].id;
    } else {
      hasMore = false;
    }
  }

  return { mrrCents, activeCount };
}

/**
 * HQ Super-Admin — server-side data fetching layer.
 *
 * All functions accept a Supabase SERVICE client (bypasses RLS) or a
 * super_admin session client (has cross-tenant RLS policies). Data spans

import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

export type HQLocation = {

  tenantId: string;
  tenantName: string;

  name: string;
  address: string | null;

/**
 * Build a per-location count from rows that have a family_id, using
 * families.primary_location_id as the attribution key.
 *
 * Fallback: for tenants with exactly one location, any family whose
 * primary_location_id is null is attributed to that sole location.
 */
function buildCountByLocation(
  rows: Array<{ family_id: string }>,
  familyLocationMap: Map<string, string | null>,  // family_id → primary_location_id
  locationsByTenant: Map<string, string[]>,        // tenant_id → location ids
  familyTenantMap: Map<string, string>,            // family_id → tenant_id
): Record<string, number> {
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const row of rows) {
    const locationId = familyLocationMap.get(row.family_id);
    if (locationId) {
      counts[locationId] = (counts[locationId] ?? 0) + 1;
    } else {
      // Null primary_location_id — fall back to the tenant's sole location.
      const tenantId = familyTenantMap.get(row.family_id);
      if (tenantId) {
        const locs = locationsByTenant.get(tenantId) ?? [];
        if (locs.length === 1) {
          counts[locs[0]] = (counts[locs[0]] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
        // Multi-location tenant with unattributed family: omit to avoid duplication.
      }
    }
  }
  return counts;
}

export async function getHQLocations(supabase: SupabaseClient): Promise<HQLocation[]> {
  const { data: locations, error } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('id, tenant_id, name, address, city, state, zip, phone, email, timezone, is_active, stripe_onboarding_status, stripe_account_name')
    .order('name');

  if (error || !locations) return [];

  const tenantIds = [...new Set(locations.map(l => l.tenant_id))];

  const [tenantsRes, membershipsRes, familiesRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('tenants').select('id, name, slug, royalty_config').in('id', tenantIds),
    supabase.from('memberships').select('family_id').in('tenant_id', tenantIds).eq('status', 'active'),
    supabase.from('families').select('id, tenant_id, primary_location_id').in('tenant_id', tenantIds),
  ]);

  const tenantMap = new Map<string, { name: string; slug: string; royaltyRate: number }>();
  for (const t of (tenantsRes.data ?? [])) {
    const rc = t.royalty_config as { rate?: number } | null;
    tenantMap.set(t.id, { name: t.name, slug: t.slug, royaltyRate: rc?.rate ?? 0.025 });
  }

  // Build family lookup maps.
  const familyLocationMap = new Map<string, string | null>();
  const familyTenantMap = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const f of (familiesRes.data ?? [])) {
    familyLocationMap.set(f.id, f.primary_location_id ?? null);
    familyTenantMap.set(f.id, f.tenant_id);
  }

  // Build locations-by-tenant map (for fallback attribution).
  const locationsByTenant = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const l of locations) {
    const existing = locationsByTenant.get(l.tenant_id) ?? [];
    existing.push(l.id);
    locationsByTenant.set(l.tenant_id, existing);
  }

  const memberCountByLocation = buildCountByLocation(
    membershipsRes.data ?? [],
    familyLocationMap,
    locationsByTenant,
    familyTenantMap,
  );

  return locations.map(l => {
    const tenant = tenantMap.get(l.tenant_id);
    return {
      id: l.id,
      tenantId: l.tenant_id,
      tenantName: tenant?.name ?? '—',
      tenantSlug: tenant?.slug ?? '',
      name: l.name,
      address: l.address ?? null,
      city: l.city ?? null,
      state: l.state ?? null,
      zip: l.zip ?? null,
      phone: l.phone ?? null,
      email: l.email ?? null,
      timezone: l.timezone ?? 'America/Chicago',
      isActive: l.is_active ?? true,
      stripeStatus: l.stripe_onboarding_status ?? 'not_connected',
      stripeAccountName: l.stripe_account_name ?? null,
      memberCount: memberCountByLocation[l.id] ?? 0,
      royaltyRate: tenant?.royaltyRate ?? 0.025,
    };
  });
}

// ─── Team ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type AdminUser = {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  created_at: string;
  last_sign_in_at: string | null;
  banned_until: string | null;
  raw_user_meta_data: {
    app_role?: string;
    first_name?: string;
    last_name?: string;
    name?: string;
    tenant_slug?: string;
  };
};

/**
 * Fetch all auth users via the Supabase Admin REST API.
 * Returns up to 1000 users (sufficient for any current franchise network).
 */
async function fetchAdminUsers(): Promise<AdminUser[]> {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  if (!url || !key) return [];

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users?page=1&per_page=1000`, {
      headers: { apikey: key, Authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
      cache: 'no-store',
    });
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    const body = await res.json() as { users?: AdminUser[] };
    return body.users ?? [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function isUserBanned(bannedUntil: string | null): boolean {
  if (!bannedUntil) return false;
  return new Date(bannedUntil) > new Date();
}

export async function getHQTeam(supabase: SupabaseClient): Promise<HQTeamMember[]> {
  const [coachesRes, superAdminsRes, tenantsRes, locationsRes, adminUsers] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('coaches')
      .select('id, user_id, first_name, last_name, is_active, created_at, tenant_id, primary_location_id')
      .eq('is_active', true),
    supabase
      .from('super_admins')
      .select('id, user_id, name, email, created_at'),
    supabase.from('tenants').select('id, name, slug'),
    supabase.from('locations').select('id, name'),
    fetchAdminUsers(),
  ]);

  const tenantBySlug = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string }>();
  const tenantById = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const t of (tenantsRes.data ?? [])) {
    tenantBySlug.set(t.slug, { id: t.id, name: t.name });
    tenantById.set(t.id, t.name);
  }

  const locationMap = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const l of (locationsRes.data ?? [])) locationMap.set(l.id, l.name);

  // Build a lookup of user_id → auth user metadata for last_sign_in_at / email.
  const authUserMap = new Map<string, AdminUser>();
  for (const u of adminUsers) authUserMap.set(u.id, u);

  // Super-admins from super_admins table.
  const superAdmins: HQTeamMember[] = (superAdminsRes.data ?? []).map(sa => {
    const au = authUserMap.get(sa.user_id);
    return {
      id: sa.id,
      userId: sa.user_id,
      name: sa.name,
      email: sa.email,
      role: 'super_admin' as const,
      tenantName: null,
      locationName: null,
      createdAt: sa.created_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      lastSignIn: au?.last_sign_in_at ?? null,
      banned: isUserBanned(au?.banned_until ?? null),
    };
  });

  // Coaches from coaches table (supplement email + lastSignIn from auth).
  const coaches: HQTeamMember[] = (coachesRes.data ?? []).map(c => {
    const au = authUserMap.get(c.user_id);
    return {
      id: c.id,
      userId: c.user_id,
      name: `${c.first_name} ${c.last_name}`,
      email: au?.email ?? '',
      role: 'coach' as const,
      tenantName: tenantById.get(c.tenant_id) ?? null,
      locationName: c.primary_location_id ? (locationMap.get(c.primary_location_id) ?? null) : null,
      createdAt: c.created_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      lastSignIn: au?.last_sign_in_at ?? null,
      banned: isUserBanned(au?.banned_until ?? null),
    };
  });

  // Owners and admins: these are portal-only roles with no dedicated profile table.
  // Pull from auth.users Admin API and filter by app_role in metadata.
  const superAdminUserIds = new Set((superAdminsRes.data ?? []).map(sa => sa.user_id));
  const coachUserIds = new Set((coachesRes.data ?? []).map(c => c.user_id));

  const portalRoles: HQTeamMember[] = adminUsers
    .filter(u => {
      const role = u.raw_user_meta_data?.app_role;
      return (role === 'owner' || role === 'admin') &&
        !superAdminUserIds.has(u.id) &&
        !coachUserIds.has(u.id);
    })
    .map(u => {
      const meta = u.raw_user_meta_data;
      const role = (meta?.app_role ?? 'admin') as 'owner' | 'admin';
      const firstName = meta?.first_name ?? '';
      const lastName = meta?.last_name ?? '';
      const name = [firstName, lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || u.email;
      const tenantSlug = meta?.tenant_slug ?? '';
      const tenant = tenantBySlug.get(tenantSlug);
      return {
        id: u.id,
        userId: u.id,
        name,
        email: u.email,
        role,
        tenantName: tenant?.name ?? null,
        locationName: null,
        createdAt: u.created_at,
        lastSignIn: u.last_sign_in_at ?? null,
        banned: isUserBanned(u.banned_until ?? null),
      };
    });

  // Sort by role priority, then name.
  const rolePriority = { super_admin: 0, owner: 1, admin: 2, coach: 3 };
  return [...superAdmins, ...portalRoles, ...coaches].sort((a, b) => {
    const rp = rolePriority[a.role] - rolePriority[b.role];
    if (rp !== 0) return rp;
    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  });
}

// ─── Revenue ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getHQNetworkKPIs(supabase: SupabaseClient): Promise<HQNetworkKPIs> {
  const [locationsRes, membershipsRes, tenantsRes, paymentsRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('locations').select('id, stripe_onboarding_status'),
    supabase.from('memberships').select('tenant_id, amount_cents, status').eq('status', 'active'),
    supabase.from('tenants').select('id, royalty_config'),
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('tenant_id, amount_cents, status')
      .eq('status', 'paid')
      .gte('created_at', new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000).toISOString()),
  ]);

  const locations = locationsRes.data ?? [];
  const memberships = membershipsRes.data ?? [];
  const tenants = tenantsRes.data ?? [];
  const payments = paymentsRes.data ?? [];

  const royaltyByTenant = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const t of tenants) {
    const rc = t.royalty_config as { rate?: number } | null;
    royaltyByTenant.set(t.id, rc?.rate ?? 0.025);
  }

  const networkMRR = memberships.reduce((s, m) => s + (m.amount_cents ?? 0), 0) / 100;

  const royaltiesCollected = payments.reduce((s, p) => {
    const rate = royaltyByTenant.get(p.tenant_id) ?? 0.025;
    return s + ((p.amount_cents ?? 0) * rate);
  }, 0) / 100;

  return {
    totalLocations: locations.length,
    totalMembers: memberships.length,
    networkMRR,
    royaltiesCollected: Math.round(royaltiesCollected * 100) / 100,
    locationsNotConnected: locations.filter(l => l.stripe_onboarding_status !== 'connected').length,
  };
}

export async function getHQLocationRevenue(supabase: SupabaseClient): Promise<HQLocationRevenue[]> {
  const [locationsRes, tenantsRes, membershipsRes, paymentsRes, familiesRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('locations').select('id, tenant_id, name, stripe_onboarding_status'),
    supabase.from('tenants').select('id, name, royalty_config'),
    supabase.from('memberships').select('family_id, tenant_id, amount_cents').eq('status', 'active'),
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('family_id, tenant_id, amount_cents')
      .eq('status', 'paid')
      .gte('created_at', new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000).toISOString()),
    supabase.from('families').select('id, tenant_id, primary_location_id'),
  ]);

  const tenantMap = new Map<string, { name: string; royaltyRate: number }>();
  for (const t of (tenantsRes.data ?? [])) {
    const rc = t.royalty_config as { rate?: number } | null;
    tenantMap.set(t.id, { name: t.name, royaltyRate: rc?.rate ?? 0.025 });
  }

  // Build family lookup maps for per-location attribution.
  const familyLocationMap = new Map<string, string | null>();
  const familyTenantMap = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const f of (familiesRes.data ?? [])) {
    familyLocationMap.set(f.id, f.primary_location_id ?? null);
    familyTenantMap.set(f.id, f.tenant_id);
  }

  const locations = locationsRes.data ?? [];
  const locationsByTenant = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const l of locations) {
    const existing = locationsByTenant.get(l.tenant_id) ?? [];
    existing.push(l.id);
    locationsByTenant.set(l.tenant_id, existing);
  }

  // Per-location MRR: attribute membership amount_cents to the family's primary location.
  const mrrByLocation: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const m of (membershipsRes.data ?? [])) {
    const locationId = familyLocationMap.get(m.family_id);
    if (locationId) {
      mrrByLocation[locationId] = (mrrByLocation[locationId] ?? 0) + (m.amount_cents ?? 0);
    } else {
      const tenantId = familyTenantMap.get(m.family_id) ?? m.tenant_id;
      const locs = locationsByTenant.get(tenantId) ?? [];
      if (locs.length === 1) {
        mrrByLocation[locs[0]] = (mrrByLocation[locs[0]] ?? 0) + (m.amount_cents ?? 0);
      }
    }
  }

  // Per-location paid amount: same attribution via family_id.
  const paidByLocation: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const p of (paymentsRes.data ?? [])) {
    const locationId = familyLocationMap.get(p.family_id);
    if (locationId) {
      paidByLocation[locationId] = (paidByLocation[locationId] ?? 0) + (p.amount_cents ?? 0);
    } else {
      const tenantId = familyTenantMap.get(p.family_id) ?? p.tenant_id;
      const locs = locationsByTenant.get(tenantId) ?? [];
      if (locs.length === 1) {
        paidByLocation[locs[0]] = (paidByLocation[locs[0]] ?? 0) + (p.amount_cents ?? 0);
      }
    }
  }

  // Per-location member count (count of active memberships, same attribution).
  const memberCountByLocation = buildCountByLocation(
    membershipsRes.data ?? [],
    familyLocationMap,
    locationsByTenant,
    familyTenantMap,
  );

  return locations.map(l => {
    const tenant = tenantMap.get(l.tenant_id);
    const mrr = (mrrByLocation[l.id] ?? 0) / 100;
    const paid = (paidByLocation[l.id] ?? 0) / 100;
    const royaltyRate = tenant?.royaltyRate ?? 0.025;
    return {
      locationId: l.id,
      locationName: l.name,
      tenantName: tenant?.name ?? '—',
      mrr,
      royalty: Math.round(paid * royaltyRate * 100) / 100,
      stripeStatus: l.stripe_onboarding_status ?? 'not_connected',
      memberCount: memberCountByLocation[l.id] ?? 0,
    };
  }).sort((a, b) => b.mrr - a.mrr);
}

export async function getHQRecentTransactions(supabase: SupabaseClient, limit = 20): Promise<HQRecentTransaction[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('payment_events')
    .select('id, tenant_id, family_id, amount_cents, status, created_at')
    .eq('status', 'paid')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(limit);

  if (error || !data) return [];

  const tenantIds  = [...new Set(data.map(p => p.tenant_id))];
  const familyIds  = [...new Set(data.map(p => p.family_id).filter(Boolean))];

  const [tenantsRes, familiesRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('tenants').select('id, name').in('id', tenantIds),
    familyIds.length > 0
      ? supabase
          .from('families')
          .select('id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name, primary_location_id')
          .in('id', familyIds)
      : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
  ]);

  const tenantMap = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const t of (tenantsRes.data ?? [])) tenantMap.set(t.id, t.name);

  const locationIds = [...new Set(
    (familiesRes.data ?? [])
      .map(f => f.primary_location_id)
      .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id))
  )];

  const locationsRes = locationIds.length > 0
    ? await supabase.from('locations').select('id, name').in('id', locationIds)
    : { data: [] };

  const locationMap = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const l of (locationsRes.data ?? [])) locationMap.set(l.id, l.name);

  const familyMap = new Map<string, { name: string; locationName: string | null }>();
  for (const f of (familiesRes.data ?? [])) {
    const fullName = [f.parent_first_name, f.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || null;
    familyMap.set(f.id, {
      name: fullName ?? '—',
      locationName: f.primary_location_id ? (locationMap.get(f.primary_location_id) ?? null) : null,
    });
  }

  return data.map(p => {
    const family = familyMap.get(p.family_id);
    return {
      id: p.id,
      tenantName: tenantMap.get(p.tenant_id) ?? '—',
      locationName: family?.locationName ?? null,
      familyName: family?.name ?? null,
      amount: (p.amount_cents ?? 0) / 100,
      status: p.status,
      createdAt: p.created_at,
      memberName: null,
    };
  });
}

import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

type CookieWrite = { name: string; value: string; options: CookieOptions };

/**
 * Refresh the Supabase session cookie on every request and gate
 * `/coach/*`, `/admin/*`, and `/hq/*` behind authentication. Role-based
 * routing (coach vs admin vs owner vs super_admin) lives in the
 * per-section layouts so we can read the JWT claims server-side once a
 * session exists.
 */
export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({ request });

  const supabase = createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return request.cookies.getAll();
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet: CookieWrite[]) {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =>
            request.cookies.set(name, value),
          );
          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({ request });
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),
          );
        },
      },
    },
  );

  // IMPORTANT: do not run code between createServerClient and getUser, or the
  // session refresh may break (per @supabase/ssr docs).
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  const path = request.nextUrl.pathname;
  const protectedPath =
    path.startsWith("/coach") ||
    path.startsWith("/admin") ||
    path.startsWith("/hq") ||
    path.startsWith("/owner");

  if (protectedPath && !user) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = "/login";
    url.searchParams.set("reason", "unauthenticated");
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  }

  return supabaseResponse;
}

/**
 * Owner portal — server-side data fetching layer.
 *
 * All functions accept a Supabase server client created from the owner's
 * session cookie.  Row-Level Security on every table restricts results to
 * the owner's own tenant automatically — no explicit tenant_id filter
 * required in most queries (though we add it for clarity & index usage).
 */
import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function daysSince(ts: string | null): number {
  if (!ts) return 9999;
  return Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(ts).getTime()) / 86_400_000);
}

function relativeTime(ts: string | null): string {
  if (!ts) return 'Never';
  const d = daysSince(ts);
  if (d === 0) return 'Today';
  if (d === 1) return '1d ago';
  return `${d}d ago`;
}

function formatDeclineCode(code: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!code) return null;
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    insufficient_funds:       'Insufficient funds',
    card_declined:            'Card declined',
    expired_card:             'Card expired',
    incorrect_cvc:            'Incorrect CVC',
    lost_card:                'Card reported lost',
    stolen_card:              'Card reported stolen',
    do_not_honor:             'Card declined',
    generic_decline:          'Card declined',
    fraudulent:               'Flagged as fraudulent',
    pickup_card:              'Card declined',
    restricted_card:          'Card restricted',
    security_violation:       'Security violation',
    service_not_allowed:      'Service not allowed',
    stop_payment_order:       'Stop payment order',
    transaction_not_allowed:  'Transaction not allowed',
    card_velocity_exceeded:   'Too many recent transactions',
    invalid_account:          'Invalid account',
    no_checking_account:      'No checking account',
    not_permitted:            'Not permitted',
    authentication_required:  'Authentication required',
    currency_not_supported:   'Currency not supported',
    duplicate_transaction:    'Duplicate transaction',
    invalid_amount:           'Invalid amount',
  };
  return labels[code] ?? code.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
}

function churnRisk(daysSinceLastSession: number): 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' {
  if (daysSinceLastSession > 21) return 'high';
  if (daysSinceLastSession > 14) return 'medium';
  return 'low';
}

function engagementScore(daysSinceLastSession: number): number {
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 - daysSinceLastSession * 4));
}

function nextChargeLabel(anchorDay: number | null, status: string): string {
  if (status !== 'active' || !anchorDay) return '—';
  const now = new Date();
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  let month = now.getMonth();
  if (now.getDate() >= anchorDay) {
    month += 1;
    if (month > 11) { month = 0; }
  }
  return `${months[month]} ${anchorDay}`;
}

function formatJoinDate(ts: string): string {
  const d = new Date(ts);
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}
