// ─── KPIs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getOwnerKPIs(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<OwnerKPIs> {
  const now = new Date();
  const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
  const prevMonthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 1, 1);
  const dayStart = new Date(now); dayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const dayEnd = new Date(now); dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

  const [membershipsRes, failedRes, eventsRes, bookingsTodayRes, newSignupsRes, churnedMtdRes, lastBookingsRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, status, amount_cents, kid_id, billing_anchor_day')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId),
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('id, amount_cents, membership_id')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'failed')
      .gte('created_at', new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000).toISOString()),
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('amount_cents, status, created_at')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId),
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('id')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .gte('scheduled_start', dayStart.toISOString())
      .lte('scheduled_start', dayEnd.toISOString()),
    supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, started_at')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .gte('started_at', prevMonthStart.toISOString()),
    supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, amount_cents')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'cancelled')
      .gte('cancelled_at', monthStart.toISOString()),
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('kid_id, scheduled_start')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'completed')
      .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1000),
  ]);

  const memberships = membershipsRes.data ?? [];
  const active = memberships.filter(m => m.status === 'active');
  const mrr = active.reduce((s, m) => s + (m.amount_cents ?? 0), 0) / 100;
  const activeMembers = new Set(active.map(m => m.kid_id)).size;
  const totalMembers = new Set(memberships.map(m => m.kid_id)).size;

  // Retention rate: active memberships / all non-cancelled memberships
  const nonCancelled = memberships.filter(m => m.status !== 'cancelled');
  const retentionRate = nonCancelled.length > 0
    ? Math.round((active.length / nonCancelled.length) * 1000) / 10
    : 100;

  const events = eventsRes.data ?? [];
  const collectedMtd = events
    .filter(e => e.status === 'paid' && new Date(e.created_at) >= monthStart)
    .reduce((s, e) => s + (e.amount_cents ?? 0), 0) / 100;
  const failedMtd = events
    .filter(e => e.status === 'failed' && new Date(e.created_at) >= monthStart)
    .reduce((s, e) => s + (e.amount_cents ?? 0), 0) / 100;

  const totalMtd = collectedMtd + failedMtd;
  const autoPayRate = totalMtd > 0 ? Math.round((collectedMtd / totalMtd) * 1000) / 10 : 100;

  // Sessions today & utilization
  const sessionsToday = bookingsTodayRes.data?.length ?? 0;
  const TOTAL_SLOTS = 8 * 14; // 8 cages × 14 hours (9 AM–10 PM)
  const utilizationPct = Math.round((sessionsToday / TOTAL_SLOTS) * 1000) / 10;

  // Paid today
  const paidTodayEvents = events.filter(e => {
    if (e.status !== 'paid') return false;
    const ts = new Date(e.created_at);
    return ts >= dayStart && ts <= dayEnd;
  });
  const paidToday = paidTodayEvents.reduce((s, e) => s + (e.amount_cents ?? 0), 0) / 100;
  const paidTodayCount = paidTodayEvents.length;

  // New signups MTD vs prev month
  const recentSignups = newSignupsRes.data ?? [];
  const newSignupsMtd = recentSignups.filter(m => new Date(m.started_at) >= monthStart).length;
  const newSignupsPrevMonth = recentSignups.filter(m => {
    const d = new Date(m.started_at);
    return d >= prevMonthStart && d < monthStart;
  }).length;
  const newSignupsDelta = newSignupsMtd - newSignupsPrevMonth;

  // Churned MTD: memberships whose cancelled_at falls within the current calendar month
  const churnedRows = churnedMtdRes.data ?? [];
  const churnedMtd = churnedRows.length;
  const churnedMrrImpact = churnedRows.reduce((s, m) => s + (m.amount_cents ?? 0), 0) / 100;

  // At-risk count: active/paused memberships where last completed booking > 21 days ago
  // OR a payment failed in the last 30 days
  const lastBookingByKidKpi: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const b of ((lastBookingsRes.data ?? []) as { kid_id: string; scheduled_start: string }[])) {
    if (!lastBookingByKidKpi[b.kid_id]) lastBookingByKidKpi[b.kid_id] = b.scheduled_start;
  }
  const failedMembershipIds = new Set(
    ((failedRes.data ?? []) as { membership_id: string | null }[])
      .map(f => f.membership_id)
      .filter(Boolean) as string[],
  );
  const atRiskMemberships = memberships.filter(m => m.status === 'active' || m.status === 'paused');
  const atRiskCount = atRiskMemberships.filter(m => {
    const days = daysSince(lastBookingByKidKpi[m.kid_id] ?? null);
    return days > 21 || failedMembershipIds.has(m.id);
  }).length;

  return {
    mrr,
    activeMembers,
    totalMembers,
    failedPaymentsCount: failedRes.data?.length ?? 0,
    atRiskCount,
    collectedMtd,
    autoPayRate,
    pastDue: failedMtd,
    retentionRate,
    sessionsToday,
    utilizationPct,
    paidToday,
    paidTodayCount,
    newSignupsMtd,
    newSignupsDelta,
    churnedMtd,
    churnedMrrImpact,
  };
}

// ─── Members ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getOwnerMembers(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<OwnerMember[]> {
  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id,
      plan_name,
      plan_type,
      status,
      amount_cents,
      billing_anchor_day,
      started_at,
      kid_id,
      family_id,
      expires_at,
      sessions_remaining,
      sessions_total,
      pause_start,
      pause_end,
      cancel_requested_at,
      cancel_effective_at,
      kids!inner(first_name, last_name, age_group),
      families!inner(parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email, parent_phone, card_last4, card_brand, card_exp_month, card_exp_year)
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .order('started_at', { ascending: false });

  if (error || !rows) return [];

  const kidIds = [...new Set(rows.map(r => r.kid_id))];
  const membershipIds = rows.map(r => r.id);

  const [{ data: bookings }, { data: payments }, { data: recentFailed }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('kid_id, scheduled_start')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'completed')
      .in('kid_id', kidIds)
      .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: false }),
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('membership_id, amount_cents, status')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'paid'),
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('membership_id, error_code')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'failed')
      .in('membership_id', membershipIds)
      .gte('created_at', new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000).toISOString())
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
  ]);

  const lastBookingByKid: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const b of (bookings ?? [])) {
    if (!lastBookingByKid[b.kid_id]) lastBookingByKid[b.kid_id] = b.scheduled_start;
  }
  const lifetimeByMembership: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const p of (payments ?? [])) {
    if (p.membership_id) {
      lifetimeByMembership[p.membership_id] = (lifetimeByMembership[p.membership_id] ?? 0) + p.amount_cents;
    }
  }
  // Map membership_id → error_code of most-recent failure (array is already DESC ordered)
  const failedByMembership = new Map<string, string | null>();
  for (const f of (recentFailed ?? []) as { membership_id: string | null; error_code: string | null }[]) {
    if (f.membership_id && !failedByMembership.has(f.membership_id)) {
      failedByMembership.set(f.membership_id, f.error_code ?? null);
    }
  }
  const failedMembershipSet = new Set(failedByMembership.keys());

  return rows.map(r => {
    const kid = r.kids as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null; age_group: string | null };
    const fam = r.families as unknown as {
      parent_first_name: string;
      parent_last_name: string | null;
      parent_email: string;
      parent_phone: string | null;
      card_last4: string | null;
      card_brand: string | null;
      card_exp_month: number | null;
      card_exp_year: number | null;
    };
    const lastTs = lastBookingByKid[r.kid_id] ?? null;
    const days = daysSince(lastTs);
    const hasFailedPayment = failedMembershipSet.has(r.id);
    // Compute risk from session gap; also flag as high if payment failed regardless of session gap
    const sessionRisk = churnRisk(days);
    const risk: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' = hasFailedPayment && sessionRisk !== 'high' ? 'high' : sessionRisk;
    const planType = r.plan_type as 'eft' | 'otc';
    const memberStatus = r.status === 'active' && risk === 'high' ? 'at-risk'
      : (r.status as 'active' | 'paused' | 'cancelled');

    let riskReason: string | undefined;
    if (risk === 'high' || risk === 'medium') {
      const parts: string[] = [];
      if (days < 9999) parts.push(`No session in ${days} day${days !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
      if (hasFailedPayment) {
        const declineLabel = formatDeclineCode(failedByMembership.get(r.id));
        parts.push(declineLabel ? `Last payment failed — ${declineLabel}` : 'Last payment failed');
      }
      if (parts.length > 0) {
        riskReason = parts.join(' · ') + (risk === 'high' ? '. Call within 48 hours.' : '. Send an engagement message.');
      }
    }

    return {
      id: r.id,
      kidId: r.kid_id,
      name: [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      age: kid.age_group ?? '—',
      parent: [fam.parent_first_name, fam.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parentEmail: fam.parent_email ?? '',
      parentPhone: fam.parent_phone ?? null,
      program: r.plan_name,
      planType,
      status: memberStatus,
      engagementScore: engagementScore(days),
      churnRisk: risk,
      lastSession: relativeTime(lastTs),
      nextCharge: nextChargeLabel(r.billing_anchor_day, r.status),
      mrr: r.amount_cents / 100,
      lifetime: (lifetimeByMembership[r.id] ?? 0) / 100,
      joinedDate: formatJoinDate(r.started_at),
      riskReason,
      cardLast4: fam.card_last4 ?? null,
      cardBrand: fam.card_brand ?? null,
      cardExpMonth: fam.card_exp_month ?? null,
      cardExpYear: fam.card_exp_year ?? null,
      expiresAt: (r as unknown as { expires_at?: string | null }).expires_at ?? null,
      sessionsRemaining: (r as unknown as { sessions_remaining?: number | null }).sessions_remaining ?? null,
      sessionsTotal: (r as unknown as { sessions_total?: number | null }).sessions_total ?? null,
      pauseStart: (r as unknown as { pause_start?: string | null }).pause_start ?? null,
      pauseEnd: (r as unknown as { pause_end?: string | null }).pause_end ?? null,
      cancelRequestedAt: (r as unknown as { cancel_requested_at?: string | null }).cancel_requested_at ?? null,
      cancelEffectiveAt: (r as unknown as { cancel_effective_at?: string | null }).cancel_effective_at ?? null,
    };
  });
}

// ─── Coaches ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getOwnerCoaches(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<OwnerCoach[]> {
  const { data: coaches, error } = await supabase
    .from('coaches')
    .select('id, user_id, first_name, last_name, specialty, is_active, created_at, capabilities')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('is_active', true);

  if (error || !coaches) return [];

  const coachIds = coaches.map(c => c.id);
  const coachUserIds = coaches
    .map(c => (c as unknown as { user_id: string | null }).user_id)
    .filter((id): id is string => !!id);
  const ninetyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 90 * 86_400_000).toISOString();

  const [bookingsRes, assignmentsRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('coach_id, kid_id, status, scheduled_start, session_types(base_price_cents)')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .in('coach_id', coachIds)
      .gte('scheduled_start', ninetyDaysAgo),
    coachUserIds.length > 0
      ? supabase
          .from('assignments')
          .select('coach_user_id, rating')
          .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
          .in('coach_user_id', coachUserIds)
          .eq('status', 'reviewed')
          .not('rating', 'is', null)
      : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as { coach_user_id: string; rating: number }[], error: null }),
  ]);

  type BookingRow = {
    coach_id: string;
    kid_id: string;
    status: string;
    scheduled_start: string;
    session_types: { base_price_cents: number } | null;
  };

  const sessionsByCoach: Record<string, Set<string>> = {};
  const studentsByCoach: Record<string, Set<string>> = {};
  const revenueByCoach: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const b of (bookingsRes.data ?? []) as unknown as BookingRow[]) {
    if (!sessionsByCoach[b.coach_id]) sessionsByCoach[b.coach_id] = new Set();
    sessionsByCoach[b.coach_id].add(b.scheduled_start);
    if (!studentsByCoach[b.coach_id]) studentsByCoach[b.coach_id] = new Set();
    studentsByCoach[b.coach_id].add(b.kid_id);
    if (b.status === 'completed' && b.session_types) {
      revenueByCoach[b.coach_id] = (revenueByCoach[b.coach_id] ?? 0) + b.session_types.base_price_cents;
    }
  }

  const ratingsByCoachUser: Record<string, number[]> = {};
  for (const a of (assignmentsRes.data ?? []) as { coach_user_id: string; rating: number }[]) {
    if (!ratingsByCoachUser[a.coach_user_id]) ratingsByCoachUser[a.coach_user_id] = [];
    ratingsByCoachUser[a.coach_user_id].push(a.rating);
  }

  return coaches.map(c => {
    const raw = c as unknown as { user_id: string | null; specialty?: string | null; capabilities?: { preset?: string } };
    const sessions = sessionsByCoach[c.id]?.size ?? 0;
    const students = studentsByCoach[c.id]?.size ?? 0;
    const weeklyHours = Math.round((sessions / 13) * 1.5);
    const utilization = Math.min(100, Math.round((sessions / Math.max(sessions + 5, 40)) * 100));

    const ratings = raw.user_id ? (ratingsByCoachUser[raw.user_id] ?? []) : [];
    const avgRating = ratings.length > 0
      ? Math.round(ratings.reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / ratings.length * 10) / 10
      : null;

    const revenue = Math.round((revenueByCoach[c.id] ?? 0) / 100);
    const specialty = raw.specialty?.trim() || 'Coach';
    const preset = raw.capabilities?.preset === 'staff' ? 'staff' : 'instructor';

    return {
      id: c.id,
      userId: raw.user_id ?? null,
      name: `${c.first_name} ${c.last_name}`,
      specialty,
      students,
      utilization,
      retention: 90,
      avgRating,
      revenue,
      weeklyHours,
      joinedDate: formatJoinDate(c.created_at ?? new Date().toISOString()),
      preset: preset as 'instructor' | 'staff',
    };
  });
}

// ─── Staff Family Directory (contact-only, no financial fields) ─────────────

/**
 * Contact fields that staff coaches are permitted to see.
 * Deliberately excludes all financial / billing data:
 *   card_last4, card_brand, card_exp_*, stripe_customer_id,
 *   amount_cents, payment_events, memberships (plan / billing columns).
 */
export type StaffFamilyContact = {
  familyId: string;
  parentFirstName: string;
  parentLastName: string;
  parentPhone: string | null;
  parentEmail: string;
  kids: Array<{ id: string; firstName: string; lastName: string; ageGroup: string | null }>;
  lastSessionDate: string | null;
};

export async function getStaffFamilyDirectory(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
): Promise<StaffFamilyContact[]> {
  const { data: families, error } = await supabase
    .from('families')
    .select('id, parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_phone, parent_email')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .order('parent_last_name');

  if (error || !families) return [];

  const familyIds = families.map(f => f.id);

  const { data: kids } = await supabase
    .from('kids')
    .select('id, family_id, first_name, last_name, age_group')
    .in('family_id', familyIds)
    .order('first_name');

  const { data: recentBookings } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .select('kid_id, scheduled_start, kids!inner(family_id)')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('status', 'completed')
    .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: false })
    .limit(500);

  const lastSessionByFamily: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const b of (recentBookings ?? []) as unknown as { kid_id: string; scheduled_start: string; kids: { family_id: string } }[]) {
    const fid = b.kids?.family_id;
    if (fid && !lastSessionByFamily[fid]) {
      lastSessionByFamily[fid] = b.scheduled_start;
    }
  }

  const kidsByFamily: Record<string, StaffFamilyContact['kids']> = {};
  for (const k of (kids ?? []) as unknown as { id: string; family_id: string; first_name: string; last_name: string | null; age_group: string | null }[]) {
    if (!kidsByFamily[k.family_id]) kidsByFamily[k.family_id] = [];
    kidsByFamily[k.family_id].push({
      id: k.id,
      firstName: k.first_name,
      lastName: k.last_name ?? '',
      ageGroup: k.age_group,
    });
  }

  return families.map(f => ({
    familyId: f.id,
    parentFirstName: f.parent_first_name,
    parentLastName: f.parent_last_name,
    parentPhone: f.parent_phone ?? null,
    parentEmail: f.parent_email,
    kids: kidsByFamily[f.id] ?? [],
    lastSessionDate: lastSessionByFamily[f.id] ?? null,
  }));
}

// ─── Failed Payments ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getFailedPayments(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<FailedPayment[]> {
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

  // ── Membership payment failures (recurring billing) ───────────────────────
  const { data: membershipFailures } = await supabase
    .from('payment_events')
    .select(`
      id, amount_cents, error_code, created_at,
      membership_id,
      memberships!inner(plan_name, kid_id, family_id,
        kids!inner(first_name, last_name),
        families!inner(parent_first_name, parent_last_name)
      )
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('status', 'failed')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

  const membershipRows: FailedPayment[] = (membershipFailures ?? []).map((row, i) => {
    const mem = row.memberships as unknown as {
      plan_name: string;
      kids: { first_name: string; last_name: string | null };
      families: { parent_first_name: string; parent_last_name: string | null };
    };
    const kid = mem.kids;
    const fam = mem.families;
    const failedDate = new Date(row.created_at);
    const nextAttempt = new Date(failedDate.getTime() + 7 * 86_400_000);

    return {
      id: row.id,
      member: [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parent: [fam.parent_first_name, fam.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      amount: row.amount_cents / 100,
      package: mem.plan_name,
      failedDate: `${months[failedDate.getMonth()]} ${failedDate.getDate()}`,
      failedAt: row.created_at,
      reason: row.error_code ?? 'Card declined',
      attempts: i + 1,
      nextAttempt: `${months[nextAttempt.getMonth()]} ${nextAttempt.getDate()}`,
      source: 'membership' as const,
    };
  });

  // ── Store order card payment failures ─────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: orderFailures } = await supabase
    .from('orders')
    .select(`
      id, amount_paid_cents, created_at, failure_reason,
      kid_id,
      kids!inner(first_name, last_name),
      families!inner(parent_first_name, parent_last_name),
      products!inner(name)
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('payment_method', 'card')
    .eq('status', 'payment_failed')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

  const orderRows: FailedPayment[] = (orderFailures ?? []).map((row) => {
    const kid = row.kids as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null };
    const fam = row.families as unknown as { parent_first_name: string; parent_last_name: string | null };
    const product = row.products as unknown as { name: string };
    const rowWithReason = row as unknown as { failure_reason?: string | null };
    const failedDate = new Date(row.created_at);
    const nextAttempt = new Date(failedDate.getTime() + 3 * 86_400_000);

    return {
      id: row.id,
      member: [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parent: [fam.parent_first_name, fam.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      amount: (row.amount_paid_cents ?? 0) / 100,
      package: product.name,
      failedDate: `${months[failedDate.getMonth()]} ${failedDate.getDate()}`,
      failedAt: row.created_at,
      reason: rowWithReason.failure_reason ?? 'Card declined',
      attempts: 1,
      nextAttempt: `${months[nextAttempt.getMonth()]} ${nextAttempt.getDate()}`,
      source: 'store_order' as const,
    };
  });

  // Merge and sort by raw ISO timestamp (stable, year-aware, locale-independent)
  return [...membershipRows, ...orderRows].sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(b.failedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.failedAt).getTime(),
  );
}

// ─── Monthly Revenue ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getMonthlyRevenue(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<RevenueMonth[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('payment_events')
    .select('amount_cents, status, created_at, memberships(plan_type)')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('status', 'paid')
    .gte('created_at', new Date(Date.now() - 365 * 86_400_000).toISOString())
    .order('created_at');

  if (error || !data) return [];

  const byMonth: Record<string, RevenueMonth> = {};
  const monthLabels = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

  for (const e of data) {
    const d = new Date(e.created_at);
    const key = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    if (!byMonth[key]) {
      byMonth[key] = { month: monthLabels[d.getMonth()], eft: 0, otc: 0, total: 0 };
    }
    const cents = e.amount_cents / 100;
    const mem = e.memberships as unknown as { plan_type: string } | null;
    const planType = mem?.plan_type ?? 'otc';
    if (planType === 'eft') byMonth[key].eft += cents;
    else byMonth[key].otc += cents;
    byMonth[key].total += cents;
  }

  return Object.entries(byMonth)
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .map(([, v]) => v);
}

// ─── Membership Packages ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getMembershipPackages(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<MembershipPackage[]> {
  const [membershipsRes, paymentsRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('id, plan_name, plan_type, amount_cents, status, started_at')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId),
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('membership_id, amount_cents')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'paid'),
  ]);

  if (membershipsRes.error || !membershipsRes.data) return [];

  const memberships = membershipsRes.data;
  const payments = paymentsRes.data ?? [];

  // Actual collected revenue per membership (from real payment_events rows)
  const collectedByMembership: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const p of payments) {
    if (p.membership_id) {
      collectedByMembership[p.membership_id] = (collectedByMembership[p.membership_id] ?? 0) + p.amount_cents;
    }
  }

  const byPlan: Record<string, { planType: string; price: number; activeCount: number; collectedCents: number }> = {};

  for (const m of memberships) {
    if (!byPlan[m.plan_name]) {
      byPlan[m.plan_name] = { planType: m.plan_type, price: m.amount_cents / 100, activeCount: 0, collectedCents: 0 };
    }
    if (m.status === 'active') byPlan[m.plan_name].activeCount += 1;
    byPlan[m.plan_name].collectedCents += collectedByMembership[m.id] ?? 0;
  }

  const totalCollected = Object.values(byPlan).reduce((s, p) => s + p.collectedCents, 0);

  return Object.entries(byPlan).map(([name, p]) => {
    // MRR: for EFT use active count × monthly price; for OTC use total collected
    const mrr = p.planType === 'eft' ? p.price * p.activeCount : p.collectedCents / 100;
    const pctRevenue = totalCollected > 0 ? Math.round((p.collectedCents / totalCollected) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
    const avgTenureMonths = 6;
    return {
      name,
      planType: p.planType,
      price: p.price,
      activeCount: p.activeCount,
      mrr,
      pctRevenue,
      ltv: Math.round(p.price * avgTenureMonths),
    };
  });
}

// ─── At-Risk Members ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getAtRiskMembers(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<OwnerMember[]> {
  const members = await getOwnerMembers(supabase, tenantId);
  return members.filter(m => m.churnRisk === 'high' || m.churnRisk === 'medium');
}

// ─── Missing in Action ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type MiaGroups = {
  sevenDay: OwnerMember[];
  fourteenDay: OwnerMember[];
  thirtyDay: OwnerMember[];
};

export async function getMissingInAction(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<MiaGroups> {
  const members = await getOwnerMembers(supabase, tenantId);
  const active = members.filter(m => m.status === 'active' || m.status === 'at-risk');

  const parse = (rel: string): number => {
    if (rel === 'Today') return 0;
    const m = rel.match(/^(\d+)d ago$/);
    return m ? parseInt(m[1]) : (rel === 'Never' ? 9999 : 0);
  };

  return {
    sevenDay: active.filter(m => parse(m.lastSession) >= 7 && parse(m.lastSession) < 14),
    fourteenDay: active.filter(m => parse(m.lastSession) >= 14 && parse(m.lastSession) < 30),
    thirtyDay: active.filter(m => parse(m.lastSession) >= 30),
  };
}

// ─── Billing Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type RecentTransaction = {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  member: string;
  package: string;
  amount: number;
  method: string;
  status: 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded';
};

export type BillingData = {
  kpis: OwnerKPIs;
  packages: MembershipPackage[];
  recentTransactions: RecentTransaction[];
  paidCount: number;
  failedCount: number;
  fetchedAt: string;
};

/**
 * Fetches billing KPIs and package breakdown from the database.
 *
 * NOTE — MRR sourcing: this function computes MRR from DB payment_events/memberships
 * (historical, not real-time). The billing page server component overrides the mrr KPI
 * with live Stripe subscription data via `fetchLocationMrr` when Stripe is configured.
 * If you reuse this function elsewhere and need authoritative live MRR, supplement it
 * with `fetchLocationMrr` from `@/lib/stripe/mrrUtils` and override kpis.mrr there too.
 */
export async function getBillingData(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<BillingData> {
  const [kpis, packages] = await Promise.all([
    getOwnerKPIs(supabase, tenantId),
    getMembershipPackages(supabase, tenantId),
  ]);

  const { data: events } = await supabase
    .from('payment_events')
    .select(`
      id, amount_cents, payment_method, status, created_at,
      memberships(plan_name, kids(first_name, last_name))
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(50);

  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

  const recentTransactions: RecentTransaction[] = (events ?? []).map(e => {
    const mem = e.memberships as unknown as {
      plan_name: string;
      kids: { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | Array<{ first_name: string; last_name: string | null }> | null;
    } | null;
    // kids may be returned as an array (when the join is one-to-many) or as an
    // object (when selected via memberships→kids as a nested relation). Guard for both.
    const kidsObj = Array.isArray(mem?.kids) ? mem?.kids[0] ?? null : mem?.kids ?? null;
    const d = new Date(e.created_at);
    const memberName = kidsObj
      ? [kidsObj.first_name, kidsObj.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
      : '—';
    return {
      id: e.id,
      date: `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`,
      member: memberName,
      package: mem?.plan_name ?? '—',
      amount: e.amount_cents / 100,
      method: e.payment_method.toUpperCase(),
      status: e.status as 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded',
    };
  });

  const paidCount = (events ?? []).filter(e => e.status === 'paid').length;
  const failedCount = (events ?? []).filter(e => e.status === 'failed').length;

  return {
    kpis,
    packages,
    recentTransactions,
    paidCount,
    failedCount,
    fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

// ─── Revenue Reports ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type RevenueReportsData = {
  eftVsOtc: {
    eftTotal: number;
    otcTotal: number;
    eftCount: number;
    otcCount: number;
    eftMomPct: number | null;
    otcMomPct: number | null;
  };
  monthly: RevenueMonth[];
  packages: MembershipPackage[];
  programBreakdown: Array<{ name: string; count: number }>;
  cohortRetention: Array<{ cohort: string; size: number; retention: number[] }>;
};

export async function getRevenueReportsData(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<RevenueReportsData> {
  const TYPE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
    private: 'Private Lessons',
    group:   'Group Classes',
    cage:    'Cage Rental',
  };

  const now = new Date();
  const currentMonthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
  const prevMonthStart    = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 1, 1);

  const [monthly, packages, bookingsRes, membershipsRes, momRes] = await Promise.all([
    getMonthlyRevenue(supabase, tenantId),
    getMembershipPackages(supabase, tenantId),
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('type_category')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .gte('scheduled_start', new Date(Date.now() - 365 * 86_400_000).toISOString()),
    supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('started_at, status')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .order('started_at'),
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('amount_cents, created_at, memberships(plan_type)')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'paid')
      .gte('created_at', prevMonthStart.toISOString()),
  ]);

  // Compute month-over-month deltas for EFT and OTC
  let eftCurrent = 0, otcCurrent = 0, eftPrior = 0, otcPrior = 0;
  for (const e of (momRes.data ?? [])) {
    const d = new Date(e.created_at);
    const planType = (e.memberships as unknown as { plan_type: string } | null)?.plan_type ?? 'otc';
    const dollars = e.amount_cents / 100;
    if (d >= currentMonthStart) {
      if (planType === 'eft') eftCurrent += dollars;
      else otcCurrent += dollars;
    } else {
      if (planType === 'eft') eftPrior += dollars;
      else otcPrior += dollars;
    }
  }
  const eftMomPct = eftPrior > 0
    ? Math.round(((eftCurrent - eftPrior) / eftPrior) * 1000) / 10
    : null;
  const otcMomPct = otcPrior > 0
    ? Math.round(((otcCurrent - otcPrior) / otcPrior) * 1000) / 10
    : null;

  const eftTotal = monthly.reduce((s, m) => s + m.eft, 0);
  const otcTotal = monthly.reduce((s, m) => s + m.otc, 0);
  const eftCount = packages.filter(p => p.planType === 'eft').reduce((s, p) => s + p.activeCount, 0);
  const otcCount = packages.filter(p => p.planType === 'otc').reduce((s, p) => s + p.activeCount, 0);

  const countByType: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const b of (bookingsRes.data ?? [])) {
    const label = TYPE_LABEL[b.type_category as string] ?? b.type_category ?? 'Other';
    countByType[label] = (countByType[label] ?? 0) + 1;
  }
  const programBreakdown = Object.entries(countByType)
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a)
    .map(([name, count]) => ({ name, count }));

  const cohortMap: Record<string, { total: number; active: number }> = {};
  const monthLabels = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

  for (const m of (membershipsRes.data ?? [])) {
    const d = new Date(m.started_at);
    const key = `${monthLabels[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}`;
    if (!cohortMap[key]) cohortMap[key] = { total: 0, active: 0 };
    cohortMap[key].total += 1;
    if (m.status === 'active') cohortMap[key].active += 1;
  }

  const cohortRetention = Object.entries(cohortMap).map(([cohort, { total, active }]) => ({
    cohort,
    size: total,
    retention: [100, Math.round((active / total) * 100)],
  }));

  return {
    eftVsOtc: { eftTotal, otcTotal, eftCount, otcCount, eftMomPct, otcMomPct },
    monthly,
    packages,
    programBreakdown,
    cohortRetention,
  };
}

// ─── Points & Rewards ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type PointsRewardsData = {
  products: PointsProduct[];
  totalPointsIssued: number;
  topEarners: Array<{ name: string; points: number }>;
};

export async function getPointsRewardsData(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<PointsRewardsData> {
  const { data: products } = await supabase
    .from('products')
    .select('id, name, category, points_cost, inventory_count, is_active, image_url')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('is_active', true)
    .eq('is_redeemable', true)
    .order('sort_order');

  const { data: orders } = await supabase
    .from('orders')
    .select('product_id, status')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('payment_method', 'points');

  const fulfilledByProduct: Record<string, number> = {};
  const pendingByProduct: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const o of (orders ?? [])) {
    if (o.status === 'fulfilled') {
      fulfilledByProduct[o.product_id] = (fulfilledByProduct[o.product_id] ?? 0) + 1;
    } else if (o.status === 'ordered') {
      pendingByProduct[o.product_id] = (pendingByProduct[o.product_id] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  const { data: ledger } = await supabase
    .from('points_ledger')
    .select('delta, kid_id, kids(first_name)')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .gt('delta', 0);

  const totalPointsIssued = (ledger ?? []).reduce((s, l) => s + (l.delta ?? 0), 0);

  const earnerMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const l of (ledger ?? [])) {
    const k = l.kids as unknown as { first_name: string } | null;
    const name = k?.first_name ?? 'Unknown';
    earnerMap[name] = (earnerMap[name] ?? 0) + (l.delta ?? 0);
  }
  const topEarners = Object.entries(earnerMap)
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a)
    .slice(0, 4)
    .map(([name, points]) => ({ name, points }));

  return {
    products: (products ?? []).map(p => ({
      id: p.id,
      name: p.name,
      category: p.category ?? 'General',
      cost: p.points_cost ?? 0,
      inventory: p.inventory_count,
      fulfilled: fulfilledByProduct[p.id] ?? 0,
      pending: pendingByProduct[p.id] ?? 0,
      image_url: (p as unknown as { image_url?: string | null }).image_url ?? null,
    })),
    totalPointsIssued,
    topEarners,
  };
}

// ─── Retention ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type ProgramRetention = {
  name: string;
  retentionRate: number;
};

export type RetentionData = {
  hasMemberships: boolean;
  retentionRate: number;
  avgLifetimeMonths: number;
  churnedMtd: number;
  cohortRetention: Array<{ cohort: string; size: number; retention: (number | null)[] }>;
  churnReasons: Array<{ reason: string; count: number; pct: number }>;
  programBreakdown: ProgramRetention[];
};

export async function getRetentionData(supabase: SupabaseClient, tenantId: string): Promise<RetentionData> {
  const { data: memberships } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select('started_at, cancelled_at, status, plan_type')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId);

  const rows = memberships ?? [];
  const MONTH_LABELS = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const now = new Date();
  const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return {
      hasMemberships: false,
      retentionRate: 100,
      avgLifetimeMonths: 0,
      churnedMtd: 0,
      cohortRetention: [],
      churnReasons: [{ reason: 'Schedule conflict / too busy', count: 0, pct: 0 }],
      programBreakdown: [],
    };
  }

  // ── Build the 10-month cohort grid ──────────────────────────────────────
  // Each cohort = one calendar month. For each cohort, compute what % of
  // members who started in that month are still with us M+1, M+2 … M+9 months later.
  // A member is "still with us at M+N" if they had NOT cancelled before
  // the first day of the (cohort month + N) calendar month.

  const cohortRetention: RetentionData['cohortRetention'] = [];

  for (let i = 9; i >= 0; i--) {
    const cohortStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1);
    const cohortEnd   = new Date(cohortStart.getFullYear(), cohortStart.getMonth() + 1, 1);

    const cohortMembers = rows.filter(m => {
      const s = new Date(m.started_at);
      return s >= cohortStart && s < cohortEnd;
    });

    if (cohortMembers.length === 0) continue;

    const size = cohortMembers.length;
    const retention: (number | null)[] = [];

    for (let n = 0; n <= 9; n++) {
      // Reference date: first day of cohort month + n months
      const refDate = new Date(cohortStart.getFullYear(), cohortStart.getMonth() + n, 1);

      if (refDate > now) {
        // Future month — we can't know yet
        retention.push(null);
        continue;
      }

      if (n === 0) {
        retention.push(100);
        continue;
      }

      // A member is "still with us at M+N" if they had not left before refDate.
      // "Left" = cancelled_at < refDate, OR (status='cancelled' with no cancelled_at timestamp).
      // Paused members are counted as retained (they are still paying / on hold).
      const stillActive = cohortMembers.filter(m => {
        if (m.cancelled_at) return new Date(m.cancelled_at) >= refDate;
        return m.status !== 'cancelled';
      }).length;

      retention.push(Math.round((stillActive / size) * 1000) / 10);
    }

    cohortRetention.push({
      cohort: `${MONTH_LABELS[cohortStart.getMonth()]} ${cohortStart.getFullYear()}`,
      size,
      retention,
    });
  }

  // ── Summary stats ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // Average lifetime: from started_at to cancelled_at (or now for still-active)
  const avgLifetimeMonths = Math.round(
    rows.reduce((s, m) => {
      const end = m.cancelled_at ? new Date(m.cancelled_at) : now;
      return s + (end.getTime() - new Date(m.started_at).getTime()) / (30 * 86_400_000);
    }, 0) / rows.length * 10
  ) / 10;

  // Overall retention rate: weighted M1 rate across all cohorts that have M1 data.
  // Falls back to snapshot (active / total) if no cohort has reached M1 yet.
  const cohortsWithM1 = cohortRetention.filter(c => c.retention[1] !== null);
  let retentionRate: number;
  if (cohortsWithM1.length > 0) {
    const totalInCohorts  = cohortsWithM1.reduce((s, c) => s + c.size, 0);
    const retainedAtM1    = cohortsWithM1.reduce(
      (s, c) => s + Math.round(c.size * ((c.retention[1] as number) / 100)),
      0
    );
    retentionRate = Math.round((retainedAtM1 / totalInCohorts) * 1000) / 10;
  } else {
    const active = rows.filter(m => m.status === 'active').length;
    retentionRate = Math.round((active / rows.length) * 1000) / 10;
  }

  // Churned this calendar month
  const churnedMtd = rows.filter(
    m => m.cancelled_at && new Date(m.cancelled_at) >= monthStart
  ).length;

  // ── Program breakdown ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const programBreakdown: ProgramRetention[] = [];

  const addProgramSegment = (label: string, segment: typeof rows) => {
    if (segment.length === 0) return;
    const active = segment.filter(m => m.status === 'active').length;
    programBreakdown.push({
      name: label,
      retentionRate: Math.round((active / segment.length) * 1000) / 10,
    });
  };

  addProgramSegment('EFT Monthly',  rows.filter(m => m.plan_type === 'eft'));
  addProgramSegment('OTC Packages', rows.filter(m => m.plan_type === 'otc'));
  const unknownRows = rows.filter(m => !m.plan_type || !['eft', 'otc'].includes(m.plan_type));
  addProgramSegment('Unknown',      unknownRows);

  return {
    hasMemberships: true,
    retentionRate,
    avgLifetimeMonths,
    churnedMtd,
    cohortRetention,
    churnReasons: [{ reason: 'Schedule conflict / too busy', count: 0, pct: 0 }],
    programBreakdown,
  };
}

// ─── Schedule ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type ScheduleBooking = {
  id: string;
  kidName: string;
  coachName: string;
  scheduledStart: string;
  scheduledEnd: string;
  cage: string | null;
  sessionType: string;
  status: string;
};

export type OwnerScheduleData = {
  bookings: ScheduleBooking[];
  totalToday: number;
  occupancyPct: number;
  openSlots: number;
};

export async function getOwnerScheduleData(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
  date: Date = new Date(),
): Promise<OwnerScheduleData> {
  const dayStart = new Date(date);
  dayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const dayEnd = new Date(date);
  dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

  const { data: raw, error: bookingError } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .select(`
      id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, cage_number, status,
      session_types(name),
      kids(first_name, last_name),
      coaches(first_name, last_name)
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .gte('scheduled_start', dayStart.toISOString())
    .lte('scheduled_start', dayEnd.toISOString())
    .order('scheduled_start');

  if (bookingError) {
    console.error('[getOwnerScheduleData] bookings query failed:', bookingError.message);
  }

  const bookings: ScheduleBooking[] = (raw ?? []).map(b => {
    const kid = b.kids as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
    const coach = b.coaches as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
    const st = b.session_types as unknown as { name: string } | null;
    return {
      id: b.id,
      kidName: kid ? [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') : 'Unknown',
      coachName: coach ? [coach.first_name, coach.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') : '—',
      scheduledStart: b.scheduled_start,
      scheduledEnd: b.scheduled_end ?? b.scheduled_start,
      cage: b.cage_number ? `Cage ${b.cage_number}` : null,
      sessionType: st?.name ?? 'Private',
      status: b.status,
    };
  });

  const TOTAL_SLOTS = 8 * 14; // 8 cages × 14 hours (9 AM–10 PM)
  const occupancyPct = Math.round((bookings.length / TOTAL_SLOTS) * 1000) / 10;

  return {
    bookings,
    totalToday: bookings.length,
    occupancyPct,
    openSlots: TOTAL_SLOTS - bookings.length,
  };
}

// ─── Member Detail ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type BookingStatus = 'completed' | 'cancelled' | 'confirmed' | 'pending' | 'no_show';
export type PaymentStatus = 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded';

export type TimelineEvent = {
  id: string;
  kind: 'booking' | 'payment';
  dateIso: string;
  dateLabel: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  status: BookingStatus | PaymentStatus;
  amount?: number;
};

export type RecentPaymentEvent = {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  amount: number;
  status: 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded';
  method: string;
};

export type MemberDetail = OwnerMember & {
  bookingCount: number;
  hittraxSessionCount: number;
  pointsBalance: number;
  timeline: TimelineEvent[];
  recentPayments: RecentPaymentEvent[];
  stripeSubscriptionId: string | null;
  subscriptionStatus: 'active' | 'past_due' | 'payment_overdue' | 'cancelled' | 'paused' | 'none';
  nextBillingAt: string | null;
  /** ISO timestamp when a cancel_at_period_end subscription will terminate. Null if not pending cancellation. */
  cancelAt: string | null;
  /** ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the pause started. Null if not paused. */
  pauseStart: string | null;
  /** ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the pause ends / membership auto-resumes. Null if not paused. */
  pauseEnd: string | null;
  /** Timestamp when the pause was initiated. Null if not paused. */
  pausedAt: string | null;
  /** ISO timestamp when the parent submitted a cancellation request. Null if no pending cancellation. */
  cancelRequestedAt?: string | null;
  /** ISO timestamp when the membership access will actually end. Null if no pending cancellation. */
  cancelEffectiveAt?: string | null;
  /** OTC pack members only. Null for EFT memberships. */
  sessionsRemaining: number | null;
  /** OTC pack members only. Null for EFT memberships. */
  sessionsTotal: number | null;
  /** EFT limited: credits used in the current weekly period. Null for OTC or unlimited EFT. */
  weeklySessionsUsed: number | null;
  /** EFT limited: sessions_per_week allowance for the plan. Null for OTC or unlimited EFT. */
  weeklyTotal: number | null;
  /** EFT limited: Monday (YYYY-MM-DD) that starts the current weekly period. Null otherwise. */
  weeklyPeriodStart: string | null;
};

export async function getMemberDetail(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
  membershipId: string,
): Promise<MemberDetail | null> {
  const { data: mem, error: memErr } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id,
      plan_name,
      plan_type,
      status,
      amount_cents,
      billing_anchor_day,
      started_at,
      kid_id,
      family_id,
      stripe_subscription_id,
      next_billing_at,
      cancel_at,
      cancel_requested_at,
      cancel_effective_at,
      pause_start,
      pause_end,
      paused_at,
      sessions_total,
      sessions_remaining,
      sessions_per_week,
      weekly_sessions_used,
      weekly_period_start,
      kids!inner(id, first_name, last_name, age_group, points_balance),
      families!inner(parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email, parent_phone, card_last4, card_brand, card_exp_month, card_exp_year)
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('id', membershipId)
    .single();

  if (memErr || !mem) return null;

  const kid = mem.kids as unknown as {
    id: string;
    first_name: string;
    last_name: string | null;
    age_group: string | null;
    points_balance: number;
  };
  const fam = mem.families as unknown as {
    parent_first_name: string;
    parent_last_name: string | null;
    parent_email: string;
    parent_phone: string | null;
    card_last4: string | null;
    card_brand: string | null;
    card_exp_month: number | null;
    card_exp_year: number | null;
  };

  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

  const dateLabel = (iso: string) => {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    return `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
  };

  const [bookingCountRes, sessionsRes, recentBookingsRes, paymentsRes, lastBookingRes] = await Promise.all([
    // Exact completed-booking count — no row limit so all completed bookings are counted
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('kid_id', kid.id)
      .eq('status', 'completed'),
    // HitTrax session count
    supabase
      .from('sessions')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('kid_id', kid.id),
    // Recent bookings for the timeline (last 5)
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('id, scheduled_start, status, session_types(name), coaches(first_name, last_name)')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('kid_id', kid.id)
      .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: false })
      .limit(5),
    // Payment events — last 5 for timeline + last 3 for billing card
    supabase
      .from('payment_events')
      .select('id, amount_cents, payment_method, status, created_at')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('membership_id', membershipId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(5),
    // Last completed booking for churn-risk / engagement scoring
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select('scheduled_start')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('kid_id', kid.id)
      .eq('status', 'completed')
      .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1),
  ]);

  const bookingCount = bookingCountRes.count ?? 0;
  const hittraxSessionCount = sessionsRes.count ?? 0;

  if (bookingCountRes.error) console.error('[getMemberDetail] bookingCount:', bookingCountRes.error.message);
  if (sessionsRes.error) console.error('[getMemberDetail] sessions:', sessionsRes.error.message);
  if (recentBookingsRes.error) console.error('[getMemberDetail] recentBookings:', recentBookingsRes.error.message);
  if (paymentsRes.error) console.error('[getMemberDetail] payments:', paymentsRes.error.message);
  if (lastBookingRes.error) console.error('[getMemberDetail] lastBooking:', lastBookingRes.error.message);

  // Build unified timeline: merge recent bookings + payment events, sort descending
  const knownBookingStatuses = new Set<BookingStatus>(['completed','cancelled','confirmed','pending','no_show']);
  const knownPaymentStatuses = new Set<PaymentStatus>(['paid','failed','refunded']);

  const bookingEvents: TimelineEvent[] = (recentBookingsRes.data ?? []).map(b => {
    const coach = b.coaches as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
    const st = b.session_types as unknown as { name: string } | null;
    const status: BookingStatus = knownBookingStatuses.has(b.status as BookingStatus)
      ? (b.status as BookingStatus)
      : 'pending';
    return {
      id: b.id,
      kind: 'booking' as const,
      dateIso: b.scheduled_start,
      dateLabel: dateLabel(b.scheduled_start),
      title: st?.name ?? 'Private Session',
      subtitle: coach ? `Coach ${[coach.first_name, coach.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}` : 'Session',
      status,
    };
  });

  const paymentTimelineEvents: TimelineEvent[] = (paymentsRes.data ?? []).map(e => {
    const status: PaymentStatus = knownPaymentStatuses.has(e.status as PaymentStatus)
      ? (e.status as PaymentStatus)
      : 'paid';
    return {
      id: e.id,
      kind: 'payment' as const,
      dateIso: e.created_at,
      dateLabel: dateLabel(e.created_at),
      title: status === 'paid' ? 'Payment received' : status === 'failed' ? 'Payment failed' : 'Payment refunded',
      subtitle: `$${(e.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)} · ${(e.payment_method ?? 'eft').toUpperCase()}`,
      status,
      amount: e.amount_cents / 100,
    };
  });

  const timeline: TimelineEvent[] = [...bookingEvents, ...paymentTimelineEvents]
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.dateIso).getTime() - new Date(a.dateIso).getTime())
    .slice(0, 8);

  const recentPayments: RecentPaymentEvent[] = (paymentsRes.data ?? []).slice(0, 3).map(e => {
    return {
      id: e.id,
      date: dateLabel(e.created_at),
      amount: e.amount_cents / 100,
      status: e.status as 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded',
      method: (e.payment_method ?? 'eft').toUpperCase(),
    };
  });

  const lastBookingTs = lastBookingRes.data?.[0]?.scheduled_start ?? null;
  const days = daysSince(lastBookingTs);
  const risk = churnRisk(days);
  const planType = mem.plan_type as 'eft' | 'otc';
  const rawStatus = mem.status as string;
  const memberStatus = rawStatus === 'active' && risk === 'high' ? 'at-risk'
    : (rawStatus as 'active' | 'paused' | 'cancelled' | 'payment_overdue');

  // Subscription billing fields (Phase 3 + Task #240 pause)
  const stripeSubscriptionId = (mem.stripe_subscription_id as string | null) ?? null;
  const nextBillingAt = (mem.next_billing_at as string | null) ?? null;
  const pauseStart = (mem.pause_start as string | null) ?? null;
  const pauseEnd   = (mem.pause_end   as string | null) ?? null;
  const pausedAt   = (mem.paused_at   as string | null) ?? null;
  let subscriptionStatus: MemberDetail['subscriptionStatus'] = 'none';
  if (stripeSubscriptionId) {
    if (rawStatus === 'paused') subscriptionStatus = 'paused';
    else if (rawStatus === 'active') subscriptionStatus = 'active';
    else if (rawStatus === 'payment_overdue') subscriptionStatus = 'payment_overdue';
    else if (rawStatus === 'cancelled') subscriptionStatus = 'cancelled';
    else subscriptionStatus = 'active';
  } else if (rawStatus === 'paused') {
    subscriptionStatus = 'paused';
  }

  const lifetimeRes = await supabase
    .from('payment_events')
    .select('amount_cents')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('membership_id', membershipId)
    .eq('status', 'paid');
  const lifetime = (lifetimeRes.data ?? []).reduce((s, e) => s + (e.amount_cents ?? 0), 0) / 100;

  return {
    id: mem.id,
    kidId: kid.id,
    name: [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
    age: kid.age_group ?? '—',
    parent: [fam.parent_first_name, fam.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
    parentEmail: fam.parent_email ?? '',
    parentPhone: fam.parent_phone ?? null,
    program: mem.plan_name,
    planType,
    status: memberStatus,
    engagementScore: engagementScore(days),
    churnRisk: risk,
    lastSession: relativeTime(lastBookingTs),
    nextCharge: nextChargeLabel(mem.billing_anchor_day, mem.status),
    mrr: mem.amount_cents / 100,
    lifetime,
    joinedDate: formatJoinDate(mem.started_at),
    riskReason: risk === 'high'
      ? `No session in ${days} days. Outreach recommended within 48 hours.`
      : risk === 'medium'
      ? `No session in ${days} days. Send an engagement message.`
      : undefined,
    bookingCount,
    hittraxSessionCount,
    pointsBalance: kid.points_balance,
    timeline,
    recentPayments,
    stripeSubscriptionId,
    subscriptionStatus,
    nextBillingAt,
    cancelAt: (mem.cancel_at as string | null) ?? null,
    cancelRequestedAt: (mem.cancel_requested_at as string | null) ?? null,
    cancelEffectiveAt: (mem.cancel_effective_at as string | null) ?? null,
    pauseStart,
    pauseEnd,
    pausedAt,
    cardLast4: fam.card_last4 ?? null,
    cardBrand: fam.card_brand ?? null,
    cardExpMonth: fam.card_exp_month ?? null,
    cardExpYear: fam.card_exp_year ?? null,
    sessionsRemaining:   (mem.sessions_remaining   as number | null) ?? null,
    sessionsTotal:       (mem.sessions_total        as number | null) ?? null,
    weeklySessionsUsed:  mem.plan_type === 'eft' && (mem.sessions_per_week as number | null)
      ? ((mem.weekly_sessions_used as number | null) ?? 0)
      : null,
    weeklyTotal:         (mem.sessions_per_week as number | null) ?? null,
    weeklyPeriodStart:   mem.plan_type === 'eft'
      ? ((mem.weekly_period_start as string | null) ?? null)
      : null,
  };
}

// ─── Coach Hours ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type CoachHoursRow = {
  coach_id: string;
  coach_name: string;
  confirmed_count: number;
  completed_count: number;
  no_show_count: number;
  cancelled_count: number;
  total_hours: number;
};

export async function getCoachHours(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
  startDate: string,
  endDate: string,
): Promise<CoachHoursRow[] | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .rpc('get_coach_hours', {
      p_tenant_id:  tenantId,
      p_start_date: startDate,
      p_end_date:   endDate,
    });

  if (error) {
    console.error('[getCoachHours]', error.message);
    return null;
  }

  return (data ?? []).map((r: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
    coach_id:        r.coach_id as string,
    coach_name:      r.coach_name as string,
    confirmed_count: Number(r.confirmed_count ?? 0),
    completed_count: Number(r.completed_count ?? 0),
    no_show_count:   Number(r.no_show_count ?? 0),
    cancelled_count: Number(r.cancelled_count ?? 0),
    total_hours:     Number(r.total_hours ?? 0),
  }));
}

// ─── Revenue Transactions (real payment_events for the report page) ───────────

export type RevenueTransaction = {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  memberName: string;
  planName: string;
  planType: string;
  amountDollars: number;
  paymentMethod: string;
  status: 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded';
};

export async function getRevenueTransactions(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
  startDate: string,
  endDate: string,
): Promise<RevenueTransaction[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('payment_events')
    .select(`
      id, amount_cents, payment_method, status, created_at,
      memberships(plan_name, plan_type, kids(first_name, last_name))
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .gte('created_at', new Date(startDate).toISOString())
    .lt('created_at', new Date(new Date(endDate).getTime() + 86_400_000).toISOString())
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    console.error('[getRevenueTransactions]', error.message);
    return [];
  }

  return (data ?? []).map(e => {
    const mem = e.memberships as unknown as {
      plan_name: string;
      plan_type: string;
      kids: { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
    } | null;
    const d = new Date(e.created_at);
    const memberName = mem?.kids
      ? [mem.kids.first_name, mem.kids.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
      : '—';
    return {
      id:            e.id,
      date:          `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`,
      memberName,
      planName:      mem?.plan_name ?? '—',
      planType:      mem?.plan_type?.toUpperCase() ?? '—',
      amountDollars: e.amount_cents / 100,
      paymentMethod: (e.payment_method ?? 'eft').toUpperCase(),
      status:        e.status as 'paid' | 'failed' | 'refunded',
    };
  });
}

 * owner/admin accounts.
 */
export async function getTenantNameBySlug(
  serviceSupabase: SupabaseClient,
  slug: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const { data } = await serviceSupabase
    .from('tenants')
    .select('name')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .single();
  return data?.name ?? 'Your Location';
}

// ─── Location Stripe Status ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type LocationStripeStatus = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  stripe_account_id: string | null;
  stripe_onboarding_status: 'not_connected' | 'pending' | 'connected' | 'restricted';
  stripe_account_name: string | null;
  stripe_payout_interval: string | null;
};

export async function getLocationsStripeStatus(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
): Promise<LocationStripeStatus[]> {
  if (!tenantId) return [];
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('locations')
    .select('id, name, stripe_account_id, stripe_onboarding_status, stripe_account_name, stripe_payout_interval')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .order('name');

  if (error || !data) return [];

  return data.map(row => ({
    id: row.id as string,
    name: row.name as string,
    stripe_account_id: (row.stripe_account_id as string | null) ?? null,
    stripe_onboarding_status: ((row.stripe_onboarding_status as string | null) ?? 'not_connected') as LocationStripeStatus['stripe_onboarding_status'],
    stripe_account_name: (row.stripe_account_name as string | null) ?? null,
    stripe_payout_interval: (row.stripe_payout_interval as string | null) ?? null,
  }));
}

/** Convenience: returns the first location's stripe status (for dashboard banner). */
export async function getLocationStripeStatus(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
): Promise<LocationStripeStatus | null> {
  const all = await getLocationsStripeStatus(supabase, tenantId);
  return all[0] ?? null;
}

// ─── Today at a Glance ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type TodayBooking = {
  id: string;
  kidName: string;
  coachId: string | null;
  coachName: string;
  sessionType: string;
  basePriceCents: number;
  status: string;
  scheduledStart: string;
  scheduledEnd: string;
  cage: string | null;
};

export type UpcomingBooking = TodayBooking & {
  dateLabel: string;
};

export type TodayStats = {
  sessionsToday: number;
  revenueToday: number;
  activeMembers: number;
  coachesToday: number;
};

export type TodayAtAGlanceData = {
  stats: TodayStats;
  todayBookings: TodayBooking[];
  upcomingBookings: UpcomingBooking[];
};

export async function getTodayAtAGlanceData(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
): Promise<TodayAtAGlanceData> {
  const now = new Date();
  const todayStart = new Date(now); todayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const todayEnd   = new Date(now); todayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  const next48hEnd = new Date(todayEnd.getTime() + 48 * 3_600_000);

  const BOOKING_SELECT = `
    id, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, cage_number, status, coach_id,
    session_types(name, base_price_cents),
    kids(first_name, last_name),
    coaches(first_name, last_name)
  `;

  const [bookingsTodayRes, upcomingRes, membershipsRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select(BOOKING_SELECT)
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .gte('scheduled_start', todayStart.toISOString())
      .lte('scheduled_start', todayEnd.toISOString())
      .order('scheduled_start'),

    supabase
      .from('bookings')
      .select(BOOKING_SELECT)
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .gt('scheduled_start', todayEnd.toISOString())
      .lte('scheduled_start', next48hEnd.toISOString())
      .order('scheduled_start'),

    supabase
      .from('memberships')
      .select('family_id')
      .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
      .eq('status', 'active'),
  ]);

  type RawBookingRow = {
    id: string;
    scheduled_start: string;
    scheduled_end: string | null;
    cage_number: string | number | null;
    status: string;
    coach_id: string | null;
    session_types: unknown;
    kids: unknown;
    coaches: unknown;
  };

  function mapBooking(b: RawBookingRow): TodayBooking {
    const kid   = b.kids    as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
    const coach = b.coaches as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null } | null;
    const st    = b.session_types as { name: string; base_price_cents: number } | null;
    return {
      id:             b.id,
      kidName:        kid   ? [kid.first_name,   kid.last_name  ].filter(Boolean).join(' ') : 'Unknown',
      coachId:        b.coach_id ?? null,
      coachName:      coach ? [coach.first_name, coach.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') : '—',
      sessionType:    st?.name ?? 'Private',
      basePriceCents: st?.base_price_cents ?? 0,
      status:         b.status,
      scheduledStart: b.scheduled_start,
      scheduledEnd:   b.scheduled_end ?? b.scheduled_start,
      cage:           b.cage_number ? `Cage ${b.cage_number}` : null,
    };
  }

  const todayBookings = ((bookingsTodayRes.data ?? []) as RawBookingRow[]).map(mapBooking);

  const MONTH_LABELS = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const DAY_LABELS   = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
  const tomorrow     = new Date(now); tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1); tomorrow.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const tomorrowEnd  = new Date(tomorrow); tomorrowEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

  const upcomingBookings: UpcomingBooking[] = ((upcomingRes.data ?? []) as RawBookingRow[]).map(b => {
    const booking = mapBooking(b);
    const d = new Date(b.scheduled_start);
    const isTomorrow = d >= tomorrow && d <= tomorrowEnd;
    const dateLabel = isTomorrow
      ? `Tomorrow · ${MONTH_LABELS[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}`
      : `${DAY_LABELS[d.getDay()]} · ${MONTH_LABELS[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}`;
    return { ...booking, dateLabel };
  });

  // Count distinct families (not raw membership rows) to avoid overcounting multi-kid families
  const activeMembers = new Set((membershipsRes.data ?? []).map((m: { family_id: string }) => m.family_id)).size;

  // Revenue = sum of base_price_cents for confirmed + completed bookings today
  // (excludes cancelled/no_show so operators see billable session value)
  const revenueToday = todayBookings
    .filter(b => b.status === 'confirmed' || b.status === 'completed')
    .reduce((s, b) => s + b.basePriceCents, 0) / 100;

  // Count distinct coaches by ID (not name string) to avoid duplicate-name false negatives
  const coachesToday = new Set(todayBookings.map(b => b.coachId).filter(Boolean)).size;

  return {
    stats: {
      sessionsToday: todayBookings.length,
      revenueToday,
      activeMembers,
      coachesToday,
    },
    todayBookings,
    upcomingBookings,
  };
}

// ─── Cancelled Memberships ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type CancelledMembership = {
  id: string;
  kidName: string;
  parentName: string;
  parentEmail: string;
  parentPhone: string | null;
  planName: string;
  planType: 'eft' | 'otc';
  cancelledAt: string;
  cancelledAtLabel: string;
  sessionsUnused: number | null;
  amountCents: number;
};

export async function getCancelledMemberships(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
  since: Date,
): Promise<CancelledMembership[]> {
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, plan_name, plan_type, amount_cents, cancelled_at, sessions_remaining,
      kids!inner(first_name, last_name),
      families!inner(parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email, parent_phone)
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('status', 'cancelled')
    .gte('cancelled_at', since.toISOString())
    .order('cancelled_at', { ascending: false });

  if (error || !data) return [];

  return data.map(r => {
    const kid = r.kids as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null };
    const fam = r.families as unknown as { parent_first_name: string; parent_last_name: string | null; parent_email: string; parent_phone: string | null };
    const d = r.cancelled_at ? new Date(r.cancelled_at) : new Date();
    return {
      id: r.id,
      kidName: [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parentName: [fam.parent_first_name, fam.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parentEmail: fam.parent_email,
      parentPhone: fam.parent_phone ?? null,
      planName: r.plan_name,
      planType: r.plan_type as 'eft' | 'otc',
      cancelledAt: r.cancelled_at ?? '',
      cancelledAtLabel: `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`,
      sessionsUnused: r.plan_type === 'otc' ? (r.sessions_remaining ?? null) : null,
      amountCents: r.amount_cents ?? 0,
    };
  });
}

// ─── Expiring Packs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type ExpiringPack = {
  id: string;
  kidName: string;
  parentName: string;
  parentEmail: string;
  parentPhone: string | null;
  planName: string;
  sessionsRemaining: number | null;
  expiresAt: string;
  expiresAtLabel: string;
  isExpired: boolean;
  daysUntilExpiry: number;
  hasUnusedSessions: boolean;
};

export async function getExpiringPacks(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
): Promise<ExpiringPack[]> {
  const now = new Date();
  const lookback  = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 86_400_000);
  const lookahead = new Date(now.getTime() + 60 * 86_400_000);
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, plan_name, sessions_remaining, expires_at, status,
      kids!inner(first_name, last_name),
      families!inner(parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email, parent_phone)
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('plan_type', 'otc')
    .not('expires_at', 'is', null)
    .gte('expires_at', lookback.toISOString())
    .lte('expires_at', lookahead.toISOString())
    .order('expires_at', { ascending: true });

  if (error || !data) return [];

  return data.map(r => {
    const kid = r.kids as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null };
    const fam = r.families as unknown as { parent_first_name: string; parent_last_name: string | null; parent_email: string; parent_phone: string | null };
    const d = new Date(r.expires_at!);
    const msUntil = d.getTime() - now.getTime();
    const daysUntilExpiry = Math.ceil(msUntil / 86_400_000);
    const sessionsRemaining = r.sessions_remaining ?? null;
    return {
      id: r.id,
      kidName: [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parentName: [fam.parent_first_name, fam.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parentEmail: fam.parent_email,
      parentPhone: fam.parent_phone ?? null,
      planName: r.plan_name,
      sessionsRemaining,
      expiresAt: r.expires_at!,
      expiresAtLabel: `${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`,
      isExpired: daysUntilExpiry < 0,
      daysUntilExpiry,
      hasUnusedSessions: (sessionsRemaining ?? 0) > 0,
    };
  });
}

// ─── Low Balance Packs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type LowBalancePack = {
  id: string;
  kidName: string;
  parentName: string;
  parentEmail: string;
  parentPhone: string | null;
  planName: string;
  sessionsRemaining: number;
  sessionsTotal: number;
  lastSessionDate: string | null;
  lastSessionLabel: string;
};

export async function getLowBalancePacks(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  tenantId: string,
): Promise<LowBalancePack[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('memberships')
    .select(`
      id, plan_name, sessions_remaining, sessions_total, kid_id,
      kids!inner(first_name, last_name),
      families!inner(parent_first_name, parent_last_name, parent_email, parent_phone)
    `)
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('plan_type', 'otc')
    .eq('status', 'active')
    .not('sessions_remaining', 'is', null)
    .not('sessions_total', 'is', null)
    .order('sessions_remaining', { ascending: true });

  if (error || !data) return [];

  const lowBalance = data.filter(r => {
    const rem = r.sessions_remaining ?? 0;
    const tot = r.sessions_total ?? 1;
    const threshold = Math.max(5, Math.floor(tot * 0.2));
    return rem <= threshold;
  });

  if (lowBalance.length === 0) return [];

  const kidIds = lowBalance.map(r => r.kid_id);
  const { data: bookings } = await supabase
    .from('bookings')
    .select('kid_id, scheduled_start')
    .eq('tenant_id', tenantId)
    .eq('status', 'completed')
    .in('kid_id', kidIds)
    .order('scheduled_start', { ascending: false });

  const lastByKid: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const b of (bookings ?? [])) {
    if (!lastByKid[b.kid_id]) lastByKid[b.kid_id] = b.scheduled_start;
  }

  return lowBalance.map(r => {
    const kid = r.kids as unknown as { first_name: string; last_name: string | null };
    const fam = r.families as unknown as { parent_first_name: string; parent_last_name: string | null; parent_email: string; parent_phone: string | null };
    const lastTs = lastByKid[r.kid_id] ?? null;
    return {
      id: r.id,
      kidName: [kid.first_name, kid.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parentName: [fam.parent_first_name, fam.parent_last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
      parentEmail: fam.parent_email,
      parentPhone: fam.parent_phone ?? null,
      planName: r.plan_name,
      sessionsRemaining: r.sessions_remaining ?? 0,
      sessionsTotal: r.sessions_total ?? 0,
      lastSessionDate: lastTs,
      lastSessionLabel: relativeTime(lastTs),
    };
  });
}

import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";

type CookieWrite = { name: string; value: string; options: CookieOptions };

export async function createClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();

  return createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll();
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet: CookieWrite[]) {
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options),
            );
          } catch {
            // Called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set here.
            // The middleware refreshes the session cookie on every request,
            // so missing writes here are harmless.
          }
        },
      },
    },
  );
}


=================================================================================
FILE: portal/lib/supabase/serviceClient.ts
=================================================================================
/**
 * Supabase client that authenticates with the service-role key.
 * Use only in server-side code where you need to bypass RLS
 * (e.g. OAuth callbacks that act on behalf of a user but cannot
 * carry their JWT because no session exists yet).
 *
 * NEVER expose this client to the browser.
 */
import { createClient as _createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

export function createServiceClient() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

  if (!url || !key) {
    throw new Error('NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is not set');
  }

  return _createClient(url, key, {
    auth: { persistSession: false },
  });
}

=================================================================================
FILE: scripts/audit-tenant-isolation.mjs
