#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/import-mindbody-clients.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Imports MindBody "Clients" CSV export into Ballpark families + kids tables.
//
// CSV columns (standard MindBody export + optional parent columns):
//   ClientID, FirstName, LastName, Email, MobilePhone, BirthDate,
//   ParentFirstName (opt), ParentLastName (opt)
//
// Key design:
//   - Groups CSV rows by Email → one family per unique parent email
//   - Emails shared by multiple rows → one family, multiple kids
//   - Auth user UUID = UUID v5(MB_NS, "user:{email}") — deterministic
//   - Kid UUID      = UUID v5(MB_NS, "kid:{clientId}")  — deterministic
//   - Idempotent: auth users created with --legacy-peer-deps, families via
//     ON CONFLICT; kids via ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/import-mindbody-clients.mjs \
//     --input scripts/fixtures/mindbody-clients-sample.csv \
//     [--dry-run] \
//     [--tenant-slug infinitehitting]
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
// =============================================================================

import { createHash, randomBytes } from 'crypto';
import { createReadStream } from 'fs';
import { createInterface } from 'readline';

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_KEY  = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

// UUID v5 namespace for all MindBody import records (arbitrary but fixed).
// Encodes "mindbo" in the last segment for easy identification.
const MB_NS = '00000000-0000-5000-8000-6d696e64626f';

// =============================================================================
// Args
// =============================================================================

const args     = process.argv.slice(2);
const DRY_RUN  = args.includes('--dry-run');
const inputIdx = args.indexOf('--input');
const INPUT    = inputIdx !== -1 ? args[inputIdx + 1] : null;
const slugIdx  = args.indexOf('--tenant-slug');
const TENANT_SLUG = slugIdx !== -1 ? args[slugIdx + 1] : (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG ?? 'infinitehitting');

if (!INPUT) {
  console.error('ERROR: --input <path/to/clients.csv> is required.');
  process.exit(1);
}
if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);
}

// =============================================================================
// UUID v5
// =============================================================================

/** Compute a UUID v5 string from a fixed namespace UUID string and a name. */
function uuidV5(namespace, name) {
  const nsHex   = namespace.replace(/-/g, '');
  const nsBytes = Buffer.from(nsHex, 'hex');
  const nameBytes = Buffer.from(name, 'utf8');
  const hash = createHash('sha1').update(nsBytes).update(nameBytes).digest();
  hash[6] = (hash[6] & 0x0f) | 0x50; // version 5
  hash[8] = (hash[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80; // RFC 4122 variant
  const h = hash.toString('hex');
  return `${h.slice(0,8)}-${h.slice(8,12)}-${h.slice(12,16)}-${h.slice(16,20)}-${h.slice(20,32)}`;
}

function mbKidId(clientId)      { return uuidV5(MB_NS, `kid:${clientId}`); }
function mbAuthUserId(email)    { return uuidV5(MB_NS, `user:${email.toLowerCase().trim()}`); }

// =============================================================================
// CSV parser (no external deps)
// =============================================================================

async function parseCSV(filePath) {
  const rows  = [];
  const rl    = createInterface({ input: createReadStream(filePath), crlfDelay: Infinity });
  let headers = null;

  for await (const line of rl) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed) continue;
    const cols = splitCSVLine(trimmed);
    if (!headers) { headers = cols.map(h => h.trim()); continue; }
    const row = {};
    headers.forEach((h, i) => { row[h] = (cols[i] ?? '').trim(); });
    rows.push(row);
  }
  return rows;
}

function splitCSVLine(line) {
  const result = [];
  let cur = '';
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
    const ch = line[i];
    if (ch === '"') { inQuotes = !inQuotes; continue; }
    if (ch === ',' && !inQuotes) { result.push(cur); cur = ''; continue; }
    cur += ch;
  }
  result.push(cur);
  return result;
}

// =============================================================================
// REST / Admin helpers
// =============================================================================

const baseHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
};

async function restGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

async function restUpsert(table, rows) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      ...baseHeaders,
      Prefer: `return=minimal,resolution=ignore-duplicates`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [rows]),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`UPSERT ${table} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

async function adminRequest(method, path, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/admin/${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: baseHeaders,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json;
  try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { json = text; }
  if (!res.ok && res.status !== 404) {
    throw new Error(`${method} /admin/${path} → ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(json)}`);
  }
  return json;
}

/** Find or create an auth user. Returns the user object.
 *
 * Imported accounts are created with:
 *   - email_confirm=false  — the account cannot be used for login until the
 *     parent completes an invite / password-reset flow.
 *   - A cryptographically random password (never logged, not derivable from
 *     any public input) — effectively unusable until the parent resets it
 *     via the proper onboarding email. This prevents account takeover via
 *     predictable credential generation.
 */
async function ensureAuthUser(id, email, meta) {
  // Check by deterministic ID first (fastest path on re-run).
  const existing = await adminRequest('GET', `users/${id}`);
  if (existing && existing.id) return { user: existing, created: false };

  const user = await adminRequest('POST', 'users', {
    id,
    email,
    password: randomBytes(32).toString('hex'), // cryptographically random — never predictable
    email_confirm: false,                       // account is inert until parent resets password
    user_metadata: meta,
  });
  return { user, created: true };
}

// =============================================================================
// Main
// =============================================================================

console.log(`\n${'='.repeat(65)}`);
console.log('MindBody Clients Import' + (DRY_RUN ? '  [DRY-RUN — no DB writes]' : ''));
console.log('='.repeat(65));
console.log(`Input:       ${INPUT}`);
console.log(`Tenant slug: ${TENANT_SLUG}`);

const rows = await parseCSV(INPUT);
console.log(`\nRows read:   ${rows.length}`);

// ── Group rows by email (lower-cased) ─────────────────────────────────────────
const familyMap = new Map(); // email → { meta, kids[] }
const duplicateClientIds = new Set();

for (const row of rows) {
  const email = (row.Email ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!email) { console.warn(`  WARN: skipping row ${row.ClientID} — no email`); continue; }

  if (!familyMap.has(email)) {
    familyMap.set(email, {
      email,
      phone:     row.MobilePhone  ?? '',
      pFirst:    row.ParentFirstName?.trim() || null,
      pLast:     row.ParentLastName?.trim()  || null,
      fallbackLast: (row.LastName ?? '').trim(),
      kids: [],
    });
  } else {
    duplicateClientIds.add(email);
  }

  familyMap.get(email).kids.push({
    clientId:  row.ClientID,
    firstName: row.FirstName,
    lastName:  row.LastName,
    dob:       row.BirthDate || null,
    kidId:     mbKidId(row.ClientID),
  });
}

const familyCount = familyMap.size;
const kidCount    = rows.length;
const dupeCount   = [...familyMap.values()].filter(f => f.kids.length > 1).length;

// ── Reconciliation report ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('\n─── Reconciliation Report ───────────────────────────────────────────');
console.log(`  Total rows read:           ${rows.length}`);
console.log(`  Unique parent emails:      ${familyCount}  → families to create`);
console.log(`  Total kids:                ${kidCount}  → kids to create`);
console.log(`  Emails with multiple kids: ${dupeCount}  (duplicate parent detection)`);
if (dupeCount > 0) {
  for (const [email, fam] of familyMap.entries()) {
    if (fam.kids.length > 1) {
      console.log(`    ${email}: ${fam.kids.map(k => `${k.firstName} ${k.lastName} (${k.clientId})`).join(', ')}`);
    }
  }
}

if (DRY_RUN) {
  console.log('\n[DRY-RUN] No database writes performed.');
  console.log('='.repeat(65) + '\n');
  process.exit(0);
}

// ── Resolve tenant ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('\n─── Tenant Resolution ───────────────────────────────────────────────');
const tenants = await restGet(`tenants?slug=eq.${TENANT_SLUG}&select=id,name`);
if (!tenants.length) {
  console.error(`ERROR: tenant slug '${TENANT_SLUG}' not found.`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const TENANT_ID = tenants[0].id;
console.log(`  Tenant: ${tenants[0].name} (${TENANT_ID})`);

// ── Create auth users + families + kids ───────────────────────────────────────
console.log('\n─── Importing Families + Kids ───────────────────────────────────────');

let familiesCreated = 0, familiesSkipped = 0, kidsCreated = 0, kidsSkipped = 0;
const errors = [];

for (const [email, fam] of familyMap.entries()) {
  const authId  = mbAuthUserId(email);
  const pFirst  = fam.pFirst  ?? 'Parent';
  const pLast   = fam.pLast   ?? fam.fallbackLast ?? 'Unknown';

  try {
    const { created } = await ensureAuthUser(authId, email, {
      tenant_slug: TENANT_SLUG,
      first_name:  pFirst,
      last_name:   pLast,
      phone:       fam.phone,
    });

    if (created) {
      familiesCreated++;
      // handle_new_user trigger already created the families row.
    } else {
      familiesSkipped++;
    }

    // Insert kids (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for idempotency).
    for (const kid of fam.kids) {
      const kidRow = {
        id:         kid.kidId,
        family_id:  null, // filled below
        first_name: kid.firstName,
        last_name:  kid.lastName,
        date_of_birth: kid.dob || null,
        points_balance: 0,
      };

      // Look up family_id from families table.
      const famRows = await restGet(`families?parent_user_id=eq.${authId}&tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id`);
      if (!famRows.length) {
        errors.push(`Family not found for ${email} (auth id: ${authId}). handle_new_user trigger may have failed.`);
        continue;
      }
      kidRow.family_id = famRows[0].id;

      try {
        await restUpsert('kids', kidRow);
        kidsCreated++;
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.message.includes('409') || err.message.includes('duplicate')) {
          kidsSkipped++;
        } else {
          errors.push(`kid ${kid.clientId} (${kid.firstName}): ${err.message}`);
        }
      }
    }

    process.stdout.write(`  ${created ? '[new]' : '[skip]'} ${email} → ${fam.kids.length} kid(s)\n`);
  } catch (err) {
    errors.push(`family ${email}: ${err.message}`);
    console.error(`  ERROR: ${email}: ${err.message}`);
  }
}

// ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log(`
${'='.repeat(65)}
DONE — MindBody Clients Import
${'='.repeat(65)}
  Families created:  ${familiesCreated}
  Families skipped:  ${familiesSkipped}  (already existed — idempotent)
  Kids created:      ${kidsCreated}
  Kids skipped:      ${kidsSkipped}  (already existed — idempotent)
  Errors:            ${errors.length}
${'='.repeat(65)}
`);

if (errors.length > 0) {
  console.error('Errors encountered:');
  errors.forEach(e => console.error(`  • ${e}`));
  process.exit(1);
}


=================================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/import-mindbody-memberships.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Imports MindBody "Memberships" CSV export into Ballpark memberships table.
//
// CSV columns (standard MindBody export):
//   ClientID, ContractName, StartDate, EndDate, AutoRenew, Status, AutoPayAmount
//
// Mapping rules:
//   - ContractName → Ballpark plan_name + plan_type via mindbody-plan-map.json
//   - Status=Active + AutoRenew=Yes → status='active', plan_type='eft'
//   - Status=Active + AutoRenew=No  → status='active', plan_type='otc'
//   - Status=Cancelled/Expired      → status='cancelled'
//   - AutoPayAmount                 → amount_cents (dollars × 100)
//
// Idempotency: membership ID = UUID v5(MB_NS, "membership:{clientId}:{contractName}:{startDate}")
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/import-mindbody-memberships.mjs \
//     --input scripts/fixtures/mindbody-memberships-sample.csv \
//     [--plan-map scripts/mindbody-plan-map.json] \
//     [--dry-run] \
//     [--tenant-slug infinitehitting]
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
// =============================================================================

import { createHash }   from 'crypto';
import { createReadStream } from 'fs';
import { createInterface }  from 'readline';
import { readFile }         from 'fs/promises';
import { resolve }          from 'path';

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_KEY  = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const MB_NS        = '00000000-0000-5000-8000-6d696e64626f';

// =============================================================================
// Args
// =============================================================================

const args        = process.argv.slice(2);
const DRY_RUN     = args.includes('--dry-run');
const inputIdx    = args.indexOf('--input');
const INPUT       = inputIdx !== -1 ? args[inputIdx + 1] : null;
const planMapIdx  = args.indexOf('--plan-map');
const PLAN_MAP_PATH = planMapIdx !== -1 ? args[planMapIdx + 1]
  : resolve('scripts/mindbody-plan-map.json');
const slugIdx     = args.indexOf('--tenant-slug');
const TENANT_SLUG = slugIdx !== -1 ? args[slugIdx + 1] : (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG ?? 'infinitehitting');

if (!INPUT) { console.error('ERROR: --input <path> is required.'); process.exit(1); }
if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);
}

// =============================================================================
// UUID v5
// =============================================================================

function uuidV5(namespace, name) {
  const nsHex   = namespace.replace(/-/g, '');
  const nsBytes = Buffer.from(nsHex, 'hex');
  const hash = createHash('sha1').update(nsBytes).update(Buffer.from(name, 'utf8')).digest();
  hash[6] = (hash[6] & 0x0f) | 0x50;
  hash[8] = (hash[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  const h = hash.toString('hex');
  return `${h.slice(0,8)}-${h.slice(8,12)}-${h.slice(12,16)}-${h.slice(16,20)}-${h.slice(20,32)}`;
}

function mbKidId(clientId)          { return uuidV5(MB_NS, `kid:${clientId}`); }
function mbMembershipId(clientId, contractName, startDate) {
  return uuidV5(MB_NS, `membership:${clientId}:${contractName}:${startDate}`);
}

// =============================================================================
// CSV parser
// =============================================================================

async function parseCSV(filePath) {
  const rows  = [];
  const rl    = createInterface({ input: createReadStream(filePath), crlfDelay: Infinity });
  let headers = null;
  for await (const line of rl) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed) continue;
    const cols = splitCSVLine(trimmed);
    if (!headers) { headers = cols.map(h => h.trim()); continue; }
    const row = {};
    headers.forEach((h, i) => { row[h] = (cols[i] ?? '').trim(); });
    rows.push(row);
  }
  return rows;
}

function splitCSVLine(line) {
  const result = [];
  let cur = '';
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
    const ch = line[i];
    if (ch === '"') { inQuotes = !inQuotes; continue; }
    if (ch === ',' && !inQuotes) { result.push(cur); cur = ''; continue; }
    cur += ch;
  }
  result.push(cur);
  return result;
}

// =============================================================================
// REST helpers
// =============================================================================

const baseHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
};

async function restGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

async function restInsert(table, rows) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=minimal,resolution=ignore-duplicates' },
    body: JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [rows]),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`INSERT ${table} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// Helpers
// =============================================================================

function parseMoney(str) {
  const n = parseFloat((str ?? '').replace(/[$,]/g, ''));
  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : Math.round(n * 100);
}

function toISODate(str) {
  if (!str) return null;
  const d = new Date(str);
  return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d.toISOString();
}

function mapStatus(row) {
  const status = (row.Status ?? '').toLowerCase();
  if (status === 'active') return 'active';
  if (status === 'cancelled' || status === 'expired') return 'cancelled';
  return 'cancelled';
}

// =============================================================================
// Main
// =============================================================================

console.log(`\n${'='.repeat(65)}`);
console.log('MindBody Memberships Import' + (DRY_RUN ? '  [DRY-RUN]' : ''));
console.log('='.repeat(65));
console.log(`Input:     ${INPUT}`);
console.log(`Plan map:  ${PLAN_MAP_PATH}`);

const planMapRaw = JSON.parse(await readFile(PLAN_MAP_PATH, 'utf8'));
const PLAN_MAP   = planMapRaw;

const rows = await parseCSV(INPUT);
console.log(`Rows read: ${rows.length}`);

// ── Build membership rows ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const report = { mapped: 0, unmapped: 0, active: 0, cancelled: 0 };
const unmappedContracts = new Set();
const membershipRows = [];

for (const row of rows) {
  const contractName = (row.ContractName ?? '').trim();
  const planEntry    = PLAN_MAP[contractName];

  if (!planEntry) {
    unmappedContracts.add(contractName);
    report.unmapped++;
    continue;
  }

  const autoRenew  = (row.AutoRenew ?? '').toLowerCase();
  // AutoRenew=Yes → EFT (recurring autopay). AutoRenew=No → OTC (one-time /
  // non-recurring), regardless of what the plan-map says. This ensures
  // active non-autorenew contracts are never mistakenly marked as eft.
  const planType   = autoRenew === 'yes' ? 'eft' : 'otc';
  const status     = mapStatus(row);
  const amountCents = parseMoney(row.AutoPayAmount);
  const startDate   = toISODate(row.StartDate);
  const endDate     = toISODate(row.EndDate);
  const kidId       = mbKidId(row.ClientID);
  const memId       = mbMembershipId(row.ClientID, contractName, row.StartDate);

  membershipRows.push({
    _clientId: row.ClientID,
    _kidId:    kidId,
    id:        memId,
    plan_name: planEntry.plan_name,
    plan_type: planType,
    status,
    amount_cents: amountCents,
    started_at:   startDate,
    cancelled_at: status === 'cancelled' ? (endDate ?? new Date().toISOString()) : null,
  });

  if (status === 'active') report.active++;
  else report.cancelled++;
  report.mapped++;
}

// ── Dry-run report ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('\n─── Reconciliation Report ───────────────────────────────────────────');
console.log(`  Rows mapped:       ${report.mapped}`);
console.log(`  Rows unmapped:     ${report.unmapped}  (no entry in plan-map.json)`);
console.log(`  → active:          ${report.active}`);
console.log(`  → cancelled:       ${report.cancelled}`);
if (unmappedContracts.size) {
  console.log(`  Unmapped contracts: ${[...unmappedContracts].join(', ')}`);
  console.log(`  Add these to scripts/mindbody-plan-map.json before running live.`);
}

if (DRY_RUN) {
  console.log('\n[DRY-RUN] No database writes performed.');
  console.log('='.repeat(65) + '\n');
  process.exit(0);
}

// ── Resolve tenant ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const tenants = await restGet(`tenants?slug=eq.${TENANT_SLUG}&select=id,name`);
if (!tenants.length) { console.error(`ERROR: tenant slug '${TENANT_SLUG}' not found.`); process.exit(1); }
const TENANT_ID = tenants[0].id;
console.log(`\nTenant: ${tenants[0].name} (${TENANT_ID})`);

// ── Write memberships ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('\n─── Importing Memberships ───────────────────────────────────────────');

let inserted = 0, skipped = 0;
const errors = [];

for (const mem of membershipRows) {
  const { _clientId, _kidId, ...memRow } = mem;

  // Look up family_id and validate kid exists.
  const kidRows = await restGet(`kids?id=eq.${_kidId}&select=id,family_id`);
  if (!kidRows.length) {
    errors.push(`ClientID ${_clientId}: kid not found (id=${_kidId}). Run clients import first.`);
    skipped++;
    continue;
  }

  memRow.tenant_id = TENANT_ID;
  memRow.family_id = kidRows[0].family_id;
  memRow.kid_id    = _kidId;

  try {
    await restInsert('memberships', memRow);
    inserted++;
    console.log(`  [upsert] ${_clientId} → ${memRow.plan_name} (${memRow.status})`);
  } catch (err) {
    errors.push(`ClientID ${_clientId}: ${err.message}`);
    console.error(`  ERROR: ${_clientId}: ${err.message}`);
  }
}

console.log(`
${'='.repeat(65)}
DONE — MindBody Memberships Import
${'='.repeat(65)}
  Inserted / updated: ${inserted}
  Skipped (no kid):   ${skipped}
  Errors:             ${errors.length}
${'='.repeat(65)}
`);

if (errors.length) {
  errors.forEach(e => console.error(`  • ${e}`));
  process.exit(1);
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/import-mindbody-sales.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Imports MindBody "Sales" CSV export into Ballpark payment_events table as
// historical revenue records.
//
// CSV columns (standard MindBody export):
//   ClientID, SaleDate, Description, Quantity, Price, PaymentMethod
//
// Mapping rules:
//   - Price (dollars) × 100 → amount_cents
//   - PaymentMethod: EFT/ACH → 'eft' | Credit Card/Visa/MC/Amex → 'card' | else → 'cash'
//   - payment_events.status = 'paid' (all imported sales are historical successes)
//   - Payment event UUID = UUID v5(MB_NS, "payment:{clientId}:{saleDate}:{description}:{price}")
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/import-mindbody-sales.mjs \

//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
// =============================================================================

if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);

function parseMoney(str) {
  const n = parseFloat((str ?? '').replace(/[$,]/g, ''));
  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : Math.round(n * 100);
}

function mapPaymentMethod(str) {
  const s = (str ?? '').toLowerCase();
  if (s.includes('eft') || s.includes('ach') || s.includes('bank')) return 'eft';
  if (s.includes('card') || s.includes('visa') || s.includes('mc') || s.includes('amex') || s.includes('credit')) return 'card';
  return 'cash';
}

console.log(`\n${'='.repeat(65)}`);
console.log('MindBody Sales Import' + (DRY_RUN ? '  [DRY-RUN]' : ''));

console.log(`Input: ${INPUT}`);

const rows = await parseCSV(INPUT);
console.log(`Rows read: ${rows.length}`);

// ── Analyse ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const totalRevenueCents = rows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + parseMoney(r.Price) * parseInt(r.Quantity || '1', 10), 0);
const methodBreakdown   = {};
for (const row of rows) {
  const method = mapPaymentMethod(row.PaymentMethod);
  methodBreakdown[method] = (methodBreakdown[method] ?? 0) + 1;
}

console.log(`  Total rows:        ${rows.length}`);
console.log(`  Total revenue:     $${(totalRevenueCents / 100).toFixed(2)}`);
console.log(`  By payment method: ${JSON.stringify(methodBreakdown)}`);

if (DRY_RUN) {
  console.log('\n[DRY-RUN] No database writes performed.');
  console.log('='.repeat(65) + '\n');
  process.exit(0);
}

if (!tenants.length) { console.error(`ERROR: tenant slug '${TENANT_SLUG}' not found.`); process.exit(1); }
const TENANT_ID = tenants[0].id;
console.log(`\nTenant: ${tenants[0].name} (${TENANT_ID})`);

// ── Import payment events ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('\n─── Importing Sales → Payment Events ────────────────────────────────');

let inserted = 0, skipped = 0, errCount = 0;
const noKidRows = [];

for (const row of rows) {
  const clientId = row.ClientID;
  const kidId    = mbKidId(clientId);
  const qty      = parseInt(row.Quantity || '1', 10);
  const unitCents = parseMoney(row.Price);
  const totalCents = unitCents * qty;
  const paymentId  = mbPaymentId(clientId, row.SaleDate, row.Description, row.Price);
  const method     = mapPaymentMethod(row.PaymentMethod);

  // Look up family via kid.
  const kidRows = await restGet(`kids?id=eq.${kidId}&select=id,family_id`);
  if (!kidRows.length) {
    noKidRows.push(clientId);
    skipped++;
    continue;
  }
  const familyId = kidRows[0].family_id;

  // Look up membership (best-effort, nullable).
  const memRows = await restGet(
    `memberships?family_id=eq.${familyId}&tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id&limit=1`
  );
  const membershipId = memRows.length ? memRows[0].id : null;

  const createdAt = new Date(`${row.SaleDate}T10:00:00Z`);
  if (isNaN(createdAt.getTime())) {
    console.warn(`  WARN: invalid SaleDate "${row.SaleDate}" for ${clientId}, using now()`);
  }

  const paymentRow = {
    id:             paymentId,
    tenant_id:      TENANT_ID,
    family_id:      familyId,
    membership_id:  membershipId,
    amount_cents:   totalCents,
    status:         'paid',
    payment_method: method,
    created_at:     isNaN(createdAt.getTime()) ? new Date().toISOString() : createdAt.toISOString(),
  };

  try {
    await restInsert('payment_events', paymentRow);
    inserted++;
    console.log(`  [upsert] ${clientId} ${row.SaleDate} "${row.Description}" $${(totalCents / 100).toFixed(2)} (${method})`);
  } catch (err) {
    errCount++;
    console.error(`  ERROR: ${clientId}: ${err.message}`);
  }
}

if (noKidRows.length) {
  console.warn(`\n  WARN: ${noKidRows.length} sales skipped — kid not found:`);
  noKidRows.forEach(id => console.warn(`    ClientID ${id}`));
}

console.log(`
${'='.repeat(65)}
DONE — MindBody Sales Import
${'='.repeat(65)}
  Payment events inserted: ${inserted}
  Skipped (no kid found):  ${skipped}
  Errors:                  ${errCount}
${'='.repeat(65)}
`);

if (errCount > 0) process.exit(1);

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/import-mindbody-visits.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Imports MindBody "Visits" CSV export into Ballpark bookings table as
// historical completed sessions.
//
// CSV columns (standard MindBody export):
//   ClientID, VisitDate, ServiceName, StaffName, LocationName, Status
//
// Mapping rules:
//   - Only rows with Status=Completed are imported.
//   - StaffName matched to coaches by first+last name (case-insensitive).
//     Unmatched staff → optional override map via --coach-map JSON file.
//     Visits with no matched coach are skipped (reported).
//   - ServiceName is matched to session_types by name (partial, case-insensitive).
//     Fallback: first active session_type for the tenant.
//   - booking.status = 'completed', attended_at = VisitDate noon UTC
//   - Booking UUID = UUID v5(MB_NS, "booking:{clientId}:{visitDate}:{serviceName}")
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/import-mindbody-visits.mjs \
//     --input scripts/fixtures/mindbody-visits-sample.csv \
//     [--coach-map scripts/mindbody-coach-map.json] \
//     [--dry-run] \
//     [--tenant-slug infinitehitting]
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
// =============================================================================

import { createHash }      from 'crypto';
import { createReadStream } from 'fs';
import { createInterface }  from 'readline';
import { readFile }         from 'fs/promises';
import { existsSync }       from 'fs';

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_KEY  = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const MB_NS        = '00000000-0000-5000-8000-6d696e64626f';

// =============================================================================
// Args
// =============================================================================

const args          = process.argv.slice(2);
const DRY_RUN       = args.includes('--dry-run');
const inputIdx      = args.indexOf('--input');
const INPUT         = inputIdx !== -1 ? args[inputIdx + 1] : null;
const coachMapIdx   = args.indexOf('--coach-map');
const COACH_MAP_PATH = coachMapIdx !== -1 ? args[coachMapIdx + 1] : null;
const slugIdx       = args.indexOf('--tenant-slug');
const TENANT_SLUG   = slugIdx !== -1 ? args[slugIdx + 1] : (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG ?? 'infinitehitting');

if (!INPUT) { console.error('ERROR: --input <path> is required.'); process.exit(1); }
if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);
}

// =============================================================================
// UUID v5
// =============================================================================

function uuidV5(namespace, name) {
  const nsHex   = namespace.replace(/-/g, '');
  const nsBytes = Buffer.from(nsHex, 'hex');
  const hash = createHash('sha1').update(nsBytes).update(Buffer.from(name, 'utf8')).digest();
  hash[6] = (hash[6] & 0x0f) | 0x50;
  hash[8] = (hash[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  const h = hash.toString('hex');
  return `${h.slice(0,8)}-${h.slice(8,12)}-${h.slice(12,16)}-${h.slice(16,20)}-${h.slice(20,32)}`;
}

function mbKidId(clientId)     { return uuidV5(MB_NS, `kid:${clientId}`); }
function mbBookingId(clientId, visitDate, serviceName) {
  return uuidV5(MB_NS, `booking:${clientId}:${visitDate}:${serviceName}`);
}
function mbSessionId(clientId, visitDate, serviceName) {
  return uuidV5(MB_NS, `session:${clientId}:${visitDate}:${serviceName}`);
}

// =============================================================================
// CSV parser
// =============================================================================

async function parseCSV(filePath) {
  const rows  = [];
  const rl    = createInterface({ input: createReadStream(filePath), crlfDelay: Infinity });
  let headers = null;
  for await (const line of rl) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed) continue;
    const cols = splitCSVLine(trimmed);
    if (!headers) { headers = cols.map(h => h.trim()); continue; }
    const row = {};
    headers.forEach((h, i) => { row[h] = (cols[i] ?? '').trim(); });
    rows.push(row);
  }
  return rows;
}

function splitCSVLine(line) {
  const result = [];
  let cur = '';
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
    const ch = line[i];
    if (ch === '"') { inQuotes = !inQuotes; continue; }
    if (ch === ',' && !inQuotes) { result.push(cur); cur = ''; continue; }
    cur += ch;
  }
  result.push(cur);
  return result;
}

// =============================================================================
// REST helpers
// =============================================================================

const baseHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
};

async function restGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

async function restInsert(table, rows) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=minimal,resolution=ignore-duplicates' },
    body: JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [rows]),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`INSERT ${table} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// Name matching helpers
// =============================================================================

function normalizeName(name) {
  return (name ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z ]/g, '').trim();
}

function matchCoach(staffName, coaches) {
  const target = normalizeName(staffName);
  return coaches.find(c => {
    const full = normalizeName(`${c.first_name} ${c.last_name}`);
    return full === target || full.includes(target) || target.includes(full);
  }) ?? null;
}

function matchSessionType(serviceName, sessionTypes, fallback) {
  const target = normalizeName(serviceName);
  return sessionTypes.find(st => {
    const name = normalizeName(st.name);
    return name === target || name.includes(target) || target.includes(name);
  }) ?? fallback ?? null;
}

// =============================================================================
// Main
// =============================================================================

console.log(`\n${'='.repeat(65)}`);
console.log('MindBody Visits Import' + (DRY_RUN ? '  [DRY-RUN]' : ''));
console.log('='.repeat(65));
console.log(`Input: ${INPUT}`);

// Load optional coach override map: { "Staff Name": "coachId" }
let coachOverrideMap = {};
if (COACH_MAP_PATH && existsSync(COACH_MAP_PATH)) {
  coachOverrideMap = JSON.parse(await readFile(COACH_MAP_PATH, 'utf8'));
  console.log(`Coach override map loaded: ${Object.keys(coachOverrideMap).length} entries`);
}

const rows = await parseCSV(INPUT);
console.log(`Rows read: ${rows.length}`);

const completedRows = rows.filter(r => (r.Status ?? '').toLowerCase() === 'completed');
const skippedStatus = rows.length - completedRows.length;
console.log(`Completed: ${completedRows.length}  |  Skipped (non-completed): ${skippedStatus}`);

// ── Reconciliation report (dry-run can still show stats) ──────────────────────
const staffNames = new Set(completedRows.map(r => r.StaffName));
const services   = new Set(completedRows.map(r => r.ServiceName));
const clientIds  = new Set(completedRows.map(r => r.ClientID));

console.log('\n─── Reconciliation Report ───────────────────────────────────────────');
console.log(`  Completed visits:    ${completedRows.length}`);
console.log(`  Unique clients:      ${clientIds.size}`);
console.log(`  Unique staff names:  ${staffNames.size} → ${[...staffNames].join(', ')}`);
console.log(`  Unique services:     ${services.size} → ${[...services].join(', ')}`);

if (DRY_RUN) {
  console.log('\n[DRY-RUN] No database writes performed.');
  console.log('='.repeat(65) + '\n');
  process.exit(0);
}

// ── Resolve tenant ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const tenants = await restGet(`tenants?slug=eq.${TENANT_SLUG}&select=id,name`);
if (!tenants.length) { console.error(`ERROR: tenant slug '${TENANT_SLUG}' not found.`); process.exit(1); }
const TENANT_ID = tenants[0].id;
console.log(`\nTenant: ${tenants[0].name} (${TENANT_ID})`);

// ── Load coaches + session_types + location ────────────────────────────────────
const coaches      = await restGet(`coaches?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id,first_name,last_name`);
const sessionTypes = await restGet(`session_types?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&is_active=eq.true&select=id,name,type_category,duration_minutes`);
const locations    = await restGet(`locations?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id,name&limit=1`);

if (!locations.length) { console.error('ERROR: no locations found for tenant.'); process.exit(1); }
const LOCATION_ID = locations[0].id;

const fallbackSessionType = sessionTypes[0] ?? null;
console.log(`\nCoaches loaded:       ${coaches.length}`);
console.log(`Session types loaded: ${sessionTypes.length}`);
console.log(`Using location:       ${locations[0].name} (${LOCATION_ID})`);
if (!fallbackSessionType) { console.error('ERROR: no session types found. Cannot create bookings.'); process.exit(1); }

// ── Import bookings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('\n─── Importing Visits → Bookings ─────────────────────────────────────');

let inserted = 0, errCount = 0;
const noCoachRows = [];
const noKidRows   = [];

for (const row of completedRows) {
  const clientId   = row.ClientID;
  const kidId      = mbKidId(clientId);
  const bookingId  = mbBookingId(clientId, row.VisitDate, row.ServiceName);

  // Validate kid exists.
  const kidRows = await restGet(`kids?id=eq.${kidId}&select=id,family_id`);
  if (!kidRows.length) {
    noKidRows.push(clientId);
    continue;
  }

  // Resolve coach.
  let coach = null;
  if (coachOverrideMap[row.StaffName]) {
    coach = { id: coachOverrideMap[row.StaffName] };
  } else {
    coach = matchCoach(row.StaffName, coaches);
  }
  if (!coach) {
    noCoachRows.push(`${clientId} (staff: "${row.StaffName}")`);
    continue;
  }

  // Resolve session type.
  const sessionType = matchSessionType(row.ServiceName, sessionTypes, fallbackSessionType);

  // Build timestamps: visitDate at noon UTC, 1-hour duration.
  const startDt = new Date(`${row.VisitDate}T12:00:00Z`);
  const endDt   = new Date(startDt.getTime() + (sessionType.duration_minutes ?? 60) * 60_000);

  const bookingRow = {
    id:              bookingId,
    tenant_id:       TENANT_ID,
    location_id:     LOCATION_ID,
    kid_id:          kidId,
    coach_id:        coach.id,
    session_type_id: sessionType.id,
    scheduled_start: startDt.toISOString(),
    scheduled_end:   endDt.toISOString(),
    status:          'completed',
    attended_at:     endDt.toISOString(),
    notes:           `Imported from MindBody. Service: ${row.ServiceName}`,
  };

  // Corresponding performance session row (capture_source='manual').
  // Idempotency: unique on (capture_source, capture_session_id) via partial index.
  const sessionId  = mbSessionId(clientId, row.VisitDate, row.ServiceName);
  const sessionRow = {
    id:              sessionId,
    tenant_id:       TENANT_ID,
    kid_id:          kidId,
    capture_source:  'manual',
    capture_session_id: sessionId, // use our deterministic ID as the dedupe key
    started_at:      startDt.toISOString(),
    ended_at:        endDt.toISOString(),
    notes:           `MindBody import: ${row.ServiceName} (${row.StaffName})`,
  };

  try {
    await restInsert('bookings', bookingRow);
    await restInsert('sessions', sessionRow);
    inserted++;
    console.log(`  [upsert] ${clientId} ${row.VisitDate} "${row.ServiceName}" w/ ${row.StaffName}`);
  } catch (err) {
    errCount++;
    console.error(`  ERROR: ${clientId} ${row.VisitDate}: ${err.message}`);
  }
}

if (noKidRows.length) {
  console.warn(`\n  WARN: ${noKidRows.length} visits skipped — kid not found (run clients import first):`);
  noKidRows.forEach(id => console.warn(`    ClientID ${id}`));
}
if (noCoachRows.length) {
  console.warn(`\n  WARN: ${noCoachRows.length} visits skipped — staff not matched to a coach:`);
  noCoachRows.forEach(r => console.warn(`    ${r}`));
  console.warn(`  Tip: create a --coach-map JSON file mapping staff names to coach UUIDs.`);
}

console.log(`
${'='.repeat(65)}
DONE — MindBody Visits Import
${'='.repeat(65)}
  Bookings inserted:        ${inserted}
  Skipped (non-completed):  ${skippedStatus}
  Skipped (no kid found):   ${noKidRows.length}
  Skipped (no coach match): ${noCoachRows.length}
  Errors:                   ${errCount}
${'='.repeat(65)}
`);

if (errCount > 0) process.exit(1);

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/provision-audit-fixtures.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Provisions four dedicated fixture users for the cross-tenant RLS audit
// (task #86, folded-in #85). Idempotent: re-running is a no-op for users
// that already exist; missing kids/families get created on the next pass.
//
//   T1 parent  audit.parent.t1@ballpark.test  (kid auto-attaches to family)
//   T1 coach   audit.coach.t1@ballpark.test
//   T2 parent  audit.parent.t2@ballpark.test
//   T2 coach   audit.coach.t2@ballpark.test
//
// Why dedicated fixtures and not the existing human test accounts?
//   - Human accounts have unknown / rotating passwords.
//   - The audit needs to log in via password and run probes; coupling to
//     real users means every run risks logging real humans out of their
//     sessions and leaking probe rows into their UI.
//   - Dedicated *.ballpark.test addresses make grep + cleanup trivial.
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/provision-audit-fixtures.mjs <password>
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
// =============================================================================

const url = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const password = process.argv[2];

if (!url || !serviceKey) {
  console.error('Missing EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.');
  process.exit(2);
}
if (!password || password.length < 8) {
  console.error('Usage: node scripts/provision-audit-fixtures.mjs <password>');
  console.error('       password must be at least 8 chars.');
  process.exit(2);
}

const adminHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: serviceKey,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
};

const T1 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
const T2 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';

const fixtures = [
  {
    label: 'T1 parent',
    email: 'audit.parent.t1@ballpark.test',
    tenantSlug: 'infinitehitting',
    tenantId: T1,
    role: 'parent',
    metadata: { first_name: 'AuditParent', last_name: 'TenantOne' },
    kid: { first_name: 'AuditKid', last_name: 'TenantOne' },
  },
  {
    label: 'T1 coach',
    email: 'audit.coach.t1@ballpark.test',
    tenantSlug: 'infinitehitting',
    tenantId: T1,
    role: 'coach',
    metadata: { first_name: 'AuditCoach', last_name: 'TenantOne' },
  },
  {
    label: 'T2 parent',
    email: 'audit.parent.t2@ballpark.test',
    tenantSlug: 'test-tenant-two',
    tenantId: T2,
    role: 'parent',
    metadata: { first_name: 'AuditParent', last_name: 'TenantTwo' },
    kid: { first_name: 'AuditKid', last_name: 'TenantTwo' },
  },
  {
    label: 'T2 coach',
    email: 'audit.coach.t2@ballpark.test',
    tenantSlug: 'test-tenant-two',
    tenantId: T2,
    role: 'coach',
    metadata: { first_name: 'AuditCoach', last_name: 'TenantTwo' },
  },
];

async function findUserByEmail(email) {
  // Admin list-users does not support a by-email filter; the `email`
  // query param does a substring match server-side and we still need to
  // disambiguate locally.
  const res = await fetch(
    `${url}/auth/v1/admin/users?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`,
    { headers: adminHeaders },
  );
  const body = await res.json();
  if (res.status >= 400) throw new Error(`list users ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(body)}`);
  return (body?.users || []).find((u) => u.email === email) ?? null;
}

async function createUser(fixture) {
  const userMeta = {
    tenant_slug: fixture.tenantSlug,
    ...fixture.metadata,
  };
  if (fixture.role === 'coach') userMeta.app_role = 'coach';

  const res = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: adminHeaders,
    body: JSON.stringify({
      email: fixture.email,
      password,
      email_confirm: true,
      user_metadata: userMeta,
    }),
  });
  const body = await res.json();
  if (res.status >= 400) throw new Error(`create ${fixture.email} ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(body)}`);
  return body;
}

// Run a parameterised SQL statement via the SQL admin endpoint. We do
// this via the supabase-js service-role client because the auth admin
// REST surface doesn't expose arbitrary SQL.
async function adminSql(sql, args = []) {
  // pg-meta isn't available in hosted Supabase; we route via the REST
  // PostgREST surface for table mutations and a small custom RPC for
  // the SELECT we need. To keep things dependency-light we use plain
  // PostgREST + service-role for the kid upsert: family lookup is a
  // straight SELECT on public.families, kid creation is INSERT on
  // public.kids, both with the service role key bypassing RLS.
  void sql; void args;
  throw new Error('adminSql unused — use rest helpers below.');
}

async function rest(method, path, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/rest/v1${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: {
      ...adminHeaders,
      Prefer: 'return=representation',
    },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json = null;
  try { json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { /* not json */ }
  if (res.status >= 400) {
    throw new Error(`REST ${method} ${path} ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  }
  return json;
}

async function ensureFamily(parentUserId, expectedTenantId) {
  const rows = await rest('GET', `/families?parent_user_id=eq.${parentUserId}&select=id,tenant_id`);
  if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`family not found for parent_user_id=${parentUserId} — handle_new_user trigger may have failed`);
  }
  const fam = rows[0];
  if (fam.tenant_id !== expectedTenantId) {
    throw new Error(`family ${fam.id} has tenant_id=${fam.tenant_id}, expected ${expectedTenantId}`);
  }
  return fam.id;
}

async function ensureKid(familyId, kid) {
  const rows = await rest(
    'GET',
    `/kids?family_id=eq.${familyId}&first_name=eq.${encodeURIComponent(kid.first_name)}&last_name=eq.${encodeURIComponent(kid.last_name)}&select=id`,
  );
  if (rows && rows.length > 0) return rows[0].id;
  const created = await rest('POST', '/kids', {
    family_id: familyId,
    first_name: kid.first_name,
    last_name: kid.last_name,
    age_group: '11U',
    primary_position: 'CF',
  });
  return created[0].id;
}

const results = [];
for (const f of fixtures) {
  let user = await findUserByEmail(f.email);
  if (user) {
    console.log(`[skip] ${f.label}: ${f.email} already exists (user_id=${user.id})`);
  } else {
    console.log(`[new ] ${f.label}: creating ${f.email}`);
    user = await createUser(f);
    console.log(`       user_id=${user.id}`);
  }

  const entry = { label: f.label, email: f.email, userId: user.id, tenantId: f.tenantId };

  if (f.role === 'parent') {
    const familyId = await ensureFamily(user.id, f.tenantId);
    const kidId = await ensureKid(familyId, f.kid);
    entry.familyId = familyId;
    entry.kidId = kidId;
    console.log(`       family_id=${familyId}  kid_id=${kidId}`);
  }

  results.push(entry);
}

console.log('\n=== Fixtures summary (machine-readable JSON below) ===');
console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs
// =============================================================================
// One-shot: admin-create coach.mike@infinitehitting.com with the raw user
// metadata that handle_new_user (v0.4 Step 4.2) needs to route into
// public.coaches. The dashboard "Add user" form does not expose
// raw_user_meta_data, so this script uses the Admin REST API instead.
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs <password>
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
//
// Idempotent-ish: if the email already exists, prints the existing user_id
// and exits 0 without re-inserting (so you can re-run safely).
// =============================================================================

const url = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const email = 'coach.mike@infinitehitting.com';
const password = process.argv[2];

if (!url || !serviceKey) {
  console.error('Missing EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in env.');
  process.exit(2);
}
if (!password) {
  console.error('Usage: node scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs <password>');
  process.exit(2);
}

const adminHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: serviceKey,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
};

// Check existing first.
const list = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`, {
  headers: adminHeaders,
});
const listBody = await list.json();
const existing = (listBody?.users || []).find((u) => u.email === email);
if (existing) {
  console.log(`-> already exists: user_id=${existing.id}`);
  console.log('   (metadata not re-applied; handle_new_user only fires on INSERT.)');
  process.exit(0);
}

console.log(`-> admin create: ${email}`);
const create = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: adminHeaders,
  body: JSON.stringify({
    email,
    password,
    email_confirm: true,
    user_metadata: {
      tenant_slug: 'infinitehitting',
      app_role: 'coach',
      first_name: 'Mike',
      last_name: 'Anderson',
    },
  }),
});
const body = await create.json();
if (create.status >= 400) {
  console.error(`FAIL (${create.status}):`, JSON.stringify(body, null, 2));
  process.exit(1);
}
const newUserId = body.id;
console.log(`PASS: created user_id=${newUserId}`);
console.log('     handle_new_user should have inserted a public.coaches row for this user.');

// Explicitly set capabilities so the column default is validated in practice.
// The column default '{"preset":"instructor"}' applies automatically, but we
// confirm it here to catch any schema drift early.
console.log('-> Confirming capabilities column default on coaches row...');
const { createClient } = await import('@supabase/supabase-js');
const admin = createClient(url, serviceKey, { auth: { persistSession: false } });
const { data: coachRow, error: capErr } = await admin
  .from('coaches')
  .update({ capabilities: { preset: 'instructor' } })
  .eq('user_id', newUserId)
  .select('id, capabilities')
  .single();
if (capErr) {
  console.warn('   Warning: could not confirm capabilities column:', capErr.message);
  console.warn('   (Run the migration supabase/migrations/20260605000000_coach_capabilities.sql first)');
} else {
  console.log(`   OK: coach row ${coachRow.id} → capabilities=${JSON.stringify(coachRow.capabilities)}`);
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/provision-superadmin.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Creates a super-admin account that can access the /hq console.
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/provision-superadmin.mjs <email> <password> <name>
//
// Example:
//   node scripts/provision-superadmin.mjs admin@infinitehitting.com 'S3cret!' 'Alex Smith'
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
//
// Idempotent: if the email already exists, checks for a super_admins row and
// inserts it if missing, then exits 0.
//
// Cleanup: if the auth user was freshly created and the DB upsert fails,
// the script deletes the orphaned auth user before exiting with code 1.
// =============================================================================

const url = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const [email, password, name] = process.argv.slice(2);

if (!url || !serviceKey) {
  console.error('Missing EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in env.');
  process.exit(2);
}
if (!email || !password || !name) {
  console.error('Usage: node scripts/provision-superadmin.mjs <email> <password> <name>');
  process.exit(2);
}

const adminHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: serviceKey,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
};

// ─── Step 1: check for existing user ─────────────────────────────────────────
const listRes = await fetch(
  `${url}/auth/v1/admin/users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`,
  { headers: adminHeaders },
);
const listBody = await listRes.json();
const existing = (listBody?.users ?? []).find((u) => u.email === email);
let userId;
let userWasCreatedByUs = false;

if (existing) {
  console.log(`-> user already exists: user_id=${existing.id}`);
  userId = existing.id;
} else {
  // ─── Step 2: create auth user ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log(`-> creating auth user: ${email}`);
  const createRes = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: adminHeaders,
    body: JSON.stringify({
      email,
      password,
      email_confirm: true,
      user_metadata: {
        app_role: 'super_admin',
        name,
      },
    }),
  });
  const createBody = await createRes.json();
  if (createRes.status >= 400) {
    console.error(`FAIL (${createRes.status}):`, JSON.stringify(createBody, null, 2));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  userId = createBody.id;
  userWasCreatedByUs = true;
  console.log(`-> auth user created: user_id=${userId}`);
}

// ─── Helper: delete an orphaned auth user we just created ────────────────────
async function deleteOrphanedUser(uid) {
  console.error(`-> cleaning up orphaned auth user: user_id=${uid}`);
  const delRes = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users/${uid}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers: adminHeaders,
  });
  if (delRes.status < 400) {
    console.error(`-> orphaned auth user deleted.`);
  } else {
    const delBody = await delRes.text();
    console.error(`-> WARNING: could not delete orphaned user (${delRes.status}): ${delBody}`);
    console.error(`-> Manual cleanup required: DELETE from auth.users WHERE id = '${uid}'`);
  }
}

// ─── Step 3: upsert super_admins row ─────────────────────────────────────────
console.log(`-> upserting super_admins row for user_id=${userId}`);
const upsertRes = await fetch(`${url}/rest/v1/super_admins`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    ...adminHeaders,
    Prefer: 'resolution=merge-duplicates',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    user_id: userId,
    name,
    email,
  }),
});

if (upsertRes.status >= 400) {
  const errBody = await upsertRes.text();
  console.error(`FAIL upsert super_admins (${upsertRes.status}):`, errBody);

  // Clean up orphaned auth user only if we created it in this run.
  if (userWasCreatedByUs) {
    await deleteOrphanedUser(userId);
  }

  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`\nPASS: super-admin provisioned.`);
console.log(`  email:   ${email}`);
console.log(`  user_id: ${userId}`);
console.log(`  name:    ${name}`);
console.log(`\nThe user can now log in at the portal and will be routed to /hq.`);
console.log(`Note: JWTs are cached — the user must sign out and back in if they`);
console.log(`      were previously signed in with a different role.`);

FILE: scripts/reconcile-stripe-migration.mjs
=================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/reconcile-stripe-migration.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Reads Stripe's PAN migration mapping JSON and updates families.stripe_customer_id
// for all migrated members.
//
// Input JSON format (array of objects):
//   [
//     {
//       "old_customer_id": "cus_OLD123",
//       "new_customer_id": "cus_NEW456",
//       "email": "parent@example.com"     ← optional but improves matching
//     },
//     ...
//   ]
//
// Matching strategy (in order):
//   1. Email match: find family by parent_email = row.email (most reliable)
//   2. Old customer ID match: find family by stripe_customer_id = old_customer_id
//   3. If neither matches → skip + report
//
// For each matched family:
//   - Sets families.stripe_customer_id = new_customer_id
//   - Optionally fetches card display info from Stripe API if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/reconcile-stripe-migration.mjs \
//     --input scripts/fixtures/stripe-migration-map.json \
//     [--dry-run] \
//     [--tenant-slug infinitehitting]
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
//
// Optional env (for card info lookup):
//   STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
// =============================================================================

import { readFile }  from 'fs/promises';

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_KEY  = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const STRIPE_KEY   = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY ?? null;

// =============================================================================
// Args
// =============================================================================

const args        = process.argv.slice(2);
const DRY_RUN     = args.includes('--dry-run');
const inputIdx    = args.indexOf('--input');
const INPUT       = inputIdx !== -1 ? args[inputIdx + 1] : null;
const slugIdx     = args.indexOf('--tenant-slug');
const TENANT_SLUG = slugIdx !== -1 ? args[slugIdx + 1] : (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG ?? 'infinitehitting');

if (!INPUT) { console.error('ERROR: --input <path/to/stripe-migration-map.json> is required.'); process.exit(1); }
if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);
}

// =============================================================================
// REST helpers
// =============================================================================

const baseHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
};

async function restGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

async function restPatch(table, filter, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}?${filter}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=minimal' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`PATCH ${table} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// Stripe helper (optional — fetches card display info)
// =============================================================================

/**
 * Fetch a Stripe customer with its default source expanded so card fields
 * are returned as an object (not just an ID string).
 * Falls back gracefully if Stripe key is absent or the customer not found.
 */
async function fetchStripeCustomer(customerId) {
  if (!STRIPE_KEY) return null;
  try {
    const url = `https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers/${customerId}?expand[]=default_source`;
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${STRIPE_KEY}` },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    return await res.json();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Extract card display fields from an expanded Stripe customer object.
 *
 * Stripe returns `default_source` as a string ID unless the resource is
 * expanded with `?expand[]=default_source`.  With expansion, it becomes
 * a Card object with brand / last4 / exp_month / exp_year fields.
 *
 * We also attempt to pull from `invoice_settings.default_payment_method`
 * (PaymentMethod object) which is common on newer Stripe integrations.
 */
function extractCardInfo(stripeCustomer) {
  if (!stripeCustomer) return {};

  // Path 1: expanded default_source (Card object on older integrations).
  const src = stripeCustomer.default_source;
  if (src && typeof src === 'object' && src.object === 'card') {
    return {
      card_brand:     src.brand     ?? null,
      card_last4:     src.last4     ?? null,
      card_exp_month: src.exp_month ?? null,
      card_exp_year:  src.exp_year  ?? null,
    };
  }

  // Path 2: default_payment_method (PaymentMethod object on newer integrations).
  const pm = stripeCustomer.invoice_settings?.default_payment_method;
  if (pm && typeof pm === 'object' && pm.card) {
    return {
      card_brand:     pm.card.brand     ?? null,
      card_last4:     pm.card.last4     ?? null,
      card_exp_month: pm.card.exp_month ?? null,
      card_exp_year:  pm.card.exp_year  ?? null,
    };
  }

  // No card info available (ACH, no default, or unexpanded ID).
  return {};
}

// =============================================================================
// Main
// =============================================================================

console.log(`\n${'='.repeat(65)}`);
console.log('Stripe Migration Reconciliation' + (DRY_RUN ? '  [DRY-RUN]' : ''));
console.log('='.repeat(65));
console.log(`Input:       ${INPUT}`);
console.log(`Tenant slug: ${TENANT_SLUG}`);
console.log(`Stripe API:  ${STRIPE_KEY ? 'enabled (card info will be fetched)' : 'disabled (set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to enable)'}`);

const mapping = JSON.parse(await readFile(INPUT, 'utf8'));
if (!Array.isArray(mapping)) {
  console.error('ERROR: Input JSON must be an array of objects.');
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log(`Entries:     ${mapping.length}`);

// ── Resolve tenant ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const tenants = await restGet(`tenants?slug=eq.${TENANT_SLUG}&select=id,name`);
if (!tenants.length) { console.error(`ERROR: tenant slug '${TENANT_SLUG}' not found.`); process.exit(1); }
const TENANT_ID = tenants[0].id;
console.log(`Tenant:      ${tenants[0].name} (${TENANT_ID})\n`);

// ── Process each mapping entry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('─── Processing Entries ──────────────────────────────────────────────');

let updated = 0, skipped = 0;
const errors   = [];
const warnings = [];
const notFound = [];

for (const entry of mapping) {
  const { old_customer_id, new_customer_id, email } = entry;

  if (!new_customer_id) {
    warnings.push(`Entry missing new_customer_id: ${JSON.stringify(entry)}`);
    skipped++;
    continue;
  }

  let family = null;

  // Strategy 1: match by email.
  if (email) {
    const byEmail = await restGet(
      `families?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&parent_email=eq.${encodeURIComponent(email)}&select=id,parent_email,stripe_customer_id&limit=1`
    );
    if (byEmail.length) family = byEmail[0];
  }

  // Strategy 2: match by old stripe_customer_id.
  if (!family && old_customer_id) {
    const byOldId = await restGet(
      `families?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&stripe_customer_id=eq.${old_customer_id}&select=id,parent_email,stripe_customer_id&limit=1`
    );
    if (byOldId.length) family = byOldId[0];
  }

  if (!family) {
    notFound.push(`old=${old_customer_id ?? 'n/a'}, email=${email ?? 'n/a'}`);
    skipped++;
    continue;
  }

  console.log(`  ${DRY_RUN ? '[dry-run] ' : ''}${family.parent_email ?? family.id}: ${old_customer_id ?? 'n/a'} → ${new_customer_id}`);

  if (DRY_RUN) { updated++; continue; }

  // Fetch card info from Stripe if key is available.
  const stripeCustomer = await fetchStripeCustomer(new_customer_id);
  const cardInfo       = extractCardInfo(stripeCustomer);

  try {
    await restPatch('families', `id=eq.${family.id}`, {
      stripe_customer_id: new_customer_id,
      ...cardInfo,
    });
    updated++;
  } catch (err) {
    errors.push(`family ${family.id}: ${err.message}`);
    console.error(`  ERROR: ${family.id}: ${err.message}`);
  }
}

// ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log(`
${'='.repeat(65)}
DONE — Stripe Migration Reconciliation${DRY_RUN ? ' (DRY-RUN)' : ''}
${'='.repeat(65)}
  Entries processed:   ${mapping.length}
  Families updated:    ${updated}
  Not found / skipped: ${skipped}
  Errors:              ${errors.length}
${'='.repeat(65)}
`);

if (notFound.length) {
  console.warn('Could not match the following entries to a family:');
  notFound.forEach(r => console.warn(`  • ${r}`));
}
if (errors.length) {
  console.error('Errors:');
  errors.forEach(e => console.error(`  • ${e}`));
  process.exit(1);
}


=================================================================================
FILE: scripts/replay-hittrax-fixture.mjs
=================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * scripts/replay-hittrax-fixture.mjs
 *
 * Local-dev tool that mimics what hittrax-poll does on a real GetAvailable-
 * ThirdPartyData response, against the canned fixture in
 * supabase/functions/_shared/fixtures/hittrax-sample.json. Skips the actual
 * HitTrax HTTP call so we can prove the swings -> sessions -> personal_bests
 * -> points_ledger -> push fan-out chain end-to-end before HitTrax keys arrive.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/replay-hittrax-fixture.mjs <kid_id>
 *
 * Requires SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in env (same names the
 * Edge Functions use). Reads the fixture, parses it through the same field-
 * mapping logic, and UPSERTs sessions/swings against the supplied kid.
 *
 * The PR trigger fires on swing INSERT and writes personal_bests +
 * points_ledger automatically — we don't need to replicate that here. The
 * script prints a summary line so the operator can grep for "PR fanout".
 */

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
  console.error('Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in env.');
  process.exit(2);
}

const kidId = process.argv[2];
if (!kidId) {
  console.error('Usage: node scripts/replay-hittrax-fixture.mjs <kid_id>');
  process.exit(2);
}

const FIELD_MAP = {
  event_id: ['SwingID', 'EventID', 'Id', 'id'],
  session_id: ['SessionID', 'session_id'],
  facility_id: ['FacilityID', 'facility_id'],
  occurred_at: ['TimeStamp', 'Timestamp', 'EventTime', 'occurred_at', 'Time'],
  exit_velocity_mph: ['Velo', 'ExitVelocity', 'ExitVelo', 'exit_velocity_mph', 'EV'],
  launch_angle_deg: ['LaunchAngle', 'VertAngle', 'launch_angle_deg', 'LA'],
  distance_ft: ['Distance', 'distance_ft', 'Dist'],
  contact_quality: ['ContactQuality', 'Quality', 'contact_quality'],
  result: ['Result', 'AB', 'result', 'Outcome'],
  pitch_speed_mph: ['PitchSpeed', 'PitchVelo', 'pitch_speed_mph'],
  spray_angle_deg: ['SprayAngle', 'HorzAngle', 'spray_angle_deg'],
};

const pickStr = (o, ks) => {
  for (const k of ks) {
    const v = o[k];
    if (typeof v === 'string' && v.length) return v;
    if (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v)) return String(v);
  }
  return null;
};
const pickNum = (o, ks) => {
  for (const k of ks) {
    const v = o[k];
    if (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v)) return v;
    if (typeof v === 'string' && v.length) {
      const n = Number(v);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;
    }
  }
  return null;
};

const supa = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

async function main() {
  const { data: kid, error: kidErr } = await supa
    .from('kids')
    .select('id, tenant_id, family_id, first_name')
    .eq('id', kidId)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (kidErr || !kid) {
    console.error('kid not found:', kidErr ?? '(no row)');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const fixturePath = join(
    __dirname,
    '..',
    'supabase',
    'functions',
    '_shared',
    'fixtures',
    'hittrax-sample.json',
  );
  const fixture = JSON.parse(await readFile(fixturePath, 'utf8'));
  const rows = Array.isArray(fixture) ? fixture : (fixture.Data ?? fixture.Swings ?? []);
  console.log(`replay: kid=${kid.first_name ?? kid.id} swings_in_fixture=${rows.length}`);

  // Group by session id, UPSERT sessions, then UPSERT swings.
  const groups = new Map();
  const parsed = [];
  for (const raw of rows) {
    const eventId = pickStr(raw, FIELD_MAP.event_id);
    if (!eventId) continue;
    const sid = pickStr(raw, FIELD_MAP.session_id);
    const occurredRaw = pickStr(raw, FIELD_MAP.occurred_at) ?? new Date().toISOString();
    const occurred_at = Number.isNaN(Date.parse(occurredRaw))
      ? new Date().toISOString()
      : new Date(occurredRaw).toISOString();
    const swing = {
      capture_event_id: eventId,
      capture_session_id: sid,
      occurred_at,
      exit_velocity_mph: pickNum(raw, FIELD_MAP.exit_velocity_mph),
      launch_angle_deg: pickNum(raw, FIELD_MAP.launch_angle_deg),
      distance_ft: pickNum(raw, FIELD_MAP.distance_ft),
      contact_quality: pickStr(raw, FIELD_MAP.contact_quality),
      result: pickStr(raw, FIELD_MAP.result),
      pitch_speed_mph: pickNum(raw, FIELD_MAP.pitch_speed_mph),
      spray_angle_deg: pickNum(raw, FIELD_MAP.spray_angle_deg),
      facility_id: pickStr(raw, FIELD_MAP.facility_id),
      raw,
    };
    parsed.push(swing);
    if (sid) {
      if (!groups.has(sid)) groups.set(sid, []);
      groups.get(sid).push(swing);
    }
  }

  const sessionIdMap = new Map();
  for (const [sid, members] of groups.entries()) {
    const startedAt = members.reduce(
      (m, s) => (s.occurred_at < m ? s.occurred_at : m),
      members[0].occurred_at,
    );
    const endedAt = members.reduce(
      (m, s) => (s.occurred_at > m ? s.occurred_at : m),
      members[0].occurred_at,
    );
    const evs = members.map((m) => m.exit_velocity_mph).filter((v) => v != null);
    const dists = members.map((m) => m.distance_ft).filter((v) => v != null);
    const { data: up, error } = await supa
      .from('sessions')
      .upsert(
        {
          tenant_id: kid.tenant_id,
          kid_id: kid.id,
          capture_source: 'hittrax',
          capture_session_id: sid,
          facility_id: members.find((m) => m.facility_id)?.facility_id ?? null,
          started_at: startedAt,
          ended_at: endedAt,
          swing_count: members.length,
          best_exit_velocity_mph: evs.length ? Math.max(...evs) : null,
          avg_exit_velocity_mph: evs.length
            ? Math.round((evs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / evs.length) * 10) / 10
            : null,
          max_distance_ft: dists.length ? Math.max(...dists.map((d) => Math.round(d))) : null,
        },
        { onConflict: 'capture_source,capture_session_id' },
      )
      .select('id')
      .single();
    if (error) {
      console.error('session upsert failed:', error);
      continue;
    }
    sessionIdMap.set(sid, up.id);
    console.log(`session: ${sid} -> ${up.id} swings=${members.length}`);
  }

  let inserted = 0;
  for (const s of parsed) {
    const sessId = s.capture_session_id ? sessionIdMap.get(s.capture_session_id) ?? null : null;
    const { error } = await supa.from('swings').upsert(
      {
        tenant_id: kid.tenant_id,
        kid_id: kid.id,
        session_id: sessId,
        capture_source: 'hittrax',
        capture_event_id: s.capture_event_id,
        occurred_at: s.occurred_at,
        exit_velocity_mph: s.exit_velocity_mph,
        launch_angle_deg: s.launch_angle_deg,
        distance_ft: s.distance_ft != null ? Math.round(s.distance_ft) : null,
        contact_quality: s.contact_quality,
        result: s.result,
        pitch_speed_mph: s.pitch_speed_mph,
        spray_angle_deg: s.spray_angle_deg,
        raw: s.raw,
      },
      { onConflict: 'capture_source,capture_event_id' },
    );
    if (error) {
      console.error(`swing upsert failed event=${s.capture_event_id}:`, error);
      continue;
    }
    inserted++;
  }

  const { data: pbs } = await supa
    .from('personal_bests')
    .select('metric, value, achieved_at')
    .eq('kid_id', kid.id);
  const { data: kidNow } = await supa
    .from('kids')
    .select('points_balance')
    .eq('id', kid.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  console.log(`replay: swings_upserted=${inserted}`);
  console.log(`replay: personal_bests=${JSON.stringify(pbs ?? [])}`);
  console.log(`replay: kid.points_balance=${kidNow?.points_balance}`);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});

#!/usr/bin/env node
// Reproduce the AddKidScreen insert path end-to-end against the real Supabase
// project so we can capture the exact PostgREST error the app would see.
//
// Mirrors useFamily.useAddKid:
//   1. Admin-create a throwaway user (handle_new_user trigger provisions the family).
//   2. Sign in to mint a JWT (so RLS runs as that user).
//   3. SELECT the family row via PostgREST under that JWT.
//   4. INSERT a kid row via PostgREST under that JWT.
//   5. Print the response status + body for each step, then clean up.

const url = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const anon = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const tenantSlug = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG || 'infinitehitting';

if (!url || !anon || !serviceKey) {
  console.error('Missing EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY / SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');
  process.exit(2);
}

const adminHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: serviceKey,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
};

const rand = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);
const email = `addkidrepro_${rand}@hooksmoketest.dev`;
const password = `Test_${rand}_pw!`;
let userId;

async function cleanup() {
  if (!userId) return;
  await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users/${userId}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: adminHeaders });
  console.log(`-> cleanup: deleted ${userId}`);
}

try {
  console.log(`-> admin create user ${email}  tenant_slug=${tenantSlug}`);
  const createRes = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: adminHeaders,
    body: JSON.stringify({
      email,
      password,
      email_confirm: true,
      user_metadata: { tenant_slug: tenantSlug, first_name: 'Repro', last_name: 'Kid' },
    }),
  });
  const createBody = await createRes.json();
  if (createRes.status >= 400) {
    console.error('admin create failed:', createRes.status, JSON.stringify(createBody, null, 2));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  userId = createBody.id || createBody.user?.id;
  console.log(`   user_id=${userId}`);

  console.log('-> signin as that user');
  const signinRes = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', apikey: anon, Authorization: `Bearer ${anon}` },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
  });
  const signinBody = await signinRes.json();
  if (signinRes.status >= 400) {
    console.error('signin failed:', signinRes.status, JSON.stringify(signinBody, null, 2));
    await cleanup();
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const token = signinBody.access_token;
  const claims = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token.split('.')[1], 'base64').toString('utf8'));
  console.log('   JWT custom claims:', JSON.stringify({
    sub: claims.sub, tenant_id: claims.tenant_id, family_id: claims.family_id, app_role: claims.app_role, role: claims.role,
  }, null, 2));

  const userHeaders = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    apikey: anon,
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  };

  console.log('-> SELECT families WHERE parent_user_id = auth.uid() (PostgREST under user JWT)');
  const famRes = await fetch(`${url}/rest/v1/families?parent_user_id=eq.${userId}&select=*`, {
    headers: userHeaders,
  });
  const famBody = await famRes.json();
  console.log(`   status=${famRes.status}`);
  console.log(`   body=${JSON.stringify(famBody, null, 2)}`);
  if (famRes.status >= 400 || !Array.isArray(famBody) || famBody.length !== 1) {
    console.error('FAIL at family lookup. Underlying cause is upstream of the kids insert.');
    await cleanup();
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const familyId = famBody[0].id;

  console.log('-> INSERT kids (matches AddKidScreen payload)');
  const insertRes = await fetch(`${url}/rest/v1/kids`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...userHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      family_id: familyId,
      first_name: 'Reggie',
      last_name: 'Repro',
      age_group: '10U',
      primary_position: 'Shortstop',
    }),
  });
  const insertBody = await insertRes.text();
  console.log(`   status=${insertRes.status}`);
  console.log(`   body=${insertBody}`);
  if (insertRes.status >= 400) {
    console.error('FAIL at kids insert. THIS is the underlying error AddKidScreen was hiding.');
    await cleanup();
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('PASS: kid inserted successfully via the AddKidScreen path.');
} finally {
  await cleanup();
}
