#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/seed-audit-rows.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Seeds one minimum sentinel row per (tenant, table) for every tenant-scoped
// table the cross-tenant audit probes (task #86). Without this seeding the
// audit's SELECT-by-id and UPDATE probes skip when an opposite-tenant row
// doesn't exist, leaving coverage gaps that the architect flagged.
//
// Tables seeded per tenant (T1 = Infinite Hitting, T2 = Test Tenant Two):
//   coach_availability, bookings, videos, coach_messages, assignments,
//   products, orders, points_ledger
//
// Already covered by other seeds / fixtures:
//   tenants, locations, session_types, coaches, families, kids
//
// Idempotent: every row uses a deterministic UUID and is upserted with
// `Prefer: resolution=ignore-duplicates` (Supabase REST honours this for
// PK-conflict NO-OP). Re-running mutates nothing.
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/seed-audit-rows.mjs
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
// =============================================================================

const url = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
if (!url || !serviceKey) {
  console.error('Missing EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.');
  process.exit(2);
}

const adminHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: serviceKey,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
};

async function rest(method, path, body, extraHeaders = {}) {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/rest/v1${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: { ...adminHeaders, ...extraHeaders },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json = null;
  try { json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { /* not json */ }
  if (res.status >= 400) throw new Error(`REST ${method} ${path} ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  return json;
}

async function get(path) {
  return rest('GET', path);
}

// `Prefer: resolution=ignore-duplicates` makes Supabase treat a PK
// collision as a no-op INSERT instead of an error. Combined with
// `return=representation` we always get the row back.
async function upsert(table, row) {
  const headers = {
    Prefer: 'return=representation,resolution=ignore-duplicates',
  };
  const arr = await rest('POST', `/${table}`, [row], headers);
  if (Array.isArray(arr) && arr.length > 0) return arr[0];
  // No row returned (= already existed and ignored). Re-fetch by id.
  const existing = await get(`/${table}?id=eq.${row.id}&select=*`);
  return existing?.[0];
}

const T1 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
const T2 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';

const PARENT_EMAIL = { [T1]: 'audit.parent.t1@ballpark.test', [T2]: 'audit.parent.t2@ballpark.test' };
const COACH_EMAIL  = { [T1]: 'audit.coach.t1@ballpark.test',  [T2]: 'audit.coach.t2@ballpark.test'  };

// Deterministic sentinel UUIDs. Suffix '0a01' = audit row 1 tenant 1, etc.
function id(table, tenantId) {
  // Embed table-shortcode + tenant-suffix for greppability.
  // Note: UUID hex chars only (0-9, a-f). Codes are mnemonics squeezed
  // into that alphabet, not the actual table-name initials.
  const codes = {
    coach_availability: 'ca',
    bookings:           'b0',
    videos:             'fa',
    coach_messages:     'cb',
    assignments:        'a5',
    products:           'fd',
    orders:             '0d',
    points_ledger:      'fb',
  };
  const tenantSuffix = tenantId === T1 ? '0001' : '0002';
  // Format: aaaaaaa{code}-0000-0000-0000-{tenantSuffix}{padding}
  return `aaaaaa${codes[table]}-0000-0000-0000-${tenantSuffix}00000000`.slice(0, 36);
}

async function lookupCoachUserId(tenantId) {
  const rows = await get(`/auth.users?email=eq.${encodeURIComponent(COACH_EMAIL[tenantId])}`);
  // auth.users isn't exposed by PostgREST in the public schema by default;
  // use the admin REST API instead.
  if (!rows) return null;
  return rows?.[0]?.id ?? null;
}

async function lookupAdminUserId(email) {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`, { headers: adminHeaders });
  const body = await res.json();
  if (res.status >= 400) throw new Error(`admin list ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(body)}`);
  const u = (body?.users || []).find((x) => x.email === email);
  return u?.id ?? null;
}

async function ctxFor(tenantId) {
  // Resolve all the FK targets we need for this tenant.
  const parentUserId = await lookupAdminUserId(PARENT_EMAIL[tenantId]);
  const coachUserId  = await lookupAdminUserId(COACH_EMAIL[tenantId]);
  if (!parentUserId || !coachUserId) {
    throw new Error(`fixtures missing for tenant ${tenantId} — run scripts/provision-audit-fixtures.mjs first`);
  }

  const fams = await get(`/families?parent_user_id=eq.${parentUserId}&select=id`);
  const familyId = fams?.[0]?.id;
  if (!familyId) throw new Error(`no family for parent ${parentUserId} in tenant ${tenantId}`);

  const kids = await get(`/kids?family_id=eq.${familyId}&select=id&limit=1`);
  const kidId = kids?.[0]?.id;
  if (!kidId) throw new Error(`no kid for family ${familyId} in tenant ${tenantId}`);

  const coachRows = await get(`/coaches?user_id=eq.${coachUserId}&select=id`);
  const coachId = coachRows?.[0]?.id;
  if (!coachId) throw new Error(`no coach record for user ${coachUserId} in tenant ${tenantId}`);

  const locs = await get(`/locations?tenant_id=eq.${tenantId}&select=id&limit=1`);
  const locationId = locs?.[0]?.id;
  if (!locationId) throw new Error(`no location for tenant ${tenantId}`);

  const sts = await get(`/session_types?tenant_id=eq.${tenantId}&select=id&limit=1`);
  const sessionTypeId = sts?.[0]?.id;
  if (!sessionTypeId) throw new Error(`no session_type for tenant ${tenantId}`);

  return { tenantId, parentUserId, coachUserId, familyId, kidId, coachId, locationId, sessionTypeId };
}

async function seedTenant(ctx) {
  const { tenantId } = ctx;
  console.log(`\n=== Seeding tenant ${tenantId} ===`);
  const out = {};

  // 1. coach_availability ---------------------------------------------------
  out.coach_availability = await upsert('coach_availability', {
    id: id('coach_availability', tenantId),
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    coach_id: ctx.coachId,
    location_id: ctx.locationId,
    day_of_week: 1,
    start_time: '09:00:00',
    end_time: '12:00:00',
    is_recurring: true,
  });
  console.log(`  coach_availability  ${out.coach_availability.id}`);

  // 2. videos ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // mux_asset_id and mux_playback_id are UNIQUE — derive deterministically.
  const muxAssetId    = `audit-asset-${tenantId.slice(-4)}`;
  const muxPlaybackId = `audit-playback-${tenantId.slice(-4)}`;
  out.videos = await upsert('videos', {
    id: id('videos', tenantId),
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    uploaded_by_user_id: ctx.coachUserId,
    mux_asset_id: muxAssetId,
    mux_playback_id: muxPlaybackId,
    duration_seconds: 30,
    status: 'ready',
    title: `Audit sentinel (${tenantId.slice(-4)})`,
    purpose: 'coach_message',
  });
  console.log(`  videos              ${out.videos.id}`);

  // 3. bookings -------------------------------------------------------------
  out.bookings = await upsert('bookings', {
    id: id('bookings', tenantId),
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    location_id: ctx.locationId,
    kid_id: ctx.kidId,
    coach_id: ctx.coachId,
    session_type_id: ctx.sessionTypeId,
    scheduled_start: '2026-12-31T15:00:00Z',
    scheduled_end:   '2026-12-31T16:00:00Z',
    status: 'pending',
    notes: 'audit sentinel',
  });
  console.log(`  bookings            ${out.bookings.id}`);

  // 4. coach_messages -------------------------------------------------------
  out.coach_messages = await upsert('coach_messages', {
    id: id('coach_messages', tenantId),
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    video_id: out.videos.id,
    sender_user_id: ctx.coachUserId,
    recipient_family_id: ctx.familyId,
    recipient_kid_id: ctx.kidId,
    message_text: 'audit sentinel',
  });
  console.log(`  coach_messages      ${out.coach_messages.id}`);

  // 5. assignments ----------------------------------------------------------
  out.assignments = await upsert('assignments', {
    id: id('assignments', tenantId),
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    kid_id: ctx.kidId,
    family_id: ctx.familyId,
    coach_user_id: ctx.coachUserId,
    title: 'Audit sentinel drill',
    point_reward: 25,
    status: 'pending',
  });
  console.log(`  assignments         ${out.assignments.id}`);

  // 6. products -------------------------------------------------------------
  out.products = await upsert('products', {
    id: id('products', tenantId),
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    name: 'Audit Sentinel Reward',
    category: 'gear',
    points_cost: 100,
    is_redeemable: true,
    is_active: true,
  });
  console.log(`  products            ${out.products.id}`);

  // 7. orders ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // redemption_code is UNIQUE; derive from tenant suffix so re-runs don't
  // collide.
  out.orders = await upsert('orders', {
    id: id('orders', tenantId),
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    family_id: ctx.familyId,
    kid_id: ctx.kidId,
    product_id: out.products.id,
    payment_method: 'points',
    amount_paid_points: 100,
    status: 'ordered',
    redemption_code: `AUDT${tenantId.slice(-4)}`,
  });
  console.log(`  orders              ${out.orders.id}`);

  // 8. points_ledger --------------------------------------------------------
  // Use reason='manual_adjustment' + reference_type='manual' to dodge any
  // partial unique indexes (the assignment_completed/redemption uniques key
  // on reference_id which is null here).
  out.points_ledger = await upsert('points_ledger', {
    id: id('points_ledger', tenantId),
    tenant_id: tenantId,
    kid_id: ctx.kidId,
    delta: 1,
    reason: 'manual_adjustment',
    reference_type: 'manual',
    balance_after: 1,
    note: 'audit sentinel',
  });
  console.log(`  points_ledger       ${out.points_ledger.id}`);

  return out;
}

const ctx1 = await ctxFor(T1);
const ctx2 = await ctxFor(T2);
console.log('Resolved fixture context for both tenants.');
console.log('  T1:', { family: ctx1.familyId, kid: ctx1.kidId, coach: ctx1.coachId });
console.log('  T2:', { family: ctx2.familyId, kid: ctx2.kidId, coach: ctx2.coachId });

await seedTenant(ctx1);
await seedTenant(ctx2);

console.log('\n=== Done. All probe target rows present in both tenants. ===');

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/seed-coach-mike-sessions.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Inserts 6 confirmed upcoming bookings for Coach Mike spread across the next
// 15 days, across 3 kids already in the demo data (de00… namespace).
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/seed-coach-mike-sessions.mjs
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
//
// Prerequisite:
//   node scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs   (Coach Mike must exist)
//   node scripts/seed-demo-scenario.mjs     (Marcus + peers must exist)
//
// Idempotent: INSERT uses ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING for future bookings.
// The today booking (days: 0) is always PATCHed after insert so its timestamps
// stay current on every re-run — preventing the "stale today" bug.
//
// Cleanup:
//   node scripts/delete-coach-mike-sessions.mjs
//
// ── UUID NAMESPACE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// All records use the `c0ac` prefix — distinct from de00… and 5eed… namespaces.
//
//   c0ac0006 = bookings  (indices 1–6)
//
// =============================================================================

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_KEY  = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const TENANT_ID    = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
const LOCATION_ID  = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101';

if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);
}

// =============================================================================
// Deterministic UUID helpers
// =============================================================================

function coachSessionId(index) {
  const i = String(index).padStart(12, '0');
  return `c0ac0006-0000-0000-0000-${i}`;
}

// Kids from seed-demo-scenario.mjs (de00… namespace):
function demoId(table, index) {
  const t = String(table).padStart(4, '0');
  const i = String(index).padStart(12, '0');
  return `de00${t}-0000-0000-0000-${i}`;
}

const MARCUS_KID_ID  = demoId(2, 1);  // Marcus Rivera
const JAYLEN_KID_ID  = demoId(2, 2);  // Jaylen Carter
const SOFIA_KID_ID   = demoId(2, 3);  // Sofia Martinez

// =============================================================================
// REST helpers
// =============================================================================

const baseHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
};

async function restGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

async function adminRequest(method, path, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/admin/${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: baseHeaders,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json;
  try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { json = text; }
  if (!res.ok && res.status !== 404) {
    throw new Error(`${method} /admin/${path} → ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(json)}`);
  }
  return json;
}

async function restInsert(table, rows) {
  const body = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [rows];
  if (body.length === 0) return;
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=minimal,resolution=ignore-duplicates' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`INSERT ${table} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

async function restPatch(table, id, patch) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}?id=eq.${id}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=minimal' },
    body: JSON.stringify(patch),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`PATCH ${table}/${id} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// Date helpers
// =============================================================================

function daysFromNowAtUTC(days, utcHour) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
  d.setUTCHours(utcHour, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.toISOString();
}

function addMinutes(isoString, minutes) {
  return new Date(new Date(isoString).getTime() + minutes * 60_000).toISOString();
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/seed-demo-scenario.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Seeds a scripted, CEO-ready demo story centred on Marcus Rivera (age 14).
// Every tab of the mobile app and the operator portal will look alive and
// connected rather than showing randomised test fixtures.
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/seed-demo-scenario.mjs
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
//
// Prerequisite:
//   Coach Mike must be provisioned first:
//     node scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs
//   The script will EXIT with an error if Coach Mike is not found.
//
// Idempotent: every INSERT uses ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING.
// The script also repairs trigger side-effects (see §12) so the final
// DB state is the same every time it is re-run.
//
// Cleanup:
//   node scripts/delete-demo-scenario.mjs
//
// ── UUID NAMESPACE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// All demo records use the `de00` prefix (valid hex, distinct from the
// `5eed` prefix used by seed-portal-demo-data.mjs).
//
// Scheme:  de00{table:04}-0000-0000-0000-{index:012}
//   de000001 = auth users  (family + demo coaches)
//   de000002 = kids
//   de000003 = memberships
//   de000004 = sessions    (HitTrax-style)
//   de000005 = personal_bests
//   de000006 = bookings
//   de000007 = coach_messages
//   de000008 = assignments
//   de000009 = kid_achievements (deterministic rows only)
//   de000010 = points_ledger
//   de000011 = products
//   de000012 = orders
//   de000013 = videos      (placeholder mux rows for coach_msg + drill)
//
// ── TRIGGER SAFETY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Several tables have AFTER INSERT triggers that auto-grant achievements and
// update kids.points_balance. This script is ordered to produce exactly the
// intended final state:
//
//   • points_ledger: ALL entries use reason='manual_adjustment' so the
//     _achievements_after_points_ledger trigger never fires.
//
//   • personal_bests: _achievements_after_personal_bests fires and calls
//     _grant_achievement(kid, 'first_pr'). This is one of the two intended
//     achievements — we let it run.
//
//   • orders: _achievements_after_orders fires and calls
//     _grant_achievement(kid, 'first_reward_redeemed'). We do NOT want this
//     achievement for the demo, so §12 finds and removes it.
//
//   • kid_achievements for first_session_attended: inserted directly with a
//     deterministic ID so no balance side-effect is triggered.
//
//   • coach_messages (video.purpose='coach_message'): trigger checks
//     purpose='parent_to_coach'; ours is 'coach_message' so it returns early.
//
//   • assignments (rating=4, not 5): homework_5_star trigger only fires for
//     rating=5, so no side-effect.
//
//   • Final authoritative patch: kids.points_balance = 847 at the very end.
// =============================================================================

}

// =============================================================================
// REST + Admin helpers
// =============================================================================

const baseHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
};

async function restInsert(table, rows, conflictMode = 'ignore-duplicates') {
  const body = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [rows];
  if (body.length === 0) return;
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: `return=minimal,resolution=${conflictMode}` },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`INSERT ${table} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

async function restGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

async function restDelete(table, filter) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}?${filter}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok && res.status !== 404) throw new Error(`DELETE ${table} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

async function restPatch(table, filter, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}?${filter}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=minimal' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`PATCH ${table} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

async function adminRequest(method, path, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/admin/${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: baseHeaders,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json;
  try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { json = text; }
  if (!res.ok && res.status !== 404) {
    throw new Error(`${method} /admin/${path} → ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(json)}`);
  }
  return json;
}

async function ensureAuthUser(id, email, userMeta, emailConfirm = false) {
  const list = await adminRequest('GET', `users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`);
  const existing = (list?.users || []).find(u => u.email === email);
  if (existing) return { user: existing, created: false };
  const user = await adminRequest('POST', 'users', {
    id,
    email,
    password: `DemoScenario-${id.slice(-8)}-2026!`,
    email_confirm: emailConfirm,
    user_metadata: userMeta,
  });
  return { user, created: true };
}

// =============================================================================
// Date helpers
// =============================================================================

function daysAgo(n) {
  return new Date(Date.now() - n * 86_400_000).toISOString();
}

function todayAtUTC(hour) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setUTCHours(hour, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.toISOString();
}

function nextFridayAt(utcHour) {
  const d = new Date();
  const dayOfWeek = d.getDay();
  const daysUntil = ((5 - dayOfWeek + 7) % 7) || 7;
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + daysUntil);
  d.setUTCHours(utcHour, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.toISOString();
}

function daysAgoAtUTC(n, hour) {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() - n * 86_400_000);
  d.setUTCHours(hour, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.toISOString();
}

function dateInDays(n) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + n);
  return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
}

// tenant_settings has a unique constraint on (tenant_id, key) that is distinct
// from its primary key, so PostgREST's resolution=ignore-duplicates header may
// not suppress the 409. Fall back to PATCH when the row already exists.
try {
  await restInsert('tenant_settings', {
    tenant_id: TENANT_ID,
    key:       'bring_a_friend_points',
    value:     '100',
  });
} catch (e) {
  if (!e.message.includes('409')) throw e;
  await restPatch(
    'tenant_settings',
    `tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&key=eq.bring_a_friend_points`,
    { value: '100' },
  );
}

// =============================================================================
// Step 11c — Points ledger (manual_adjustment only — trigger-safe)
//
// All entries use reason='manual_adjustment'. The trigger only acts on
// session_attended / pr_hit / redemption / assignment_completed → no fire.
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── POINTS LEDGER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

let runningBalance = 0;
let ledgerIdx = 0;
const ledgerRows = [];

function addLedger(delta, note, createdAt) {
  runningBalance += delta;
  ledgerRows.push({
    id:             LEDGER_IDS[ledgerIdx++],
    tenant_id:      TENANT_ID,
    kid_id:         MARCUS_KID_ID,
    delta,
    reason:         'manual_adjustment',
    reference_type: 'manual',
    reference_id:   null,
    balance_after:  runningBalance,
    note,
    created_at:     createdAt,
  });
}

// Session history (6 completed sessions):
[6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1].forEach(w => {
  addLedger(10, `Session completed (${w === 1 ? 'last week' : w + ' weeks ago'})`, daysAgoAtUTC(w * 7, 21));
});

// Completed assignment:
addLedger(25, 'Drill completed: Hip Load & Drive', daysAgo(7));

// Season / hard work top-up:
addLedger(812, 'Season points — hard work all spring', daysAgo(2));

// T-Shirt redemption (recorded in ledger history):
addLedger(-200, 'Redeemed: Infinite Hitting T-Shirt', daysAgo(21));

if (ledgerIdx > LEDGER_IDS.length) {
  throw new Error(`Ledger overflow: used ${ledgerIdx} IDs, have ${LEDGER_IDS.length}`);
}

await restInsert('points_ledger', ledgerRows);
console.log(`  ${ledgerRows.length} ledger entries for Marcus (manual_adjustment — trigger-safe)`);

// Peer leaderboard entries (one per kid):
const peerLedgerRows = PEER_DEFS.map((def, i) => ({
  id: PEER_LEDGER_IDS[i], tenant_id: TENANT_ID, kid_id: PEER_KID_IDS[i],
  delta: def.pts, reason: 'manual_adjustment', reference_type: 'manual', reference_id: null,
  balance_after: def.pts, note: 'Demo scenario: leaderboard seeding', created_at: daysAgo(1),
}));
await restInsert('points_ledger', peerLedgerRows);
console.log(`  ${peerLedgerRows.length} peer ledger entries seeded`);

for (let i = 0; i < PEER_DEFS.length; i++) {
  await restPatch('kids', `id=eq.${PEER_KID_IDS[i]}`, { points_balance: PEER_DEFS[i].pts });
}
console.log('  Peer kids.points_balance updated');

// =============================================================================
// Step 12 — Achievements + Cleanup Pass
//
// a) Grant first_session_attended directly (deterministic ID, no balance effect).
// b) Verify first_pr was granted by the personal_bests trigger; grant directly
//    as a fallback if personal_bests was already in DB before this run (trigger
//    skipped due to ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on personal_bests).
// c) Remove the unwanted first_reward_redeemed achievement (granted by orders
//    trigger) and its points_ledger achievement_bonus entry.
// d) Final authoritative PATCH: kids.points_balance = 847.
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── ACHIEVEMENTS + CLEANUP PASS ──────────────────────────────────────');

// Look up catalog achievement IDs:
const achRows = await restGet(
  `achievements?key=in.(first_session_attended,first_pr,first_reward_redeemed)&select=id,key,name,points_bonus`,
);
const achMap = Object.fromEntries(achRows.map(a => [a.key, a]));

// a) Grant first_session_attended with a deterministic ID (bypasses
//    _grant_achievement → no balance update, no auto-gen ledger entry).
if (achMap.first_session_attended) {
  await restInsert('kid_achievements', {
    id:             FIRST_SESSION_KID_ACH_ID,
    tenant_id:      TENANT_ID,
    kid_id:         MARCUS_KID_ID,
    achievement_id: achMap.first_session_attended.id,
    earned_at:      daysAgo(45),
  });
  console.log(`  Granted (direct): "${achMap.first_session_attended.name}" — deterministic ID`);
} else {
  console.warn('  WARN: first_session_attended not found in catalog — run migrations first');
}

// b) Verify first_pr (should have been granted by personal_bests trigger).
if (achMap.first_pr) {
  const existing = await restGet(
    `kid_achievements?kid_id=eq.${MARCUS_KID_ID}&achievement_id=eq.${achMap.first_pr.id}&select=id`,
  );
  if (existing.length) {
    console.log(`  Confirmed: "${achMap.first_pr.name}" already granted (trigger-granted)`);
  } else {
    // personal_bests row was already in DB from a prior run → trigger skipped.
    // Grant directly as fallback.
    await restInsert('kid_achievements', {
      id:             FIRST_PR_FALLBACK_ID,
      tenant_id:      TENANT_ID,
      kid_id:         MARCUS_KID_ID,
      achievement_id: achMap.first_pr.id,
      earned_at:      todayAtUTC(14),
    });
    console.log(`  Granted (fallback direct): "${achMap.first_pr.name}"`);
  }
}

// c) Remove the unwanted first_reward_redeemed achievement and its ledger entry.
if (achMap.first_reward_redeemed) {
  const unwanted = await restGet(
    `kid_achievements?kid_id=eq.${MARCUS_KID_ID}&achievement_id=eq.${achMap.first_reward_redeemed.id}&select=id`,
  );
  if (unwanted.length) {
    const kaId = unwanted[0].id;
    const deletedLedger = await restDelete(
      'points_ledger',
      `kid_id=eq.${MARCUS_KID_ID}&reason=eq.achievement_bonus&reference_type=eq.achievement&reference_id=eq.${kaId}`,
    );
    await restDelete('kid_achievements', `id=eq.${kaId}`);
    console.log(`  Removed unwanted "First Reward" achievement + ${deletedLedger.length} bonus ledger row`);
  } else {
    console.log('  "First Reward" achievement not present (already removed or order trigger skipped)');
  }
}

// d) Final authoritative balance patch — overrides any trigger-driven changes.
await restPatch('kids', `id=eq.${MARCUS_KID_ID}`, { points_balance: 847 });
console.log('  Final balance patch: Marcus Rivera = 847 pts (rank #3)');

// Verify final state:
const finalAchs = await restGet(
  `kid_achievements?kid_id=eq.${MARCUS_KID_ID}&select=achievement_id`,
);
console.log(`  Marcus achievements: ${finalAchs.length} (expected: 2)`);
if (finalAchs.length !== 2) {
  console.warn(`  WARN: Expected 2 achievements but found ${finalAchs.length}.`);
  console.warn('        Run scripts/delete-demo-scenario.mjs then re-seed to reset.');
}

// =============================================================================
// Done
// =============================================================================

console.log(`

  Past bookings:   6 completed sessions (past 6 weeks)

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/seed-harjinder-work-data.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Seeds dummy Work-tab data for harjinderharry@gmail.com so every sub-tab
// (Swings, Assign, Messages, HW, Drills) shows realistic content.
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/seed-harjinder-work-data.mjs
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
//
// Re-running is a no-op — all inserts use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING or
// ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE on natural idempotency keys.
// =============================================================================

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_KEY  = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const TENANT_ID    = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
const TARGET_EMAIL = 'harjinderharry@gmail.com';

// Public Mux test asset (same one used by training-videos.sql).
const MUX_TEST_PLAYBACK_ID = 'DS00Spx1CV902MCtPj5WknGlR102V5HFkDe';
const MUX_SEED_ASSET_ID    = 'seed-coach-msg-asset-harjinder-001';

if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);
}

const headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
  Prefer: 'return=representation',
};

async function rest(method, path, body) {
  const url = `${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`;
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers,
    body: body != null ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json;
  try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { json = text; }
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(`${method} ${path} → ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(json)}`);
  }
  return json;
}

async function adminGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/admin/${path}`, { headers });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`admin GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${await res.text()}`);
  return res.json();
}

console.log(`\n→ Looking up ${TARGET_EMAIL}...`);
const listBody = await adminGet(`users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(TARGET_EMAIL)}`);
const targetUser = (listBody?.users || []).find((u) => u.email === TARGET_EMAIL);
if (!targetUser) {
  console.error(`ERROR: No auth user found for ${TARGET_EMAIL}. Has this account been created?`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const parentUserId = targetUser.id;

}
const familyId = family.id;
console.log(`   family_id      = ${familyId}`);

const kids = await rest('GET', `kids?family_id=eq.${familyId}&select=id,first_name`);

console.log('\n→ Resolving Coach Mike...');
const coachRows = await rest(
  'GET',
  `coaches?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&is_active=eq.true&first_name=eq.Mike&last_name=eq.Anderson&select=user_id,first_name,last_name`,

if (!coachRows.length) {

  console.log('   (name lookup missed — trying email fallback)');
  const coachEmail = 'coach.mike@infinitehitting.com';
  const coachListBody = await adminGet(`users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(coachEmail)}`);
  const coachAuthUser = (coachListBody?.users || []).find((u) => u.email === coachEmail);
  if (!coachAuthUser) {
    console.error('ERROR: Coach Mike not found by name or email. Run scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs first.');
    process.exit(1);

    'GET',

    process.exit(1);

}

}

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/seed-portal-demo-data.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Seeds realistic demo data for the owner portal so every page (Dashboard,
// Members CRM, Schedule, Coaches, Billing, Failed Payments, Revenue Reports,
// MIA, At-Risk, Points & Rewards) shows populated charts and clickable rows.
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/seed-portal-demo-data.mjs
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
//
// Idempotent: every insert uses ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING so re-running
// is a complete no-op.
//
// Cleanup (removes every seeded record by its deterministic ID):
//   node scripts/delete-portal-seed-data.mjs
//
// ── NOTE ON AUTH USERS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The families table has `parent_user_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES
// auth.users(id)` — a hard FK constraint that cannot be bypassed even by the
// service role. Seeded families therefore need a corresponding auth.users row.
// These accounts are created with email_confirm=false so they are functionally
// inert (no confirmed email, @ballpark.test domain is unreachable, no login
// possible without first completing email confirmation). They exist solely to
// satisfy the FK and are removed precisely by the delete script.
// =============================================================================

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_KEY  = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const TENANT_ID    = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
const LOCATION_ID  = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101';

// Session type IDs (seeded in migrations):
const ST_PRIVATE_60 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000302';
const ST_GROUP      = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000303';
const ST_CAGE       = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000304';

if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);
}

// =============================================================================
// Deterministic UUID map — PORTAL_SEED_ namespace
// Every record inserted by this script has a fixed UUID so the delete script
// can remove it precisely without touching real data.
//
// Scheme:  5eed{table:04}-{segment:04}-0000-0000-{index:012}
//   5eed0001 = coach auth users
//   5eed0002 = family auth users
//   5eed0003 = kids
//   5eed0004 = memberships
//   5eed0005 = payment_events  (second segment = membership index 1-15)
//   5eed0006 = bookings
//   5eed0007 = products
//   5eed0008 = points_ledger   (second segment = kid index 1-15)
//   5eed0009 = orders
// =============================================================================

function seedId(table, idx, seg2 = '0000') {
  return `5eed${String(table).padStart(4, '0')}-${seg2}-0000-0000-${String(idx).padStart(12, '0')}`;
}

// Auth user IDs (specified on create so they're deterministic):
const COACH_USER_IDS  = Array.from({ length: 4  }, (_, i) => seedId(1, i + 1));
const FAMILY_USER_IDS = Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => seedId(2, i + 1));

// Table row IDs:
const KID_IDS         = Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => seedId(3, i + 1));
const MEMBERSHIP_IDS  = Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => seedId(4, i + 1));
const PRODUCT_IDS     = Array.from({ length: 5  }, (_, i) => seedId(7, i + 1));
const ORDER_IDS       = Array.from({ length: 5  }, (_, i) => seedId(9, i + 1));

function paymentEventId(memIdx, monthSeq) {
  return seedId(5, monthSeq, String(memIdx + 1).padStart(4, '0'));
}

function bookingId(n) {
  return seedId(6, n);
}

function ledgerId(kidIdx, n) {
  return seedId(8, n, String(kidIdx + 1).padStart(4, '0'));
}

// =============================================================================
// REST helpers
// =============================================================================

const baseHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
};

async function restInsert(table, rows, conflictMode = 'ignore-duplicates') {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${table}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      ...baseHeaders,
      Prefer: `return=minimal,resolution=${conflictMode}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [rows]),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const t = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`INSERT ${table} → ${res.status}: ${t}`);
  }
}

async function restGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

async function adminRequest(method, path, body) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/admin/${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: baseHeaders,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json;
  try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { json = text; }
  if (!res.ok && res.status !== 404) throw new Error(`${method} /admin/${path} → ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(json)}`);
  return json;
}

async function ensureAuthUser(id, email, userMeta, emailConfirm = false) {
  // Check if user with this email already exists.
  const list = await adminRequest('GET', `users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`);
  const existing = (list?.users || []).find(u => u.email === email);
  if (existing) return { user: existing, created: false };

  const user = await adminRequest('POST', 'users', {
    id,                    // deterministic UUID — Supabase Admin API supports this
    email,
    password: `PortalSeed-${id.slice(-8)}-2026!`,
    email_confirm: emailConfirm,
    user_metadata: userMeta,
  });
  return { user, created: true };
}

// =============================================================================
// Date helpers
// =============================================================================

function daysAgo(n) {
  return new Date(Date.now() - n * 86_400_000).toISOString();
}

function monthsAgoDate(n) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - n);
  d.setDate(1);
  d.setHours(10, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.toISOString();
}

// Build UTC ISO timestamp for today at a given hour.
function todayAtUTC(hour) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setUTCHours(hour, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.toISOString();
}

// UPDATE products SET image_url = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1508344928928-7165b67de128?w=400&q=80' WHERE id = '5eed0007-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
// UPDATE products SET image_url = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1521572163474-6864f9cf17ab?w=400&q=80' WHERE id = '5eed0007-0000-0000-0000-000000000004';
// UPDATE products SET image_url = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1579952363873-27f3bade9f55?w=400&q=80' WHERE id = '5eed0007-0000-0000-0000-000000000005';

// Target points balance per kid (descending for leaderboard visual interest):
const KID_POINTS = [820, 650, 590, 480, 440, 390, 370, 320, 290, 510, 180, 140, 60, 45, 30];

// =============================================================================
// 1. Coach auth users  (trigger creates coaches rows automatically)
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── COACHES ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const coachTableIds = []; // ID from public.coaches (auto-generated by trigger)
for (let i = 0; i < COACH_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const def = COACH_DEFS[i];
  const { user, created } = await ensureAuthUser(
    COACH_USER_IDS[i],
    def.email,
    { tenant_slug: 'infinitehitting', app_role: 'coach', first_name: def.first, last_name: def.last },
    true, // coaches can log in (existing pattern: see provision-coach-mike.mjs)
  );
  console.log(`  ${created ? '[new]' : '[skip]'} ${def.first} ${def.last} (auth id: ${user.id})`);

  // Fetch the coaches row created by handle_new_user trigger.
  const rows = await restGet(`coaches?user_id=eq.${user.id}&tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id`);
  if (!rows.length) {
    console.error(`  ERROR: coaches row not found for ${def.email}. handle_new_user trigger may have failed.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  coachTableIds.push(rows[0].id);
}

// =============================================================================
// 2. Family auth users  (trigger creates families rows automatically)
//    email_confirm=false so these accounts cannot be used to log in.
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── FAMILIES + KIDS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const familyIds = []; // auto-generated family UUIDs from public.families
for (let i = 0; i < FAMILY_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const def = FAMILY_DEFS[i];
  const email = `portal.family.${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}@ballpark.test`;
  const { user, created } = await ensureAuthUser(
    FAMILY_USER_IDS[i],
    email,
    { tenant_slug: 'infinitehitting', first_name: def.pFirst, last_name: def.pLast },
    false, // email_confirm=false — inert account, exists only to satisfy FK
  );
  console.log(`  ${created ? '[new]' : '[skip]'} ${def.pFirst} ${def.pLast} / kid: ${def.kFirst} ${def.kLast}`);

  const famRows = await restGet(`families?parent_user_id=eq.${user.id}&tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id`);
  if (!famRows.length) {
    console.error(`  ERROR: families row not found for ${email}. handle_new_user trigger may have failed.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  familyIds.push(famRows[0].id);

  // Insert kid with deterministic ID.
  await restInsert('kids', {
    id:               KID_IDS[i],
    family_id:        famRows[0].id,
    first_name:       def.kFirst,
    last_name:        def.kLast,
    age_group:        def.age,
    primary_position: def.pos,
    points_balance:   0,
  });
}
console.log(`  Kids: ${KID_IDS.length} rows (idempotent via ON CONFLICT id DO NOTHING)`);

// =============================================================================
// 3. Memberships
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── MEMBERSHIPS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const membershipRows = [];
for (let i = 0; i < FAMILY_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const def = FAMILY_DEFS[i];
  const row = {
    id:                  MEMBERSHIP_IDS[i],
    tenant_id:           TENANT_ID,
    family_id:           familyIds[i],
    kid_id:              KID_IDS[i],
    plan_name:           def.plan,
    plan_type:           def.planType,
    status:              def.status,
    amount_cents:        def.amt,
    started_at:          monthsAgoDate(def.joined),
    billing_anchor_day:  def.anchor ?? null,
    cancelled_at:        def.status === 'cancelled' ? daysAgo(30) : null,
  };
  membershipRows.push(row);
}
await restInsert('memberships', membershipRows);
console.log(`  ${membershipRows.length} memberships (idempotent via ON CONFLICT id DO NOTHING)`);

// =============================================================================
// 4. Payment Events  (12 months per membership — paid + sporadic failed)
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── PAYMENT EVENTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const failedReasons = ['insufficient_funds', 'card_declined', 'expired_card'];
const paymentRows = [];

for (let i = 0; i < FAMILY_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const def   = FAMILY_DEFS[i];
  const monthsToBill = Math.min(def.joined, 12);

  for (let m = monthsToBill; m >= 0; m--) {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - m);
    d.setDate(def.anchor ?? 1);
    d.setHours(10, 0, 0, 0);
    if (d > new Date()) continue;

    // ~15% of EFT events fail (not the current month, not OTC).
    const isFailed = def.planType === 'eft' && m > 0 && ((i * 13 + m) % 7 === 0);

    paymentRows.push({
      id:             paymentEventId(i, monthsToBill - m + 1),
      tenant_id:      TENANT_ID,
      family_id:      familyIds[i],
      membership_id:  MEMBERSHIP_IDS[i],
      amount_cents:   def.amt,
      status:         isFailed ? 'failed' : 'paid',
      payment_method: def.planType === 'eft' ? 'eft' : 'cash',
      error_code:     isFailed ? failedReasons[(i + m) % failedReasons.length] : null,
      created_at:     d.toISOString(),
    });
  }
}

// Insert in a single batch (idempotent via id conflict).
await restInsert('payment_events', paymentRows);
const paidCount   = paymentRows.filter(r => r.status === 'paid').length;
const failedCount = paymentRows.filter(r => r.status === 'failed').length;
console.log(`  ${paidCount} paid + ${failedCount} failed payment events seeded`);

// =============================================================================
// 4b. Look up Coach Mike (separately provisioned, not a seed account)
//     Capture his coaches.id so we can assign him today's bookings.
//     If he hasn't been provisioned yet, we skip gracefully and log a warning.
// =============================================================================

let coachMikeId = null;
{
  const COACH_MIKE_EMAIL = 'coach.mike@infinitehitting.com';
  const list = await adminRequest('GET', `users?filter=${encodeURIComponent(COACH_MIKE_EMAIL)}`);
  const mikeUser = (list?.users || []).find(u => u.email === COACH_MIKE_EMAIL);
  if (mikeUser) {
    const rows = await restGet(`coaches?user_id=eq.${mikeUser.id}&tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id`);
    if (rows.length) {
      coachMikeId = rows[0].id;
      console.log(`\n  Coach Mike found: coaches.id=${coachMikeId} — will seed 5 today's bookings for him`);
    } else {
      console.warn(`\n  WARN: coach.mike@infinitehitting.com auth user exists but no coaches row found.`);
      console.warn('        Run scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs first. Skipping his bookings.');
    }
  } else {
    console.warn(`\n  WARN: coach.mike@infinitehitting.com not provisioned.`);
    console.warn('        Run scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs first. Skipping his bookings.');
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// 5. Bookings
//    20 for today (Schedule cage grid) + 75 historical completed (engagement)
//    + up to 5 for Coach Mike (IDs 96–100) if he has been provisioned.
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── BOOKINGS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const SESSION_TYPES = [ST_PRIVATE_60, ST_GROUP, ST_CAGE, ST_PRIVATE_60];

// Today's bookings: 20 slots across 8 cages and 4 time windows.
const todaySlots = [
  // 14:00 UTC block (8 bookings)
  { hour: 14, cage: '1', kidIdx: 0, coachIdx: 0 },
  { hour: 14, cage: '2', kidIdx: 1, coachIdx: 1 },
  { hour: 14, cage: '3', kidIdx: 2, coachIdx: 2 },
  { hour: 14, cage: '4', kidIdx: 3, coachIdx: 3 },
  { hour: 14, cage: '5', kidIdx: 4, coachIdx: 0 },
  { hour: 14, cage: '6', kidIdx: 5, coachIdx: 1 },
  { hour: 14, cage: '7', kidIdx: 6, coachIdx: 2 },
  { hour: 14, cage: '8', kidIdx: 7, coachIdx: 3 },
  // 15:00 UTC block (6 bookings)
  { hour: 15, cage: '1', kidIdx: 8, coachIdx: 0 },
  { hour: 15, cage: '2', kidIdx: 9, coachIdx: 1 },
  { hour: 15, cage: '3', kidIdx: 0, coachIdx: 2 },
  { hour: 15, cage: '4', kidIdx: 1, coachIdx: 3 },
  { hour: 15, cage: '5', kidIdx: 2, coachIdx: 0 },
  { hour: 15, cage: '6', kidIdx: 3, coachIdx: 1 },
  // 16:00 UTC block (4 bookings — pending)
  { hour: 16, cage: '1', kidIdx: 4, coachIdx: 2 },
  { hour: 16, cage: '2', kidIdx: 5, coachIdx: 3 },
  { hour: 16, cage: '3', kidIdx: 6, coachIdx: 0 },
  { hour: 16, cage: '4', kidIdx: 7, coachIdx: 1 },
  // 17:00 UTC block (2 bookings — pending)
  { hour: 17, cage: '1', kidIdx: 8, coachIdx: 2 },
  { hour: 17, cage: '2', kidIdx: 9, coachIdx: 3 },
];

const bookingRows = [];

// Today's bookings (IDs 1–20):
todaySlots.forEach((slot, idx) => {
  bookingRows.push({
    id:              bookingId(idx + 1),
    tenant_id:       TENANT_ID,
    location_id:     LOCATION_ID,
    kid_id:          KID_IDS[slot.kidIdx],
    coach_id:        coachTableIds[slot.coachIdx],
    session_type_id: SESSION_TYPES[slot.coachIdx % SESSION_TYPES.length],
    scheduled_start: todayAtUTC(slot.hour),
    scheduled_end:   todayAtUTC(slot.hour + 1),
    cage_number:     slot.cage,
    status:          slot.hour < 16 ? 'confirmed' : 'pending',
    attended_at:     null,
  });
});

// Coach Mike's today bookings (IDs 96–100) — only if his account is provisioned.
// Uses a spread of session types and kids from different families; hours chosen
// so they don't collide with the existing 14–17 UTC slots above.
if (coachMikeId) {
  const mikeSlots = [
    { hour:  9, cage: '1', kidIdx:  1, sessionType: ST_PRIVATE_60 },
    { hour: 10, cage: '3', kidIdx:  4, sessionType: ST_GROUP      },
    { hour: 11, cage: '5', kidIdx:  7, sessionType: ST_CAGE       },
    { hour: 13, cage: '2', kidIdx: 10, sessionType: ST_PRIVATE_60 },
    { hour: 16, cage: '6', kidIdx: 13, sessionType: ST_GROUP      },
  ];
  mikeSlots.forEach((slot, i) => {
    bookingRows.push({
      id:              bookingId(96 + i),
      tenant_id:       TENANT_ID,
      location_id:     LOCATION_ID,
      kid_id:          KID_IDS[slot.kidIdx],
      coach_id:        coachMikeId,
      session_type_id: slot.sessionType,
      scheduled_start: todayAtUTC(slot.hour),
      scheduled_end:   todayAtUTC(slot.hour + 1),
      cage_number:     slot.cage,
      status:          slot.hour < 16 ? 'confirmed' : 'pending',
      attended_at:     null,
    });
  });
  console.log(`  + ${mikeSlots.length} today's bookings for Coach Mike (IDs 96–100)`);
}

// Historical completed bookings (IDs 21–95): 5 per kid, spaced 7d apart
// starting from lastSession days ago. These drive engagement scores and MIA.
let histId = 21;
for (let i = 0; i < FAMILY_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const def = FAMILY_DEFS[i];
  for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
    const daysBack = def.lastSession + j * 7;
    const startDate = new Date(Date.now() - daysBack * 86_400_000);
    startDate.setUTCHours(14 + (j % 4), 0, 0, 0);
    const endDate = new Date(startDate.getTime() + 3_600_000);
    bookingRows.push({
      id:              bookingId(histId++),
      tenant_id:       TENANT_ID,
      location_id:     LOCATION_ID,
      kid_id:          KID_IDS[i],
      coach_id:        coachTableIds[(i + j) % coachTableIds.length],
      session_type_id: SESSION_TYPES[j % SESSION_TYPES.length],
      scheduled_start: startDate.toISOString(),
      scheduled_end:   endDate.toISOString(),
      cage_number:     String((j % 8) + 1),
      status:          'completed',
      attended_at:     endDate.toISOString(),
    });
  }
}

await restInsert('bookings', bookingRows);
console.log(`  ${todaySlots.length} today's bookings + ${bookingRows.length - todaySlots.length} historical completed`);

// =============================================================================
// 5b. Tenant settings — bring_a_friend_points
// =============================================================================
// Ensures the operator-configurable Bring-a-Friend bonus is present.
// The migration seeds this row with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, but re-asserting
// here keeps the seed script self-contained for environments where the
// migration was applied before this script was updated.

console.log('\n─── TENANT SETTINGS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────');
try {
  await restInsert('tenant_settings', {
    tenant_id: TENANT_ID,
    key:       'bring_a_friend_points',
    value:     '100',
  });
  console.log('  bring_a_friend_points = 100 (idempotent)');
} catch (e) {
  console.warn(`  WARN: tenant_settings upsert skipped — ${e.message}`);
  console.warn('        (table may not be in schema cache yet; safe to ignore)');
}

// =============================================================================
// 6. Products (5 store items)
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── PRODUCTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const productRows = PRODUCT_DEFS.map((def, i) => ({
  id:              PRODUCT_IDS[i],
  tenant_id:       TENANT_ID,
  name:            def.name,
  category:        def.category,
  points_cost:     def.cost,
  is_redeemable:   true,
  is_purchasable:  false,
  is_active:       true,
  sort_order:      i + 1,
  inventory_count: def.inventory ?? null,
  image_url:       def.image_url,
}));

await restInsert('products', productRows);
console.log(`  ${productRows.length} products seeded`);

// =============================================================================
// 7. Points Ledger + kids.points_balance update
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── POINTS LEDGER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const ledgerRows = [];

for (let i = 0; i < FAMILY_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const target = KID_POINTS[i];
  // Use session_attended for visit credits (universally accepted reason since v0.5).
  // Average ~3 pts/visit gives plausible ledger totals.
  const sessionCredits = Math.floor(target * 0.7 / 3);
  let balance = 0;

  for (let j = 0; j < sessionCredits; j++) {
    balance += 3;
    ledgerRows.push({
      id:             ledgerId(i, j + 1),
      tenant_id:      TENANT_ID,
      kid_id:         KID_IDS[i],
      delta:          3,
      reason:         'session_attended',
      reference_type: 'booking',
      balance_after:  balance,
      note:           'Portal seed: session credit',
      created_at:     daysAgo(sessionCredits - j + 1),
    });
  }

  if (target > balance) {
    const topUp = target - balance;
    balance = target;
    ledgerRows.push({
      id:             ledgerId(i, sessionCredits + 1),
      tenant_id:      TENANT_ID,
      kid_id:         KID_IDS[i],
      delta:          topUp,
      reason:         'manual_adjustment',
      reference_type: 'manual',
      balance_after:  balance,
      note:           'Portal seed: balance adjustment',
      created_at:     daysAgo(1),
    });
  }
}

await restInsert('points_ledger', ledgerRows);
console.log(`  ${ledgerRows.length} ledger entries seeded across ${FAMILY_DEFS.length} kids`);

// Update kids.points_balance to match ledger totals.
for (let i = 0; i < FAMILY_DEFS.length; i++) {
  await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/kids?id=eq.${KID_IDS[i]}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=minimal' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ points_balance: KID_POINTS[i] }),
  });
}
console.log(`  kids.points_balance updated for all ${FAMILY_DEFS.length} kids`);

// =============================================================================
// 8. Orders (sample redemptions for Points & Rewards page)
// =============================================================================

console.log('\n─── ORDERS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const ORDER_DEFS = [
  { kidIdx: 0, productIdx: 0, status: 'fulfilled', code: 'PSDM0001', daysBack: 14 },
  { kidIdx: 1, productIdx: 1, status: 'ordered',   code: 'PSDM0002', daysBack: 3  },
  { kidIdx: 2, productIdx: 2, status: 'ordered',   code: 'PSDM0003', daysBack: 5  },
  { kidIdx: 9, productIdx: 3, status: 'fulfilled', code: 'PSDM0004', daysBack: 21 },
  { kidIdx: 4, productIdx: 4, status: 'ordered',   code: 'PSDM0005', daysBack: 1  },
];

const orderRows = ORDER_DEFS.map((def, i) => {
  const createdAt = daysAgo(def.daysBack);
  return {
    id:                ORDER_IDS[i],
    tenant_id:         TENANT_ID,
    family_id:         familyIds[def.kidIdx],
    kid_id:            KID_IDS[def.kidIdx],
    product_id:        PRODUCT_IDS[def.productIdx],
    payment_method:    'points',
    amount_paid_points: PRODUCT_DEFS[def.productIdx].cost,
    status:            def.status,
    redemption_code:   def.code,
    created_at:        createdAt,
    fulfilled_at:      def.status === 'fulfilled' ? createdAt : null,
  };
});

await restInsert('orders', orderRows);
console.log(`  ${orderRows.length} sample orders seeded`);

// =============================================================================
// Done
// =============================================================================

const mikeBookingCount = coachMikeId ? 5 : 0;
const historicalCount  = bookingRows.length - todaySlots.length - mikeBookingCount;
console.log(`
=============================================================================
DONE — Portal demo data seeded for Infinite Hitting
=============================================================================
  Coaches:         4  (Tyler Brooks, Alexis Kim, Jordan Walsh, Morgan Davis)
  Families + Kids: 15 (10 active, 2 paused, 3 cancelled)
  Memberships:     15 (Private Hitting · Group Classes · Team Training · Cage)
  Payment Events:  ${paidCount} paid + ${failedCount} failed (12-month history)
  Bookings:        ${todaySlots.length} today (4 coaches) + ${mikeBookingCount} today (Coach Mike) + ${historicalCount} historical
  Products:        5 store items
  Points Ledger:   ${ledgerRows.length} entries
  Orders:          5 sample redemptions
${coachMikeId
  ? '  Coach Mike:      5 bookings seeded (IDs 96–100) — "My Sessions Today" is now populated.'
  : '  Coach Mike:      NOT provisioned — run scripts/provision-coach-mike.mjs to enable his bookings.'}

  All records use deterministic UUIDs (5eed…).
  Cleanup: node scripts/delete-portal-seed-data.mjs
=============================================================================
`);

#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/setup-cron-guc.mjs
// =============================================================================
// One-time setup: writes app.settings.supabase_url and
// app.settings.service_role_key as Postgres GUCs so that pg_cron jobs
// (cancellation + pause/resume) can call edge functions via pg_net.
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/setup-cron-guc.mjs [--dry-run]
//
// Required env vars:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL   — e.g. https://exjcwvvglthnxerzpukw.supabase.co
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY  — from Supabase dashboard → Settings → API
//   SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN      — personal access token for the Management API
//
// What it does:
//   1. Calls the Supabase Management API /database/query endpoint to:
//        ALTER DATABASE postgres SET app.settings.supabase_url  = '<url>';
//        ALTER DATABASE postgres SET app.settings.service_role_key = '<key>';
//        SELECT pg_reload_conf();
//   2. Verifies the GUCs are readable.
//   3. Verifies both cron jobs appear in cron.job.
//
// Idempotent: safe to re-run. ALTER DATABASE SET is idempotent.
// =============================================================================

import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';

const DRY_RUN = process.argv.includes('--dry-run');

const SUPABASE_URL     = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const ACCESS_TOKEN     = process.env.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN;

// Derive project ref from URL: https://<ref>.supabase.co
const PROJECT_REF = SUPABASE_URL
  ? new URL(SUPABASE_URL).hostname.split('.')[0]
  : null;

function requireEnv(name, value) {
  if (!value) {
    console.error(`ERROR: ${name} is not set.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

requireEnv('EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL', SUPABASE_URL);
requireEnv('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY', SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);
requireEnv('SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN', ACCESS_TOKEN);

const MGMT_BASE = 'https://api.supabase.com';

async function dbQuery(sql) {
  const res = await fetch(`${MGMT_BASE}/v1/projects/${PROJECT_REF}/database/query`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ query: sql }),
  });

  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) {
    const parsed = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return null; } })();
    // ALTER DATABASE requires superuser — the Management API runs as a restricted user.
    // If we hit a permission error, emit clear guidance and exit.
    if (res.status === 400 && text.includes('permission denied to set parameter')) {
      console.error('\n✗ The Management API cannot set database GUCs (requires superuser).');
      console.error('\nRun the following SQL manually in the Supabase SQL editor:');
      console.error('  https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/' + PROJECT_REF + '/sql/new\n');
      console.error(`  ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.settings.supabase_url"     = '${SUPABASE_URL}';`);
      console.error(`  ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.settings.service_role_key" = '<your-service-role-key>';`);
      console.error(`  SELECT pg_reload_conf();\n`);
      process.exit(1);
    }
    throw new Error(`Management API error ${res.status}: ${parsed?.message ?? text}`);
  }
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return text;
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log(`Project ref: ${PROJECT_REF}`);
  console.log(`Supabase URL: ${SUPABASE_URL}`);
  console.log(DRY_RUN ? '[DRY RUN — no changes will be made]' : '');

  // ── Step 1: Set GUCs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const setGucSql = `
    ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.settings.supabase_url"      = '${SUPABASE_URL}';
    ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.settings.service_role_key"  = '${SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}';
    SELECT pg_reload_conf();
  `;

  // Redacted version for display — never print the actual key
  const setGucSqlRedacted = `
    ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.settings.supabase_url"      = '${SUPABASE_URL}';
    ALTER DATABASE postgres SET "app.settings.service_role_key"  = '<SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY>';
    SELECT pg_reload_conf();
  `;

  if (DRY_RUN) {
    console.log('\n[DRY RUN] Would execute:');
    console.log(setGucSqlRedacted);
  } else {
    console.log('\nStep 1: Setting GUCs...');
    await dbQuery(setGucSql);
    console.log('  ✓ GUCs set and pg_reload_conf() called');
  }

  // ── Step 2: Verify GUCs are readable ─────────────────────────────────────
  if (!DRY_RUN) {
    console.log('\nStep 2: Verifying GUCs...');
    const rows = await dbQuery(`
      SELECT
        current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url', true)     AS url_set,
        current_setting('app.settings.service_role_key', true) AS key_set;
    `);
    const row = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows[0] : rows;
    if (row?.url_set && row?.key_set) {
      console.log(`  ✓ app.settings.supabase_url is set`);
      console.log(`  ✓ app.settings.service_role_key is set`);
    } else {
      console.error('  ✗ GUCs do not appear to be readable after setting. Check DB access.');
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }

  // ── Step 3: Verify cron jobs are registered ───────────────────────────────
  if (!DRY_RUN) {
    console.log('\nStep 3: Checking cron job registrations...');
    const cronRows = await dbQuery(`
      SELECT jobname, schedule, active
        FROM cron.job
       WHERE jobname IN (
         'process-membership-cancellations-daily',
         'resume-paused-memberships-daily'
       )
       ORDER BY jobname;
    `);

    const jobs = Array.isArray(cronRows) ? cronRows : [];
    const expected = [
      'process-membership-cancellations-daily',
      'resume-paused-memberships-daily',
    ];

    for (const name of expected) {
      const found = jobs.find(j => j.jobname === name);
      if (found) {
        console.log(`  ✓ ${name} — schedule: ${found.schedule}, active: ${found.active}`);
      } else {
        console.warn(`  ✗ ${name} not found in cron.job`);
        console.warn('    Run: npx supabase db push to apply the latest migrations, then re-run this script.');
      }
    }
  }

  console.log('\nDone.');
  if (DRY_RUN) {
    console.log('Re-run without --dry-run to apply changes.');
  }
}

main().catch(err => {
  console.error('Fatal:', err.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

#!/usr/bin/env node
// scripts/_smoke-122.mjs — read-only smoke probe for task #122.
// Verifies the achievements/fulfillment migration objects exist and behave
// correctly on the target Supabase. SAFE: every call is either a head-count
// SELECT, an RPC with a deliberately-bogus argument expected to error, or a
// type-only probe — nothing is INSERTed or modified.

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import WebSocket from 'ws';

const url = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
if (!url || !serviceKey) {
  console.error('Missing EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');
  process.exit(1);
}
const NO_REALTIME = { realtime: { transport: WebSocket } };
const sb = createClient(url, serviceKey, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
  ...NO_REALTIME,
});

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n, d) => { pass++; console.log(`✅ ${n}${d ? ` — ${d}` : ''}`); };
const bad = (n, d) => { fail++; console.log(`❌ ${n}${d ? ` — ${d}` : ''}`); };

async function run(name, fn) { try { await fn(name); } catch (e) { bad(name, e.message); } }

await run('A1 achievements catalog seeded (≥12 rows)', async (n) => {
  const { count, error } = await sb.from('achievements').select('*', { head: true, count: 'exact' });
  if (error) throw error;
  if (count >= 12) ok(n, `${count} rows`);
  else bad(n, `expected ≥12, got ${count}`);
});

await run('A1 kid_achievements table reachable', async (n) => {
  const { error } = await sb.from('kid_achievements').select('id').limit(1);
  if (error) throw error; ok(n);
});

await run('A1 notification_log table reachable', async (n) => {
  const { error } = await sb.from('notification_log').select('id').limit(1);
  if (error) throw error; ok(n);
});

await run('A1 orders.fulfilled_by_user_id column exists', async (n) => {
  const { error } = await sb.from('orders').select('id,fulfilled_by_user_id,fulfilled_at').limit(1);
  if (error) throw error; ok(n);
});

await run('A6 mark_redemption_fulfilled gates on auth (no JWT → 28000/42501)', async (n) => {
  // Service role calls have no auth.uid()/JWT claims — function MUST refuse.
  const { error } = await sb.rpc('mark_redemption_fulfilled', { p_code: 'ZZZZZZZZ' });
  if (!error) bad(n, 'expected auth gate, got success');
  else if (['28000','42501','P0001'].includes(error.code) || /authenticated|admin|tenant/i.test(error.message)) {
    ok(n, `${error.code} ${error.message.slice(0,60)}`);
  } else bad(n, `unexpected: ${error.code} ${error.message}`);
});

await run('A11 get_kid_weekly_rank_delta gates on auth', async (n) => {
  const { data, error } = await sb.rpc('get_kid_weekly_rank_delta', { p_kid_id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' });
  if (error && ['28000','42501'].includes(error.code)) ok(n, `${error.code} ${error.message.slice(0,60)}`);
  else if (!error && data === null) ok(n, 'null as expected');
  else if (!error) ok(n, `returned ${JSON.stringify(data)}`);
  else bad(n, `unexpected: ${error.code} ${error.message}`);
});

  // We expect this to error because non-existent kid_id; but the function MUST be reachable.
  const { error } = await sb.rpc('_grant_achievement', {
    p_kid_id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    p_key: 'first_swing',
  });
  // Function exists if error is NOT "function ... does not exist" (42883)
  if (error && error.code === '42883') bad(n, 'function not deployed');
  else if (error && error.code === 'PGRST202') bad(n, 'PostgREST cannot find function — check schema cache');
  else ok(n, error ? `reachable (returned ${error.code})` : 'reachable, returned successfully (no-op on missing kid)');
});

await run('A1 points_ledger CHECK includes achievement_bonus', async (n) => {

  // Simplest: attempt a service-role insert that should be rejected on missing FK rather than CHECK.
  const fakeKid = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
  const fakeTenant = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
  const { error } = await sb.from('points_ledger').insert({
    tenant_id: fakeTenant, kid_id: fakeKid, points: 25,
    reason: 'achievement_bonus', reference_type: 'achievement',
    reference_id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

  else if (/check constraint/i.test(error.message) && /reason|reference_type/i.test(error.message)) {
    bad(n, `CHECK rejected achievement_bonus/achievement: ${error.message}`);
  } else {
    // FK violation, NOT NULL on idempotent uniq, etc — means CHECK passed. Good.
    ok(n, `CHECK passed (rejected on ${error.code}: ${error.message.slice(0,60)})`);
  }
});

    method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },

FILE: scripts/validate-mindbody-import.mjs
