#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/validate-mindbody-import.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Post-run validation for MindBody imports. Queries the database to verify
// data integrity and prints a PASS/FAIL summary.
//
// Checks performed:
//   1. Row counts per table (families, kids, memberships, bookings, payment_events)
//   2. Families without any kids (warning)
//   3. Memberships without matching families (error)
//   4. Memberships with invalid status (error)
//   5. Completed bookings without attended_at (error)
//   6. Payment events with zero amount (warning)
//   7. Kids without a family (error — should never happen due to FK)
//   8. MindBody-imported rows specifically (identified by UUID v5 namespace)
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/validate-mindbody-import.mjs \
//     [--tenant-slug infinitehitting]
//
// Required env:
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
// =============================================================================

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE_KEY  = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

const args        = process.argv.slice(2);
const slugIdx     = args.indexOf('--tenant-slug');
const TENANT_SLUG = slugIdx !== -1 ? args[slugIdx + 1] : (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG ?? 'infinitehitting');

if (!SUPABASE_URL || !SERVICE_KEY) {
  console.error('ERROR: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be set.');
  process.exit(2);
}

// =============================================================================
// REST helpers
// =============================================================================

const baseHeaders = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: SERVICE_KEY,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${SERVICE_KEY}`,
};

async function restGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'return=representation' },
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} → ${res.status}: ${text}`);
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; }
}

// Fetch count using HEAD + Content-Range.
async function restCount(path) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    method: 'HEAD',
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, Prefer: 'count=exact' },
  });
  if (!res.ok) return 0;
  const range = res.headers.get('content-range') ?? '';
  const match = range.match(/\/(\d+)$/);
  return match ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 0;
}

// =============================================================================
// Checks
// =============================================================================

const errors   = [];
const warnings = [];

function pass(label, detail = '') {
  console.log(`  ✓  ${label}${detail ? `  (${detail})` : ''}`);
}

function fail(label, detail = '') {
  console.log(`  ✗  ${label}${detail ? `  — ${detail}` : ''}`);
  errors.push(`${label}${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ''}`);
}

function warn(label, detail = '') {
  console.log(`  ⚠  ${label}${detail ? `  — ${detail}` : ''}`);
  warnings.push(`${label}${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ''}`);
}

// =============================================================================
// Main
// =============================================================================

console.log(`\n${'='.repeat(65)}`);
console.log('MindBody Import Validation');
console.log('='.repeat(65));

// ── Resolve tenant ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const tenants = await restGet(`tenants?slug=eq.${TENANT_SLUG}&select=id,name`);
if (!tenants.length) {
  console.error(`ERROR: tenant slug '${TENANT_SLUG}' not found.`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const TENANT_ID = tenants[0].id;
console.log(`Tenant: ${tenants[0].name} (${TENANT_ID})\n`);

// ── 1. Row counts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('─── Row Counts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

const familyCount  = await restCount(`families?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}`);
const memCount     = await restCount(`memberships?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}`);
const bookingCount = await restCount(`bookings?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}`);
const paymentCount = await restCount(`payment_events?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}`);

// Kids count via families lookup (PostgREST doesn't support subquery in count filter easily).
const allFamilies  = await restGet(`families?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id`);
const familyIds    = allFamilies.map(f => f.id);

let kidsTotal = 0;
if (familyIds.length > 0) {
  // Batch in chunks of 50 to avoid URL length limits.
  const chunkSize = 50;
  for (let i = 0; i < familyIds.length; i += chunkSize) {
    const chunk = familyIds.slice(i, i + chunkSize).join(',');
    const c = await restCount(`kids?family_id=in.(${chunk})`);
    kidsTotal += c;
  }
}

console.log(`  families:       ${familyCount}`);
console.log(`  kids:           ${kidsTotal}`);
console.log(`  memberships:    ${memCount}`);
console.log(`  bookings:       ${bookingCount}`);
console.log(`  payment_events: ${paymentCount}`);

if (familyCount === 0) {
  warn('No families found — import may not have run yet');
}

// ── 2. Kids per family ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
console.log('\n─── Data Integrity Checks ───────────────────────────────────────────');

if (familyIds.length > 0) {
  let familiesWithoutKids = 0;
  const CHUNK = 50;
  for (let i = 0; i < familyIds.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const chunk = familyIds.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    for (const fid of chunk) {
      const c = await restCount(`kids?family_id=eq.${fid}`);
      if (c === 0) familiesWithoutKids++;
    }
  }
  if (familiesWithoutKids > 0) {
    warn(`${familiesWithoutKids} families have no kids`, 'may be expected for parent-only accounts');
  } else {
    pass('All families have at least one kid');
  }
}

// ── 3. Memberships with valid status ──────────────────────────────────────────
if (memCount > 0) {
  const invalidMems = await restGet(
    `memberships?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&status=not.in.(active,paused,cancelled)&select=id,status&limit=10`
  );
  if (invalidMems.length > 0) {
    fail('Memberships with invalid status', `${invalidMems.length} rows`);
  } else {
    pass('All memberships have valid status');
  }

  const activeMems = await restCount(`memberships?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&status=eq.active`);
  const cancelledMems = await restCount(`memberships?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&status=eq.cancelled`);
  pass(`Membership status breakdown`, `active=${activeMems}, cancelled=${cancelledMems}`);
}

// ── 4. Completed bookings have attended_at ────────────────────────────────────
if (bookingCount > 0) {
  const completedMissingAttended = await restGet(
    `bookings?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&status=eq.completed&attended_at=is.null&select=id&limit=10`
  );
  if (completedMissingAttended.length > 0) {
    fail('Completed bookings missing attended_at', `${completedMissingAttended.length} rows`);
  } else {
    pass('All completed bookings have attended_at');
  }

  const completedCount = await restCount(`bookings?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&status=eq.completed`);
  pass(`Booking status breakdown`, `completed=${completedCount} of ${bookingCount}`);
}

// ── 5. Payment events with zero amount ────────────────────────────────────────
if (paymentCount > 0) {
  const zeroPayments = await restGet(
    `payment_events?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&amount_cents=eq.0&select=id&limit=10`
  );
  if (zeroPayments.length > 0) {
    warn(`${zeroPayments.length} payment events with $0 amount`, 'may be free services');
  } else {
    pass('All payment events have non-zero amounts');
  }

  const paidCount = await restCount(`payment_events?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&status=eq.paid`);
  pass(`Payment event status breakdown`, `paid=${paidCount} of ${paymentCount}`);
}

// ── 6. Orphan check: memberships without a valid family ───────────────────────
if (memCount > 0 && familyIds.length > 0) {
  let orphanMems = 0;
  const allMems = await restGet(`memberships?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id,family_id&limit=1000`);
  for (const mem of allMems) {
    if (!familyIds.includes(mem.family_id)) orphanMems++;
  }
  if (orphanMems > 0) {
    fail('Memberships referencing unknown families', `${orphanMems} rows`);
  } else {
    pass('All memberships reference valid families');
  }
}

// ── 7. Bookings with invalid coach reference ───────────────────────────────────
if (bookingCount > 0) {
  const coaches = await restGet(`coaches?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id`);
  const coachIdSet = new Set(coaches.map(c => c.id));
  const allBookings = await restGet(
    `bookings?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&select=id,coach_id,status&limit=2000`
  );
  const bookingsWithBadCoach = allBookings.filter(b => b.coach_id && !coachIdSet.has(b.coach_id));
  if (bookingsWithBadCoach.length > 0) {
    fail(
      'Bookings referencing a coach not in the coaches table',
      `${bookingsWithBadCoach.length} rows — run coaches import or update coach-map`
    );
  } else {
    pass('All bookings reference a valid coach');
  }
}

// ── 8. Sessions import completeness ───────────────────────────────────────────
const sessionCount = await restCount(`sessions?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&capture_source=eq.manual`);
if (bookingCount > 0) {
  const completedBookingCount = await restCount(
    `bookings?tenant_id=eq.${TENANT_ID}&status=eq.completed`
  );
  if (sessionCount === 0 && completedBookingCount > 0) {
    warn(
      'No manual sessions found but completed bookings exist',
      'visits import may predate sessions linkage — re-run import-mindbody-visits.mjs'
    );
  } else {
    pass(`Manual sessions linked to completed visits`, `${sessionCount} rows`);
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// Summary
// =============================================================================

console.log(`\n${'='.repeat(65)}`);
console.log(`Warnings: ${warnings.length}  |  Errors: ${errors.length}`);
console.log('='.repeat(65));

if (errors.length === 0) {
  console.log('\n✓  PASS — MindBody import validation passed\n');
  if (warnings.length > 0) {
    console.log('Warnings (non-blocking):');
    warnings.forEach(w => console.log(`  ⚠  ${w}`));
  }
  console.log();
  process.exit(0);
} else {
  console.log('\n✗  FAIL — MindBody import validation failed\n');
  console.log('Errors:');
  errors.forEach(e => console.log(`  ✗  ${e}`));
  if (warnings.length > 0) {
    console.log('\nWarnings:');
    warnings.forEach(w => console.log(`  ⚠  ${w}`));
  }
  console.log();
  process.exit(1);
}

FILE: scripts/verify-auth-hook.mjs
=================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env node
// =============================================================================
// scripts/verify-auth-hook.mjs
// =============================================================================
// Smoke test for the Custom Access Token Hook on the *remote* Supabase project.
//
// What it does:
//   1. Signs up a throwaway user (random email) with `tenant_slug` in
//      raw_user_meta_data.
//   2. If a session token is returned (email confirmations off), decodes the
//      JWT and asserts `tenant_id`, `family_id`, `role` claims are present.
//      Otherwise — when email confirmations are on — uses the service-role
//      admin endpoint to mark the user confirmed, then signs in to mint a
//      JWT and inspect its claims.
//   3. Cleans up by deleting the throwaway user via the admin endpoint when a
//      service-role key is available.
//   4. Reports PASS/FAIL.
//
// Why it exists:
//   Hosted Supabase auth hooks must be enabled in the dashboard
//   (Authentication -> Hooks -> Custom Access Token). The local
//   supabase/config.toml [auth.hook.custom_access_token] block does not always
//   propagate via `supabase db push`. Until the hook is enabled remotely, JWTs
//   will NOT carry tenant_id/family_id/role and every RLS policy that depends
//   on them will silently deny rows.
//
// Required env (read from process.env):
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY  (publishable key for the new key system, or
//                                   legacy anon JWT for projects still on it)
//
// Optional env:
//   SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY      (sb_secret_... on the new key system, or
//                                   legacy service_role JWT). Required when
//                                   the project has email confirmations on —
//                                   without it the script can't mint a JWT
//                                   for the throwaway user and will exit 1
//                                   with an actionable message.
//   HOOK_TEST_EMAIL_DOMAIN         (default: hooksmoketest.dev — pick a
//                                   non-blocklisted, MX-resolvable domain if
//                                   the default ever gets rejected).
//   EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG        (default: infinitehitting)
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/verify-auth-hook.mjs
//
// Notes:
//   - Uses the auth REST API directly (no @supabase/supabase-js) so it runs in
//     plain Node without needing `ws`.
// =============================================================================

const url = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const key = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const tenantSlug = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TENANT_SLUG || 'infinitehitting';

if (!url || !key) {
  console.error('Missing EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in env.');
  process.exit(2);
}

const headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  apikey: key,
  Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
};

const adminHeaders = serviceKey
  ? {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      apikey: serviceKey,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
    }
  : null;

const rand = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);
// NOTE: avoid @example.com — Supabase ships a default disposable-domain
// blocklist that rejects it with `email_address_invalid`. Use a domain that
// is not in that list (override with HOOK_TEST_EMAIL_DOMAIN if your project
// blocks this one too).
const emailDomain = process.env.HOOK_TEST_EMAIL_DOMAIN || 'hooksmoketest.dev';
const email = `hooktest_${rand}@${emailDomain}`;
const password = `Test_${rand}_pw!`;

let userId;
let token;

if (adminHeaders) {
  // Preferred path: create the user directly via the admin endpoint with
  // email_confirm=true. This bypasses both email-confirmation requirements and
  // the public-signup email-send rate limiter, so the script is robust against
  // any project-side auth config.
  console.log(`-> admin create user: ${email}  (tenant_slug=${tenantSlug})`);
  const create = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: adminHeaders,
    body: JSON.stringify({
      email,
      password,
      email_confirm: true,
      user_metadata: { tenant_slug: tenantSlug, first_name: 'Hook', last_name: 'Test' },
    }),
  });
  const createBody = await create.json();
  if (create.status >= 400) {
    console.error(`admin create failed (${create.status}):`, JSON.stringify(createBody, null, 2));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  userId = createBody?.id || createBody?.user?.id;
  console.log(`   user_id=${userId}`);

  console.log('-> signin to mint JWT');
  const signin = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
  });
  const signinBody = await signin.json();
  if (signin.status >= 400) {
    console.error(`signin failed (${signin.status}):`, JSON.stringify(signinBody, null, 2));
    await cleanup();
    process.exit(1);
  }
  token = signinBody?.access_token;
} else {
  // Fallback path: public signup. Works only when email confirmations are off
  // AND the project hasn't recently rate-limited confirmation emails.
  console.log(`-> signup: ${email}  (tenant_slug=${tenantSlug})`);
  const signup = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/signup`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify({
      email,
      password,
      data: { tenant_slug: tenantSlug, first_name: 'Hook', last_name: 'Test' },
    }),
  });
  const signupBody = await signup.json();

  if (signup.status >= 400) {
    console.error(`signup failed (${signup.status}):`, JSON.stringify(signupBody, null, 2));
    process.exit(1);
  }

  userId = signupBody?.user?.id;
  console.log(`   user_id=${userId}`);
  token = signupBody?.access_token;

  if (!token) {
    console.error('FAIL: signup did not return a JWT (email confirmations appear to be on),');
    console.error('      and no SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is set so the script cannot admin-');
    console.error('      confirm the throwaway user. Provide SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');
    console.error('      (Project Settings -> API Keys -> "secret", sb_secret_... or legacy');
    console.error('      service_role JWT) and re-run.');
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

if (!token) {
  console.error('No access_token returned from either signup or signin.');
  await cleanup();
  process.exit(1);
}

const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token.split('.')[1], 'base64').toString('utf8'));
const claims = {
  tenant_id: payload.tenant_id,
  family_id: payload.family_id,
  app_role: payload.app_role,
};

console.log('-> JWT custom claims:', JSON.stringify(claims, null, 2));

const missing = Object.entries(claims)
  .filter(([, v]) => v === undefined || v === null)
  .map(([k]) => k);

if (missing.length > 0) {
  console.error(`FAIL: missing claims: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
  console.error('The Custom Access Token Hook is not registered in the Supabase dashboard.');
  console.error('Fix: Authentication -> Hooks -> Custom Access Token ->');
  console.error('     enable, schema=public, function=custom_access_token_hook.');
  await cleanup();
  process.exit(1);
}

// Signups go through handle_new_user -> families row -> hook resolves role='parent'.
// If we see anything else (e.g. 'authenticated'), the hook executed but the
// families branch did not match, which is a partial regression worth catching.
if (claims.app_role !== 'parent') {
  console.error(`FAIL: expected app_role='parent' for a signup-flow user, got app_role='${claims.app_role}'.`);
  console.error('The hook ran but the families lookup did not resolve. Check that:');
  console.error('  1. handle_new_user trigger is installed on auth.users');
  console.error('  2. tenant_slug in raw_user_meta_data matches a row in public.tenants');
  console.error('  3. families.role default / column matches expectations');
  await cleanup();
  process.exit(1);
}

// PostgREST will SET ROLE to whatever `role` claim is present. If the hook
// overwrites it with anything other than 'authenticated' / 'anon' / a real
// Postgres role, every authenticated request returns 401 with
// `role "X" does not exist`. Guard against regressing into that bug.
if (payload.role !== 'authenticated') {
  console.error(`FAIL: reserved JWT claim 'role' must remain 'authenticated', got '${payload.role}'.`);
  console.error("The custom_access_token_hook is overwriting PostgREST's reserved `role` claim.");
  console.error('Application-level role belongs in `app_role` instead.');
  await cleanup();
  process.exit(1);
}

await cleanup();
console.log('PASS: tenant_id, family_id, app_role all present; reserved role=authenticated preserved.');
console.log(`      (app_role=${claims.app_role}; handle_new_user trigger fired; family_id resolved.)`);

async function cleanup() {
  if (!adminHeaders || !userId) {
    if (userId) {
      console.log(`-> NOTE: leaving throwaway user ${userId} in auth.users (no service-role key to delete).`);
    }
    return;
  }
  const del = await fetch(`${url}/auth/v1/admin/users/${userId}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers: adminHeaders,
  });
  if (del.status >= 400) {
    const body = await del.text();
    console.warn(`-> WARN: cleanup delete failed (${del.status}): ${body.slice(0, 200)}`);
  } else {
    console.log(`-> cleanup: deleted throwaway user ${userId}`);
  }
}
